Rotfai 3 Alley, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has moved to an apartment area near Bang Sue. It's located next to a small pond, and the restaurant is quite large with plenty of seating. The food is quite spicy, so if you don't like spicy food, it's recommended to inform the restaurant beforehand. It's also a good idea to call and reserve a table and order food in advance because it gets very busy, especially at lunchtime.

Recommended menu item: Fried Chicken. Order it in advance!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudawan C.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and flavorful, the prices are cheap, the atmosphere is pretty good, and there's parking available. They offer separate mortar and pestle for papaya salad (with or without fermented fish sauce), and there are drink promotions. They also have a stall selling dried squid. Overall, it's a good experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: นักรีวิวกูเกิ้ลแมพ

sample_reviews_en.text: It would be great if you could find parking for customers that doesn't obstruct other residents in the village. Currently, some cars are parked with their rear ends sticking out, making it difficult to turn, and some are blocking the road. If you build a shop, having a properly organized parking area would be even better.
sample_reviews_en.author: WARAPORN IN

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried chicken was the best! Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and not greasy. I was so busy eating I forgot to take pictures. As for the papaya salad, it's for those who like really spicy food, and it pairs perfectly with alcohol!
sample_reviews_en.author: Luna The Orange Cat

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and affordable. A chill and friendly atmosphere. The fried chicken, fried duck beaks, crispy catfish salad, and crispy catfish larb are all excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thank Rocknroll

sample_reviews_en.text: Isaan food is delicious and reasonably priced. It's very hard to find it in Bangkok. It was a bit hot, but the waitress brought a fan to help cool us down.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cha Wang

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great restaurant in this area. Every menu is delicious. In the evening, you must come before 7:30 PM because the kitchen closes early.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theerayoth Pralomkarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food at affordable prices. Tourists are welcome to try it. Highly recommended. Accessible to all ages.
Friendly service.
sample_reviews_en.author: a

restaurants.name: kitchen Uncle Wang
restaurants.address:

339 Thappraya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We've been here several times, and we loved the Tom Yum the first time. They had a generous amount of ingredients, even though the shrimp were overcooked. We came back three times, getting both the Tom Yum (80 baht per serving) and the BBQ chicken (140 baht each). The chicken was absolutely delicious. We noticed a different chef cooking each time, but oh well... the fourth and fifth times, the Tom Yum was completely different. The ingredients kept getting fewer, the herbs kept getting more and more, they practically stopped adding coconut milk altogether, and each time there was a different chef, as if we were going through a casting process. One evening we came at about 6 o'clock, and the waiter approached the hostess, she muttered something dissatisfied, he told us that everything was fine, he would cook for us himself))) Regarding the interior... it was dirty, there was an old, torn carpet on the ground, all in bumps, but you can take food with you to go in lunch boxes and bags.
sample_reviews_en.author: Кирилл Грабарь

sample_reviews_en.text: I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. My first impression was that it was very dirty. There wasn't a price listed. We asked for tom yum, and they initially quoted 60 baht, so we stayed. We started paying, and they charged us 60 baht for the dish. A minute later, another Thai guy came running in and said the soup was 80 baht and we had to pay extra. We started explaining that the original price was 60, but they didn't listen and just started yelling at us. And the dish they brought us wasn't even worth 30 baht because it was so tasteless. There weren't enough ingredients, just herbs, and the broth was tasteless. No one in our group was able to finish the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Дмитрий Епанешников

sample_reviews_en.text:
The portions here are generous and the prices are affordable. They have noodles, à la carte dishes, and Southern Thai curry with rice. Everyone in the restaurant is friendly and the service is good. The food is delicious, and the restaurant has been renovated and looks much better than before. 👍👍👍
I just returned and I'm very impressed. The restaurant looks much cleaner now, and all the dishes look appetizing.
Go support them! Parking is convenient.
I went there before during COVID and wasn't impressed because it didn't look clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darawan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious 😲‼️ And the portions are huge.
A Thai restaurant.
The restaurant is a bit dirty, so you might hesitate to go in. But it's delicious!
We ordered chicken, green curry, yum woon sen, roast pork, stick rice, and more.
The green curry and yum woon sen were especially delicious. Better than some of the cafes ranked highly on TripAdvisor.
Four of us were full.
Cost: 370 THB, or about 1,200 JPY.
sample_reviews_en.author: かわうそ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just driving past and seeing the vendor wearing a hairnet tells you it's clean. It's a simple roadside stall, but every tray has a cover. The food is delicious and the portions are huge! Two dishes with rice for 50 baht.
The shrimp paste chili dip is also delicious!

Parking is available along the road. The food is delicious, excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thong Nokia7plus

sample_reviews_en.text: I believe this restaurant may now be closed as the area across from Grande Carribbean Condo has been demolished this week and there is now nothing remaining. He may have been able to move, but is no longer in this location.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rebecca Parkin

sample_reviews_en.text: It's located downtown but is affordable. I had Tom Yum Goong, Pad Thai, and stir-fried morning glory, and they were really delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ShangHoon Gang

sample_reviews_en.text: Street Thai food. Food is really good. Was on the way to jomtien Beach and decided to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ciwei Gan

restaurants.name: ส้มตำบ้านแม่ อาหารอีสานรสแซ่บ
restaurants.address:

109 หมู่3 Wat Sangkhathan Alley, Tambon Bang Phai, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommend visiting today (December 2025).
The atmosphere is great.
It's a family-run business.
Spacious parking. The food is delicious.

The prices are reasonable 10/10. Papaya salad is around 70-80 baht.
Hot pot is 200 baht, the portions are just right. We ordered papaya salad, grilled chicken, grilled beef, and hot pot, totaling a little over 500 baht. Not expensive at all.

The food is delicious 10/10.
For example, the hot pot broth is made with pork bones, and it's very tasty. The Thai papaya salad is authentically central Thai style, with a well-balanced sweet and sour flavor.
The grilled chicken is delicious.

The parking is plentiful and spacious 10/10.

The service is excellent 10/10.
They are attentive. We didn't finish our food, and the owner came to ask if we didn't like the leftover meat. They said we could tell them. Actually, only my sister eats beef; I don't.

The cool evening air is great for drinking alcohol.
The young man also helps his mother with the work, which is very sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: thitinan wongkitrungrueang

sample_reviews_en.text:
So incredibly delicious!!! A hidden gem that I wish were still around 🥹 I want this place to stay open, I want it to be discovered!!!! The papaya salad is perfect, I could eat it every day. The ingredients are amazing value for money. They sell things so cheaply, I don't want such a good place to disappear. The owners, the mothers at the shop, put so much effort into making the food.

I've tried Thai papaya salad, corn papaya salad, crab and fermented fish papaya salad, Luang Prabang style papaya salad, and Tam Sua papaya salad – they're all delicious and never disappoint. But my absolute recommendation is the water spinach and boiled shrimp papaya salad! OMG, I've eaten it four days in a row 😂 And the fried chicken, marinated with herbs by the owner, is incredibly delicious. I'm going again tomorrow!!
sample_reviews_en.author: SFWJ。

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for a really delicious somtum (papaya salad) place, try this one. Their somtum is amazing; you can order it spicy to your liking. Their larb moo (spicy minced pork salad) is also delicious, with generous portions of pork liver and skin in every bite. The grilled pork neck is also excellent. It's a hidden gem that shouldn't be kept secret! You have to try it! The somtum was so good I forgot to take pictures! The owner is very kind and polite. The restaurant is clean and has a great atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arunrung Jirawattanapong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in the Newpark food complex.
All dishes are made fresh.
The staff are friendly and provide excellent service.
The grilled pork is well-grilled with minimal fat (which I love). For those who prefer tender meat, try the grilled pork neck.
The Luang Prabang papaya salad is spicy and delicious.
The grilled catfish is perfectly dry and flavorful.
The shrimp in fish sauce is tasty.
The spicy minced meat salad is also delicious.
Everything is reasonably priced.
I will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachamas Pang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the plates and cutlery are clean, the atmosphere is friendly, and the prices are affordable. The owners, a mother and sister, are very lovely.
I was impressed with the grilled chicken; it was fragrant with pepper and herbs, well-marinated, and grilled perfectly. The grilled catfish was also delicious, and the corn salad with salted egg was flavorful.^^
sample_reviews_en.author: Casperr _ttt

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was incredibly delicious!
The owner was also very lovely. Great service and a nice atmosphere.
The prices weren't expensive, just moderate. I highly recommend this restaurant. The papaya salad is delicious. There's another dish I'd highly recommend: the grilled pork neck – it's incredibly delicious! 👍🏻🥰
I will definitely be back to support them again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khoanchay Os

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, and the atmosphere in the evening and early night is relaxed. Besides papaya salad, they offer other dishes such as spicy salads, rice porridge, BBQ pork, shabu-shabu, Tokyo-style pancakes, and various fried snacks. There's ample parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sawanya Boonrawd

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was delicious, very flavorful.
The restaurant was clean and the atmosphere was comfortable.
The waterfall pork was delicious, as was the grilled pork neck with blood. You can tell the staff what kind of flavor you prefer. 10/10
Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: รวย รวยย

restaurants.name: ร้านค่าเวลา หลักสี่ New Generetion
restaurants.address:

200/635 อาคาร บุราวรรณ Chang Watthana 10 Alley, Thung Song Hong, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The restaurant is located on Chaengwattana Soi 10 Road. There's parking available next to the shop. They sell food and are open from noon to evening. They offer quick meals and takeaway lunch boxes for 50฿ each. There are seating areas in front of the shop under the trees and inside. I ordered:
- Shrimp Fried Rice 50฿: The fried rice was nice and dry. Chili fish sauce is available at the table.
Okay.
- Pork and Shrimp Basil Rice 50฿ + Fried Egg 10฿: Ordered for takeout. The basil rice was nice and dry, the shrimp were large, and it included long beans. The packaging was good.
sample_reviews_th.author: Koy Koya

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a restaurant that feels like eating at home. The owner is very friendly. The first time I went, I was worried about whether I could bring my dog ​​inside. I called the restaurant to ask if dogs were allowed, and they said yes. So, what are we waiting for? Let's give it a try. In short, I was very impressed on my first visit. Everything was great, from the taste of the food to the service (the owner even served the food herself, haha). Every service, whether you dine in or order via delivery, the owner provides generously.
It's a shame I don't have pictures from dining in or ordering via delivery because everything was gone before I could take photos!
sample_reviews_en.author: ไข่ตุ๋นหมาแสบ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located inside the Burawan Condominium on Chaengwattana Soi 10 (Soi Benjamit), opposite the MIDA Hotel.

There aren't many seats, mostly under the trees on the front patio, creating a pleasant and relaxing atmosphere, perfect for enjoying a cool drink in the evening.

The food tastes good and is delicious. The restaurant mentioned they had a lot of takeout orders on the day I visited, but the food didn't take long to arrive. The staff were attentive and provided good service.

Parking is available within the condominium grounds.
sample_reviews_en.author: YSPK (JA)

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating there. It's a small restaurant, perfect for a meal and a chat. The owner is kind and friendly. We ordered several dishes because the prices were reasonable. My favorite was probably the french fries; they have a special recipe – crispy on the outside, soft and fluffy on the inside, and the portion was just right. I didn't get a chance to take a picture before they served it and we ate it all! Haha. If you're in the area, you should stop by for a meal. P.S. There's parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stellar Thip

sample_reviews_en.text: What a delight, while staying at the Mida Airport Hotel I dropped in to the New Generation. They have an excellent menu and all the dish's I had were very tast authentically prepared and cooked. There are plenty of fans blowing and mosquito coils dicreetly smouldering away. Nice background music playing, excellent service from very attentive staff. As Mcarthur said "I shall return", A memorable meal at an affordable price. 300Bt for 3 meals and a large beer chang, how affordable is that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Derek C

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is great value for money. The food is good, the atmosphere is nice, and parking is convenient. They have a diverse menu, excellent service, and the staff are very polite. The ingredients are high-quality and fresh. The salmon salad is deliciously spicy, the steamed egg custard is good, the stir-fried three-flavor vegetables are tasty (in the restaurant's unique style), and the stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce is okay. The prices and portion sizes are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jagrapat Jungtrakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pretty good food and very friendly staff.
The fries were quite excellent and a large portion; the glass noodles with sator and the som tum were very good too.
The taste of the phat phet moo baa was good but the meat was so tough and chewy that it was nearly impossible to eat.
Some dishes maybe a tad expensive too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cecil M

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a good restaurant across from the Mida Don Mueang Hotel. Their papaya salad with fermented fish sauce is delicious. They also have stir-fried mixed vegetables (including stink beans, acacia leaves, and pickled garlic), and a good variety of other dishes and appetizers.
sample_reviews_en.author: BigTrees Project

restaurants.name: Sit 2 Sis Restaurant & Ent Club
restaurants.address:

135 Ratchadaphisek 7, Khwaeng Din Daeng, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owner said that because it was the Buddhist festival that day, the bar could only open at midnight. I couldn't go that day, but I saw a lot of guys chatting inside.

The bar's location is really hidden and hard to find, so I made a map guide. First, if you see this parking lot in the alley, with writing next to it (circled), you're in the right place. Walk towards the parking lot to the second floor, then further in to the stairs and elevator area. Go down to B1, and the correct location is behind the wooden door! Usually, when someone appears, the parking lot guard will ask you "club?" and will lead you there. It's a bit scary at night, so remember to go with a friend!
sample_reviews_en.author: 郭芷維

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm here for work, not for leisure. It's a men's bar, perfect for tomboyish girls to come have fun and relax 😊😊 It's been open for a while. I haven't tried the food though, haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: TOUKEN SOGOOD

sample_reviews_en.text: Sisters, the male models are really good at this, they're really good at it. If you're rich, just go for it! They're full of emotional value!
sample_reviews_en.author: Olivia SUN

restaurants.name: ร้านก๋วยเตี๋ยวเย็นตาโฟ
restaurants.address:

MFQ2+HM2, Bang Khun Thian, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
There is parking available. "Go into Soi Ekachai 33 for about 30 meters, then turn right into the covered parking area."
It's really worth the 25฿ price. The taste is just like the old-fashioned noodles. I highly recommend trying it!
sample_reviews_th.author: Smaxty

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant's key features are its low prices and generous portions. The quality of the ingredients may not be the best, but they're edible and worth the price.

The thin, dry noodles are cooked perfectly, not clumped together, and have a nice chewy texture. They come with a variety of toppings. The Yen Ta Fo has a rich sauce, and the crispy fried tofu is delicious.

The downside is that parking can be difficult to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Lai

sample_reviews_en.text: It's pretty tasty. The broth is clear and delicious, the price is cheap, and they give you a generous amount of ingredients. Regular is 30 baht, special is 35 baht. I always buy some to take home, even though I live far away. You can park on the street on even-numbered days. The shop is closed every Wednesday.
sample_reviews_en.author: สมชาย ไผทสิทธิกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: This old shop has moved from the entrance of Soi Ekachai 31. The Yen Ta Fo tastes amazing and is very cheap. Compared to the price, it's worth it for both the price and the deliciousness. There's no parking, so you have to park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: kasi vorawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious!!! I ordered two bowls and still wasn't full.
Super cheap, generous portions. The Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup) with dry noodles is the best!
Love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: ภูวเดช ธรรมคะนา

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is delicious and affordable. The only downside is that it's always crowded and there are rarely any tables available.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชัชวาล แตงอุดม

sample_reviews_en.text: It's not expensive, really. The soup is good. I recommend it. There's no parking. Motorbikes are the most convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pk station

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great price, delicious taste.
The broth is fragrant and well-balanced.
The noodles are perfectly cooked.
sample_reviews_en.author: supradit aungtrakul

restaurants.name: Taco Hachi @TRIBE Bangkok
restaurants.address:

122 Sukhumvit 39, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A part of our memories remain on The Tribe's rooftop, where the calm evening air and the glow of the city created a moment of pure serenity. Under the open sky, we sat, taking in the beauty of Bangkok—its rhythm, its energy, its quiet whispers in the night.
The fusion of Japanese and Mexican flavours was a discovery worth savouring, each bite perfectly paired with their signature mocktails. But more than the food and drinks, it was the warmth of the people that made this place feel like home.
Ms. Thin Thin, with her kindness and unwavering care, made every evening special. She looked after us like an old friend, ensuring our final moments before sleep were filled with comfort, laughter, and a perfectly crafted cocktail in hand.
Thank you for your genuine warmth and exceptional service. It wasn’t just hospitality—it was heartfelt care, the kind that lingers long after we’ve left. We will most certainly be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rudy Andika

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're a fan of Mexican food, Taco Hachi at TRIBE Living Bangkok Sukhumvit 39 is a must-visit! I had the all-you-can-eat 2-hour session and it was absolutely worth it — delicious, full-flavored dishes served non-stop.

They offer a wide variety of authentic options like tacos, quesadillas, and other Mexican favorites. Every bite felt like a little trip to Mexico!

Top Recommendations:

HAMBRIENTO – A selection of juicy burgers, including the bold Mexican Burger and Chili con Carne.

TRIO DE TACOS – Rich, traditional tacos that pack a punch.

SALAD – Fresh and flavorful with a unique Mexican twist.

SNACK AND BITES – Perfect for sharing or snacking in between; super addictive!

SWEET – Don’t miss the churros and other desserts — a perfect ending.

Highly recommended for anyone craving great Mexican food in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanida Raweelertpunya

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to the rooftop bar at TRIBE Sukhumvit 39. The atmosphere was amazing, the view was beautiful, and the breeze was nice – perfect for chilling out and enjoying a cold drink in the evening. 🍸

Another thing that impressed me a lot was the service. The staff member named Gun was very attentive, polite, and always looking after me. He made me feel comfortable and provided excellent service.

The bartender, Bank, also made great drinks. He was fun to talk to, friendly, and very dedicated to his work. The drinks I ordered were delicious and exactly what I wanted.

Overall, I loved everything – the atmosphere, the view, the drinks, and the service. Especially Gun and Bank, who made this evening so memorable. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: May Morita

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a fantastic dining experience as always ! The cuisine was creative, delicious, and beautifully presented.

A special thank you to Jib, our server, who was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and attentive throughout our visit. She made us feel right at home with her warm hospitality.

We also want to thank Claw, the chef, who was very helpful in explaining the dishes and recommending the perfect options. His passion for the food really showed, and it made the experience even more enjoyable.

As someone who has worked in the hotel industry, I truly appreciate excellent service and this team delivered it perfectly. Highly recommended, and we’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Apicha Heinrich

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered the fish Tacos and the Roboto 5 skewers. I’m staying at the hotel. The Robato is excellent really enjoyed the juicy beef. They use locally made binchaton charcoal and as the place is not so busy I did have to wait a very long time to get the skewers. None the less service and staff and very welcoming. Having another round tonight and also tried the Kaizen Salad which is excellent so fresh and colorful. Also I’m a big eater so I did order quite a bit but actually everything is shareable which makes coming here in a group very very easy on the pocket. Otherwise if you do want to try a couple of items you will hit the 1000+ as a solo traveller.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saud Lamki

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taco Hachi is a truly beautiful rooftop bar with a great atmosphere.
The staff were very warm and welcoming, and the service throughout the visit was excellent.
The tacos were absolutely delicious honestly the best tacos I’ve ever had. Everything tasted fresh and well made, and I was really impressed with the food quality.

The signature cocktail wasn’t quite to my taste, but the regular cocktails were very good and well balanced.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience and I would definitely come back again for the food, the view, and the lovely service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marie

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is fantastic, perfectly complementing the hotel's decor. I especially loved the tropical cactus accents, and since I was staying downstairs, it was a great experience.

The rooftop offers unobstructed views of the nightscape, which is truly amazing. Unfortunately, we arrived late and there was no food available. The cocktails were decent, nothing special but not bad either. Overall, it's a worthwhile place to stop by for a drink!
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great, very relaxing and beautiful. The food was delicious, but the service from the staff was terrible. They were rude, made condescending faces, and the food took a very long time to arrive, even a simple dish like a salad took almost 30 minutes. When I asked about it, I was told, "The chef is preparing it," in a very unpleasant tone. For the price, I expected much better service. I felt very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: prom pitchanan

restaurants.name: ร้านก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อ
restaurants.address:

53 Somdet Phra Chao Tak Sin 17 Aly, Samre, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The waterfall noodle soup here is delicious, especially compared to many other places in the area. The price is affordable and the portion size is generous. The atmosphere is casual and the service is ordinary. The ice water isn't very clean, so it's better to bring your own drinking water and tissues. There's no parking for cars, only 2-3 motorcycles can park. It's better to cycle or walk here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tirawoot Muangthong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, clean, and affordable.
Closed Thursday and Friday.
They have fresh beef, stewed beef, spleen, tendon, beef meatballs, and tendon meatballs.
Located in a small alley, no car parking, but you can park 3-4 motorcycles nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon Choy

sample_reviews_en.text: It's edible, but I wouldn't recommend it for big eaters. The noodle portion is very small; three bites for a small mouth, one for a larger mouth. 50 baht is very expensive. Even I, who eat little, wasn't full.
sample_reviews_en.author: kookai kookoo

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious and cheap, especially the beef noodle soup which isn't fishy, ​​and importantly, they have fermented tofu sauce, which some restaurants don't usually have.
sample_reviews_en.author: มานะ

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and affordable, but it's located in a small alley with no parking. Recommended to walk or take a motorcycle taxi.
sample_reviews_en.author: บ้านพักหัวหิน smart home huahin

restaurants.name: Noodle Pen Shop (ก๋วยเตี๋ยวยายเพ็ญ)
restaurants.address:

1/55 1/55 Vibhavadi Rangsit, Thung Song Hong, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Traditional Pork Noodle Soup, 35฿ per bowl.
Still cooked over a charcoal stove.
Fragrant fried garlic, roasted chili, and roasted peanuts. Hot broth.
Contains boiled pork, fish cake, boiled liver, fish balls, and minced pork.
What I really liked was the minced pork, which is real minced pork, not the bouncy kind.
✅✅ Delicious!
Free drinking water is available (self-service).
The shop is located in Soi Viphavadee 25.
Drive straight to the end and turn right twice.
The shop is in the basement of a house, so it's not hot.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jib Jib

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the chance to stop by Vibhavadi 25 and had to try this amazing noodle shop. It's been open for ages, since my student days (almost 20 years! 😅). If you come at lunchtime, you might have to wait in line. The taste is incredible, the best in the area. I ordered the Tom Yum and barely needed to add anything; it was perfectly balanced with sour and spicy flavors. They give you a generous portion of ingredients: minced pork, sliced ​​pork, meatballs, and liver, all for only 35 baht for a regular bowl and 45 baht for a special one (I had the regular size). It was so delicious I ordered three servings! If you're passing through this area, I highly recommend this shop. You won't be disappointed! ♥️ Oh, and the shop is closed every Friday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phatthawan Cruise

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant I've been eating at since I was a kid. It's been open for at least 15 years, passed down from Grandma Phen to her grandchildren. The prices have increased due to rising costs, but they're still affordable. The atmosphere is like eating noodles in a spacious, cool, open-air setting under a house, with a concrete floor.
I recommend the Tom Yum soup; any type of noodles is fine. We eat here almost every Saturday. However, the restaurant only accepts cash; no transfers or cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abolista Lilete

sample_reviews_en.text: I call this place the "Noodle Shop Under the House" in the Railway Village. It's 30 baht a bowl, but it's totally worth it. The taste is delicious, and they give you plenty of toppings. The Tom Yum soup, in particular, has a wonderful aroma of ground peanuts. Highly recommended! They open around noon and are closed on Fridays. Go try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tun Thamsara

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this hidden gem of a restaurant.
It's so popular, the place was packed!
I loved it. The food is unique.
Delicious. The owners are friendly and fun to talk to.
It might be busy at lunchtime, but not crowded.
The prices are incredibly cheap. Eat until you're stuffed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chivanon Thorn

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small, family-run shop where the owners make everything themselves. Their Tom Yum noodle soup is delicious, made with real minced pork and nothing else mixed in (I don't like bouncy pork). It's an authentic flavor that's becoming harder to find these days.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bundit Kenny Jiamanukoonkit

sample_reviews_en.text:
A noodle shop in a house with affordable prices, only 35 baht per bowl.
The Tom Yum noodles taste good and aren't too sweet.
They're cooked over a charcoal stove.
There's also a cute cat that comes to cuddle. 😺
sample_reviews_en.author: theSMOKKOK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious and spotlessly clean. The restaurant opens at 12:00 PM.
Finding parking might be a bit difficult, but it's worth it for the delicious food.
sample_reviews_en.author: dewdew chantarasopak

restaurants.name: แป๊ะตงบะหมี่เกี๊ยว ปู ณรงค์ นนทบุรี
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 1 Soi Rewadee 61, Talat Kwan, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Only around 50-60 baht then you could get a Crab & Roasted Pork Egg Noodle and it is really delicious. If you like Wonton then it is also nice as well. The egg noodle is soft, the roasted pork is good whereas the crab is fresh namely non-smell. Recommend if you are finding an egg noodle & wonton with crab but in economical price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanakorn Jornjarern

sample_reviews_en.text: Noodle soup with crab and roast pork. This noodle shop has a delicious taste. The noodles are soft, and the crab has no smell. If you want to eat noodle soup, try this shop and you won't be able to find your way home (you'll be captivated by the taste). I heard they close at midnight. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: กริช ดิเรก

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a recommended restaurant for its crab wonton noodles; they give you a generous amount of crab meat at a cheap price. If you're passing by, I recommend stopping in for a meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: natthaphong muangboon

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! And inexpensive, 50-60 baht. They give you a generous portion too. Real crab, not just a hint of it. Truly delicious. I eat here very often!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bananabacon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes decent, but the parking lot needs improvement; when it rains, it becomes muddy and makes cars dirty.
sample_reviews_en.author: ikew sung

restaurants.name: Jok Ari 1
restaurants.address:

5 อาคาร, สนั่นนภา 5, Soi Ari 1, สามเสนใน, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Overpriced!!! So expensive! For two people, two servings of congee with two eggs and two servings of broth cost 170฿!!!
Bringing only 100฿ isn't enough for this congee. 😦
sample_reviews_th.author: Miw Sriket

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rice porridge itself was tasteless (homemade, with a grainy texture).
The pork meatballs were okay (pre-made bouncy pork is tastier), about 6 pieces.
The small fried dough sticks had a rancid smell.
And some vegetables as a garnish.
One soft-boiled egg.
That's all in one bowl.
(One bowl of rice porridge + small fried dough sticks + Namthip bottled water, total cost 70 baht)
sample_reviews_en.author: suwanchai sukkanalak

sample_reviews_en.text: It was like eating dog food. The pork was spoiled, and the owner refused to admit it. We ordered three bowls for three people, and all three bowls had rotten pork. We couldn't eat it. I told the owner to come and eat, but I wouldn't dare. With service like that, I feel sorry for the customers. I was very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Praphon K

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork is spoiled and smells bad, the rice is mushy, and they still have the nerve to sell it. They mixed old and new pork in the bowl. The pork is so sour I can't eat it. They're acting clueless, ignoring it, and not taking responsibility. I'm going to report this to the authorities. Don't think it's over.
sample_reviews_en.author: Po0 S

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't understand the negative reviews, I think this place got review bombed or something.

Delicious Jok Mhu, and I love the atmosphere sitting right on Ari 1. The women working here are so hard working and very kind. This was my breakfast many mornings when living in Ari and I miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aidan Pine

sample_reviews_en.text: This breakfast spot offers excellent value for money. The offal is well-prepared, the pork is full of flavor, and the ginger is exceptionally fresh. Highly recommended for those seeking a tasty and satisfying meal. Open very early in the morning, making it a great choice for early risers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aimamorn Suvichakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Congee shop near Ari BTS station.
Atmosphere: Single shop unit in a shophouse.
Menu ordered:
- Special plain pork congee with egg (THB 60). The congee itself was bland; sauce should be added for flavor. The minced pork was seasoned and salty, and cut into bite-sized pieces, easy to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boat ANRPS

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best value in the Ari area. A regular portion is only 40 baht, but they give you a generous portion. I love the intestines, the liver is delicious too, and the pork is minced pork, not the bouncy kind. It's tasty, I've been eating here for years.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittikorn Anuthien

restaurants.name: Tandoori Flame Nana
restaurants.address:

20 11 Sukhumvit 4 Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is significantly overpriced. As soon as I sat down, I realized my mistake in not checking the prices before coming in. Out of politeness, we decided to stay and eat anyway.
​To be fair, the food wasn't bad. However, my wife's lamb dish was mostly bones with barely any meat. The portion sizes are simply too small for what they charge.
​A small beer costs 120 baht. That might be the standard for this specific area, but it's still a completely nonsensical price.
​On top of these already inflated prices for an Indian restaurant, we were surprised by an extra 10% service charge. This added fee makes even less sense than the menu prices.
​If this place were 30% cheaper, it could actually get a positive review. At the current rate, however, it is definitely a no-go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marco Damonte

sample_reviews_en.text: Tandoori Flame Nana is one of the best Indian restaurants in Bangkok for authentic flavors and a cozy dining experience. The food is rich, fresh, and full of delicious Indian spices — especially their butter chicken, naan, biryani, and tandoori dishes which are cooked perfectly. The portions are generous and worth the price. The restaurant has a warm atmosphere, nice interior, and a great location near Nana, making it easy to visit. The staff are friendly, polite, and provide quick service, making guests feel welcome and comfortable. Perfect place for lunch, dinner, or enjoying Indian food with friends and family. Highly recommended for anyone craving tasty and authentic Indian cuisine in Bangkok.  ￼
sample_reviews_en.author: Moon

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great place in Bangkok Nana for delicious Indian food! 😍 I tried the dal tadka and bhindi masala, and both were absolutely delicious—full of authentic flavor and perfectly cooked. 😋

The ambience is nice, the staff is friendly, and the food really feels comforting, especially if you’re craving Indian food while traveling. Definitely a great spot to have a satisfying meal in Bangkok. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Mehul Batra

sample_reviews_en.text: Tandoori Flame in Nana 4, Bangkok is very bad don't go there.  On 8th Aug 2025 I went there and ate Kadai Chicken and Tawa Roti. It mad me sick and I woke up at midnight with discomfort,  vomiting and loose motion and fever. I had to take medication and rest for a day to get better. I became very weak
sample_reviews_en.author: Abraham Joseph

sample_reviews_en.text:
Go somewhere else!!!
To expensive for the food you get!

Ordered Chicken Tikka Masala for 270 bht. Rice was not included so they charged 160 for the rice!
+10% service charge!!

Food looked bigger on the fotos.
Also waited long.

Update my wife vomited!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Samuel Leinbach

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was okayish...too much garlic on top of naan...and the time taken to serve was quite a little.... One star is for service charge also food ...why charge extra for service this was the first restaurant in Thailand charging extra for service...
sample_reviews_en.author: Nischhal Tiwari

sample_reviews_en.text: Indian restaurant. The owner of this restaurant is Punjabi. Best option for vegetarians. Food is good and cheap. Very helpful to nature. When the curd ran out during the meal, he went to 7 Eleven shop and bought curd for me. Very delicious food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr Bhawani Singh Vishnoi

sample_reviews_en.text: I really wanted to like this place, but our experience was awful. A cockroach crawled onto our table and even jumped on me, then walked across our plates. When we told the staff, they just killed it right in front of us - no apology, didn't …
sample_reviews_en.author: doge bond

restaurants.name: บู๋ อบเตาถ่าน
restaurants.address:

168/27 Thanon Si Ayutthaya, Wachira Phayaban, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We stopped here for a quick lunch before heading back to the National Library, and it turned out to be a great place for a short break. We tried the sandwich, the roasted chicken rice, and the fried pork with rice. The meat was really tasty and well cooked, with flavors that weren’t too spicy, just right for a balanced meal. Drinks are not served inside, but you can easily grab one from the 7-Eleven right across the street. The gentleman who does the cooking is very skilled, and you can really taste the care he puts into the food. A simple, satisfying spot for lunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: giacomo farru

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork neck sandwich is incredibly delicious and great value for money. The pork is tender and marinated in a tasty sauce, and they give you a generous portion of scrambled eggs. The packaging is good and clean. I'm very impressed and have ordered several times already.
sample_reviews_en.author: Waew S

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this gem at the start of my two week stay in Bangkok and it instantly became my go to place to eat. The food is excellent, the portion sizes are just right, and the prices are a great value
sample_reviews_en.author: Jakob Aruvald

sample_reviews_en.text: A small restaurant in the market near Wat Tewaraj Kunchorn. The chef is lovely, the food doesn't take long to arrive, and the taste is good. The scrambled eggs are soft and melt in your mouth.
sample_reviews_en.author: หนิงนางฟ้ายอดหญ้าอาเจ้าหมูหิน

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious! I want to try many more dishes.
What I liked best was that they took a picture of my meal after I finished and put it on the board. That's great! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Mm PP.

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! I love the smoked duck breast, and the pork is good too. I always order on Lineman. Lots of protein! But why is the shop closed? 😭😭 Where did you go?
sample_reviews_en.author: winkie

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The pork is tender but has something to chew on. The price is very reasonable. It's even better than expected for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: ToTo CS

sample_reviews_en.text: The vendor was polite, the food was delicious, the portion size was just right, and the price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: ผริตา เอมสวัสดิ์

restaurants.address:

4th Floor Phenix Pratunam 604 Siam Square Soi 3, Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really dont understand why its 4.8 rating.
I would spit out this Monhingar if its were in Yangon. Their fried bean is just bad -

Full disclosure- I only try Monhingar- one of the worst in comparision with other shops around.

Funny- when i pay my bill in cash- the guy said they dont have exact change. It doesnt matter I was gon a tip anyway.

All the 5 stars review muat be fake or via friends and families. I will never come back to this plce again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sai Blair

sample_reviews_en.text: I rarely leave negative reviews, but my experience at this restaurant was disappointing from start to finish.First, the service was incredibly slow and unprofessional.When the food finally came, it was not worth the wait. My dish was lukewarm, poorly seasoned, and honestly tasted like it had been microwaved.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rajar timsinar

sample_reviews_en.text: We came to try their truffle crab meat caviar mohingar but it is out of stock. So we tried their squid ink mohingar. It was nice. I say it is a good creation and should try. I like their Nan Gyi Thote and Cylon Tea. I will come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandy Cho

sample_reviews_en.text: Si Long Tee's Burmese tea is fragrant, delicious, and incredibly enjoyable. Their Anja rice is rich in flavor and fragrant with authentic spices. I highly recommend this place; you absolutely have to try it! 🤤😍
sample_reviews_en.author: praew praewy

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is delicious, I highly recommend it!
The food is fresh, flavorful, and authentic. The atmosphere is great, and the service is friendly. If you like Burmese food, you can't miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thida K.

sample_reviews_en.text: The customer service is absolutely terrible and the owner is rude. The food is also bad and unhealthy. Burmese food is not good at all. If you go and eat it, you will regret it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wella Asdf

sample_reviews_en.text:
Anyone who hasn't tried this dish yet must try it, it's delicious!
Burmese rice noodles: Thick noodles paired with chicken salad, fishcake, and a perfectly cooked duck egg.
sample_reviews_en.author: คํา ล่ําสัน

sample_reviews_en.text: For those who miss the taste of Myanmar Mohingarr in Yangon, it will really make you feel nostalgic, and because of the good food, you will be fully satisfied. …
sample_reviews_en.author: JEREMY AUNG NAING

restaurants.name: Joy Zone Restaurant & Entertainment Bar
restaurants.address:

12 Si Lom Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This compact restaurant has a simple yet beautiful design. The atmosphere is calm, clean, and comfortable, with a lovely, warm feel. Most importantly, the food is delicious! It's perfect for solo diners, couples, and small groups of friends. Above all, I was impressed by the service from the staff – polite, smiling, and full of energy and attentiveness to every customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jumbo Nucha702

sample_reviews_en.text: Really enjoyed our night here! Pleasantly surprised — prices matched exactly what was listed on the menu, no hidden fees or extra charges (we’d read some scary reviews about Bangkok bars beforehand, so this was a relief). Tips were completely optional, no pressure at all. Great staff, delicious cocktails, awesome atmosphere. Will definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Михаил Коробер

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

So many handsome hosts, beautiful drag queens, and amazing performances! The entertainment was fantastic, the prices were very affordable, and the atmosphere was fun and welcoming. The service was charming, and it’s truly a hidden gem in Silom. I highly recommend coming here—you’ll have an unforgettable time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phoe Pyae

sample_reviews_en.text: Great vibes, even better music. The live performances are the highlight, and the friendly service makes it even better. A go-to spot for a fun, feel-good evening. With the restaurant downstairs, you can get Burmese, Chinese, Thai and Italian cuisine. Highly recommended 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Aye Myat Phyu

sample_reviews_en.text: The cabaret show is amazing! The staff is super attentive and the host, Alice, is a sweetheart from the moment you arrive. It's definitely something I'd love to do again when I return to Bangkok. The prices are well below the average for the area. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gerardo Alvarez Duron

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything about this place is great- the performances, the service, and the food and drink. The performers slayed, even on a Wednesday night, and the staff were super attentive. I had the samosas which were tasty, too. I’d come back if I had the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sadie Y

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly entertaining and great performance. Only few Go Go boys but they aim to please you and are open to all sorts of play. Ended up tipping more than I had intended because I truly enjoyed my self thoroughly. Better than W club, F club or …
sample_reviews_en.author: Bryce Ang

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely loved my experience here. The service is outstanding for a casual restaurant — warm, attentive and welcoming from the moment you walk in. The food is just as impressive, with every dish full of flavour and beautifully presented. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jamie Presland

restaurants.name: ทรูจาจัง สาขาศรีนครินทร์ True Jjajang Srinagarindra
restaurants.address:

Srinagarindra Alley, ดอกไม้, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I tried three dishes. All were delicious, and I wasn't disappointed.
- Jajangmyeon, paired with the restaurant's yellow pickled radish, was incredibly delicious, not greasy at all. I'm usually not a fan of pickled radish, but this restaurant makes it incredibly delicious.
- Budae Jjigae Soup, a pork soup served with ramen noodles and rice. The soup was very rich and flavorful.
- Garlic Fried Chicken, served with dipping sauce. The chicken was crispy and had a slight curry flavor.
- I ordered extra kimchi, which was delicious, but a little sour. Those who like sour food might really like it.

I felt it was worth it to try it. The restaurant is decorated like a typical Korean restaurant. The food is delicious and reasonably priced. You have to try it at least once. Don't forget to try the yellow pickled radish, it's truly delicious.

The only problem is parking. If you come to this branch, you might not find any parking in front of the restaurant. You have to park in the parking lot for 20 baht per hour and then walk.

I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: chuthathip onbunchong

sample_reviews_en.text: Really loved this place! It’s just a short walk from Seacon Square and has a super authentic Korean vibe. The staff were friendly and the service was fast. Prices are good too — not expensive at all. I had a tasty pork dish, and the fried chicken is a must-try! I’ll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben Partridge

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered food through Grab Food yesterday evening. The food tasted sour. About an hour after eating, I experienced severe vomiting and diarrhea. I'm requesting that the restaurant improve the quality of their food before serving it to customers.

Here's the medicine I bought.
sample_reviews_en.author: R

sample_reviews_en.text: A rare Korean restaurant in Thailand that offers affordable prices and guaranteed quality. While this location is a bit inconvenient to find, it's not a problem for me since I live nearby, and since I'll be focusing on delivery anyway... I hope it stays here for a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: 몰라

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the atmosphere is nice, and it's air-conditioned so it's not hot. I'd recommend coming here if you like Korean food. The food is delicious, prepared quickly, and you won't have to wait long.
sample_reviews_en.author: นพคุณ จิรูปถัมภ์

sample_reviews_en.text: I really suppressed to find clean and cute Korean restaurant! I ordered a kimchi fried rice for about 100 baht, and it has a lot of portions to eat! I really fulfilled that 😊 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Erika UEDA

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The price was great too. The staff were very helpful, the restaurant was clean, and they played Korean music. It was a really enjoyable experience! 🥹💛💚🍜🍗 …
sample_reviews_en.author: mmookarin m

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly delicious! I wasn't disappointed at all. The flavors were rich and delicious. The wait wasn't too long, and the food arrived piping hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: pao pao

restaurants.name: โอชาม ข้าวต้มแห้ง สาขา ดาดฟ้า O-Charm Ricebowl Dadfa branch
restaurants.address:

โครงการดาดฟ้ามาร์เก็ตปาร์ค, 539 Sukhumvit 105 Alley, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: It tastes good, easy to eat, and the food comes quickly. It wasn't crowded, which was convenient. However, one bowl wasn't very filling; the portion was a bit small for the price. 99฿ for the rice porridge seems overpriced due to the location.
sample_reviews_th.author: I am Happy

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was incredibly delicious and flavorful. Today I tried the dry rice porridge, rice noodle rolls, braised pork ribs, and dessert. The ingredients here deserve five stars; they're fresh and clean, and the dipping sauces, like the soy sauce and seafood sauce, are perfectly balanced. The only downside is that the prices are a bit high... but I'll definitely be back because I often pick up family members at Bearing BTS station, and if I'm hungry while it's raining, I just stop by! I'm hooked on the delicious flavors and high-quality ingredients. The restaurant is open until 9 PM, and there's plenty of convenient parking behind the building.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jub T. Vorakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rice porridge tasted good, the broth was clear and refreshing.
It was easy to season to my liking.
They gave generous portions of ingredients; one bowl is enough for a woman to feel full.

The only downside was that the broth wasn't as hot as it should have been.
It was hot enough to drink without needing to blow on it, but by the time I ate half a bowl, it was no longer hot.
Also, there were still several clumps of rice.

The fried items I ordered were overpriced.
The pieces looked large in the picture, but the actual items were much smaller.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wundertan Wundertan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dry rice porridge with minced pork and tom yum soup was delicious. The dry rice porridge with pork ribs was also good. The dry rice porridge with chunks of pork was just average, nothing special.

The last dish was a mixed fried platter of three items: chicken wings, tofu, and pork cracklings. It was unique; I've never seen that anywhere else, as they deep-fry these three items and then stir-fry them together.

Oh, and the soup was tasty.

The prices were a bit high, but understandable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varat Jan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've seen many O-Cham branches, but this one has seating and a comfortable atmosphere. It wasn't crowded.
_It's a dry rice porridge menu where you can choose your toppings.
_Lots of toppings, very generous portions.
_The ingredients are very good, the pork and offal are excellent.
_I liked the braised pork the most, delicious with the dry rice.
_The dipping sauce wasn't very spicy.
_The fried items were a bit oily.
The food came out quickly. The taste is good, but the price is high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana Relax

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is nice, but the large sign outside should be removed or replaced if a promotion has ended. It shouldn't have been put up six months ago when the promotion ended. Alternatively, the staff should inform customers about the promotion when they order.

Overall, the food was okay, but the three dishes I ordered cost almost 500 baht, which I think is a bit overpriced. 🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: TJ JRB

sample_reviews_en.text: The broth in the rice porridge is fragrant and delicious. The braised pork pieces are firm and the ingredients are fresh. The atmosphere in the restaurant is good, the food is served quickly, they have dry rice porridge, desserts, and traditional drinks. They also offer online ordering, the staff are friendly, and the online ordering process is well-organized.
sample_reviews_en.author: An Charlie

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork was delicious, and the ribs were tender. The soup was average, but a bit too peppery. The rice portion was just right. The boiled fish with dipping sauce was fresh, but had some fish scales, suggesting it wasn't prepared properly. It's a small restaurant with friendly staff (though there weren't enough staff for lunchtime).
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichakorn Chaikumharn

restaurants.name: Bangrak Riverview
restaurants.address:

72 ถ. เจริญกรุง Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: This venue hosts many great events. The event I went to, called One Love, had a fantastic atmosphere; it was a great art and music event. Entry was only 600฿ for an 8-hour event – ​​you couldn't get a better deal! It's located opposite IconSiam. If you come by car, parking is available at the CAT building for only 20฿ per hour. If you don't bring a car, it's also easy to get back.
sample_reviews_th.author: Tong Limmontree

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bangrak River View, a new landmark on the Chao Phraya River, CAT Tower Bangrak ⛴, a ferry hub offering free shuttle service between CAT Tower and ICONSIAM.

“Bangrak River View” is a pier and mall development project on over 1 rai of land, featuring commercial buildings 🏬 and a smart pier ⛴ to facilitate tourists and the general public 👭👭.

💢Including💢

▶️ Large riverside restaurants, fast food restaurants, and convenience stores.

▶️ A Smart Pier passenger waiting area with LED screens connected to a Smart Tracking system displaying ferry arrival and departure information. To find out what type of boat it is, where it's coming from, and where it's going:

▶️ Pier 2 (Floating Pier)
🔹There will be free ferry service daily (09:00 - 23:00) between CAT Tower Pier and ICONSIAM.
🔹Soon, there will be tourist boat services to 8 major piers👏 including Sathorn Pier / CAT Tower / ICONSIAM / Yodpiman Pier / Wat Arun Pier / Tha Chang Pier / Phran Nok Pier / Pinklao Pier.
🔹And CAT WiFi will also be available both on the boats and at the piers.

See you soon!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Saitanmanee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is very poorly managed; the organization needs a complete overhaul, which is a shame because it's a beautiful establishment.

The staff have limited English. Everyone speaks their own version. A smoking area is provided for smokers until 10:30 PM. By 10:50 PM, smoking is no longer permitted in the designated area! You have to go down to the ground floor. Go figure! It's not possible to order a glass of alcohol or a cocktail, only by the bottle, wine or champagne! Stupid!!! Especially if there's only one person drinking! The location was ideal for watching the fireworks, which was the only positive point!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ornella Esp

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been there before to eat, the Pad Thai is delicious ❤️❤️
Recently, I saw they offered boat tours, so I decided to try it. And the photos I got were incredibly beautiful. It's been a while since I've taken a boat to visit a temple, it was such a great experience. 5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: ณฤดี วิทิตสกุลธร

sample_reviews_en.text: For anyone wanting a change of scenery, I highly recommend it! Enjoy a relaxing boat ride and admire the Bangkok views from the river. The breeze is great, and the photos turn out beautifully. At 1,500 baht per person, it's very reasonable. Absolutely amazing! 💖✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Bunny Lover

sample_reviews_en.text: The ferry pier to Icon Siam has been redesigned to be more modern and has a great atmosphere. There are cafes and coffee shops where you can relax and enjoy the view of the Chao Phraya River. It's not quite finished yet, and the shops aren't fully decorated.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bodipat Asapan

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent Almond Whey protein, great location, ok prices and wonderful staff. I've been looking for this type of small outlet selling protein shakes for long time and I'm very happy to have found one. Location is great as well. Will go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Analyze This

sample_reviews_en.text: I took my mom on a trip to this newly opened boat tour. The price was great, and it offered a truly new perspective of Bangkok. We saw everything! It was my first time on a boat tour and I was very impressed. 😍😍🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: ศิริโสภา เม้ามีศรี

restaurants.name: Chai Na Pork Satay (หมูสะเต๊ะนายนะ)
restaurants.address:

132 Rama VI Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It's really delicious. I didn't call to reserve, but I waited almost an hour to buy it. They give you a lot of pickled vegetables and dipping sauce, not holding back like other places. If there's not enough, they also sell more. It's fair. It's still delicious when I get home. I reheat it in the air fryer the next day and the taste is still good.
sample_reviews_en.author: komon sermboonkrong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating this since I was born. It used to be the best satay in Thailand, but this time the pork is just scraps, the dipping sauce isn't as thick as before, and it's much sweeter.

Please bring it back to how it used to be immediately. Increased costs justify a higher price; customers understand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirisilp Kongsilp (Tai)

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork is shaped into round balls, it's tender, the satay sauce is good, and it goes very well with the pickled vegetables. Plus, the price is not expensive either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emmy Poko

sample_reviews_en.text: A friend bought it for me. It's very delicious. The pork is soft and grilled just right. Don't skimp on the dipping sauce and you'll get plenty of Ajad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyarat Svang

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork was tender, the dipping sauce was plentiful and tasty, and the pickled vegetables were also generously portioned. The price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Salinroj Makmana

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered from Line Man or Robin Hood, but all my orders got cancelled. What's going on? Did they not have time to prepare them, or...?
sample_reviews_en.author: Phanor Punsay

sample_reviews_en.text: Awesome, just as delicious as ever. The price has increased by 1 baht per stick, making it 70 baht per set.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saisaward Boonkumpra

sample_reviews_en.text: Should come to lotus parking entrance there is a lot of parking inside and can walk to market.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kriengkrai Sarakune

restaurants.address:

20, 27-29 Soi Ruamrudee Community, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
On Wednesdays and Fridays, there's music from the band PHD.
It's perfect for Baby Boomers and GenX, but you can request songs or even sing along!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatchai Atichat

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on the third floor. I've been there many times for private parties where they offer a buffet. The food is pretty good.
sample_reviews_en.author: พร้อมพูล ชอบเพื่อน

sample_reviews_en.text: Good service and good food. The bar is located on the 3rd floor of Yoka Yoka (Japanese restaurant in Ruamrudee Village).
sample_reviews_en.author: Pia Suwannalert

sample_reviews_th.text:
Vietnamese Noodle Soup (Kuy Jup Yuan) 50฿
Stir-fried Noodles (Koy See Mee) 55฿
Delicious and generous portions.
Cash only.
Each bowl is made fresh to order. It's quite busy, we waited in line for about 30 minutes.
sample_reviews_th.author: Mii Blue

sample_reviews_th.text: Incredible Vietnamese noodles (maybe also called kway chap?). Was very flavorful and a big portion of noodles and pork. Was a line and waited about ten minutes. A bargain at 60฿ (only 50฿ if you skip mushrooms).
sample_reviews_th.author: Nicholas K

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was good, but today, January 19th, 2026 at 9:00 PM, I was extremely disappointed. Normally, the portions are much smaller than usual. This is before I've even eaten anything! Usually, I get a generous portion for the price, but today I was really let down. It wasn't worth the price at all. Even ordering the "special" portion had less than usual. And this "special" portion was so small you could count the pieces! The fried shallots and vegetables were just scraps. Even ordering the regular portion online gets you more. Don't hire this person again; you'll lose all your customers. If they work here again, I won't eat here. It has to be the tall, tanned guy and the short, good-looking, fair-skinned guy who give bigger portions and better service. This person is chubby, fair-skinned, with a round face, tall like a Thai man but I don't know his nationality, and he speaks with a thick accent. He worked near closing time today; check the security camera footage. I'm so upset!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuna Nitee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good, but I was confused by the service. I wanted to order a regular dish but didn't want bamboo shoots. When I told them, the staff said no, I had to order from the menu. The menu only had bamboo shoots, young coconut shoots, and plain fish maw as options. I didn't want young coconut shoots either. How was I supposed to order that? If I ordered plain fish maw, would I get mushrooms and other ingredients? I'm so confused! Why couldn't I just not get bamboo shoots? I was really annoyed after waiting in line for so long. 😠
sample_reviews_en.author: luksanaporn bai

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff's attitude was terrible. I've been eating here for many years and eat here often, but this time was really bad. The food was incredibly bland, like they didn't want to cook it at all. Normally, I don't mind the staff being rude like this, it's happened many times before, but this time it completely ruined the experience. I hope the owner will supervise their staff; bad staff tarnishes the restaurant's reputation. 10/09/66 17:40. Go find out who did this; I've included the date and time.
sample_reviews_en.author: NTTTK “Sa TanG”

sample_reviews_en.text:
A famous noodle restaurant.
There's always a line of five to ten people waiting.
The menu offers a wide variety, but tourists have to choose from three menus with pictures.
It's adjacent to the Big C food court, but don't be confused because you can't use food court cards.
As someone who enjoys Thai food, this isn't something everyone will enjoy.
I wasn't particularly impressed, so I was a little disappointed.
Keep in mind that this isn't a restaurant you'd travel far for.
sample_reviews_en.author: jerome Shin

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located inside the food park of Big C Ratchada. I personally like it because everything is made fresh and hot, but you might have to wait a bit because it's very popular. The taste is delicious, whether it's the fish maw soup or the Vietnamese noodle soup. You can order additional items you like and eat inside the food park or order takeout, but eating in the food park is better because it's more convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: mou ter

sample_reviews_en.text:
This fish maw soup stall in the mall is surprisingly crowded. Just walking past, the aroma of spices fills the air. The soup is made bowl by bowl, and the taste rivals a high-end Chinese restaurant. The price is also very reasonable, with a special fish maw soup costing only 65 baht.

The seating area is in the air-conditioned food court of Big C.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirad Sreerattana-arporn
