restaurants.address:

1283 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious! (Excuse the vulgar language, I can't find a better word to describe the taste.) I had to check out this review on Google! I ordered through Lineman and it arrived surprisingly fast. The minced beef basil stir-fry was perfect – the beef was fragrant, the chilies were aromatic, it was amazing! I ate it all, leaving nothing behind, so I didn't get a chance to take a picture. The price on the app might seem a bit high, but it's truly worth it for the taste. I'd give it a thumbs up! It's definitely the best basil stir-fry I've had in this area. Not a paid endorsement either.

(The rest of the text appears to be a string of Thai words and phrases in Thai and English, likely a corrupted or garbled translation.) Lerd, Lerd, Lerd, Lerd, Lerd, Lerd, Lerds ... Lerttrakarn, Lertlerperfect, Lerkkha, Lerkkha, Lerkkhaa, Lertfiew, Lertmakkk, Lertkingkongkaew, Lertkha, Lertkra, Lertkhra, Lertsirilak, Lertsophon, Lertwarit, Lerts ...
sample_reviews_en.author: Supustarakran Nutchanart (ice)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry) is amazing! Their signature dish is Pad Krapow Tida, an old-fashioned, special recipe from the restaurant. It's stir-fried dry over high heat, giving it a wonderful wok aroma and the fragrant scent of dried chilies. The taste is satisfyingly spicy. Free soup is included.

I recommend the beef or minced pork Pad Krapow. You can add toppings like a fried egg or egg tofu. I tried the squid and crispy pork Pad Krapow and weren't as impressed.

-Prices start at 70 baht.
-The restaurant is in a clean, air-conditioned shophouse.
-The staff provides good service.
-There is no parking lot; you'll have to park a little further down the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paew Waew

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry) restaurant near my house. The highlight seems to be their Pad Krapow. The atmosphere inside is quite nice and clean. I really appreciate the staff training at this branch; the service is excellent! 😬 Another point I'd like to mention is that each chef has a slightly different cooking style. Sometimes it's too sweet, sometimes too spicy, sometimes too salty. It seems to depend on the cook's mood at the time! 🤣😂 If the taste were more consistent, the restaurant would be much more popular with people in this area. 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaiko Joy

sample_reviews_en.text: The squid basil stir-fry was delicious, and the chicken basil stir-fry was also great, especially with the fried egg. The tofu and minced pork soup was excellent. The service was good, and the food came quickly; we didn't have to wait long. I would highly recommend this restaurant to others. Thank you to the staff for letting us sit down even though it was close to closing time; they welcomed us and let us eat comfortably without rushing us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leung Phattaranateethong

sample_reviews_en.text: Tida Pad Krapow Thong, Charoen Nakhon branch, serves flavorful and aromatic Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry) with a perfect dry-fried texture – not too oily. The ingredients are fresh, especially the crispy pork and minced pork, which are perfectly seasoned. Service is fast, the staff is polite, the restaurant is clean, the atmosphere is simple, and the prices are reasonable. Definitely worth the taste!
sample_reviews_en.author: winrhcp

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small, air-conditioned restaurant. The food tastes decent, and the atmosphere inside is clean. However, I have one complaint: a female waitress was eating and looking at her phone with the speakerphone on, which was loud and disturbed other customers and was inappropriate. This should be improved.
sample_reviews_en.author: nopporn kruesing

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! Rich and flavorful, the basil aroma is amazing – unlike any other I've ever had. The staff at the Charoen Nakhon branch are all excellent, polite, and speak nicely. The price is also very reasonable. The packaging is clean and looks great, exceeding expectations for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jin

sample_reviews_en.text: I've ordered delivery twice now, and the basil chicken portion wasn't proportional to the rice. Today I tried the seafood with chili and salt for 140 baht, and this is all I got. If I hadn't ordered a fried egg, I would have had to mix the leftover rice with fish sauce and eat it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana L

restaurants.name: โอ้กะจู๋ ซีคอนบางแค
restaurants.address:

609 ห้างสรรพสินค้าซีคอนบางแค ชั้น1 Bang Wa, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was slow from taking the order and serving the food to paying the bill. I waited almost an hour to pay. I sat there for ages, getting frustrated, and called out for service twice. Staff walked past without a word. My seat wasn't even in a secluded corner. On the third call, the same staff member said they thought another employee had already checked the bill (how does this restaurant manage its operations? They can make excuses however they want, but they don't even bother to follow up!). My biggest complaint is that from the moment I walked in, no one came to seat me. Did no one see me? Was I a ghost? I don't know if staff usually come to seat customers, but I saw them escorting other customers to their tables that day. I ended up seating myself. This is blatant discrimination. I'm starting to get disappointed with this brand in many ways, but this is my first complaint.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Wola

sample_reviews_en.text: Today was very lucky! Normally you have to reserve a table beforehand because the queue is very long. Today there weren't many people. The food tasted as good as always. The staff were kind and gave us complimentary garlic cheese bread. We used a buy-one-get-one-free drink coupon. Burdock root is very hard to find. If you don't want to wait in a long queue, I recommend coming on Wednesday or Thursday. Everything was delicious as usual. I'll be back next time! 👍😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Malikee Lohmani

sample_reviews_en.text: Huge portions, great value for money, and lives up to its reputation. The quality is consistently excellent no matter where you order. I want to try every item on the menu! The spaghetti is amazing – perfectly spicy and not cloying. And the dessert, the "Long Chong" (a Thai dessert), is a must-order; it's incredibly delicious! Other dishes are equally fantastic, all delicious and reasonably priced. Plus, the staff always provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wimonwiew Sin.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is always good here. We ordered the Lady CNX pork ribs because of the story mentioned in the menu. The taste was delicious, but I don’t think it’s ideal for a lady on a date, as the story suggested, since you still have to cut it, and some parts were hard to cut, lol. I love the matcha avocado drink here. I went during Chinese New Year, and they gave us a red envelope, which was a voucher for a free drink next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: inky Lalita

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and the portions were generous for the price, but the wait was quite long.
While waiting in line, it seemed like the staff didn't notice us, who had already sat down to wait. When other customers came in later, they were served first. So we had to go and inform the staff that we were here first.
I wish the food came out all at once or more continuously.
I hope they can improve on this aspect a little.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puchit Kamsankot

sample_reviews_en.text:
We arrived around 5:00 PM and only ordered two dishes: glass noodle salad and salmon roll.

We waited for over 40 minutes, but it seemed other tables received their orders before us. Our first dish arrived at 5:55 PM, while the second still hadn't arrived.

We received an apology from the staff and were given bread.

There was no staff to help us follow up; we had to do it ourselves. This experience was very unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: N S

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is our family's go-to restaurant. The food is always delicious, the atmosphere is great, and the staff are always smiling, lovely, and provide excellent service.

Today was a special occasion, so we brought a cake to celebrate. The restaurant offered free cake decorating, which was very impressive. They even sang a happy birthday song with a light-up sign! Simply amazing!

Thank you so much!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat Chonkaphat

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at this branch several times, with considerable time between visits, but the problem remains the same: extremely slow food service, even when the restaurant isn't full and there's no queue. The service is abysmal; staff seem to constantly avoid customers, and getting their attention is incredibly difficult. Serious improvements are needed, and it's very frustrating to dine there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitchada C

restaurants.name: KFC Samyan Mitrtown
restaurants.address:

ชั้น G, Samyan Mitrtown, 944 Rama IV Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch has a very strange management system. They have an ice cream machine, but you can't place orders using it. More importantly, there was some kind of event or filming going on at the branch today, but there were no signs announcing what they were doing. We thought we could still order, but when we went to the order vending machine, an employee came and informed us that the branch was closed. We thought this was very strange, especially since we saw people eating in the store. We were quite disappointed with this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruangrit Naksuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: This fast food place is incredibly slow, the service is terrible, and they have no problem handling immediate issues. There are long queues, but they can't manage it. It's baffling. They keep telling customers to wait, both riders and walk-ins. Even existing customers haven't received their orders. They're just piling up new orders – what kind of service is that? If they know they're busy, shouldn't they be managing things better? If they know they're doing well, why keep telling customers to wait? Think before you speak.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pall Hearts

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a tourist, they serve ice cream! We weren’t expecting it, but decided to give it a try, and it did not disappoint.
The ice cream came in a cup, and it was creamy, rich, and not watery at all.... surprisingly filling for the size. Smooth texture, just the right amount of sweetness, and honestly better than what you’d expect from a fast-food chain. Perfect little treat to cool off from the Bangkok scorching heat.
sample_reviews_en.author: OfficialG Tui

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Automatic drink dispenser
- Clean, convenient, suitable for working while eating.
- Automatic vending machine and counter service available.
- Complete a survey and get 2 free Wing Zabb (spicy chicken wings) on your next purchase over 100 baht.
- Accepts various mobile carrier benefits such as Galaxy Gift, etc.
- Spacious seating.
- Crispy chicken, very hot and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benzjie

sample_reviews_en.text: Just ordered 4 boneless chickens but I have to wait like almost an hour because your que system my order show on screen and then disappeared but I didn’t even get my order if I didn’t tell a cashier I’ll have to wait forever I hope this will not happen again and PLEASE check your freaking system errorS Thanks. HOPE THIS HELP 😃 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Vasi KKh

sample_reviews_en.text: Very special KFC. Handed me a part of my order stating that I will get some more later (did not happen). The other day their soda machines were empty and I was left with empty glass costing 50 baht. Well, happens, I asked for a bottle of Pepsi. They refused to sell as those are "for delivery only".
sample_reviews_en.author: First Last

sample_reviews_en.text: Many times the wait time for food is much longer than at other branches. Most recently, I waited over 20 minutes. They said they were out of stock but offered to replace it with a less valuable item. Otherwise, I would have to wait another 20+ minutes for them to get the item from another branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joey Jioh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice decoration, cool facilities

There’re 2 kiosks for order, no need to wait for a long queue to order with staff.

Refill sodas with digital screen, very cool KFC.

Chicken and food is same with other branches, it all comes in paper box with disposal cutlery.

Best thing is, it opens 24hrs
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukhum Cheff Truengtrachitkul

restaurants.name: budda
restaurants.address:

7/8 buddabar Lat Phrao 8 Alley, Lane 3, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We really love going to this place to listen to music. The food is delicious, the music is great, and the atmosphere is chill. However, lately I haven't been able to wear flip-flops anymore. Normally, I always come in casual clothes because I don't like the crowded, cramped atmosphere. It might be okay on days when the place isn't very busy, as the restaurant wants more customers, but definitely don't wear flip-flops on Saturdays! I guess the restaurant needs to be a bit selective about who they let in. 😶
sample_reviews_en.author: Narumon Sree-umpai (New)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is flavorful and just right. The fried items are great as beer snacks. The restaurant is currently open as usual, but it's best to call ahead to check as they might not be open. Parking is limited, but you can find parking in the nearby alley. Highly recommended for watching football; it's a really great place to sit and play.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bee love cats

sample_reviews_en.text: It's nice. The food is delicious. My friend said the restaurant was renovated and they even have a bed in the bathroom! 5555555555 But the music is a bit old-fashioned; I'd like to hear some T-pop mixed in, because some of the songs are very 90s and I wasn't born yet. But overall, it's good. The service is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lee Minnie

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a drink and waited for an incredibly long time, at least half an hour. Even when another staff member came to ask, I still hadn't gotten my drink.

I need to improve and train my staff on customer service and avoid discrimination.

P.S. The staff responsible for the bar area in front of the restrooms
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitas Sunanta

sample_reviews_en.text: The food wasn't good compared to other bars in the same price range. The quality doesn't match the price. The decor is like old-fashioned bars from 10 years ago. The staff were attentive, and the location is convenient. Would I recommend it? No, go to another place. The price and atmosphere are mismatched.
sample_reviews_en.author: teerapat y

sample_reviews_en.text: v good band!!! ❤️ enjoyed the vibes here too! OMG revisted...and other groups also 👍🏻 will come again!!! when the music is so good, i really don't care about no slippers, food quality or expensive ice (but this is true @90 baht 😂...more true than the above ✌🏻...but I can go ICELESS for them 😁😁😁 …
sample_reviews_en.author: G G

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were attentive, the atmosphere was great, with both indoor and outdoor seating, live music, and delicious food. The restaurant was quiet and peaceful, located a short distance down a side street. The outdoor area has trees and a projector screen for watching football.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arthier Design studio

sample_reviews_en.text: The store has a stylish and inviting atmosphere, creating a comfortable and pleasant ambiance as soon as you enter. The food and drinks are plentiful and delicious; the live music is great, and you can even spot a few pretty girls – overall, a very good experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Google User

restaurants.name: Dune Pattaya Restaurant & Residence
restaurants.address:

397/26 Thanon Second, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just an average Bangladeshi run Indian restaurant. Food tasted  just like any other indian restaurant. You might consider that all Indian restaurants have the same chef or food coming from the same kitchen.
We tried the tanduri chicken and it tasted so bland and flavourless that we had to deep it in the sauce and actually asked for extra salt to eat it.
While we ordered the waitress was standing by our table, I was wondering why and figured out that she was waiting when I finished reading the menu so she could take away! Amazing!
While my 5y old daughter was playing around the table, the owner warned us that some kid did some damage to his chair! Wow, we came to a restaurant but it feels like we were in a senior parents house!

There is nothing special about this restaurant, tasteless food and not kids friendly at all, do not go there with family.
Oh did I forget to mention that their toilet has an extremely old breath taking a bad smell? Do not use it while you are there, it might ruin your appetite
sample_reviews_en.author: Mahmud Farooque

sample_reviews_en.text:
There’s a lot of great Indian restaurants (which for me mostly just means Curry chicken if I’m honest LOL)

I walk past this restaurant essentially every day, always someone out front to find what you might like on the menu, finally decided to check it out and was not disappointed!

It’s a classy, nicely maintained location for starters.

Fair portions, I easily ate half of the rice and Chicken Masala and had a full meal to enjoy later.

Lastly; the flavours! Excellent rich flavours, from the bread to the curry to the side plate of sliced cucumber etc.

Recommended 👍🏽👍🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: D “EZ” Androso

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was excellent.  I got the chicken tikka marsa, naan (onion & garlic), and veggie pakora. The pakora and onion naan were good, ok.... the chicken tikka marsala & garlic naan fantastic,  delicious.
The order was put in promptly,  and the food came out in about 10 minutes. The place was clean,  and they put the a/c on for me, and the service was polite and professional.   If you're looking for good Indian food you'll be satisfied here.  I would not hesitate to return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephen D

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place look clean. I dive in and there nothing like when they get your order wrong is there I'm from london and indian food is become a British culture
I absolutely love indian food and I know how to cook as well none of this people in thailand know how to cook Indian food periodly. I have tried so many places and to be honest with you I give up do I recommend this place not on your life I can go into more details but I want keep away
sample_reviews_en.author: Yiannakis Yiacoumi

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is absolutely delicious. I tried the shrimp biryani 🍤, which was excellent. The chicken soup was amazing. The vegetable yogurt salad was legendary. The food tasted great and was piping hot, and the service was fast. If there were more than 5 stars, I'd give it 👌. The location is within walking distance of Hilton.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abdullah H

sample_reviews_en.text: I love Indian food and this is exquisite! The service was very friendly. The place is very clean. They even played traditional music to create a pleasant atmosphere! If you're visiting Pattaya for the first time and haven't tried this type of food, this is a great place to start. I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicolás Gómez Fuentes

sample_reviews_en.text: This lunchtime meal was good, the sauce was what I expected, the lamb could have been more, the veg rice had Peanuts in it, so be aware allergists to tell them. It was the first Indian restaurant that looked inviting. The waiting staff were polite and friendly and a good experience all round.
sample_reviews_en.author: cornelle brown

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fabulous Indian food! Great staff!

So far, I've tried;
Mutton Curry,
Chicken Tikka Marsala,
Shrimp Tikka Marsala,
Egg Tikka Marsala,
Garlic Naan,
Thai rice,
and Indian Rice.

All were excellent and above. Egg Marsala really surprised me with how filling it was. (I'm usually a carnivore.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan Whiteside

restaurants.address:

Soi Chulalongkorn 42, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good Taste Good Design Cozy Place.
A little bit expensive. Cost around 189 per dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sangtian Anurakwongsri (Tian)

sample_reviews_en.text: Tiny little poke shop, that has some super tasty Poke dishes with a Thai twist (green chili and the laab versions were both stellar!). Very reasonably priced compared to others. Seems like more of an online delivery place, but there are tables to stop for a quick bite to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing sets of healthy menus such as Salads, Poke bowls and Vegetarian bowls. Open later than most standalone restaurants. Great Price and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: วศิน สุวรรณ

restaurants.name: ขาหมูเจ้พร
restaurants.address:

190 Thanon Si Wiang, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The pork leg was delicious, but the vendor was very aggressive. I couldn't finish it and asked to take the leftovers home, but she refused and threatened to fine me 100฿.
sample_reviews_th.author: พิมพิกา น.

sample_reviews_en.text: To be frank, for someone who likes braised pork leg, the cleanliness is 3/10. The pork is tender and the aroma is 3/10. The dipping sauce is average. The gravy is salty 7/10 and sweet 4/10. The vendors, both men and women, use their bare hands to scoop the pickled cabbage, garlic, and chili peppers. They use Khao Saohai rice. The braised pork leg is served in a bowl with chili paste and plain rice on a plate. One set includes one bottle of water for 70 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: ROCK AND RIDE

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited twice to try Jjareunsaengsilroom. The first time, I arrived at 9:30 and it was sold out, so I had a rice bowl and left. The second time, I arrived at 7:10 and it was sold out. Anyway, I came here as a second choice. I don't know how delicious the whole pig's feet at Jjareunsaengsilroom are, but I enjoyed them here. They were tender and had no gamey smell, so I enjoyed them.
sample_reviews_en.author: 정국영

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork leg was delicious and flavorful, incredibly tender and soft. The portion was very generous, exceeding expectations. Rice was free refills but quite hard. It came with a full set of side dishes including pickled cabbage, chili peppers, garlic, and a chili vinegar sauce that was just right, not too sweet. Overall, it was a good meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicky Achiraya E.

sample_reviews_en.text: I asked the cook three times for wide fllat  she kept saying ok but meanwhile pointing at vermicelli the whole time; she did not give me flat noodles in my soup. What came in my soup was vermicelli. Broth is also too sweet for my taste, Staff brought napkins to everyone, but me. They appear to prefer locals and I would not return here.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Lindsay

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best food and price

The duck legs might have a slight gamey smell, but it is bearable enough to eat.

The other menu items also seem quite reasonable.

The combination with spicy sauce is the ultimate truth, so if you want to experience the true flavor, I recommend mixing the spicy sauce well into the dish and tossing it all together.
sample_reviews_en.author: 박순길 (Soon-gil)

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork knuckle rice here was quite good, and the food came out quickly. It wasn't crowded around lunchtime, but the environment wasn't great. The seats were in a back alley, so you had to eat quickly. There were flies everywhere, so don't look around while you're eating. It's near Disneyland with several Mickey Mouse statues.
sample_reviews_en.author: man fat sze

sample_reviews_en.text: The area around Saphan Taksin station is lined with famous Khao Kha Moo restaurants, and this is one of them. The mountain of pig's trotters is very appetizing. I got it to go, and the meat was tender, sweet, and delicious. I heard that you can enjoy various cuts of meat, so I would like to go again many times.
sample_reviews_en.author: ぴろ

restaurants.name: ครัวน้องแนน
restaurants.address:

ปาก Ban Rawipha Sukhumvit Alley, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nong Nan's Kitchen

Single-dish meals & Northeastern Thai food 👍

After running errands at Central Bangna, I looked for a somtum (papaya salad) restaurant.

Personally, I liked the taste overall. The dipping sauces – somtum, duck beak, spicy dipping sauce, sukiyaki dipping sauce – were all good. The prices were moderate.

The restaurant has a comfortable seating area with stone benches, bamboo gazebos, and wooden tables, both indoors and outdoors. For parking, we parked at the Udom Suk Walk lot and walked over. It seems parking in front of the restaurant can be difficult at certain times due to heavy traffic; parking directly in front would block the road.

The service wasn't anything special, just a typical restaurant. Drinks are self-serve. 😁

If you're planning on trying this place, give it a try. It's worth it.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Oran Tantinantatrakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taste: The food is well-balanced and flavorful. The spicy flavor is strong if you don't ask for it.
The restaurant makes it mildly spicy.
Cleanliness: Overall, it's acceptable.
Parking: There's no main parking lot, so you have to park on the sidewalk.
Service: Quick service, always refilling your water. Ordering comes quickly, and the bill is also quick. The restaurant isn't overly crowded.
Price/Quantity: Typical restaurant prices.
For example, grilled pork neck costs 90 baht.
Water costs 20 baht per bottle, ice 20 baht.
Sticky rice/steamed rice costs 15 baht.
Somtam is 80 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: NU’S CUPIDON GALLERY

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥩The highlight is the grilled beef with jaew sauce. The tender, juicy beef (order it with fat) is served with a dipping sauce that contrasts perfectly with the flavor of the meat. Grandma promises it's absolutely delicious.
🥗The glass noodle seafood salad, ordered with a spicy twist, is absolutely delicious, packed with flavor and incredibly spicy.
🥗The Thai papaya salad still needs a little more work.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thatchawat Taweevanichakul

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a truly authentic and delicious som tam (papaya salad). For anyone wanting to relive the spicy, flavorful atmosphere of Isaan cuisine, this is the only place to go. I highly recommend the tam pa (spicy papaya salad with various ingredients) and the koi khom khua (spicy minced meat salad). They are so delicious you'll want to ordain the chef as a monk!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ritthirong Juntaloon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great taste, good price, and reasonable portions.
A standard Isaan restaurant menu with everything you'd expect: grilled pork neck, grilled intestines, and a spicy minced pork salad with plenty of offal. Soft and tender liver and intestines. Crispy fried small intestines with garlic. The minced pork omelet was incredibly flavorful, sweet, and tender.
sample_reviews_en.author: Satit Nakarin

sample_reviews_en.text: A truly spicy dish in the On Nut area, Somtam Krua Nong Nan, with authentic Isaan flavors and delicious fish sauce. Grilled intestines and grilled pork neck, slightly charred, very delicious. The Jim Jum is equally delicious. The soup doesn't have a lot of MSG. Overall, I'm impressed with the service. They keep refilling my beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: K K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant I frequent a lot. When I can't decide what to eat, I come here. The atmosphere is friendly and chill.
As for the food, the absolute best are the garlic fried pork ribs and the ant egg salad. They are amazing! I highly recommend trying them; you won't be disappointed. This is my own review after eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elena Chai

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it's good. The food is delicious and flavorful. The atmosphere is Isan style. There's football to watch and music to listen to. The price is not expensive. I recommend you come and try it yourself. You don't have to wait long for this restaurant. But the soda is very expensive at 20 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลุงหนานCEOร้านลาบ

restaurants.name: Chef's Kitchen - Indian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

505 2 Phatthaya Klang 12 Alley, Muang Pattaya, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chang Wat Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
During our trip to Pattaya, Thailand, we found this amazing Indian restaurant that truly felt like home. The food was absolutely delicious — authentic, fresh, and full of real Indian flavors.
What made it even more special was the owner. He is a genuinely kind and helpful person who not only served us great food but also helped us and guided us during our stay. His honesty and hospitality made our experience unforgettable.
Highly recommended to anyone visiting Pattaya. Great food, great service, and an even greater human being behind it. We will definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: BHAT YASIR

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best Indian food experiences in Pattaya, Thailand! 🇮🇳✨

The taste was absolutely authentic and full of rich Indian flavors. Every dish was fresh, perfectly spiced, and beautifully served. From the soft naan to the delicious curries, everything reminded me of home.

The staff was friendly, welcoming, and the service was quick. The ambiance was comfortable and perfect for enjoying a proper Indian meal.

If you’re in Pattaya and craving real Indian food, this place is definitely a must-visit! Highly recommended! 🙌
sample_reviews_en.author: lazar sharoon

sample_reviews_en.text: I was on a solo trip to Pattaya and this Indian restaurant became my go-to place. The location is perfect, surrounded by many restaurants, 7-Eleven, Big C, and other necessities, making it very convenient for travellers. The food was always delicious and comforting. The staff and the owner are humble, friendly, and very kind. They suggested places and activities for my solo trip and answered all my questions patiently, which made me feel at home and made my journey even more special. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Saista Nikhat

sample_reviews_en.text: Without a doubt the freshest most delicious authentic Indian cuisine I have ever had! This knocks Michelin star Indian restaurants I’ve eaten in in the out of the park!  The tandoori kebabs and biriani were incredible I ordered far too much food as everything looks so good!! 10 out of 10 I highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Borszeki

sample_reviews_en.text:
As an Indian, I can surely say that this place is the best. The taste is perfected and the atmosphere is quite homely. The food had an authentic Indian taste. And the service was also really good.
It was overall a great experience. And you have to try out the chai!
sample_reviews_en.author: RAGHAVA GROUP

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was fine. But the restuarant staff was trying to scam with me. When I ask for bill, he gave me handwritten bill with total of 745 baht. When I said why it's 745, he calculated again and the actual bill was 525. He was about to scam 220 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanchan

sample_reviews_en.text: Gaurav and Ankit are absolutely outstanding hosts! They always go out of their way to help and make sure every guest feels at home. The food is simply amazing — rich in flavor and cooked to perfection every single time. Their mutton curry, …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ankur Nautiyal

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate lunch. That evening I had severe poisoning and the doctors had to come to the hotel to give me an IV. Stay away from this place if you don't want a high fever, diarrhea, and vomiting. I thought I was going to die that night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Erika Zamprioli

restaurants.name: Al Zahra Restaurant الزهرة( HALAL FOOD طعام حلال)
restaurants.address:

WVFF+M7W, Pattaya Sai 2 Soi 17, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I traveled ten kilometers to reach your restaurant. I ordered rice and mutton. The mutton smelled very bad. The rice was also tasteless. We didn't eat it. I searched for this restaurant on Google.I am giving a session to every customer who comes to you. Please pack a little care , there would be no problem in giving money If the food is good, there is no problem in paying, but when the food is not good, it does not feel good to pay, and that too is expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Showkat Hussain Bhat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a wonderful restaurant! The setting is charming and relaxed, a bit of a retro feel about it.

The food is delicious, healthy (not oily as is the case with many others), and most importantly, it is FRESHLY MADE.
In particular, I love their dhal (lentil soup) and mouth-watering naan bread.

I found the staff to be helpful, friendly and very professional.

It's far far far better than the competition.

In short, this is my favourite in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohamad Mahdi

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant's prices were very high, the order was very poor, and it wasn't complete. I contacted the restaurant after receiving my order, and they told me delivery would cost 150 baht, and the hotel was 1.5 kilometers away. There was no honesty or explanation from the beginning. I advise you to choose another restaurant. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: humaid tayyari

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was really good. I enjoyed their serving. The chicken kabsa was supposed to be cooked in Arabian style, but they fried in butter or oil to make its skin crispy. Generally i like the chicken cooked in steamed. This restaurant is besides to VC hotels in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syedur Rahman

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had Kaware soup that was great, then Maqloobah with rice and grilled fish. All tasted great.
There is prayer room inside. Otherwise, the place is a little old already. Service was ok too.
Would come again for lunch. They have Gulf & Yemeni food 🥘 🍱🥗
Enjoy your meal 🥙
sample_reviews_en.author: Rashid

sample_reviews_en.text: It says "Lebanese restaurant with a Damascene flavor," but the food is Kuwaiti. Haha. Anyway, the food is excellent and the service is superb. May God bless them and grant them success.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mi gusta

sample_reviews_en.text: The food i orderd tasted very bad . I wanted to through up when i tasted the kebab . Chicken soup its same powder bag from supermarket,  it was very thick and tasted 🙄
sample_reviews_en.author: Rasool Zarah

sample_reviews_en.text: A nice, clean restaurant with decent food and a breakfast experience. The prices weren't right for me, but they might be suitable for others. Cash only.
sample_reviews_en.author: ابو روز النوفلي

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวป้าม่อม ซ.ภูมิจิตร
restaurants.address:

89/14 พระรามที่ 4 Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is truly authentic traditional noodles. The flavor is rather mild, allowing you to season it yourself. I'm not very good at seasoning; usually I just add sugar and chili, and it's okay. But this time, I added fish sauce, and wow, it was good. Then I tried a little vinegar, and that was even better. It's perfect for those who like to season their own noodles, but I'm not good at it at all, haha. The offal was okay, not smelly. 50 baht, not expensive at all. Come and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: เทพสุริยะ จําปา

sample_reviews_en.text:
Proper. You can point to choose your noodles, meat, and with or without soup. We had the regular pork, it was very lean and high quality.

The green vinegar garlic chilli sauce on the table was spicy enough and very tasty, but not so hot our cowardly companion couldn't stand a spoonful. Ground nuts are also available.

The portions were not very big but the price was only 50B. Mamma was very friendly and helpful. Strongly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: TJ

sample_reviews_en.text: Simple, delicious, noodles, sometimes with soup, sometimes without. All time favourite groggy morning pickup: sin Lek nam tok moo toon with an ice cold bottle of coke 🥴👌🏾
sample_reviews_en.author: Maximillian Scott Murray

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, tender meat, rich and flavorful broth (both the famous gravy and the flawless dry version). Sold for over 20 years, according to locals in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Littletiger style

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating there since it was beef noodle soup, and now it's braised pork. It's a little less delicious now, but I still go there to eat it to this day.
sample_reviews_en.author: อภิชาติ ทุมาวงศ์

sample_reviews_en.text: We've been selling it for over 40 years. Originally, we sold stewed beef, but due to a cattle disease outbreak, we switched to stewed pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: อร่อยกับตาปุ๊

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle shop serves high-quality, clean pork noodles with delicious crispy pork cracklings. I've never tried it before, but I have to!
sample_reviews_en.author: Veelaprol Lardphiriyasakulkiej

sample_reviews_en.text: A legendary noodle shop in the Phra Khanong area; the crispy pork cracklings and braised pork are things you shouldn't miss.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyapon Panmongkon

restaurants.name: Souffle House Bakery
restaurants.address:

105 Charat Wiang Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The bakery is supposed to specialize in creating a unique product, the soufflé.  It is the only product that brings people to the store.  I ordered the coffee soufflé with the cream brûlée for 219 bahts.  The  soufflé is freshly made and you have to wait 30 minutes. It is the worst dessert that I ever had in my life for both.  The store wasted their time and mine. The soufflé doesn’t even had a hint of coffee taste or creaminess.  It rises to make it look big, and pack with lots of empty airs.  I finished artistically in three spoon.  The cream brûlée is another story.  It is worst than a burn egg tart.  Now I know why nobody is in the store and empty bakery shelves.  I wouldn’t recommend to anybody.  It is so shameful.  The best cream brûlée that I had is in an old market in Rennes, France.  That’s the kind of decent business that I support.
sample_reviews_en.author: SS MW (Peace)

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you love soufflés, Souffle House Bakery is a must-visit. Their Vanilla, Chocolate, and Coffee Soufflés are all incredibly light, fluffy, and full of aroma. Each flavor stands out on its own — the vanilla is comforting and fragrant, the chocolate is rich without being heavy, and the coffee has a smooth roasted note that’s just perfect.

Pairing the warm soufflé with a scoop of ice cream takes it to another level — the hot-and-cold contrast is heavenly.

A simple dessert done perfectly. If you’re in Bangrak, don’t miss this spot! 🍨🔥🍫☕
sample_reviews_en.author: Punlop Taweevoranat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop's owner recommended Cheesecake Souffle which is superb. It is so light and fluffy. Its taste is absolutely perfect, not too sweet but delicious. A small scoop of vanilla icecream has been served with Cheesecake Souffle. It really satisfies me. Iced Matcha Latte with less sweet is also a perfect match with Cheesecake Souffle.

I have recently ordered Chocolate Souffle. It is just good as it used to be after 40 minutes waiting for baking.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิน วิน พลัส

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice and cozy cafe. The souffle was very authentic and delicate - keep in mind that it will take around 20-30 minutes to bake. They  offer a wide variety souffle flavors in addition to cake and coffee. There is a few parking spot available beside the cafe. The owner was also very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kongpope Naranong

sample_reviews_en.text: The freshly baked soufflé is worth trying if you happen to be passing by. It's about 10 centimeters in diameter. The downside is that it takes about 20 minutes to bake. The coffee is very fragrant and also great.
sample_reviews_en.author: arthur Wu

sample_reviews_en.text: My wife and I had enjoyed the souffles over a few visits, and they never disappoint. They are served freshly baked on order and take about 30 minutes. Small cafe is cozy with ground and mezzanine floor seating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeff Leong

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop display was empty. No cakes or soufflé on display. Disappointed since I traveled quite far to visit. They had quite a menu but only 3 cakes were available and it was neither soufflé nor cheesecake.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tracy Frantz

sample_reviews_en.text: The souffle is really big and soft inside, not heavy. It is served with a scoop of ice cream. You have to wait about 20 minutes for the souffle. Super recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marco Melis

restaurants.name: Khaow Suk Thai Cuisine By Suk Siam Hostel
restaurants.address:

223 Sukhumvit 4 Alley, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice service and very good food. The restaurant saved us from the rain outside and even though we didn't know what we were going to, we ended up really liking it. The fried rice wasn't hard and dry, like it is in some establishments, but on the contrary, it was beautifully soft and very tasty. They also made me a vegetarian option, even though it wasn't written on the menu. The service was also very nice and when we explained that we had the last of our cash because we were leaving, she was very forgiving. She even offered us a free umbrella for the rain when we left, which made us very happy, but since we only had a little bit of it, we didn't take up the offer. Otherwise, the restaurant is cozy and a bit expensive for Thai food, but very clean with a family atmosphere and nice pictures.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alice Kodešová

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited this restaurant for the first time today. I chose it based on the pictures and reviews on Google Maps. Unfortunately, the reality didn't match the pictures, and the drink prices (a small Leo beer costs 120 baht, and a bottle of plain water costs 30 baht) are way overpriced for a regular Thai restaurant. The owner didn't seem to care when I asked her about it. The food was okay. However, I did mention when ordering that we only wanted it a little spicy. Unfortunately, this was ignored. I could only eat it if I removed all the chilies. All in all, it was rather disappointing, and I can't recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marcello Nenna

sample_reviews_en.text:
One star for the really nice woman who served us, but we couldn't understand the positive reviews about the food at all.

We've been traveling in Thailand for a month now, and we haven't eaten this badly anywhere, especially considering the relatively high prices. We couldn't finish our meals because we could barely swallow them, and the presentation wasn't very appealing either. She was working alone and seemed a bit overwhelmed. And half the menu items weren't even available because she told us she hadn't been shopping very often lately. 😂 Huh?! Why even run a restaurant then?
sample_reviews_en.author: P Häfner

sample_reviews_en.text:
A friend and me were there for eating dinner. We both know Thailand quite well - he lives here, I was about 20 times in Thailand, so we can compare to a lot of other restaurants.

The pictures promise more than we really found. The restaurant is on a busy road and has only 2 small real tables inside.
The food was ok, nothing Special, at least the amount was good.
To charge for a small beer 120.- bath is even more than you pay in a bar.
Giving this as a feedback the owner reacted quite unfriendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karsten Thalau

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Thai Flavors in Bangkok!!
We enjoyed a delicious meal at this cozy Thai restaurant. The stir-fried morning glory was fresh, garlicky, and perfectly spiced. The cashew chicken stood out with its tender meat, crunchy cashews, and rich, savory sauce. The fried noodles with chicken were well-seasoned and satisfying, with a great balance of flavors. A fantastic spot for authentic Thai cuisine! We appreciated the more quiet end of an otherwise very busy street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A terrible resturant disguised in a cosy little hut.

Gave me food poisoning after eating the tomyum soup.

Service was good, until they tried to gas light me into thinking the badly treated noodles was supposed to look like a block of flour (ive been having Thai food for more than 30 years and most definitely know how things should look like).

Price was high and not justifiable with the quality of food.

Will definitely avoid.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mandy Yeo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff at the restaurant are friendly and helpful.
I ordered massaman curry and lemon soda. The massaman curry was delicious and contained large potatoes that made it very tender.
The lemon soda also had fruit juice in it, and the sweet syrup was served separately, so I liked that I could adjust it to my liking.
The terrace seats are comfortable and recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ka Na

sample_reviews_en.text: A highly recommended restaurant with a cozy atmosphere. The food was delicious, and the service was friendly and attentive – they even asked if we wanted the egg omitted when we requested Pad Thai without meat. And the vegan spring rolls were the best we've ever had! We paid 700 THB for two Pad Thais, two spring rolls, and drinks. We would definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nine x3

restaurants.name: IPPUDO The Mall Bangkapi
restaurants.address:

3522 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
A popular ramen shop with a hot, fragrant broth and a well-balanced flavor. The noodles are just the right amount of chewy and soft, just like eating in Japan.

If you're visiting this branch, we recommend the great value set: rice, octopus balls, and refillable green tea for only ฿214. I ordered a single dish and was shocked! It's so cheap and a great value! You can even ask the staff for side dishes to add more flavor.

The tonkotsu soup is amazing! The ultimate in flavor. You definitely won't be disappointed.

Credit cards accepted.
sample_reviews_th.author: Arinta

sample_reviews_en.text:
IPPUDO at The Mall Bangkapi has a nice restaurant setup and a comfortable atmosphere. The place looks good and the staff were polite and helpful during the visit.
However, the ramen was very average, especially considering the price. I expected more in terms of flavor and overall quality for what you pay. One issue to note is that the card reader was not working when we visited, and we were lucky to have enough cash to pay. Overall, it is an okay experience, but for the price, I was hoping for something better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Roberts

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried two unique items (unique in comparison to other Japanese and Thai restaurants): soft shell crab (tempura style) in a bun and mala gyoza.  Owing to the reverse order in which the stronger gyoza came out first, and not knowing how long I should wait for the soft shell crab, I was immediately taken by the northern style sauce — immensely powerful and uplifting.  After the gyoza was 2/5 gone, the crab tempura appeared: crispy and even delicately sweet — just heavenly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Silver Lining

sample_reviews_en.text:
The soup was tasty, but not too thick. I wish it was thicker.
I could still taste the soup powder afterwards, and I felt very thirsty afterward.

The pork was tender and flavorful, but the Thai spring onions, not Japanese spring onions, were a bit too strong.

The noodles were thin and chunky. I personally prefer the softer, bouncier texture.

The staff provided excellent service, but the wait for the food was quite long, even though there weren't many customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: minoru dokidoki

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ippudo at The Mall Bangkapi is located on the Ground Floor, near Gourmet Market. It’s part of the popular Japanese ramen chain known for its rich and flavorful tonkotsu (pork bone) broth

Popular Menu Items:
•	Shiromaru Motoaji Ramen – classic tonkotsu ramen
•	Akamaru Shinaji Ramen – rich broth with miso paste and garlic oil
•	Karaka-Men – spicy tonkotsu ramen
•	Kasane Ramen – double broth made from pork and chicken
sample_reviews_en.author: Nittreeya Wongsa

sample_reviews_en.text:
“Spicy Niku Soba” 🍜🌶️
Rich tonkotsu soup
Followed by a zesty spiciness
Finally, the aroma of chili oil was fragrant.

Delicious! The soup was easy to sip without feeling greasy.
But I wish the egg was pickled instead. 😆

The staff at the restaurant provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuchapa Rattanapan

sample_reviews_en.text: This ramen place is considered one of the best in Thailand. They have a diverse menu, giving you the authentic Japanese ramen experience. The prices are also quite similar to those in Japan.
sample_reviews_en.author: Easylife

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very cheap and delicious. It tastes great. This was my first time here and I was very impressed. I will definitely come back again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: เกริกฤทธิ์ รุจาคม

restaurants.name: Doux Cafe & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

89/9 Rang Nam Alley, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The breakfast was excellent in terms of both taste and price, and the restaurant ambiance was also very nice. However, that tall male waiter was a huge letdown! Not only did he have a black face the entire time, but he also spoke a strange language that was hard to classify as English, leaving us completely confused. He was the worst service staff we encountered in Bangkok. One star for him. Everything else was great. Hopefully, you won't encounter this tall man when you go, as he would ruin your dining experience. By the way, the chicken wrap was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: leather Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The female staff member spoke good English 👍🏻 and provided excellent service 👍🏻
The restaurant and hotel don't coordinate, so you have to order yourself in the morning.
The restaurant opens at 6:30 AM.
I ordered Fried Eggs & Eggs Omelette, both were quite delicious.
The iced cocoa was good, but the iced tea wasn't.
Overall, it's not expensive and quite reasonable.
None of the food can be ordered à la carte; you can only order set meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wei Ching

sample_reviews_en.text:
I absolutely loved this place!! The food was delicious and the staff were so friendly.

I ate here three times during my trip to Bangkok.

Every time I ordered Thai milk tea (it was so good!). On our last day, when we were leaving the hotel, the staff saw us with our luggage and even came out to say goodbye! 🥹💘✨ I highly recommend everyone to dine here.

I'll definitely visit this place again next time I'm in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tong Fan

sample_reviews_en.text: The cafe/restaurant is just outside the hotel I believe it’s the same business. Since when I walked in the staff asked me for the room number, though I didn’t stay there. I ordered for ale carte. Food price was very reasonable and good portion. The environment is very quiet and relaxing too~ staff was nice and easy to communicate with.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yumi Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The cafe is located in Soi Ratchawithi 1, opposite the Lift Able Hotel. It's a bit far from the BTS, but not difficult to find.

I stopped by in the morning and they serve breakfast. The coffee was decent, and the prices were okay for a cafe located in a hotel. The atmosphere was nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onic.j

sample_reviews_en.text: A newly opened shop located under a hotel near Din Daeng/Victory Monument. The drinks are good, rich and flavorful, tastier than expected (I thought they focused more on food, but the drinks are great too). There's plenty of parking as it's inside the hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: WingZero 00W0

sample_reviews_en.text: I just came to have a coffee. It is not really a coffee shop but a restaurant in the hotel and at that time they were serving breakfast, but they still allowed me to have a cup of cappuccino. Price is not expensive, only 70 baht. Place is nice and pleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maryna Y.

sample_reviews_en.text: I’m staying at the Livable hotel next door, which apparently cannot provide basic eating utensils. So I came here to ask if I could borrow some. They told me they only sell them — fine, no problem. But charging 30 baht for a plastic spoon …
sample_reviews_en.author: Long Nguyễn hoàng

restaurants.name: SomTam Palot
restaurants.address:

1736 Soi Thap Phraya 3, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If there's any Koreans reading this, congratulations!
This is a restaurant I don't want anyone to know about.
The pool villa I stayed in was right across the street, so I was feeling hungry and thought I'd buy chicken to take home, but I didn't have high expectations, and it was delicious.
So, the next day, I tried a few different dishes for brunch to soothe my hangover.
There's nothing I can't eat. Everything was just delicious. Seriously.
I asked them to leave out cilantro because I can't eat it, but a friend who does, asked for it separately, and they served it to me with other vegetables.
Ate (Seafood Stir-fried Noodles, Seafood Fried Rice, Poo Pa Kung Curry (Shrimp, Not Crab Meat), Tom Yum Kung, Chicken)
I think I ate more, but I can't remember.
sample_reviews_en.author: 훅갈수있어

sample_reviews_en.text:
The spit roasted chick was decent but the papaya salad was, as the kids would say, "mid".

I went at 4pm, just before they closed. Nobody was in there (a couple of Grab drivers picking up orders) but didn't think anything of it coz of the time.

It's a big, dingy shack, there are no walls, doors or windows. I wouldn't recommend anyone eat in unless they want to spend their time swatting away mosquitos and flies between bites.

You might enjoy it more as a takeaway but the lack of cleanliness of the place put me off before my food had even arrived but it was too late, I'd already ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony M

sample_reviews_en.text: Real Thai food at an affordable price with friendly staff! Soooooo good. I’ll be back soon. The papaya salad is on par with the best you can find and better than most 5 star restaurants. Chicken was fresh off the rotisserie and the Phad See You again soon was delicious. Nothing but win win win here.
sample_reviews_en.author: set back

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cheap and delicious.
The som tam is even better than the one at Buddha's Valley in Gangnam Shinsegae.
The chicken is tender and generous.
The pad thai is just as delicious the next day, even when reheated in the microwave.
The tom yum goong is also incredibly rich and packed with seafood!
sample_reviews_en.author: Miyoung Leem

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered many dishes but didn't take pictures of them. It's a simple, local restaurant, but everything was delicious. The food came out quickly, the service was good, and the prices were reasonable. I'll definitely go back again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilairat Chaiyawang

sample_reviews_en.text: Our favourite restaurant in Pattaya. We ate here many times and always had the roast chicken and papaya salad. Would recommend even travelling out here. The chicken dipping sauce unbelievable and super friend people running this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: pauljonnash99

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited in late June and had half a gai yang and khao niao.
The gai yang came with two types of sauce.
Free water was provided.
The gai yang was very delicious.
Next time I'd like to try the whole chicken.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hide T

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu sign said "Pad Krapow" (Thai basil stir-fry) was 60 baht, but when I paid, it was 80 baht. The crispy pork with kale was 60 baht, but they charged 65 baht. Terrible service!
sample_reviews_en.author: สุดหล่อ ในก่อไผ่

restaurants.name: Nuatair Restaurant Halal by Company B at Siam Centre
restaurants.address:

PGWM+F7R Siam Centre Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I ate crispy basil chicken at the Siam Center branch, and the chicken wasn't crispy anymore! I'm so disappointed. I'm a big fan of their authentic beef basil chicken; everyone knows it's incredibly delicious.

I took one bite and asked for a replacement, but the first time it was the same, and the second time it wasn't crispy either. I asked the staff if they'd changed the recipe or if it was just the Siam Center branch.

Since it wasn't crispy anyway, I just put it in a box to take home and eat in the morning. I was so sad and didn't want to eat any more, and I didn't dare cancel the order because they'd made it again twice. So I just messaged the admin. The admin responded quickly, but what I really want is #BringBackTheCrispyBasilChicken.

P.S. I had to ask for spoons, forks, and fish sauce; they didn't bring them. Double disappointment! 😭

I'm giving them a 5-star service rating because I gave feedback to the admin via Facebook inbox. Two days later, an employee called to ask for my feedback and offered a 10% discount on my next visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hi MaMilk

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time we went there, i ordered 2x Tenderloin Steaks MEDIUM RARE!!(even showed him the picture on the menu)
What do i get? Well done steaks.
I really didnt want to make a big scene about it, so i just ate it. Paid. Went on my way.

Now after about 2 weeks we went there again. This time its even worse and i really never expirienced something like this. First we had to wait for a table, no big deal.
Then we wanted to order, they didnt have the steak that i wanted, alright. I wanted to order a different steak with french fries, they didnt have french fries. I was getting a bit frustrated there. So i ordered the pasta with pink sauce. I cannot talk about the taste since it is something everyone likes different, but the portion size? Cmon, i had to dig my fork 4 times in and it was already gone. For that kind of treatment, its wayyy to overpriced.

I really tried to give this restaurant a second chance and it has failed for me.
Wont go there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikola Dimitrijevic

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ignored service and no beef at a beef restaurant.

My boyfriend and I came here and were repeatedly ignored despite empty tables. A staff member cleaning a table saw us waiting but didn’t seat us or acknowledge us for several minutes. During this time, a group of foreign customers who arrived first were still looking at the menu outside, yet staff chose to assist them instead of us, even though we were ready to be seated.

After finally being seated by another staff member, we waited 10–15 minutes with no menu while the other group was already ordering. We had to call someone ourselves just to get menus. When we tried to order steak, we were told they had run out of beef — at a beef restaurant when they could’ve given us a heads up from the start.

Poor organization, lack of communication, and very disappointing service overall. We left and went to Kobe instead, the customer service is hundred times better for a cheaper menu with good beef.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawornrat Pranayanuntana

sample_reviews_en.text:
My wife and I went to Nuatair at Siam Center because we wanted to try their steak. The first time we went, the waiter told us only after we sat down that all the steak was finished. Fine, we let it go and ordered something else.

A few days later, we gave them another chance. Before even sitting down, I asked the waiter if they have steak today — he confidently said yes. So we sat down… and guess what? Another waiter came and said, “Sorry sir, no steak today.” Like seriously??

At that point I was just annoyed. This happened twice already. If it’s not available, at least be honest from the start. Don’t give customers false hope. We ended up ordering something else again, but the whole experience was just disappointing.

P.S. When we left the restaurant, we saw one customer being served steak? So at this point, is steak really not available or do they just choose who they're serving it to?
sample_reviews_en.author: avegelage 21

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, a major disappointment. Even placing a simple order was difficult, we asked for pasta with red sauce, a burger with cheese and fries, and some vegetables. After more than 20 minutes, the pasta arrived, followed five minutes later by the completely tasteless vegetables, but still no burger. Only after my partner had already finished eating did a staff member tell us the burger was sold out.

The pasta was bland and the portion size was so small that even a child would have left hungry. The service was chaotic, with wrong dishes repeatedly brought to the wrong tables.

We visit Thailand several times a year, but this was by far the most heartless meal we’ve ever had. Disorganized, careless, and a disgrace to the Thai hospitality industry. If you’re looking for a good meal, avoid this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: SimSim

sample_reviews_en.text: Beef lovers who are Muslim and looking for Halal steak place must come visit this place when in Bangkok. We were incredibly hungry after a whole day of shopping and drop by this place at around 7:30 PM. Ordered their basil chicken rice meal, meatballs, pepper steak, steak jaew and original steak. The jar of Citrus drink was an incredible refreshment to start our meal with. All the steaks were incredibly flavorful and the meat was tender and juicy. Highly enjoyed the variation of the flavors. Pricewise I think the steaks are a great deal. The basil rice meal was also very delicious, slightly spicy, something to be cautious of if you have low tolerance. Personally I love spicy so I loved this dish. Enjoyed our meal here. So glad seeing a Halal steakhouse of this standard exists in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ami Sharadin Khai

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The food preparation is very slow (about 30 min to get the 1st dish and another 20 to get the second dish)
- A lot of waiters are waiting to serve food but the kitchen gets the dishes done very slowly unlike other branches
- Not very crowded at 15:00
- Spicy beef soup is very tasty (recommended)
- Stir-fry minced beef comes in a very small portion and is pretty oily
- Mandi with braised beef is not tender
- Ordered meatballs but the waiter said they lack the proper chef to prepare today
- All Thai style spicy salad (yum) cannot be ordered as there is no ingredients

- Visit here on Jan 1st 2025 and the restaurant seems like they are not ready to provide a service. Suggest the owner/branch manager to consider improving the resource management if they would like to open during New Year.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangkamol L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service and management were absolutely terrible.
There was no coordination between the kitchen and the order-taking staff.

The first dish was served within 5-10 minutes of ordering. Shortly after, they informed us that the salad was sold out. The mashed potatoes were left sitting there for so long they got cold because the protein wasn't served.

In total, we waited about 40 minutes and only got cold mashed potatoes. The cheesy meatballs never came or were served. We even saw the table next to us getting their dishes before us!

When we asked for an answer from the staff, they replied, "Should we cancel the order?" Is that how you solve problems?
We went to eat because we were hungry. What was the point of wasting our time waiting while starving?

Terrible management!
sample_reviews_en.author: Angiolina Gia Spagnuolo

restaurants.name: มาหาหน่อย หม่าล่าทั่ง สาขา ม.หอการค้า (Mahanoi Malatang UTCC)
restaurants.address:

126/4 ซ. วิภาวดิรังสิต2 แยก 6 Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This has happened three times already. The first time, they lost my order number and called my turn after I'd already passed. I had to go ask to find out my order was missing and had to get it again. The second time, the staff's attitude was very unpleasant. I just asked if there was space upstairs, and the staff member turned around and replied, "I don't know," in a very rude tone. It would have been much better if they had said, "I'm not sure, you could try going upstairs to check." The most recent time, they didn't remove the tongs while weighing my food, causing the price to be higher than the actual amount, even though I had already paid. It seemed like the staff realized this and removed the tongs, reducing the price, but I had already paid. The staff member then responded that it was the price for the previous customer, and their facial expression was very unwelcoming. I'm extremely unhappy about this.
sample_reviews_en.author: SUMITRA KATHAI

sample_reviews_en.text: We've eaten here several times. The prices are okay, the taste is good, and the service is good. However, when we couldn't finish our food and asked to take it home, they said we had to pay 5 baht for the container, which we said was normal for the restaurant. But when it came time to pay with my friends, they said it was 11 baht in total. We asked what the extra 1 baht was for, and the staff said it was because it was a combined payment. We were confused; even if it was VAT, it shouldn't be more than 1 baht. We accepted it, but when we asked for a dipping sauce bowl, they said we had to pay for that too. We gave up; they really charge for everything. Luckily, they didn't charge for the chopsticks and spoons.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanoknipa Booncharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incorrect, and the soup I ordered was wrong. When it arrived, I noticed it didn't seem like the soup I requested. When I asked the staff, they said it was correct. However, after opening and eating it, I realized it was the wrong soup. I called to inquire, but after explaining the details, they took no responsibility and hung up. I tried calling again two more times, but couldn't get through. The staff member who took my order, according to the bill, was named Ncang.
sample_reviews_en.author: Potaerungrot

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered "dry stir-fry," but got "thick sauce." Dry and thick sauce are completely different! But I was tired and didn't want to say anything because the restaurant kept getting busy (it was the only restaurant open during New Year's).

The dipping sauce bar had very few options. They didn't tell me how many bowls of sauce I would get (you had to ask). It was mostly self-service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Todd Elric

sample_reviews_en.text: Dirty. At first, I didn't believe what others said because maybe they didn't like mala food? Recently, I ordered mala and there was a steel wool scouring pad in it. The restaurant is crowded, but that makes it look messy and unclean. The restaurant is very hot, and the air conditioning isn't working.
sample_reviews_en.author: Korawan Suphaditphokhin

sample_reviews_en.text: I really need the restaurant to improve its cleanliness. The interior smells musty, and the food wasn't fresh. The pork was so tough I could only chew it 2-3 times before spitting it out and not eating it again. I wasted so much of it, luckily I didn't take too much. At least the soup was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: SharkyWee

sample_reviews_en.text: It tastes good, but before they used to give more dipping sauce. Now they only give two cups, and you have to spend 250 baht to get three cups or more. I like a lot of dipping sauce, you know. Some people like a lot of sauce too. The staff isn't managed well, and the shop is cramped.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gda

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes worse and worse every time I eat there. The other day I ordered the dark broth soup, and the broth was so watery and bland that it didn't even taste like dark broth. The restaurant is also dirty and smelly. The food bar doesn't have the variety of food it used to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naannn Kennu

restaurants.name: The Pizza Company พลับพลาไชย
restaurants.address:

9/1 329 Phlap Phla Chai Rd, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've ordered takeout from them several times, and the service keeps getting worse.

First time: The card machine was broken, and the staff member was very rude.

Second time: They gave me the wrong order (4 pizzas).

Most recently, today, August 22nd, 2024: I placed my order at 5:00 PM, saying I'd pick it up at 5:30 PM. I arrived at 5:50 PM, and the counter staff said to wait a moment and then went to inform the kitchen to prepare it (just started making it???). Okay, that was the first time.
A little later, that staff member left. I waited another 20 minutes. I went to ask, and had to shout to get their attention from the kitchen because no one was at the front of the store. A staff member came to look, then went inside to talk. They only came out and said they were still making one more pizza, then walked away. They kept saying they were making it. So I canceled the order and asked for a refund. The service is terrible, especially the overweight, dark-skinned, big-eyed staff member with a very blank expression.
They didn't care about solving the customer's problem at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Max Max

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was absolutely awful — the staff were loud, unprofessional, and spent the entire time laughing and messing around instead of doing their jobs. The pizza was tiny, shockingly overpriced, and not even tasty. We waited ages for it to arrive, only to be completely let down. Don’t waste your time or money here — this place is a joke!
sample_reviews_en.author: אור מוטחדה

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through 1112, 4 large pizzas with cheese crust and sausage. I asked for sauces and received 1 serving of tomato sauce, 1 serving of chili sauce, and 1 serving of oregano and paprika powder. That's four large pizzas and only one serving of each sauce! This branch is terrible. I won't be ordering from them again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponpen Aeung

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop isn't very welcoming to customers who order at the counter. They don't provide ice for dine-in customers; you have to buy it yourself. The expense isn't the problem, but the manager was grumpy and the staff weren't welcoming either. You can check the shop's security camera footage to see if this is true.
sample_reviews_en.author: M.r. Ritnaphon Rakwanicphong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quite expensive for Thai standards.

Medium pizza is 9 inches, large is 12 inches.

The large pizza is supposedly for 6-8 people – a joke in my opinion, and easily enough for one person.

Unfortunately, the pizza and pasta weren't very tasty either.

The service was friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan H

sample_reviews_en.text: If there were 10 branches with employees like this, the restaurant would go bankrupt. The food is delicious, but the staff ignore customers, aren't at the counter, and you have to call them over. I wonder if the manager is also to blame for never training their subordinates.
sample_reviews_en.author: KuKa

sample_reviews_en.text: It's not premium pizza, but at least you can still get something to eat here late at night. The place is clean, the service is good, and you get your food quickly. At least you know what you're getting. For a really good pizza, though, I'd …
sample_reviews_en.author: Timo Daedrich

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff review was terrible. They didn't wait at the counter, walked out wearing headphones, and while I was ordering food, said "excuse me for a moment" and went out to smoke. They had a grumpy face.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onsucha Sriboonchaichusakul

restaurants.name: getfresh at J Avenue
restaurants.address:

323, 323/1-3 Soi Sukhumvit 55 (Thonglor) Klongtan Nua Sub District, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
UPD: I used to live in other part of the city and Getfresh was my go-to place for healthy food. But after many tries... this branch is bad. I'm updating review to 1 star and looking for alternatives.
Toasts were so soaked in oil that my hands and wallet are dirty. I don't think it counts as healthy. Food is not delicious. Waiters are not smiling. Service is slow. There were mistakes in the bill. I don't like it at all.

Worse than other branches. I ordered two dishes, both were different from other branches, not so tasty. I would appreciate more consistency.
sample_reviews_en.author: First Last

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve eaten here before and it was okay. But I ordered the salmon fillet with tom yam spaghetti   The salmon was so dry it was almost inedible. When I pointed this out, I was told it was always like this. Not ideal for what is quite an overpriced dish. The staff are nice but won’t eat here again, quality for price just isn’t worth it
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Whalley

sample_reviews_en.text: ordered chicken panini, choco protein smoothie, chia coconut pudding, and chicken quesadilla. all excellent. the bacon on the chicken panini needs to be more cooked and crispy though, it almost seemed uncooked. the chia pudding was amazing. will order here again hoping they’ll fix the bacon issue
sample_reviews_en.author: Luca Tonino

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered a dish the same 2 times, one dish come after 10 minutes the other one comes after 20 minutes, I like get fresh in other locations, but this one the service is and the mindset of preparing the same dish in this way makes no sense at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manuel Limitless

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice healthy restaurant. Well, they have plenty of shops across Bangkok. Salad bars are still rather rare. And this place too is not only a salad bars they have everything that’s considered healthy / light food. I had a Caesar salad …
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere at the restaurant is nice and inviting. The food tastes delicious, the vegetables are fresh and clean 👍🏻 The plating is very appealing. The staff provides excellent service. I was very impressed. 🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐวดี อินนุ่น

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff is better than before. The food looks as advertised, looks delicious and tastes good. There are many fresh vegetables and salads to choose from. Overall, it's okay.​
sample_reviews_en.author: THANAKRIT JORADOL

sample_reviews_en.text:
I asked chocolate bowls with little ice cream, look like a water soup .
We ordered 2 bowls in the same time but just 1 is arrived . For the second one they asked to wait more 🤷🏻‍♂️ …
sample_reviews_en.author: S V

restaurants.name: Tummour
restaurants.address:

แบริ่ง, ชั้น 1 ศูนย์การค้าลาซาล อเวนิว ถนน ลาซาล, บางนาใต้, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I ate at this restaurant several years ago (not this branch) because I personally don't like air-conditioned som tam because the taste is not as spicy as other roadside restaurants.

I ordered the som tam very spicy (28 chilies). It was spicy, but I don't think they put 28 chilies in it, judging from the orange color of the som tam. The taste was as I thought, not delicious, not sweet, sour, salty, full flavor, only chili flavor. But I ate it all.

Chiang Hai fried pork was fried until crispy, but not very delicious.
The pork neck was not as appetizing as in the picture.
Spicy instant noodles with shrimp and pork roll was edible. The shrimp was frozen, not fresh.
Spicy soup with three kinds of mushrooms was normal.
Boiled small noodles was terrible.
Total 800฿, average price for restaurants in shopping malls.

Service/staff were good, recommended menus, and took good care of me.
sample_reviews_th.author: CHATCHAWAN CHAIVISITRAKUL

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. The papaya salad was excellent, the grilled pork neck had just the right amount of fat, not too much. The dipping sauce was also tasty. The Tom Yum soup might be quite spicy for those who don't like spicy food – medium spicy is fine.

The staff were quite slow to refill our soft drinks, possibly because we were sitting near the edge and they didn't notice us. They were also slow to bring extra tissues. 😔

However, the atmosphere was terrible the day we went. While we were eating, a family with children (not sure of their ages) came in and cried loudly for about 20-30 minutes.

I recommend this place for those who can tolerate noisy children. It would be great if the restaurant had measures in place to handle noisy customers. Personally, I don't have a problem with bringing children to eat, but if you have children and can't supervise them, please order takeout instead. That way, you won't inconvenience others. Nobody wants to listen to a crying child while eating. 🥺🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Beem

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is spacious and airy, with several levels of spiciness to choose from.
My regular orders, whether in-store or via Grab, include: Stir-fried noodles with mixed ingredients, Pork sausage salad, Mae Noi's Lao-style papaya salad, grilled pork neck, and mixed seafood salad.
If you don't like spicy food, choose the least spicy option (it's still spicy though 😅).

Today I tried some different dishes, as shown in the pictures:
Corn salad - decent flavor.
Pork sausage salad - a bit bland today.
Stir-fried noodles with mixed ingredients - still delicious.
Sweetened liver - okay.
Thai papaya salad - avoid this one! It's sickeningly sweet with chunks of sugar.
Mae Noi's fried chicken - okay, a bit too much batter, but crispy.

Overall, the food is edible, but the flavors aren't as amazing as when the restaurant first opened.
sample_reviews_en.author: Werawan Rattanachotiwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This air-conditioned somtum (papaya salad) restaurant has many branches throughout the country.
The food tastes good in every dish we ordered.
Therefore, we didn't consider the items ordered.
The tables are small, and the chairs have no backrests. If you go with a large group, it will feel very cramped and tiring. It's not comfortable to sit and eat at all.

The service staff is considered good, polite, and efficient.
They inform you beforehand if some items are out of stock and ask if you want to wait.
They are diligent in refilling water.

For a group of 9 (7 adults and 2 children), the bill came to 2,200 baht.
I was a little taken aback by the price of air-conditioned somtum restaurants these days.
There are many other restaurants with even higher prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worawit Laosatirawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, but a little too sweet.
