The Thai papaya salad with crab had a very small portion, not very good value for money. It was good that they charged half price (maybe a promotion), but it still felt expensive and way too sweet.
The sun-dried pork was delicious.
The Northeastern Thai sausage was delicious, I recommend it!
I sat at table number 13, and after a while it got hot. I looked up and wow, the light was shining directly over my head! No wonder nobody was sitting there, even though the restaurant was full.
The staff were friendly.
The food prices didn't have any hidden charges, which is good considering the already high prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: I am Happy

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here several times, but I won't be coming back.

Disappointing! Especially considering the price and quality.
The sticky rice was 20 baht per packet, soggy on the outside and hard in the middle.

The papaya salad was too salty to eat. I asked the staff to change it, but they used the same one; the noodles on top weren't in the broth, so it was less salty, but the parts that were in the broth were extremely sweet.

I ordered spicy pork rib soup, but they gave me fatty pork instead.
Why order pork rib soup then?!
sample_reviews_en.author: Theerachai W.

sample_reviews_en.text: It used to be great. Good service, fast delivery, delicious food. Now, everything has declined, from the service to the staff's attitude and demeanor. The food is also very slow; I don't know if it's because they're still washing the mortar and pestle that they haven't started preparing the food yet. I waited until I had almost finished my other dishes. Not okay. This is the last time I'll eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thivaree Sanampol

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered takeout on October 23, 2022 at 1:30 PM. I didn't have time to check the food. It turned out I ordered sticky rice but it wasn't included. When I unpacked the food, I was shocked to find there was significantly less sun-dried pork than I usually get in the restaurant. I was very confused by this order. There weren't many customers in the restaurant either. This has never happened before.
sample_reviews_en.author: T.Sivakan HanaStudio

restaurants.name: สว่าง บะหมี่ก้ามปู บรรทัดทอง sawang noodle
restaurants.address:

1584-1586 Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Sawang Noodle (สว่าง บะหมี่ก้ามปู บรรทัดทอง) was a clean and comfortable spot, but our visit was a bit disappointing as they had run out of crabmeat—the main reason we came. Unfortunately, that meant we couldn’t try the crab dish we wanted.

We did order other noodle dishes, which were just okay—not particularly memorable. Might be worth another visit if we’re guaranteed the crab next time, but otherwise, it didn’t quite live up to expectations. 🍜🦀
sample_reviews_th.author: That’s How We Feast

sample_reviews_th.text:
Pork noodle soup for 85฿ plus 20฿ for the broth.
The bowl is about the same size as a boat noodle bowl, slightly bigger.
Taste = average, as expected.
The price is very high. I was shocked to see pork noodle soup for 105฿ in Thailand in such a small portion.
*The soup version costs the same as the dry version, but they charge 20฿ for extra broth.*
This is quite unfair to consumers.
sample_reviews_th.author: MAPRANG YAEMBOON

sample_reviews_en.text:
This char siu wonton noodle shop near Chulalongkorn University is a branch of the original shop, which has a history of 60-70 years and has been a Michelin-starred establishment for several consecutive years.

The noodles are indeed springy and chewy, with distinct layers of aroma from garlic, shallots, and pork lard. The char siu is well-made; the secret lies in the sour sauce, made with local sauces, which tastes delicious. However, it's a bit pricey, costing 140 baht for only a small bowl of noodles. The portion sizes are also small, even thinner than boat noodles; it's okay as a snack, but don't expect to fill you up. The fried tofu skin and shrimp rolls, on the other hand, are quite tasty.

The environment is comfortable, air-conditioned, not crowded, quiet, and clean. On a hot Bangkok street, being able to sit down and enjoy a bowl of noodles in air conditioning is quite pleasant.

If you don't mind the price and portion size, it's worth a try. I'll come back next time for a snack.
sample_reviews_en.author: Master Anton

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very disappointed with the restaurant's standards today. I ordered takeout in front of the staff and pointed to the menu, but received the wrong dish – crispy pork instead of crispy pork. It wasn't busy and there was no queue, yet they still made a mistake. Furthermore, the food quality was completely different from what was advertised. The amount of crab meat was very small, just tiny scraps of minced crab, far less than the price paid. The condiment packets were also very small, insufficient for seasoning, and the packaging was terrible – the condiments were haphazardly bundled together, not befitting the brand's image. All for a total of 180 baht.

Customers should receive higher quality food, not feel like they paid only 50 baht.

Please urgently review the staff's performance standards and food quality. I am extremely disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akkaporn K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Michelin star wanton mee. Priced more on the high side but delicious. So worth it.  If u order the dry noodle thb130, there is no soup. Soup will cost tbh20.

Noodle is chewy and there is fragrant oil with garlic n shallot n pork lard crisp.  Many layer of texture. Char siew also nicely done.

Portion is very small. Very much like a bigger boat noodle.

Will come eat again next time as a snack as the portion is small 😀
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean Sean

sample_reviews_en.text:
The newest branch just open a month (Jan 2026). The first branch established about 60-70 years ago.

The noodle (food) is very good 👍 apparently the portion is too small compared to the price. The secret is the sour sauce that using the local sauce. The restaurant atmosphere is fine, quite clean, cool, not noisy except the music from the restaurant.

Totally is worth to try if you don’t mind with pricing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gaan Puenpipat

sample_reviews_en.text: Not worth the price. I bought crab and char siu pork noodles to take home, and they only gave me scraps of crab. They charged an extra 20 baht for extra soup. The vegetables were also wrapped together instead of in individual portions. I don't know if this is just this branch or not. Michelin-starred restaurant is only good for its noodles, which really taste great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rawi W.

sample_reviews_en.text: Overpriced and TOTALLY bland. Every dish we tried was flat, and even the wanton had no real meat flavor. Portions are tiny, and they even charge an extra 20 baht for a plain soup that’s just overpowered with pepper. How this place held a Michelin for so many years is beyond me. Honestly, even 7-Eleven food tastes better.
sample_reviews_en.author: ruo qi

restaurants.name: U-Steak
restaurants.address:

60 Ratchadaphisek 7, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good, my favorite is the 3-piece set – it's filling and not too expensive. Besides steak, they also have other single-serving dishes.

The location is in a small alley. If you come by car, you might have to look for parking. If you're on a motorcycle, you can park on the side of the road.

The service is average, nothing spectacular, like most restaurants.

The price is good for this place; the 3-piece set is less than 150 baht (price as of 2022), but I think it's cheaper than some well-known restaurants.

Finally, I recommend this place for those who are reducing their carb intake and looking for meat. The price is reasonable, and the quality is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mawin Boonwitaya

sample_reviews_en.text: The employee forgot to include the french fries. I called to tell them to order them next time and they would include them for free. When I asked if I lived far away and said no, they claimed they didn't have a delivery vehicle. The employee made a mistake but shifted the blame to the customer. There was no good way to resolve the problem. As a regular customer, I'm starting to wonder if I should continue being a customer after all. 👎👎
sample_reviews_en.author: Mikki Kawaii

sample_reviews_en.text: It's not worth going out of your way to eat here, but it's worth it if you're nearby. The pork steak is delicious and the price is reasonable at 100 baht. There are plenty of other restaurants nearby, so if you want to enjoy a beer while soaking up the local atmosphere, I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 포천 지박령

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, good, and affordable. They should be open during the day too, and maybe partner with food delivery services like Foodpanda, GrabFood, etc.
The steak here is very delicious. It can compete with Sizzler or Eat Am Are in the big malls, based on my experience. I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tathtianchanok Wongphomkasem

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the wait was extremely long. We ordered the mackerel, and it had so many bones. I didn't expect the fish steak to be so bony; we had to constantly remove the bones ourselves, sometimes even picking them out of our mouths. It wasn't good at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: M' Mint

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is okay, the service is good, the staff are polite, and the price is quite cheap. The vegetable salad is okay, not fresh but not bad. There's no parking for cars, only a little parking for motorcycles. The seating inside is a bit hot. Overall, it's acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Run for Food

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to eat at this restaurant very often, but lately I've felt the food tastes very average. It used to be much better before; it was one of my favorite restaurants. But lately, it's just not good at all. So I think I'll take a break from this restaurant for now. 🥲
sample_reviews_en.author: Ung Ing

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken steak was so tender; I just looked at it and it fell apart. I confess, I came back more often than is respectable. Mostly for the beer though, which is cheap and ice cold. Does that make me more respectable?

I will dream of the chicken forever more...
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Jones (Runebear)

restaurants.name: Khrua The Rich
restaurants.address:

57, 1 New Arun Amarin Rd, Wat Kanlaya, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is cheap, good quality and big portions. The staff is very friendly, even though they speak very little english. The atmosphere is excellent, I feel accepted and treated well. If you go for lunch and take the daily special, you only pay 35baht, otherwise you pay around 60-80 baht, which is still very reasonable. I will definitely go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Béla Toth

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's really delicious. You can order the catfish cooked with traditional flavors. The taste can't be judged by the presentation, because it's even better than it looks.
You can choose to sit outside or inside the comfortable air-conditioned room. The place is clean, and the owner is very friendly.
Highly recommend!
(English menu available)
sample_reviews_en.author: Dmitry Elson

sample_reviews_en.text: The pricing is completely inaccurate. Prices on the menu have been mismatched multiple times, and we've caught them several times. Anyone planning to eat at this restaurant, don't get carried away! We warn you! Don't get drunk or have too …
sample_reviews_en.author: tee lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went there around 30 times during 3 months and the quality of the food is very good.
Everyone is friendly and trying their best to help you even if you dont speak Thai.
I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julien

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northeastern Thai, Thai, and Chinese restaurant is located on Arun Amarin Road, opposite the entrance to Wat Kalayanamit. It's easily accessible and offers karaoke with excellent sound quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: รักษ์ถิ่นรักษ์ไทย Rakthin-rakthai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and flavorful.
The atmosphere in the restaurant is nice and cozy.
The staff are friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: badboy badboy

sample_reviews_en.text: We loved the service and the food. The best pad thai we've had in a month traveling through Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: L pm

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is good. I highly recommend it. But don't go in a large group or I won't have any seats.
sample_reviews_en.author: กัมปนาท กุศลาสัย

restaurants.name: Rom Pho
restaurants.address:

33 35 เจริญนคร 1 Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We wanted to try the food at “The Jam Factory” and “The Never Ending Summer” but the food there was expensive. Being a group of hungry developing young adults, we decided to try this restaurant.

The restaurant is tucked away in the corner of a street on the way to the popular cafes stated above. It has a dilapidated and rustic exterior with shabby looking images of their food. We were initially hesitant to try the food because of their dull appearance.

Upon entering the restaurant, we were greeted by a zealous old man who i believe runs the family owned restaurant. He couldn’t converse in English but we managed to order what we wanted in the end.

The food was authentic, tasty, and full of flavor. We especially loved the papaya salad and grilled pork, till we finished all of the pork they had left in the restaurant.

We were pleasantly surprised by the quality of food served.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ru Xue Sim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good foods.
Went to Iconsiam but plan to take some local food instead inside mall & we found this.
5mins walk from Iconsiam main entrance, right side where you will passby a morning market area.
We ordered Somtum, grilled pork neck, soup & fried chicken, you can feel the tender & juicyness for the food & the portions are enough for 2 of us…4 dishes with 2 rice (excluding drinks) only cost you 270baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: c m2

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northeastern Thai restaurant serves delicious and flavorful papaya salad with fermented crab and fish sauce. The fried chicken, grilled pork neck, and squid salad are also tasty. Other dishes are generally okay. The prices are reasonable, and the air-conditioned room is comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teelin Cheer

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious, like the curry rice I ate in front of the shop in the mornings, which was also very tasty. Overall, I liked it very much. The owner and staff were friendly and had a great attitude. The prices were also very reasonable and affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: pooda pee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. However, the tables and chairs are not very comfortable and quite crowded. If you go during lunchtime, expect a very long wait. I recommend going before or after lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rose Journey

sample_reviews_en.text: We usually go here for New Year's parties or other events. The atmosphere is great, the music is nice, the service is good, and it's easy to get to, but there's no parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: วชิรพงศ์ มาคะวงศ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The Isaan food is delicious. The restaurant was full of customers, and I felt a little cramped by the noise from everyone talking. Just be prepared for lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sinon Phaiboon

sample_reviews_en.text: The Northeastern Thai food tasted good, but the service was slow because it was crowded. The tables were cramped and too close together.
sample_reviews_en.author: อาภรณ์ จันทโชติ

restaurants.name: Ya Lek (Grandmother Lek) Phad Thai Hoi Thod (Thai Fried Noodle & Fried Mussels) [2nd branch, Dinner)
restaurants.address:

RFHP+CCQ, Nakhon In Rd, ตำบลตลาดขวัญ Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is another restaurant that really impressed me with the taste and quality of the food.

📌 Dishes I tried:
• Fresh shrimp Pad Thai: The noodles were chewy and not soggy, the flavor was rich, and the shrimp were large, fresh, and firm, with no dryness or smell.
• Fried mussels: My partner tried this and said it was delicious.

The cleanliness of the restaurant is good. Even though it's a market stall, they seem to take care of it and manage it well. The atmosphere is friendly.

If you like Pad Thai or fried mussels, I recommend trying this restaurant. There's plenty of parking and the wait isn't long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamoluxii

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an original branch of Pad Thai, located nearby (in the alley next door).
Both the Pad Thai and the fried mussels are delicious. The seafood is very fresh.
The price is higher than regular Pad Thai, but the ingredients and food quality are quite good. It's worth trying.

The picture shows the fried mussels with squid.
The squid is served whole and is quite fresh, crispy, and delicious.

The restaurant is located in a complex with plenty of free parking.
However, the restaurant is on the roadside, so there might be some issues with car exhaust fumes in some seating areas.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathorn S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, it's really expensive. We ordered stir-fried squid with basil and egg over rice, with a fried egg on top (forgot to attach a picture). I thought it would be around 150 baht at most. But when the bill came, it was 290 baht!!! Oh my god, how expensive is that?! The squid was big, but there wasn't a lot of it (maybe it's the quality). For me, I didn't get my money's worth. I added shrimp to the Pad Thai and got two shrimp for an extra 60 baht (30 baht per shrimp). Was it delicious? Yes, but it's a bit pricey.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภาคิน รัตนจันทา

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small restaurant with limited parking. The prices are quite high, but the ingredients are very good.
The Pad Thai is delicious, fragrant with tamarind, and the noodles are chewy and soft.
The stir-fried mussels with basil are tasty, with large mussels and a spicy, flavorful dish (but we preferred the Pad Thai).
The fried mussels have a crispy batter, but are a little oily; they can get a bit cloying after a while.
We went on a weekday afternoon, so it wasn't crowded and the food came out quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maprang Kasipa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ya Lek's Pad Thai and Fried Mussels, Nakhon Inthra Market Branch (Rama 5)
🍝 The Pad Thai has a tangy tamarind sauce flavor, not too sweet, but personally, I thought it was a little too sour. I liked the chewy and delicious noodles.

The fried mussels had a crispy batter, large mussels, and a generous portion.

This was my first time trying it, and overall it was delicious. Taste is subjective, but I recommend giving it a try!

P.S. The food takes a while to prepare, about 15-20 minutes.

👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: JIJE Ptrwd

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered Pad Thai with fresh shrimp (no bean sprouts) and stir-fried beef with basil and a fried egg.
The staff were polite and provided good service.
The food took a while to prepare. The stir-fried rice with basil arrived and I finished it before the Pad Thai arrived, after about 15 minutes.
Regarding the taste of the Pad Thai, in my opinion, it was average, spicy but not very flavorful, and not worth the price. The stir-fried beef with basil also had very little meat compared to the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasama H.

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located in the food stall area. This is the second time I've tried Ya Lek Pad Thai and Hoi Tod (fried mussels). The original shop is not far from that area, but you have to ride down the street. Their famous dishes are Shrimp Pad Thai and Oyster Sauce Omelet. The price ranges from 70 baht and up. The food is really delicious, but you need to be patient to get your food. I ordered fried mussels. The taste was amazing, but I felt the portions were small.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thuzar Nwe

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is spacious and comfortable.
The menu was placed on the table immediately after we sat down – very fast. The staff were polite and courteous.

The Pad Thai tasted good, but the portion was quite small.

However, we waited a very long time for our food – 20 minutes or more.
It might have been because of the high volume of orders, but we ordered while the table next to us still hadn't received their food and had already finished eating. 🥲
sample_reviews_en.author: PHAKHWAN P

restaurants.name: Tum Pak Pert
restaurants.address:

Around Community Mall, 1087, Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The spicy papaya salad with mango was incredibly flavorful and delicious. The crispy fried chicken wings were served hot and crispy. The spicy cockle salad had large, plump cockles and a generous portion. The grilled pork neck was lean, not fatty. The tom yum soup with pork ribs was amazing with rice. We ordered 7 dishes, 3 servings of rice, and a large bottle of water, and it cost 1,085฿. The restaurant is located in a PTT gas station. Parking is limited. There's live music in the evenings, but the sound is a bit echoey. Overall, it's a comfortable and relaxing place to sit.
sample_reviews_th.author: Bun N

sample_reviews_th.text:
The food tastes very average, nothing amazing.
It's overpriced compared to the taste and quantity of food.
For example:
1. Spicy pork rib soup (4-5 pieces) 180฿
2. Egg cluster curry with pickled bamboo shoots (1 cluster of eggs, less than 2 tablespoons of pickled bamboo shoots, full bowl of liquid, very salty) 200฿
etc.
sample_reviews_th.author: พุงโต ขาเลาะ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The first night in Bangkok my boyfriend and I arrived late and I came across this restaurant from which I honestly didn't expect anything special. And instead it became my favorite restaurant and I'm not kidding saying that we went there every day for 3 consecutive evenings.

Great food, the food arrived quickly and the staff was very kind, especially the lady who I think is the owner.

Last night I went to the restaurant and I hurt myself on the way and I asked her if she had plasters, she was very kind since she didn't have them she went to buy them at 7eleven.

Stop by this restaurant very good and very good staff❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: ploy somchit

sample_reviews_en.text: The food selection was diverse and looked delicious. I ordered a set meal online that included rice, egg, and Tom Yum soup for 99 baht. The price was inexpensive, and the taste was good. I ate it all before I could take a picture! They provided watermelon as an appetizer. The only downside was the cucumber; it was very old and inedible. The music in the restaurant was very loud. I called for the bill through the system three times, but no one heard the bell. I had to shout to get a staff member to come and collect the payment. The restaurant was clean, and the staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nalee meesook

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to eat there often when it first opened because the food tasted great. After a while, I went back in early May 2025 and was very disappointed with the taste. The spicy salad was awful; it was bland and strangely salty, unlike how delicious it used to be. Especially the salmon salad, which cost almost 300 baht, but the salmon was terrible and not fresh. I really hope the restaurant can bring back the quality they serve, because the staff are lovely and provide good service, and the restaurant often has promotions with freebies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pkrainukool K

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was to my liking: fried rice, fried rice noodles, basil, and green papaya. While some of the staff were not fluent, they were still friendly and helpful. There was live music in the evening, which was relaxing. Although the prices were slightly higher than street stalls, there was no service charge and no additional tax, making it a comfortable place to chat at a reasonable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: IE Lin

sample_reviews_en.text:
💗 I was impressed! They served a spectacular welcome with watermelon!! It was delicious, sweet, and refreshing!!

🫶 If you're tired from work and want a meal that looks exactly like the picture, enough for a group, and in a cool, air-conditioned environment, you have to try it!!

I think it's worth it 🥰✨
sample_reviews_en.author: AURA ไดอารี่

sample_reviews_en.text: The food wasn't as good as it should have been. The crab curry and the spicy pork sausage salad were too salty and bitter. The hot pot sauce wasn't flavorful enough. Only the minced pork salad was somewhat tasty. However, the restaurant atmosphere was nice; it was air-conditioned and had live music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supaporn Siripan

restaurants.name: Hobs Ari Samosorn
restaurants.address:

QGJP+535, Ari Samphan 11 Alley, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
1 star review for three reasons:
- Service: the waiter sit down us in a table and we told her that we just wanted to drink two Cokes Zero; in the table there was one plate and cutlery and she did not remove it. I had to do it myself. Remember, we were two people so if they wanted to make us feel hungry they should have added at least another plate and another cutlery. None of them she did it.
- No WiFi area: we needed WiFi as we had not internet and at first, the waiters refused saying that they had not WiFi. I asked them please to share some personal WiFi to us as we needed to order a grab and after almost praying they accepted to share the Bar WiFi pass… so, yes, there was WiFi but they did not want to share it
- Pricing: two Coke Zero for 188 baths (more expensive than having two Coke Zero in Puerta del Sol in Madrid, Spain)
sample_reviews_en.author: Zaira Perez

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come for the beer! Very nice offering with amazing options. As a Belgian, I’d send any quality beer loving soul here.

But this was not the reason we came. We’re been watching celebrity cooking shows on Netflix, and we’re starting a series of reviews on their actual restaurants, or at least the restaurants that are somehow associated with their name.

Although the food on the menu here is well prepared and very tasty, please do not come if you are hoping for Iron Chef, or Master Chef creativity. There is none of that. Just come for good food, and dishes you could find in an endless list of other places, just very well executed here.

And again, come for the beer. That would be my appetiser, main and dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bert Grobben

sample_reviews_en.text:
The day I went was a Friday - for a meeting and social gathering.
- The atmosphere was suitable for dinner and business meetings. Not too noisy, not crowded, quite private.
- Some of the food was delicious. There was a good selection of cocktails and alcohol for socializing. The food was a fusion of Thai and Western styles.
- The singer sang well, I really liked her, but she ended the show early. I understand there weren't many customers.
- The restaurant closes late. You can call to reserve a table. There is parking available but you have to pay, or you can park on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: nitirath s

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is beautifully decorated and has parking.

The carbernet wine was delicious by the glass.
The pork rind and beef fried rice were delicious.
The picanha steak was delicious and satisfactory.

The pork ribs were a bit small. I tried ordering both small and large sizes.

The food didn't seem to be outstanding. I initially expected everything to be better, but everything was a bit too salty.

I wish the staff would recommend more dishes and promotions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanvisa Tassanan

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Thai food so far in Thailand. They are closing very late and it’s perfect for everyone who are craving at night. All dishes are by very well-known Chef Pruek. He’s very good at his technique and his recipe is beyond. Textures in each dish with the flavorful ingredients are perfect at any occasion. Definitely coming back for more!
sample_reviews_en.author: Buddy T

sample_reviews_en.text:
An excellent bar and restaurant located in Aree garden.

All of foods were delicious.
Lots of imported and local beer.

The best menu was Ari fried which was fried augerbine with bacon and maple syrup.

Beef tongue was excellent.

The price was high but reasonable.

There was good live music.

Parking lot available in Aree garden but few.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phanusorn Chancharoenchai

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is good, the service is good, and the menu is unusual and not very familiar with this type of fusion food. But overall, it's delicious. The cookies are very delicious. We went on a Saturday evening and the tables weren't full, but it's best to make a reservation in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minnie Trakulyingyong

sample_reviews_en.text: Feel the mood of bar/restaurant with live music (only Tue-Sat). Main menu are mostly smoked/grilled meat; pork, chicken, beef, corn and vegetables. There are some rice toppings with egg and fried. Good for friends gathering rather than family with children.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

restaurants.name: โจ๊กหมูเด้งกลางซอยลือชา
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 781 Soi Phahon Yothin 1, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had the opportunity to stay near Victory Monument, so we walked to Soi Luecha and found this shop, so we decided to try it out since it was busy.
The congee tasted good, with bouncy pork, liver, intestines, and egg. You can ask them to omit any ingredients you don't eat.
Crispy noodles are available on the table for customers to add themselves. However, I have one complaint: the tables for eating in the shop were covered in small ants.
The water in the plastic pitcher also had ants floating in it when we poured it into a glass, and the lid was dusty. I'm deducting one star for that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sujinda Simarak

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has the kind of atmosphere where locals come for breakfast.
I couldn't read the writing, but they probably provided me with a joe, and I ordered from the person standing at the front after sitting down. The woman spoke a little English and gave me recommendations.
The 40B joe with chicken meatballs, pork innards, ginger, green onion, and egg was very delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: 薮原涼世

sample_reviews_en.text:
Affordable and delicious, but you might have to wait a bit. It's busy in the mornings, so they hand out queue numbers. The air-conditioned seating is comfortable. Most people buy takeout or order via delivery riders.

Crispy noodles are refillable, water is free, condiments are available, and tissues are provided.
sample_reviews_en.author: Praphon Wongsakpakdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The female owner is kind, and the food is delicious haha.

I had a stomachache, so I happened to come in because there was a porridge place nearby. The owner's kindness put me in a good mood, and the taste is great with generous portions!

Thank you :)

To think it's this tasty for 35 baht, good good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Local guide master

sample_reviews_en.text: It was better than expected. The pork was tender and bouncy, with generous portions of vegetables. They even gave free crispy noodles! Come support them. There's comfortable seating. The shop opens at 5 pm and accepts the government's co-payment scheme.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nan Nopparat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rice porridge was incredibly smooth, and the pork chunks were so delicious I had to order a second serving.
The liver, kidneys, intestines, and other offal were all fresh and not at all gamey. Highly recommended! 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: รณิดา เกษมสวัสดิ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Two bags of pork porridge took almost half an hour.
That's too much. They made the rider wait for half an hour, they didn't care about the rider. The shop is terrible. This porridge is awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Baw Wan

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions are generous and the food tastes great. I often order delivery because the restaurant is always very busy, and I don't want to wait in line, so I just order through the app.
sample_reviews_en.author: วัชรพล จันทร์ธรรม

restaurants.name: VESSEL Wine & Cocktail Bar
restaurants.address:

อาคารศูนย์การค้า Emsphere ชั้น G เลขที่ 628 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A glass of red (a bottle for a wine person like me) after long shopping walks throughout Emsphere is truly a lovely respite. Staff are super kind and they even allow you to bring in food to accompany your drinks. Love love love the selection of wines - price range is amazing as well. Just love the fact they encourage you to grab a bite from the food hall and even from the supermarket if you’d like. Hundred percent recommend this place!!! Must must must visit if you are here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fabian John

sample_reviews_en.text: LOVE IT,  a place where it is relaxing to have a drink in a mall that's got so much to see. The staff are 110% excellent,  really friendly and professional, which always makes this place a pleasure to go back to. Toilets are very close by and a ATM, plus they accept cards, cash etc. There is a wine and Spirits shop next door where you can also choose from so their selection is huge, just tell them what you want and the staff will organize it for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brendon

sample_reviews_en.text: Look - the wine / wine selection is great, for sure. Hundreds of quality wines from the world over - by the glass !! Not many places on the planet that do so. 🥰. So for the food, the way it works is you can ‘bring’ food from anywhere in Emsphere. They need to work on and develop how this works with the mall’s f&b operators to make it smooth/less confusing. Anyway, I managed to sort out some cheese and butter and baguette so I was happy in the end.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Torrance

sample_reviews_en.text: Vessel is one of the happiest restaurants I've ever been to, and this is an honest review. The staff are very friendly and provide excellent service. The overall atmosphere is good, especially for those who prefer a less crowded environment. It seems that most of the customers are repeats, and what I really like is that you can bring your own food, which is a great option for those who are picky about what they eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: sirilak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Staff has a bit of knowledge on wine. When ask for the preferred note, the staff tried to show to wines that have been opened. Part of it was my bad that i forgot to check for time bottle was opened. Always better to have the bottle that freshly opened. It makes so much different.

Anyway, wish for integrity to serve the good quality one instead of trying to sell the leftover.
sample_reviews_en.author: N P

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is really chill 🤍🤍 It's located in a mall, near Godmother's. Wine is available by the glass starting at 2xx, which is a good variety. If you're coming with a group, ordering a bottle is more cost-effective. If you want snacks, you can ask the staff to order them from nearby shops.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vachiraporn Yenchaisith (fonnie lapluie)

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice wine bar inside Emsphere mall. You can have drinks while waiting for someone do shopping!!! The price list was reasonable. Unfortunately they didnt offer something to nibble, not even nuts :D however they allowed you to bring food outside to eat with drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arisa Kamchokechai

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a place where local businessmen and Japanese managers drop in. It's really great to exchange information here. There are many people here who are doing very well both in Japan and Bangkok, so it's a good idea to be brave and start by saying hello.
sample_reviews_en.author: 有田栄公

restaurants.name: ร้านวิเชียรโภชนา (สาขากว้านสิ่วกี่ ตลาดน้อย ซ.จันทน์ 43)
restaurants.address:

122 Chan 43 Alley, Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Wichian Phochana, Kwan Siu Kee branch in Talat Noi, has been open since 1974. Wichian is a cousin of the owner of Kwan Siu Kee. He inherited his father's Cantonese cooking skills, which have now been passed down to Wichian's daughter. I tried the roasted pork fried rice, which was perfectly cooked, with a fragrant wok aroma and perfectly balanced rice grains. The roasted duck was roasted the old-fashioned way, with dry skin and tender meat. The roasted pork and crispy pork were also delicious. The gosi mee dish featured fragrant wok-fried noodles with a delicious sauce and tender chicken. All the other stir-fried dishes were well-prepared, with a distinctive salty flavor, and the prices were incredibly affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: นาย กาแฟ

sample_reviews_en.text:
A clean, tidy Chinese restaurant in a shophouse along the street.
Ample seating for customers.
Excellent service; the owner is kind and friendly.

The food is familiar in style,
but the taste is anything but. Everything is stir-fried over high heat, resulting in a slightly burnt texture. The rice and noodles are crispy – you can order them crispy, but with a slightly hard, crunchy texture.
It's oily and not salty, with a unique flavor.

I liked everything I tried, including the stir-fried noodles with gravy,
and the rice with stir-fried kale and marinated pork – quite unique.
The prices are affordable. A reliable place to eat if you're passing by.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worawit Laosatirawong

sample_reviews_en.text: Red pork/crispy pork, cut into large pieces, thick and soft meat, fragrant with the smell of charcoal grilling, good taste, red pork rice sauce, not sweet, well-rounded taste, using good quality rice, fried rice/soy sauce, stir-fried with a wok aroma, very well-rounded taste, Rad Na/Koi See Mee, stir-fried noodles dry, fragrant with the wok, well-rounded sauce, good taste, wonton noodles in soup, using good quality, soft and chewy noodles, pork wontons, good taste, clear soup, well-rounded aroma, sold at a cheap price.
sample_reviews_en.author: pongsathorn poolpoka

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old, forgotten Chinese restaurant with affordable prices. The crispy pork fried rice is incredibly fragrant and a must-try. The wonton soup is uniquely flavorful, with a light broth and a lovely aroma of fried garlic – perfect as a side dish. The stir-fried noodles are crispy, fragrant, and have a delicate flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิริทธิ์พล เอื้อทรงธรรม

sample_reviews_en.text: The roast pork fried rice was delicious. The roast pork was very tender. The crispy pork and roast duck were delicious. The duck sauce was excellent. The fried rice was topped with juicy duck sauce. It was very delicious. The owner was very friendly. The shop is near Wat Phai Ngern. You can walk there to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonticha Homwan

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The crispy pork is very good. The roast duck is okay, lots of meat. My girlfriend really likes the roast pork. 60 baht. Today, the two of us had three plates full of it. The owner is very talkative. If I come around here again, I will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: มารุต เจริญทรัพย์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Three-ingredient fried rice: large pieces of crispy pork, tender roasted pork, and flavorful Chinese sausage. Aromatic with a wok-fried scent.

The vendor provides excellent, fast, and friendly service. Prices are affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: rongpong olanpetikul

sample_reviews_en.text: If you want to try authentic, traditional Cantonese food, you have to come here. The taste is original and hard to find elsewhere, and the prices aren't too high. I always stop by to eat whenever I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Artittaya Dhammanives

restaurants.name: Nai Pon Kao Seer Po
restaurants.address:

ปาก Soi Suan Mali 1, Wat Thep Sirin, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A roadside stall that I came across on my way to another restaurant! 1st time having duck rice by the roadside and decided to try. I ordered 1 portion of duck breast rice, and for 80 Baht, this is rather small in portion size. For big eaters, it'll be good to order more if you’re keen. But I wanted room for more food later on, so this was a good portion size.

Duck meat was not gamey at all, and the roasted duck skin is surprisingly smooth, crisp, and fragrant. The mild savoury gooey gravy over the rice provided a great deal of moisture! I'm surprised that the chilli sauce that goes with it was sliced chillies in black vinegar! Helps to cut the grease if you're eating too much meat.

The piping hot soup that comes with it has a tangy profile and has 1 duck wing in it and a quarter of a winter melon. Ice tea is also served at the side which I am not sure if it's chargeble.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yi Ling

sample_reviews_en.text: Although not the oldest, this is one of the original Che Po restaurants in town, a dish that's quite hard to find these days. "Che Po" is a variation of "Sia Po," where "Po" refers to a gambling term from over 50 years ago. When you lose at Che Po, you have to eat rice with a mixture of scraps of pork, duck, chicken, and offal, all mixed together and topped with a sauce similar to braised pork. This particular restaurant includes braised duck, roasted duck, char siu pork, pork trotters, crispy pork, and Chinese sausage, but doesn't include offal. The sauce is light in color, with a mild, balanced sweet and salty flavor—a mild, Chinese-style taste. Adding a little dark soy sauce and chili peppers makes it perfectly delicious. The price is reasonable at 70 baht, considering the generous portion of meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpan Pornprommin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious as always.
The roast duck is tender and odorless. The char siu pork is good, with a subtle aroma. The crispy pork is second to none. The braised pork knuckle and Chinese sausage are excellent. The highlight is the grilled ribs; delicious and fragrant from the oven. The sauce is also good, not too sweet or too salty.

The stewed winter melon with lime is the best. This dish is the best I've ever had at this restaurant. Don't miss it!

They're only open for a short time, from 5-6 pm. After 8 pm, they won't have everything. After 9 pm, you'll miss out!
sample_reviews_en.author: tanny kee

sample_reviews_en.text:
13/9/68

Parking: 20 baht per hour at Sriworachak Building, but circling is a bit difficult. The restaurant mentioned that later in the evening, you can park in the alley a little further down the road.

Food: Mixed minced meat 150 baht, Pickled lime soup 30 baht.
Taste: Salty and sweet, easy to eat.

Service: Good service from the staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Danupol Chavengkijsakol

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's the same shop as the one on Nakhon In Road,
Bang Khu Wiang, Bang Yai, Nonthaburi.
They sell from their home in the morning until late morning.
Around 2 PM, they start making the second batch of roasted duck.
Then they sell at Soi Suan Mali 1.
The taste is good, and the sauce is delicious.

From a finger…typing on the keyboard.

The duck with rice at this stall is spectacular, some of the best I've had in Thailand for only 60 baht. They also give you a free soup with duck broth, cucumber, and some other vegetables. It's absolutely delicious. The guy who takes your money is friendly and helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miguel Enrique García Arrabal

sample_reviews_en.text: Simple but delicious and affordable... Fast service and flawless food... The roast duck, the crispy pork, the sauce, the melon soup... All executed with skill and amazing flavor... Dinner for two, about 170b... Would eat again and try some of the other meats!
sample_reviews_en.author: A Fong

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are a few roadside restaurants that are relatively clean, the staff provides good service, and the drinking water is Chinese tea.
The roast duck was excellent, the crispy pork was superb, but the best dish was the braised duck with winter melon.
sample_reviews_en.author: L B

restaurants.name: APCD 60+ Plus Kitchen by CP
restaurants.address:

264 Ratchawithi Rd, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a bakery 🍞🥨🥯 run by people with disabilities. The taste is consistently good, and everyone is dedicated to their work 👏. The coffee here is excellent and very strong ☕️.

🍽️ There are several tables available for seating.

🚘 Parking is not very convenient and can be difficult to find.

♿️ The road leading to the shop is flat and easily accessible.
sample_reviews_en.author: NoBi Kung

sample_reviews_en.text:
👏 Very good.
In the morning, they only serve noodles, soup, and drinks. The staff will inform you that only non-dairy drinks are available in the morning. Full food menu will be available after 11 am.
The restrooms are very clean and spacious, suitable for wheelchair users.
The furniture in the restaurant is of good quality and sturdy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panadda Wongkhatekorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small shop but full of quality. The interior is clean, and the staff are attentive and provide excellent service.
The menu offers a wide variety of dishes, including both rice and noodle options.
The drinks are tasty.
There is parking available inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anunthanawat Watthanaphirun

sample_reviews_en.text: Convenient parking. They serve delicious coffee and savory and sweet dishes that are very tasty, meeting the standards of a hotel chef. The portions are large, and you'll be served by lovely staff from the association.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patteera Lynn

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered set meal A, which included stewed pork noodles with meatballs and a watermelon smoothie. The taste was perfect, no need to add any seasoning. The only downside was that the meatballs weren't very chewy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siriporn S.

sample_reviews_en.text: We held a meeting at this restaurant to support it. It has ample parking, making it ideal for beer gatherings of 30-40 people. The food is delicious, and they provide sound equipment for singing and dancing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. Krishna Fongtanakit

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, and the staff are very attentive and friendly, always smiling. There's a wide variety of other dishes on the menu. I highly recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: เตือนตา จิตรรังสรรค์

sample_reviews_en.text:
CP's CSR shop.
It's a shop that supports senior citizen work.
The food selection is limited, but the seating is comfortable and there's parking. The food is average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phongthon Tharachai

restaurants.name: 532 BAR&CAFE
restaurants.address:

7 3 Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this place on Google Maps and stumbled upon it randomly on a rainy day.
The atmosphere is amazing. It's perfect for chilling out in the nice weather, watching the longtail boats pass by the canal. The owner is very attentive.
The food menu is diverse and the taste is good. They're open to feedback and suggestions.
The live music is great for chilling out.
They have a wide variety of drinks to choose from.

This will definitely be one of my regular chill-out spots.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anno Dominiz

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is great, the atmosphere is fantastic, and the owner is lovely.
The restaurant is a bit hidden, but you won't be disappointed once you get there! 😍
I've been back many times. I brought my family here for a birthday celebration, and everyone enjoyed it immensely.
sample_reviews_en.author: ROHTCHALYNNTAHN PINK

sample_reviews_en.text: The evening atmosphere was great, the food was delicious, and the musicians sang beautifully. I loved the lighting and the decor; it was very chill. I saw it and immediately decided to come in :) I'll definitely come during the day again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dear JT

sample_reviews_en.text:
Personally, I loved it. I don't know where to deduct points.
🤍🤍 The spaghetti and other appetizers were great. The atmosphere was nice, with a river view.

In the evening, there's draft beer and a good band, perfect for chilling out. 🍻🍻
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasithon Tiangdah

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, the food is delicious and very fresh, worth the price. I recommend coming here with a group. The owner is also very kind. Overall 10/10. I will definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttaphon Nearnpak

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow, this restaurant is amazing! I found this one near my house. The atmosphere is great, right by the river. The owner is lovely, the service is excellent, and every dish is delicious. 💗
sample_reviews_en.author: MEW KAELYN

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good, the atmosphere is great, and the music is lovely. The restaurant offers two zones: by the river and in a camping style. The owner provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanha Kuku

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, there's live music, and the food is delicious and affordable. It's perfect for chilling out with a beer. It's crowded but not chaotic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sopanat Sirisubbowon

restaurants.name: PP Farms Seafood
restaurants.address:

684 Thanon Kanchanaphisek, Khwaeng Bang Phai, Khet Bang Khae, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm usually a regular customer, having eaten here over 10 times because the food is fresh, delicious, and good value for money. However, my experience yesterday was very disappointing. I understand that ingredient costs have increased, resulting in smaller portions, which is acceptable for other dishes. But yesterday, I ordered a clear tom yum soup with catfish in a hot pot for almost 300 baht. When it was served, there were exactly three tiny pieces of fish in the pot. I called a staff member to inform them, and they said it was the pre-prepared portion and that it contained 150g of fish. Visually, those three tiny pieces definitely didn't even amount to 150g. Finally, the staff member said that if I didn't accept it, they wouldn't charge me for the dish and would take the pot away. Honestly, I was very disappointed because I informed them in case they hadn't served the full portion. The way the restaurant handled it was very poor. I'm not sure if this is the portion size they've adjusted for, but if so, I think it was definitely not worth the price. From a regular customer who might not come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanchompoo C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service at the restaurant was terrible. I called ahead to inquire about whether dogs were allowed in the designated area, but they said they could only enter the designated area, but reservations were not possible due to the public holiday.

When I arrived, they informed me that dogs were not allowed in. The designated area was full, and there would likely be a long wait. If I wanted to let my dog ​​in, I would have to put him in a cart outside the restaurant. They hadn't previously informed me of the conditions for dogs. In the end, I didn't get a table and decided to switch restaurants.

However, I saw a customer in the area where the staff had stated that dogs were not allowed in, and he had a pet, not sure if it was a dog or a cat, in a zip-lock bag and placed it on the dining table. I'm not sure what the restaurant's regulations are.

The restaurant needs to be clear about their handling of pets. If I encounter this, I won't go back. If they don't allow pets, please let them know in advance so I don't bring my dog ​​there. Or I'll go to another restaurant. It's not like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: NN CHI

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, I've been to this restaurant ten times but never reviewed it before... When I think of a really good seafood restaurant near me, I always head to PP. My go-to dishes focus on seafood – shrimp, shellfish, and fish. My absolute favorites are the grilled shrimp, salt-fried shrimp, and oysters – I order them regularly. Another must-try is the stir-fried squid with shrimp paste; it's perfect with rice. They have a huge menu, the food is delicious, and most importantly, the ingredients are fresh and clean. The staff are also very friendly and provide excellent service. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: money meetang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fresh and delicious food at Bangkok seafood restaurant prices.
The crab and shrimp fried rice was delicious, just the taste I missed.
The blue crab was very fresh, the meat was easy to peel.
The seafood dipping sauce was a little too salty.
The garlic butter scallops weren't that great.
The sour curry with acacia leaves, shrimp, and mixed vegetables was a bit too sweet.

All the staff, especially the younger ones, provided excellent service. When I asked for salt, pepper, and lime, they quickly brought them without I having to wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: nok moo

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the fried sea bass with fish sauce first, before ordering other dishes in the second round. I understand that it takes a long time to prepare, but it arrived last, after I had finished everything else. Other tables that ordered the same fish dish later received their orders first. I don't understand how the restaurant prioritizes orders. If you plan to eat here, I recommend planning ahead because I waited about 1 hour and 15 minutes for my sea bass.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattpat ketsrirattana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes great and delicious. Once ordered, the food comes out quickly.
The atmosphere in the restaurant is nice, and the seating is clean and well-organized.
The service from the staff is good and they speak politely.
Parking is available around the restaurant, except during peak seasons.
I recommend the seafood dishes; they are always fresh. I personally like the curry stir-fry.
sample_reviews_en.author: BENZ VSC

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been a regular customer here for a long time. Today, the taste of several dishes had changed, especially the spicy snail curry. It tasted bland, like plain soup. I informed the staff, and they asked the cook, who replied that they forgot to add seasoning powder to the curry, making it bland. Then they just let it go, showing no responsibility for their mistake. Terrible!
sample_reviews_en.author: thongchai chaipurithanasit

sample_reviews_en.text: The seafood was incredibly fresh, sweet, and delicious. The shrimp heads were full of juicy shrimp roe. The fried fish with garlic was amazing. The steamed crab was so sweet and tender. The prices were reasonable, the staff were friendly, and the restaurant had parking. The Surat Thani oysters were huge; we ordered them one at a time, and they were so sweet and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwapat Puangkaew

restaurants.name: MONKEY HUT RESTAURANT
restaurants.address:

18 Soi Phetchaburi 15, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
First of all, the atmosphere is nice.
2. The food is okay.
3. The service is not good. Good service means taking care of customers and asking if they need anything, rather than just calling them.
4. The location is in a tourist area attracting foreign customers, but your singers only sing Thai songs to entertain people on TikTok. Why have a restaurant if you only sing Thai songs?

The staff and singers are only interested in themselves.
Overall, it's a failure. A waste of money because the food and drinks are expensive, and it's a waste of time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratchanok Sawatram

sample_reviews_en.text: Fantastic little place. We came here because I'm born in the year of the monkey. Food was delicious (I've never had bad food in Thailand), was particularly nice to sit outside. There was nobody here when we arrived at 8pm, but also no more live music. So the pop music in the background was a bit cheesy. Waitresses were very kind. I have to admit, I found it a bit 'forceful' to be asked to take a review, and that she should take a picture of it as proof. That never happened to me before . . .
sample_reviews_en.author: Marc Rizkallah

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was okay. Staff was hard to understand. But They were alright . I asked for bill and waiting for change too long. They should be team work. I watch them, cashiers leave the change at the bench and not let staff know. They should communicate more. I checked the details and it seemed like a good restaurant, but I was disappointed with the service. Each serving of food didn't come with a serving spoon; I had to ask for one every time my food was served.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wareerat Inkor

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! That's the main thing. It's open late, too, which is good. We arrived in Baiyoke around 10:00 PM and were looking for a place to have dinner. We chose this restaurant and weren't disappointed: we had the tom yum—very good: a huge amount of seafood, mushrooms, and the perfect broth. The pad thai was great—with giant river prawns. The catfish was excellent, and the portions were generous!
sample_reviews_en.author: arkiselev

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Thai restaurant (in Thailand) that's terrible. The Tom Yum Goong tasted like bland sour curry, the clams were dry and unclean, and the glasses were cracked and chipped, yet they were still given to customers to use.
I ordered 4 dishes and none of them were tasty. I tried this restaurant because of the good reviews, but I was very disappointed and regretted spending my money here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthanan Sanoo

sample_reviews_en.text: We were really hungry and craving some Thai food for dinner, so we randomly picked this place. Overall, the food was good, nothing too fancy, but ok satisfying. They also had a live band, which added a nice atmosphere to the evening. As usual, the hospitality was great and the staff were friendly and welcoming. Overall, a pleasant dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Selvagnanam Monesha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love the atmosphere and choice of music!!! Not forgetting the exceptional service given by Zarchi. Who was pleasant and always smiling, with very good English and communication skills. Keep up the great work Zarchi!

Both my husband and I enjoyed our evening very much and will definitely return whenever we are in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Priscilla Tay

sample_reviews_en.text: Bangkok visit - After visiting Pratunam Market, I headed to dinner at Monkey Hut. The Tom Yum soup was outstanding—rich, spicy, tangy, and exactly what I needed after a long walk through the market. The service was warm and attentive, making the whole experience awesome. A perfect end to the evening in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prem Joseph

restaurants.name: Tum Factory Siam Square One
restaurants.address:

4th Floor Room One Building 388 Siam Squre SS4023 Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌶️ Papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce: The taste was predominantly sweet, with a balanced, medium fermented fish sauce flavor. However, the chilies weren't spicy at all, or maybe we ordered it too mild (4 chilies). Normally, it should be 10 or more.
🐟 Vermicelli salad with mackerel: They gave a generous amount of mackerel, probably a large one. We almost couldn't finish it. The taste was salty, sweet, and slightly spicy.
🍗 Half grilled chicken: The meat and skin were juicy, not dry, with a light herbal aroma. However, I recommend the restaurant grill or check the chicken's temperature more carefully, as some pieces still had red blood.
🍚 Steamed rice: Served in a rice container like in Korea. A generous portion, not small at all.
Overall, it was okay. The price wasn't too high, suitable for groups because there's a wide variety of food to choose from, and the portions are generous.
As for the service, the staff were helpful and fast. You can scan to order from the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Hungry Oab

sample_reviews_en.text: This is usually my regular restaurant because I like their fermented fish sauce (plara) – it doesn't have a strong smell, the ingredients are fresh, and the papaya salad is crispy and flavorful. But today, I ordered fresh shrimp papaya salad, but the staff said they only had three shrimp left. I asked if it was ready, and they said it had already been made. They asked if I wanted to add squid or crab, and I said squid. But when I ate it, the taste wasn't the same. The papaya wasn't crispy, the salad wasn't flavorful, and it seemed like the squid hadn't been properly drained. There was a fishy smell, and the shrimp and squid weren't fresh. The taste was very bland and lacked any flavor. I also ordered sticky rice, but received regular rice. I'm very disappointed. Next time, I recommend the restaurant check their ingredients before serving customers, instead of preparing the order and then telling customers later that they're out of stock.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pin

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to the restaurant around 1 PM. The air conditioning wasn't on, it was very hot, and the AC unit was very noisy. I ordered half a grilled chicken, but it seemed like I didn't get half a chicken, and it seemed like old chicken that had been reheated. I ordered Tom Yum chicken, and it seemed like they used leftover grilled chicken that wasn't sold, and there was still red inside. I'm not sure if that's the restaurant's recipe. The papaya salad didn't taste the same as before. I really want them to improve. I can't attach pictures.
sample_reviews_en.author: wiyada doksee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant is located in a corner of the restaurant district in Siam Square One. I was brought here by some Thai friends.
The prices are a little higher than at food stalls or food courts, but they will bring the food to your table and they accept credit cards.
They even have a food delivery robot.

The raw shrimp and salmon dishes were always fresh, so I could eat them with peace of mind. The raw shrimp salad? Marinated? dish was particularly delicious, and I'd love to eat them again.
sample_reviews_en.author: k n

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled beef was very tough. They said it was Australian beef but it was so tough that I couldn't chew it. The salmon larb was very expensive compared to the quantity. The salmon was probably about 2 pieces, not large, but cut into very small pieces. The staff wasn't very nice. Customers were looking at the menu and they rushed me to order. The taste wasn't amazing. This was my first and only time at this restaurant. I felt a bit sorry for the money. I'd rather go to another restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat Patchara

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come here for some tasty Isaan food! Be ready for the 🌶️🌶️🌶️!

The theme is papaya salad / som tum here. Traditional Isaan food and very hot! 🌶️🌶️🌶️

The pork cartilage soup, roast chicken and of course the som tum are all recommended!

A cute robot scurries around to deliver the plates too. So much fun!

This haul of food was reasonably priced too!

Siam Square One is a “lesser” or “cheaper” mall across from the mega expensive hi-so Paragon mall, separated by the BTS Siam station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Always Very Spicy

sample_reviews_en.text: I was drawn in by the promotional picture outside the shop and had to come in to try it. The staff brought out the menu with pictures, but you had to scan a QR code to order. The portion sizes were good, and you could order several dishes for a reasonable price. The grilled pork was perfectly cooked, and the spicy instant noodle salad was delicious (you could choose the spiciness level). The quality was decent. They even had a robot helping with the serving!
sample_reviews_en.author: Suppasa Aimsaard

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered fried chicken wings, but they were undercooked. I opened them and saw that none of the three pieces were cooked through. I told the staff and they said they would re-fry them. However, the three wings were never served and I was still charged the full price. I was very disappointed and would like the restaurant to pay more attention to the quality of the food and service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex PSN

restaurants.name: อ้ายศิโรลาบ (AiSiroLarb)
restaurants.address:

2 Soi On Nut 34, On Nut, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is spacious and comfortable, not hot at all. I love the atmosphere. This time I ordered Tom Yum soup, Nam Tok Moo (spicy pork salad), sweet liver, grilled pork neck, grilled chicken, and Som Tum Sua (spicy papaya salad with noodles). Everything was delicious! Highly recommend it. I'll definitely come back again.

**I especially liked the grilled chicken and pork neck. The grilled chicken had crispy skin and tender meat. They currently have a new store opening promotion, so check it out!**

There is parking available, shared with the Nang Nai restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: มุก ก.ไก่

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Northeastern Thai food here is flavorful and affordable, perfect for today's economy. The dishes I ordered were:
- Luang Prabang Papaya Salad: Spicy, with a hint of shrimp paste. I personally liked it; it had a nice, savory flavor.
- Grilled Chicken: Well-marinated with spices, the chicken was juicy, and the dipping sauce was delicious.
- Spicy Pork Rib Soup: Spicy, flavorful, and packed with sweet, sour, and savory flavors.

Overall, I'd give it a 9.5 out of 10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sompot Jantrawadee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. I liked the crispy-skinned grilled chicken, the flavorful and tasty papaya salad with fermented fish sauce, the refreshing spicy beef soup, the grilled chicken waterfall salad, the grilled beef, a large Coke, and a small bucket of ice. The total bill was 570 baht. The price wasn't too high, and the food tasted great. Overall, it was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: BERICH CHANNEL

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves very flavorful Isaan cuisine.

Orders are placed by writing them on a checklist.

If you order grilled items, they probably start grilling them in-house, and they kindly tell you the estimated waiting time (it was 20 minutes for the gai yang).

*Be aware that there are a lot of mosquitoes, so insect repellent is a must.
sample_reviews_en.author: HIVN HIVN

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is near my house. I saw that it had just opened and I didn't dare to try it because I was afraid of being disappointed. But the first time I came here, everything was excellent. It was exactly what I wanted. The price was good. There's a promotion right now. It's very delicious. I'll come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: yyahwangg (Dhuriyah)

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! They have a huge menu selection. The Tom Yum soup is super spicy and the grilled chicken is amazing. The atmosphere is great. If you're looking for a place to chill at night, you can come here and stay until late. They also have alcohol deals, and the restaurant stays open until midnight!
sample_reviews_en.author: นภาพร สมชัย

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another restaurant that I've tried and I'm amazed at. The food is delicious, the grilled chicken is very tender, the spicy beef soup is delicious and authentic. The price is good, and parking is convenient. I'll definitely come back and support you often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natjalin Phruksatanonkul

sample_reviews_en.text: This Isaan restaurant is clean with a good vibe. The prices are reasonable, leaning towards the affordable side. The food is delicious, and the staff are lovely, friendly, and provide great service. So why wouldn’t you choose to eat here?
sample_reviews_en.author: Shawn Ong

restaurants.name: MUI Yen Tafo
restaurants.address:

200 Worachak Rd, Wat Thep Sirin, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Worachak Mui Fish Ball Noodle Shop is a small, one-unit shop located on Worachak Road. Inside, there are 4-5 tables, with a noodle boiling pot set up in front. The menu includes noodles, tom yum, and yen ta fo, priced at 40฿ for a regular serving and 50฿ for a special serving. Today, I tried:

Dry Fish Ball Noodles (40฿): The thin egg noodles were perfectly cooked, soft and chewy, with a fragrant aroma of pork fat and fried garlic. The toppings included fish balls, shrimp balls, and fish cake. It tasted great as is, with a little seasoning or as is. 😍😍😍😍

Dry Yen Ta Fo (40฿): I ordered thick, soft noodles. The toppings were the same as the fish ball noodles, with a dark red yen ta fo sauce on top and morning glory underneath. The yen ta fo sauce was rather mild. 😍😍

Overall, I liked the toppings – the fish balls, shrimp balls, and fish cake were all tasty and not starchy. The shop was clean, the food arrived quickly, and the prices were affordable. The only downside is the lack of parking. Alternatively, you can park at the Sriworachak Building (30฿/hour) and walk over.
sample_reviews_th.author: wichak phijaisanit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop in the Worachak area makes its own fish balls. The fish balls are excellent, including fish balls, fried shrimp balls, and boiled shrimp. The highlight is the shrimp balls; they're delicious, with a fragrant blend of shrimp and pork fat, and a chewy texture – no water chestnuts! The fried version is incredibly aromatic, while the boiled version has a filling similar to dumplings. The fish balls are also good. Another highlight is the broth; it's refreshing, fragrant, and slightly sweet.

A bowl of Yen Ta Fo (a type of noodle soup) costs 60 baht. It comes with a generous amount of morning glory but a little too few fish balls.

The seating is quite cramped, suitable for 1-2 people. The shop is rather hot and stuffy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puripat Kitkarncharoensin

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this shop by accident while heading to another restaurant. I saw the sign for homemade fish balls and decided to try it. For my first order, I got dry noodles with just fish balls. When I saw the noodles, they were incredibly thin and had a wonderful aroma of fried oil. Unbelievably, they were chewy and soft, not mushy at all – perfectly cooked. The noodles were delicious! The fish balls were bouncy, fragrant, and not fishy at all. I immediately ordered another bowl, adding more noodles and all the toppings. I didn't like the shrimp balls though. People kept coming in to buy, and I kept ordering more noodles. No wonder, these noodles are a gem! Anyone who loves noodles needs to try this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ken Ken

sample_reviews_en.text:
MUI Yen Tafo (Homemade Fish Ball Noodles)
This noodle shop in the Worachak area makes its own fish balls. The fish balls here are excellent, including fish balls, fried shrimp balls, and boiled shrimp. The highlight here is the shrimp ball; it's delicious with a fragrant blend of shrimp and pork fat, and has a chewy texture. The fried version is very fragrant, while the boiled version is similar to the filling of a dumpling. The fish balls are also good, the noodles are perfectly cooked, and the soup is clear and refreshing.
The shop is located by the roadside and is easy to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went during the vegetarian festival, so I didn't get to try the fish balls. There are limited seats and the shop is cramped.
I ordered vegetarian Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup). The broth was spicy.
The food was prepared quickly. The price is 60 baht. *****Cash only.

Update:
I got to try the fish ball noodle soup after the vegetarian festival. The soup was good and delicious. The noodles were small, soft, and bouncy. The fish balls had a smooth and bouncy texture on the outside, and were bouncy on the inside, but not very soft and tender.
The price is still 60 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Santiporn Kiatsirirote

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish balls are delicious, the thin noodles are chewy and soft, and the sauce is homemade red Yentafo (Thai noodle soup). It's superb, made with high-quality ingredients. The pork bone broth is generously added. During festivals, they also sell crab claws packed with crab meat. If you want to try crab claws or shrimp rolls, you should ask, as they might have a regular supplier.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฟ้าจัง

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are good, the meatballs are excellent, and the broth is tasty. The shop is located near Worachak; you'll need to stay in the right lane when driving because it's a one-way street. The prices are reasonable. There's a shop next door selling fried shrimp and fried squid, which are delicious to eat with the noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text:
The prices are ridiculously expensive and the portions are far too small.
It's awful.
The taste is only mediocre.
And the place is noisy and chaotic.
The foreign staff are unbalanced; I ordered two bowls, but the quantity was noticeably different.
sample_reviews_en.author: อานุภาพ ชนะนิรันดร์

restaurants.name: Cafe de Nata & Cataplana Restaurant
restaurants.address:

10, 12 Soi Ram Maitri, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A fantastic experience at Cataplana, the restaurant above Cafe de Nata. Their menu is Portuguese Mediterranean and the flavors are quite elevated. Run by a Portuguese chef, everything from the sourced ingredients to suggested menu pairings was spot on and so delicious. I’ll be back and looking forward to trying new combinations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Schurig

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you haven’t checked out cafenatabkk  yet, you really should.
It’s a cozy little spot in Nana–Yaowarat serving homemade Portuguese desserts, coffee, and cocktails.
Everything’s made with care — and their egg tarts? Simply addictive. 💛✨
Go try it once, and you’ll understand why everyone’s talking about it.
sample_reviews_en.author: TT 43

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let me tell you, it might seem quiet when you come in, but come on in! It's amazing, especially the Creme Brulé.
I thought it was a dessert, right? No, it's not. The cocktails are 10/10, no deductions. Plus, the staff are super cute. If you want something or a drink, just ask. May and Oh are the best.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mss. Penchan Kordkan

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff here are incredibly sweet and they talk to you in good detail about what you want. Really good cocktail and the pastry and coffee are really good. Heart of new age bars in chinatown area. Beautiful indoor and outdoor searing giving an intimate yet bustling vibe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sri Ranganathan B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came across Cataplana a few weeks ago when strolling recently through Soi Nana. A beautiful, cosy, inviting little restaurant.

The food was fantastic, service very attentive and the atmosphere warm. This was a really, really nice dinner. Fully recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rupert Grimes

sample_reviews_en.text: A great place to chill and listen to fantastic music. Vinyl record aficionados are encouraged to bring their own favorites to impress and enjoy! Superb coffee and treats. Colorful neighborhood vibe just off Chinatown.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeff Meide

sample_reviews_en.text: A lovely find in the heart of Chinatown… Creative cocktails that you can pair with Portuguese “tapas” or even a traditional dish. And don’t miss a little delight — the pastéis de nata, just like in Portugal 🇵🇹
sample_reviews_en.author: Georges Sara Gonçalves

sample_reviews_en.text:
The drinks are fabulous in China town. Must visit once in your life.

Thank you Khun May, bar manager, for recommendations for the fantastic drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sripat_ice

restaurants.name: เจ๊บุ๊งหมูตุ๋นเนื้อตุ๋น
restaurants.address:

323/12 ถนน บรรทัดทอง Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I had an amazing experience at เจ๊บุ๊งหมูตุ๋นเนื้อตุ๋น. The food were absolutely delicious perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and served in generous portions. The broth was rich and comforting, and the toppings were fresh and well-balanced. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, making it a great spot for a casual meal or a quick bite. If you're a noodle lover, this place is a must-visit. I'll definitely be coming back to try more of their menu!
sample_reviews_th.author: chainpae Z.

sample_reviews_en.text: A humble stall in an alleyway, and almost everything displayed is in Thai so we had no reason to stop and dine here. But we passed by a couple of times and the lady (and I assumed her husband) were just very warm and always smiling to us as we walked by, so we eventually stopped on our track and thought “let’s give it a try?” And so we did. And what a delight it was! The broth is very flavorful and the mixed beef is cooked to perfection. Funny how street vendors like this serve the best food sometimes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ravio Patra

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw locals eating there while shopping, so I ordered two bowls. What struck me was the small portion sizes of meatballs and meat, as well as the limited soup and noodles. Yet, the price wasn't cheap. Although the hygiene was decent. For me, unless I'm really hungry, I'd rather eat inside a department store; the prices and portions are significantly better, and there's air conditioning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bee Kidson

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped by for lunch… and oh my! They have one of the best noodle soups I’ve had in a long time! The broth was so fragrance and flavorful,  the noodle was cooked perfectly and the meats were melt in my mouth. Will definitely go back if I’m in Bangkok again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonchanok Koch (Poon)

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent beef noodles and rice. Flavourful broth, wonderful rich brisket and tendons, and delicious meat balls. Three types of rice noodles to chose from, and off you are to a great meal. 100% recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Jens Seidl

sample_reviews_en.text: Anyone visiting Ratchathewi must eat at this restaurant. The food is incredibly delicious, the flavors are accessible and comforting every time you eat there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasiwan Panpitak

sample_reviews_en.text: It's incredibly delicious! Anyone who comes to Ratchathewi, Soi Phayanak, and doesn't eat at Je Bung's restaurant hasn't really been to Ratchathewi yet. 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: อิษฎ์อาณิก เชาว์วิสุทธิกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork belly is excellent, the broth is fragrant, and the portion size is just right. I highly recommend everyone try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayawat Thichangtong

restaurants.name: ร้านตรอกแซ่บ จุฬา20 บรรทัดทอง
restaurants.address:

35/8 จุฬาฯ 20 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I eat here regularly because I work in this building. It's considered one of the best somtum (papaya salad) restaurants. My go-to dishes, and ones you should definitely try, are the Luang Prabang somtum, grilled pork neck, and sweet liver – they're the best!
