I love chilling here at night. My favorite dish is the "Tiger's Cry" fried rice.

****Update 2026: The chef changed, and the recipes have changed :(
The fried rice isn't as good as before; it's too soggy. The food is bland, the somtum is too sweet, and the bitter soup isn't as good as it used to be.

I wish they would change the recipes back to the spicy, flavorful ones they had in late 2025.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawarisorn Thungthin

sample_reviews_en.text: Open air Eastern Thai restaurant. This restaurant cook any Esan food very well, especially the spicy dishes. One of our surprisingly good dish was the BBQ pork neck. It is tender and very succulent. However their non spicy dishes was terrible. We ordered several fried rice dishes to share and the taste was poor. We dine in group of six and the food took very long to arrive, so if you are in a rush it's not recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Katethip Varanyuwatana

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is open from lunchtime and is located in the Dragon Town project, next to the AmPark side. The food is delicious and flavorful; if you prefer less spice, be sure to specify. The clay pot roasted chicken is delicious and tender; it's a must-order every time. The food doesn't take long to arrive, and the service is good, but due to the limited space, there might be a shortage of tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sittipong KH

sample_reviews_en.text: Just because I ordered it without chili, they just canceled the order? It would have been better to send a message or call to discuss what was possible or not, or if I wanted to change to a different menu item. There were already dishes that didn't contain chili that I had ordered. Canceling like that is very rude. I was really looking forward to eating!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattasit W.

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are inexpensive, the service is fast, and they taste good. They give a small portion of pork and meatballs, but it's acceptable considering the price and location (the clear broth noodle dish in the picture is 45 baht). Both the pork and meatballs taste good. There's covered seating, but it's still hot. It's suitable for a quick, light meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ornwara Tritrakarn

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious. Because it's next to a university, there's no alcoholic beverage on the menu. However, they'll bring it to you if you ask. And because the restaurant doesn't seem to be making a profit, large bottles of beer are 62 baht. The toilets are a bit far away, which is a bit of a drawback, but it's a great place for drinkers.
sample_reviews_en.author: 雨露市徳雄

sample_reviews_en.text:
The perfect Som Tum with thin rice noodles ✔️✔️✔️✔️✔️✔️✔️
I ordered Som Tum with thin rice noodles without fermented fish sauce, priced at 80 baht. It was incredibly delicious! The taste was amazing, so sour and satisfying. It's exactly what I've been searching for in Som Tum with thin rice noodles for so long!
sample_reviews_en.author: Macky Sauce

sample_reviews_en.text: This open-air restaurant is located in a corner of Dragon Town near Suan Luang, on the side next to I'm Park. They offer pork and beef noodles, along with some single dishes. The restaurant stands out with its red color and Chinese-style decorations that match the building. Prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coke Somchai

restaurants.name: ราดหน้าดินแดง เจ้าอร่อย กรุงเทพฯ Rad Na Din Daeng BangKok
restaurants.address:

Pracha Santi Alley, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the best Rad Na (Thai noodle dish with gravy) restaurants I've ever tried. The flavor is rich and intense, and almost every bowl is made fresh. There's always a long queue, so be prepared to wait. Parking is quite difficult; it's best to come by motorcycle. The restaurant is located on Din Daeng 1 Road, or Soi Chaturathit 2, Intersection 9. It's not directly on Din Daeng Road, but behind an apartment building on a road parallel to Din Daeng Road. If you're craving Rad Na, you won't be disappointed here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerawut Savangboon

sample_reviews_en.text: This is what you call real Rad Na (Thai noodle dish with gravy). The stir-fried noodles have a unique texture, the gravy is fragrant with a special recipe, and the marinated pork is the best part of this restaurant's Rad Na. I can honestly say it's incredibly delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanarat TK

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles in gravy were delicious. The pork pieces were huge, and the vegetables were soft and easy to eat. If you're passing by and the shop is still open, you definitely have to get some to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthum Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you don't mind street food, give it a try.

Both the Rad Na and the mixed Rad Na are delicious.

The seasoning isn't too strong, so it tastes great if you add chili powder, sugar, and vinegar.
sample_reviews_en.author: 허접당구 (허접당구)

sample_reviews_en.text: The gravy noodles were delicious, with tender, large pieces of pork, but the stir-fried noodles with soy sauce weren't quite to my liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy Ploiz

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles in gravy were delicious, the flavor was just right, and they gave a generous amount of large pieces of pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarunthon Sarunthon

sample_reviews_en.text: Deliciousness that's worth the money spent! #SuperDelicious #ExtremelyDelicious #QualityBeyondPrice
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarinda Suksombat

sample_reviews_en.text: Large portion of stir-fried pork with noodles, fragrant with a slight smoky wok aroma.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Mighty Servant 3

restaurants.name: ร้านบ้านนาย ( Cafe' & Restaurant)
restaurants.address:

95 Phibun Watthana 4 Alley, พญาไท Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went for lunch on a weekday. It wasn't very crowded. The restaurant is air-conditioned. The food tasted good but wasn't too spicy. The portions were generous and worth the price. The staff provided good service and were polite.
💸 Average price per dish starts at 90.-
🚗 Parking is available on the street in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mins Min

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered beef noodle soup with waterfall-style broth. The beef was fresh, tender, and not chewy. The flavor was good and the seasoning was delicious. The server was attentive and found a table in a cool, air-conditioned corner on a hot day. On some days, they also have fresh sugarcane juice.

The food was delicious, and the owners were both lovely. The service was excellent; they were very attentive to customers. I highly recommend this restaurant. All the food was delicious and the prices were reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: manami best

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and affordable. Everything on the menu, including the drinks, is tasty. The owner is also incredibly friendly and provides excellent service. Fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: พัชรี สวนไธสง

sample_reviews_en.text: A cute restaurant that opens early in the morning. Good prices. Staff are happy to serve. Parking available for 2 cars in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Woraphan Atikomtrirat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the atmosphere is good, and the staff is friendly. I recommend you come and try it at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeranat Onprang

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the coffee is very fragrant. Don't miss the fresh cream cake, I always miss out on trying it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aekkarat_S

sample_reviews_en.text: The coffee is delicious and cheap. A hot cappuccino is only 50 baht. The American breakfast is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cl Larp

restaurants.name: คาเฟ่​@เจ๊ก​โรงโอ่ง
restaurants.address:

MG6J+624, Tambon Bang Phueng, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This cafe has a great spot, fragrant coffee, delicious toast, and a relaxing atmosphere by the Khlong Lat Luang canal. It's a peaceful corner with shady trees. I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Solo Cyclist

sample_reviews_en.text: The coffee was brewed perfectly to my liking. The price was reasonable, and the atmosphere by the canal was great, with a gentle breeze that really cooled me down.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moraine Lake

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, rich flavor, not too sweet. Doi Chang coffee. The vendor is friendly. There's parking and seating available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eve Bikery

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small shop by the canal.
Shady and cool.

The menu item I had today was chilled bread, it was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: JR LUE

sample_reviews_en.text: The iced coffee is delicious, and there's seating with a canal view. The owner is friendly. I really like it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chak N

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried oysters and oyster omelet are delicious, the coffee is great, and the atmosphere is nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nukoon 9555

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoy richly flavored drinks in a satisfying serving, with riverside seating and a natural breeze.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitima Nutsuk

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice atmosphere by the river. The shop isn't very big, but the coffee and tea are good.
sample_reviews_en.author: PORAMATE BUAYAM

restaurants.name: SANEH BANGKOK RESTAURANT
restaurants.address:

372 Sam Sen Rd, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I absolutely love this place. Cheapest and best food near Khao San road. Please ignore the other reviews about the kitchen staff. Yes they can be brief and straightforward with there answers, and sometimes it takes a while. But if you get to know the ladies and especially the one taking orders they are all so lovely and you can tell they cook with a passion! And to those who left bad reviews, shame on you. Have you ever ran a wok outside in Bangkok heat? Didn’t think so. They do their best with what they have and it’s amazing. If I could leave 10 stars I would. They also have such cute decorations of past customers, and have such a love for the food they put out that they offer it for free if anyone is struggling to pay. Like seriously who does that? People who are amazing. That’s who.  Thank you so much :)

With love,

-Sammy ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Sammy Mcgonigal

sample_reviews_en.text:
This joint is perfect.

Service is what I would call "relaxed" which is my polite way of saying that they are perfectly balanced between not giving a toss and being bloody lovely. Food will satisfy the pickiest of eaters as well as purists, and everything is cheap (with free ice and Chinese tea to boot) away from the bustling street but not difficult to get to, I literally cannot fault this place and I wish I came here sooner so I could eat every second meal here. As all other reviews say, it works for tourists and locals alike and I tend to agree. I saw a complaint about the smells and smoke from the kitchen getting in diners faces but for me this is a plus without question. I want my nostrils to flare with the choices of my fellow diners to sacrifice tomorrow's rear end. Plus that old abandoned floating barge is Wak. Tops.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas

sample_reviews_en.text:
Six years after our first trip to Asia, we're back in Bangkok. And if there was one place we wanted to revisit, it was this one! Incredible memories from 2020, which we've just added to in 2026. Multiple choices depending on availability and unbeatable prices!!
Bonus: free ice and Chinese tea!
I wouldn't call the staff particularly friendly, but after a few visits, we managed to get a few smiles. Very authentic, and we loved it.
The atmosphere is authentic; we take notes on our own slips of paper, and the service is still relatively quick! Come experience it at least once if you're in the area, whether it's for breakfast, an iced lemon tea, or a meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Never experienced such disgusting customer service in my life. It is standard for this place to deliberately ignore me. I was forced to wait 30–40 minutes for a simple order while a dozen other customers who arrived much later were served, finished their meals, and left.

This is not a mistake or a busy kitchen; it feels completely personal and intentional. They consciously choose not to make my food while taking care of everyone else around me. To treat a paying customer with such blatant disrespect and silent hostility is pathetic

Terrible management and toxic attitude.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan Lebedev

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you made poor financial decisions and drinking choices during your night at Khao San Road, then do yourself a favour the next day and walk down to this tiny and beautiful food joint. The food is fresh, delicious, wholesome and UNBELIEVABLY cheap. The location is quiet (during the day) and peaceful, overlooking the canal - I saw a monitor lizard in there!
It is one of the rare local food joints which has a variety of vegetarian options and a well-translated menu. I got an amazing portion of stir-fried veggies with rice for 30 THB! Absolutely recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Devanshi Srivastava

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly one of the best spots I’ve tried! 🔥 If you’re looking for something cheap but seriously delicious, this place is a gem. The portions are generous, everything is full of flavor, and you can tell the food is made fresh.

The prices are super affordable, especially for the quality you get. Perfect if you’re on a budget but still want to eat really well. The staff is friendly, service is quick, and the vibe is relaxed and welcoming.

I’d definitely come back again and again. Highly recommend if you want amazing food without spending a lot! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Cyrine Bousselmi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is just amazing, probably one of the best meals we've had in almost two weeks around Thailand. Especially recommend the seafood basil fried rice.
I don't know if it was a thing of the day but we had to wait almost 40min for our food, which had never happen before in street food stalls and restaurants. Given that the place is by a filthy canal, it's not the most pleasant experience. Nonetheless, recommend due to the high quality of the food and reasonable prices
sample_reviews_en.author: Pedro Pereira

sample_reviews_en.text:
Riverside restaurant with Thai and farang food. Good service, very good food and very competitive prices Hut very basic. No frills here!!

So why have I only given it 3 stars?

Most of the seating is overlooking the river. The floor surface is uneven and there are no river barriers. One loss of balance on the uneven surface could find someone in the river. Totally unsafe for children.
These issues need sorting out especially as the restaurant has many good points.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Hampton

restaurants.name: Grow Charoennakhon
restaurants.address:

129/3-4 Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I went on a weekday, so it wasn't crowded. The food arrived quickly after ordering. The air conditioning was comfortably cool, the atmosphere was bright and clean, and the staff were very attentive. There's a wide variety of menu options, and the portion sizes are just right for one person. The food was delicious, with great flavor and high-quality ingredients. They also offer a selection of drinks, including almond milk and oat milk as alternatives to cow's milk. The matcha was especially good. I was very impressed and will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: N X

sample_reviews_en.text:
Arranged a surprise bday meal for a friend here, and the female staff member (that I unfortunately did not get the name of, but next time!) was super helpful. I’m especially very impressed (and amused 😂) with how we communicated with our eyes when to bring it the cake 🍰😂

10/10 fire service
Every dish we ordered was good and generously portioned.
Drinks were all great
Will definitely come back

Note: even though the parking is spacious, the soi entrance is SUPER narrow and not got the faint of heart 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirada T

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here believing the people who said it was delicious,
but is it just my taste buds that are weird...?
The pasta wasn't even seasoned properly,
and the cream tasted like it had been diluted three times with water;
it was bland and I couldn't even tell what it tasted like.
How could that be a recommended dish?
The pizza was bland, but the dough was a bit better.
The prices were about the same as in Korea,
but this was the first restaurant I've been disappointed with since coming to Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: 치키치키

sample_reviews_en.text:
For lunch today, I went to a hidden gem in Charoen Nakhon, Grow, tucked away in a secluded alley. It's a cafe with excellent, award-winning coffee.
They also have amazing, freshly baked sourdough sandwiches that are crispy yet soft.
Plus, they offer a diverse menu including pizza, pasta, and salads.

The atmosphere is comfortable, the service is excellent and very friendly. They sell sweet potato cranberry sourdough and multi-grain sourdough, freshly baked daily.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noom xuto

sample_reviews_en.text: Found my new favourite cafe! They have a wide variety of food and drinks, they have everything! From breakfast, brunch, dinner. They have coffees, cold pressed jucies (which i love), cocktails, smoothies, etc! Pizza, pasta, rice meals, thai food, everything! And they're good! Staff are lovely too, and the interior is giving Bali vibes, very bright and chic! Would definitely be regular here I'm sure, good thing it's close to home! 🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: Grace

sample_reviews_en.text: The cafe is accessible through the hotel, located next to the SANN Hotel in Charoen Nakhon Soi 12. There's ample parking. The staff are attentive, the coffee is delicious, and the food selection is diverse, using quality ingredients. One pancake, however, seemed undercooked. Other menu items were good. Visiting during Songkran allowed me to witness the traditional water-pouring ceremony and the currently popular lotus flowers.
sample_reviews_en.author: wanee duangchalomnin

sample_reviews_en.text: I love it so much! I've been here many times. The restaurant has a great atmosphere, and every dish is delicious with great flavor and high-quality ingredients. There's a wide variety of dishes, the staff are attentive and provide excellent service, and it's not too crowded or noisy. It's perfect for hanging out, working, or bringing the family. I've been eating at their Phutthamonthon branch since then. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: chingnihc ching

sample_reviews_en.text: This coffee shop is located in the hotel. It looks a bit sterile as the whole street does. Seems like a little parallel cosmos of bright buildings for the upper middle class. It doesn’t really match Soi 14 or Soi 12. But the coffee is good. I had to wait a bit too long but they apologized and that‘s fine. The food looks good too. A bit pricey maybe but if the ingredients are as good as they look like it is fine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

restaurants.name: Sot Bangkok - Korean Pot Rice
restaurants.address:

591/9 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: A new Korean restaurant near the bts พร้อมพงษ์ only few mins walk. The menu is super simple, only three choices: pork, fish, or chicken but the food was really good. Most of the side dishes are refillable, except for the egg. The staff were so nice and really attentive, which made the experience even better
sample_reviews_th.author: Best Chiratchaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place definitely needs more love. The interior’s cozy, the service is solid. And sure, it’s tucked away behind the soi behind Villa Market, but trust me, it’s worth the hunt.

Funny thing. My friends and I are usually super talkative, but the moment the food hit the table? Dead silence. Just pure, focused eating. I think it’s as  the chef intended, there is instruction how to enjoy the food.
Every bite is meant to be paired with banchan, so each combo brings something new. Playful. Clever. Keeps your tastebuds guessing.

First time here, and we all agreed. This might be the best Korean food we’ve had. Not your usual bland, mass-produced stuff. Case in point: I refilled the banchan three times. 🤪

And yeah, the sigeumchi. I’m a sesame oil fiend, so part of me wanted it stronger. But honestly? Keeping it mild was the right call. It balances the whole plate. Also, the yuzu paste? If they sold it by the jar, I’d take one home. No question.

If Chef Ahn Sung-jae ever walked in, I think he’d nod in approval. This place gets his philosophy: “If there’s something on the plate, it has an intention, a flavour, a reason.” Every dish here proves it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darwin Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dropped in on this specialty Korean rice pot joint for a quick and easy lunch.

Just a short walk from Phrom Phong BTS station, you can find this cozy, clean cafe-like spot serving up delicious and wholesome rice pot sets (fish, beef, pork or chicken). Like most Korean joints, each set also comes with refillable assorted Banchan (side dishes) and barley tea.

Whilst I'm familiar with soju and makgeolli, this was my first time seeing chungha on a menu so I ordered it out of curiosity and was very pleasantly surprised. This one by Lotte tasted very much like a sparkling sake but with an ABV of only 7% (basically just like a strong beer). A great option if you want something sweet and refreshing but light and not too boozy.

The beef set, with its mix of sesame, garlic, spring onions and gingko, was pretty good. And it was fun experimenting with the various Banchan to create different flavour combinations.
Much like with claypot rice, scrapping up the tasty burnt rice bits at the bottom of the metal bowl was also delightful.

Overall, a great place for a quick but satisfying meal 👌🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher Ho

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a wonderful surprise to discover this restaurant! One of my Korean restaurant friends recommended it to me, knowing that I love trying new places—and it was simply wow. The food was incredibly good, clean, and full of amazing flavors. It truly feels like a rare gem.

I even asked to meet the owner, but she was at the new branch in Siam Paragon, which didn’t surprise me for their success.

We ordered the signature dishes, so it wasn’t exactly an everyday lunch price, but it was absolutely worth it. I will definitely bring many of my farang friends who are always searching for truly good Korean food. The refill service was outstanding—they kept refilling nonstop, and we eventually had to ask them to stop!

The staff are among the best-trained I’ve seen in Thailand. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miwha Shin

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw the review score was very high and was eager to try it. However it's not as splendid as I expected.

I ordered the Seabass Sotbap, since I think seabass is not very common in Korean restaurant. The taste was good but it just tasted like dolsot bibimbap (without vegetables). To be honest, I was unsure what makes this restaurant so special. Given the very high pricing, I expected it to be much better. The side dishes were good though, and the service was very good as the waiters were always on standby to refill the tea or side dishes.

Overall it's a okay experience but I don't really think it's worth the money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abe

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small place for Korean hot pot rice!

Very simple menu, only rice in a hot pot (pork, beef, mushroom, etc.) It comes with assorted sides, which are also refillable (and the server keep asking me whether I want more!)

I tried beef (which is the most expensive), it's worth the price! High quality beef and rice, good quality side dishes.

No dessert and coffee available (coke and some alcohol are avialable as well) - only rice hot pot and some sides, as I said simple but great! (You get free barley tea.)

The place is also simple and small, not suitable for a big party.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronrapee Leelawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great food, a nice place, and excellent service. Beautifully presented dishes. The only downside was that the protein portions were a bit small, and there wasn’t an option to order extra meat as a side. Other than that, everything was great.

If you want more meat, it’s not listed as a side order. However, it’s worth asking the staff, as they may be able to accommodate an off menu request I was able to get an extra serving at the end. Otherwise, you can simply enjoy more of their delicious hot pot rice and kimchi.

The servers are lovely and polite  .
sample_reviews_en.author: Pratch Siri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Saw it on grab, and decided to dine-in instead. The store is a little packed but the atmosphere is nice and clean.

I ordered the pork sotbap, and it came in a set which you can refill your side dish until your stomach explode. (The staff keeps coming over to ask if you want more, very proactive)

The dish itself is on a little salty side, but that’s where the side dish came in to balance it out (expecially the poached egg, which however is the only thing tou can’t refill)

Worth coming and try it out for yourself!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wachara L

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst food ever. Do not fool by fake reviews. They’re doing google review event (if write good review, you will get a soft ice cream)  Beef was very chewy. Pork collar was so dry and smelly. Overall all the food taste was much more bad than outside street food. This restaurant seems supported by tourists. The server forgot our one of orders but it was lucky that she forgot so we could save money on this kind of food. Very disappointing experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amy

sample_reviews_en.text: Generous portions, good value. The dipping sauce is salty, as expected. I liked how it was presented as a set with both papaya salad and steak on one plate. The staff seemed to be foreigners, but they were trained and could communicate. The price was great. Overall, okay. I'll come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vodka

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was good, but the service was poorly coordinated.

We ordered as a family of four, but the food and drinks were served very randomly. We had to ask for both the drinks and our youngest child’s meal. His food was served last, after the rest of us had already finished eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jan

sample_reviews_en.text: Compared to the other delicious meals I've had these past two days, this place was really too ordinary!! I ordered the river shrimp tom yum soup, but the spices were very weak, very basic. I wouldn't recommend it to anyone looking for something special!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah Ma

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌶️🍽️ Tam Siam @ ICONSIAM 🇹🇭✨

Delicious authentic Thai food with bold flavors and fresh ingredients. Great atmosphere, friendly service, and a lively mix of locals and tourists. A perfect stop for a true Thai dining experience! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatree AAA

sample_reviews_en.text: The welcome was warm and professional, and the dishes on the menu looked delicious. We ordered some food, and it was very good, no complaints, and the atmosphere was quite peaceful. I highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathalie Nam

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious, the flavor is rich and satisfying. If you love Northeastern Thai food but want something with a rich, meaty kick, you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vectis Fang

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the most delicious cashew chicken and egg fried rice here! It set a new bar for this meal (which is one of my favorites).
sample_reviews_en.author: Catherine Mumm

restaurants.address:

พัทยา, 218 หมู่ 10 Beach Rd, ตำบลหนองปรือ, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ice cream meets Swensens' standards. Small, quiet Swensens in the mall. Friendly waitress (Nong Ploy) but complete disorganization in the preparation. Customers are served in any order and with a long delay between each ice cream, while other tables are served first. They need to learn to fully serve one table before moving on to another. It's obvious.

Visit December 2025: Staff in training, mixed service... Limited seating, the seats are very close together... For a table of 5, we had to add a seat in the aisle because the back room was closed... Two napkins for 5 people, and we had to ask twice for the extra ones. Ice cream was good 👍✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Laurent GUITARD

sample_reviews_en.text: I come here for ice cream very often because it's close to my workplace. However, I feel that the ice cream melts very quickly, so I can't eat it continuously; I have to eat it fast. I've also noticed a thick layer of ice on the ice cream freezer. I suggest that someone clean or wash the freezer regularly so that it can stay colder for longer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Namnueng Muhammad

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Swenson is something special.

The quality of Swenson's ice cream speaks for itself. However, the service here deserves special mention. Of all the Swenson shops I've visited, she's by far the friendliest employee I've ever encountered. If Swenson were ever looking for an employee of the month, this would be her.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wolfgang Tellmann

sample_reviews_en.text: I came to use the services at the Royal Garden Pattaya branch. The young female employee gave very good advice. She recommended a sundae cup for the children. The service was very good. I will definitely use the services again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumalai Rodjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bad service, they didn't clear the glasses of the people sitting in front of me, the order didn't arrive in full, they forgot to bring the entire order. The waitress ignored the customers.
But the ice cream is excellent
sample_reviews_en.author: segev yehuda

sample_reviews_en.text: All staff are filled with hospitality service mind. Being very helpful and willing to help us organise special Birthday occasion for our party. Highly recommend people to come for very yummy ice cream here. Love it xx
sample_reviews_en.author: Joy Wao

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I celebrated my birthday at Swensen's, RGP branch. The female staff member was very lovely and provided excellent service. She served water and took my order quickly. I will definitely come back again! 🤍🫶🏻 …
sample_reviews_en.author: HAPPY VIEW

sample_reviews_en.text:
Happy birthday! I came to celebrate my birthday at Swensen's Royal Garden Pattaya. The staff sang really well.
The manager, Ying, provided excellent service. I was very impressed. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: ทูว่า กชพร ขอพันธ์กลาง

restaurants.name: เจ๊แดงหมูจุ่ม หน้า ธ.ไทยพาณิชย์

PFGX+V2M, 274/1 Lat Ya Rd, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The wait for food was really long. I wouldn't recommend going when you're hungry.
The prices seem high, but the portions are large and the taste is standard.
The service was good from everyone except the person making the papaya salad.
I asked for my papaya salad three times, and they gave it to another table first.
Then, on the last request, they yelled angrily.
They told their staff that they were out of stock.
I was very confused. Their tone and demeanor were like they didn't want to sell anything.
It was like they were so busy they didn't want to sell anymore. I was just not okay with this one person.
If you're tired, take a break. Don't sell food.
It ruined the mood for both the customers and the staff.
Other than that, the service was good. They kept asking if we needed anything and followed up on orders.
sample_reviews_en.author: Picha L

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a local Northeastern Thai-style hot pot restaurant, using a clay pot heated over charcoal. Other Thai dishes are available as side dishes. This type of hot pot is often enjoyed for dinner. Simply put your choice of ingredients into the pot and wait for it to cook.

The clay pot hot pot is delicious, and the dipping sauce is tasty. They also offer Northeastern Thai dishes like papaya salad, grilled meat, and grilled fish with herbs. It's a roadside restaurant that opens in the evening. Parking is available along the roadside in front of the restaurant. It's suitable for a dinner or a beer. The food doesn't take long to prepare. Don't forget to order their delicious hot pot!
sample_reviews_en.author: Warich Nathtigoon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was awful, everything was too sweet, the restaurant wasn't clean, the staff was terrible, the plate for the papaya salad was broken, some things we didn't order came, the staff gave us dirty looks, and when we asked how much it was, it was a thousand...a thousand, like they were reluctant to pay. I wonder if they even read the reviews. Everything was terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ingfa4512 Tyern

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food and prices are okay.
The portion sizes are quite reasonable.

However, the service needs improvement. Orders were often incorrect, and the food was served quite slowly. We had to repeatedly reorder to get our food.

Parking is difficult; you can park along the sidewalk and walk over.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patthamon M

sample_reviews_en.text: This was a local stall food that provide the multiple Isan food and some raw meat / veggies for Hotpot. Good experience the food seems to be clean and tasty. The service was good, they always ask if we want something, best part was the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brightastic
