sample_reviews_en.text: I'm giving it only one star because the food took forever to arrive. The restaurant next door was closed, so I tried this one. The service was terrible, and I still hadn't received my order after ordering twice.
sample_reviews_en.author: อามิ ตาพุทธ

sample_reviews_en.text: The only person who damaged this restaurant is the person who makes the papaya salad. I must say, they have bad manners. If it weren't for this person, the restaurant would have prospered a lot more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saranphat

sample_reviews_en.text:
July 5 2022 - they closed during the pandemic but just reopened 2 months and I just had to try the chicken cashew again. Unfortunately it wasn't as good as before but still better than most I have come across. Their version is spicy and not the usual tomato based which is merely sweet.
March 2020 - Small decent place that serves inexpensive food. Breakfast of eggs, toast and a salad w'coffee @100B is always a good deal. And they have bigger portions if youre so inclined. Beer is reasonable at 90B a pop. I especially like their chicken cashewnut. One of the better versions i hsve come across. Service is good too although wait staff appear a tad overworked.
20 May 2019 - I had to return just for the cashew nut chicken. While it wasn't as good as the first time it is still far better than most. It is spicier and darker than others I have eaten which are lighter, sweeter and more tomato'ish. And inexpensive!! With a beer the bill was B270.
sample_reviews_en.author: leon j

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owner, a male, seemed to target us from the start, as most of the customers were locals.

I was carrying a camera, and we are Taiwanese.

The original price was NT$290, but for some reason, they miscalculated and charged us NT$480. I absolutely do not recommend this place. I was furious!!!

We only ordered three things: a cup of Thai milk tea (probably NT$50 or 80, not sure if it was a large or small), curry (NT$160), a bowl of white rice (I don't know the price), and boat noodles (NT$60). When we went to pay, he kept issuing fake receipts at the cashier. When I suddenly called out the prices of each item, he started miscalculating again and issuing incorrect receipts. Finally, the owner's wife apologized. I initially saw two reviews mentioning this miscalculation, thinking it was an isolated incident, but it wasn't. I strongly advise everyone not to patronize this restaurant!!

They really take advantage of tourists!
sample_reviews_en.author: chang flora

sample_reviews_en.text: The boat noodles are authentic, the ingredients are fresh, and the staff are friendly. In addition to boat noodles, they also offer stir-fried set meals. The taste is authentic and the price is reasonable. The boat noodles come in different sizes, and the prices are clearly marked. I recommend them to everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: 罌粟花

sample_reviews_en.text: Closest place to my hotel with Thai food. Decided on basil pork with rice and egg on top. Very good. Egg on top is “khai dao” btw. Prices are not Thai cheap. This dish in a food court is about 70thb. This was double. Small LEO beer bottle is 90thb. Place seems visited by white farangs more than locals.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gurmit Singh

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great place for pork noodles. It opens a little earlier than Google Maps suggests, around 9 AM, but you can only order Thai food in the morning. However, that is fine. The pork noodles are incredibly delicious and offer great value for money, so order a medium or large size and go twice.
sample_reviews_en.author: 재관

sample_reviews_en.text: WARNING!! Foreigners and tourists- BE WARNED!! The owner and staff is very cunning and extremely unethical! They use all sorts methods to charge us with ridiculously high food prices. May bad karma follows the owner for the rest of her life on intentionally cheating customers’ hard earned money
sample_reviews_en.author: CEO

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is quite a different style from the boat noodles I usually eat.

I smiled the moment I tasted the broth; the texture of the chewy egg noodles and the melt-in-your-mouth meat was excellent. I think it is a flavor that no Korean could possibly dislike. I highly recommend the Mix + Egg Noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jemin Kook

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant on the ground floor of Cozy at 10 offers a variety of Thai food, including Italian and Thai dishes. Prices are reasonable, with drinks included for under 200 baht. The food is delicious with just the right amount of spiciness. The beer is cold, and the atmosphere is cozy.
sample_reviews_en.author: 池田'Ikeda'史昭'Fumiaki'

restaurants.name: Sushi Mai
restaurants.address:

Tree Square 1133 Inthra Phon Rd, Phlabphla, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I brought my child to eat there, and for some reason, my child accidentally knocked over a plastic cup, spilling water on the floor twice. A staff member then said, "There's a 100 baht fine for spills. Did you see the sign?" I was surprised and said, "Oh, really? No, I didn't see it. I didn't notice the sign." I apologized and said, "Besides, how was I supposed to know my child would spill it? Nobody wants this to happen." But I think this restaurant isn't suitable for children because of the high risk of making a mess. Part of it might be because the tables are narrow, and children or adults probably drop things frequently, so they put up the sign. In the end, we got charged 100 baht for cleaning up, and the food wasn't very tasty. The noodles were hard, the chicken was inedible, and the dumplings were so hard we barely ate them. Some of the sushi was edible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bgjds Bbbss

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small Japanese restaurant, Sushi Mai 33, is affordably priced but uses ingredients that exceed expectations. Located in the Tree Square project, it offers ample parking and a comfortable, air-conditioned dining experience.

Sushi prices start at 15 baht and include salmon sushi, sweet egg sushi, crab stick sushi, abalone sushi, and shrimp roe sushi.

My favorite dish is the Spicy Salmon (85 baht). It features a large, generous piece of salmon, is delicious, and comes with a side of fresh salad. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ry Orraphan

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The sushi pieces are large and the quality is worth the price. You can't finish it in one bite; you have to split it into two bites 🤣
- The salmon salad has a dressing that's like seafood dipping sauce, with a predominantly sour taste.
- The restaurant has a small atmosphere with about 10 tables and a counter bar.
- There are few staff members, so food preparation takes a little while.
- The restaurant is located in the Tree Square project, which has plenty of free parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narumi Nice

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! Considering the quality, quantity, and taste of the food, the price is very reasonable. There were quite a few customers when I went, but I didn't have to wait long. They have a fairly extensive menu, including ramen with three broth options, and almost every type of sushi you could want. The restaurant atmosphere is nice, well-decorated, and comfortably air-conditioned. There's also a well-organized parking area. I'll definitely go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ร่างกายต้องการป่า by ครูที

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is now called AiShushi.
It's pretty good. The price isn't too high, it's fresh and delicious.

Currently supporting Thai businesses through the "Thai Help Thai" program, it's very worthwhile.
The salmon sashimi is sliced ​​quite thick.
The cream cheese roll set is delicious.

But it's a shame the soy sauce isn't quite right. If they adjusted the soy sauce a little, it would be even better.

The price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nar Vir

sample_reviews_en.text:
This sushi restaurant isn't in a mall, and almost everything is delicious.
🐟 The seared mackerel has a very crispy skin. The fried items like gyoza and fried shrimp are also good 🍤. The sushi is decent 🍣, and the grilled sweet egg is okay.
I deducted points for the California roll.
Overall, I'd rate it as OK number 1 (the restaurant is nice).
📍Located in Tree Square.
sample_reviews_en.author: pong chaivoot

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices here are affordable, the food tastes okay, and there's a diverse menu. The restrooms at the back are reasonably clean, and there's plenty of parking, although it might get crowded around lunchtime. I recommend arriving before or after noon. There are also dessert shops and coffee shops nearby where you can stop for a break. Overall, it's good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miaow Krit

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for something filling, it's okay. But if you want something delicious, it's not. It looks appetizing when served, but it's actually very difficult to eat. The pieces are too big to be eaten in one bite like normal sushi should be. There's also way too much rice, so much that it's not tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punpun Dolphina

restaurants.name: The Jai kitchen
restaurants.address:

269/43 ถนน สาธุประดิษฐ์ Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love - Dal Makhani
Love - Aloo Matar

One of our friends took us to this place and the food exceeded our expectations. All the dishes were decently priced.

I personally found Dal Makhani too good, they all taste kind of homemade food but slightly rich. In Paneer Kaju you could taste mild extra oil but delicious. Aloo methi was satisfactory. Lacha Paratha was crispy (good). In drink menu, they only had was Pepsi and ice tea however you could also order lassi which was not bad either. We also had hot tea and it was better than any other restaurants.

People are humble and super nice.  Place looks simple.

This place has the potential to beat Amritsr Restaurant and other good restaurants easily. For us, this will be one permanent spot to dine in often.
Cheers
sample_reviews_en.author: Racha King

sample_reviews_en.text:
First impression is umm SO SO
BUTthe moment food is on the table it’s WAO. DELICIOUS and YUMMY. We ordered Chinese bhel paneer tikka and biriyani with boondi raita ( curd preparation) and dal makhani. Every item was tasty. Service was good and staff was very cooperative. Their mint chutney was super tasty. Only thing I didn’t like much was their cutlery. But food is just too good , we finished everything to the last bite
sample_reviews_en.author: Meena Jain

sample_reviews_en.text: It took them 30 minutes just to serve the starters, and the staff's attitude towards customers was terrible. I witnessed the owner shouting at both customers and members of my group. The overall experience was extremely disappointing. I would definitely not recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Priya Haldiya

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food. Requested for no seed oil which staff kindly accepted. Friendly atmosphere, family vibe it seemed. Staff told me it might take a while for food to arrive but in the end it came super fast. Would come back and recommend to others.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marcus Bright

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good food. Expect some delays if there is a crowd. Very good North Indian food available. They also deliver food to your place. "Tawa Sabjee" was really great along with Bhindi Masala. Must try this place for Vegetarian Indian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: dkkhamar

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place earlier was serving Thai food, but now offer north Indian cuisine vegetarian food only..
Good portion of food and service, however little space for dine in & dull atmosphere
On call food order & delivery also available
sample_reviews_en.author: Prashanth Kumar

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst service on Sunday😡😡, if you can wait like an idiot for 1 hour or more. Than it is definitely a place to come. Or else order in morning and get the food in evening.🤣🤣🤣🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronak Dhadda

sample_reviews_en.text:
Indian vegetarian restaurant,  good place vegan lovers. Very reasonable price with good service.

Easy to find, it's on the roadside.  Have some parking slots.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saratha Ramanan

restaurants.name: Maisonblue38
restaurants.address:

7 ถ. เจริญกรุง Khwaeng Bang Rak, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
If you’re a fan of Thai flavors, this place is a must-visit! I recently had the chance to try their crispy fried chilli-salt belly pork with rice, and it was absolutely delicious.

I also try their pad sam chun (Stir-fried Trio of vegetables) with minced pork and shrimp, which was equally impressive. And One of the highlights was Khao Kham Pu, mixed rice with fresh crab meat, herbs, and lime dressing. Every bite was zesty, savory, and bursting with umami from the sweet crab.

The presentation was neat, and the portions were generous. Plus, the staff were friendly and the overall vibe was cozy and welcoming. Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic Thai comfort food! ค่าาาาา🥰💓
sample_reviews_th.author: krinna m

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant is located on a corner lot connecting Soi 40 and Soi 38 on Charoen Krung Road.
The restaurant is beautifully decorated. The second floor has private rooms for group banquets. The food is acceptable, but unfortunately, there seems to have been a mistake in the cooking process; some dishes were pre-cooked and reheated, or there may have been a change of chef. I was disappointed, as I had hoped. The air conditioning might also have played a part, as the air blowing on the food caused it to cool and dry out. I suggested this to the staff, and they suggested improvements to improve the quality of the food. If they had listened, I would have ordered several dishes, including large river prawns (three per kilo, approximately 900 baht each).
sample_reviews_en.author: พร้อมพูล ชอบเพื่อน

sample_reviews_en.text:
The name is Botanical Cafe,

and since it's a place where you can enjoy local food in a cafe atmosphere with powerful air conditioning,

we took a Grab to get there.

They said they don't have Regency here (after calling ahead), so we bought some at a local supermarket and brought them along.

The atmosphere is nice, the food isn't bad, the service is good, and everything is great, but,

since it's a place for dates, the portions are a bit small.

I wonder if it's a botanical garden concept, but it is certainly clean. Or maybe the second floor has that kind of interior design.

Since there are four of us guys... that is why.

We ended up ordering several dishes,

and went to a second place for dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: K 365bestfood

sample_reviews_en.text:
We booked for over ten people for a Friday evening.
👍🏻 We got a private room, which was quite comfortable and private.
The room's atmosphere was incredibly luxurious, almost too luxurious! 555555
The food was served quickly (you can order in advance and specify when you want it served).
🍽️ The menu was delicious, and the quality of every item was good. The prices weren't expensive.
🍽️ It's Thai food. Since we were a large group, we ordered many dishes such as fish paste with mackerel, stir-fried prawns with chili and salt, crab rice, fried liver with garlic, and roti with green curry. Every dish was delicious and met the standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panida Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food service was extremely slow, and the management system was terrible. Even though they forced customers who had made reservations in advance and paid a 50% deposit, we still had to wait a very long time upon arrival. The food tasted mediocre and wasn't worth the reservation fee. In the evening, there was a singer performing, and the small restaurant was very noisy. The table next to us kept trying to talk to each other, shouting and being boisterous.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lilian Yang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Warutti Botanica Cafe

A hidden gem in the Charoen Krung area, near M.O. Their grilled prawns are fresh and delicious, with the antennae already removed. The mackerel chili paste features a very large mackerel and the paste is excellent. Other dishes include crispy pork with sataw, and crab claws.

The restaurant has a comfortable atmosphere; reservations are recommended.

#Eatanywhere
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachit Chairat

sample_reviews_en.text: There's no parking lot, you have to find your own parking. The food service isn't great, you have to wait a very long time. It's a popular restaurant, customers have to be prepared to wait and manage their own food. Maybe there wasn't clear communication when I called to make a reservation. The food taste is acceptable. I'd like to commend the staff for their good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krissy Kulpa

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there two days in a row! I discovered a great Thai restaurant near the Mandarin Oriental Hotel, and it's perfect for Korean palates. 👌 It's a completely different style from the many Thai restaurants in tourist areas, and it felt like a new experience. The food was great, the atmosphere was great, and the value was great!
sample_reviews_en.author: neuf

restaurants.name: Rakuchin
restaurants.address:

24/13 Sukhumvit 69 Alley, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: This Japanese izakaya is located just a right from Kinjo, an Okinawan restaurant on Sukhumvit 69. Its low prices make it easy on the wallet. Their Thai dishes are tailored to Japanese tastes, making them easy to eat. They even quickly whipped up a dish called Yam Kai Dao (ยำไข่ดาว), which may not have been on the menu. They also offer set meals, so it seems like a good place to eat. Recently, about 10 new karaoke bars have opened on Soi Pridipanom Yong 3, so it seems like a popular spot for accompanying your partner to work.
sample_reviews_th.author: ニック（Nick）

sample_reviews_en.text: Whenever I come to Bangkok, I love to eat at this restaurant. The atmosphere is like dining with family. The food is fresh and delicious. They have both Thai and Japanese food. Everyone is lovely. The staff provide good service and are fun. When I stay late, everyone comes to sit and drink with me. The food is not expensive. I recommend it to anyone who wants to eat and have fun drinking. You can call the staff to drink with you. There may be a small charge for drinks, but I really like it this way. It's not lonely.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุปราณี กองสูงเนิน

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a bar where cheerful staff will join you for a drink. They also have Japanese TV on and a separate room for karaoke. The daily specials include freshly delivered fish and shrimp marinated in soy sauce, which are delicious, and the kui-jap (Japanese cucumber) at the end of the meal is also nice and mildly seasoned. The full izakaya menu is reasonably priced. The staff seem well-trained in their etiquette and attention to detail, which makes it a comfortable place to be.
sample_reviews_en.author: Terry a k

sample_reviews_en.text: This small but lively Japanese izakaya combines a bar and private rooms, perfect for solo drinks or small gatherings. The soy sauce-marinated fresh fish, fried dishes, and oden are all of high quality, and you can have a satisfying meal for around 120 baht. The staff are young and enthusiastic, willing to drink with you but not pushy, making it a comfortable place for women to dine. The karaoke on the second floor is a plus; the only downside is parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷上门服务 Escort Bangkok 看主页

sample_reviews_en.text: You can't have a good meal without trying soi, and this Japanese-style little shop is full of beautiful waitresses from the moment you enter. I only ordered drinks, oden, and tempura, and the food was quite good. With the decor and ambiance, I believe the atmosphere will be even better in the evening. This is a small shop where the atmosphere and flavor are what make it special.
sample_reviews_en.author: 遠方來鳥

sample_reviews_en.text: I dropped in for dinner. With both a counter and tables, it was a restaurant reminiscent of a Shinbashi izakaya, where you can feel at ease even if you're dining alone. Even if you're dining alone, the staff, who speak broken Japanese, will tease you. Personally, I recommend the Atka Mackerel. I found the whole fish to be much tastier than the half.
sample_reviews_en.author: SiamPal

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the Tonkatsu set, which included tonkatsu, rice, soup, and four side dishes: sweet potato, crab sticks, cauliflower, and maroni salad.
The pork was thin, not thick, and tender. The side dishes were average, and overall, not very high quality. It cost 190 baht, and the green tea refill was 30 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: K K.

sample_reviews_en.text: Most dishes are around 120 THB each and are quite tasty❤ The value for money is quite good☺ The staff are young and cheerful. There is karaoke on the second floor, so women are welcome too. It's a good place to hang out with close friends or for everyday use! If it was close to home, I'd go there anytime❤✌
sample_reviews_en.author: 川尻セリカ

restaurants.name: ออกรส
restaurants.address:

166 ถนน พุทธมณฑลสาย 1 Khwaeng Bang Duan, Khet Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
August 14, 2024
Plenty of parking. The entrance to the restaurant looks intriguing; if I hadn't done some research beforehand, I definitely wouldn't have come. Through the narrow entrance, you're greeted with a spectacular large wooden archway framed by soft yellow lights. Even more amazing is the beautiful garden, waterfall, and koi pond behind the restaurant. Unfortunately, we arrived near dusk, so we couldn't admire it for long. We'll have to come back next time. The food is quite expensive, with a 10% service charge and 7% VAT, but the food was delicious and suited our taste. For example, the sour curry with shrimp and acacia leaves (300++ baht) was so good you could drink the broth! The shrimp were just small and not very firm. The grilled pork neck was tender and well-marinated (220++ baht), and the fried squid with garlic was crispy and chewy (350++ baht). That was enough to fill us up. Luckily, there was a Mother's Day promotion, so we'll be back again! 555
That's a real customer attraction strategy! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Pantira T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant opens at 8:30 AM. I arrived at 10:30 AM.
I ordered 5 dishes. I ordered Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) but received Tom Yum Seafood instead. I ordered Coke Zero but got regular Coke. I ordered fried sea bass with fish sauce, but when I came out, they said none of the fried items were available yet because the stove wasn't on. I wanted to order seafood curry but don't eat shellfish, so I asked the staff if I could have it without shellfish. The staff said yes. When it was served, the shellfish were on top! I called a staff member over and asked why I didn't order shellfish. She replied, "I'll go take them off for you."!!!!! There was no apology either. After that, I didn't say anything else.
If the restaurant isn't ready, they should improve things before opening. The food is delicious, but the service, I can only say one word: terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: pornpimon thitaweera

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The stir-fried Gnetum leaves with eggs, the steamed sea bass with lime (the fish was very fresh and tasty), the stir-fried squid with salted egg, the spaghetti carbonara, the shrimp fried rice, the salmon roll, and the shrimp cakes were all excellent. It's a shame we didn't get to try the cafe because we were already too full. Overall, the food was 10/10 – even better than many upscale restaurants in shopping malls. The parking lot was convenient and spacious, with staff providing umbrellas in the hot sun. The staff were polite and provided excellent service. The restaurant itself was spacious and comfortable, with a tropical garden and waterfall perfect for strolling around and taking photos while waiting for our food. Everything was great; there's nothing to complain about.
sample_reviews_en.author: narinz pinc

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd rate the garden highly. The food is good, the service is good, and there's plenty of parking. It's a unique blend of Thai and Japanese restaurants and a cafe, all beautifully designed as a central hub connecting everything.
My only minor criticism is that the restrooms are only available at the Ookrot restaurant, which isn't very convenient. A public restroom would be ideal. I found the Ookrot restaurant a bit cramped, and the interior decoration could be improved.
If the larger trees continue to provide more shade, I think the outdoor seating area could be arranged more comfortably and expanded.
The food prices are quite high, but considering the large, newly landscaped garden surrounding the place, it's acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: อนัตตา

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant on Phuttamonthon Sai 1 Road has a spacious paved parking lot with plenty of parking spaces. There's a garden behind the restaurant with many trees, providing a relaxing seating area in the evening. There's also a cafe serving coffee and other drinks.

The food is delicious. The fried sea bass with fish sauce is crispy and tasty. The grilled beef with herbs is tender and flavorful even without dipping sauce. The fried cabbage with fish sauce is crispy and delicious.
The glass noodle casserole has medium-sized shrimp and is very tasty.

It's best to call and reserve a table to avoid waiting. The staff provides good service, although some dishes might take a little longer to be served.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ukrit Salyapongs

sample_reviews_en.text: Despite comments from other people saying that taking orders was disorganized and there were long waits for food, in reality, it didn't take long at all. I waited only 10 minutes and everything arrived exactly as ordered. Importantly, the taste was excellent – ​​well-balanced, not too salty, not too sweet, and not too sour. The sea bass congee, in particular, was superb. The prices weren't too expensive and were quite affordable. The garden was also very beautiful. The staff were attentive, checking to make sure we had finished eating and bringing the restaurant's dishes promptly.
sample_reviews_en.author: ARIYA JAYO

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is nice, with a large garden area for walking and relaxing.
It's a Thai-Japanese fusion restaurant.
There's also a cafe, but I didn't try it.
The food tastes good.
However, the service, starting from the table reservation process, was quite poor and confusing. They should have a more standardized table reservation system.
Plus, the food took a very long time to arrive, served one or two dishes at a time. We ordered 6 dishes and ate for over 2 hours because we kept waiting for the food to be served.
The prices are quite high, but acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mojichu

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful, and the garden is lovely, which makes the food even more enjoyable 😋 The food is delicious, flavorful, and every dish is excellent. The prices are reasonable, the food doesn't take long to arrive, and the staff provides great service even on New Year's Eve... It was so delicious I forgot to take pictures of many dishes 😉
sample_reviews_en.author: Nit D.

restaurants.name: เจ๊นงค์ นักชงมืออาชีพ
restaurants.address:

252 ซอย จุฬาฯ 3 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible! I don't know whose fault it is, but on my second visit, they forgot my rice both times. I ordered it ages ago, and people who came after me have already finished eating and left, and I still haven't received my rice. The staff were also very grumpy. I went to ask for it two or three times until I was furious. I'm paying for it, not begging for it. If this is how you manage a restaurant, then go ahead. The drinks are delicious, I won't deny that, but the food isn't that great. It's extremely salty. No matter how delicious something is, if the service is bad, it's over. There are many other restaurants that are willing to take good care of their customers. Furthermore, I cleared my own table before sitting down. The staff didn't come to clear it, but there were no other tables available, so I had to sit there. Other restaurants don't do that; they always beg and take good care of their customers. It's up to each restaurant whether they can sit there or not. Well, I wish you all the best and hope you get rich. The restaurant itself was also filthy. Food safety = 0. Should the Consumer Protection Board investigate?
sample_reviews_en.author: Alocker

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop is a lifesaver for Chulalongkorn University students when their blood sugar is low. They have a huge menu, covering all tastes, from sweet drinks and fresh milk to fruit juices, and even toasted bread and iced bread.
In the evenings, it gets quite busy with students, but if you order takeout, the wait isn't long at all.
This shop is legendary. During my student days, I ate here almost every evening. Now, I only come back when my blood sugar is low because they make it perfectly. 😆
The prices are affordable, and most importantly, it stays open very late.
My favorite menu item ❤️
🥤 Chocolate Banana Smoothie. I highly recommend trying it. On days when I have a lot of work to do, this drink is a lifesaver and gives me energy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benyada P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I'm going to recommend a budget-friendly drink shop that's a regular haunt for office workers near Chulalongkorn University. It's located in Soi Chula 3.

Parking is limited in this area, so most people walk to the shop.

There's usually a long queue around lunchtime.

They offer a wide variety of drinks, including some made-to-order food.

Today I ordered their best-selling item, an iced Thai tea. They use a blend of Thai tea and Southern Thai tea, giving it a unique and fragrant aroma. It's only 30 baht per glass.

I also ordered an iced fresh milk, which was also delicious and fragrant, for 30 baht.

If you have the chance, stop by and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: เดินสายกิน เดินสายเที่ยว ศราทราเวล

sample_reviews_en.text:
Help! This beverage shop is so affordable! I ordered a watermelon drink and a mango drink before the meal. The mango drink is no exaggeration; it was still very rich even at the last sip. The mango drink was like drinking mango jam, but with a strong fruity flavor 😀. The green tea with whipped cream topping was amazing! The cream was super delicious and very refreshing, like Japanese-style cream, the kind used in red leaf cakes 😀.

The best part is, it's very cheap! Only about 40 yuan a cup, and it's over 700cc. Such a great deal!
sample_reviews_en.author: 尉博益

sample_reviews_en.text: You can practically fall asleep while you wait after ordering; it takes so long you'll forget. The rice with fried egg and minced pork didn't match the picture; the egg was overcooked and there was only one egg, and the minced pork was sparse. I ordered three simple rice dishes and one sukiyaki, and waited 30 minutes, even though it wasn't crowded and there wasn't a queue outside. I don't know why it was so slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulanit Kaew-ngam

sample_reviews_en.text: So slow, took forever. Waited for half an hour. Went to tell them twice, but it still hadn't come. Other people who came later got their food first. The staff seemed confused; both times my order was late. I'm never coming back. The shop isn't clean, they don't care about customers, and the staff are rude. Terrible service. I hope they prosper, but I'm never coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alocker

sample_reviews_en.text:
• The shop is located on Banthat Thong Road, but it's located inside an alley.
• It's a small shop with 4-5 tables and no air conditioning.
• They offer a la carte dishes, toasts, fruit smoothies, and blended teas.
• The shop is inexpensive and the taste is quite good.
• Milk tea with less sugar and whipped cream costs 30 baht + 15 baht, totaling 45 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eattillyoudrop foodie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Iced bread with coconut milk costs 45 baht.
I ordered the regular version, and it was very sweet.
Next time I might order it less sweet.
The portion size is generous.
The bread is soft, but the slices are a bit too big.
The tea flavor doesn't seem to be the signature Cha Tra Mue brand, so it felt a bit strange.
But overall, it wasn't bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: King Bob M.

restaurants.name: บางกอกกริลล์ ถนนเจริญรัถ (Bangkok Grill)
restaurants.address:

926 ซอยปากซอย Charoen Nakhon Rd, แขวงคลวงคลองต้นไทร Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a late dinner around 9 PM at a small restaurant behind a 7-Eleven. The air conditioning was nice and cool. We started with spaghetti carbonara, the familiar Thai version – creamy, flavorful, and delicious. Next was a spicy chicken burger; the chicken patty was huge, so big I was surprised and asked to take some home (it was still delicious even after reheating it a day later). Then there was green curry fried rice with grilled chicken – just fried rice with green curry paste and basil, no eggplant, a mild flavor, but the grilled chicken was excellent – ​​tender and well-marinated. The corn salad was incredibly sour, like they'd accidentally dumped a whole lime truck into the mortar! Finally, the T-bone steak was a bit chewy. Overall, it was good, the quality matched the price. Including drinks, the bill was over 700 baht. The food didn't take long to arrive, probably because there weren't many customers, just our table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naiya Snow

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located opposite Khlong San Market, just past the crosswalk. It's a small doorway but has many tables.

The menu offers a variety of steaks, spaghetti, and appetizers.

The food arrived fairly quickly, and the service was good.

The ground beef was delicious, with a distinct beef flavor, and cut into just the right thickness.

The black pepper pork steak was firm yet thin, and came with french fries, salad, and bread.

I liked the mashed potatoes; they were smooth and the gravy was rich, but there wasn't much of it. A little more gravy would have been perfect.

The onion rings were finely chopped, not sliced ​​and battered.

The total bill was 523 baht. The price is mid-range to high, but it's a decent place to eat when you're hungry.
sample_reviews_en.author: NJ Story

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to a casual steak restaurant near Icon Siam and it was amazing! 🌴🥗🍕

The spicy chicken steak was super spicy 🌶️🌶️, the fries were hot and crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, and the salad dressing was rich and satisfying. The price was very budget-friendly.

I highly recommend it! Go try it, it's really worth it! 🤣😀🌤️🥬
sample_reviews_en.author: มาโปรด

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the quantity is worth it. There is a promotion that includes steak with soup and free ice cream. It's a great value. I highly recommend it. The day I went, I didn't have to wait long for the food. The atmosphere of the restaurant is a bit dark. During the lunch break, it gets lively.
sample_reviews_en.author: J S

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered three things. The spaghetti was delicious, but the steak's price has gone up, which is one thing, but the portion size is smaller than before.
The steak portion was smaller than before, I only got 5 pieces of French fries, and there were fewer vegetables. It didn't taste as good as it used to.
sample_reviews_en.author: TaMMa

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is truly delicious. I've been eating here since university until now, about 5-6 years after I started working. The meat is high quality, the cuts are large, and it's marinated/grilled perfectly – cooked just right, not too dry or tough. You have to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Champagne

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was alright, kinda average. Some dishes are pretty good, though. The staff who waited on me that day weren't exactly the friendliest, and the service was a bit slow, to be honest.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chai Hok

sample_reviews_en.text: It's affordable, air-conditioned, has plenty of seating, and is close to the Gold Line Skytrain. I ordered the New Zealand sirloin steak; the taste was okay, but a little tough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akat Kittiwarachet

restaurants.name: พนมแซ่บอีสาน
restaurants.address:

ร้านพนมแซ่บอีสาน Saha Kan Pramun Alley, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Improving the order taking process would be great. Having customers write down their orders, but then entering them into the system incorrectly—the kitchen blames the person entering the orders—and the service staff doesn't check if the customer has added (...) or specified additional requests. I suggest that if the order isn't entered correctly after customers write it down, give the bill to the kitchen. I'm not very impressed. I've ordered this way twice, even though I come here often, but neither time was it. If you're worried about adding items to the menu and it not being cost-effective, please inform the customer. We're willing to pay the extra charge. Many people have expressed similar opinions. Especially being near a busy area, you should pay more attention to this. Don't just be nice and then leave it to your staff to deal with the consequences. 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Really Really

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm usually a regular customer at this restaurant, spending at least 1,000 baht each time. Today, I brought my team for a meal as usual. We ordered four bottles of Regency whiskey. When we tried to order more, they said they were out of Regency and only had Sangsom left. My team ordered one bottle of Sangsom, but some wanted to continue drinking Regency, so we went out to buy some elsewhere.

The bill was checked at 9:09 PM (20:09).

We waited a very long time. The restaurant insisted on charging us for the Regency we bought from outside. After a very long wait, they claimed the owner was checking the CCTV footage.

We then told them to check the 8:15 PM footage to see if my colleague actually brought the liquor in. It wasn't resolved until 9:56 AM.

An hour spent inconsistent with your own stock was very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Irin

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm giving it 1 star for now. I'll change the rating once improvements are made.

I'm a regular customer, eating here almost every week.
The food is delicious and the staff is friendly, but there are so many dogs. At first, I saw one, which was okay, but now there are four. It's not that I dislike them, but they sit and stare at me constantly, as if they haven't had enough to eat.

I wish the owner would be more considerate of their customers. I'm not sure if the restaurant owns the dogs, but it's not okay when they sit and stare and lick me while I'm eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: อรรถยา เกษมโกสิตพงศ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Isaan food here is generally good. I like that many dishes come with pickled garlic.

The French fries are also good; thick and chunky, perfect for snacking.

The restaurant is spacious and airy, comfortable seating, and doesn't feel cramped. Soft music plays in the background, making it pleasant to listen to.

One of the single-dish meals I've tried and found delicious is the stir-fried beef with basil and a fried egg. It tastes great.

The fried egg even has the yolk separated before frying, which is perfect.

Parking is easy and convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supachai Bunsan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Monday, July 10th, 2023: I was planning to eat at the restaurant, but...it was closed. I checked the map and it said it was open. So sad, I missed out.

Today, July 11th, 2023: I went again, and the restaurant was open! I ordered takeout today. The prices are reasonable. The restaurant has parking for cars and motorcycles. The atmosphere is nice, not hot, clean, and the food is delicious.
(I asked and the restaurant is closed on Sundays. It might be open every day in the future.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Rungnapha kantawee

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, spacious and comfortable. The food is delicious and clean, the staff provides excellent service, and the owner is attentive, constantly checking on customers. I recommend the Luang Prabang papaya salad, lotus stem salad, fried chicken wings, minced pork salad, and coconut milk dessert. We ordered over 10 items and everything was delicious. I was surprised by how cheap the bill was! I highly recommend this restaurant. **Phanom Saap**
sample_reviews_en.author: Karakate Worakulamornrat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is good, delicious, and meets the standard of having a complete balance of spicy, sour, and sweet flavors—well-rounded and not overpowering. They offer a full range of Thai, Northeastern, and Central Thai dishes. There's convenient parking, and the food doesn't take long to arrive.
*However, it's not very clean now; there's a lot of dust on the tables and chairs. This needs improvement, so I'm not really keen on eating there anymore.
sample_reviews_en.author: Choco Mori

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate here a year ago and the taste was just okay, but this time everything was delicious. Maybe they changed chefs, I don't know, but the food is definitely better. The papaya salad was amazing, very flavorful, and the corn salad was delicious (but I forgot to take a picture). If I'm craving papaya salad again, I'll definitely go back. The only downside is the dog that keeps sitting there watching the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stam Aimsumang

restaurants.name: 98BBQ
restaurants.address:

641, Srinakarin Road near the corner of Srinakarin Road and Phatthanakan Road Beside Asakan Condo, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is not bad
It's good
The fried rice and pork chops for breakfast
The pork is tender
It goes well with the pickled chili paste
(I think the rice is a little hard, but not so hard that it's hard to eat)

The grilled meat is also delicious even without the pickle
I give their pickles about 3/5 (I like grilled meat with pickled tamarind ☹️)

The soups they serve
are pretty good

The service is
The whole restaurant is alone
They don't give you tissues so you have to get them yourself
If you want something, you have to find someone
You have to ask them
One of the staff is quite stern

The price is 70 for fried rice and pork chops
Tax included
The grilled meat and corn salad is as shown in the picture
295. Not bad
(I wonder if the black chicken is a little expensive)
sample_reviews_en.author: Boom

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's probably a Burmese-style restaurant. When you arrive, they'll serve you a bowl of soup (free refills!). It tastes similar to our Thai sour soup but spicier. It's delicious. The restaurant lets you choose items from a refrigerated display and they'll grill them for you. The highlight is the grilling technique using their special spice blend. The prices for the grilled items are very cheap, mostly 14 and 19 baht. Honestly, if they improved the quality of some dishes and increased the price, I wouldn't mind. Don't forget to ask for the mala chili powder – it's not spicy but amazing for dipping. It's in the last few pictures, it looks like chili powder. We drank beer and they provided free ice. The staff were very attentive.
P.S. There were a few mosquitoes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narisara Ph.

sample_reviews_en.text: This establishment is an open-type barbecue restaurant. The menu features dishes prepared with tiger, leo, chang, etc and Korean soju. The barbecue is of exceptional quality and incorporates Burmese flavors. While the current offerings are limited to beer bottles, the restaurant plans to introduce C beer draught beer in the near future. The ambiance is characterized by a pleasant atmosphere, free from excessive noise, and the presence of a projector. This combination makes it an ideal venue for enjoying a football match.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kyaw Thu Latt

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those who want to sit back and relax while having a beer and enjoy Myanmar, this is the place to go.
The grilled fish is not expensive and tastes good. The grilled pork tail is also delicious.
This is a good place for those who want to have a cheap and relaxing meal. 😋😋😋
This place is cozy and offer various delicious grills with affordable price. The environment is great and nice to chill. The staffs are friendly and quick service.😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Hsu Mon Theint

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything about this small Burmese restaurant is perfect. Came here around 7 on a weekday night. Most of the 8 tables were taken. Got to code from a variety of meats most were under a $1 usd. My bill without drinks was around $12. What a bargain . Also, you get unlimited soup. The Burmese seasoning was great, next time I’ll ask them to make it more spicy. Come here, you won’t regret it!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: ztredded B

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there to eat Burmese Mohinga & Chinese Youtiao with Peas at around 12 noon (as their ads they can provide breakfast from 8 am to 1 pm). Their Mohinga is very delicious and not salty. Youtiao was fried at the same time when I ordered. That one texture was also very soft and not a hard one. Good place to eat Burmese Breastfast. P.S. Their tea is nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaung Xatt

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled fish & pounded dried mutton with tea leaf are ones of the best I have had outside of Myanmar. Prices were reasonable for such an authentic experience. If you’re looking for a unique spot to enjoy Burmese flavors with great hospitality, this is the place to be!
sample_reviews_en.author: K H

sample_reviews_en.text: Burmese-style mala BBQ with Burmese dipping sauces and soup that are hard to find in this area. If you like trying new things, give it a try. Beer and music are also available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montawat Sripusitto

restaurants.name: CUCU Bar & Terrace @The QUAD
restaurants.address:

Ground floor, The Landmark Bangkok Hotel, The Quad Sukhumvit Eatery, 138 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: CUCU Bar & Terrace is located in The Landmark Bangkok. Lovely location on the terrace and a great place to soak up the bustling atmosphere of Sukhumvit. I was staying at the hotel. I had a really bad cold on New Year's Eve. I had dinner somewhere else and wanted somewhere not too busy to see in the New Year. This was perfect. Great music, cool atmosphere. Wasn't too crowded and best part being I could just easily go to my room after without having to face any traffic! Staff were super nice. Even though they had stopped serving hot drinks, they made me a cappuccino especially which I really appreciated. Very comforting when you are ill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taylor Deni

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a wonderful time at this restaurant and bar. The atmosphere was relaxed and the service was excellent. But what truly made my visit special was the way Boyd treated me.

Boyd was incredibly kind and helpful, quick to respond to any request, and treated customers with respect and a constant smile. His presence added a special touch to the experience, making it much more comfortable and enjoyable.

I highly recommend this place, especially for those looking for exceptional service and a friendly atmosphere. A huge thank you to Boyd for his professionalism and wonderful spirit.
sample_reviews_en.author: نبيل البلوشي

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a great experience at this restaurant and bar — the atmosphere was welcoming, the service was excellent, and the overall vibe was just what I needed.

A special mention goes to Boyd, who truly made our visit exceptional. He was incredibly polite, friendly, and attentive. His quick response and helpful attitude stood out and made the experience even more enjoyable.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food, a relaxed setting, and outstanding service. Thank you, Boyd, for your kindness and professionalism!
sample_reviews_en.author: Abdulsalam Hussain

sample_reviews_en.text:
A pleasant and luxurious complex with a selection of excellent restaurants and exceptional service.
Very high quality food (the pasta amazed us)
Also recommend the Ruben sandwich.
We have been back to Pen several times and will continue to return on our next visits to Bangkok

Thank goodness there is a place like this in Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Rom Gal

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a wonderful experience at your hotel, especially thanks to the excellent service in the cucubar area. The staff were warm, welcoming, and extremely helpful with all my questions and needs. Their professionalism and friendly attitude made a great first impression and set the tone for a very pleasant stay. Thank you, K.Fluk
sample_reviews_en.author: Sipatta Jiradeemankongvanit

sample_reviews_en.text: Bee was absolutely amazing. He helped us multiple nights and went above and beyond. He is a great photographer and took lots of great pictures of our family! We are very happy with our experience here and with Bee! I definitely recommend going here!  The food and drinks were also amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marissa MacIver

sample_reviews_en.text:
CUCUBAR — Back Again with the Same Familiar Warmth
A fresh new vibe that's just as cozy as before. The cocktails are still delicious, and the staff are as friendly and welcoming as ever. It feels like reuniting with an old friend on a day that's even brighter than before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyada Yakaew

sample_reviews_en.text: Fluke provided the best service, the atmosphere was great, the food was delicious, and the prices were fair. I wish there was a small discount because the economy isn't doing well right now. Overall, everything was great, especially the bar, which gets 5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: สิริวรรณ เกษร

restaurants.name: เตี๋ยวเรือราชา สาขา โพธิ์แก้ว
restaurants.address:

54 ถ. โพธิ์แก้ว Khwaeng Nawamin, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Tiew Ruea Raja, Pho Kaew Branch" is a popular boat noodle restaurant known for its rich and spicy broth.

Restaurant Information and Recommended Menu:
Signature Dishes: Pork and Beef Waterfall Boat Noodles, Thin Noodles with Pork and Liver Waterfall Soup
Price: Starting from only 20 baht for a regular bowl, with a special price of 60 baht.
Taste: The broth is rich and spicy. It's recommended to "taste before adding seasoning" as the chili peppers are very hot.
Side Dishes: Fresh vegetables such as bean sprouts and basil are available for free self-service. Crispy pork rinds and Thai steamed custard are also available as dessert.
Location and Directions:
Location: Located in Soi Pho Kaew (Intersection 5), Nawamin Road, Bueng Kum District, Bangkok.
Parking: Ample and convenient parking is available behind the restaurant.
Opening Hours: Open daily from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The boat noodles were perfectly seasoned and delicious, with just the right amount of spiciness for us (please let them know if you don't like spicy food). The broth was thick, and the noodles were perfectly cooked, soft and easy to eat.
The steamed rice cakes were incredibly delicious. They had a traditional flavor that's hard to find elsewhere, with a perfect balance of sweetness and coconut milk. A pair for 10 baht is a great deal.
They also sell delicious ice cream, though I can't remember the brand.
The day we went, it was very breezy. The restaurant was airy and well-ventilated, not hot at all.
There's parking available behind the restaurant, which is very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papong Jaisai

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was so delicious! I'll definitely be back to this restaurant.
The noodle broth is rich and flavorful; you can order it with or without chili. The noodles are perfectly cooked.
The steamed rice pudding isn't overly sweet, and the iced black tea is also delicious.
Everything was delicious and the food was prepared quickly. The restaurant is spacious and comfortable, with plenty of fans to keep it cool. I love this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanok Pun

sample_reviews_en.text: This ready-to-eat boat noodle shop is a must-try. The service is so fast that even ordering during lunchtime, you won't have to wait long. The shop is spacious and well-ventilated. The price and portion size are reasonable. The flavor is very well-balanced, but if you can't handle spicy food, be sure to order it less spicy or not spicy at all, because the chilies are very hot. However, it's still incredibly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wallop Eiamsomboon

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle broth is very thick, and the usual flavor is very spicy with a strong chili aroma (if you can't handle spicy food, ask them to make it less spicy). Personally, I found the broth a bit too thick. I tried the dry version and it was delicious. The steamed rice cakes are tasty, and the crispy pork cracklings are delicious. Parking is available on the street in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jipjip Veeranuch

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and flavorful, the dry version is amazing, I really liked it. The noodles are chewy and soft, the portion is just right, the pork pieces are large, and the price of 20 baht is reasonable. The spiciness is just right, although there's a little too little crispy pork crackling. The disposable chopsticks are great. There's parking behind the shop. I'll definitely come again 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarinrat Wonglee

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, flavorful, no need to add seasoning. The broth is rich and concentrated (you have to specify whether you want it with or without chili). 20 baht for a regular bowl, 2 bowls are enough. The blanched vegetables with dipping sauce are a bit unusual, unlike what you'd find at other shops. The steamed rice cakes are just right, not too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: noppadol boonsong

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a huge fan of boat noodles and I've been searching until I found this place (P. Prateep was too crowded lately and not as impressive). This place is truly amazing; the broth is rich and flavorful, and you can specify whether you want it spicy or not (even the non-spicy version is delicious 😋). I'm a regular customer here now ☺.
sample_reviews_en.author: วนาลี สันติไชยะกุล

restaurants.name: Prai Raya Saladaeng ปรายระย้า ศาลาแดง
restaurants.address:

71, 1 Sala Daeng 1/1, สีลม, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited with high expectations, but the food was just so-so and it was expensive. Also, I found a hair in the crab omelet and mentioned it; they said they would remake it if I wanted. Who would want to eat that again? It completely ruined my appetite. In the end, they wouldn't even cancel the order, so I just paid 500 baht. There was also a communication error with the order; I ordered a Diet Coke but received a regular Coke instead. It was disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai restaurant has a beautiful atmosphere, but it was a bit hot. Overall, the flavors were mild, suitable for foreigners, perhaps because we didn't order any southern Thai dishes. The stir-fried curry with large, fresh, and firm prawns was good, but the chicken wrapped in pandan leaves was quite tough. The food was served slowly because there were many customers. The sago pudding was delicious, but the O-ew (a type of Thai dessert) was very average.
sample_reviews_en.author: KANNI ANUTHI

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wonderful Southern Thai restaurant in Sala Daeng. A bit hidden, but once you know it, you know. Tucked into a small soi with on-site parking, it feels like a quiet discovery in the city.

The food is deeply authentic - spicy, sour, complex, and comforting all at once. Service is warm and attentive, and the atmosphere leans classy and relaxed, making it ideal for both family meals and special occasions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: Just happened to had read the 1star review after I got tummy upset....not surprised as I ordered the crab yellow curry this evening too.  Was told by my friend that she got hospitalized by this dish last time but didn't know I would hv just ran into the toilet right now.  The quietness of this restaurant makes me wonder if the sea/food is fresh or not....well well ..
sample_reviews_en.author: Johnny K (johnnyk_jk)

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden Thai restaurant in a side street off Silom Road. Parking is available. The exterior has a vintage feel and a great atmosphere. The food is absolutely fantastic; everything was delicious and not too spicy. The shrimp was excellent, the dipping sauces were great, and the stir-fried sataw (bitter beans) was particularly tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanawat Sevaphai

sample_reviews_en.text: Prai Raya, originally from Phuket, is the second branch in Bangkok. The food is just as delicious as before, with only the right amount of spiciness. The atmosphere is nice, playing old Thai songs, perfect for bringing your parents. The staff are friendly and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanaichon Smitthileela

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great, the service was lovely and professional. All the food was delicious. The only thing that could be improved was the pineapple curry; it only had the pineapple core and wasn't ripe enough to make a curry. // I will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natt

sample_reviews_en.text: Gave 3 out of 4 people diarrhea...this restaurant needs to check the freshness of their ingredients...may be the FDA should investigate...just because it's a well know Phuket brand (chained restro) doesn't mean the quality/standard is there same.

restaurants.address:

75/2-29 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good but the price is not worth it at all. I don't know if it's because the shop is selling it for a profit. You pay 50/60 for a dish, but it's not enough for one person. When I went to buy it, I thought I was going to buy food from a Myanmar restaurant, and when I saw the food, I was surprised that it was 50. I have bought it from other Myanmar restaurants. So far, it's not too much. I wish it was 50/60, but if I add it, I don't want it to be too much. Since it has to be added in a bottle, I can't add a lot, so I think I should just put it in a bag.
sample_reviews_en.author: Linn

sample_reviews_en.text: First time eating Burmese food. Came to eat at noon. Tried Mohinga (rice noodles with boiled eggs and beans, creamy taste, not too strong, easy to eat). Recommend squeezing lime for great aroma. Served with hot tea, goes well together. Not expensive, this bowl is 80 baht. The staff doesn't speak Thai. Order in English/has a Thai menu. Overall, okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Moving Sun

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I had tofu salad and pork curry for lunch. Then, I enjoyed Myanmar tea and coconut milk jelly as dessert. Everything was very delicious and satisfying. What I can’t forget is the service at their shop, the friendly smiles truly warmed my heart. I’ll definitely come back again. Wishing them great success and lots of customers!
sample_reviews_en.author: Moe Pyae Pyae Kywe

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through food delivery.Feels just like eating at home! The pork curry was super tasty — rich, tender, and full of Burmese flavor. Would love to see it on the daily menu. Loved the fried rice made with Shwe Bo Paw San Hmwe too. Finished everything off with a hot cup of perfect Burmese tea. Can’t wait to try more dishes!
sample_reviews_en.author: saw kyawt

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this place through facebook review and became a regular right away. I’ve dined in, ordered online, and now I’m on their one-month rice box package. The taste is always delicious, the portions are just right, and their food honestly makes my day every time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aye Sandar Min

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is great ,more like a home cooked but I still hope to get the potion is much more than this.
Sweet pork stew-60, pork offal curry-60, tamarind leaves salad-40, nga pi kyat-30.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiri Htoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small restaurant near BigC.

Refreshed my memory of good food.

Every dish was fantastic, especially the cake.

I'll definitely come again.

sample_reviews_en.text: Lately service had been a little bit subpar compared to it before.Dishes are good but not tasty as before.Overall still a good place to eat
sample_reviews_en.author: Silver Strong

sample_reviews_en.text: A 5 stars private restaurant that  gives you the "dining- at- home" atmosphere. Located at Sukhumvit Soi 49/14. This place has only 1 table for 12 seats, available for reservation only. Suitable for arranging the event of "Chef Table" like the evrbt I had joined for today. Also they have their food & beverages available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pantipsuda Posayanonth

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food and atmosphere. Excellent hospitality. The location of the restaurent is quite a limitation especially early after business hour. If you will start dinner after 19.30 or 20.00 it will be a great place to enjoy the meal with your friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nauthaniel Grogan

sample_reviews_en.text: I had an absolutely fantastic birthday dinner for my wife at MIGHTY. Renzo is the perfect host and his chef team are truly gifted. If you're looking for something special, this is the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben Howard

sample_reviews_en.text: Under expect. Un organised and only one serving staff for 14 guest. Not professional as i think.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theerat Pattanapram

sample_reviews_en.text: My surprise dinner for my boyfriend went perfect, and Renzo was extra nice to us :)
sample_reviews_en.author: K R (KR)

restaurants.name: The Oriental Shop (Siam Paragon)
restaurants.address:

394 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went on a weekday afternoon after lunch. When we entered, we saw 3-4 staff members in the back and one in the front (busy with other customers to the side). We tried waving to get their attention, but they kept chatting amongst themselves. My friend had to call out to them to buy cake, and only then did a staff member, who looked like a chef in a white uniform, come running over.😅
We ordered three pieces of cake and a decaf Americano. The decaf coffee was strong and satisfying, with syrup provided separately. The lemon cake was delicious, with a refreshing sourness. The chocolate cake was rich, with what seemed like jam inside, but the chocolate flavor overpowered it. The last one, a red dome cake, was something we didn't really like. It felt like foam on the outside, and the inside was sour. It was the sweetest of the three. In summary, they were edible.
P.S. Every time I've been there before, the staff have been cheerful and provided good service from the moment we entered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyaraht Chi

sample_reviews_en.text: “Khao Chae” is a very popular Thai menu during hot summer that you must try. Every year leading Thai restaurants always serve it as special menu for only a few months. Here this menu is very authentic and delicious. It always be served as a set menu; with a bowl of jasmine rice to be filled icy-cold floral fragrant water to cool down the heat and specific dried & fried finger food dishes only for this menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: nisakorn masunthasuwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Always my favorite ❤️☺️❤️❤️❤️❤️
For more than a decade. The very best pastry ❤️ Spinach quiche ❤️ ham&cheese croissant 🥐 Thin apple pie. Many macarons flavors. If I got a time to sit in quick bite pastry with nice tea like Mariage Freres try Marco Polo. They also have it for sale. Great service and polite as usual.
sample_reviews_en.author: ꈍöꈍ

sample_reviews_en.text: A favourite place whenever we are in Bangkok. Located in the centrally-located, busy Siam Paragon shopping Centre, this is usually a haven of calm. Very good coffee, cakes and pastries, friendly and efficient service. A little expensive perhaps but excellent value for money. Wheelchair accessible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew S

sample_reviews_en.text: The food on the second floor is delicious and cheap, perfect for those who want to save money. You can have a filling meal for 40 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bsunetra Busayaperapak

restaurants.address:

ปาก Pracha Songkhro 22 Alley, ดินแดง Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to buy from them a lot when the guy and his tomboy partner were selling together 1-2 years ago. Now I'm delivering the food myself. I don't know what time the shop opens, but whenever I get an order around 12:30 PM, I arrive at the shop in 5 minutes. The shop hasn't even started preparing anything yet. They should probably open the app once everything is ready. I've received orders around this time 3-4 times now. The foreign customers who order through the app don't complain about the cook, they complain about the delivery person saying their order took too long and it's still not ready. 😮‍💨😞
sample_reviews_en.author: Sattaya Kanhawan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef burger is delicious. The beef is of excellent quality for the price, and they give you a generous portion. The sauce is tasty, and it's a very filling, satisfying meal. It's served piping hot.

The fried chicken and cheese burger is also great. The chicken is perfectly fried, with crispy skin and tender, steaming hot meat inside. The cheese is gooey and the sauce is rich and flavorful.

Open 24 hours.
Highly recommend trying it.

They also accept BTC.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonphun Kosta

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Burgest burgers are genuinely hilarious and surprisingly delicious. The pork is substantial, not just a tiny bit of pork; the chicken is substantial too. Both are juicy and intensely flavorful. The chicken buns are thin and crispy with tons of meat. If you're near the University of the Thai Chamber of Commerce, don't forget to stop by! 🤩🤩👍🏻

That whole street must have Bitcoin Lightning accepted throughout! LOL
sample_reviews_en.author: Liew BoonyanuchW.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I happened to stop by this restaurant because I was hungry.
Price: Add cheese and a fried egg to the basic price, and it's only 80 baht.
Taste: The fries and burgers are delicious.
There's a separate seating area, so you can choose between takeout or eat-in.
You absolutely must try the fries.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minsama

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was here just to help out a fellow bitcoiner business owner. But surprise with the quality of the food. They are really great. The location is less than desirable to my like though. But they make up with the good service.

TLDR; i recommend it. Especially to anyone who love hamburgers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warut Wattana-anan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered a burger. It was ok. I was expecting to get a chicken breast but it was possibly a leg. There was a lot of skin and a dough not much  meat. I really liked the sauce, lettuce was fresh, egg was ok.  Would I order again?
Unfortunately most likely not.
sample_reviews_en.author: M “A” K

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a pork and beef burger, I needed some farang food and it really hit the spot. He toasted the buns, the burgers were cooked extremely well and all the extra sauces and salads he added was a nice touch. Very clean highly recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: Maddy Swann

sample_reviews_en.text: First time trying burgers and fries from this place and let me tell you, it was an amazing meal. The patties were great quality meat, fresh vegetables, yummy sauce, and soft and tasteful buns! 10/10!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pete P.

restaurants.name: 海味 Umi BKK at Velaa
restaurants.address:

87 Soi Langsuan, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Umi BKK at Velaa has a new course to recommend for those who don't have much time but still want to enjoy a complete and delicious omakase experience. This course from Umi Bangkok is perfect. We recommend dining with Chef Pu. All dishes use premium ingredients, freshly imported from Toyosu Fish Market, Japan 🇯🇵 the world’s most renowned seafood market.

The Shorter Omakase Course, priced at 2,800++ THB, includes 12 courses: 3 tsumami, 6 sushi, soup, tamagoyaki, and dessert. It takes less than an hour to enjoy, yet still provides the full omakase experience.

The ingredients are excellent, the sushi rice is perfectly seasoned, and there are many interesting pieces such as Matsukawa Karei, Shima Aji, Aji, Ama Ebi, Akami, and Anago. I personally loved the Ankimo (shrimp) because of its creamy, melt-in-your-mouth texture.

For those who want to enjoy omakase but don't want a long meal, this course is a great option. And if you're still hungry, you can order additional à la carte dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Enjoyvips

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everyone talks about how good the service is. Let me tell you exactly how good it is.

Walked from Chit Lom station, and it started raining halfway. We had an umbrella, but as the rain got heavier, we got completely drenched.

When we talked in, we were shown to our seats. The young lady immediately placed a cup with paper towels in front of us for us to pat ourselves dry.

Not long after, she came out with a brand new shirt, and offered it to us to change out if our clothes that was dripping wet.

I felt very touched by the kindness the staff have shown us.

The chef was also very good, and very professional.
The food prepared was delicious, and the ingredients used were very fresh.

We visited the Sukhumvit outlet previously, and added on a piece of uni gunkan due to how fresh and creamy the uni was.
This time round, we did the exact same thing as the uni was exceptional as well.

We look forward to visiting this outlet again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Donnavan Loh

sample_reviews_en.text:
My favorite Japanese restaurant! 🍣✨

The service is exceptional—the staff are warm, attentive, and make every visit feel special. It’s an omakase experience, so it’s definitely pricier than a typical Japanese restaurant, but every course is thoughtfully prepared and well worth it.

The location is fantastic, and every dish lets the quality of the ingredients shine. The sushi rice is perfectly seasoned, allowing the fresh fish to take center stage.

My absolute favorites were the uni and the silky egg custard—they were simply outstanding. And ending the meal with the charcoal ice cream was the perfect finale. A truly unforgettable dining experience that I’ll happily return to again and again

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Kegani Omakase Course at UMI Velaa is an exceptional showcase of craftsmanship and premium Hokkaido crab. Each of the 14 courses highlights the natural sweetness and delicate texture of kegani, prepared with remarkable precision.

From the first bite of perfectly picked crab meat to the stunning charcoal kissed kegani dish topped with ikura the balance of flavor and technique is outstanding. The uni topped crab sushi is especially memorable rich, buttery, and beautifully harmonious.

sample_reviews_en.text: Saffron Indian Restaurant near Glow Pattaya Hotel is an absolute gem and easily deserves five stars! The food here is authentic, flavorful, and freshly made, capturing the real essence of Indian cuisine. Their menu is extensive, offering both vegetarian and non vegetarian delights. Signature dishes like bataka pauwa, aloo paratha, egg paratha, and chhole bhature are full of homely flavors. The dal makhani, paneer saag, bhindi, and roti are perfectly cooked and highly recommended. For something unique, try their famous dal baati paired with refreshing masala chhash a true taste of India. They also serve fried rice, egg fried rice, and club sandwiches, giving more variety for all tastes. To finish, their tea is the perfect comforting touch. The staff are warm, attentive, and always ready with suggestions. With its cozy ambiance and incredible flavors, this restaurant is a must visit in Pattaya for authentic Indian dining!

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had an amazing experience at Saffron East Indian Food here in Ban Thai Wat Khot, Thailand. This place truly became my go-to spot during my stay. I was here for five days, and honestly, I came twice a day that alone says everything about how good it is!

The food quality is consistently excellent. Every meal was fresh, flavorful, and prepared with great attention to detail. Whether it was breakfast or dinner, the taste and presentation were always impressive.

What really stands out is the exceptional staff. They are welcoming, attentive, and genuinely care about their guests. The service is smooth, professional, and always delivered with a smile.

If you’re anywhere near Ban Thai Wat Khot, this place is a must-visit. Fantastic food, outstanding service, and a warm atmosphere every single time. Highly recommended!

The staff is incredibly polite, attentive, and makes you feel welcome from the moment you step in.Whether you’re a local or a tourist looking for a genuine Indian dining experience, Saffron is a must-visit. sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is good. They offer both à la carte (priced per plate) and buffet options. I ate until I was stuffed, and the price was still less than the buffet price. It's decent, I'd give it a thumbs up.

The à la carte dishes are priced from 19-119 baht, but the buffet is 699+ baht, not including service charge, tax, and drinks. I estimate it would be around 750+ baht including everything, but the day I went, I ate until I was completely full and it only cost 650 baht. It was okay, the taste was good. The seaweed wrapping the rice was very fragrant. The miso soup was sweet with dried fish, but it didn't have seaweed, tofu, or mushrooms – just plain miso soup. The beef rice bowl was also good, with a sweet sauce. The ingredients for the sushi rolls were fresh. Green tea is refillable. In short, I ate until I was full. It felt like sitting at a conveyor belt sushi restaurant, but they don't really put things on the conveyor belt; they focus more on having you order. This is good because the food on the belt gets cold, so fresh food tastes better. There are comics to read to kill time. The restaurant is small, but not too crowded. Overall, it's okay. Worth a try if you have the chance.
