sample_reviews_th.text:
I visited the นิตยาไก่ย่าง branch at Thanya Park and was quite pleased with my experience. The taste is consistent with other branches I’ve tried, offering the same delicious and flavorful grilled chicken. The food was cooked to perfection, and the side dishes like the Som Tum complemented the meal well.

The cleanliness and professionalism of the service were excellent. The restaurant had a cozy, traditional Thai ambiance, which added to the dining experience. The decor is simple yet welcoming, and the staff were attentive and friendly.

If you’re looking for reliable Thai food with authentic flavors, I’d recommend this branch. Consistency, good taste, and excellent service make it a great spot for family meals or casual dining.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sukawat Keratimanoch

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm extremely disappointed with the staff. They took my order incorrectly, and even after it was served, it was obvious it was wrong. I asked them to double-check, and they insisted it was correct. Only after tasting it did I realize it was definitely wrong. I even called another staff member to confirm the order, and only then was I certain it was the wrong dish. Even when the staff member came to talk to me, they claimed I ordered incorrectly and that the restaurant couldn't make it that way, despite everything I said when they served it. I understand that miscommunication can happen, but serving a papaya salad with dried shrimp and a clear orange sauce—clearly Thai style—and calling it fermented fish sauce papaya salad is unacceptable. The restaurant needs training on menu understanding and how to handle customer issues. If they had paid more attention to the customer, they would have noticed and double-checked. But they didn't seem to care. I know mistakes happen, but what really bothered me was the staff's lack of responsibility and inability to properly handle customers. This is what made me extremely disappointed with the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: tw Pgn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the glass noodle casserole with shrimp, and it was terrible. It was greasy, bland, and I couldn't finish it, so I had to take the leftovers home. I called a waiter to pack it up, but when they brought it to the table, there was no dipping sauce. I asked for some, and the waiter said they had to use the leftover sauce from my table for the takeaway and wouldn't give me new sauce. That was awful and very disappointing. They were so stingy with the dipping sauce!

I've never encountered a restaurant like this before – taking the old sauce from my table and giving me a new one. Other restaurants always give you fresh sauce.
And the dipping sauce they did give me was minimal – just a tiny bowl for a large plate of shrimp that was also bland and not tasty.

The bill came to 1,300 baht for three people. The price is high, but the service was terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phenny Penne

sample_reviews_en.text: The service system is terrible, like they can only do one thing at a time. There are too few staff members. When you call a staff member, they turn their heads away. I called to reserve a day in advance. When I arrived, the water was slow to arrive, and they served one table while another wasn't. The rice wasn't cooked properly and they didn't inform me. By the time the rice arrived, the side dishes were all gone. The service was inconsistent; one table got what they wanted, another didn't. The bill even showed extra side dishes. I brought elderly people to eat here and it was a very disappointing experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: กุลนาถ สําเนียงนวล

sample_reviews_en.text:
I liked the grilled chicken; the skin was juicy and tender, just like in the picture. It was well marinated.
I ordered the Nam Prik Num (spicy chili paste) set (it took a while to arrive and I had to follow up on the food), but it was delicious.
For dessert, the Lod Chong (rice noodle dessert) was chewy and the Tub Tim Krob (crispy water chestnut dessert) was delicious.

My suggestion is for the service to be more cheerful and for the food to be served a little faster.
I was happy to use your service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sivapoj R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very clean and spacious place to enjoy a nice meal in a relaxing environment. Staff are well mannered and ready to assist and serve, the minute you walk in, with a smile.
Large menu containing a large selection of specialty items including signature dishes, be it chicken or seafood. Drinks and desserts are also available.
Prices are slightly higher than average, but still considered in the normal range.
All that we ordered came to the table fairly quickly, and all were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch is delicious. The Tom Yum soup is rich and flavorful, the fried larb is great, the chicken is as good as always, and the Som Tum Pa (spicy papaya salad) is ordered with 2 chilies (because I don't eat much spicy food), but next time I might need to add 3. The grilled pork neck is also good but a bit fatty. For dessert, I recommend the coconut ice cream.
P.S. Parking is convenient right in front of the store, perfect for seniors as it's not a long walk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hi I'm Chucky i wanna playyy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Introducing coconut ice cream!
I ordered it through the app.
Half a kilo, served in a box, scooped with a spoon.
The taste is light, cool, and refreshing.
There are a few pieces of coconut flesh to chew on.
The texture is nice and you can keep eating it. Not too sweet.
It comes with peanuts to sprinkle on top.

It has a feel of old-fashioned ice cream that's hard to find elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bewara Forday

sample_reviews_th.text: It tasted just like home-cooked food, and the prices were very reasonable. Prices start at 20฿. I thought the portions would be small, but they were huge! My sister and I were so full we couldn't eat anymore.

There were small pieces of chili pepper on the plate, but the younger male staff members served it without even looking. The dipping sauces were delicious. However, the wait was a bit long, about 10-15 minutes, for the food to be cooked and served. Please consider improving your staff's service. This is genuine feedback. Also, the owner, I'm not sure, was talking loudly over the customers' heads.

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend this place! The pork hot pot broth is incredibly flavorful, and it's only 20 baht per bowl. The rice porridge is good, and for side dishes, I recommend the omelet with preserved radish, and other dishes are also delicious. Overall, the taste is great, and it's super close to my condo! I'll definitely be back. The staff are lovely and provide excellent service. The music is pleasant too. 👍👍👍

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup was delicious, the aroma was noticeable from the moment it was placed in front of me. They provided three types of dipping sauces: spicy, seafood, and sukiyaki. All were delicious, the seafood sauce was a little too sour. Overall, the food was delicious and affordable. Highly recommended! 😋😋✨✨

sample_reviews_en.text: I like the broth of the pork hot pot; it's sweet and delicious. The prices are friendly and it's a community-friendly place. The rice porridge is very cheap at 2 baht, and the side dishes taste just right. I'm satisfied with both the price and the quantity.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakorn Trongtong

sample_reviews_en.text: We love the pork hot pot so much! The spicy salad is also delicious. The prices are very affordable, only 20 baht per plate for the pork hot pot. Importantly, the vendors are lovely and the waitstaff provide excellent service. It's a winner!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonticha Khongpramot

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is affordably priced and tastes absolutely delicious! It came out quickly, the staff provided excellent service, and requests were fulfilled promptly. I was very impressed. Anyone passing by or stopping in should definitely try it!

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is average, commensurate with the price. I'd like them to improve the way they check the meat before serving. The overall atmosphere is good. In summary, I went for two but ended up with leftovers. They give generous portions.

sample_reviews_en.text: I had an amazing experience at this hot pot restaurant in Pattaya. The ingredients were incredibly fresh, and there was a great variety of meats, seafood, and vegetables to choose from. The broth was rich and flavorful, making every bite delicious. The staff were friendly, attentive, and always ready to help. The atmosphere was cozy and perfect for a relaxing meal with friends or family. I would definitely come back again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Richkas Polies

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for an authentic Sichuan kick in Pattaya, Yi Hotpot is a must-visit. The dual-pot setup is perfect—one side is a numbing, spicy Mala broth packed with dried chilies that really brings the heat, while the other is a soothing herbal broth with jujubes and mushrooms that balances everything out. The ingredients were fresh, and the marbled beef held the flavors of the soup beautifully. A great spot for a slow, flavorful dinner!
sample_reviews_en.author: 兴

sample_reviews_en.text: At first glance there were no customers at all in the whole shop which give me doubt of the quality of food but after trying I can say it’s very good hotpot! Soup base was rich and tasty, a bit salty but still it’s very good. Portion were also quite reasonable. Overall very good hotpot after a night out of drinking

Would love to visit again.

sample_reviews_en.text: Don’t hesitate to stop here for lunch or dinner after exploring Chatuchak, or even just to escape the heat or seasonal rains which is how I stopped by on this visit. They have open air (fan cooled) and air conditioned tables so there’s something for everyone, with delicious food and if you time the visit right, happy hour and live music. It’s a restaurant suitable for everyone.

sample_reviews_en.text: Toh-Plue is so good!! From the service down to the presentation is top tier, we got to seat in the airconditioned room, really helped beat the tiredness and the heat from outside, for the ones that really likes fusion and unique tastes with getting the bang for your buck.

A completely new experience!
- I placed a pre-order online through this shop's website at 9:10 AM (for 12:00 PM delivery).
- What the shop did was... deliver at 2:00 PM!!!! They said they had a lot of orders!!!! (The only reason they delivered was after I called to rush them. If I hadn't called, they probably would have delivered at 3:00 PM. Sigh 🙄)
- And they were out of thick and soft crust! 555555+ (I ordered 5 thick, but got 2 thick and 3 thin) ---> Pre-ordering doesn't help at all. Sigh.

>>> Excuse me, but I ordered in advance at 9:10 AM. Is it fair to push my order to the back of the queue, delaying it by 2 hours from the delivery time???? 🙄🙄🙄 And they were out of stock too!

Thank you for this experience. I won't be ordering from them again.

The delivery was poorly done. The condition was unbelievable. I couldn't believe they had driven so far. The boxes were crushed and stuck to both pizza toppings. There was sauce all over the bag, probably chicken sauce. Half a bottle of Coke had already spewed out when I opened it. I informed the restaurant and they said they would fix it. That was all they could do to apologize. They said they would have the delivery person call to apologize, but they never called.
If you don't want to sell, then close the restaurant.

sample_reviews_en.text: Must-try Indian food in Bangkok. They're right in W District (Phra Khanong) but they also deliver via the usual apps if you don't feel like going out. The curries are really, really nice and the garlic naan is excellent. I'm also a big fan of their paneer 65 and gulab jamun. The food is good value for money as well. In addition, you get great service when you call their listed number or use their official LINE--super friendly, helpful, and effective, and they speak both Thai and English. Highly recommended!

sample_reviews_en.text:
Got there by accident, just crossing for errands.  Saw the place and decided to try.   I got an extremely delicious mouton vandaloo.   Aloe mattar, rice, bread.
Everything was clean, tasty.  Rice was cold little bit, but that wasn't decisive, still edible.
Mohamed who takes orders etc... Was very nice and helpful.   Great place.   I will definitely order from them now, i know they exist.
Will

sample_reviews_en.text: I think they must be using the same menus from the first time I visited around three or four years ago. They are so grainy that it actually made my hands feel unclean to touch the menu. I left without ordering. By the way I'm not a huge germaphobe, just maybe they could replace the menus every year or two, is that asking so much?
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan Siekman

sample_reviews_en.text: Just had a lovely Indian meal at Breads and Curries in W District’s lovely outdoor food court at Phra Khanong bts stop. I had the butter paneer which was wonderfully tasty and my husband had the lamb rogan josh. Again very flavourful and perfectly spiced. Will definitely be eating here again.

Today we visited their stall in wdistrict and tried their beef sheek kabab and chicken 65 which were so delicious. On top of this amazing food their service was top notch as well. Surely would go back again!

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious; I've eaten there many times. That day, I took my girlfriend and her sister. Normally, someone takes your order, but that day they made us write it down ourselves. My girlfriend did, and I didn't pay much attention until my girlfriend said the staff member said she couldn't read it and seemed to be using a translation app on their phone. She was confused why they didn't ask instead of just saying "I can't read it," and then implying "you made a mistake." My girlfriend and I both work in service, and I understand that not all customers have perfect handwriting. However, they should have asked, not just said that. It made a big deal for my girlfriend and me. The staff member even used a translation app on their phone to translate the order my girlfriend had written. Asking politely wouldn't have been so rude.
sample_reviews_en.author: Korakid

sample_reviews_en.text: Extremely slow service. I walked in, ordered, and waited 20 minutes. A staff member came to ask if I'd ordered, and I said yes, repeating the order. Another 10 minutes passed, and they asked again what I ordered and when I ordered. After a while, two staff members looked confused and argued, saying they hadn't received my order. I waited until tables that arrived before me had already left, and tables that came after me, full and already served their food. In total, I waited almost 40 minutes. There was no apology or sign of responsibility whatsoever. They only accept cash. If you're planning to come with a large group, be prepared for a long wait. This is probably the best the restaurant can do.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratch

sample_reviews_en.text:
This late-night noodle restaurant offers a bright, clean atmosphere with a variety of noodle and soup options to choose from. While the tom yum I ordered was delicious, it wasn't particularly special, and I found the soup to be too sweet. The servers were polite and the food was served quickly. The price range is reasonable (65-75 THB).

The only downside is the lack of parking; I had to park at the bus stop in front of the restaurant. Since it was late at night (1:30 AM), it wasn't a big issue, but it could be disappointing during the day.

Despite this, I'll definitely come back to try other soups they have to offer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawit Chirayukool

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time eating at this restaurant after living in On Nut for three years. I noticed it was open late and always had a lot of people passing by.
I tried it and the food was delicious, but the service was not great. The staff were rude and didn't seem very welcoming. No matter how delicious the food is, if the service isn't great, it's not that great.

I told to waiter and they took the food and just give me back with the bowl that is looks really dirty and the noodle is still the same . Also the taste is not usual and it’s not good at all. Overall the service was really bad . Never again.

I'm definitely stopping eating at MK.
I had a similar experience at Fuji. We sat down at a table, and no one came to take our order. We called for them, but they just walked past to take orders from other tables that had just sat down. We waited for 3 minutes, then our whole table left. I've never eaten at Fuji again.
Black Canyon is the same way. The staff don't see customers sitting at tables and don't come to take orders. I've stopped going to Black Canyon too. There are plenty of other restaurants to eat at.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wimon Jaroenwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The MK Suki restaurant at The Mall Ngamwongwan has two sections. The section next to the escalator going down is the newer section, which has more spacious and comfortable seating than the old section. The food quality at MK Suki is fresh and delicious, similar to all other branches, but the service from the staff on this section isn't as good as it should be.
Currently, MK has a promotion on their braised pork broth, which is similar to the broth at Mani Mee Pot, but the taste is better because it's not too salty.
MK Suki is a good restaurant that offers suki, crispy pork, roasted pork, and à la carte dishes similar to a typical Chinese restaurant. They also have dim sum during lunchtime.
The prices at MK Suki are mostly reasonable, although some items are overpriced, such as fresh vegetables.
sample_reviews_en.author: K. Wangvitayakun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I took Mayo to MK The Mall Ngamwongwan. It was delicious!

MK has a new promotional menu: Duo Soup. It includes Kimchi Soup and Kurobuta Pork Soup with collagen. One set is 399 baht, but two sets are 699 baht. We ordered two sets, one original and one Kurobuta.

Kimchi Soup - Slightly spicy, a little sour, just right.
Kurobuta Soup - Tastes creamy, similar to Tom Kha but not spicy.

The sets include both vegetables and meat. Some items are only available during promotions. The Kurobuta pork was tender and delicious. The meatballs were also firm and tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakda Dulyachart

sample_reviews_en.text: I often eat at this branch because it's close to home. It's clean, and the staff provides excellent service and always recommends great promotions. What impressed me the most, and prompted me to write this review, was when I accidentally dropped my wallet at the restaurant. The staff tried every possible way to contact me, and finally reached me after a week (at the time, I didn't realize I had lost my wallet because I was sick and feeling a bit out of it). I commend their kindness and dedication. Thank you so much!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanutchaporn n.

sample_reviews_en.text:
No matter what, I always choose MK because of the freshness and cleanliness. Now they have a variety of soup bases to choose from, but I still stick with the Original.
Even though they have set menus, since there are two of us, I prefer to order individual items because if we ordered a set, I think we wouldn't be able to finish it all again 😂
There were a lot of customers and a lot of staff. We didn't receive all of our orders, some items didn't arrive, and some items that did arrive...we didn't order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Goodluck Dhepp

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is spacious, the wait time isn't too long, and the food is served quickly. It was during a festival evening, so it got very crowded and the duck and crispy pork were sold out, but other dishes were just as delicious.

The desserts are equally delicious, with many options to choose from, including sticky rice balls in coconut milk, water chestnut jelly, and shaved ice – a refreshing way to end the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayuth Mangmesap

sample_reviews_en.text: I just realized my phone was missing this morning. I think I must have left it at MK yesterday. I contacted them and received excellent assistance. The branch had kept it for me, and I've already picked it up. I want to thank all the staff at MK The Mall Ngamwongwan branch for their honesty and dedication to their duties. They made me feel safe and secure when using their services. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: 2MT

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is as delicious as ever.
However,
the service at this branch is quite slow.
The service is inconsistent.
I ordered bottled water first.
I had to ask for it twice.
I waited about 30 minutes for the water.

The tea ran out, and I had to keep calling staff to refill it.
Even after calling, I had to call again.
Then I had to wait a while longer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yaowalove Review

restaurants.name: Black Peper Steak พระราม 2
restaurants.address:

MC6Q+RVM, Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Black Pepper Steak 🥩 A roadside steak stall starting at 59 baht. Open late, until 11 PM.

🍝 Spicy Seafood Spaghetti 89 baht. The flavor is spicy and hot, perfect for Thai taste buds. The shrimp are huge, there's plenty of squid, and lots of mushrooms. I loved it!
🧅 Onion Rings 59 baht. 10 large pieces. Delicious and worth the price.
🥟 Gyoza 49 baht. 5 large pieces. I thought the taste was just average.
🧊 Blue Hawaiian Drink. Sweet with a hint of sourness and a slight fizz. A good way to cut through the richness of the onion rings.

Location📍 Along Rama 2 Road (next to Big C Rama 2)
🚘 Parking available behind the shop.

🙏 Thank you all ♥️
For clicking "Follow"!

YouTube 🎬 Paopao Studio
TikTok 🎙️ Paopao Studio
Wongnai 🍭 Paopao Studio
sample_reviews_en.author: Paopao Studio

sample_reviews_en.text: This roadside stall looks so cool 🤣 and their fried food is amazing! The fried food is the best! The french fries are thick, soft, and crispy on the outside, soft on the inside. On my first visit, I ordered the BBQ ribeye steak. Personally, I found the sauce a bit sweet and not very spicy, but the meat was a large, tender, and not dry. I also tried the chicken set and the chicken karaage. I saw they have giant-sized dishes on the menu, perfect for content creators or groups of friends. They also have drinks and toast. Go try it! 😋🥩🥗
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratchanok Merl

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very good, but the service is not okay. I went three times and all three times the same thing happened. No staff came to serve me, and I had to get the menu myself each time, even though the staff were sitting around playing on their phones! They didn't take my order; I had to call them every time, even though they were free and not busy with other customers. Other steak restaurants, even when full, have much better service. Please improve this aspect of your service.
sample_reviews_en.author: อรพิมพ์ ปริลุน

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there twice. The first time was great, but the second time was awful. The waitress, a tomboyish girl, completely ignored me. Not only did I order, but she didn't send the bill to the kitchen. If another tomboyish girl hadn't asked if it was my bill, I would have just been waiting. It was so confusing. I waited for my food for ages; I went from not being hungry to extremely irritated. And I didn't even get an apology from her.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kantasuda Tumkhunnui

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here based on a TikTok review and it was delicious! The chicken was tender and flavorful, the pork was also tender and fragrant from the marinade. The corn soup was creamy and delicious. Importantly, the price was affordable, as shown in the picture, it was only 219 baht. This is definitely a steak restaurant I'll be back to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ton Saksit

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the meat was very tender, a little too fatty. The marinade was tasty, we liked it. However, as you eat more and the oil comes out of the meat, there's a lot of black pepper. Reducing the amount of pepper a little would be perfect. We'll definitely come back again. Everything was good and the taste was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: SUJITRA PHUIWPNG

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! This dish cost a little over 400 baht. It was enough for two people and very filling. The taste was great, and the atmosphere was chill, sitting by the roadside with a cool breeze. The staff provided good service, and the food came out quickly. Overall, I really liked it and will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwang Per

sample_reviews_en.text: The salad was delicious, the mushroom soup was okay. I ordered the black pepper pork steak. The steak looked black in the picture, and it was indeed black. It was very spicy and salty. Even after scraping off the pepper, it was still salty and spicy. I wasn't very impressed, but the meat was tender and not thick.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutty 07

restaurants.name: Chang An Restaurant
restaurants.address:

315/601-606 Sathu Pradit 19 Alley, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't usually eat Chinese food, but I went because it was near my hotel. The restaurant is clean and spacious. The two stir-fried noodle dishes were delicious, the fried rice and mapo tofu were decent, and the first dish on the sign, the vegetable and minced pork, was also good. I wanted a soup dish, so I ordered a soup with pork meatballs, tofu, and cabbage, but it was tasteless. It felt like it was boiled in plain water without using any broth.

--

It has been a while since I went, and the food is still good. However, I ordered a chicken dish, but they switched the meat to pork. It is common sense to either not take an order if they are out of ingredients or to ask for understanding in advance. It is best not to go to places you cannot trust.
sample_reviews_en.author: jinwoo park

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are a lot of Chinese restaurants in Bangkok now, aren't there? 🇨🇳
There are a lot of them, but they're often bland or too spicy... 🥵
I've never really found a Chinese restaurant that I like. 🚶🏻‍♀️🚶🏻‍♀️‍➡️🚶🏻‍♀️🚶🏻‍♀️‍➡️
But Coco Chang'an is a rare place where everything tastes delicious and suits Japanese palates. 🫵🏻🧏🏻‍♀️
It's also reasonably priced. 💸

Please check it out if you have the time. 🚙💨
There's parking. 🅿️
sample_reviews_en.author: PEARL

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, freshly stir-fried, and authentic – just like eating at a restaurant in China. Recommended dishes include: Salt and Pepper Chicken, Crispy Pork, Tomato and Egg Stir-fry, and Bitter Gourd Salad. The food is reasonably priced and offers great value for money. It's conveniently located with parking available. The staff provided excellent service, and the restaurant was clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Spa Born Academy

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Chinese restaurant is just a three-minute walk from my house.
Everything I order is delicious; it's easily the best Chinese food I've had in Thailand so far.
The fried dishes are crispy and the stir-fried dishes are perfectly salted.
I don't have a hangover the next day and I want to eat it again the next day.
I want to try everything on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: KOICHI MIYANAGA

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an excellent Chinese restaurant. We ordered six different dishes, and everything tasted amazing. The ingredients were fresh, portions were generous, and the food was cooked very quickly. The staff was friendly. I highly recommend trying this restaurant if you're in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trey B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Chinese food.
The taste might be a bit too Chinese.
Some dishes are quite oily.
It depends on personal preference, but overall it's delicious. The staff provides excellent and attentive service. The prices are mid-range, standard for a Chinese restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: sally cha

sample_reviews_en.text:
The portions were huge and the food was delicious! It felt like I was eating in China...
The restaurant was spacious, clean, and had a great atmosphere...
I loved it and will definitely come back to try other dishes next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: อรจิรา แซ่เอี้ยว

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, every dish is tasty. I highly recommend coming here. The Yunnan Chinese food is excellent, the prices are good, and the staff provides great service.
I stop by every day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lawan Pookie9999

restaurants.name: ร้านเจ๊ลา ตือฮวนเกี้ยมฉ่าย ต้มเลือดหมู
restaurants.address:

PH95+XCV, Rama IV Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located in an alley, behind both of Auntie Muey's shops. They offer both pickled mustard greens and pork blood soup, priced from 30-50 baht. The pork blood soup includes water spinach and lettuce, with a generous amount of large pieces of offal. The pork is not bitter or smelly, and the kidney is odorless. The portion is generous for the price. The dish in the picture costs 40 baht. There's a separate dipping sauce bowl for you to mix yourself, and iced tea is free.
sample_reviews_en.author: ittipol M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, good ingredients, well-balanced flavor.
Pork blood soup and pork offal soup with pickled mustard greens: regular 45 baht, special 60 baht.
Very cheap, generous portions, great value.
This shop also has pork offal soup with pickled mustard greens, which is hard to find these days. I really like it, it tastes great.
The shop offers crispy pork, minced pork, blood, kidney, stomach, liver, intestines, tongue, and heart. All taste good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Winai Thampornvatee

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are three pork blood soup stalls lined up in a circle here. The taste and price are very similar, so it really depends on individual preference.
Jae La's stall is next to Jae Muey's stall. The broth is smooth and easy to drink, not overly seasoned with MSG. The ingredients at this stall are in large pieces and not chewy. This stall appears cleaner and is cheaper than the other two.
sample_reviews_en.author: DukeTK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jae La's pork blood soup has a mild broth that's very easy to drink. All the ingredients are really fresh, and most importantly, they give you a huge amount of toppings—more than worth the price. It'll keep you full until noon!
The price is affordable, and the rice is just average.
In summary: Generous portions and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ทศพร บ้านกระบก

sample_reviews_en.text: There are probably three or four pork blood soup restaurants in that area. I've tried them all, but I like this one the most because it looks the cleanest. The pork and offal in the stew are very tender. The soup is fragrant with pickled mustard greens. It's very easy to drink. Eat it with hot steamed rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitti Khong (Jiib)

sample_reviews_en.text: Jae La's shop, near Khlong Toei market, serves pork blood soup, clear broth noodle soup, and pork offal soup. The special portion is very filling, with large pieces of meat. Tea is available, and seating is provided.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิชัย แตงอ่อน

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and worth the price. The soup is not as fragrant as the shop next door. It depends on the person's preference. But they give a lot of ingredients. The internal organs are good and don't smell fishy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Voravut Klomdee

sample_reviews_en.text: Pork blood soup with pickled mustard greens. Excellent service. The vendors were kind and even added extra pickled mustard greens. They also offered me some fruit for the offering ceremony.
sample_reviews_en.author: Navaporn Luengluepunya

restaurants.name: Tamnak Isan Ekamai
restaurants.address:

86/1 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I eat here once or twice a week every time I'm in Bangkok (fourth-year visit). I'm not sure how many dishes we have tasted (photos are just of the last two visits), but they are always well prepared and presented, and there are also always a pleasant surprise, taste wise. They offer an extensive menu, and never fail, which is hard to do. All the staff is very welcoming and friendly, although we don't speak Thai. Prices are honest, and the ratio quality/price is excellent. Can you ask for something else?

They also prepare a delicious homemade chilli sauce, which this year I will definitely bring back to Barcelona with me.

Update 2026, it continues to be as good as always!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: JUAN GALEANO

sample_reviews_en.text:
We found this space because we were looking for an alternative place that sells deep fried duck tongue.

We tried Tom yum soup, raw shrimp
Salad, deep fried fish, deep fried duck tongue, grilled beef, papaya salad, bamboo shoots, morning glory. All good! Satisfactory meal with a decent price tag, in a lovely clean environment. We also ordered sticky rice cuz we wondered how it’ll go with savoury dishes and it was good! It soaked up the sauces and gravy, added a chewy bite to the sauce experience.

Will come back and try more of their other dishes and back for more duck tongue!
sample_reviews_en.author: Verena Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a local restaurant. The prices are affordable, the food is delicious, and the portions are generous. Since it is a typical local eatery, it is not particularly clean or fancy, but considering it is a local spot, it is decent.

I had the pork fried rice, and the portion was huge. I especially loved that it had a lot of meat.

The staff are friendly, and many Koreans visit this place.

Pork fried rice is 120 baht, and drinks are 30 baht.

I was unable to pay using the GLN QR code. However, I was able to pay with a credit card.
sample_reviews_en.author: Botacu

sample_reviews_en.text:
definitely one of my fave go-to places for lunch every year.
love the mama noodles 😛 first time trying their green curry with chicken and it’s pretty good too.
a little on the spicy side so if you don’t take spicy food well, do remember to request for less spicy.
food was served rather quickly as well.
not a big fan of the honey lemon drink. too sour for my liking. can’t taste the honey.
price point seems a little pricey for 2. given that we only ordered 1 (or is it considered 2?) main dish with 2 drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: S

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't specify the spiciness level, but the som tam was on the sweeter side, with a crisp texture and a refreshing taste. The enoki mushroom larb was a little spicy. It went well with the sticky rice. The gai yang was made only with thigh meat, well seasoned and tender. There's a famous restaurant nearby, so I tend to go there, but if you want to eat som tam or larb as your main dish, this place might be better?
sample_reviews_en.author: 2pong

sample_reviews_en.text: Great little restaurant with friendly people. My prawn pad thai was delicious. You could really taste the fresh ingredients. Perfectly seasoned and nicely spicy, just the way it should be. If we'd had another day in Bangkok, I would have gone back the very next day to try another dish. Unfortunately, we didn't have the time. The prices are more than fair for such great quality. You absolutely have to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Zvone Ba

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a large papaya salad and ate it all by myself. It seemed like a good, clean meal. Even for someone who can handle spicy food, it was a bit spicy.
Many people said it was cheap, but it wasn't that cheap. Mine was 195 baht.
The som tam was 75 baht, and the green curry was around 165 baht. There are many cheaper options, so it felt like a mid-priced option.
sample_reviews_en.author: 슬지이

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was drawn in by the word “Isan” in the name, but this turned out to be one of the worst larb moo dishes I’ve ever had. The waiting was long, even though I was the only customer in the restaurant. The larb was swimming in liquid. It was also served without the usual cabbage and fresh herbs that normally come with the dish.
I won’t be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dmitry

restaurants.name: Veraviet restaurant เวลาเวียด
restaurants.address:

Thon Buri Plaza, 4 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Talat Phlu, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Craving Vietnamese food in the Rama III area? This restaurant is less than 20 minutes away, and it's fantastic! There were three of us, and we ordered five dishes, plus drinks and dessert. It cost one 100-baht note and one 200-baht note.
The Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) was easy to eat because the vegetables and rice paper were already pre-packaged, ready to add the filling – very convenient, I loved it! The fried spring rolls used the same wrapper as the Nem Nuong. The beef pho had a good broth and tender beef. The steamed rice rolls had soft wrappers, but the dipping sauce was a little mild, so we tried the pickled vegetables from another dish, which was a good match. The Vietnamese crepe had a slightly thick batter. We were going to try the Vietnamese pizza, but thought we wouldn't be able to finish it, so we ordered dessert instead. The star fruit ice cream was good, the matcha was decent, and my friend liked the ginger-flavored glutinous rice balls – not too sweet. We were perfectly full. We'll definitely come back again!

There's parking in front of the restaurant if there's space, but you can also go upstairs.
sample_reviews_en.author: KINGKARN S.

sample_reviews_en.text: This Vietnamese restaurant has a very comprehensive menu. They even have ready-to-eat Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage), which I really liked – no need to soak the rice paper wrappers or anything like that yourself. The prices are very reasonable and affordable. There are plenty of staff, and the service is attentive. I especially loved their desserts, especially the ice cream. I highly recommend it! This time, I ordered the rum and dried banana ice cream, which was the first time I'd ever had it, and it was incredibly delicious! I'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiamporn Chaichana

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm deducting a star. The food was delicious, but it wasn't very hot when it arrived, like it had been prepared a while ago but hadn't been served. The food took a very long time to arrive. The service here was unimpressive. The staff just kept wiping tables and didn't make eye contact when called. It took ages to order and ask for the bill. Overall, I'd like to come back because the food is delicious, but I wish they would pay more attention to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimsiri Pam

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time here and it was delicious, but a bit too sweet. The grated radish was extremely sweet. The restaurant is large, air-conditioned, and the service is good. They serve authentic Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage), lotus stem soup, grilled pork wrapped in betel leaves, drip coffee, Banh Xeo (Vietnamese pancake), sago with cantaloupe, and a refreshing, tasty broth.
sample_reviews_en.author: C Wana

sample_reviews_en.text: This small Vietnamese restaurant in the Tha Phra area has been open for a long time but still maintains its delicious standard. They provide plenty of fresh vegetables at reasonable prices. The flavors are well-balanced; the pho soup is slightly sour, and the grilled pork nem nuong is delicious. Overall, it's good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parchaya Veecharungson

sample_reviews_en.text: Whenever I go there, I always order Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage). The ingredients are fresh and the dipping sauce is delicious. If you eat at the restaurant, they prepare the rice paper wrappers for you, ready to eat. The Pho is also delicious, and the food is reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dhanaithorn Tunya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, high quality, and reasonably priced. I've eaten here many times. I especially love the calamansi juice; I order it every time I come!

You can park right in front of the restaurant; the security guards are always there to help.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joy Joice

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the few local Vietnamese restaurants in Bangkok. The food, drinks, and desserts are incredibly delicious and reasonably priced. The food comes out quickly and continuously, and the service from the staff is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jumbo Nucha702

restaurants.name: Mary's Cafe
restaurants.address:

495/1 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mary's Cafe is a bright yellow-themed cafe offering a variety of food and drinks, including easy-to-eat snacks, brunch options, and homemade baked goods made with premium ingredients. They also have a wide selection of board games for everyone to enjoy, from beginners to advanced. You can order drinks, coffee, and food to enjoy in the cafe as it's located in the same area.
I tried the Gateau Dark Chocolate Lava (135 THB), a very rich and delicious chocolate lava cake with fresh fruit for a colorful presentation.
The Americano (100 THB) is a signature drink, a hot Americano made with medium-dark roasted beans and latte art resembling Mount Fuji.
I also had the Pink Lemonade (100 THB), a refreshing sweet and sour drink that's great for cutting through richness.
The Banana Cream Cheese (120 THB) is a homemade banana cake with a soft texture and a fragrant cream cheese frosting.
The cafe is located on Sukhumvit 63, between Ekkamai Soi 21 and 23 (almost reaching Phetchaburi Road). It's open daily from 11:00 AM to 12:00 AM, closed on Mondays. There's parking available next to the cafe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ph031

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a board game cafe with a huge selection of board games... and the best part is there are Game Masters on hand to teach you how to play. The cafe area offers a variety of brunch, lunch, and dinner options, and the food and drinks are delicious.

✨ Recommended Menu Items ✨

🍞 Brioche Brunch
Premium brioche bread topped with ham and scrambled eggs.

🍰 Basque Burnt Cheesecake
Smooth and creamy burnt cheesecake with a delicate sweetness.

🥃 Pink Fresh Milk
A refreshing pink milk drink with a perfect balance of sweetness and creaminess.

🍹 Virgin Mojito
A sweet and sour drink with a cool minty aroma.

💛 GameHaus Board Game Cafe has a massive selection of board games. Whatever genre you're interested in, the Game Masters can recommend something for you. Board game activities are only 60 THB per hour – incredibly good value! Perfect for families or groups of friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: พี่ผัก

sample_reviews_en.text:
This board game cafe in Ekkamai offers a place to play all day without getting bored.
With thousands of board games to choose from, whether you're a serious gamer or a complete beginner, everyone can play comfortably thanks to the friendly Game Masters who will teach you how to play.

The cafe is decorated in a bright yellow tone, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere perfect for long sessions. It's ideal for groups of friends, dates, or any other activities.

They offer a full range of food and drinks, including savory dishes, desserts, and homemade bakery items. The taste exceeds expectations; it's more than just a game cafe, you can have a proper meal here too!

💡 We recommend making a reservation, especially in the evenings or on weekends, as it can get quite crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chin Chinnawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mary's Cafe @marysbakehaus is a cafe that combines cuteness, vibrancy, and the fun of board games. Whether you want to chill out or have a blast playing games with your friends, it's the perfect spot! 🎮 🍰🍵

If you're looking for a place to meet up with friends or do something special with your loved ones, Mary's Cafe is the place to be. It's not just a cafe; it's also a GameHaus Board Game Cafe @gamehaus_board_game_cafe, boasting over 100 board games. Importantly, it's open from morning until midnight, offering brunch, lunch, and dinner – from hearty main courses to light snacks.

We highly recommend trying their homemade desserts, made with carefully selected ingredients and recipes from Le Cordon Bleu. You're guaranteed fresh and delicious treats every time! 🧁🎂
sample_reviews_en.author: PANGZ KOKII

sample_reviews_en.text: Mary's Cafe is a cozy cafe perfect for relaxing, working, or spending time with friends. What I really liked was the wide variety of board games they offer, making time at the cafe very enjoyable. It's ideal for groups or couples looking for something to do together. The interior is charmingly decorated with several seating areas and a friendly atmosphere. They have a good selection of drinks and snacks, making it a comfortable place to chat. Overall, it's a cafe that offers more than just drinks; it also provides a great experience for spending time with friends and family. If you're looking for a place to relax for a long time with some fun activities like board games, this cafe is definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: SunSun T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come chill at Mary's Café, a cozy cafe with everything from brunch 🍳 to desserts 🍰 and board games 🎲.

Mary's Café — A cozy cafe with a full range of food, desserts, and board games! 🎮💕
Perfect for any occasion, whether you're with friends, a significant other, or family, they offer brunch, lunch, dinner, and freshly baked homemade pastries daily. 🍰

The food focuses on comfort food, simple yet stylish, with both large and light dishes that are perfectly balanced. 😋
Desserts created by chefs from Le Cordon Bleu, using premium ingredients, are guaranteed to satisfy your cravings. 🍮

🎲 A wide selection of board games, plenty of photo spots, and a great atmosphere, perfect for a relaxing getaway! 💬
sample_reviews_en.author: Natchanan Pea

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is a cafe, board games, brunch, lunch, and dinner all in one! It was my first time here, and the food was amazing. Everything is made fresh right in front of you. The staff said their recipes were developed from Le Cordon Bleu 🤩 The shop is beautiful, currently decorated in a Christmas theme, which is adorable. The staff are super nice 🥰 You can even bring your food to the board game area and play at the same time – it's so relaxing. Even the more difficult games are explained by the staff, which is fantastic. The restrooms are clean. Before leaving, I bought a ton of board games to take home! 🤭
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakuna Seangphaeng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Halloween Sweets 👻

💫 Mary's Café and Gamehaus Boardgame Café 🎮 A board game café with two zones, decorated in bright yellow, offering both a café and over a thousand board games, along with food, drinks, and homemade desserts made with premium ingredients, catering to everyone!

Today's chosen desserts and drinks include:
⚡️ GRAVEYARD HALLOWEEN CAKE - CARAMEL
💥 GRAVEYARD HALLOWEEN CAKE - THAITEA
🔫 MONSTER CAKE
❕ GHOST LEMON CAKE
BOOGIE MELON SOUR 🐛 💚
POPPING GRAVE 🍇 💜
THE AMERICANO 🖤
sample_reviews_en.author: cameragirl bkk

restaurants.name: 居酒屋 虹
restaurants.address:

178 Sukhumvit Alley 22, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
There were many Japanese people in this area. When I went in and sat down, I saw that the customers on both sides were also Japanese, so I figured the food couldn't be bad.

The price was about mid-range. The portions were generous. The staff would write down the order for you for the hot pot: first the meat, then the vegetables (lots of vegetables, I ate two rounds), and finally the chicken porridge. All the other food was delicious, and the environment was fairly clean. Unfortunately, there's no smoking ban indoors in Thailand, so I was eating while constantly smelling smoke, which made it less than perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julia Cheung

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu offers a wide variety of delicious dishes at reasonable prices, making it a great place to visit like a casual diner. They're happy to make dishes not on the menu, so you'll never get bored. The ramen is surprisingly delicious, which is a mystery. It's cheap and the owner is friendly, so I highly recommend it. The beer is cheap too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nor “Nora” K

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was craving Japanese food, so I happened to go to this restaurant alone around 11 PM, only to find two Japanese men and a female staff member drunk and having a wild party!!! LOL
It was incredibly noisy, so I canceled my reservation.

I'll definitely go again sometime! LOL
sample_reviews_en.author: JJ Katy

sample_reviews_en.text: It tastes awful. There is absolutely nothing good about it. The interior is very noisy, and a female waitress sits at the table. She is screaming and making a complete ruckus. It’s hard for fried food to taste bad, usually.
sample_reviews_en.author: MyungSeok Chae

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and priced similarly to a typical izakaya (Japanese pub).

For a seating fee of 300-400 baht, you can drink and chat with several staff members.

It was a very lively and enjoyable experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mitsuhirp Takaki

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s my second time that I visit this restaurant. Everything is great the same. All menu is good taste. All staff are very friendly. I’m great to recommend you to go there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Inbee (Kim)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff are lively, but the clientele is a bit rough around the edges lol.
Recommended for business travelers who want to enjoy a noisy meal♪
sample_reviews_en.author: daisuke

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was great as ingredients were fresh. Very authentic Japanese cuisine experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anastasia B

restaurants.name: Aunty Somsri Restaurant
restaurants.address:

87 Soi Paracha Chuen 6, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Aunt Som Sri's restaurant is a charming little eatery hidden away in Soi Prachachuen 6. The atmosphere is warm, comfortable, and friendly, like having a meal at a relative's house. The simple yet comfortable decor makes it perfect for family meals or gatherings with friends.

The menu offers a wide variety of delicious dishes, all freshly prepared (including vegetarian options). Besides the tasty food, the staff are incredibly friendly, cheerful, and helpful, always ready to assist.

If you're looking for a cozy restaurant with great food in the Prachachuen-Bang Sue area, I highly recommend this one. It's a hidden gem you won't regret visiting!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattanan J

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was quite disappointed with the service and the staff's attitude.

When I ordered the chocolate waffle, I clearly stated "classic chocolate," but when it was served, I received a strawberry waffle. When I informed the staff about the order error, they argued that I hadn't specified the correct item, even though I had said "chocolate" twice when ordering.
Finally, the staff informed me that the chocolate waffle was sold out (immediately after I mentioned I didn't want strawberries) and offered no further solution. They also seemed unhappy that I asked for a refund.

I will not be returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mt Mt

sample_reviews_en.text: We went on a Saturday at noon. Two cute dogs greeted us. We were the first table. The menu has a variety of single-dish meals, and they came quickly without a wait, but I can't guarantee service when it's busy. If you want to order anything extra, be sure to tell the staff taking your order clearly. The food is delicious, but the desserts are even better! The chocolate ice cream waffle was amazing! I loved it! There's a restroom outside the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: sspg 224

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to eat here very often, but now the service is terrible. The food isn't cheap either. I called ahead to order, but they didn't fulfill my order in the queue, making me wait a very long time. And they didn't even apologize. The restaurant is incredibly arrogant, and the staff are unwelcoming. The food used to be much better. Think carefully before considering eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mini Studio11

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff needs immediate improvement. Hiring them is a complete waste of time. Customers walk in, glare at you with displeasure, refuse to give you a menu when you ask, and even when you ask if they're still selling, they just stare at you, sigh, and finally bring a menu. My child asked why they were acting like that, so we left and went to buy food at 7-Eleven instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sp AR

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small shop in Soi Saphan 99, Prachachuen.
Enter the soi and you'll see a 7-Eleven; the small shop is hidden away.
Inside, there are 5-6 tables, and the atmosphere is friendly.
They offer a selection of Thai and Western food, as well as snacks.
Coffee, water, and desserts are also available.
Feel free to stop by anytime you're hungry. The prices are affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thavisak Phongsai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the restaurant has a cute, cozy decor. However, it gets crowded around lunchtime, so you might have to wait longer than usual for your food. I personally liked the fish maw soup, ordered with vegetable spring rolls; it was very tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: ทวีรัชต์ ศิริกุล

sample_reviews_en.text:
The cooking style is inconsistent; some dishes are delicious, others are too salty.
The food looks appetizing, and there's a wide variety of dishes on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornsawan Supab

restaurants.name: ลาบยโสธร
restaurants.address:

MCWC+5W5, Bang Khae, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located by the roadside. You can park in the market, but there aren't many parking spaces, so sometimes it might be difficult to find a spot. The food is delicious. The papaya salad is just right, the grilled pork neck is tasty, and the intestines have good flavor but are a little chewy. The dipping sauce is average. The service is good and the food comes out quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kp Kp

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've passed by this place many times and noticed the grilled pork stall every time. I'd been eyeing it until it moved behind the market, and finally got to try it.
And it was really delicious, especially the Thai papaya salad. It's rare to find a place that makes such a flavorful Thai papaya salad. The noodles were perfect. I loved it and want to go back again 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana Sakulngam

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered some of the recommended dishes, the same ones I used to order when the restaurant was located in Lang Suan, but the taste wasn't the same and the portion size didn't seem worth the price. It was raining when I went, but the atmosphere in the restaurant was still very hot and stuffy.
sample_reviews_en.author: สมชาย แซ่ซื้อ

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually have a regular restaurant, but today I'm trying a different one.
The food is beautifully presented, appetizing, and the portions are generous. The sticky rice and rice noodles are served in very large portions, as you can see in the picture.
sample_reviews_en.author: ISUZU BOYZA พระราม 2

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're hungry, order and sit back, you'll get your food in less than 3-5 minutes – quick and delicious! The spicy salad is great, the Thai papaya salad with salted egg is fantastic, but the grilled pork neck is definitely the highlight!
sample_reviews_en.author: วัชราภรณ์ แสงใส

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered pork waterfall salad. At first, they said it was sold out. Then, they said they had some. When I got to eat it, I got some kind of meat I didn't recognize. It was awful. I totally regret spending my money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasipron Khiensuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: Located near the market, there is parking for cars and motorcycles. The food is prepared quickly, the dishes are large and generous, and the food is delicious and spicy. The atmosphere is homey and comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sedthachai Jawana

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and affordable. Come late and you might miss out, as they sell out very quickly. I recommend the shrimp in fish sauce (spicy dipping sauce), crying tiger beef, and grilled beef.
sample_reviews_en.author: JB Butcher

restaurants.name: ขนมจีนน้ำยา บ้านประโดก โคราช
restaurants.address:

295 Thanon Tanao, Sao Chingcha, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Delicious and flavorful. Fast and polite service.
Lots of vegetables, clean.
3 bowls of curry, 3 servings of rice noodles, 1 bottle of water, 3 glasses of ice.
💵190฿ Scan to pay.
sample_reviews_th.author: Wawa

sample_reviews_en.text:
This chicken curry is a must-try!

The broth is rich and flavorful, with just the right amount of spiciness and a touch of sweetness. It's so delicious you'll lick your lips!

The chicken is chopped into chunks with bones, and includes chicken blood – exactly what I wanted!

There are plenty of other curry options too, such as coconut milk, jungle curry, green curry, etc.

The portion size is generous; one bowl is enough to fill you up. If you're a small eater, I recommend asking the vendor for less rice noodles to avoid wasting food.

There's a good variety of vegetables to choose from, but personally, I think they should be served in a basket instead of a plastic bag for a more appealing presentation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akara Kiattiajin

sample_reviews_en.text: Ban Pradok Noodle Shop in Korat is located on Tanao Road, next to the Phueak Himma shop. It's an open-air shop with tables for dine-in. They sell Korat-style rice noodles with four types of curry: spicy jungle curry, chili paste curry, coconut milk curry, chicken feet curry, and Korat chicken curry. The price is 50 baht, both for dine-in and takeout. Side vegetables are provided. Parking is available along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธวัชชัย ใหญ่อยู่

sample_reviews_en.text: Ban Pradok, a Khanom Jeen Nam Ya (rice noodles with curry) restaurant in Korat, is located on Tanao Road, opposite the Chao Pho Suea Shrine. It's an open-air restaurant with tables for dine-in. They sell four types of Korat-style rice noodles with curry: spicy jungle curry, chili paste, green curry with snakehead fish, and Korat chicken curry. Side vegetables are also available. Parking is available along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyakit Thanabriboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fish balls were delicious. The fish balls were tasty.
Both broths were bland.
There was no plate for the vegetables; they brought another plate. They didn't even give us a spoon.
We had to get our own water, even though it was in the fridge.
They didn't ask anything at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Endless

sample_reviews_en.text: Variety of curry to eat with soft rice noodles. Recommend menu is "Khanom jeen namya ban pradok" (Rice noodles with chicken curry). You can add more veggie e.g. bean sprouts, lemon basil, banana bud on your meal (no charge)
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanon P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rich and creamy coconut milk curry.
The fish ball curry has a nice, chewy texture and is delicious.
It's a shop in a shophouse, but it has many regular customers.
Near the Chao Pho Suea Shrine and Sao Ching Kha.
sample_reviews_en.author: vipa wongkij

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korat-style chicken curry is incredibly flavorful! If you like it spicy, there's fish sauce with bird's eye chilies to add some kick. It's packed with vegetables too! Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Irin

restaurants.name: In The Middle by Kaizen
restaurants.address:

490 10 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant impressed me from my first visit with its clean, airy, and very comfortable atmosphere. The meat here is fresh, well-prepared, and beautifully presented. The menu is quite diverse with many dishes to choose from, so it's easy to find something to suit your taste whether you're with a group or family. The variety of meats and toppings is extensive, and the quality is consistent, giving you peace of mind when eating.

The staff are enthusiastic, friendly, and always quick to assist customers when they need more dishes or a change of grill. The atmosphere is quite cheerful but still comfortable enough to chat and fully enjoy the meal. Food is served quickly, and there's no long wait, even when the restaurant is busy.

In my opinion, the prices are reasonable compared to the quality of the food and service received. This is a suitable place to gather with friends, relax after work, or enjoy a meal on the weekend. Overall, I had a very good experience and will definitely return in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nhismee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in the Aqua Saphan Kwai project. I went on a Friday evening. The restaurant said reservations were required, but it wasn't that crowded.

I opted for the most expensive option, which includes premium cuts of meat and salmon sashimi.

The salmon sashimi was fresh and delicious. The salmon yukke with marinated roe was tasty; the roe was chewy, creamy, and slightly salty.

The meat quality was quite good, but I was hoping for better. The beef tongue was a big disappointment.

The yukke beef was delicious and high-quality, but the portion was very large.

Adding the all-you-can-drink beer buffet for 100++ baht was well worth it. It's draft beer, but only Budweiser is available.

Another plus is the grill; it heats up very quickly.

The staff provided good, fast, and attentive service, constantly refilling the food.

The buffet gives you 1 hour and 30 minutes, which felt too short; you'd finish eating before you knew it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Vongphantuseth

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating at this restaurant. I had planned to come on the 14th but there were no tables available. So today was my first time. It was delicious, I loved it! I paid 999 baht. The male staff member (or possibly LGBT, I'm not sure) provided excellent service. He recommended dishes, the food came out quickly, refilled our water quickly, cleared the table quickly, and even rearranged the plates during the meal to make it more comfortable for customers. Even though it was a small thing, I was very impressed. The service was better than most buffet restaurants. The food was delicious and the staff were great, making the dining experience enjoyable. The only minor issue was that some air conditioning water was dripping on my food. 🥓🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: pchta k

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant was near our hotel, a 10-minute walk, but it was definitely worth it—good service and good ingredients. The beef, in particular, melted in our mouths. We had it charcoal-grilled; they don't have electric hot pot, so the charcoal-grilled version was even better. They offer both buffet and à la carte options. Since we don't eat much, we ordered à la carte. It cost a little over 3000 baht for three people, about the same price as the buffet, but because we ordered à la carte, we grilled the leftovers and took them home. You can't take home food if you order from the buffet! This was my second time back. They even gave us complimentary fruit after the meal! The ice cream was also great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bo Yu

sample_reviews_en.text:
We arrived around 3 PM and seemed to be the first table. The male waiter provided excellent service; he probably would have fed us if he could! He changed plates and grills constantly and gave great menu recommendations. We ordered the 849 baht set meal, and he advised us not to order the regular beef as it wasn't worth it – the beef was truly excellent. The menu was diverse, but personally, I thought the seafood wasn't that great. However, the river prawns were amazing and totally worth it! We used our birthday discount of 100 baht. Most importantly, the ice cream was delicious!

Parking is available in the complex next door.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pantira U

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, but you should inform customers before they arrive about what's out of stock. It's unacceptable to sit down and then find that certain items are unavailable. If you're going to open a shop, you should have everything in stock. If something is missing, you should inform the customer beforehand. Don't let them order only to find out it's not available. For example, if you ask about the romaine lettuce, which was sold out yesterday, and it's already evening, you still don't have it. The shop closes at 11 PM. Are you not going to restock? Or are we just supposed to wait? ****Please improve this.****
sample_reviews_en.author: PENSUDA YUBONPRING

sample_reviews_en.text: We visited on a Wednesday night around 9 PM and were the only customers there. The food was fresh and tasted amazing. Mr. Cucumber, who previously worked at Dusit, provided outstanding service—he was attentive, offered numerous suggestions, and even assisted us in cooking the meat. This was the best service I’ve ever received from the ‘In The Middle by Kaizen’ brand. I now drive to this branch specifically for Mr. Cucumber, even though there’s a closer one to me. The price was reasonable at around 1,000 baht per person after fees. It’s the perfect spot to enjoy with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tontrakun Chaimongkol

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu is diverse, and the meat isn't thin like in other buffet restaurants. The sushi fish is thick and fresh, and the pork bone soup is incredibly tender – a must-try! The sweet boiled shrimp is also very sweet and has a great texture.
The service is excellent, especially from an older gentleman who takes great care of us. He's like a restaurant captain from the old days; he should be awarded Employee of the Month.

Parking is available at The Hub project and it's a short walk. You can get your parking ticket stamped at the restaurant for 1 hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutta A.

restaurants.name: ITAEWON KOREA BAR BKK
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvitplaza(Koreatown) 2nd floor, Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was craving soju, so I was looking for a place to drink, but I didn't want to go to a meat restaurant and wanted to go to a pojangmacha (traditional Korean food truck)-style place. It's a proper pojangmacha (traditional Korean food truck) with cucumbers and soybean paste as side dishes. I went early and had a quiet meal. They say it's hot in the early mornings.
sample_reviews_en.author: jude seok

sample_reviews_en.text:
It stays open late, so I recommend stopping by for a casual meal when you're in the mood for a drink.

The atmosphere is great, and the food is all clean and delicious.

The owner is friendly, and the service is excellent. You should definitely stop by if you visit Koreatown. The steamed egg bomb is especially insane.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean

sample_reviews_en.text:
No need to worry about Korean food in Bangkok

Itaewon is another Korea.

For the taste and friendliness, you absolutely must visit!!!!

Highly recommended!!! The atmosphere is insane~~~
sample_reviews_en.author: 문상현

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were lovely and provided excellent service. The food was delicious. I didn't expect the papaya salad at a Korean restaurant to be this good! 55555 The staff were lovely 💕😜
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐนิชา ประสาทเขตการ

sample_reviews_en.text: If you go to Bangkok and don't visit Itaewon? Then you haven't really been to Bangkok. You absolutely have to go.
sample_reviews_en.author: 정홍모

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the service was great. I highly recommend this restaurant for Korean food lovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supatra Samoodkwam

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious, delicious, delicious, delicious, there was nothing else to say. It was so delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatuphon Tangjai

sample_reviews_en.text: The manager I met for the first time was so kind and had great service. I will come here often!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: 유희수

restaurants.name: Yoe Yar Restaurant
restaurants.address:

1013, 6 Soi Phanit Anan, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been coming to this restaurant several times over the years. Before, it was very clean and the atmosphere inside was nice with a pleasant smell.
However, in 2026, I’ve visited many times again and noticed a big change. The cleanliness inside the restaurant has gotten worse. There is a strong unpleasant smell, similar to cat urine, especially around the tables and corners, which makes the dining experience uncomfortable.
I hope the restaurant can improve this by keeping the place cleaner and making sure pets are not around the dining area.
I still like this place, so I hope it can return to the good standard it had before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ye Yint Kyaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fried rice in a copper pot
It tasted more like a soy sauce paste than a copper pot, and there was no taste of the fried rice. The worst thing was that it was served with pork, but the meat didn't taste like pork, and it tasted like fish.

The side dish with shrimp
The side dish with rice didn't taste bad, but the soup that was served with it was cold.

The unwashed egg salad
I don't know if it was because of the bowl that was used to serve the salad, but the unwashed egg salad smelled of horsetail.

The environment
It was next to a karaoke bar, so the sound was not good, so I wanted to eat and leave quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maverick Htoo Pyae

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm a Rangoon-born Burmese and I've never tasted anything as authentic as this restaurant in whole of Bangkok. Tasting food here feels like I am back in Rangoon wholly!

There are many Burmese restaurants all over Bangkok but I assure whoever is thinking to come to this place, please do. The food will not disappoint you!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaung Myat Lwin

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I went to eat at a traditional restaurant. Among the Burmese restaurants in Thailand, I can say that this is a very good restaurant. The taste is very good and the price is very reasonable. I would like to tell my brothers and sisters who are wondering where to eat in Thailand to go and try this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: เมจิ วินมวง

sample_reviews_en.text: A very atmospheric restaurant serving Burmese cuisine. The menu features delicious and unusual dishes. The space is clean, and pleasant music plays. The staff is very attentive, and it was a pleasure to receive complimentary traditional appetizers and tea. We'll definitely be back! I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aleks T

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent food and great value for money! Everything was fresh, crispy, and full of flavor. The fried platter was perfect for sharing, and the fried chicken with spicy herb sauce was my favorite. Friendly service, clean atmosphere, and generous portions. I’ll definitely be back. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bo Lay

sample_reviews_en.text: As a starving expat for home cooking this an awesome little place. Great authentic Burmese food with typically friendlyBurmese people. Luckily the menu has images as I could never read burmese furthermore, the English description is limited. Beyond that it’s a must try place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paneristi171

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good, but it’s not supposed to be a karaoke place where people sing inside. The sound quality is terrible, and people were drunk and shouting. I will never go back. It would be more accurate if they called it a Yoe Yar karaoke bar instead of a Yoe Yar restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lastat William

restaurants.name: Fu Hua Chinese Cuisine Restaurant
restaurants.address:

74/6 Pracha Rat Bamphen Rd, Khwaeng Huai Khwang, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10320, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious but...😋 I was a little apprehensive about my first visit because of the many negative reviews about the unfriendly service.

However, the staff member (probably the owner) who spoke to me in Japanese spoke fluently and talked about the food and the restaurant, creating a pleasant atmosphere throughout my visit (I don't know what it's like when the owner isn't there, as he's apparently not out much).

This time I ordered:
Jajangmyeon 120B‼️ (Probably the best in Bangkok😋)
Cheap and delicious, I'll definitely be back
Dumplings 120B
They're all homemade, from the wrappers onwards, and these were also absolutely delicious (they take a little time to cook).

According to the owner, other dishes recommended for Japanese people are:
Mapo Tofu
Beef with Green Peppers
Ramen

I think I'll try those next time.

The opening hours are 10:00-22:00.
sample_reviews_en.author: ちゃんなお

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited alone.
The proprietress served me in broken Japanese.
I wanted to try the tomato and egg stir-fry, which wasn't on the menu, so I asked if it was possible to order it, and they did.
The tomato and egg stir-fry (140 baht) wasn't what I expected, but it was piping hot, light, and the tomato juices had a soupy texture that made it delicious.
The pan-fried dumplings (120 baht) were served just as I was thinking to double-check whether my order had been accepted. lol. The dumplings were very homemade and had a lovely texture. The skin was thick, the filling was dense, and they were piping hot and delicious. I was strongly encouraged to order a drink, but when I firmly declined, they brought me hot tea, which appears to be complimentary.
I'd like to try their other dishes as well. I'll definitely visit again, so thank you in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: じょじょじょぬらりひょん

sample_reviews_en.text: We weren't originally planning to eat Chinese food in Thailand, but my wife wanted dumplings, so we went to Fu Hua Restaurant next to our hotel for dinner. We ordered spicy diced chicken, hot and sour shredded potatoes, stir-fried kale, and pan-fried chive dumplings. The food was really delicious! The chicken and shredded potatoes, in particular, were fragrant, spicy, and crispy. They're already on my wish list, and maybe I'll invite some friends who work nearby to try them in a couple of days…
sample_reviews_en.author: 周玉章

sample_reviews_en.text: Very old place with very retro decor where you can get pretty authentic Chinese cooking from different parts of China. I only took photos of the vegetable dishes cos we were too busy eating once our noodles arrived. I'd recommend the place for its authentic and good tastes as well as affordability, but some mobility challenges when trying to use the toilet (it's on the second floor), and the restaurant is not wheelchair accessible. Other than that, I think it's great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yi Jun Kwok

sample_reviews_en.text: We arrived when there weren't many customers, so we didn't have to wait long. The food was delicious and the portions were generous. The fish was very fresh, and the fried rice was good. I recommend the stir-fried green beans with chili, the stir-fried chicken with chili, and the stir-fried tofu as pictured. The chrysanthemum tea was not too sweet. I recommend taking the MRT to Huai Khwang station and walking a short distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: nawa s

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is generally of high quality; the Yunnan stir-fry, hand-pulled noodles, chive dumplings, and salt-baked chicken are all worth trying, and the prices are reasonable. Service is occasionally lacking, with a few staff members lacking in etiquette, but most of the time they are warm and attentive, and the atmosphere is relaxed. If the owner can refine the service details, it will be well on its way to a five-star rating.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷上门服务Outcall Services

sample_reviews_en.text: This Chinese restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes, and they're tastier than expected. The noodle soup is excellent, and the stir-fried green beans seem to be in the Sichuan style because they're very spicy with mala flavor. The prices are commensurate with the portion sizes. There's no parking, and the wait is very long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratthakarn pup

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered Twice Cooked Pork and Pan-fried Dumplings. They only had a set of 10 pan-fried dumplings. The Twice Cooked Pork was greasy and had a strong ginger flavor. The pan-fried dumplings had a lot of chives, a thick skin, and a light taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: S “サリー” J

restaurants.name: Mali
restaurants.address:

43 Plaeng Nam Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Khet Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: It's a take-home restaurant. I would recommend braised pork belly (เคาหยก), fish maw soup (กะเพาะปลา), and stewed pork leg with intestines (ขาหมู). It's old-style Chinese cooking, so it tastes savory with a salty note.
sample_reviews_th.author: Gunn Vanichbuncha

sample_reviews_th.text:
เคาหยก 扣肉; Pinyin: kòu ròu; kau3 juk6)
Is pork belly stream with salte vegetable,
A bit salty, yummy and umami. Most recomende menu is stir fried jute leaves, a bit bitter and more dimetions flavor.
sample_reviews_th.author: Anocha U

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you want to try Chinese Chiu Chow cuisine in Bangkok's Chinatown, this is a good place.

Most customers take their side dishes to go, but you can also enjoy a quick meal in the restaurant.

You can choose your side dishes and then select rice or porridge for your main course.

Although my wife is from Hong Kong, her parents are Chiu Chow, so she says this is authentic Chiu Chow food.

She particularly noted that the porridge is made well in the Chiu Chow style.

The vegetable side dishes were similar to Korean vegetable dishes, and the side dish made by boiling radish greens with fish was delicious.

The fish seemed to have been fried before braising; the skin was chewy, and the flesh was tender.

The braised pork was also good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sangcheol Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highlight of my recent Bangkok trip last December , no other than having the braised Teochew Dao Gua. The dish that I fall in love long time ago before MCO but discontinued because of some reason. And this trip it’s on their manu again. So excited when I see this dish again 😍😍😍😍😍. ￼
A humble porridge stall that off the main road that can be easily miss out.
Braised olives leaves, stirfry jute leaves, pork belly with salted vegetables, braised fish maw with crab meat and abalone ￼￼are some other signature dish and many more. Oh yes the porridge itself already is a star 😋😋😋😋.
This trip I tried their teochew Bak Chang. Gave me an open eye 🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩 so so so delicious. ￼
I will definitely return to this place from time to time🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: William Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: Nothing special to talk about, mediocre dishes and you can get better food nearby.
