Feels like the owner put in lots of msg and salt into the fish maw, the entire bowl turns out even saltier when it cools down; not to mention the price isn’t very reasonable for this quality. Also, be prepared to receive some stares from the lady-boss if you dine in and eat too slow, the shop is cluttered with random items and there’s only 1 or 2 small table, hence she expect people to eat fast, pay up and leave asap.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nigel Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't miss dish is Braised fish maw with crab meat,quail eggs and abalone. The taste is classy and perfect without any added sauces.
A chinese homemade food store owned by two aunties.
Traditional chinese recipes are well-cooked. When vegetarian festival began,this store has always turned to offer vegan recipes. Another vegan famous item is Olive pickled green mustard with mushroom ; their secret recipe since motherhood.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nopchaluk U.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is amazing! Auntie Mali is very kind.
I've been eating here since I was a kid, back when there wasn't a storefront like this.
I'm hooked! Whenever I'm in Bangkok, I always stop by to eat. This is authentic fish maw soup. I highly recommend trying it; I'm sure you'll love it. The price is also reasonable, appropriate for the quantity, quality, and taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Premsuk Mungsung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come to this restaurant for a light meal, try the fish maw soup, then take a leisurely stroll through Yaowarat.
After your meal, grab some delicious Grandma's food and head home.
The pickled mustard greens are amazing! The snakehead fish stomach soup is also delicious. I'll have to try the stir-fried pork with preserved plums and betel leaves sometime.
sample_reviews_en.author: prapan worakul

restaurants.name: ซุปเปอร์แซ่บเวอร์ (เมืองนนท์)
restaurants.address:

47 31 หมู่ 7 Yothathikan Nonthaburi Sai Suan Luang Rd, Maha Sawat, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's not expensive, and everything is delicious. The seafood sauce is amazing. If you don't like the stir-fried dishes too oily, you can ask the owner to reduce the oil.
The owner's children are very diligent and provide excellent service.
/Just a small complaint: The menu is a bit hard to read.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phachamon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! Great taste, affordable price. The kids helping their parents serve the food were so cute.
I went back to eat there again after it had been closed for a long time. The taste was even better, and the price was still affordable. I loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bas Bas

sample_reviews_en.text: The female vendor had poor manners. If she's the owner, I suggest she improve. If she's an employee, I recommend the owner (the owner, Mr. Aun) fire her. The Tom Yum soup and stir-fried kale were okay, but the stir-fried clams weren't fresh …
sample_reviews_en.author: thanakorn wasinnitiwong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and suited our taste perfectly. The Tom Yum sea bass was especially good; the fish was very fresh and the portion was generous. We ordered so much that we couldn't finish it all!
sample_reviews_en.author: เกศิณี บํารุงทรัพย์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, but a bit too sour. Overall, it's okay. If you want to eat rice soup at night, you can stop by. It's near Saphan Jesadabodin. The price is good. They give a lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุทธิเจตน์ หวังสิริเลิศกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to a restaurant and ate chicken feet soup and shrimp in fish sauce. The flavor was so spicy I almost cried. I had to order a Pepsi to cool down the spiciness. Haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samsung S 23 ULTRA .1976

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. Order it to take home and it's just as delicious as eating it at the restaurant, plus you get a lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darika Pungkeiw

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, inexpensive, kind owner, food comes quickly, no parking, located on the main road, a bit difficult to find a place to park.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mathi J.

restaurants.name: TUMMi Brunch Club
restaurants.address:

Chao Chon, 4 Soi Lasalle 46, Khwaeng Bang Na, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited in mid-November 2024. We were a little disappointed because the main shop was closed for renovations and we couldn't sit in the charming atmosphere we'd seen in reviews, but we were still able to dine at the Chawchon restaurant instead.

We arrived around lunchtime, and the food took a while to arrive.

We ordered a beef sandwich, egg benedict with bagels, a hot latte, and an iced mocha.

We recommend the beef sandwich; it was well-made with plenty of cheese and beef, and the bread was perfectly crispy. We really liked it.

As for the egg benedict, it was a bit of a disappointment for us. The egg was overcooked, a soft-boiled egg with a runny yolk that didn't flow when cut open 🥲, and the sauce wasn't to our liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Issaraporn Suksamer

sample_reviews_en.text:
I agree with many reviews by foreign visitors who mention inattentive service.

We visited as a group of nine for brunch and arrived ready to order. The menus were provided, but after waiting 20–30 minutes, no one returned to take our order or check on our table despite several attempts to get attention.

What made the experience particularly disappointing was seeing staff members chatting with one another while our table remained unattended.

In the end, we had to go to the counter and place a takeaway order ourselves because we no longer had enough time to stay for brunch.

Unfortunately, this left us with a poor impression of the service and little reason to return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tatsakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has a great, very homey atmosphere. I love that they now offer evening dining, transforming from a brunch spot into a place where you can enjoy dinner and hang out for longer. The food is delicious and the ambiance is fantastic.

🌿 They offer a complete selection of dishes including brunch, pasta, pizza, steak, and salad, all prepared by Chef Folk from Hell’s Kitchen.

Personally, I loved the Truffle Pizza and Short Ribs; the flavors were amazing and so enjoyable. It's perfect for dinner or hanging out with friends. There's live music on Fridays and Saturdays too. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulin Kakaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
it is NOT worth your money, i ordered -**THICK** cut bacon with croissant : croissant raw in the middle, bacon is like 2 mm in thickness and from my experience that not what thick cut is
-sausage with mash : sausage actually pretty good 8/10, but the mash is obviously not homemade, ready made mash
- pasta dish

3 dishes for 950 baht

just go to other resto, aint gonna pay this much for this cheap quality food
regret

moreover, service aint that good either, staffs aint acting professional at all; playing and joking with each other while on floor
sample_reviews_en.author: SRK T

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a European-style breakfast restaurant. The portions are very generous, keeping you full until late afternoon or evening. They offer a variety of Western-style options. You can order a chicken sandwich with fragrant cheese and crispy bread, or a delicious croissant with bacon and scrambled eggs. They also have a special coffee called 'dirty coffee'. There's parking available on the restaurant premises. Oh, the prices are around 100 baht. It's worth trying!
sample_reviews_en.author: Art C

sample_reviews_en.text:
My personal opinion:
-The beef sandwich (probably smoked) is 10/10. Delicious and worth the high price.
-But the croissant with egg and bacon was just average, so it felt expensive.
-The portions weren't as big as the reviews suggested. They felt just right for one person.
-The coffee and green tea were average. I prefer Amazon's coffee; it's more aromatic.
-If I go back, I'll definitely try the beef sandwich again. I love it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thara KPK

sample_reviews_en.text: This brunch restaurant has a great atmosphere and a wide variety of dishes to choose from. Try their signature Big Breakfast, a huge breakfast dish with tons of ingredients – so filling you'll be stuffed! We also ordered the Egg Benedict on Chip Pan, which was delicious. The eggs were perfectly cooked and paired wonderfully with the smoked salmon, sauce, and salted bread.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mana Krasprapan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were friendly, and the food was delicious.

My companions also said the taste was good.

However, there were a lot of flying insects in the store. I wondered if it was because we were next to a huge flowerpot, so I moved seats, but they were still there, so I ate while being careful not to get bitten.

I would be willing to visit again if the insects are gone.
sample_reviews_en.author: ANNA

restaurants.name: ร้านชายสี่บะหมี่เกี๊ยว สะพาน 99 by อ๊อด
restaurants.address:

258 ซอย ริมคลองประปาฝั่งขวา Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered crispy pork rice. The crispy pork was delicious, but the sauce wasn't to my liking; it was too sweet. The soup had a lot of fat floating on top.
sample_reviews_en.author: Weerawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is superb, fresh, clean, and delicious. Anyone who tries the food at this restaurant will come back regularly.
sample_reviews_en.author: บุตร นิรนาม

sample_reviews_en.text: The crispy pork rice is delicious, the noodles are delicious too. They also have pork leg. Everything is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: อนุรักษ์ อนัญญาเขต

sample_reviews_en.text: There are options like pork leg rice, roast pork rice, crispy pork rice, and Chay Si noodles to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: preecha buatong

sample_reviews_en.text: A favorite among Bang Sue residents, offering affordable and delicious food that lives up to its reputation.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุชาติ ถาวรกิรติขจร

sample_reviews_en.text: Good service. The roasted pork rice, crispy pork rice, and braised pork leg rice are delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vaki Kavee

sample_reviews_en.text: Drinking the clear broth is fine, but the special thing is they'll add cabbage to it.
sample_reviews_en.author: MR.SOUL52

restaurants.name: Tacos State
restaurants.address:

185 Pattayasaisong 9 Aly, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been told to come here for months but hadn't. Glad, I finally did. They are located in Tree Town and the 2 staff members there were welcoming and answered any questions I had about the menu.

Ordered the spicy chicken taco and it was really good. I forced myself to not order more while eating.

It's not Thailand Spicy. It was Mexican spicy and yes, that makes a difference.

For 140 baht, it came with 2 tacos and 1 bottled water. I will be returning and trying other menu items.

Update:
I have gone back a few times and tried the chicken burrito and chicken quesadilla. Both are really good, but I prefer the quesadilla.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somchai Camilo

sample_reviews_en.text:
In my opinion does not taste anything even remotely close to a burrito.

I ordered the beef burrito. The portion was extremely small. The sour cream was off and the burrito itself I had two bites of and could not muster anymore. Staff was very friendly but but in my opinion it did not taste like a burrito of any kind.

Maybe I'll give the tacos a try next year when I'm here, but I can't recommend the  beef burritos
sample_reviews_en.author: Ron Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was tasty but it wasn’t quite Mexican, more like an interesting Thai-Mex fusion! Beef burrito had a slightly sweet taste (like a hint of pineapple) and the guac had onions in it. The service however was superb and the atmosphere of a fun but clean food court made it a memorable experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hojat Salehi

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been to many countries around the world, and when I think of street food, I think of a generous portion at a reasonable price. But here, the portions are incredibly small. I've tried tacos, burritos, quasadillas, and nachos, all with …
sample_reviews_en.author: Dilşat POSMA

sample_reviews_en.text: Had the nachos with beef, no kidding they were excellent, perfect heat and the chips were crunchy to the end. I was shocked, so good, and the young man who owns the stand was so nice and took such pride in what he does. I am hooked.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kelly Leonard

sample_reviews_en.text: This snack bar in the Three Town food court is definitely worth a visit. The service and explanations of the dishes are good, and the food is very tasty for a reasonable price. I'd be happy to come back to try more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ulrich Herzog

sample_reviews_en.text: Worth it! Not authentic Mexican but the flavors are there and if needing your Mexican fix, this place will do the job. Prices are very reasonable and staff friendly and accepting of challenges.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Murray

sample_reviews_en.text: Fresh and tasty. Service was of a high standard. Will definitely return to try more of the menu. The fella does a good job preparing the food and also takes care of the customer service.
sample_reviews_en.author: P H

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารจีน เสฉวน ฝูลี่
restaurants.address:

128 16 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 24 Yeak 30, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great prices, huge portions! One dish is enough for 2-3 people.

- Crispy and delicious stir-fried chicken with chili and salt. Hot, generous portion, fried fresh to order. Good salty flavor (not as spicy as Thai-style stir-fried chicken with chili and salt, but very enjoyable). 180 baht.
- Stir-fried tofu with mixed ingredients. Similar to Mabotofu, but also delicious and spicy.
- Rice noodles (similar to Khanom Jeen but not quite, chewier and more springy) + a little similar to Nam Ngiao (130 baht). A massive portion! Three people couldn't finish it.
- Yangzhou fried rice. Very fragrant, with a great wok aroma. The rice grains were perfectly cooked. A little less meat than expected, but delicious. Enough for 2-3 people. 100 baht per dish, very cheap and great value.

The restaurant was full of Chinese people. Parking for 2-3 cars in front of the restaurant. Excellent taste and cheap prices.

We ordered all this plus water for just over 500 baht. We even got to take some rice and noodles home because there was so much food! Great value!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maneeporn Sinthamrong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Sichuan Chinese restaurant, cooked and served by Chinese people. The person taking orders speaks Thai, but not much in terms of description. The food took a very long time to arrive. Not recommended if you're very hungry; they probably have a lot of online orders.
- The sour fish soup wasn't sour at all, it was more salty than sour, and contained pickled cabbage.
- The fried pork ribs with chili and garlic were tender, but extremely salty.
- The mixed tofu dish had crispy fried tofu and tasty sweet peppers, but it was very, very oily.
- The stir-fried liver was the best dish. Not fishy, ​​not too salty, and fragrant with ginger, although the liver was sliced ​​a bit too thin, but there was a generous portion.
- The "Three-Glass Chicken" – I don't know what it is, but I ordered it. It came in a pot as pictured. It tasted salty and sweet, not spicy, and was extremely oily, with oil covering half the pot.
- The Sichuan rice noodles were delicious; the noodles were chewy and soft. This dish wasn't oily.
sample_reviews_en.author: Olivia P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The only right choice if you’re looking for up-to-date Chinese dishes, is to go to the restaurants run by people from Chiang-Mai or Chiang-Rai. Their Yunnan and Sichuan dishes are authentic, like the ones we would have in China, just like this place.
And the prices here are what a NORMAL restaurant should have - where ordinary people actually come.

The Chinese-run restaurant nowadays are just totally rip-offs.

I ate here 11 times in the past month, hence so many photos. Tried to pick different dishes each time.
sample_reviews_en.author: MAN BOK CHAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
After spending over a week in Bangkok, and coming from northeastern Laos where the food is similar to Yunnan cuisine in China, especially the meat dishes, I discovered this restaurant.

Each dish was beautifully presented and well worth the wait. The flavors of everything I ordered were authentic southwestern Chinese, and I can confidently say they were very close to Yunnanese cuisine. As someone of Lao and Isaan descent, I would rate this as the best restaurant I tried during my Bangkok trip.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keosavanth-Chern Thammavong (JuJu)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good, some items might be a little spicy.
There's a variety of dishes, but the fish dishes take a while to prepare.
It's very slow, especially with so many people ordering takeout.
I suspect there's no parking. There's plenty of parking space for delivery drivers in front, so ordering takeout might be more convenient than dining in, as the restaurant is quite cramped and hot.
There aren't any large tables; seating for 3-4 people is possible.
sample_reviews_en.author: J V

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this restaurant so much; it's a hidden gem. I've been there twice already and will go again. The food is delicious, the service is great, and the chef makes whatever I request. The prices aren't too high either. The fish stew with pickled mustard greens is a must-try; I never get tired of it! Love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nj Klai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, but a bit too salty. I'll give it 4.5/5.
The staff provided good service, but they kept pressuring us to order before we even opened the menu. That's a little impolite for Thai people.
The food arrived quickly, the portions were large, and the prices were reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: R Chx

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and the prices were reasonable.
The atmosphere felt just like eating in China.
The restaurant might seem a bit messy, the tables were a little sticky, and the air conditioning was a bit too warm, but the food was truly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napak Rungroekrit

restaurants.name: PJ Coffee&Kitchen
restaurants.address:

54 SL.Residence (ตรงข้ามปั้มแก๊ส) ถ.วิถาวดี ซ.5 แยก2, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was incredibly delicious! No matter what I tried, I wasn't disappointed. 😅 The ingredients and portion sizes were definitely worth the price. The shrimp and squid were huge, the minced pork had almost no fat and no bone fragments, and the rice portion was generous. This isn't a paid endorsement; I just wanted to encourage the owner who is so dedicated and attentive to their customers. I highly recommend everyone try this restaurant. Sending the owner lots of positive energy to continue cooking!

Ps. Thank you so much for the delicious food and excellent service. It really made my day, especially for someone like me who's stressed from work and doesn't have time to cook or eat on time. Keep up the good work!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattra P

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and the portions were great value. The owner was very friendly, the ingredients were very fresh, and the plating was appealing. The fried rice had a wonderful wok aroma, and the shrimp were plump and very fresh. The price was cheaper than other restaurants I've eaten at, and the portions were larger.
The Southern Thai dishes were also very flavorful. I will definitely go back again. It was delicious, I loved it, and it was truly great value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: LALIDA PUECHAMNUAY

sample_reviews_en.text: I absolutely love the garlic shrimp at this restaurant! They give you a huge portion; I'm usually not a big eater, but this was enough for three meals. But what impressed me most is the excellent service, the consistently delicious taste, and the owner's attentiveness to customers – seriously, I was so impressed I wanted to write a review. I've never encountered a restaurant that cares about its customers this much! 💓
sample_reviews_en.author: B H

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves made-to-order food. The owner's cooking is excellent. They give generous portions, as if they're selling to the community. They're really taking care of their customers. I usually order online, but I've never eaten at the restaurant. (The bowls are separate from the eggs and rice, which are on the bottom.) 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Petsupang Kh.

sample_reviews_en.text:
But let me tell you something…
My go-to dish is only the "Shrimp Basil Rice" here! 🦐🔥
It's so delicious I can't possibly order anything else.
The shrimp are big, fresh, and succulent, stir-fried with a rich, flavorful sauce that's just the right amount of spicy and perfectly seasoned with basil.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิชดา คชชานุโรจน์

sample_reviews_en.text: Just as delicious as always! I usually order online, but today I got to eat at the restaurant. The crispy pork and fried fish are so freshly made – that's what makes it so good! 😋 And luckily, I came during the New Year period, so I also got a super cute handmade keychain. Happy New Year! 🥳
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaisiri Kitpaosong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The coffee shop is located in the SL building, near the ThaiBev building, behind Thairath TV.
Nearby, there's a restaurant (the same restaurant) serving made-to-order food for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. You can grab a meal here!
sample_reviews_en.author: เรานะ ชื่ออะไร

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a little disappointed. It used to be delicious. I'm confused why the crispy pork is so hard this time. It's almost inedible. I tried to pick out what I could eat. It was so hard that a spoon couldn't cut it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Buzzlightsyear

restaurants.name: Sekai no Yamachan @The Manor
restaurants.address:

The Manor ฃ32/1 เดอะ แมนเนอร์ Sukhumvit 39, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Authentic Nagoya-Style Izakaya in Bangkok!

Sekai No Yamachan @The Manor, Sukhumvit 39, delivers an authentic Nagoya-style izakaya experience with standout flavors and a lively atmosphere.

🍽️ Food Highlights:
✅ Fried Chicken Wings (Tebasaki) – Crispy, flavorful, and addictive, with the perfect savory-spicy balance. Served in stacks of five—great with beer!

✅ Yakisoba (Fried Noodles) – Hearty, well-balanced, and packed with flavor. A must-try alongside the wings.

✅ Aubergine (Eggplant) – Soft yet firm, delicately seasoned, and a great lighter option.

🎎 Ambiance:
A vibrant, casual izakaya setting, ideal for social gatherings or after-work drinks.

👏 Service:
Friendly & efficient, with prompt service despite the busy crowd.

💰 Value:
At 250-500 THB per person, generous portions & top-notch quality make it a great deal.

✅ Final Verdict:
Highly recommended for authentic Japanese cuisine & a fun dining experience!

📍 Location: Sukhumvit 39, Bangkok
🔄 Would I return? Absolutely!

This version keeps it concise, engaging, and informative while still reflecting the restaurant’s key highlights. Let me know if you’d like it trimmed further!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thailand Hidden Places

sample_reviews_en.text:
First try here after ***dinner*** but swung by to taste their famous fried chicken, the taste is good! I personally love unsweeten fried chicken. Fresh and perfectly fried not too dry.

The overall service is deem to unimpressive, though the number of staffs would be enough but they seem lost. Instead of placing essential trash box for chicken bone, you have to ask for it and the plastic gloves are available only if you know it and ask for it. This is unusual compare to Korean fried chicken restaurant. Upon a promotion is the same …only if you carefully read it and ask for it.

The parking lot is available at the spot which is convenience with limited area, it’s normal for Sukhumvit.

Booking in advance on prime time is recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: AquarTech TechDailyUse

sample_reviews_en.text:
4 stars Yamachan.

1st time at Yamachan.
The reason I came for was Eehire( grilled String Ray) which was very hard to find in NY.

Briefly,
A MUST TRY
1. Fried chicken wings ; their signature
2. Karakage chicken with Wasabi sauce
3. Toki whiskey with ginger ( do not order the L, get the S, trust me)
4. Yama salad

A MUSTN’T
1. Sukune( grilled meat ball) way too dry
2. Yuzu beer (-_-“, you know why?
3. Curry with Katsu ( it’s ok but gold curry was better)

Overall service was very nice, some servers were very attentive, some weren’t. Atmosphere was ok, not ideal for dating.

Price was kinda acceptable. 4 of us spent about 4,500 baht. It’s in thailand, so I rated this place a bit pricy.

Come back? Yeb.
sample_reviews_en.author: Some1loveu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a great experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious and it really felt like eating in Japan. The udon was warm and comforting, with a light but very flavorful broth and perfectly chewy noodles. The toppings like seaweed and bonito flakes added great flavor.

I also tried the grilled chicken wings and sushi, and they were amazing—very fresh and tasty. Everything was simple but done very well. The atmosphere was nice and the food felt very authentic.

If you like Japanese food, this place is definitely worth visiting. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great spot for tasty Japanese food with a fun and casual atmosphere! The menu is full of variety — from crispy chicken wings and grilled skewers to fresh sashimi and hearty rice dishes, everything was flavorful and satisfying.

The highlight for me was the balance of taste — well-seasoned, not too heavy, and perfect to share with friends. Parking at The Manor is very convenient, which makes dining here stress-free in busy Sukhumvit.

A good choice for both casual dinners and group gatherings. Will definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukawat Keratimanoch

sample_reviews_en.text: Here is my favorite place! The chicken taste likes traditional fried chicken! If you do not eat spicy, you can order because the original taste is a little bit spicy from pepper. Last time, I had tried milk ice cream and fried potato, the taste is billion! I would recommend all you guys to order this menu “ Aisuru Oimochan”, if you cant pronounce just pick from the menu picture 🤣. The price is acceptable 5 wings/ 130THB. I do attached here with the menu, enjoy the meal! #Yamachan #YamachanBangkok #LittaStyleReview
sample_reviews_en.author: CHALITTA PIAYURA

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken wings are very delicious, salty but perfect. They have a promotion. If it is ur birthday month, you add their line ID and show your ID card then you get 30 pieces of the chicken wings for free.The cold ramen is also very nice. Rice curry was okay.  Squid with wasabi is a small portion , delicious but expensive. On the weekend they don’t have Asahi tower. The Lemon extra for the high ball drinks it costs 30 Baht. The service can be better in my opinion. Anyway they are friendly.

One of my favorite chains from Nagoya, right here in Bangkok! Good prices, great Tebasaki! What else can you wish for? Staff is nice, the place is clean and the chicken ...also don't forget to try the miso cucumber

You sometimes have issues with the traffic to get here, being nestled in Prom Phong between all the tiny Sois.

I ordered Hainanese chicken rice (boiled chicken) to eat personally.
I thought it was very delicious. The packaging (in a box) was very good.

The chicken was tender, the pieces were large, and the meat was firm and tasty.
What I liked most was the dipping sauce; it was very delicious.
The soup also had pumpkin in it.
I will definitely order again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunisa Tisdang

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the chance to try the food at this restaurant. I ordered the pork noodle soup with fresh chilies, and it was incredibly delicious! The dumplings were also tasty, and the pork meatballs were the best. I'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apollo

sample_reviews_en.text: The most tasteless soup I have ever try in my entire life! Mineral water has got more flavour than the soup. Pork dumplings ok. Shrimp dumplings - better buy a frozen ones and do yourself. Stuff is very friendly though. Kap.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tomasz Kuczynski

sample_reviews_en.text: It was incredibly delicious! The pork was so tender, the vegetables were fresh and crispy, and everything was perfectly clean and to my liking. The rice was perfectly soft, not hard at all. This is definitely my go-to order!
sample_reviews_en.author: nutthakarn chayarat

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was great. The dumplings were soft, full of shrimp, and the noodles were soft. The grilled pork neck was decent, perfectly grilled. I'll definitely come back again.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place serves really delicious food.

sample_reviews_en.text: Never eat at this restaurant again!! The restaurant said it closes at 8 PM. I drove a long way to eat your basil chicken rice. I arrived at 7:50 PM, 10 minutes before closing time. I saw they were still cooking because there were only two tables of customers. But when I walked in, the staff said they weren't selling, they were closing the shop. I suggest that if you don't want to sell, just close the shop and do something else. If you don't have the heart to provide good service, the food you produce won't be of good quality, so just close down. I have money, I'm not begging anyone for food!!

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers a wide variety of made-to-order dishes. If you're hungry and passing by, you can stop in for a meal. The restaurant is located in a PTT gas station, has plenty of parking, and clean restrooms.

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was delicious! The basil chicken was flavorful and the meat was tender and of high quality. The clear soup was well-balanced. Free water and ice were provided 🥹. My only minor complaint is that the fried egg was very oily and needed blotting. If they could fix this, it would be perfect! …

The kimchi stew was good, but Bonchon is tastier and cheaper. I understand that the side dishes are refillable.

It's unlikely to be able to handle it when it's full.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gift Angsuphant

sample_reviews_en.text: A new Korean BBQ restaurant has opened. They have a promotion: buy one pork set, get one free for 299 baht. Lots of side dishes, refillable. sample_reviews_en.text:

sample_reviews_en.author: mew Jung

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! I'm so glad I brought my siblings here. The staff were very attentive, especially Umiim, the grill attendant at our table. She was wonderful, always smiling, and constantly asking if we needed anything else.

sample_reviews_th.text:
Soup prices are updated as shown in the picture.
**5฿ per skewer for a few items, such as glass noodles (1 stick) and small, cute noodles.**
Chicken feet 20฿ per skewer, fish tofu 20฿ per skewer (2 pieces), large sausage cut in half 10฿ 😂
The portions are very small. Pork belly platter 40฿ with 5 thin slices. Dipping sauce 29฿ per person. The sesame sauce is almost gone from the pot, and the taste is just average.
For 2 people, the bill was over 800฿. Personally, I feel the price and quantity are not appropriate.
sample_reviews_th.author: Thitiya P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are looking for a Chinese restaurant, you will be able to find a Chinese restaurant, a Chinese restaurant, and a Chinese restaurant. If you don't want to go back and forth, you can go back and forth. Several cockroaches were present, and the hygiene was worrying. There was even sand in the seaside area. I wouldn't recommend this restaurant to anyone; food safety is seriously a concern.
Terrible dining experience. There was a stale, rotten-like smell as soon as I walked in. The ingredients looked not fresh. Dipping sauce selections were incomplete; even garlic was unavailable. Several cockroaches were spotted near the hot-pot pot; hygiene is really poor. There was sand inside the kelp. I cannot recommend this restaurant. Serious food-safety concerns.
My dining experience was terrible. Upon entering the restaurant, I smelled rotten food. The ingredients were not fresh. The dipping sauces were incomplete, and even garlic was unavailable. Several cockroaches were found near the hot pot. The hygiene is very poor. The seaweed was contaminated with toxins. I do not recommend eating here. There is a food safety risk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Long Nai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've always wanted to try a hotpot experience after watching so many Chinese dramas, and Hueng Hueng Hot Pot in Ratchathewi was a great place to do it!

We visited after a long day of shopping and found it to be quite affordable and fun. The concept is simple and DIY—you first choose your soup base (we went with the mushroom broth), and then pick whatever ingredients you'd like from the rotating selection of toppings and add-ins.

What I liked most was the flexibility. You can take as much or as little as you want, and the pricing depends on the colour of the tong used to pick the ingredients, making it easy to control your budget.

The whole experience was interactive, enjoyable, and perfect for trying different combinations in your hotpot. A great option if you're looking for a casual meal in Bangkok and want to experience hotpot for the first time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kshitija

sample_reviews_en.text:
Even though I'm back in Taiwan, I still have to give this a 5-star review to prove it's really delicious. If you've eaten too much Thai food in Thailand and are craving some Chinese-style spicy hot pot, you should definitely try this place. They also have a Thai-style hot pot, but we didn't order it, so I don't know how it is. However, I found the spicy version incredibly delicious, much better than places like Haidilao. The vegetables were also very fresh; they even had lettuce, which I can't find in Taiwan. For those who enjoy spicy food, try my dipping sauce:

4 tablespoons sesame oil + 1 tablespoon Sichuan peppercorn oil + 2 tablespoons oyster sauce + garlic + salt (adjust to your liking) + cilantro + a little chili oil from the hot pot. Mix it all together and give it a try—it's delicious and goes perfectly with the hot pot!
sample_reviews_en.author: A Po

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm assuming the 5 star reviews were bought. Ingredients were fine but really lacking in variety, and the business practices were absolutely shady. The menu advertises items for 5 BHT but there is ONE item and it's some nasty imitation crab. Everything else is on the upper end with items reaching 50 BHT. You're also charged separately for sauces, and the lady who helps you REALLY pushes things on you, the upsell is absurd. Expect to pay no less than 300 BHT per person even if you're being careful. Much better and more honest options elsewhere. No wonder it was empty.
sample_reviews_en.author: KCC

sample_reviews_en.text:
Small cockroaches were found under the table and in the crevices where the pots were placed. Many of them, some even coming out while we were eating! I was very shocked.

Tables with built-in stoves like this constantly have food scraps falling into the corners and crevices, and the smell of food lasts all day.
If the restaurant isn't cleaned properly after closing, it becomes a perfect breeding ground for cockroaches at night when it's quiet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Loma

sample_reviews_en.text: They have a huge selection of items, everything you need, and the prices are great. I've been here twice already and brought a lot of things, so they provide a cart for me to put my purchases in. 🙏🏼⭐️ It's easy to find the shop; look for the red streetlights. There's construction on the road, so the shop isn't very visible. 🤎🤍🍓🍅
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunkanya Bunthueng

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the most successful hot pot restaurant we've ever had in Thailand, even better than Haidilao! The dipping sauces are also plentiful, highly recommended! Chinese people can go without hesitation! The Tom Yum soup base is also amazing, the kind of place where you end up eating a lot without even realizing it, awesome!
sample_reviews_en.author: 雍珍珍

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves authentic Thai food in a traditional Thai house with a lush garden. There's also a Thai-style resort in the same area. We ordered two Michelin-starred dishes: Miang Kleeb Bua (lotus petal wrap) and Gaeng Kua Krathong Moo Yang (grilled pork curry with star fruit). They were delicious and unique. I especially loved the crispy, sweet and sour sea bass with tamarind sauce. They also have Khao Chae (rice in chilled broth). Everything looked so tempting! It's best to go with a group to try everything. If you love authentic Thai food, I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุนีย์ พรตอุดม

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is nice, with a garden and lotus pond atmosphere.
You might have to turn a blind eye because the land is adjacent to residential apartments where people hang their clothes to dry on the balconies.
It's not 100% wheelchair accessible, but the staff (especially Khun Muay) was helpful.
The food was decent, and beautifully presented.
We didn't order the must-try, rare, traditional dishes,
but simple, ordinary things because we were hungry.
The crispy rice crackers with toppings, the chili paste with minced pork and vegetables, and the Ran Juan curry were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wednesday Child

sample_reviews_en.text: Recommended by the Michelin stars, far from all the hustle and bustle. The Thai food looks traditional, I wonder if it's old recipes, not sure. But the food tastes good. The curries are rich and fragrant, the Pad Thai is even better than it looks, the Banh Xeo is delicious, the steamed fish curry is a little bland. Overall, it's tasty. A bit pricey at 300-400 baht per dish, but acceptable. Good service, not many people, but more staff than customers. The restaurant is beautiful and clean, the surroundings are lovely, with a huge garden.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tui Dusadee

sample_reviews_en.text:
An isolated retreat in the suburbs, this property offers accommodation, meeting room, and functional spaces, all set amidst greenery and a sleepy pond.

The cuisine is traditional royal Thai, meticulously prepared with refined flavors. I ordered several dishes and a dessert, all of which were exceptional. The Srang-Wah-Kung; a spicy grilled shrimp salad with herbs, served in lotus petals. It was particularly flavorful. The red santol curry was incredibly delicious, and the Hor-Mok-Ka-Nom-Krok was a delightful choice as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pui Tippapong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is beautifully presented in an authentic Thai style. The venue is spacious, with the restaurant located in a traditional Thai house. It's also a wedding venue. The food is delicious, and the desserts are made to order, with the sweetness level adjustable. We've brought foreign guests here who were very impressed. They offer Thai traditional costumes for rent, and if you book a package, it includes them. For those who want to experience a retro atmosphere, they also have rooms available.
sample_reviews_en.author: naraporn chainvirattanapit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The authentic Thai royal cuisine here is delicious. I recommend the Miang Klap Bua (lotus leaf wrap), Saeng Wa Kung (shrimp salad), Thung Thong (golden pouches), and many other dishes.
The place is beautiful, they offer Thai costume rentals, and the staff are lovely and provide excellent service.
I hope to come back again to wear Thai costume and enjoy Thai food. They also have accommodations in traditional Thai houses surrounding a lotus pond, but I haven't tried staying there yet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noi Ruchanee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything here was great — especially the staff, super friendly and attentive! There’s plenty of parking space, which is a big plus. I’d recommend making a reservation since it can get busy.

The menu has dishes from all over Thailand, so there’s a lot to choose from. I tried the southern-style food when I was there, and it was really good. Definitely worth a visit if you want to try authentic Thai flavors in a nice setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: VISHNU NUAN-SNITT

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, mostly traditional Thai dishes such as Khao Chae (available only during the summer), Gaeng Ranjuan, Saeng Wa Kleeb Bua, Miang Dok Bua, Nam Prik Long Ruea, Khao Tang Na Tang, Som Chun, etc. The prices are a bit high. The staff provides good service. Most of the flowers used to decorate the dishes are grown on the premises. It's also a venue for banquets and weddings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Omiiigod CJ.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to buy sushi and salmon sashimi at the restaurant. It looked fresh and cheap.
But I was upset because I saw sea urchin sushi in a box on display at the counter, it looked fresh, so I ordered one for about 70 baht. However, the employee gave me a mushy, dark-colored one. I refused to accept it because I couldn't accept its condition, but the employee insisted I pay and said it was already made. The conversation became tense because the employee was trying to force me to pay. I responded, "Even if it's rotten, am I supposed to buy it and eat it? That shouldn't happen. You work here, you should know whether the product is ready to sell or not. You shouldn't force me to buy something that's mushy, watery, and discolored."
I was very disappointed. It's only about 70 baht, I can afford it. I would have willingly paid 300-400 baht before if it was worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHAOTIC 1987

This is the best Ani branch I've ever eaten at. I recommend the squid/octopus sushi with wasabi and the various salmon toppings; they are fresh and tasty. The only downside is that there are only three tables for seating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarocha Thaongthai

sample_reviews_en.text: The sushi was delicious, but the staff's manners need improvement. They stared at customers' every move, intently watching which piece they picked up. I don't understand why they were so intense. When asked questions, they answered as if they didn't want to sell anything.

sample_reviews_en.text: Just feel like giving the locals some support. Food was fresh enough and the shop is suitable for a quick bite.

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't recommend coming here. I heard that the owner has changed. The fried rice tastes average and they are not very customer-friendly. The fried rice in the picture is 60 baht for a small portion and 80 baht for a large portion. I ate here for several days in a row and they charged me 80 baht every time, no matter whether I ordered a large or small portion. It doesn't look like a large portion of fried rice from the picture. Today was even worse. I ordered 80 baht, but the younger of the three female waitresses, a middle-aged woman, charged me 100 baht without any explanation and refused to give me change until I asked her. She then said that she added shrimp to my bill, so it was 100 baht. This is funny. There is no 100 baht price on your menu, and I didn't ask you to add more shrimp. This is forced selling. Because of this restaurant, my impression of Thailand has become bad. Of course, I also met some kind Thai people.
sample_reviews_en.author: synge

sample_reviews_en.text:
I frequented this place during my stay in Pattaya, Japan.

It's bustling with locals from morning till night.

It seems they've been operating in this area for a long time.

They're accommodating even to someone like me who doesn't like spicy food, and everything I've tried is delicious.

If you're considering eating expensive Japanese food,

I think you'll be satisfied if you go here.

They also have fries (better than hamburger joints) for those with children.

Takeout is available.
sample_reviews_en.author: flamingo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stayed at the Melia Hotel and went there every day. The menu is simple and easy to choose from.
I think the reason for the freshness and low prices is that they don't use too many ingredients.
The taste is low in salt, so you can adjust the amount yourself and you won't get tired of eating it every day.
It's reassuring to know that many locals frequent this restaurant.
Beer is also cheaper than other places, so two people can eat and drink for 800 baht and still have change.
sample_reviews_en.author: 大西義

sample_reviews_en.text:
My boyfriend loved it the first time we ate here.
The price is great, and most importantly, the food is delicious and the portions are generous. We ordered shrimp pad Thai and stir-fried basil with a fried egg for only 140 baht – incredibly cheap!
My boyfriend loves it so much he's made it his favorite restaurant in Pattaya.
The staff are also lovely. 🫶🏼🫶🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: สุพักต์วรณ์ เบญพรม

sample_reviews_en.text: As I’m writing this review, I’m enjoying some amazing traditional Thai food at this restaurant. From the outside, it looks like a simple local spot—no AC, no fancy sign—but trust me, the food is absolutely delicious, homemade, and super affordable. It’s a hidden gem in the heart of Pattaya. Come and treat yourself!
sample_reviews_en.author: Prince of Persia

sample_reviews_en.text: Awesome! Delicious food at a very reasonable price. The only thing that surprised me was the ginger in the Tom Yum. We had two Tom Yum, fried chicken wings, and a rice noodle salad. Ice water is complimentary. The food is safe, and it didn't cause any digestive issues at all. A very good place.
sample_reviews_en.author: dar4ik

sample_reviews_en.text: This place offers exceptional value for money. Everything is delicious and costs between 60 and 80 baht. I especially recommend the fried rice. The rice is of excellent quality (I think it's jasmine rice).
sample_reviews_en.author: 杉野正

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly recommended. I go there for breakfast quite often. The food is authentic, healthy, and affordable. The place is usually very busy for breakfast. Not only tourists eat there, but many locals too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul D.

Photo 2 dans l'avis rédigé par Martin Girard

restaurants.name: Kho Khun Beef & Pork Noodle Shop
restaurants.address:

482 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
• Surprisingly good!

• Because the name Kho Khun Mor Fai (โคขุนหม้อไฟ) sounds quite plain, I didn’t expect much from the taste. But as a big noodle soup fan, I found the flavor excellent, on par with many of the well-known beef noodle restaurants in Bangkok.

• Highly recommended if you are in this area, though parking can be difficult to find.
sample_reviews_th.author: Pongpit Pinsai

sample_reviews_en.text: It has to be the hot pot! Absolutely amazing. The meat is top-notch, every cut is good. The beef meatballs are delicious! You can easily finish the whole bowl of rice. The broth is rich and flavorful, with a unique taste that you know is exclusive to this place. The restaurant isn't very big, no air conditioning, a little hot but okay. The staff is quick. It's a street food feel, which is great. I'll definitely be back. The price is mid-range, around 80-100 baht per bowl. The beef hot pot is 300 baht, enough for two people to be full. We also bought some to take home for 100 baht per bag. It's not cheap, but acceptable because it's so delicious. (There's no parking. You might have to park on the side of the road, but I'm not sure if that's allowed. I went to the hospital that day, so I parked at the hospital and walked over.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Abby

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat was delicious, perfectly tender, and there was a variety of cuts. The noodle soup broth was rich and flavorful, perfectly seasoned to complement the meat. The thin noodles were chewy and tasty. They also took orders efficiently. I usually don't eat bean sprouts, but they accommodated my request well. Many restaurants like to add bean sprouts, which ruins the dining experience.

I ate at 11:30 AM and didn't have to wait in line, but if you come at lunchtime, you'll probably have to wait a bit because this area gets very crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Quantump

sample_reviews_en.text:
I happened to be at the hospital and went out to eat.
My pork noodle soup was delicious. The broth was fragrant, slightly sweet from the simmering process. The pork, meatballs, and braised pork were all excellent. I loved the piping hot broth! Just adding chili made it perfect.
My boyfriend had the beef noodle soup with everything in it. He loved it! Lots of ingredients, especially the beef tendon.
After we finished eating, I saw a review of the beef hot pot. My boyfriend has bookmarked it for next time! 😆😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittiya Eksorakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let this be proof I ate here before the hipsters!Smelled so good when I walked by had to bookmark it.

Preferred the dry noodles with the soup on the side. Sauce is so potent every bowl is stained. How is the meat so tender? Would recommend 1.5 portions per person as it’s a little small for me.

Guy at front speaks English well too (nice guy) so tourist friendly. AC’d rooms!
sample_reviews_en.author: Frank Chung

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat and broth were delicious. It's great as a noodle dish or as a soup to eat with rice. It's a casual, easy-to-eat place with mid-range prices.

It's a small shop. If you go during off-peak hours, it's very comfortable. However, during peak hours, you might have to wait in line and it can get a bit hot.

The staff are efficient. Overall, it's good. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Mi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here by chance because it was crowded and there was a queue, but the restaurant was well-managed, friendly, and welcoming. There was a short wait, I don't know how long.

The noodle soup I ate had beef; the portion was generous for the price, and the beef was truly tender and delicious. I've been here twice and have been impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanlayawee W

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a really delicious beef noodle soup. The broth is rich and flavorful.
They give generous portions; the beef and other offal are all tender. If you like tendons, this is the best – super chewy!

The quality is well worth the price. It's always busy, no matter when you come, the restaurant is always full.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tharinee Chaidee

restaurants.name: Swensen's Central Bangrak
restaurants.address:

1522 ถ. เจริญกรุง Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I waited outside the store, made eye contact with the staff, but they just stared back and walked away. So I went in myself. Once inside, the table hadn't been wiped. I waited for a while, but no one came; I had to call them over. After they wiped the table and brought my order, I saw staff members constantly walking in and out of an inner room. I don't know what they were doing there; they seemed very slow and uninterested in taking my order. About 15 minutes passed, and they still hadn't taken my order, continuing to walk around without serving other customers. I tried to make eye contact, but it was no use. I don't know if they're blind or something. So I had to call them over again before they finally came to take my order. I usually eat at this ice cream shop often, and it's the only one I go to. I've taken my family and my partner there, but after this experience, I don't want to patronize them anymore. Looking at other comments from the same year, most are also negative about the staff's service. If the shop continues like this, even if the taste is good and the location is good, nobody wants to go back. If they act like they don't care about customers, they won't last long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sodium Phosphate

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm not okay with the staff. Please read other customer reviews. What kind of service is this where they discriminate? They used judgmental stares, and it took forever to take my order. They acted like they didn't see me, like they were extremely busy. That's not okay. If you're going to be in the service industry, please treat customers properly. This kind of behavior is very impolite. One visit is enough for this branch. If you can improve the staff, please do so. This long message clearly indicates that the staff were unprofessional.
sample_reviews_en.author: Seesuda Sarod

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I came to eat ice cream. They had a good menu item for 88 baht on the 8.8 promotion. I saw they had a Samsung promotion and pointed to the promotion sign to order the Banana Boat. When it was time to pay, they said I didn't mention I could use the 69 baht Samsung discount. But I did point to the sign for the Samsung promotion item (originally 169 baht). A little disappointed. Maybe I didn't communicate well. 🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: JeddxDev

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were young, unenthusiastic, and made mistakes. They took orders completely but didn't fulfill all the requested items. There was no apology; they were laughing and chatting amongst themselves. A male staff member brought a replacement ice cream because the old one had melted before the ordered item arrived. Overall, their work performance was poor.
sample_reviews_en.author: P.

sample_reviews_en.text: There were many staff members, but the service was very slow. It took a long time for them to take our order; they mostly just stood around chatting. The order was incorrect and incomplete. I asked how many items were entered into the order, but they still didn't serve everything. It was quite confusing. The manager should improve the service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apisara Jongyingyot

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff are incredibly rude. If they don't want to work, they should just go home and sleep. They stand around twisting their butts and laughing loudly. How can I not talk about it? When people hear about it, they act like they can't take it, glaring at me. If they know they're being rude, they should at least smile.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรภัสสร จันรอด

sample_reviews_en.text: Located right at the entrance to Central Bangkok. A typical Swensen's place. Unfortunately, our table wasn't properly cleaned, the service was slow but okay, though without any smiles or greetings. I've never experienced that in Thailand before. The shakes were made with a lot and much too large ice cubes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matze Schenke

sample_reviews_en.text: There was absolutely no organization whatsoever, from customer service to order taking. We had to call three times to get our food, and even then, the order was incomplete. Some items were out of stock without any prior notice, which likely caused the delay. I'm not sure why, but please address this issue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittiwat Suwakhon

restaurants.name: สเต็กลุงหนวด บางอ้อ
restaurants.address:

RG26+XPQ, Charan Sanit Wong Rd, Bang O, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A blonde female employee with tattoos on her arm was incredibly rude. I'm not sure if she was the owner or an employee. The bill didn't include the water charge; it stated 145 baht but she charged 159 baht.
When I asked about it, she replied, "Who paid for the water?" She just said there was a water charge and it wasn't included in the bill. Is that so hard to say? She shouldn't be selling things like that. She didn't apologize at all, just sat there smiling. If she's mentally unstable, she should get treatment, not take it out on customers.
I was extremely disappointed. Should I have to experience this?
If you're an employee, please provide some training. Even for a roadside stall, the service should be better. I was paying for this, not asking for it for free.
Below standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jee P

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes okay. We eat there regularly because our condo is nearby. One day, the pork chop was undercooked. We informed the staff, but no one paid attention. The next day, when we went back and asked the staff member to cook it well, she yelled at us, which was very confusing. She was very rude, repeatedly asking who we told to tell her. Her manners were terrible. No matter how delicious the food is, if the staff speaks like that, I won't be going back. This is from someone who works in the service industry and has eaten there frequently; this kind of behavior is unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wiparat W.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is absolutely terrible. I ordered a chicken steak set to take home and waited for almost half an hour, and it still wasn't ready, while other people who ordered after me got their food first. What kind of service is this? Why didn't they tell me anything? Why did they just let me sit there like that? Are they choosing their customers? Why don't they have a queuing system? Terrible, awful, awful. This is the last time I'll ever go here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bankkie Ztyza

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food: 8/10
Service: 1/10 because customers arrived without taking orders.
Both the guy with glasses and the lady with pink hair kept clearing the plates on the table. The menu was displayed for customers to see before they cleared the plates. The lady standing near the stove saw this and brought the menu to me to take my order. This isn't new, this is the second time I've encountered this.
Please improve our service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apinya Apinya

sample_reviews_en.text: Anyone using the government's co-payment scheme (Plus) can use it at Uncle Nuad's Steakhouse. We ate their chicken salad two days in a row. The first day, we ate at the Pin Ngern Pin Thong branch, and they gave us the dressing separately in a bowl. Today, we ate at the Meeting Mall branch and asked for a little extra dressing (a little means as much as the restaurant provides), but the server said no. That's it!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Latisha Luamsri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork chop was huge and delicious.
The only downside was the salad it came with; it wasn't the same as the salads I've had with steaks at other restaurants.
No big deal, but maybe the pictures should better reflect the actual dish to avoid customer expectations.

I'll definitely visit again if I have the chance. Parking is easy within the complex.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phanpilas Tun.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food portions are very small, and many items seem like they weren't sourced from a franchise and don't meet the standards of other branches at all—it's outrageously different. I'd also like to see improvements in the staff's communication and demeanor. Small portions, not tasty, unfriendly staff. The Maggi sauce was the best part!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pan Pitch

sample_reviews_en.text: The sausages were delicious, but the pork and chicken steaks could be better. I was confused about the salad on the side; it was just plain greens with no dressing. You have to buy dressing separately to eat with the vegetables. The food didn't take long to arrive. The bread wasn't amazing, just edible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gloyjai ᯓᰔ

restaurants.address:

G. Floor Ambassador Hotel Bangkok (Sky WIng 171 Sukhumvit 11 Aly, KlongTeoy Nue Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything about Am Cafe is Five ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐.
The food quality here can't be matched along with the sheer variety of options to choose from are simply the Best.

I can tell that the staff really care about their culinary food craft. They really take pride and are very friendly and helpful.

We always, always look forward to eating here with our stay. It simply cannot be matched. Thank you, thank you to everyone here who makes it happen. I can't wait to return for this wonderful experience and great care.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr Google

sample_reviews_en.text: Visit this place many times, always happy because of the real coffee, but this time no more real coffee but a kind of powder coffee, horrible. The manager Oak helped me out here and brought my wife and me real freshly brewed coffee, what a wonderful service
sample_reviews_en.author: koenraad schmitz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was great, except the coffee, which used to be freshly brewed, had been replaced with machine-made coffee.😆 But Mr. Oak, the manager here, took good care of us and found freshly brewed coffee for us instead. Happy Day!☕️😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Meena Saengow

sample_reviews_en.text: This Am cafe is only for the guest at Ambassador Hotel, Bangkok. We cannot go for breakfast buffet if not guest. Massive restaurant. Full of hassle and bustle. Amazing decor and spacious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nisha Noronha

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant manager is very kind and he treat my sister who come to meet me |he treat coffee and water also and good compliments amazing he is kind and polite parson nice people
sample_reviews_en.author: seemar sutar

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoy a delicious breakfast at Ambassador Hotel...Breakfast with a great atmosphere, inviting you to savor a variety of exquisite dishes. Welcome 🙏 …
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนธา ต่อตัน

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a best experience .. the food was good so many options,
staff was soo friendly helpful and aslo i like to be here in my next trip aswell😍😍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Soni Singh

sample_reviews_en.text: Great selection of tasty food. All staff were friendly and professional. Spotlessly clean. A good hotel eatery.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rotary Dee Why Warringah

restaurants.address:

363/32 ซอยพัทยาใต้ 16 Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered hummus for delivery to the hotel but I received something else that looked horrible I don't know what it is at all, and I charged a taxi 100 baht not as stated in the conversation, I went to the store but they disclaim responsibility and they send me to another store claiming that they didn't make the order. The food is not recommended at all Name of the store aicha lebanon
sample_reviews_en.author: אהרון רצון

sample_reviews_en.text: The fava beans tasted like nothing but spices and onions. The arayes were just a name, and the bread they said was from a tandoor oven, but they brought burnt Lebanese bread. The food had no flavor whatsoever; it wasn't even worth 20 [currency unspecified]. It had no taste at all. Not good food, no taste at all. I don't like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Falih

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, I went to smoke shisha there and many people told me it was the best place after Al-Jamrah shisha, but unfortunately Al-Jamrah has been closed since we arrived until we left. Anyway, they have double apple shisha. It's good. It's a lifesaver.
sample_reviews_en.author: طارق المطيري

sample_reviews_en.text: I enjoyed this restaurant because they offered shisha during my meal there. The meal was good and the service was attentive. One of the best restaurants to have dinner and relax. They run the ventilation well so you don't get smothered by smoke.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Sosa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place! Great price and quality! It's hard for a tourist to find a hookah or nargile for under 900 baht, but this place is more or less okay. You won't see any Russian tobacco. But Retro Adalya and Al Fakher are welcome.
Recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Иван Макаров

sample_reviews_en.text: Hello, I've been coming here for years, very, very good team, very friendly, open 24 hours a day, excellent manager, I have rarely seen a restaurant as clean as this one, I recommend it and I will come back often.
sample_reviews_en.author: twityanis938

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd say it was a great experience. The shisha was made differently than usual, but it was excellent. For example, they used small pieces of coal instead of the usual large cubes. The food was also very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Loris Bertoldi

sample_reviews_en.text: Very disappointed, it's not a restaurant but a shisha bar. The food isn't good and it's very expensive compared to other places. They claim to serve alcohol, but you have to wonder if it's really halal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yves Sauvegrain

sample_reviews_en.text: I order from this restaurant very often. I've almost tried every item on the menu. I highly recommend it. The food is delicious and suits my taste. The restaurant is very clean, the staff are lovely and friendly, and they give great recommendations. I'd definitely recommend it to others.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poo Kii

sample_reviews_en.text: The spicy salad was incredibly delicious! The fermented fish sauce was great. The price was very cheap. I didn't expect much at first, but it was amazing! 💕 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pinky cake

sample_reviews_en.text: The spicy salad is delicious! Whenever I'm in the area, I always stop by to buy some. The vendor is lovely and speaks politely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanoknapa Massaya

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so delicious! The staff at the Sriwara branch in front of 7-Eleven were very impressive and made it incredibly tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: SAII

sample_reviews_en.text: I order the glass noodle salad with minced pork regularly. It's the perfect glass noodle salad flavor!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rutporn

sample_reviews_en.text: Came back for more, it's delicious and spicy. I love the minced pork glass noodle salad the most.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธีรธรณ์ หลีประเสริฐ

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was incredibly delicious. The shrimp paste salad with shrimp was especially amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lynda Issara

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is a bit high, but the taste is rich and delicious, but it's a bit too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Setthaphon Man

restaurants.address:

517 Rama III Rd, Bang Phong Phang, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes great, it seems like they have a secret recipe. The braised beef is incredibly tender, the crispy pork is deliciously crispy and not chewy, and the roasted duck with rice is tender and flavorful – delicious even without dipping sauce. However, this dish takes a while to prepare. The restaurant is located by the roadside, and you can park on the side of the road in front of the restaurant. The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lin R.

sample_reviews_en.text: Parking is inconvenient as you have to park on the side of the road. They give very little dipping sauce, unlike other restaurants. For a group of 5, they only gave one set and we had to ask for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: จุฑาทิพ ทองบุญรอด

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish is delicious, especially the rich and flavorful Gaeng Om (Thai curry). The owner and staff are friendly and attentive. It gets busy in the early evening, so expect a wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandra Sukhabut

sample_reviews_en.text: It's right at the entrance of my street. My girlfriend loves their ant egg salad; it's delicious and not too spicy. Their grilled chicken is also tasty. It's crowded every day.
sample_reviews_en.author: ratchanee NaThanee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is flavorful, in the style of Northeastern Thai cuisine, with a rich and savory taste. Every dish is delicious. I recommend the fried sea bass with fish sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: โศภณ สัจจวัฒนกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: We live near by and I come to eat here regularly. The food is amazing, real Thai street food. The food is consistently good and the plates and silverware are clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christophe Amatayakul

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers a wide variety of delicious Northeastern Thai dishes at affordable prices, making it perfect for group meals and drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worapot Ch

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled food tasted good, but the papaya salad was a disappointment; it was too sour. We also waited a very long time for our food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chairat Chuen-Ahrom (Tun)

restaurants.name: Ban Hao Kitchen
restaurants.address:

18, 89 Nak Niwat Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times. It's tasty, I understand, and there are children who understand, but you should tell the kids to stop being disobedient. Playing with water guns through the papaya salad plate and getting it on my shirt like that is inappropriate. Anyone who wants to eat here should eat at the restaurant next door instead. I recommend it; it's also delicious. Terrible, terrible, terrible, terrible, terrible!
Terrible, terrible, terrible, terrible, terrible! I'm a woman wearing a white shirt and it got stained with fish sauce. I wiped it with water, but my shirt is thin. I paid and walked out. It's good that I paid because I felt like a fellow human being. Terrible, terrible, terrible! I do not recommend eating here. I do not recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charawi

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried out Ban Hao Kitchen on Nakniwat Road, Lad Phrao, and it's a decent spot for local food, especially if you're into northern Thai cuisine. Some dishes pack quite a spicy punch, so be prepared if you can't handle the heat. The atmosphere is pretty laid-back, making it a good place for a casual meal. While the food was generally good, it didn't completely wow me. Overall, I'd give it three stars. It's worth a visit if you're in the area and craving some northern Thai flavors.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zainal

sample_reviews_en.text:
Larb Krua Baan Hao Restaurant
Open 5 PM - 3 AM
Cool breeze atmosphere by the roadside
Spacious with many tables, rating 9/10
Parking available on the street and in the alley, rating 9/10

sample_reviews_en.author: pongpot chaijaruwanich

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! This is the first time I've found a somtum (papaya salad) restaurant that doesn't use garlic. The staff were lovely, the spicy salad was tasty, and the larb (spicy minced meat salad) was flavorful. We finished everything! Haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: butsabong panya

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers traditional dishes from the Isan region of Thailand. I had Som Dam and Yum with seafood, which I thoroughly enjoyed and highly recommend. The staff were very friendly and attentive. There is ample seating available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonchanok Kluakaew

sample_reviews_en.text: The spicy papaya salad with fresh shrimp was delicious! The fermented fish sauce was perfectly spicy and just right. The sticky rice portion was so generous it overflowed the container! ❤️❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: BIBI

sample_reviews_en.text: There were a lot of mosquitoes. The food was delicious, the hot pot was excellent, the dipping sauce was great, the papaya salad was tasty, and the chicken feet soup was fantastic. Love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Karnistha Teerameteachot

sample_reviews_en.text: Great find! Nephew's stall at Chokchai 4, near the Crime Suppression Division, serves grilled meat, grilled intestines, and cheap beer. Open late.
sample_reviews_en.author: Afro Maple
