restaurants.address:

Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
From my visit, I’d more than likely NOT return, nor would I recommend a friend to go here…

UNLESS they changed and added a couple of things …

I bought the Crown Box, Not Spicy…

The chicken was bland, meaning no flavor no seasoning at all…

You don’t offer Hot Sauce, I’m not talking about chili sauce, I’m talking about hot sauce that people like to put on their chicken…

Examples,    Red Hot Sauce and or Texas Pete Hot Sauce…

You should offer whole pickled flavor jalapeños also, people love those with their chicken also and yes customers will pay for them…

Have them displayed on your menu board and have them displayed in a large clear glass jar behind the counter…
sample_reviews_en.author: CHRIS WOODS

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best fried chicken in Pattaya. Better than kfc and McDonald’s

Great location, clean, hygienic, good food and service

Our food was made quickly and tasted exceptional and is the best fried chicken we’ve had in Thailand. The staff were friendly and courteous.

The prices have increased by 50% since we were last here a month ago for no logical reason

They have free parking to the rear of the building and you can use the exterior toilets for free if you show your receipt from the restaurant

Food prices and menu on grab are completely different
sample_reviews_en.author: King S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chicking was a fantastic dining experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely delicious, with great flavors and quality that really stood out,

A special mention to the manager, Mr. Haris, who was exceptional. He was attentive, welcoming, and made sure every customer felt comfortable and well taken care of. His professionalism and genuine care truly elevated the entire experience.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food, a halal-friendly environment, and outstanding hospitality. I’ll definitely be coming back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Moh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely Fantastic! I wanted to order delivery however none of the delivery services were delivering as it was out of range, requested to the restaurant directly and they went out of the way to support! They arranged online payment and a rider who delivered within no time!

The food was freshly prepared, hot when received and very tasty! Can beat any fried chicken chain any day and on top of it its Halal as confirmed by the restaurant!

Highly Recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Saqib Riaz

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow.  Went on Saturday 01/10.  Ordered a 3pc Royal Meal at 12:03pm.  Nobody in restaurant except a single diner who already has his food and couple ladies with their child who already had their food.  I didn’t get my order until 12:27pm.  And they forgot my fries, had to ask for them.  I’ll give it to them the food was fresh and hot, but not very tasty.  Need some retraining.  Good luck on staying open.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: Easily one of the best fast food restaurants I’ve been to, the service was immaculate, staff were extremely friendly and the manager made us feel welcomed and comfortable. The wait time was not too long considering we ordered 30 minutes before closing time. The food was fresh and delicious, all cooked to perfection. Overall the experience was amazing, will be returning soon ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: hayley poop

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pride Chicken Specialty Shop
I recommend this place because it's cheap.
There's no toilet, so you'll have to pay to use the outdoor toilets.
The chicken itself wasn't that tasty.
But, looking at the prices, the nuggets and other items are cheaper than the McDonald's next door.
I think the best thing to do is get some takeout and relax on Pattaya Beach.
sample_reviews_en.author: 輝宮城

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thank you for inviting us to the store opening!
The fried chicken is incredibly crispy on the outside and still very tender on the inside. It's affordably priced and 100% halal. For anyone who prefers halal food, you absolutely can't miss it!!!

Melt-in-your-mouth chicken pops, incredibly tender and delicious.
🎉🎉
sample_reviews_en.author: จูน สาธิตา

restaurants.name: Bangkok Congee (Soi Sutthiporn)
restaurants.address:

248, 2 Sukkasem Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Great place for breakfast! Tidy and calm. Filling and delicious.

Today we tried pork porridge and black beans bao pao.

Certainly going here tomorrow - there is an option with 3 different eggs: regular, salted and century egg I’m looking forward. Strong beginning of the day with a lot of protein!

Next day:
จ๊ก 3กษัตริย์ (ไข่ลวก ไข่เค็ม ไข่เยี่ยวม้า ) 3 kings (poached eggs, salted eggs, braised horse eggs). Porridge itself was with chicken and pork offal. Salted and century eggs are a perfect match for the jok (Thai rice porridge)
sample_reviews_th.author: Nina Kilaru

sample_reviews_en.text: It wasn't as good as the food I ate at the Khao San Road night market before. The female staff were very enthusiastic and always greeted everyone who came in with a smile. Although they didn't speak English, they helped me with gestures. I'm giving it five stars for their enthusiasm.
sample_reviews_en.author: 白慕寒

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoyed the porridge and bpao lot! The price-quality ratio is great. There are tables inside, and the service was attentive and kind. They do lack a menu in English 😅 which makes the place only more authentic anyway.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I often order delivery.
The porridge here is very delicious.
The toppings are portioned and fresh.
I recommend the porridge with meatballs and poached eggs.
sample_reviews_en.author: TK A

sample_reviews_en.text: I just ate here for the first time. Personally, I like to eat hot porridge. This one is not very hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: พัชรพร เสริมสินสายทอง

sample_reviews_en.text: A very good restaurant to eat a Thai breakfast staple: jok, rice porridge. With meatballs or offal.
sample_reviews_en.author: LZK “Jibeset” Bernard

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is very authentic and delicious 👍 It's a local breakfast, definitely worth a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas

restaurants.name: ห้องอาหารบ้านของเรา
restaurants.address:

230, 2 Lat Phrao 130, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: If the owner happens to see my review, I have a few minor suggestions for improvement. Everything else is pretty good already; the place is inviting, the atmosphere feels upscale, and the food is delicious and reasonably priced. My areas for improvement are the sound system – specifically, the sound from the speakers could be better – and the microphones; reducing echo in the room makes it difficult to understand. Replacing the curtains with red velvet would enhance the luxurious feel of the restaurant by over 70% and also provide more privacy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thongchai

sample_reviews_en.text: We arrived almost in the evening. The place was fully equipped. The food was good and delicious, as were the drinks—tea, coffee—and desserts. There was also live music, and you could order whatever you wanted, creating a relaxed atmosphere. You could even dance or ballroom dance if you wanted! I loved it. Nearby, there's also a football field, fitness center, and golf course.
sample_reviews_en.author: WanI wani

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is beautiful, the music is good, and the sound system is great, but the food wasn't very impressive. And the staff... none of them seemed welcoming or helpful; they worked as if they were being forced.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธีระบุตร ศุขสวัสดิ์

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a really cute shop. It's full of senior members who sing and ballroom dance, having a great time. If you have older relatives who enjoy music, I highly recommend coming here. It's a true community hub.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sitichok Ekbundit

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere in the restaurant is great, the sound system is good, there's live music playing in the background, the food is decent, the prices are fair, and there's very convenient parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wichien Chantayasakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Chicken stir-fry with basil and creamy egg. Delicious, spicy and flavorful. The atmosphere is beautiful, and there's a coffee shop where you can sit and relax.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภัทรกฤต สุวรรณจิตร

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant where customers can sing along to live music from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. The musicians are skilled and can play a variety of genres.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชาญชัย นิลศิริ

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the special stir-fried noodles with pork and wide rice noodles. It looked great, tasted delicious, and was very filling. I recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Suphol Pachpun

restaurants.name: Horse Shoes Tavern
restaurants.address:

308/76-77 ทัพพระยา, Nongprue, Banglamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A visit to the "8 Horseshoes" restaurant was a true gastronomic treat. The interior is tastefully decorated, creating a cozy and atmospheric ambiance. The service is top-notch: the staff is polite and attentive, always ready to help with your choice.

The menu offers a varied selection, each prepared with care and attention to detail. We were particularly impressed by the Russian and Uzbek dishes. We also appreciated the high-quality drinks, which perfectly complemented the food.

Overall, "8 Horseshoes" is the perfect place for a romantic dinner or a get-together with friends. We will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ирина Мошкина

sample_reviews_en.text:
I loved everything! It was delicious and inexpensive. The service was absolutely top-notch; you could tell the waiter was putting in the work, caring, and trying.
I had the eggplant rolls. I personally like them fried in oil, but the baked ones were delicious too.
I ate less than half of the roll; it was huge and filling. It could have used a little more sauce; it was a bit dry, but it didn't affect the taste. It was a truly worthwhile dish with a delicate cheese filling 🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Olya

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible, disgusting manti. Never, ever, ever order manti from here. We ordered manti, but they brought us some kind of undercooked khinkali. The dough and minced meat were half-raw. The kids went hungry because of your food! 🤬😡 How can this be? If you don't know how to cook this dish, why even put it on the menu? And we spent 750 baht on it! 🤬😡 I don't recommend it!!!! Horrible!!! Horrible!!! Horrible!!! I want to throw up from these manti!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Meyil Muratova

sample_reviews_en.text: Second visit photo of Double Beef Burgers(Salsbury Steak) and German fried potatoes was excellent 👍......As the name suggest well stocked Bar.However I went for dinner.The menu has a nice variety from Thai to Russian with Soups, Salads and Desserts.I personally had the Beef Stroganoff and Chocolate Lava Cake for dessert.The beef was tender and a large serving of mashed potatoes.I recommend and will return to The Horseshoe Tavern
sample_reviews_en.author: Del Rudd

sample_reviews_en.text:
Large and juicy cutlets! Delicious with a light and appropriate spiciness. I was pleasantly surprised by the amount of meat 👏🏼 The cucumber and tomatoes were also delicious. I would have liked the potatoes to be more fried, not soft. But the sauce made me laugh. Ketchup and mayonnaise are not serious business for a restaurant. Please come up with a more interesting sauce 🙏🏼😀
Very pleasant atmosphere and music
Meal: 230 baht
sample_reviews_en.author: Алеся

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're tired of Thai food and miss your homeland, this place is for you. I haven't had such delicious food since leaving Russia.

Huge respect for the aspic; it was like visiting grandma in the countryside. The only thing was the mustard wasn't very good, but that's okay.

Fast service; they brought everything in literally 15 minutes. I'll definitely want to come back again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Артем Всефизиков

sample_reviews_en.text: The minced beef dumplings were extremely low quality—filled with small bones, tough cartilage, and very difficult to chew. To make matters worse, they were served scalding hot and burned my tongue. For dessert, the syrniki were disappointing; they were mostly dense dough with barely any cheese, nothing like traditional syrniki should be. I would not recommend eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ron Nõmm

sample_reviews_en.text: First time we tried this place, but it a as just fine. We seated outside, and the light above our table did not work, so it was a bit dark to see a menu. Solyanka and longman were nice, but shashlyk (BBQ) from chicken and pork was hard and no much taste, seems it was not marinated. The price is a bit high as well. I have tried better Russian restaurants in Pattaya
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Pav

restaurants.name: Jarn Kub Kao Restaurant Vibhavadi 20
restaurants.address:

90, 146 Vibhavadi Rangsit 20 Alley, Lane 7, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: This Thai restaurant in Soi Viphavadee 20, แยก 7 (intersection 7), has a simple yet stylish and chic decor with plenty of photo opportunities for customers who enjoy taking pictures. The food focuses on Thai cuisine. The calamari fries are an unusual but delicious dish. The spicy snail curry was to my liking, but I personally didn't like the coconut milk dip as it was a bit too mild, although others might enjoy it. Many other dishes were also delicious and not overly spicy. The food was beautifully presented, and the service was quick.
sample_reviews_th.author: Moolyracing

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai restaurant serves delicious food, perfect for family gatherings. It feels just like eating at home, with flavorful and well-balanced dishes suitable for all ages. Today, I ordered several dishes and my favorite was the braised eggs in soy sauce – the broth was amazing! I highly recommend it. The sour curry with acacia leaves and shrimp was also good, and the fish cakes were incredibly soft and delicious. The service was excellent; the waitstaff were attentive, clearing plates, refilling water, and providing great care. The cutlery and plates were spotlessly clean. The atmosphere was wonderful; the interior was warm, homey, and beautifully simple, creating a comfortable and inviting feeling. It's not overly luxurious or intimidating, making it suitable for everyone. I personally loved it and will definitely bring my family back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Realnon 17

sample_reviews_en.text: My husband and I discovered this restaurant through Google while searching for options nearby during our stay. The positive reviews made us want to try it, but unfortunately, we left without tasting your food because, upon entering, the three staff members at the counter were unfriendly and racist. There was no welcoming greeting; we smiled for a while, but no one said anything or seemed pleased to have customers in the restaurant. We were confused by the treatment we received. Although we weren't dressed formally, we weren't inappropriately dressed either. We felt like we were being stared at and left the restaurant immediately. It was a very unpleasant experience. Please address the behavior of your staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lalaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is just like mom's home-cooked meals. It's delicious and authentic. I highly recommend trying it at least once.

Taste: 10/10 (no deductions)
Service: 9/10 (5% service charge applies)
Atmosphere: 10/10

Food ordered:
Fresh Shrimp Chili Paste: Perfectly balanced sweet and sour flavor. A must-try.
Kua Kling (stir-fried minced pork with chili): For those who don't like dry food, you might like this.
Stir-fried Cowslip Flowers with Glass Noodles: A little too oily.

Overall, I will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: TC Review

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very comfortable place to eat, with air-conditioned space, and comfortable chairs. Space to park is limited. The hor mok was excellent, and the stir fried chilli stink bean prawns were very good,  although a little too mild in taste for me. It was fresh, but the sauce could have been cooked a little longer to smooth out the ingredients. It is a place to order a variety of dishes, but the southern style dishes are more enticing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam Aitken

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was so delicious I forgot to take pictures! There were four of us as a family, and we ordered seven dishes and two bowls of rice – and we finished everything… Unbelievable! It was truly delicious. The atmosphere was great, the service was good, the restaurant is easy to find, and there’s parking. We’ll definitely come again!
sample_reviews_en.author: จิรนันท์ กุสุมานนท์รังษี

sample_reviews_en.text: Nov. '14 Delicious restaurant in the area behind Thai Airways. Accessible from both Vibhavadi 20 and Soi Lat Phrao 18. Recommended dishes: Shanghai pork. There are many other dishes that I haven't tried, but judging from the menu, they should be delicious. There is parking in front and on the side. The staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฅนสัญจร

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Southern Thai restaurant.

The food is served quickly.
It's very delicious and flavorful.
The sour curry with acacia leaves is rich and tasty.
The stir-fried stink beans with shrimp paste and shrimp is superb; flavorful, and the shrimp is fresh and firm.
Every dish tastes exactly right.

The atmosphere is also nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Park Bodhisundara

restaurants.name: MARU MARU PIZZA
restaurants.address:

14 Sukhumvit 67 Alley, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were very lucky to get a table for two as a walk-in ♥️

The atmosphere is what makes this place special. It feels like stepping into a creative space, the jazz music, and the overall vibe make it feel unique.

We ordered the Quincy Jones pizza and it was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of flavor, with four cheese and a refreshing orange jam combination. We also ordered the broccoli grilled dish, it was wonderfully crispy, flavorful, and had a great texture.

We also tried the Pasta Vogole, which was very tasty. The portion was generous and perfect for sharing for 3 people.

We each had a cocktail, we ordered the Honeymoon in Kochi, and we also tried the Marzcal Sour. Both drinks were excellent and complemented the meal perfectly.

The food was delicious, the cocktails were excellent, and the staff were attentive, friendly, and welcoming. The team is international and speaks English well.

Parking is available on-site.

Definitely a great place to hang out with friends. The cozy atmosphere, jazz music, and overall vibe make it a wonderful spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melanie Sukhyanga

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have followed these guys since their  warehouse pop up. Their new location does not disappoint.

Best pizza I’ve had in Bangkok, best in Southeast Asia, and comparable to anything I’ve had in Tokyo. If you’re a fan of crispy Neo-Neapolitan, this is the place for you.

I was amazed they were able to do the flavors and the char on the pizza when they were using an electric oven, and now that they have an Italian fire oven, the pizzas feel dialed in and their ingredients do not disappoint.

They do a 48 - 72 hour ferment on their dough, the pizza sauce is well thought out, and they use great tomatoes. This leads to an incredibly fluffy pizza with great crisp and awesome flavors; really a testament to the Neo-Neapolitan / Tokyo style.

This is a can’t miss for any pizza fanatics. Will be dining here any chance I get.

The marinara is my favorite, followed by the fancier smoked pork belly. Special shout out to their charcoal smoked olives and their soy sauce tiramisu.

Congrats to the team, love the new spot. See you soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Liu

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is extremely difficult to catch open for those of us who don't live nearby.  The hours are very limited.  But some good news is that if you go on a weekend and arrive by 2pm, you can stay beyond that time to eat (but kitchen does close at 2pm so you have to order before then). The staff were very friendly and helpful.  The pizza options are interesting and unique. I particularly liked the Caesar Salad, as they serve it with these crushed up super crispy croutons. The Sapporo on tap was also a nice change of pace.  But honestly I probably won't repeat this place because it is VERY PRICEY.  The beers alone were nearly 300 baht (with their ++ surcharges) for a small size.  Some pizzas were 800 baht. And the execution on the pizzas left a lot to be desired. The vodka sauce pizza didn't have enough vodka sauce to actually taste it (dominated by the polish sausage).  Pepperoni pizza was extremely greasy.  Our bill was over 4,000 baht for 4 people.
sample_reviews_en.author: chriskennedy100 Kennedy

sample_reviews_en.text:
I think I’ve found the best pizza in Thailand and Maru Maru is it! I know it sounds like an exaggeration but it’s true.

Crust is crisp on the outside (think NY style pizza) but the dough inside is still fly and moist. Pizza sauce was perfectly seasoned, toppings were simple but expertly balanced in taste and texture.

Pasta was also cooked al dente with generous portions and served piping hot. The kale and butterscotch salad was refreshing and tangy.

Vibe of the restaurant is super cool - funky jazz music, good energy from the kitchen and a blend of steel & neon interior. Staff are super friendly and efficient. Drinks menu is exhaustive too! Love it here! 🍕🍷🍺

This place gets super full so highly recommend you book. Some parking on site but hard to find as it’s down a small alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernard Cheng

sample_reviews_en.text: Located at the end of the soi, this hidden gem is a must-visit for anyone who loves expertly executed Japanese-Italian fusion. The atmosphere is stylishly industrial and chic, complemented by a highly attentive staff with deep knowledge of the menu. Unlike many high-end restaurants that serve small portions for a premium, the pricing here is very fair, offering generous quantities without compromising on quality. The cocktails are on point and the pasta was served perfectly al dente. While the experimental tiramisu with soy sauce wasn't personally to my taste, it’s an interesting experience for the adventurous. Overall, this is an ideal spot for both an intimate date or a group dinner, and I will definitely be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: HL

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here lived up to the hype. The pizza was great, especially the dough (I enjoyed the crust almost as much as the toppings!). Although we tried the special northern thailand topping and I didnt enjoy it as much as the more classical toppings its my bad for trying something unproven. The vongole pasta was also great and the portion was huge! The open kitchen was exciting but may give your clothes and hair smelling like the food. We booked our table in advance and around the reserved time a kind staff called me to check whether we were still going to come or not which was nice (we were a few mins late). There were plenty of parkings around. Quite pricey so wont be having it often but will come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Djakić

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried Maru Pizza and honestly… it was SO good 🍕✨
Like, “light shining out of your mouth” level good 😭

Everything tasted super well-made and balanced, and you can really tell they care about the quality of the food. What surprised me most was how worth it the portions are — each dish is pretty big, so it feels super reasonable for the price.

I’d definitely recommend going with friends because you’ll want to order multiple dishes and share everything together 👀

The atmosphere was really nice, the staff were incredibly sweet, and the overall experience just felt warm and welcoming from start to finish 🤍

Good food, good vibes, great service, and definitely worth going back for.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peryp. Jindawattanachok

sample_reviews_en.text: Tucked away in a quiet alley is Maru Maru Pizza. Cool industrial looking restaurant, granted the area beside looked like a warehouse. Service was great, no question here. Broccoli was mediocre, nothing worth raving about - seems like it’s lacking a kick. Salad was as expected. Pork jowl was standard. Vongole was nice with a kick of spice and the pizza was fantastic. Will definitely be back to try other dishes. Truffle dip for the fries was also good and definitely worth sharing as an appetizer. Music was a touch loud, but acceptable. Making a reservation however was a bit of a hassle. Number of pax and availability was a challenge. Understandably, it’s a busy restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gordon Guy

restaurants.name: Osteria Sendi
restaurants.address:

327, 269 Pattaya Tai 16 Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Choosing this restaurant for our annual date on February 14th was a great decision. The young waitress showed an excellent level of service, was friendly and helpful, and spoke excellent English. The restaurant does not have a large menu, but it has absolutely all the necessary dishes, so this is a huge plus. The pasta was excellent, the home wine warmed our souls, and the incredibly delicious desserts lifted our spirits. The atmosphere in the restaurant is incredible and intimate due to the decor and music. Oh, that music! The owner undoubtedly has excellent musical taste. The only "minus" for us was the lack of space for dancing, because the dinner, atmosphere and music were inclined towards slow dancing. :) Thank you very much for a wonderful evening, we will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nora

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic restaurant..
Food 90% rating (there is always room for improvement that how idea pop out of nowhere) 😈 felt chef Passion !

Service 90% rating ( newer staff need to be educated, if ē tip is good enough for the senior staff,if not she will be poach away)

Atmosphere 120% rating I really like it it's just like a step into Italy

Order a appetizer + main + dessert + house wine very satisfying !!! 😍👍🏻

I assume chef is the boss? No idea at all
I think the chef need a apprentice to settle all easier type food so that chef will have time to talk to those couple or solo
For group customer they are busy haha

If possible maybe chef can pick a 3 course meal w house wine for solo / couple

Hopefully to come back next time 👍🏻

From 🇸🇬
sample_reviews_en.author: Th0mas

sample_reviews_en.text:
A lifeline for Italians abroad when they're longing for the true flavors of "mamma," but also an exceptional advertisement for Italy for those who have never been there or want to refresh their memories.
The food is excellent, as is the service and the hospitality of the staff and the owner, the Chef, always present, smiling, and attentive to detail.
Fresh homemade pasta and specials that change every day, accompanied by a nice glass of wine for a mini trip to Italy without having to catch a plane.
There are only a few tables, so it's best to reserve during peak hours to be safe, although early or late are easier to find.
Please don't spread the word too much, because I don't want to wait long next time I return to Pattaya 😉
sample_reviews_en.author: Davide Poggi

sample_reviews_en.text:
At Osteria Sensi in Pattaya it really feels like stepping into Italy.
The place is small but very charming, tastefully decorated, and with a cozy atmosphere that immediately makes you feel at ease. The staff is friendly, skilled, and always attentive, giving the restaurant a touch of both familiarity and professionalism.

The menu is simple, without unnecessary frills, yet well thought out: every dish is made with genuinely Italian ingredients, imported to ensure the true flavor of tradition. It’s like sitting in a classic Italian osteria, where quality, simplicity, and hospitality are what matter most.

A place well worth trying if you want to enjoy authentic Italian cuisine in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivano Esposito

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent meal.  Nicely done small restaurant on soi bonkot.

Staff is well trained and took orders without incident.

Appetizers came out quickly. I went with the burrata salad. The burrata had a nice firm consistency on the exterior and just melted on the inside. Beautiful.

For the pasta course I selected a rigatoni with bacon and onion and tomatoes. Was fresh and flavorful.  Came to the table piping hot.  The red sauce with bright and tangy. The rigatoni was perfect audente.

Final course was shrimp and squid and potatoes .A heartier red sauce and fresh peas complimented the meal well

The serving are large and prices are extremely affordable.

I shall return
MacArthur
sample_reviews_en.author: Pm Phone

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at this wonderful Italian restaurant and tried their Paccheri con Tonno Fresco e Melanzane. It was a delightful surprise! The pasta was cooked to perfection, “al dente” obviously. The harmony of flavors in this dish was simply outstanding. It's clear that the chef puts a lot of love and care into their cooking, using quality ingredients that truly shine in every bite. This dish alone is a reason to come back. An easy 5 stars for a genuinely fantastic dining experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: KRAIZ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Definitely in the top 5 Italian restaurants I've tried in Pattaya.
The tuna tartare is worthy of applause: fresh, balanced, and carefully prepared.
The calamarata with fresh tuna, eggplant, and cherry tomatoes is amazing. The bread is truly Italian, soft on the inside and crunchy on the outside.
The house white wine... simple, good, and perfect.
The restaurant is tastefully set, with an elegant atmosphere and authentic cuisine.
Definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan Straccia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommend if you are looking for an authentic Italian home cooks.

I ordered 4dishes. (appetizer/Pasta/Beef steaks/Tiramisu)
especially the appetizer which “tomato sauced mussels” was amazing then pasta also okay.

finale was the beef steaks. (should ppl needs to try this too as quality of beef more than good enough and the price was super affordable)

in conclusion, i will definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eddie Shim

restaurants.name: Bonchon Tha Maharaj
restaurants.address:

ห้องเลขที่ F1-02 ชั้น 1 เลขที่ 1/11 ซอย, Trok Maha That, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous Korean fried chicken restaurant with many branches is located in the Tha Maharaj Riverside project.

Their signature dish is their fried chicken. They offer a variety of cuts to suit your preference: drumsticks, wings, or boneless chicken.
The sauces are soy, garlic, and hot, both delicious.
Today, I had the boneless chicken thigh. Personally, I found it to be less flavorful than I've had before. The skin wasn't as crispy as before, and the chicken was dry. I was a little disappointed.
The other dishes were the tofu salad and fried chicken tendons, which were standard.

They're currently offering a free gift when you sign up for a LINE account.
Overall, the prices are quite high.
The staff provided good service and frequently refilled my water, but I was a bit disappointed when I miscalculated the bill, which was a bit of a hassle.
The restaurant isn't very large, with mostly small tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichsaran Ves

sample_reviews_en.text:
After the grand place, we went to catch a ferry back down the river, was needing a drink and a bit peck'ish (hungry), but there is a limited choice of food in that area, all western franchisees (didn't know there was an upstairs)

So only one had people in it, so we picked that one, surprisingly good...
we had, boneless chicken thighs, bonchon fries (with parmesan cheese !!?) And the gyoza- basically a wonton/ dimsim with soya sauce... and a couple of drinks.
The gyoza are really good and parmesan (only the cheap can stuff) on chips is just as you would expect.... cheesy chip concoction for coronary chaos.....
Korean KFC but with cheap chilli sauce, should have just gone across the water to the Wang Lang market for street food at a fraction of the cost and 10 times the choices, still not bad for western food, would have it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: MaKy

sample_reviews_en.text: There were about 4 staff members, 3 of whom seemed unwilling to provide service. When asked about promotions, they seemed reluctant to answer. The food was slow to arrive, even though there weren't many other tables occupied. We ordered over 500 baht and received a free mini birthday cake. We finished our meal, but the cake still hadn't arrived. When we inquired, the staff said to wait 6 minutes. It took longer than that, so we asked to take it home, and received it immediately. Is this offer only for takeout, or is it only available for dine-in? The cake itself didn't seem to require much preparation. Perhaps the long wait was because it was free? If you're not ready, don't offer the promotion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutinan Srithon

sample_reviews_en.text: Bonchon at Tha Maharaj has a fantastic atmosphere because it's right by the Chao Phraya River. Unfortunately, I went around 4 PM and the sun was still strong, so the restaurant had their curtains closed to block the sun. I ended up sitting in the air-conditioned room inside. The Bonchon chicken is delicious; I ordered the Bonchon Chicken Soy Garlic (not spicy). And every time I go, I have to order the Bulgogi Wrap – Korean-style stir-fried pork with fresh vegetables and chopped onions. It's incredibly delicious and I order it every time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ry Orraphan

sample_reviews_en.text: It's quite expensive. There's no Wi-Fi. They give you a welcome drink, but I'm not sure if it's alcohol. I ordered the cheapest dish, bibimbap. It still cost 190 baht plus a 10% service charge. The taste was average. When I search for "restaurants" on Google Maps, I get no results. It's a mystery, or rather, most restaurants don't come up. There are lots of restaurants and cafes around here. There are also Starbucks and Subway.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rolly (hiyokomame)

sample_reviews_en.text: I want to love the food here but the service makes me really upset. It was very awful. While we were ordering the food, the server was so slow and couldn’t answer any questions (of course, all questions were about the food on the menu not other stupid questions.) The drink was so slow to be served. If you are hurry and need a fast-serving food, I wouldn’t recommend this place. It’s just a waste of time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwankamon Udomboonyanuparp

sample_reviews_en.text: Bonchon has opened a branch at Tha Maharaj! The service is good, and the Tha Maharaj branch has plenty of seating, both inside and outside. It's perfect for those visiting the Sanam Luang, Siriraj, or Thammasat Tha Phra Chan areas. Plenty of comfortable seating. The Bonchon menu is standard in taste and price. The restaurant is located right by the river, next to After You. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanthida 'Mim' Saiphim

sample_reviews_en.text: Slow service. Waited for over 30 minutes to be told that my food will not be here due to fault at the back which should at least tell us earlier on instead of making us wait. Did not even serve water until when asked too. Food is nice though. But small portion. Also the place wasn't really crowded so unsure why the food is takes so long for them to inform us that there is fault at the back.
sample_reviews_en.author: seaz

restaurants.name: Santa Fe Steak
restaurants.address:

7F Central, Rama IX Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Santa Fe Steak Happy Steak, 7th floor, Central Rama 9. The restaurant is on the same side as Harborland.

I visited after the re-branding, but the decor in this branch isn't as bright or orange as the fully rebranded branches. The menu has been updated to be brighter and more eye-catching with an orange and blue color scheme. The brand looks younger and more approachable. The restaurant isn't too small or too large, with plenty of seating, and it wasn't overly crowded.

There are many tempting menu items, including beef, chicken, fish, and pork steaks, with prices starting from 100-300 baht per dish. Larger sets are 450+ baht.

The food tasted good, with plenty of side dishes. The beef steak was excellent, tender and delicious. I personally found the American fried rice a bit soggy. The fish and chips were good and not oily. The mushroom soup was a bit watery, not very rich, but still flavorful.

The service was good, and the food arrived quickly, allowing us to enjoy our meal. They even gave out free ice cream cones after the meal, which was a nice touch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Littlepaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
The wait staff were inattentive, including the supervisor or manager (in the brown uniform).
The pork was undercooked. We asked the staff to cook it more, but they didn't bring the pork. We had to ask for it after everyone else had finished eating.
After getting the pork, we asked for dessert, but we had to wait a very long time and had to ask for it again.

It was a meal with an extremely long waiting time, several hours. It was a series of bad experiences: undercooked pork, forgotten pork that needed to be asked for, and forgotten dessert that needed to be asked again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tharittapol Takhumsuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had chosen the truffle pasta, but it contained chicken. I asked if it was possible to substitute fish, but this was refused. To my surprise, when my plate finally arrived, I only received a small amount of pasta for the same price as a full meal; it was as if they had simply removed the chicken from the plate and served it as is.
It's a real shame, especially since my friends thoroughly enjoyed their meat dishes. The restaurant has potential, but I hope they will make an effort to be more flexible and offer larger portions in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isis GALUSKA

sample_reviews_en.text: A classic steakhouse with many branches in Bangkok, nothing exceptional. It's inexpensive, so don't expect anything delicious. There is a decent selection of meats, but it would be nice if they offered high-quality Wagyu beef. It's a bit disappointing because I used to go to this restaurant several times a month for my protein diet and had a membership card for discounts. However, I eventually got tired of it. I find that the food lacks flavor. I wouldn't say it's bad, but it's really just average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mathieu Chaumont

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steak was mediocre.
I ordered the pork chop; the meat was tough and dry, not tender. The sauce was bland.
The mashed potatoes lacked buttery flavor; I only found out from the staff that they were mushroom sauce mashed potatoes 🙄, hence the lack of buttery aroma and taste.
The spaghetti carbonara wasn't fragrant; the sauce was very light and not rich.
Overall, the quality didn't meet the standards it used to. They should improve the flavor and make the steak more tender.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napat W.

sample_reviews_en.text: This steakhouse has decent-tasting steak, but they don't accept credit cards unless you meet a minimum spending requirement. It's unbelievable that a franchise restaurant of this caliber would have such a rule. I hope they improve this practice because this kind of poor customer service negatively impacts service quality and the company's reputation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Non Arkaraprasertkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌴 Delicious! Value for money. Average price. European food with a Thai twist. Large, comprehensive menu.

👨‍🍳 Lots of options with chicken, pork, beef, and even fish 🐟.

By the way, it's great 👍 for kids. Good kids' menu. It's a chain restaurant, great portions.

One of 5 places to eat non-Thai food in the mall. Definitely #recommendation 🤝
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexey Nenashev (Aloha Samui)

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's been a long time since I ate at this steak brand. The last time was several years ago at The Mall Bang Khae, but back then I wasn't very impressed; the chicken was still pink.
But this time it was delicious, the portions were generous for the price, and there was no queue at all as there were plenty of empty seats.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitichote Pao

restaurants.name: Chocolab at SO/ Bangkok
restaurants.address:

2 N Sathon Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
TLDR: drinks were overpriced for what they were... think cheap chocolate powder, milk and ice. Seating area was air conditioned, clean and comfortable

Full review: stopped by with my husband as part of our child-free date day. The place looked promising at first glance.

We ordered the Chocolab Choco Frappe and iced chocolate.

The iced chocolate was a complete disappointment. It was comparable to a cheap cafe in the 1990s in Australia. It literally tasted like cheap chocolate powder (not even Ovaltine for nostalgia value) mixed with milk and ice cubes. After a sip, we left it aside. For the price I was expecting at least nice chocolate flavour if not the kind of iced chocolate with a scoop of ice cream and chocolate sauce.

The namesake drink was at least acceptable, though I still wouldn't describe it as tasty. Note that the white chocolate on the sides of the glass was not part of the drink and purely decoration. Do not consume - I tried scraping some off and it's disgustingly stale.

I also had the coconut and lemongrass truffle. It was tasty but not exceptional.

Overall, not worth the price
sample_reviews_en.author: Cynthia Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a jaw dropped experience with this cafe in So Bangkok hotel….
Came in at 9.30am, trying to get some coffee with some breakfast bite like sausage muffin and hash brown.
But yet we were told that we need to wait for 40mins for the sausage muffin to be ready and 30mins for a simple fried hash brown!
That is a crazy wait time 40 mins! For me, it is enough for me to complete a meal and maybe even a dessert!

Who would wait 30 mins for just a fried hash brown?  And “being prepared by the hotel kitchen upstairs” is not a good reason for your guest to wait 40mins for a simple sausage muffin and harsh brown. To add on, we are only the two customers that is in the cafe! No queue and the cafe is empty!

Terrible experience. Unacceptable wait time. So Bangkok Chocolab, ad a 5 stars, I’m sure you can do better than that.
MacDonald and other fast food outlets is doing much more better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juztin Png

sample_reviews_en.text:
An excellent chocolatier and cafe on the ground floor in SO hotel.  Beautiful ambience, very chill space and the care and quality in food served is excellent.  After 3 stops here it's almost a reason to book into the hotel by itself.

Food scores out of 10:
Ham and brie toastie 8
Danish 10 (as good as anything in Europe)
Hot mocha and hot chocolate 11
Cherry cola float 10
Box of chocolates 9

Chocolate quality is quite excellent hence, and clearly the star ingredient of drinks and foods here.

Yes, it's a bit pricey, but for the quality it's good value.  We paid about 800b average for 2 drinks and 2 food items (eg Danish and toastie).  The chocolates are about 50b each, get a box of 9 for a good selection.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rob

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wanted to eat croissants and hotel pastries but there was no delivery, so I tried ordering Yindii set for 180 baht. It turned out that I got 1 mini cupcake and another piece of sloppy croissant. I think chocolab shouldn't join the app.

I understand that it's leftovers, but it's too much. 180 baht is when you have to throw things away anyway. If you want leftovers that are small or sloppy, give more. Doing this is like just throwing away trash and getting a refund.

Btw, the cupcakes tasted terrible. Some of them were undercooked. Chocolatey. Everything else tasted like hotel standards.

The number you left on the messenger couldn't be contacted. Don't join the app. It's a disgrace.
sample_reviews_en.author: An No

sample_reviews_en.text:
10/10 pastry &choco have been stable for quite sometime now. Quality is the same old standard pastry style.

Other stuff:
I thought they would have better techniques for pastry by now (eg. thinner layers, even butterly, new products ) like London Jerome or Cedric Grolet but it’s totally understandable as it’s just part of hotel services.

Too bad Wisdom Kbank is longer having good privilege here. Also on their sport club, meeting room stuff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napa P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice ambiance and decor, ok staffing but the chocolate products were a huge letdown. We were recommended the iced chocolate and the chocolab choco (frappe). The iced chocolate was watery and terrible, tasted like powdered tin chocolate mixed with milk and served with ice. The frappe was just ok. My wife found the lemongrass chocolate average.
This place is most definitely not a specialist chocolate spot. Would highly not recommend visiting
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went for afternoon tea, at first our booking seems missing and then the food was slow. The scones were so hard and do not taste good. Other food was so so.

The staff seem always missing, we have to walk and asked.

Luckily that manager was there. She able to help us and solve the issue on time.

However, if the manager was not there. It will be worst time here. Otherwise I would give 1 star.

FYI, the mini chocolate was good!!
sample_reviews_en.author: S K

sample_reviews_en.text: Croissant was hard and dry inside. I saw the lady heating it IN THE MICROWAVE for 30 long seconds until practically all the softness evaporated, and the she put it  in a regular oven to make the croissant crispy. Inside the so called butter croissant was all white (maybe no butter at all). 133 Thai Baht wasted with hardly any pleasure gained from it. I told her this so that you the reader may enjoy it next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gabriel Lim

restaurants.name: Sultan Turkish Restaurant Türk restoran
restaurants.address:

Walking St, Pattaya City, Pattaya, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We happened to go to the restaurant on a Champions League day. The doorman told us they were showing the match inside. While we waited for the match to start, they took our food order and said we had to order alcohol as well, otherwise they couldn't show the match. We accepted all the conditions and sat down. When the match started, no broadcast was made. Later, the food arrived, but it was so tasteless that the meat was difficult to cut even with a knife. Dissatisfied, we asked for the bill, and this time they said we couldn't pay by credit card. There is absolutely no customer satisfaction at this establishment. It was strange that all the other businesses on the street accepted credit cards but this one didn't. I definitely do not recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hüseyin Selçuk

sample_reviews_en.text: Unlike in Türkiye, they don't bring salad or dips with the kebab. I think it's unnecessarily expensive; you can get a better meal for the same price. I ordered Adana kebab and was full just from the flatbread. The taste was average. They don't accept credit cards, which I really disliked; if you don't accept them, state that upfront. They said there was no tea at the end of the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hüseyin Yigittekin

sample_reviews_en.text: It's not good at all, it has nothing to do with Turkish food, the boss at the cash register probably looks angry, does he look like an Indian? We regretted coming, it's very expensive, I think the name Yaşar is unnecessary, Yaşar is probably the boss, we came as customers, not to fight with you, but you are very snotty, calm down, master..
sample_reviews_en.author: Tolga Benay

sample_reviews_en.text: Walking Street offers fantastic flavors reminiscent of Turkey, with a spacious and airy hall suitable for groups and individuals, and a wonderful sea view where you can enjoy a great dinner. I can say it's the best among the places I've visited. They have a rich meze menu and also serve raki. I recommend it to everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deniz sik

sample_reviews_en.text: If you come to Türkiye for a holiday and miss Turkish cuisine, warmth, and hospitality, this is a magnificent restaurant that will completely satisfy your longing. The friendly owners and sincere staff will make you feel at home. Don't miss it!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maniac Sevko

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there expecting a restaurant, but it turned out to be a kebab shop. I looked at the menu; they had kebabs and burgers. I asked the lady who greeted me about the restaurant menu, and she said they only had this one, plus a menu with …
sample_reviews_en.author: Dilşat POSMA

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is garbage. sad excuse for Turkish food. Not authentic at all. Worse than McDonalds. My family was so disappointed they just walked out. Do not support this place. There is too much good food around
sample_reviews_en.author: Astin Panos

sample_reviews_en.text: We went to a Turkish restaurant, I ordered Iskender kebab, but it was nothing like it. I tasted it and left. It couldn't be this bad. There's no need to deceive anyone; this is unbecoming of Turks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Çvt

restaurants.name: ร้านบุญเลิศ บะหมี่เกี๊ยวหมูย่างซีอิ๊ว - สาขาปั๊มปตท.บรมราชชนนี97
restaurants.address:

ปั้มปตท, ซอย บรมราชชนนี 97 Chim Phli, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered two dishes. I actually wanted to eat the grilled pork, but it was sold out.

1. Baked Pork with Rice: The baked pork was tender and flavorful, with a light aroma of seasonings. It came with a seafood dipping sauce that complemented it well. It would have looked more appealing if the pork had been cut into larger pieces.
2. Dry Wonton with Crispy Pork: The wontons were delicious and flavorful. The crispy pork was tasty, with a crispy skin and tender meat, cut into just the right size. Adding the pickled chili soy sauce made it even better.

The restaurant is newly opened, so the staff might not be fully settled yet. It's important to double-check your order to avoid mistakes.

The atmosphere is spacious and air-conditioned. Parking in the gas station is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charming_Journey

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious according to Boonlert's standards. The noodles are soft and chewy, and the roast pork and crispy pork are fragrant. The location is good, located in a gas station with convenient parking. The staff are good, but they may not be very skilled at providing service. They don't recommend the menu very well. I ordered noodles and the staff didn't ask if I wanted a drink, so I didn't drink any. (I had brought a bag of Amazon coffee from outside, but I didn't drink it in the shop because I was afraid of being impolite. I planned to order water to drink in the shop instead.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Jumpoon Accessories

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, but the price is high. Today I ordered dry mixed noodles. It was served very quickly, perhaps because there were few customers. The noodles were fragrant and soft, just right (but you have to cook the dry menu yourself). The crispy pork was very good, the meat was soft and the skin was thin and crispy. There were dumplings and roasted red pork with sauce, which was delicious. It wasn't very soft, but it wasn't hard either. There was also crab meat sprinkled on top. If you don't season it, it's quite bland. Overall, it was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: พลศิษฏ์ พี่พานิช

sample_reviews_en.text: Located at a gas station, there's a Michelin sign in front of the restaurant, which houses three resorts. Their main dish is wonton noodles. I ordered two things: wonton noodles and roasted pork with rice. I ordered the extra portion, but if you have a big appetite, you might not be full. The pork was tasty enough, and they provided seafood dipping sauce. The wonton noodles needed seasoning, and they gave me all the necessary ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: Little piece of me

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious and worth the money. I stopped by on my way home to my mom's place and tried it. I liked it so much I ordered some to take home for my mom, dad, and everyone in the family to try. Everyone said it was delicious and worth the money. I was too hungry to take any pictures!
sample_reviews_en.author: KAJIAB sername

sample_reviews_en.text: Located inside the PTT gas station, on the left side. The roasted pork rice dish didn't quite live up to the picture; the pork was tough and not as tender as expected. Other dishes were quite bland. The restaurant doesn't accept credit cards, but bank transfers are accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bestlingchan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was mediocre, almost delicious, but the female staff member was a complete letdown. Her service was terrible, and her tone was practically abusive towards customers. One visit was enough. Even if it was raining and I was starving, I would never go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapapat Piya-arayanan

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The noodles were excellent, chewy and soft, not too thin or too thick. The dumplings were also very good. I ordered the all-crab dish and they gave me a generous amount of crab. The soup was delicious. The restaurant is comfortable and air-conditioned.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kratai Suthasinee

restaurants.name: เดอะลองตำ พัทยา
restaurants.address:

Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is delicious and depends on the customer's preference, as everyone's taste is different. For us, it's delicious...
Recommended dishes: Fried chicken wings and deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce. The pork is marinated perfectly before frying, resulting in a crispy yet tender texture that's importantly not greasy. The pork sausage is made with high-quality, firm pork and is delicious, with a fragrant pepper aroma. The shrimp is fresh, from the sea.
Anyway, stop by... You can park your car in the Sawang School parking lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: เหล้าปั่น บาเร้ตต้า

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered 5 dishes and they were all delicious. The quality of the food and ingredients was good. I ordered the soi chu and tried it for the first time and it was good. It didn't smell bad at all. Dipped in the sauce, it went really well together. If anyone is in Pattaya and passing through this area, I recommend you come and try this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: nutnicha k

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate at this restaurant today and the food was delicious. The young man at the counter provided excellent service. All the food was fresh and the restaurant was clean. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Holly G

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the taste suits my palate, and the prices aren't excessively expensive. You can tell the restaurant what kind of flavor you'd like.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ladapha 6395

sample_reviews_en.text: Bought to take home 2 sets of salmon salad. The fish meat was already dark, the salad dressing was salty, and the corn was spoiled.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttha Rattanavised

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and affordable. Too bad I didn't get a chance to take a picture of the fried chicken; I ate it all before I could!
sample_reviews_en.author: May May

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad is delicious. There are many things to choose from. If I go that way, I will buy it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piriyaporn Pimsena

sample_reviews_en.text: We recommend the lotus stem and fresh shrimp dish, and the spicy noodle soup – both incredibly flavorful!
sample_reviews_en.author: อรุณสวัสดิ์ โนรีรัตน์

restaurants.name: Lodchong Singapore (Pichit) Halal St. Louis 3
restaurants.address:

ทางขึ้น 288 เจริญราษฎร์ 3/จันทน์32 แยก 6 3 Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I ordered 6 sets of food via Grab, only ate one bag and vomited. My child also ate one bite and threw it all away. It was mostly starch, the taste was terrible. I will never buy from them again. I've never held a grudge against the owner before, really. After eating theลอดช่องทับทิมซาลิ่ม (a Thai dessert), I vomited, so I looked up the shop and the seller on Google. There are many delicious things in the Chan Road/Saint Louis area. I live at Chan 43. Anyone thinking of eating this kind of food should think carefully before throwing their money away. I'm still feeling nauseous.
sample_reviews_th.author: Supat Yakham

sample_reviews_en.text:
Service: 1/5
They never pay attention to customers. They're pushy and complain when customers order extra. Ice splashes onto customers and they don't even bother apologizing. The seller is quite self-centered.

I used to give them full marks for the taste, but since November 2017, I've been very disappointed. The sweetened lod chong is incredibly sweet, and the service is just as bad as ever.
Taste: 2/5
This shop seems to be reaching its peak. It's a good case study.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worasit Tachapuntukul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the ultimate lod chong (Thai dessert with coconut milk and jelly noodles). When eaten at the shop, add a little more of the incredibly fragrant syrup for the ultimate experience.

- My last visit was on 8/10/19. The flavor was much weaker than before; it wasn't as fragrant and creamy. I'm deducting one star. Although it's not the absolute best as it used to be, it's still pretty good.
sample_reviews_en.author: DukeTK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Singaporean cendol starts at 25 baht per glass.
At Ishak Singaporean Cendol Halal - the original shop in St. Louis 3.

They offer various options including cendol, grass jelly, and water chestnut jelly. The taste is delicious.

The shop accepts cash and QR code payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

sample_reviews_en.text: It's really delicious! I'd pay for a taxi just for you. The taxi fare was 80 baht. The lod chong (Thai dessert with coconut milk and jelly noodles) was so delicious, 20 baht per glass. It's delicious in a funny way... don't think too much about it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Somsri Ampailumlerd

sample_reviews_en.text: Finally a shophouse where you can sit down and enjoy lod chong right away. Been coming here like forever since it was a shop cart! A family favourite since childhood!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nantschya Wirunantmetin

sample_reviews_en.text: Thank you to all our customers. Our shop has now moved to the opposite side of the Doi Kham Royal Project. We have seating available. Prices remain the same.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saranrat Phetphaijitjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text: The halal Singaporean cendol is delicious! It has a mild, not-too-sweet flavor and comes in several varieties at reasonable prices. Easy on the wallet!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitphokin Thanapornrattanatad

restaurants.name: iron pan
restaurants.address:

3 (1st floor, CP Tower, Phaya Thai Rd, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The biggest draw is the incredibly extensive menu. You can enjoy dishes from various Asian countries, from Chinese and Korean to Thai and Vietnamese cuisine. What's more, they recreate the authentic flavors of each country, so you can savor the real thing.

Furthermore, the menu changes seasonally, so even repeat customers won't get bored. Trying new dishes is always something to look forward to. The teppanyaki dishes, in particular, are fascinating to look at and absolutely delicious!
The restaurant is spacious, with both table seating and private rooms, making it perfect for dates or parties with friends. The staff are friendly, explain the menu thoroughly, and offer recommendations.

This is a restaurant that anyone who loves Asian food will enjoy, so be sure to visit! You're sure to discover something new.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yusuke

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered two dishes: Pork Fried Rice with Chiwa Sauce (90 baht) and Stir-fried Wide Rice Noodles with Chiwa Sauce and Pork (90 baht). I added an omelet for 15 baht. Some of the food is already eaten in the picture. The taste was very good, and the portion size was just right – not too much, not too little. The food arrived quickly, and the seating was comfortable. They are open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM on weekdays and from 7:00 AM on weekends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bunlue Chowdok

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, but the service is extremely unprofessional. The wrong dish was served to us, and even after we had touched it, the staff still took it away and gave it to another customer—very poor hygiene. The food was lukewarm, not hot, resulting in a poor experience. The cold seafood salad looked nothing like the picture, and the price was not cheap; it was low value for money and not recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: 杨浩城

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I ordered food at Iron Pan, CP TOWER 3 branch.
I ordered two items at the counter. The employee took my order for item 1, but item 2 was sold out, so I quickly chose another item. I thought the employee would take my order, but it turned out she was just standing there on her phone, not taking my order. I waited for 3-5 minutes. The employee was a chubby, dark-skinned woman.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tie

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice was soggy. When I first asked if it was spicy, they said no, but when it actually arrived, it was spicy and inedible. Overall, the food was quite tasty, but the prices were high, as expected for the location. The restaurant is quite small, so if you come in a large group, you might have to wait in line. The main dishes were served quite slowly, in order of the queue.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตามล่าของอร่อยและสถานที่สวยๆ

sample_reviews_en.text: ordered a duo set meal. the pan fried seabass is flavorful and spicy enough. the omelette with minced pork is tasty and just the right chewiness. staff are patient and approachable. lots of tables and chairs for dining in. great location beside phaya thai station
sample_reviews_en.author: melson teo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stir-fried noodles with soy sauce were delicious, the noodles had a nice chewy texture.
The minced pork with basil was tasty.
The traditional fried rice was a bit bland and the rice was soggy.
The shrimp patties were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Waewwan Pawutiyapong

sample_reviews_en.text:
German pork knuckle with basil, tasted good.
The atmosphere in the office building was nice and not crowded in the morning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narathip Pradidpol

restaurants.name: ร้านหญิงแหนมเนือง
restaurants.address:

304/1104, 304/1119 Phahonyothin Rd, Talat Bang Khen, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here because the nem nuong (spring rolls) with fresh vegetables weren't bitter at all. I was so impressed yesterday that I couldn't review it, so I came back today.
I added crispy pork pad thai, squid stir-fried with salted eggs, sour curry with fried acacia flowers and fresh shrimp, and fried spring rolls.
They were both inexpensive and delicious.
Three of us split the bill for less than 200 baht. The air conditioning was cool and comfortable.
It was a great value!

I've been here twice in a row with just two of us.
I added pork with cha-plu leaves, dry shrimp sukiyaki, the indispensable nem nuong, and stir-fried chicken noodles, sea bass jungle curry, lemongrass salad with boiled shrimp, and crab fried rice. It's always delicious no matter how many times I come here. 🥰🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: kris sata

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a hidden gem of a restaurant located in a side street in Bang Bua. They offer both Vietnamese and Thai food, and everything is incredibly delicious. The deep-fried tilapia with herbs is a must-try! The prices are reasonable, the service is excellent, and the owner is very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thananon Inprasit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Large portions, typical prices. The quantity is equivalent to an extra-large size. Customers keep coming in the evening.
*Recommended dishes: Pad Thai, Nem Nuong (with fresh, crispy vegetables)
*Location: Shop 1, corner lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: NP Nll

sample_reviews_en.text: I had an amazing time eating here today! The food was incredibly clean and every dish was delicious. I highly recommend coming back. I forgot to take pictures of the food because I was so hungry!
sample_reviews_en.author: กนกกาญน์ ไชยประโคม

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) through Grab and it was delicious! The ingredients were varied, and the vegetables were crispy and not bitter at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y. S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was excellent; the squid and shrimp were fresh and delicious. The service was great, and the price was worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: LookJeab Happy

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean, the food is delicious, and the highlight is the friendly atmosphere. The prices are affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakchai Tiasirivarodom

sample_reviews_en.text: Grilled pork noodles, pork wrapped in betel leaves, steamed rice flour dumplings, and many other delicious dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornpitak Kaoon

restaurants.name: Taj View Authentic Indian food
restaurants.address:

124, 50 S Pattaya Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love the TEA.
We visited this restaurant for the search a good tea with the help of Google reviews and i was so lucky I Found it.
This is one of the most delicious Indian meals we have ever eaten in Thailand. We had a group of 36 members. We all are family, some vegetarian and some Non-Veg. But we both enjoyed very much.
The best part of this restaurant is only 199 Baht BUFFET (no hidden taxes or charges). The menu is extensive and varied and caters for all tastes of Indian cuisine. We had the paneer and chicken tikka to start and this was absolutely delicious. For mains we had Chicken curry and Paneer pasanda both wonderful and filling, and the dessert Halwa was amazing.
The staff were very helpful and pleasant. I listened in to other diner's commenting on their meal and all was positive. Washrooms are large and very clean, hygiene. We will certainly go back here. A must Visit. Thank-you for the service and food guys.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shiva Reddy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited The Taj View, Pattaya for food, and the experience was absolutely excellent. The dishes were fresh, flavorful, and well presented, with a great balance of taste and quality. Every item felt carefully prepared, and the ingredients were clearly of high standard.

The ambiance of the dining area is pleasant and relaxing, making it a great place to enjoy a meal with family or friends. The staff were courteous, attentive, and quick to serve, which added to the overall positive experience.

Portion sizes were generous, pricing was reasonable, and the overall hygiene and cleanliness were well maintained. Whether you’re visiting for a casual meal or a special occasion, this place is definitely worth trying.
sample_reviews_en.author: ArunKumar S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unlimited Authentic Awesome Indian Buffet
If you wanna true taste of indian food with budget in Pattaya, your search would be end here happily. Have visited this place to eat many times, whenever I hv visited to Pattaya. The food is always fresh, hot and awesomely delicious. Portions are plentiful. They use fresh ingredients all the times. All veg and non veg foods hv great mouth watering taste.
They serve Unlimited Buffet always in only 200 Baht.
In addition to the nice meals, the Manager Mr Rajiv and staffs r very friendly, courteous and efficient.
The menu has a good variety that met the diversified likes.
Would happily recommended this restaurant and bar to everyone. You should try once.
sample_reviews_en.author: rajive N

sample_reviews_en.text:
Big portions, amazing taste, and warm hospitality – Taj View is more than a restaurant, it’s an experience. Highly recommended!
From the first bite, I knew this place was special.
If you’re craving authentic Indian food in Pattaya.

I was actually about to leave without eating, but the director kindly insisted that I should at least give the food a try.
And I’m so glad I did, because the moment I took my first bite – it was pure magic. ✨
What started as a “maybe next time” moment turned into one of the best meals I’ve had in Thailand.
If you’re looking for real Indian food with heart and hospitality, Taj View is the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shivansh Bhandari

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a wonderful experience at this Indian restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious, with rich flavors and authentic spices that truly captured the essence of Indian cuisine. The hospitality was top-notch—right from the moment we walked in, we were warmly welcomed and made to feel at home. The staff is incredibly friendly, attentive, and always ready with a smile, which made the entire dining experience even more enjoyable. The ambiance was also cozy and inviting, making it a perfect spot for a relaxed meal. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great Indian dining experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kalivili Lokesh Kumar

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Hotel Taj View in Pattaya, and I must say, it was an incredible experience for anyone craving authentic Indian cuisine.

The menu offered a wide variety of traditional dishes, and each one I tried was a delightful burst of flavors. Rice pudding was just WOW!!

What stood out the most was the authenticity — it truly felt like a slice of India in the heart of Pattaya.

If you’re in Pattaya and looking to indulge in genuine Indian flavors, Hotel Taj View is a must-visit. Highly recommended for both tourists and locals alike!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanghadina Badole

sample_reviews_en.text: I really enjoyed my visit to this Indian restaurant. The food was super tasty and full of flavor—everything we ordered was cooked just right. The staff were very kind and friendly, and they made us feel welcome from the moment we walked in. Their service was great, always checking if we needed anything without being too much. The place also had a nice and comfortable vibe, which made the whole experience even better. I would definitely come back and recommend it to others who enjoy good Indian food and warm service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kalivili Srinivasa Rao

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time to have tried dining in an authentic Indian restaurant here in Pattaya.

Their chicken biryani tasted just fine, not overly flavorful and spicy, with few chunks of chicken meat.

Garlic Naan tasted sooooo good and was freshly made. So tender and really garlicky.

The buttered chicken is so rich and creamy, with few chunks of chicken meat too.

Quite pricey. Smaller serving sizes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vee Dee

restaurants.name: Yello ลูกไก่ไข่ฟู
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 300 Lat Phrao 35/1 Alley, Khwaeng Chan Kasem, Khet Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The sun has set, and night has awakened to greet us. Actually, there are many restaurant options near Lat Phrao intersection, but perhaps I'm tired of the mall restaurants, or maybe just tired of the crowds, so I drove a little further, about 15 minutes, away from the hustle and bustle, and turned into Soi Lat Phrao 35/1. This wasn't my first time at this restaurant, but if I'm ever in the area with enough time to relax, I'll definitely stop by. It's a curry restaurant that's part of the owner's house. The orange lights illuminate the area, creating an atmosphere reminiscent of a Murakami-esque sanctuary, yet one that exudes warmth. I always order the fried pork curry rice; I'm captivated by the unique Thai-infused sauce. Honestly, I'm not a food reviewer. If I had to close my eyes and taste several dishes like on a TV show, I couldn't say which one is better. But one thing's for sure: the rice here has a comforting warmth to it. Many elements, not just the rice itself, but everything in the restaurant, feel like home. I left the restaurant near closing time, wondering what it would feel like to try more dishes there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapop

sample_reviews_en.text: The world's only curry with fermented fish paste. Meticulously crafted, the restaurant puts a lot of effort into creating this dish. It's the most delicious in the world! The atmosphere is amazing +++ A hidden gem, romantic and cozy, perfect for relaxing and letting happiness melt in your mouth 🥰 Everything is done with care, creative menu, and excellent taste. #BeenHere #WillBeBackAgain and #WillKeepComing. This is a restaurant I want to stay in Bangkok for a long time. Love it! Other dishes are also unforgettable, like the instant noodle hot pot and homemade ice cream. The prices are lovely and great value. 10/10/10 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Beige Magenta

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant moved from Banthat Thong less than a year ago.
They serve unique Thai-style Japanese curry, unlike anything you've ever tasted. It's medium spicy, just the right amount of spiciness.
The fermented fish curry has no strong smell and is easy to eat.
The portions are large and the prices are reasonable.
The atmosphere is homey, it's a family-run business with excellent service.
The food comes out steadily, not too fast because they cook each dish individually. You can be patient and wait comfortably.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kikku Natchanun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review of a Thai-style curry restaurant that has moved to the Ladprao side.
I previously ate at their original branch in Sutthisan before it closed for a while.
This time, a friend invited me for lunch. I had ordered the Thai curry with fermented fish sauce before. It was spicy and savory, without a strong fermented fish sauce smell, but very satisfyingly spicy. They even double-checked my order when I placed it. The portion was generous, enough to fill me up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichaya Putong (ppeachyx)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted delicious and suited my palate. The ingredients seemed fresh. The restaurant was clean and tidy, with a pleasant atmosphere. The staff provided excellent service; they were polite and attentive. The prices were reasonable and offered good value for the overall quality. This is a restaurant I would definitely return to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pauland Thompson

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small eclectic place; I believe it might be part of a residential home...but its well appointed and thoughtfully decorated. And the food...wow, these folks really know what they are doing. I'm not an expert, but high quality ingredients and thoughtful preparation and subtle great taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Redblock Industries

sample_reviews_en.text: I was running errands in this area and happened to pass by the restaurant. I tried it and it truly deserves 5 stars! Everything was perfect: taste, service, atmosphere. The curry rice with fermented fish sauce was delicious, and the tonkatsu was perfectly cooked. I loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Neen Neeranalin

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The fish curry, panang curry, and green curry were all amazing – rich, flavorful, and spicy. Another thing that really impressed me was the fried chicken; it was incredibly crispy and delicious. The restaurant …
sample_reviews_en.author: อิศราภรณ์ ด่านธํารงกูล
