restaurants.address:

16 Pattaya Sai Song Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Biryani Junction in Pattaya and it was an absolute delight! From the moment I walked in, the warm and inviting atmosphere made me feel right at home. This gem of a restaurant offers authentic Indian flavours that truly stand out in the city’s diverse food scene.
The biryani here is nice with rich spices The portions are generous and the dishes are beautifully balanced in flavour. What impressed me most was how fresh and well-seasoned everything tasted, especially considering most items are priced very reasonable.
Every dish I tried was served hot and with care. The thalis are a great choice if you want to sample a variety of tastes in one sitting they’re hearty, satisfying and great value for money. Whether you’re craving classic biryani, savory curries, or comforting Indian sides, this restaurant delivers with bold, authentic flavours.
The staff were friendly and attentive, making the experience even more enjoyable. I left feeling completely satisfied and already planning my next visit. Highly recommend Biryani Junction to anyone in Pattaya looking for delicious Indian food that doesn’t disappoint!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dharmendra Singh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good and delicious north indian food available.We had lunch, dinner and some snacks with Indian tea which was delicious 😋.
Very knowledgeable person who guides and plan your site visit responsibly with reasonable price. ( Have witnessed how much other paid and how much we paid for the same site visit)
Activities are to be paid @ the respective places.

Mr. Harish ( Riyanshi Travel & BIRYANI Junction)was down towards and understandable and person with precision.

Good luck and way to go Mr.Harish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karthikeyan A

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mr. Harish (gem of a guy) who guided us with the travel plan within pattaya and the schedule was on dot. The price which he billed us also normal. Some places virtually we undertsood the difference in prices how huge others paid and how much we paid for the same activity or against the travel plan. Most trusted person.

Also had good and delicious North Indian food @ his restaurant BIRYANI JUNCTION.

Must visit place and worth,both place and Mr. Harish 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Nambirajan Azhagia

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited Thailand and tried an Indian restaurant called Biryani Junction in Pattaya. The place has a nice and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for Indian food lovers missing authentic flavors while traveling.
The biryani was flavorful, well-cooked, and reminded us of traditional Indian taste. The spices were balanced and the portion size was satisfying. The menu has a good variety of Indian dishes, and the staff was polite and helpful throughout our visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Avishkar Adavade

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dont even go there. Chefl dont even know what is indian food. Veg thali came after 1hour 15min. When asked waiter‘s response was we open only 12 and Tandoor takes time.
Chicken Briyani - Just plain rice with color and chilli powder and raita was 10 days old curd ( smells like rotten broth).
Kadai chicken had no taste - plain chi ken mixed with spices.

Total waste of 2hours and money
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakash U

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing experience! The food was absolutely delicious and full of flavor. The staff was very friendly, polite, and welcoming. The service was quick, and the overall atmosphere of the restaurant was really nice and comfortable.
Everything was well managed and clean.
If you’re in Pattaya, I highly recommend visiting this place. Will definitely come back again! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: yaman guglani

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly one of the best Indian food spots I’ve tried in Pattaya. The taste felt just like proper Indian food, full of flavor and really satisfying. The food quality was great, and everything I ordered was on point.
Also, the owner and staff were super friendly and welcoming. Definitely coming back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandiip Silwal

sample_reviews_en.text: When I came here, I didn't even feel like I was in another country. It felt like I was in my own country, eating home-cooked food. And the owner and the staff were truly wonderful. I stayed here for 8 days, and I felt completely at home with all of them. Thank you so much, Harish bhai and all the staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rahul Shepherd

restaurants.name: Tam Lae Restaurant
restaurants.address:

4543/1 Sukhumvit Rd, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10270, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was mediocre. They brought spoons but no forks. I don't know what kind of standard they're using. When I asked for them, instead of serving quickly, I had to get up from the table to ask a second time. They need to train their staff on customer service and how to interact with customers.
The food was okay. The sun-dried pork was a bit too salty, but the grilled chicken was delicious. The food was just average in taste. The service was the problem. Also, the hand sanitizer they gave me was some kind of water put in the alcohol bottle, which smelled really musty. It ruined my mood for eating sticky rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pun Pun

sample_reviews_en.text: I really enjoy the food here...the flavors are strong and spicy. I especially like the fresh shrimp papaya salad, the mixed papaya salad, and the fried chicken. The prices might be a bit high for the soups because the portions are very small, but overall it's okay. The cook has excellent cooking skills; the taste is almost the same every time I eat here. The service is also okay. On weekends, there's usually a long wait due to the large number of people. It's much easier to get a table on weekdays. The tables are clean, and the restaurant feels spacious and not cramped.
sample_reviews_en.author: YUI AND TOUR OUR HAPPINESS

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices on the receipt don't match the prices on GET delivery, and the portions aren't worth the price. For example, the sweet liver dish cost 120 baht but only the amount shown in the picture was served. The grilled chicken was the same. The price listed on the receipt is the price from GET delivery.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patsaya Chuephanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
Class division.
I ordered sticky rice and got cold, sticky rice that stuck to my hands.
Meanwhile, another table, well-dressed, received hot, fresh sticky rice. Thank you for showing me this firsthand.
I ate at the Imperial World Samrong branch.
I paid for quality food.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชัยวัฒน์ ปานา

sample_reviews_en.text: From a girl from Khon Kaen! I'm so happy that someone from the South is opening a Northeastern Thai restaurant. 👃👍👍👃 I hope you have great sales and that you'll have the opportunity to expand to Khon Kaen someday. 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: อนงค์นุช หอมวิไล

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is too high for the quality. The fried duck beaks had a rancid smell. I gave it a chance thinking it was just one piece, but it turned out to be every piece. The papaya salad was just average.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธีรภัทร โตะมะ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is fresh and delicious, but a bit pricey. Papaya salad starts at 90 baht. It's suitable for eating with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miew A

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been visiting this place since I was a child, but the organization and maintenance have changed quite a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tharadheppradit Varangkun (Bird_Paknam)

restaurants.name: Royal Pizza Bangna
restaurants.address:

2838 Sukhumvit Rd, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered delivery to my home with a chosen delivery time, but it started raining close to the scheduled time, so the restaurant wasn't quite on time. By the time I ate it, the cheese had started to harden a bit. However, the pizza crust was delicious. I think it would have been even better if I had eaten it hot at the restaurant.

I ordered several pizzas through the restaurant's website, but they don't usually have their own delivery staff; they used Grab. When it arrived, the top tray of pizzas was open, and they had slid together. The manager called to ask if I had received the order, so I explained the situation. They made a new tray and delivered it again. The service was incredibly impressive. I asked for the manager's name, and she said it was Ms. Na. 🩷👏👍

If I have the chance, I'd love to try eating at the restaurant in person.
sample_reviews_en.author: ps ppp

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered pizza through the Robinhood application at 18:31, but I only received my pizza at 21:51. I kept asking the rider about the delay while he waited for my food. He mentioned that even riders from other applications who arrived later got their orders before him. He went inside to check with the kitchen several times but received no response.

I also tried calling the restaurant, but no one answered. When I finally received my food, the kitchen printer showed the as 20:34!

Every order should follow the queue by order time. The rider lost valuable time for earning income, and I lost my dinner time to celebrate with my family!
sample_reviews_en.author: jum apinya

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered delivery and it took a very long time, almost 2 hours to get the food.
The food I ordered was also terrible. The pizza topping looked like it only had scraps of ham, and the crust was thin but not crispy at all.
The fried chicken wings were undercooked; I ordered 6 pieces but could only eat 2.
The hummus had a strange taste, much sourer than I'm used to.
P.S. I used to order from them very often, and the food quality was much better. Once, the wait for my order was so long that I stopped ordering for a while. I thought things would improve, but they're much worse than before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mathurot Lekjaem

sample_reviews_en.text: Small shop probably set up for takeaway and deliveries.  Anyway they cleared the table and I ate inside.  Didn't have the Pizza but had the Burger deal.  Australian beef burger was small in size (but guess they all are now) with a large serving of french fries; a coke and a good salad. Certainly value for money at 239 THB.  I liked it so might head back for the Pizza.  Store could do with a massive clean though.  Anyhow recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neil McArthur

sample_reviews_en.text: I order from this restaurant regularly, mostly for home delivery. The pizza is consistently good and high-quality. The crust is soft and chewy, not too thick. The carbonara pizza is loaded with cheese, overflowing! The American pepperoni pizza also has a generous portion and tastes better than some other places. Delivery is fast, and they often have a buy one get one free promotion on 10-inch pizzas for 499 baht with free delivery.
sample_reviews_en.author: info

sample_reviews_en.text: This place has pinned my address wrong, so the delivery driver has been going to the wrong place for many, many times taking my delivery for an hour. Even after complaining and making sure the address has been changed, it still happens. Incompetent people work here that really dont care about customer service. Even verifying two times(!) that it has been changed, but still delivered to the wrong place..
sample_reviews_en.author: How Ying Lai

sample_reviews_en.text: We have been ordering food from this restaurant for 2 years. But one day they delivered an expensive order and did not put a portion of nuggets in it. When we complained, they simply sent us a coupon for 25 baht. Once again: a portion of nuggets and a coupon for 25 baht. Guys, thank you, we do not need your penny coupon in exchange for stolen food. You are super irresponsible boors.
sample_reviews_en.author: Виктория Водная

sample_reviews_en.text:
the worst pizza in the world because they will take 2 hours to make your order.

Most importantly, they use the driver bike broken as reason to cancel the deal ( no driver show to pick up the order on grab )

Yes! I waited from 630-900! Plz, don’t order from this restaurant, it gonna ruin your day

Reminder ( it’s just 4mins drive from my condo to this restaurant!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicky Chow

restaurants.name: McDonald's Supreme Complex
restaurants.address:

1024 Sam Sen Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the spicy chicken rice at the self-service kiosk.
The staff suggested I choose table pickup and quickly informed me that the rice would take 20 minutes to cook, fearing I would have to wait too long. They asked if I wanted to change to another menu item and brought a menu to my table for me to choose from.
They also apologized for the inconvenience.
Overall, the service mind was 10/10!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutwan

sample_reviews_en.text: McDonald's Supreme branch has a steady stream of customers, mostly students from the nearby area. In the evenings, it's often families coming to eat. There are promotions that allow customers to use coupons, making it easier to save money. The fries are always hot because they are frequently ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arpar Arpar

sample_reviews_en.text: Friendly staff and good service but if you plan on eating there make sure you go during the quiet period because it's almost impossible to find a seat due to teenagers hogging the tables and chairs and playing on their phones for hours on end.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mieder Jan Van Loggerenberg

sample_reviews_en.text: Good McDonalds, they could make it a bit more cozy and interesting. The food is fine as always, the service at some of the other MCDs is better, I love the McDonald in BBB building near Asoke. 5 star service
sample_reviews_en.author: Green Snow

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff ignores delivery orders, doesn't process them, only works at the front counter. Aren't customers who order through delivery also customers? I waited 20-30 minutes for my food.
sample_reviews_en.author: นัยนา แม้นศรี

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I enjoyed trying the deep-fried dough sticks with custard. I finished three of them! The custard wasn't too sweet, which I liked. I didn't get a chance to take a picture.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onanong Sukpheng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waited a very long time.
The staff were just chatting amongst themselves.
They ignored customers.
The way they took orders was rude.
I wouldn't give it even one star.
sample_reviews_en.author: ekanit romyanon

sample_reviews_en.text:
McDonald's Supreme Crispy Chicken
Delicious burger
Pineapple fries are also delicious with coffee
Not too crowded these days
Nice and quiet atmosphere
sample_reviews_en.author: Somboon Trongkarndee

restaurants.name: Thai Italian restaurant
restaurants.address:

WVHP+V76, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Underlit,quite gloomy ,just a few old light bulbs hanging, noisy from the street noise and surrounding cacophony, uncomfortable chairs and dirty tables. Very unfriendly, even  RUDE waitress ! Very slow food preparation...
But once you have overcome all these obstacles... you'll be pleasantly surprised by the home made food, actually tasting  yummy. generous portions. Standard Quality products and simple though authentic Italian dishes. The choice is yours. Go or not go...but I personally  don't mind going there occasionally as it's delicious in a rotten place!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: One Step at a Time

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been coming here for many years whenever I'm in Pattaya...incredibly delicious, a huge amount, and very reasonably priced. My favorite is the cordon bleu. In my opinion, it's the best I've ever eaten (how can they possibly fit so much cheese in it?).

Addendum: Yes, when it's busy, you have to wait a long time...but when the food arrives, it's always very hot and absolutely fresh.

And something else regarding various reviews...complaining about old chairs or loud music in Pattaya is like complaining about sand on the beach...
sample_reviews_en.author: Bjoern

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unusually large portions. Everything I tried was delicious. The schnitzel was better than in some German restaurants.

The only downside is the potential wait time when it's busy, as the kitchen is small. However, you are warned beforehand ☝️.

Unfortunately, you can sometimes see the stress on her face. It's not a big deal, but if she smiled warmly, it would be a full 5 stars despite the wait :).

This was my go-to restaurant during my 15 days in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tobias Spöcker

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered spicy seafood spaghetti for takeout. It cost 160 THB.
It was delicious, but also incredibly filling.
The ingredients were shrimp and squid, I think.
It was about two to three times the size of a typical serving.
After ordering, I went shopping at Family Mart, and when I came back, it still wasn't ready, so it must have taken more than 15 minutes.
It seemed like there were no other customers there, though.
sample_reviews_en.author: kー kuma

sample_reviews_en.text: An utterly unpleasant restaurant. The food may be good and inexpensive, but everything else is unacceptable. The server was very unfriendly and tried to pressure me into ordering quickly because she was about to close. If you can't even give a customer two minutes to look at the menu, you should probably find another job. I certainly won't be pressured and I won't be returning to this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: H S

sample_reviews_en.text: The foods are delicious, the lady that cooking all the dish is so friendly with a hand of a helper. Came because of the good reviews and ratings but unfortunately it took long time to get your foods due to a busy dinner time. Prepare yourself a mosquito repellent as it's outdoor sitting set up so mostly probably you get bites. But definitely will come back to try more foods
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana J

sample_reviews_en.text: The food itself, and especially the portions, are fantastic. I had spicy seafood spaghetti, and after that generous portion, I fear the oceans are finally overfished. The quality of the food at such a reasonable price more than makes up for the rather gruff service and the rustic ambiance, even by Thai standards. Definitely worth a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Udo Vetter

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is near the hotel and is usually full to capacity in the evening, so I was curious to try it.
There were a few seats available a little earlier in the evening, so I had seafood fried rice and singha beer.
The seafood fried rice was lightly seasoned and delicious, with plenty of toppings such as vegetables and shrimp.
sample_reviews_en.author: Takeuchi Tadamichi

restaurants.name: Tokyo Land
restaurants.address:

991/1 ซอย จุฬาฯ 14 ริม, Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ate at a restaurant across the street and saw this place, so we crossed the road to try it. We ordered the Tokyo Ice Cream, and it was delicious! The ice cream and texture were amazing. The drinks were average.

However, what I really disliked was an older woman – I'm not sure if she was the owner – who kept sitting and chatting with people in the restaurant at a nearby table. It was very intrusive. She was also shouting to each other asking if they wanted the bill, and then rushed us to pay while we were still eating. I felt too embarrassed to order anything to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: R P (PB)

sample_reviews_en.text: I went on a Saturday, and it was quite crowded. The Tokyo-style pancakes (Tangkok-style) tasted good. They have both sweet and savory fillings. Sweet fillings start at 18 baht, and savory fillings start at 28 baht. Bingsu, however, starts at over 100 baht and goes up to over 300 baht. The prices are a bit high. The shop also looked a bit cluttered, but it was okay considering the atmosphere of Banthat Thong on a Saturday night when every shop was packed. Maybe it was my fault for going on a Saturday night, because it was so crowded, everything felt cramped.
sample_reviews_en.author: nerv

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate a strawberry bingsu for 189 baht. It had two sliced ​​strawberries on top. I was happy to find a filling, but it turned out to be 2-3 pieces of Pipo jelly. The bingsu itself was just plain milk, not fragrant or delicious at all. In short, you really disrespect your customers. For this price, 89 baht would be much better. Think carefully about what you're going to sell before you lose all your customers. The staff were good, and they had board games, but this is a restaurant, after all. I've never had such a terrible meal at a restaurant before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Money Boy

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came twice during our stay to try kakigori, and it was a wonderful discovery!

The service is very pleasant, there are board games available, and the atmosphere is unique with a K-pop playlist we weren't familiar with, which added a nice touch.

The portions are generous: we tried mango and strawberry, with a preference for the mango.

The only slight drawback was the air conditioning, which was a bit too strong for our liking. A friendly and refreshing place that we highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vaite Naehu

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a kingdom of sweets that I really like, especially the Tokyo ice cream menu. The dough is crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, with a variety of toppings. Inside, there's very soft and smooth whipped cream ice cream. Another menu that I like is the Tokyo Jumbo Sheet, Truffle Sausage, served tightly packed. Or if you like the regular Tokyo, they have both savory and sweet fillings, stuffed very tightly. Next time I go to Banthat Thong, I'll definitely have to try it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: journey young

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a durian bingsu set + Thai tea for 388 baht. They asked me to pay immediately after I ordered.
In summary:
1. The durian bingsu didn't match the picture; it only had durian scraps, and the actual price wasn't even 150 baht.
2. The Thai tea was very bland.
It wasn't tasty at all. You should provide honest and straightforward service. This is very unacceptable. Don't treat customers like this; people won't come to your shop again. Please improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattasit Soonjan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible, the staff were terrible, the restaurant was dirty, the bathrooms were dirty, and the food was so unclean it was almost inedible.
I've seen many people come into Father Sisan's restaurant from the outside, but once inside, it's very scary, from the waiters to the cashiers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiwat Terdpadungchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
After a hearty meal, I came here for shaved ice.
I ordered the Thai milk tea shaved ice ♡
The flavor was rich, and the slightly salty cream on top was a perfect match for the shaved ice ⭐︎⭐︎ However, it might be a bit too much for one person to finish. Three of us shared one ♪
Cash only
sample_reviews_en.author: masako nagao

restaurants.address:

507/3 Sirindhorn Rd, Bang Bumru, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The female server seemed reluctant to discuss much. A male server was very polite and patiently explained things to me. As for the shrimp, there were two options: 100 baht per hour and 200 baht per hour. The difference was the quantity of shrimp versus prawns. The male pole kept tipping over, making the signal unreadable. The pole seemed old; the line was very tangled. BEE was better value for money, but it was a bit far. Two shrimp for two hours. The shrimp were large.
sample_reviews_en.author: 張永永

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was great. Its fun and tons of prawns. Normally you can get 6-8 prawns in 3 hours (100baht pond) or you can get 12-20 in 3hours(200baht pond) and the size of the prawn is huge. I been to 3 places. This is my favorite But it's very far from where i stay. It took me 300baht taxi to get there.
sample_reviews_en.author: All Star - Entertainment

sample_reviews_en.text: It was crowded and there was no staff to attend to us, which was one thing. But while I was talking to a staff member and wanted to sit down, another customer ran in and snatched the seat. The staff just let them. The management was terrible. I left immediately; I was very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: ppm s

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here on a trip from Japan.

It was my first time shrimp fishing, but the staff and the regulars around me were so kind and helpful, I was very satisfied!

Only the owner-like person spoke English, but he was very kind to me. 🍤
I would like to visit again!
sample_reviews_en.author: 森田

sample_reviews_en.text: We think the restaurant is good, but the staff are incredibly unwilling to serve. You have to ask everything yourself, and they don't explain anything clearly. We've been here often, but this will probably be our last time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adisak

sample_reviews_en.text: Great experience ! Life betting and good fishing roughly 3 catchable per hour. Locals there were really friendly and helpful. Overall great activity for tourists who want to do something more “local” and fun.
sample_reviews_en.author: Timothy Whitton

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are a bit high considering the portion sizes, but the taste is great. It's delicious and fun; you might even be willing to take a gamble and see if someone can help pay for the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: กฤศ รุจิรพันธุ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a fun time, though i only caught 2 river prawns but it was of decent size.
The staff refilled river prawns every hour.
The per hour rate is of reasonable rate for locals.
sample_reviews_en.author: michelle_mxth

restaurants.name: Otake Japanese Restaurant
restaurants.address:

39 Sukhonthasawat Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to eat there today because I'd wanted to try it for a while. Today was a very disappointing first experience.
I ordered a California Roll, and the table next to me, who arrived just minutes later, got their food before me. I asked the staff if they'd served the wrong table. They said the menu items were the same. I'd seen the table next to me order the same California Roll with avocado, even though there were only two tables occupied. I knew from the start that the table next to me ordered something different, but one sentence made me not want to eat the rest of my meal. They said the avocado was simply pulled out – is that even Japanese food prepared that way?
When paying, I called a staff member over to explain.
The staff member then blamed the chef, saying the chef was incompetent. They shouldn't be passing the buck like that.
Just an apology and admission of fault would suffice. But a chef needs to be meticulous in preparing food. To say that pulling the avocado out of the dish...
I've never had it like that before. Other restaurants don't do that; they usually replace it.
My first visit was very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: AUTOBALL BOAT

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've dined with Chef Khammoon since his time at Grass Thonglor, then his restaurant in Ratchada, and now his current location. He's a lovely chef, very skilled and dedicated.

However, Japanese food these days can't be priced as high as it used to. There are so many options. If you want to charge high prices for Omakase, go for it at 3,000-10,000 baht per person. But if you want to maintain this style – a casual restaurant in a community location, offering mid-to-good quality food – the prices need to be at least 25% lower. Otherwise, you won't be able to compete. Just two minutes drive away, you'll find Hinoki, which is considerably cheaper and better quality. This is constructive criticism. I'd love to see more good restaurants closer to home so I can dine there regularly, but for now, I probably won't be returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tee Wuthisarnchawakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an honest review. I went alone and let the chef prepare a meal for me. They didn't tell me the exact price, just that it was by weight. I got Hamachi, Salmon, and Chutoro, plus rice and soup. It cost over 2000 baht – very expensive. I was just looking for dinner, searched on Google, found this place looked nice and gave it a chance. And I was pleasantly surprised.

The food quality was fresh, I won't argue with that, but the price wasn't commensurate with the quality.

The decor is very homey, a converted house with a 70% Thai and 30% Japanese feel. Overall, it looks very Thai.

Honestly, there are many Japanese restaurants with this quality at lower prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ohm Aumnuayporn

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste of the mixed raw fish donburi is pretty good. The fish is fresh and varied. The rolls are okay, up to standard. The soy sauce is good, the wasabi is good. Overall, the price of the food is quite expensive, considering the taste and quantity, but it's good that there is no ++. Lunch set, rice is refillable, soup is refillable. I tried the ginger pork set, this one is not tasty, very small portion compared to the price (350). Needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worawut Tantipisnu

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was okay, but I wish the prices were clearly stated when ordering.
Or, if the chef wanted to do an omakase menu, the price per person should be disclosed beforehand. We are willing to pay, but if we asked and there was no price listed, and we didn't know the price, then the bill came, which was quite a surprise. (It's not that we didn't know the prices; we were quite aware because my boyfriend is also a chef ;) )
sample_reviews_en.author: kitty manow

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the ingredients are excellent, and the price is reasonable for the portion size. I will definitely come back again. I highly recommend it! (This isn't a paid review, it's genuinely delicious!)
sample_reviews_en.author: kao Thanawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located under a condo, so the atmosphere isn't great. The food tastes good, but it's not amazing. I liked the California roll the most, and the salmon sashimi was very large and thick.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pekky 41

sample_reviews_en.text: Chef Khammoon, another top master of Japanese cuisine in Thailand, is here today to try the fish head at his restaurant. Let me tell you, it's absolutely amazing! Reservations are highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Art Suwarnatemiya

restaurants.name: โทรุ หม่าล่า (Toru Hmala) Cafe'
restaurants.address:

40 ถ. บางบอน 5 คลอง, Bang Bon, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It said there was a promotion offering three bottles of Chang beer for 220B, but it was listed as 240B without the discount.

This kind of thing should be applied automatically, not just because a customer points it out.

Trying to save a small amount will only ensure that a customer like that never comes back.

I went there because there wasn't a single group of customers in the back, unlike other places that were full, but it made me regret it.

I don't know if that's just Thai people's taste, but all the food was too sweet for my liking. It was a restaurant I regret choosing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenny Kang

sample_reviews_en.text: The mala seasoning here is delicious, and they use good quality mala powder. I've tried it at many restaurants, and this one is really good. The rice dishes are served in generous portions, and the prices are reasonable. They also have drinks. I usually order via Line Man, but I decided to try eating at the restaurant this time. The atmosphere is nice, and the restrooms are clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thirapat Thiprach

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner is super lovely 🥰 The service is excellent, truly impressive. The food tastes great, so delicious 😍 The prices are reasonable for the portion sizes. The live music is also great, the singer is entertaining and sings beautifully 🎶🎤 If you're hesitant, you should definitely try it, you don't want to miss out on a great place 😊 Highly recommend! 👍🏻👏🏻💖
sample_reviews_en.author: Night Praewpan

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this restaurant! The atmosphere is great, there's live music, and the food is delicious. The mala is amazing, and there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from. It's definitely one of my favorite restaurants. Importantly, the prices are good, but the quality of the food and the atmosphere are well worth it. I highly recommend this restaurant! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Daf

sample_reviews_en.text: The mala skewers were delicious and satisfyingly spicy. The marinated salmon slices were very thick, but the marinade hadn't fully penetrated the flesh. The seafood dipping sauce wasn't very flavorful, but overall everything was tasty. The food was served quite slowly because it was crowded. There was live music with a good singer.
sample_reviews_en.author: miling moon

sample_reviews_en.text: This mala restaurant is delicious and the atmosphere is great. Please support them! It's perfect for going with friends or your partner. The staff are lovely. The restaurant isn't very big. I'll definitely go again. I like it. They have a variety of dishes. The fried chicken tendons are delicious, and the spicy salad is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanoshi

sample_reviews_en.text: The mala skewers were so delicious, I loved them! I've never seen a restaurant sell grilled garlic before, and I love garlic. Ordering it as a salad was amazing, 10/10, no complaints. The marinated salmon was also fantastic, so fresh. They even gave us pickled radish when we ate at the restaurant ♥️♥️♥️
sample_reviews_en.author: Aticha Manakarunkij

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was okay, but the service was terrible. They spilled the mala hot pot on my foot, and there was absolutely no care or attention given. They only asked if I needed anything, and that was it. I had to walk to the restroom myself. It was awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฺBuffοnᴥ

Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and clean, every dish is reasonably priced.
The restaurant is open until 3 AM. If you're hungry late at night, this is the place to eat.
The food is really delicious. As soon as the food arrived, everyone ate it all up, I almost didn't have time to take pictures! (I didn't even get a chance to photograph some dishes).

I recommend these dishes that we actually ordered, they were all delicious:
Stir-fried water spinach with crispy pork
Spicy morning glory with crispy pork
Super chicken wings
Stir-fried kale with crispy pork
Stir-fried pork with preserved olives
Pork with lime sauce
Spicy fried fish salad
Spicy century egg salad
Stir-fried white chives
Basil with century egg
Papaya salad with crab
Minced pork omelet
Stir-fried preserved radish with egg
Fried chicken tendons
Sun-dried squid

Everything was so delicious, we ordered several dishes again. It's truly delicious, I highly recommend it! It's worth coming back often!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sadanan Lorpenpop

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is fresh, and the service is excellent. They pay attention to the food, cleanliness, and friendliness. Their hospitality and approach to customers are excellent. The food is delicious and worth the price. However, if you're looking for a variety of food, I must emphasize that this place probably isn't the place for you. The selection isn't as diverse as it should be. There's no beef, and the chicken menu is minimal. But the taste is delicious. Overall, I can say it's excellent. Give it a try. I guarantee you won't be disappointed, and if the restaurant maintains this concept, it will definitely be one I'll visit often. Oh, and by the way, you can pay via payment.
sample_reviews_en.author: nudtapong pic

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a rice porridge place I've found myself coming to quite often. It lives up to its name, "people's rice porridge," something everyone can enjoy. The price is quite affordable (actually, "cheap" would be a better word), but honestly, the taste reflects the price. It's not bad, just average, perfect for a meal before heading home or as a hangover cure after leaving the pub nearby. It's one of those places with friendly prices (and I mean genuinely friendly) and decent taste; you won't regret spending your money here.
sample_reviews_en.author: hispeed design

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is fresh, clean, and delicious; everything we ordered was great. The Luang Prabang papaya salad was amazing. The fish dishes were fresh and good. They have both rice porridge and papaya salad on the menu. Single dishes are reasonably priced. The restaurant is spacious and comfortable, the restrooms are clean, the food comes out quickly, and the service is good. They close at 3 AM, and it gets busier the later it gets.
sample_reviews_en.author: effe relax channel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Update 2020 // Reopened after COVID. The restaurant has been upgraded and is bigger, with more comfortable seating, a larger and more diverse menu. They now offer rice porridge, main courses, and shabu-shabu – a complete menu.

Open late, affordable prices, delicious soup, clean, good portions, friendly service, comfortable seating, and cool air conditioning. It's my favorite shabu-shabu restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Snash Smash

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was delicious. At first, seeing the prices, I thought the portions would be small, but no, the portions were generous and appropriate. More importantly, I now have another great restaurant option in the Charoen Krung area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suttinun Seesaeng

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious, especially the papaya salad. I didn't have high expectations because it's hard to find good papaya salad in Bangkok. I braced myself for it to be just okay, but it was surprisingly delicious! 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: SIRI SHUM

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, good prices, nice and cool air-conditioned room, and excellent service. It's our family's regular restaurant. We come all the way from Sai Mai, but we're always here. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Regret LoukTao

They have the best Khao Soi I've ever had, frankly better than the one I had in Northern Thailand. The curry is rich and flavorful, the chicken is incredibly tender, and the noodles are perfectly cooked. Highly recommend!

This Khao Soi with chicken is the best I've ever had. The chicken is very tender, the noodles are perfectly cooked, and the best part is the curry broth – rich, creamy, and full of flavor. It's even better than the one I had in Northern Thailand.

The spring rolls and soup were okay. The noodles were so-so. The staff were very nice. Great atmosphere for a noodle shop.

The fried spring rolls, pork rib soup, and braised pork were delicious.
The restaurant is clean, the atmosphere is good, and the service is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: M

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is nice, with a garden area perfect for taking photos.
However, I didn't see many people eating there, and many menu items were discontinued. The food was delicious and the portions were just right.

There was plenty of parking.

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was good. The restaurant is a glasshouse-like cafe, airy and spacious. The food was delicious, with a rather strong flavor; I recommend the stir-fried minced meat salad (larb kua), it has a wonderful aroma of spices.

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried noodles with crab meat are delicious. The food is tasty and of good quality, and the atmosphere is nice. The menu might not be complete, but I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: karusuda wanma

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the portions were generous, the prices were reasonable, the atmosphere was nice, and the staff provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pranomjit Boonmgoen

sample_reviews_en.author: Nopparat Thinhuasuea

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, great atmosphere, lovely music, and especially the staff, excellent service.
#100 out of 10 is still not enough 😊😊😊

sample_reviews_en.text: July 2026: Stay away from this place! Horrible service!!! Owner let the staff be rude and play on the phones instead of attending customers... and during the 2026 FIFA Word Cup cheer for every opposing team against Sweden, although dressed in the Swedish Team Jerseys... in a Swedish owned bar that pay their salaries... with Swedish fans (among them the golf regulars) watching the game. sample_reviews_en.text:
Ate at this restaurant twice and the second time was the last time for me the staff are terrible !

No greeting on entering complete ignoring for 5 minutes untill i called them over to order food .
They didnt have a specials menu i had to point at a board outside what i wanted food is ok but nothing special you cant find at other western orianted places would not reccomend sorry ! .
sample_reviews_en.author: Ramon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is located Soi Diana offers authentic Western cuisine. While the prices are on the higher side, the quality is guaranteed.

Since there are many Western customers, the waitresses speak fluent English, which is a great advantage for tourists.

If you're staying in Pattaya for an extended period, you should definitely check out the lunchtime and happy hour promotions.
sample_reviews_en.author: whiskey nao

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious breakfast. Friendly staff. The price was right.

I stayed at the hotel for the first time in December 2025. And not just for breakfast. The room was really good. Friendly staff. Daily room cleaning. The taxi to Bangkok airport that the hotel arranged was fantastic. Thanks again to Kim for organizing it. I had a great time there. If it works out, I'd gladly come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bjoern Wendt

sample_reviews_en.text: The location is good, and although it was a balcony room in a building on the main road, it is less noisy than the Soi Leng Ki area. Otherwise, it is at the level of a Thai hotel for the price range, and the housekeeping is clean. The room felt a bit humid, perhaps because the bathroom ventilation is connected to the room. The 99 baht breakfast menu has increased to 145 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김연우

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried the “All You Can Eat Meatloaf” at Harry’s RESTAURANT today and honestly it was a very good deal for the price. The meatloaf was tasty, the potatoes were good and the portion size definitely won’t leave you hungry. Sauce could use a bit more flavor, but overall a fun and affordable lunch option in Pattaya. Friendly staff and a nice relaxed atmosphere.

#KOLBMASTER
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefan Kolb (#KOLBMASTER)

sample_reviews_en.text: Good hotel, good staff and great location. Lots of good food near by. Street food carts on same street was good and cheap. Only problem i had with the room I was in #204 the air conditioner drained into the bathroom so the floor was always wet so it had mildew and stunk. The owner should put in a pipe from AC drain to shower drain to fix it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Armando Gonzales

sample_reviews_en.text:
1.1 Unfortunately, only 4 out of 5 stars because after 3 months I'm still waiting for my cashback for 1 out of 4 bookings 😔

1.2 The booking was made through Agoda…as far as I know, the cashback has to be released by the hotel, just like it worked for the other bookings, except for one (16 USD).

restaurants.name: Buenazo - CEVICHERIA & PERUVIAN EATERY
restaurants.address:

335 Akkhara Phatsadu Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Incredible Peruvian Flavors at Buenazo in Bangkok!
If you're in Bangkok and craving some authentic Peruvian cuisine, Buenazo is the place to be! Nestled in a super cool complex with various food stalls, this gem stands out with its spectacular dishes. One of the owners is Peruvian, and it shows in the authenticity and quality of the food.

First things first—the food is absolutely *amazing*. Every dish is so well-prepared and bursting with flavor. The ceviche is a must-try; it's fresh, tangy, and simply divine. And let’s talk about the Pisco Sour—wow! It's hands down one of the best I've ever tasted in Bangkok. Perfectly balanced, refreshing, and oh-so-delicious.

The setup is a cozy bar where you sit, order, and enjoy your meal. The ambiance is fantastic with great music and a vibrant atmosphere that makes it a perfect spot to hang out with friends or enjoy a family meal.

Overall, Buenazo delivers an unforgettable dining experience with top-notch food, a friendly vibe, and a wonderful setting. Don't miss out on this culinary treasure!
sample_reviews_en.author: María Auer

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was our first time trying Peruvian cuisine, and we were genuinely impressed! 🇵🇪

We ordered five dishes: Ceviche Clasico de Pescado, Causa de Pollo (Chicken), Lomo Saltado, Crema Volteada, and Torta de Chocolate. Every single dish was delicious and full of authentic flavors. It’s rare to find a restaurant where every dish stands out, but this one definitely did. The Lomo Saltado was rich and comforting, the Ceviche was incredibly fresh, and both desserts were the perfect ending to our meal.

The atmosphere is cozy and relaxing. The restaurant is currently expanding, so the interior isn’t fully decorated yet, but that didn’t affect our dining experience at all. The owner and staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and attentive throughout our visit.

If you’re thinking about trying Peruvian food or are still deciding where to go, I highly recommend Buenazo. You definitely won’t be disappointed. We’ll absolutely be coming back! ⭐️🇵🇪
sample_reviews_en.author: Preemada

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Peruvian restaurant located on the basement floor , is owned by Peruvians, which already sets the tone for an authentic experience.

We ordered the classic ceviche, made with raw fish. The flavor was really interesting — briny and fresh, with a deep umami from the seafood stock balanced by the sharpness of citrus. It gave me a completely new kind of umami that I hadn’t tasted before.

A friend mentioned that this style is influenced by Japanese sashimi culture, which makes sense and adds another layer of appreciation to the dish.

We also tried the seafood rice stew. It was creamy and carried the same fresh seafood-stock flavor, rich but not heavy. Overall, it gave us a really good introduction to Peruvian cuisine.

A great place if you’re curious about authentic Peruvian flavors and want to experience something different.
sample_reviews_en.author: leotrails

sample_reviews_en.text: I was excited to see ceviche in Bangkok, but it felt like a disappointment. It’s quite a small (in fact tiny) portion, (I think they measure exactly 100g of fish) that’s done right there in front of you, so basically the fish doesn’t really have much time to get cooked in the lemon juice. It’s served with a handful of corn and two slices of sweet potato. The size is more or less enough for a starter. It offers a very poor value for 430THB which is almost £10. Honestly in Latin America you can get 100x better ceviche even by the dirt road at no man’s land. It’s not exactly a rocket science dish. Anyway, they have other Peruvian staplers like Lomo Saltado or Chicharron too, but I wouldn’t think it’s worth it. You can pay with a card and I think they add 7% tax and service charge on top of what you see on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juliet for OnlyOnwards

sample_reviews_en.text: The vibrant atmosphere and the open kitchen layout allow you to witness the magic as it happens. The chefs here are not just cooks; they are true culinary artists. Each dish I tried was a masterpiece, particularly the stunning ceviche and the visually arresting causa rellena, which were not only beautiful but bursting with flavor. The passion and authenticity shine through in every bite, making Yuna a must-visit for anyone craving a taste of Peru. The attention to detail, from presentation to the freshness of ingredients, ensures a dining experience that is nothing short of spectacular. Highly recommend for an unforgettable culinary journey!
sample_reviews_en.author: Brice G

sample_reviews_en.text: It had been quite a while since I last had Peruvian cuisine, and by chance I came across a restaurant at The Commons (Thonglor) called Buenazo. It was a very pleasant surprise—especially meeting the owner, Santiago, and talking with him about Peruvian and Latin American cuisine. I started with a pisco sour, which was excellent and immediately brought back memories of my time in Peru. I then had the classic ceviche, prepared very well, followed by the corazones, which were new to me but highly recommended. Definitely a place I’ll come back to.
sample_reviews_en.author: OHS

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had the classic ceviche made with local sea bass. The dish was presented beautifully and looked very appetizing, served with split corn kernels and slices of sweet potato on both sides of the ceviche.

The sweet potato, however, was slightly too firm and seemed undercooked.

Aside from that, the seasoning was excellent, the fish was fresh and flavorful, and the presentation was elegant.

Prices are medium-to-high by Bangkok standards, which is to be expected for places of this kind in the heart of the upscale Thonglor neighborhood.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eat the world

sample_reviews_en.text: Our first try of Peruvian food. And it was so simple, yet so super flavourful. There was a lady from Peru eating next to us and she vouched that the food was legit good. We had the Ceviche Mixto, Fried Squid with Yuca and the Chicken Arroz. So super good. Not to mention, the 2 staff (though from Myanmar), were super friendly and knew exactly what to do. Excellent comms skills too. Totally made my day eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eileen Lui

restaurants.name: Katsukura Central Park Bangkok
restaurants.address:

Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I came to the Central Park branch with fairly high expectations. Unfortunately, this visit was deeply disappointing and far below the standard associated with the brand.

From the beginning, the service appeared disorganized. Staff seemed confused and inattentive, and even the table cleanliness upon seating was not properly handled. The waiting time for the food was also excessively long considering the overall dining experience delivered.

Most disappointing, however, was the tonkatsu itself. The pork cutlet lacked the crisp, light texture one would expect from a quality tonkatsu restaurant. Instead, it arrived noticeably greasy, overly saturated with oil, and quickly became heavy and unpleasant to eat.

For comparison, the branch at ICONSIAM delivers a much better and more authentic experience that is much closer to the standard I remember from Kyoto.

A restaurant carrying the Katsukura name should uphold a consistent level of quality and execution. If this branch cannot maintain those standards, it risks seriously damaging the reputation of the brand

เอาง่ายๆนะ ทำให้ดีไม่ได้ก็ปิดสาขาไปเถอะ เสียชื่อ
sample_reviews_th.author: Watcharapong Suwandumrong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fragrant aroma of roasted sesame seeds and spices welcomes visitors from the moment they step into Katsukura at Dusit Central Park. This legendary premium tonkatsu restaurant, directly from Kyoto, offers a warm, relaxing atmosphere and attentive service.

The experience begins on a clean wooden table with the grinding of roasted sesame seeds in a perfectly sized bowl. The fragrant scent of freshly roasted sesame seeds hits your nose as soon as the pestle hits the grains, before the rich sauce is poured over and mixed to create a perfectly balanced dipping sauce.

The main course is served piping hot. A thick, large piece of pork cutlet is hidden beneath a thin layer of golden breadcrumbs, meticulously fried. The first bite reveals a light crispness before the tender, juicy pork melts in your mouth without being greasy at all. Served with thinly shredded cabbage dressed with fragrant sesame dressing, plump and shiny Japanese rice, and a comforting bowl of hot miso soup, this meal is a truly delightful and satisfying experience in an impressive contemporary Japanese setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phrompirun Wattanawiggid

sample_reviews_en.text:
Katsukura Kyoto (Dusit Central Park) delivers a fine, respectable tribute to tonkatsu. The craftsmanship shows where it matters most—in the breading, the balance, and especially the array of dipping sauces, which are thoughtful and genuinely well executed.

Where it falters is service.

Attention to detail at the table feels absent. Rice and miso soup aren’t topped up unless you chase it. Drinks sit empty longer than they should. The staff seem distracted, inward, more occupied with themselves than the room. It takes the edge off what should be a seamless experience.

And that matters.

Having eaten this dish for over a decade—from my years in Singapore to multiple trips across Japan—I don’t take tonkatsu lightly. It’s a deceptively simple dish that lives or dies on precision. The kitchen here largely gets it right. The floor does not.

It’s a pity, because better service would elevate the entire experience.

As it stands, it’s still a decent stop if you find yourself at Dusit Central Park in Silom. Just don’t expect the full, polished ritual the dish truly deserves.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. Aman Bhonsle

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried pork was hard and greasy, and took an extremely long time to arrive, even though there were no customers. The kitchen staff were standing around chatting, I don't know if they forgot about the food or if they just took too long to fry it. It was like the hard, stale fried pork skewers you find outside a school. Edible, but the price was exorbitant; it didn't feel special at all. The egg roll seemed hot on the outside but was cold inside; I don't know if that's how it's supposed to be eaten. The sauces tasted good, and the sesame dressing was delicious. The restaurant looked dark, and the kitchen seemed messy and cluttered; it didn't give a good impression. Items were haphazardly placed. The service was poor; there were about 5-6 staff members chatting at the front of the restaurant and behind the bar, so you had to get up to call them. Personally, I think the price and service were too high for the quality received. This was my second visit, and I wasn't impressed enough to make a third visit worthwhile.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bonus Yodyut

sample_reviews_en.text:
The 80g and 120g pork loin cuts were almost indistinguishable; the pork was very thin and practically the same, feeling tough and dry. The pork and rice were hard, making it very difficult to swallow. The miso soup took a long time to refill, making it a torture to eat. The shredded cabbage was good, but the chicken karaage was completely bland. The rice with egg was extremely bland, like rice with plain soup.
The restaurant was noisy, but the staff were even louder talking amongst themselves. I didn't want to know them, but they were talking so loudly. I just wanted to eat. I kept calling for refills of rice and soup until I was exhausted. The staff walked back and forth, avoiding eye contact with customers. I regret the service charge I paid; I want it back. This is the second branch in Thailand of a famous Japanese restaurant. I've eaten at the Ginkakuji Temple branch before. I recommend they shouldn't use the Japanese name as a reference if the quality isn't good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chindara Kanrap

sample_reviews_en.text:
Before going into the review, let me just say that I have been going to Katsukura in Japan since early 2000s, so for over 20 years and have loved it for a long time.

The Katsukura set meal of the Large prawn cutlet and Berkshire pork tenderloin cutlet is my go to and is the perfect pork and prawn katsu meal I have ever had. The Central Park outlet got everything right except the rice, which was hard and wrong texturally compared to other outlets. You can even tell just from my photo of it if you are a fan of Katsukura.

I do not need to eat katsu all year as long as I can eat katsukura when I go to Bangkok or Japan and this will continue unless more standards start to drop. The soup version is similar to the iconsiam one and the old way Japan branches did it which is what I prefer, vs the current Japan version with a lot of weird veges in it.

Still the best though and always a must have for me in Bangkok or Japan.
sample_reviews_en.author: raphmeister

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered the 120g pork tenderloin tonkatsu set.

The pork was tender, well-fried, and the breadcrumbs were crispy without being greasy.
The rice mixed with millet was delicious; the rice was fragrant and soft, and the millet wasn't hard. It paired perfectly with the fried pork; I finished the whole bowl!
There's a rich and sweet sauce, and the restaurant recommended mixing them for a different but equally delicious flavor.
The shredded cabbage was finely chopped, and the two types of dressing were great mixed together – I really liked it.
There was also pickled mustard greens with sesame seeds and mustard to balance the richness.

The staff provided excellent service, constantly checking on us and refilling the salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bunnarach Punnarach

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the opportunity to dine at Katsukura Central Park Bangkok, but I was quite disappointed with the service.
The staff tended to stand together in groups rather than spread out to attend to customers. As a result, I had to call several times to order food or ask for assistance.
Even asking for refills of rice or soup required multiple requests, which made the overall experience less than ideal.
Compared to the Katsukura IconSiam branch, the service there was noticeably better. I hope the restaurant will take this feedback into consideration for improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandy L

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come enjoy the Gon Buffet promotion (March 24th to April 11th, 2025) at "Barbecue Plaza" Supreme Complex branch, 3rd floor (Samsen Rd., Dusit District, Bangkok). It's a Mongolian-Japanese fusion BBQ with the restaurant's delicious dipping sauces. The food is fresh and the service is good.
- Choose the Pork Buffet promotion for 399 baht per person (including VAT). Includes rice, drinks (tea, chrysanthemum tea, Pepsi, lemonade), ice cream (coconut and chocolate), and children under 110 cm tall eat free. Children 111-140 cm tall get a 50% discount, and those over 60 years old get a 50% discount.
- The restaurant's unique features are the electric grill pan with boiling function, its signature dipping sauces, and the green dragon "Barbeque Gon".
- This is the first branch opened at... CentralPlaza Ladprao Shopping Center, established in 1987. Currently, there are over 156 branches.

Barbecue Plaza, Supreme Complex Branch, 3rd Floor, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si Subdistrict, Dusit District, Bangkok.
13°47'23.3"N 100°30'54.9"E (13.789806, 100.515250), altitude 9.03 m.
