sample_reviews_en.author: Satjarthip Thusneyapan

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork slices were cut very thin. When grilled, they broke apart like scraps. Eating it felt like I was eating scraps of pork. I didn't dare order more. I quickly finished grilling it and went to eat somewhere else. The food quality was terrible, ruining Barbecue Plaza's reputation. This was at the regular price, not the buffet. They really need to improve; otherwise, they'll lose all their customers. Especially at the Supreme Mall branch; there were only two tables occupied. When we complained to the staff, they called a manager who came over with an unwelcoming expression. Instead of listening and improving, they told us to pour broth onto the pan, which would cause the burnt pork scraps to fall into the broth. Is that the correct instruction from the manager? There should be standards in place. Please, the company should control the standards of both service and food quality. Thank you. (Dining experience: Monday, July 6th, 2026, Supreme Mall branch, 2nd floor, approximately 5:00 PM)
sample_reviews_en.author: pennapa chamchue

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered food and waited a very long time. The staff were not very attentive. We asked about our order three times, but to no avail. There's a 1:30 time limit, but we'd already waited 40 minutes. This was our first time eating here with my girlfriend, and we were very disappointed. Other branches have never been like this. I wish they would be more attentive and provide better service.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรชิตา สุวรรณสังข์

sample_reviews_en.text: The delivery rider arrived to pick up the order at 10:25 AM. I've been waiting for over 20 minutes, and it's almost 11 AM, but it's still not ready. There are no other customers, and the order is just a set of sliced ​​pork, garlic fried rice, and 3 dumplings.
sample_reviews_en.author: sastra kittiraveechote

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pan heats up very slowly. I waited forever for the pork to be cooked. I told the staff.
They said the pan would heat up gradually, but it heats up very slowly. I've eaten here before and it didn't happen like this before.
sample_reviews_en.author: กุลธิดา บุตรเนียม

sample_reviews_en.text: It wasn't crowded on a weekday. The staff were polite, the food was served quickly, and they were very diligent in refilling the cabbage. The Bua Loy Sundae ice cream was the best.
sample_reviews_en.author: ครู แอปเปิ้ล

sample_reviews_en.text: The food quality is acceptable, but this branch doesn't have a smoke extractor, so the smoke from grilling has nowhere to go and just lingers in the restaurant. 😣🥓🥢 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Phongwarit Jarukalya

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been sitting here for hours and still haven't received my hot pot meal; it's taking forever!
The staff aren't paying much attention either.
sample_reviews_en.author: บรรหาร ไตรทุกร้าง

restaurants.name: ตั่วเตี้ย ข้าวหน้าไก่ ก๋วยจั๊บน้ำใส
restaurants.address:

77 Sutthisan Winitchai Rd, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Tasty dishes, love the the 'al dante' flat rice noodles (ก๋วยจั๊บ), it's not easy to find this kind of texture.
sample_reviews_th.author: Skao Krit

sample_reviews_en.text:
A local chicken rice, noodle soup, and crispy pork shop... I've eaten there four or five times now. The chicken rice is delicious, but it's not really my thing.
The vendors are an elderly couple, who are friendly.
The shop is bright and airy, with several tables, and they can easily accommodate additional tables if they're full.
Today, I ordered pork noodle soup (without offal) and plain rice.
The pork bone broth is barely seasoned, and of course, the tofu is definitely free of MSG. The flavor is a bit bland, but you can definitely feel the umami of the pork bone soup and pepper, but it's not overly fragrant. The crispy pork is delicious and crispy. The pork and meatballs are also okay.
The plain rice is high-quality, chewy, soft, and delicious. The portion seems a bit small compared to the noodle soup, as it was all gone first, lol.
Overall, the price is reasonable, considering the quality, quantity, and deliciousness.
For those looking for chicken rice or other bland, lightly seasoned dishes, I highly recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narukom Sakoonvilaikidcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here because my boyfriend loves chicken rice. It just so happens to be on the way to a barbershop, so he's stopped by several times. Today, I finally got to try it myself. It's a traditional chicken rice dish with a thick, sticky broth. It's medium-flavored and suitable for all ages. It doesn't contain MSG. Condiments like sweet soy sauce or mustard are provided. The hot noodles are good, and the flavor is also medium-flavored. You can add more seasonings to your liking, and it's delicious. The shop also sells drinks like tea. The shop is clean, and there's a parking lot next to the shop. The prices are reasonable and not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Auwae CH

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chicken stew in a Thai-Chinese way and clear broth noodles!

This restaurant is run by the Auntie and uncle who are very kind and seem passionate about their food.

Most of their regular customers like to order ‘Khao-Na-Khai’ or Trio meat. The chicken stew is pretty flavorful and you can add the chili sauce then it becomes more interesting. I think the pork belly is a bit too sad. The Chinese sausage is good. The soup is okay, but a bit too bland for me.

There is an English menu available. During lunchtime, the service can be slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuchnalin Leerasantana

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so delicious! The chicken rice bowl was huge, with lots of lean chicken meat, no skin. The soup that came with it was also very tasty, with just the right amount of pepper spice. The pork ribs in the soup were incredibly tender. It was so good I had to ask for seconds. The staff were lovely. There's plenty of parking, and the restaurant is air-conditioned, making it very comfortable to eat in.
sample_reviews_en.author: MinMelonie

sample_reviews_en.text: Many people have probably been reviewing this restaurant for a long time now, so let me add another voice to confirm that this restaurant is truly delicious. The flavors are truly delicious and satisfying. They put their heart into every dish. I didn't review it the first time I tried it, but I did after eating it for a while. The dry kuay jap is the best!! 🫶🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: Apisit Sriyeam

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my number one favorite crispy pork rice restaurant. I've been eating here since I was a kid. The crispy pork pieces are perfectly sized and truly crispy, and the sauce is unlike any other. The secret is that you have to add sweet soy sauce to it. Their other dishes are delicious too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ake piyapong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered crispy pork with Chinese sausage and rice, and noodle soup without offal.
The crispy pork had a rancid smell.
The rice was good, the Chinese sausage was okay, but the crispy pork ruined it!!
As for the noodle soup, it also had an offal smell. That's it!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Camozii

restaurants.name: Meng Kway Chap
restaurants.address:

PHC4+PC3, Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an amazing kway chap (rice noodle soup) I stumbled upon by chance. While working in the Khlong Toei area, I found Nai Meng's Kway Chap shop. I was hooked after my first bite. I usually prefer the famous shops in Yaowarat (Chinatown), but this one is just as good, at a more affordable price and with comparable taste.
- The broth isn't overly spicy with pepper, it's fragrant and perfectly balanced.
- The offal is clean, not at all gamey or bitter.
- The tender, fatty pork is incredibly delicious.
- If you don't eat offal, you'll get minced pork instead.
- The crispy pork isn't super crispy, the skin isn't puffy, but it's not bad; it depends on how much fat you get. The dark soy sauce is sweet and delicious.

The elderly couple who run the shop are quite loud but very lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: J F

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been searching for years for the kway chap (rice noodle soup) shop that used to be across from the Queen Sirikit Convention Center. I finally found it had moved to a soi (alley) next to Med Park Hospital, right next to the Moo Uim Rad Na (stir-fried noodles with pork) shop. They're open from 3 PM until late evening. It's just as delicious as before, with generous portions of both noodles and toppings. The shop's signature dish is the pork skin – a must-try! It's soft and slightly crispy. The kway chap noodles are also soft and slippery. Seriously delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwandee Chaiwarut

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best I've ever had in Thailand. The offal is cleaned thoroughly and doesn't smell at all. In my opinion, it's tastier than Nai Ouan in Yaowarat and better than Ek Phailin's Kuay Jab. This place is original, old, and has been selling for a long time, but they moved locations so not many people know about it... I wonder if the person who gave it 3 stars is a competitor?
sample_reviews_en.author: Tattaya Srisaksorachart

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible. The service was awful. Just ordering without offal resulted in a grumpy face, furrowed brows, and a harsh, rude tone. The taste was mediocre too.
sample_reviews_en.author: man phuthipong

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious, clean, I come here to eat all the time. The vendors are very friendly. My favorite restaurant. The crispy pork is the best.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadia Nedruthai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Outdoor supper / dinner on street side.
Inside has parking on the side. Good soup base and clean pork inside organs.

No AC
sample_reviews_en.author: Nijaya I

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is the same as always. 50 baht per bowl, 60 baht for the special.
Crispy pork is 100 baht per 100 grams.
sample_reviews_en.author: chok pisut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good flavor, not too spicy, good offal, good crispy pork.
The mom is a bit famous, but nothing special.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kritsada Phisetphattanakun

restaurants.name: Cafe Pitini
restaurants.address:

502, 31-32 Soi Buakhao, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best all-around restaurant in Pattaya! Pitini has quickly become my husband’s and my favourite place to eat. It’s excellent value for money. We first stumbled upon it on a hot, humid evening while looking for somewhere with air conditioning. We went in once—and have been back many times since. It’s now our daily go-to.

We’ve had both breakfast and dinner here, both Thai and Western and everything we’ve tried has been consistently delicious. We’re especially fond of the Chicken Kiev and the Minced Beef Pie. The Bisto gravy is amazing and tastes just like my mom’s.

The service is the best we’ve experienced in Pattaya. The staff are incredibly friendly and fast, and they remembered our drink order after just one visit. The manager is always present, attentive, and ready to help wherever needed.

It’s also exceptionally clean, which is important to me because I’m very particular about cleanliness. The windows are spotless—never greasy or marked—and the bathroom is always very clean as well.

And don’t miss the cappuccino—it’s excellent.

You really can’t go wrong here.
sample_reviews_en.author: KK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Apparently we won't be coming here anymore. And I don't recommend it to others either.
To our great regret, the café has changed beyond recognition for the worse. It was a good old cafe... and now it's a food outlet where the products first sit in the refrigerator for a long time, and then they just heat them up.
We ordered Fish & Chips and a Kiev cutlet. Both were 100% semi-finished products bought somewhere in a supermarket like Macro. The Kiev cutlet was flattened to the state of a chop and there was no talk of any oil inside this cutlet. In general, the semi-finished potato and defrosted green peas did not improve the taste of the dishes.

Cutlery is served wrapped in a paper napkin. Everything would be fine if the blades were wrapped. But the fact that the handles were wrapped in a napkin and the knives, forks, spoons themselves were on a dirty table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sergei Artemenko (We'll help)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stumbled across this place on a Sunday evening, a roast dinner was a sight for sore eyes on the menu, a choice of beef, pork, or chicken all come bistro gravy, with a choice of roast potatoes or mash, and either mixed veg or peas. I opted for beef with 1/2 and 1/2 potatoes and peas, which got me 2 roast potatoes and a scoop of mash.
The beef and mash were really nice, the gravy just right, a healthy portion of peas, 1 roast was nice but 1 was undercooked and hard. I will forgive this as I loved the rest, and will definitely be back to try the Breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neill Gordon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic place to relax, clean, spacious, with attentive waitresses and, above all, air conditioning.
I ordered what I think was the British Breakfast and a bottle of water. It was served quickly, hot, and in such a large quantity that I couldn't finish it all.
Highly recommended.
220 Bath
August 2025
sample_reviews_en.author: Fernando Martínez Alfaro

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had breakfast one day and lunch a couple days later. Smiling, friendly staff with prompt service. Both meals were excellent with great coffee. Can recommend 😀
Another visit to Pitini’s and it never disappoints. Had the omelette which was huge. They also have the best coffee I have found in Pattaya 👌
sample_reviews_en.author: WOD JISM

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there twice now for breakfast, once I had a club sandwich and another time breakfast with an omelet and vegetable soup. Both times the service was very friendly and the food arrived quickly. I'll also be having dinner here tonight. Dinner was also good and plentiful, just to my liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Willi G.P. Buech

sample_reviews_en.text: When on Holidays I have eaten here for the last 15 Years The meals are good Quality and Fresh, and the Deserts are Lovely too, Although the Staff have changed over the years they still like a bit of small talk and a laugh, the Owners are great people too, Drop in, You'll be glad you did.
sample_reviews_en.author: Grim Reaper

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended for breakfast; you'll get a good meal at a fair price. The staff is excellent, and there's usually no wait since there's almost always a table available!

I didn't find the sandwiches particularly good, but the American breakfast and the omelet were fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kai Gorter

restaurants.name: ITAEWON@EKKAMAI
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 124/1-2 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I love it! Finally, there's a Korean restaurant near my workplace. I love the fried chicken the most, but I have to bring a friend because it's huge! The grilled intestines are also crispy and delicious. Another favorite is the Tteokbokki Carbonara 🥰🥰 The cheesy corn and kimchi fried rice are also incredibly delicious 🙂‍↕️🙂‍↕️🙂‍↕️🙂‍↕️
sample_reviews_en.author: Fang Fang

sample_reviews_en.text: I really enjoyed this Korean restaurant. The kimchi soup was the highlight—rich, spicy, and full of deep, fermented flavor. The broth tasted homemade and comforting, with tender pork and fresh tofu. Portions were generous, and it was perfect with rice. The atmosphere was cozy, and the staff were friendly and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aung Kaung Myat

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff are incredibly friendly and this is the best Korean pojangmacha in the area. It's a popular restaurant, so many locals visit. The generous opening hours also make it a frequent stop during my recent trip. I highly recommend it, and it's all made with my own money.
sample_reviews_en.author: 배준호

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s been a while since I had Korean food that truly felt satisfying. The flavors are deep without being overpowering, and above all, you can really feel the generous food quality with no shortcuts on ingredients. A place that leaves you genuinely satisfied after a meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: 국두

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried their kimchi fried rice, and it was absolutely delicious. The flavor was rich, well-balanced, and perfectly spicy. The kimchi tasted fresh, and the rice was cooked just right. The atmosphere was great , and I would definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yo Lay

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited a Korean restaurant and tried their famous Korean onion chicken. From the first bite, it was incredibly delicious. The chicken was crispy on the outside, juicy inside, and perfectly balanced with sweet, savory onion …
sample_reviews_en.author: Korn Lao

sample_reviews_en.text: Korean dishes were just as delicious, especially the bibimbap and tteokbokki, which were well-seasoned and satisfying. The flavors felt authentic, and every dish was served hot and fresh, making the whole meal enjoyable and memorable.
sample_reviews_en.author: dalaohu baobao

sample_reviews_en.text:
I come here very often. Sometimes I come with friends, sometimes I come alone.
What impresses me most is when I come alone; the staff are so incredibly lovely! And they have a karaoke room too! Love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nami nami

restaurants.name: Lee Café @ Q House Lumpini
restaurants.address:

1 คิวเฮ้าส์ ลุมพินี ตึกไลฟ์เซ็นเตอร์ S Sathon Rd, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Normally, I don't rate an establishment if I will just give it a low rate. However, I publish this one for AWARENESS to avoid being surprised when your paying your bill.

Quality of Food, just okay. For the price you paid you expect a nice quality and decent size serving.
What appears in the photo is not as reflect in person. I understand that everything increase but with the price charge to the customer plus additional service charge on your bill, I think the customer deserves to get what they paid for.

Customer service in most places I went or dine here in Bangkok is lacking of touch.

So most establishment in this complex where the Lee Cafe is have service charges 10% and tax 7% charge on top of the price of your meal, which is alright if your aware of it, that's why we went in this said restaurant because upon checking we didn't see any signage notifying their customer that they charge such  charges. So when we pay the bill it reflect that there is an additional 10% to our bill which is the service charge which shocked us.

For the management, I recommend that you have a signage like Ponn have on their entrance to notify customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reyna Nangan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another excellent restaurant in Q House Lumpini. It has all the elements of a great restaurant: it's an old establishment, and it has photos of members of the royal family who have dined there displayed.

• The dim sum set is served in a large bamboo steamer. The shrimp dumplings, ha gao, and seaweed-wrapped shrimp are all incredibly delicious and fragrant. We couldn't finish the steamed buns and had to take some home.
• The stir-fried noodles with chicken are superb. The flavor is perfectly balanced, with plenty of chicken, a wonderfully fragrant sauce, and a very generous portion.
• The hot pot Yentafo is honestly very delicious, but the spiciness prevents you from fully enjoying it. However, they give you a lot of ingredients, especially the fish balls, which are high-quality – not frozen ones.

💯
sample_reviews_en.author: Puripat Kitkarncharoensin

sample_reviews_en.text: Lee Café @ Q House Lumpini, Bangkok, serves delicious Chinese-Thai food, from stir-fry noodles to desserts like mango sticky rice. The extensive menu offers a wide variety of options. The café is clean and well-organized, providing a simple and relaxed ambience. The servers are friendly, though a bit shy. I've been a regular visitor for over seven years and always enjoy the experience. It's a great spot for a satisfying meal in a comfortable setting. I give it a four-star rating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zainal

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the taste is consistent.
However, please improve the service from the staff.
They barely pay attention when called, and their demeanor is unfriendly and they don't smile.

I used to eat here often, but now I've switched to the Sifaa restaurant across the street instead.
The service there is much better and even exceeds expectations; they remember customers (they know what we want without us even having to request it).
sample_reviews_en.author: NATTAPON T

sample_reviews_en.text: After a tiring workout, stop by LEE cafe’ for a delicious meal before heading home. The stir-fried pork with basil is hearty, and the fried rice with mackerel is fragrant. The seating is comfortable and spacious, the food is delicious, served quickly, and most importantly, the portions are HUGE! For a relaxing, satisfying meal, or just a place to rest, wait, and enjoy yourself, LEE cafe’ is the place to be.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lee Cafe at Q House Lumphni is known for its Chinese-Thai Fusion food. With its wok-stir fried style dishes, every dishes smells wok-pan.

Food are very delicious here. Not easy to find a well rounded various menus thats goes beyond fabolous. From single alacarte fried rice dishes to desserts, wonderfully cooked and served.

Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is still as delicious as before. There's a wide variety of dishes on the menu. Today I went alone and ordered stir-fried noodles, shrimp dumplings, salted egg yolk cream-filled sandwiches, and chrysanthemum tea. Everything was delicious and satisfying. Highly recommend! 😋😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Myday

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food and nice service. Lee Cafe is a restaurant chain in Bangkok. This branch is located on the G floor of the Life Centre. This building is next to MRT Lumpini. The restaurant serves many fusion fishes and set menus are available. Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadharatch Ounlert

restaurants.name: ร้านจิ้มจุ่ม ถ.นางลิ้นจี่
restaurants.address:

PG4V+775, T.T.N. Avenue, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hot pot lovers should stop by. The menu is standard, but they give you generous portions of ingredients. The pork comes with egg already poured over it, and they provide plenty of vegetables.

The food is prepared quickly; you won't have to wait long. The papaya salad is good, and the grilled and fried items are okay. The larb and nam tok dishes are considered good.

Overall, it's standard, but not amazing.
It's a roadside restaurant, but there's parking available for 20 baht per hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Unexpert

sample_reviews_en.text: Kids from Nang Linchee area must know this place. It started as a food cart in front of Krungsri Bank, moved several times, and is now a permanent shop in the back area of ​​Tops Daily. Parking is easy in the evenings; free for 2 hours. I love their grilled pork neck and salted egg papaya salad. Their hot pot is also delicious. I usually buy two dishes plus sticky rice to take home for a relaxing 150 baht meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: piya

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is authentic, with the grilled pork neck and green papaya salad being particularly good. At 200-300 baht per person, it offers excellent value. They moved to a smaller shop in an alley in August; parking is available but requires luck, and wheelchairs need to be carried up the stairs. The overall atmosphere is clean and quick, with a simple yet pleasant ambiance, suitable for gatherings with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷上门服务Outcall Services

sample_reviews_en.text: Just come and eat, don't overthink it. This is the best restaurant in the area. The food is delicious, the papaya salad is great, the grilled pork neck is amazing (they use real pork neck), the dipping sauce is perfectly balanced, and the hot pot is very reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nateegarn Koonyotying

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the pork hot pot for 220 baht, which was very expensive. There was very little pork and a lot of vegetables. The dipping sauce was excessively sour and not to my liking. I think buying the ingredients and cooking it myself would be more worthwhile.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pupy Lkab

sample_reviews_en.text: Song Dan offers typical Thai local cuisine, including grilled chicken, grilled pork neck, and Thai hot pot, all at reasonable prices. Since August 1st, some of the shops have moved from roadside stalls to shops in Top Alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: mobanche li

sample_reviews_en.text: For those who eat offal, I highly recommend the fried intestines. They're amazing! I usually order 1-2 plates every time. The papaya salad and grilled pork neck are all very good. The service is also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: jeeraporn Chunhasuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, and everything tasted great. The flavors were bold and delicious. There's also parking available next to the restaurant for 20 baht per hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dollaya Wirojwattana

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเจ๊หมวย (อาเล็ก)
restaurants.address:

182 Thanon Charoen Mueang, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This decades-old restaurant, originally located on the main road, has now moved into a side street. You'll find a small, clean door, a large fan, and a quiet, peaceful atmosphere. The service is good, portions are generous, and iced tea is 2฿. Tissues are free. There are only 6 tables.

Menu: Tom Yum, Yen Ta Fo (50฿). Most people order Yen Ta Fo.
Highlight: Fried chicken meatballs.
sample_reviews_th.author: Cook Kook

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jae Muey Noodle Shop, near Saphan On intersection. Turn left and go about 100 meters; the shop is at the entrance of the soi (alley).
They serve homemade fish balls and meatballs, including fried minced chicken meatballs, fish balls, and fish cakes.
They also have fish dumplings and fried dumplings, with plenty of toppings.
Minced pork is also available in both Tom Yum and dry versions.
Yentafo (pink noodle soup) is also offered.
Price:
40-50 THB per bowl.
Opening Hours:
Monday-Saturday
9:00 AM - 4:00 PM
Jae Muey Noodle Shop
sample_reviews_en.author: ชายหมี หนีไปเที่ยว

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located on the side of the road, easy to find. Price per bowl is 50 baht, while the noodle soup is 60 baht. Parking is available in front of the shop. The soup is boiling hot, just like a real noodle shop. The homemade fish balls and fried shrimp balls are very delicious. (However, in front of the shop on the left-hand sidewalk are 4-5 empty Bangkok garbage cans, which might make the overall look not as good as it should be.)
sample_reviews_en.author: รัตนธร

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dry noodle salad (Lek Haeng Yam). The noodles are thin, similar to Chantaburi noodles, and don't stick together.

The meatballs are delicious and the seasoning is okay.

50 baht per bowl. Payment via bank transfer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerapat Ungsriwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fried chicken balls are delicious, and the wonton wrappers are also delicious!

The fried chicken balls are delicious, and the wonton wrappers are also delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: selin cheung

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is really good. The meatballs are delicious, and the noodles are tasty. If you're in the area, you should definitely stop by.
sample_reviews_en.author: amnat jet

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a real gem! Personally, I love the chicken meatballs and fish dumplings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kendo Tv

restaurants.name: YOK-KA-DOK ยก-กระ-ดก Craft Beer Bar
restaurants.address:

192 Krung Thon Buri Road, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Great place with very chilled atmosphere well priced drinks."

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cozy craft beer bar with 10 taps, where you can sample before choosing your beer. They offer a menu with both Thai and Western cuisine. I decided to try their Carbonara spaghetti without high expectations, but it exceeded my expectations and I devoured it eagerly. Now I'm tempted to try their other pasta dishes too. Their staffs are also nice.

Update on April 1st, 2025
They changed their menu and they only have Thai style spicy salad, no western salad. I will not come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

sample_reviews_en.text: Insanely loud music have to sit outside to protect my ears! Tap beers are Chang Budweiser and hoegarden ( not craft) and have only few cans of «craft » Thai beers in he fridge. Food took 40min to come (for fried pork belly) and wasn’t good at all. Very disappointed and overated place. Just walk 2m back or forward and you will save time and money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas BEDARRIDES

sample_reviews_en.text: So, trekked across town to get here for the craft beer. 10 taps, looks good. Except they had only Chang and Budweiser on tap! Not exactly what I was expecting. Reasonable selection in bottles or can. Staff have no beer knowledge. And despite a full bar, no wine. Could do better
sample_reviews_en.author: Darren Barton

sample_reviews_en.text:
They have a wide variety of craft beers, which is a paradise for beer lovers.

For those who can't drink beer due to gout or other reasons, they also have a whiskey tower!

The food is delicious and enjoyable.

The staff are friendly and the atmosphere is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: stonecold kawauso

sample_reviews_en.text:
The worst cafe I’ve ever visited.
They served me with a WARM beer (Budweiser pint). So I had to put my glass into the fridge for couple of minutes.
I ordered Tom Yum Chicken Soup it was full of bones not meat.
DON’T VISIT THEM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Артем П

sample_reviews_en.text: Small place with a  Great atmosphere. Have some South African style food and bbq here too. If you like meeting up with other South Africans for rugby, beer and 'braai vleis', this is the place to go to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leon Koen

sample_reviews_en.text: Although the listing is Google maps says this is a craft beer place, the only craft beers they had when we were there were a few cans in the fridge. Also the atmosphere was lunar.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Cook

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is nice, the atmosphere is great, the air conditioning is comfortably cool, and the food is delicious. Overall, it's a great restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: jackket CH

restaurants.name: ทาสยำ TasYum
restaurants.address:

VG29+W27 T10 Mall Tiwanon Rd, Talat Kwan, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The spicy salads were delicious! Today I ordered salmon spicy salad, three-ingredient spicy salad, and pork sausage and salted egg yolk spicy salad. The salmon was amazing, so fresh and clean, I loved it. The three-ingredient spicy salad had sausage, crab sticks, and meatballs – everything was so fresh and clean, with no fishy smell at all. The taste was spicy and satisfying. The pork sausage and salted egg yolk spicy salad was also excellent. In short, all three dishes were incredibly delicious, clean, flavorful, and the portions were generous for the price. The prices were also reasonable, and the delivery was fast. I will definitely order again! ❤️❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunsanee Maneeprawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a spicy instant noodle salad from GRAB for 70 baht, plus an additional delivery fee.
The portion size was far too small for 70 baht.
The spicy instant noodle salad only contained about half a packet of regular instant noodles. You could easily twirl it all up with a fork (similar to the 10 baht boat noodles near the Victory Monument).
The minced pork was also very minimal.
Overall, the amount of noodles and toppings was less than half the size of the food container.
sample_reviews_en.author: Waratchaya Ouppaphan

sample_reviews_en.text: This spicy salad (Yum) restaurant is located in the same area as KFC. It's air-conditioned with a simple atmosphere and ample seating. The food is delicious; the spicy salads are particularly good, the oysters are fresh, the lotus stems are crispy, and the basil fried rice is tasty. Overall, the food is good, the staff provides good service, the prices are reasonable, and the food arrives quickly. It's not too crowded. Spicy salad lovers shouldn't miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pixel 8 Bit

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried garlic in the pork neck was delicious!! Personally, I found the spicy salad a bit too salty. People who like salty food might enjoy it. The salad base is made with shallots and sawtooth coriander. The salmon pieces were cut a little too small. During COVID, it was takeout only, and the restaurant added a 5 baht charge per item for the container. The service might need adjustment, as other reviews have mentioned.
sample_reviews_en.author: BaiToeyy K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is predominantly sweet (personally, I don't really like it). I'd like the restaurant to improve on cleanliness. We received pork sausage with the plastic wrapper still attached, which was very shocking when we ate it. Thank you.
The items we ordered were fried pork neck salad, glass noodle salad with pork sausage, and salmon salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: twoo mm

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients are incredibly fresh, including the shrimp, oysters, and salmon. The spicy salad is delicious and flavorful, with options both with and without fermented fish sauce. The atmosphere is relaxed, and they play music. If you're staying in or passing through Nonthaburi, you should definitely stop by this spicy salad restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Auttawut Oat

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time at this restaurant was great! The atmosphere was good, the staff were very friendly and welcoming, the air conditioning was comfortably cool, and they played music. The prices weren't expensive, and the food was pretty good. Excellent! I'd give it a 9 out of 10. I'll save the 10 for my next visit! 5555
sample_reviews_en.author: weerawat phromsawas

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying a spicy salad with fermented fish sauce. The flavor was well-balanced and delicious, very spicy!
The dressing was tasty, and the premium cocoa was also well-balanced and just the right amount of sweet.
If you like spicy food, I highly recommend this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Simakorn Jaruchart

restaurants.name: Nagiya Nihonmachi
restaurants.address:

115 Room 105, soi Sukhumvit 26, Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It s my comfort place to come alone everytime i work til late night and really need some varieties of foods to eat but being alone sometimes it requires a small portion per each. So i love izakaya place and Nagiya can satisfy me everytime.

Area of improvement may be the 2nd floor japanese seats that are not practical for those who are tired at work and have to sit on the ryukan style.  If i can select, i dont want to have the upstairs seat.

Lastly, the overall cleanliness like electrc stove in front of the bar area may need to get cleaned more often.  All the rest about foods and services are superb as always!
sample_reviews_en.author: Su P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Izakaya place at nihommachi mall near k-village. There is really no public transportation there, so drive yourself or grab there. The food were satisfactory with many great options from hot kitchen as well as sushi.

The staffs were attentive. We went there for a birthday party and they were accommodating with our cake surprises! We had a great time there. The pricing was sensible and will definitely come back.

One downside was the nabe we ordered which was too salty and some food arrived late.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongsakorn Somsittichock

sample_reviews_en.text:
Could be that I’ve been to many Izakaya restaurants, especially in Bangkok; I’d say that this place was ok, but nothing special.
I had many dishes with my friends, and I couldn’t remember much about them. Could be from the fact that they were all fine, but not standing out from other restaurants. My friends seemed to like the place tho
sample_reviews_en.author: Boonraksa Sopak

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is our family favourite place to go for Japanese food. There is a variety of sushi, sashimi, yakitori skewers, salads to choose from.  The service is quick and the atmosphere is relaxed.  It's family friendly and children are made to feel welcome and special.
I would recommend you reserve a table in advance as it can get busy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ka Ping Man

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food: Delicious
Service: Very good
Atmosphere: Excellent
I like sitting on the second floor; the atmosphere is great and the air conditioning is cool. It feels like being in Japan because I saw a lot of Japanese people.
I love the salt-grilled chicken skin (so delicious). Honestly, everything on the menu is delicious! ☺️😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Alisa Eiam

sample_reviews_en.text:
A pretty nice, cozy but small joint along the street with many other Japanese restaurants. As there were only another occupied table, so felt very nice dining in. If the restaurant is full, the ambience might not be so nice but not in a bad way.
Taste and quality of food is not too bad too.
sample_reviews_en.author: JA A

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Izakaya in Bangkok! So fresh so good so chilled, feels like Japan. They have 2 floors and smoking room as well, I ordered nama Tower 3L, Oroshi Harami, Bijin Tomato, Hotaru ika, Ginnan, Tori Hatsu, Tori Reba, Sunagimo and Engawa nigiri. Anyway, I highly recommend this 🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: l3arosi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food menu has changed a lot. Some of my favorites from the past are gone.
Food was less impressive than in the past.
Staff service is good.
I felt that the food had a lot of msg.
Also the feeling of smoke on the clothes is too much after leaving the premises compared to the past.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paulo Gaspar

restaurants.name: Lue Amnat Pochana - 盧阿姆納特·波查納 - ルアムナート ポチャナー
restaurants.address:

Soi Ratchadaphisek 3, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't go eat there, it's ridiculously slow.
Just one box of minced pork basil with a boiled egg, and it took an hour! I'm going crazy. There's not a single day that a delivery rider doesn't get yelled at by a customer. It's just going to stay the same, damn it.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิ่งสําคัญคือการบริการ ผู้พิพากษาการบริการ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was absolutely awful. The taste was completely different from what it should have been. Everything was stale, like it wasn't made to order. The presentation didn't match the pictures at all. In short, I threw everything away. I couldn't eat it at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: ZinFadz Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: According to ChatGPT, this huge franchise boasts 80,000 locations worldwide, but some unlicensed locations and those claiming to be so have been criticized for not being the world's largest franchise. This is one of the Thai locations of this restaurant chain, which originated in Fujian, China. Apparently, its rapid growth was fueled by its low prices, but this place isn't particularly cheap (but it's not expensive either). There's no real reason to come to Thailand to visit this place, but it seems the main customers are Chinese, and even though they all seem a bit tired, they seem to be a bit tired. I didn't expect much from the food, and that was exactly what I expected, which is why my companion scolded me.
sample_reviews_en.author: _r kikyo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow!  Glad to finally try this place!  Nice staff & delicious freshly cooked food & good prices.  I usually always go next door (Yong He Dou Jiang Soy Milk) but they ran out of my favorite must have dish there - crab filled soup dumping (xiao long bao).  So I saw this place was busy with customers and gave it a try.

The pork auto dumping here is pretty good, at least an 8/10 from all the ones I’ve had. My only wish is that they also offer it with crab or shrimp :). The vegy was fresh and not over cooked. The ma po tofu but had a very strong mala (peppery chili) taste, not sure I’ll get it again & the mushroom vegy bun was GOOD, def want that again. Keep up the good work, I’ll come back :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Curt P

sample_reviews_en.text: Surprisingly good Chinese meal. If you are looking for a quick and individual dish of Chinese food, this could be a match for you. Clean and modern restaurant located just a short walk from Chongnonsri BTS station. My favourite dish is the minced beef dried noodle with toppings of spring onion, peanut and pickled cabbage & green bean. Fried rice with prawn is so aromatic and nice rice texture mixing sweet corn, pea, and carrot. Spicy cold chicken salad contains mala flavour. Dumplings come with thinker flour type. Each dish is around 100 Baht but the portion is quite big. Will definitely come back here for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apichart Dausiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an authentic Chinese restaurant with a limited menu. Many items are discontinued, but the menu sign isn't updated. The food is average in taste. The chicken soup is good, the fried rice is tasty, and the duck leg is tender and chewy. The xiao long bao is just okay in taste and texture.

Price: 4/5
Quality: 3/5
Taste: 3/5
Cleanliness: 4/5
Speed: 4/5
Service: 3/5
Location: 4/5
Value for money: 3/5

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu offers a wide variety of choices. The taste, I think, is more authentically Chinese than Thai-style, perhaps not quite to everyone's taste, as there are many Chinese customers.

The xiao long bao might be a little dry, but considering the price, it's okay. For the braised pork belly, I recommend adding chili oil and vinegar or soy sauce; it's delicious eaten with plain rice.

sample_reviews_en.text: Punjabi restaurant and bar: I recently visited left a lasting impression on me. From the moment I stepped inside, the warm and inviting ambiance made me feel right at home. The staff was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable guiding me through the extensive menu filled with authentic Punjabi dishes. I decided to try their signature dish, Butter Chicken, and it did not disappoint. The flavors were rich and well-balanced, with just the amount of spice. The naan bread was soft and perfectly baked, a wonderful accompaniment to the delicious curry. The restaurant also offered variety of vegetarian options, including flavorful lentil dal and paneer tikka masala. The portion sizes were generous, ensuring that I left feeling satisfied and content. Overall, I highly recommend this Punjabi restaurant to anyone seeking a memorable culinary experience with service!
sample_reviews_en.author: Simonne kaur Bhatia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Missing Indian food in Thailand? This is a place I recommend for it's all you can eat buffet for 200 BHT. Great value for money and food tastes great!

I got a chance to meet the owner Mr. Bhatia who runs this place with utmost passion and dedication. 'We source all our spices from India' he said and I could see his attention to detail, steel thalis (a rarity) embossed with restaurant logo is no mean feat for a restaurant that operates in a fleeting tourist population. The place is open 24x7 and Mr. Bhatia was there till 3am overseeing operations.

The chairs are cushy and comfy. Staff is responsive and eager to support. Good Punjabi music. Overall, a good place to visit!

PS: I have reviewed a few other Indian restaurants in Pattaya beach area, Amritsar stands out, in addition, I would prefer this place as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: TheUltimateReview Level8Guide

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing Experience at Panjabi restaurant & bar
1/5 stars

I visit Panjabi restaurant & bar last weekend, and unfortunately, it was a letdown from start to finish. Here's what went wrong:

first Poor Service Our server seemed overwhelmed, taking ages to take orders and forgetting one of our appetizers altogether.
Second Mediocre Food The dishes we ordered lacked flavor and creativity. The portions were small, and the presentation was unappetizing.
Third Uncomfortable Ambiance The seating area was cramped, and the noise level was unbearable. We had to shout to converse with each other.
Frouth Overpriced Considering the subpar quality of food and service, the prices were exorbitant.

Unless Panjabi restaurant & bar revamps its menu, service, and ambiance, I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shefali Biswal

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m writing this honestly, not angrily.
I used to order from this place many times before and really liked it.
That’s why this delivery was so disappointing.

This was a delivery order, and I paid a total of 380 baht including delivery.
I even added a 20 baht tip to the delivery rider, because I expected good food.

An Indian thali arrived with Thai rice instead of basmati, and the sweet listed on the menu was missing.
For the price, it felt like the quality and care were no longer there.
I’m not sure what changed, but as a returning customer, this was sad to experience.

This had to be the worst meal that I have ever eaten in Thailand.
I ordered the Thali.
Only 2 dishes for Thali that had one over salted dahl, that was sent back only for a more saltier version to arrive, and the most tasteless potato ever.
The bowl just full of only, and just only red uncooked Spanish onion, was considered the 3 dish for my Thali.
If you're seeking a very disappointing dining experience and a tragic meal this is the place for you.
I left over 3/4 of what I ordered at the table because it was inedible.

sample_reviews_en.text: My boyfriend came here after coming to Thailand and said it was delicious, so we came together! It was the best Pad Thai I've had in Thailand, and I loved that they cut the cilantro separately for me. The Pad Thai noodles were chewy and the portions were huge. The fried rice and Tom Yum Kung were also delicious, and the portions were huge. They also had a lot of shrimp. I was worried because the shrimp at another restaurant was fishy before, but the shrimp and other food here weren't fishy at all. The quality was great and the food was delicious! You should definitely come here!! And no matter what, you should definitely order Pad Thai!!!! The owner was really friendly and fun. The drink he recommended was refreshing and delicious!!! The portions were large, it was delicious, and the price was cheap. It's a taste I'll be craving again when I go back to Korea. ㅠㅠ I'll go again next time 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: 박서원서원

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was the best Thai restaurant we tried during our 8-day trip!
We loved it so much that we came back twice. We ordered Pad Thai, Tom Yum Goong, fried rice, salad, curry, Thai tea, and green tea — everything was absolutely delicious. On our second visit, we even let the owner choose the dishes for us, and he didn’t disappoint.

The food is high quality, local, and reasonably priced. You can also customize the flavor — we told him we can’t handle spicy food, and he adjusted everything perfectly to our taste. The tea was flavorful and not overly sweet, just the way we like it.

The owner is humorous and incredibly friendly, which made the dining experience even more enjoyable and memorable. He also shared some great travel tips for Pattaya and Bangkok.

If I ever come back to Pattaya, I’ll definitely visit this restaurant again — more than once!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jackie Chen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dropped by for dinner and choose this restaurant based on the positive reviews.
Good range of dishes on the menu and we went for papaya seafood salad, crispy pork and kale + rice.
The service we received did not match that of previous reviews, rather half hearted.
The crispy pork dish was quite nice but the papaya salad had some ingredients that were not fresh unfortunately.
My thai partner said the fish balls and squid were not good and most of the dish was left uneaten.
On the upside, pricing was quite good.
We have travelled thailand extensively and have eaten all types of Thai so know what to expect.
Our experience did not align with the other reviewers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul H

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't know why everyone has praised the food here to the skies. That's exactly why we chose to go to this place and try it. The girl didn't think her dish was particularly good. My paneng chicken could have looked better. Tasted just fine. But no vegetables except for a few beans. A little carrots and other things would have definitely made it better. But the biggest disappointment was the Thai tea, it barely tasted like anything at all. Then it took a long time before you got what you ordered. Will I go here again? For lack of anything else, maybe.
As a customer, you get to write down your order yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Everdeen-Johansson

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't like to leave negative reviews, but I don't understand why this place has so many positive ratings.

Upon entering, no one came to take my order; I had to go to the entrance myself and order from the woman cooking. She seemed a bit pushy, and I didn't feel welcomed at all.

The food was just average, I suppose.

There are much better restaurants in Pattaya, so I won't be coming here again.

The Pad Thai, Crispy Pork Stir-fried with Water Spinach, Seafood Salad, and Tom Yum Soup were all delicious and very fresh. Most importantly, the prices were much cheaper than in the bustling Pub Street area, and the portions were generous. The owner speaks excellent English and is very welcoming.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Carniel Grilled Pork is located in Soi Hem Wong, Soi 1. Driving to the shop is quite difficult, as the deeper you drive, the narrower the alley gets. Before you reach the shop, a group of people are blocking off the alley. Normally, there aren't any outsiders, but when you pass, they move to let the cars through. However, to exit, you have to back out a long way, out of consideration for the people in the alley. The grilled pork skewers aren't as small as in the reviews. I ordered 10 lean skewers and 2 packets of sticky rice. The flavor and texture of the pork were excellent, delicious and satisfying.
- Grilled Pork: 8 baht per skewer (at-the-shop price)
- Sticky Rice: 7 baht per packet (at-the-shop price)
Open daily from 5:00 AM to 12:30 AM
sample_reviews_en.author: Ry Orraphan

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through delivery. The app said about 30 minutes. The rider arrived at the store 10 minutes after ordering, but I still hadn't received my food after 30 minutes. So I called to follow up. From what I heard, their queue management was terrible. They only got my order after I called to expedite it. If I hadn't called, when would I have gotten my food? I feel sorry for the rider who waited, but I also feel sorry for myself for ordering breakfast and being late for work because of this incompetent queue management. The taste was mediocre, and the skewers were small.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mashita Rx

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I'm going to introduce a famous grilled pork skewer shop in the Din Daeng area, located in a dead-end alley before the Pracha Songkhro intersection.

The shop sells grilled pork skewers for 8 baht each, with options of lean meat or meat with fat. Sticky rice is 7 baht per packet.

Today I ordered 10 skewers of the original recipe (with fat) and 10 skewers of the original recipe (lean meat).

They were grilled hot and fresh. The taste is predominantly sweet, and the pork is tender.

If you have the chance, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: เดินสายกิน เดินสายเที่ยว ศราทราเวล

sample_reviews_en.text: Arrive at the shop and be patient. They grill the skewers to order, not pre-grilling them. The skewers aren't big, 5 baht each. What I like is that it's the original grilled pork, not the milk-marinated kind. I really like it. Come early in the morning or around noon, as there are many delivery orders, so the queue is long. It's worth the wait, but it's delicious.

I'll definitely go back again. | I recently went back and this time got the fermented fish sauce dip. Let me tell you, it was incredibly delicious! Everyone should try it!
