sample_reviews_en.text:
We ate at the buffet between 7-8 PM. The buffet price was strange, and it wasn't that crowded, but the food was very slow to arrive. I think it's because there aren't enough staff. Also, the self-serve items like vegetables weren't refilled often. We waited for half an hour to get some vegetables.
The atmosphere inside the restaurant was hot. There were only two fans, and they didn't even reach all areas. The menu sign outside was confusing; the 250, 350, and 550 baht sets didn't show what you got. The dipping sauce was initially sour; I don't know if the staff added lemon or not. Overall, the food and staff were okay, but the restaurant management seemed strange. I've eaten here before and it was better. Personally, I think for this price and with this kind of service, I probably won't go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theerapat Wongsasuwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Anyone wanting to try a BBQ pork place other than the popular Tui restaurant in Talat Phlu,
don't overlook this one! It's right next to Tui! 🤗

Although it might look a bit empty and quiet because everyone's going to Tui, it's hidden gems. They offer both shabu-shabu and BBQ pork, in sets priced by size or à la carte. The broth is naturally flavorful and the dipping sauces are delicious. We ate the 350 baht set for two, which included a large bottle of Pepsi. Ice is extra. The price is reasonable, and we were perfectly full.

I recommend giving it a try. The restaurant is spacious, comfortable, and not too crowded – it exceeded our expectations! 👍
I'm not exaggerating. I usually go to Tui, but I'm tired of the crowds and wanted a more comfortable place to try. The price wasn't much different.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyalux KS

sample_reviews_en.text: After not eating at this restaurant for over a year, I stopped by for the buffet, which included drinks and cost 388 baht per person because the restaurant participates in the government's co-payment scheme. The ingredients were good, but the selection was limited. The only dipping sauces available were seafood and shabu-shabu. Ordering required writing with a pen, which wasn't as convenient as scanning with a mobile phone. I ordered three plates of meat, but they served them together in one plate with only six slices. This happened twice after I ordered twice. It seems to be the restaurant's policy. I think for a buffet in the 400-500 baht range, there are many other restaurants that offer a more impressive experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Artit Bunjongjit

sample_reviews_en.text: The order took a very long time to arrive, and it was incomplete. I ordered several times, and the delivery was slow and incomplete. I had to keep following up, even though there weren't many customers. The delays were enormous! It seemed like they didn't care about their customers. Although the soup tasted good, I'm definitely not coming back again. 😡😡😡
sample_reviews_en.author: Aiko Bombell

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there many times, and the food has always been delicious. This time, while the food was still delicious, the service was terrible. The food took a very long time to arrive, and the staff this time were awful. Please improve this; you'll lose all your customers if you do.
sample_reviews_en.author: นันท์ฐิตา อาภัสรา

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious. A set meal cost 350 baht. Since we were tourists, we didn't know if it was worth it. I especially loved the marinated roast pork, and the soup was very flavorful and sweet. I particularly loved their sauce; it had a unique flavor with lemon and herb aromas.
sample_reviews_en.author: yifan wang

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauce is delicious. A set of pork barbecue is reasonably priced and enough for two people to eat until full. But if you eat a lot, there's an all-you-can-eat buffet option at an affordable price. Overall, the quality is good considering the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: ART QCM

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every time I go, I'm very impressed. The service is excellent, the ingredients are top-notch, and the dipping sauces are the best – unlike anywhere else. It's a buffet that's well worth the price.

P.S. We ate the 229 baht option.
sample_reviews_en.author: ๋Jinny Chanz

restaurants.name: ร้านข้าวขาหมู คูณสมหวัง 1
restaurants.address:

ร้าน ข้าว ขา หมู คูณ สมหวัง 1 หน้า ปั๊ม susco ติด อี ซู ซุ แสง หง ษ์, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This roadside braised pork leg rice stall is highly recommended if you prefer a sauce that isn't sweet.

The pork leg they sell includes only meat, skin, trotters, and braised eggs; no intestines.

The fresh chilies are beautifully presented, and the garlic is good too, but you have to peel it yourself. The stall uses Thai garlic, and the bird's eye chilies are very fragrant when chewed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bla bla

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavor was just right, and they gave a generous portion of rice and pork leg. I ordered the special with an egg for 55 baht. It came with plenty of garlic and chili. So filling! 😋😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirapatsorn Channel

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like that they have unlimited fresh chili and garlic.
The braised pork leg is tender and has a salty recipe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pond Kwang

sample_reviews_en.text: It's okay, but the taste is a bit strange, like they're being stingy with the ingredients and seasonings.
sample_reviews_en.author: chay yai

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, great taste. But for bottled water, I recommend buying it from the store at the gas station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Act.Capt.Pisan Suthadsanawichit

sample_reviews_en.text: New menu item: Pork leg noodles with extra egg, the broth is fragrant and the taste is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aui Cabonclub

sample_reviews_en.text: It tastes great, and at 40-50 baht per plate, one serving is enough to fill you up completely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasan Pimram

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, free water, parking available at the gas station next door (limited parking).
sample_reviews_en.author: ณฤทธิ์ สุริยภาณุมาศ

restaurants.name: Shell
restaurants.address:

Kw.Nongborn Kt, 67 Chaloem Phrakiat Ratchakan Thi 9 Soi 13, Khwaeng Nong Bon, Khet Prawet, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very impressed. I came for an oil change, and the staff member named Noi provided excellent service and explained everything in detail. She advised me on what needed replacing and what didn't, without pushing sales. Coming on a weekday, the service was quick. The place was clean, and they used protective covers to prevent damage to the car. They even let me take any leftover oil home. The waiting area was comfortably air-conditioned, and they offered me water. The car wash and vacuuming were very thorough, reaching every nook and cranny. There were several staff members, but they all worked very efficiently and systematically. This will definitely be my regular place of business.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phusanic B.

sample_reviews_en.text: The male cashier on the 9:00 AM shift was very unfriendly. He made faces at customers and spoke in a rude tone. I didn't know when I might get punched. I only went there once. I only went because my gas was running low this morning. Now I know I shouldn't go to this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atid Sutheeworapong

sample_reviews_en.text: Free tire inflation, and the gas station attendant even helped when I didn't know how to inflate my tires; he helped me, and my grandfather just stood there watching. How nice!
sample_reviews_en.author: สําเนียง พุทธชาติ

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were happy to provide service, helping to inflate tires and there was a convenience store, but the area inside the gas station was quite small.
sample_reviews_en.author: Max Go

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a gas station with good service from the staff. There's no need to wait in line at the pump; you can just pull in whichever pump is free.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปาทู น้ําจืด

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent; they changed the oil, washed the car, and even gave me a discount coupon.
sample_reviews_en.author: 袁蕙芳

sample_reviews_en.text: The restrooms were very clean, the staff provided good service, and the car wash was spotless.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panchii Jaruphumpattana

sample_reviews_en.text: I like going to the car wash; it's clean, the service is good, and the price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dujj Fyjj

restaurants.name: Baanying
restaurants.address:

PGGW+8Q9 One Bangkok Boulevard Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baan Ying One Bangkok (3rd Floor) is an absolute must-visit for any Thai food lover! We had delicious Pad Thai with chicken and aromatic tom yum soup – both dishes tasted exactly like those found in Thailand's best night markets. For dessert, we had the mango sticky rice, and it was simply perfect – fresh, creamy, and perfectly balanced.

A huge plus is the very affordable prices for a restaurant in a shopping mall, and the quality and authenticity of the flavors are truly impressive.

The service was incredibly friendly and attentive, and the owner and manager were absolutely wonderful – warm, engaging, and taking the highest level of care of their guests.

Definitely one of our favorite places in Bangkok – we will definitely be back on our next visit! 🍜🥭🇹🇭
sample_reviews_en.author: Bartosz Zielaj

sample_reviews_en.text:
I rarely write comments for restaurants, but how is a Thai restaurant in Bangkok even worse than all the Thai restaurants I’ve tried in Hong Kong. And I mean, even including those cheap ones. Most dishes are mediocre at best. Especially the fried morning glory, I never thought morning glory could taste that bad. The only decent dish must be the fried glass noodles and the raw shrimp.

I mean it’s a lovely place. The appearance of the dishes is amazing. The service is not bad, but the food and how it became a well-known restaurant chain are unfathomable 🤯
sample_reviews_en.author: Boris

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely awful!

First of all, the waitress was incredibly rude. I was genuinely shocked. She didn’t even say hello or goodbye, and her behaviour was appalling.

Second, the food was very mediocre. I ordered the Pad Thai, and it was one of the worst I’ve ever had.

Third, and most importantly, I got food poisoning after eating here. It wasn’t just a mild stomach ache - it was serious. I had to change my plans for the following day because I felt so unwell after eating here.

Avoid this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: M

sample_reviews_en.text: They added items to the bill that we hadn't ordered. We only noticed this after paying and checking the receipt. The manager said she had processed a refund, but the money never arrived. In the end, I paid twice for lunch; I do not recommend visiting this place. August 9, 2026.  В этом заведении работники обманывают посетителей на деньги. I will pass the information on to the police and the embassy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Мурзик Петрович

sample_reviews_en.text: I ended up coming here like three times over the course of 5 days because everything was so good and I kept wanting to try more things. The Tom Kha Gai was particularly memorable, but so was the spinach salad, the omelette rice, and the pad Thai. My only “complaint” is that the portion sizes are so generous that I couldn’t try more food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nishesh Sharma

sample_reviews_en.text:
One Bangkok… While shopping, I found this restaurant. The food was just average… It lacked the care and attention of street-side eateries.

The pork liver was very dry, the tom yum soup didn't have enough coconut milk, and the Northern Thai sausage was okay!

It felt like fast food! A bit disappointing 😞
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole Tse

sample_reviews_en.text:
My family and I stopped by this place during our trip to Bangkok last week. We came in by chance and the restaurant was very crowded, and the service was not very good.

The food was average, I would say not very tasty. The raw shrimp dish was not fresh, and the soup had a slightly bitter taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kim Tran

sample_reviews_en.text: I found Baan Ying Original Siam Kitchen a bit uneven overall. Some dishes were fine, but a couple of the portions and vegetables didn’t feel worth it, so I’d probably look elsewhere if I wanted a standout Thai meal. It wasn’t a terrible experience, just not memorable enough for me to rush back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Loera

restaurants.name: เอี่ยวไถ่สุกี้โบราณ
restaurants.address:

127, 2-3 ถนนสมเด็จพระปิ่นเกล้า Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: YUMMY!  I have not been to Thailand for ages and finally have to chance to visit my parent in Thailand.  The food here is excellent! I highly recommend the signature old school  sukiyaki and the crispy calamari with spicy garlic salt! My mom liking it so much she took the seasoning home! Server Inn (อิน) is knowledgeable and attentive! I am impressed! Will come back again :)
sample_reviews_th.author: TIENSIRIN

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for an authentic Teochew-style Chinese restaurant with traditional flavors, you shouldn't miss this place. Eiw Tai, the branch near Pinklao Bridge, has been open for over 50 years and maintains its excellent standard of deliciousness.
Chinese dishes I tried today:
Shark Fin Soup in Red Sauce: Served hot, the broth was thick and flavorful, with a fragrant Chinese herbal aroma and a refreshing taste that I really liked.
Hong Kong-style Noodles: The noodles were chewy and soft, stir-fried until dry and fragrant with a wok aroma. Generous amount of toppings.
Salt and Pepper Fried Sea Bass: The fish was fried until crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, stir-fried with dry chili and garlic. The flavor was spicy and savory, perfectly balanced.
Dessert: Mango Sago, delicious and refreshing.
Atmosphere: This branch has a traditional Chinese restaurant feel.
Service: The staff were quick and friendly, and very helpful with recommendations.
Price: The total was approximately 1400 baht. The price was reasonable considering the quality; the portions were large and the ingredients were good.
Parking: Street parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wannaporn Punudom

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just stopped by briefly and ordered the Hong Kong-style stir-fried noodles. It was a surprisingly delicious dish! The noodles were great, with a wonderful wok aroma and the caramelized sauce was perfectly done. The ingredients – shrimp and squid – were fresh and succulent. I want to try other dishes next time.

However, the service was disappointing. Even though it wasn't busy, they didn't refill my water, and they placed it far away, forcing me to get it myself. The staff didn't seem to notice at all. LOL.

In summary, the food was delicious, but the service was so-so and not really worth the price for a restaurant of this grade.
sample_reviews_en.author: Athikom Rawd-own

sample_reviews_en.text: I was unimpressed with the service from the staff taking our order. We informed them that our group wasn't complete yet and asked for some time to look at the menu and choose our food before taking our order. However, the staff insisted on ordering for us. My mother, feeling obligated, ordered their recommendation without checking the price. The result was steamed grouper with lemon sauce for 600 baht; the portion was small and very fishy. This is the first time I've encountered a Chinese restaurant that makes such a bad dish with fish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bo Wimalin

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, in a traditional Chinese restaurant style with round tables. The old-fashioned sukiyaki is also tasty. We ordered Peking duck with crispy skin, and the leftover meat was made into larb (spicy minced meat salad). There's a selection of drinks including beer and wine. The service is okay, but the restaurant is a bit small, and the tables are quite close together. There's a huge TV screen showing Thai national football team matches. Parking is available outside on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eakachin Techapongkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food! These are dishes we highly recommend and encourage you to try, if... you're open to our advice!
1. Genghis Khan Roast Pork and Genghis Khan Roast Beef: Customers can grill them themselves or have the restaurant grill them for you.
2. Peking Duck: Special offer now 650 THB + choose one additional duck dish.
3. Roasted Suckling Pig
4. Shrimp Rice Noodle Rolls
5. Pork Knuckle and Mantou (Steamed Buns)
6. Grouper Fish Soup with Taro
sample_reviews_en.author: Energy4Ever

sample_reviews_en.text: This roadside restaurant has street parking near the Pinklao Bridge. Slow down and tell the kids there, and they'll wave you to park right in front of the restaurant. The Peking duck is a must-try; I order it every time I come. The steamed grouper (or something similar) served with crispy noodles is also excellent. I've never been disappointed. The service is superb.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joy Trinya

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant had a promotion on river prawns, 350 baht each, or 4 for 990 baht. So I ordered one. When the bill came, it was over 900 baht (220 baht per 100 grams). When I asked the staff, they just said that I didn't inform them beforehand that I wanted the promotional item. I felt cheated and disappointed, especially since I'm a regular customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHEN Li

restaurants.name: 818 Mala Hot Pot (Sai ​​Phai Restaurant)
restaurants.address:

313, 49 Soi Chalermphrakiat35, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chang Wat Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: best kept secret in Pattaya… not too may all you can eat buffets, and this was exceptional for ฿258. …
sample_reviews_th.author: Zulu

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff was terrible. We didn't know that the tongs couldn't be dipped in the pot because it was our first time there. A staff member came to tell us with a nasty look on her face, so we apologized. However, a tall, large female staff member acted very rudely. She slammed things down in a show of displeasure and glared at customers as if she were looking for a fight. Please train your staff. The restaurant is also unclean and smells terrible. One visit is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: ประไพพร สีวันคํา

sample_reviews_en.text: After a night of eating, drinking, and traveling around Pattaya, I'm really hungry. This restaurant is the perfect place to stay until an early. The food is fresh and clean, and the prices are reasonable. There are many soups to choose from. It's warm and delicious, and it's a must-try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanderer Wherever

sample_reviews_en.text: If you sit down and face forward, you'll make eye contact with the customer across from you, so it's interesting that everyone just eats without talking. Those who know will understand the brutal atmosphere. There's no need to get too familiar. Just eat quickly and leave quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: yoomat6

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible! What's going on with the store's system? It said they opened at 10 AM, but when I arrived and asked the staff, they said 11 AM. I was so confused! Then they said the staff had just arrived and the items weren't prepared yet. That's it!
sample_reviews_en.author: กชกร

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious, but I'd like to see improvements in cleanliness. I know the price is cheap, but please pay attention to cleanliness. We saw that the tongs weren't washed. The customer got up and the staff came to clear the table, only …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawanrat Atpthong

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and good value for money. The pork is lean and looks great, which I personally like. The only downside is that the dipping sauce is a little too sweet. Cleanliness is average. The shop is small and parking is difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: real bear

sample_reviews_en.text: Since I discovered this restaurant, I hardly ever go to other places. I only come here because the prices are affordable and the service is great. If you haven't tried it yet, I highly recommend it. It's really delicious! 👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Nong Nong

restaurants.name: KFC The Bright Rama 2
restaurants.address:

15/9 Rama 2 Rd Kwang Thakham Khet Bangkhunthien, Tha Kham, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm not sure if the service here even wants to welcome customers. I came to eat around 4 AM. I understand it's almost dawn, and I don't know what the staff were thinking or if they were just being lazy, but the way they reacted—standing and staring, turning their back and shaking their head—was unacceptable. (The staff had just mopped the floor, and I stepped on what they had mopped.) I understand and apologize for stepping on the mopped area, as I wanted to sit at a table in the back. But is it normal for staff to react like that to a customer? This person acted displeased from the moment I started ordering. Does this mean customers can't eat at this time? It was just one person, not other staff members, because the others didn't behave like this. Also, I come every Tuesday, and each time the staff is usually wonderful, smiling and speaking very nicely. But today, I don't know if it was a shift change or not, but I was very disappointed. I usually love this restaurant, but today was unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: บัณฑิตา คงเจริญ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Even though I finished work almost at 11 PM,
KFC, which is open 24 hours, was still there to refuel before bed. No matter how late it was, the taste was still delicious and consistent.

At that time, there were about three tables of customers in the restaurant, and delivery riders kept coming to pick up orders. It seems Thai people eat late! 😋😋

The staff provided good service. The sign on the counter said there was a buy-one-get-one-free offer on mashed potatoes, but I ordered through the screen and it wasn't available. The staff helped me get the free item without any problem.

After ordering, I waited about 10 minutes and finally got to enjoy some hot, crispy fried chicken.

It was delicious! 👍🏼👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree Tripetpisai

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible experience. I came specifically to buy ice cream, but this branch doesn't have it. You can't get your parking ticket stamped unless you order something. Parking costs 40 baht from the first minute, and without a stamp, the security guard can't return the ticket. The staff couldn't stamp it either. When I asked which menu item was cheapest, the staff told me to check the menu board. In short, I was forced to buy something I didn't want just to get my parking ticket stamped, without any explanation from the staff. Never coming back to this store.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tangkwa Th

sample_reviews_en.text: I always order from them late at night, but there's one thing I don't understand: why do they give so little sauce? I once asked for extra sauce at the counter, and they refused and gave me a nasty look. Even when I ordered delivery and left a note asking for extra sauce, they still didn't give it to me. Is this the standard amount they should give? It's really too little. Sometimes I have to buy extra sauce from a convenience store. The chicken is delicious on its own, but you still need to dip it in sauce, right?
sample_reviews_en.author: ฑิฆัมพร ดอกกุหลาบ

sample_reviews_en.text: Just happened! My girlfriend ordered through Line Man for over 500 baht, but what she received was tough and cold chicken. I don't know how long the chicken can be kept in its oven at that branch, but judging from its condition, it looked like it had been sitting there for several hours. I'm not concerned about the amount paid, but I'm very disappointed. Next time, I will call your store manager directly. I really hope you will find a way to resolve this issue soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: นฤดล ลําพาย

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible. My order was incomplete; I ordered a large order of French fries but received only a regular-sized one. When I asked, the staff said they were the same. They also forgot my drink, which I had to get myself. Then I ordered Spicy Chicken Wings, and had to get those too.
It was awful. They really need to train their staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: bankiil sawa

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat at this branch often and order via Line Man frequently. I wish the staff or owner would see this review and make improvements. I bought 400-500 baht worth of chicken and they only gave me 3-4 packets of sauce. Is that even enough? I have to buy more sauce from 7-Eleven. The sauce is so little; it's only worth eating at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: SUJITRA PHUIWPNG

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered chicken from Robinhood. The chicken was dry, like it had been left out in the air for a long time. It was chewy and not crispy at all. I called customer service and they said it was fresh chicken, Colonel Sanders' recipe 😳😳😳
I asked the customer service representative if they normally eat dry, air-dried chicken.
sample_reviews_en.author: thira fasaengchan

restaurants.name: Khunying
restaurants.address:

55 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The seafood is beyond average with decent price, however it took the kitchen more than 40 minutes after ordering to bring the first raw dish for a table of 6 guests. It is lacking proper management. When asked why does the food took so long the staff blames the party for "walking in too many people at one time without reservation". The place is enough to hold 100+ guests but was complaining about having 40, which cost delivery to take longer than 40 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Linhsuan Chu

sample_reviews_en.text: There are two types of crab curry: one with just crab meat and another with the whole crab in its shell. The crab meat version was mild and delicious, not greasy, but the portion was small for the price of 600 baht, which was a little disappointing. The restaurant is spacious, but there aren't many tables inside, so it might be a bit tough if you're sitting outside on a hot day.
sample_reviews_en.author: ふでぐち

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a long-established Thai restaurant, but it seems to have a relatively Western-style flavor, so I think it's suitable for Japanese people as well. Compared to Thai restaurants that are well-known among Japanese people, it's reasonably priced, and you can eat decent Thai food. Their Poo Nim Pad Pong curry is especially delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Masahiko Ishikawa

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! (^o^) I want to go again next time! (^○^) There was also parking available. Some of the menu items were written in Japanese, so even if you don't speak Thai, you can just point and say "mai pen rai" (no problem) (^o^) Maybe it could have been a little spicier though! (^o^)v
sample_reviews_en.author: Toshiya IMAMURA

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, the prices are reasonable, there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, the spiciness is moderate, and it's quiet and not crowded, which is nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aon's Kitchen

sample_reviews_en.text: I was there in the afternoon, the foods were not the good. The stream carbs were no fresh. Some dishes were so cold, seem like not a fresh cook. :(
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyakarn Pojchamarnwiputh

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious.

The price isn't cheap compared to regular Thai restaurants.

Considering it's located in Thonglor, it's not bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tenny J

sample_reviews_en.text: The Food is good. The Service is ok. Atmosphere is ok. The Moo Krob is was good. Satay was good. Fish & Shrimp was just ok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Balvinder Grover (Bob)

restaurants.name: Best Azel Restaurant Pattaya
restaurants.address:

200 Pattaya Sai 2 Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chang Wat Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Friends, we are three people on vacation. Following the recommendation of the restaurant owner, Aydın abi, we had a fish dinner. We had eaten calamari and shrimp in many places around here and decided that they didn't taste the same, but Aydın abi set up a table that proved the skill lies in the cook. The price was also a third of what it would be in Turkey. Anyone who comes here should ask Aydın abi for a fish feast; there's absolutely no other taste like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: cenk kurga

sample_reviews_en.text:
Total disaster. Doener kebab is way too salty and thick meat with full of extra salty sauces. Packing is ultra amateurish that you can’t even hold the wrapped sandwich, they took the orders wrong and charged me wrong (more). Choosing different alternatives might be your best choice in Pattaya

Edit to his reply:!you might get good comments by your fellows but what is this rage against to negative ones. No need to be rude. Well that is your real face huh?
sample_reviews_en.author: yasuhiro nishioka

sample_reviews_en.text: I had an amazing experience at this Turkish restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious, bursting with authentic flavors that truly represent Turkish cuisine. The staff was incredibly welcoming, attentive, and made the whole dining experience even more enjoyable. The ambiance was cozy and perfect for a relaxed meal. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for excellent food and outstanding service!
sample_reviews_en.author: HAMZA AKBAR

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved this place, which offers the most exquisite Turkish flavors you can find in Thailand. As a very sensitive person, it was amazing, and I definitely recommend it. There's olives, cheese, breakfast cakes, and all kinds of food. Everything is authentically Turkish, with Turkish ingredients, and it's all a taste of our region.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rabia Tekman

sample_reviews_en.text: The Albanian liver you'll eat will make you question whether it's liver or Turkish delight. I had ice-cold ayran and Antalya piyaz with it. Everything was delicious. We'd like to thank Chef Aydın for his generous portions, reasonable prices, delicious products, and warm personality. I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Enes Uz

sample_reviews_en.text: As someone who has lived in Pattaya for a long time, I can say that you can eat the most delicious and high-quality food at TAKSİM TURKISH RESTAURANT with complete peace of mind. You'll be surprised when you see the prices. Take my word for it. Yanie Hanım and Chef Aydın's hospitality deserves thanks. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deniz Üsmali

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the grilled meatballs and Antalya piyaz here, and they were amazing! The meatballs were juicy and full of flavor, and the piyaz was so fresh and delicious. The staff was friendly, and the whole place had a nice, relaxed vibe. Definitely a spot I’d recommend to anyone who wants to try good Turkish food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beyzanur Kurt

sample_reviews_en.text: During my 15-day trip to Pattaya, this was the first time I'd ever felt truly full 🤣 The local food is good, but you sometimes miss your hometown cuisine. I found Taksim Cafe by chance, and the food is truly amazing. The staff are very friendly, especially Ms. Yanne, who is very kind. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hüsnü ünal

restaurants.name: ข้าวต้มพเนจร
restaurants.address:

QJHR+RGF ซอย แฮปปี้แลนด์ 1 แยก 3 Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This rice porridge shop has delicious pork satay!!

It's a small shop but every table is full. The shop has recommended menus..
Fried pork strips with garlic,
Sour curry with acacia leaves, eggs and shrimp (but I didn't order this one).

The fried pork was very good (80), slightly crispy on the outside, soft and not chewy on the inside. It's great with rice porridge!!
Stir-fried pork with preserved olives (80), standard rice porridge shop taste.
Squid with lime (100), spicy, but personally I felt indifferent, not that amazing.
Pork satay (60), this is the highlight. The marinated pork is soft and fragrant, the dipping sauce is perfectly balanced, and the pickled vegetables are fresh, crispy and delicious. Too bad there's no bread. If there was bread to dip in the peanut sauce, it would be amazing!!

In summary, I ate 3 bowls of rice porridge by myself this meal. I almost couldn't go home 😅

#WanderingRicePorridge #HappyLand
sample_reviews_en.author: w sittiwong

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordering food for delivery was a great experience, as the restaurant is only open in the evenings and it wasn't convenient to go there. However, I want to say the food is delicious and reasonably priced. The taste is perfect, and the portion sizes are well-matched. I often order from them regularly, especially their crispy pork belly with chili and salt. I'm always pleasantly surprised by the taste; the crispy pork belly, fried again, is incredibly crunchy and the aroma of the fresh chilies inside is delightful. I always order four portions at a time – unfortunately, I didn't take any pictures!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arch Chong

sample_reviews_en.text: We're regular customers; we eat here every day. Everything is delicious. The pork satay is amazing, and the fried pork belly is incredible. The dish we never get tired of and order every time, to the point that the chef (the woman at the counter) recognizes us, is... extra spicy seafood basil stir-fry without dark soy sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: อรัญญา ตามสมัย

sample_reviews_en.text: This rice porridge shop has moved locations so many times that it's earned the nickname "wandering rice porridge shop." It's been settled in this location for a very long time now. Their crispy pork stir-fried with curry paste is delicious, as are their fried pork slices, clear soup, and other tasty à la carte dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Praphon Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food arrived quickly after ordering, perfect for when you're really hungry! I love the crispy pork slices, they were just right. The Tom Yum soup was delicious. And the stir-fried vegetables were also delicious and crispy!
sample_reviews_en.author: aplusgood168

sample_reviews_en.text:
My go-to restaurant. The owner's cooking is consistently excellent.
Anything you order is delicious.
The atmosphere is like a roadside rice porridge stall,
but the food is like restaurant quality. 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Jarutpim SRIBOONRUANG

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was flavorful. I especially liked the chicken stir-fried with cashew nuts, the glass noodles stir-fried with egg, and the fried snakehead fish was perfectly crispy – I ate it all!
sample_reviews_en.author: anidnoi music

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes delicious and is reasonably priced. The food is prepared quickly, so you don't have to wait long.
sample_reviews_en.author: เอกอนันต์ พงษ์พิพัฒนากุล

restaurants.name: The Raw bar - Central Embassy (at The Open House 6th Flr)
restaurants.address:

Central Embassy 1031 Phloen Chit Rd, เเขวง ปทุมวัน Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was good, the oysters were fresh and had a nice, firm texture, but the price was quite high.

However, I'm deducting a star for the poor service.
The staff were unclear in their explanations. They suggested we look at the menu ourselves to see the prices and check them carefully.

They mentioned wine by the glass was 370 baht with a 50% discount.
In the end, they charged 460 baht without the discount because we didn't order 6 oysters.
But they didn't tell us beforehand that we needed to order 6 oysters.
They also calculated the food price incorrectly, and the staff didn't apologize at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varistha Phetcharakupt

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you come to Thailand, you must visit Bangkok, and if you come to Bangkok, you must try these dishes!

Raw oysters with truffles and cheese, plus a few drops of lemon—it's incredibly delicious!

Grilled snails are also exceptionally fragrant; even the bread served alongside them is tasty. You can tell how much you'll miss them!

The mussels are a bit small, but they're very clean; most of the weeds have been removed!

For those who enjoy a drink, there are also white wine, red wine, and sake options available!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rilala

sample_reviews_en.text: The food prices are quite high, and the service is not as good as it should be. Staff didn't come out to greet customers, and my order was missed twice before they claimed they forgot. The pasta portion was very small, and the oysters were more expensive than other restaurants but not very tasty. A waste of money. I wouldn't recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ananya Worarat

sample_reviews_en.text: My son and friend loves this place so much! Perfect taste! Although it is expensive, cost us 5,700 but its reasonable price the taste with great wine too.Depends to what you ordered.Highly recommended for Hi-so if you have to meet for Luncheon meeting /buss.orientation this is the best place. Located inside the mall of Emporium.
sample_reviews_en.author: julia lokatour

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a fantastic place to enjoy wine and oysters in a quick and easy way. You can enjoy oysters from various countries. They seem to have regular promotions, so I always check them out. The staff are friendly and unobtrusive. Because of its location, it might be difficult to relax and take your time. I love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: 鈴木麻美

sample_reviews_en.text: Located inside Open House, 6th floor Central Embassy, this restaurant offers choices of lobster, oyster, beef cooking in American or raw styles. Lobster bun is yummy but Raw Scallop with Yuzu sauce may not be recommended. With the high price, I think the restaurant should offer order services at table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a scam, not a place where you order food, i don't believe that they were advertising that they have lobster rolls, ohh man it cost 1766 bhat and the portion literally one small piece of lobster and the rest a salad, and French fries on the side, i left the restaurant hungry or hangry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Majed Alhammadi

sample_reviews_en.text: Fresh oysters, but pretty pricy. If you don’t mind spending $6 USD+ per oyster then it’s not a bad place at all, everyone I had was very fresh. Also tried to get caviar and they only had certain sizes, not the one I wanted . It was a week day mid day so don’t hold that against them .
sample_reviews_en.author: K J

restaurants.name: ราดหน้า ยอดผักเมืองทอง
restaurants.address:

MP59+H32, Racha Thewa, Bang Phli District, Samut Prakan 10540, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crispy noodles stir-fried with soy sauce were amazing! A little salty, but the wok aroma was fantastic. Definitely ordering again! 😋😋

P.S. The restaurant is open from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM every day. It opens very early!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lady Mafia

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been living on King Kaew Road for almost 20 years and just found out there's a restaurant with such delicious food. The first time I went, I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: อนุสรณ์ มานุช

sample_reviews_en.text: The Rad Na is very delicious. This restaurant has been open for over 30 years. Please stop by and try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpichai Ratchadanuwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious.
It has a wonderful wok aroma when stir-fried.
If you like the smell of a wok, this is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. RNKO

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my old village, I've lived here since I was born. I've eaten here all the time, it's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: เยาวลักษณ์ ภูขะมา

sample_reviews_en.text: If you want to eat delicious stir-fried vegetables and noodles with soft pork, you must come and try.
sample_reviews_en.author: iNote

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, consistently good. You have to try your luck; if there's parking available, grab a plate!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jira Panpremjit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stir-fried soy sauce with a fragrant wok-fried aroma.
Stir-fried dry and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: saharat saranwat

restaurants.name: เจ๊รักหมูตุ๋น
restaurants.address:

1064 51 Soi Choei Phuang, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Jae Rak's Braised Pork Noodle shop near TTB Bank has a delicious, well-balanced flavor that suits my taste. The pork meatballs, braised pork, and bouncy pork are all tasty. The noodle maker is very skilled and fast, which is fun to watch. The owner, Jae, is kind and friendly. It's busy with office workers during lunchtime, but the wait isn't too long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pim lada

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork noodle soup is delicious, with a slightly sweet and well-balanced flavor that's sure to please Thai palates. The pork slices, braised pork, and bouncy pork are all tasty. The chili powder is spicy. The owner, an elderly lady, is kind and friendly. During lunchtime, many office workers come to eat, so expect a wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worrawut Arunlumlert

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the queue management at lunchtime was poor. They asked us to move to another table in the sun without even asking if we wanted to move, even though our original table only seated two people anyway.
sample_reviews_en.author: PPTT

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner is very kind, and the noodles are delicious. I recommend asking for chili paste to try adding to your noodles; it's delicious even without any extra seasoning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chin Char.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is highly recommended! Everything is delicious, I especially recommend the stewed pork noodle soup, rice mixed with shrimp paste, and fried dumplings.
sample_reviews_en.author: nirun boonsamruay

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are delicious, the dumplings are amazing, and the dipping sauce is fantastic. The owner is friendly and fun to talk to. Great value for money!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sittiporn Inthuprapha

sample_reviews_en.text: Both the noodles and the rice mixed with shrimp paste are delicious. They also have crispy fried dumplings as a snack. The owner is very kind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornsak Techapitakkul

sample_reviews_en.text: When you come to this restaurant, you have to order the dumplings. They give you a generous portion; one bowl is enough to fill you up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawan Kantupat

restaurants.name: Little Dragon Restaurant
restaurants.address:

ใกล้ 1464 Charoen Krung 44 Alley, Khwaeng Bang Rak, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Service good and food is great ! Timsum is good

Only minus one for
1.Mapo tofu is not same as picture and tasty is not possible as normal
2.Bugute (บัคกุดเต๊) so sweet

Location near bts Sapan Taksin and no parking
sample_reviews_th.author: Nutthamon Chin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Back when I lived in U.S. I always eat shrimp toasts at my favorite Chinese take-out restaurant. It’s like one of my favorite comforting snacks.

Now living in Bangkok, I found this shop by chance and they serve pretty good shrimp toasts. I had to order like 3 plates which I finished it all by myself.

Other menu I got were decent: Noodles with fish and black beans sauce. Crispy squids with chili and salt. Price is reasonable for the quality of food you get.

Staffs are efficient, one of the guys looks like a manager also incredibly friendly with me. Made me feel like I’m eating at home with family.

Not much else to say but shrimp toasts is a must try 🤤 I will come back for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cafe S

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was good, and most of the staff were friendly & courteous, especially the uncle who wears a hat. The uncle even advised the customers. However, we have one concern. The young man with fussy hair who sits at the front of the shop seemed to be unapproachable. He should at least know "how to greet a customer" or "how to say thank you". He didn't even say thank you after we finished paying the bill as he was the one who proceeded our bill. Given the value of our bill, I believe this level of service is reasonable to expect. Please train him..

We hope this feedback is helpful for future training and service enhancements because your food is very nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lianna Wen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is average, but their billing practices are completely untrustworthy. They don't even provide an itemized receipt unless you explicitly ask for one.

They deliberately overcharged me by upgrading my order to a more expensive option on the bill without asking, charging significantly more than the menu prices.

To make matters worse, I noticed the table next to us was also overcharged for extra items they didn't order (they only got a refund because they caught it on the spot). This seems like a routine tactic to scam tourists who don't double-check their bill.

Make sure to demand an itemized receipt and check every single price before paying!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fan Kelly

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish was delicious. We started with ordering several dim sum, which you can see in the photo on the wall. They quickly arrived and were one better than the other.  We also had a salad of jellyfish ( large, crunching and very tasty), a fried morning glory (delicious and crunchy) and a pork noodle soup (filling and abundant). The staff was very attentive, kind and fast: great service, responsive with everything we asked.
We could communicate in English.
Honest and low prices. Excellent gem. Don't let you turn off by the guy trying to hack clients at the entrance: it is a genuine and quality Chinese restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monika Peruffo

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very friendly restaurant with amazing owner/ manager. We ordered 3 dim sum items, 1 vegetable dish, 1 egg noodle soup with wontons and the last (and recommended by the owner) their Hong Kong style fried noodles with chicken. All very delicious, pipping hot with the appropriate contianers and bags to vessel everything in. Got 3 vinegar pouches, 1 plum sauce for the fried prawn cakes, 2 generous containers of their delicious fragrant chilli oil.
The owner also gave me a complimentary iced chrysanthemum tea while waiting. All the workers were also very tentative and friendly. It was delicious and recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nita

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this shop while transferring near Sathorn Pier. The waiter spoke a little Chinese. The shop was clean, the air conditioning was comfortable, and they even had guzheng music playing. The dishes I ordered were all pretty good: Cantonese dim sum, pineapple fried rice, clear tom yum soup, and mango sticky rice. The mango sticky rice was served hot, freshly steamed, cleaner and fresher than what I'd had at the night market. The clear tom yum seafood soup was also delicious. When I arrived it was past 4 pm, and they were already sold out of chicken feet, so if you want them, come earlier.
sample_reviews_en.author: mengying gou

sample_reviews_en.text: The dim sum was absolutely delicious! The flavors were rich, and it was perfectly steamed – not too mushy, not too hard. The ones with broth were especially tasty. The Hong Kong-style stir-fried noodles were amazing – dry-fried, fragrant with a wok aroma, and a generous portion; enough for two people. The Szechuan tofu was a little too sweet. The prices were good, and the staff were lovely and provided excellent service. Next time I'll try the fish maw soup and ginger-flavored glutinous rice balls!
sample_reviews_en.author: J S

restaurants.address:

10320, 1 ซอยสุโข, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "The food here is good quality, decent portions & reasonable priced 👍👍💯"

restaurants.name: ลิ้นติดนัว | ส้มตำ อาหารอีสาน | สุขุมวิท 101/1
restaurants.address:

417 67 Wachiratham Sathit 29 Alley, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The open-air area with fans... No one speaks English or Chinese. The pork neck was quite good because it had some fat. The basil pork rice had a generous amount of pork. I specifically asked for it not to be too salty after reading reviews. The taste was okay; not bad, but nothing particularly amazing. The steak was cheap, supposedly from Australia, but it tasted like it had been frozen for a long time. I asked the server to try a piece, but he thought it was fine. Okay, then it was my fault. There was a tough tendon in the middle that I couldn't chew.

Mushroom soup is hard to make bad in Thailand, so it was alright. This soup was still quite tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Huang Keiko

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Thap Kaew Camp" has a great atmosphere and is perfect for relaxing in the evening. The food is delicious, the prices are reasonable, and the service is friendly.

Recommended dishes include their various types of Som Tum (papaya salad), including Thai style, crab style, and mixed style, all with authentic, spicy and flavorful Isaan flavors. Their Moo Jum (pork hot pot) is also excellent; the broth is fragrant, sweet, and well-balanced, the pork is tender, and the dipping sauce is perfectly matched.

It's ideal for a meal with friends or family, or simply for chilling out and listening to soft music. Definitely worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนพงศ จันทร์แรม

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was served very slowly. Some items were already cold when they arrived. They served ice even though I didn't order it (and charged for it).

There was someone smoking at a table while I was there.

The grilled pork neck was quite dry.

The grilled chicken was okay, dry on the outside and juicy on the inside.

The steamed squid with lime was very bland; even other restaurants' tom yum soup is sourer.

The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce was extremely salty.

The staff were quite attentive, but there are areas for improvement. Every time I looked over, they were either looking down or elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marilyn Blue

sample_reviews_en.text: The food prices are amazing! Not expensive at all. Today I ordered papaya salad with thin rice noodles and papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce – both were incredibly flavorful! I loved the spicy, intense taste; I couldn't stop eating! The spicy pork rib soup was so tender and soft, it practically melted in your mouth. The waterfall pork was also delicious and the meat was tender. I highly recommend this place to anyone passing by. P.S. This is my own review, no sponsorship. It was genuinely delicious, that's why I wanted to recommend it 😊😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutima Poonsombat

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the medium-sized beef set for 299 baht. The restaurant uses high-quality Wagyu beef; the meat was delicious, not tough, and thinly sliced ​​into bite-sized pieces. The portion was perfect for two people. The soup and dipping sauces were delicious and refillable. The service was good and attentive. Other dishes were also delicious; the fried rice was amazing, and the spicy pork neck salad was fantastic. They also accept the government's co-payment scheme. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Teeradej L

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food is delicious and affordable. The meat portions are generous and not chewy. The papaya salad is incredibly tasty and perfectly suits my palate. I've eaten here many times. The hot pot is also delicious, but I didn't try it today. They have a promotion on cold beer. The staff are lovely and provide excellent service. They even remembered me after a long time and kept refilling my water. If you're in the area, you should definitely stop by!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichaya Jompang

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere, perfect for chatting with friends. They play a mix of Thai and international music, making it easy to listen to. The food uses high-quality ingredients, with large prawns and squid. Their signature dish is the flavorful pork hot pot with its aromatic broth. Currently, they have a beer promotion for 299 baht, sure to please beer lovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: อรรค อมะโร

sample_reviews_en.text: I found a restaurant that I thought would be expensive, but the prices were amazing! Papaya salad was only 69 baht. The place is spacious and airy. The grilled pork neck (picayaya) with dipping sauce was incredibly delicious, only 199 baht – we ordered two plates! Parking was very convenient. They even provided french fries for the kids.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bella G2528

restaurants.name: Honey Pizza Pattaya
restaurants.address:

Chor Buakhao 502/64, Pattaya City, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: After reading all the good reviews on this place i came and visited a couple days ago. I can totally agree, this place does amazing pizza. I think, for me, this is by far the best pizza you will find in Pattaya, by a long shot. I had the four cheese pizza and it was amazing, the outer crust so light and lovely, the whole thing. Even the fries were on point. The owner is also a very nice genuine guy, as others have mentioned, he came over and spoke with me and i found this for myself. If its pizza your after this is definitely the place to go. You leave this place feeling happy and content, thats what real authentic food does for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ray Brown

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for authentic pizza in Pattaya, Honey Pizza is a must-visit. The pizza has a perfectly crisp crust, quality fresh ingredients, and rich, flavorful sauce that tastes like true Italian-style pizza. Every bite is cooked to perfection, and you can tell they take pride in what they serve.

The service is friendly and welcoming, and the atmosphere makes it a great place to enjoy a meal. After trying many pizza places in Pattaya, Honey Pizza stands out as one of the best. Highly recommended for anyone craving genuine, delicious pizza. I’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Terry Hicks

sample_reviews_en.text: The best pizza in Pattaya. And by an Italian chef, no less. Crispy and delicious pizza. High-quality garlic bread. Warm welcome. Open for a few months now, we wish them a long life. The restaurant is just behind the Tree Town food court. If you don't see it, don't worry, a small sign on the street will point you in the right direction; just follow a short corridor that runs alongside Tree Town.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fayçal BENYAHIA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly a hidden gem, authentic Neapolitan style pizza with a light airy crust that doesn’t leave you feeling bloated afterwards.
The chef who I presumed was the boss too is from Italy himself. You are defiantly getting a taste of Italy in every bite!
I am definitely going back to try other items from the menu today!
Thank you for the experience and great food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naren Jadeja

sample_reviews_en.text: Good morning, I went last night to eat pizza at HONEY PIZZA and I have to say that I really liked it, he is a Roman pizza chef, small but quiet environment, already from the photos you can see that it is a pizza different from the others, I ate a good vegetable pizza, too bad I found out afterwards that he makes the sausage😋, next time I will definitely try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Carlo Volpati

sample_reviews_en.text:
A really great pizza! The crust is crispy and not dry. The toppings on my pizza were just right. Not swimming in them like on some others I've had. The price is really justified, especially for Pattaya. You can get a pepperoni pizza of this quality for under 300 THB in Italy, and maybe at a good Italian restaurant in town.

Thanks, simply a really great pizza!
sample_reviews_en.author: Big Rauschebaer

sample_reviews_en.text: Pls note the opening hours is from 5pm, not 2 pm. When we were there at 4 pm, it's still not open. Since we really wanna tried the pizza before we left Pattaya, we waited for the owner to return. Turns out the pizza are so good and delicious. The crust are crispy. It really worth our time to wait. Highly recommend for people who wants pizza in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rosana Kwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the best pizza in Pattaya and surrounding areas.

Proper Italian thin crust pizza with excellent ingredients cooked to perfection.   Even better the prices are very reasonable for such quality.

It’s like being in Naples!

If you like processed junk garbage from the usual chains then this place is not for you..
sample_reviews_en.author: P.O.

restaurants.name: So Niku Yakiniku
restaurants.address:

1/8 Sukhumvit 49, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I’ve been eating at this place for a while every weekend I’ll stop by their น้ำตกต้มยำ is amazing no seasoning needed, quality of the meat is great and the price is soo great considering the shop being in Sukhumvit Thonglor area, ohh come try the Thai milk tea it’s good for only 25 THB love
sample_reviews_th.author: Janet Samcea

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a very unpleasant experience at the restaurant today.
I arrived at noon, one of the first tables occupied, but the food was incredibly slow. I only received one dish by 12:49 PM and had to cancel the rest of my order because it was taking so long. It turned out the staff served other tables that arrived later than me, 2-3 tables in total. The staff seemed confused today and the service wasn't as good as usual. Please improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jutharath V

sample_reviews_en.text: Ah, it feels like Jjim Jjim. It’s like Korean Shabu-shabu or Japanese Nabe—it’s incredibly delicious. It’s a soup dish. It was nice and hot, and although there was no air conditioning, the fan and the weather were good, so it wasn't hot at all. I don't usually write reviews, but I’m posting this in case the place goes out of business. Definitely a great restaurant. Just like Shabu-shabu, you can add more as you eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: 매뇽

sample_reviews_en.text:
The queue management was really disappointing, definitely needs improvement.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered delivery and the rider messaged me saying the staff weren't paying attention to delivery customers, only serving the in-store orders. I understand that the in-store orders should be prioritized, but I asked the rider if the in-store was busy, and he said no, it just seemed like the staff weren't paying attention to me. I can wait, no problem, since I'm just staying home waiting for the food delivery. But I feel sorry for the rider who had to stand there for so long. sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were too busy chatting and playing around, which made preparing orders extremely slow. Reasonable price with Exceptional quality

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, I'm taking you to the special Sunday Social lunch buffet at Avani Ratchada Bangkok Hotel. Food lovers absolutely can't miss this!

The international food selection is incredibly extensive. Premium seafood is abundant, including Alaskan crab, oysters, grilled river prawns, and other grilled seafood. The meat selection is also impressive, featuring ribeye steak, Australian sirloin, Peking duck, roasted duck, and crispy pork.

There's also sushi, sashimi, pasta, and Wagyu beef noodles – all available at your leisure. Desserts and drinks are also plentiful. Everything you need is in one place.

The price is incredibly good value at only 1,099 THB net per person, including unlimited soft drinks. For a more relaxed experience, I recommend adding the Your Gin Vibe free-flow gin cocktail for 500 THB net per person. Enjoy a drink while listening to soft live music; the atmosphere is perfect for a Sunday.

If you're looking for a relaxing lunch buffet, this is it! Good quality food, easy to get to. Sunday Social here is another great option to try.

📆: Every Sunday
⏰: 11:30 AM – 3:00 PM
📌: One Ratchada Restaurant
🚝: MRT Phra Ram 9, Exit 1
sample_reviews_en.author: tiewtookduan

sample_reviews_en.text: Since we were staying at a hotel upstairs, we thought we'd try this place for dinner, but it was far from what we expected. The grilled seafood on the counter (grilled Thai shrimp, squid, and shellfish) was cold, so we asked the chef to grill some raw seafood from the counter. However, I personally saw the chef put the entire plate of raw seafood back on the counter and then go to get the grilled seafood that had been sitting there for who knows how long. He even cleverly waited several tens of minutes before bringing it back, unaware that I had witnessed it all. Furthermore, the sashimi, smoked salmon, fruit, cake, grilled fish, and many other items were all gone, but no one replenished them. It wasn't until a group of guests complained to the manager that the chef started replenishing them, indicating that they hadn't bothered to replenish them unless someone complained. We also complained to the manager when we paid the bill, but the staff all looked very annoyed, as if we were causing trouble. A very disappointing meal!

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were here 5 years ago and have been bragging about this place since. We recently found out that it closed for a while but reopened (Like most places due to covid we thought).
The whole place has changed and the typical "Thai thalat" is gone. Everything is Americanised and a lot is boutique style. We were attacked all the time by people with big signs that they shoved in our faces, even tugging our sleeves to drag us in to eat. Much like the pingpong shows in Patong.
This place used to be crazy in typical Thai style with anything and everything for sale but most of all, an array of Thai food that I have not seen anywhere else in this country.
We left, very disappointed. Certainly not worth it anymore.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This all-you-can-eat seafood buffet offers up to 4 hours of unlimited food. The highlight you can't miss is the plump, fresh, and sweet Korean oysters.

The seafood on ice section is fully stocked with shrimp, mantis shrimp, and other fresh seafood. For grilling enthusiasts, the grilled river prawns are a must-try – succulent, sweet, and with creamy heads, perfectly paired with the spicy seafood dipping sauce.

Meat lovers can enjoy Australian sirloin steak, grilled to perfection with a tender, juicy texture. Or indulge in the sashimi and sushi section with fresh fish, complemented by a wide selection of international hot dishes.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The phone service was honestly shocking!
I called to politely confirm whether the place is pet friendly and whether dogs are allowed in the airconditioned area. The staff simply replied, “No,” and hung up almost immediately. Since Google Maps clearly states that this place is pet friendly, I assumed perhaps I had called the wrong number.
So I called again and asked the exact same question, this time mentioning that your Google Maps information says the place is pet friendly. The response I received was, “Oh, I’m alone right now,” followed by another rushed hang up.
I’m genuinely confused as to what being alone has to do with answering a simple customer inquiry professionally. More importantly, why is there such a rush to cut off customers on the phone?
If this is how basic customer communication is handled, perhaps the restaurant should reconsider who is representing the business over the phone!

sample_reviews_en.text:
This resort and cafe is hidden among a throng of Korean restaurants. The food selection is extensive, and the drinks here are all excellent (from what I've tried), especially the Thai-style smoothies. There's a guava in plum sauce, a pineapple with chili and salt, and a mango with sweet fish sauce. All are delicious, with a perfect balance of flavors and richness. The blenders are well-made, with a smooth, fine texture and no ice particles to irritate you.

The venue has both indoor and outdoor seating, and you can even bring your small pets.

They're currently running a promotion: Like and share and get a free drink! It's a great deal!

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bang Pho Steakhouse is an affordable steak restaurant that has been a fixture at Bang Pho intersection for over 20 years. It continues to be popular with both locals and tourists thanks to its delicious taste that exceeds its price and its friendly, street food-style atmosphere. There are tables set up on the sidewalk outside, with minimal props. Prices start at just 50-60 baht per dish. The marinated meat is moderately salty, so no additional seasoning is needed. Be patient when ordering, as the owners only work as a team of two.

As you can see in the picture, this is a 79 baht steak with an added fried egg for 10 baht, totaling less than 100 baht for a filling steak meal. We think that's a great deal!
sample_reviews_en.author: JJYY - BKK Street Food Lover

sample_reviews_en.text:
Average Food, Average Service, and Uncleaned Restaurant

When I first passed by Bangpo Steak, I couldn't help but wonder what kind of steak they offered, especially considering the reasonable prices.

So I decided to give it a try and ordered the Pork steak. To my surprise, it only took about 15 minutes to prepare. I mean, for Thai food, that seemed quite fast. lol

The Pork steak turned out to be thinly sliced and small in size. It felt more like pan-seared pork with a gravy sauce rather than a proper steak. The salad dressing tasted like sweet mayo.

Overall, the food was just average. However, I must emphasize that the restaurant cleanliness needs immediate improvement.

The surrounding atmosphere is acceptable.

sample_reviews_en.text: Exploding in Thailand! What's the deal with Ebisu, the ultra-affordable ramen chain with a price tag of 98 baht? This Thai-run, Japanese-style ramen stall chain has expanded to over 60 locations in just three years. Its bold locations, such as in front of the Czech Club in Ekkamai, and exceptional local prices starting at 98 baht per bowl have captured the hearts of Thais. The appeal: The fresh, homemade noodles delivered daily are chewy and high-quality. Side dishes start at 48 baht, making it incredibly easy on the wallet. The honest truth: The soup is light and not very flavorful, setting it apart from the "authentic" ramen sought after by Japanese people. While it's perfect for those who want a cheap, easy ramen experience, the delicious noodles warrant further development in the soup. This is truly a prime example of Thai comfort food.
sample_reviews_en.author: アムロ礼

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd been curious about this place for a while, so I decided to give it a try.

I arrived around 12:15pm.

Outdoor seating only.

No other customers.

I sat down after paying the bill.

I ordered the specialty? Hakata ramen.

98 baht.

The bowl arrived in about 3 minutes.

It looked good.

The soup was thin...

It lacked punch.

The noodles were thin.

The toppings were
wood ear mushrooms, roasted pork, and half a boiled egg.

The wood ear mushrooms... tasted like rubber.

As expected...the soup wasn't very tasty...

I guess it can't be helped at this price?

Thanks for the meal.

sample_reviews_en.text:

It's light and refreshing, perfect after drinking.
The menu didn't indicate whether they offered large portions or extra noodles.

However, if you're looking for the strong, distinctive flavor of Japanese tonkotsu ramen, you should go to a different restaurant.

sample_reviews_th.text: This is a made-to-order restaurant with about 10 menu items.
