sample_reviews_en.text: When I think of dishes using egg noodles, I remember "I am one of those who love to eat, to eat delicious, nutritious, and beneficial food." From the Kook Wua intersection, Mokkh was the beginning of a simple, sufficient, and unpretentious culinary experience, full of memories. It remains true to Thai culture, always welcoming with a smile, just like family visiting, for decades. "🥇Koy See Mee🥇🥇Crab Curry🥇Tom Yum Goong🥇Stir-fried Noodles🥇Spaghetti with Minced Pork" In Thailand, only Mokkh can deliver Koy See Mee, maintaining the unique character of Thai cuisine that, at first glance, seems common, but in reality, there are steps that show the care put into it, from sourcing the ingredients, selecting them, preparing them, to the final dish. The spirit of the Thai family institution is perfectly conveyed through the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนเกียรติ International

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate there for the first time on January 10th, 1968. I don't want to write a long review; just look at the pictures to thank the restaurant. There are few good restaurants left in Thai communities like this, where nowadays the focus is on branding and content, forgetting that delicious food comes from good ingredients and dedication in cooking. I ordered crab fried rice (60 baht) and shrimp noodles (60 baht). My definition of this restaurant is:

A restaurant that cooks like family, "with dedication" and using the best ingredients they can find.

I will definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: WITTAYA LAORIENDEE

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant, located in a shophouse in the Bang Pho area, offers a casual atmosphere but surprisingly delicious food.

The crab fried rice and tender pork fried rice are perfectly seasoned and cooked to perfection, with a wonderful wok aroma. The pork is tender, and the amount of crab meat is just right for the price.
The garlic pork is also excellent, tasting like it's from a high-end restaurant.

The prices are in the tens of baht, but the taste is worth hundreds!

Online ordering is available through platforms like Robinhood.

Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Khitja Boonsri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant focuses on single-dish meals.
The wok-fried rice with shrimp is fragrant and delicious.
The ingredients are fresh; the shrimp are fresh, not frozen, and have a sweet, crispy, and bouncy texture.
The clear tom yum soup with shrimp is flavorful and refreshing.
The portions are generous, exceeding the price. The price is very good.

The restaurant is located on the main road; look carefully for the sign. I drove past it many times! 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Patchara Ployy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, affordable, clean, and high-quality. I've known this restaurant for a long time and eat here regularly. I'm always happy. I hope there are more good restaurants like this. I hope it stays open for a long time!

P.S. I miss the cashew chicken stir-fry so, so much! No other restaurant makes it as delicious as this one. Even upscale restaurants can't compare. I miss it so much! I really want this menu item back, please!!! 🥹🥹🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: R R

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a traditional shophouse-style restaurant. From the outside, it looks ordinary, but inside it's very clean. There's no air conditioning, but it's not hot. The food is presented and tastes like it's from a fine restaurant. Parking is available in front of the shop. The prices are affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: panist nakrumpai

sample_reviews_en.text: First off, I was impressed by the owner. They greeted me with a smile. The food tasted good, the prices were reasonable, and the place was clean. (Even though the GPS gave me the wrong directions, directing me into an alley, I still managed to get there.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawinee Siripoolsaring

restaurants.name: RYU - สุขสวัสดิ์78
restaurants.address:

2, บางจาก 61 Suksawat 78, Tambon Bang Chak, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently ate there, around 7-8 PM on a Sunday. Several dishes weren't available (the staff mentioned that set meals require advance reservations). The Thai food was delicious and came out quickly.

However, the spaghetti carbonara was bland and had a very strong cheese smell (it felt like they used blue cheese). It was so bland I couldn't eat it. After informing the staff, they quickly offered the option of not accepting it and removed it from the bill. My family ordered the seafood stir-fry instead, which was very good.

P.S. I'm a little disappointed I didn't get to eat the bingsu because it wasn't available. 🥲
sample_reviews_en.author: janorn tangwan

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant you could eat at every day, every meal, without getting bored because there's such a huge variety of delicious dishes. Every dish tastes amazing, and the service is great. It's recommended to reserve a table or order food in advance via LINE. Western dishes take a little longer to prepare, while Thai and Northeastern Thai food is served quickly – spicy and flavorful with generous portions of ingredients. It's a place the whole family can enjoy, with Thai, Western, and Northeastern Thai food, as well as desserts, smoothies, and bingsu.
sample_reviews_en.author: toon Chanatip

sample_reviews_en.text: I just ate there today. When I entered the restaurant, there was a large table with many people talking very loudly and letting 3-4 children run around. We had to move from the air-conditioned room to sit outside because the noise was unbearable. The staff didn't say anything or react, even though we were already dissatisfied. As for the food, I ordered the minced pork basil stir-fry, and it wasn't good at all; it was too sweet. It used to be much better when I ate there regularly.
sample_reviews_en.author: sofia drive

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, flavorful, and reasonably priced. There's a wide variety of dishes, including main courses, à la carte options, single-serving meals, steaks, som tum (papaya salad), drinks, and desserts – everything you need in one place. It's air-conditioned, though perhaps a little too cold! They accept cash and bank transfers. There's parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: phat Ounchalanon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been there three or four times, but the last time the food was quite bad. The glass noodle salad and stir-fried vegetables were delicious.
But the fried rice was soggy and salty, the minced pork salad was extremely sour, and the papaya salad was diluted. I was quite disappointed and regretted going there. Maybe they changed chefs. 😂😂😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Watchara Ladda

sample_reviews_en.text: The basil chicken dish was delicious and suited my taste. The food came out quickly, and there was a wide variety of dishes to choose from. The prices were slightly higher than typical street food stalls, but there was parking and air conditioning, making it comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supharada Saeteiw

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the air conditioning is cool, and the prices are very good. The noodles and papaya salad are especially tasty. They also have desserts, tea, coffee, and fruit smoothies. The staff are friendly and attentive. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: joob joob

sample_reviews_en.text: Under 4 bucks for a Cashew Chicken, rice and drink.  Food was very good. Veggies super fresh and amazing sauce.  Very clean lace. Restroom was even spotless.  I highly recommend. Want to see the video.  Check out Greeny Travels on U Tube
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian Greeny

restaurants.name: อมลวรรณแหนมเนือง
restaurants.address:

VG7P+V89, ซ. งามวงศ์วาน 23, Tambon Bang Khen, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This old Vietnamese restaurant in the Wat Buakhwan alley area is clean, the food tastes good, and the prices are reasonable. My favorite is the Banh Cuon (Vietnamese steamed rice rolls); the dough is perfectly soft and there's plenty of filling. Another dish I often order is the Vermicelli Salad, which consists of vermicelli noodles, fresh vegetables, topped with Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork skewers), pork skin, and crushed peanuts, all mixed with a sweet and sour dressing. Although the dressing is a little sweet, it's a good combination. The dipping sauces and salad dressings at this restaurant tend to be quite sweet, so if you don't like sweet food, I recommend using only a little at first.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vimlet Kir

sample_reviews_en.text: A small Vietnamese restaurant near Wat Buakhwan. They serve typical Vietnamese food with decent taste and a clean environment. The fried spring rolls are delicious, and they also have very good papaya salad. The prices are reasonable, and the owner is warm and lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isra Weeraratna

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Amolwan Naem Nueang" is located in the middle of the soi (alley), in a commercial building. The prices are reasonable.

- Naem Nueang: Good taste, can eat continuously.
- Pak Mo Yuan (Vietnamese steamed rice rolls):
- Kuay Jap Yuan (Vietnamese noodle soup):
sample_reviews_en.author: V Vara

sample_reviews_en.text: This Vietnamese restaurant is delicious, clean, and reasonably priced. Personally, I think it's even better than the one near the orange grove. I especially like the Nem Nuong (grilled pork skewers) and Banh Xeo (Vietnamese savory crepe).
sample_reviews_en.author: Patchanee Treedet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Vietnamese savory crepe (Banh Xeo) 60 baht, crispy and fragrant.
Small set of Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork skewers) 100 baht.
Delicious and worth the price.
Parking available for 2 cars in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: P Mountain

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious, I've eaten there many times. But the vendor seems grumpy and not very welcoming. Other than that, everything is good. Go try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongsak Duanduan

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoy Vietnamese food with peace of mind. The vegetables are clean, the food is delicious, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suppharoek R.

sample_reviews_en.text: Some things are cheap, some are expensive. The taste is average, not exceptional, but not amazing either. It's edible.
sample_reviews_en.author: หมีอ้วน

restaurants.name: อาโก ก๋วยเตี๋ยวชาบูต้มยำ สาขาเลียบคลองทวีวัฒนา
restaurants.address:

58 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Sala Thammasop, Thawi Watthana, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: My go-to order is Tom Yum noodle soup with soft-boiled egg. Once I found this shop's Tom Yum, I stopped ordering from anywhere else. Every time I'm at Thonburi Market, I only order from here. The broth is rich and flavorful, not too spicy, and perfectly balanced with lime. It's delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: AAS Family Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. The staff were rude to customers and looked like they didn't want to sell anything. It made me not want to shop there at all. I was very unimpressed. Please improve your service.
sample_reviews_en.author: nuns b

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum soup was incredibly flavorful and delicious. The noodles were perfectly cooked. The meatballs were average. I highly recommend the Tom Yum soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nora Tap

sample_reviews_en.text: The broth is fragrant, and the fermented tofu used to make the red sauce is perfectly aromatic. This flavor is hard to find these days.
sample_reviews_en.author: BUZZ IT

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum soup was delicious, with plenty of ingredients, and the meatballs were good.
sample_reviews_en.author: S M

restaurants.name: หน่อยเล้ง เพรา ดาว ด้ง
restaurants.address:

88 M.8 Phetchahueng52, Bang Kobua, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is like having a meal in your own garden.
Shady, good air, fresh and clean food, and reasonable prices. Located on Soi Phetchahung 52, Bang Yo Subdistrict, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan Province.

Near Bang Nam Phueng Floating Market.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sun Smile เอ๋

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is flavorful, especially the spicy pork rib soup (Leng Saap), which has plenty of meat on the bone and a wonderfully spicy broth. The place is spacious, with pavilions for seating and a pomelo orchard to admire. The owner is very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sor Somboon

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located on private land. The menu is in Thai, but you can read it with Google Translate. You can get there by renting a bicycle from the pier. Recommended for those who want to take their time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trueman Oaktale Reficul

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by by chance while passing through, and the food is delicious and affordable. The owner is friendly. They also provide ice water, but if they happen to forget, try saying "Nam-kang (ice)."
sample_reviews_en.author: 소소

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a lovely atmosphere, with bamboo gazebos, like a home garden. The service is good, the food is delicious, and it's not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: pronong BSD

sample_reviews_en.text: Crispy pork basil stir-fry with shrimp and a fried egg is the best. The crispy pork is truly crispy and comes in chunks. The shrimp are whole.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasama Benjaminn

sample_reviews_en.text: We just found this place by chance today and we were surprised how good the quality was. Very tasty and inexpensive. On top very nice staff!
sample_reviews_en.author: A. B.

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is currently closed because a family member is ill. It's a nice place to sit, with private booths. The food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: จุฑามาศ บุญสมัย

restaurants.name: Madcow Burger by Toni Santos Asok
restaurants.address:

39 1 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The bun is black and looks cool. It has a faint, nice smell.

I appreciate the "Guts" written on the wrapping paper, but the patty has almost no meaty flavor, and for a burger in this price range, it's completely unremarkable (like the old Burger King!?).

The staff aren't exactly skilled at customer service either, so I think it's only worthwhile if you're craving a burger in the area.

This is my second visit; last time I ordered the Asok Burger, and I had a similar impression, so I bought this one without much expectation. Well, it was just as I expected.

I like their spirits written on their paperbag, but their burger is just okay. The bun is charcoal color and looks great, while the beef patty is not as good as expected, considering the price.
The clerk is okay, no smiles, just gave me the burger.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack and the Beans T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The main menu item at this restaurant is the regular Mad Cow Burger, priced at 280 baht.
But I tried the Double Beef Burger, which has two patties, for an additional 100 baht, bringing the price to 380 baht.
Overall, the taste was okay, but not amazing. Considering the price, it's quite high, but understandable given the restaurant's location.
I also ordered hash browns.
90 baht for 4 large pieces.
That's considered reasonable for the price, around 22 baht per piece. The taste was very plain.
The restaurant doesn't have its own parking. I recommend parking at the plaza across the street. Parking costs 35 baht per hour, but you can get a free hour of parking free if you spend 100 baht or more at MaxValu, or at the restaurants in the plaza.
sample_reviews_en.author: 15monDe

sample_reviews_en.text: I got it to go, and I can't believe they've been in business for years and don't know how to cook a single patty properly. My kid was eating and checked the patty inside, freaking out... I'd already eaten half, but mine seemed undercooked too... It's not like it's steak; common sense dictates that ground meat should be cooked thoroughly. Do they even know that before running a business????? They charged me 280 baht for a burger, and wow, they even told me to throw away the bun if it gets old... It was so dry and tough. Ugh, I'm so annoyed and pissed off...
sample_reviews_en.author: JJ

sample_reviews_en.text: Good burger joint on the side of the road. Gourmet burgers with a traffic jam atmosphere. Great food, not exactly cheap but unique (Asok Burger, spicy). Very friendly service. Drawback: no beer. You have to get that from the 7-Eleven next door if you want it. I stuck with C-Zero. The next day I had diarrhea (7 hours after eating with extra mayonnaise). Conclusion: tasty, but beware of hygiene issues.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jochen G

sample_reviews_en.text:
The burger is decent, with plenty of cheese. The patty is thick, the lettuce is tasty, and the bun is soft and good. But you don't necessarily need onion rings. Just order the burger.
It's a bit pricey, and there's not much seating inside. And while there's air conditioning, it's open, so it's quite hot.
It might be worth a visit if you're nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김완태

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was okay.   I don’t think it’s the best burger in town.   But service is good.    I prefer another burger joint which serves a smash burgers near here.

I had the mad cow and the chicken burger.      The chicken burger is little spicy, but it doesn’t say so in the menu.  I think I like the chicken more than the beef burger.
sample_reviews_en.author: H S

sample_reviews_en.text: On vacation from the U.S. after a week of amazing Thai food I was just craving a burger. This did not disappoint. One of the best burgers I’ve had in years! Also, the fries had the perfect mix of crispness and slightly buttery. May be the best fries I have ever had. Check them out 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: TheDarkRitual

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant that really opened my eyes and made me want to swear when I came to Bangkok... The combination of the juicy meat and cheese sauce...

I'm leaving tomorrow morning, so I think I'll have to get another one to go for dinner. It's so delicious...
sample_reviews_en.author: 이정민

restaurants.name: Richdee's Eatery and Cafe
restaurants.address:

192/2, Banphanthom Alley, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Sometimes they have live music - we enjoyed a special evening of a really good Thai blues duo. Really lovely atmosphere. Decent prices for food and drink on quaint cosy cute boutique rooftop view over canal for drinks. They provide shade in the daytime too.  Romantic setting.  Friendly service, they have a good selection ice cold Thai beers, in the large size so we can share., and a food menu. We were also provided with complimentary tasty sweet potato crisps as a drinks snack, and a small tropical fruit dessert after our meal, nice touches! We will come back !  Good pad Thai and penang & green curry chicken fried rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: MNML journey

sample_reviews_en.text: This place could, should and will be so much more one day . Its let down by poor but polite initial  service , staff do not check to see if people want more drinks or food when on the 3rd floor   . SO CHEAPSKATES hide up stairs,playing cards and sipping one drink for ages .   BUT do not judge this place by the ground floor , go upstairs to the top floor where the money has been spent to enjoy a good dining experience ( be patient ) . It's a different world for the better on the top floor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gene Keeley

sample_reviews_en.text: Typical cheap backpacker cafe. The food is not delicious, lacking Thai taste, typically made to cater foreigners. The staff looks clueless even I order food in Thai, not repeating the order, just quietly walks away. Thai fish sauce isn’t served with Thai dish, you have to ask for it yourself. But what kind of service can you expect from backpacker place? I try to avoid these places but come only for a canal atmosphere and breeze.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alla D

sample_reviews_en.text: Cool place with a really nice rooftop bar. The service was really nice. But more importantly the selection of beer was excellent. Many Thai microbrews offered if all kinds (IPA, lager, etc). I found it difficult to find a selection like this elsewhere, at least in this area. It’s right on the canal, a really sweet location. The decor (ie. plastic plants) are a bit much, but it’s kind of charming. Would def visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephen Bishop

sample_reviews_en.text: I love it so much! They have stir-fried instant noodles with seafood, chicken, pork, and bacon options. You can even ask the staff about your spice level – no need to worry about it not being spicy enough! The atmosphere is great; sitting by the canal is so refreshing, and there are big trees, so it's not too hot and scorching.
sample_reviews_en.author: อิงอิง ดญ.รักความฮา

sample_reviews_en.text: We stopped in for dinner today! We had the Thai green curry with chicken fried rice & a double pork burger, with 2 cokes our total was 350B!! Both meals were delicious, but the curry was a beautiful flavour! Will pop back tomorrow to try their breakfast menu & coffee!! Very good vibes, really enjoyed the choice of music 👌🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Georgie B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice bar / restaurant by the khlong. That have several floors including a covered roof top and a top rooftop.

The staff is very nice and prices are fair. Just a stone throw away from Samsen road. Perfect little stopover on a chill Old Town day. We just had a beer. But the people next to us ate and it looked nice too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text:
A nicely located café right by the canal in Banglamphu, a good place to stop if you’re walking through the area.
Coffee was good, with a latte at 60 baht, which is very reasonable for the location.
Nothing particularly out of the ordinary, but the setting by the water makes it a pleasant place to take a break.
sample_reviews_en.author: André Mohr

restaurants.name: Dragon Restaurant and Steakhouse
restaurants.address:

198/16, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a very unassuming place with a very large menu - the prices are really good a Pagnan Curry 115 Baht which was really creamy and tasted good. We also had a roasted pork, about 200-250 grams for 120 baht, which can also be recommended at this price. They also have cheap breakfast variations on offer around 175 with bacon, beans, egg, coffee, orange juice, sausage and toast. The big Tiger beer only costs 95 baht. The waitress was there very quickly and served us straight away and brought the menu. The ambience is simple/purist Thai. A lot of pensioners here are otherwise thumbs up for the food/service and prices
sample_reviews_en.author: Markus Stolz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very good, but the lady with the long black hair is incredibly unfriendly; I've never experienced anything like it. You're afraid that if you say the wrong thing, she'll jump down your throat. She should really deduct four points for that. I've been there a few times now, and it's some of the best food around. If they worked on the service, I'd give the food five stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Frank Schultheis

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, I can't recommend this restaurant!

It advertises authentic Thai cuisine, but then, for example, the spring rolls come straight from the freezer.

Other dishes were also prepared from frozen. On top of that, the staff is slow, inattentive, and completely bored… that's why I'm giving it a thumbs down 👎
Not recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Markus Reichelt

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a red Currie with duck. Tasted really good but too bad the veggies were not to my taste. Little spicy, not too much. Well priced and a big variety of food available. Will go back to check out some other duck dishes which are recommended by them. Nice location just on the beginning of soi Diana (50mtr) on the left.
sample_reviews_en.author: danny haren

sample_reviews_en.text: Another Thai/western restaurant catering more to the western taste. As the old saying goes you get what you pay for. What it lacks in quality they make up in portion size. To be fair the spring rolls weren't to bad and to be fair you got eight of them. The steak though large was poor quality rather chewey and fatty .
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Christou

sample_reviews_en.text: I agree with some of the comments. The skinny employee was terrible; she had a grumpy expression the whole time and answered questions with a displeased look. She shouldn't be working in customer service. The other employees were all very friendly and cheerful.
sample_reviews_en.author: P, Ranima

sample_reviews_en.text: Centrally located restaurant serving Thai and Western food at good prices. I had the Thai meal and it was very good. Two cats seemed to be part of the staff, roaming around the restaurant and providing some fun.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bill cipher

sample_reviews_en.text: The skinny employee provided terrible service. He slammed the menu down in front of customers and clearly showed his bad mood. It's the same every time I come. However, the other employees provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawarat Bouryai

restaurants.name: Lucky Panda - American Chinese Eats (Asoke)
restaurants.address:

21/6 Sukhumvit Soi 18, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Mostly I find the food here pretty good, only ever ordered take away though. At times though the quality drops from OK to terrible! Made the big mistake of ordering their crispy Massaman Chicken. Looks pretty appetising on their Grab menu (picture 1). What arrives though bears no resemblance to that image.  Mushy chicken in some sauce that tastes mostly of pepper with some chopped up fries! (Picture 2).  Disgusting. I threw it in the bin. The other thing I find VERY poor value is the pots of extra sauce they charge ฿25. It’s literally a thimble full of sauce! I didn’t even realise you could order pots so small. I’ll stick to what is mostly ok, just no Massaman or extra sauce!
sample_reviews_th.author: Ed Ward

sample_reviews_en.text: Previously enjoyed. Recently ordered again. Ordered sweet and sour chicken and chicken rolls, both of which come with sweet and sour sauce. When the order arrived, I put the sauce on my food without checking (as I had done with my order previous) to find when starting to eat my food that it was in fact ketchup. Disappointed to have ruined my food, I called up the restaurant, contact grab and sent pictures to both. The contact at the restaurant told me that it wasn’t ketchup and that she could tell it was sweet and sour (despite my taste and smell of the sauce). Didn’t care to apologise for the situation, just wanted to carry on insinuating I was wrong or lying. Grab also only provided 50THB as a replacement for a ruined meal. Food can be good if comes correct. Order checking and customer service requires a lot of work.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryan Dean

sample_reviews_en.text:
Heard about Lucky Panda location in BKK and thrilled to see them having a location in Pattaya so had to try.

I ordered a combo deal which contained:
Wontam soup
Chicken spring rolls
Chao Min noodles
Mongolian stir fried beef
General Tao chicken

Portian size is HUGE !!
Food quality is EXCELLENT

Especially the Chao Min Noodles you can taste it's not the standard factory quality but home made....I was surprised to get this quality for this price

Paid just under 500THB and it's more than enough for 2 people to eat from.

Lucky Panda...will from now on ordered at least once a week...highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Björn

sample_reviews_en.text: The most pathetic customer service ever. I placed a order through Grab. After 1.5 hour of wait the restraun refused to send the order saying they were unable to find a driver. If the organizers of this restraunt had any courtesy, they could have told me earlier and not 1.5 hour later when every restraunts were also closing. This left me with no option to order food. To the owners, It doesn't matter how good your food is, but such disgrace and not at all customer focused will one day lead to your downfall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitin Bali

sample_reviews_en.text:
7/8/2026 — 8:35 PM (20:35)

I was craving some orange chicken and noodles.  I wish I never ordered here.

My order:

—Large orange chicken
—Large vegetable chow mein
— Large chicken low mein
—side green beans
—egg drop soup

The orange chicken, green beans and soup tasted fine.

Once we tried the chow mein and low mein everyone was disgusted.   The low mein is the worst, it tastes like plastic.  The chow mein just tastes like soy sauce and plastic.

I won’t ever order here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: G

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely amazing. VERY VERY VERY good. We ordered the orange chicken (no spicy) and it was the best orange chicken I've ever had. If you're yearning for a little Americanized Chinese food this is the best. I'm sure we will hit this one every so often. I'm so full... But I want more, Lol.  No real place to sit so we will probably order via grab next time but I'd go get it in a minute. Think Panda Express in the USA but very well done!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Keith S

sample_reviews_en.text:
This has to be the only spot in Asoke that serves portions this big for the price and with decent packaging. At this price point and for the quality, there’s really little to complain about. I ordered via LINE MAN at almost half the price and couldn’t finish it.

It’s a bit too oily for my taste, but honestly for how cheap it is, the portion size and taste are solid. It’s Western-style Chinese takeaway, so that’s kind of expected 🤷‍♀️
sample_reviews_en.author: Rattiyakorn Dacanay

sample_reviews_en.text: As far as I know its pick up only (need to order online) but food is prepared quickly and fresh. Orange chicken is 10/10, general taos chicken was an 8/10 for us and adding everything else we ordered we can give an 8/10 overall which would be 4/5. We would recommend this place its good if you're craving western Chinese I would say a solid choice :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Mayg Collins

sample_reviews_en.text:
This chicken noodle shop is delicious because the stewed chicken is of very good quality, and the broth is very tasty even without adding any seasoning. However, the chili peppers were advertised as very spicy, which challenged me and made me want to try it. I couldn't stop eating! It was genuinely spicy and delicious.
Price: 3/5
Quality: 4/5
Taste: 4/5
Cleanliness: 5/5
Speed: 4/5
Service: 5/5
Location: 4/5
Value for money: 5/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapatr Chiraarreebutr

sample_reviews_en.text: This newly opened restaurant is clean and tidy. The flat noodles are excellent, soft and tender. The chicken is so soft you don't need to chew hard. The flavor is fantastic, with a fragrant herbal and radish aroma in the soup. The soup isn't too salty. The chrysanthemum tea is only slightly sweet. In short, I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: REDCHEEKGiRL

sample_reviews_en.text: A chicken/pork noodle shop in Soi Chulalongkorn 12, near Banthat Thong Road. The shop is a two-unit commercial building painted bright yellow, eye-catching. They offer both chicken and pork noodles, as well as snacks like grilled meatballs and fried sausages. The highlight is probably the soup, which is very sweet with radish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coke Somchai

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork and chicken are incredibly delicious! The meat is perfectly tender, making it easy and enjoyable to eat. There's an air-conditioned room to sit in, so it's not hot. The broth is flavorful and delicious on its own, but adding extra seasoning makes it even better! 👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Shang Pikanate

sample_reviews_en.text: Great service, affordable prices, and amazing taste! It's top-notch, fabulous, and absolutely fantastic! They even have a promotion where you get free chrysanthemum tea. Want to know how to get free chrysanthemum tea? You have to try their stewed chicken noodles! 🤩✨💅🏻 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tipayaporn Polma

sample_reviews_en.text: There are cute little staff members to serve you. The braised chicken is tender and melts in your mouth, and the fried items are freshly fried and served hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luna The Orange Cat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Leave a review and get 2 free glasses of chrysanthemum tea!
If you want to eat something delicious, you must stop by this shop. It's really delicious 👍👍👍❤️ …
sample_reviews_en.author: ชนิดา ทรัพย์ประเสริฐ

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times already. It's become one of my favorite restaurants.
Both the pork and chicken are very tender.
Delicious and worth the price!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bantita Suksawang

sample_reviews_en.text: The snacks to pair with coffee are limited and not very diverse. Recently, I encountered a new employee making coffee who didn't provide a saucer or stirring spoon. The supervisor didn't check for compliance either, instead calling customers to pick up their orders and letting them do it themselves. This really damages the image of their service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Drinking Naka

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is normal, but the staff seems to have received some kind of online training, and they're using speakerphone for some reason. I don't know why they're not using headphones and listening to themselves. I recommend improving this. Normally, the sounds of making coffee and taking online orders are loud enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatthanan Maitapat

sample_reviews_en.text: The coffee was good as usual, and the atmosphere was okay. It was nice and cool inside. The only downside was the staff; whether they were chatting, washing dishes, clearing tables, brewing coffee, knocking coffee grounds out, or doing other things, they were very noisy. It would be better if they were quieter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moana P.

sample_reviews_en.text: You can work by the window; there's a workspace with power outlets, but they're limited. It's quiet and peaceful, and the shop is cool due to the shade from the trees. The air is quite good because it's near the Chao Phraya River, but you can't see the riverbank.
sample_reviews_en.author: W.B. SSC

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was great: the coffee, the service, the cleanliness of the place. BUT...it's a gathering place for police officers who sit and chat. What used to be a peaceful coffee shop turns into a mess when the police show up…😤
sample_reviews_en.author: nannie leung

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service. I ordered through Grab and asked them to separate the ice, but they didn't. By the time it arrived, the coffee had spilled. Incompetent. They have no intention of doing their job.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploypapat Kijchaprechawanich

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch tastes better than the one across the street. The one across the street charges 25 baht for a sweet mocha, and every time I order it, it's never good. This branch is great!
sample_reviews_en.author: [ N ] o o m

sample_reviews_en.text: the three girls working at the café were arguing loudly inside. This is supposed to be a calm, quiet space where people come to relax, but the noise just ruined the atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harsh sharma

restaurants.name: Dicey Reilly's Bar & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

218/2-3 Thanon Second, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Venue is quite large with ample outdoor and indoor seating and I found each area to have comfortable seating with pool tables.
I tried their stone oven cooked pizza, the dough came out very light and crispy, really enjoyed the flavours.
They serve quite a large array of drinks and the rest of the menu has some nice choices.
I believe this restaurant is partnered to the adjoining the 4/5 star hotel next to it so it strives to be good quality but anyone can come and dine - IE not just for that hotels' guests..
Friendly staff, clean good sized toilets. Inside decor reminiscent of an up-end western pub/bar.
sample_reviews_en.author: SJB

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really really disappointed called in today for a couple of pints and lunch, Kilkenny was on the turn, going sour, couldn’t finish the drinks. Told the staff who said it was fresh on yesterday !!!.
Chicken wings were dry and tough, tasted as though they’d been re reheated, prawn rolls where tasteless and dry, must have been frozen and defrosted for hours or days.
This used to be a really good bar but it’s gone so far down it may not be recoverable, interesting to note that at lunchtime it had six customers, that should have made me think.
Staff very polite and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norman Robinson

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly one of the best wood-fired pizza places I’ve ever tried 🍕🔥
The pizza had that perfect smoky flavor from the wood-fired oven, with a crispy crust and incredibly fresh ingredients. The cheese was rich and delicious, and every bite tasted authentic and perfectly balanced.
The service was friendly and fast, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming.
You can truly feel the passion and quality in every pizza they make.
If you love real wood-fired pizza, this place is an absolute must-try 👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Amir Hanna

sample_reviews_en.text: Great restaurant! I highly recommend visiting during the low season. The last time I came, it was during a game or holiday, and the place was packed—the staff seemed overwhelmed and rushed. However, this time, with fewer people, the service was amazing! The staff was attentive, kind, and made our experience truly enjoyable. We celebrated my brother’s birthday there, and they gave us a free beer, which was a very nice gesture. Another plus was the of parking at the hotel. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maria H

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very quiet Happy Hour after Boxing Day (4-6pm). Lots of sports silently displayed on screens across the large bar and seating area. Conversation-level music. Standard menu and Happy Hour menu showed the same prices, but server explained that beers were 2 for 1 during Happy Hour. No billing issues.
A great place to chill once you adjusted to the low air-conditioned temperature inside. All forms of interior and exterior seating and tables.
Next visit to try the Guinness.
sample_reviews_en.author: tom ciccateri

sample_reviews_en.text: We ate here twice during our stay at Avani hotel including an all-you-can-eat lunch buffet. The food and service were excellent. The bar area is generously laid out and a great place to get a drink and watch sports. The restaurant is very clean and well organized in contract to most everything else we saw in this downtown area. It can accommodate large groups. Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rainer Ackbari

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice restaurant attached to the hotel.

Positives:
Large menu
Good tasting food
Inside and outside seating
Large restaurant
Good service in English

Negatives:
I went on a Sunday expecting to have the buffet but I was the only customer… so I had to take the regular menu.
Not the cheapest meal around, but good quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Hern

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible food. I order the chicken parm and it was dry tasteless and lacked any base sauce. The fries were cook but that's as much I cared for them.  I watched other tables pay and leave half eaten meals (pizza etc) . If you value your taste buds and wallet...Just don't.
sample_reviews_en.author: M T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a really good experience at Bnboon in Pattaya. The atmosphere is super relaxed and welcoming — the kind of place where you can sit back, unwind, and enjoy your time without feeling rushed.

There’s an impressive variety to choose from, and the staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and happy to help you find something that suits your preference.

What I liked most is the sense of community. If you’re someone who enjoys the culture and likes meeting others who share the same interest, this feels like a comfortable little spot to hang out, have a conversation, and enjoy the vibe.

A great find in Pattaya with good variety, friendly people, and a genuinely chilled atmosphere. 🌿
sample_reviews_en.author: varun sud

sample_reviews_en.text:
Service on point 👌
Every question answered ✅️
Weed of every range - Strong - Weak and Cheap - Top Shelf
I recommend coming and giving it a try
Nice smoking lounge with a ps5
Bong for use
Live resin, hash and gummies available here
Nice trinkets to buy aswell
If you are looking for a bong, related equipment, or even a necklace, all available here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tal Cohen

sample_reviews_en.text: A very cool shop, we were among the first to pick up our gift for a logo tattoo 🔥 We had a great chat, played the console, the product is also top notch, I recommend it to everyone, you won't regret it🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Princesss

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place, lots of different options for all your smoking needs and beverages are available as well! Nice ambiance, would definitely recommend :)
sample_reviews_en.author: yang

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place, we won the competition, we're happy with our winnings, we had a great chat and had a great time, thanks for the experience 🔥🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: кирилл ледовских

sample_reviews_en.text: Living on the other side of Thailand, I won a competition and managed to get it back after 5 months. The coffee shop itself is top-notch!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arsenii

sample_reviews_en.text: Very chill and cozy vibes , Cool environment, products are also very good and the workers were very helpful and nice to me and my frnds
sample_reviews_en.author: Shreyaan Saha

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, the air conditioning is very cool, the staff are lovely and friendly. Everything is perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: ottozxasqw fedfe

restaurants.name: เอี่ยวไถ่ สุกี้โบราณ เดอะมอลล์งามวงศ์วาน
restaurants.address:

30 39-50 Ngamwongwan Rd, Tambon Bang Khen, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
There was a Peking duck promotion for 499฿, so I came to try it. The duck skin was crispy enough, but the cucumber was a bit dry. I asked for seafood dipping sauce to add flavor, which was great. The Teochew dumplings were delicious. The duck meat was fried with garlic, but it wasn't hot when it arrived, so I had to ask them to reheat it. The hot Chinese tea (refillable) had a nice jasmine aroma and was good for cutting through the richness of the food.
- The tables in the restaurant seemed to be geared towards large groups. Since we were a couple, we had to sit outside.
- There weren't enough staff, so if it's busy, they probably wouldn't be able to keep up with the service.
sample_reviews_th.author: Love U._.naja_

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried the 399 THB NET buffet at Yiew Tai (drinks included). It's great value for those who like a variety of food. The menu includes traditional sukiyaki, tender marinated pork, flavorful dipping sauces, fresh vegetables, and many individual dishes such as Teochew dumplings, stir-fried ginkgo nuts with chili and salt, stir-fried green beans with minced pork, etc.

Most of the dishes tasted good. The pork and vegetables were fresh, and the broth had a fragrant traditional sukiyaki flavor. Stir-fried dishes were served hot and had a nice wok aroma. You can order as much as you want within the time limit.

Things to know: A minimum of 2 people is required, and there's a 2-hour time limit. There are no desserts. It can get crowded on weekends, so expect longer waits for food. I recommend going on a weekday.

Overall, if you prioritize a wide variety of savory dishes at an unbeatable price, it's worth it. You get to try many different items, and the flavors are consistently good. Value for money: 4/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Warich Temrungsie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mid-December 2025, with a promotion for Peking Duck at 650++ baht.
We went as a couple and it was just the right amount of food. We ordered the duck meat with pickled cabbage soup, which was free of charge. The staff said it would take about 20 minutes, but we enjoyed the meal and thought it came faster than expected. Both the Peking duck and the duck soup arrived at the same time. There were 14 large pieces, enough for 14 bites for two people, which was very filling. The pancakes were perfectly thin, but still allowed for large, delicious bites when wrapped around the ingredients. The duck soup was flavorful, delicious, and plentiful; we even had some to take home for another meal.
The staff provided excellent service. We were pleased with everything. Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jinny Soontorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time eating there. I ordered the set meal for 1799 baht and the crispy duck for 650 baht, probably a promotion (the duck wasn't that great, the skin was too thick and the wrapper was also too thick, which detracted from the enjoyment).
As for the food, personally, I wouldn't go back. The taste was ordinary, average.
I had to call the staff repeatedly, but the service wasn't bad.
The bill came to almost 3000 baht for 3 people, including a 10% service charge and VAT.
Personally, I think the price is high. The chairs with cushions weren't very comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: gusgus ohsweet

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to the 399 baht buffet.
The taste was not up to par; it was quite bland, especially the sukiyaki soup.
I also disliked that they served a pre-set meal that we didn't order, which included various meats and vegetables. They should have asked the customer beforehand.

The chairs need significant improvement. They were very difficult to sit on. When you sit on them, they sag, making the table chest-high, which is very difficult to eat. You have to stand up to get food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nithee Girdchoochuen

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here for lunch with the family. The service was very fast, polite and humble. We ordered their signature Chinese inspired hotpot along with many other Chinese inspired dishes. The quality of their produced were excellent, generous amount and simply tasty. For us, our favorite dish was the thick gravy pork noodle soup. Unfortunately this time we only ordered small dish, and it's gone too quickly!!! Got to get a bigger plate next time
sample_reviews_en.author: Katethip Varanyuwatana

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍽️It's a buffet, the taste is okay, considered delicious, but it feels a bit repetitive. All the meat dishes are marinated and tender. The spring rolls and stir-fried morning glory are very delicious.
💰The price is a bit high at 399 baht per person for the various dishes we tried.
💁🏻The service is good, but since we were sitting in the outdoor area, the staff didn't seem to notice us.
✨The restaurant atmosphere is nice and clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanya Kantapattarasakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly slow. Even though we called ahead to order, simple hot Chinese tea took forever; we had to go and ask for it and refill the water ourselves. There weren't enough staff, and they didn't seem to pay much attention to customers. I heard every table complaining about the slow service. The food tasted okay, but with this kind of slowness and service, I don't think I'll be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kessara Kosalprapai

restaurants.name: Shell
restaurants.address:

258, 2 Charan Sanit Wong Rd, Khwaeng Ban Chang Lo, Bangkok Noi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: On Friday, October 17th, 1968, at approximately 7:40 AM, I went to refuel my motorcycle with 95 octane fuel. The price was clearly stated as 200 baht. However, a female employee wearing glasses filled the tank, but the nozzle didn't dispense fuel. A male employee then tapped the dispenser, which activated it, but the display still didn't show the total. He continued tapping, and eventually, the total jumped to 326 baht. The employees then pressured me to pay the additional amount. While I could afford it, I felt this was unacceptable. I informed them that this was wrong, and the employee in charge gave me a very condescending look. Shouldn't a polite apology have come first? There should be better training for employees in using the equipment, checking its condition, and providing proper customer service etiquette. Please consider this.
sample_reviews_en.author: nichapat Korsanan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I brought my car in for an oil change. The mechanic was very attentive, checking other parts and letting me know what else needed replacing (like the fuel filter).

Importantly, he was very friendly, offering advice throughout the process and providing excellent service.

While I waited nearby, a car wash offered me a wash for 130 baht. The quality was decent; the vacuuming and washing were thorough. However, for a newer car, I'm concerned that at this price, the quality probably won't be on par with a high-end car care center. Bringing my own cloth would likely be safer against cat hair.
sample_reviews_en.author: Valen Hammer

sample_reviews_en.text: I got a car wash and vacuum for 130 baht. The price was okay, but the quality of the wash was terrible. I've had my car washed here many times before, but this time I have to give a rating because it was awful. The car was covered in stains, and the windows were streaked with water. After washing, the staff didn't properly dry or blow-dry the car; they were busy playing around until the water dried, leaving streaks that I had to wipe off myself. I really can't stand this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: SaLMoN69 XxxX

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nowadays, it's not really clean. You can rub it with your finger and the stains come off, but the people who clean it say they can't get them off. Especially the young people who come to clean, it's like they just pat the cloth on and dry it, that's it. They use big cloths, but that's all.
You have to inspect it carefully, be a bit picky. Don't wash it in the evening or late at night, you won't see the dirt stains.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darunee

sample_reviews_en.text: This car wash is incredibly thorough. They even wash the car under the hood! I've never seen that price before – 140 baht! Inside and out, the work is unhurried and meticulous. The gas station attendants are also very friendly. If you don't get your car washed here, they offer free tire inflation and windshield cleaning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aorr. Ornp

sample_reviews_en.text:
They offer car wash and vacuuming services, and everything is very clean.
All the staff are very helpful and provide excellent service. They even helped fill my tires with air. While waiting for my car, I received a 50% discount coffee coupon. The waiting area was very comfortable. 👍👍👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pekky Chawee

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to fill up my car with gas. The attendant gave me the bill to scan. I drove out, and a young man on a motorcycle came up and knocked on my car, saying the fuel tank cap wasn't closed; the drain plug was still hanging down. Your staff is beyond amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Surawit Chotenuntanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The night shift gas station attendant was very polite and provided excellent service. Wow, I've never been to a gas station where the attendant asked me if I wanted air. He said, "I'll fill it for you." He filled all four tires. Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Issaraporn Sae-tung

4-6-8 ถนนเทียนร่วมมิตร แขวงห้วยขวาง Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The quality and taste of the food have been maintained well, even though Aunt Ray probably doesn't cook herself anymore. She's always attentive and kind to customers, which is why she has a loyal customer base. The restaurant is located in a Broadcast company area, which seems to have been accommodating, so there weren't many changes to the space, such as the sloping ground, but this doesn't affect the dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tooh Local Insights

sample_reviews_en.text: Three years, 30 years have passed, and the taste is still the same. Shut your mouth, you chicken! The restaurant has expanded far from its original location. I haven't stopped by to eat here since. The food is delicious, they have every kind of dish imaginable, from papaya salad to single-dish meals. Next time I'll go for the chicken rice and Hainanese chicken rice. But hey, warm water... what's with that?
sample_reviews_en.author: หนานเมือง Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: This rice and curry shop run by Auntie Le is a place where you can order whatever curry you want and have it served with rice, then sit and eat at the shop. The prices are moderate, and the taste is decent. If you don't know where to eat lunch, try stopping by Auntie Le's shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฐิติพงษ์ หิรัญรำไพ

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since I was a delivery boy living in a rented room. The original shop was located at the old Cultural Center curve. Now that I'm the CEO, whenever I pass by, I always stop by to eat. 50 baht is enough for two meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: User Review

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai buffet (à la carte also available)
Almost every dish is delicious and reasonably priced.
Many office workers and taxi drivers stop by to eat.
Plenty of tables.
But after noon, there's not much food left.
sample_reviews_en.author: anuran srivachirawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I read the reviews, but haven't been there yet.
It looks interesting because I walk past this spot every morning when I go to the gym.
The atmosphere of the shop and the breakfast curry look delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kosin Siriwattanaworagul (ช.ช้าง คนเมืองยะลา)

sample_reviews_en.text: Parking is available in front of the shop. Inside, there's a wide variety of food to choose from... including à la carte options and rice with curry, depending on what the customer prefers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Top Komkrit

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but it's a shame they didn't use jasmine rice; it would have been even better. Free bael fruit juice was available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nisakan Bo.

restaurants.address:

Kanchanaphisek Rd, Sala Thammasop, Taweewattana, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is incredibly delicious! It's like the owner is personally overseeing the service. The fish is so fresh! I came to the restaurant unintentionally, but I've been hooked on the taste of the food countless times. However, I wish the music was a bit louder or that they changed the genre to something more relaxing; the music is a bit too heavy for me. The prices are good, and they have set menus available during lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ja Pann

sample_reviews_en.text:
Medium-sized restaurant near the roundabout, parking available.
Easy to find, good service.
Cool air conditioning, private rooms available for large groups, nice decor.
Delicious Japanese food.
Green tea is refillable.
Anyone passing by should stop in! The restaurant is open in two shifts.
Nomura won't disappoint.
Plus, the restaurant has its own restroom.
No need to walk far to the main area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naerunyaporn Rodlak

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here. I ordered tonkatsu pork rice bowl, pork yakisoba, fried rice, takoyaki, and salmon sushi. Everything was delicious! Before the food arrived, they served seaweed soup, which was very fragrant. If I'm in the area again, I'll definitely stop by again. The restaurant atmosphere is great, the air conditioning is cool, and it's very comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chamaiporn Luangwiset

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and affordable. The staff are attentive, and the quality of the ingredients is good, although some of the vegetables might be a bit old and have a lot of tough fibers. The grilled chicken gizzards were excellent but slightly undersalted. The oden with the unboiled egg had a unique and delicious flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: S. Wongsa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere was great, and the staff were very dedicated and attentive. They were proactive and made me feel well cared for. I commend all the staff and encourage them to continue this level of service.

The food was high quality and delicious.

I will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanakorn Youpanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and enjoyable, and the prices aren't too expensive.
If you can drink beer, the food pairs perfectly with Sapporo beer, which isn't bitter, allowing you to keep drinking while enjoying the music. The atmosphere is ideal for relaxing after work.
sample_reviews_en.author: กษิดิศ เมืองสมบัติ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, the air conditioning was cool, and the promotional menu was great value for money. The staff kept refilling our water. It's a shame they didn't have sushi and sashimi today.
But I still got to eat my favorites 😊
The takowasabi is the best 😘
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuma Travel

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for an izakaya in this area, this one is pretty good. The ingredients are high quality, and the food is delicious. My kids loved it too. However, you might need to call the staff frequently because there aren't enough of them.
sample_reviews_en.author: K. Barameechai

restaurants.name: Yuk-do Korean Premium Grilled Buffet
restaurants.address:

Gateway Ekamai, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Korean BBQ buffet restaurant offers incredible value for money 🔥🇰🇷
The pork slices are large, tender, and juicy, grilled over a hot grill until fragrant. Eating it with fresh vegetables and kimchi is pure bliss. Side dishes are unlimited refills, and they also have fried chicken, tteokbokki, and jajangmyeon to choose from. It's truly delicious, filling, and great value. I've been here many times and I'm definitely coming back again 💛✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Heawon Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
I think they need to train the staff who serve meat. I've been here 4 times, and every time I asked for more meat, they were wearing masks, but their expressions were distorted. I get it. We've all experienced COVID, so even the expressions on a masked face convey nuances.
Then, when I went back and asked for more meat, they gave me three servings, even though it wasn't the amount I ordered. LOL
Other than that, it was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: 진심

sample_reviews_en.text: i have never been to a buffet that is so stingy and tight on time. the staff warned us not to over order and that our time was up. it was a strict 90mins. one of the staff didnt look happy and unpleasant. we have been to many buffets in thailand and they are very laid back. there wasnt much variety as well. give this place a miss and go somewhere else for a great time
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice selection of comfort food (fast-food type). Reasonably priced. They only offer pork for the grill, but they also have various other items including fried chicken on the buffet.

Their spicy chicken could be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: 최Charly

sample_reviews_en.text: It's even better than I expected. There are a variety of sides, and they're all delicious. I recommend the tonmahawk; it's really tender. If you're craving Korean food, you should definitely try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 윤이버스

sample_reviews_en.text: Here, you can enjoy unlimited refills of pork belly, pork neck, and tomahawk steak. Side dishes, vegetables, and ramen are all free. I'm full after eating tteokbokki and other various dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김구깡

sample_reviews_en.text: First time eating here. Pork neck, number 5, very soft and delicious. The side dishes look delicious. Lots of things. You should come and try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittisak_Tub

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent! Staff are Amazing! Food is really good. The place is busy, so food is fresh. The salad is so good. Great cuts of pork. Amazing staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Liam G

restaurants.name: Jack's Seafood Buffet
restaurants.address:

567 Soi Ratchaprarop 2, Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent service and hospitality. Went there with a big group, initially when informing the host, she look fluster. Thinking that it’s due to the lack of seats to accommodate us, I reassure her that we can squeeze a little. To my surprise her reply was that the prawns were a little short and she’ll check to give us a discount. Sure enough discount was given, and throughout the dinner, the host were ensuring us that we get a good deal by ushering seafood to us while making us feel like home. The live prawns given are quite a handful and a delight, and the rest of the ingredients are fresh. It’s a definitely a place I would recommend to enjoy the best of Bangkok seafood at an affordable and reasonable place (even before discounted), complete with great hospitality and service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon Goh

sample_reviews_en.text: If you are a foreigner, here is not a good place to try. The crab is not good. Shrimp is good it is alive. But when we want to change or add more coal， they said they cannot do it; it is not including in the 399bath. And if you want to have one more pot which have water around you need to add 100 bath to have this pot. Although you have 6 people, they still only give you one grill to do the BBQ. Although they said there doesn’t have time limit, when you coal is done, you are done. So I just can said it’s not a good place to go for foreigner.
sample_reviews_en.author: SHERRY Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: Fresh water prawn galore! Eat all you can prawns that is definite to satisfy your prawns cravings. Also offers other seafood like squid, mussels, oysters, huge cockles, clams, escargot and flower crabs. Choose their charcoal grill or add also their mookata for steamboat and grill. p.s. Their pork ribs and belly is very succulent and juicy when grilled on their slow charcoal fire. This place also offers unlimited refill for water fountain drinks too all in for 399THB per pax. Beers sold separately 😉
sample_reviews_en.author: kellaw kellaw

sample_reviews_en.text: the food looks goooood. 399/pax for the seafood grill, plus 100/table for the mookata. location very near to our hotel (centara). service not bad, very helpful w changing the grill. cooked food nothing interesting. good spread of seafood (crab, prawns, sotong,clams etc) the prawns are really juicy!! scallop a little sandy. the meat is too big and soup quite salty so cooking on the mookata isn’t a very pleasurable experience. otherwise this place is not bad!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Celine Chong

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is a delicious seafood buffet worth making a special trip to eat here.

It was so, so great to be able to eat fresh seafood for 399 baht per person.

You can even eat live shrimp that have been stunned on ice right away.

It was a wonderful time. Thank you♡
sample_reviews_en.author: TALK JYP

sample_reviews_en.text: This BBQ place offers great value for money! Aside from the slightly hidden location, everything is fantastic. The shrimp are huge and the meat is excellent. I highly recommend the pork ribs, shrimp, and king oyster mushrooms!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wendy Wu

sample_reviews_en.text: A decent spread of seafood ranging from scallops, cockles, crabs to prawns and oysters. Could have more skewers and vegetables but you are paying only 399 baht (499 baht for hotpot). Produce are ok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alicia Ng

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there several times. The seafood is very fresh, but the selection isn't very diverse yet. Overall, the price is reasonable. I'll definitely stop by again whenever I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonmaphoom Singhad

Open 09:00-21:00

sample_reviews_en.text: The Vietnamese spring rolls (Nem Nuong) were delicious and worth the price. The menu is limited, but the papaya salad is considered expensive compared to Je Kai Udon's. The food was slow to arrive because there are only two people working there. The restaurant is clean and pleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: soraporn leelabuddhanondha

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant owner was so kind! The food was delicious and clean, and it only cost 300 baht per person. Thank you for taking care of the three of us today, we had so much fun! We'll definitely come back again! 🥹❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Grace Rattana

sample_reviews_en.text: Please allow me to comment that the vegetables weren't fresh, the cucumbers were bruised, and the mangoes were overripe. This has happened 2-3 times already. Please improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: หนุ่ม เลิศวัฒนกูล

sample_reviews_en.text: Very disappointed. Since ordering, it seems like they're just repackaging and selling the dipping sauce; there's so little of it. 😑
sample_reviews_en.author: First

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients are fresh and clean, the vegetables are fresh and clean. It tastes just like eating in Udon Thani!
sample_reviews_en.author: Annabel

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! 🌟👍🏻 Great value for money. The packaging was beautiful. Definitely a repeat customer! ❤️ …
sample_reviews_en.author: SAYANON

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, clean, and fresh. The vendor is kind. You can sit and eat comfortably.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr Chawyin

restaurants.name: มุมหวาน By ภัทร์รดา
restaurants.address:

JGR7+7J6, Pracha Uthit 69 Alley, Lane 15, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steak is delicious and affordable. As for the desserts, you'll have to try them yourself (I'm not an expert)... The atmosphere in the restaurant is relaxed... The chefs are friendly...
I recommend entering via Soi Suk Sawat 66. Keep going until you reach a three-way intersection, then turn left. Follow the road, cross the bridge over the canal, pass the Lat Luang Floating Market, and continue a little further. Look to your right before the 7-Eleven; there's an alley leading to Suk Niwet 7 village. Turn into Soi Suk Niwet 7 and go about 200 meters; the restaurant will be on your left. There's parking for cars and motorcycles...
sample_reviews_en.author: มูฮัมหมัด บุตรแห่งซำเซี๊ยห์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and cheap, and the vendor provides good service. The only downside is that the shop doesn't have a restroom.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudteerak Love

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another restaurant I'd recommend as an option for foodies. It's delicious, you should try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: suporn s4

restaurants.address:

Soi Mu Ban Chok Chai Garden Home 1, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cheap hotel, nice pool and seats at the pool/bar.
But the most special experience is the French kitchen based menu and fantastic food for very affordable prices.
The service style could have been more gentle and polite
sample_reviews_en.author: J.P. van der Meulen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, it's great.
The food is excellent; I recommend the carbonnade and the vol-au-vent...
The staff is very friendly and competent.

As for Toy and Eric, I'll let you discover them for yourselves...
sample_reviews_en.author: Jean-mi Barbier

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great village pool bar.

Food excellent & prices good.

Always enjoy the peppercorn chicken!
sample_reviews_en.author: M H

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice place.Good for relaxing and swimming.Delicious food with friendly staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marc Gelhorn (Mayo)

restaurants.name: SUSHIRO THAILAND La Villa Ari
restaurants.address:

ลา วิลล่า อารีย์ ห้องเลขที่ LAV02LS301,LAV02LS301A, LAV02LS302 ชั้น 3, 356 Phahonyothin Rd, สามเสนใน, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Here are some negative reviews for Sushiro that you can post (in natural Thai, with some mild profanity depending on the intensity of the emotion):

Polite but very bad (concise):

"Terrible. The air conditioning wasn't working, people were cutting in line constantly, the service was awful. In short, I was very unimpressed. There was no atmosphere for eating. I will definitely not be coming back."

Stronger (generally usable):

"Terrible. This Sushiro branch didn't have the air conditioning on at all. It was stuffy and hot. The queuing system was a disaster; people were cutting in line everywhere. There was no management. The staff were terrible and didn't take care of customers. I almost fainted from the heat while eating. I will never be coming back."

"Very unimpressed. It was extremely hot, the air conditioning wasn't working, and the worst part was the queuing system. Many customers cut in line, and the staff were indifferent. I wouldn't recommend coming here."
sample_reviews_en.author: 杨生（天才小熊猫）

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice in the sushi rolls was terrible. Every piece was broken in two, sticky, and difficult to remove from the plate. The salmon hadn't even thawed before being molded, resulting in a snowy texture in my mouth. The red shrimp was mushy, not fresh, and not at all. Personally, I'm not someone who's never eaten sushi before; I love sushi both in Thailand and Japan, and this time I was very disappointed. Please improve this. The restaurant's atmosphere was really good though, I really liked it – it felt like eating at someone's house. The staff were attentive and gave good recommendations. I'll visit again when I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: First RBT

sample_reviews_en.text:
I returned an order because I received the wrong item due to an order mistake, and since then, subsequent orders have been incredibly slow. Furthermore, the second order arrived after they had already checked it (an order from over 30 minutes ago).

Well, with the increase in stores, Sushiro has become more familiar to Thailand in many ways.

There's a huge difference between the very friendly and competent staff and the others.

The taste is typical Sushiro: cheap and delicious.

Is this in the picture acceptable...? It looks like salmon roe, but it's actually flying fish roe.
sample_reviews_en.author: koh bk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Anyone coming to this branch after work needs to be prepared. God is testing your patience. Besides being crowded, the staff are also very slow to clear tables. I used to go every day, Monday to Sunday, because it's near my house.

Most recently, I went at 9:20 PM (last order 9:30 PM), and they said the tables were full, but I insisted on going. Once inside, the tables weren't fully cleared! The service at this branch is getting worse and worse. I have to lower my review rating. I can't take it anymore. 🤮
sample_reviews_en.author: jj

sample_reviews_en.text: SUSHIRO at La Villa Ari offers a delightful sushi experience with fresh ingredients and a wide selection of dishes. The conveyor belt sushi concept makes dining fun and convenient, with options ranging from classic nigiri to creative sushi rolls. The prices are reasonable, and the quality is consistent. The ambiance is casual and family-friendly, and the staff is attentive. Overall, it’s a great spot for sushi lovers looking for good value and variety.
sample_reviews_en.author: PK PTD

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch has a poorly organized system. Even after booking online, you still have to check in again. No staff member informed me about this. Why have an online queuing system if you have to do this? After booking a queue number, those behind me in the queue just skipped over me.

In short, I asked the staff, and they said it's first come, first served, regardless of how early you booked online.
Why have an online system if it's going to work?
sample_reviews_en.author: tedjik

sample_reviews_en.text:
Asahi draft always smells bad due to poor server cleaning, -1 point.
If they can't control the quality, should change it to bottles.

But thank goodness for sushi at this price and place.

Update:
The Asahi draft beer no longer had the unpleasant smell and tasted much better. While there is still some minor inconsistency in operations, I appreciate Sushiro Thailand for delivering this level of quality in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N

sample_reviews_en.text: We had heard good things about Sushiro, so we wanted to go eat there. It was a bit busy and there were three of us. We had to wait 10 minutes for a table. This eventually turned into 45 minutes, during which we saw pairs going in one after the other, including those coming after us. So, with more than two people, you have to wait longer. The staff was great, but the sushi was a bit disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rob Bakker

restaurants.name: Bazi &Leckerle - Deutsches Restaurant/German restaurant/อาหารเยอรมัน
restaurants.address:

655 Pattaya-Na Kluea Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We have just got back from our first visit to Pattaya since Covid. Our favourite restaurant hadn’t survived the lockdowns, but we chanced upon the lovely Zum Bazi in a side street close to our hotel.  It looked busy so we thought that we would give it a try. There is a wide range of western food catering for the mainly German clientele, but we ate from the Thai menu, which was fantastic.  The restaurant is a perfect blend of German efficiency and quality together with fantastic Thai cooking and gracious service.  The deep-fried fish with garlic was especially good.  We were so impressed that we ended eating here on 3 nights during our 8 day stay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Martin Whiteland

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn’t dare to visit this café before because there is no air-con area, and I thought it would be too hot for me. But this time I really wanted some German sausages, so I decided to have lunch here. I asked the staff if they had an air-conditioned place, and they told me I could sit at the “Ice Cream” café right next door,  it seems to have the same owner.
The portions are big, the prices are reasonable, and the service is excellent. I really liked everything and will definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maryna Y.

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely the rudest staff woman i have ever encountered in Thailand, let alone only Pattaya.  We were well dressed and polite, spoke in both Eng and Thai. But the crone just simply stared at us as we entered.  Looked very annoyed and only spoke in a threatening tone "what you want!". I ordered and when it brought our drinks, just had a scowl that said hurry up and leave.  Very very nasty piece of work.   Drinks were good tho
sample_reviews_en.author: James Langlois

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hunter's schnitzel with fries and salad.

The salad was swimming in oil; less isn't necessarily worse.

The schnitzel was good.

The fries were too brown and inedible. When I asked the server if a German or Thai person was cooking, they said a Thai person. I complained on Monday, December 8, 2025, but I could have just let it go; they didn't care. According to my friends, the Thai food wasn't anything special either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander Pütz

sample_reviews_en.text: Tucked in a Soi behind Terminal 21. Easy access. Food was good and very reasonably priced, but on 2 occasions not well patronised. Not crowded at all, maybe because too many food options in Pattaya. Dare say, chef know how to cook steak properly. Good options of Western and Thai food. The pastries Apple Crumble Cake looked so tempting, but resisted due to diet restrictions. Will drop by again for a good fix of steak
sample_reviews_en.author: eric tham

sample_reviews_en.text:
A good "German" restaurant in Pattaya. It's a long-established business, but moved within Naklua about two years ago.

They serve the German dishes you'd expect, two daily specials, and also Thai classics.

The prices are reasonable, and the service is friendly.

A good place to go if you're in the mood for German food and beer.

Your Thai companion will also find something to their liking...
sample_reviews_en.author: Harald Roth

sample_reviews_en.text: Not recommended, not tasty. Ordered a simple dish - potato pancake with eggs and Americano with cream on top. The pancake was half raw and the coffee was overcooked and had a burnt taste. It seems that coffee machine is not serviced or quite cheap to brew a good coffee. Don’t understand why the rate of this place is so high if they can’t make a simple breakfast 👀
sample_reviews_en.author: Kirill Neklyudov

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to go to Bazi and Leckerle a lot years ago. The coffee was always terrible, but what they sold me today as a cappuccino was an absolute disgrace and completely overpriced for a lousy place with no air conditioning and unfriendly staff. Probably the worst coffee in Pattaya. Disgrace, never ever again
sample_reviews_en.author: Lebua Tower

restaurants.name: Yakiniku Oniku To Gohan Sukhumvit 26 (Nihonmachi Branch)
restaurants.address:

115 ห้อง113, นิฮอนมาชิ, Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥩 Yakiniku Oniku To Gohan Sukhumvit 26 (Nihonmachi Branch)

Had a really great experience here tonight.

I first discovered this place from the Ari branch years ago, which has already closed down, so I was actually surprised to find out they now have quite a few branches. What impressed me most is that the quality control still feels very consistent despite expanding this much.

The service was honestly one of the highlights of the meal. The staff were super attentive, energetic, and always ready to help. They checked on the table regularly, changed the grill quickly, served everything fast, and made the whole experience feel smooth and welcoming 👏🏻

The quality of the meat was excellent. We ordered A5 for almost every dish and every plate was impressive rich flavor, beautiful marbling, soft texture, and incredibly satisfying once grilled 🤤✨

The atmosphere also felt very authentic and comfortable, especially if you enjoy Japanese-style yakiniku dining.

Price-wise, it’s definitely on the higher side, but personally I think it’s worth it for both the food quality and the level of service. Really happy to see the brand still maintaining such a strong standard.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornpong W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The quality of the meat is really great—juicy and has the perfect thickness—but also quite pricey for the amount that we got. The beer and side dishes, on the other hand, are just straight up expensive.

The staffs were pretty nice and they would tell us if something we ordered would take long beforehand. One complaint I do have is that they shout very loudly to communicate with each other and it can be pretty startling. It was to the point that we thought they were fighting but it was just a way to ensure that they get the message across in the loud environment.
