The seat we got was quite hot as it was pretty close to the kitchen but the whole shop didn’t look cramped even when there were a lot of people there. The entire shop was quite loud and, as mentioned before, the staffs were even louder.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawat Ngerncham (Nawat)

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the worst restaurant experience.  Staffs were poorly trained (most are not thai and cannot communicate well).  Service was extremely unorganised. Manager/owner was unaware of staffs mistakes and did not take actions, our beef wagyu were all burnt to charcoal and stuck to the grill, the staff had to change the grill twice and we had to request for a new serving to be served (the staff was unable to explain the her members she made a mistake). Another Staff spilled warm oil on us the counter bar was messy causing accidents to happen. It was lucky no one was badly burnt. We were compensated with one ice cream. Food was ok, but not as expected for 3500baht meal for 2-pack. The recommended beef tongue was hard and unchewable. The service was the worst we’ve ever experienced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minna L

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the best time here. The menu they have is limited but packed with quality.

Their selection of meats is amazing. We got wide array of Wagyu A5 in different cuts. The rice is cooked to perfection and the meat is just heavenly.

Would really recommend you to try their Yukke, it was the highlight of our meal.

All the meats were served at the right temperature and cut to perfection.

The staffs are all lovely and polite 100/10 would recommend visiting this place when you are looking for authentic Japanese Yakiniku.

You really get what you’re paying for. All the food you see in our pictures and videos cost €85 in total. Split 3-way that’s less than €30 each.

If I was back in Europe I would be paying at around €100 per person for a meal like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Erika

sample_reviews_en.text:
A yakiniku restaurant located near K Village on Sukhumvit 26.
We went to this restaurant to celebrate the wedding announcement of one of our former interns.

It was one of the best yakiniku restaurants I've been to in Bangkok.

We drank quite a bit, but it still only cost about 1,000 baht per person.
Considering the quality of the meat, it feels incredibly cheap.
The beef tongue (high-quality?) was especially delicious.
I was amazed at how thick it was and how delicious the meat was.
The offal was also very tasty.

As the name suggests, they also specialize in rice, so I'd like to try that next time.
*I was so busy drinking that I forgot about the food.

Also, the atmosphere and staff were great.
I feel like this is a very friendly restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: KAZUYA WAKASUGI

sample_reviews_en.text: On June 2nd, 2026, a group of six went for dinner. They were seated in a cramped alleyway inside the restaurant, with only one small grill, too small for six people. After grilling for a while, the exhaust fan broke. We ate while constantly exposed to smoke until we couldn't stand it anymore and asked for the bill and to take the leftovers home. The unprofessional staff tried to fix the exhaust fan, but when they couldn't, they said, "That's just how it is with BBQ, there's always a lot of smoke..." So rude! There are plenty of other, much better restaurants. After paying the bill, we moved to the restaurant on the second floor. It was spacious, air-conditioned, and the food was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Greencase Coconut

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was my first time there, and the meat was delicious, the service was great, and it felt very comfortable.
This time I ate Hitachi Beef, a brand of beef that Ibaraki Prefecture is proud of! I could taste the sweetness of the fat, and it was so tender that it seemed to melt in my mouth.
The restaurant's sauce was also exquisite.
The rice served in the rice container was also incredibly delicious. White rice with yakiniku...this is a true Japanese food culture!
Many of the staff were local women, and they were very attentive. The service was also impeccable.
The restaurant's logo was cute, and the special plastic bottles were a nice touch.
Thank you for the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hilo Cassi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing Japanese yakiniku, very valuable for money.

Pork tongue with green onion is a must. Make sure you order rice with your grilled meats too. If you can’t finish the rice, they can make onigiri from the leftover to go for you.

Beef skirt also great, very tender from the way they scored the meat.

Italian style chicken was just ok to me.

Make sure you order an assorted pickled to help you cut through all richness from the meat.

Beef intestines was quite interesting, very fatty with a hint of gaminess. I must try have you haven’t had it before.

Beef soup with seaweed was amazing I highly recommend. Light soup with fork tender beef stew, perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanawat B

restaurants.name: House of Hotdogs
restaurants.address:

3rd floor, Nana Square Shopping Mall, 49, Soi Sukhumvit 3, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Saw on Facebook and was intrigued by the look of the Hot dog. Its not everyday that you come across New York Style Hot Dogs in Thailand.
Must say I am rather disappointed. Hot dogs look nothing like the photos. Buns not toasted, sausages taste like straight bought from macro and the "seasoning" on the fries is just powder you can buy on shopee.
Honestly safe your money and make these hotdogs at Home. Mediocre experience at best.
But the cherry on top was: Staff was not wearing mask at any point. From taking oder, preparing food to giving it to us. During these times I am expecting a little bit more professionalism.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Maria Feder

sample_reviews_en.text: Great little hole in the wall- literally. 3rd floor above burger king & Starbucks. I had the all beef New York hotdog. It had an awesome smoky flavor, as well as a nice crisp snap to the casing of the hotdog. Bun was warm and toasty toppings were plentiful, highly delicious in my opinion. I also ordered cheesy fries, which were not what I was expecting, but a huge plate of very nicely cooked french fries, sure to cure anything that ails you. The gentleman that took my order was very pleasant and helpful. Just one star for the ambience because it is a 3rd floor food court at night with no people. Ha ha ha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ameri Mom

sample_reviews_en.text: I regretted coming here and ordering. The men working in the kitchen are sloppy. The cashier was transferring food from one container to another without gloves, licking his fingers in the process. Before that, he'd touched money, the cash register, and his phone. And he sent that container of food out for delivery. The kitchen looks dirty. Basic sanitation is definitely not observed here. Terrible experience. Take action!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexandra Polovtseva

sample_reviews_en.text: Fries were obviously reheated as they were chewy and not fresh at all. The hot dogs were okay, but the prices for everything are just much too high. 140THB for stale fries, and 150+ THB per hot dog. These are import prices for something that shouldn’t cost that much to make locally. I did like the jerk and homemade BBQ sauces though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jamie H.

sample_reviews_en.text: I love love love a good hotdog and this place has it. House of hotdogs in Bangkok is so delicious and such a variety of different hotdogs and the fries are fried perfect crunchy outside and soft inside seasoned to perfection. Great taste and service I very pleased.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keshia Chris

sample_reviews_en.text: Not worth the money. If you're paying 99 baht and above for hotdog you expect something special. No toppings. mediocre sausage. decent bun. I'd part with it for 59 baht but not 99. it's only slightly better than the hotdogs you get at 7-11.
sample_reviews_en.author: Javin Jonchhe

sample_reviews_en.text:
Way below average hotdog, rather eat 7-11 hotdog probably better, way overpriced.
Caution : Steer away lol. Bun was ok but not toasted as advertise, low quality hotdog, bad execution, and charge a premium price.

Totally Not Worth It !!
sample_reviews_en.author: Panlikit Punnakanta

sample_reviews_en.text:
Being in a foodcourt area the space is spacious but simple.
Doesn't really matter cuz the dogs are DELICIOUS, albeit a bit pricey.  But that being said the toppings justify the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Laskowski

restaurants.name: Lulu Rooftop Bar
restaurants.address:

PHV3+FCG ซอย สุขุมวิท 3/1 แขวงคลองเตยเหนือ แขวงคลองตันเหนือ Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing experience. The sheesha had virtually no flavour from the moment it arrived. We informed the staff, but they were unwilling to replace it or offer any solution. Since the sheesha was not enjoyable to smoke, we returned it, yet we were still charged the full amount.

Good customer service is about addressing genuine concerns, and unfortunately that was lacking here. Paying full price for a product that had no flavour and was returned left us feeling unfairly treated. Would not recommend based on this experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sharan Kirpalani

sample_reviews_en.text:
Watch out for the hookah hose, it is moldy!
The shisha tobacco has no flavor, seems mixed; the shisha is very bad.
When we asked for a new hose, we had to pay 100 baht for it; I think that's bad service!

The atmosphere is cozy, it's on the rooftop, it's small but looks nice.
Nice music.
The staff are friendly, but they don't make an effort for the customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Z H

sample_reviews_en.text: Lulu Rooftop Bar is a classy and beautiful spot with an amazing atmosphere. The setting is stunning, the service is excellent, and the prices are very affordable. They offer a great selection of delicious cocktails and mocktails, all well prepared and refreshing. It’s a perfect place to relax and enjoy a great evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angel Ratatouille

sample_reviews_en.text: A rooftop bar on the 7th floor. The view is practically nonexistent, but there's fresh air and hookahs for 300 baht (Al Fakher) and 500 baht (Adalya). A large screen hangs above the entrance, showing music videos. Overall, it's a decent lounge for the Arab quarter.
sample_reviews_en.author: G T

sample_reviews_en.text: This is right in the middle of Nana...so be prepared for a less then appealing surrounding....the first order of the shisha was terrible....they had to make a new one that was also just mediocre....I've been to better shisha places in BKK....skip this one
sample_reviews_en.author: Zain Shah

sample_reviews_en.text: Personally, I love the atmosphere so much 🥰 It's fantastic 👍 The staff provides great service 👏👏👏 and the food is reasonably priced 👍 I've been many times 😊 If you haven't been, you should definitely give it a try 🥰 I guarantee you'll love it 😉😘 …
sample_reviews_en.author: อรทัย ไพพะนา

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s nice place for sit and relax. Very nice music and a good hookah . Price is very good, only 300 baht for hookah . They have nice pineapple juice too 😉. It’s located in the 6th floor. You need to take elevator to come up
sample_reviews_en.author: Cavidan Xeyri

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good shisha und Service. It’s a bit hidden but when you are there it’s a very relaxing spot. Not to noisy not overcrowded. All perfect for relaxing at the evening. And it’s a rooftop so the view is good aswell.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Wall

restaurants.name: Dedgapao - Udomsuk
restaurants.address:

596 Sukhumvit 103 Rd, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Udom Suk lives up to its name! There's a wide variety of delicious food here, from the beginning to the end of the soi (lane). Today, I had the chance to try a restaurant near my house called "Ded Kaprao," located in Udom Suk Soi 28 and 30, right on the main road. The restaurant is a good size, and there's street parking available. Their signature dish seems to be the basil pork with lava egg, but today I ordered a fluffy omelet with minced pork basil stir-fry. The flavor was spicy and rich, in the restaurant's signature style. Importantly, they claim all their recipes are MSG-free. I think it's perfectly balanced. A little note about the service: genuine service from the heart is what truly wins their loyal customers. Trust me, you'll find everything you need here. (But the prices are a bit high!)
sample_reviews_en.author: ลุงหนานCEOร้านลาบ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited this place during my trip to Thailand and it was one of the best Thai basil stir-fry (Pad Kra Pao) meals I’ve had. The food was freshly cooked, full of authentic Thai flavors, and the spice level was just right. The portion was generous and the price was very reasonable.

The staff were friendly and the food was served quickly. If you’re looking for a delicious and authentic local Thai meal, I highly recommend this restaurant. I’ll definitely come back the next time I visit Thailand. Greetings from Singapore! 🇸🇬
sample_reviews_en.author: S. Wor

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I I’m in Bangkok, I task myself with trying someplace new and local. This time around, I stumbled upon this place, the menu looked really good so I decided to give it a shot. And let me tell you, it did not disappoint! The flavors were powerful, the seasonings are delicious! And the spice was just right. Not to mention the owner, and the staff were very pleasant and hospitable. If you are in the area, or have time to come to the area please stop by here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Amari Dixon

sample_reviews_en.text: Eating at the restaurant might make your nose sting a little. Parking is available in front of the shop, but you might need to check with them about parking restrictions during certain times. As for the taste, it's excellent. One of the best restaurants for making delicious and flavorful basil chicken/pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kan Shida

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually don't eat MSG, and I liked that this restaurant didn't use it in their cooking. However, the "Seafood Basil Stir-fry" disappointed me; the portion was too small for the 89 baht price. I probably won't order it again. Price isn't the issue, small portion isn't the issue if it tasted good.
sample_reviews_en.author: alex wiwa

sample_reviews_en.text: Does not take cards. Kind of an inconvenience. They only take scan pay. That sort of ruined my experience. Then I tried to place an order on line. They wouldn't honor the coupon that line applied to my order. Although the food was good, I probably will not return.
sample_reviews_en.author: 5 Star Reviews

sample_reviews_en.text: They're not very welcoming to customers, focusing primarily on pre-orders (which explains their consistent sales). I've eaten there more than twice, and the staff are rude, making faces, and acting like they don't care about customers. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanatsha M.

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff recommended the promotional menu items. The taste was good and delicious. There are 4 tables available for dine-in, spaced apart. The braised beef with basil dish was a bit small in portion and the beef was quite salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aoi C.

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารอินเดียใกล้ฉัน
restaurants.address:

บ้าน, เลขที่ 280 ซอย inthamara 57, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch has buffet options at 299 (40 menus) and 399 (80 menus), with a 120-minute time limit. All the dishes seem to be freshly made, so there might be a slight wait. The food is tasty, though some dishes are a bit salty. The desserts are extremely sweet (if you eat them all at once!), so it's better to eat them slowly to avoid realizing how sweet they are. The butter chicken was delicious the first time I ordered it – sweet, creamy, and crunchy. The second time it was saltier but still tasty. The staff were polite and provided good service. The atmosphere has an Indian feel to it.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHE PRO

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a buffet at this restaurant, and the portion sizes were just right.
The Chicken Butter was creamy and slightly spicy, with a great flavor. The grilled chicken masala curry was another delicious option; the grilled chicken in the curry was fragrant. We ordered it with garlic naan.
The Baigan Bharta was also good, with a nice eggplant flavor that was enjoyable. The chickpea curry here uses very large chickpeas.
You can specify how many Pani puri you want, which is a great feature.
We ordered the masala chai with spices; it had a wonderful aroma. They use real green cardamom here.
sample_reviews_en.author: P K.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, with flavors adjusted to suit Thai palates. The service was excellent. I'm not sure if the woman was the owner or a staff member, but she gave great recommendations, explaining the flavors and suggesting which dishes to order. She even let us sample the dishes if we were unsure about the taste – so lovely! They offer buffet, à la carte, single dishes, and set menus – everything you could want. The prices are reasonable, the portions are generous, and the food is served piping hot. They even offer to pack up any leftovers for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tawanwad Duangchai

sample_reviews_en.text: Since I have only tried Indian food once before and am not very knowledgeable about it, it took me a while to order. However, seeing the many certifications displayed in the restaurant and tasting the food that was served, I truly experienced the essence of Indian cuisine. In particular, I cannot remember the name of the dish, but it was absolutely amazing when eaten with naan. My wife and I said how delicious it was several times. The drinks also left a fresh impression on me. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: GWANGCHAN YU

sample_reviews_en.text: Tiny restaurant located inside an alley just opposite Soi 77.  Only a handful of fresh food choices like dal, mixed veggies, egg curry, etc. are prepared daily. Other items on the menu are previously cooked, frozen and heated up for quick service. They also have 299 Baht All you can eat Buffet.  When the only server is absent, it becomes difficult by one person to both cook and serve including taking orders. Freshly cooked food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asahi K

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious! Everything was tasty.
The portions were quite large, great value for money.
I recommend coming with a group so you can order many different dishes.
All dishes are made fresh, so there might be a slight wait.
The garlic naan bread was amazing – hot, thin, soft, and fragrant.
The lime juice and yogurt drink were refreshingly tangy and great for cutting through the richness of the food.
Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fon Prum

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Indian restaurant offers both à la carte and buffet options. Prices are 199, 299, and 399 baht. We tried the 399 baht option, which included drinks.
Some dishes took a while to prepare.
Not recommended for those who dislike salty food, as almost everything is very salty.
The owner provided good service and even helped us find parking. Parking is difficult here as the restaurant is located in a small alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jintana K

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the portions are very generous. This is my second visit, and I wanted to try many things, but I always have to take leftovers home because I can't finish it all. But it's incredibly delicious! The service is excellent. The food takes a little while to prepare, which might be frustrating if you're very hungry. It's easy to get there; just get off the BTS at On Nut and walk 400 meters.
sample_reviews_en.author: เจโน่ ลี

restaurants.name: Taimao Shan Restaurant
restaurants.address:

5, 5 Pracha Rat Bamphen Rd, Khwaeng Huai Khwang, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Similar to the food of our 1980s

I once visited a Burmese restaurant in Bangkok, Thailand.

They say there are 100 tribes living in Myanmar, but the place I went to last time was a restaurant that served food from four tribes.

This place, however, is a local restaurant for the Shan tribe, one of the tribes. This is not a place catering to tourists, but a local restaurant for the Sen people of Myanmar living in Bangkok.

It should be viewed as a restaurant that serves the authentic taste of their hometown, rather than offering fancy cuisine.

This looks like a sausage, too,

but it has a sticky texture and a significantly high carbohydrate content.

Before the 1980s, filling dishes like Gukbap and noodles were popular in Korea as well,

and the freshness of the raw ingredients, rather than the sauce, determined the taste of the food.

As countries become more developed, they focus on sauce blends, combinations, and diverse textures,

which forms their food culture.

In that respect, the leading countries in Asian food culture are

exactly three countries: China, Thailand, and India.

Well, that is my personal opinion.
sample_reviews_en.author: K 365bestfood

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Burmese restaurant is located in a small shophouse with only 4-5 tables. It was a completely new experience for us; it was the first time we'd ever tried Burmese food. We ordered the sticky rice noodles and braised pork. We liked the sticky rice noodles more; the taste was hard to describe but very delicious. The braised pork was similar to the jelly-like cold pork trotters served at Chinese banquets, but not quite the same. The restaurant is located on Pracha Rat Bamrung Soi 9, opposite Tops supermarket, further inside the soi.

If I have the chance, I'd love to come back and try other dishes. They have many interesting items on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐศรัณรัชช์ ยุ้ย กุลถวายพร

sample_reviews_en.text: Once, I went to this restaurant and had a terrible experience. I've never encountered such poor service before. If any of my friends go, I recommend cooking your own food because they charge a service fee. I've never seen a restaurant like this before where you have to pay a service fee, wait for breakfast, and the food doesn't even come together. The taste was also mediocre. 🙄 In general, I will definitely not return to this restaurant again. This one time was enough. Goodbye to this restaurant. As for the price, compared to other restaurants, it's quite expensive. I think it's not worth the money I paid considering the service I received. 🙄🙄
sample_reviews_en.author: Njims Momo

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is a real gem for someone who misses home and the taste of mom’s cooking from Northern Shan State, Myanmar. The flavours are truly authentic, just like the Shan dishes back home. Plus, the prices are reasonable! I do think they should add the menu in Shan language, though. I’ll definitely be coming back whenever I’m craving my mom’s cooking!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nang Lee Hark Onn

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s a simple local restaurant serving Shan traditional food in Huai Khwang. Overall, the dishes were quite ordinary, but I really enjoyed the complimentary hot and sour soup (စွန်ထန်ဟင်းရည်), which was a nice surprise. I wouldn’t go out of my way to recommend it, but if you’re in the Huai Khwang area, it’s worth trying at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: GlobeStepsby Yune

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this place as foods here are really delicious. Especially Tofu noodle (တို့ဟူးနွေး) is my favourite one. We tried shan noodle and shan fried rice including fried tofu and potato mala. All the foods are really yummy though. Easy to come here just taking MRT blue line and use exit 1, then walk around 10 mins to reach there.
sample_reviews_en.author: paing set soe

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there yesterday and I would like to give a small recommendation. The Shan noodles were not cooked properly, so the tomato sauce had a slightly green smell, which was not good. The sour cream was not good to eat, but the rest was okay. I would like to see the small things fixed.
sample_reviews_en.author: MWe Saing Hlaing

sample_reviews_en.text: Pork stick were small but charged 5bhat per stick when I have to bring my order myself to the tabel. I asked a waiter (wearing earring) to get us sauce, he asked me to go get myself. My eyes almost came out. Overall food is Ok but service is Big time SUCKS!!!.Never go there again 👎👎👎👎
sample_reviews_en.author: Y'ALL Pet Lovers

restaurants.name: Northeast Muan Suen (E-Sarn Muan Suen)
restaurants.address:

303 Rama VIII Rd, Bang Yi Khan, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northeastern Thai restaurant is not far from Pinklao Bridge and has a wide variety of dishes. The food is pretty good and the staff provides excellent service. You should definitely try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: อรรถพล ลาภูตะมะ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food in general was delicious. The bitter beef stew was especially good. There's no parking lot; you have to park on the side of the road. The prices are considered reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: jom

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northeastern Thai restaurant on the roadside in the Pinklao area has delicious duck larb.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tumnam Nuanual

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and affordable Northeastern Thai food in a great atmosphere. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratcha Kanoknitibune

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything on the menu was delicious. The music was nice and pleasant to listen to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thunyaporn N.

restaurants.name: ワイン酒場 CASK(カスク) トンロー店
restaurants.address:

858 ถนน สุขุมวิท 38-40 Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first impression was that it was a stylish, hidden-away wine bar.

However, the conclusion is that it was a very disappointing and unpleasant experience. I will never come back.

Upon entering, even though there weren't many customers, it took 50 minutes for the food to arrive after ordering.

I ordered shrimp ajillo and raw oysters, all things that don't take long to prepare.

The oysters that arrived were also excessively large and uncut. There's no way you can eat something like that in one bite. At the very least, they should be cut.

The interior was also unclean; there was dust on the display glasses, and the kitchen lacked cleanliness.

They even rolled up a dropped paper towel and used it as if nothing had happened. This is unhygienic, especially since it's visible to customers. This was the most unpleasant incident for me.

The selection of wines was also very limited for a wine bar...

There seemed to be many family members enjoying themselves, but...

By any measure, this is not a place to go as your first stop, and I wouldn't even come back as my second stop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Otokoume Food Hunter (Otokoume)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a casual wine bar where you can enjoy wine in a relaxed atmosphere. The interior features a U-shaped counter with seating for just 12 people, giving it a hidden gem feel.

Bottles range from 1000 to 1600 baht. Glass orders are available at 200 baht per glass. They offer a sufficient selection of white, red, and sparkling wines.

Even those unfamiliar with wine will find it approachable.

Of course, they also offer a variety of food. Their homemade hamburgers come in four different sizes, and they have a wide selection of pizzas, pastas, ajillo, cheeses, and more – everything is designed to complement your wine and meal.

With a pre-booked set menu, you can enjoy a full course meal for 500 baht per person.

However, reservations are required for two or more people, so it's recommended to go with close friends or companions.

Why not spend some time drinking, eating, and chatting freely with friends or your significant other?
sample_reviews_en.author: Shinichi Hoshi

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍷 CASK (Thonglor) is an adult wine bar with a quiet and warm atmosphere, feeling like a small private room – perfect for dates or gatherings with friends. 🍷
They offer a wide selection of wines, and you can order them by the glass, allowing you to easily sample many different types.

And the highlight is…

⭐️ The 499 THB course is the best!

It's incredibly good value for money.

The course includes:
・Salad
・Ahiyo (Shrimp/Seafood baked in olive oil)
・One special dish
・Hamburg Steak
・Pasta
・Cheese

The quantity and quality for only 499 THB is amazing!

I recommend ordering this course first, then you can order other dishes if you want to try more. ✨

If you want to enjoy wine in a relaxed atmosphere in Thonglor, this place is perfect. 🍷✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy Chanida

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is inexpensive and serves delicious hamburgers.

The hidden-away atmosphere and location are nice, but it's fairly well-known, and there are quite a few Japanese people there, so it might be difficult to have a private conversation as everyone can hear.

The prices of the drinks and the food are excellent.

The service was also good.

The parking fee is charged even if you use the restaurant, so it ends up being a bit expensive.

I recommend taking a taxi or walking.
sample_reviews_en.author: チャッキー

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were friendly and the menu was written in Japanese. They also had a selection of wines. The burrata cheese and Thai mushroom salad I ordered to go with the wine was delicious! I visited because I wanted to drink wine, but I wasn't interested in listening to other Japanese people's conversations... It seemed like a place where expatriates gather to exchange information (for better or worse).
sample_reviews_en.author: chomo

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came to this wine bar, which is a little hard to find, but serves delicious food. 

The day before, we had a 499 baht course and two bottles of wine for the four of us, but the hamburger was so delicious that we came back two days in a row. 

This time, they serve red wine by the glass, so we ordered a glass of what appears to be the house wine. 
Of course, we didn't forget to order a hamburger.
sample_reviews_en.author: 山田次郎

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's more of a Western-style pub than a wine bar. It doesn't particularly specialize in wine; in fact, the wines they stock are comparable to those in the 2000 yen range at Japanese shops.

The hamburger steak was particularly memorable and delicious. It seems to get crowded on weekends, so reservations are recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: K M

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a recommended Western restaurant. They also serve the menu items from the neighboring Ito-ya restaurant, so even customers who don't like Western food can enjoy it.
Recommendations include cold cuts (cheese and smoked meat), hamburgers, pasta, and pizza.
All of the menu items are sure to please Japanese palate.
sample_reviews_en.author: shu shu (Shu2)

restaurants.name: ครัวเงินถุงเงินถัง
restaurants.address:

324 Soi Charoen Nakhon 34, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered food via Grab and tried it out. The taste was delicious and the portions were huge! They weren't stingy with the ingredients at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Witchulada Amornsomkiet

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was terrible, like something offered to ghosts. I ordered via Grab and waited almost 2 hours. Very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rattana

sample_reviews_en.text: I order grab and get discount from grab+credit card (SCB). The food is good in the proper portion. The taste is ok.
sample_reviews_en.author: BHRD o

restaurants.name: Ohkajhu The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 3 ห้องเลขที่ 343, 344 ที่อยู่ 3522 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat at Ohkajoo and know they serve large portions. I initially ordered a salmon salad and another dish at the queue counter. After a while, a staff member informed me that they were out of gas and asked me to change my order. I asked how long it would take, and they said it might. So I changed my order to chicken steak instead, because they couldn't fry anything due to the gas shortage. I agreed and waited for the chicken steak, but it took a very long time. I followed up with the staff 3-4 times, until finally I couldn't wait anymore. I asked the staff to check on my order and said I wanted to cancel if it wasn't ready. The staff said it would take 3 minutes, and then it was served looking like the picture. I felt it was usually much better; there was no pumpkin or cucumber. Compared to the restaurant's sample picture, it was nothing like it. I waited so long, and then to receive food that looked like it was hastily prepared, I wasn't very happy with this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: yamolporn wamaputta

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended for anyone who wants to eat loads of vegetables!!!

The portions are generous, full of ideas, and there are many edgy menu items. Many of the dishes are made with vegetables grown in their own garden. Many of the drinks and other items are healthy and there is a wide selection.

It's located in the restaurant area of ​​the mall, but it always seems busier than other restaurants. This makes you think that this is due to the increasing number of health-conscious people.

It's so busy that the staff seem to be having a hard time. However, they are all kind, polite, and friendly.

If you want to eat lots of delicious vegetables and fruits, be sure to stop by. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kori Planning

sample_reviews_en.text:
We eat at this branch very often with our family. We like that they now offer more menu options in small and large sizes. The vegetables are fresh, the taste is good, and it's great for seniors because of the many vegetable dishes.
We always order the spinach and cheesy gratin twice.
Teenagers eat the fried chicken (though it seems a bit oily).
The cheese balls are amazing! You MUST order the cheese balls!!!🤣🤣🤣🤣🤣

There are large tables available, and wheelchairs are accessible, but it's better to leave your wheelchair with the staff as the aisle is quite narrow. We order a lot, sometimes ordering multiple servings of certain items, for about 4,000 baht for 8 people.
sample_reviews_en.author: uxsry

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went to The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi for the 3-day Thai Football Jersey Festival — and stumbled upon this hidden gem when we weren’t sure where to eat.

Easy to find — 3rd floor of the mall. We took the MRT Blue Line, transferred to the Yellow Line, got off at Bangkapi station, and followed the signs straight to the mall.

Ambience & service were decent. Super busy — almost full house.

🍽️ We ordered a grilled chicken salad and a small portion of pork ribs. Portions were huge — so glad we didn’t order more, couldn’t even finish these. Flavor was on point, ingredients were fresh. Definitely coming back if I get the chance! 🥗🍖
sample_reviews_en.author: HAOLIN LI

sample_reviews_en.text: Waited more than an hour for the food, was told to wait for dish to be redone as initial order was not prepared according to instructions. Once the new dish was ready, it was served to another table, before another waiter realized they have made a mistake and then serving us that same dish. Terrible experience on New Year's eve. Kitchen was not busy, redone order was not prioritised (and seems to requeue from the start). Different staff informed about validity of the promotion (guy said there's a promotion, lady said that it's incorrect). Extremely disappointed after having good experience of the same brand in Chiang Mai.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jun Soh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ohkajhu X Phedphed caters to those who love spicy and flavorful food but also care about their health.
💵 Pay for 1, get 2 dishes for 495 THB. Offer ends 30/9/68.
🥗 Salmon Steak with Spinach and Truffle: Large, thick piece of fish.
🌶️ Spicy Fermented Fish Sauce Noodle Soup with Fried Chicken and Mixed Vegetables.
Be warned, it's very spicy! The fermented fish sauce is thick and fragrant. Pour the sauce slowly because it's extremely spicy.

Enjoy 2 delicious dishes for only 495 THB!

#OHKAJHU #OhkajhuVegetableGarden #Ohkajhu #ORGANIC #GrowingVegetablesBecauseWeLoveMom #SuperValuePromotion #TravelUntilTheCatScratches
sample_reviews_en.author: Cat Travel

sample_reviews_en.text:
This salad shop serves large portions, but the prices per dish are quite high.
The overall quality of the food is good. I really liked the salmon steak with spinach. The salmon salad was spicy and helped cut through the richness, and the truffle soup, in my opinion, could have been more concentrated.

This branch has an open-plan design and is decorated in mint green, in keeping with the brand's identity. There was a steady stream of customers, and the wait time wasn't long. The staff were quick, but the food took a little while to come out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Littlepaw

sample_reviews_en.text: In a world or disconnected reality where denizens of Thais queuing to eat a marginal mediocre salad restaurant is beyond me. First red flag was the q system that forces you to order in advance outside giving you a rushed experience instead or a relaxed environment. A lot of the menu items were not available or ran out towards the end of the day (poor ingredient management). The salmon showcased on the menu was a nice slab but the real piece cane out 60% of the size. Oh kah ju no more for me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tai

restaurants.name: พาเพลิน Bar & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

52, 29 ลาดพร้าว Phlabphla, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10312, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, there are a lot of people, the music is great, it's suitable for meeting up with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supachai Thaicharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: Great music, delicious food, cheap beer, Mahatthai style. But parking for cars can be a bit difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Nawarit

sample_reviews_en.text: Pa Plearn lives up to its name as a live music restaurant. Sit and listen to the music, enjoy the friendly atmosphere. The table arrangements are not crowded. The service is very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paiboon Srecummoon

restaurants.name: Sripol Seafood
restaurants.address:

61/12 Rama IX Soi 7, Khwaeng Huai Khwang, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The seafood is genuinely fresh and the portions are huge.
The menu isn't extensive, and you need to order in advance because there's only one chef.

Emperor Clams - Truly lives up to the name "emperor," incredibly fresh, and the seafood dipping sauce is excellent, not too spicy.
Steamed Grouper with Dipping Sauce - Fresh and delicious fish, filleted for easy eating.
Grilled River Prawns - Large, otherwise similar to typical river prawns.
Salted Fish Fried Rice - The best dish, with a unique and fragrant salted fish flavor, and the most important dish (without this, we probably wouldn't have been full).
Stir-fried Green Beans with Crab Claws - Came last, so the saltiness of the fried rice overpowered the flavors, making it seem a bit bland.

In summary, the taste is great and the portions are genuinely large.

Value for money depends on individual perceptions.
We went with 7 people, ordered 5 dishes, and it came out to 4,000 baht per person.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chut Nakornchai

sample_reviews_en.text: This seafood restaurant in Soi Chong 9, which I visited many years ago, was back again today with a group of five. We ordered steamed crab (smaller than before), fried shrimp, blanched cockles with peanut dipping sauce, stir-fried green beans with shrimp roe, fried rice, and sea bass wrap. Each dish was large; we couldn't finish everything and had a lot left over to take home. It seemed like we were the only ones having dinner tonight.
sample_reviews_en.author: พร้อมพูล ชอบเพื่อน

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best dish is the salted tiger fish fried rice. The rice is perfectly cooked, fluffy grains, and served hot with an irresistible aroma. The restaurant serves only one table at a time, with the owner cooking and serving personally, creating a very friendly and welcoming atmosphere.

Here’s how I’d define this place: Those who eat never pay; those who pay never eat.

A hidden gem!!! 💎
sample_reviews_en.author: Phaiboon Trikanjananun

sample_reviews_en.text: It's too expensive. My stomach felt uncomfortable and I had diarrhea after eating the blood clams. The price per person is outrageous. It's really more expensive than a five-star hotel, just like the reviews said. It's not worth it. Seafood markets and street restaurants are just as good, but they only cost one-sixth of this price. It's shockingly expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Olivia

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious. The menu is limited, but the chef uses the ingredients well. It's expensive. There were only two tables occupied in the whole restaurant, so it's recommended to call and reserve a table. There is parking available in front of the restaurant.

High-end Thai cuisine. A bit expensive but totally worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: prakaipan ถนัดโซ้ย

sample_reviews_en.text: BEST FRIED RICE in town. It's a MUST! Gaelic giant grouper is also on the list. Everything is quite gigantic with top quality indeed. It's always better to come in a large group. The place also offer private seating or rooms. Make sure advanced booking is made and prepare to spend big bucks!
sample_reviews_en.author: Preeyakorn Palm

sample_reviews_en.text: The seafood was incredibly fresh, and the pieces were huge! I've never eaten seafood this enormous before in my life. The clams were perfect, and the steamed sea bass with dipping sauce was amazing – crispy, sweet, and incredibly addictive. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Supanut_P

sample_reviews_en.text: The size is matter! The place you find jumbo size of clam, river prawn, grouper & crab. Bring 7-10 people to enjoy variety of food with huge portion! Prepare to pay 3000 baht per person or more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

restaurants.name: Kobe Steakhouse
restaurants.address:

Central Plaza, FL1, 160 ถนน พระรามสอง Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old Japanese restaurant, passed down from my grandparents' generation, back when it only had one location in Siam Square, and now it's run by Boy P.

The food tastes just as good as before, but this branch has fewer menu items than other branches. They don't have the same sashimi as other locations; only salmon is available. If you want other types of sashimi, you have to go to another branch. I informed the staff at this branch, and they said the head office isn't supplying sashimi to this branch. They only have the items they mentioned.

The restaurant is quite small, but it's perfectly fine to dine there as it's not too crowded. However, the tables are a bit cramped. I wish the restaurant were bigger so customers could sit more comfortably.

Anyway, I'll keep coming back; it's a long-standing favorite of my family's.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitibordee Yindeear-rom

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a very Japanese style decor. The prices are reasonable, not too cheap and not too expensive, but there's a 10% service charge.

The taste is good, both the fish and chicken steaks. The meat isn't tough, but it's not particularly tender either. However, I have a strong complaint about the sweet egg omelet; it was extremely cold, like it had just been taken out of the refrigerator and served.

The staff seemed a bit rushed. When refilling the green tea, it overflowed, spilling onto the table and then onto the floor.

Another incident involved refilling the dipping sauces. They refilled sauce A, but when they lifted the spoon, sauce A accidentally spilled onto sauce B.
sample_reviews_en.author: wasun wasunn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, but the service needs improvement. For example, if a dish is taking longer than everyone else at the table, the customer should be informed when the order is placed. When the customer inquired about the order, the staff replied that it was because the customer ordered fish, which caused the delay.

The kitchen should also manage the time between orders more efficiently, ensuring that there isn't a significant 5-10 minute gap between orders.
Everyone else at the table had finished their meals, while this person was left waiting.

The manager should understand that this is the standard service practiced by other restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anicha K

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a legendary teppanyaki restaurant. When you come here, you must order the hot plate steak set. Dip the beef in mayonnaise, add scallions and sesame oil, and eat it with Japanese rice.
For spicy food lovers, I recommend the spicy bulgogi pork set and the kimchi fried rice. It's fragrant from the hot plate and incredibly flavorful. If you want to cut through the richness, order the hiyashi chuka (cold noodles) or sip on the hot soup from the tempura udon. For appetizers, try the takoyaki. The food at this restaurant tends to be on the milder side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poppydoo

sample_reviews_en.text: This steakhouse offers more than just steaks! They also have Japanese food on the menu, including salads, appetizers, sashimi, and salmon – a wide variety. Prices are affordable; you can order a set meal for just 3 red banknotes (approximately 12,000 baht). Sets include rice, soup, and a drink, ensuring a filling meal. The steak here is premium quality, incredibly tender and flavorful. The staff provides excellent service, and the food comes out quickly. Highly recommended! Definitely worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiamporn Chaichana

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time at this branch. There was only one other table occupied when I went.
_The food didn't take long to arrive.
_The staff weren't Thai, but they were polite and attentive.
_The food quality and freshness were quite good.
_The flavors of the food weren't very balanced. For example, the sauce on the steak didn't go well with the dish, and the sauce on the hamburger was too strong.
Overall, there wasn't a single dish that stood out; the flavors were just average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana Relax

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant needs to manage its rat problem better. Today, while I was ordering, a rat ran out of the kitchen. I let it slide because I like the food and the staff are friendly. But while I was eating, another rat ran up to the table next to me, jumped onto our table, bumped into my feet, burrowed across the table, climbed onto a chair, and jumped to another table where an elderly woman was eating. So I stopped eating and left.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy K

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was average in taste, nothing outstanding. The ingredients were quite good. The fish steak, according to the staff, was sea bass, not dory, which was okay. The set meal included one drink and a small plate of fruit after the main course. Overall, the price was reasonable and good value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phonchai Lai

restaurants.name: KFC Harbor Pattaya
restaurants.address:

1st Floor, Harbor Pattaya, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Looking for a place to feed underprivileged children in Chonburi? When kids want fried chicken, they think of KFC.
We called the KFC network.
We had a problem with 94 children, including teachers and staff.
It was difficult to find a branch that could accommodate them because the restaurant was closed and unable to accommodate other customers.
This branch helped coordinate with the Computer Building to provide tables and chairs.
This mission was born. The children enjoyed the little things that everyone is used to. They pressed the refill button and enjoyed themselves. They enjoyed 26 large buckets of fried chicken. The children ate until they were full, and everyone left with smiles on their faces.
Thank you to the restaurant and Baan Jing Jai for making this good deed a success.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tawee Jittibopith

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is hot, fresh and super tasty. I got here after being so hungry and I felt awesome having food here. Ambience is so peaceful it’s in the Harbour mall. Rates are very reasonable you could get stomach full of food for less than 150 THB.
I recommend you to have either 129 combo or 149 combo which is more than enough.
Here you get soft drinks with all combos which you can refill.
sample_reviews_en.author: MOHAN KUMAR

sample_reviews_en.text: A typical KFC branch. They serve chicken, just like everywhere else. Prices are standard, and the service is fast and polite. The staff doesn't understand much English, but you can always point to a picture to order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vladimir Borozenets

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered via grab. Delicious KFC. Chicken is fried so fresh so crispy! Must order the wingzzab! It is so spicy and a hint of sourness. Very nice. Can skip the wrap, tastes more like kids food. Yummy!
sample_reviews_en.author: rocksando

sample_reviews_en.text: Order in line App. Very bad service. The staff forgot to put the Pepsi in the bag, so the order was late. The drinks weren’t cold as expected. Very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: your roy

sample_reviews_en.text: Someone tried to use my sons credit card that he stole  here do yall know him ..the name on card is wysdem caesar
sample_reviews_en.author: Marvin Culver

sample_reviews_en.text: They dont have menu written in English, only Thai language, so we selected food from pictures or posters
sample_reviews_en.author: cutelady baluch

sample_reviews_en.text: If you look at KFC itself, it's just okay. The Harbor building itself is nothing special.
sample_reviews_en.author: TONGTONG GOLF

restaurants.name: Yimsoo Cafe
restaurants.address:

ซอย, 39 Arun Amarin Rd, Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: To be honest, at first I thought the good reviews were just out of sympathy, since other reviews only mentioned people with disabilities. But after eating, wow, it was incredibly delicious and worth the price! I had two dishes. The first was ✨Special Boat Noodles (70 baht). The portion was generous, the noodles were perfectly cooked and didn't stick together, and the liver was outstanding – cooked through but not tough, bitter, or smelly. It was so delicious, I'll definitely order just the liver next time! The other dish was 🌟Teriyaki Chicken. I didn't have high expectations, but it was the best! Better than the chicken in the mall. The chicken skin was crispy with no burnt marks, perfectly pan-fried, the chicken pieces were large and tender, and the teriyaki sauce was well-balanced and fragrant – not the thick, sweet sauce like other places. The miso soup was also good, with plenty of seaweed and tofu, only 99 baht. There's also a set with a drink. The only downside is parking; you have to park next to the restaurant, but for this taste and price, I'd park wherever! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Hatsadin Riangtonglang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food and drinks are inexpensive. We ordered 3 items (noodle soup + teriyaki chicken rice + peach tea = only 199 baht 😋).
They have a diverse menu. This is my second visit. I tried the boat noodle soup with pork; the noodles were perfectly cooked, the broth was rich, and the pork was tender and delicious. The only downside was that the crispy pork rind topping was a bit chewy. The teriyaki chicken rice was also delicious; the chicken was tender and served with miso soup that tasted good and wasn't too salty.
The peach tea was a little too sweet, but refreshing. The bread and bakery items were also delicious. The sausage bread was very soft.

The staff were quick, smiling, and very dedicated. The restaurant is clean and the air conditioning is cool.
I'll go back to try the tonkatsu pork cutlet; it looks tempting. The spaghetti with pork sauce also looks interesting.
I'm happy to be supporting people with hearing disabilities. 💝
Highly recommended!
Parking is available on the sidewalks next to the restaurant in the alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jidapa Samphunjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Smile Cafe is a cafe run by people with disabilities.
The cafe is spacious, quiet, airy, and comfortable, perfect for working.
Upon entering, you're greeted with the amazing aroma of boat noodles. The cafe offers a variety of food, drinks, and cakes.

Ordering can be done by pointing at the menu or using sign language. There are videos demonstrating sign language usage.
The staff are very friendly; some may not be able to speak sign language, but there's a cook who can if you have any questions.
Regarding the food, we ordered boat noodles, which were delicious and a generous portion.
The cocoa was also delicious, rich, and not too sweet – we loved it!
Overall, the prices are reasonable, the portions are generous, and it's good value for money.

Parking is available on the street, but there aren't many spaces.

🚗 Visited on Saturday, June 7th, 2025.
sample_reviews_en.author: Plapangdaeng

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were finally able to visit Yimsoo today after returning from nearby Siriraj, and were able to find a roadside parking space reserved for the cafe's clients - just in time for lunch.😋😋
Both our boat noodle dishes were delicious and so was the plate of stir-fried mixed vegetables. The iced mocha mint did the job to beat the mid-day heat.
Importantly, everyone we met at Yimsoo today were welcoming, smiling ("Yim" means smile after all!) and appeared genuinely happy to work here. Wonderful! We will surely visit again when we are in the area and wholeheartedly recommend you to do so too.
Tip from Yimsoo: if street parking is not available, try nicely asking the security at nearby Amarin Mansion and say that you're visiting Yimsoo!👌
sample_reviews_en.author: GPO 5605

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is quiet, the atmosphere is nice and cozy, and the decor is beautiful. The staff are friendly, cheerful, and lovely, providing excellent service.
The cafe is staffed by hearing-impaired individuals, and you can communicate with them using sign language or by pointing to the menu items you're interested in. There are pictures of each menu item, including desserts and other food items, displayed on the counter.
There are also many beautiful paintings by disabled artists to admire, both around the shop and in the rooms inside.
There's a noodle shop with simple and appetizing dishes, and the food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varinthon Tangkitiwongporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This isn't just a foundation where you can view art and make donations; it also has spaces for events, including a café serving savory and sweet food and drinks, private rooms for small group activities (at an additional cost), and an art gallery showcasing artwork by the foundation's founders. All proceeds from your purchases, entrance fees, and souvenirs go towards the foundation's social activities.

The staff at the foundation are lovely and very helpful and accommodating.

Organizations, businesses, and companies can issue tax invoices for tax deduction purposes legally.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ha_NAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
This cafe, run by people with hearing disabilities, serves drinks, snacks, and single-dish meals at affordable prices. The food is delicious and clean.
The shop is spacious and beautifully decorated, with comfortable chairs for working. Parking might be a bit difficult; I recommend parking under the Arun Amarin Bridge and walking for only 5 minutes.
I am happy and touched to see people who refuse to give up in the face of life's obstacles 🙏💛 I will definitely go back to support them again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kit Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This cafe run by people with hearing disabilities is located in Soi Arun 39. Upon arrival, choose your table, inform them of your table number, and then order food by pointing to the menu. They serve drinks, snacks, and single-dish meals at affordable prices. The food is delicious, the place is clean, and the boat noodles are excellent. The cafe is spacious, beautifully decorated, and has comfortable chairs suitable for working. Parking is available in front of the cafe.
sample_reviews_en.author: แม่ ณิชา

restaurants.name: Yada Kitchen
restaurants.address:

20, 1 Khaosan Rd, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
There really is no reason not to recommend this place.

I stopped by to look around and have a meal, and even though it's right at the entrance, the prices are really cheap.

The food (I highly recommend the Pad Thai) is really delicious, and the drinks are great too.

When I ordered an orange smoothie, they squeezed all the fresh fruit right in front of me and made it while tasting it with a disposable spoon, so it was sweet and tasty. There are tons of places that put way too much ice in their smoothies and make them taste awful enough to throw away, but this place is genuinely good.
sample_reviews_en.author: 윤상혁

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited for lunch.

Usually, restaurants located at the entrance of tourist areas rip you off, but ultimately, the food here is delicious and reasonably priced.

Other super cheap places often have subpar taste, but that is absolutely not the case here.

I ordered one Pak See Ew. The harmony of the soy sauce and various other sauces, along with the seasoning, was just right. I think it ranks among the top tier of food I've eaten in Thailand. If there is nothing else around or you are hesitating to find a place to eat, give this a try! I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: 함츄츄

sample_reviews_en.text: TOTALLY agree with the other critical reviews, such a disappointment!  I ordered the pad kra pao with fried egg.  This should be a benchmark dish for any Thai restaurant in much of the country, and this dish was almost flavourless, with a watery sauce, no flavour, no spice, and not much basil.  I had to reach for the condiment rack to add spice and flavour.  Service was okay, took about 10-15 minutes from ordering to serving.  The inflated ratings must be from people who don't know how good Thai food can really be...
sample_reviews_en.author: Bubba Bri

sample_reviews_en.text: We've had better Thai food in Nebraska, USA. I understand farang are not local, but if someone comes to Thailand, they are at least open minded. What we had last week was the blandest, most soulless food we've had in a long time. Either the ingredients weren't fresh and you ran out of seasoning, or you are pandering too hard. The people giving you 5 stars will still give you 5 stars if you add flavor. If this was truly a misunderstanding I apologize, but it was 2 orders that were very bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Travelle

sample_reviews_en.text: I think it's cheap in Bangkok!!! The Pad Thai was so delicious and the Tom Yum Kung made with coconut milk is a bit rich so I prefer clear ones, but I changed my mind after eating here...!!! It wasn't greasy and it was so delicious that I thought this is Tom Yum Kung. It's a street food restaurant but it's very clean and nice. I highly recommend it!!
sample_reviews_en.author: 지나무

sample_reviews_en.text: Super good food, it tastes sooo delicious and the prices are also good in my opinion! I had a very delicious panang curry for 130 Baht. I asked them to put tofu inside, since I am vegetarian and it was no problem at all. Also the smoothie was very delicious. I came here 3 times already and I am looking forward to come back over and over again 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: raintwo

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a perfect place where the food is prepared with so much love and dedication. The service is outstanding; they are incredibly attentive and friendly to tourists. The hygiene is impeccable, especially for street food. They keep all their vegetables and meats refrigerated and are constantly washing all their utensils. Come, you'll love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: María Belén Constenla

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a bit salty overall, but it was good! I thought I got a good deal for the price, but I realized that restaurants on Khao San Road are around this price range. The fruit smoothie was really delicious :) Just so you know, they only accept cash! There is a currency exchange office right next door, so I exchanged money to pay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Celina Choi

restaurants.name: Mambo Yo-Yo
restaurants.address:

pattaya Sai Song Road, Tipp Plaza, Thanon Second, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s a 4 star restaurant! Food could be better but the Service was good and pleasant! Mexican Nachos are served on a bed of Green Salad ( with the cheese barely melted) which I never experienced before at any restaurant! Definitely not worth the 270 bht! As far as the Chicken and Pork Skewers are concerned,they were nicely presented , but my Chicken was definitely not Well Done ( it was medium at best ) as I was told by the staff and my Wife’s Pork was dry! Definitely there is room for improvement!
Keep in mind that there is no A/C and it’s a good idea to come after 6:00 pm when the Sun is down! I hope the Owner of this Restaurant reads my comments and improves the food!
P.s. I just read the Reply from the Restaurant Owner ( I presume ) in French suggesting that I should have returned the dish ( Chicken, I presume) to be cooked more! I suggest for the Owner to hire and train the cooking staff to cook the right way to begin with , which is done in good restaurants! If the business wants the repeat customers, work on the quality of your product and service! I do appreciate the reply though!
sample_reviews_en.author: Root66 Root66

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there because of its 4.7 rating, but I was extremely disappointed. First, the wine, over 900 yuan a bottle, came with a twist-top cap instead of a cork. The "cute" staff member even spent ages trying to open it with a knife using a wine opener. The wine itself was bad.

Next came the foie gras, which wasn't cylindrical like in the picture, but rather a thin pancake shape, topped with a lump of yellow butter or something similar. When it first arrived, we couldn't believe it was foie gras; we thought it was a biscuit with some yellow butter on top. The taste was also poor. We ordered two steaks, each over 700 yuan, and asked for them medium-rare, but they arrived cooked to a very rare or medium-well—too tough. We spent over 3000 yuan for two people, and what did we get? I strongly suspect the chef wasn't working today, and the kitchen staff were just cleaning staff.

The dining area is semi-open, and smoking at neighboring tables is allowed. I wouldn't recommend it for non-smokers. A large rat was running around while we were eating.

The only good thing was the service!
sample_reviews_en.author: hion

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were looking for a good place to eat on Google Maps and came across Mambo Yo-Yo. The reviews convinced us, so we made the walk from our accommodation specially to try it — and it was worth it. The food was fresh, full of flavour, and nicely presented. The green curry was well balanced, the rice perfectly cooked, and the chicken cashew nut stir-fry had a rich, savoury sauce. The seafood mix was also a pleasant surprise. Service was attentive and friendly, making the whole experience easy and enjoyable.

If there’s room for improvement, it’s in the details. The aubergine in the green curry was a little overcooked, and the beef (an unusual addition for green curry) was slightly chewy. Still, these were small points in an otherwise well-prepared meal.

They do not accept cards, only cash: so be prepared.

Overall, a surprisingly good dining experience with quality ingredients, great service, and food that leaves you satisfied and confident in coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert M.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's rare that I give a five-star review but I really like this restaurant. My friend and I have been there twice now and ordered the sword dinners or sort of Kabab. They basically use a large sword shaped skewer and barbecue your meal on the skewer. I believe that style of BBQ  or cooking originated in Argentina and it is really a fun way to prep your dinner.

You also get an appetiser and sides with the skewer dinner.

I suggest getting  the yellow curry sauce to dip your food in, but definitely expect to have "accidents" over your shirt front. Ask me why I say that....

I definitely think the food is good and the fun experience of the sword dinner is worth making a special trip down to Tipp Plaza for an evening, or I guess, an afternoon trip. If the owner is in, ask him for a sample of his homemade Mead liquor.  Interesting flavour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rob S

sample_reviews_en.text:
To my great regret:
1. at first the waiter mixed up our order and brought fried salmon instead of tuna;  2. I insisted that my dish be replaced.  Result: everything was quite tasty, but in the night I felt unwell and was actually in a state of poisoning for a day.  That is, as they say, I didn’t go far from the toilet.
By the way, nothing like this happened with my friends who agreed to eat salmon.  Apparently, the tuna was not fresh enough after all.

But overall a  nice cozy restaurant.  It's nice to sit.  I recommend you to visit, just check how the waiter understood you and ask him again twice - three times,
sample_reviews_en.author: Sergei Artemenko (We'll help)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dropped in for dinner as it was close to our accommodation. Decent variety in the menu with emphasis on the big skewers.
Tried the sausage skewer and thought it was quite tasty though there was a little less on it than appeared once stripped down.
The Vietnamese spring rolls were rather dry and a bit disappointing though the quantity was good.
Cocktails were nice and priced well.
Staff were attentive and service was good.
We did think food pricing on the menu was a little inconsistent with some priced well and others seemingly rather high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul H

sample_reviews_en.text: First of all, the atmosphere of the shop is very good, and the boss lady is very friendly, which is recognized. But I don't know why, this is the first time I am disappointed with the steak. The price of 3900 baht is not expensive, but there is too much fat. As shown in the picture, there is more fat than lean meat, so we just give up and choose another restaurant. The steak still did not reach Medium-well after the second cooking. Maybe this is just an individual case, but personally, this consumption is really too disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack Yu

sample_reviews_en.text:
The greatest tasting food in Pattaya. I loved trying all the assortment of skewers.
Very delicious, Very fresh and top quality.
The staff and management are very friendly and look after all your needs.
Take my word and find this restaurant as you will not be disappointed.
Thankyou to the staff for looking after me and having a taking the time to have a chat with me. I appreciated it alot.
I will definitely be back next holiday to Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lochlan Meres

restaurants.name: Bistro x Josh
restaurants.address:

35, 5 Mana Witthaya Alley, Khwaeng Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here based on reviews. Upon arrival, I found out they had Beef Wellington, which I wanted to try, but it requires reservations months in advance. Luckily, Chef Josh had enough meat to skip the queue and make it for me today. I had to wait 45 minutes, but it was worth it. The taste was even better than the one at Bread Street by Gordon Ramsay (although I think the pastry here was a little less than I'd like, and the beef wasn't as tender). While waiting, I ordered Calamari. It was well-fried and the squid was tender, but the dipping sauce had a strong fishy smell that didn't go well with the white wine I chose (how?).
The plating here is beautiful and impressive, as is the hospitality of the owner, Chef Josh, and Khun Hong.
The biggest inconvenience is the parking. The restaurant has reserved parking spaces on the street in the alley in front of the restaurant, which only accommodate 2-3 cars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aey Juntrakarn

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here because of the wine tasting promotion, but the experience was better than expected. Starting with the receptionist “Liger” who led us to our table and entertained us from time to time. I was really excited about the Wagyu A5 Ripeye because I am a meat lover. But my favorite part of the meal was the dessert, “Pavlova with Passion Fruit Sauce”. The perfect balance of sweet and sour that I think everyone should not miss. The wine list also has a good variety to choose. The atmosphere is comfortable and warm, suitable for sitting and chatting with friends or going on a date.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arreephan Seerai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chef cooks alone, and there's only one server. We went on a weekday, so it wasn't crowded. The food came out on time, without a long wait. The taste was delicious.
I especially liked the New Zealand Metharadium and the Spicy Salmon; they were incredibly delicious! But if you want something truly worth trying, it's the Wagyu Filet Mignon Wellington. Order it about an hour in advance. The meat is tender and juicy, the sauce is delicious, and the crust is thin and crispy. The mashed potatoes in this dish are the best part. Finishing off with red wine was perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phapreem P.J

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem, walking distance from BTS Wongwien Yai.

Parking spot is available but limited in front of the restaurant.

Foods are delicious and freshly made. Cozy ambience with super friendly and professional staff.

Strongly recommend and would visit again for sure! 💓

We ordered:
- Homemade Nacho with Seasonal Dip 200.-
- Lobster Bisque Soup Served with Garlic Bread 200.-
- Gnocchi with Tomato Concasse  240.-
- Pork Loin Wrapped in Bacon 360.-
- Creme Bulee Served with Homemade Ice Cream 200.-
sample_reviews_en.author: Chawisa Chen (Wendy)

sample_reviews_en.text:
First night in Bangkok and was looking for a decent dinner in the neighbourhood, and this indeed is a hidden gem.

Loved this place!

Ordered Arrabbiata and Carbonara.
The pasta was good, the presentation was out of this world just wonderful 👌🏻
Went there in January and the place still had Christmas decorations which was joyful.
Loved the atmosphere, the music, and the staff.
Would definitely go back to try the calamari.

The prices are reasonable 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Rawiya AL-Riyami

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is taste good , however the presentation and quality of some ingredients is lower than it should be ; Octopus is so hard, river prawn is not fresh.

Pork chop steak and mash potatoes is great!! Waitress service is amazing :-) and atmosphere is just warm feel like eating at home, we will come back for sure.

We went for Valentines set with wine pairing for 6,424 baht I will give 8/10 for Valentines dinner
sample_reviews_en.author: Usada Klinbhiboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place deserves a worthy mention for its tasty food, amazing presentation, and service quality. Especially impressed with the Penne Pesto with shrimp, super delicious! Generous food portion and well-seasoned dishes. Overall restaurant vibes were nice. We also got the complimentary Pavlova with passion fruit for our birthday occasion :)

Recommend to try and we would absolutely come again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lp Lp

sample_reviews_en.text: If the chef has the guts to serve burnt salmon wellington, then I think I should have a guts to write the comment too. Well, the pie obviously burnt to the point that I wonder how could he didn’t see it. Though the taste was good inside, but with no side dish 990 was not worth in my opinion. Still, how could he served the over cooked dish? it’s so unprofessional.
sample_reviews_en.author: Li Chin Cai (珍 チン)

restaurants.name: Summer's Pizza (Seenspace)
restaurants.address:

251/1, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Great pizza with a nice balance of flavors. The crust was crispy on the outside and soft inside. Service was quick and staff were polite. Worth the visit if you’re craving good pizza.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supisara Teerapappong

sample_reviews_en.text: On the menu the prize of the pizza is 280 baht but there is a hidden 17% tax fee on top, so in the end i paid 315 baht for probably the smallest pizza i ever got. …
sample_reviews_en.author: bart kriesels

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden Gem, owned and run by a Thai Pizzaiolo and the food you’ll just have to try for yourselves….. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Sayyid Taimur Bin Badr Bin Taimur Al-Said

restaurants.name: Sunbird Smoothie & Sandwich
restaurants.address:

263, 55 Thong Lo 13 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the pepper pesto chicken sandwich. It was alright it costs extra to get it toasted  which I did but I think that’s a bit ridiculous. It wasn’t the best sandwich I’ve ever had, personally I wouldn’t come back for it. The service was good as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wendy

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice industrial, artistic environment with excellent AC. I liked how calm and quiet it was in the morning. The service was fast and the cashier spoke great English. I had the protein powerhouse smoothie (nice creamy, dreamy, earthy taste …
sample_reviews_en.author: Lauren Payne

sample_reviews_en.text: The experience was very good overall, but the problem is that the menu is very small and the variety is limited. The oatmeal was excellent, and the egg sandwich was good, but the sauce was a little too much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manal Alshamsi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted delicious! The wait wasn't long, and the staff were lovely and very attentive.
The Korean egg sandwich was delicious, slightly spicy, and the kimchi added a nice kick.
sample_reviews_en.author: teya

sample_reviews_en.text: My favorite place for breakfast in Bangkok. Try pesto chicken sandwich or apple crumble oatmeal — it’s delicious. They recently got a coffee menu, so more reason to come back :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Irina Novikova

sample_reviews_en.text: The oatmeal is delicious, especially the date crumble with its lovely caramel flavor. The restaurant has a quiet and peaceful atmosphere, and there's free parking for one hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narueporn Leelanuwong

sample_reviews_en.text: The strawberry mint smoothie was delicious. I had the egg mayo sandwich which was also good, the sourdough bread is fresh. Nice style and friendly staff. i will come back !
sample_reviews_en.author: Lui Kohl

sample_reviews_en.text:
The brunch is delicious, the shop is cute, and the vibe is great.
The butter jam they make in-house is amazing, and the homemade peanut butter is the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: sunisa sansri

restaurants.name: บะหมี่ไข่ เชฟเหม่งตลาดพลู Bameekai Chefmeng taladphlu
restaurants.address:

สี่แยกใต้ 1125 ถนน รัชดาภิเษกถนนเทอดไท กรุงเทพมหานคร TH สะพานตลาดพลู Talat Phlu, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a local restaurant that's more decorated than a typical local eatery. We waited 5 minutes for a table. The atmosphere was decent. We ordered three dishes, and they were all good. I especially liked the noodles – chewy and springy, delicious in any dish. I particularly liked the honey pork noodles (only 29 baht!), sweet and delicious with tender vegetables, but the small bowl might be a bit overwhelming. The wonton wrappers were very thin and slippery, which I liked, but the soup was just okay; it reminded me of my mom's homemade clear soup 😂. The Tom Yum noodles were a surprise! At first glance, I wondered if it was a "drunkard's" style, but it came dry (I hadn't seen a picture or review beforehand). It was delicious, a little rich, but the shrimp were huge! The price was incredibly cheap – three shrimp in one bowl! I thought it would cost over 100 baht. This meal, including drinks, was over 160 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: bowlyngz

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍜 Egg Noodles
The egg noodles are chewy and firm, not mushy, and pair perfectly with the flavorful, aromatic, and moderately spicy broth. Adding an onsen egg (soft-boiled egg) makes it even better! 🥚
🥩 The pork is tender and not tough, the meatballs are bouncy, and the toppings are generous for the price.
The restaurant has a vintage Chinese style decor, making it great for photos with many cute corners to enjoy.
We went on a Sunday around 8 PM and only waited in line for 10 minutes before getting a table.
sample_reviews_en.author: กรวรรณ ไชยฤกษ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw the reviews on T.T. and thought it would be like most others, just "overrated." Today, I had the chance to drive by and decided to try their braised duck noodles, grilled pork noodles, and spicy soup.

In short... wow, it's delicious! Especially the noodles, they're the best. Although it's expensive, it's worth it. The duck is very tender, the grilled pork is excellent, and the spicy soup is good...
sample_reviews_en.author: Opas Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum Seafood soup was perfectly seasoned and delicious without needing any extra seasoning. The price was reasonable, and the food arrived quickly. The cheese and pork dumplings were thinly fried, crispy, and easy to eat. The matcha latte was tasty, and ordering it with less sugar was just right. The Tie Guan Yin and Da Hong Pao teas were smooth and refreshing. <3
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiraphat Dej-am

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought noodles and wonton soup to take home. The takeaway price was 59 baht. The portion was just right. The noodles were delicious, both the flavor and the pork. The wonton soup was a bit too salty. I had to wait a long time, even though there weren't many people when I went. It took a while for each dish to come out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jitrawee Ngammanussiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Across the street is paid parking. You can call to order and pick it up, parking in front of the shop if it's not for long.
The bouncy pork is delicious, with a little cheese inside, but I didn't like the shabu-shabu pork; it was bland, dry, and thin. The noodles are thick, flat, but soft.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tahn Chai-a-ya

sample_reviews_en.text: The seating in the restaurant is a bit limited. The food is delicious, but the prices are quite high. The service is good. The noodles are delicious, and the dumpling wrappers are amazing. Parking is difficult to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: bo walaipron

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles were delicious, the roasted pork was fragrant, and the tom yum soup was flavorful.
Parking is available across the street from the restaurant, and there is a parking fee.
sample_reviews_en.author: D P

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวนายใบ้ย้อนยุค
restaurants.address:

