65/2224 ศิริสุข ซอย 1 Bang Phai, Bang Khae, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is clean, and you can park along the roadside. There's a fairly large selection of dishes on the menu. Overall, the food is pretty good for those who like spicy flavors. The Tom Yum soup is very flavorful, but if you order it dry, it's quite salty. The dry rice with sea bass is also delicious, but don't pour the fermented soybean dipping sauce that comes with it all at once because it's very strong; add it gradually.
Overall, it's worth stopping by if you're passing through. It's clean, air-conditioned, and has a wide menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตณสุทธิ์ จินดาสุทธิ

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here. The fried taro was crispy and delicious, freshly fried by the restaurant. The sea bass rice porridge was also very tasty. In short, everything was delicious. The staff were polite. I'll definitely come back again to try other dishes I haven't tried yet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siri

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers a hot pot option for groups, with 1-2 compartments where you can choose your own broth, such as clear broth, tom yum soup, etc. The prices are not too expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปิยะชัย แพร่พานิชชัย

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is reasonably priced, not too expensive. The pork satay is unique because it's not on skewers. The only downside is that the fish balls weren't fresh and had a fishy smell.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชัยโรจน์ ปัทมานนท์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the menu is well-organized and clear, and the atmosphere is decent even though each table is for one person only.
sample_reviews_en.author: T Ss

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch does not yet offer home delivery. You can call to place your order in advance and pick it up yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pairach Tiensirirerk

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is good. You can park on the side of Kanchanaphisek Road, just past the Charan 13 intersection.
sample_reviews_en.author: WKCONTO khieoon

sample_reviews_en.text: The popular foods taste .Near home .Conveniently dinner by the way when go home .
sample_reviews_en.author: Frank Wang

restaurants.name: การ์เด้น คาเฟ่ (GardenCafe)
restaurants.address:

28 Prasert-Manukit Rd, Chorakhe Bua, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff member was very friendly and polite, appropriate for a customer service job. They answered questions willingly and without rudeness. The atmosphere was pleasant, perfect for relaxing while waiting for your car to be washed.
sample_reviews_en.author: มนัสวี คําปาน

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem tucked away in an alley, but with parking available. The interior is decorated with charming paintings and a lovely gallery, plus a small, shady garden.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dararath Thummung

sample_reviews_en.text: While waiting for your car to be washed, there's a service area with delicious food and drinks in a nice atmosphere at reasonable prices. Highly recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Smile Tarada

sample_reviews_en.text: I sat and waited while my car was being washed. The atmosphere was nice, the drinks were decent, and they also had food to order.
sample_reviews_en.author: ASHIRAGOGOWA

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice, and there's a wide variety of food and drinks available while waiting for your car to be washed.
sample_reviews_en.author: T S

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice and the drinks are delicious. There's a car wash next door, so you can comfortably wait here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyarat Amnatharungsak

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. I like to stop by to get my car washed and then have a meal at this restaurant regularly. 👍🙂
sample_reviews_en.author: Risky

sample_reviews_en.text: The weather is nice today, no rain, perfect for sitting outside. The stir-fried curry is delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marin sew love ช่างเย็บบ้านๆ

restaurants.name: Kaprao and Co (Khaosan)
restaurants.address:

127 Thanon Tanao, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here to try authentic gapao rice for the first time!
The restaurant was very clean, and the staff were very kind and welcomed me to use the Wi-Fi, power outlets, and restrooms. The food was delicious too!!
If you don't like spicy food, I recommend ordering it at 0 (no spicy). When I told them I was Japanese, they played J-POP in the restaurant. lol
This is a restaurant you should visit at least once if you come to Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: まるまる

sample_reviews_en.text: I had some very delicious gapao rice. Even if you don't like spicy food, they offer a "no spice" option, so you can eat it with peace of mind! The staff were also very customer-friendly, playing Japanese music and even trying their best to speak to me in Japanese. I had a wonderful time and highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: ちゃりる

sample_reviews_en.text: Awesome place to have nice, affordable food. Good vibes, clean, friendly staff. Seating is very limited tho, there are only 2 sets of 4 and 2 sets of 2 tables. Highly recommend all to try this place when you’re in Khao San!
sample_reviews_en.author: J T

sample_reviews_en.text: Near Khao San Road, the staff member Nick was so kind, and the gapao rice was incredibly delicious! It was amazing! 😍🫶🏻 I definitely want to go back when I come to Thailand again!
sample_reviews_en.author: 徳永沙音

sample_reviews_en.text: The friendly service of the staff, who love Japanese people, was a great help! The food was also delicious! There are tourist attractions nearby, so I recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: 松﨑陽大

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely delicious! Just so you know, their food will delight you! The young and friendly team is perfect, well done again, and I wish you much success! 🙏😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Max

sample_reviews_en.text: This time I can't rate it better but I feel sorry for the "waiter" we ordered 4 portions plus a starter and one main course was missing
sample_reviews_en.author: Paulina

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was a great experience; the Wagyu beef krapao was amazing, and the tofu and egg option was great too!

I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Victor Lachambre

restaurants.name: Reims Bar & Bistro
restaurants.address:

507, 46 ซ. เทพหัสดิน Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The picture on Google Maps doesn't match the actual restaurant. It's not that big; it can easily fit about 10 people inside. It's located next to a hotel, and the actual dining area is very small. If you're coming with a small group of friends, it's a cozy place, like cooking at a friend's house. The menu focuses on pizza and spaghetti. The pizza is decent, but I wouldn't recommend the spaghetti.

The staff tried their best to provide good service, but because there were so many people and so many orders, and there was only one person working, the food was incredibly slow. Customers had to help serve themselves. 😅😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Gibguew U

sample_reviews_en.text:
Do not come. The price doesn’t match with the food you get…
We came here for the late lunch.
Order a Tom yum pizza + calamari + fries.
In the beginning I wanted the vongole pasta but they said they don’t have clams anymore.
The reason why we came was because reviews are great.
The pizza tasted like microwave dought…
Calamari and the fries were very oily…
So for the pizza + calamari + fries + beer + water = we paid 730 baht……
Totally not worth it.
I will not come back at all and do not recommend to anyone.
We were in Fam Time Steak so many times with the same price and 100% better food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivy W

sample_reviews_en.text: This cute little restaurant is located in Soi Sri Ayutthaya 8, behind the XT Phayathai condo, beneath the Oriental Smile Hotel (the street name on the map might be incorrect). Today I ordered the Carbonara with fettuccine pasta. It was delicious, not too rich, and the pasta was perfectly al dente – not too hard or too soft. The chef was very friendly and helpful, and you can ask him for recommendations based on your preferences. I'll definitely try his pizza next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thapanaphong Tubtimaramwong

sample_reviews_en.text: A great cafe with a very interesting interior, with seating both inside and outside. The prices are high, but the food is delicious. Apparently because of the location, there aren't many people there, so there's only one employee there. He's the one who calls you in, takes your orders, cooks, and handles bills. We ordered pizza and risotto, and everything was delicious. The pizza is made right there, in a special oven. In short, everything is superb!
sample_reviews_en.author: Александр Налевин

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing little spot!
It’s a small place where the waiter is also the cook, and he does an incredible job. We had the roasted chicken breast with gravy and the Carbonara both were amazing! The food tasted fresh and homemade, and you can tell he really cares about serving you and what he’s cooking. Super friendly, cosy vibe, and great value too. Definitely worth stopping by!
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Rattigan

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were looking for a good pizza spot and found this small restaurant close to our hotel.  Very friendly chef. Pizza was fresh with a nice thin crust. The Vongole pasta was delicious too.
Nice selection of beers and wine.
A very pleasant night. We would recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janet N

sample_reviews_en.text: Chef Dan is kind, courteous and a hard worker. The food was delicious. The service was great. Highly recommend the pepperoni pizza and spaghetti bolognese. We enjoyed our relaxing evening at this quaint spot in our neighborhood. We will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Char Y. Shada

sample_reviews_en.text:
We tried the seafood pasta, pizza and the steak, everything is so good to the point me and my friend licking the dish. The ingredients were all fresh.

Chef Dan is kind, friendly and present us with high quality food. Highly recommend. Such a hidden gem.
sample_reviews_en.author: PingSana Sana

restaurants.name: Bangkok Grill
restaurants.address:

285/2 ซอยวังหลัง ถนนอรุณอัมรินทร์ แขวงศิริราช Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating at this restaurant. I saw it looked inviting, so I decided to try it. There was no need to wait for a table because the restaurant was quite quiet. There was an unpleasant smell, but the air conditioning was nice and cool. After ordering, the food arrived within a normal timeframe – not too fast, not too slow. However, the taste was quite bad, and the portions weren't worth the price. The fish pieces were tiny, which wouldn't be a problem if the taste was okay, but it wasn't. The fish was very fishy, ​​and the french fries were so sour I couldn't eat them. For this price, considering the quality of the food, I felt like I wasted my money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thxnwarat Aimaxd

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had 2 cheese burgers and chips (takeaway) and it was just as pictured, a double beef patty with melted cheese, salad of lettuce, tomatoe and mayo, on a white bun.
Not huge size, standard size (macca's- McDonald for you yanks) chips are fresh and they gave us some tomatoe sauce and some chilli sachets.
Was sceptical to get western food in a local Thai market place, but happily surprised.
It was very neat, tidy and clean, with great air-conditioning, but not a special atmosphere, just like any fast food place back home.
I would recommend it for anyone who looking to escape Thai food for a meal.
4 stars because it is nothing fancy, but just as described.
sample_reviews_en.author: MaKy

sample_reviews_en.text:
• The atmosphere is quite quiet.
• The food is okay, but the pot shot was very tough and not juicy.
• The service, if it were me, would be a negative rating.
1. The menu was served as if it was thrown at me, and then the staff member disappeared without a trace, even though no one was there.
2. When paying, the staff member had a displeased expression. Other restaurants would probably say thank you. It was a terrible experience; I probably won't go back.

The service is quite bad. I recommend going to another shop if you choose to come to this one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Swed

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, and I was quite impressed with the taste of the food and the reasonable price (we ordered C5). My only minor complaint is that the staff were using their phones; if they could improve that, I'd give everything a perfect 5. I personally liked the atmosphere; it felt like going back to when I was a kid and eating with my family.
sample_reviews_en.author: mj momi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very disappointed in this steak house.
They use salting preservation meat (not fresh meat). And the beef steak which I was ordered is, I believe my sense of taste, it's not beef, it's PORK!! Also my small wish was ignored that I orderd it as Rare, but served one is as very-well-done.... If you say you would want to go anyway, I would not stop you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taro Sugano

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located in Wang Lang Market (the alleyway leading to Wat Rakhang), opposite Khun Daeng's Vietnamese Noodle Shop.

Prices start at around 100 baht, with average taste and quality. The shop is spacious, with plenty of tables and cool air conditioning.

Today, we ordered a 3-piece set for 369 baht (January 6, 2025).
sample_reviews_en.author: Pathitta D.

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was just okay. The steak was a good size, and the chicken was well-marinated and juicy, unlike the pork which was quite dry and tough. The black pepper sauce was watery and not very tasty. The prices have increased considerably compared to before. The atmosphere inside the restaurant is rather run-down and old.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neeranuch C.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is bland, but salt is available on the table, suitable for health-conscious individuals who can add salt to their liking. The food is freshly cooked, not leftovers. If it's not crowded, I recommend eating here; the wait time is short. Government discounts of 40/60 baht are available.

sample_reviews_en.text: I shop here every week. They always have new stock. The staff are very attentive and provide excellent service. They constantly message me via LINE to let me know about new arrivals and promotions.

sample_reviews_en.text: I regularly buy health food at this Baimiang branch. I like that they have a wide selection of superfoods, proteins, and carefully selected organic products. They also have monthly promotions.
sample_reviews_en.author: อนุชา นนทภา

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff member was very helpful and accommodating. They were able to reserve the items and let me pick them up later. Excellent service!

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff provided excellent service and gave great advice about the products. The snacks were delicious too.

sample_reviews_en.text: There were so many items! The pretty girl was very helpful and gave great recommendations. :)

sample_reviews_en.text: The store has a wide selection of items, the service is good, and it's convenient.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's good. Clean, convenient, the air conditioning is comfortably cool, and the staff are very welcoming.

sample_reviews_en.text:
19/5/68
"Kin Lab" is an Isaan-style restaurant, perfect for a chill roadside hangout after work, a great place to relax with friends for drinks, or a spicy dinner.
The menu mainly features beef dishes like larb and koi, with pork, duck, and chicken available. The taste is good and customizable; you can specify your preferred level of sourness, sweetness, richness, and saltiness.
The service is excellent.
The atmosphere is nice for a chill roadside setting, but it's not crowded with traffic. The restaurant is well-organized and offers a wide variety of drinks.
The restaurant is located on the roadside next to the expressway before the Suk Sawat-Rama 2 entrance. You can use GPS to find it.
Parking is available on the roadside in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: link kin pak

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The Thai papaya salad had lime pieces in it, so you had to squeeze the lime yourself. The peanuts weren't ground in the mortar but sprinkled on top, so you had to mix them in yourself.
- The minced beef salad was very bland; I'm not sure if they forgot to season it or not. Or maybe that's just how it's supposed to taste.

The beef stew had a rich broth, which was good. Everything else was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: HappY TriP

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled meat was delicious and not tough. The spicy dipping sauce was well-balanced. The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce was also delicious. This was my first time ordering it and I was impressed. I've passed by the restaurant many times but never sat down to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิภาทิพย์ วีรหิรัญธานนท์

sample_reviews_en.text: I've driven past this place many times and finally stopped to try it. I loved the fried chicken wings – they were amazing! Hot, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. Everything else was delicious too. Good service and reasonable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jedsada Supanchanaburee

sample_reviews_en.text: Last night, I stopped by and bought papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce, spicy minced meat salad (larb), and sticky rice to eat at home. It was delicious! I'll definitely be back to support your business again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theerapat R

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Northeastern food restaurants, there is papaya salad, Pork rib in spicy herb soup and more. In my opinion the taste is not outstanding as the long waiting order. Anyway you should try by your own.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natsima Chuenthammanat

sample_reviews_en.text: All the dishes were delicious. The prices were moderate, neither too cheap nor too expensive. There is seating inside the restaurant, but only a few tables, and also tables outside on the sidewalk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nontharat Thasapwisin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The price is really cheap, but the taste is terrible.
The papaya salad is excessively sour, the dipping sauce for the hot pot is also excessively sour, and the vegetables they provide are rotten.

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good Tom Yam Kung. Much better place than all of the restaurants for tourists nearby. Also much better priced. A lot of uniform and government employees eat here. I think it means something. They also have beer, but speak little English. Open 3pm - 11pm.
sample_reviews_en.author: Łukasz Chołajczyk

sample_reviews_en.text: It's located in the alley next to Wat Tri Mun, right on the corner. In front of the shop is a noodle and wonton shop selling roast pork and crispy pork. This restaurant offers a variety of à la carte dishes at reasonable prices, and the taste is decent.
sample_reviews_en.author: SWC

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious soup. It's best to arrive halfway through the street food opening hours. We were there at 8:30 PM and there wasn't much left. Very cheap, only 40 baht for the soup. There's a 7-Eleven nearby, so you can grab a cold, reliable drink.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karolina

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the ultimate Thai restaurant. A typical Thai restaurant that's neither good nor bad in every way. It's not so good that you'll groan, but it's not so bad that you'll click your tongue either. They used to serve unusual dishes like …
sample_reviews_en.author: kawashimas teshirou

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first visit. They also run a restaurant, but I came because I heard they had a ramen-like dish. The noodles were thin and the broth was light and delicious. I'll definitely go again while I'm in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: World Hiro

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious and quick food. The little stand at the front has a really great noodle soup, and we also tried several dishes from the menu. Everything was delicious!

Thank you for your hospitality 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Pilar Lips

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not too big portions, but delicious food. I jad chickrn -kale 2 times and noodles. They were great.

( I do not recommend soup in the evening as it has a bit of chemical flavour...probably MSG)
sample_reviews_en.author: Barbara Guttman

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and inexpensive Tom Kha soup with tofu. My Thai-speaking companion ordered it for me; I don't think the soup was on the menu, and the selection of vegetarian dishes is very limited.
sample_reviews_en.author: Seph

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_en.text:
A handmade Chinese dumpling and noodle spot that recently opened, but it is already always packed. The price and portion sizes are kind of crazy. One dish is already enough for a full meal. We didn’t realize and ordered five dishes, and barely managed to finish two.

The dumplings are made fresh in the shop and feel very hearty. You can choose from a few different sauces, which is nice. They also have several vegetable dishes as sides, but the portions are so big they could easily be a main dish on their own.

The soup noodles are only 50 baht and the bowl is huge. I ordered one even though I was already full. The broth was comforting and the noodles were well made, soft but still chewy with a nice aroma.

They also have some interesting items like fresh corn milk, which is only served hot. It’s very good but quite filling. Another thing that comes in a set is a chilled green bean dessert. It’s similar to Thai mung bean desserts, but not really my style.
sample_reviews_en.author: N S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the mixed-filling wonton soup. It's delicious on its own, with chili dip, and with pickled vegetables. I personally liked the seaweed filling the best.

The lettuce with garlic sauce was delicious!

The Three-Ingredient Shrimp Wonton Noodles:
The noodle texture was just okay. The sauce was like a mix of chili oil, mala, and sesame sauce. It was tasty, but got a bit cloying after a while. The shrimp wontons were delicious!

I wanted to order more because there are so many menu items, but this was enough for two people. Definitely coming back! / They also sell wontons by the kg for takeaway. The price was around 1xx (I can't remember the exact price), in case anyone wants to take some home.

The prices are reasonable. Everything in the picture cost less than 300 baht. You can park at the Kittisak Technical School across from the restaurant; it's 20 baht per hour.
I went at 10:30 AM; it wasn't crowded, very relaxing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuchy Chen

sample_reviews_en.text:
They've brought authentic Chinese cuisine here!
The side dishes and dipping sauces are amazing. I especially loved the salty pickled radish.

The snacks are fun to eat.
The fried items are crispy and hot!
- The potato chips are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.
- The spring rolls are okay, the filling is average. I probably won't order them again.
- The spicy wood ear mushroom salad is tangy and crunchy, very enjoyable. I'd order it again.

The dry noodles with pork dumplings are fantastic, delicious!
I didn't really like the noodle soup; the broth was bland, and the shrimp and crab egg dumplings were just okay.

Ordering via QR code might be difficult for older people. There are few staff members at the front counter; they focus solely on online orders and serving.

We came for breakfast. After 10:30 AM, it gets crowded and tables start filling up.
Parking is available at Kittisak School.
sample_reviews_en.author: NJM B.

sample_reviews_en.text:
When the restaurant first opened, I ate there every day. But as it got busier, they raised the prices, the quality deteriorated, they switched from lettuce to bean sprouts, and increased the price of the pork wonton noodle soup from 75 baht to 99 baht. I find that unacceptable. Also, water was initially free, but now you have to buy it. And please note that the prices do not include tax.

sample_reviews_en.author: thanawin preechhalertpiriya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yuan Ji Wonton Dumplings 🥟🥢

📍 Chinese Dumpling Shop

🥟 When I went this time, the dumplings were sold out, and even the wontons had to be made on the spot. If you want dumplings, I suggest coming early.

🥣 Wontons: Firm texture, but the taste was rather ordinary.

🥟 Pan-fried Dumplings: A bit too oily; this part could be improved.

🥩 Crispy Pork Belly: Actually, this was the most memorable dish; it had a spiced flavor and tasted very good.

🍵 Lotus Seed and Mung Bean Soup: A good dessert; a bowl after a meal is perfect.

👉 Remember to come early if you want their dumplings, otherwise the popular items sell out easily.

Second Visit: The dumplings were very ordinary 🥟, but the side dishes and desserts were quite good 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: 小威（LP）

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fresh, made-to-order Chinese dumplings with great side dishes and an active staff.

This authentic Chinese dumpling restaurant stands out because everything is made fresh to order, giving the food a wonderfully fresh and delicious taste. The dumplings pair perfectly with their tasty soups and sauces, and they even have a self-service sauce station where you can mix your own custom blend. Ordering is super easy via a QR code at the table, and the side dishes are both delicious and well worth the money for the portion size. With an active, attentive staff and a clean, high-vibe atmosphere, it makes for a fantastic and affordable dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: NNchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
A noodle shop that everyone seems to talk about, well known for its noodles and Chinese-style dumplings with various minced pork fillings.

The issue wasn’t unfriendly staff, but rather poor management and organization. Queue handling was unclear, there weren’t enough staff, and the wait was very long. There was no clear guidance on how to order, which made the experience confusing.

The flavors were average, the noodles were overcooked and mushy, and overall the operation felt unstructured and not fully in place.

If you plan to visit during this period, allow at least 1.5 hours just to get your food.
sample_reviews_en.author: MARINA PHONE

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on St. Louis Street in a two-shop shophouse. 🚗 We recommend parking in the school across the street; it's 20 baht per hour. You can scan a QR code to order and pay in advance. They offer a variety of dumplings, noodles, and some snacks. Orders will be served after they're prepared. There's a self-service counter with water, dipping sauces, condiments, and side dishes that you can help yourself to. Personally, I prefer the shrimp dumplings over the pork ones. The noodles are also delicious. My favorite dish is the lettuce with garlic sauce; it's really tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Phinun

restaurants.name: SO asean Cafe & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

139/4 Phaya Thai Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: As a Vietnamese, I’ve been missing food from Vietnam. I decided to order their food on grab. I thought that it would taste good since the pictures looked tasty and the stars were not too low. I got the grilled pork with spicy sauce and crispy pork size L. The food came in a state where the salad are not even fresh as you can see on the picture… on top of that it’s not clean you can see the “root” still sticking to the leave. The pack of vermicelli is half clean ? Half contaminated with pork belly ? Not even talking about the taste which is unflavored only a bit salty. The meat tastes like it has been there for a while (maybe cooked the morning or yesterday) I don’t know I don’t want to accuse the restaurant but it is the taste that I feel in mouth. I ordered crispy pork at other restaurant in Bangkok and none of them taste like this (not fresh and oily smell). I am deeply saddened to be forced to put 1 star and not 0. I never give bad reviews but for this case I am forced to. As a restaurant you should care about hygiene and mostly about freshness of what you serve your clients. This restaurant is not worth it don’t stop by there or even order from them.
sample_reviews_en.author: lisa Juuh

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was overcharged at this restaurant today.

Because it wasn't a Thai credit card, the exchange rate was different, and the store refused to refund me, saying the card amount was different from the Thai baht amount, and didn't want to directly address whether they had overcharged me.

I tried to communicate with them in Thai and English, but to no avail.

I won't comment on the taste, but this whole incident made me very uncomfortable, and I ended up having to swallow the money. Encountering something like this while traveling really ruins the mood.

Think twice before eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wu Corne

sample_reviews_en.text: I happened to walk by and the menu looked delicious. I was craving Asian food, and they had pho. It seemed like they had other promotions too. The prices weren't too high considering it's in a mall, and the food tasted really good. I just came back from Vietnam and ordered pho, and it tasted exactly the same! It felt like I hadn't even returned from Hanoi. Excellent! The staff were also very attentive. They had a matcha latte on sale for 65 baht instead of 120 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanchanok Nil

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I ordered the 199 baht promotional set: Lahpet, Pho, and herbal drink. The portions were great value for money. The Pho had plenty of noodles, pork sausage, and grilled pork. The Lahpet was also a large bowl. Both dishes had a very Thai flavor, but were delicious. I also wish the restaurant had a tissue box on the table, or at least a tissue served with the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonkorn Buangsoong

sample_reviews_en.text: Some dishes tasted good, but the portions were very small for the price. I was quite disappointed with the food portions. Even when we ordered larger portions because we were a large group, the amount of food remained small, and the service was inconsistent.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปิ่นมนัส ชูเอียด

sample_reviews_en.text: Not worth the price... The basil pesto pasta is hardly pasta; it's made with something like Yunnan rice noodles, so it's all sticky and sticky. It's different from the picture, so I don't recommend it. The mango lemonade was tasty, but expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: dragon lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good overall, delicious as usual.
I used my Krungsri card and got a free pork bun, but this one was extremely oily. It was sickeningly greasy. I understand it was free, but it really affected my overall experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pholkrit

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's located on the first floor of the mall.
As the name suggests, you can eat food from various Asian countries.
When I asked something I didn't understand, the staff were friendly and helpful …
sample_reviews_en.author: Go Shim

restaurants.name: MK Restaurant (Big C south pattaya)
restaurants.address:

140/94 M.11 Sukhumvit Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It can say that MK Restaurant is always the best place for family dinner.

Atmosphere - Overall restaurant area is alike normal Thai restaurant. Most people come here for a Thai-Style Hotpot(unlike the Japanese Shabu or Chinese Huoguo). Iced Plain Tea are served and available for refilling all the time while having meal at the restaurant which is good.

Taste - Like a Thai-Style Clear Soup and you may dip meats and vegetables with the Suki Spicy Sauce(Pinky Sweet Tofu Sauce is also available for "No Spicy" too). The deserts are also good choice for the finale.

Price - Medium Range(pesonally) also depends on the meats and vegetables you order.

P.S. Food Delivery Service is available on various applications with varieties of promotions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warich Nathtigoon

sample_reviews_en.text: Much the same as always, but the days after dining was allowed again, the didn't have everything that was on the menu. The service was a bit odd. We got three sauce bowls but only one of them contained sauce. The sauce comes with sides of garlic and chilies, so you can adjust the sauce to your taste. We got two sets of these. Later three more appeared and two more filled sauce bowls were added. Clearly they have reimagined the dining experience to minimize contact between staff and customers, so our complementary tea glasses were never refilled.  The food was up to their usual standards. The duck was as delicious as ever. My discount card had expired and I was not asked if I would like a replacement.
sample_reviews_en.author: le s

sample_reviews_en.text: MK is popular with Thai families and couples. A Shabu style restaurant which focus on you cooking your own food at your table. I find that the food is OK and the atmosphere and the staff is a little sterile and not so warm and welcoming. Usually lots of parking as most are located in shopping malls.  There are many set menus to choose from and individual dishes should you want to pick and choose. Good for a quick lunch and a good alternative to the fast food restaurants found in most malls!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gwyn Mills

sample_reviews_en.text:
The MK Suki restaurant at Big C Market in South Pattaya is so unfriendly that the employees are rude. You shouldn't go to this restaurant. I believe MK headquarters is training its customers to provide educational services without manners.

Big C Market MK Suki Store South Pattaya: It's so unfriendly that the employees lose their manners at work. Don't go to this restaurant. I believe MK headquarters is training its customers to provide educational services without manners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sangmuk OH

sample_reviews_en.text: A standard MK chain cafe, simple format, limited menu. If you don't have time for a hot pot, you can choose from the prepared dishes. Several types of duck, soups, dim sum, seafood sprint rolls. Very fast service. Drinks are free. Card payment accepted. Prices are very reasonable. A meal for two can cost 200-300 baht. The portions are decent, and the soups are fairly large. Simple, delicious. This cafe is not a restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vadim Moskalchenko

sample_reviews_en.text: Very disappointed for the price, never again. This restaurant chain will soon replace its employees with robots, as the menus and trolleys for the waitresses are already electronic, and the waitresses themselves don't smile because they all have flashlights in their hands, even though the fake pandemic is over. A bottle of water costs 30 baht, which is ridiculous when other restaurants charge 10. Never again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick

sample_reviews_en.text: To the manager of this branch, I just met a staff member who looked like he was going to work at MK. The other staff members were very nice. The only ones in the office were two elderly women, both wearing MK uniforms, with stern faces and rude language, as if we were begging for food. If you're in a bad mood, you shouldn't take it out on customers. They need urgent training.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nara รัศมี Jira

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered seafood noodles, 145 baht with soup, which was delicious. I wonder how the hot pot is; this seems to be their specialty. I'd come back to try it.

The servers were very friendly; they came over to ask if I needed more water when it was almost gone.

The food came out quickly; I didn't have to wait long.
sample_reviews_en.author: S Jasmin

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish balls are homemade. The flavor might not be very strong, but the balls themselves are delicious. They also provide a unique chili paste with pork cracklings to add, something you won't find anywhere else. Add it little by little because it's very spicy! The shop is clean, with a cheesecloth partition under the display case and covers for the condiment jars. You can scan to pay. I recommend giving it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: ploy smile

sample_reviews_en.text:
This fish ball noodle shop is:
Clean and delicious.
The owner is very friendly.
It has customers from all walks of life.
They come to support the shop throughout the day.
However, if the weather is not good,
the number of customers decreases accordingly.
Please stop by and try it!
The price is very affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: namtip pongsopha

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish ball noodle soup is delicious. The broth is flavorful, and you can add free spicy chili pork cracklings. The salmon skin is crispy and not oily.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนาวุฒิ ปึงศิริเจริญ

sample_reviews_en.text: This fish ball noodle soup is so delicious I have to recommend it! It's also affordable and they give you plenty of toppings. 👍🤘🍜 …
sample_reviews_en.author: chaiyarat chaianurak

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is a bit old-fashioned, the taste is average, the prices are affordable, and the service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutsara S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The meatballs are bouncy, and the crispy pork, roast pork, and roast duck are tender.
sample_reviews_en.author: คณิต ประโยชน์พิบูลผล

restaurants.name: Kapraokhunchang Bangmod
restaurants.address:

644/64 Pracha Uthit Rd, Bang Mot, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried a new restaurant with a little gimmick: when customers are seated, the staff will place a plate shaped like a banana leaf on the table. I ordered minced pork basil stir-fry with rice and a fried egg. When it was served, I noticed the rice was a little soggy. The taste was okay, but not amazing. I ordered it extra spicy, but after tasting it, it felt like just average spiciness, even slightly sweet. The restaurant's recipe uses both freshly pounded chilies and coarsely ground dried chilies. Besides basil stir-fry, they also have fried rice, garlic stir-fry, green curry, soup, and their signature Khun Chang omelet and Khun Chang fried egg, available with both plain rice and rice noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิน วิน พลัส

sample_reviews_en.text: Ka Prao Khun Chang (Bangmod) seriously delivers when it comes to Pad Kaprao. I had the crispy pork with scrambled egg—perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and just the right level of heat. You can tell they use quality ingredients, and the holy basil aroma really stood out. Service was quick and friendly, and the prices are very reasonable for what you get. If you’re craving authentic Thai comfort food, this place is 100% worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naunt Kham

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered the Jumbo Stir-fried Minced Pork with Basil, it was delicious and the portion was amazing 🔥 The staff were very attentive 🔥 I've started buying takeout again. Too bad there's no parking 🔥❤️ Khunnai Many
sample_reviews_en.author: Khunnai Many

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing Thai basil rice! Full of flavor, perfectly spicy, and super satisfying. I love squid kaphrao with basil. Fresh seafood and great taste. Quick service. A must-try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Su

sample_reviews_en.text: There is no air conditioning, but sufficient fans are provided. The food tastes good, and the menu includes English labels and the customer service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sora

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Thai basil stir-fry is dry-fried using dried chilies, resulting in a perfectly balanced, spicy flavor. It's served with tender chicken.
sample_reviews_en.author: K. diamondzz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. Whether you order it or eat it at the restaurant, it's equally delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: อามีนะ เขียวเซ็น

restaurants.name: บักเก็ตลิส ( Bucket List ) | อาหารไทย-อีสาน สไตล์คาเฟ่
restaurants.address:

290 Rama IX Rd, Khwaeng Suan Luang, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "The food is delicious and reasonably priced."

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce) was great, the Som Tum Poo Pla Ra (papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce) was excellent (the fermented fish sauce was delicious), and the Yam Woon Sen Moo Sap Talay (spicy glass noodle salad with minced pork and seafood) was absolutely fantastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arisa Patthawaro

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here many times and it's great. The atmosphere is nice, and the hot pot is good. The vendor is very good at recommending new items when things are almost sold out. If you're in the area often, you should definitely try it, just like the restaurant's name suggests.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matichai “North” Suksombut

sample_reviews_en.text: This small shop offers reasonably priced food that is delicious, flavorful, and spicy. Parking is available along the sidewalk. The owner is lovely, and the food is served quickly, although she speaks a bit loudly, possibly due to the small size of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: L’tao Spm

sample_reviews_en.text:
The spicy salad was delicious and not expensive.
This time I had deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce, spicy glass noodle salad with minced pork and pork sausage, and crab with fermented fish sauce. Overall, it was a thumbs up!
sample_reviews_en.author: อรวรรณ อํานวย

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad, Ubon-style noodle soup, and Gaeng Om (spicy herbal curry) are all delicious and authentic. The restaurant has a nice, chill atmosphere. I've eaten here many times, and they always introduce new menu items.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattaphong P

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is very cute. The food is clean and delicious, and the prices are very good. The owner is very kind. She moved away from the border in Sisaket to live a safer life. Please stop by and support her!
sample_reviews_en.author: Oh!! EAT

sample_reviews_en.text:
The papaya salad with apple is delicious and reasonably priced.
The pork stew is also tasty, with just the right amount of saltiness, not too salty.
The sukiyaki is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanyaluk O.

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for a restaurant with a "vibrant" atmosphere and delicious Northeastern Thai food in the Rama 9 area, we recommend trying this cafe-style eatery.
sample_reviews_en.author: เจ้าแม่ อ้อยสร้อย

restaurants.name: ข้าวมันไก่ซั่งไห่ Marché Thonglor
restaurants.address:

ชั้น M 150 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible. The staff sighed from the moment we walked in, their faces looked bored and like they were forced to work. Their attitude was awful. I ordered a special Hainanese chicken rice and was choosing some steamed buns to add.
The staff just put everything on the plate without saying anything, even though we hadn't specified that we wanted to eat in.
We were still choosing other items. So we said, "Takeaway, please." The staff member put down the knife they were using to chop the chicken and said,
"Why didn't you say that earlier?" We quickly paid, grabbed our food, and left.
We didn't order anything else. We'll wait for that staff member to quit and then come back to buy more. :D
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanapon Sangin

sample_reviews_en.text:
There were only two people in line, but I waited for over 10 minutes. The staff member didn't ask what I wanted to order or inform me to wait a moment. Actually, with two staff members, they could have divided the tasks and checked what the next customer had ordered. I only ordered one steamed bun, which I could have picked up immediately.

But the two staff members were busy with the first group, without updating the overall situation or informing the next customer. I had to go and ask if I could pick up my single item right away; otherwise, I think I would have had to wait another 10 minutes.

Sharing this feedback for staff improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Praiya U.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating at this Hainanese chicken rice restaurant for two years now, probably about 30 times. The chicken is tender and juicy, the rice is delicious, and the spices are great. The service is also excellent. So, I highly recommend trying their Hainanese chicken rice; it's probably the best in Bangkok.

However, today I must say that one of the main servers was very rude, which is unusual for this restaurant. Normally, both the male and female staff provide good service, but today the male staff was very rude. I think the restaurant manager should address this issue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trevor Clark

sample_reviews_en.text: Hainanese chicken rice, an original recipe from Shanghai. Boiled chicken, soft meat, big, thick pieces, and very juicy. Fried chicken, crispy skin is unique. Each dish has a lot of chicken meat. There are many delicious dipping sauces to choose from, up to 4 types. The highlight is the Shanghai dipping sauce. The chicken rice is special, mixed with seaweed from China, giving it a gentle aroma. The dark color is different from other chicken rice shops. Eating just plain rice is still delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kinklaikrung Page

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! The chicken is tender, the rice is tasty, the dipping sauce is delicious, and the soup is delicious.

It's a shame the prices on the app aren't the same as in-store prices; I'd eat here every day. It's close to my workplace, but I don't like crossing the street here. Cars rarely stop at the crosswalk, the food court seating is usually full during lunchtime, and I often find tiny cockroaches.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bow BKC

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice was quite a bit harder than typical Hainanese chicken rice. I ordered the special thigh meat for 75 baht, but got breast meat mixed in (customers know this). They should go and see how the incredibly lucky Singaporean Hainanese chicken rice on Phutthamonthon Sai 2 works; they order only whole pieces of meat, which is better than using a whole chicken, because few people prefer breast meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vichit Chin

sample_reviews_en.text: I like it! It's a great value chicken rice for 60 baht. I ordered it without the skin and got a large, tender, and bouncy piece of chicken. The dipping sauce was delicious – light, not too sweet, and the combination of both was perfect. It would be even more delicious if the rice was cooked less soggy and had a nice, fragrant, sticky texture. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Rinlada Panpoonsub

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another place with really delicious Hainanese chicken rice, but this branch serves it on paper plates with plastic spoons, which makes it a bit difficult to eat. The chicken is tender, the rice is fragrant with spices, the chicken liver is perfectly tender without being mushy, and the dipping sauce is good and well-balanced.
sample_reviews_en.author: cloud549

restaurants.name: Salad factory @Susco square
restaurants.address:

365/1665 ถนน พุทธบูชา Bang Mot, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was craving spaghetti, so I stopped by this restaurant. I saw they had spaghetti on the menu.
I ordered spaghetti carbonara; it tasted okay.

I also ordered two other things: a salad and some kind of chicken rice dish. They were delicious and came with a large piece of baby carrot.

The restaurant has seating, but it's quite limited. If there's no seating, you can order takeout.

Update... I came back for a second time. I ordered the same salad – a large bowl and just as delicious. The other two dishes were cauliflower rice with basil pork (they used cauliflower instead of rice – delicious and unique!), and maybe pork neck larb rice? Both were also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phichamol W

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a regular customer at Salad Factory, especially the branch at the Susco gas station because it's close to home. The food is consistently good, and the staff are excellent—very attentive and having outstanding service mind. The only downside is that this branch consistently has a problem with the air conditioning (the ceiling-mounted unit). It gets incredibly hot, making it impossible for customers to eat comfortably. I repeat, the AC is broken!! Another question is, why doesn't the branch manager in this area address this issue, despite the staff reporting it multiple times? I hope the owner of Salad Factory is aware of this problem.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daweerit Chullasapya

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu of the shop is diverse. Fresh vegetables are served in a beautiful way. There are options to choose from many varieties. And all the ingredients look bright and healthy Making vegetables have a rich and delicious taste. In addition, there is an option to add protein from meat or truffles or soybeans. Making it suitable for everyone, the service here is good and friendly. The staff is happy to help to choose the right item. Fast in food service And the cleanliness here is one of the highlights that makes me want to come back again This is satisfactory for people who want good health and delicious taste in the Salad Factory.
sample_reviews_en.author: loma wawa

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a wide variety of healthy food options available. Preparation time is reasonable, depending on the dish ordered. The taste was very impressive. Even vegetables I used to dislike were easy to eat. The pork with butter was a great combination, the quinoa was delicious, and the chicken breast and mushroom wraps were also tasty. I can't forget the clam soup, which had various vegetables in it but cleverly balanced the flavors of the vegetables with the perfectly chewy clams.
sample_reviews_en.author: นพพล สกุลรัตนศักดิ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The portions are large and the food tastes great. There's a wide variety of healthy options for those who like them. The vegetables are very fresh.
My absolute favorite is the french fries – fresh, crispy, and the dipping sauce is incredibly delicious! It's best eaten at the restaurant; I've tried ordering them for takeout, but they weren't as good as when eaten hot.
The restaurant has limited seating, only 4 tables, so you might have to wait for a table at certain times.
sample_reviews_en.author: kan tem

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the menu is diverse. I like that they have new monthly specials.
I like that the drinks are less sweet, befitting a salad restaurant. This time I ordered the Peach Cobbler, which was refreshing and had crunchy cookies sprinkled on top.
I've eaten at Salad Factory many times before, but this is my first time at this branch.
This branch is a bit small.
I didn't have time to take pictures of the food, haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangduean L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thank you to all the staff at the restaurant.
The food was delicious and of high quality, and the service was very quick.
I was impressed and will definitely be back.

Today's meal changed my mind.
I never thought that Salad Factory, a small branch in a gas station,
would be so dedicated to making every dish so excellent and delicious, far superior to the larger branch in a shopping mall!
sample_reviews_en.author: pat ch

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant pays attention to detail. Their salads are quite affordable. I enjoyed watching the entire process, from growing the vegetables to harvesting and delivering them to the restaurant to be used in the dishes for customers. It looks simple, but I believe it's not as easy as it seems. At least I could see the dedication of the owner.
sample_reviews_en.author: กุ๊บกิ๊บ แอนด์เดอะแก๊งส์

restaurants.name: ลานจอดรถ มาชิตะgrill
restaurants.address:

12 Rarm Intra 91/2 Aly, Ram Inthra, Khan Na Yao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, with a wide variety of savory and sweet dishes, including seafood. The staff provided good service, except for the cashier, who was rude because we wanted to use a birthday promotion, so we ended up not using it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Milk Key

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, fresh, and there's a huge variety to choose from, including savory dishes, desserts, and snacks. The staff are also very attentive, polite, and friendly. I've eaten here many times and I'm absolutely hooked!
sample_reviews_en.author: ธีรวัฒน์ ศิริพันธ์

sample_reviews_en.text: It's quite spacious. We went at 9 PM and there were plenty of parking spaces available. There are lights in the parking area.
sample_reviews_en.author: วรัชยา ปานเมือง

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes great, it's delicious, and the restaurant is packed. Kids love it because there's a wide variety of dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dgc Hjo

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a long time since I last visited, and I'm still impressed. The variety is great, and everything is delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐธภา จิตธรรมาภร

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was nice, the food was fresh, although the sukiyaki dipping sauce was a bit salty. Overall, it was
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudarat Majan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and well-prepared, especially the dipping sauce for the BBQ pork, highly recommended!
🤩🤩🤩
sample_reviews_en.author: Chat

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here many times and I really like it. The service is great and there's so much delicious food!
sample_reviews_en.author: AchiX

restaurants.name: Shell
restaurants.address:

KT, 538 SOI RAMKAMHANG 39 THEPLEELA1, 538 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 39, Wang Thonglang, 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Avoid if possible, one of the worst gas service experience from Shell in Bangkok vicinity.

Been there around 18:00 and service attendants literally refused to fill the tank because they are waiting for “Shift change”!! (While waiting, they are literally sitting and loitering around!!)

We (5 cars in the station are facing the same fate) were told to wait 10-15 minutes to resume the service…But when asked what is the challenge filling the tank?, they made a grumpy face and barely speak the language, just sayin “Shift change” and walked away…

I am looking forward to see Shell being kicked out from the competition
sample_reviews_en.author: Watcharapong Suwandumrong

sample_reviews_en.text: The worst of the worst!! This place ask you 250 bahts for a small car and your car come back to you dirty again. Many things they don't care, they don't wash carefully. Just put in their machine and let dry it. Nothing. And when I show them the places they forgot to clean, they laugh on me. Ok they hate Farang, we are use to it. But please be professional!!!!  #shellneveranymore #shell #jwash
sample_reviews_en.author: Axel GAUTHIER

sample_reviews_en.text: There are only Burmese employees, no Thai manager. They've overfilled my car three times already, and there's no one to complain to. If it weren't near my house and I prefer V-Power fuel, I wouldn't fill up here. The air pump is also constantly broken. The owner doesn't care about maintenance; they only care about profit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thana Keawfanapadol

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to fill up my car with gas, but the fuel gauge didn't show any change in price. When I got home, the gauge had even dropped. I was very confused. The employee was a foreign woman, and I didn't even notice if she actually filled the tank or not.
sample_reviews_en.author: Burimas kanchanothai

sample_reviews_en.text:
J Wash Car Care Center is now open! Featuring cutting-edge automatic car wash technology imported from Japan.
# Fast and clean in 5 minutes
# No scratches
# Shiny and clean
# Get your car clean in just 5 minutes!
sample_reviews_en.author: ສີລິພອນ ອິນທະວົງ

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is terrible, there's no one at the gas station, and paying is slow. Don't come here; you'll save a lot of time by going elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Wu

sample_reviews_en.text: Excuse me, could I please have the contact number for this gas station? The number listed isn't working. I forgot my gas receipt.
sample_reviews_en.author: เซลล์เมย์ ขายรถมือสอง

sample_reviews_en.text: They said they were open 24 hours, but when I arrived at almost 11 PM, they were closed and didn't refill the stock at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: nattavut boonnim

restaurants.name: RYSH Ratchayothin
restaurants.address:

1456 2 Sathian Sut Alley, Chan Kasem, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really wanted to go to Rysh because my friend lives nearby. We were going to celebrate a friend's birthday there.
We booked a month in advance. They said we could book up to 7 days before the reservation date. When we messaged them just 2 minutes before the reservation date, at 11:58 PM, they told us to message at midnight. When we messaged at midnight (2 AM), they replied that it was fully booked. Wow. They've booked before and it was always full. Real customers couldn't get tables. People who resold their tables got them. They were advertising tables for sale all over Facebook groups. It wasn't even the 12th of the reservation date yet; they posted on the 11th and I saw them advertising tables for sale on the 18th. Even Thonglor isn't like this.
I don't know if the admin only reserves tables for their friends or if this is just the restaurant's standard. Ugh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thi Ti

sample_reviews_en.text: This newly opened bar in Ratchayothin is beyond amazing! The atmosphere is beautiful, glamorous, and has great taste. The lighting and colors are unlike anything seen in this area before. It's perfect for taking photos from the outside to the inside. The DJ plays fun and tasteful music – they serve everything mainstream. The space is well-designed, not too crowded or cramped. Personally, I think this bar offers a distinct feel and elevates the chic, glamorous, and tasteful vibe compared to other bars in the Ratchayothin and Kasetsart University area. If you're looking for a new hangout spot, I highly recommend checking this one out. You won't be disappointed!🥂✨
sample_reviews_en.author: frtz clisa

sample_reviews_en.text: We really wanted to go, 20 friends. We couldn't book three or four weeks in advance; it had to be before the 7th. We tried to book at midnight on the 7th, but within seconds they replied at 2 AM that it was full. It's ridiculous; people were reselling bookings all over Facebook groups. What are they trying to hide? Going on a weekday, the tables are cramped. The only good thing is the restroom. The DJ area looks big and fun in the photos, but it's actually tiny; they use camera angles to make it look better. The staff were nice, although one staff member spilled water on us that day, but they apologized and it was fine.
sample_reviews_en.author: pannawit sukkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was good. The staff were lovely. The entrance was great.
The music was to my liking.

But after midnight, I ordered a beer set three times and didn't get any.
Is that it? Do they not sell beer after midnight?
Or maybe we have to go and get the beer ourselves?

Couldn't they manage this better?
Should they write it down on paper so they can remember?
Or should they key it into a system so they know which tables didn't get anything?
I'm confused. Three times and still didn't get any. Is the beer sold out?
sample_reviews_en.author: JIRANA

sample_reviews_en.text: So gooood! It was incredibly fun, whether it was the live music or the DJ. I danced until my waist was about to break! The drinks were amazing, and the staff were so attentive, paying attention to every table, no matter how crowded it was. It was the best! I have to come again. It's truly different from the Ratchayothin area. I saw it on TikTok before coming, and I just knew it would be fun. And it was the real deal! (I've attached some pictures.) If you're still hesitating, you have to come!
sample_reviews_en.author: jadcmm

sample_reviews_en.text: The tomboyish waitress provided terrible service. I ordered three times but never received my order; I had to order from another person. Also, there were many empty tables, but they had been moved together so close that it was impossible to breathe and I couldn't even go to the restroom. Please look into this, as I frequent the place and this is the first time I've encountered a waitress making customers move tables themselves. Overall, the service is good, but the staff is not excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachanëë körn

sample_reviews_en.text: The music was just okay, not really hyping things up (it was still lukewarm at 11 PM). The live music was good enough to shout and talk with friends until 11 PM. It took a very long time for the DJ to come on and for us to finally get to dance. The staff were friendly and very entertaining. The food was delicious, although the crispy fried bamboo shoots were a little lacking. There were plenty of restrooms, although there was still a queue late at night. 6/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: twnn n.

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time here, based on reviews. The place is spacious, not cramped at all, and they played the right kind of popular music. The staff were attentive and there were plenty of them. Importantly, the place was surprisingly crowded, but the restroom was huge and very clean. I loved the mirror and the lighting in the restroom! And I wasn't surprised, I came on a Thursday and it was incredibly busy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Waralee Official

restaurants.name: ร้านลาบชำนาญ
restaurants.address:

QHJ8+7WP, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad is incredibly delicious and flavorful. They have a wide variety of other Northeastern Thai dishes that are also very tasty. *The prices are very cheap too!* This is definitely one of our top Northeastern Thai restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarocha Thaongthai

sample_reviews_en.text: Friendly service, affordable prices, relaxed atmosphere. Park in the alley, just don't block anyone's driveway.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุนทร อินทร์ขาว

sample_reviews_en.text: Papaya salad, minced meat salad, grilled fish, hot pot... everything is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChamP Khomthong

restaurants.name: ตำล้าน
restaurants.address:

Ratchadaphisek Rd, ห้วยขวาง, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious!!! It started with me coming here based on 5-star reviews. At first, I hesitated because there weren't many reviews, but I tried it myself and I wasn't disappointed at all. I accidentally tasted it before I could take a picture because it was so delicious I had to take photos for this review.
🥗Papaya Salad: Flavorful, spicy, and perfectly balanced!! You can choose the level of spiciness.
🥩Grilled Beef: The best! The meat was tender and not chewy. You can choose the level of doneness that's perfect, so much so that I ordered 2 plates.
The Tom Yum soup was also very delicious and well-balanced. Actually, everything was delicious, and the prices were good. I was very impressed that they let me leave leftover beer at the restaurant. This is definitely going to be one of my regular restaurants!🥹❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Mookda Diary

sample_reviews_en.text: I've passed by this place many times but only recently tried it. My first impression was great because everything was delicious. The prices are reasonable, and the quality of the food is excellent value. I don't eat spicy food, so I ordered papaya salad with less chili and it was still flavorful but not too spicy, with a lovely real lime aroma. The grilled pork was so delicious I didn't even need the dipping sauce. The restaurant is clean, the atmosphere is comfortable, there are plenty of tables but it's not crowded. You can order via QR code and pay by bank transfer or credit card. I'll definitely be back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: May N.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the ingredients were fresh, and the flavors were perfect in every dish, especially the papaya salad which was perfectly balanced and savory. The owner (Khun Mo) is lovely and friendly, and the service is excellent, making the atmosphere warm and inviting, like having a meal at a friend's house. I highly recommend Tam Lan for anyone looking for delicious Northeastern Thai food with fresh, clean ingredients and impressive service. They also have a full range of drinks. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nessa K

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! I love everything. This is my go-to restaurant now. It's clean, the service is good, the prices are good, and the food comes out quickly. I eat here very often, both ordering through Grab and eating at the restaurant. However, it feels a bit hot when I go during lunchtime. There's convenient parking nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Feletso

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered mild tom yum, and not only was it mild, it was AMAZINGLY delicious and rich. 😍 In short, it was the best tom yum I've had in Bangkok. It's a clean, quiet place, with very friendly and attentive waiters. For those who enjoy delicious Thai cuisine and a little Chinese, this is perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Милена Старкова

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! After trying it, I could tell they used high-quality ingredients. The fermented fish sauce was tasty, the grilled chicken was delicious, but what surprised me, and something I'd never tried before, was the spicy noodle salad – it was surprisingly good, I really liked it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jarut Nuanchan

sample_reviews_en.text: It was very delicious, but there was a spicy dish for me... However, everything I ate was delicious, and the staff were very considerate, offering extra ice and sauce!! If you like spicy food, this is a must-try!
sample_reviews_en.author: 北原萌呼

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the flavors were amazing. The fermented fish sauce was incredibly flavorful. I randomly chose this dish but got a great one! Loved it! Will definitely come back again. It was fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kao Inchang

restaurants.name: ร้านจุกลิ้นปี่
restaurants.address:

Phatthanakan 53, สวนหลวง Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I drive past this restaurant almost every day, but I've never stopped to eat. I think it's because of the name or some kind of feng shui that makes it seem uninviting, like it's been cursed, even though the restaurant is spacious, comfortable, and not hot, with a large parking lot right by the road. But today I finally got to eat there, and OMG, how could I have missed it? Everything was delicious, and the service was great. The prices might be slightly higher than other street food places, but they use high-quality ingredients, and the service is excellent. I highly recommend trying it. Support the hardworking elderly couple who run the place; you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: CoCo Glam

sample_reviews_en.text: The Phatthanakan Noodle Shop is a large, open-air restaurant with plenty of seating. The menu offers a wide selection of single-dish meals, including tom yum noodles, pad thai, stir-fried chicken, fried rice, stir-fried basil, and congee. The food is quite tasty. The tom yum noodles are delicious and packed with ingredients, just like the noodles. The stir-fried chicken is tasty, but I personally don't like the chili sauce that much. The yen ta fo is delicious. Desserts are also available. Prices are not expensive, averaging 70 baht per plate. Roselle juice, longan juice, and soft drinks are also available. If you're passing by, stop by and try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pixel 8 Bit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Since it was only a 10 baht difference, I ordered the Seafood Fried Rice Special for 90 baht, which has a larger portion.

The staff can speak basic English, and they even kindly explain the menu; you can really feel their friendliness toward foreigners.

It comes with shrimp and squid by default, and it tastes even better if you add a little bit of spicy chili seasoning.

The taste is decent, but I like it because the hygiene and service are better than other restaurants.

It is a restaurant worth visiting again before leaving Hua Mak.
sample_reviews_en.author: 오크삼촌

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best made-to-order food in the area. The flavors are bold and you get exactly what you ask for. The stir-fried chicken, water spinach noodles, pork blood soup, and pad Thai are all delicious. Plenty of parking. It's amazing how this place isn't popular! The owner is lovely. You can tell they use high-quality ingredients. And there's a cat as a friendly companion!
sample_reviews_en.author: Porntip Prasongrattanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: This single-dish restaurant at the entrance of Soi Phatthanakan 53, formerly known as "Hey... Delicious" (the old sign is still there), offers very similar dishes and flavors to the original. The prices seem to have increased slightly, but the portion sizes have also increased to a reasonable level, and a single dish is truly filling for an average person.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coke Somchai

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited today, August 16, 1968, and ordered Yen Ta Fo soup with plain rice. The Yen Ta Fo sauce tasted good; adding a little lime juice made it perfect. It contained fish balls, fish cakes, jellyfish, and fried tofu. The price was moderately high (80 + 15). The food didn't come out too fast or too slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: suwanchai sukkanalak

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious! The fried rice, basil chicken, stir-fried chicken – every dish was great. The wok-fried dishes were fragrant and the portions were generous. At this price, other restaurants would probably only give you a few pieces of meat. I hope more people will come and support this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nithinart S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
We drove by looking for a place to have lunch. It was delicious! The restaurant is mid-range and not too expensive. We ordered seafood basil stir-fry with a fried egg (comes with soup), shrimp fried rice (comes with soup), and Tom Yum noodle soup.
The restaurant also has parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siripa

restaurants.name: หงส์ หงส์ หม่าล่าสุกี้ สาขาแฮปปี้แลนด์
restaurants.address:

833 Happy Land Sai 1 Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was average, not terrible, but the service was awful. The staff's Thai was poor. I told them from the start that I didn't want the buffet, and they just responded "Okay, okay." After we started eating, another staff member came and said that the a la carte menu had been discontinued for a long time. There was no prior notification of any promotions or options, including or excluding drinks. The conveyor belt was long, yet the staff kept trying to refill the food right in front of me, reaching right up to the pots. Why didn't they wait until the food had moved past the customers before refilling? The side dishes like french fries and nuggets were soggy and not hot at all, even with the food warmers. One visit is enough. I recommend the restaurant train their staff's Thai language skills better and remove the color-coded price tags for the trays, simply stating that only buffet is available so customers won't be confused, especially since the staff don't speak Thai.
sample_reviews_en.author: S. ss

sample_reviews_en.text:
You should hire some Thai staff. Miscommunication is making customers reluctant to return. I saw the sign outside the restaurant that said: 1. Buffet 249 baht + drinks 39 baht. I thought I could skip the drinks, so I told the staff I only wanted the buffet and not the drinks bar. The staff said okay, just that I didn't have to go to the drinks bar.
2. When it came time to pay, they charged me for the drinks bar. I told them I didn't want the drinks bar, but they said okay, but I had to because I brought my own drinks. I was very confused because there was no prior notification, and I didn't even go to the drinks bar. The staff said it was okay from the start, but they still charged me for the drinks bar.
*I wish your staff could communicate better; otherwise, you might lose more customers.*
sample_reviews_en.author: Takpps

sample_reviews_en.text: It used to be really good when I first started eating here, but lately it seems to have declined. The food looks old, and the staff doesn't seem to pay much attention. Or maybe it's because I'm eating alone, but I'm a customer too, and it's kind of annoying. At first, I thought, "Oh, maybe it's just me," so I was chill, but then I saw the water dispenser had plain water for Coke, and instead of the staff telling me, they just sat there silently, playing on their phones, video calling, filming clips, etc. It was irritating.
sample_reviews_en.author: chawisa

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a long time since I ate here, and it's gotten so much worse. The quality is terrible. The vegetables are wilted and black, the meatballs are dry and tough, like they've been sitting around on the conveyor belt for days. The red sausage tastes like it's spoiled. It used to be my regular place because the ingredients were good for that price, but this is definitely my last time. It's getting worse every day. I'm even wondering if I'll get a stomachache when I get back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wonbunny 01

sample_reviews_en.text: The mala soup base tasted good. Food was delivered via conveyor belt, and the dipping sauce corner allowed you to mix and match as you like. This was my first time here with friends, and it's a reasonably priced mala buffet in the Bang Kapi area. Not recommended for those who can't handle spicy food; even the less spicy soup was still quite hot 🔥🔥🌶️
sample_reviews_en.author: Weerasit Phanucharoenkul

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a regular customer at this restaurant. I eat here so often that the staff even recognize my usual soup order! 🤣 The soup is delicious, the pork and beef are high quality, and there's a wide variety of ingredients. They even have Coke Zero! I really want this restaurant to become more popular. A truly authentic mala hot pot restaurant! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchada pts

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of my top choices when I'm eating alone. I've been here four times and they've maintained a good standard of quality. The only downside is that the dipping sauce isn't quite to my liking, but everything else is great. The buffet, including drinks, is 288 baht per person, and since you get to eat beef, that's perfectly fine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kei

sample_reviews_en.text: Great value for money. This is my regular restaurant; I've been eating here since before they offered a buffet. The food is delicious. There aren't many staff members, but they are very attentive and take good care of the customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dorah Sang

restaurants.name: ณี อาหารตามสั่ง
restaurants.address:


sample_reviews_en.text: NEE restaurant! This is a delicious made-to-order restaurant with a wide variety of dishes at affordable prices. The owner is very friendly, and the ingredients are very fresh – shrimp, squid, pork, chicken, salmon – everything is delicious. I love every menu by Khun Nee.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lunas Moony

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! Parking is available along the roadside, opposite Khlong Chan Botanical Garden. Prices are moderate, and there's plenty of seating in a large outdoor area in the back. The staff were all very friendly. 🥇
sample_reviews_en.author: NUNNAPHAT KOLLAWUTTIKRAI

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! I came here based on reviews. I'll definitely be back for a second, third, and fourth time. The owner is lovely and provides great service.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุรจิตร แก้วชาติ

sample_reviews_en.text: A small shop, but with top-notch ingredients. Large, fresh prawns – quality that exceeds the price. Thank you to our lovely customers for your wonderful support!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pannee B

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, and the prices are reasonable. I highly recommend Nee's Restaurant (a la carte).
sample_reviews_en.author: Mcเอยรีวิว Aoei Reviews

sample_reviews_en.text: The made-to-order food at this shop is delicious! I order from them regularly. The owner is super kind and friendly. I highly recommend this shop!
sample_reviews_en.author: พัชร์ฐนันทน์ ใจงามแท้

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very delicious.
And there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from.
For example, today I had the green curry salmon. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: jack singha

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very clean, the ingredients are fresh, and the food is delicious. This is the place to go for great deals!
sample_reviews_en.author: คน ดี

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great atmosphere, good pool table and nice staff. But the food 😳 …..  there is a looooot of space for improvement. I have eaten here 3 times and it was very disappointing to be honest. I am sorry for that, I hope you can improve it in the future!

Addition: the owner also needs to learn some manners when he is present. Never greeting customers and switching tv programs just as he wish is not a nice attitude.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Zander

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice food friendly staff, penang curry with prawns plus rice on side, curry was very flavoursome but unfortunately not much prawns , would like to try another dish sometime, it was delicious though.will be back for sure.saw some other dishes come out, they looked really good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Xaralambos Psihogios

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best roast chicken dinner by far in Pattaya.
The portion size was massive.
Chicken perfect, no carcass just pure chicken breast the disolved in you mouth an the chicken fell off the bone legs.
Best roasted potatoes ever and stuffing.
Lovely
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is good, drinks are properly sized, staff is naughty but nice and If you get to meet the owner on one of his sporadic visits and he's in the right mood you'll have a true Pattaya experience - for good and bad. ;)
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel C-zon

sample_reviews_en.text: 160 baht for a budget blend 285 and soda. No air con   not a gogo   just a very basic open air bar.   My friend have blend coke zero  (I think bar tender think zero blend)   shocking
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Manley

sample_reviews_en.text: This is just before covid . I was Brought wrong meal and Thai waitress basically accused me of lying. Paid for meal without eating . Expat manager of no help . I’ll never go back .
sample_reviews_en.author: peter kortum

sample_reviews_en.text: They have food, BBQ buffet every Saturday. Otherwise there are girls at the bar who can entertain you. Bar fine 1000 baht. They show sports. Located a bit on its own in soi 13
sample_reviews_en.author: Rune Sonne

sample_reviews_en.text: 3 couples meals came out in order they were ordered we finished our meals before 3rd couple got their meals.Main meals before entrees
sample_reviews_en.author: Nantha Krachumram
