sample_reviews_en.text: The steak is reasonably priced, not expensive, but very tasty. The only downside, which is not related to the taste of the food, is that there are few tables, it is cramped, and there is no parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antarez Zir

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food here. Would 100% recommend u the dry wan tan mee (u will understand if ur chinese/malaysian) ESPECIALLY IF UR MALAYSIAN bcuz trust me, u have never tasted something so delicious b4.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lukas Slvkra

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop owner is friendly, and there's a long queue. Even though it's in a Din Daeng apartment building, the cleanliness is acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpisit Aumarapitak

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered rib eye, tender and flavorful. Little family owned shop, almost on its own, will go again. Did not have the chance to taste the mashed potatoes with cheese. Dish came with a small salad and 1 buttered toast. Will go back again. Just fyi, they only take cash.
sample_reviews_en.author: M. C.

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is affordable, the taste is decent but a little salty. There weren't many people when I went, it was comfortable and the air conditioning was cool. They were serving a small breakfast, but it was okay. The street is narrow, so there's limited parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: R Ts.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is good and the price is affordable, but there's a long wait. It's a small shop with about 4 tables, so it can't accommodate many people.
The mashed potatoes tasted like they used tomato sauce, which gave it a unique flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Autthaphon The Dream Chaser

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to eat there many times before COVID. It's delicious and reasonably priced. They have steak, pizza, and baked spinach with cheese. I haven't been there much lately... I'll update with pictures when I find them...
sample_reviews_en.author: เกดจัง ลูกน้ําเค็ม

sample_reviews_en.text: One of our family's regular restaurants. The Australian beef steak is delicious and great value for money. The pork steak is equally delicious. The portions are generous for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornkanok Ratana

sample_reviews_en.text: Affordable prices and delicious food. The pork steak is especially tender. If you like pork steak, I highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: toi kung

sample_reviews_en.text: The steak was tender and flavorful, the spaghetti was delicious, and the mashed potatoes were creamy and delightful.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิสาขา ดีหลกเจริญ

sample_reviews_en.text: There's no sign for the shop, you have to look carefully to find it. And the steak was very salty.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I order from Robinhood every day, 4 bags a day, in the morning before 10 am. The Robinhood app doesn't give ratings to the restaurant or the driver, so I didn't know what to praise. I searched here and found this place. I want to say #It's incredibly delicious and incredibly cheap!

Thank you for selling high-quality food at such low prices. These days, most shops just make and sell without considering taste, but this shop pays attention to flavor, which is very rare, and we found each other! 😍😍😍

We live so close to each other! I live on Soi 69. I didn't realize there was such a delicious and cheap curry rice shop around here. I didn't take any pictures because I ate it all already! 55555
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuntharat S.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered from the RO app. The orange coffee was delicious! It came with two pieces of orange, very refreshing. The food was also delicious and the prices were reasonable. There were no extra charges on the app. I loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangkamol Tamchimplee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and satisfying, with a wide variety of choices. The prices are also reasonable, it's clean, and they even heat the food up before serving.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุรเชษฎ์ ฉวีวงศ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food looks good and tastes good, but some items are a bit too salty. The service is friendly, but it's a bit difficult to find parking for cars.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุธรรม มานะธิติการ

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a delicious roadside food stall where you can buy food to go or sit and eat at the stall for a different atmosphere.

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! There were many dishes to choose from. The vendor was kind and lovely.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food looked delicious, fresh, and clean, and the vendor was lovely and friendly.

sample_reviews_en.text: Passionate and fiery with the intoxicating flavors of ingredients that are smooth, tender, and succulent. Five stars isn't enough, six stars would be laughable, and still not enough, it needs seven stars above all else.

sample_reviews_en.text: Local breakfast and lunch favorite. Very basic but delicious, many Thai dishes cooked to order. Recommend crispy pork with basil (spicy) or chicken cashew nuts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pieter Demaeght

sample_reviews_en.text: When you come to this restaurant, you must try the dry noodles with crispy pork and seafood dipping sauce. Finish off with the daily dessert. Delicious!

sample_reviews_en.text: Very much recommend this restaurant, local but tasty and worth to pay. It's hidden gem

sample_reviews_en.text: It's incredibly delicious! I eat here regularly. The ingredients are high quality, the portions are generous and worth the price. All the stir-fried dishes are tasty. I often order Tom Yum Seafood, Egg Explosion, Beef with Oyster Sauce, and Stir-fried Morning Glory with Crispy Pork. The flavors are bold and spicy. The atmosphere is like a familiar Chinese family-run shophouse. Some comments say the owner's service is poor, but I find it normal. Loud noise doesn't necessarily mean bad intentions. I've brought over ten friends here before and they all loved it.
sample_reviews_en.author: NMY

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is okay, the price is okay, cash only.
But the biggest problem is the male owner; he has a terrible attitude, is loud and abrupt the whole time he's answering questions or serving customers. There's absolutely no politeness left. He's shouting. I've never encountered anyone with such a personality while working here. I believe everyone who eats here has had the same experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Foo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owner was unfriendly. At first, he accepted bank transfers, but later, he only accepted cash. When I ran out of cash, the owner snapped, saying he only accepted bank transfers. Why only 50 baht? Don't you have cash?

I'm so disappointed. You're open, but you have no service mind. Just close the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pooky Korakrot

sample_reviews_en.text: Located in an alley (Trok Rong Mu), it's open on Mondays. The prices are reasonable, and the taste is average; not very well-balanced. Some dishes, like the pork and plum soup, have a very strong flavor. The food is served quickly. There's …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana Relax

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food: Budget-friendly price, variety of menu, plain taste
Service: Need to be improved, particularly the restaurant owner (old man), no service mind, behave aggressively toward customers
Atmosphere: Not really good but acceptable
sample_reviews_en.author: Akarapon Srivorakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Quick service, tasty meal, aircon/fan inside is refreshing. Busy during lunch, but food comes out in a couple minutes. Large, varied menu. Sukyaki with seafood was great for 70bht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom S

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoy this local small place. Very good taste. Basil rice is simple great. Suki is soft spicy taste. Cheap with good food portion. At soi 1 , snall road. Parking on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: ThePaweena S

sample_reviews_en.text: The à la carte dishes, especially the fish dishes like fried rice with fish, fish with basil, and stir-fried fish with chili paste, were delicious and suited my taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutchawan Tangsujaritwijit

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's on this street and is always packed with customers, so when I went in, it was cheap and delicious. 
There's no menu with pictures, and the waitress doesn't speak any English, so the woman cooking the food at the entrance will help you. It's a shame that you can't order everything you want because of the language barrier. The food is delicious, so I recommend it for anyone who can speak even a little Thai.
sample_reviews_en.author: Toshiaki Hatanaka

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s really really cheap price 50-70 THB/per dish and inside small restaurants have air conditioner and free water too

It’s really amazing and nice chef she’s kind and makes fast dishes.

Actually I’m not from BKK just here for a few days but so lucky to find this restaurant because I always hungry at midnight and this restaurant still opens

That’s awesome!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mermaid Ployy

sample_reviews_en.text: Good local Thai food with authentic taste. Though ambience is just ok, service was fast and with a smile. Nice place for a quick bite and bit of street food experience. It's open late night. I would love to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pramod Panda

sample_reviews_en.text: The à la carte menu offers a wide variety of choices, including dishes like papaya salad and other spicy salads.
sample_reviews_en.author: Unchalee Mhoomak

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely amazing fried rice and great service and price, the store also has AC so it's very comfy
sample_reviews_en.author: Mathias P

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried rice was delicious. Communication was a bit difficult, but it tasted good so it's okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shan paul

sample_reviews_en.text: We have rice noodles, spicy papaya salad, and other à la carte dishes. Choose whatever suits you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ich Petite

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so delicious, just as good as always. It's a small shop, but comfortable to sit in.
sample_reviews_en.author: jitriya chuata

sample_reviews_en.text:
CLUB TALK
is a cafe and restaurant located in the Lasalle Avenue project, Bearing-Lasalle Road, Bangkok. It's open daily from 9:00 AM to 11:00 PM.
The restaurant has a spacious area, divided into two zones: a cafe zone and a restaurant zone. The cafe zone is decorated in a modern style, emphasizing bright, comfortable colors, with many beautiful photo spots. The restaurant zone is decorated in a loft style, emphasizing dark, cool colors.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nont

sample_reviews_en.text: I enjoyed the atmosphere here. I have visited the shopping center many times, but it was my first time trying CLUBTALK. Usually I’m in the busier cafe, so I’ll definitely return here next time. It’s peaceful and relaxing. The staff was laid back. All I ordered was an Americano and the price was cheap compared to next door! I’ll be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Brown

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried this place because I saw it on Facebook as a breakfast & brunch restaurant, but the menu was a bit limited. It leaned mostly towards spaghetti and burgers, and completely skipped over alcohol. I only tried the coffee, but it was surprisingly cheap – an iced cappuccino for only 70 baht! And it tasted pretty good too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sapachanan Thongyoosuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went for Sunday morning breakfast 7:40, inside just one table with customers (not busy at all). Had to wait 8 minutes for the menu ( a QR code) and 30 minutes for an American breakfast. Waiting time way too long.
Coffee was good, breakfast average (bread too hard, eggs cold)

Coffee    5/5
Food       3/5
Service   0/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Jannick Zimmer

sample_reviews_en.text: The daytime atmosphere is perfect for working comfortably. The shop offers a variety of drinks and food, so I chose to have lunch here. I liked the chicken karaage rice; they gave a generous portion of chicken and the sweet sauce was delicious. The lemon tea was strong and flavorful. I'll definitely go again! 🫶🏻✨
sample_reviews_en.author: PIMME PIMSIRI

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, and the prices were reasonable. Drinks were around 100 baht, give or take.
Food was around 100+ baht.
The restaurant is comfortable, the music is good, and the atmosphere is nice. You can come here to work; there are plenty of charging stations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ami Otokke

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best part about this place is the fact that they serve Guinness in the Bangna area. I no longer have to go to the nearest Irish pub downtown to get this drink.

Besides this, the food quality was okay, but the portions are on the smaller side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Bell

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, good prices, good service, cute restaurant. Come on over!
👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻

Located at Malasalle Avenue. Walk to the parking area at the back, near Wine Connection. It's closer if you park when you're about to leave.
sample_reviews_en.author: 7ackie Srichompan

restaurants.name: Gugu Chicken
restaurants.address:

สีลมเอจ ชั้น B1, 2 Si Lom Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd like to file a complaint. I usually eat at this branch quite often, but usually after midnight. Today, May 29th, around 10-11 PM, I went to eat at the restaurant. The food is delicious, I have to admit that. But what was really disappointing was:
1. The service. The staff didn't seem very willing to serve customers. There was no smile or greeting. I smiled at the staff repeatedly, but they never smiled back, not even when I paid the bill.
2. Today, I ordered food, but it still hadn't arrived after a very long time, even though other tables that came later and ordered the same dishes had already received their food. I asked the staff if they could please check on my order because it had been so long, but they said they forgot to make it. I understand that they forget to make something, as they also work in service and might get tired or forget things. But what was most unacceptable was that I didn't even receive an apology.
After this, I probably won't be using their services anymore. No matter how delicious the food is, if I have to experience this kind of service again, I'd rather eat at another restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Area wip

sample_reviews_en.text:
The story is that I initially asked the staff at the front of the store if this set could be ordered for takeout, and they said yes. However, when the staff brought it to me, I didn't check it carefully. But after walking outside, I became suspicious, opened the box, and checked the food, and it didn't look like the picture I showed the staff. So I went back to the staff and asked repeatedly why the set I ordered and the set I received were different. The staff replied that the takeout sets are different from the dine-in sets, even though I had already asked if it could be taken out. If it couldn't be taken out, why didn't they tell me that when I first asked? The staff didn't seem surprised at all; I just got an apology. They answered in a dismissive way, so I just walked out.
I'm so disappointed! It was a terrible experience. I really wanted to eat there!!! ❌❌❌
sample_reviews_en.author: T J

sample_reviews_en.text: Today was my first time trying the restaurant, as I usually order online. They had a promotion on the 19th: buy 10 pieces of chicken, get one free. Overall, the taste and price were okay, but the wait time for food was extremely long, about 40 minutes. Even my drinks took a long time to arrive, and I had to ask the staff about it. The restaurant wasn't full at all, but it seemed like they were prioritizing online orders. I noticed that during my wait, online orders were going out of the kitchen more than 6 times, while only 2 tables in the restaurant had been served. I'm not sure how the restaurant manages things to prioritize in-store orders, so I hope they improve this aspect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kantapat Montawan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food took an extremely long time to arrive. When I asked the staff, they said there were only two stoves. There were four of us, each ordered a set meal, and we shared a bowl of ramen. I was the only one who didn't get to eat my set meal, so I only got the ramen because lunchtime was almost over. Even though there weren't many customers when we arrived, there were only two staff members in the whole restaurant. The food tasted like typical instant noodles, like they just cooked them themselves with sausage and other toppings – something you could easily make at home. The price was also very high. I was very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: M. methinee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I used this branch during a very busy period, with every table full. A male staff member greeted me before taking my order and informed me that the food would take a while to arrive. The staff were constantly taking orders and serving food, always smiling and providing excellent service. They handled the large number of customers without showing any signs of fatigue.
The pork rice set was delicious and reasonably priced. The service was good, the restaurant atmosphere was nice with soft music playing, and the food didn't take long to arrive. Highly commendable and recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: รวีวรรณ

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought a buy-one-get-one-free fried chicken promotion on the 9th for takeout. The restaurant wasn't crowded when I ordered, so there was no queue. However, I waited almost 40 minutes for my food, which was extremely long. The chicken was cold and soggy, as if it hadn't been heated at all. This was completely unreasonable considering the 40-minute wait. I'd like the branch to improve this. This isn't the first time I've waited this long and received chicken like this. As someone who frequents this restaurant – it's one of my favorites – I'm very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanokkorn Pinthong

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited on the 22nd around 2:30 AM. The staff member was very unfriendly. I ordered two plates of rice, and the rice was undercooked. How dare they serve that to customers? I'm speechless. I stopped eating there. If you're a service employee and you don't have a service-oriented attitude, go home and sleep. Her tone was rude and lacked politeness. Please train your staff. I'm a customer, not asking for free food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Baitoey

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were incomprehensible (especially the skinny male employee). The food was slow to arrive, and some items were missing. Just as we were about to eat, they rushed us to get the bill, saying they were closing the account before midnight. They didn't even give us a receipt when we paid, as we needed it to stamp the parking lot.
I think the entire staff needs retraining.
sample_reviews_en.author: KevinK Channel

restaurants.name: Khao Kaeng Ruttana
restaurants.address:

QG56+QV5, Trok Nang Loeng 2, Talat Noi, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Khao Gaeng Ruttana (รัตนา)

Khao Gaeng Ruttana (รัตนา)

One of my favorite Thai rice and curry restaurants in all of Bangkok is Khao Gaeng Ruttana (รัตนา), located in the historic Nang Loeng Market. Before lunch, starting at 11:00 AM, a multitude of curry and Thai dishes are displayed. You can get curry to go, or order what you see, then take a table and eat there. The food is exceptional.
sample_reviews_th.author: boris bodisson

sample_reviews_en.text:
A popular Thai-style fast food restaurant at Nang Loeng Market. Clean food, good taste, affordable prices, mostly good for delivery, but also table service.

Khao Kaeng Ratana, Nang Loeng Market, is an old-timey rice and curry restaurant in the Nang Loeng area. It's unlikely that the restaurant would have lasted this long. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout options. Today, I brought home a bowl of beef green curry and pork panang curry. I arrived before noon, and the beef green curry was almost sold out. This guarantees the deliciousness of the menu. The green curry was delicious, with a rich beef flavor and not overly coconutty. The pork panang curry was incredibly tender, with a well-balanced, non-greasy curry. It was delicious when paired with hot jasmine rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: wichak phijaisanit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rattana Rice and Curry (Nang Loeng Market) is a popular rice and curry restaurant in Nang Loeng Market. You can tell by the sheer number of customers. They have a wide variety of dishes, so choose from their recommended dishes and other options to suit your preferences.

Crispy Fried Fish with Spicy Sauce is a recommended dish that I tried and found delicious. The stir-fried dish was spicy, sweet, and fragrant with galangal. The braised eggs and beef green curry were acceptable. Of the three dishes, the dishes were a bit sweet and a bit oily. Overall, it was okay, but not particularly impressive. The price isn't cheap for a rice and curry restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: MrStew LuiRoj

sample_reviews_en.text:
Whenever I've been to Nang Loeng, I've been eyeing "Rattana Curry" (rice with curry) and many other dishes that look delicious. I often see tour guides bringing their foreign tourists to a table.

Today, I didn't know what to eat, so I decided to give it a try. I ordered two dishes (stir-fried zucchini with shrimp) and a fried fish. It was delicious, with a traditional feel, like eating my mother's food when I was a kid. My favorite was the fish. It was fried, with tender meat and crispy skin.

But it wasn't cheap either. All of this came to 140 baht (I guess the fish was 80 baht per piece).
sample_reviews_en.author: Albert PJ

sample_reviews_en.text: Located inside old Nang Leong market, the restaurant is hard to miss with its massive display of dozens of curries. The owner speaks some English and was very helpful in assisting 8n my ordering process. The chicken curry massaman he suggested was outstanding. And the curry steam fish wrapped in banana leaf was interestingly tasty. I can understand why this place has been around for so many years, enjoyed by locals as well as visitors
sample_reviews_en.author: Amanda Li

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw people stopping by to buy things all the time, so I decided to stop by and eat at the restaurant.

The food was delicious. It was clean and well-ventilated. The portions and prices were reasonable for a rice dish with curry these days.
(I really like the spicy catfish stir-fry.)

Personally, when I first ordered, I was a bit confused. There were so many dishes, and I was confused about who was the seller. 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: miraipa OiL

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I'm going to introduce a famous curry rice shop in Nang Leong Market that offers a wide variety of dishes. Locals and tourists alike come to try the food.

The shop sells both rice with curry and side dishes.

Today I ordered pork rib curry (60 baht per bowl), which was delicious, and stir-fried tofu with celery and minced pork (50 baht per bowl), also delicious.

If you have the chance, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: เดินสายกิน เดินสายเที่ยว ศราทราเวล

sample_reviews_en.text:
This stall is inside nang loeng market. It sells many types of pre-cooked dishes - many of which are curry dishes.

If you go around lunch time, the queue can be long but it moves quickly. You can pick and choose whatever you want.  It can be tough choice as everything seems delicious. Very flavourful and price is reasonable.

Definitely worth the trip to this part of town.
sample_reviews_en.author: Evelyn Heng

restaurants.name: WKK Muay Thai Gym
restaurants.address:

153/3 Lat Phrao Rd, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I spent a week training at this gym and genuinely loved the experience. From the very first session, I felt welcomed and comfortable. The atmosphere is friendly and supportive, and the coaches are not only professional but also attentive and encouraging.
The training program is well-structured and suit for all levels, which made it easy to follow and stay motivated throughout the week.
One of the main reasons I chose this gym was the ability to book sessions online. It made everything so much easier, especially since many other gyms I looked at didn’t have clear information or English-friendly communication. Here, everything is simple, smooth, and well-organized.

I’m really happy I found this place and had the chance to train here. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a great Muay Thai experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mariia Kruk

sample_reviews_en.text:
WKK Muay Thai Gym offers an exceptional experience, especially if you're looking for personalized training. I had the chance to do a private session with Kru Mach, and his attention to detail truly stood out. As a female walking into a gym, it can be a bit nerve-wracking, but the welcoming atmosphere created by all the coaches and staff instantly put me at ease and made me feel right at home.

Although I only managed to fit in one personal training session before heading off to Chiang Mai, I left feeling inspired and eager to return. I’m planning to be back in January and hope to squeeze in one or two more sessions to continue improving. For anyone hesitant about stepping into a Muay Thai gym, especially as a woman, WKK’s supportive environment makes it a great place to start and grow your skills.
sample_reviews_en.author: AZARIAH HARDY

sample_reviews_en.text:
Trained here for just about two weeks as a beginner. Coaching is great and staff are very friendly. highly recommend this gym to all levels.

Do group sessions at 7 AM and evening group sessions at 4 PM. A nice time slot that skips the crazy heat in the afternoons.

Have a few meal options and sell water on the bottom level.

Have a sauna and Cold plunge but cold plunge was not working when I was there due to technical issues.

Great place to grind out Muay Thai and improve as a fighter. Also have a gym floor with treadmill, sled and weights.

Thanks guys.
Leo O
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo Ostroff

sample_reviews_en.text:
The trainers were friendly and the equipment was clean. Overall, the gym seemed tidy. However, what I missed was individual feedback – aside from three rounds of pad work, there was hardly any direct contact with the trainers. Furthermore, the workout ended about 20 minutes earlier than announced.

For me personally, the workout was therefore a bit too impersonal and not convincing enough to make me want to return. Another minor drawback was the lack of disinfectant spray. Overall, not bad, but there's room for improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kostja

sample_reviews_en.text:
I joined WKK with zero experience and honestly expected to feel lost, but the group classes surprised me in the best way. The coaches break everything down so clearlyy and they always check in to make sure beginners like me aren’t falling behind. Even in a mixed group, I never felt judged or out place

Everyone trains hard but the atmosphere is super supportive. The instructors remember your level, give personal corrections when you need them, and celebrate the small wins that make you feel like you’re actually improving.!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bùi Thùy Linh

sample_reviews_en.text: WKK Gym is the kind of place where the work speaks louder than words. Real Muay Thai, real structure, and a serious training atmosphere without ego. Coaches pay attention to detail, whether you’re drilling basics or pushing through hard rounds. You feel challenged, supported, and respected at the same time. It’s not about looking good for the camera here  it’s about showing up, learning properly, and earning every improvement. If you want honest training and a gym that values discipline and growth, this place delivers.🙏🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Emperor Nael

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delighted to find a beginner and women-friendly Muay Thai gym near me.

The team are welcoming, professional, attentive and encouraging for which I’m grateful.

Toilets and I believe a shower are onsite and you can purchase bottled water if needed.

Facilities are very clean too, which has varied with other locations.

I’ve still got much to learn and I’m practicing elsewhere in SEA for now, but once I’m back in Bangkok I’ll certainly be returning to WKK!
sample_reviews_en.author: Esther Brown

sample_reviews_en.text:
The day I went, it was exceptionally closed for holidays and competitions, but despite that, the team welcomed me with incredible kindness and let me train.

The coaches are patient, attentive, and always motivating. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, even for beginners.

This gym exudes the authenticity of Muay Thai and the spirit of community. I 100% recommend it to anyone who wants a real Muay Thai experience in Bangkok, beginner or not!
sample_reviews_en.author: ryan A

restaurants.name: Miss Saigon
restaurants.address:

1147 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place doesn't serve Vietnamese food, it's dog food. The portions are ridiculously small, the prices on the menu are wrong… Nothing but negatives. One star is far too generous for this kind of place! 🤮🤮🤮 The waitress speaks English until you confront her with the situation and the quality of the "dishes."

Reply to our dear Pascal: Is the almost hypocritical amount of meat in your Banh Mi Grilled Pork also due to the fact that the products are undeniably high-quality and incredibly fresh?
Despite the fact that you know how to delight the taste buds of our dear Vietnamese friends, I think it would be a good idea to come back and improve the quality of your staff, who, frankly, are no longer as fresh and energetic as they once were. It would be fair to update your menu and prices, as I don't think your loyal customer would be happy to see a different bill than it should be.

Thank you, Pascal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arnaud Gillemon

sample_reviews_en.text: We looked up this place on Google and decided to give it a try; my wife and I stayed in the Hua Lamphong area and traveled to this restaurant; it was raining when we arrived, and the restaurant was very slow at this time, anyway, we sat down and ordered Phở Bò tái( Rare beef Pho) and an order of a variety of different spring rolls and egg rolls. I'll tell you the food from This restaurant is delicious and excellent, and I feel lovely eating at this place. The food is authentic in every form, from the seasonings to the dipping sauces; every item we ordered goes together, and to declare that I'm Chinese, mix Vietnamese with US citizenship, and am in my 40s. I have been out there. It does not get any better; even in Vietnam, most restaurants lost their origin. If you ever visit Thailand around this area, I recommend you to try this place out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Van Valentine

sample_reviews_en.text:
We would always remember our experience at Miss.Saigon,  up there among the best and most authentic Thai/Vietnamese dinning experience in Bangkok! We tasted dishes from both cuisine's and were very pleasantly surprised by the fresh ingredients, delicious flavors, presentation and very important, authenticity of both!
Service,  was very much “up to par” with the food! Everyone was very attentive and professional. However, the lady owner
(neglected to asked her name, sorry!) is a “Class Act”! Very lovely, she shared with us her love for cooking, as well as some great tips from the kitchen, very much appreciated, since we love to prepare these cuisines at home. It was indeed a pleasure, thank you!
We would highly recommend Miss. Saigon (not far from ICONSIAM) to our friends and anyone visiting Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: grace bodden

sample_reviews_en.text:
Reading the reviews made me decide to visit this restaurant.
I ordered a small bowl of beef pho, which was just the right size. The soup was delicious and they came with plenty of side dishes, but the beef was very tough.
The sandwich looked good. The bread was toasted to a crisp and the texture was good, but there was only a little pork sausage, which was so-so. There was no butter, liver pate, or mayonnaise, but they offered a strange-looking, sweet sauce. I was very disappointed, as it reminded me of Vietnamese pâté.
I was the only customer, but the staff forgot to bring me drinks. I had to ask for them.
The price wasn't cheap.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prasas Prasasvinitchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the real Vietnam I tasted in Thailand!!

I visited after seeing the reviews, and the moment the pho arrived, I lost my mind and devoured it haha.

I couldn't take a single photo.

I had pho, spring rolls, banh mi, and spring rolls, and every item on the menu was delicious.

I would definitely visit again.

Since it is Thailand, I recommend Thai food, but I also recommend visiting if you happen to get tired of Thai food or are craving something a little different.

By the way, the owner is incredibly friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Kang

sample_reviews_en.text: Miss Saigon is a very unique Thai restaurant, where you'll meet locals and visitors alike looking for an authentic escape from the usual tourist traps. Don't expect any grandstanding; Miss Saigon is a rustic restaurant loved for its simplicity. The dishes are delicious, authentic, and full of flavor. Everyone is incredibly kind, from the French expat owner to the smiling and friendly waitress. A place that will stay in your heart.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marc Goodmorning

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good, the atmosphere was nice, it wasn't crowded so the food didn't take long to arrive. The portions were large and satisfying, but the service wasn't great. However, I spoke to the staff and they were understanding, saying they had a lot of preparations to make and there were only 3 of them. The restaurant has been open for a while, this was my first time eating here, and I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ekkavee Nana

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is a Vietnamese restaurant with a comfortable, home-like atmosphere.

The staff are friendly.

The prices are affordable, and the portions are very generous.

In Korea, the same amount of pho would cost over 250 baht, but here, you can have a really filling meal for around 100 baht. 😀

If you are in the area, I think it would be great to come and have a meal here at least once. 🙂
sample_reviews_en.author: Myeongjin Choi

sample_reviews_en.text: This satay was amazing! 🩷 The pork was tender, the marinade was fragrant, the dipping sauce was rich and flavorful, and the toasted bread was delicious. 😋 Most importantly, the owner, an elderly lady, was incredibly kind and friendly. She provided excellent service, spoke politely, and was very impressed. If you're in the area, I highly recommend stopping by and trying it. Please support her! 🫶🏻🩷🩷🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: Candy Pootsorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This satay pork stall on Chan Road is amazing! 🥹💕 The pork is tender, firm, fragrant with a nice grilled aroma, and perfectly juicy—not dry at all. The dipping sauce is rich and flavorful, and it pairs perfectly with the pickled vegetables.

The skewers are large, the price is reasonable, and the taste is great. Anyone who likes satay pork must try it! 😋✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai Supaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork satay is fragrant and delicious, and the dipping sauce and pickled vegetables are also very tasty and they give you a generous portion – they're not stingy at all. I've ordered many times, both for myself and as gifts. It's delicious and great value for money – this is the place to go!
sample_reviews_en.author: Surapee R

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork satay is incredibly tender, fragrant with spices and a smoky flavor from the charcoal grill. The dipping sauce is delicious and unlike any other. My family has been a regular customer of this restaurant for a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pairoj K

sample_reviews_en.text: Great pork satay! It's delicious and not expensive at all. The ingredients are of good quality. I called ahead to order and picked it up at the shop, very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanwemol Zhuang

sample_reviews_en.text: The skewers were large, the pork was tender, perfectly grilled, not dry, and the flavor was well-balanced. The dipping sauce was absolutely delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimphattha Siritanapirom

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The price was great, and the seller was very kind. I bought this to take home and reheated it, and it was still delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: maythawee pongtippun

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork satay was very tender and the skewers were large. The dipping sauce was delicious. The service was good and delivery was on time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornsri Pratumrat

restaurants.address:


sample_reviews_en.text: Today I encountered a marketing tactic from this brand. They launched a promotion with a trap: 100 The 1 Card points for a 100 baht discount. Normally, I've redeemed points with this brand before and used them for a set purchase. However, when I tried to redeem, they said I had to pay for each item separately because the promotion didn't explicitly state "value set," even though the image clearly showed it as a set. As someone with marketing experience, I recognized this as a trap designed to lure customers in. It's terrible and immediately created a bad impression of this brand. Marketing professionals should have ethics; don't do this. Even if it's not direct deception, it's a trap that takes advantage of customers. I'm not the only one who fell for this; many customers have complained. In this social media era, if you take advantage of customers, you'll have difficulty growing.
sample_reviews_en.author: walaiporn Pornwiroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just bought something today, May 14th, 2023, for takeaway around 5:30 PM. I have to say, the counter staff were very rude. They answered curtly. I just asked if I could have extra sauce on my burger, and they responded curtly, "We have to follow company procedures." Normally, when I buy from other branches, the staff are much nicer and at least they would refuse more politely. This staff member acted like I was begging for free food.
As for the food, the taste has deteriorated and the prices have increased significantly. From previously paying 180+ baht per set, it's now 260+ baht. I'm quite surprised. I'm permanently stopping eating at this branch. I used to eat there often and was a regular customer. This experience is very disappointing. The staff should go home and sleep; they shouldn't be working in customer service like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gifto Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for a fast-food option that feels a little more refined, Mos Burger @ The Crystal SB Ratchaphruek is a solid choice. This well-known Japanese burger franchise brings its signature attention to detail and balanced flavors to the Ratchaphruek area.

The burgers here stand out for their soft, lightly toasted buns and neatly assembled fillings. The classic MOS Burger with its rich meat sauce has that slightly sweet-savory Japanese touch, while the rice burgers offer a fun alternative if you want something different from the usual bun. Ingredients taste fresh, portions are just right, and everything is made to order — so it’s hot and satisfying when it arrives.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text: I was extremely disappointed with the restaurant's standards. I ordered the teriyaki chicken donburi with extra chicken, but the chicken skin was badly burnt and blackened. The front-of-house staff couldn't do anything about it, so we just had to accept it. I tried complaining via Line, but there was no admin response. I've read reviews of other restaurants that serve burgers, and although it's hard to find a branch, I always try them whenever I get the chance. Plus, the inside of the restaurant was incredibly hot with only one air conditioner. Luckily, no one else was sitting there, so we just sat in front of the fan.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanlop Sangvonyodhin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mos Burger's small, cozy branch, hidden inside the Crystal Design Center, is truly an oasis in the area for those craving Mos Burger.

The branch is small and compact, with a warm atmosphere, but there's always a seat available. The restaurant has a steady stream of customers, but it's not crowded. If you prefer a quiet, less crowded environment, this branch is perfect.

The staff are polite and attentive, always offering advice on promotions and loyalty programs.

Mos Burger remains my absolute favorite burger to this day.
sample_reviews_en.author: tome Nattapong Worapivut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went there yesterday to get a burger. I redeemed my AIS points to get a discounted classic beef burger and iced tea set. After sitting for a few minutes wondering why my food took a while, it turns out they were freshly cooking my burger and boy ! Look at that juiciness !! And The buns were soft but perfect crisp. Will definitely go there to have a bite again.

P.S. Iced gree tea was also refreshing and aromatic.
Also great service, the waiters/waitresses were smiling and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panzer Faust

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese-style burger chain has been around in Thailand for a while. Before, you had to go to the Siam Paragon branch, but now there are many branches, and I still frequent it. Personally, I like the original burger with the beef, their special sauce, and a big slice of fresh tomato. Try it out at whichever branch is closest to you. The prices are also reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nopporn JIRA (Gan)

sample_reviews_en.text: Mos Burger is a popular Japan brand. Even, Burger is not my cup of tea but, I admire to this professional brand where is keep social distancing. I went to survey and felt that all customers who dine in here or take away so, they feel safe ever because very social distancing from my capture photos. Also, it is located next to gate and car park zone at Central rama 3

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves delicious and affordable food. There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, including rice options. The pork toast is delicious and inexpensive. The service is also good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Looknu Manikan

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant serves pork leg rice, noodles, and pork satay. It's located on Happyland Road and has parking nearby. The food is delicious, not expensive, and the service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunny พาสุข สนุกสนาน

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, home-style food. The pork leg dish has a generous amount of pork, and the pork satay is very tender. The prices are very reasonable. They also have noodles on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyabut Petcharat

sample_reviews_en.text: This old-school satay pork stall in Happy Land has been around for over 40 years. The pork and dipping sauce are delicious and flavorful, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachanee Saejiew

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. The owner is friendly. However, you have to find your own parking spot, and sometimes there's hardly any space available.
sample_reviews_en.author: THE WAN

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything we ordered was delicious. The noodle portion was huge, the pork satay was tasty, and the prices were reasonable. Everything on the menu looked tempting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonwan Prateepram

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Kao Kamu & Moo Satay in the area. Price is incredible for the quality & service is always great. One stop shop for a variety of Thai dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Y K

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork noodle soup was incredibly delicious! The meatballs were good, and the stewed pork liver was also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutanee Freedom

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_en.text:
Street food stalls that serve made-to-order meals are typically those offering quick service and a wide variety of customizable dishes. Popular choices often include fried rice, stir-fried basil pork, fried pork with rice, garlic fried rice, noodles in gravy, and curry fried rice, among others.

Here are some common advantages of street food stalls:

1. Speed: Street food stalls usually prepare food quickly, ideal for quick lunches or times when you don't want to wait long.
2. Affordable: Made-to-order dishes are often inexpensive yet offer sufficient portions, providing good value for money.
3. Variety: Menus offer diverse options and customization, such as adding vegetables, adjusting spice levels, adding fried eggs or omelets, or incorporating other side dishes as desired.
4. Local Flavors: Most street food stalls focus on flavors familiar to Thai people, especially those with a balanced mix of spicy, sweet, and salty tastes.

If you have a favorite street food stall or would like a specific review, I can provide a detailed one!
sample_reviews_en.author: parichat bu

sample_reviews_en.text:
A friendly restaurant serving Thai and Isaan food.
A la carte dishes are also available. Recommended dishes include crispy pork with basil, squid tentacles with basil, shrimp fried rice, pork fried rice, salmon with wasabi, Luang Prabang papaya salad, fresh shrimp papaya salad, crab and fermented fish papaya salad, and many more. Order anything and everything is delicious. Snacks and cold drinks are available. The sound system is great. Enjoy delicious food with live music. The owner is beautiful and friendly. The waitresses are beautiful and friendly and take excellent care of customers. If you're in the area, please stop by and give them a try. You'll be hooked. ❤️🥰👍🎉⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I give it 5 stars.

sample_reviews_en.text:
SIN Rooftop Bar in Bangkok, located on the 27th floor of the Avani Hotel, has an amazing atmosphere with a stunning rooftop view of the Bangkok skyline. The vibe is really cool and perfect for enjoying drinks and music at night.

The DJ is great and keeps the energy lively throughout the night. What made the experience even better was the staff — they are incredibly friendly and welcoming.

Special thanks to Ken, Tong, Pee, N’Tong, and Tree for their warm hospitality. They made us feel like friends and made our moment and experience even more enjoyable.

Highly recommended place to chill, enjoy the music, and take in the beautiful Bangkok skyline!
sample_reviews_en.author: Andri Senjaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came because of the positive reviews, looking for something a bit more Western after so much fried food, but in our case, the staff's service left much to be desired; we didn't like the way we were treated. Be aware that they only accept card payments! No cash.
The Thai tea was good, the sandwiches a bit greasy. Not much else to add, just an average place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rach

sample_reviews_en.text: When away, I really try and avoid home like comforts as such. However on this occasion we were meeting for a tour here so why not. The staff were friendly, the coffee was decent, the almond croissants was good for a quick snack. I liked the decor, particularly the painted skateboard decks. Overall pretty decent. If you’re nearby, give it a go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Kilkenny

sample_reviews_en.text: The almond croissant was dry and tasteless. I ordered a vanilla latte and an Americano, and both were average. But I asked the person in the bathroom, whether it was a part-timer or the owner, and since I couldn't understand English at first, I asked again, and they just sighed and didn't answer;;

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place for good coffee and a good working environment. The staff tolerates working on the PC. There is air conditioning, but it doesn't work at 200%, so you can sit here and not get sick after a few minutes. Payment only by card, we always found a place to sit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Augustin

sample_reviews_en.author: W G

sample_reviews_en.text:
The view from the window is simple and distinctly Thai, which is nice.

It's not a place that's photogenic or trendy, but it's a very relaxing place with affordable drinks and a quiet atmosphere.

restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Crepes were really bad and way overpriced."

sample_reviews_th.text: The shop is located in an alley before the riverside. Look for the sign on the right. Parking is available along the roadside or in the parking lot at Phayeo Ying School (40฿ per hour).
sample_reviews_th.author: D P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kho Creperie has stolen my heart 💙 This might just be my most favorite find yet!

The vibe is absolutely enchanting—like stepping into a charming old patisserie somewhere in France. The design is a perfect match: think classic royal blue with pretty toile de prints, contrasted beautifully with raw, unfinished brick walls. It’s that wabi-sabi aesthetic that feels both elegant and effortlessly cool.

Oh, and the sweets? Delicious 😋 We tried the soft cookie topped with homemade vanilla ice cream… and yes, it was as dreamy as it sounds.

But what really makes this place special is how it feels just right—not overdone, completely unique, and totally me.

Already planning my next visit for their signature crepe! 🥞

📍 Kho Creperie
#KhoCreperie #HiddenGem #CafeHopping #DessertLovers #CrepeTime #WabiSabiStyle #InstaEats #FoodieFinds
sample_reviews_en.author: Whereaimsavor

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really really slow service. It’s almost as if they are very reluctant to serve you. Was waiting for a table and while there were some empty spots (plus only 2 people left on the guest list), they really took their time.

Update: I beg to differ on the level of service and attention. When I walked in, no one greeted me or said anything. I also saw the guest list, it wasn’t that long at all. What got me frustrated was that plates that were left sitting uncleared on a table longer than it should be (from the time that I arrived, looked at the menu front and back, put my name on the list, talked to the staff and then sat down to wait). That table that was uncleared could easily fit 4-5 people. And it isn’t just my experience about the service, there are other reviews that mentioned this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gail L

sample_reviews_en.text:
Koh Crêperie - Song Wat
Take it slow, it's ok.

A little corner of Paris hidden in the vibrant streets of Bangkok… As you wander through the alleys of Song Wat, Koh Crêperie suddenly appears like a secret door to France. With rustic brick walls, floral accents, and the warm aroma of coffee, it feels as though you’ve stepped straight into a cafe by the Seine.

Each crêpe is crafted with care, carrying the elegance and simplicity of French cuisine.

The coffee here is just as special – rich blends prepared with precision, evoking the classic European café culture. One sip and the whole atmosphere comes together, as if you’re starring in a French movie scene.

Koh Crêperie isn’t just a cafe. It’s a Parisian escape tucked away in the heart of Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Cafe Hunter

sample_reviews_en.text: I went during an event for a clothing brand. The staff didn't say anything but stood there with grumpy,ضغط expressions while we were taking photos with friends outside the cafe. I assume they thought we wouldn't order drinks. The prices were overpriced for the taste. The taste wasn't terrible, but for the price, it might not be worth it. However, the female cashier was friendly and smiling. The cafe is beautiful and photogenic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rawisara Jamthawornn

sample_reviews_en.text: It felt like we were tricked into wasting money on transportation. The sign said the shop closed at 8 PM, but we arrived at 6 PM and it was already closed. No one answered the phone. I suggest that if there's a reason for closing early, please announce it on your page, or answer the phone and inform customers. People who travel to your shop also pay for their trips, and you shouldn't let them know when you're closed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chollada Si.

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop has nice decor, and the crepes taste okay, but not amazing, which makes the price feel quite high. I ordered one sweet crepe and a Peace Soda for 160 baht, totaling 420 baht – quite expensive! It was very hot in the afternoon, the air conditioning wasn't sufficient, and there was no restroom available, especially considering the price. I hope the shop improves these things.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apinat Khamboonmak

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is cute, decorated with a Christmas theme. It's air-conditioned, but not too hot. I ordered a mixed berry crepe with ice cream.
The taste was average. I thought it was a cold crepe, but it seemed like it had been left out, so it was a bit shriveled. The ice cream was average. Overall, a cute shop, but the desserts were average.

sample_reviews_en.text: The bingsu is so delicious! They actually have many menu items, but I tried the bingsu first, and I really liked it. The price is great, and they also have fried chicken rice. I tried the fried chicken rice and it was delicious! They have a lot of sauces to choose from (my favorite is the sour cream cheese fried chicken). I hope this place goes viral! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

sample_reviews_en.text: The bingsu is delicious! Just the right amount of sweetness. They have a huge selection of desserts. The shop plays music constantly, making it feel like a chill hangout at a friend's house. There's parking available in front of the shop.

The restaurant's atmosphere is relaxing, the lighting is beautiful, and the food is delicious. I visited at 4 PM on a Saturday; there were only two tables occupied.

This time was fantastic. I will definitely go back.

sample_reviews_en.text: This was our 3rd time visiting Dean & Deluca Sarasin. It is on the north side of Lumphini Park, at the corner of Wireless and Sarasin Roads. It is collocated with a fantastic golf shop (and simulator facility). You can enjoy your awesome breakfast/lunch/dinner while watching or before/after playing. The manager is a great, cheerful guy and truly understands what the D&D customer enjoys. The staff and chefs are also wonderful. The food is delicious and very well prepared. Highest marks for D&D Sarasin.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Coffee is great .
Prawn Salad nice .

Change job. Service industry is not MMA fighting .

The lobster roll’s bread was way too hard and crumbly and the lobster itself was way too chewy and had no taste. The bolognese pasta was way too acidic and didn’t have a good balance. The fries tasted like they were microwaved and previously frozen. Very overpriced and thoroughly disappointed.

And the price of drinks here is not expensive at all.

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is clean, air-conditioned (not hot), and has seating with charging ports. The coffee is reasonably priced, the toast is okay, and the waffles are just average – you need to ask for honey to add to make them tastier. The female staff member is kind.

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I went to the shop and ordered two Americanos and two sandwiches, one for me and one for my boyfriend. But I spilled his coffee! The staff were so kind and made him a new one. Thank you so much! Great service and reasonable prices. Highly recommend!

sample_reviews_en.text: The music is good, the drinks are delicious, and the croissants are good too. It's a nice, relaxing place to kill time while waiting for the bus. The air conditioning is cool, and there are plenty of power outlets for charging your phone. Excellent!

sample_reviews_en.text: I previously ate here and loved it; the crispy pork was really delicious and not hard, so I gave it a 5-star review. But I should revise my review because, while the food is delicious, it's unsanitary. The woman put the order note inside the bowl with the crispy pork, when there were other ways to do it—like placing the paper and then putting the bowl of pork on top. I won't buy from them again until they improve. The woman was slow and hesitant. I understand there are many orders, but the management is quite poor. My previous order seemed so slow that they wanted to cancel it, but luckily it arrived on time, so I had to eat it. Also, they should improve the way they hold the spoons. They're packed too tightly and placed vertically, and everyone's hands touch the spoons, then I use them to eat. I recommend a new, horizontal spoon holder.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charin

sample_reviews_en.text:
HERO Crispy Pork Restaurant
Located in Siam Nara Food Court.

Crispy pork rice dishes start at 89 THB per plate.
Fried egg or omelet is 16 THB per egg.

Generous portions, delicious taste, and truly crispy pork.

The restaurant participates in the Thai Chuay Thai Plus 60/40 project.

The restaurant accepts cash and QR code payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is considered a must-try crispy pork restaurant in the Sathorn area, with a Japanese style.
The place is spacious and the atmosphere is friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: พัชราพร โฆสิต

sample_reviews_en.text: The crispy pork was very crispy and delicious. The staff were friendly and provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: 27น.ส ทิพสุคนธ์ อุชม

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and satisfying, it tastes just as good every time I eat it. Great value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: prakaymard ketkarn

restaurants.name: Okii Katsu
restaurants.address:

ชั้น g Central Plaza, 160 ถนน พระรามสอง Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
To be honest, I just realized that this style of restaurant requires reservations. I understand it might be because it's busy during mealtimes, but I stood for a very long time when I arrived. The staff didn't even inform me that I needed to reserve a table because there were empty tables at the time. Only after I sat down did they tell me to reserve a table. Then, when it was my turn, they gave me a small table. I've eaten here before, and when I put the set meal, appetizers, and water glasses on it, the table was cluttered. I told the staff that there wasn't enough space, but they just ignored me and acted like they didn't hear me, even though I asked to change tables even though there were 3 empty tables. (The kitchen staff/serving staff were okay, doing their job), but the counter staff taking orders (the woman in the black shirt) needs retraining.
And I also found a hair in my food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nkukky PP

sample_reviews_en.text: Okii Katsu is a brand I've only recently discovered. It's a Japanese restaurant specializing in katsu, or fried pork cutlets, served with various side dishes. The best part is that the side dishes are unlimited! This includes Japanese rice, miso soup, steamed egg custard, kimchi, pickled vegetables, and potato salad. You can order seconds of each side dish. I ordered the pork loin set for 175 baht + 20 baht for green tea. The pork cutlet was well-cooked and not greasy. The dipping sauce was good, and I really appreciated the unlimited side dish refills (just ordering seconds of each already makes it worth it!). The restaurant is located on the lower floor, in the new Food Patio area of ​​Central. It's definitely a place you should try if you like tonkatsu. I'll be back to try other menu items next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Davich New Klinadung

sample_reviews_en.text:
The advantages are that it's delicious, great value for money, and there's no service charge. The pork loin was well-fried and tasted delicious when eaten hot, almost as good as Katsukura's. However, it became chewy once it cooled down. The fried shrimp was very tasty and not oily at all. Compared to the price and quality, it's excellent value because the side dishes are delicious and refillable. We liked the kimchi; it was perfectly salty and the vegetables were crispy. The steamed egg was also good, not bad at all. The mashed potatoes were good too. Importantly, the rice was hot in every bowl.
The disadvantages are that the sesame grinder is too small; it takes a lot of effort to grind it finely. The miso soup was too salty, and the hot green tea we ordered wasn't hot at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyavee Apichitchai

sample_reviews_en.text: I went on December 2nd, 2024, at approximately 5:00 PM. The female employee taking the order, who had recently had a nose job, had a very condescending attitude towards customers. Her tone was like a teacher scolding a student. I simply ordered a set meal, specifically just the mackerel, and there was a child with me who didn't want to eat, so I ordered only adult dishes. She should have spoken more politely and smiled. Initially, I was going to let it go and ordered a child's set meal, but when the food arrived, she kept glancing at the child, as if she was worried the adults would share their food. This was disrespectful to customers who were simply having a proper meal. My 4-year-old child couldn't even finish their own set meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: pongphan eaumchaimongkol

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re craving tonkatsu that’s affordable but still good quality I highly recommend this place 🤍

I personally love how rich the tonkatsu sauce is and the salad dressing pairs perfectly with the meal. This is my go to spot whenever I can’t decide what to eat.🤣👌🏻

The best part is when you order a set menu you get unlimited refills of side dishes (rice, soup, mashed potatoes, shredded cabbage, kimchi and steamed egg) I always go for at least two rounds of each 🤣 and the portions are just perfect! Definitely great value for money and super filling.

📍 English menu available

📌 Located on the G floor
sample_reviews_en.author: Nirun S

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese pork cutlet rice bowl restaurant is located on the G floor, near the Top supermarket. They offer various cuts of breaded fried pork, including tenderloin, sirloin, and neck, all sold as set menus. Each set includes one plate of pork cutlet, Japanese rice, shredded cabbage, mashed potatoes, soup, and kimchi – everything except the pork cutlet is refillable. It's perfect for big eaters; one plate of pork cutlet is enough for two bowls of rice comfortably. If you don't want to spend more than at larger restaurants, this is a good option; the taste isn't significantly different.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kia KK

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate at the Central Rama 2 branch.
I ordered the refill set, which included miso soup,
steamed egg custard, potato salad, and kimchi.
However, when I asked for more,
the waitress was very grumpy.
She didn't say anything, just made a face and walked away.
I also had to wait quite a while for a water refill.
The food was delicious, but there weren't many customers.
It might be because of the service.
A little improvement would be appreciated, because the food is tasty.
It's a shame that customers might not come because of the service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Methika Kasemumpaipran

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the price was good. I tried to overlook the service, but after taking the order, the first thing that should have arrived was water. There were staff members available, but they were just standing around (the woman in the black uniform was probably the one taking the order, or maybe they divided the tasks and didn't interfere), and they didn't serve water first. When the food arrived, I had to ask for water first. The staff member in the white uniform was very helpful and did it immediately.
sample_reviews_en.author: pronpimon yamboonmee

restaurants.name: Srinagarindra Food Court
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 96 Srinagarindra Rd, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The market is very quiet. There's parking in front along the street, and if that's full, there's plenty of parking in the back, but it's uncovered. Only Suki Teenoi is a bit busier, but after 6 PM, there's only a short queue, unlike other branches which are always packed. This is branch number 14, located at Srinakarin Market, opposite Paradise Park and near Seacon Square Srinakarin. Many students from Triam Udom Suksa Pattanakarn School eat here after school. ***The main drawback is that the restrooms are very far away and cost 5 baht each time.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิโรจน์ ภัทรพงศาวณิชย์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restroom costs 5 baht, but when I inserted the coins, the revolving door wouldn't open. When I asked the cleaning lady, she said, "Then you're wasting your money..."
1. If you're going to run a market and charge for restroom use, just stop.
2. You need to be more selective with your cleaning staff.
Charging money is tolerable, but this place is broken, and the cleaning lady has a bad attitude. That's it, it's terrible. The Paradise Market across the street is much better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Muffin Luffy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The hospital is now open, with parking available on the 3rd floor, and all facilities are operational. However, restroom renovations are not yet complete and will take a little longer. Most areas are open for service.
Restrooms on the 2nd and 1st floors can be used as an alternative to the 3rd floor, and the 3rd floor hallway is still undergoing renovations.
sample_reviews_en.author: วัชระ เปรม

sample_reviews_en.text: We got lost and ended up in this food court. This booth is great: (1) the owner uncle (low key stylish) is very nice and helpful, the food is sooooooo affordable and taste is just totally fine! You couldn't believe how little we've spent on our dinner (see menu) 🫶🏽 It's such a pleasant surprise. We hope you good business 🙌🏽 Happy 2025
sample_reviews_en.author: - AC

sample_reviews_en.text: Paradise Park has renovated its retail space on every floor. The original delicious restaurants are still there, just on different floors and in different locations. There's also a medical center from Ramathibodi Hospital. The food court now offers a wide variety of choices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yok Wongtananan

sample_reviews_en.text: The parking lot in the market. The view while waiting in line for Sukiyaki Teenoi was great, especially with the chilly weather. The restrooms are provided by the market and cost 5 baht to use; they're clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noppamat P.

sample_reviews_en.text: Love it. A very clean place with many Thai food choices plus a small  bakery shop. A good lunch option when shopping at the Villa Market next door.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Chang

sample_reviews_en.text: Srinakarin Market is located on Srinakarin Road, opposite Paradise Park Shopping Mall. There is plenty of parking space behind the building.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyachat Piamduaytham

restaurants.name: Thai Express
restaurants.address:

257, 6 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Samre, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The authentic thai food restarant is located at riverside shopping mall so, they are able to present what's really thai food and a taset of delicious is able to take you to reach how is literal tasty thai food beside the staffs are pretty kindness and they can provide suggestion to clients and expand the menu as well you guy must'n miss for having a great time at there with you family or your friends either it cloud be lunch or dinner it such a nice restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Itkun Itkun

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is pretty good, it’s local food made for tourists but in a good way. The decoration lacks a bit of charm, it’s his standardized style that you find in every second bistro in big cities. You place your order directly on an ipad attached to your table. I don’t really see the point when the place is as small as this one. Beside that, service was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y.

sample_reviews_en.text: The Basil Thai Kitchen in the Laguna Entrance area @ Boat Avenue Phuket is a fantastic restaurant with great Thai food options for vegetarians. Our hostess Sao( Thitapa) is one of the loveliest, friendliest and most helpful person we have met here in Phuket... I wish her well and the best of luck 🤗🤗🤗 …
sample_reviews_en.author: bhavin bhatt

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst Thai food I've had in years: Microwaved/dried out Gai Tod, mouldy Som Tam, Kao Pad (fried rice) tasted like plastic, shrimps like surimi-sticks... and Overpriced too - due to the extra service/VAT charges! All together a totally disappointing experience. Never again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kennis Werkt

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant replaced Thai Express, but the taste isn't as good as it used to be. The food seems a bit saltier, and the portions have gotten smaller, so I'm still hungry after eating. I think Korean Pad Thai tastes better.
sample_reviews_en.author: 상종페레스 (상종페레스)

sample_reviews_en.text: Although known for its fast preparation, Thai cousine finds its pinnacle here. A plate is ready in 5 minutes and it doesn't means that it isn't good. As a matter of fact it is surprisingly tasty for a brandy restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sebastian Herbert

sample_reviews_en.text: i ordered pad thai with seafood and pad see ew with chicken. i like thai food and i would say that the food of this restaurant is below than the average. but coconut juice, the only menu that i liked, was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Haena Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: Too limited menu. Dishes in physical menu are different from the ones in tablet. The taste and quality is very different from dish to dish. Seafood is frozen which I did not expect at this price range.
sample_reviews_en.author: A guy in his 40s.

restaurants.name: Chester's, C.P. Tower Si Lom
restaurants.address:

B Floor, C. P. Tower, 313 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch seems to use a lot of staff training, but I often encounter arrogant employees here, even when they make mistakes. They're stubborn, don't apologize, and today was no different. My order was lost, and when I followed up, they acted arrogant as usual, refusing to apologize and just being haughty. / I sent a DM to the Chester's page. A little while later, an employee took out their phone pretending to take pictures of the restaurant's atmosphere, but it was obvious they were taking pictures in my direction. (They're busy but taking pictures; it's clear they're taking them to send to their supervisor. PDPA (Personal Data Protection Act) – that's a crime, jail and fines. You have CCTV, you can't claim that. There's no need to take personal photos. When I saw them, they quickly put their phone down. I have a picture of the person who took it; you can ask to see it if you want.) In short, it took 20 minutes. If I hadn't gone to follow up, I wouldn't have gotten my food. I was just waiting. They're loud and greet people well, but the service is...
sample_reviews_en.author: B. TK.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch is located in the CP Tower building and opens early (7:00 AM on weekdays), providing office workers with a convenient breakfast option.

The restaurant is spacious and not crowded, making it a comfortable place to eat. A special feature of this branch is that it also offers Chester's Coffee for coffee lovers.

Even better, if you work in this building (CP Tower), you can call and order for free delivery right to your office! Enjoy a delicious and convenient meal. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Bad Bad'z

sample_reviews_en.text: I went for lunch and accidentally left my bag at the CP Tower Silom branch in the afternoon. I didn't realize it until after work. I was shocked because all my important belongings were in it. Luckily, the branch kept it for me. Thank you so much to the branch manager and all the staff for being so attentive and taking such good care of my belongings. I'll definitely visit this branch often when I have the chance! 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: ทิพยา ฟังเร็ว

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai childhood memory fast-food restaurant

- food tastes pretty average

- with the similar price, I’d personally go for other local Thai restaurants; yet, for what its worth, considering it’s a Thai childhood fast-food restaurant, it’s not too bad!

- everything is very much average but the tastes isn’t so special though :)) Good for a quick meal! 👍🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwon Se Yang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant was fairly spacious, and when I went around 5 PM, there seemed to be a lot of solo diners. Many of the staff were chatting idly, perhaps because they were bored.

The taste was average, neither particularly good nor bad.

The grilled chicken was slightly spicy.

The only drink option in the set meal was cola.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kei

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I've been eating at since I was a kid. The chicken is still as delicious as ever, but the pieces are getting smaller each time. The crab sauce and seafood dipping sauce are pretty good. The prices aren't expensive, but not cheap either. The focus is on a relaxed atmosphere and quick service.
sample_reviews_en.author: NY H

sample_reviews_en.text:
The usual chicken menu is okay, though.
It's a decent place to grab a meal... It's a shame the quality keeps declining.

The new June 2023 product, the milk-marinated chicken, looks very different from the advertised picture, and the taste isn't good either.

Deep down, I'm kind of disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisby

sample_reviews_en.text:
The new store is nice, more space & clean. But, the food is so disappointing & does not worth the money.

The food quality is not as it used to be.

We were so upset with the snow chicken. The onion slice was too thick, which was not suitable for the dish but the battered onion ring indeed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Triet Le

restaurants.name: ก๋วยจั๊บดาวรุ่ง
restaurants.address:

QH74+GG7, Alley, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A box of crispy pork rice costs 50 baht and comes with a generous portion of rice, plenty of crispy pork, and a half-boiled egg. I highly recommend trying it! It's incredibly delicious. I'll upload pictures later. Here are some more pictures (17/10/64). Honestly, I buy this regularly to eat in my room. In the mornings, the wait isn't too long because it's quite popular. They sell various dishes including noodle soup, pork leg rice, and crispy pork rice (the crispy pork usually sells out quickly). I personally love the crispy pork rice. They give you a side of broth and sweet sauce. Putting everything together in a bowl is just amazing! Everything goes together perfectly. You have to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gifsy Kornkanok

sample_reviews_en.text: The kway chap (rice noodle soup) was delicious. A friend recommended it, so I tried it. The taste was good, and the offal had no smell. Regular is 50 baht, special is 60 baht. They separate the noodles, toppings, and broth, which is great because I ate it at lunchtime. I'll definitely stop by again.
sample_reviews_en.author: MahUnZaa

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was very poor, and the staff were rude. They need to improve. I'm also in the service industry, and I believe this kind of service is unacceptable. #KuyJapDaorung (opposite Prachasongkroh Market)
sample_reviews_en.author: แป้ง เเป้ง

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. The in-store order taking process was awful. They really need to improve their business practices; people are paying for their goods, not begging for food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papa Papa

sample_reviews_en.text:
16/05/64 Ordered 4 bags of noodle soup, but they didn't include the broth.
In short, I couldn't eat it when I got home because there was no broth for the noodle soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nesle Psk

sample_reviews_en.text: They start selling around 3 AM until 10 AM. Everything is delicious, including the noodle soup and the pork leg rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: กฤษ กาสิกพัสสตร์

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was decent. The offal was good and not gamey. The only downside was that the crispy pork was sold out...
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanphat Kijprueang

sample_reviews_en.text: The seller refused the customer's order, had a sour face, and spoke rudely. It was a terrible experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gfj Gfjh
