sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the service staff made several mistakes. They said they didn't have soft drinks even though there were some in the fridge at the front of the store. They also didn't prepare all the dishes I ordered, and when I asked about them, they just kept saying "Sorry, we'll get it done quickly."
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyawat Chaisomtrakul

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat here occasionally because I love the curry; it's delicious! The service is good, and it's easy to get to. The atmosphere might be a bit quiet, but I wish there was a no-smoking sign and that the prices were adjusted accordingly.
sample_reviews_en.author: BKcat

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in the Ari Station project. It has a nice atmosphere, perfect for dine-in or takeout, and they also offer online ordering. There are many menu options to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lampai Pa

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a comfortable seating area (the food is delicious and appealing), provides useful information and knowledge, and the staff are very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theeramet Ch.

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese restaurant might be a bit hard to find, located behind Nong Mac's restaurant. But it's worth the price, the taste is good, and you'll be full.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nave Accavie

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating at the restaurant, and it was much better than ordering takeout. The price was good and the taste suited my palate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bay Vijitakula

sample_reviews_en.text: Japanese and korean style food, prices are affordable. Menu choices are limited but they have wagyu.  I liked the chicken gochujang.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenin Rathnayake

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food wasn't very hot.
The prices at the shop were much cheaper than on Shopee, so I decided to come here myself.
sample_reviews_en.author: PCR _A

restaurants.name: Wandee Coffee by Koy
restaurants.address:

26 Arun Amarin Rd, Wat Kanlaya, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the 2 eggs and sausage slice of bread, really good and they have a good coffee too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oly Ramirez

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a lovely restaurant with delicious food. The owner is friendly and attentive to every dish. It's near Wat Kalayanamit, so you can stop by to recharge after visiting the temple before heading home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanya Suwannangam

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is cute and inviting. The food is delicious and the prices are reasonable. There are a variety of food and desserts. It's suitable for both children and adults.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Nort

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารสวนไผ่
restaurants.address:

Bang Krasaw, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A noodle shop nestled amidst a bamboo grove, offering a rustic, nature-filled atmosphere. The flavors are home-style, with coconut milk curry, spicy curry, and sometimes green curry. They also serve fruit from the garden. The shop is tucked away in an alley; there's no parking lot, so you have to park on the side of the road. There's no air conditioning; you enjoy the natural breeze and fans.
sample_reviews_en.author: Be Birth

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small, cozy, homey shop with a simple, relaxed atmosphere and a cool breeze. The curry sauce is delicious, not watery, and the ingredients are good. The place is clean.
The cantaloupe is tasty, but the coconut milk isn't fragrant. The lod chong (Thai dessert) is just average. I recommend the cantaloupe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sai Sutti

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rice noodles with curry sauce were delicious, both the coconut milk and the spicy version were great.
I happened to have some curry rice there too; the stir-fried chicken with basil was delicious and cheap. I'll definitely stop by often. The owner is lovely 💘
sample_reviews_en.author: Saowanee .s

sample_reviews_en.text:
01/02/64

I love Auntie's shop. Auntie accepts the government's co-payment scheme.
It's not hot eating at the shop.

The best part is the fish sauce.
You just order plain rice and eat it with the fish sauce.
Just kidding!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mongkhon patikachodok

sample_reviews_en.text: I love the atmosphere. Eating here is so relaxing. I recommend the fried sun-dried tilapia, the coconut milk dessert with rice noodles, and the excellent rice noodles with curry sauce. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: ปอ.เปิ้ล ดีดี

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, the omelet is delicious, fresh and clean. The owner takes very good care of her customers. The atmosphere is close to nature with a fan at every table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soonthorn Nunimitr

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a simple restaurant with average-tasting food, but one you could eat at regularly. It also has a nice garden view.
sample_reviews_en.author: Su Khamenngan

sample_reviews_en.text: Homemade style rice noodles, delicious, and we also sell tender bamboo shoots from our garden at an affordable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mom Chaisuk

restaurants.name: Come On
restaurants.address:

26 ซอยสุขสวัสดิ์ 19 ต Bang Pakok, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Good neighborhood restaurant with a good selection of western and local favorites. Menu is in Thai but they have good pictures. Clean and most importantly it’s air conditioned! Quality of food is good. Portions are large by Thai standards and prices are fair. Stir fried pork in garlic and rice, Stir fried pork with thai basil with egg, stir fried shrimp and beans in chili sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roland Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: There are plenty of tables, which is good. The chicken steak was just right, not too spicy, and the fries were crispy. The staff provided good service. Since the steak takes time to prepare, I recommend taking a taxi. Motorbikes can easily be parked in front of the shop. Plus, you can stop by Bake a Wish cake shop on the way back.
sample_reviews_en.author: kosin skb

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff provided supplementary food, not water. I ordered twice and didn't drink plain water. The service was terrible. I ate supplementary food and paid for it. They said no water was served and I could drink it in my car. The staff responded with a 'yes' instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชัยโย แก้วเกิด

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Southern Thai food is delicious. The flavors aren't too strong, but if you prefer it spicier like authentic Southern Thai food, just let the restaurant know...
The staff are attentive and provide good service.
I'll try other dishes next time! 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Pun PK

sample_reviews_en.text: The small restaurant like a hidden gem around the area,  great taste with incredible low price, big portion plate and variety menus, both real taste southern thai style and western food. Highly recommend to everyone
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanya Takoonsawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu has so many choices!
I went there a long time ago and remember ordering some kind of spaghetti dish.
The portion was huge; I could barely finish it.
I'll definitely go back again sometime!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kansuda Sun

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was beautifully presented and tasted delicious. The male staff member was lovely and provided impressive service. The overall atmosphere was good and clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: เจริญ ทองมี

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, but the wait is very long. During peak hours, you could even lie down and wait. The steak is inexpensive and comes with plenty of vegetables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakorn Saokaew

restaurants.name: ร้านมหาวงศ์เป็ดย่าง Mahawong
restaurants.address:

179 Phahonyothin Rd, แขวง พญาไท Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I just ordered from Foodpanda, but there was no sauce included. I called the owner, and they said they would bring it, but I told them I'd pick it up myself. When I got to the shop, they had everything prepared for me, and even gave me some dumplings. They were so kind!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mann Zomzaa

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried it for the first time because of the government's "Taste, Shop, Use" campaign. The dry wonton soup with barbecued pork was delicious. The wontons were soft, full of filling, and incredibly tasty.
The shop is located by the road and looks clean. I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phitharat Sitthirung

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles were excellent.
The duck wasn't quite up to par; it was a bit crumbly.
The dumplings were okay.
The flavor was a bit bland and needed seasoning, but personally, I like it this way.
sample_reviews_en.author: S. Srisawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop was recently renovated (2018), has been open for a very long time, and is located at the entrance of Soi Luecha, in front of Sanam Pao Market.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wiwat Kanjanakaroon

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The duck noodles, duck rice, and crispy pork are all amazing. The sauce is delicious and rich.
sample_reviews_en.author: jantarush comwien

restaurants.name: Pan Lee Bakery
restaurants.address:

1335 ถ. เจริญกรุง Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An old-fashioned bakery, reminiscent of grandparents' era 🥰
A wide variety of pastries including various filled breads, cookies, and pies 🍪🥧🥮
Delicious (I especially like the BBQ pork bun, black sesame bun, purple sweet potato bun, Pla Khlib (a type of Thai pastry), and the dried shrimp cracker).
In addition, the shop has a drinks and food section on the 2nd floor.
Park at Central Bang Rak 🚗🚙 and walk to the shop, which is about 300 meters away 🚶‍♂️🚶‍♂️
P.S. Along the way, there are many interesting roadside stalls such as:
Heng Piew Grass Jelly
Prachak Roast Duck
Peng Hiang Fish Ball Noodle Shop
Prince Bang Rak Congee Shop
Kha Moo Tewada Bang Rak (a type of Thai pork knuckle shop)
Jee Ma Wu Black Sesame (enter Soi Charoen Wiang Road)
sample_reviews_en.author: R.A.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I bought three boxes of bread, including brownies and pork floss bread, from a booth at Central Rama 2 after finishing my banking transactions. They were delicious, chewy, and just the right texture. The total price was 100 baht, which wasn't too expensive. I'll definitely support them again when I'm in the Bang Rak area.

Update
Today I finally visited their main store and bought a small box of custard buns. It cost 90 baht in total, but I used the government's co-payment scheme to pay only 45 baht. The bread's softness and the custard filling were excellent, truly befitting a legendary Hainanese bakery.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Commizza

sample_reviews_en.text:
For a taste of classic Bangkok flavors, you can't miss this historic bakery that blends Chinese and Western styles.

Their Hainanese-style mooncakes, available only during the Mid-Autumn Festival each year, are incredibly fragrant and a coveted treat for foodies.

When visiting on weekdays, be sure to bring a char siu bread, a kaya toast, and an iced cocoa – a perfect combination that will leave you wanting more.

A classic taste with a fresh twist – highly recommended, don't miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ping'er Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old bakery on Charoen Krung Road. They have a wide variety of pastries. I arrived around 11 am and many items were already sold out. I only managed to buy 2-3 things. The custard-filled bread was not too sweet, had a lovely custard aroma, and the bread itself was soft. 😋😋 The staff provided good service. They also have drinks and seating on the second floor. There is no parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small yet charming bakery with a good variety of cakes and bread. Ordering is done at the counter.

It’s a pity that the milk tea seems to be made with creamer (just my guess).
The Korean Cream Cheese Bun is very large — it can feel a bit too heavy for one person to finish.
The American Breakfast is served with thick toast instead of sourdough, and overall it tastes quite good.
sample_reviews_en.author: JYH

sample_reviews_en.text: The bread is delicious, especially the custard filling, and the prices are affordable. They have a wide variety of fresh pastries to choose from, including the chicken floss cake with salad dressing 👍🏻, which is also reasonably priced. They have a variety of drinks on the menu, and their traditional strawberry jam cake comes in several sizes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phutthakul Janpakdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I used to eat at their branch in Soi Pho Pan, Din Daeng, but it's closed now. I happened to be in the area for business and decided to stop by to support them. It's still as delicious as before, and they now have more menu options. However, there aren't many seats available as it's located on the mezzanine floor.
#BaldHeadTravels
sample_reviews_en.author: นฤชิต สุนทรสนาน

sample_reviews_en.text: This bakery is a little gem. Freshly baked goodies and a very nice selection. Purchased the Pandan Custard Buns and they tasted very nice. Soft bun, fresh green custard filling.  Was a nice choice for a different and light breakfast. Not expensive and the staff were easy to talk to (English) and welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Buckingham

restaurants.name: La Taverna del Salbanèl · Italian Northern Tavern
restaurants.address:

Burgundy Door (ประตูสีแดงขวามือ, 14 Charoen Rat 24 Alley, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Italian restaurant serves Northern Italian style cuisine. The flavors aren't the overly salty, cheesy kind with lots of Pecorino cheese. They don't serve pizza, but who knows what the future holds.

Reservations are recommended.

Before ordering, the owner will explain the details of each dish on the menu.

Double-check your order to avoid any omissions.

The portions are large (but we finished everything). For two people, don't order more than three dishes.

The quality of the ingredients is excellent. I recommend trying the cold cuts and the cheese board. The salad with EVOO olive oil is fantastic; the oil itself tastes great.

Personally, I still prefer spaghetti with Pecorino cheese – it's more cheesy – but theirs is delicious; I've never had a better spaghetti elsewhere. My mom and sister also said it was delicious.

The beef cheek is tasty, and the side of mashed corn is excellent – ​​definitely worth trying.

The Tiramisu and ice cream are also good, but I'm not a big dessert person, so I can't compare them.

For parking, it's best to park in the building with Lotus and walk about 10 minutes. If you like to try your luck, you can park on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bla bla

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a hidden gem of a restaurant in Bangkok, truly a little gem. I can honestly say it serves authentic Italian food from an Italian chef. The atmosphere is warm and homey, perfect for a family dinner or a romantic date. We highly recommend calling ahead to reserve a table, as the restaurant is always fully booked. We were very lucky to get a reservation for just the two of us. We ordered three dishes, and let me tell you, the portions were huge! It might take a little time to prepare, but we didn't mind as the chef works alone. Each dish has its own unique story. We recommend ordering two or three dishes if you're dining with a partner. And of course, the wine pairs perfectly with the food. For dessert, we highly recommend the Timori Mizu – not too sweet and incredibly delicious, the best we've ever had. For us, the prices are very reasonable considering the quality of the ingredients. It feels like we've traveled to Italy and are dining at a truly authentic Italian restaurant. ❤️❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Oonwika Pd

sample_reviews_en.text: After a month travelling through Thailand and Laos eating great local foods we needed a change of flavours and this tiny taberna (just 4 tables)proved the perfect answer. This isn’t a generic pseudo’Thaitalian’ that you’re going to find across Bangkok but instead a totally authentic homely trattoria of the type you hope to find in a village square in the hills around Bergamo. All of the ingredients are carefully sourced and imported from Italy, the breads are home baked to order, the pastas are homemade and fresh, the wines are carefully chosen and properly served. As a result It’s not the cheapest meal you are going to find out here but if you’re in the mood for a true taste of Northern Italian home cooking then this is the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keith Marsh

sample_reviews_en.text: Northern Italian food is like being in Thailand and having to eat sai ua (Northern Thai sausage) and nam prik num (Northern Thai chili paste). Italian cuisine emphasizes cheese and ham because of the mountainous terrain. It was a great experience trying high-quality cheese and ham. The portions were huge; even though they said it was for 1-2 people, we had to share among 6! Even the gelato was massive. Normally, I get breakouts and bloating from eating milk and cheese, but yesterday's meal was packed with cheese in every dish, and I was fine. If you want to try a different kind of Italian food, I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: หรรษา วรัญญูวงศ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
After 5 months in Southeast Asia, my girlfriend and I found this restaurant.
Finally, we ate ITALIAN!
Everything was cooked by a friendly Italian guy, using excellent Italian ingredients.
The menu had so many delicious things we wanted to try everything!
Everything we ordered was delicious, just like at home.
His wife, a Thai woman, works with him and explained the menu to us thoroughly and was very kind and friendly.
Highly recommended for anyone who wants to try authentic Italian cuisine in Thailand. If we ever come back, we'll definitely visit them again. Thanks for the wonderful dinner! 🍀
sample_reviews_en.author: Davide

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant isn't huge, but not too small either. The atmosphere is nice, the portions are generous and delicious. The ingredients are fresh and premium; the cheeses and beef are especially tasty. The side dish for the main course isn't mashed potatoes, but rather Italian-style mashed corn, which the staff explained is eaten as a substitute for rice in Italians. The wine is also of good quality and reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amyyy _

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Northern Italian food. I tried the truffle, porcini and Italian sausage pasta, loved it so much, the aroma of truffle filled the whole place. The beef cheek ragu pasta and the salad with stracciatella cheese and parma were also very good. The Thai lady owner explains each dish nicely and makes you feel very welcome. Portions are quite big for Thai standards. I’ll come back to try more dishes next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ning

sample_reviews_en.text:
We finally visited this North Italian restaurant after its long renovation, and the wait was worth it. The space is now beautifully cozy - almost like a chalet in the Italian Alps.

The food easily transports you out of Bangkok. These are not your typical Italian dishes; they’re rich, hearty Northern classics made with authentic ingredients and real depth of flavor. Very good place. Try yourself!
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text:
#Noodle and Basil Stir-fry Restaurant
#HiddenGem @Located near BTS Ratchathewi exit (but you have to look carefully). The storefront is narrow, and the entrance has two steps, so be careful not to trip.
Then you'll find an automatic door, but you still have to press a button to open it.
The restaurant is stuffy inside, and the air isn't fresh. It's even worse when they're stir-frying; you might sneeze.
The restaurant has a good queuing system, but it would be better if they could communicate the different spice levels to customers.
I tried the shrimp basil stir-fry. The shrimp were large, the rice grains were perfectly separated, the aroma was fragrant, and there was no fishy smell. The taste was well-rounded, with an intriguing aroma that lingered in my mouth, and a tingling sensation at the end. This is the unique characteristic of their basil stir-fry, found only at Noodle and Basil Stir-fry Restaurant, and you absolutely have to try it at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: BB VVIP

sample_reviews_en.text:
How could you not try one of Thailand's most popular dishes...pad kra pao!!
The restaurant is located right under the BTS station, so it's easy to get there by public transport, but if you have a car, forget it. No parking!!
Unfortunately, the restaurant doesn't have restrooms, and service is "do-it-yourself" with a QR code, which is unfortunately slow...probably because a lot of people order online.
The food, however, is delicious, well-balanced, and the spiciness I chose was perfectly matched.
The price might be high for some, but for me, it's worth it.
Overall, I recommend trying it. Very good!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex ander

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a hidden gem restaurant! Their basil rice is absolutely delicious, and it's frequented by many locals. Grab orders are constantly pouring in. I've tried basil rice at several Michelin-starred restaurants in Thailand and on Dianping (a Chinese review platform), but none of them were as good. Without this restaurant, I probably wouldn't have enjoyed basil rice. Highly recommended! If you can't handle spice, you don't need the medium spicy option; the mild spicy is just right. The chicken wings are also excellent—crispy skin, tender, and juicy. I highly recommend everyone try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: 张伟

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re craving Thai food, especially Pad Kra Pao, this restaurant is highly recommended. The dishes are flavorful and perfect for spice lovers, though you can adjust the spice level to your preference. The staff are friendly, the restaurant is clean, and it’s conveniently located just a short walk from the BTS. Prices are fair, slightly higher than ordinary local shops, but the quality and taste make it worthwhile.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pyae Linn Aung

sample_reviews_en.text:
My favorite supper during my Bangkok trip!
I pre-ordered before arriving home, so the waiting time was minimal. The dish I had was stir-fried minced pork with holy basil, paired with twin fried eggs and a scrambled egg—such a luxurious yet satisfying meal! The flavors were incredible, and every bite was pure enjoyment. The soup that came with it was so heartwarming, adding the perfect touch to the meal.

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has an eye-catching design and a table-top scanning ordering system. The food tasted delicious; I ordered 50% spicy, but it wasn't spicy enough for me. Next time I'll try the 200% spicy version. However, I noticed my basil chicken dish wasn't hot at all, and the soup was just average. The staff were all lovely.

sample_reviews_en.text: This late-night restaurant is run by only one person, so the service is extremely slow, and there's not a single apology. sample_reviews_en.text:
Iew Pad Thai with Morning Glory Noodles, Talad Phlu Thet Thai 27

Is this a chef's table? 😂 Come to the front of the shop, sit in front of the stove, you'll feel it right. For this shop, Iew Talad Phlu, a small shop with about 2 tables, so we had to sit at the table in front of the stove. We ordered 3 dishes with 2 friends. Let's start with the first dish, morning glory noodles with crispy pork. It's delicious and spicy. I give it the No. 1 ranking. It has a slight grilled aroma, not too much. The crispy pork is very crispy. The next dish is stir-fried minced pork with basil and thick egg. It tastes good. The basil is stir-fried to perfection. And the last dish for us, the pork is soft with garlic and pepper. It's really delicious. We don't need to add fish sauce. Moreover, the vendor is friendly. Super friendly, impressive

Shop name 📌Iew Pad Thai, morning glory noodles, Talat Phlu Thet Thai 27

sample_reviews_en.text:
This stir-fried noodles with water spinach was incredibly delicious! It had a wonderful wok aroma, and the seasoning was perfect – just the right amount of spiciness and saltiness. Eating it with the crispy pork enhanced the flavor even more. The pork pieces were a good size, easy to eat, not too big. The shrimp were large, bouncy, fresh, and clean. Only the tender shoots of the water spinach were used, making it easy to eat. The restaurant clearly pays attention to the quality of its ingredients.

However, I went in the afternoon when they were about to close, so I ordered it to go and asked for chopsticks to eat in the car 😂

Personally, I think it's tastier than the one under the bridge, and the price is better too.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the portions were just right, and the price was reasonable. The Wagyu beef stir-fried with garlic, chili, and salt was amazing. The basil pork and oyster sauce pork were also good; the pork was tender. sample_reviews_en.text: The receptionist was unhelpful. Initially, we looked at the menu outside the restaurant. Once we decided to eat, we walked in with the receptionist. We sat for a while, but no one brought us a menu. It seemed like no staff member was interested in us. We glanced at the receptionist, who knew we were new customers, and saw he was wiping dishes or doing something in the kitchen. We asked for a menu, and he replied, "Just a moment," and went to wait for menus from another table. We could see he didn't have enough menus because other tables were using them, but instead of immediately informing us to wait for a menu as soon as we entered, he just seated us and went off to do something else. We had to ask about it ourselves.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eye Eye

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent Korean fried chicken with amazing flavour and quality. The chicken was perfectly crispy on the outside while staying juicy and tender on the inside. Every bite was packed with flavour, and the sauces complemented the chicken really well without being overpowering.

The restaurant was clean, comfortable, and had a welcoming atmosphere. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made the dining experience even more enjoyable. The portions were generous and definitely worth the price.

Overall, a fantastic place for Korean fried chicken. Great food, great service, and a great atmosphere. I’ll definitely be coming back to try more flavours!
sample_reviews_en.author: KURI NGUYEN

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the least enjoyable Korean fried chicken I've ever had. The batter is light and crispy, causing the sauce to soak in quickly, resulting in a rather sweet and cloying flavor. The sundubu soup had a very confusing mix of flavors; mildly spicy with a salty aftertaste, and I wasn't sure if it was cucumber or zucchini, but the strong smell completely overpowered the other flavors.

The staff provided good service; I visited during lunchtime on a weekday when there were no other customers and no queue.
sample_reviews_en.author: J. KT

sample_reviews_en.text: I personally didn't like the fried chicken because the batter was thick, hard, and not fluffy. The kimchi soup was extremely salty. The prices are on the expensive side compared to the quantity, quality, and taste. And the prices don't include 7% VAT and a 10% service charge. The staff member preparing the takeout orders was constantly loud and seemed unhappy about something. When there were no orders, they were chatting loudly with other staff members.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mae Mae

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean fried chicken restaurant is incredibly delicious. I always go there whenever I'm in Bangkok. BHX Chicken has many branches, so I just go to whichever one is closest and most convenient. I usually get tired of eating just the fried chicken, but today I tried the rice dish, and it was amazing! It turns out everything at BHX Chicken is delicious, super high quality!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony Khoa

sample_reviews_en.text: From dining in to requesting delivery, the staff provided excellent advice and service. I highly recommend this place and would definitely share my experience! 👍😊

I'll definitely try the restaurant when I have the chance. I've ordered from her three times in a row now!
