sample_reviews_en.author: KP “kanoon” 12

sample_reviews_en.text: It's cheap and delicious. The only downside is the lack of parking. Getting there might be difficult for those who don't live nearby. I always go by motorcycle, and I can usually park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongsatorn Mingmit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and affordable.
The crispy catfish is amazing; it's made with pure catfish meat, no flour or breadcrumbs mixed in.
The à la carte dishes are really tasty and the portions are generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chuanplern Sawangmek

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. The crispy catfish salad is excellent, the fried pork with garlic is tasty, and the tom yum pork leg soup is spicy and delicious. Almost every dish is tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: numnIm Thongruam

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and affordable, with a wide variety of made-to-order dishes. The absolute must-try is the crispy catfish salad; if you see it, buy it! It sells out very quickly!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eto Shigeru

sample_reviews_en.text: Crispy catfish salad with delicious dipping sauce. The catfish is not mixed with flour.
sample_reviews_en.author: อุทัยวรรณ รุ่งมี

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือนายเกรียง สามย่าน
restaurants.address:

PGMG+PXM ซ. จุฬาลงกรณ์ 50 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Spicy pork noodle soup with pork balls, braised pork, and pork liver, served in an air-conditioned room.

Nai Kriang Boat Noodles, Samyan, is a popular pork noodle restaurant that has opened 2-3 franchise branches in Bangkok. The sign says the noodles are so delicious you don't need to add any seasoning. This is a newly opened branch located in Soi Chula 50. The main menu item is pork noodles, with additional dishes like blanched vegetables and à la carte options such as crab fried rice, pork with garlic and rice, or stir-fried pork with soy sauce. Today, I tried the spicy pork noodle soup with all the toppings except sprouts (55฿). The bowl was large and generous, containing pork balls, liver, and blanched pork. The broth was dark, rich, and perfectly seasoned – no need to add anything. The restaurant is a single-unit shophouse with an open-air front and air-conditioned interior. However, parking is difficult, and Chulalongkorn University charges for parking.
sample_reviews_th.author: wichak phijaisanit

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordering through Grab gave me a great discount. I got one bowl of noodles, one bowl of soup, one minced pork basil rice, and one stir-fried noodles with soy sauce for only 164 baht. The taste was delicious, and the portions were generous for the price. Importantly, the restaurant was very cute, and the packaging was sturdy and well-made. They even provided spoons, forks, and paper cups without extra charge, which I was initially worried about because my hotel didn't have those utensils. I'll definitely be ordering from this restaurant regularly from now on.
sample_reviews_en.author: tae pulpipat

sample_reviews_en.text: This boat noodle shop serving pork noodles in waterfall style is located in Soi Chulalongkorn 50. The taste is decent; it's lightly seasoned, but if you prefer a stronger flavor, you'll need to add more. I liked the generous amount of crispy pork cracklings they included. My only minor complaint is that, as it might be a relatively new franchise, the noodles were overcooked. The price is affordable: 45 baht for a regular bowl and 60 baht for a special one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coke Somchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rice was in clumps, I thought it was sticky rice.
If the chef wasn't there, there was no need to order it. Someone who didn't know how to cook it would make it even worse. I ordered a fried egg, and I just flipped it.
But the cook poked the egg with a spatula, and it was a complete mess.

Actually, this restaurant has it. It's more famous than the other place when it's well-made, but...
sample_reviews_en.author: Tee raB

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered the boat noodles! Super! Delicious!

Highly recommend this place to anyone going across the street to eat at Chula 50! Seriously, I rave about it!! ❤️❤️

(An absolute must-try!)
sample_reviews_en.author: 楊貽婷

sample_reviews_en.text:
The tom yum soup was delicious, the chicken was crispy, and the boiled egg had a perfect soft-boiled yolk.
(But even though I ordered it without peanuts, I still got peanuts.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Irin Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is okay, but you HAVE to order the boat noodles. If you order à la carte, it's incredibly slow, and they even prioritize tables that came later. Terrible!
sample_reviews_en.author: ** PYMN **

sample_reviews_en.text:
The snacks are a bit pricey.
Boiled meatballs cost 60 baht for ten pieces.
The taste is more like fish meatballs than pork meatballs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sin Rwt

restaurants.name: ราชา ราดหน้ายอดผัก
restaurants.address:

1118 1 Sukhumvit 71 Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time eating here, and the gravy noodles are still as delicious as before. I ordered stir-fried wide rice noodles with egg and gravy noodles, and stir-fried thin rice noodles with egg and gravy noodles. I love how they stir-fry the noodles, both the wide and thin noodles; it's a delicious wok-fried style. The owner is lovely and accommodating; I asked for less noodles and more vegetables, and they delivered exactly as requested. You can park in the alley near the shop; you can ask the owner, and they'll help you find a parking spot. Personally, I prefer the marinated pork, not the garlic pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucky Tiger

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop also sells Hainanese chicken rice. I ordered chicken rice and noticed the chicken was undercooked and had blood in it. I questioned whether the chicken was cooked properly, but the seller said that's how thigh meat is and refused to replace it. In the end, I had to buy it and throw it away. I couldn't eat it. How can they sell undercooked food to customers? If this continues, I'll never eat at that shop again. It was terrible. They shouldn't sell chicken rice at all. Selling only noodles would be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panda Wang

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is okay. There are many menu options, and the prices are around 40-50 baht. I'm a regular here, but I sometimes order their other dishes. At night, they sell noodles and other made-to-order food. During the day, they sell roast pork rice and crispy pork. The taste is generally good. If you're hungry and looking for something inexpensive, you can stop by here. It's located near the Khlong Tan intersection, opposite the Super One Plaza night market, where they often hold Luk Thung and Mor Lam concerts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kriengkrai Story Teller

sample_reviews_en.text: The special stir-fried noodles with soy sauce are 90 baht per pack and they're delicious! Both the vermicelli and the thick noodles are good. They're stir-fried until dry, not mushy, and have a wonderful wok aroma. The pork is tender and tasty, and the vegetables are crisp and not bitter. In short, I highly recommend them!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vitaya Kunavichayanont

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried noodles with egg are delicious and inexpensive. They also have sukiyaki (both soup and dry versions), which I'll try next time; everything looks so tempting. The à la carte dishes are also tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิโรจน์ แซ่ฟอง

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since I lived in Pattanakarn, and even after moving to Lat Krabang, I still go back. It's the best I've ever had, even better than many of the famous restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Riders-Outlet Bkk

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was served quickly, and the pork with wok hei (wok aroma) was delicious. The restaurant had fans, so it wasn't too hot to dine in at lunchtime. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jim Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious, especially the stir-fried noodles with soy sauce. It has a wonderful wok aroma, but sometimes it's slightly burnt.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pirapol Jaidee

restaurants.name: Wine Connection Sukhumvit 31
restaurants.address:

18, Sukhumvit 31 (Soi Sawasdee Klong Tan, Nua, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Wine Connection, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience! The ambiance was warm and inviting, perfect for a relaxed evening with great food and wine.

The highlight of my meal was their lasagna—absolutely delicious! The layers of pasta were perfectly cooked, and the rich, flavorful meat sauce combined with creamy béchamel and melted cheese made for a heavenly bite every time. It was well-balanced, comforting, and generously portioned.

To top it off, their wine selection is impressive, with knowledgeable staff who helped me pair the perfect glass with my meal. Excellent service, great food, and a cozy atmosphere—I’ll definitely be coming back!

Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality Italian comfort food and a fantastic wine selection.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Richard

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had salads as starters, which were delicious. The house rosé was also good. The truffle pasta was tasty. The pappardelle with salmon was okay. The salmon was completely overcooked and dry. I pointed this out to the staff, and they acknowledged it without comment. There's an extra charge for Parmesan, which should really be included as standard.

The music was completely inappropriate (gangsta rap) and very loud. The staff doesn't speak; the waitstaff can't even say "thank you" or "please" and simply put down food and drinks without a word and left. It's okay, but not worth a second visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maximilian

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been to this restaurant many times, but this time my friend called a taxi and paid in cash, so I was waiting for the taxi. When the taxi arrived and I was about to leave the restaurant, a waiter chased after me, shouting loudly and demanding to see proof of payment, as if he hadn't paid yet. I was so embarrassed in front of the other customers in the restaurant. I've eaten at many restaurants, both cheap and expensive, but this has never happened before. It was very rude and humiliating. Why didn't he ask another waiter to confirm whether this table had already paid?
sample_reviews_en.author: Sky “ST” Sora

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a fantastic experience at Wine Connection Sukhumvit 31! The food was delicious, the service was impeccable, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting.

The wine selection is excellent, and the staff is very knowledgeable about pairing recommendations. Whether you’re looking for a casual dinner or a place to enjoy quality wine with friends, this is the perfect spot.

Highly recommend this place for great food, great wine, and a wonderful ambiance! Will definitely visit again. 🍷✨

#WineConnection #SukhumvitDining #GreatFoodGreatWine #HighlyRecommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Lokendra Oli

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ambience is ok and food is not bad, but Service makes me very angry!!
I was seating outside, I got my fan direction to me!
After, i was not finish to eat my last bite and the service staff came to take out the plate from me... she really left me with my fork on the hand and then with my food on the mouth she asked me if I want dessert!
Then another guest came outside and she take out the fan from me and moved it to the new guest!
That really offended me, as new guest is more important thank me!
I think they need more training to the staff!
sample_reviews_en.author: Luca Di Pietro

sample_reviews_en.text: The food at this branch is delicious, the space is spacious with plenty of seating, and the service is good. Unfortunately, the wine recommendations weren't very extensive, although tasting wasn't a big deal. I'd come back if I have the chance to celebrate with friends. The meal for four people cost less than 1000 baht per person, which is a reasonable price. Food was around 200+ baht. There's parking available, and it's conveniently located near a motorbike taxi stand and the BTS.
sample_reviews_en.author: Knungnit Un. (สาม)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was completely full after lunch!

The portions are a bit large for a Japanese woman, so you might want to share if you're hoping to get a bite. I ate half of my wife's burger, but I was still full and satisfied.

I really liked that the first dish was soup. If I could choose between soup and something else, I might have accidentally chosen something else, but I rediscovered the goodness of soup and felt very happy.

It was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack and the Beans T

sample_reviews_en.text:
We regularly attend this branch to eat out and always have a great experience.  The food is always tasty and well presented, Pepper and the girls are always attentive and provide amazing service.
One major issue that has been going on for a long time is the awful foul stench in the male toilets. Every time I go in there it puts me off my meal. It's disgusting,can you please rectify this issue.
Thank you..
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Buck

restaurants.name: LUZ Bangkok Tapas Bar
restaurants.address:

INNSiDE by Melia 1472 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Revisited August 2026
I took my son and granddaughter there when they came to visit from Japan.
Since it's a bar, I called to ask if it was okay to bring a middle schooler when making the reservation, and they replied, "That's fine! We'll be waiting for you!"
My granddaughter dressed up and made her rooftop bar debut 👍
I was a little worried about the food, but it was much tastier than last time. It's Spanish cuisine. We all ate a lot. Happy hour was also great 🆗
Some of the previous staff were still there and were very kind. The service is good. I recommend it.

2025
Near BTS On Nut station!
This is a rooftop bar above the newly opened Inside.
We went in around 5:30 PM.
By 6:00 PM, it was quite full, so it's best to make a reservation or go early.
There's also a poolside bar on the upper floor, which is less crowded and more relaxing.
The atmosphere is also very nice!

The food was okay; the croquettes and garlic shrimp were average, but I wouldn't recommend the paella.
The rice was undercooked!!
I think it would be better to have some tapas and a light drink around sunset.
The staff were friendly, and the service was very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: KYOKO S

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent, the night view was fantastic, and it wasn't crowded, making it very comfortable. They have a buy-one-get-one-free cocktail offer before 7 PM. The downside is that the food portions are small and a bit pricey. I ordered Paella for $1150, and it came in a tiny portion with very thin rice (I don't think it was even this thin in Spain). It was probably only enough for one person. I recommend eating something first before coming here for drinks and the night view. Chocolate lovers can order the chocolate Basque cake with vanilla ice cream; the cake is very rich, and the combination of hot and cold ice cream is incredibly satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lana

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to LUZ tapas bar for an aperitivo, taking advantage of my overnight stay at the Innside by Meliá hotel. What can I say, everything was fantastic! The location and vibe of this place are fantastic, on the rooftop of a beautiful hotel. The staff and chef Nacho are super kind and knowledgeable. Fern, in particular, was brilliant; she recommended which tapas we should try. The patatas bravas were delicious, but the rabo de toro tacos were the highlight. We also had the calamari with lime and aioli, a sauce I'm crazy about. Everything was truly excellent. A perfect option for those looking for something different in Bangkok, so highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Michela Antonini

sample_reviews_en.text:
This rooftop bar offers absolutely spectacular panoramic views of Bangkok. Watching the sunset over the city skyline and the twinkling night lights was unforgettable.
I want to give a special compliment to our server Ronda! She was incredibly warm, patient and attentive throughout our whole visit. She recommended great cocktails and checked on us frequently without being intrusive.
The atmosphere is lovely, drinks taste wonderful, and Ronda’s friendly service made our night far more enjoyable. 100% worth visiting when you travel to Bangkok, I will definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Zhouyue Tong

sample_reviews_en.text:
A spectacular place, and not just for its breathtaking views.

The Spanish food is of excellent quality, and the service from all the staff was outstanding. I especially want to highlight Ronda's attention to detail and care in ensuring that every dish was perfect. From the bar, you can watch them plate each order, and they all look incredible.

Quality, service, views, and cuisine that is truly worthwhile. Congratulations to the chef and the entire team. Thank you for giving us such a special dinner high above Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marina San Pedro Fernandez

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had croquettes, ajillo, salmon, paella, and more, and everything was delicious.

I recommend going in the evening, enjoying a light meal with beer or sparkling wine, watching the sunset turn into nighttime scenery, and then having paella when you get hungry.

The staff are friendly and attentive, making for a very comfortable experience.

If you want to get a good seat, I recommend making a reservation.

Chef Earn, the food was delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Masaki.S

sample_reviews_en.text: New update, I came last year same like this one and the service now is really terrible, the girl in reception was so rude and looking down on me and my family  (the restaurant & not the hotel) the paella is roasted and not good taste, we order whiskey and they give us like juice glass, the customer service now is so terrible  I spent thb $6000 and no even like that I could have good service
sample_reviews_en.author: Stiven L.

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a very fun birthday party! They gave me lots of gifts, the food was delicious, the staff were friendly, and it was a famous and spectacular event. Thank you, Hye, for being so friendly and recommending so many delicious dishes! I hope you work here for a long time; I need you! 😭 P.S. Have a wonderful day, Hye! Thank you for making my special day a hundred times more special!
sample_reviews_en.author: Namo

restaurants.name: Pakwan
restaurants.address:

390/16 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this place average. Foods were just good enough, not the best of course! Ambience was good and staffs were friendly. The price too was reasonable, but we had to wait longer than usual to get out food delivered. If you ask me, I will recommend you this place, but just for once. They offer variety, but if you are not used to with eating spicy food, make it clear to them beforehand. It's always better to take precautions than to be sorry, right? Their less spicy food, however, was also spicy for me. I had veg biryani, which was nothing sort of what I had in Hyderabad once. So, don't expect much. The best part is you will get some people whose English is comprehensible unlike most of the restaurant or bar waiters/waitresses in the city. I hope you will have good time there!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikunja Bhandari

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited this place as it was the nearest and We were hungry. Didnt seem to be like the right option.. staff kept talking within themselves looked more confused rather. Some highlights of our experience:
- Wrong order captured!
- Ordered mango lassi got Fruit lassi which turned out to be sour possibly spoiled! Advised the staff and she blamed it on the chef saying she doesnt know what he has made
- Chicken tikka tasty but chicken was hard!
- Having asked to change the plates after finishing appetizers was like commiting crime. Got the worst look of my life from the staff!

Overall not happy. Prices are also on higher side. First time/day in Bangkok, looking forward towards a better experience
sample_reviews_en.author: Dawson Britto

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointed with the food. We decided to visit this place since it is an Indian restaurant we were craving for some great Indian food. The restaurant ambiance is good but the food was very disappointing. We order a veg dish I don't remember the name it had mushroom and peas in it. We were 4 people and the quantity was too less even not enough for one person. Taste was also not as expected. Mushroom were very chewy and the gravy was bland. The prices are too high. If you are charging so much at least provide decent quantity.
Service was quick but disappointing food. After all that's the most important thing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikhil Mhatre

sample_reviews_en.text: The main thing that works for Pakwan is its location - its proximity to BTS Asok. The woman serving is diligent, whereas the men seem to be disinterested. Coming to the food - the bhindi (okra) masala was good (on the spicier side though), the naans were so hard and it took me quite a while to get through them. Tried the biryani on my second visit - it was a little soggy at the bottom, but tasted good. The raita/salad for the biryani had to be purchased separately, and it was a tad sour. Some items on the menu are just outrageously priced!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nakul Kamath

sample_reviews_en.text:
Only had the one dinner here but what we ordered was bad at best. Vindaloo tasted more like a reheated butter chicken. Not appealing at all.
Very over priced, prices were on the menu so I did know upfront but the drinks WOW $$$.  Then added tax to the final bill. Made it all a bad experience.
I wasn't out for a dining experience just to fill a hungry tummy. But I wish I had chosen somewhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rick Mcbroom

sample_reviews_en.text: This place appeared in one of our searches for Indian restaurants in Bangkok and we gave it a try. The location is convenient as is serviced by the Metro and the Skytrain both. The food quality was also decent but the upkeep of the place needs attention as we noticed 2-3 small insects under the table where we sat. Notifying the staff didn't help much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neeraj Sharma

sample_reviews_en.text: Very worst services....For namesake only its a Indian Restaurant...The food was Average & the services are very dull...All other Indian guests were also dissatisfied when they were serving food...The prices are high but food is not worth of it. I prefer the Indian Travellers not to visit this ****ing restaurant....Refer to the bill i attached...
sample_reviews_en.author: Satyendra mandalapu

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is not very good. Service is not bad. Price is on the higher side. Hygiene has to be better. My table and the one in front had cockroaches moving around which was disappointing. But there was nothing found in the food. Even as a courtesy, the PIC didn't offer a refund or waiver. Will not recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sun Sang

restaurants.name: ChaaChaa Malatang (ชาชา หมาล่าทัง) - หอการค้า
restaurants.address:

112 ซอยวิภาวดี2 แยก 4 Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff are friendly and provide excellent service. The mala skewers are delicious; this is definitely one of my favorite restaurants. I'll be going there often.
sample_reviews_en.author: ญาณวุฒิ เเย้มสรวล

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were lovely and provided great service. The restaurant looked clean and inviting, and it was conveniently located near my accommodation.
sample_reviews_en.author: บุษญาลักษณ์ พันกกค้อ

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean and beautiful, with a diverse menu and reasonable prices. The staff are lovely and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิมไพลิน โวระแสง

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful and the atmosphere is inviting. The staff are very attentive and provide excellent customer service.
sample_reviews_en.author: 22 Sanchai

sample_reviews_en.text: Hot and sour soup, very delicious. Most importantly, every piece of ice is cold. Moderate price. Crispy vegetables.
sample_reviews_en.author: bubbleboba

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The restaurant didn't have sesame dipping sauce, but they found one for me. Excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichakul IIce

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious and clean. I usually eat at Central Ladprao, but this place is also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthanicha Phanphut

restaurants.name: Berlin's Doner Kebab - Pattaya Walking Street
restaurants.address:

10, 21 Walking St, Pattaya City, Pattaya, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I seldom review restaurants, as food is generally a matter of personal taste.  However, I just wanted to comment on this place. As a fast food place, I was very pleasantly surprised. The 12 inch doner I ordered was completely stuffed with ingredients - something I don't often see in fast food type establishments - and you could taste the freshness of the veggies. The meat was a little dry, but it was also like 2 in the morning and a slow night,  so it had probably been sitting on the spit for quite some time. I ordered a combo meal and it came with a large amount of fries - more then you would get at say McD's or some place like that.  Will definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Barry

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a beef kebab and curry wurst.
The kebab was mediocre; the meat seemed pre-made, not freshly sliced ​​from the grill. The bread was good, with plenty of vegetables stuffed underneath and the meat sprinkled on top. After finishing the meat, what was left was just bread and vegetables. 299 baht wasn't worth it.
The curry wurst wasn't hot at all, and the sauce was very salty. The french fries were mostly broken, short pieces from the bottom of the bag. The 135 baht promotion wasn't worth it.
The staff took the order and then disappeared. I was confused.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thepa Theppitak

sample_reviews_en.text: Aside from the name, this doner kebab has little in common with Berlin kebabs. The bread is okay, the meat is terrible – I got food poisoning. It doesn't seem to come fresh from the spit (you don't see a doner kebab spit as a customer) but rather from the kitchen, tasting like it came from a can. I've eaten at Berlin's Doner in Bangkok, and everything was fine there, the meat was fresh, but apparently not in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lars Zurawski

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't understand why the doner kebab costs more here than in Berlin.

The quality is, to put it very kindly, "average."

Everything comes in cheap cardboard trays with plastic cutlery.

The portions are barely recognizable.

There are better options for less baht on many other streets around here.

I was hungry enough to eat it.

But I certainly won't be having it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: MauMau

sample_reviews_en.text: After hearing a review on you tube I had to try it for myself.   The beef donner is excellent and the yogurt sauce is just like I  like.   Too many times the sauce lacks flavor  but this brings out the flavor of the meet.    The feta is also really good.  This is true to the style you will find in Europe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darrell R

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried one of the Turkish kebabs on walking street last week, it was very disappointed. Punch was very welcoming, smiley, happy and helpful. Tried Berlin Kebabs tonight and it was much better. I got the doner chicken set, 319 baht and will walk away feeling full. The salt on the fired has a nice flavour.
sample_reviews_en.author: N B

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered gym box with beef, clearly shown on order. Didn't receieved some vegetarian paddy replacement instead, green. Also everything arrived very cold, will not use Grab delivery again. Also request utensils, cutlery but nothing given so had to eat salad with hands... Very small for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tallow Marble

sample_reviews_en.text: The main dish, Doner Kebab, is incredibly delicious. The meat is marinated in fragrant spices, grilled to perfection, tender and juicy. Served with freshly baked bread and crisp vegetables, every bite is fragrant, tender, and refreshing – a …
sample_reviews_en.author: วันนี้กินไรดีชลบุรี

restaurants.name: ปั้นคำหอม สาขาเดอะสตรีทรัชดา
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 139 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khwaeng Din Daeng, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small dessert cafe offers a variety of authentic Thai desserts as well as cookies, cakes, and bakery products. While some locals may feel the taste is average, I think foreigners will enjoy trying different kinds of Thai dessert packed and served in a small bite size. Watch out for your sugar level though as Thai dessert has a tendency to be a bit too sweet for western foreigners.

The cafe is mainly for buying take-away. There is a small seating area that is a bit cramped so it’s not recommended to dine in. The staff can be a little bit cold.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charn Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
Open from 10:00 AM to 8:30 PM (approximately).
Average price of food is 50-60 baht, which is cheaper than Foodland's "Cheap and Good" restaurant.

The atmosphere is nice and not crowded. There is a wide variety of food to choose from, including à la carte dishes, curries, noodles, rice noodles, desserts, ice cream, Hainanese chicken rice, stir-fried noodles, dry sukiyaki, vegetarian food, etc. (but I didn't see any steaks).

You can pay for food and drinks with a Rabbit Card.

There are restrooms nearby. Almost every table has a tissue box.
sample_reviews_en.author: Movie Area

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday, I was going to buy a birthday cake. I asked two questions and the skinny employee was talking on the phone and then walked away to the back of the store. I was like, "Are you not going to sell it?" or something. So I went upstairs and bought a cake. Swensen's is the best. The service is amazing. It's so different. They have so many customers, but they care about everyone. That's enough for me at this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fah Lysa

sample_reviews_en.text: On Google Maps, it says it closes at 10:00 PM. I went to buy at 9:30 PM, but the staff didn't sell to me anymore. I sat on my phone, waiting for work to get off work, and prepared to close the shop. At most, 15-20 minutes should be enough. Or if it takes too long, it would be better to change it on Google Maps to say it closes at 9:30 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gug

sample_reviews_en.text: I wish all locations had the same selection. Here they have a bread (like a farmer’s loaf) that was actually very good. Much better than expected. Good bread, that is acceptable as per my German standards, is difficult to find. This is the only location that I know that carries it. Will definitely come back and buy more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cecil M

sample_reviews_en.text: The snacks at this shop are delicious. I've been a customer for many years. Today, I encountered terrible service from a front-of-house employee. They spoke rudely and slammed the bag of snacks down. I hope the owner will provide some customer service etiquette training. If they're tired, let them rest.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุชาณัฐ มาลัย

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice tasty  bakery  with plenty of pies, snacks and  nice cakes as well actually I must say very nice cakes !!, I tried the tiramisu and it’s really the best I ever eaten in a shop ( number 1 !! ) , the American cheesecake it’s very delicious, the Thai sweets are great ! Price not expensive at all !
sample_reviews_en.author: Simo D C

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is reasonably priced and delicious. The atmosphere is nice, suitable for working. The staff service is good. Nearby locations include Big C Ratchada, Train Night Market, Esplanade Mall, Fortune Mall, Central Rama 9, and others. Transportation is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: 冰淇淋冰淇淋

restaurants.name: Taco Bell
restaurants.address:

4361 Sukhumvit Rd, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It was my first time eating there, and I didn't know anything on the menu. I tried asking the staff, but they wouldn't recommend anything, just said "Yes." I think the guy was Nat or Nut, I can't remember. The service was terrible. I went at 7:56 PM, and they had already removed all the chairs and even put them in front of the drink dispenser. Why were they in such a hurry to close? The map said they were open until midnight.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benja Puengroekdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
• Atmosphere: Very clean and modern.
• Food and Drinks: Delicious! I love the self-refill machine.
• Service: Staff are friendly and trying their best to help, even if they don't all speak English.

❗️Note: No restroom or sink inside; you have to walk about 10-15 meters outside to wash your hands. But it's ok 👌🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: Ana

sample_reviews_en.text: The worst service I've ever experienced. The staff opened the wrong order, and the item I received didn't match the picture. I called to ask how they would handle it, and they just hung up on me. Terrible service. I will definitely not order from them again. This was for a 345 baht order, absolutely outrageous.
sample_reviews_en.author: JOW ch.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a crunchy wrap. The promotional picture showed a thick, round wrap with plenty of filling, but the actual product was thin and flat with very little filling. The staff said it was made according to a recipe. I definitely won't be ordering from here again. A waste of money.
sample_reviews_en.author: pichit voraprukpisut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sorry... Poor service and delivery. Taco came almost empty in shell, waste of time and money
Shop works till midnight but when you visit them at 9 pm they already stop working, flipping tables upside down, closing door and turning off the lights 🤷‍♂️

Please improve everything
sample_reviews_en.author: REALL.

sample_reviews_en.text: We like the Mexican food at this restaurant. We think it's surprisingly delicious, contrary to our expectations that it would be just average. It turned out to be really good! Haha. (This franchise brand is known for its delicious food; other branches are delicious too.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuma Odd

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered from Taco Bell through Lineman and tried the Taco Supreme, Loaded Griller, Cheese Quesadilla, and Chips. My absolute favorite was the Cheese Quesadilla, so tasty and soft, every bite felt like heaven. The Loaded Griller was also …
sample_reviews_en.author: Naw Hsu Ei Thin Zar (kk)

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice and clean place. Fairly new and well-kept. Can’t complain about the service of staff. Young and friendly. Only major turn-off is that the staff makes your delicious tacos or prepare raw food with the same pair of gloves when they …
sample_reviews_en.author: Car Lim

restaurants.name: ครัวจิตรา
restaurants.address:

2005 2004 Pracha Songkhro Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible service, the absolute worst! I've been to this restaurant 1-3 times, but this time was awful. I waited almost an hour for my food; the sticky rice and regular rice were cold. My friends who arrived after me got their food before me, and the table next to us even finished eating, while I still hadn't received a single dish. I ordered mushroom curry, and the staff didn't even repeat the order to clarify what kind of mushroom curry I ordered; they just made mushroom curry without any explanation.
But I wanted to order "Hed Thob" (a type of mushroom curry).
So confusing!
My husband ordered raw minced meat salad, and when it was served, it was completely raw. He asked them to cook it a little more. The staff took it back, and then when they brought it back again, it was wrapped in a bag, even though I didn't ask for it to be taken home! Don't mess with someone who's really hungry and angry!
sample_reviews_en.author: นานแสง ลุงรืน

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, standard for a typical somtum (papaya salad) restaurant.
However, I really wanted to eat grilled pork neck on the day I went, but they were sold out. A little disappointing. The fried shrimp was delicious, and the Lao-style papaya salad was also tasty. If you like a strong fermented fish sauce flavor, this restaurant is for you. The spicy soup was delicious, and I highly recommend the grilled chicken wings – they were really good.

The staff provided excellent service and gave good recommendations. They were very accommodating, letting us know what they had and what was sold out.

The restaurant has air conditioning but is quite small. There is no parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun Jay

sample_reviews_en.text: I haven't eaten here in several months. The papaya salad isn't as spicy as before. I drove a long way to get the mushroom curry. Today, I'm a little disappointed. Normally, there are many vegetables. The staff should ask the customers' tables if they've all gotten their food. When I asked, they told me to wait in line. I continued to press the phone. There weren't many people. I was almost finished eating the other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onanong Ngoensoongoen

sample_reviews_en.text: I went out to eat with my sister today. The food at the restaurant is delicious; this was my third time there. I keep going because their papaya salad is truly amazing. However, today I found a chicken hair in my papaya salad. It felt so unclean and disgusting that I felt like vomiting. It completely ruined my appetite. I hope they will maintain better hygiene in food preparation. Finding chicken hair is very unusual. 😢
sample_reviews_en.author: ปรามิตา

sample_reviews_en.text:
After buying e-cigarettes nearby,

I went to this restaurant recommended by the guy there 🤣🤣

The grilled fish was fresh and cheap~

The grilled shrimp was just okay 🤔

Last time I had Thai water spinach, I was blown away,

so I ordered it as soon as I saw it!!

The stir-fried water spinach here had a wonderful wok hei (wok aroma) and was super delicious 👍

The texture was much better than in Taiwan 🫢🫢
sample_reviews_en.author: 王同學

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious.
It's prepared quickly.
I recommend taking public transport because parking is difficult.
The spicy dipping sauce is amazing.
The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce is incredibly flavorful.
The bamboo shoot soup came out piping hot, so satisfying.
The grilled squid with dipping sauce is fantastic, spicy and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parichat เอิงเอย

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a really delicious somtum (papaya salad) and yam (spicy salad) restaurant.
If you want something not on the menu, you can ask the chef to make it for you. They'll make any dish you request. (If you don't like spicy food, please specify the amount of chili you want.)
sample_reviews_en.author: JIRAPORN Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: Sitting in an air-conditioned room, but sweating all over. Oh, it's so delicious and spicy. Huai Khwang really did it. It's so delicious and doesn't smell like fermented fish. My husband almost drank it all.
sample_reviews_en.author: hattaya tabtimsai

restaurants.name: Den Thai Fish Boiled Rice
restaurants.address:

374 Lat Ya Rd, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This fish porridge shop near Wongwian Yai offers various seafood porridges including fish, shellfish, and other dishes, as well as Tom Yum soup and stir-fried fish with celery.

The shop is located in a shophouse along the road near a bus stop. Parking might be a bit difficult, but since I went on a motorcycle, it was easy to park on the side of the road.
It was a bit hot inside on a hot day, but the food was delicious, high-quality, and reasonably priced. The wait wasn't long.
However, one minor complaint: the bag I bought for my takeout soup wasn't very durable; it leaked after putting in the hot broth. It would be much better if they used reusable heat-resistant bags.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirirat Sirikul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Den Thai Fish Porridge, Lad Ya

The taste exceeded expectations. The ingredients were fresh. The fish porridge was good, and the broth was delicious. They have many à la carte dishes. I ordered the minced pork and shrimp with garlic and an omelet over rice. It was very fragrant and delicious. I really liked it. It might be a little salty.

The prices are reasonable. They accept Thai government subsidy programs like "Thai Help Thai" and "Half-Price Plus" (June 2026).

Parking is available on the street in front of or near the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree T.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers affordable fish porridge with piping hot broth and a reasonable amount of ingredients for the price. A bowl of porridge with two pieces of fish and one medium-sized shrimp costs 40 baht. Stir-fried morning glory is 50 baht and tastes good. Opening hours are unpredictable on holidays, so it's best to call ahead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kosin Juasiripukdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious flavors, fresh ingredients. The stir-fried grouper with celery was absolutely delicious.
The Tom Yum soup was excellent.
The blanched fish was very fresh.
The mixed seafood salad was just right.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภัทรานิษฐ์ ธัญรัตนเศรษฐ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Old but still great!
The rice porridge is good, they have sea bass and grouper too.
The highlight is the oyster omelet; perfectly crispy and delicious, with big, plump, fresh oysters.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khomsan Pongsathaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! Oyster omelet, Tom Yum soup, mixed seafood rice porridge, and stir-fried grouper head with celery were all excellent. 👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanokpat Sumongkhol

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice porridge is delicious and reasonably priced. // The grouper fish rice porridge is especially delicious; the fish is very fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marisa Thirat

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and very affordable! The fish is fresh every day! However, parking can be a bit difficult, so you have to take your chances.
sample_reviews_en.author: P N

restaurants.name: ข้าวต้มแห้งคุณนิด สาขาวิภาวดี 16 - โชคชัยร่วมมิตร
restaurants.address:

34 3 S. Vibhavadi Rangsit 16, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The new shop has a new, clean-looking white decor. There are 4-5 tables and it's air-conditioned. The original shop required reservations.
The menu isn't extensive; you only choose between rice porridge (soup or dry) and noodles (soup or dry) with your toppings.
The food is delicious. There's a dipping sauce similar to the one used for fish porridge.
The dry rice porridge is soft and tasty, but it wasn't hot. The noodles, however, are excellent – ​​egg noodles with lots of egg, fragrant, and amazing with the garlic oil. The various toppings make it even better.
There's no parking. The shop is located behind the yellow bus stop, next to the garage at the entrance of the soi (alley).
sample_reviews_en.author: Meesit Kruehong

sample_reviews_en.text: Starting at 70 baht, the taste is decent. The rice is good quality and the toppings are good, but the portion size, location, and service—the staff didn't offer any recommendations—make it difficult to return. The shop is completely blocked by a bad garage next door with cars being repaired, forcing people in the alley to park on the side and walk through the smell and fumes. The location is really bad. It'll be tough, though. Wish them luck though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie November

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a mixed noodle soup with added onsen, but I couldn't get pork or chicken. I didn't read the instructions, so I had to order the roasted chicken separately. However, the chicken was very tough. If I could get mixed chicken and pork, it would be a good choice. The restaurant is clean, but the entrance is unacceptable. This meal cost 200 baht for just chicken and pork, which is quite expensive. The portion size isn't very large either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jennie J. Thamphiwatana

sample_reviews_en.text: The crispy pork is delicious, the rice is soft, the offal is good, the restaurant is clean, and the wait isn't long. Adding an onsen egg is also a good idea. The restaurant is next to a car repair shop behind the bus stop (the car might block the view, so you might not find it). It's very delicious, go and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: moa _rosk

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. Minced pork, crispy pork, roasted pork, liver, and stomach are all tasty and clean. There's a bit of a wait for the food. The location is easy to spot, behind the bus stop at the entrance of Soi Vibhavadi 16. The service is friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: จุมพล เขมานุรักษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered takeout. Good packaging, delicious food. The crispy pork was good. Ordered to try the dry rice porridge, dry noodles, the broth porridge, and their soybean paste dish. The taste was good, but you need to drink the soup to feel full.
sample_reviews_en.author: PasN Pas

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything on top of the rice was excellent, very delicious. They used high-quality ingredients, and every piece was tasty. The fried garlic was perfectly crispy and fragrant, without any unpleasant garlic smell. I give it a 10/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jit Pianp.

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients are fresh and clean, and the taste is delicious. I really love the dry rice porridge; they give you plenty of toppings, and the price is affordable. The restaurant is air-conditioned, which is nice and cool! 💖
sample_reviews_en.author: min mintra

restaurants.name: Agave Foomuikee
restaurants.address:

61 127 Rama IX Soi 7, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Easy to find , have a parking lot in front of the restaurant. the restaurant is quite old.The food is old Hai-nan chinese style , reccommend to try chicken curry , หอยจ๊อ (hoy jor)  and pork chop. the price is a little bit pricey
sample_reviews_th.author: Meiling Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was of very good quality, and the ingredients were excellent (except for the stir-fried dried fish maw; I wish they used real fish maw, but it was still delicious as is).

The chicken macaroni was perfectly cooked and stir-fried.

The gravy pork chop was superb; the pork was perfectly fried.

The clay pot rice with squid, pork, and sausage was delicious.

The crab cakes were better served without the shell; they were large with plenty of firm crab meat.

I ordered 5 dishes to try and take home myself.

I even got curry and custard buns to take home. It felt like a true foodie!

All of this cost around 1500 baht.

There was one lovely server who did everything. I'm not sure if she was the owner, because she said her wife made the bread herself. I also saw the owner, an elderly gentleman, who was incredibly kind. It felt like eating at a grandpa's house that had opened a restaurant. I don't want it to close; I hope it stays open forever. 🩷🩷🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: Jane P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This legendary cookshop-style restaurant is a childhood favorite. My dad used to take me here often when I was a kid. It's been over 30 years since my last visit, and coming back brought back so many old memories. The atmosphere is very vintage, and the food retains its original delicious flavor. Here's what I ordered:
1. Porkchop (Baked Pork Ribs): Delicious! The portion wasn't huge, just right for two people. The pork was very flavorful.
2. Stir-fried Shrimp Balls with Vegetables.
3. Corn Soup: A little extra salt made it perfectly balanced.
4. Clay Pot Rice: Similar to chicken rice, the color might look bland, but the taste was excellent. It was packed with ingredients: shrimp, squid, tender pork, and sausage.
5. Custard Buns: Soft bread, and the custard wasn't too sweet.

Overall, the food was delicious and brought back fond childhood memories.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mummy Sombatsiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best and oldest fusion hainan restaurant in Bangkok.  We had chicken curry, pork chop (fried pork fillet with mild sauce), stir fried mixed Vegetable (Hainan style), and fried fish with sweet sauce and trimmings.  The flavor of all the dishes are mild, except for the fried fish with sweet sauce and trimmings, my favorite dish, which was spiced up with ginger.

We also got bread and custard back as souvinir (the staff said it can last for 3 days only as no preservative was added).

Overall, very satisfied.

FYI, the restaurant accepts only cash for payment.  We had to go to an ATM nearby to withdraw the cash.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukawan R.

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, following a review from Tammeow. The sign is small; you wouldn't notice it's a restaurant unless you looked closely. The food looks simple, not beautifully presented for Instagram, but the ingredients are high quality and every dish I ordered was delicious, befitting a restaurant that's been around for 90 years. The prices are very cheap compared to restaurants in malls; there's no VAT or service charge, which is rare these days. However, they don't accept scanned payments; credit card payments require a minimum of 1500 baht. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Somkiat Jittham

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Five star dining at Agave Foo Mui Kee!

This is one of Bangkok's original cook-shops operated by a family of Hainanese migrants since the 1930s 🧓👴🏻.

There is a lot of old-school charm 😎about this place and I do recommend to everyone to come and enjoy a meal here, try some of the original dishes on offer and support a restaurant which is part of Bangkok's heritage .

Recommended dishes: The signature baked pork chop 🥩, agave spicy salad🌶️, deep fried hor mok with seafood 🦞.

There is a gentleman who helps with parking in front of the restaurant in case you drive here 🏎️ .
sample_reviews_en.author: Croque Madame

sample_reviews_en.text: This old-school cookshop, now 90 years old, is a legendary establishment that maintains its high standards. The prices are reasonable, and every dish is delicious. Signature dishes include beef tongue stew, beef tenderloin salad, baked pork ribs, Singaporean fried chicken, kway teow (stir-fried noodles), and bread with kaya jam. It's one of my favorite cookshops; the taste is consistently excellent, making it hard to find this style of cuisine elsewhere. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Techinee Kongthorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unexpectedly stopped by at around 1pm. Empty, got to choose any table.

Dishes like tongue, and deep fried shrimp were the highlight for me. Nothing like i ever had before.

Atmosphere is super vintage, i loved the interior.

For the desert don’t forget the pandan custard with toast, texture of the custard was the most unique I’ve had, aroma amazing too!

Bill for around eight dishes was a bit above one thousand baht. Definitely quality incidents used.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dasha Karlson

restaurants.name: ลองดิ ฮาลาล อาหารตามสั่ง
restaurants.address:

249 ซอย โรงเรียน งามมานะ Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located in front of the Islamic kindergarten. They sell congee in the mornings and a la carte dishes from lunchtime to early afternoon, closing in the evening.

The food tastes good and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: W W

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the portions were very generous. The atmosphere was nice, not hot, and they provided fans. There was a wide variety of menu options. Plus, get a free Coke for leaving a review!
sample_reviews_en.author: ยุพรัตน์ โสรเนตร

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop only sells congee in the mornings. Later in the morning, they sell made-to-order dishes. I eat congee every morning; it's incredibly delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hapza Zahap

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! It was hot inside, but there were fans. The staff were friendly and provided good service. The restaurant was clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: LP Yahh

sample_reviews_en.text: The vendor is friendly, the food is delicious and cheap, and the portions are generous—you can specify whether you want more or less rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตาหวาน น้องอ้อน

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great. I bring my daughter here to eat before school every day. It's clean and safe. It's also Muslim-friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dak Top

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is diverse and delicious, the atmosphere is great, the owner is talkative, and there's plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kathrine

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was delicious, the restaurant was clean, I was very satisfied and will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sureerat Sreesamai

restaurants.name: Hyderabad Nawabs Restaurant
restaurants.address:

59, Beside The Beverly Hotel, 24-25 Moo 10, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just wanted a simple Dal Khichdi and Masala Peanuts for 550 THB. But they slapped me with a bogus bill for 3 Idlis at 680 THB! When I called them out, they mumbled “mistake” and handed over the “real” one.
Then, they tacked on 150 THB VAT, saying “reclaim at airport.” What a joke! Every Indian restaurant in Thailand pulls these scams – overcharging, excuses, zero respect. As an Indian, it breaks my heart seeing our community’s name dragged through the mud. Day by day, the world loses faith in us because of these cheats. So disappointed and angry!
#ThailandScam #IndianFoodFail #HyderabadNawabs
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohan Chowdary

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5

Amazing experience at Hyderabad Nawabs Restaurant, located in Pattaya, beside The Beverly Hotel. Authentic Indian cuisine with rich flavors!

Tried the Chicken Biryani, Spicy Mutton Roast, Matka mutton Biryani, and Butter Chicken with Garlic Naan — everything was delicious. The Kebab Biryani is a must-try and definitely the standout dish 😋🔥.

Loved the cool ambience and great vibes. The staff were polite, pleasant, and attentive, which made the experience even better.

Highly recommended for biryani lovers! Will definitely visit again 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhanu Pyde

sample_reviews_en.text:
Flavor & Aroma: Mentions of fragrant spices, rich ghee, and a perfect, non-greasy blend.

Meat Quality: Described as "succulent," "tender," and "perfectly cooked".

Rice Texture: Light, fluffy, and separate grains (often aged basmati).

CHEF : SUCH A NICE PERSON. HE TREATED WELL. AND THAT PERSON WAS CHEF HARI FROM SOUTH INDIA. WE ARE WAITING 10 MIN BUT ITS WORTH I AM especially love that biriyani ❤️ WE ARE SATISFIED THANKS FOR THIS KIND OF FOOD. THANKS TO HYDERABAD NAWABS RESTAURANT.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ashik “Ashik” CHEF Arun 3603

sample_reviews_en.text: The omlette was pathetic tasteless half done and the cutlery provided for eating an omelette was wrong instead of a knife and fork got a spoon and fork and the tomato chilli sauce provided was in lacking of better words to be avoided looked dubious from the start but one silver lining was the masala tea was above average and the sweetness and the masala were perfectly balanced but 140 bhat for a basic omelette is priceey even for Pattaya these guys are fleecing the tourists.
sample_reviews_en.author: siddhartha bhowmick

sample_reviews_en.text:
Congratulations to the entire BV Group team on the opening of their new restaurant in Pattaya on Walking Street!

This is the first à la carte restaurant in the area serving top-quality Indian cuisine, and it truly stands out. The food is exceptional, and the team is incredibly enthusiastic and welcoming. It genuinely feels like dining in Hyderabad.

Wishing the team great success ahead!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vineet Srivastava

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve been to this restaurant this is the best restaurant to have food in Pattaya it’s atmosphere and the service and the staff and cleanness hygiene the staff Shekar and Kiran were very good friendly they are the best to treat a guest very budget friendly hotel in the pricing and quality of food was amazing must visit
sample_reviews_en.author: Rithik Pvt

sample_reviews_en.text:
While walking through Pattaya Soi road number 2, noticed this restaurant. A young guy Mr. Kiran invited me to visit .
Nice ambience, clean and tidy .
Had masala dosa. Really it was so tasty .The combination with sambar, coconut chutney, kaara chutney was very delicious.
Hospitality supreme .

Santhosh kumar
sample_reviews_en.author: santhosh kumar

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited this new Indian restaurant, and it was a wonderful experience. The dishes were perfectly spiced and full of authentic flavors. The ambience was cozy, and the service was attentive. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a true taste of India!
sample_reviews_en.author: Manoj Kumar

restaurants.name: หลากเส้นหลายรส:LarksenLairose เจริญนคร17
restaurants.address:

1277 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes with good taste and moderate prices – not too expensive. Parking is available along the street.

Dishes ordered today:
* Pork stir-fried noodles (45฿): A decent portion, good taste, suited my palate.

* Pork neck steak (75฿): Understandable given the current price of pork, the portion wasn't very large. The taste wasn't quite to my liking, and the salad didn't look very appetizing.

* Iced black tea: Seems like pre-made bottled iced black tea, not freshly brewed, so it lacked aroma.

Overall, it's okay. A good place to grab a bite to eat after work. They have a good selection of dishes. The restaurant was full today, probably because it's located right at the entrance of the hotel alley.
sample_reviews_th.author: Wanvi K

sample_reviews_en.text:
the basil pork and chicken is tender and flavorful. the pork is about 50% fat and 50% lean which i like.

the vegetable spring rolls are crispy and delicious, skillfully done. goes very well with the sweet sauce.

the banana samosa are crispy and the banana inside is sweet. goes very well with condensed milk. a perfect dessert for me.

i like the water curtain. nice decor. the place is air conditioned.
sample_reviews_en.author: melson teo

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is simple, the taste is average, and the price isn't too high, but what exceeded my expectations was the excellent service from the staff. Everyone was wonderful. Usually, restaurants around here tend to cater to foreigners, but even though I was dressed sloppily and had just finished work, they still welcomed me so warmly. Everyone greeted me hello. I was truly amazed. Bravo!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mahasamud Melodizz

sample_reviews_en.text: A typical Thai restaurant with excellent cuisine. The menu is varied and the dishes are freshly prepared. They can also make it less spicy upon request. The staff is friendly and helpful, speaks broken English, but the menu is in both Thai and English and includes photos of the dishes. Anyone who loves authentic Thai food should visit at least once. I'll be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: hans obenland

sample_reviews_en.text:
They served verious kind of food from thai to italian.

The taste was acceptable and reliable. there was no highlight menu but all of thier food was ok.

the price was ok. not expensive at all.

the place was ok. clean but a bit cramped.

I got ignored by staff sometime.

reliable place. good place if you don't know what you want to eat
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanin Rungwanichsukanon

sample_reviews_en.text: Unfriendly and disgruntled waiters. They didn't put the vegetables (as pictured) in one dish, saying they were out. After asking for something else, they finally found some. The second dish was completely wrong (rice instead of noodles, shrimp instead of seafood). The final price was even higher than what was listed on the menu 👎👎
sample_reviews_en.author: Billy Kid

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on the roadside, making parking a bit difficult. It's ideal for walking street food. There's a wide selection of food. The restaurant is air-conditioned, so it's not hot. The atmosphere is chill. The food is reasonably priced, and the service is clean and good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ew Wangye

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, 90 baht for a plate of basil chicken is ridiculous. I understand the regular price is 60 baht, maybe 70 baht for the special, but how can it be 90 baht? Are they charging 20 baht for a fried egg? That's incredibly greedy. Are they trying to buy a fancy house or something?
sample_reviews_en.author: Panrawat Phosri

restaurants.name: ดูดเส้น แอนด์ นมนัว นอร์ธ ปาร์ค
restaurants.address:

VH95+XQ5, Thung Song Hong, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop has a nice atmosphere, although the space is quite small. It's right next to a noodle shop, so you can order from them and eat there. However, my friends and I had already left and paid the bill, so we decided to have dessert here instead. The prices are reasonable. There were three of us, and we ordered three different desserts, which were all great – if only we hadn't already eaten so much savory food! 5555
sample_reviews_en.author: Naruemon Keereetheerakun

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at this restaurant many times. Many of the savory dishes are delicious. The soup that comes with the rice is always so good I almost finish the whole bowl. I don't know about the desserts, I've never tried them. The restaurant has air conditioning, comfortable sofa seating, and the staff wear masks and headscarves, so the food is definitely clean. There's parking behind the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: A0nk

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a wide variety of menu options. It seems like you can now order food from the noodle shop and eat it here, which is good, in case you want something sweet after a savory meal. However, the prices at the dessert shop might be a bit high compared to other places, although the portions are similar.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yama chameleon

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I've been a regular at for many years. Lately, the taste hasn't been as good as before, especially the spaghetti with dried chili and bacon. It's quite expensive but not tasty; it's too sweet, which is unnatural for this dish. The scrambled eggs, however, are just okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchanya Sakulwathanyoo

sample_reviews_en.text:
- A nice local place for hanging out or taking a break.
- Not easy to get to. There's no public transportation. You'll need a private car or taxi.
- The overall price range is okay.
- Many menu choices, including sweets and snacks.
- Few parking spaces, or you can park on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: ThePaweena S

sample_reviews_en.text: I arrived and was told they were out of bananas. When I tried to order, they just told me they were out of toast. When I tried to order waffles, they said those were also out. In short, it was a wasted trip. The orders were very slow. I won't be coming back next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siriyakorn hachimoto

sample_reviews_en.text: The matcha chocolate brownies are delicious; they have a dense, chewy texture and great flavor. The ice cream and whipped cream are also tasty. The shop has plenty of seating and parking is available behind the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kade Neelasawee

sample_reviews_en.text: There are a variety of food, both savory and sweet, drinks, toast, bingsu, etc. The atmosphere inside the shop is good, the staff provides good service, and the price is also okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: PT RTP

restaurants.name: Dusita Tokyo Dip ( โตเกียว ดิป )
restaurants.address:

ตั้งอยู่หน้า 7/11 ซอย หน้าทางเข้าโรงเรียนอุดมศึกษา, Bang Phai, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Premium Tokyo-style pancakes! Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, with generously filled pancakes.

I was impressed from the first glance. The pancake batter is incredibly delicious – crispy, thin, and wonderfully buttery. Upon tasting, the batter is perfectly soft, not hard or dry. Each pancake is generously filled; the savory fillings are abundant, and the sweet fillings are fragrant, subtly sweet, and not cloying.

What I loved most is that they are made fresh to order. Seeing the preparation process was clean and appetizing. The ingredients looked high-quality, and you could feel the dedication put into them. 💛

I highly recommend these to anyone who loves Tokyo-style pancakes. They're incredibly addictive and truly deserving of a 5-star rating! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
sample_reviews_en.author: Nan Sk.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've tried several pieces with different flavors.

1. Custard: The custard is sweet and fragrant, but not overly sweet. Combined with the soft batter, it's a delicious combination.

2. Nutella: I already like Nutella, and this one, with its subtle Nutella aroma, is a perfect 10/10.

My favorite part is the batter. I've never had a modern Tokyo-style pancake like this with such a thick batter. It's just the right thickness, soft, and the aroma of the ingredients subtly wafts from the batter when you bite into it. Unlike the traditional crispy Tokyo pancakes. I'll definitely go back to buy more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sornram Srithong

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the "custard filling," but it was spoiled. I bought it from the shop, brought it home, and left it in my air-conditioned room. I ate it about an hour before eating; it wasn't left out for a long time, but the filling was sour and smelled spoiled. The other fillings were fine and delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sawittee Soramad

sample_reviews_en.text: The crab stick and shrimp roe filling is very delicious. Full of crab stick and shrimp roe. It's a perfect savory Tokyo dish. Finish with a sweet blueberry cheesecake filling. Use fresh blueberries. Delicious again. The owner is cute. Very good service. Will definitely come back to eat again. 100/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Pijittra Limtrakul

sample_reviews_en.text: A new Tokyo-style pancake shop has opened in front of the 7/11 in Bang Phai. The aroma was amazing as I walked past! It tasted as delicious as the reviews said. I ordered 4 pieces and was completely full. I'll definitely come back to try other fillings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pavena Luengdeeden

sample_reviews_en.text: I really liked it. The pastries are delicious, and the dough at this shop is uniquely soft. It's so good, I highly recommend trying it. The shop looks clean, which makes it even more inviting. Overall, I give it a thumbs up! 😉😉 🍰🍫🍡👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongsakorn Kpsw

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dessert is delicious, clean, and not too sweet. I eat it almost every day. I recommend the Blueberry Cheesecake. It's rich and hot, fresh from the oven. I recommend you try it. You'll definitely come back many times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patpicha Patchakamonwat

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here based on the reviews, and it was as delicious as they said! The fillings are so generous, it's hard to choose! Today I ordered 6 pieces, and they were all delicious. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalermphon Sangsuksai

restaurants.name: Greyhound Café
restaurants.address:

CUBE MahaNakhon, ห้องเลขที่ G103 ชั้นG อาคาร เลขที่96 Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra Rd, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is just awful... I don't know who writes good reviews, we were there today, there was only one waiter and one cook working, the wait was incredibly long. I ordered fish, it was terribly salty and tasteless, the same with meat, terribly salty, undrinkable. Afterwards I ordered dessert, thinking that at least that would fix the situation, since they apparently make the ice cream themselves, but it tasted like frozen yogurt with some additives (tasteless). I won't even mention the exorbitant prices, which are unreasonably high. Also, the tip for the waiter is already included, so it's understandable, I wouldn't leave a penny in tipping, I don't recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: София Носкова

sample_reviews_en.text:
SAWASDEE KRAB KIN KHAO YOUNG?
Based on the "Western Thai Twiz" concept, a fusion of Western and Thai flavors, this dish is Salmon topped with a sauce reminiscent of Thai Tom Kha. It's incredibly delicious and the flavors blend perfectly. I had a wonderful time enjoying the meal; the atmosphere was pleasant, the taste was great, and the service was excellent. You can also order from six other restaurants in this area; there's a combined menu available.

@greyhoundoriginal #GreyhoundCafé at Mahanakhon
Meat & Spice by Another Hound Café
#Hroy #Hroyrang #100Hroy #enjoyfood
#GreyhoundCafe
#GreyhoundCafe
#CapCut
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr.Kittipon Prangkaew (Jaded)

sample_reviews_en.text: Occupy what used to be Dean & Deluca, now renamed as Mahanakhon Eatery, occupied by multiple tenants. One of them is Meat & Spice by Another Hound Cafe. They are serving meat dishes combining western and Thai flavors. Great ambient and modern industrial interior. Excellent varieties of dishes. Fantastic presentation and above all, delicious. Service is wonderful and attentive. Affordable piece point consider this is at a high end neighbourhood. I definitely must try again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dante Not

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recently dined here for lunch. We opted for the set lunch menu of which there are 4 options available with different dishes available for the main and dessert.

Everyone enjoyed their dishes though the chocolate chilli ice cream was much spicier than I was expecting. It was still delicious but definitely you want to like heat before ordering.

Coffee was excellent as was the service. Overall highly recommended for lunch!
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael R

sample_reviews_en.text: Lovely brunch experience at the Eatery. Can’t emphasize enough how friendly the staff there was! They’re very welcoming, warm, and polite. On top, the food quality was just amazing. We ordered the crab stir fry and the stir fry with Wagyu Beef. Both were so fresh and delicious. The miso soup was so warm and refreshing. Prices are average considering the quality of food and service. Would definitely recommend to visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yara

sample_reviews_en.text:
**Rating: 4.5/5**

I had a wonderful dining experience at Meat and Spice by Another Hound. The food was excellent, with flavorful dishes that were well-prepared and nicely presented. The staff were friendly and attentive, making sure we had everything we needed. The atmosphere was cozy, adding to the overall enjoyment of the meal. I highly recommend this restaurant for anyone looking for great food and warm service.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Designer restaurant in a designer tower.

Nothing special. The waitress was more focused on her phone than the food, several menu items were unavailable, and when we asked for extra meat for our burgers, there was no option, even if we paid extra.
Two small burgers (approximately 80g of meat each) and a bottle of water cost 1200 baht.
The burger was good.
Terrible value for money.
Not recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niko R

sample_reviews_en.text:
I randomly picked a restaurant.

It was very good, and the staff were very friendly.

The Thai food was delicious, especially the Hainanese chicken rice.

The presentation was also exquisite, showing the restaurant's attention to detail.

Although I'm unlikely to go back, since it's in Thailand,

I'd still like to eat there again, haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: bron23 chen

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวหมูน้ำตก(ป้าเพ็ญ)
restaurants.address:

2321 Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant's soup is delicious. The broth is rich and flavorful, not overly thickened with blood or other additives, but perfectly seasoned with just the right amount of spice. It's perfect as is, no need to add anything extra. I ordered the stewed pork soup with rice, and the rice was also high quality and paired well with the soup. It's conveniently located right by the Forestry Department BTS station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ongart Sukthanoo

sample_reviews_en.text: The queue was disorganized. Those who arrived first were served last. We waited for a very long time. Two tables that arrived after us received their food before us. When we inquired, the staff said they couldn't find our order. I'm not sure if you have to be a regular customer or call ahead, but many walk-ins were cut in line. There's no organized system in place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Buzzlightsyear

sample_reviews_en.text: Waited a very long time. They don't really follow the queue; people who came later always got their food first. It's very slow because there's a long queue. The taste is good, but they give very little pork and more water spinach and bean sprouts than pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: JUMP

sample_reviews_en.text: 🔺The waterfall noodle soup is delicious, the broth is rich and flavorful. It's crowded during lunchtime, so there might not be any tables available. Prices have recently increased due to the economic situation. 😑
sample_reviews_en.author: TONJAKKIT JP

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love it, especially the noodle soup. It's absolutely amazing!
Tell your friends! The price is neither cheap nor expensive, it's filling and delicious.
Come early during lunchtime, otherwise it will be crowded!
sample_reviews_en.author: NoONuTTy Pk

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish is delicious and doesn't need any extra seasoning. The broth is rich and fragrant with spices, the liver is perfectly cooked, the braised pork is very tender, and the fresh pork is also tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: POTOTAE PLANTAE

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup was a little too sweet, but seasoned well enough to my liking. I liked that they offered free refills of crispy cabbage and basil. It's located near the BTS Forestry Department station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vava P

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork noodle soup is delicious. The broth is rich and flavorful, and the braised pork is tender but not mushy – incredibly smooth and melts in your mouth.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noohin Chai
