restaurants.address:

60 15-17 S Pattaya Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Banglamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday, I went to this restaurant. When I arrived, there was a long line of empty tables. When I sat down, the staff said that a table was reserved, but since I arrived at 11 PM, it was still possible to reserve it. The staff said it was the owner's table. I was very confused. Can the owner just reserve a table like that?
sample_reviews_en.author: Eoll Youii

sample_reviews_en.text:
They have a wide variety of drinks at reasonable prices. The staff are attentive, friendly, and comfortable. The atmosphere is relaxed, and everyone else in the shop feels the same way—fun, open-minded, and not chaotic.
Perfect for hanging out with friends or unwinding after work ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Mangpor Yodhong

sample_reviews_en.text: It's good, but the smell of cigarettes is very strong. Please prohibit customers from smoking, or provide a designated smoking area. Stop smoking at the table. Customers at other tables shouldn't be exposed to the smoke. It's dizzying and …
sample_reviews_en.author: LOVE LY

sample_reviews_en.text: This place has great service and delicious food. The beer-loving staff are handsome and provide excellent service. The drinks are the best. They have a DJ and you can request songs. The beer-loving staff are very attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: ดาวนิน พรมราช

sample_reviews_en.text: Great atmosphere, huge drink selection, fun music, suitable for all ages. The food is also delicious. Overall, this is a great place to go in Pattaya, especially if you're coming down from Bangkok. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kung Nan

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was almost perfect, except for the fact that customers were smoking in the music area, which is a private room, and the smell was very strong and pervasive.
sample_reviews_en.author: นายธนบดินทร์ เชื้อแพง

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great place to chill out. The music is nice and relaxing, the staff are attentive, and the atmosphere is perfect for a long, leisurely stay.
sample_reviews_en.author: อาลิษา รอดกร

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful and has a great atmosphere. The food is delicious and the prices aren't too high. The staff provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katarina Sarah Ward

restaurants.name: GUGU Chicken สาขา อโศก บ้านก้ามปู
restaurants.address:

68 ถนนสุขุมวิท 21 (อโศก บ้านก้มปู Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time in Baan Kaam Pu, but I was drawn to GUGU Korean Fried Chicken, a restaurant a colleague had raved about, saying it was delicious but there wasn't one near my house. Today, I finally got the chance to try it. I arrived at 11 am, right when they opened. The restaurant doesn't have many seats, suitable for groups of 2-4 people. There were 3 tables for 4 and 3 tables for 2. The staff were friendly. Then it was time to order. They have 9 different chicken flavors to choose from. I ordered 5 pieces of Soy Garlic Fried Chicken, 5 pieces of Yangnyeom Fried Chicken, and kimchi fried rice. Since there was one adult and one child, I wrote this review while waiting for the food. The wait was quite long. Both flavors were good but a bit sweet. I didn't order wings. The chicken was tender and crispy, but not extremely crispy. For the kimchi fried rice, I recommend ordering extra kimchi as a side dish; it makes it much tastier.
sample_reviews_en.author: putharin ph

sample_reviews_en.text: New menu items from GuGuChicken include a collection of delicious new fried chicken flavors and tempting snacks. Try the Kimmi Fried Chicken – crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, with a rich and savory seaweed flavor; crispy Korean seaweed chips coated in fragrant seaweed powder; Korean-style stir-fried glass noodles with a rich and savory flavor and sesame oil aroma; Korean Eomuk Soup; Korean sweet potato cheese balls; and hot plate Corn Cheese – soft corn topped with stretchy cheese for a delicious and creamy treat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kinklaikrung Page

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small shop located inside a building, not visible from the outside. I ordered 5 pieces of fried chicken with sauce and onions (139 baht) and Korean ramen with fish tofu (179 baht), which I thought was a bit expensive.
The taste was okay; the chicken was crispy. I ordered it non-spicy, which kids liked, and teenagers also came to eat there.
There are few tables and limited parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Art C

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken was tasty as usual, but when I went in, the male staff member in the uniform acted like he didn't see me. When I asked, he just told me to wait with a stern expression.
There are few tables in the restaurant, and the floor is very slippery.
I ordered a 7-Up and a Coke. The Coke was regular, but the 7-Up was just plain soda.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutinee Tosiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant doesn't have many seats, it's crowded at lunchtime, but the food doesn't take long to arrive.
The crispy fried chicken with cheese powder is delicious and savory.
The Kimmari (rice balls) taste good.
The Rose cheese tteokbokki is sweet, best eaten while still hot, the cheese is stretchy and the rice cakes are soft.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bow

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is tiny, but not really uncomfortable. The staff and service are nice and fast. It was crowded when I visited but I didn't wait long. The menu pretty much varies, the food is delicious, and the price is affordable. The place is also available on delivery apps and offers a lot of promotions.
sample_reviews_en.author: 王家英

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at this restaurant 2-3 times now. The food is delicious, but the service is terrible. The staff taking orders, whether male or female, are all awful. Customers are seated at tables, and the staff stand behind the counter taking orders, speaking rudely and aggressively every time.
sample_reviews_en.author: kewalin numrit

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I visited the Baan Kaam Poo Asoke branch and the service was terrible. The staff didn't come out to greet customers; they just stood in the kitchen even though there were no customers. They were inattentive and answered questions dismissively. It was a very bad experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jittima Suksatianchok

restaurants.name: The Abyss - ร้านพิซซ่า เตาฟืน
restaurants.address:

185, 1 ถนน พหลโยธิน Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found it over-pricy for average food.
The place is beautiful due to a gigantic aquarium wall. If you are lucky to have a table by this wall, you are in for an amazing dinner.
Their speciality is pizzas cooked in a wood oven, which we did not try, prefering to eat local food than European. Note that their pizzas are very expensive around 400 bhats. We had a chicken madaman, recommended as their n°1 thai dish (175 bhats). Presentation was poor, looked like a soup with 3 vegetables, 1 leave and a piece of chicken floating. Taste was average. Steamed rice was good (30 bhats). Pad thai was very well presented and original but the taste was very average (285 bhats), I had tastier pad thai in more humble places. The fried chicken appetizers were well presented but were basically chicken wings with lemongrass on top and sweet and spicy sauce. The best were the shakes, well presented, very tasty, normal price (90 bhats).
Service was good, all the staff is very kind (we were the only table having dinner).
Prices exclude 7% VAT and a 10% service charge. So we ended with a bill of 982 bhats for 2 shakes and 3 dishes. We can afford it but it felt way too expensive for what it is.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fred H.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is fair, not as I expected since I  watched the review from social media. Thus, for me, the price is expensive, especially the Caesar Salad, which I am disappointed. You can see the photo for the explanation. Exclude sevice charge and tax. No car parking is available in the restaurant or the hotel because there is construction in the hotel and it needs the area for the equipment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcha Watthana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Vegetarian- friendly ! You can order any menu and tell them about veg option !

Good service and atmosphere.

Recommended Tom yum fried rice with mushroom that good taste not spicy too much.

This restaurant recommend pizza but I went that day not sell pizza (Mon)

Recommended to come !
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutthamon Chin

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice cafe as we have buffet breakfast there while staying in V20 hotel. It comes with a choice of egg to order + local spreads, fruit, salad and cereal for you to choose. Whats more, you have a large sea water aquarium right besides you as you eat.Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eng Siong Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time eating here. The first time the food came very quickly, but this time it was very slow, even though there was only one other table of customers. The crispy catfish, in particular, was very slow to arrive and quite oily.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karin Lerdprapat

sample_reviews_en.text: Best Neapolitan pizza in Bangkok! Wood fired, soft and crunchy dough with the famous ‘leopard spotting’ just like you find in Italy. The highlight was the truffle pizza. Beautiful atmospheric setting in front of the aquarium too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sophie T

sample_reviews_en.text: First when I came inside the restaurant I had to wait for about 10 minutes to get a menu. The food itself was alright, but not great. Very expensive though and with a hidden surcharge of 50 baht! I can't recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin morgenstern

sample_reviews_en.text:
A lovely restaurant attached to the hotel 🤩
Attentive service from staff fluent in English.
A quiet hotel & restaurant located in a residential area.
The wood-fired pizza is chewy and delicious 🤩 …
sample_reviews_en.author: M M

restaurants.name: Kuwaiti kitchen Restaurant
restaurants.address:

شارع ينسباي, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
(Al-Kuwaiti Kitchen)
Pattaya, Thailand

Visit 3– September 21, 2025

Disappointing Experience

I was very disappointed with this visit. The kebabs had a bad odor and were inedible, the biryani tasted old and seemed reheated in a microwave, and the bread was overcooked and burnt. Even the hummus was let down by low-quality oil that tasted more like frying oil than proper olive oil. For the price charged, the freshness and quality were far below expectations. This restaurant has potential, but serious improvements are needed in food quality and preparation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chef_SF

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a meat maqluba, and it was excellent, just like the authentic Kuwaiti restaurant food.

The service was outstanding, and their hospitality was impeccable. I arrived during prayer time, and they provided me with a clean place and a clean prayer rug.

The owner is a young Kuwaiti man who personally oversees the restaurant and came by to ask if I needed anything or had any feedback about the food.

The prices are very reasonable.

The restaurant is excellent and clean, and definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abdullah Ali

sample_reviews_en.text:
🇸🇦🇰🇼🇧🇭🇶🇦🇴🇲🇦🇪❤️❤️
Honestly, the best restaurant! They have all kinds of flavors, including Basmati rice and everything else you could want.
The Kuwaiti owner oversees the cleanliness and service, and all our Gulf brothers and sisters are there – Kuwaitis, Saudis, Bahrainis, Qataris, Omanis, and Emiratis. The restaurant is a winner; everything is fresh and clean. I hope they open a branch in Phuket!
sample_reviews_en.author: ابو خالد

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is called "Kuwaiti," but the cooking and flavor are in one world, and Kuwaiti food is in another! We ordered a lamb machboos, and unfortunately, the meat was of very poor quality (may God preserve the blessing) and inedible. A completely unsuccessful experience, and I don't recommend it unless they improve their cooking and the quality of the meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohammad Alazmi

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the mutabak seabass, and it was absolutely delicious! The fish was fresh and perfectly cooked, and the spicy side sauce added the perfect kick of flavor. Everything tasted authentic and was well prepared. The staff were friendly, and the service was excellent. I would definitely recommend Kuwait Restaurant in Pattaya and will be back to try more dishes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alajmi 22

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Food
​The Arabic food here is very tasty and high quality. Everything we ordered was delicious and well-prepared.

​The Service
​The staff is very kind and friendly to everyone. However, they don't seem to know a lot about the details of Arabic cuisine.

​The Price
​The prices are good and not too expensive. It is a fair amount to pay for the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syed Saad

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is clean.
There is floor seating and table seating.
The staff is friendly and speaks Arabic.
The appetizers are good.
The chicken curry stew is excellent.
The lentil soup is delicious.
The chicken grill is excellent.
I didn't like the lamb grill.
The kabsa and biryani are not good.
sample_reviews_en.author: HM HM

sample_reviews_en.text: Mashallah very good tasty food, I came back here like 5 days in a row and sometimes twice a day. The best halal restraunt in town. The chef knows what he’s doing and serving size is perfect. My main dish was the kabsul laham, only thing was the meat was inconsistent sometimes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mahir Elmi

restaurants.name: BARBÙ - Rooftop Restaurant & Bar in Pattaya
restaurants.address:

390 Thanon Pattaya Sai 2 Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District Chang Wat, Pattaya City, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at BARBÙ Rooftop Restaurant & Bar in Pattaya, and I genuinely can’t recommend it enough.

From the moment I arrived, I was blown away by the view. Sitting up there and looking out over Pattaya, especially around sunset, felt really special. The atmosphere is just perfect—relaxed, beautiful, and a little bit magical.

The food was another highlight. Everything I tried was delicious, fresh, and clearly made with care. You can really tell they put effort into both the taste and presentation, which made the whole evening even more enjoyable.

What truly made my visit unforgettable, though, was the service. The staff were so friendly and welcoming, and they made me feel completely at home. I especially want to mention Miss Anamarin—she was incredibly kind, attentive, and genuine. Her warm personality really made a difference and turned a great dinner into a memorable experience.

For me, BARBÙ isn’t just a place to eat—it’s a place to enjoy the moment. I’ll definitely be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Armin Eder

sample_reviews_en.text:
We actually went to Barbu restaurant before going to the Big fish restaurant in the same hotel but the views the ambience and the menu meant we decided to stay here for the evening and it was very very nice the food was great the cocktails very enjoyable and the food was delicious.
What made it extra special was the staff that looked after us so a big shout out to Kenny Enrico and Arin who between them were attentive great fun and very professional
We plan to return again in June
Thanks so much for a great evening
sample_reviews_en.author: Timothy Merriman

sample_reviews_en.text: My family and I had a wonderful time dining here. The staff was incredibly accommodating and friendly, going above and beyond to assist us with all our needs. They even helped us take some family photos. The ambiance of the restaurant and the breathtaking scenery made it a truly memorable experience. However, I will say that the food portion is quite small especially for it's price. Other than that, It’s a great place to take your friends and family, and the staff will make you feel right at home.
sample_reviews_en.author: E Or

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a fantastic dinner at Barbu in Pattaya. The food was excellent – fresh, tasty, and beautifully presented. The restaurant also offers a lovely view of the city, which makes the atmosphere even more special.

The service was outstanding. A special thanks to Chophet, who took care of my table. She was friendly, attentive, and very charming, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable.

Highly recommended if you’re in Pattaya and looking for great food, a nice view, and warm service!
sample_reviews_en.author: Elvio Russomanno

sample_reviews_en.text:
An amazing rooftop restaurant in Pattaya!
The place is absolutely wonderful with a beautiful atmosphere and a breathtaking city view of Pattaya. The staff are very cooperative, friendly, and their service is more than perfect.
A special thanks to Rainbow, she was extremely kind, helpful, and made our experience even more enjoyable with her positive attitude and great service.
This place is truly worth visiting, and I highly recommend everyone to come and experience it for themselves
sample_reviews_en.author: Reeman Eldorado

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited here many times in march 2026. I was not a hotel guest so I paid 500 baht to use the sunbed and pool facilities.  You do actually get this back in food and drinks so I found it excellent value. All staff was welcoming especially the lovely Anamarin. Anamarin went above her duties and always had a welcoming smile and lovely talk with me. What a lovely lady.  Thank you to everyone and also to the manageress who I briefly talked with has we are both from Bury. Thank you 😊.
sample_reviews_en.author: The_Undie_Taker.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This venue is absolutely stunning staff ultra helpful and very friendly. Food here is amazing with stunning views of Pattaya city great vibe with 2 infinity pools bar and restaurant. Wonderful atmosphere with a warm ambience anyone visiting Pattaya who enjoys the better things in life really need to visit this venue you will not be disappointed.
Thank you to all of the Barbu staff for such wonderful service we will be back to try more of your amazing dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Platt

sample_reviews_en.text:
What an exceptional find in Pattaya. Just opened and it’s going to change things.
The Spanish, Italian and Greek food is delicious and superrrrr well priced. They have  really cool mix of cocktails and the views are spectacular.
They have this plate smashing tradition which is really fun. The overall experience is amazing. We went for sunset and dinner/drinks but they also have a pool and serve lunch too for those looking at a daytime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Camila DPW

restaurants.name: Homm Siam (Thong Siam)
restaurants.address:

The Street Ratchada G Floor Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a pork boat noodle soup for 85 baht. The bowl was large and the portion was generous. The noodles were okay, but the broth wasn't very flavorful. The meatballs were like those from roadside stalls (the roadside stalls are even better). The pork slices were mediocre, edible, and they even added bean sprouts, which was very confusing. I added dumplings for 25 baht and got 5 pieces. The total price was expensive considering the quality and cost. Then, when the bill came, there was a 10% service charge, which was the most confusing part because they didn't provide any service at all. They didn't take my order; I had to write it down myself. I had to walk to the cashier to pay. What kind of service is this? What time do they provide it? I definitely won't be coming back. The End.
sample_reviews_en.author: iwannabeyourfavsong

sample_reviews_en.text: At Homm Siam, excellence goes beyond taste. With a focus on hygiene and attentive service, every visit is a delight. My go-to order, the Pork Noodle without soup, never fails to impress. It’s akin to a noodle salad, bursting with vibrant flavors that dance on the palate. The combination of sweet, sour, and spicy notes creates a harmonious symphony of taste, making each bite an unforgettable experience. In addition to the noodle dish, the Pork Lemon Salad has become another favorite of mine. The tender, succulent pork paired with zesty lemon creates a delightful contrast of flavors, leaving me longing for just one more bite. If you’re in search of authentic Thai noodles that deliver on both flavor and quality, look no further than Homm Siam.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naw Hsu Ei Thin Zar (kk)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, the taste was good. I tried both the boat noodles and the stir-fried noodles, but personally, I preferred the stir-fried noodles.

The stir-fried noodles come with sweet soy sauce; you can add your own spice level to your liking. At 115 baht, it includes broth, braised pork, sliced ​​pork, and meatballs. It's a fairly standard price for noodles in a mall, and the quantity and quality are worth the money.

The flavor was well-made, easy to eat, not too heavy, and the toppings were quite complete.

My only minor complaint is the 10% service charge.

Even though customers have to select their own menu items and pay in person, I feel like the experience would have been even better without it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mickey Amollapa

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate there shortly after the restaurant opened, around 11:00 AM. I ordered boat noodles with braised pork and dry rice porridge with braised pork.
The staff member said they only had one bowl of braised pork left; the other bowl was sold out and they were braising more but it wasn't ready yet. So I changed one bowl to braised beef instead.

But it was a bit strange... why were they out of braised pork so soon after opening? And was the braised pork they had left from yesterday? I'm deducting points for that.

As for the taste, it was okay, not bad, but not amazing either. The price is high, as expected for a restaurant in a mall, 110-125 baht per bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vrapol Supowkit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hom Siam Boat Noodle restaurant is located at The Street Ratchada.
Open 24 hours.

They serve boat noodles and other single-dish meals, along with various side dishes.

There are plenty of tables for dining on the ground floor (G).
There weren't many people when we arrived. We ordered medium spicy thin rice noodles (a bit too spicy for me).
If it's your first time, I recommend choosing non-spicy and then adding seasonings, or choosing mildly spicy, which would probably be just right.

They also have fruit juices like hibiscus and chrysanthemum tea.
We chose soft drinks.
The staff provided good service.
There is ample parking inside The Street Ratchada.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Victory

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant charges a 10% service charge and should understand how to provide good customer service. Customers shouldn't have to write down their own orders; orders should be taken and payment brought to the table, not at the cashier. The food tastes good, but the service needs significant improvement. We finished our main courses, and the fried dumplings only arrived when we asked for the bill. They refused to return them. If it's going to take that long, they should inform customers how long the item will take. We ended up taking the fried dumplings home.
sample_reviews_en.author: สาวิตรี จูฑะสุวรรณศิริ

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried the branch at The Street Ratchada.

The noodles were delicious, with a spicy flavor that Thais love. You can choose your spice level.
They also have single-dish meals like basil chicken, omelets, and basil chicken with fried egg.

Located in The Street, there's plenty of seating. Snacks and fruit are available for sale in front of the shop.

They have a drink menu. The menu has been updated; a new, more attractive version might be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sachai_watta

sample_reviews_en.text: I really appreciate that this place stays open late it’s perfect for when I’m craving my favorite beef noodles and Pad Krapao Beef. The food is always delicious, and my visit last night was no exception! The only thing I’d love to see improved is the soup; I find it a bit too salty sometimes and would prefer a more balanced flavor. Still, it’s one of my go-to spots!
sample_reviews_en.author: MP JOURNEY

restaurants.name: Scala Shark Fin Restaurant
restaurants.address:

ชั้นG, 991 อาคาร สยามพารากอน, Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old brand that's been around forever, with its flagship store in Chinatown.

Decor is simple and lots of rosewood furniture, but needs a little more soft furnishings to make it more welcoming. lighting is a little harsh.

Service is friendly and helpful. Food is authentic but not very generous for the price tag.

We ordered sharks fin soup but there were probably only 4 small pieces of it, at the price tag of 1500 baht, I don't think it's reasonable. The fried rice was tasty and well seasoned.

Disappointed they removed the lunch set, which was tasty and great value for money. They should really bring that back to draw the crowds back in.
sample_reviews_en.author: D3AR C

sample_reviews_en.text:
After 25 years of trying sharks fin across Thailand, Scala's is among the top 3 in my opinion. The aroma umami from medium bull shark fin broth was divine and amazing this taste level achieved without MSG. A must try.

Second highlight was the northern Thai mud crab curry recommended by Mr Lau and the sauce for this dish was accompanied by fried rice.

Overall Scala's dishes lean towards the Teochew style as it tastes are more balanced, lighter and more refreshing than usual Chinese cooking. Prices are above average but worth to try for its uniqueness.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harry Ng

sample_reviews_en.text: Stepped in on a pretty quiet Thursday evening and was greeted by the friendly staff and boss who made us feel so comfortable with their service and recommendations. I'm surprised on how tasty the shark fin soup, fish maw soup and crab glassnoodles were. Servings were generous with 6 to 7 pincer pieces in a small portion of glassnoodles. Not to mentioned the plentiful ingredients used to prepare the rest of the dishes. Definitely lived up to its reputation. Thank you for having us 🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Xavier Ng

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd heard about this restaurant for a long time but this was my first time trying it. I was impressed with every dish I ordered, from the shark fin soup to the crab with glass noodles and fried rice. The taste and quality were excellent, befitting a high-end restaurant. But my absolute favorite was the ginger-flavored glutinous rice balls; they were the best I've ever had. This restaurant exceeded my expectations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apichaya K

sample_reviews_en.text: A fantastic shark fin restaurant! The owner was very welcoming and assisted with taking our order. The crab was very fresh. The shark fin was different from other places – thick and delicious. One serving could feed three people. The goose feet were a bit of a disappointment; they weren't as good as Fu Lam in Hong Kong.
sample_reviews_en.author: BW

sample_reviews_en.text: it was visited by a number of hongkong's celebrities, movie stars and food connoisseurs. The set meals are not that expensive, but once i could not find those sets from menu given to me, so i tried the more expensive small sized shark fin, keeps its standard as its main shop in the bangkok china town.
sample_reviews_en.author: dr ken chao

sample_reviews_en.text: Main restaurant in Chinatown! China City building! Oldest Thai Chiu chow sharkfins restaurant ! Liu’s family owned and most reputable! This one in Siam paragon mall is very comfortable clean and nicely decorated! Food is excellent! Highly recommended! Well done Rex!
sample_reviews_en.author: Goldy Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't think it's worth it!  Not that tasty and so so small amount of sharks fin for THB1500!
Crab claws with vermicelli in clay pot was quite disappointed!   vermicelli very dry and all the crabs claws are overdone!  Definitely won't come next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: C C

sample_reviews_en.text: I  don’t want to give even 1star🙂.Service and food is totally very bad . First of all one waiter is coming and ask about my order totally his reaction was bad but it’s ok . I ordered pork Kyay Oo . I didn’t said kyayyy oo sii chat .. . After that they come and serve me Kyayy oo sii chat .. I just order only one meal that guy how can do mistake..it’s mean how is he interested about his position . After 10min they change for me Kyayy oo but the teast was so bad .. I feel like a noodle soup . I didn’t feel the soup was not like a pork soup . In all of that process I asking one more bowl to another waiter even I finished the food the bowl was’t coming 😂 and I feel it’s all of this process I’m also working in Fnb position in UAE . But the worker must to be interested about his job . I miss Kyayy oo that why I came there I get the service and food was totally Zero !!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mellisa Phi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Call before you go and ask first, many of the items on the menu are not available, which is disappointing.
We went there from Ekkami for having မုန့်ဟင်းခါး and ပလာတာ it’s such a long way but we went.
The မုန့်ဟင်းခါး was sold out
Many of the items including pala are not available because the chef is sick.
Even on Sunday, most menu items out of stock.

The taste is not bad, but it’s not attract us to go again.Service just normal. The prices are reasonable, not too expensive.
It’s a good place to eat in the evening, so it’s easy to talk to people.
sample_reviews_en.author: Su

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a dish at the restaurant, but it took about 30 minutes to arrive, which is honestly unacceptable. While the food itself and the restaurant’s atmosphere were good, the long waiting time really affected the overall experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naing Htet AAA

sample_reviews_en.text: There are a few other small Burmese restaurants in the area, but this is my favorite for breakfast, and dinner too. The food is tasty, there's a great variety, it's reasonably priced, and the service is attentive. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luis Sánchez

sample_reviews_en.text:
Many delicious meals and snacks.
Prices are reasonable compared to similar range of Burmese restaurants.
They have indoor aircon dining area as well as roofed outdoor dining area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soe

sample_reviews_en.text: Lots of variety to order, can order vegetarian food. Nice staff and quick food preparation.  Repeated customer and some of the dishes are quite good. Thanks for reading.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanda Linn Aung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Friday unplugged was a real vibe and food are great and variety of choice
And The Burmese Tea is the best in Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Ananthan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is convenient and the service is very good. It's a Mon restaurant, so I'm very happy to support it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wan Chai

restaurants.name: เจ๊น้อยอาหารอีสานรสเจ็บ
restaurants.address:

Satri Witthaya 2 Soi 4, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is okay, but the prices are a bit high. Bottled water is 20 baht per bottle. It's difficult to get the attention of the staff; they don't stand around much.
We needed two cars to back up when leaving (customers who ate at the restaurant) because the staff didn't come to direct traffic. The road is narrow and dangerous. I probably won't go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Danuda Tipparat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my 5th visit today.
There were people smoking in the restaurant, it smelled terrible.
No one stopped them, and they were noisy.
Probably my last visit. (revised)

Hidden gem
Delicious food, good service.
Ice-cold beer. It's also close to home.
The instant noodles (60 baht) get a 10 out of 10!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rungroth Aumkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there a few times already. The food is delicious, the beer is chilled, and they don't even use ice! I highly recommend it. The papaya salad with thin noodles is amazing, and the Korat-style papaya salad is also good. Everything is great, so don't forget to stop by! You'll love it! 😍😍😍
sample_reviews_en.author: สหายน้อย TV

sample_reviews_en.text: We wanted to eat there, but there was very little parking, so we couldn't. We parked behind the cars that had already parked. After we parked, my boyfriend noticed that the restaurant also sold beer and there were only a few tables, so he suggested we go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moo Na

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to buy food based on reviews and took it home. I was shocked by the portion sizes. I ordered fermented pork ribs and other dishes, but the amount of fermented pork ribs was surprisingly small for this price. I wish they would increase the quantity.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรพรรณ แสนโคตร

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! I wanted to eat more but my stomach would burst. I highly recommend the spicy beef tendon soup, it's the best!!!! The dipping sauce is also amazing. Even just dipping sticky rice in the sauce is delicious. Absolutely fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Supree Manyarom

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything on the menu is delicious, especially the spicy noodle salad and the shrimp in fish sauce. The prices are affordable, you could eat here every day. The atmosphere is great, and the drinks are super cold!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kantika Choocheep

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant that I can say has very good taste and atmosphere. The service of the owner is what makes me come here very often. The food is very spicy and you can add more flavors as you like. I love it.
sample_reviews_en.author: คุณธนา

restaurants.name: Krua Chidlom
restaurants.address:

22, 12 Soi Ratchadamri 2, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This made-to-order restaurant in the Chidlom area is a popular lunch spot for office workers. The restaurant is spacious, airy, and offers a variety of made-to-order dishes at reasonable prices for this area. We ordered rice with stir-fried kale and canned fish, plus a fried egg; the portion was quite generous, but a little too salty. We also ordered Southern-style sour curry with canned fish, which was also quite salty and spicy. It seems that most of the food at this restaurant tends to be on the salty side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaya Aungtananukul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was edible, but the wait was incredibly long. Like, really, really long.
I don't know why it's so slow; there weren't even that many people in the restaurant. If you want to eat here during lunchtime, you need to allow at least an hour. I've been waiting for my food for 40 minutes now, and I haven't even seen a single grain of rice. I've been drinking Coke until my stomach feels like it's going to burst.
sample_reviews_en.author: popaep

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the prices are reasonable, and the portions are just right for someone like me who doesn't eat much. However, those with a big appetite might not be full.
The picture shows some food already eaten. The stir-fried waterfall salad with chili and salt was delicious. The stir-fried kale with crispy pork that I ordered before was also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: coco maw

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the taste was great, and the price was excellent, but the wait was extremely long, almost 40 minutes. The staff forgot to inform customers that some items were out of stock and held onto the order until we had to follow up before they finally checked on it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nahathai Boontae

sample_reviews_en.text: It's great! I like the variety of dishes, they're delicious, and the prices are affordable. Sometimes I make mistakes when writing my order – for example, I order Tom Yum Spaghetti but omit the word "stir-fried," but the restaurant still makes it and it tastes delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: JTP Jay

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a made-to-order restaurant popular with office workers in the area.
The taste is decent.
The portion size is just right, not too much or too little, enough to fill you up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gavin Montfleur

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is moderate, the portion size is normal (not too little, not too much), the taste is average, but the food is served quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: อรรถกานต์ แก้วชินดวง

sample_reviews_en.text: This small restaurant in a side street offers a variety of delicious and affordable made-to-order dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: vichayut sawet

restaurants.name: ร้านมากินนี่ Makinni (กรุงเทพมหานคร)
restaurants.address:

251 1 Amnuay Songkhram Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a medium-sized restaurant located by the roadside, with seating both inside (air-conditioned) and outside. The atmosphere inside is very relaxed, not crowded, and pleasantly cool. Food is served relatively quickly, and customer service is excellent; the staff are attentive and constantly observant of customers. There's live music at night, which makes the atmosphere even more chill.
The food tastes good and is reasonably priced. I recommend ordering the fried chicken wings with fish sauce, chicken cartilage, and spicy pork salad – they are truly delicious. The seafood fried rice has a wonderful wok aroma and a traditional soy sauce flavor; adding a squeeze of lime makes it even better. Especially at night, with the cool weather, sipping on a cold beer is the perfect combination!
sample_reviews_en.author: ครู แอปเปิ้ล

sample_reviews_en.text:
There's live music too! A folk singer with just a guitar – her voice is amazing.
The price we paid included sparkling drinks.
The sound system is surprisingly good for a place with limited space. It wasn't noisy at all, neither the live music nor the songs they played. It was a pleasant surprise. And importantly, I love rock music! 555
sample_reviews_en.author: Chompunoot Kumlangkeng

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a less spicy jellyfish salad with not too much dressing, but what I received was half a carton of dressing. It was extremely spicy and sour, probably because they used bottled lime juice. And there were two strands of hair in the …
sample_reviews_en.author: Saidah Kaewsrisupawong

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great restaurant! The service from everyone is excellent. I highly recommend this restaurant. The food and drinks are very reasonably priced. 👍🏻👍🏻💘💘 …
sample_reviews_en.author: PATITTA B.

sample_reviews_en.text: Friendly and excellent service, delicious food, great atmosphere, affordable prices, clean and safe environment, perfect for a safe drinking experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chawalvit Manpan

sample_reviews_en.text: This is our gang's regular restaurant. The food is delicious, the atmosphere is good, and the staff at the restaurant provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piggy Pink

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is really good. The service is very good, friendly, and lovely. It's chill to sit alone, and fun to come with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: The PopKunanz

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, the staff are lovely and provide excellent service. They are very attentive and the location is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutta Wijitpanya

restaurants.name: ครัวนัวขมิ้น (Kruanuakamin)
restaurants.address:

Sana Nikhom 1 Soi 12 Yaek 2, Chan Kasem, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first time trying this restaurant was because I wanted to try authentic Southern Thai curry. I ordered the sour fish curry with sea bass. What impressed me initially was the generous portion of rice and the large, fresh sea bass. The sour curry was spicy, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. It paired wonderfully with the crispy omelet.

However, on my subsequent two visits, the taste had noticeably changed. Both times, it was excessively salty, as if they had added too much shrimp paste, overpowering all other flavors. While I could understand the first change as a possible mistake, the subsequent visits were disappointing and left me feeling regretful because my first experience was so positive. I hope the restaurant will improve the consistency of the flavor and bring it back to its original deliciousness. 😀
sample_reviews_en.author: Napat Dollapavijit

sample_reviews_en.text: Oh, how good! We've already had lunch here two days and had a great time. The problem, for those who are sensitive, is that it's a restaurant serving typical Southern Thai cuisine and the dishes are very spicy, but just ask and the very kind staff will be able to tell you which ones are less spicy. The restaurant has only been open a few weeks and everything is spotless, even the restrooms. The dish called hong pork is special! If you're in the area, it's not to be missed. It's next to a 7/11. There are tables and chairs for dining in.
sample_reviews_en.author: Al

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owner, clearly visible, was standing at the door, not opening it for customers. It's understandable she didn't mind, but then she slammed the door shut! When I finally ordered just one item, she curtly asked, "Just one item?!" If there's a minimum order of two items, please put a sign outside so everyone knows! The portions were small, and the prices were exorbitant!

The restaurant across the street, called Khao Mai, is more expensive, but the portion sizes, quality, taste, and service are far superior.
sample_reviews_en.author: korn M

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s one of the most delicious food I’ve ever had in Thailand.
The sweet pork is like Chinese stewed pork with brown sauce but with extra good flavor, another big pork is tasty even with the fat (Aroi mak ka).
And the southern dishes are very tasty even spicy🤣 we finished them all.
Five star and have already recommended this restaurant to my friends😋
sample_reviews_en.author: amy chen

sample_reviews_en.text: This Southern Thai restaurant is amazing! The food is delicious and the prices are reasonable. The flavors aren't overly spicy, but rather rich and well-balanced. Everything I ordered today was delicious. The ingredients were high-quality and the service was excellent.

sample_reviews_en.text: Xiang Cha Jasmine Milk Tea is not good at all 😣 The tea is very clear and the milk is thin. It tastes bland like dissolved tea. I bought it during a promotion but it's still a waste of money. Please improve it.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Enjoy André Restaurant

Honest Flemish cuisine and Belgian beers, also featuring Thai specialties

⭐⭐⭐⭐☆

Enjoy André Restaurant is a special spot in Thailand where, surprisingly enough, you can find Belgian flavors. The kitchen serves classic Flemish dishes and home-style fare, as well as a few Thai specialties. This makes it an ideal place for those who love familiar flavors and enjoy tasting local.

A major plus is the fine selection of Belgian beers, which perfectly complement your meal. Additionally, the daily specials are correctly priced, ensuring you always get value for your money: honest cuisine with an excellent price-quality ratio. The restaurant itself is simple and no-nonsense, yet precisely because of that, it is cozy and welcoming.

It might be located a bit out of the way and you have to know where to find it, but that also makes it a hidden gem. Those who settle here will discover a warm place where both Belgian and Thai cuisine come into their own.

In short: anyone in Thailand craving Flemish classics, Belgian beers, and a touch of Thai cuisine will certainly not be disappointed at Enjoy André Restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: XAVIER

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is good, the portions are generous, and the setting is decent. But for Pattaya, the prices are a notch above what one would expect for the quality offered, which dampens the enthusiasm.

What works well, however, is the organization of the service: the appetizers arrive first, followed by the main courses, in that order. It's basic practice, but it's far from standard in restaurants in the area, so it's worth mentioning. The service is quick and flawless. The waitress could have been a bit more welcoming; the greeting lacked warmth.

A decent place, but the value for money could be improved to make it worth repeating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Valentin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is nice, open but covered. There's no air conditioning, but the tables have fans, which is usually sufficient in the evening.
The staff is attentive at all times.
The meat is good and cooked to perfection, although the portion size seems to have decreased lately.
The house wine is good.
The prices are reasonable. On the downside, the portions are getting smaller, the Roquefort sauce I ordered (paying a small supplement) didn't actually contain Roquefort cheese and was indistinguishable from the other sauces, and they serve margarine instead of butter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonio Socías Carrillo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Negative:

Cordon Bleu: Unfortunately, the cordon bleu here is prepared in a deep fryer and not pan-fried. This is a shame for the quality and my stomach.

Positive:

Service: The staff are very friendly and attentive.

Atmosphere: The music is good and creates a pleasant atmosphere in the restaurant.

Side dish: Since I didn't want anything from the deep fryer, I ordered the boiled potatoes. They were really good, freshly prepared, and very tasty.

Covered outdoor seating in older house, staff was friendly.
I had the daily special that came with soup and small dessert. Dinner was Vol Au vant with mashed potatoes.
Soup and dinner was a bit bland but with adding salt and pepper it improved.
About 350 Bath so price was right.
Personally I was hoping for a bit better quality of food.
sample_reviews_en.author: W DV

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice atmospheric restaurant . Service is swift and very good.
I don't think most customers expect here fine dining , haute cuisine or style , but just rather very good food .
Don't leave without having tried one of the strong Belgian Beers that are here available , and ask for some advise because they are not all listed on the menu.

sample_reviews_en.text: We were looking for somewhere to eat in the evening and passed a lot of places while walking down the street. We saw this sign in an alley by pure chance. We liked everything. The portions were huge and the prices were reasonable. The wine was delicious. We came back for the second time and I think we'll stop by again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Александр Медников

sample_reviews_en.text:
In the prawn cocktail the prawns were warm, whichbthey shouldn't be, the sauce was almost non existent and tasteless.
The chicken pieces on main course were dry hard and rubbery. In 5 weeks visit to pattaya it was by far the worse food I have had!

sample_reviews_th.text:
Nadia’s kitchen’s staff were friendly and welcoming, it was quite busy when we arrived about 2pm, several tables had “reserved” signs, surprised to see for a mid week visit.

Ordered “big breakfast” ฿219, but when it arrived, it wasn’t that big lol.

Baked beans, bacon, eggs were all on point, bonus to have proper mushrooms too!!

My English breakfast came with complimentary OJ however, there was no option to change this for a coffee 🤷🏻‍♂️ IDK why not, as this is usually standard for any breakfast.

Unfortunately my sausages were disappointing 😕 tasteless, not good.

Overall it’s an average rating for today’s visit, our dining experience was negatively affected, as it was too hot inside restaurant, fans weren’t efficient.
sample_reviews_th.author: Ziggy Stefaño

sample_reviews_en.text:
On the positive side:
- The food is good. And the Wednesday chicken parmesan special is tasty, plentiful, and reasonably priced at 189 baht (2024 baht).

- The staff is helpful, efficient, and attentive.

- For sports fans, there are many TV screens showing sports (thankfully without sound) while music plays in the background.

- There's a free pool table.

On the negative side:
- It's hot. The restaurant is outdoors and has no air conditioning, so the numerous fans don't do much.

- For some strange reason, ketchup and mustard are free, but mayonnaise and salad dressing are extra: 20 baht.
- The beers are only small, so you have to order two, and the price almost equals the cost of the food.

- Because the restaurant is outdoors and located next to a busy street, there's constant traffic noise.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It grieves me to review Nadia’s this way, the staff could not be more accommodating, but even though I enjoyed  the food, full English Breakfast and fantastic coffee, plus following teas all less than 200baht.
Unfortunately I found that the idea of returning to an eatery again where the experience is predominantly centred around breathing in cigarette smoke from customers sitting at the front of the business Chainsmoking while sipping a coffee impossible.
On both occasions I ate at Nadia’s I had to personally challenge hard of hearing retirees who were playing their phones at full volume. Pattaya has so much choice so it puzzles me why the management cater to a couple of selfish customers. If that’s you bag enjoy, I’ll stay here at the Jasmine Cafe in AC.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steveuploads iluvdang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went that morning with my girlfriend to have breakfast. We sat , and I noticed that the TV was showing Thai boxing.
I asked the waitress ( blond shorthair) to change the channel as I have no desire to eat watching violence.
She replued that she cannot change.
So, we left.
I am very disappointed of the lack of understanding and customer respect.
I used to go EVERY morning for 15 days.
If you guys want to spend money for this kind of behaviour, up to you.
As for me, they will not get my money anymore.
The problem at the end of the day is not the staff, because they do not have the culture to serve, but to the management that lets this kind of behaviour occur.
The day, customers will stop coming or not giving any tip, they will react...probably too late.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were unfriendly, especially the short-haired woman and the short, chubby woman with braids. They were folding tissues near the restroom. I went to the restroom at 3:40 PM on January 29th and waited outside, thinking someone was inside. The short-haired woman, with a grumpy face, said, "The restroom is up ahead." 👎🏼 "I'm buying something, not asking for it for free." "If you want others to respect you, learn to respect others first." She acted like someone who hadn't been properly raised.
Speak more politely to customers. Learn to smile. P.S. It's very noticeable that the staff at this shop aren't very friendly to women, but with foreign men, oh my! They're so cheerful! Double standards, really. 😏😏👎🏼👎🏼👎🏼

sample_reviews_en.text: Great restaurant, offers plenty of Western and Thai food options. Great prices too. I like that they open super early and stay open pretty late. Only thing to beware of, since the restaurant is all open air, you have to be careful not to sit next to a heavy smoker if breathing second hand is not your thing. Other than that tiny detail, everything in this restaurant is top-notch! Great WiFi and attention to the detail (e.g. they give you real substantial napkins here, not those tiny little thin squares at many Thai restaurants that make you wonder if someone is tearing off sheets from a toilet paper roll in the back, haha). Anyways, I will definitely be back. This place is great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cheerful Charlie

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by this place for breakfast while waiting for my laundry to finish at the laundromat.

The restaurant was very clean, and the staff were very friendly. They also have an English menu, so I think Japanese people can feel comfortable going there.

The breakfast menu is incredibly extensive, making it hard to choose! Today, I really wanted fried potatoes, so I ordered the 7-item set for 149 baht. I added hash browns and chips, and also chose pancakes. It probably isn't very healthy, but I was very satisfied.

It's also nice that tea or coffee is included with breakfast.

They recommended premium coffee for an extra 10 baht, but I'll try that next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daisuke Murayama

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nadia's kitches is a mix between a restaurant and a sports pub. The frontal section has multiple seating areas for dining whereas the inner side has a pool table and bar stools. Nadia's kitches has many TVs showing different sports to cater to everyone's preferences which is nice.

We usually only visit here for the restaurant aspect. The food quality is very good and the cooking is delicious (both Thai and Western). The food dishes were also served quite quickly which is great.

The only downside is the difficulty in finding a parking spot for cars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yawarakai O.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food: Absolutely delicious. The flavors are excellent, and you can specify your preferences. The chef is generous with ingredients; everything is top-notch. This is a genuinely honest review. The food was incredibly delicious. The menu in the booklet might not be extensive, but there are plenty of options on the wall – don't hesitate to look!

Service: Excellent. Upon entering, I'm not sure if it was the owner, but they greeted me with a "Welcome in" and handed me a menu. There's a very clean-looking restroom inside the restaurant (though I didn't use it). The interior has a great atmosphere and is very clean. The restaurant is located on a corner; you'll need to park in the side street (I parked there), or you might be able to park on the street in front – I'm not sure. It's easy to get there from Srinakarin Road, but if you're coming from behind Ramkhamhaeng, you'll need to take the ring road, exit at Srinakarin, and then find a place to make a U-turn.

Price: Reasonable. Not too cheap, not too expensive, just right.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nua Restaurant, Hua Mak 3 branch, serves delicious, flavorful food with fresh ingredients at reasonable prices. They have a huge menu, including various som tum (papaya salad), seafood, à la carte dishes, and noodles.
Everything is delicious, but my must-try dishes are:
🫶🏻 Fried Som Tum (papaya salad) - I loved it!
🦐 Garlic Fried Shrimp - The shrimp was plump and delicious.
🤤 Luang Prabang Som Tum - The fermented fish sauce was fragrant and clean, the flavor was rich and spicy.
🐂 Sun-dried Beef - Tender and delicious.
🍄‍🟫 Mushroom and Mackerel Chili Paste Set.

#jjonthewaytravelfirstreviewwhenfreetime
#NuaRestaurantHuaMak3 #NuaRestaurant #SomTumHuaMak3
sample_reviews_en.author: JJ ON THE WAY

sample_reviews_en.text: This dish is absolutely divine! The first bite hit me with a perfect balance of flavors—rich, savory notes that melt on the tongue, paired with a subtle hint of freshness that cuts through just right. The texture is incredible too; tender yet with a lovely slight crisp, making every mouthful satisfying. You can tell the ingredients are fresh and high-quality, and the seasoning is spot on—not too heavy, just enough to let each component shine. I couldn’t stop going back for more, and by the end, I was already craving another serving. Hands down one of the best meals I’ve had in a while!
sample_reviews_en.author: lijiao feng

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and very satisfying. I've been back many times. I highly recommend it. My favorite is the Som Tum Sua (spicy papaya salad with fermented fish sauce), the fermented fish sauce is truly flavorful as the name suggests. The garlic chicken rice is also delicious, the Tom Yum soup and fried chicken wings are good. The staff and owner provide excellent service. The restaurant is spacious, comfortable, clean, and plays good music. I highly recommend this place; the food is tastier and the atmosphere is much better than the famous Som Tum restaurant nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thunchanok Sirikantaramas

sample_reviews_en.text: Nua restaurant is amazing! The food is surprisingly delicious. The crispy pork belly with fish sauce is juicy and addictive. The squid larb is spicy and flavorful, just as described. The mushroom curry is so good it makes you feel like you're eating in the highlands. They also have single-serving dishes. The chili fish sauce is perfect, with whole chilies, and so flavorful you could mix it with rice and eat it without any side dishes. If you're looking for authentic, spicy Northeastern Thai food, Nua is the place to go!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dollaya Panyatip

sample_reviews_en.text: The food exceeded my expectations! The flavors were amazing, and the Northeastern Thai cuisine was very clean. I ordered three dishes of crab, and none of them had any strange smell or taste. The crispy pork with dipping sauce was excellent. The mushroom chili paste, papaya salad, and other salads were all great. I also ordered beer, and it came in a perfectly chilled glass – so refreshing!

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the atmosphere is pleasant, and there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from. The best experience I had in Thailand was in this restaurant. The hotel check in was at 2 pm and we reached here at 8 am. sample_reviews_en.text: They have the best Tandoori chicken I have ever had.  The chef is very talented in my opinion.  We ordered the masala dosa with every meal and we ate here almost every day of our vacation.  Delicious food and excellent prices!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jake

sample_reviews_en.text: Respect and care come for free in this hotel/restaurant. Needless to say,  the food is delicious. It is a must visit for everyone. The family is friendly and welcoming. You will feel at home here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pramila Singhal

sample_reviews_en.text: They very kind,good service l never eat Indian food before but they told me about good and ask many things what l want like some drink or too spicy or not,,and they food very delicious ❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Earnnn __

restaurants.address:

125 อาคาร ห้างคาร์ฟูร์ สาขา Ratchadaphisek Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10320, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: What's wrong with these employees and their obsession with taping cup lids? It's just taping the lid, is it going to kill them? Arguing with riders and customers. Taping cup lids to prevent spills or them opening is perfectly normal, but these employees refuse to listen. What's the big deal about just taping? Where's the manager? Why isn't anyone supervising this? I can't accept this kind of behavior from these employees. They argue about everything, repeat the same things over and over. They're just using their mouths to work, showing no improvement. They should even try to read customer complaints!
sample_reviews_en.author: กด เอ่ส

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's quite good as a cure for missing crispy fried chicken because I've been boycotting KFC for a long time.
I bought the spicy chicken and crispy chicken packages. The spicy one was quite good, but the chicken was a bit tough and looked less appealing. There were a few fries. For the crispy chicken package, you got 2 pieces of wings (not a whole wing, just one).
The plus point here is that the potatoes and chicken are salty, by the way, I like salty because other places don't have that flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sofya MC

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is quite small.
The C1 crispy fried chicken with fish sauce set looked very appetizing; the skin was crispy and puffy, and it was freshly made.
This is unlike some branches that might have been fried and left out for too long, resulting in a lack of crispiness.
The fish sauce with chili had plenty of chili and garlic. The interior of the restaurant was quite clean.
The atmosphere was good.
However, the air conditioning was not very cool in some areas.
sample_reviews_en.author: Normal Bears

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait was long. There were 4-5 staff members standing at the counter, but only one counter was open for ordering. Three customers were in line, waiting for almost 10 minutes. It was a huge waste of time. Why have so many staff members standing at the counter if you're going to keep it a secret?
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy C.

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff was unhelpful and the service was impolite. One customer complained, and then the staff member started yelling at another customer. This is unacceptable. The problem was only with that one female staff member; I don't know what she was making such a fuss about.
sample_reviews_en.author: อนันยา สิริโชด

sample_reviews_en.text: ******When ordering online, I often specify in the notes that I only want chili fish sauce and chili sauce, but sometimes they forget or don't include them. They should pay more attention to this. I order frequently, but this experience is disappointing.******
sample_reviews_en.author: siriporn chomboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
If the staff are unwilling to serve or don't want to, they should go home and sleep. They shouldn't slam things down on customers or make faces like they don't want to sell. Learn to respect customers more.
I'm buying this food, not begging for it.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธัชเทพ กิจศุภไฟศาล

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled chicken tasted like they gave customers old stock. It was extremely dry, like it had been reheated many times. When I bit into it, it didn't taste anything like the chicken I've had at other branches. It's unacceptable to give …

restaurants.name: Indian flame fine dining
restaurants.address:


sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

An exceptional Indian dining experience in Bangkok!

The food was absolutely delicious, but what truly made my visit special was the warm hospitality of the owner. She personally took the time to understand my taste and recommended and prepared dishes that were perfectly suited to my preferences.

What impressed me even more was her genuine willingness to help beyond the restaurant. She gave me excellent guidance for shopping around Platinum Mall and recommended some wonderful places to explore in Bangkok. Her attention to detail, friendliness, and personal touch made me feel genuinely welcomed.

It’s rare to find a place where the food, service, and hospitality come together so beautifully. A must-visit for anyone looking for great Indian food and a truly memorable experience in Bangkok. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Amol Gabhane

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sam prepared delicious food for us; the menu is varied, and the food is fresh, featuring the wonderful flavors of India. The service is courteous, and the location is central and easily accessible.

Sam prepared delicious food for us; the menu is varied, and the food is fresh, featuring the wonderful flavors of India. The service is courteous, and the location is central and easily accessible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soli Samson

sample_reviews_en.text: “I had a really great experience! The food was absolutely delicious, and all the dishes tasted authentic and fresh. The staff was very polite and friendly, and the service was excellent. The restaurant also has a nice, clean, and welcoming atmosphere. If you’re looking for good Indian food near Platinum Mall, Phenix mall is definitely worth trying. Overall, a wonderful experience! ❤️🔥”
sample_reviews_en.author: Da Ra

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious and highly recommend! Great staff, great food. With a craving for quality Indian meal we arrived for late dinner. Was not disappointed. Amazing raita, naan, tikka masala and Masala tea sheesh. Really amazing. Special thanks to owner Reshu  Semwal from Uttrackhand for
menu advice and excellent service. We live in Bangkok so will definitely see you again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Devendra Negi

sample_reviews_en.text: We had dinner at Indian Flame Restaurant at Phoenix Mall.. excellent food that got us truly Indian taste and Sachin was highly instrumental n cooperative.. his hospitality is highly appreciated, must visit place for food. Apart Sachin guided very well for shopping, we enjoyed a lot n got what we were looking for….
sample_reviews_en.author: Sagar Chudiwal

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are visiting Bangkok and looking for safe, hygienic, and delicious Indian food, I highly recommend dining here. A special shoutout to Sachin, who took excellent care of us. He went above and beyond to customize our meals to be less oily and mildly spiced, exactly to our preference!
Rajiv and Nitiya
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitiya Sapru

sample_reviews_en.text:
Missing Indian food ? That aroma ? That home taste ? Come here !!
I was craving for Indian food badly after 7 days of Thailand tour and it was worth every penny .
I loved the way Sachin treated us and the way he got us low spicy food in Indian way.
I would definitely recommend this place .
sample_reviews_en.author: Tushar Gogia

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing Indian meal, right next to Platimum mall. Great hospitality by Sachin Ji. Food was even better. Paneer was just like we have in India, and the stuffed Kulcha was just amazing! Definitely a must go if one is looking for Indian options near Platinum

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant maintains its high standard of taste. We ordered a good variety of dishes, including sushi, salads, and hot plate dishes. Each dish was well-presented and the ingredients were fresh, especially the sushi, which had fresh fish, a clean flavor, and was easy to eat. The hot plate dishes were also quite generous in portion size, leaving us feeling full.

Another thing to commend is the attentive staff. They were observant and helpful when needed, making the meal comfortable without needing to constantly call for assistance.

Overall, it's a restaurant I can return to regularly because the taste is reliable, the food is fresh, and the service remains consistently good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthaphon Sueb-Am

sample_reviews_en.text: premium japanese restaurant but you got what you paid for: quality food and many good choices on menu, including drinks. maybe this time the restaurant a bit busy, wasabi did not come together with aburi salmon sushi ordered and need to make a special request for wasabi (whether it is a policy to conserve environment i do not know, as some people do not eat wasabi with sushi), the hot green tea ordered came with a teapot which i like, as i like green tea and can drink as much as i like. i like the beef yakiniku.

sample_reviews_en.text: I was impressed with the staff. They provided excellent service. They were good at recommending food, giving good advice, explaining things well, and giving detailed, attentive, understanding, and approachable service. Giving them a million stars isn't enough. It's a shame the doctor only made an appointment on a Buddhist holy day. Otherwise, I would have been able to eat a wider variety of food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutpaphat Klungsuwun

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was a meal I had when I wasn't particularly hungry, but I felt very full.

I've stopped by here 2-3 times for doctor's appointments.
It's convenient, even though there aren't many other restaurant options.

The service wasn't spectacular; I didn't feel any special treatment, but it wasn't bad either.

Overall, it's okay. The food is delicious and up to standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tassa Lerdwatta

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was okay. I would say low to medium level japanese food. Thats expected for the price though. The only let down was the noisy kitchen staff. sample_reviews_en.text: I want to vote this as the worst restaurant ever. The food was cold, tasted terrible, and the portion sizes were appalling. I used to frequent this place, but I won't be going back again. If the price and quality are so drastically different, only the hot plain rice and water are tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pagamart Thongsak

sample_reviews_en.text: Very convenient if you’re visiting the doctor at Rama 9 Hospital. The food was generally nice, but the fried fish salad was a bit too salty for my taste. Service and atmosphere were good overall. To be honest, I personally preferred Fuji in the past more than it is nowadays.
sample_reviews_en.author: MP JOURNEY

sample_reviews_en.text: When I come to this hospital I always eat here. The food is extremely delicious. I always get the tempura. The food is high quality. The shrimp is crispy outside and tender inside. I like fuji restaurant. The soup is also very delicious. Great restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fishy Buy

restaurants.address:

ถนน จักรวรรดิ Chakkrawat, จักรวรรดิ, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Traditional Thick Noodle Soup (Kuy Jup)
👉 The shop is located on Chakrawat Road, opposite Chakrawat Temple. It's a food cart at the entrance of the soi (alley). This road is one-way.
👉 You can park on the right side of the road, but it's not recommended during rush hour as traffic is very heavy.
👉 The shop looks like it's been selling for many years. There are about 4-5 tables set up in the soi. I ordered a special takeout. The vendor separated the toppings and the noodles. When I poured it out, I was surprised by how much there was, especially the toppings: crispy pork, tofu, pork skin, and thick chunks of pork meat that completely obscured the noodles. I added chili powder and pepper. The hot broth was incredibly fragrant. I kept complaining about how much there was, but it was so delicious that I finished the bowl in no time! 555
👉 I'll definitely stop by again if I have the chance. I highly recommend this shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชรินทร์ วิภาวีพลกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup shop is located in a side alley off the main road. It's easily visible from the street and not far in. The shop looks clean, and the seating area is clean and spacious. The noodle soup is a rich, flavorful broth with all the necessary ingredients. It's delicious. If you're tired from walking around Sampeng, you can stop by for a rest and a meal; you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanarat Prechawanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a place on my wish list for braised kueh chap (flat rice noodles) that I've been eating at for over 10 years.

It's not on a main street in Chinatown, but it's just as delicious as any famous kueh chap stall.

The ingredients are fresh, the braising broth is flavorful, and the price is very reasonable! 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻😘😘 I love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: J 穎川DONNER

sample_reviews_en.text: Generous portions, large pieces of pork, and the offal has no unpleasant smell. However, I feel the taste is sweeter now and it doesn't have the same fragrant Chinese herbal aroma as before. From being a favorite restaurant, I might only eat there occasionally. The restaurant is located in an alley and has limited seating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napas Is me

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered kway chap without offal and without pork skin.
The crispy pork was delicious, and the tofu was also tasty! It was served piping hot. The shop also seems to have iced coffee/chrysanthemum tea, which you can order to drink with the kway chap. The soup had a fragrant stewed pork flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: polarz mew

sample_reviews_en.text:
Uncle Jua's Thick Noodle Soup Shop...
It's located in a side alley off the main road, easily visible from the street. It's not far in, and the shop looks clean, with clean and spacious seating. The thick noodle soup has a mild flavor, with all the ingredients included. Delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text: Very tasty Guay chap, if served slightly lukewarm. This is rather common in Thailand unfortunately, and that’s the only reason I’ve docked a star. Otherwise, highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Erik

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavor is predominantly sweet, the noodles are good, and there are plenty of toppings. If you like sweet-flavored kway chap (Thai noodle soup), this is the place for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatthoraphop Witthawatpaphapinn

restaurants.address:

26/18 Soi Yen Chit 3, Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
It's really good!
No need to add any seasoning. I like the balanced flavor of the broth.
I like it light and refreshing.
And the price is only 35฿. A winning combination!
sample_reviews_th.author: Arus C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Je Kiao's Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) is 35 baht per bowl.
Good value. The portion isn't huge, but it's delicious and the ingredients are good.

- The shrimp meatballs, in particular, are amazing. They're very unique; I've never seen anything like them at other shops.
- The soup and Yen Ta Fo sauce are seasoned with a slightly spicy and sour taste, which is delicious. It's not sweet, so those who prefer sweet flavors might not like it.
- The clear broth version, served with thin rice noodles, is excellent. The noodles are similar to Pad Thai noodles, and they don't clump together after being cooked. I really like them.
- The egg noodles are made with real egg noodles. They're translucent after being cooked, but still retain their chewy, firm texture; they don't become mushy.
sample_reviews_en.author: plpps

sample_reviews_en.text:
The price sign says Regular 30 baht, Special 35 baht.
When we ordered one bowl without specifying "special," the owner made it special for us.
We only realized when paying that if you order one bowl at a time, they'll make the special version.
(Confusing!) But if you order two bowls at once, they'll make the regular version. (Even more confusing!) We asked the owner, and she said that's usually how they do it. Okay, then maybe they should write a big sign saying that. When we eat here for the first time, we should check if it's delicious before ordering again. Probably just once is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: JibJib Khun

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop's Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) is delicious as is, no need to add any seasoning. The flavor is perfectly balanced, with a prominent sweet and sour taste. The broth is rich and flavorful, made from simmering pork bones in a large pot, always tempting to sip. The shrimp meatballs are the signature item, unlike any other, made from real shrimp with a rich flavor and a fragrant peppery aroma. The shop is old but clean, and the prices are very cheap at 35-40 baht. They accept QR code payments. Although the portion is small, the taste and unique flavor are well worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Lai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is ordinary, but the pricing is extraordinary. The sign says 30/40 baht. I thought it was regular/special, so I ordered one regular bowl. When I paid, they charged 35 baht. I was confused. The answer was that you have to order two bowls to get the 30 baht price. In short, they want me to eat two bowls each. What kind of logic is that? Paying more for one bowl isn't harder than ordering two. I came alone and don't eat much, so why do I have to order two?
Be careful. You must pay more than the price shown if you order one dish. You have to order 2 or more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucie Lert

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to love eating here; the food was delicious. Today, I wanted to buy some to take home. I went to order, and one of the staff members, an older woman in a blue hat, gave me a condescending look. When I ordered, she said, "Just one bag? You've been waiting so long!" Then she shouted, "Your noodles are ready," and just left the dirty bag there, telling me to go get it. But after saying that, she went to serve herself some banana in coconut milk dessert. I was so confused by the service. I probably won't eat here again; I felt so disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tatchanan Pudpong

sample_reviews_en.text:

Je Kiew's Yentafo, another delicious Yentafo shop. The shop makes its own flavorful Yentafo sauce, but the highlight is the broth, made from pork bones – rich, flavorful, and enjoyable to sip.
