restaurants.address:

304/1 304/1 Moo 9, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday afternoon (August 21, 2026), two of us went to the Siam Lounge Central for lunch. We ordered drinks and two dishes. The drinks arrived, and we waited for the food. After a relatively long wait, one dish arrived. We assumed the second dish would arrive within the next minute or two, so I started eating. We were surprised when the second dish still hadn't arrived, even after a considerable wait, and I had finished my meal. We were there to eat because we were both hungry! We then asked where the second dish was. We were curtly informed that it had been forgotten and asked if we were willing to wait for it after already having waited 30 minutes. We declined and went to pay. The bill was brought to us, we paid, and were about to leave when the woman came back and said she had brought us the wrong bill and that we owed an additional payment. How could anyone be so inattentive and not notice that the food wasn't complete after 30 minutes, and then bring the wrong bill? I've never experienced such terrible service. Siam Lounge - no thanks!
sample_reviews_en.author: Andreas Noack

sample_reviews_en.text: Update 02.2025: same good as always ! Great food at new styled atmosphere ! Good job ! join again ! Update 02.2024: Saturday is "Schnitzel Day" !!! Absolutely great German style Schnitzel (taste the Cordon Blea) , german beers and the day became good ! For sure one of the best Schnitzel at Pattaya downtown !!! p.s. we just saw when the owner come with a lot of fresh meat from the supermarket. So all food is fresh cooked  !!! our highest  recommendations...   2022: A real underdog restaurant, not easy to find, with great coffee, some brands of wheat beer and a wide field of german and Thai food ! The prices are resonable ! The owner and staff is always friendly ... Last sunday we stay with 10 friends there and we all enjoy and had a stunning "Weißwurst-Frühschoppen" till afternoon ...  So, we all will come again and also warmly recommend this place !
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Kaercher

sample_reviews_en.text: This is absolutely outrageous! I live in Pattaya and traveled there specifically for the spinach with regular potatoes and egg, as pictured in the restaurant, on the menu, and on Facebook. I arrived, ordered, and they brought me a measly sliver of fried potatoes with the rest of the meal, without informing me beforehand that it didn't come with regular potatoes. If they had posted that on Facebook, they'd surely have attracted fewer customers, or maybe no one at all. Naturally, I left without eating, and to top it all off, they gave me a stupid, arrogant grin.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mario Thurau

sample_reviews_en.text:
Siam Lounge – Fantastic food and impeccable service

Siam Lounge is absolutely fantastic. The staff are attentive and friendly, making every visit special. The food is delicious—German-style and Thai options alike offer high quality. The owner is very lovely, which adds a personal touch that’s hard to beat. They feature German and Thai menus, and the price relation is excellent for the quality you receive. I can fully recommend Siam Lounge to anyone seeking great food, great service, and good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: M E

sample_reviews_en.text: I was here and honestly wouldn’t give it the 4.6 out of 5. The 200B breakfast doesn’t include coffee, so that’s an extra 70. Then it says bean coffee but it comes tasting like a coffee out of a capsule machine. The staff don’t really understand your requests in English , ok, they’re not supposed to. But still, the food and ambience is not worth the $ and the walk if you’re not staying at this hotel. And if you are, might as well still go to the beach street for a livelier atmosphere and better deal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vladimir Mashnin

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered food for two people, long wait, then one dish arrived – how long the wait was again! The second dish was missing. I pointed this out to the server, and she told me it had been forgotten. At that point, I'd had enough and didn't want to eat anything more. Then, to top it all off, the wrong bill arrived. I've never experienced anything like it, even though I've worked in the service industry for a very long time. Very bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sonja Graf

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a great experience at Siam Lounge. Greeted by friendly attentive staff and a wonderful relaxing atmosphere for dinner.
My first time at this restaurant. Had the special - Cordon Bleu. Delicious! Finished with a cappuccino and the Kaiserschmarrn
pancake. Enjoyed the meal and the staff were friendly and very attentive to customers. I would recommend and will visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darren Whitehead

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here for four weeks now and eat here at least once a day. I can only say it's fabulous! I mostly eat Thai food, but I've also tried the German breakfast – delicious! The pasty was my favorite. However, I've gotten so used to Thai cuisine that I now eat Thai food for breakfast too. I can recommend this restaurant 1000%. Keep it up!
sample_reviews_en.author: o appel

restaurants.address:

laychale สามเสนใน Phaya Thai, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was average in taste. Ordering based on other reviews was acceptable. The desserts were pre-made Thai sweets, which was a little disappointing because I saw many Western savory dishes and expected cakes and pies, but there weren't any.

We were a group of almost 20 people. There was a delay of over an hour in our food. When the second batch of dishes finally arrived, everyone in our group was confused because it had taken so long, and we had already received our desserts. The staff didn't inform us when we ordered that there would be a delay in our food and why.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a lovely dining experience here today, while visit the renowned Dr. Darat of Intimex Hearing.

We ordered eggplant fries, calamari, roast duck salad, and Australian steak. Everything came out delicious, with the eggplant fries and calamari being the most standout dishes. We enjoyed coffee and soda water as well.

The space is large and ideal for large parties / parties in general. Owner was very kind, and prices are commensurate with the quality / plating of the food. Decent blend of Thai and western options. Would recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anish Thakkar (Doc Thakkar)

sample_reviews_en.text: The Western food is good, but the Thai food is a bit too oily. My fried rice took so long to come out that I'd finished everything else, and I had to ask for it before it was ready. There seem to be frequent problems in the Thai kitchen; they should improve this and reduce the oiliness. The restaurant allows customers to sing on stage, which might not be ideal for everyone. There are no separate seating areas if you don't want to listen.
sample_reviews_en.author: FoodLover

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very disappointed with this restaurant today. They weren't prepared at all. When I asked why my order wasn't ready, they said they were waiting for eggs because they were out of them. I ordered salted beef fried rice and still haven't received it after more than an hour. If I have to wait this long, I'd rather eat somewhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Veerachai Sungwai

sample_reviews_en.text: This beautifully designed, contemporary Italian restaurant offers a wide variety of delicious Italian food, and also has a Thai kitchen. The place is spacious, convenient, and has ample parking. The atmosphere is great, the food is delicious, and there are also private function rooms available.
sample_reviews_en.author: don bhusa

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place for quiet it down dinner. A variety of Thai and Western dishes at reasonable price. Three zones to choose from but sometimes closes one of the zones if the restaurant isn’t busy. 50 + parking space. This restaurant is great for hosting private events from 10-100 guests.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siam Pimlico

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The food is diverse, delicious, and flavorful.
- There is ample parking space for many cars.
- The atmosphere is pleasant, with private rooms available for booking to accommodate larger groups.
- The service is relatively fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawarin Punyawajee

sample_reviews_en.text: Great restaurant, plenty of parking. The fried pork is delicious, the best in the area. Highly recommend! Everyone in the restaurant is smiling, the owner is very nice. They also have catering and karaoke.
sample_reviews_en.author: code capito

restaurants.name: Yuènán
restaurants.address:

Central Plaza, 7/222 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yue Nan Vietnamese Restaurant is another favorite for those who enjoy authentic Vietnamese cuisine. The taste is quite similar to what you'd find in Vietnam, the ingredients are fresh, and the dishes are well-balanced and easy to eat.

A highlight that impressed me was the fresh vegetables served with the dishes. They were fresh, clean, and the restaurant replenished them regularly, so you don't have to worry about running out for wrapping or eating with your various dishes. This enhances the flavor and value of the meal.

Overall, it's a Vietnamese restaurant with great taste, quality ingredients, and attention to fresh vegetables. It's suitable for both those familiar with Vietnamese food and those wanting to try it for the first time.
sample_reviews_en.author: ทํามาเพื่อหากิน

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Vietnamese restaurant has many delicious dishes. The Nem Nuong (grilled pork skewers) is very tasty and high quality. The shellfish is also delicious. However, the beef pho at 200 baht a bowl is a bit expensive for the small portion and not very good value. I wish they had more variety on the menu. Overall, it's good and very delicious. I recommend trying it. The restaurant is clean and spacious, the staff are very attentive, and everything is well-organized. I highly recommend it.

Google says the restaurant is permanently closed, but I still ate there! It's located on the G floor of Central Pinklao. I'll update it later when it's officially closed. I had to contact them twice before they admitted the restaurant was still open.
sample_reviews_en.author: BB KNG

sample_reviews_en.text: A new Vietnamese restaurant recently opened in Central Pinklao. It wasn't very crowded. Most of the dishes were on the sweet side. The grilled pork with vermicelli was very sweet, and the Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) with its dipping sauce was also sweet. The only thing that was good was the Vietnamese pork sausage with skin. However, the side vegetables were provided in very small quantities; we had to ask for more, and even then, the amount was still very small, which made us reluctant to keep asking – unlike most Vietnamese restaurants. The prices are quite expensive compared to the portion sizes, and they also charge a 10% service charge. The staff provided good service, and parking was convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sissy Ko Ko

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Vietnamese restaurant that I'm so hooked on that I can't eat Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) anywhere else anymore. I first discovered this restaurant at its first branch near Wat Sommanat, and I was so happy when they opened a branch at Central because it's closer to home. The Nem Nuong pork is delicious, the vegetables are fresh and clean, and they give you unlimited amounts. The grilled pork wrapped in betel leaves is perfectly cooked. I order the Yuzu pork salad every time. All the dipping sauces are delicious and well-balanced. The sugarcane and lime juice is a great addition. The staff are attentive. I wish they would offer a membership card for loyal customers; it would be fantastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tulip Drinking Water

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the worst Vietnamese restaurant I've ever eaten at. I ordered four dishes, and all four were terrible. The shrimp wrapped in sugarcane was like eating deep-fried batter. The Vietnamese noodle soup (Goi Cuon) was like plain water, completely lacking the sweetness of pork bone broth. The grilled pork with vermicelli was extremely tough and tasteless except for sweetness. The spring rolls weren't crispy at all, just chewy.

They were incredibly stingy with the vegetables, giving only a tiny amount the size of a kindergarten child's water bowl. The dipping sauce spoons were also tiny.

The price is exorbitant considering the quality and taste. One visit is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanvit Pornnoppadol

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Vietnamese restaurant offers a taste unlike any I've ever had, in the Yuen Nan style.

🫕 The Nem Nuong (grilled pork skewers) uses thin rice paper wrappers that don't need soaking, making them easy to wrap. Served with pineapple, the flavors complement the fragrant grilled pork perfectly.
A subtle, pleasant aroma.
🐽 The grilled pork with vermicelli noodles comes with fresh cucumber and crispy spring rolls. Here, it's served with pickled diced radish and carrots, drizzled with the restaurant's special sweet dipping sauce – a truly delicious combination! 👏🏻

😍 The staff were very attentive, offering unlimited refills of vegetables, and the food came out quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nopchulee Cheeveevatanagool

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Vietnamese restaurant in Central Pinklao serves delicious food.
I ordered the beef pho and it was great. The soup was fragrant, the beef was good, and the noodles were similar to thin rice noodles but firmer. It came with two sauces: Sriracha and tamarind pho sauce, both delicious, but it was also tasty without any sauce at all.

The vegetables were fresh, crispy, and not bitter.

I liked the sugarcane juice with lime (if I remember the name correctly). The sugarcane juice came with lime slices (if I remember correctly) served separately, to your liking. The sugarcane juice alone is too sweet, but adding the lime juice made it just right – refreshingly sour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atchara Set

sample_reviews_en.text: The Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) was delicious! The dipping sauce wasn't too strong, but it tasted even better with the pineapple. The vegetables were fresh and crispy. I loved the rice paper wrappers; you don't even need to soak them – they're very thin and crispy with a slightly salty taste that pairs perfectly. The fresh spring rolls had a unique, thick dipping sauce, but there wasn't quite enough of it. It came in a small ceramic bowl, but you can ask for extra vegetables. You absolutely have to order the sugarcane and lime juice. The portions are quite large, but it's easy on the stomach. It's best to come with a group of people.
sample_reviews_en.author: แม่ ณิชา

226/8 Beach Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Incredible food

and flawless service! Easily one of the best Indian dining experiences I've had. Shahi Indian Restaurant gets everything right-from the rich, deeply layered flavors of the curries to the perfectly crisp, fresh naan. Every dish tasted authentic, fresh, and made with high-quality ingredients. The staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, providing fast and attentive service throughout the meal. The atmosphere is clean, inviting, and perfect for family dinners or casual nights out. I will definitely be a returning customer!
sample_reviews_en.author: Safiqul Islam

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited Shah Indian Restaurant, Pattaya, as recommended by Mauzee Holiday, and had a very good experience.

The food was delicious with authentic Indian flavours, and the service was excellent. The staff were friendly, attentive and welcoming. We really enjoyed our meal.

Good food, great service and definitely recommended for Indian travellers visiting Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mauzee Holiday

sample_reviews_en.text: I had tried from Amritsar to Girnar.. but this restaurant is good w.r.t food and price. I ordered Alu paratha and dahi Puri which cost me 260Bhatt I'm not sure why this place has negative reviews. I find good when it comes for quantity n quality. I wish I would have gone here first instead of spending an extra amount for the same food in a fancy restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: munmun sarkar

sample_reviews_en.text: I visites this restaurant, I am really saying you will feel best in whole Pattaya I tried many times before other restaurant but this is really amazing and Kishan is best service provider here you must visit once
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohan Kumar

sample_reviews_en.text: If you are seeking your indian food just go for it. Very reasonable price among most of the Resturant even the taste are spices are very balanced , the kishan guy very well welcomed us and serviced well ❤️.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rajat sharma

sample_reviews_en.text: good taste, pakistani taste, awesome.. i forgot my little shopping stuff and had a flight after 6 hours later from Bangkok, staff walked behind me and handed over my stuff that i didnt realized missing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raheel Shamim

sample_reviews_en.text: Desi food at its best with great service and reasonable pricing. Owner and Staff are both friendly & helpful. Great food and experience 👌 😋 👍 😀 😊 🙌
sample_reviews_en.author: Dharmz Kara

sample_reviews_en.text: Simple restaurant with good food and service.The prices were very reasonable. The owner greets you....Will definitely return.....try it
sample_reviews_en.author: Sami Rahman

restaurants.name: Ta Chai Sukhothai Noodles
restaurants.address:

119/1 Bamrung Mueang Rd, Sao Chingcha, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is delicious, but it's often hired by people to set up shop at various events, so you might find it closed if you have to travel a long distance. It's best to call the restaurant first to check if it's open. A recommended menu item is the dry noodles with spicy salad. It's very delicious. The restaurant opens early in the morning, so there aren't many people. If you come during lunchtime, it can get quite crowded. When ordering, write it down on a piece of paper and hand it in to be sorted in order. However, the restaurant doesn't forget your order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norrasade Sritam

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so delicious! 😍 The owners, an elderly couple, were so lovely. I went with my family and everyone loved it. If it were closer to home, we'd come every day. My dad, who's a picky eater, said this place was amazing, and my mom said it was the best she's ever had. We even ordered some to take home. I want to go back again and again! 😍 I usually don't like green beans, but they gave us a lot here, and they were so delicious! We finished the whole bowl! ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Witar Asawa

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely recommend this gem of a find in Bangkok! There’s 5 types of noodles to choose from, dry or soupy and regular sized or large. It’s that simple and absolutely brilliant. The recommended version - dry egg noodle tom yum - is what I tried and it was a real cracker. Pair it with some packet chips of pork crisps or fish skin that’s on the table, and you have one of my definite recommendations for Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charles Victor

sample_reviews_en.text:
May this restaurant remain a favorite among Thais forever. Those who love Sukhothai noodles will be very happy.
The taste is good, the ingredients are good, and the atmosphere is comfortable, just like eating at my favorite restaurant when I was a child. Regulars know this place well; it's delicious and reassuring. You don't need to follow any reviews; this restaurant is genuinely delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yaikaab Sueng

sample_reviews_en.text: We were hesitant to look around the place because we couldn't see any English signs. The owner smiled and gestured for us to sit down. The noodles were very tasty, as was the soup offered before each course. The selection is limited because they only have two types of dishes, but they're delicious. Very traditional and incredibly affordable; we spent 140 baht for two.
sample_reviews_en.author: OTTAVIA ALLEGRINI

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious dry egg noodle tom yum.
The sourness, the sweetness, they are both balanced, with combination topping of BBQ pork, long beans, bean sprouts and crushed peanuts, definitely yummy.
Clean and tidy preparation.
Great service of all staffs, polite, friendly, greeting me for afar.
Price is good at 60b for large portion, obviously worth it.
Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rbw dinata

sample_reviews_en.text: Great tom yum noodles. Visited in the morning and were the only customers, but they get very busy during lunch. Noodles (dry) were very good, came topped with red pork, minced pork and beans. Flavor is very much on the sweet side, which not everybody might enjoy. Prices on the menu seem not to be correct anymore and need to be updated.
sample_reviews_en.author: nik

sample_reviews_en.text: Nefis !! 😋 We tried the noodle dish from the photo, and it had such an amazing flavor that I honestly can’t describe it. It was incredibly, incredibly delicious — I can even say it was the best food I’ve had in Thailand! You should definitely try it, you’ll thank me later. This place is truly a hidden gem 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Ec S.

sample_reviews_th.text:
The taste was good, the dipping sauce was delicious and not too sweet, and the price was reasonable, although the grill took a while to heat up. 🤣🤣🤣
It would be even better if the pork slices were thinner; I prefer my food drier. I'll definitely come back again! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

We went with 3 people, and it cost 215฿ per person.
sample_reviews_th.author: Natchanan Muangthanasunthon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been a fan of Chef Pae's food since his old location until he moved to the new Nuanchan spot. He used to frequent Pho Kaew, a shabu-shabu place, but then it disappeared, reappearing as a fried chicken spot.
I tried a set meal the first time; the dipping sauce was delicious – I suspect MSG had spilled in it, typical of Chef Pae's cooking style. The fried chicken was tasty, crispy, and flavorful – worth the price.
Three months ago I saw him at Central Eastville, but last week he was gone. However, I drove past Pho Kaew and the shop was still slightly ajar. I don't know if he's open, but I hope he's still selling. I'll try Chef Pae when he goes to Bangkok.

I went again, but the shop is smaller now. The sticky rice was soggy it wasn't in grains, and the chicken wasn't as flavorful as before. I paid 20 baht for the dipping sauce, hoping to find something to dip my French fries in, or maybe the sweet potato fries, but they weren't crispy. This time there were some left, which I ate with hot rice the next day.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตะนาว 419

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Drunken Cook" - the name speaks for itself. The food tastes delicious and is sure to please your palate.
OG Fried Chicken: Crispy batter, tender meat, flavorful and savory.
Tom Yum Wings: Spicy and satisfying.
Sticky Rice with Fried Pork: Easy for kids to eat, filling for adults. Enhance the flavor by dipping in fermented fish sauce or adding mango salad dressing for an even more delicious experience.
Fried Chicken Skin: The best! Crispy without being tough, stays crispy for a long time, intensely crispy, and flavorful. Dip in the sauce or pour over the dressing; you can eat a kilo and satisfy even the pickiest eaters.
Pickled Mustard Greens Salad: The sesame oil aroma cuts through the richness.
The star has to be the mango salad dressing. It tastes good with everything. You can even pour leftovers over fried fish! 🤣🤣🤣
The Pho Kaew branch has no seating; it's takeout only. There are plenty of delivery riders. I haven't been to the Central Eastville branch yet.
Don't just take my word for it, try it yourself!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ake Intarakosit

sample_reviews_en.text:
• A good fried chicken shop, though it’s not easy to classify its style neither purely local nor Western.

• The highlight is the generous portion and quality of the chicken, especially for its affordable price. The flavor is decent, not outstanding, but satisfying overall (3–4 stars for taste and value).

• However, I must deduct 2 stars because while waiting for my takeaway order, I noticed one staff grab a piece of fried chicken from the serving tray with his bare hand and eat it. This is quite concerning for food hygiene. I hope the management will pay closer attention to staff behavior and food safety.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpit Pinsai

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located in Soi Pho Kaew (near Wat Bueng Thonglang), on the road that connects to Nawamin Road, directly opposite KFC.🤣 I ordered takeout (there are tables to sit and eat at the shop). You have to wait quite a while for the chicken to be fried fresh (over 10 minutes). Personally, I thought the fried chicken had a very strong spice flavor mixed with the frying oil, making it a bit greasy. But the portion size is quite generous. I personally liked the sticky rice with fried pork, fried chicken wings, and fried chicken skin – they were very enjoyable. You can park on the street in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: yimp yimpdow

sample_reviews_en.text: Yay! The Pho Kaew branch has reopened! Freshly fried chicken, following the concept of takeout only (no dine-in). You can call to order and pick it up. The storefront might look a bit less fancy, and I heard they've adjusted the recipe – it's more flavorful, less salty, and the batter is crispier. The staff are friendly, and the chicken smells delicious. You won't be disappointed buying it to take home!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wongpanit Phokaew

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried chicken is incredibly delicious! I could order it every day and not get bored. It has a lovely herbal aroma, the skin is crispy, and the meat inside is still tender. The sweet potato fries are also tasty. If you order it and it's been sitting for a while, I recommend reheating it in the air fryer; it'll still be just as delicious. There's no seating area to eat at the shop itself.
sample_reviews_en.author: PUIFAI

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fried Chicken, Cook Inful Dang
The fried chicken is well-fried, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, delicious, with a salty flavor.
The dipping sauce is the restaurant's own recipe, likely a mix of sweet chili sauce and ketchup. Personally, I wasn't a big fan of the sauce.

I would have preferred a more standard, regular sweet chili sauce and ketchup.
sample_reviews_en.author: JunGGi uniQue

sample_reviews_en.text: *Ashok Restaurant, Pattaya* is a true savior for anyone enjoying the vibrant vibes of Walking Street! Open *24x7*, it offers *hot, fresh, and delicious Indian food* anytime you need it. Whether it’s late-night hunger after partying or an early meal, the quality and taste never disappoint. Friendly staff, quick service, and authentic flavors make it a must-visit spot for Indian food lovers in Pattaya. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: jarvik munshi

sample_reviews_en.text: Ashok resturent is my best experience they have the best staff and the best quality food they can make every food according to the taste bird of every one  and the best partnis their location its opposite to the botique city hotel i must recommend this hotel to everyone

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing experience! The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of flavor. The quality and presentation were excellent, and the taste truly stood out. The staff was friendly, polite, and quick to serve, which made the visit even more …

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was very nice and the saff was very friendly and humble I highly recommend this place

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the rice is generous, and the price is reasonable. You can park your motorcycle on the roadside in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sansern Laosawangsuk

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried pork rice is very delicious. The marinade is absorbed into the meat. I like the pork loin type, which has no fat at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: tiffy berrypink

sample_reviews_en.text: Damn it! One order took almost an hour. That's so long! People are waiting, and the sellers are just chatting amongst themselves.
sample_reviews_en.author: เเล้วมึงจะทําไมกู ไอกระดอ

sample_reviews_en.text: The spicy salad was delicious, and the grilled pork neck with its juicy sauce was fantastic. I really liked this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: อาร์ทอี๊ด Eatart

sample_reviews_en.text: The yam tam is delicious. You can tell the vendor what flavor you want. The fried food is delicious. The pork neck is juicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varatchaya Prasatchai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, fresh, and very clean. The taste was exactly as requested and perfectly suited my palate.
sample_reviews_en.author: KayKay Clinic

sample_reviews_en.text: Grilled chicken and grilled pork neck rice is very delicious. The flavors are very well-balanced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pinpak Augkarapon

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely amazing! The food was incredibly delicious and perfectly suited my taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: aunna donct1001

restaurants.name: Lilysukimala@Rang Nam Alley
restaurants.address:

101/5 Rang Nam Alley, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant I visited because I was craving spicy food while traveling.

The broth costs 59B and the sauce costs 29B. The ingredients—beef, pork, dried tofu skin, king oyster mushrooms, glass noodles, shrimp, etc.—are almost identical to those found in the Mala Tang I used to eat in Korea.

Ingredients continuously rotate on a conveyor belt, and you simply select the ones you want and dip them into the broth.

I chose the Mala broth and did not order any sauce. I ate a little bit of everything until I was slightly full, and the bill came to 290B. It was slightly cheaper than eating in Korea, and I was satisfied because it had an authentic Mala Tang taste.

However, it was a bit uncomfortable because there were many people and the seats were packed close together. I was also flustered when a packet of ramen that the person next to me had eaten and needed to pay for was left on my side.

It seems like a good place to visit if you are craving spicy food while traveling in Thailand...
sample_reviews_en.author: 꿈돌이

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's my first time here again!.... I was craving mala, so I opened Google Maps and arrived at the restaurant in 10 minutes.
Seriously, what a surprise! The staff were incredibly attentive and helpful, I was really impressed. As for the menu, there's a wide variety of dishes, with 9 soup options to choose from. We opted for the most popular ones: mala soup + pork bone soup. We wanted to try the flavors that most people like. Next, the dipping sauces were amazing! There are two options: Sichuan style and white sesame sauce. We chose the white sesame sauce, which suited our taste and cut through the mala oil well. That's all for now, I'm going to continue eating!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natcharee Jongkhavadee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was good, the soup was delicious.
But! The staff took the fresh ingredients to replenish the stock, then scooped the ice provided for drinks and put it in the fresh ingredients.
>>>The ice for fresh ingredients and the ice for drinks should be clearly separated<<< It's unsanitary. If they improve this, I will add more stars because the taste was very good.

Update: The last time I ate there, it seemed like they weren't scooping ice haphazardly anymore.
Also, when staff cut the ice cream cone bag, they should cut from the tip of the cone so it's easier to pick up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dukdae BigBunnY

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an authentic 100% Chinese-style restaurant. If you like mala soup, you'll love this place. The soup is rich and authentically mala flavored. If you don't like mala, there are 8 other soup options to choose from. Each soup base costs 59 baht, and the dipping sauce costs 29 baht, which you can customize or use the restaurant's recipe. Food items are priced according to the color of the skewers or trays, ranging from 19-69 baht. Personally, I like the beef tenderloin; it has beautiful marbling, is tender, and not chewy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Komgrit S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's convenient, each person gets their own pot. You can just throw in whatever you want to eat. There were two of us, and we ate until we were stuffed. The total bill was 721 baht.
There's unlimited ice cream too!

We came back again, and ate until we were completely full. We didn't eat much meat, so this time it was 240 baht. We got two free scoops of ice cream, Ete brand too, which is delicious. The mushroom soup is delicious! The mushroom dipping sauce, mixed with oyster sauce, sesame oil, and a little sugar, is amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Van W.

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like the food and the taste, but is it something else? Every time I go... they always change the menu, rotating nearby places, practically ignoring me... I hate it so much. I tried not going for a while, but when I went back, they did the same thing again. Are they crazy? And the way they calculate the price is confusing; they always overcharge me... I'll ask for details the next time I go... It feels like I'm getting ripped off all the time.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธาดากุล แพนแก้ว

sample_reviews_en.text:
Friendly staff and good hotpot broth 😍
The price is reasonable - the one on the sticks range from 5-20 baht. The meat in the plate range from 50-80 baht.
They also have a sauce station where you can mix your own sauce. I tried tom yum and mushroom broth, both were good.
The ice-cream flavors there are really tasty. Make sure to not skip it 😆
There is 1 staff that speaks good English. She was also very supportive
sample_reviews_en.author: Eleanor Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time at the restaurant and I was very impressed! The owner is lovely and friendly. The food is fresh, delicious, and especially the mala soup and the restaurant's signature dipping sauce are the best! 😄😁😊👍 (P.S. The restaurant has great promotions and no time limit. Highly recommend!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Promsuphat Phongsawai

restaurants.name: บีฟเบอแรงก์
restaurants.address:

เซ็นทรัลพลาซา รัตนาธิเบศร์ ชั้น 3, Rattanathibet Rd, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The quality of the fresh ingredients was excellent. It's a shame they didn't have shrimp or pork udder on the day I visited. Almost all the meat was good, except for the sirloin, which was incredibly tough.

The dipping sauce, in my opinion, wasn't quite to my liking. It's also a pity they used regular salt; Himalayan salt would have made it so much more delicious.

The service from the staff was outstanding. I was very impressed with the service. I hope they maintain this quality.

For meat lovers, this is a must-try. You definitely won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jackey BB

sample_reviews_en.text: My recent experience at the Central branch was terrible. The rice was hard, dry, and grainy – it felt like eating pebbles. The vegetables weren't fresh, and the Wagyu chuck was incredibly tough. At 1400 baht a piece, it was tougher than the meat I buy from a street vendor near my house. That's it, the last time I'll ever go there. For 1400 baht, add a little more and go to a better restaurant. It was an advanced level of disappointment. My teeth hurt from chewing. A complete waste of money. The price is excessively high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Orawee Pir

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible. They couldn't answer any questions. When asked about the best cuts of meat, they said they didn't know and didn't eat meat. When asked about promotions, they told me to read the sign.

The meat was mediocre, over a thousand baht per person, and quite tough. Not recommended.

If a buffet at this price has such bad food and terrible service, you should prepare to go bankrupt and close the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: kamonchanok manakaew

sample_reviews_en.text: Almost all the food was frozen, requiring a while to thaw, which affected the limited time available for the buffet. The soy sauce-marinated food was good, and the salmon sashimi was tender. The staff were confused about the orders, often combining two servings into one dish without informing customers. I was not impressed and won't be returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amornrat C.

sample_reviews_en.text: It was my first time eating there. It seems the restaurant didn't take the food out of the freezer, which caused it to come out very slowly. There wasn't enough meat to eat, and even near the end of the meal, they still hadn't finished serving it. So I couldn't finish my food because of the time constraints.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yamatos

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was okay, and the staff were welcoming, but the food was served slowly. The charcoal grill wasn't hot enough, so the meat cooked very slowly. Meat tastes best with a strong fire. I was almost impressed, but as I said, it wasn't. I'll try coming back again. This time, I'm giving it 2 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naruedom Wongphromma

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good. I went there at 8:40 PM, and at 9:30 PM, a staff member, a transgender woman, came over and asked in a rather annoyed tone if I wanted anything else because the kitchen was closing. I think this staff member needs improvement; they need to pay more attention to detail.
sample_reviews_en.author: MJAOF CH

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are quite high, but the quality of the meat and food is excellent. I didn't try anything else, just ate the meat. The promotions were good, the service was good; they changed the grill and refilled the charcoal without extra charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natee Korsanan

restaurants.name: Auntie Anne's (Chaophya Hospital)
restaurants.address:

113/44 อาคาร โรงพยาบาลเจ้าพระยา, ชั้นที่ 1 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, อรุณอัมรินทร์ Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Auntie Anne's (Chaophraya Hospital branch) is located in the front building of the hospital, easily visible upon entering. This brand has many promotions with various companies, dozens of them. I personally used discounts on 5 items, with varying amounts of savings. Some promotions allowed me to redeem points.

The freshly baked goods are delicious, but they become chewy if left for a while. The Pretzel Dog, with its sausage wrapped in pretzel dough, is a good size. The Lemonade is perfectly balanced between sweet and sour and tasty. The prices are a bit high, but there are many promotions available to offer discounts.
sample_reviews_en.author: MrStew LuiRoj

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like this branch. It feels like they really meet customer needs. I've ordered from this branch twice now and the quality and taste have remained consistently good. They even cater to customer requests regarding sweetness levels – 75% less sugar or stronger tea – unlike other branches that don't always accommodate those requests. I really like this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: ::THIS NaM::

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff is terrible, I want them fired. This has happened many times. The employee with long, curly hair speaks rudely and, worst of all, badmouths customers behind their backs. This has happened repeatedly at this branch. Please fire her.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimnada Siriyakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch is small and cramped, not really suitable for dining in. However, the wait for the dessert was not long. The staff were abrupt and unfriendly, but the service was good and fast. The portions were correct and complete as ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niccy nan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were lazy and seemed unwilling to sell.

The presses weren't hot and were tough and hard, but they were served in a way that was idiotic.

Poor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karentown

sample_reviews_en.text: Located at the corner near Chaophraya Hospital (formerly Booksmile bookstore, which has now closed). Newly reopened and still has promotions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paradorn Tonthong

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small order, so expect a long wait because there's only one person working there. I waited almost 40 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyapat Sripinyo

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were rude, lacked politeness, and had no customer service skills whatsoever.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutthapol Aunjai (Get)

restaurants.name: อาเฮงก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือ อยุธยา
restaurants.address:

Chanhunbamphen Market, Soi Pracha Rat Bamphen 26, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a really delicious boat noodle shop. I usually order it less spicy, and the flavor is just right – no need to add any extra seasoning. However, sometimes they give too little broth; by the time it's served, it's almost completely dry. I prefer ordering the special portion; it's a generous amount and enough to fill me up. Crispy pork cracklings are 20 baht per bowl, and they give a good amount. I like the egg noodles, but the ones at this shop aren't very good. They overcook them, boiling several ladlefuls at a time and then soaking them in the broth for too long. The egg noodles become mushy and unpleasant. They should be boiled separately and not overcooked. The shop is located behind the market near Chanhun School, and there's convenient parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karnrawee Naratham

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my third time eating here. Normally I like to eat noodle soup with rice, but every time my boyfriend comes, he eats the thin rice noodles and they look so chewy, so I ordered some too... and it was exactly as I expected! The noodles are perfectly cooked, chewy and springy, and the broth is flavorful and well-seasoned. I ate it without chili and it was still delicious – no need to add anything! I highly recommend trying it, their food is really good. Location is as per the check-in.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taw MC

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been looking for a delicious boat noodle shop near my house for a long time. Today I tried this place, and wow, it was so delicious! Just like they say, no need to add any seasoning. The broth was very rich and flavorful. The price was good too.
Most importantly, the papaya salad was incredibly spicy!
This will definitely be my regular spot from now on.
For boat noodle lovers, you have to try this place. You won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanjana Tri.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Boat noodles are delicious, no need to add any seasoning. Small bowl 20 baht (delicious, rich flavor). Large bowl 40 baht (a little salty). Steamed rice cakes are 10 baht for a pair, decent for the price. Crispy pork rinds are 20 baht per bowl, delicious and crunchy.
There weren't many people in the shop, but there were many delivery riders waiting in line. If you eat in the shop, you'll have to wait a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: ก็ กบเอง ไงครับ

sample_reviews_en.text: I order this very often; it's incredibly delicious and flavorful. However, I have to deduct points because even though I clearly state "no offal or liver" when ordering, there's always a significant amount of offal or liver included. It's a little frustrating, but the taste is truly amazing, so I keep ordering it. I hope they improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutikan Meelong

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup tasted good, the noodles were good, and it was delicious and flavorful without needing any extra seasoning. However, the crispy pork cracklings had a slightly rancid smell and weren't crispy. The atmosphere in the restaurant was ordinary.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pekky 41

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant looks dirty. The plate for vegetables was very dirty, like it hadn't been washed. Orders were never delivered correctly. The condiment bowls were also unclean, and the spoons and chopsticks were dirty. I hope the restaurant improves.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirapha Muansutha

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very flavorful boat noodle soup. Please let them know if you don't like spicy food. A small bowl is 20 baht, and vegetables are provided free of charge. Steamed rice cakes are 15 baht for a pair. Delicious, I can confirm!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ery N!ee

restaurants.name: Cleanfit Delivery
restaurants.address:

90 Phibun Watthana 11 Alley, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food arrived on time as scheduled. It's delicious! At first, I thought it would be bland like other healthy food, but it has flavor. I really like it. I chose the chicken stir-fried with tamarind sauce, and it's as delicious as the comments said.

This was my first order, I tried 21 bags in total. I ordered mostly dishes with strong seasonings,
because I was afraid it would be too bland for someone who likes spicy food like me.
But after trying it, it wasn't bland at all. It wasn't as strong as regular food, but it wasn't so bland that it tasted like hospital food. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Sinita milk

sample_reviews_en.text: I opened the box and thought it was cat food. The picture in the advertisement is completely different from what I received. The food wasn't packaged in a box like advertised, but came in a bag that needed to be cut open and microwaved. Furthermore, there was no rice included. The admin didn't mention any of these details during the purchase. I'm very disappointed and feel like I've been scammed. Honestly, the food wasn't cheap, but the packaging looked like food donated to the needy. I won't buy from them again because it's so inconvenient to eat. Goodbye.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phatdanai Jutong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is great, but the delivery service is really bad. Every single time, there’s a problem with the delivery. One time they gave me the wrong order, and twice they delivered to the wrong building. The delivery guy also doesn’t call when he arrives. He can show up an hour early or late without any call or tracking system, so the frozen food could melt or spoil while sitting in the sun. They used to be much better before,not sure what happened.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farid Kamar

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been ordering from CleanFit for quite some time. However recently their service has become very poor. I scheduled a delivery before I went away, on the day of the delivery, no food turned up and when I messaged them, they said it wasn't handed over to DHL and I would now have to wait an extra 2 days which is unacceptable.

The quality of food that turned up was very poor also.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefan Witchell

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered Tom Kha Gai (chicken coconut soup), and this is what I got. I also ordered Kua Kling (stir-fried minced chicken with basil), but the minced pork was chopped extremely finely, like mushy, just to make the portion look bigger. Honestly, if you're going to do this, just raise the price. It's extremely unacceptable. Of all the places I've eaten at, this is the worst.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somying Jingjai

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the sachets and the packaging was great. The taste is also good, perfect for someone who follows a healthy diet. I'll order again soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pigee

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent. Whether it was receiving or sending packages, the GPS was perfectly accurate, with no errors whatsoever.
sample_reviews_en.author: เข็มทอง พรมเดช

sample_reviews_en.text: They have a wide variety of dishes, the prices are affordable, and almost everything is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: nittaya metha

restaurants.name: Smizzle Burger - EmQuartier
restaurants.address:

695 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had the Uncle Sam burger + bacon .. absolutely delicious .. the tater tots was all crispy .. hope it was not because I asked for it because Thai tater tots are usually not crispy🤣👍🤤🤤 all very good. But taking away stars for hiring so many ‘blind’ attendants who somehow just could not see me frantically waving at them to get some service. So I had to walk to self serve.
Overall quite expensive for tasty burger without good service …
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark mk

sample_reviews_en.text:
unfortunately, this was our first and last time trying Smizzle Burger.

the food was extremely greasy.
the moment we held the burgers, our hands were covered in oil, which made the whole meal feel heavy and unpleasant.
we couldn’t finish the food because of how oily it was, and the taste itself was not worth it.

even one of the fries options had barely any flavor and was just soaked in oil.

overall, very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aisha Althani

sample_reviews_en.text:
On one hand, the hostess informed me they were behind and orders would take 20 minutes.

On the other, they served me my drink and fries before the burger. I left after 25 minutes of waiting. Was going to pay for the fries/drink, but they gave it for free given the wait times.

I can’t stay mad because they were kind and upfront about situation. I hope they find a more efficient way of serving burgers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony Chung

sample_reviews_en.text:
The burgers were way too greasy, though the taste was decent.

The fries, however, were absolutely delicious.

What really put us off—aside from the overly fatty burger—was the service. First, the fries arrived, then my girlfriend’s burger, and mine followed ten minutes later.

What’s up with that? I wanted to eat together and enjoy my fries with the burger, not separately!
sample_reviews_en.author: Florian Hoflehner

sample_reviews_en.text: The burger with the smashed patty was very delicious. The pickles, in particular, were a real kick. I tried the Uncle Sam Burger because it seemed to be their signature item, and I would definitely visit again. However, the fries were actually a bit ordinary. Overall, it felt like a franchise restaurant with nothing special, but the staff provided decent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: 킴디노

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just opened today December 29th, 2024

+Great burgers and fries
Same quality as the original branch

+Many more seatings with charging sockets by the wall. Cozy and comfortable
There is a sink right there to wash hands

+Convenient location, B floor of Emquartier

+Friendly staff

I might come here instead of Bambidi branch entirely
sample_reviews_en.author: Onic Cuppac

sample_reviews_en.text: Smizzling great burgers 🍔🍔🍔, need more 🌶🌶🌶for added zziingg...burgers usually 🐮 but how it became 🐷is wierd., stick to meat balls!..curly fries were right on but very small portion- must be a shortage 🥔, mickyDs still z best 🍟 ...and what's with the gloves?!🖐🏿 is it for going to toilet 🚽...
sample_reviews_en.author: rony soerakoesoemah

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. This was my first time eating here. The staff at the EmQuartier branch were very attentive and gave great recommendations. I was very impressed and will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thunyaluck Perathavewate

restaurants.name: Baimiang Healthy Shop ใบเมี่ยง - เกษรทาวเวอร์
restaurants.address:

11 หน้า 7 เกษร ทาวเวอร์ ชั้น B 127 Ratchadamri Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A female employee with long hair tied back, approximately 40 years old, who was at the shop around 2:15 PM, seemed unwilling to provide service. She was preoccupied with processing tax invoices and didn't want to answer questions.

She appeared to lack the concentration to attend to customers and was only interested in the documents.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justice99 Pp

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I bought protein at the Gaysorn branch. The staff were very helpful and polite. I'm a newbie regarding protein supplements and didn't know much about them. The staff here explained everything in detail. Anyone new to protein supplements doesn't need to worry at all! I'll definitely be a regular customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mafern Chai K

sample_reviews_en.text: Bai Miang shop has a wide selection of healthy drinks and keto food. I like that they also have products for vegans. The staff were very helpful in providing recommendations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ppoommyy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quality products
Sales girls are super nice and very informative.
If you’re looking for clean snacks, they have variety for vegans and everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumyat Tharaphy

sample_reviews_en.text: I've bought blended chicken breast from them many times. The staff are kind and the product is high quality. Now I'm a regular customer!
sample_reviews_en.author: Drttt Hujji

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were excellent, always giving out free snacks, and they were all beautiful and lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Riam

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff provided excellent service; they were polite, friendly, and always smiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฮั่น แน่

sample_reviews_en.text: Natural, organic and healthy food/ snacks/ milk/ ice cream etc with vegan options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yellow Bear

restaurants.name: Toom's Kitchen OV
restaurants.address:

6 Soi King Chamnan Aksorn, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went to try dinner at Krua Tum Ing Nam OV restaurant.

- Stir-fried glass noodles with shrimp and acacia leaves
- Stir-fried fish with chili and salt
- Fried rice with salted beef and bird's eye chili
- Fried liver with garlic
- Fried pork neck with fish sauce
- Fried minced pork with salted fish (not a salad)
- Stir-fried squid with shrimp paste

The food tasted good, not too sweet, well-balanced, and delicious. Everything came out quickly; we didn't have to wait long.

The female staff member was cute, talkative, friendly, and gave good recommendations. She was also efficient.

The male staff member was quick and efficient.

☎️ Please call to reserve a table; walk-ins won't get a table.
🚙 There's a parking lot next to the restaurant, easy to park, but it gets crowded in the evenings.
🕰️ Open 4 PM - 9 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanokporn Kaisin

sample_reviews_en.text:
A friend recommended this place a long time ago, and I finally got the chance to try it.

My favorite dish was the fried liver with garlic; it was perfectly cooked, not tough, and very flavorful.
My friends really liked the stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce; the vegetables were just right, crispy, and not too salty.
Other dishes we ordered, like the soup, larb, and omelet, were also delicious. None of the dishes we ordered tasted bad.

The prices were very reasonable.
However, the restaurant is quite small and not ideal for long conversations.

I recommend making a reservation beforehand. The restaurant has both indoor (air-conditioned) and outdoor seating, so you might need to check if you have a table available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supanida Limpongsanurak

sample_reviews_en.text: Paula tried her best to provide excellent service. She was very lovely, even though the restaurant was crowded and she was constantly being called upon. The Thai food was authentic, a little on the salty side, but I liked it. I've ordered the minced pork with salted fish many times and never less than two servings, plus some to take home. But this time I ordered the herbal fried rice and loved it so much! I've never ordered it before, it was delicious, I highly recommend it. I also tried the chili paste fried rice, but it was a little too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: BOEY

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here for a casual Thai meal and it really delivered. The food is the main highlight, strong flavors, well cooked, and feels like proper home-style Thai rather than anything fancy. Service was smooth and friendly, but I needed to book in advance, and my seating was limited to about 1.5 hours since there’s a queue after. Prices are reasonable for the quality, so it’s a spot you can come back to anytime. My favorite dishes were glass noodles with shrimp and cha-om, and minced pork with salted fish, both really bold and flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was great, but nothing to write home about. There were a few dishes that really stood out, but with the service was rather unpleasant, I am not sure I would endure that to have them again.

Having said that, I still highly recommend the place. Their food is very flavourful.

Highly recommended dish: fried minced pork and salted fish patty topped with yum dressing, stir fried vermicelli with climbing wattle tips (aromatic leaves), which was a bit on the oily side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pete P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Once you've eaten here, you'll want to come back again. Every dish is delicious, with rich flavors and excellent ingredients. The shrimp and squid are fresh, so you won't have to skimp on the seasoning.

The atmosphere is like dining at a friend's house. There aren't many tables, so you need to arrive early. The staff are very skilled and provide excellent service. There's no problem.

There's public parking behind the restaurant for 20 baht per hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pink Nattaporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
It just happened that Leo beer was the most delicious item I had. Pork (supposedly pork jowl) was dry and too chewy. Stir-fried liver was as hard and as dry as the pork. It tasted so basic I could only taste the dryness. Spicy salad with prawns was just not what it would like to be called. Instead, it tasted like a weird stir-fried pork dish.

I wouldn't give this place another try. Others may have different experiences though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vasin Boonpattanaporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
All the food was delicious and highly recommended!

However, those who can't handle spice should be aware that everything is quite spicy.

The restaurant is like a local's everyday street food stall.

On the day of the visit, it was mostly Thai people eating there.

The prices were reasonable, and the portions were just right.

It's a restaurant I'd like to go back to, but the location is rather out of the way.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fartima Chan

restaurants.name: Santa Fe Steak
restaurants.address:

VHW4+58X Tesco Lotus แจ้งวัฒนะ, Khwaeng Thung Song Hong, Khet Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, temperature checks were conducted again, and we were required to register on the We Chana app. The service staff were excellent, polite, and courteous. They inquired about membership card promotions and explained the process clearly. The food tasted good and was prepared quickly. The spaghetti and fish were cooked perfectly, while the pork dish still had a slight pink hue, possibly due to insufficient heat or concerns about toughness. However, the taste and texture were superb. The honey lemon drink was a perfect balance of sweet and sour, while the yuzu drink was more sweet than sour. This restaurant is ideal for those seeking a reasonably priced steak.
sample_reviews_en.author: warat saikij

sample_reviews_en.text:
Santa Fe Steak is currently running a great promotion. They've curated a menu that perfectly suits customers, pairing pork tenderloin steak with spicy chicken steak—both favorites—plus a bottle of water and ice for just 149 baht.
The steak was a little oily, but still acceptable.

The restaurant's layout is well-designed, with posters strategically placed. You'll see the promotion poster right after coming down the escalator and walking straight ahead. I couldn't resist and went right in! Haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: พชรวิทย์ เรืองฉัตร์ธนกุล

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like eating at this branch in Lotus Chaengwattana. It's not crowded, the taste is good and up to standard. Especially the promotional sets available at certain times are great – not expensive, filling, and worth it.
Today I had the Steak Buddy set:
1. Spicy chicken steak 🍗 with Kurobuta pork sausage 🌭 plus strawberry juice. Good taste, delicious sauce.
2. Spicy ham spaghetti. Okay, but a little oily.
👍⭐👍🤪
sample_reviews_en.author: a r t s @ t i t a t a r n

sample_reviews_en.text: The steak was delicious and worth the price. I loved the cheese menu, but when I went back the next time, the cheese menu was gone. It seems like the promotion has ended. Cheese makes the steak even tastier; they should bring it back! The staff were welcoming, friendly, and provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyatida S.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate there on February 4th, 1968. I was very impressed with the service from all the staff, from the receptionist in the orange shirt to the person in the white shirt who seemed to be the manager. They all provided excellent service, spoke very politely, and were very well-mannered.
sample_reviews_en.author: sirawit chunchorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The steak tasted delicious and maintained its usual high standard. Waiting for the steak to be grilled took about 15 to 20 minutes, which wasn't too long. They served corn beforehand to whet the appetite. The staff were polite and courteous, and the tables were very clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pipo_pollapat

sample_reviews_en.text: There were many promotions. The staff provided excellent service, explaining how to sign up for membership and recommending menu items. I was very impressed! The food was delicious! 💛🧡
sample_reviews_en.author: Mindworld

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hall staff should be retrained.
She was folded in arms.
I got no response to my food complaints
Even speaking in Thai, I felt that I ignored customers
sample_reviews_en.author: Appa Hyun

restaurants.address:
