sample_reviews_en.text: I got my food and walked out five steps, then went back in to ask for chili sauce, but the staff said I needed to take the food bag inside. I was confused; I asked twice, and they said the kitchen wouldn't give it to me. I'd just gotten my …
sample_reviews_en.author: ปราโมทย์ กองแก้ว

sample_reviews_en.text: The fat guy with the visor is a bit of a dog's service. He talks like a real jerk. I don't know where he's rushing to die while driving. If you don't love service work, why are you driving? If I could remember his license plate, I'd …
sample_reviews_en.author: แบงค์ ชิว

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, the center staff are very good. However, there should be some chairs for partners to sit and wait for their food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karn Aimsakool

sample_reviews_en.text: During peak hours, there are many orders and we can't keep up, causing riders to wait a long time. This should be fixed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chai Kub

sample_reviews_en.text: Chicken stir-fry with basil is 99 baht, plus a fried egg for 10 baht. You get 4 pieces of chicken and 100 chilies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pai Gavin

sample_reviews_en.text: Grab drivers are not very polite, most of them. Pedestrians need to be careful. I encounter this almost every day.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณิรชา อุปแสน

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a gathering place for delivery riders who pick up food from various shops in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: thanawat lertbanditkul

restaurants.name: GUGU Chicken สาขา สวนดุสิต
restaurants.address:

189 Ratchawithi Rd, Dusit, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried chicken is delicious, crispy, and not greasy. There are many side sauces and snacks to choose from. There are many sizes to choose from. You can eat it alone, with a partner, or with a group. You'll be hooked. However, I recommend finding a good parking spot. The shop only accepts scanning payment. However, it's really delicious. I'd like you to come and try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dollapron Ph.

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. They completely ignored customers. I called them twice, and three people were in the kitchen – none of them paid any attention. They just ignored me. People like this shouldn't be working in service. The food was good, but with such bad staff, I won't be eating here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภันทิลา พรศรีเจริญกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: The kimchi soup was a bit bland, and the kimchi (side dish) was so minimal that I had to order extra. The chicken itself wasn't to my liking, or maybe the recipe I ordered just wasn't to my taste, so I had to buy extra sauce to make it edible. Overall, it was acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorasit Hanwiwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I walked into this branch and asked to buy the buy one get one free promotion on the 9th.
The employee said, "This promotion is over. We won't have enough stock here." What does that mean? I could have understood if they had simply said the stock was sold out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kim Eunji

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken was delicious, and there was a bucket for bones and scraps on the tables.
The staff spoke some English, which was a plus.
But we ordered 10 pieces, and the wait was long, even though we were the only ones there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ria

sample_reviews_en.text:
Korean food is easy and casual, like fried chicken and other dishes that most children enjoy. The taste tends to be slightly sweet.
The staff provided good service and the food was served quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Can Do

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken initially smelled and tasted like popcorn aroma at the first bite. While I enjoyed the caramel soy sauce flavor, the cheese powder version was a bit too sweet and dry for my taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ade Ho

sample_reviews_en.text:
The kimchi soup was bland, not spicy, not sour, and the portion size wasn't worth the price.
The fried chicken was tender, but the fried garlic was bitter and burnt (soy garlic sauce).
sample_reviews_en.author: Give Give

restaurants.name: Pad Thai Wat Yang
restaurants.address:

1066, 4 ถนน พรานนก Ban Chang Lo, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible! I bought Pad Thai, asked for extra vegetables and extra lime, and they complained the whole time.
They kept telling me to leave some for others, like, "What does that even mean? Vegetables are expensive?"
They wash the pan with a plastic bag. Where's the hygiene?

It wasn't like this before. The taste was good.
Since Grab and Foodpanda started, it's like they don't care about customers anymore.
They put less tamarind in the Pad Thai, and the taste has changed.
If I add a lot of seasoning, they give me a dirty look. If I ask for a little more vegetables, they complain.

They complain about just three lime wedges.

They complain about less than 10 stalks of chives. Great!

At other restaurants, you can take as much as you want. I really regret recommending this place to others.

Pad Thai is more than half profit per serving; it's just noodles, stir-fry, and sauce. After dividing the profits, there's always a profit margin. And there are plenty of people who don't eat vegetables.

Nowadays, I just cook it myself. It's so much more convenient. 100 baht investment for the whole family.

They're so stingy, it's like I'm asking for free food. Honestly, it's awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sahanboriboon Jitjaitham

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's terrible. They complain when you add more vegetables, and the taste changes.
Honestly, look closely at how the restaurant cleans the pans.
I've seen them use plastic bags to clean the pans, turn on the heat, add water, and then search the bag.
Did the plastic melt? Then they let us eat it. I bought it and didn't dare eat it.

What about the previous times I ate it? I don't even want to think about it.

Enough. I won't eat it again. That's it.
sample_reviews_en.author: เภสัชฝ้าย ตอบได้ทุกปัญหาสุขภาพ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Pad Thai is from an old, established shop.
The taste is consistently the same (though it's a little on the sweet side). The noodles are chewy and soft, the toppings are plentiful, and the dish is freshly made and clean.
Anyone who likes traditional Pad Thai should try it. If you're in the area, I recommend giving it a try. Importantly, the price is also affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: MAN OSK127

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! I walked past and the aroma of the Pad Thai sauce was so tempting, I turned back to eat. (Don't be surprised there's no meat; I ordered the vegetarian version.) The noodles were chewy and soft, not too soggy or too dry. The stir-fry had a wonderful wok aroma. I didn't need to add anything extra besides chili powder and a squeeze of lime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Walk with toods

sample_reviews_en.text: As the name suggests, this shop sells only Pad Thai, and that's the only dish they make, and they do it exceptionally well. The taste is excellent, the ingredients are top-notch, the price is standard, the portions are generous, and it's clean. The owner/staff are friendly and easygoing, which is why I eat here often.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตี๋หนุ่ม กาแฟสวนกวางตุ้ง

sample_reviews_en.text: It's affordable, tastes good, and is enough for two people if you don't eat much. If you buy it to take home, they'll put chili and sugar on the side; just mix it in and squeeze some lime juice, and it's perfectly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nukul Kumsee

sample_reviews_en.text: I love Pad Thai, it's the fourth time I've visited Thailand, here I ate the best one. I paid 50 baht, very fair, in addition to being a super cook the lady is very kind. Absolutely worth trying
sample_reviews_en.author: Luca Azario

sample_reviews_en.text: This Pad Thai is delicious, the traditional kind that's hard to find elsewhere. The noodles are moist but not too soggy, and the flavor is perfect without needing any extra seasoning.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปทุมทิพย์ ชวินกุล

restaurants.name: ร้านลาบยโสธร สุขุมวิท16 (ลุง&ป้า)
restaurants.address:

574 4 Phai Singto Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Restaurants should not allow smoking inside the premises.
Not everyone likes cigarettes. Some people have allergies, underlying health conditions, or simply find the smell and smoke unbearable. Restaurants should operate legally and manage customer issues properly, rather than expecting customers to resolve them themselves. Such behavior appears unprofessional for a restaurant establishment. If the restaurant only serves smokers, a clear sign should be displayed so that those with allergies are aware and can avoid the establishment. Even suggesting takeout for those with allergies isn't a direct solution, as customers still have to wait for their food and it's not a truly smoke-free environment.
sample_reviews_en.author: แซลมอนคานิ สเต็กกุ้งถัง

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tasty Esan food
Recommend: beef soup, grilled fish, grill beef (so called : Sua Rong Hai / crying tiger ) Papaya salad esan style (very spicy 🌶️) with rice noodles and sticky rice. Waitress maybe a bit confused all the time need to make sure your order is correct. If many people the food will take longer time to be served and the place inside is a bit hot for Farang, suggest to take table across the street instead. Expect local, street food vibes, do not expect a “fine dining atmosphere ” 👌🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonthicha Nathongthip

sample_reviews_en.text: Roadside Streetfood with seats inside and across the road outside under a cover. The pricing is reasonable, the portions are okay, the quality of the meat was fine. We had Sabu Moo, Som tam and beef with of course a Leo 🍺 Service was quick and staff was very friendly. This is roadside so cars are passing and a lot of locals eat here. There's a 7-eleven next door where you can park your car/bike. They did charge 20 baht for the ice, and the glasses are plastic but both weren't a real issue. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Latte

sample_reviews_en.text:
The weather was quite hot and there were a lot of mosquitoes. We arrived at 11 PM and sat on the opposite side of the shack from the restaurant. The food line included items like offal stew, beef stew, grilled intestines, and udder, but nothing else.
Prices start at 90 baht, not including papaya salad which starts at 50 baht. The prices are on the high side for a roadside laab (spicy minced meat salad) restaurant, probably because it's an area with many foreigners living there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peerumpa Lerkshayee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was spicy and sour, and we had to follow up on our order 3-4 times. Even after we finished eating, we still hadn't received our food after repeated inquiries. It was terrible. In the end, we canceled the order. We're not coming back.

Tables that arrived after us received all their food, but we, who came before us, still hadn't received ours even after finishing our meal. We don't understand the restaurant at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nut Nuttapol

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I've been here many times. The staff provides good service, and the owner is lovely, always smiling and friendly. The highlight is the fried chicken wings; I love them so much! Every time I come, I have to eat them, and at least two plates! 🤣 The papaya salad is also great, even for someone who doesn't like it too spicy. Everything on the menu is delicious (and there are so many!). Highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Besttybeat

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northeastern Thai restaurant is located on the roadside in Soi Phai Singto. The food is delicious, especially the fried chicken wings which are a must-try. The grilled pork neck is lean, perfect for those who don't like fat. The "beef with chili powder" is also tasty, especially when paired with the tangy dipping sauce. The atmosphere is homey, but the flavors are anything but ordinary.
sample_reviews_en.author: GNK23

sample_reviews_en.text: This place was delicious! I stumbled upon it by chance because I was disappointed at El Mercado – they were full. The seafood was incredibly fresh; the shrimp was crispy and the oysters were amazing. The papaya salad with fermented fish sauce was fantastic, and the dipping sauce was delicious too. I'll definitely be back. Parking is available along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: dfond supattana

restaurants.name: The Marble Cafe & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

198/21 M.9 Pattaya 2nd Road, Soi 13 (Soi Diana Inn Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Saw this restaurant that is attached to the Acera lodge and decided to try it. Nice variety in the menu. Ordered the salmon salad. Good serving of salad and menu said it would come with a balsamic vinaigrette.

Unfortunately it only had a splash of balsamic vinegar. There was no oil to the base at all. You could tell the salad wasn’t coated at all with the vinegar. Surprisingly for a restaurant that looks like they have good chefs. Vinaigrettes are not rocket science in culinary circles.

Nonetheless, the salmon was excellent. Came hot and off the grill and cooked to perfection.

If I would to order again, I would ask for the oil and balsamic vinegar on the side and properly season the salad.
.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Falcone

sample_reviews_en.text:
Since I always stay in Areca Lodge as long as I am in Pattaya, I frequently order from the Marble cafe. The staff is really friendly and professional.

I ordered a lot of food here from breakfast to dinner. My favorites in this restaurant are the ham-cheese sandwich with fries and their fruit shakes (Pineapple and Lychee).

Their pizzas are not bad either, and even the steaks are really good. I like to order some food if I'm getting a tan outside and or woke up too late and want to have a late breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun Kenzo

sample_reviews_en.text: I would of liked the food if it was even warm but it came cold. One note which I found greedy was a 5% charge for using my credit card coming from a nice hotel. I would expect that out of a Hindi hotel not a high end. I asked for no salt on my fries and it was too late. They could of accommodates such a simple request. Then There was a butter knife given for a steak dinner. I would still come back and demand that the food came out hot. The dipping sauces for my dish were good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stone Cold

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a bad experience I ordered a particular meal was given something totally different but they would not change it because they said it was the same price ...I was not happy how I was treated and would not ever give that person another order....as far as I was concerned I was entitled to a refund
sample_reviews_en.author: Glenn Porter

sample_reviews_en.text: A decent Thai restaurant at the large Marble Hotel. It has a nice interior, and seating is available both inside and outside on its own terrace with a bar. The Thai cuisine at this restaurant is very spicy (classic)—it's best to ask in advance for "no spicy or a little spicy." 🌶🌶🌶
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Ledo

sample_reviews_en.text: For lunch, I ordered a plate of stir-fried shrimp noodles and a plate of grilled chicken with fries. I thought they would be small plates, but they were large, so I left a lot of food, which was wasteful. The service was very good, meeting hotel standards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Crypto GK

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn’t expect the food here to be good, but it was really very tastefull. I had the Wiener schnitzel. The Marble restaurant is part of the Areca Lodge Hotel. It was cheap and very, very good. The Thai food ordered by my wife was very good as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Johan Geuens

sample_reviews_en.text: Really good restaurant. Beautiful interior, clean and I guess very new. The staff were really nice and the food was delicious. We loved it, definitely recommended for a calm nice dinner🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Mika Poklitar

restaurants.name: Normal Steak ตึกวรรณสรณ์
restaurants.address:

35 อาคารวรรณสรณ์, Phaya Thai Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Normal Steak has opened a new branch at Wannasorn Building. It just had a soft opening in early February, and since it's near my workplace, I took the opportunity to try it.

The vibe is similar to the popular steak restaurant near the Victory Monument that now has branches in malls. The difference is that if you order a main dish, you can get unlimited cheese bread and refillable drinks. You can choose your side vegetables, dressing, and condiments without extra charge.

A single steak (pork, chicken, fish) is around 200-300 baht.

Combo sets start from 288 baht.

From my experience, the bread was warm and freshly made, with crispy and soft cheese – delicious! I ordered the spicy chicken and pork loin / spicy chicken and strip loin (small size). The taste was average, and the portions were okay, but compared to the popular chain, I might prefer it slightly less.

Overall, it's okay. Anyone who likes unlimited cheese bread and drinks will probably enjoy it.
sample_reviews_en.author: T. Santi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steak portion was just right, not too filling. I ordered the combo, which included two steak options, free salad, free water, and unlimited bread – great value! I think the bread would taste better if it were warm.

You order via QR code by clicking on the image. Be sure to read each line carefully and follow the steps. I didn't know that you also had to order the bread from the image, but the staff repeated my order and ordered the bread for me.

I arrived at 6 PM on a Saturday. Their famous spinach salad, lemon soda, and chrysanthemum tea were already sold out. The restaurant seems to be very popular on weekends. (The accompanying picture is an old photo from when I had the chance to eat the delicious spinach salad and lemon soda.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Memayu

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a medium well steak, as pictured on the menu. The first time, the meat was completely cold, not even warm. Nothing on the plate was hot, even though the restaurant was busy and the food had just been served. Even the side dishes weren't hot. The second time, I found the meat wasn't the doneness I ordered; it was medium rare, even though I asked for medium well. I asked them to remake it. The third time, the meat was still only slightly warm. After two bites, it was still rare. Terrible! I could get better food at a roadside stall for 49 baht. I had to pay 320 baht, and the first refill of my Coke was fine, but the second refill was some kind of random mix of orange juice and Coke. That's it. I asked for the bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darlean Bmm

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good steak despite its name. Perfect service with a friendly atmosphere. This is my favorite, regular restaurant. I've been eating here since it first opened. They still have opening promotions! I come here about twice a month. The food is delicious and the price is worth it. You can refill the bread, cheese, and drinks unlimitedly. The bread is delicious and freshly made. The steak is also delicious. The truffle spinach is the best. The sweet potato fries are also tasty. There are many delicious steak dishes on the menu. I recommend the spicy chicken steak, Manhattan duck, spiced chicken, and BBQ pork ribs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minlada Ariyasajsiskul

sample_reviews_en.text: What made my day at the restaurant was how attentive the staff were. My friend and I were eating and chatting away when we used sign language to ask for sauce. What we did was, a staff member looked at us and immediately went to get a tray of sauces without us even asking! They also refilled our water glasses constantly. It shows they care to pay attention to their customers. ☺️ Other staff members were also constantly checking on customers at other tables. 💕🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: ouxtta

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a new location for Normal Steak. If you are hungry and happen to be at the Phaya Thai from the airport or just traveling past this area, head into the Warrrasorn Building, first floor. You will find the Normal Steak restaurant, new and clean, with friendly professional staff. Lots of comfortable seating, a menu with many choices. The steak, fries, and salad I had was great! All at a reasonable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Morgan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steak was large, and including all the side dishes, the portions were generous. Bread and drinks were refillable.
The service was good, especially with one male staff member who was very polite.
My only minor complaint is that the steak was quite thick, which might have prevented the marinade from reaching the inside of the meat, making it taste a little bland.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sky

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this new restaurant and it's even better than I expected. The black pepper chicken steak, probably breast meat, wasn't dry at all. The salad greens were high-quality, not the typical cabbage you find at most restaurants. Free bread and unlimited drinks are also included. This has become one of my favorite restaurants for health-conscious people.
sample_reviews_en.author: May Kulwadee

restaurants.name: ร้านกวานทรงคนอง
restaurants.address:

50 1, Tambon Bang Yo, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a hidden restaurant, but the taste is restaurant-level. Their soups, stir-fries, curries, deep-fries, and spicy salads are all prepared with rich flavors and are not stingy with the ingredients. They have a wide variety of dishes, and the atmosphere is relaxed, with a gentle breeze. It's a great place to chill and enjoy a beer. The service is friendly and the prices are reasonable. **It's a shame I've eaten here so many times that I haven't had time to take photos of many dishes. I highly recommend it. It's delicious, the ingredients are good, and the price is definitely worth it. 👏👏👏
sample_reviews_en.author: Hi Biker

sample_reviews_en.text:
Well, we passed this restaurant foe many time for local walked.

Food: Quality of ingredients were good especially the fridge things that we were ordered really nice taste per pictures. The overall food tastes really good and original from local.

Atmosphere: Seem it was local next to pound. Lot of mosquitoes around us during 7PM it was disturbing us a lot as per bitten.

Service: Seem to be nice with family style and not much fancy
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanchai Quinzy Yokto

sample_reviews_en.text:
By far the best night we had in Bangkok in our 10 days here,
We’re two adults and a kid (2.5 years old) everyone was super friendly and the staff provided a top notch service.

It was karaoke night and we had tons of fun :)

It’s a very local place, and definitely worth the visit (Saturday night) just for the the experience and the chats with the locals:)

Food quality was good nothing to complain about:)
sample_reviews_en.author: Emil Behnke

sample_reviews_en.text: On the day I went, there was a singer who also owned a restaurant performing at the event.
sample_reviews_en.author: ไข่นุ้ย ล.หนองหล่ม

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a simple, local restaurant. The taste is acceptable and the price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: วราวุฒิ หนูแก้ว

restaurants.name: Je Kiao Duck Noodle
restaurants.address:

1281 Soi Phet Kasem 4, Wat Tha Phra, Bangkok Yai, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious. I was going to sit and eat at the restaurant, but it turns out there were no tables. And it sells well, too. The blood is good, the duck meat is delicious, and the soup is good, not too sweet. Personally, I like this kind of taste. It's not surprising that there are a lot of people. We stand and eat next to each other. We also order to take home. There are a lot of people.
sample_reviews_en.author: K GK

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was okay, the price was okay, nothing amazing. But what I couldn't accept was the way they cut in line so brazenly. Unacceptable. Go and observe for yourselves.
sample_reviews_en.author: L B

sample_reviews_en.text: Guaranteed! We've been selling this for over forty years. The broth is delicious, rich, and fragrant with stewed spices. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Charoon Jearanairungroj

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and generous portions for the price...but you have to be lucky whether they're selling it today.
sample_reviews_en.author: giftza zagift

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is very delicious. I don't miss coming here every lunchtime when I have a day off from work.
sample_reviews_en.author: Best Natthavee

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely delicious and incredibly good value...the best duck noodle soup in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason 13 Liverpool Fc

restaurants.name: Long Pasta
restaurants.address:

111 ถ. บางบอน 5 Bang Bon Nuea, Bang Bon, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An Italian-style restaurant in the Bang Bon area.
The restaurant is easy to find and beautifully decorated. Their recommended dish is probably the spaghetti, as they make the pasta fresh.
But today I wanted steak,
so I ordered:
🌷Pork Chop Steak served with Gnocchi and sautéed vegetables 250.-
💐Passion oolong fizz 89.-
The steak was large, the gravy was fragrant and creamy, and it came with boiled vegetables. It tasted delicious.
The passion fruit soda drink was refreshing and tasty.
I visited in the afternoon, so there weren't many customers. There's plenty of parking. I forgot to mention that the restaurant accepts credit cards and there's no service charge.
If you're passing through Bang Bon, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: สราวุฒิ จินดาประเสริฐ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Instagram: mikaxtheworld
Fanpage: Mika's Travel Blog

-------------------------------------------
Long Pasta offers more than just pasta; they also have a variety of salads and snacks to choose from.

A must-try: Truffle Ravoli Cream Sauce with Truffle White Sauce

The truffles are filled with shrimp and mushrooms, each one incredibly generous. The sauce is another must-try; the truffle and white sauce are a perfect match, and it's not cloying even when cold!
For pasta, I recommend the Salmon Cream Cheese Pasta.
They give you six slices of salmon, and the sauce even includes salmon roe.
Mika chose wide noodles, which easily absorbed the rich sauce, and she finished them off in no time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mika 邊走邊吃

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great service by very friendly hosts, despite arriving about 20 minutes before kitchen cut-off time (30 minutes before close time).

We ordered 2 of their must try dishes (noted in the menu) and unfortunately it wasn't good enough for both of us liking each other's dish choice. The food wasn't bad, it was good, not great, not exceptional.

There wasn't anything noteworthy from the decor except that you can observe the staff making fresh pastas as the room is windowed (obviously not making pastas at the time we went) and that we were comfortably seated in a banquet seat.
sample_reviews_en.author: DominiQC Asean

sample_reviews_en.text:
Oh my gosh!

So delicious! I recommend the feta noodles. They're so soft and chewy that you'll finish them before the toppings. They're packed with shrimp. I'm not a big fan of the calamari sauce, but the pasta is so good! Definitely worth it! The Caesar salad is delicious and up to par. The fish and chips are also good.

For dessert, the chocolate lava is soooooo delicious! 😭🩷

Go try it! They truly deserve their pasta. The flavors are amazing!

Parking is available right in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rafrenze (ゆう)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good, the atmosphere is nice, the service is good, and there's parking available, but the time management is terrible. Three tables waited almost an hour before their order was taken. I understand that, but they still need to manage their time better. People can wait 7-15 minutes at most, especially considering the price. If this continues, the restaurant is unlikely to survive in the long run.
sample_reviews_en.author: Set Chao

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a wonderful time at this pasta restaurant. The pasta is made fresh in-house, and you can really taste the difference — it’s flavorful, perfectly cooked, and served with well-balanced sauces. The staff were attentive and genuinely caring, making the whole dining experience even more enjoyable. If you’re looking for a place with great food and warm service, this spot is definitely worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Songkran Charukwongsawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. Personally, I think the pasta is better than many restaurants in town, especially the gnocchi, which is amazing. The beef fried rice is also delicious; the beef isn't tough and the rice is fragrant and tasty. All the other dishes I've tried have been good, and the portions are neither too small nor too large.
sample_reviews_en.author: Twk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! I didn't see them making the pasta, so I don't know if they made it in the morning.

The shrimp and chili paste pasta was amazing.
The pizza, which was a recommended item on the menu, was also delicious and you can get a half-and-half option.
The salad was fresh and crispy.

Everything was great. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirasuda Pantachot

restaurants.name: Texans Barn-B-Q
restaurants.address:

144/36 หมู่ 9 Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I want to be clear about something: I did not go to Texans BBQ. Texans BBQ came to me. And that is somehow more impressive.
Because here's the thing about delivery brisket — it should not be this good. The laws of physics and takeout containers basically guarantee that brisket dies somewhere between the kitchen and your door. It dries out, it tightens up, it arrives looking like it's been through something traumatic. That's just the deal. We've all accepted this.
Texans BBQ has not accepted this.
The brisket showed up huge — like whoever portioned this genuinely respects you as a person — and it was still tender. Still juicy. I'm sitting in my apartment in Thailand eating brisket that cooked to actual perfection and somehow survived a delivery driver and a bag and the existential uncertainty of the whole journey and it arrived like it had something to prove.
Best brisket I've had in Thailand. And I didn't even have to put shoes on.
I don't know what they're doing over there but I'm not going to ask questions. Some things you just accept as a gift and move on.
Order it. You're welcome.
sample_reviews_en.author: Edward

sample_reviews_en.text: Excited to go as we were all from Texas. The building is beautiful and felt like a BBQ place. The staff were very helpful, although there was only one other table in there for lunch. I’m sure they would be great even when busy. The menu was just okay. They had pictures of stuff you could not order, which was odd, so you had to mix and match if you wanted to try more than one thing. The sides were small and the meat was unfortunately tough. Especially for the price. I don’t mind paying more for good BBQ, but It needed a few more hours in the pit. The flavor and smell was great, but it didn’t really live up to what a BBQ is. Tender and fall apart. You couldn’t even pull the ribs apart. Now I heard that already from friends so I ordered a pulled pork sandwich and that was tasty. I don’t mind driving out there if the food was good, but I’ll give it another try in 6 months and see if they have improved. If not, it’ll be off the list.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jery Jeritza

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely amazing BBQ!
We ordered takeaway  for our  Daughter Bday  from Texans Barn-B-Q in Pattaya, and it was one of the best BBQ meals we've had in a long time. The pulled pork was incredibly tender, juicy, and packed with smoky flavor. The sausage was perfectly seasoned with a great snap, and the ribs were simply outstanding—fall-off-the-bone tender with a rich, delicious BBQ glaze and the brisket Outstandinng.
Everything arrived hot, fresh, and carefully packed, with generous portions and excellent quality. It's rare to find authentic Texas-style BBQ done this well.
If you're in Pattaya and craving real smoked barbecue, Texans Barn-B-Q is a place you shouldn't miss. Fantastic food, great value, and we'll definitely be coming back for more.
Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Max Massimo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came for the short ribs but found out they are served Friday and Saturday only. The friendly staff recommended calling ahead. So I settled for a slice of delicious brisket! I also ordered 3 sides: green beans (with bacon), potato salad, and coleslaw. The brisket was very tender and tasty. The included BBQ sauce topped it off perfectly. Green beans were also delicious. The potato salad was very basic, but excellently seasoned and perfect in texture. The coleslaw was a bit on the sweet side; I prefer a bit less sugar, but it was still excellent. I cleaned my plates!
The restaurant itself is huge. A real barn! Overall, I very much enjoyed this dinner. This was my first visit, but I will be back. :-)
sample_reviews_en.author: Rudolf Usselmann

sample_reviews_en.text:
A fantastic find in Pattaya! The meat is excellent, perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality. You can tell the team puts a lot of effort into what they do.

The portions of the main dishes are generous, but I would have liked a bit more in the side dishes, which tend to disappear quite quickly when sharing.

Despite this minor point, the experience was very positive. Considering the restaurant has only been open for about five months, it's impressive. This is a place that deserves to be better known, and I would gladly recommend it to fans of American barbecue. We'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jules Garavet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great Texas BBQ in the Pattaya area. They have a massive building that resembles a barn from the outside with pleanty of parking along the train access road.
The aroma as you enter inside and the food were delicious, well cooked and nicely plated for the table. I will definitely be back for more and tell friends to visit!

The service is good but during our visit everyone would disappear from the bar/seating area for periods of time and unfortunately it was when we needed a drink, would like to order additional food or ask for the check. I hope this is a training issue and wont be an issue in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: J G L

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't often review restaurants in Pattaya, since it's not the best place for food. However, our visit to this place was fantastic. Me and my partner both got beef brisket and absolutely loved it. It's been a while since we've had beef, as Thai beef is usually quite poor quality, but man this really hit the spot! We both left feeling completely satisfied and happy. Honestly we both looked at each other on our way home and said 'that was good'. I hope business goes well and you stay open. We'll be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ever Wondered Asia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finding a truly authentic, low-and-slow Texas barbecue joint outside of the Lone Star State is hard enough—finding one in Thailand that pulls off a flawless smoke ring, a pitch-black bark, and melt-in-your-mouth beef ribs feels like striking oil.

If you want a spot that treats the craft like a religion, this hidden gem is as legit as it gets.

The beef ribs to my understanding is only sold on fridays and saturdays.

Go early
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony M

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_th.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Five star dining at ครัวระนอง by J&T restaurant in Bangkok Noi in Bangkok, Thailand 🌃🇹🇭!

Come and experience the bold flavours of Southern Thai Cuisine at Ranong Kitchen. The menu includes classic Southern Thai dishes and also less common dishes from Ranong's ethnic Chinese minority groups.

Recommended dishes: Gaeng Som with prawns and cha-om omelette, Bai Liang Pad Khai, Crispy pork belly stir-fried with shrimp paste.

Parking 🏎️ available in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_th.author: Croque Madame

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible restrooms, difficult parking, long wait times for food, dirty tables, insufficient staff, awful curry paste, ate because I was hungry, dirty and plastic plates and bowls – no investment in quality.
The restroom was disgusting...the bidet spray was broken and unrepaired – no investment in quality.
Unpleasant atmosphere. I ate there because someone took me.
They said a celebrity ate there, so I (they probably) followed suit.
Steamed fish curry.
The braised pork leg was awful, extremely fatty.
Some kind of salad was sour and rancid.
The fish soup was old and smelled terrible, hard like it had been frozen.
The shrimp wasn't fresh, very hard, either grilled or grilled the day before.
They couldn't issue a tax invoice.
80-90% of the photos on the wall have one person in them – people who asked them to take the pictures.
Everyone went home with stomach aches.
Oh...goodbye. The service was terrible.
I'm not trying to discredit them, but this was my experience.
Extremely unimpressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daranmon Jirat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Many of the dishes on the menu were unheard of. They're Southern and Chinese dishes. The menu is quite diverse, and I recommend coming with a large group to try a variety of dishes. The ingredients are carefully selected. For example, I ordered the "Kaeng Ti Med Riang with Coconut Shoots, Pork/Chicken." I ordered the pork version. The curry was well-balanced, not too spicy or strong. The pork was tender and chewy, which went well with the coconut milk curry. The Med Riang (which I'd never tried before) was similar to Stink Beans, but milder. It was a real eye-opener. Another dish was stir-fried morning glory with eggs. The eggs were served in a perfectly cooked wafer (like a Japanese egg on rice). This was also delicious. There are many other dishes I'd like to try. I'll definitely be back.

The atmosphere in the restaurant is lined with quotes from Ajarn Tul, who has interviewed me on various TV shows, to help fans relieve their longing (or maybe even make them miss me more).
sample_reviews_en.author: มังกร เจริญไทย

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious.
The restaurant is small, air-conditioned, with 6-7 tables. The decor is simple and clean, and they play nice jazz music.
The menu features unique Ranong local dishes that you don't often see elsewhere.
-Sour fish curry with acacia leaves and fried egg: The curry was very tasty, but the fish was a bit tough, and the acacia leaves and egg were also a bit hard. It wasn't as spicy as typical Southern Thai curries.
-Spring rolls:
Minced pork mixed with crab meat and pork liver, wrapped in tofu skin and fried. Very delicious. Crispy, not greasy, with a mild filling. The dipping sauce was excellent, like a chili sauce with pineapple.
-Gnetum leaf salad: Gnetum leaves mixed with roasted coconut, tamarind juice, and garlic. Also delicious.
-Fresh shrimp chili paste with lime:
Lime (sour citrus). A unique and delicious dish with just the right amount of spiciness.
There's ample parking in front of the restaurant, although the entrance lane is a bit narrow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnarerk Thongcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was flavorful and delicious, truly authentic Southern Thai cuisine.
1. Southern Thai sour curry with young coconut shoots: The flavor was intense, the broth was tangy, spicy, and salty – a perfect blend of flavors. I loved it.
2. Nam Chub Yam Som Klao (a local noodle dish): Delicious, especially when eaten with the accompanying vegetables.
3. Crispy pork stir-fried with fermented shrimp paste: Good, with the fermented shrimp paste and lemongrass, but personally, I prefer it with regular pork. Next time I'll order it with regular pork, as I think it pairs better with the fermented shrimp paste and other spices.
4. Chicken stir-fried with cashew nuts: The flavor was excellent, well-balanced, and served as a nice contrast to the more intensely flavored dishes.

The restaurant was clean, the atmosphere was nice, and the staff were lovely and friendly.
I've lived in this area for a long time and this was my first time trying it. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: PO

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) was incredibly delicious! 😍😋 I've never had this recipe anywhere before; it was a first in my life. They even added shrimp paste! I really want the recipe to make it myself. The ingredients are simply river prawns, lemongrass, tamarind juice, and high-quality shrimp paste. The flavor was perfectly balanced and delicious. The owner is the chef herself and said it's a unique family recipe not sold anywhere else. Everything on the menu was delicious. I'll definitely come back to try other dishes. The restaurant has only been open in Bangkok for 6 months; the original restaurant has been in Ranong for over 40 years. It's a small shop, only one unit wide, with a few tables. There's some parking available in front of the shop. It's located in Soi Bang Khun Non 4, not too far in but the alley is quite narrow.
P.S. I just found out it's a family-owned restaurant of A. Tul, the chef of "Chef Meow's Kitchen."
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthida T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ranong cuisine, with its distinctive Ranong recipes, is characterized by the unique aroma of Ranong soy sauce and Ranong shrimp paste, one of Thailand's most famous types. The unique fragrance of the ingredients is evident in the dishes. My favorite dishes this time were the braised pork, the stir-fried Gnetum leaves, and the steamed fish curry served on a tray typically used for making Khanom Krok (Thai coconut pudding).

There were also some Southern Thai dishes that are rarely found in Bangkok, which I thought I had to try, such as Khor Sim Bee (a soup similar to fish maw soup, but with wood ear mushrooms instead).

And Yaow Ye (a Southern Thai salad) similar in taste to winged bean salad.

Unfortunately, they were out of shrimp this time. The restaurant said they had to use Kraburi shrimp, which has a delicious texture and flavor, but it hadn't arrived yet.

P.S. The prices were very good and not expensive at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: knin a

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Ranong cuisine prepared by local Ranong people, using ingredients sourced from Ranong.

Southern Thai flavors, especially the soft-shell crab curry – the rich, flavorful Southern Thai curry paste, served with crispy fried soft-shell crab, is delicious.

The steamed fish curry has a smooth, delicate flavor, and the crab claws are unusually large – unlike anything I've ever seen before. With secret recipe dipping sauce

Food is southern local food from Ranong, Thailand , an ingredient also from ranong too.
The taste was amazing like you travel in Ranong! They are very warm service. And location is near the mrt with 5-10 minutes by walk.

Recommend food was Kangsom (a little bit spicy but good for you :)

Ranong is the owner of the Ranong family. Bang Khun Non 5-10 minutes after booking, the next day will be completed again, the next day will be completed!

The price is inexpensive at 39 baht, and the small bowl is just the right size. The noodles are chewy and soft, and the pork is tender and delicious. It also includes Japanese meatballs, bamboo shoots, and seaweed.

sample_reviews_en.text:
-The tonkatsu broth was delicious, not too salty, just right. Recommended.
-The other dish, Tom Yum, was a bit too sweet. But the small size made it fun and enjoyable to eat.
-There's a counter bar where you can sit and watch the chef prepare your food, which is entertaining.
-However, for me, the table was a bit too high, or maybe because I'm short, it made eating a little difficult.

The price is affordable. This is my first, last, and only time I've tried it.
I ordered jasmine tea but got lemon tea. When I claimed it wasn't the jasmine tea I ordered, the staff said they were out of jasmine tea. They didn't tell me when I ordered so I wouldn't have to pay an extra 20 baht. It's still money, but it's such a small amount. The service was also poor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutthida Mano

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is inexpensive, delicious, and looks clean. I had ramen, tonkotsu soup, tom yum, and miso soup, all delicious with rich broth. The rice was also tasty, and the grilled chicken was tender. However, the restaurant is like a booth, so there aren't many seats around the perimeter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Watcharee Jiemsiri

sample_reviews_en.text: The tonkatsu soup is delicious. They have various sizes and prices depending on how much you want, and the prices are affordable for frequent visits. The restaurant is located on the Season side, shared with other nearby shops, so you can enjoy your meal with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hi !

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste was okay, not very rich.
I ordered Miso Ramen, priced at 39 baht.
I added extra noodles, but there were very few noodles. It didn't feel very worth the price.

Personally, I don't think I'll come back again. But if anyone wants to try it, feel free.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the second time I've used their service. The staff went to the restroom, and when they returned, they served other customers first, even though we arrived first. And the way they spoke sounded like they weren't pleased.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes okay and the prices are affordable, but the owner should add more staff. The young woman working alone is very hardworking. The staff at Seacon Bang Khae are overloaded; customers have to wait a long time.

I really love the waffles from this shop. They're crispy, delicious, and the batter is light and fluffy. They taste great with whipped cream.

I usually buy from them often, but today it seemed like the owner (?) was working alone and might not have been very efficient. They also didn't seem very welcoming. But I still love the waffles! I'm a little disappointed. 🥲
sample_reviews_en.author: Chotiros K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today there was a buy one get one free promotion, so I decided to try it.
I saw a lot of good reviews. The price is high, and there's very little chocolate. The waffle seemed like it had been made a while ago; it wasn't hot when reheated, the texture was hard and dry, and it didn't smell like butter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ohayui Cu

sample_reviews_en.text: Finally got to try the waffles that everyone's been raving about, and I wasn't disappointed! The taste, crispness, and lightness of the waffle are just like the ones I had in Brussels. I'm so happy they've opened a branch in Bangkok! I highly recommend it for anyone who loves crispy waffles.
sample_reviews_en.author: LUX LIVING AGENCY LLA

sample_reviews_en.text: WaW Waffles and Waffles is a new waffle shop in CTW. Waffle fans shouldn't miss it! The waffles are fragrant, crispy, and incredibly delicious – not greasy at all, and the batter is amazing. Definitely coming back!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Asthachai Chavengvorakul

sample_reviews_en.text: I was drawn in by a tweet and came to try it. The shop is cute, and the waffle smells amazing! It looked so delicious. And it really was delicious! Not too sweet, crispy but not dry, soft and fluffy. A must-try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kavita Chetanom

sample_reviews_en.text: The Waffle experience was delightful! Crispy on the outside, fluffy on the inside, and topped with a perfect blend of ice-cream and fresh fruit. A delightful treat for waffle enthusiasts!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kluayishappy

sample_reviews_en.text: The waffle batter at this shop is light and crispy, not soggy or runny. It's incredibly delicious! Today I ordered the plain begium waffle, and everyone agreed it was delicious 👍🏼👍🏼 …

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of my favorite restaurants. I always make a point of coming here, but yesterday I was a little disappointed. I ordered a long time ago and was playing games, but I saw people who came in after me getting their food first, which confused me. I wasn't sure if the bill hadn't been issued yet or what. I asked the staff, and they said the bill probably hadn't been ready yet because they were filming the order. I only got two servings of bread and two drinks. I was really looking forward to my order of the custard topped with ice cream!
sample_reviews_en.author: 248 ธนิดา

sample_reviews_en.text:
To reiterate, "There was absolutely no notification about items being sold out."

I'd been wanting to eat at this restaurant for a while but never had the chance. Now that I finally got to, the staff didn't inform me that anything was sold out. Their attitude was unwelcoming. When I checked the menu, I thought only a few items were sold out, but after looking down to the bottom, it turned out a huge amount was sold out! Only drinks were left. The restaurant opens at 5 PM, and everything's already sold out?
sample_reviews_en.author: Super Man

sample_reviews_en.text: It took 10-15 minutes to drive to the shop, and when I arrived, my order wasn't ready. Not only that, they didn't give me all the items I ordered, so I had to call and ask them to come back. When I arrived, a female employee said it wasn't ready and I had to wait. When I asked again, it turned out it was already packed. It was raining, and I had to drive back and forth. Anyone coming to this shop, please check your order carefully before leaving. It was a huge waste of time!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Schwarze Jager

sample_reviews_en.text:
The desserts were delicious and tasted great, but the service experience wasn't very impressive.
During my visit, there were quite a lot of orders, and there seemed to be insufficient staff, resulting in slow service. When I inquired about details, I felt the staff's attitude wasn't very friendly.
I believe that if the shop could manage its manpower and service better, it would greatly improve the overall experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pascal Kwon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today was my first time eating here.
I ordered hot milk and cold pink milk, both were delicious.
However, I ordered the milk toast and it was extremely salty. I'm not sure what kind of butter they used... Is toast normally supposed to be this salty? I've never had toast this salty before. I only ate 2-3 bites. 🥲
The price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sponggy

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is comparable to what you'd find at any other restaurant. The service is passable, but the waiter didn't bring all the food we ordered, even though we only ordered four dishes. The water ran out and they didn't check on it, just left it like that. The music they played was nice. It's been hyped up a bit too much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitawat Yenjai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The cocoa is delicious, the taste is good.
But I'd like to see improvement in the service. The staff member had a very grumpy expression. After we finished scanning the payment, the staff member went outside. So we had a male staff member check the payment slip instead. They weren't very attentive to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nittaya Boonyarit

sample_reviews_en.text: The fresh milk is delicious, perfectly sweet and fragrant. You can order it less sweet if you like. The cocoa is also delicious and rich. The atmosphere is well-ventilated, and the staff are very polite. Same account as before. Oh, and the prices are very reasonable, student-friendly prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: จูถิง กูสวย

restaurants.address:

PJ32+W5Q, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had always seen this place bustling with customers while passing by, and I finally visited today.

We ordered four different types of pho, but overall, all the dishes were "too sweet."

The Kiew Tod was small in portion for the price and lacked crispiness. It also tasted bitter, perhaps due to a problem with the dough.

The Luk Chin Kung Tod was also quite different from what you'd find at famous restaurants.

You have to pay extra for the Horapa leaves and bean sprouts, which are usually provided for free at other places, and the portions are insufficient.

I suppose tastes differ as a foreigner... but as someone with six years of experience eating Kuay Tiew, I was a bit disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: 아임프롬프롬퐁

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service staff were good and enthusiastic. The place looked clean. The taste is a matter of personal preference, leaning towards sweet. The dry yum pork noodles were decent. For 20 baht, two bowls are enough for a woman to feel full.
It is a great restaurant for foreigners who want to try different kinds of Thai noodles (yum noodle, boat noodle, or Yen Ta Four). It comes in a tiny 20 baht bowl. The soup may taste a bit sweet, so I suggest ordering dry yum pork noodles (with or without chili) along with other snacks. You can also change the vegetables from bean sprouts to Thai morning glory, which I did to reduce non-organic vegetables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narin P. Rattanaroj

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's located on the first floor of Lotus, directly connected to BTS On Nut station, towards the back.

They offer four types of boat noodles. You can also choose your noodles. It's 20 baht per bowl, so it seems like everyone eats 2 or 3 bowls.

There was also a set meal, so I chose the beef noodles.

Adding a Coke makes it 39 baht more expensive. The flavor is quite strong! ️Delicious! ️Adding bean sprouts and basil makes it quite refreshing.

The staff service is also good!

However, it's always crowded (-_-;)

The turnover is quick, so you don't have to wait too long. There's a constant stream of takeout and delivery orders too! 😲
sample_reviews_en.author: KYOKO S

sample_reviews_en.text: There's no noodle shop with a Chinese or English name. We stopped here for lunch on our way to Lotus On Nut. The shop is easy to find, the staff are attentive and speak English. We ordered chrysanthemum tea, fried wontons, fried spring rolls, dried beef noodle soup, and beef noodle soup. It was delicious, mildly spicy, and the hot food was all made to order and served piping hot. Before visiting, I was a little worried that the food wouldn't be good because I had Lotus Food Court last year and it was just so-so. But this shop exceeded my expectations and tasted great. I'll definitely visit Lotus again next time I'm in town.
sample_reviews_en.author: wong1 wong1

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is up to standard. The menu includes both noodles and snacks. You can order noodles in small or large portions, whichever you prefer. For snacks, I tried the crispy wontons with bouncy pork filling; they were crispy on the outside and soft and bouncy on the inside, and the dipping sauce was light and complemented them very well. For drinks, the butterfly pea lemonade was on the sweet side, but not overly sweet like some other places. It's a typical Thai fast food option – when you can't think of anything else to eat, just head to a noodle shop! 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: jesda yenjabok

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop serves food quickly and the prices are affordable.

Tom Yum Noodle Soup (Large Bowl) - The taste is okay, 8/10. It's not outstanding in any particular aspect, but it has all the standard Tom Yum noodle soup ingredients.

Spring Rolls - 8/10. Edible, but not particularly flavorful. They are very large and served hot! The only downside is the long wait, 15-20 minutes, before they are served. So, if you're interested in trying this dish, be prepared for a wait and order immediately upon entering the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Earn Nie Gi Zer

sample_reviews_en.text:
The boat noodle soup is rich and delicious. At 20 baht, it's very cheap, especially in a mall like this. Please don't raise the price!

The staff were attentive, even though communication was a bit difficult. It took several tries to communicate (but that's understandable, as they were trying their best. As Thais, we should be kind to them).

Things I'd like to see added:
1) The ability to order noodles via QR code.
2) The chili isn't very spicy. I'd like to see chili oil or black chili available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Win Ra

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, December 25th, I ate only 4 bowls of noodles, but the staff charged me for 8 bowls, over 200 baht. Our table was close to the cashier, so they could clearly see how many bowls we ate. Plus, there was another staff member taking notes, so they should have known. I pointed out the overcharging. If someone didn't know, they'd be easily swayed. It's blatant cheating. Please improve this. The male staff member who handled the bill was the one who did this last time at the Samyan branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arin Panda fat

sample_reviews_en.text: I have visited here a couple of times and always been looked after well upstairs. I just wish one of the ladies would use the fittings upstairs if you know what I mean. I am sure I will return.

sample_reviews_en.text: One of my favorites, good atmosphere and friendly service, everything is just right here.

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean-style pizza is truly delicious! The first time I tried the shrimp topping, and it exceeded my expectations – it tasted just like the pizzas in Korea! The shrimp were huge, and the flavor was slightly spicy, typical of Korean style. Today, I ordered a second time with the Gangnam Bulgogi beef topping and doubled up the shrimp topping. It was just as delicious! The staff were very attentive and explained the menu in detail. I'm so happy there's such a great restaurant in the On Nut area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Onanong Wa

sample_reviews_en.text:
"GOPIZZA - Korean Fast Pizza 🍕 & Chicken"
Gopizza is located in Lotus's Sukhumvit 50, on the second floor near the Food Court. The pizza tastes delicious. The staff is welcoming and provides good service.

This newly opened pizza shop is located near the food court. Since I'd never tried it before, I wasn't sure if it would be good. I tried the smallest size and my familiar Hawaiian flavor. It turned out to be great!
(January 20, 2024)
sample_reviews_en.author: Kij Thangs

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered at 8:34 PM today. The staff were talking amongst themselves and taking orders. When it was time to get the pizza, the female staff member said, "Just a moment." It turned out the customer had already placed an order. I was very confused. If they're not ready to provide good service, why are they working in customer service?
sample_reviews_en.author: Takoyaki girl

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time trying their pizza was a disaster. I'd been meaning to try it for months but never had the chance. Yesterday evening I bought some and tried it. The pizza was okay. Then, around 1 AM, I went to the toilet and almost exploded. In short, my first time trying it gave me diarrhea. That's it, one chance is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pyw ks

sample_reviews_en.text: Not too bad for 350 bhat. Service is fast, with a smile and the dough isn't bad. Real mozzarella is a plus, however the sauce is a little too sweet for me and I'd have thought too sweet for most western palates. Overall, I'd probably go, if in need for the pizza craving.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve S

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean pizza with spicy Buldak chicken topping is great! The french fries are just okay, and the cheese pizza is also just okay. The price is reasonable, and the size is good; one pizza is easily enough for one person. The seating area is in the Lotus food court.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutikarn .p

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing service and food. The order came super fast via grab ordered almost at closing time and they still help me out. The pizza sizes are perfect and the topping is really amazing unique and yummy. Love the sides too especially dumplings and noodle.
sample_reviews_en.author: M M

sample_reviews_en.text: I was traveling and spotted a Go Pizza that I'd seen in Korea, so I was happy to try it. It's just as fast and delicious as it is in Korea. The shrimp pizza, which you can only taste here, is also tasty, and it's much better than other pizza places.
sample_reviews_en.author: 한건희

sample_reviews_en.text:
🎈I was already thrilled to find a restaurant in Bangkok that serves authentic Phuket-style Hokkien fried noodles, but they also have #Oow Tao, which I absolutely loved because I've never been able to find it outside of Phuket. And their version is even drier and tastier than some places in Phuket!
🎈They have tons of other Phuket local dishes, like #PhuketPomeloSalad, a dry-style salad often found at religious ceremonies, with toasted coconut and long beans. Fried noodles and other main dishes are 100+ baht.
🎈They also have #OowEw and #BikoMoi for dessert, in case anyone wants to try them.

📌 #KapPhuket, The Old Siam, 3rd Floor
sample_reviews_en.author: FoodJourney

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Phuket Chinese food, which is very difficult to find in Bangkok, such as rice noodle soup with pork ribs and stewed pork belly, is made with a taste very similar to what you'd find in Phuket. For me, it was a little too salty. The ingredients were good and worth the price. The restaurant is located in The Old Siam, it's spacious and decorated in a Sino-Portuguese style that enhances the experience ✨🍜🥘
My only complaint is that the staff were unfriendly and the order was slow, even though I went before noon, just as the restaurant opened and there weren't many customers 🥲
sample_reviews_en.author: Yam Asamapohn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The wait for food was very long. We ate on a weekday around 1:30 PM.
We ordered 3 dishes…the chili paste set with crispy pork took the longest.😅 The Gnetum leaves were very tough; we could only eat the egg.
The braised pork was the best dish; the pork was tender. You shouldn't come when you're extremely hungry. The prices are also high.

The restaurant is nicely decorated, but it's quite noisy inside. The tables are too close together.
You can park in The Old Mall and get your parking ticket stamped by the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jidapa Samphunjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're in Bangkok and craving Phuket food, you don't need to go all the way to Phuket anymore! Go to The Old Siam Plaza, 3rd floor, and you'll find "Gab Phuket," a restaurant that's been open for many years. I recently had the chance to try it, and the sour fish curry was excellent – ​​the broth wasn't too spicy. The braised pork was also very flavorful and the taste permeated the meat. I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: suchart cc

sample_reviews_en.text: How dare they charge a 10% service charge? There are too few staff, so waiting times for orders are long. Even though there are tissues on every table, there aren't any. The staff can't communicate in a third language with foreigners. Why should we have to pay for this? The service is very mediocre; there's nothing worth paying for.
sample_reviews_en.author: visa siri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Suggestions and Criticisms:

The restaurant charges an 8% service charge + 7% VAT on top of the food price.

This is not mentioned on the menu or anywhere else in the restaurant.

This action is considered disrespectful to both the restaurant and its customers.

We request an explanation from the restaurant.

The food tasted good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manutchai Sisubsatid

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted decent. We ordered three dishes and the total price was a little over a thousand baht.
The prices on the menu do not include 7% VAT and 10% service charge. There were relatively few servers. We ordered refillable drinks,
which cost 79 baht per glass. We had to keep looking for a server to refill them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jane Montita

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love it!

If you love spicy food, you basically gonna enjoy it.

1. Moo Heng - super tender and tasty.
2. Pamelo Salad - not many restaurants served this salad. So, it’s a must try! i love it.

and many more haha. can’t remember the dish name.

Most of the menu is Phuket origin.

I definitely will come back again !

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here for steak many times. The entrance is a bit hidden. They have a huge menu with lots of options. What's great is you can choose between a vegetable salad or boiled vegetables. I personally like ordering the fish steak (didn't take a picture), it's nice and crispy. The picture shows mixed fried vegetables, which I like too. The atmosphere is nice and the air conditioning is comfortably cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: zyjen fjo

sample_reviews_en.text: The pictures in the menu don't match the actual food; the portions are so much, so huge! Just look at the photos. I feel a little sorry for the restaurant being tucked away, but if you're in Wang Lang, look for the sign. It's on the second floor. Good service, good food, the garlic bread is delicious, and the steak is amazing – huge portions, great value for money. Highly recommend! 1000/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Paweennan Kaewpremkusol

sample_reviews_en.text: The location is excellent, opposite Wang Lang Soi 5. It's an air-conditioned restaurant with a bright and comfortable atmosphere, perfect for escaping the heat. The food is clean, prepared quickly even when it's busy. They offer both steaks and Thai-style single-dish rice meals. The food is delicious, priced around 100+ baht, using good quality ingredients, and the portions are generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aeronote8tical SJ

sample_reviews_en.text: The steaks and spaghetti are delicious. The steaks come in large portions with plenty of toppings, and the price is good value. The restaurant is located on the 2nd floor of Wang Lang. It gets crowded during lunchtime, so you might have to wait. They also accept the government's co-payment scheme. If you're passing through Wang Lang, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpichai Ratchadanuwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
とても素晴らしいレストランです。
料理も美味しく、お店の方の雰囲気もとても良いです。
また旅行で近くへ寄ったら食べに行きます。
It's a really wonderful restaurant.
The food was delicious, and the atmosphere and service at the restaurant were excellent.
If I have the chance to visit this area again, I will definitely stop by to eat again.
sample_reviews_en.author: コマシちゃん

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant for office workers, students, and those who are very hungry. It focuses on large portions, decent taste, many options, and mid-range prices in the Wang Lang area. The steak is okay, nothing spectacular. The service is also okay, at an average level.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peach Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: I arrived late, but those who arrived earlier got their food last. The food was terrible. The pork was incredibly tough; it required a lot of effort to tear it apart. It was so chewy I couldn't even bite into it, it stuck to my teeth.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nan Sophia

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is quite affordable, the portions are appropriate for the price, and the food tastes delicious. I often stop by this restaurant when I'm in Wang Lang. They have a fairly wide variety of dishes to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: AOHAORR SKK

sample_reviews_en.text: Having started the dryer in a coin laundy just a couple of steps away, I decided to give this place a try. A wide variety of options in the menu, but most of them not actually available. "Paneer no have, chana no have, have chicken only".  As I'm not too keen on having dead animal remains mixed with my food, I finally settled on an egg curry with Jeera rice. The service was fairly stoic, and the food took about half an hour to be served, although I was the only one having a lunch at the time, apart from a bloke who seemed to be the owner or manager, as he was later summoned to get the change for my payment. The curry was quite basic, but the taste was passable with an adequate level of spicyness. The portion size for the curry was small and did not match with the larger serving of rice.

1. No Bangladeshi staff here, specially the Chef is a Nepali and the waiters too.

2. Thai rice used so there is no base for Bangladeshi food here as its start with Thai rice itself.

3. Khichuri was somehow okay but its not the Bangladeshi bhuna khichuri.

4. Beef curry had Indian or Nepali taste not Bangladeshi at all.

5. Bhortas had Indian taste not Bangladeshi.

Overall its not authentic Bangladeshi food. Yet may be this is the best you can get in Pattaya.

Staff here need to trained the body language and manners of waiters.

sample_reviews_en.text: We went here for lunch and the food was served warm and fresh. We ordered pilau rice, paratha, prawns, chicken, and an omelet. The flavors were good, and the restaurant was clean and tidy. That said, the portions felt a bit small for the price, so overall we didn’t find it to be great value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Imthiyaz I

sample_reviews_en.text: Noorjahan Bengali Restaurant offers truly authentic Bengali flavors. The food was fresh, delicious, and well-presented. Staff behavior was very polite and helpful, and the environment was neat and pleasant. A perfect place for family and friends. Will definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: MD Nurul Islam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent food and genuinely kind and friendly owners. It was great to stay in the hotel upstairs (clean, modern, air conditioned rooms) and come downstairs to have amazing Indian food. They will even bring it to your room. Highly recommended.🙏

-- David from Canada
sample_reviews_en.author: A DM

sample_reviews_en.text: Good cordial service with the flavour of bangladeshi food, really worthwhile to be mentioned.  Location is also good, just beside the Pattaya beach. Those who are from Bangladesh can have the dinner or lunch here. Breakfast is also available here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohammad Saifur Rahman

sample_reviews_en.text: Previously this place was good but recently the sevice has become very disappointing. It seems stuff are not very bothered about keeping the customers happy and the plce is on autopilot. I will try a different place for desi food next time.

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to this restaurant based of the Instagram video. What caught my attention was flavours and huge portion. Taste wise is fine bit portion was just adequate. The staff unfortunately are inexperienced or have lack of awarenesses. The large table was not cleaned when we arrived, maybe a group had just finished but surely it doesn't take long to give a wipe. I orders seems to come out one at a time and we had to wait for our guest to receive the food. There was only chopsticks on the side and didn't have that right cutlery for our ordered food. Experience serves would have noticed this and ensured everything was in place. As food was placed on the table, we had to ask amongst us who ordered what as they didn't remembered who ordered what. I had high hopes for this and was a leaving lunch treat for one of the guest. Instagram really did their work for this.
sample_reviews_en.author: UK MrLeo (UkMrLeo)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai Basil Restaurant is a great place to enjoy authentic Thai cuisine in Pattaya. During our visit, we found the Thai dishes to be absolutely delicious—full of flavor, freshly prepared, and served very quickly. If you're looking to experience authentic Thai food, this restaurant is definitely worth a visit.
We also tried some of the Western options, including steaks, but they weren't as impressive. The preparation took noticeably longer, and the quality didn't quite match the excellent standard of the Thai dishes.
The restaurant has a pleasant atmosphere, friendly staff, and efficient service when ordering from the Thai menu. My recommendation would be to stick with their Thai specialties, as that's clearly where they shine.
Overall, it's a wonderful restaurant for authentic Thai cuisine, and I'd happily return for another delicious Thai meal
sample_reviews_en.author: Saurav Roy

sample_reviews_en.text: Without a doubt the worst Thai Food ever. Not just in Thailand but compared to every other Thai restraunt in the world I've eaten at. I ordered  vegetarian spring rolls and vegetarian pad Thai. The spring rolls tasted like standard stuff you'd buy in the frozen food aisle of your neighbohood grocery store. The noodles of tha pad thai were so overcooked they were a gelatinous clump. The only vegetables to be found were raw bean sprouts. There were little cubes of raw tofu too. With food like that i don't know how the place stays in business.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Cambron

sample_reviews_en.text: Of all the restaurants in Pattaya I've tried, this is by far the cleanest and best. While I've had hygiene issues at many other places, here I was finally able to enjoy a fresh, delicious meal without any worries. The food is prepared with great care, the ingredients are fresh, and you can taste the quality in every bite. In addition, the location is beautiful, and the friendly staff makes you feel completely at ease. Anyone in Pattaya looking for good food in a clean and inviting atmosphere should definitely visit this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: The Real Kamikaze

sample_reviews_en.text: I chose to eat here based on the great Google reviews, and the restaurant itself has a nice, welcoming atmosphere. Unfortunately, the prawn pad Thai was a disappointment—it was soggy, lacked flavor, and only came with four small shrimp. It’s the worst pad Thai I’ve had in Thailand, and honestly, I’ve had better back home in North America. On top of that, they add a 5% service charge that goes to the owner. Overall, not worth the hype.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin C

sample_reviews_en.text: Nicest halal gourmet i’ve visited in pattaya beach. location easy to walking and meet online transportation. price affordable. friendly staff. clean toilets and table. restaurant looks warmth and aesthetic. offer a wide selection of dishes and set menu. food taste is great. and the flavors are well suited to Indonesian and other Asian palates.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yana Bunga Driwinata

sample_reviews_en.text:
This service by name Bow was so nice and helpful. Very respectful. I was just passing but the way she approached me was very nice so I had to come in and she served me so well. I wish all service were like that. I’ll recommend this restaurant and Bow to all my friends. She deserves an appreciation.
Thanks,
George Lapsamba.
sample_reviews_en.author: GEORGE LAPSAMBA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fresh food and very tasty. They catered for a majority vegetarian family.
Super fussy kids wanted simple plain noodles with soya sauce which they delivered on.
Only downside if they are slow on service. Seems like the kitchen can only do 1 dish at a time which means you are waiting a while for each dish
sample_reviews_en.author: Dipesh Karia
