sample_reviews_th.text: Loved this place.  One of a few restaurants on this street not blasting music or full to capacity with tourists. Enjoyed two dinners here.  Food was good - pulled pork was amazing.   Got “real” napkins. Wide beverage and food selection on menu.    Dinner for two was approximately ฿1000.
sample_reviews_th.author: TNT .:.

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the few places in Pattaya serving great steaks, but my absolute favorite dish here is the smoked brisket. I've ordered it three or four times over the past month. The quality of the side dishes is also impressive; I usually get the mashed potatoes and Caesar salad. The staff is friendly and always ready to help. I will definitely be back again and highly recommend checking this place out.
P.S. Finding Cherry Dr. Pepper was a pleasant surprise, as it's extremely hard to find in Pattaya.

One of the few places in Pattaya that serves good steaks, but my favorite dish here is the brisket. I've had it three or four times over the past month. I'm also pleased with the quality of the side dishes. I usually get the mashed potatoes and Caesar salad. The staff is friendly and always ready to help.
I will definitely be back again and definitely recommend this place.

P.S. It was a pleasant surprise to find Cherry Dr. Pepper, as it's a good choice. It's extremely difficult to find in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maksim Kudriavtsev

sample_reviews_en.text: I have eaten here at least a dozen or over the past several years. The food is solid but I had probably the worst experience with a waitress I’ve ever encountered in Pattaya and paid my bill and left without touching my order. The waitresses English was bad, her phone was going off as I was trying to order, which contributed to her not being able to take a correct order. When she brought the wrong order she proceeded to argue with me then made a face, rolled her eyes, took it back to the kitchen, and I could hear her for the next two minutes complaining that it’s not her fault to her supervisor. Get staff who leave their phones off when dealing with customers. I walked out and left after.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brad Fisher [KIS]

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this restaurant twice because it was close to my hotel.

On my first visit, I was craving fish and ordered salmon. Thinking salmon alone might not be enough, I also ordered a chicken Caesar salad, but the chicken on it was enormous, and I gave up.

On my second visit, I was craving fish again and returned. Determined not to make the same mistake this time, I ordered garlic shrimp as a side dish. It was delicious, and I finished it all.

Even though it was only my second visit, there were quite a few of the same customers, which made me think it's a restaurant loved by long-term guests.
sample_reviews_en.author: 和義

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent American breakfast on offer here.   Well prepared to order, quality Canadian bacon, crispy bacon and standard hash browns.  Something that is extra special is the quality brewed coffee and refills.  Rare to see that.  Stand out bread bar selection.  Included raisin bread, dark wheat, rye?, white French.  This combination of choices at this price point is amazing.  The decor is very nice, comfortable padded bench seats, air conditioning.   Incredibly attentive waitress "Mook" .  Polite, professional, happy, standout employee. .  I can highly recommend this restaurant for breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Martel

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service. Staff take forever to take an order because they're figuring out how to use their tablets. I got Biscuits and Gravy. They serve only enough gravy for half the biscuits.  I asked to order more, told them I was happy to pay, but they refused because it's "not in their menu". So I took home the other half.  I'll have to go to Tigglebitties or another American restaurant to buy some gravy so I can finish the biscuits. We had planned to come back to try their dinner, but obviously we will never return here now.
sample_reviews_en.author: chriskennedy100 Kennedy

sample_reviews_en.text: Hi this is a very organised  resturant  super clean many interesting  meals there is a very good entry  point breakfast  for 129 baht I also like the Salmon breakfast it's very nice  For dinner i like the Pork chop its probably  the best pork chop  i seen in Pattaya i prefer it with garden salad but there are other choices also very nice and  welcoming stuff and very interesting  seating  arrangement  if you try it one day you will not be disappointed. Regards Joseph.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Tabone

sample_reviews_en.text: My go to place in Pattaya - staff is attentive, food is always perfect and best iced tea in Pattaya. The one morning one of the staff went to the store and got equal sweetener for me, as they were out.  I would eat breakfast here each morning. St Louis ribs were my favorite. Come and enjoy. You won’t be disappointed. I will miss NoI, Wi and Dai when I go back home
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark M

restaurants.name: Chabi Chabi Ramen House
restaurants.address:

11 225,225/12,226 Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chabi Chabi Ramen House is a must-visit spot in Pattaya for ramen lovers. From the first spoonful, you can tell that real care goes into every bowl.

🍜 Rich and flavorful broth – Deep, well-balanced, and incredibly satisfying, just like authentic Japanese ramen.
🍖 High-quality ingredients – Tender chashu pork, perfectly cooked noodles, and generous toppings that elevate the whole experience.
Cozy and relaxed atmosphere – Comfortable and welcoming, ideal for a casual dinner or a late-night meal.
Great opening hours – Open late, making it perfect after a night out or when cravings hit late in the evening.
Excellent value for money – Fair prices for the quality and portion size.

Overall, Chabi Chabi Ramen House delivers consistently delicious ramen, friendly service, and a great vibe. Highly recommended if you’re in Pattaya and want a comforting, authentic ramen experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr Fazh F

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chinese Translation

I came across this ramen shop with a really nice view of the sea, so I decided to try it. It's located at The Bay Pattaya, which is a very lively area with many restaurants to choose from. The staff here are very helpful. They recommended the dry ramen, so I ordered it. It was really delicious! The noodles were soft but not mushy, the marinated pork was tasty, and the sauce was delicious.

The other dish was pork bone broth ramen. It was tasty, but very salty!! I had to ask the staff to add some clear broth because it was too rich and salty. After they added more broth, it was much better and tasted delicious.

🚗 Parking is available on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Co Cime

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been waiting 30 minutes since ordering, but my order still hasn't arrived. It's a good thing they're doing well.
--
Post-meal update
They seem to get the order wrong a lot, which is why it's taking so long. I got it wrong three times before I finished. They threw away the tsukemen because there were no other orders, but when they accidentally brought a bowl of ramen with lots of toppings to my regular ramen order, they grabbed the toppings with their hands and served them. They left the toppings on the cutting board, so I guess they were going to serve them to the next customer. In Japan, this would probably lead to an argument.
sample_reviews_en.author: ぐっちー

sample_reviews_en.text:
The tonkotsu ramen is delicious! The noodles are just right. It's perfect as a final ramen. Does the soy sauce ramen have sugar in it? It's sweet, so I don't recommend it. If the boiled egg isn't ready, they'll serve it as a boiled egg. The basic is a seasoned egg.
The portion is small, so even the regular size may feel a little small. It's enough to eat as a final ramen after drinking. The char siu is also pretty tasty.
It's a little pricey in terms of value for money. A regular-sized tonkotsu ramen with a boiled egg costs 199B.
sample_reviews_en.author: lostman772er

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by Chabi Chabi Ramen House and got a FULL HOUSE TONKOTSU RAMEN for 259 baht.
I'd been hungry all day and wasn't sure if one serving would be enough, but I ended up completely full and didn't feel hungry for a couple of hours. It was very tasty and filling for the price.
One small caveat: they sell beer in cans, so it's more of a "eat and go" experience. But if you want a quick, tasty meal without breaking the bank, I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vitaly Homich

sample_reviews_en.text: Since you eat outdoors, it can be a bit hot, but it's not a problem if you go in the cool early morning. The Tonkotsu Ramen is a bit more authentically Japanese than other Japanese restaurants in Pattaya. As a result, it is a bit saltier. It tastes good, and the price isn't too high.
sample_reviews_en.author: gaool g

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious. I tried the Full House Pork Tonkotsu.
They cook quickly.
It's relatively large; medium would have been fine. The flavor is unique. It seems tasty, but by the end of the meal, the taste had gotten boring. It's a one-time thing for me. Maybe I should try a different flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Иван Павлов

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved it so much the first time I ate here that I had to come back a second time. Both the tonkatsu and the shoyu ramen are delicious. Next time I'll try the saru ramen. The atmosphere is great, with a sea view. 👍🏻👍🏻💯
sample_reviews_en.author: tchpndy

restaurants.name: ราดหน้ายอดผักศิริราช2523
restaurants.address:

182/6 Arun Amarin Rd, ศิริราช Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork noodle soup, which I ordered with extra shiitake mushrooms, was tastier than some other places. It had a wonderful aroma, and the pork pieces were large, tender, and melted in my mouth. They kindly provided chili fish sauce when I asked for it. The seller was welcoming, polite, and thanked customers for their patronage. Their humility and politeness are truly commendable. I highly recommend their cooking; it's excellent. The restaurant has a modern decor, and the price is reasonable at 55 baht per bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai Jindalucksanalerk

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered seafood noodles in gravy, and the flavor was like a traditional Chinese restaurant. If you like that style, you'll probably like this place. It's hard to find that kind of gravy anymore; most places these days serve the thick, sweet broth version. This is exactly what I was looking for. So I also bought a bag of pork noodles in gravy to take home. If I go to Siriraj Hospital again, I'll try some other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: darunee chitchaimongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered pork with garlic rice. Before ordering, I asked if it was possible to omit the garlic. They said yes, but they still put it in the dish. What's the point? I asked politely, but they were sarcastic when they received the order, and then they still served it with garlic. If you couldn't do it that way, you should have said so from the start, so I wouldn't have ordered it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuwalak Poonsatain

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crispy noodle dish is delicious, and they give you a generous portion of crispy noodles. Besides noodles, they also have rice dishes like stir-fried pork with basil and pork sausage, which are tasty and flavorful, slightly on the salty side.

The food comes out quickly.

Choose a seat, grab the order form, and hand it in – it's convenient for payment when it's time to pay.
sample_reviews_en.author: pairash pleanmalai

sample_reviews_en.text: Randomly passed by this shop and saw the menu with dry fried Kueh Tiaw. Surprisingly the taste of this fried Kueh Tiaw is amazing and awesome. This is totally recommended. Unfortunate we only try one dish. Maybe you can share more for other foods if you stop by here and try. Again it is amazing. Enjoy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Allen Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The first time I ate there, I ordered both to eat in and to take away. The portions were very generous and the food tasted great. I ordered stir-fried chicken but couldn't finish it, so I took another dish home. I asked if they could put …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chino Chino

sample_reviews_en.text: The Rad Na (Thai noodle dish with gravy) was delicious, truly authentic like the old-fashioned version I used to eat as a child. This flavor is hard to find these days; it's not too sweet, well-balanced, the pork is tender and in large …
sample_reviews_en.author: ชนิดาภา วชิระชินกฤต

sample_reviews_en.text: I went into the restaurant because it looked clean, but I won't be going back. I asked if they could make the Pad Thai less sweet, and the answer was, "Only the regular sweet version is available, and everyone's definition of sweet is …
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutida Manaspiti

restaurants.name: be3 Cafe
restaurants.address:

332 Pradit Manutham Rd, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great coffee shop with a chill atmosphere, offering both indoor and outdoor seating. The coffee here is smooth and flavorful; I recommend trying the Caramel Macchiato. They also have a variety of food, including several types of spaghetti, noodles, stir-fried noodles, and Pad Thai. But you absolutely must try their desserts, especially the Panna Cotta and the bouche and crème gornet – they're delicious! It's a perfect spot to relax in the Ramintra-Ekamai area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Davich New Klinadung

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant and bar features a loft-style design with high ceilings and striking, comfortable wooden accents.
It's located within the same area as be bebe, a one-stop shop for mothers and young children.
The space is divided into indoor and outdoor seating areas, perfect for parents to enjoy a family meal with their little ones or for groups of friends to relax and chill.
sample_reviews_en.author: iambebebe 2014

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small restaurant but the food is delicious. It's perfect for a family meal, with a play area for kids and a children's shop. The restaurant might be a little quiet, but I think it would be great if they promoted themselves more to attract more customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fame Wasa

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, the coffee is decent, but the prices are a bit high. The atmosphere is quiet and peaceful. They also sell children's products.
sample_reviews_en.author: net san

sample_reviews_en.text: Does not open on time and has a habit of switching off the Aircon in the afternoons, therefore making the experience in the cafe very unpleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Agnes Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a slight difference in floor level when entering the restaurant. The food is delicious and healthy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirikool Kiatprathum

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice clean environment with good quality food and a but pricy.  Great coffee, tea and desert options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tawich Virangkur

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, and there's enough parking. It closes a little too early though.😅 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratchapol Phaometwaree

restaurants.name: ร้านข้าวต้มอ้วนผอม2 (วงเวียนพระราม5)
restaurants.address:

ข้าวต้มอ้วนผอม 2, วงเวียนพระราม 5, 45/2 Ratchaphruek Rd, Bang Krang, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I accidentally came here to eat, but left feeling impressed. This rice porridge and a la carte restaurant near Rama 5 Roundabout.

The rice porridge is thick and sticky, but the rice grains are still there. It's delicious. I've been looking for this kind of rice porridge in the Ratchapruek area for a while now. The food was impressive. Every dish was delicious. The price and portions were reasonable. From now on, this will be my regular restaurant in my neighborhood. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ace Pisal

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, not too sweet, and the colors are bright and eye-catching. Every dish looks delicious, but the price is based on weight, so please ask before ordering. I ordered fried mackerel with celery, and when I checked the bill, it came to 420 baht per dish. I was shocked. There were 6 dishes in total: 1 pot of rice + 3 cups, 2 small bottles of water, 1 small Coke + ice, totaling 1230 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: ART ART

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered stir-fried grouper fish, shrimp omelet, crispy pork knuckle, and mixed seafood salad. The food was delicious. The dishes were large and the price was reasonable. It's another option near Ratchaphruek Road.
sample_reviews_en.author: KAMON CHANOK

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is a bit salty, but I'd like to see the bathrooms improved. There are two bathrooms, one with a broken doorknob, but the usable one has a leak, and the water heater and toilet won't flush. -,-
sample_reviews_en.author: Theethawat Pattanawatcharakul

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very impressed, especially with the papaya salad. Every dish had a well-balanced flavor. The restaurant is located by the road and has both air-conditioned indoor seating and outdoor seating.
sample_reviews_en.author: leard09.66

sample_reviews_en.text: It seems like a newly opened restaurant that not many people know about. It's easily accessible on the main road with street parking. The food is delicious and the service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: meme Kst

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was very delicious. Everything was delicious and the price was good. The owner provided excellent service. I will definitely go back and eat there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napa Sorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, plentiful, the price seems to have gone up, but it's okay, as long as it's still delicious, I'm willing to pay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Term

restaurants.name: Strack Yum สะแตกยำ สาขาเซนทรัลปิ่นเกล้า
restaurants.address:

7/222, เซ็นทรัลปิ่นเกล้า ชั้นจี Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I want to complain about the two male employees at the front of the restaurant. I ordered fried sun-dried tilapia and waited a very long time. Tables that ordered after me received their fried fish first. When I asked the employees, it turned out they had mistakenly fried snakehead fish instead. I then asked if the price was the same, and they said yes, so I accepted it (the fish was tough and had a lot of bones). In the end, the bill was 24฿ more expensive. The employees offered no apology or took any responsibility. They lacked the ability to handle unexpected situations. The restaurant needs immediate staff improvement; otherwise, it will lose customers. Don't let the employees manage everything themselves! 👎🏻😡
sample_reviews_th.author: Ravena

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Northeastern Thai restaurant in Central Pinklao has everything you'd expect from a Northeastern Thai menu, including papaya salad, various salads, grilled dishes, and even some twists like peanut butter.

I tried three dishes today:
- Luang Prabang Papaya Salad with Fresh Shrimp: Delicious! The flavor was well-balanced, the shrimp were large and fresh, and there was no strong fishy or shrimp paste smell. I loved it.
- Lotus Stem Salad with Pork Sausage and Salted Egg Yolk: A little sour, which those who like sour flavors would enjoy. The pork sausage was nice and substantial.
- Grilled Pork Neck: Delicious!

It paired perfectly with the rice noodles. I liked everything; the flavors were good, and the prices were mid-to-high.
There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, and the food didn't take too long to arrive.
The service was standard.

The restaurant isn't very big, with limited seating, but it wasn't full when I went, so there was no need to wait in line.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichsaran Ves

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves clean, delicious, and reasonably priced Thai salads (Yum), with a wide variety of dishes, including other options besides salads. The presentation and presentation of each dish are beautiful. The order form allows you to choose the spiciness and flavor of the salad, and whether or not to include fermented fish sauce (Pla Ra).

My favorite dishes include:
• Luang Prabang Papaya Salad (with Pla Ra)
• Fried Pork Belly
• Grilled Pork Neck
• Corn Salad
• Sticky Rice

The restaurant is comfortable, not too big, has good service, is cool, serves food quickly, and the prices are good. I will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnatorn Vechaputi

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I went to Central Plaza. They're currently renovating the mall, and I got lost and got tired of walking, so I stopped at this restaurant because I happened to be passing by it. The food tasted pretty good, and the portions were just right. However, I was surprised by the price, especially the 7% VAT added to the prices shown on the menu. Basically, it was like paying 21.4 baht for a bottle of water including VAT. It would be better if they displayed the price including VAT upfront, so customers are aware of the price they're paying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piri PTK

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Thai Northeastern restaurant specializing in salads and papaya salad, with single-dish meals like rice and fried meat.

The prices are reasonable for the portion sizes and taste. There aren't many tables, around 20 seats, so it can get crowded during meal times, and you might have to wait.

The deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce was disappointing because the pork skin wasn't removed before frying. It was hard and chewy, and lacked the fragrant fish sauce aroma. The dipping sauce also had too much roasted rice powder.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuu T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
📍: Strack Yum, Central Pinklao Branch

A delicious Northeastern Thai restaurant 🦞 with a wide variety of dishes to choose from. The ingredients are high-quality and fresh 🍗
I initially thought a somtum (papaya salad) restaurant in a mall would be average, but this one exceeded my expectations. The flavors are rich and delicious 🤤
The somtum is spicy and flavorful, and they also have a variety of delicious yam (spicy salads) 🥗
The restaurant is located on the G floor of Central Pinklao 👍🏻

#1stEyeView
sample_reviews_en.author: Tananun Na sai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes great.
The service staff is good and polite.
The food isn't overly sweet; the salads are delicious.

- Luang Prabang papaya salad is delicious.
- Grilled pork neck salad: large pieces of pork, fragrant and delicious.
- Fried pork ribs with fish sauce: delicious, good portion size, the dipping sauce is tasty and has a nice lime aroma.
sample_reviews_en.author: PO

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! No matter how many times I come here, I'm never disappointed. Whenever I want to eat yam/somtam, this is the first place that comes to mind. The ingredients are good, clean, delicious, the pork is crispy and crunchy, the shrimp are fresh and bouncy, and the yam sauce is so spicy I want to slurp it up.
sample_reviews_en.author: S. Piw

restaurants.name: Hong Bao ICONSIAM
restaurants.address:

5th floor, ICONSIAM Shopping Center, 5 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time eating here. The food was delicious and clean.
The shrimp were large in every dish I ordered.
This branch has a beautiful view and a great atmosphere.

However, the staff cleared the plates very quickly.
I understand that they would clear plates and baskets once the food was finished.
But I was in the middle of chewing, with one bite left on my plate,
and was on my phone discussing work.
A staff member rushed to clear my boyfriend's plate, which he had just finished.
So I had to quickly take another bite, and the staff member asked to clear my plate again.
It felt like they were rushing to clear the plates, making me feel pressured to eat and leave quickly, even though it wasn't crowded.

If I had ordered dessert and the staff asked to clear the plate, it wouldn't be a problem.
But I didn't order dessert, so they should have let me finish my meal first instead of rushing to clear the plate like that.
They could have waited until the customers paid before clearing the plates.
sample_reviews_en.author: p A

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I ate at Hong Bao's ICONSIAM branch.
The dim sum here is large with plump shrimp, living up to Hong Bao's quality standards.

I also ordered Peking duck. The restaurant prepared the duck meat as sweet and sour duck, which was delicious and perfectly balanced the richness. The pineapple in the sweet and sour sauce was incredibly fresh and juicy.

The Char Siu Bao (BBQ Pork Bun) was as delicious as ever. The char siu pork was tender and juicy, and the bolo cookie on top added a crunchy texture, making it even more enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawadee Sanwichai

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm one of those  who after reading the reviews almost don’t want to go to this restaurant.  bad reviews are just their perspectives. I wanted to experience it myself. and Today, I decided to try the food,  it was delicious! amazing DIM SUM and many dishes that taste amazing I'm usually a light eater, but I finished almost every dishes . The service was excellent  staff were lovely. I want everyone who reads the review to experience itself . But again, this is just my perspective. you should try it
sample_reviews_en.author: malai kabklang

sample_reviews_en.text: If you are looking for dim sum, this is the place. The siu mai is giant and loaded with shrimp. But the absolute star of the show was the Peking duck—specifically what they do with the meat after. We chose the sweet and sour preparation for the duck meat, and it was literally the best sweet and sour dish I've ever had. Usually deep fried meat dries out, but this was cooked perfectly. I can't recommend this place enough, just please make sure you try the sweet and sour duck!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Manasathit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This dim sum place was better than I expected to be honest. I don’t usually like chains. But it was very good. We ordered shrimp (ha Gao), Shui Mai, radish cake, friend tarot, cream buns, and more. So so good. The location had a beautiful view of the river too!!

We couldn’t get a reservation, but they told us to walk in. So we got there at 11am right when they opened with plenty of tables to choose from. Go early to pick your own table with the best view!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Solera Cheng

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst restaurant in Bangkok… I've been in Thailand for two weeks and this is the worst restaurant I've been to… I don't usually write these kinds of reviews, but every single dish disappointed me. Half the menu wasn't even available. The value for money is awful; I paid €125 for frozen fried rice, bland dishes, and terrible quality. The service was also appalling. Each person was served with a 15-minute gap between them. In short, run away for your own good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ekaterina Ariel

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited today, January 17th. I’ve tried dim sum at many places before, and this was truly excellent. Great quality, amazing taste, very clean, and the service was outstanding — especially the table service. Highly recommended. Possibly the best dim sum I’ve ever had! I have over 15 million views as of today, and I hope many people see this review.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bo Gramdal

sample_reviews_en.text: Found this place by accident since Nara Thai but was not available due to private function. Surprisingly, the dimsum served here were quite good, surpassing our expectations. The ‘ma lai ko’ was soft and 黑糖 used is of good quality. Rice roll with shrimps goes well with the soya sauce. 虾煎饼 well done. Others are good too! We left with happy tummies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Loh Siew Peng

restaurants.name: Le Bordeaux
restaurants.address:

20 Soi New Day Night Pattaya City, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Very good french food / fair priced and good service"

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent service, very reasonably priced dishes. Two of us had Beef Carpaccio, Foie Gra, Seafood Bisque, Truffle Mushroom soup with real black truffle and not just drizzles of truffle oil, 6 very fresh French Oysters, Salmon Caviar with pate toasts, a whole Lobster Thermador, Australian Ribeye, 2 glasses of house white wine and the bill came to only 3300 Baht. The food reminded me that I was in fine dining in Paris, of course minus the Parsian atmosphere. The chef stayed true to the French food and not adjusting the flavor to locals! Very commendable for staying true to the authentic French cuisine. Definitely will be there again and again for dinner. In the 6 months of  moving to Pattaya, this is so far the best value authentic French dinner we had. A similar dinner in USA or Paris would have cost me my kidney. Went there again yesterday, the food and service was excellent as usual.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stanley Ting

sample_reviews_en.text:
**Note that low season hours are 12p - 3p and 6p - 10p.

We had a great experience last night eating dinner here.  Ray and the team were great hosts and took excellent care of us.  I saw their specials on their Facebook page and we decided to give it a try.  My girlfriend had the Lobster Thermidor and she absolutely loved it!  Two very large lobsters with a salad for 799 baht.  I had a charcuterie plate that included a very nice glass of Cote du Rhône wine for 299 baht.  We were the only customers for the first hour and then a party of 4 came in.  The service was very professional.  You can sit either outside or in the air conditioning room.  The lighting in the restaurant was quite romantic and really set the tone for the evening.  We will definitely be coming back soon.  Be sure to check their Facebook page for their specials!
sample_reviews_en.author: Matt Jones

sample_reviews_en.text:
Exceptional Dining at Le Bordeaux Pattaya
Rating: ★★★★★
If you are looking for an incredible dining experience in Pattaya, Le Bordeaux is an absolute must-visit. From the moment we walked in, it was clear that this place operates at a gold-standard level.
The staff are brilliant—incredibly attentive, welcoming, and professional. They really go above and beyond to make sure your evening is perfect. As for the menu, the food is excellent. We tried several dishes, and every single thing we had was fantastic. The flavors are authentic, the presentation is beautiful, and the quality of the ingredients is top-notch.
Everything about this restaurant is brilliant, from the atmosphere to the service and the world-class cuisine. It’s easily one of the best spots in the city. We will definitely be returning!
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve

sample_reviews_en.text: Decent French style restaurant with mostly classic menu. There are daily specials (announced on a blackboard, which are really very good in terms of value for the money). We were satisfied with our choices, mix of specials and a la carte. Innovative foie gras with pineapple and liver salad as starters were the best, slow cooked lamb shank was soft and really big portion, beef tenderloin decent, but not really cooked as prescribed (nearly well done instead of medium). Desserts (mango and pear tarts) were average, sorbet served as a side, way too sweet. House red wine was rather disappointing for French restaurant, much better ones are served in other steakhouses around Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bartosz Brozek

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited the restaurant on Sunday the table was available ( as we pre booked) one of our guests smoked so outside suited us sll - we were shown a specials menu, the normal menu and the wine menu.
The staff were very attentive to us and also the other patrons inside - the food was amazing and of very good taste - we opted for onion soup starter accompanied with bread, with a good break in between we then ordered our main - the special - lobster - well presented and tasted amazing - finally couldn’t resist the dessert - opted for Eaton mess ( meragine cream and strawberry sauce) - lovely evening lovely staff well worth the money
sample_reviews_en.author: Lavinia Johnson

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was very good. Was the first one in the restaurant.  I had, I know it's odd, first steak tartare of beef, second mussels in cream sauce with chorizo and finally the lamb stew.  I told the waiteres that the tartare was a starter, it came with French fries,  I send the fries back, then the mussels came also with fries,  the same as the starter,  so they where cold. The stew was super. The music on the background where 4 songs who repeatedly pass the evening could be some French music to create a better environment.  The prices were European,  for the Thai people to be expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Druyts

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this wonderful restaurant a couple of nights ago. The food from the 750 bahts menu was for 3 courses plus a glass of wine. The quality and taste of the food oustanding. I've visited this restaurant many times over a twenty year period, but this was the best experience I've had without any doubt.
The service provided by Khun Ray and Khun Thu was welcoming and very friendly and being introduced to the two kitchen staff was a wonderful experience.

I can very highly recommend this restaurant for what was an excellent value for money dinner
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Returning to Le Bordeaux for the third time, we enjoyed a seafood platter—ordered 24 hours in advance—of remarkable freshness (oysters delivered that very day, including Fines de Claires and Gilardeau oysters). The crab, lobster, and whelks were cooked to perfection and accompanied by a well-balanced aioli.

The service is always attentive, discreet, and refined.

Thank you to Thomas and his team.

Le Bordeaux is a must for a truly unique culinary experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: BOUQUET ANNE

restaurants.name: Ar Keng Restaurant
restaurants.address:

297/444-445 ถนนสาธุประดิษฐ์ Sathu Pradit 19 Alley, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steamed grouper with soy sauce was delicious; the soy sauce was flavorful, not too salty or greasy.

The black chicken and fish maw soup had plenty of fish maw, was not fishy, ​​and had a soft, chewy texture. The broth was flavorful and not too salty.

The stuffed tofu with seasoned shrimp was delicious; the filling was crunchy fresh shrimp, and the seasoning was well-balanced.

The Hong Kong-style shrimp dumplings had fresh shrimp.

Many other dishes were also truly delicious, flavorful, not too salty, and not oily or greasy.

All the staff were lovely, constantly checking and refilling our water glasses, and very attentive. The hot jasmine tea was fragrant. 😊

They always give complimentary desserts, including Chinese grass jelly (slightly bitter but soft and chewy) with honey, young coconut sago, and ginger-flavored glutinous rice balls.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kyujin OmYimYak

sample_reviews_en.text:
First of all, the food is the king of Cantonese cuisine in Bangkok. The flavour is authentically local with a strong Wokhei! I highly recommend every dish here, it’s all wonderful and superb. For all Chinese, you would fall in love with this place.

The service is is superb as well. The staff and owner are super friendly and a staff even offered me free dessert. The staff even warned us that we ordered too much, showcasing that they focus on customer satisfaction over profit. The owner (chef) also comes out to welcome us, and he definitely has the best chef skills!

The atmosphere is friendly, like a typical Chinese restaurant with a more premium touch.

Overall, everyone would love this place, both the food and the exceptional customer service!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Henry Qi Sheng Lau

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the portions are large.
Highlight dish - Half Roast Duck (600 THB): Small size. The skin is crispy, truly crispy, somewhere between the crispiness of typical roast duck and Peking duck. The meat is thick, tender yet firm, and easily falls off the bone. The meat might be a little bland, but the sauce is delicious and complements the duck meat well (the crispy skin is probably fried).

Beef Rad Na (380 THB): The menu says pork Rad Na, but you can change it to beef. The noodles used are not as thick as typical noodles, chewy and firm. The sauce is a little dry, but the flavor is just right. The beef is tender, and it contains bean sprouts, shiitake mushrooms, blanched Hong Kong kale, and green onions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasi Noina

sample_reviews_en.text: From the outside, you might feel it is just a regular Chinese restaurant, but you will change your first impression when tasting the food there. We stayed in the private room and the service was excellent. We ordered different kinds of dishes on the menu, and the freshness and balanced texture of every dish informed high-skilled cooking and high-standard cooking ingredients. The steamed shrimp and fish were super tasty. Various dim-sims with porridge were another highlight. If you are a lover of Cantonese cuisine, Ar Keng is a must-visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Winona Wang

sample_reviews_en.text: Several dozens of the authentic Cantonese dishes. Clean, friendly and excellent service. Reasonable price. They have many dishes to fit your budget. Pay cash and get 5% off. I am a Chinese from California, traveled and eaten Chinese foods all over the world. Ar Keng is one of the best restaurants that I experienced. highly recommended. Try it, you will say Thank you me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kim Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my mom's favorite Cantonese restaurant near her house. My absolute favorites are the crispy-skinned roast duck, Hong Kong-style stir-fried beef with soy sauce, and the Chinese herbal braised beef. In short, everything is delicious! I recommend calling to make a reservation before you go, otherwise you might not get a seat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tumnam Nuanual

sample_reviews_en.text: We visited as a family group of about ten and unanimously agreed that the roasted duck and dim sum were the standout dishes—flavorful and satisfying. On the other hand, the Hangzhou fried rice and stir-fried noodles with BBQ pork didn’t quite hit the mark and could use some refinement. Still, the overall experience was enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nance Allie NcNkn Emiri

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions are large and the food is delicious, but the servers are Burmese and the owner is Chinese. There's no VAT (I just found out!). I probably won't eat here again. There's a 5% discount for bank transfers, but no VAT invoice; only cash receipts. Parking is 40 baht per hour for hours over 2 hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch Rapatsorn

restaurants.name: Mae Pranom Original Thai Food
restaurants.address:

138 Dinso Rd, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I’m picky about the food & meat I eat and I’ve never had a bad meal here. That’s why I come to eat here at least once per day while I’m in BKK. Everything is fresh and cooked to perfection. The smoothies and mango sticky rice are top tier. I get the garlic chicken or chicken Pad Krapow + refreshing smoothie (watermelon & pineapple). The atmosphere is authentic and the staff is attentive. Family owned, women-owned, clean & fresh, swift service and high quality food. Make sure to stop by while you’re in town for truly authentic, clean Thai food. You can also sub any item as veg. And they speak English too. No complaints here 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Pheral Adult

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here coz of the reviews which said multiple vegetarian options available, but came and got told only vegetarian option were the spring roll. Not at all divine as mentioned by a reviews here, noting like that very average. My friend ordered the roti and green curry and kept waiting for the order only to get frustrated and ask when it's going to be served - to be told they are closing. Either don't take the order if you are closing or come back to us and communicate that you can't serve. This is basic etiquette regardless of the language barrier which wasn't followed. One star  for this lapse.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keer B

sample_reviews_en.text: This place offers good portion sizes for the cost and the service is great. It can run a little slow when busy but the people who work here are usually in a jovial mood and treat foreigners fairly. An average meal costs 50 to 60 baht and everything tastes good. I recommend highly, the restaurant opposite has very poor service and overcharges foreigners :(
sample_reviews_en.author: Declan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my favorite restaurant in Bangkok. It's inexpensive and everything is delicious! 😋 I went there almost every night during my stay in Bangkok. I wanted to take lots of pictures of the food, but my gluttonous friend ate it all, so I only have one photo.

It seems to be temporarily closed right now, but I wonder when it will reopen?
sample_reviews_en.author: コロッケつくね

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to eat my first green curry in Thailand. I'm so happy, it was seriously delicious! Thank you!! I'll be back to try other dishes on the menu!

The price is incredibly affordable!

For those with a sweet tooth, they also have lots of smoothies that are also very good!!

I recommend this restaurant if you're ever in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mickaël Damour

sample_reviews_en.text: We almost ate every meal here while songkran. Our hotel was just 3 minutes away from it. The restaurant was also at the street so you could watch everyone having fun. The food was very cheap and delicious. The service is really great and the food also arrives really quickly. I definitely recommend it!:)
sample_reviews_en.author: Weronika Rest Casalderrey

sample_reviews_en.text: Unassuming family run restaurant - kinda like 家常菜 vibes. Affordable and yummy. Very vego friendly - red curry paste stir fry, pad kra pow, etc. I also had 2 cut up mangoes (w/o sticky rice) price adjusted to $5. Meets my needs. Love it. Smoothies look delish too. Can't really go wrong.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tai Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: What a wonderful find in this area in Bangkok!!! The selection of food is great and everything is fresh and super tasty. I came here literally for every meal for the last days. The staff is also nice, friendly, and caring ❤️🙏🏽 I can only recommend! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Olessia Ronn

restaurants.name: Goodburgs - Burgers & Fries
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 3 ห้องเลขที่ RQ.7 002 3 Soi Prachan Khadi, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you look at my profile, most of the reviews iv given are negative(not that they werent deserved) BUT this place....O-M-F-G i just had to leave a review here. Absolutely excellent burgers and fries.To start with, i wasnt really hungry when, i ordered but the first bite i took completely unleashed the hunger gates. (Mr Goodburg) Burger seasoned perfectly, the thick sweet pickles meshed perfectly with the bun, bacon and beef in every bite. the only slight issue was that the caramelization wasnt perfectly distributed around the patty. Regardless, still a great burger. Halfway in and i was already sad to see so little left.

Now the Oklahoma fries. Where do i begin...oh my...perfectly crispy fries and onions (mind you my grab rider too about 30+minutes to arrive and they were STILL crispy tho lukewarm) combined with the mincemeat and blue cheese sauce..sigh im hungry again typing this out. Just try it. Dont take my word for it.

Suggestion, a couple packs of hot sauce would have made the fries the perfect side dish. I added some mexican chipotle hot sauce on em and it really pushed it up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jon Snow

sample_reviews_en.text:
10 out of 10, in all departments.

The chicken breast was really good quality
The breast was freshly battered and fried, so when it was served it was super hot
The batter was so tasty and crispy
The chips were fluffy and crunchy and piping hot
The garnish in the burger was balanced perfectly
The bacon was perfectly crispy
The buns were slightly toasted
The lemon ice tea I had had the perfect amount of syrup to make it sweet and sour

Maybe the best chicken burger meal I've ever had?
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan Grehan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I generally dislike pickles but I *might* just revise that opinion after having a Mr. Goodburg burger here!

We also had The 24 Hour BBQ which I'd really recommend for those who prefer a flavour-bomb of a burger — super meaty and loaded with flavour.

From the old reviews it seems like this burger place was previously in another venue — can't fault the new one for location and a really nice chill ambience.

Extra note for vegans: there's the option for Beyond Burger patties.
sample_reviews_en.author: Irene Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is not great, the cost of the food too much, charging for lettuce and basics, we had delivery and the fries were cold, the drinks were warm.

Just another over priced generic burger place, scraping as much from the customers with no consideration of portions or service.

If you want generic burger just go to one of the chains, same meal, half the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjamin Powell

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered from Grab, this is a well seasoned smash burger with cheese. What sets this particular burger apart is the crunchy sliced dill pickles that have a hint of sweetness.  The burger is perfectly seasoned.  Fries were also pretty good for being a delivery.

There are many decent burger shops in Bangkok.  I will definitely keep this one on my go to list.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Bruneel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Due to being allergic I had to eat it without ketchup and cheese. Tho meant I could really taste the meat quality. I wasn’t impressed and the beef is very small and thin so I think the seasoning could be better. Like fry it with some garlic powder, pepper, thyme, rosemary, pepper and salt.

Staff understood English good so that was nice. 😊👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Barner

sample_reviews_en.text: Hands down the best burgers I’ve had—especially in the smashed style. They taste homemade, full of flavour and care. The only thing I’d love to see added is the option to include sliced tomatoes in the classic burger. Otherwise, perfect! 🍔❤️💪
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin James

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm from LA and was homesick. Ordered the chili burger through Grab and was worried about how good it would be. It was one of the best burgers I've had in a long time. Perfectly seasoned and a little spicy. Will be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tray Johnson

restaurants.name: ข้าวมันไก่ไห่หนาน (ศูนย์ประชุมแห่งชาติสิริกิติ์)
restaurants.address:

60 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an ordinary Hainanese chicken rice. But the price is not ordinary. The price is high and the voice is high. Everything is ordinary. I only tried it once because it is expensive or you can call it expensive. Sichuan dumplings, 6 pieces for 100 baht, which is very expensive. They are CP shrimp dumplings with sweet sauce. How much should they sell them for? If I remember correctly, it should be 150 baht or more. Very expensive. As for the Hainanese chicken rice, each plate costs 100 baht, which is also expensive. The shop is small. Plus, they hired Burmese people to communicate. It is hard to understand. You order this and you get that. I give it 3 stars. The taste has no uniqueness. I am not attacking them. It has no uniqueness. It is like an ordinary roadside Hainanese chicken rice. After I finished eating, I just found out that they had chili and garlic. The Burmese staff did not serve me. It was as if I was just eating ordinary dipping sauce. They did not give me any chili and garlic. I was very confused.
sample_reviews_en.author: nerv

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently tried Hainanese chicken rice at "Hainan Chicken Rice Restaurant." They have a wide variety of menu options, including single dishes, sets, and snacks.
The rice is fragrant, with beautiful grains, and not too oily or greasy. The chicken pieces are thick and tender, served with the restaurant's special dipping sauce. Adding chili and ginger enhances the spiciness – it's perfectly delicious. For those who like strong flavors, I recommend the "Saliva-inducing Chicken," boiled chicken in a Chinese-style Sichuan sauce with a perfect balance of sour, sweet, salty, and spicy flavors. The "Braised Chicken with Bitter Melon in Red Sauce" has a mild, comforting soup. The "Braised Pork Belly with Herbs" is also excellent; the pork belly is tender and juicy with a flavorful sauce, served with pickled vegetables to balance the richness. Eating it with hot Hainanese rice is pure bliss! Chicken rice lovers, go try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tweesart Pinnoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located on the LG floor, near the entrance to Hall 6, opposite Fuku. It was quite crowded at lunchtime, so we had to wait, but the wait wasn't long.

This Hainanese chicken rice restaurant's signature dish is Benja chicken, a naturally raised, premium chicken that produces tender, juicy meat.

The menu features boiled, roasted, and fried chicken, as well as other boiled and appetizer dishes. You can order them as a set or as individual dishes.

The food we ordered:
Benja Boiled Chicken, size M, is a single boiled chicken dish. The chicken is generously portioned, with tender pieces and a juicy, delicious sauce.

The Original Roasted Chicken Rice Set is a size S roasted chicken served with rice and one appetizer. We chose the Emperor with Oyster Sauce (you can choose an appetizer). The roasted chicken has thin skin and a fragrant grilled aroma. The chicken is not dry and goes well with the rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: zOm aZy

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a chance to stop by the National Convention Center, and I stumbled upon "Hainanese Chicken Rice."
This chicken rice restaurant offers delicious, perfectly balanced flavors, with tender, firm, and juicy chicken served with a dipping sauce.

Our menu items:
- Boiled Chicken Rice Set (129 baht): Firm boiled chicken
- Fried Chicken Rice Set (129 baht): Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside
- Grilled Chicken Rice Set (129 baht): Delicious flavors

Served with sweet and refreshing Chrysanthemum Tea

And to finish, we had "Sra Loi Kaew" (Sra Loi Kaew) for dessert.

The taste was absolutely delicious! 💯

The restaurant is located on the LG floor of the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center.

If you're looking for premium chicken rice, this is a must-try! 🐔🍚
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploywarin Rinmukda

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by the Queen Sirikit Convention Center for some errands and saw this restaurant with lots of people eating, so I decided to try it. The rice was delicious, fragrant, and not hard at all. The chicken was very tender and soft. The set I ordered had chicken breast, and it was still soft and delicious. The dipping sauce was also delicious, I really liked it. The soup was a little not hot, but everything else was perfectly balanced and delicious. Because I was hungry, I also ordered shrimp cakes and shrimp dumplings to eat as well. They weren't my main dishes, but they were also delicious and the portions were generous, great value for money. In short, "Hainanese Chicken Rice" gets a 10/10 from me! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Panot Panotsaksiri

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I stopped by the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center and browsed through restaurants to find something to eat. I found this chicken rice restaurant. It looked clean and inviting, and it's incredibly popular. I wanted to give it a try. There's no need to call a waiter; you can simply scan and order your food, which is incredibly convenient. We ordered a set meal. The picture looks small, but the actual dish is huge. Even with two of us, we couldn't finish it. The flavors were delicious. The boiled chicken was incredibly tender, and the spicy fried chicken lived up to its name. Everything was delicious. I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: SINE KTT CHANNEL

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there three times while I was at the book fair. The last time I went very early and waited for the shop to open, I ordered grilled chicken and boiled chicken. The grilled chicken was undercooked and the meat was red and translucent. I called the staff and they quickly changed it for me. I'd like them to look at it carefully. Raw chicken is dangerous. The food tastes good. The chicken isn't dry. It's juicy. The grilled chicken is fragrant. It's cut into large pieces. I ordered a set for 139 and was full. The soup is average. The food is served quickly. The chrysanthemum tea is very sweet. The shop is a bit narrow.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Barbatorta

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes really, really good +++
The price is worth it for a restaurant in a mall.
The portions are huge, you'll be stuffed!
The boiled chicken rice is so juicy.
The original fried chicken rice is incredibly delicious.
The grilled chicken rice is very fragrant.
The rice is juicy, fragrant, and slightly oily.
The soup is indescribably good.
The dipping sauce is amazing! I've never had a dipping sauce with this kind of flavor before, haha. It's unique and delicious.
Overall, the price is worth the quantity and the taste is fantastic.

I will definitely go again.

P.S. This is a review from a real customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanks You

restaurants.name: ซุ้มโจร 107 - หมูกระทะบุฟเฟต์
restaurants.address:

Soi Lat Phrao 107, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: It's a reasonably priced pork barbecue at the entrance of Soi Lat Phrao 107, Soi 24. The price is 198฿ net/person. The taste is really good. There's a lot of food. The sauce is delicious. There are no tissues provided. You have to buy them separately. And the stove runs out of heat very quickly. I'm a bit disappointed about this.
sample_reviews_th.author: Thiiskk

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service. Everyone was difficult to communicate with, probably the female owner. We told the restaurant to calculate the bill for 4 people and we wanted to use the split-price scheme (3 machines) because we wanted to pay before eating since it was very late and the split wouldn't work then. However, they calculated the bill for 3 people and charged the fifth person the full price. We didn't think anything of it and scanned the machines as instructed. We clearly stated that the combined bill meant everyone's bill, regardless of how many people were in our group. We don't understand what they were confused about. Then they said paying the full price was the same thing! We were confused!! The restaurant still gets the same profit, but we were supposed to pay half price, but we were charged the full price!! And then the restaurant told us we didn't understand from the moment we chose a table. But the staff told us we could choose a table, so we did! This shows that the restaurant was rude to us from the moment we chose our table. They really need to improve.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปลา ทู

sample_reviews_en.text: This all-you-can-eat BBQ restaurant offers great value for money. It's 159 baht per person + 29 baht for unlimited drinks, totaling 188 baht net. There are two options: a BBQ grill or a hot pot. There's a wide variety of food, including white shrimp, which is quite good value for the price. However, the squid is either sliced ​​squid, frozen squid, or crispy squid. Sliced ​​pork belly is available to order from the counter, but it's not extra charge; they just don't have it readily available for self-service like regular pork. Ice cream is available for dessert. The dipping sauces are delicious and there are many to choose from. The only downside is that they don't provide tissues; you have to buy them separately. The atmosphere is great. The outdoor area is spacious and has nice decorative lights, but if it rains, you'd have to move inside. From what I experienced while getting food, the indoor area was quite hot and stuffy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Junthida Nunta

sample_reviews_en.text:
Basic food for the price..  however arrived at 11pm and no more beef.

They also did not inform us that drinks cost extra. But they did inform us that grill changing costs extra 20B which I am not accustomed to but at least they informed us.

When the bill arrived we were charged for 2 purchases of drinks (party of 2) but only I was having drinks at the restaurant. My friend only wanted bottled water and as I had some on me I offered her my already opener water bottle but they charged her 28B for it.

When requesting to adjust the bill the server refused.

All in all kinda shady. No ethics and human quality to do the right thing.

If anything should have discount on food since I mainly wanted beef and had to settle for pork. Annoyingly, I was told they only has 1 type of pork but later I discovered 2 more types of pork cuts. Again, pretty lousy customer service.

Not very good Thai business.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robin Chung

sample_reviews_en.text: We had to buy extra tissues. The fire went out very quickly. We called the staff three times. They changed the charcoal until we were fed up. We didn't want to eat anymore; we were embarrassed in front of the staff. They told us to eat slowly, even though the charcoal was burning so slowly. It was rude. People came to eat BBQ and had to sit there waiting for the pork to cook. My friend and I just looked at each other. We only ate what we had taken and didn't get up to refill. I guess this is why the restaurant has lasted this long.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปรารถนา ผ่องอําพันธ์

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm so frustrated with the charcoal. The fire is so weak. It's really disappointing to come here hungry. The fire is strong for the first 5 minutes, hissing and burning, but then it goes out again very quickly. Please improve this. It's been like this every time I've eaten here. At first, I thought it was because of the rain today and the humidity, but that doesn't seem right. Because the fire is so weak, it makes me not want to eat anymore. Or is this some kind of secret curse on the charcoal?
sample_reviews_en.author: เมนี่

sample_reviews_en.text: It's terrible. Every time I go, the charcoal is weak. It's strong for the first 10 minutes, then it goes out again. I used to go often, but then I stopped going. This year I tried again, and it was the same. It's probably the restaurant's intention; is the charcoal like this every year? I sat there waiting for the pork to cook, getting so frustrated. I called a staff member to change the charcoal, but it was still the same. The table next to us was complaining just like us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tumtugom naka

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauce was okay, but the charcoal was terrible – very weak and burnt out after just one grilling session. When we asked for a replacement, they told us to wait and then disappeared, completely ignoring the customers. The pork fat was still burnt even after we finished grilling! The restaurant is cramped, and customers have to scramble for drinks and food. Personally, I wouldn't go back. One visit is enough. For this price, there are far, far better restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Social

restaurants.name: ครัวคุณตุ่ม
restaurants.address:

QJ4G+V6P อาคาร การกีฬาแห่งประเทศไทย Soi Ramkhamhaeng 24 Yeak 30, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant inside the Hua Mak Sports Complex (Sports Authority of Thailand) serves fresh, clean, and affordable food daily. It's located opposite the radio station. Parking is available on the street; choose a spot that's mostly empty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuttana Namsaga

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a really delicious boat noodle restaurant. It's located inside the Hua Mak Stadium. Enter through the main stadium gate, follow the road until you reach the clock tower roundabout, then turn left and you'll find the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: หนุ่ม เสียงเหน่อ

sample_reviews_en.text: This affordable rice and curry shop at the Sports Authority of Thailand is a great place to stop by after your run on the synthetic track or your morning workout. They offer almost 20 different dishes, including pork noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nipat Smiththikanon

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're visiting the Sports Authority of Thailand, you must stop by this restaurant for breakfast. They offer a variety of traditional Thai dishes at affordable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: น้ําพริก ปลาทู ธินิศิริ (นพ)

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service, overpriced, grumpy staff, dirty shop, not tasty. It feels like I'm begging for food. I've been eating there for years and it's never improved.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ningnong Nattanan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is pretty good, and the prices are reasonable. The atmosphere is mostly quiet and peaceful.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Wafu

sample_reviews_en.text: The à la carte dishes are decent and inexpensive, but the curry rice dishes aren't appealing.
sample_reviews_en.author: PAISARN NONGSUWAN

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! Every time I come to the Sports Authority of Thailand (SAT), I have to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: karoon kanhleung (Oatbonsai)

restaurants.name: เครปสมหวัง สาขาช่องนนทรี - Crepesomwang Chongnonsi
restaurants.address:

4 Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra Rd, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small crepe shop serves tasty crepes that meet the standard of typical crepes.

They offer a wide variety of fillings, with prices varying depending on the chosen filling.
The menu includes both hot and cold crepes.

They also offer Tokyo-style pancakes, regular pancakes, and other items, making for a diverse menu.

The shop is located on Narathiwat Road, in front of the Siam Nara Foodworks food court.

There is no dedicated parking, and street parking in front of the shop is unlikely given the traffic conditions. You may need to park in a nearby building.
sample_reviews_en.author: YSPK (JA)

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! ❤️ I ordered the strawberry, banana, Hokkaido milk ice cream with a generous amount of caramel sauce. The shop gave a lot of whipped cream, and it wasn't too sweet. They accepted the government's co-payment scheme, which was perfect! ✨️😭🫰💘✨️ I'll have to go back and try everything on the menu. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Natarin 444

sample_reviews_en.text: I've ordered from them through the app before and it was great! They have a wide variety of menu items, and everything is delicious, both the cold and hot crepes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeddy Pattamaporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The filling is incredibly generous, the dough is fragrant, and the filling is very abundant. Delicious!
👍🏻👍🏻 …
sample_reviews_en.author: chanok inkok

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hot crepes with crispy batter and generous fillings.
Cold crepes with soft, melt-in-your-mouth batter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chulavudh Kasetsuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: The crepes are delicious! You can use the government's co-payment scheme too. Highly recommend! 🫶🏻 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Wannarat Wisawasukmongchol

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious, I wasn't disappointed. I'm so glad they opened a branch near my workplace.
sample_reviews_en.author: juthamas keatsaard

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a wide variety of menu items, and many of them look incredibly delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Apiwich Bunprakasit

restaurants.name: Pun le One Shawarma Shop (Halal)
restaurants.address:

Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: In a short three weeks, I bought takeaway or eat-in food from this place 4 times. Most of the time I had Beef shawarma, and less often Chicken shawarma. Except for the last time, everything was good, which is why I went back. 👍 The last time, however, the beef roll was inedibly chewy. At that time, I got the very end of the skewer. That is, I had the last two beef shawarmas that day. Specifically, the meat was so rubbery that it was impossible to chew. It's a shame because it could be a good place. The guys work fast and with good flavors. If you also order a soft drink and drink it on the spot, you get unlimited refills from the soft drink selection. Experience: you have to pay attention to how much meat is left on the skewer. If there is little, it is worth skipping the Beef shawarma.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gábor Tóth

sample_reviews_en.text: This shawarma shop in MBK Center, Bangkok, offers some of the best shawarma in town with halal certification. They serve delicious chicken and beef shawarma with juicy flavors. The shop has a seating area and live cooking, adding to the experience. The staff are friendly, and the service is great. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dewan Asif

sample_reviews_en.text: The kebabs were so delicious! The flavor wasn't as sweet as I expected 😂 The sauce, vegetables, and meat were perfectly balanced, and the portions were huge – much bigger than average. Great value for money; you'll definitely be full! I tried both the chicken and beef versions, and they were all delicious 🌟🫶🏻💖
sample_reviews_en.author: This is an INDEED customer review

sample_reviews_en.text: really disappointing shawarma with axe meat yesterday, the taste was good but the meat was of really poor quality had to chew each bite for 5 minutes really an extremely bad experience, and probably the worst I've had in Thailand in 16 years and not again, even though it was only 169.bath for me it's a no go
sample_reviews_en.author: Mick Sridee

sample_reviews_en.text:
good kebab shop

i tried beef kebab.
it tasted very good and looked very authentic. price was ok.

the place was a bit too small and very dark.
the staff was friendly but not very helpful

overall it was an ok shop to enjoy dinner Just not expected exceptional service and atmosphere

sample_reviews_en.text: I was so tired of the street food and their low standard on hygiene. And I Found this restaurant in the mall and their chicken Shawarma with cheese and garlic, fries and drink for 204 baht, and it was Sooo good! Also they have a great …
sample_reviews_en.author: Dennis Borglund

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located inside MBK center, have few seats inside and few outside with road view.
Halal food, ordered chicken shawarma wrap with fries and soda.
Price is fare, warp sauce was not the best.
Good option if you were inside the center.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raya Al Abri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is very delicious,  specially the rice with chicken or beef.  Mostly everytime i come to MBK, I spot by here to eat ot take away.
The place is small but comfy enough to enjoy your meal and talk. …

sample_reviews_en.author: Rungnapa Ichiroma

sample_reviews_en.text: The food I received contained a foreign object, a steel wool scouring pad, in the dish I ordered: stir-fried kale with salted fish. It's clear there's a hygiene issue.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious and the portion is generous, enough for two meals. Good value for the price.

restaurants.address:

20-4 Soi Phetchaburi 13, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
• An underrated small beef soup stall in the Pratunam area.

• Although the shop is small and looks very simple, the beef quality is surprisingly good. The overall quality and taste are not far from some well-known beef soup restaurants in Bangkok.

• If you enjoy beef soup/noodle , this place is worth trying when you pass by this area. The price is on the higher side for a street stall, around 100 THB per bowl, but acceptable considering the quality.

• There is no parking available, and it is about a 10-minute walk from the BTS station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpit Pinsai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Decent bowl of beef noodles soup located at the side building of metro resort.
Clear beef broth, mixture of different beef parts, from slice beef, stomach, beef balls, tendons.
The beef was handled well, No strong beefy taste. Love the beef balls, really meaty and springy.
If you like beef noodles, this is worth your calories 😉

If only I can speak Thai, would love to order another bowl with extra fresh beef slice & stomach 🤭
sample_reviews_en.author: Wellness Coach Ivy Hwi

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s so good it would cure a cold you didn't even have!!! It’s a totally local noodle shop, but the broth is so rich and delicious ㅠㅠ Sprinkling some chili powder on it instantly soothes my stomach haha. There isn't much noodle, but

there’s a lot of meat lol. It would be amazing even with rice!! Perfect for Korean palates!!! I highly recommend it to anyone in the area!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: choriable

sample_reviews_en.text: My Bangkok ritual for 15 years. Metro Beef Noodle at Phetchaburi Soi 13 serves super-good beef with genuinely authentic flavor; I make a point of coming almost every trip. Parking is a pain now because of MRT work around Pratunam — you'll need to tuck into Soi 15 or use a nearby mall car park—but it's worth the scramble. I keep coming back and will keep doing it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Barry See

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall excellent tastes and flavour. It’s a street side stall so it is what it is for atmosphere. Located along the corridor of a building, there are ceiling fans along the way keeping the area well ventilated and cool. Portion sizes are small, order 2 if you’re really hungry. They also offer a rice and soup combo if you don’t feel like noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Koreans, this is the place: Bangkok Noodle House.

First off, the broth is insane. Just add exactly one spoonful each of lime and chili powder. It will drain your body of all the flavor. However, those with big appetites might find the portions small. Just order two bowls. You won't regret it at all, even if you eat two. It is the best.
sample_reviews_en.author: EUNHEE LEE

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner's attitude was terrible, and the food was average. I ordered a bowl of beef tendon and fish balls, and two of the three fish balls seemed sour. Perhaps the food was spoiled by the heat. I explained this to the owner through a Thai translator, but she completely ignored me. She even charged 100 paise for a bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: terence chong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located in an obscured corner.

Offering various cuts of beef and choice of noodle.

Kway teow was of average quality.

Soup base was clean and flavorsome and the beef was tender. It is unlikely most which packed a punch, this stall offers a light to medium bodied style.

Good but not outstanding.
sample_reviews_en.author: MNG

Healthy food superfood for a good health.
Acai fruit topping.

sample_reviews_en.text: My favorite Acai shop! I never get tired of coming back! 🍌🫐 The fruit is fresh and clean, the acai base has a perfectly smooth texture, not overly sweet, and very refreshing. The staff are lovely and provide excellent service. I'm very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Charinrat.N

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and refreshing. The acai is rich and flavorful, with lots of fruit. I loved it and will definitely go again! The shop is very easy to find; it's less than ten steps from Tops.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nann pat

sample_reviews_en.text: The main menu item is acai bowls, where you can choose your toppings as you like, perfect for health-conscious individuals. The staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saowaluk

sample_reviews_en.text: The acai is delicious! So refreshing, and the ingredients are top-notch. They often have promotions, so I'll definitely be back.😋🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: pichaprak apisekmongkhol

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff member was very helpful and gave great product recommendations. The acai skewers looked delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yusnee Kama

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, good prices, clean restaurant, convenient location in a mall, and lots of discounts. Great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Park Wink

sample_reviews_en.text: The vendor was lovely and gave good recommendations. I'd never tried it before, so I had to give it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suparwadee P

restaurants.address:

53 Ratchaphruek Rd, Khwaeng Taling Chan, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Came on Monday, items weren't fully stocked, the food was okay but not very fresh, the fish wasn't sliced ​​well, and the foie gras was as thin as pork liver. It seemed like good value but wasn't. Spent 5,000 baht and got some complimentary items, but the complimentary items were tastier than the main courses. Try it yourself, my taste buds might not be sophisticated enough. There was live music, but it would have been better without it; too loud and the music wasn't engaging. Overall, it wasn't worth the money spent. A little disappointed. The fried fish was too soft and mushy.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนะเมศฐ์ ตันติฤทธิ์ดำรงค์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was not worth the price at all. The taste was not very good, and the miso soup was even a little fishy. For two people, it cost 2,700 baht, which is ridiculously expensive, even with the buy-one-get-one-free menu and 30%-50% off menus. I woke up with a very dry throat, as if the restaurant had used a lot of MSG.
The good thing is that there was live music and a magician performing, which was really fun.
If the restaurant reads this review, please help improve.
I only took one photo, which is of the beef. The meat used was really poor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Big Phuritat

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is ok but still very over price. Seem to be the the premium Japanese restaurant but not reach that standard yet e.g. no free small snack while waiting meal, no complementary fruit served after meal...etc.  The decor is simple like normal new opened restaurant.  Not impressed at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nkr bear

sample_reviews_en.text: Extraordinarily fresh food unlike those chain japanese restaurants. They have happy hours and good promotions. Great service but a bit pricey and small parking lots.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thadchawadee W

sample_reviews_en.text: The first time I ate here, it was great. But this time, the quality has dropped. The delivery was packaged very haphazardly; it's not the same as before. T T
sample_reviews_en.author: Tim Red Line

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is fresh and delicious. The restaurant's layout seems geared towards groups who come to drink, chat, socialize, and watch sports.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongsatorn Netrakom

sample_reviews_en.text: Good taste, quality ingredients, different menu, signature dishes. If you're tired of other places, you must come to this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahe.Akara Siranarakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is fresh, delicious, and clean, although the prices are a bit high. There is ample parking available.
