sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small, charming cafe. It was early evening when I visited, and there weren't too many people, giving it a relaxed feel. The staff were lovely and provided excellent service. The food was delicious. It would be even better if they added a soup option with bread to the menu. They also offer free books to read, many of which looked interesting. I plan to return to the cafe to enjoy a coffee and read the books they provide.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thunya Y.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, the ingredients were top-notch, and it was great value for money.

The first dish was striploin steak served on fragrant garlic fried rice, accompanied by sautéed button mushrooms and onions. It was a perfect combination.

Another dish was cappellini pasta stir-fried with olive oil, garlic, and dried chilies. The aroma was amazing, and it was topped with crispy bacon. I loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: MUIMUI

sample_reviews_en.text: The pasta was delicious, the portion size was just right, and they used high-quality ingredients. You can dine in at Cafe Golden. The owner is polite and friendly, and always answers customer calls quickly. The atmosphere is nice and comfortable, with the air conditioning just right – not too hot and not too cold. I recommend everyone try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Beau Cws

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The truffle spaghetti with beef was a little too salty, but the pasta was fresh and well-made. The ingredients were high-quality and the flavors were authentic. The sous-vide chicken breast was crispy on the outside …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ketchup

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is delicious. There are many kinds of beef fried rice, pasta, and spaghetti. At the moment, you can only order delivery. The chefs said they are waiting to open the store in the middle of this year.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanit Sukjitnitayakarn

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried the coffee, bakery items, and the garlic picanha fried rice, and loved them. The grilled meat was excellent, and the dipping sauce had a very complex flavor – delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Krittapas Poonkasem

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! The flavor was well-balanced and the ingredients were high quality.
The portion was quite generous.

Thank you for the delicious meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Charoentham Borisut

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the restaurant is chill with cool air conditioning and a great atmosphere. The owner is also lovely and friendly to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saksin Viriyaprasit

restaurants.name: Bonchon Siam Center
restaurants.address:

979 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nov 15, 2025, Entered at 2:00 PM, Exited at 3:40 PM (Thailand Time)

Bonchon Siam Center Review

The two female staff members were incredibly slow.

There were tables inside that hadn't been cleared yet, but the male staff member just stood there as shown in the photo (no guidance provided).

Four of us ordered the same type of food, and it took over an hour for it to come out.

(I wasn't asking for it to be served quickly; I've been in Thailand for 5 days, and even though it wasn't peak time, this was the slowest I've ever experienced. There was no feedback, and they avoided talking to me.)

I endured it for a while, but when I mentioned it on my way out, they said they would give me a discount, which made me feel bad.

Clearing tables after customers leave takes forever, and even simple dishes take at least an hour to come out.

Seriously, if you are busy and feel like every minute and second counts while traveling, please, please do not go here.

My entire schedule for the rest of the trip got messed up here.

I am Korean, but I gave them a piece of my mind on my way out.
sample_reviews_en.author: 양동파워

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat at Bonchon, and today I came because I saw a buy-one-get-one-free promotion that was only for two days. When I sat down, the staff said the promotion wasn't ready because the free chicken portion was sold out. They should have informed me while I was waiting outside, as I had already waited 30 minutes+ for the promotion. Okay, the promotion issue is one thing – the staff not informing me, but it's also my fault for not asking. However, I ordered the hot pot and chicken and waited a very long time, about 40 minutes. I saw the table next to me looking unhappy; I overheard them waiting an hour for their fries and then canceling their order. I don't want to blame the staff; they did their best. It's also partly the restaurant's fault for having too few staff. But the staff didn't show any negative attitude, so I'm not too bothered. It seems to be a matter of management varying between branches. Honestly, this was the worst Bonchon experience I've had. End of review.
sample_reviews_en.author: chanoknet

sample_reviews_en.text:
The female staff member had a very grumpy face.
The service was reluctant, and the 10% service charge was a waste of money.

When I asked for a separate bowl for the soup, she used her phone and hooked her thumb inside the bowl (I wonder if she was trained for that).

They didn't inform me about the long wait time, and the food wasn't hot when it arrived. It's confusing; I waited a long time, but the food wasn't hot.

After I finished eating, I saw a male staff member taking orders from the table next to me. He was polite, informed the customer about the estimated wait time, and seemed genuinely willing to serve. He deserved the service charge.
Overall, it's no surprise that the number of customers is decreasing.
-----------
For those who can't read THAI:
The food is great, same as other branches.
But the service is poor, not worth the 10% service charge.
While serving the dish, she lacked hygiene.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tidadoi .S

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went at around 3pm for late lunch. There were only another couple in the restaurant. We ordered the fried chicken wings and they were served quite quickly.

However, for our beef bulgogi and pork bulgogi, the kitchen took a long time to prepare. Worst part of it, the stone bowl was cold and the rice was not even hot. We had to request for the waitress to take back our rice bowls and exchanged for piping hot ones.

When she returned, there was no word of apology. She just placed the hot rice bowls on our table and left. My friend’s beef bulgogi was ok but my pork bulgogi was not cooked properly - the rice was mushy and the pork slices were undercooked.

Terrible food and service. Expensive and not worth it. Won’t visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: laybit

sample_reviews_en.text: Upon entering the restaurant, there was no staff member to introduce or greet us. It's a large restaurant, but there aren't enough staff to adequately serve the customers. The food was slow to arrive and very cold. Table clearing was also slow. We ordered refillable drinks and called for a staff member several times, each time saying "just a moment." Ten minutes passed, and it still hadn't arrived, so we had to call again. The staff member gave the excuse that it was slow because there were so many people and they forgot. But is it acceptable to forget? We came here to eat, too! That's an excuse that shouldn't have come from a staff member's mouth.
sample_reviews_en.author: 29. Auto Kulthawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was slow to come out, which is understandable because the staff informed me. However, the order was incomplete and I had to follow up several times. One time I followed up, the staff disappeared. Another time, they ignored me. Luckily, on my third follow-up, a male staff member sorted out all the items. If I hadn't followed up, I probably wouldn't have gotten everything. For example, I ordered two servings of rice but only received one. I also ordered a set meal, but didn't receive the sauce I requested. I was quite unimpressed compared to other branches I've been to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornsawan Sutthinon

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate here on February 27th, 2025. I waited an hour for my food. I ordered refillable drinks but the staff never refilled them. Not only did I wait a long time for the food, but they didn't bring plates or glasses when more customers sat down. I had to ask for them. The fried chicken arrived cold. It was a terrible experience. The management system is poor, and the staff couldn't provide information about promotions. It's better to eat at another branch. I've been a Bonchon fan for many years, but this branch was the most disappointing I've ever experienced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyanat Yuangthong

sample_reviews_en.text: A waitress brought us the wrong food, and we told her we didn't order it. She then made a face at us. We tried to be okay with that, but then our water glass was empty. Since we ordered a refill, the staff should have refilled it constantly, but this time it was completely empty. We had to ask for a refill, and a staff member came and poured it until it almost overflowed. I'm not sure if that was intentional, but I hope they improve on that. We were paying customers, not getting free food. It was quite upsetting. The service at CentralWorld is much better.
sample_reviews_en.author: จุทามณี แก้วผลึก

restaurants.name: Mekiki no Ginji
restaurants.address:

95 Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The woman staff namely เอ๋‘ is very rude.
She looks down on the customer when  i just asked that the  dish will be served with rice or not. …
sample_reviews_th.author: Pitnaree Wonglertsiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
🏝️ No need to fly to Okinawa to experience authentic Japanese culture!
Mekiki no Ginji brings the complete Okinawa experience to the heart of Sukhumvit 26.

Every dish is a relaxing treat after a long day.
🥃 Refreshing and fizzy Highball.
🦐 Seafood baked in uni sauce, a delicate and fragrant Okinawan style dish. A must-order every time!
🍣 Fresh and abundant Hamachi and Ikura (seasonal). Regular sashimi is also available. Beautiful and tempting.
🥗 Free unlimited refills of the salad bar.
🍰 Burnt-top cheesecake, the perfect way to end the meal (limited). Try other desserts too!

The atmosphere is like sitting in a local izakaya.

It's very chill to dine alone, sitting at the counter and watching the chef prepare the food.
It's equally great for gathering with friends, but you'll need to make a reservation or book in advance to avoid disappointment. Delivery is also available. But you won't get the atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sugarcanebkk

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times because I like that the restaurant isn't crowded or noisy. I usually come with friends when we're at K-Village, but today I came alone. The staff are always lovely and provide excellent service.

I ordered the grilled mackerel set. It came as a whole, a small fish. I chose the grilled version with sauce. It tasted delicious and wasn't fishy. The price was 199 + 100 (set includes rice, steamed egg custard, miso soup, and refillable green tea). I'm a little disappointed that the rice isn't the chewy Japanese rice; it would have been even better with the grilled fish. But what I really love about this place is the free salad bar. It's great because I love vegetables, seaweed, corn, and they even have boiled okra, which you don't often find in Japanese restaurants. The salad was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rinlada Panpoonsub

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place has got a nice, warm atmosphere and if you want to dine a little more privately they've got special table for you and your date.

The food is so good, undeniably fresh. Their specialty 'uni sauce' its a must try. Although the Taco Rice is a bit too heavy on ground cumin, everything else was perfect.

They also got a "happy hour" discounted drinks for your table starting right after your first alcoholic beverage order. The happy hour drinks can still be ordered, at full price, after the hour has ended.

The service is very good. Waitresses are polite, caring, and answer questions with clear explanations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakdichote Totiam

sample_reviews_en.text: Japanese Izakaya-style restaurant located on the first floor of K-village.  Food is in small portion appetizer size.  Fresh and authentic Japanese tastes.  Most seatings are well compartmentalized, so privacy is ensured.  Clean and comfortable atmosphere.  Self-service free salad bar, despite very limited variety.  Polite and attentive service.  Keep in mind, though, that menu prices may seem low but they come in small portions.  In addition, menu prices are before 10% service charge and 7% VAT on top of it.  Overall a little pricey, but well worth the money if you can afford it.
sample_reviews_en.author: mars universe

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is nice, staff is great, ...only thing we (perhaps too out-of-luck) found sub par is the rice!

The place decorations and interia are intersting. You can sit at the cooking bar, inside a huge replicated wooden bukets or private rooms.

Staff is very attentive and helpful.

The food overall is good. Drinks are many to choose from. We tried hot-plate beef tenderloin... love it! Sashimi is fresh and high quality... but... a big BUT one crucial thing we found is the sushi rice is ...ummm... not good. Too soft and wet, we are not sure, perhaps it was our bad day :-(
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronrapee Leelawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is OKINAWA style and very authentic. This Japanese Restaurant is located within an open shopping complex named K-Village.
Indoor and outside seating, nice setting, the interior has numerous lanterns, Japanese signs, split into little private rooms.
Staff are well trained and the service is as efficient as you get in Japan.
The food is delightful, fresh with a variety not found in other Japanese restaurant in Bangkok.
GRILLED OYSTER with UNI SAUCE is absolutely fantastic.
Better to make reservation; it’s very often full at  noon!
For Japanese food lovers only!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pascal Pecheur

sample_reviews_en.text:
Oysters were small and bland with no natural sweetness. Salmon toro was subpar and tuna was a little smelly. I got diarrhea following morning, can’t say for certain that it’s from the seafood, but my other meals that day were cooked well at home.
Tamagoyaki was not what I expected. The center was more soft and jiggly like pudding rather than usual firm layered texture. I’d prefer the usual style though. That orange sauce on top of tamagoyaki was uni sauce but I didn’t smell much uni from it.
Staff are nice. Nice decoration. Not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Penne

restaurants.name: Mum
restaurants.address:

420/192, 15 Soi Buakhao, Pattaya City, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mum is nice little break from the normal Pattaya buzz. It has a cozy vibe and warm atmosphere which is clearly sprung out of the neat interiors. The inside area is air-conditioned which might be good to mention. The mix of colorful sofas, marble tables, wood and plants makes it kind of interesting and trendy at the same time. It has an outdoor terrass as well for the people who prefer the warm air.

The menu is not the biggest but it's absolutely well thought through with a focus on more western style dishes. It kind of feels more to the healthy side of dining. On the drink side of things Mum is offering fresh and cold pressed juices, fruit smoothies and all the common coffee and tea drinks.

In terms of sweets, Mum is offering the basic stuff like peanut/chocolate chip cookies, brownies, waffles and a granola bar. All home baked of course.

It's located in the heart of the city, almost right in the corner of Soi 15 and Soi Buakhao.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dave Legendary [Notforsale]

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing portion size & cash-only surprise

Review:
The beef sandwich portion was surprisingly small — just two bite-sized pieces, more like canapés than a proper meal. When I asked to pay, I was told they only accept cash. It would’ve been helpful to mention this upfront, especially for tourists. In a refined place like this, not accepting credit cards is quite unexpected.

On a positive note, the service was polite and the atmosphere, location, and design of the place are very well done.

Reply to the restaurant: I wish your cashier had told me there was a QR payment option too—she only said “cash.”

Your baguette sandwich looks like a standard baguette cut in half, then each half split into two equal parts. So in total, it’s about half the length of a regular baguette.

Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cantekin Güngör

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are above average. The salmon teriyaki poke was delicious, the cocoa was unsweetened. They even served a glass of water with my drink, and that's when my adventure began. I ate first, drank the cocoa, and then took a sip of water. It was terrible. I think they got it from the swamp behind my house. The terrible taste of stagnant water (probably) made me want to go back down. As a result, after a while at home, I developed severe intestinal colic, and I spent the entire evening suffering from pain and weakness, sitting on my white friend. Is it related? Who knows, but I suspect. How can they not keep an eye on ordinary drinking water with such prices and such a self-promotion?
sample_reviews_en.author: Olga Neko

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good vibe, good food, good service. I really liked it here. Not only because it was literally across the street to our hotel.
We spent quite some time in Mum Cafe, as you can see in my pictures.
We tried a variety of dishes, including two bowls, two sandwiches, pancakes and poached eggs. I asked for a recommendation, they told me the club sandwich. And it was really good. Being used to good bread, as a German, i think i can tell good from bad. This was awesome.
All the Coffee varieties we tried were perfect, as well as the juices. I liked the beetroot one.
It's a bit pricy for Thailand, i guess they take what they can get.
But the quality is just on point.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maximilian Degen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pancakes were HORRIBLE. Dense and nasty. Thinking of them now makes my stomach churn. I've never been anywhere to mess up simple pancakes, but they did. Puke. I was expecting just decent pancakes because they were priced at 250 Baht! Couldn't finish one. They forgot the blueberries (and when I asked about them they gave me three separate blueberries in a bowl. Lol) and they forgot the syrup.

I will say, the Coffee here was terrific, but goodness gracious, the pancakes were disgusting. Not sure if they forgot an ingredient or what. If I could post a video here I would, couldn't even cut with my fork. Very disappointing. Will not be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Valerie Cunningham

sample_reviews_en.text: We've been here twice. The first time, we had poke bowls for breakfast (not exactly what we're used to, but okay), and the toast with eggs and fish was delicious. But when we came for lunch, we liked it less: the fit burger was covered in so much mustard that it was practically impossible to discern the flavor of anything else in the dish. They even forgot to bring another dish and add it to the bill. It's worth a visit, though, probably more like a cafe—breakfast and drinks, not a proper lunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Лиса Курочкина

sample_reviews_en.text:
Well, it's been a perfect Friday morning and a good vibe for the whole day, thanks to this place
We had spinach chicken panini and the club sandwich
Portions are great
Food is simple and exquisite at the same time
Nice cozy coffee shop
And if they add some decent cold cuts to the menu, it will be just brilliant
Staff is very professional and well trained
It's nice to visit a place with a wonderful barista and an attentive watress sometimes
There should be more places like this one in this town
sample_reviews_en.author: Kirill Fomin

sample_reviews_en.text:
A really great place :) The menu is small but the food delicious and so was my long black (Americano).
I ordered the breakfast skillet without tomato. It was sensational - so tasty and delicious! Sorry the only photo of it is the empty skillet. I devoured it before realising I should have photographed it haha.
One star off for atmosphere as the music was a little too loud to chill and read to. It may have just been the playlist as this was better later. Will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Craigy_boy

restaurants.name: Pranakorn Boat Noodle
restaurants.address:

944/1 BIU003 ชั้น B Rama IV Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I went to eat there today. The staff said the large bowl was 99฿, but the quantity wasn't worth the price. I ate one bowl. I initially ordered a small bowl from the staff...
sample_reviews_th.author: Supanan Setanoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Title/Subject: Viral Intestinal Infection

I eat at this restaurant quite often, but I frequently notice uncleanliness in the food and the premises. I try to avoid it, but one day I finished work late and decided to eat here. The result was that the next day I had a high fever of 39 degrees Celsius, which lasted for several days. The doctor diagnosed me with an acute intestinal infection. After reading the reviews, I'm not surprised that people are gradually stopping coming back. The average review score is only 3 stars.

I urge the restaurant to consider improving this. Based on the reviews, the restaurant doesn't seem to be taking action on this issue. Please don't make more people sick.

English summary: Had dinner and suspected that the cause of my viral intestinal infection is from the meal served here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anonymous Poster

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been a customer since COVID, but lately the restaurant's standards seem to have dropped significantly. The taste has changed a lot; this branch is currently very bland. Moreover, in this month alone, I've eaten here three times and they've gotten my order wrong twice. I'm not sure if the staff are foreigners and don't understand, or if they're just lazy, but they're making mistakes that shouldn't happen. It's very frustrating. And every time they make a mistake, when I ask them to change the order, they ignore me. If they don't want to serve customers that much, they should find another job. (Most of the female staff provide terrible service; the male staff seem more eager to work.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Panphimon J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has increased its price to 99 baht per bowl specifically for the Songkran period. This is twice the normal price, even though the portion size remains exactly the same. It feels like they are taking advantage of the festival to overcharge customers. Please consider this carefully before deciding to eat here!

The restaurant has adjusted its price to 99 baht per bowl, stating that the increase is only for the Songkran festival. This is twice the normal price, even though the portion size remains the same. It seems like they are exploiting the festival to increase prices. Please consider this carefully before deciding to dine here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutwaranon P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The highlight is that it's open 24 hours, a lifesaver for late-night eaters, because I went when Samyan was closing. I was worried about reviews regarding cleanliness and service, but I didn't experience any problems. They've probably improved that. The steamed rice cakes looked good. The boat noodles with waterfall-style broth were delicious and standard, but the Tom Yum noodles lacked Tom Yum flavor; I'll skip that next time. The fried spring rolls were tasty. The fish balls had a strong fishy taste, maybe they're low-grade. If you can tolerate a strong fishy taste, it should be okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kornravee r

sample_reviews_en.text: I received the menu but hadn't even glanced at the items before the staff said, "You can order now." Why the rush? I ordered three bowls of thin noodles, one with tripe, and one with braised beef. The result was that no tripe was served, and they didn't inform me. There were also no fresh vegetables. This might be because I was alone or ordered a small amount, which I understand. But the absence of tripe might be a mistake; the staff might not have repeated the order. Customers assume they heard everything I ordered. This needs immediate improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luckygirl

sample_reviews_en.text: The meatballs were nice and bouncy, very delicious. The dry beef noodle soup I ordered was also very flavorful, with just the right amount of spiciness and a well-balanced salty taste – not overly salty. It was so delicious I wanted to order a second serving! The price is standard for the Samyan area, which is on the higher side. The large bowl I had cost 99 baht. I recommend trying it. Before writing this review, I read other reviews and I think the restaurant has probably taken note of the feedback and made improvements.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bill PariMan

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm usually a regular customer at this noodle shop and have been to several locations before, and everything has always been fine. But this branch is different. Many menu items are disappointing. The noodles are a mix of salty and sour – extremely sour. The sauce for the fried items is also too sour. And the noodles are way spicier than other branches. I tried several things, and everything was sour.
sample_reviews_en.author: tebblue

restaurants.name: ร.เรือ เอกมัย
restaurants.address:

1/5 สุขุมวิท 63 Ekkamai Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the Bangkok Combo, a set menu that included a slice each of pork and chicken steak, fries, and vegetables. Including a Sprite, it cost about 8,500 won (approximately $8 USD). The portions were just right, and the meat was delicious. I preferred this place over the overpriced fake Japanese or Korean restaurants nearby. It's pricier than the outskirts of Bangkok or Pattaya, but considering it's in Ekkamai, the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: jinwoo park

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place to eat, one downside is when the fans are on and the lights flicker so it gives you a bit of a headache.

Food wise, I ordered the recommended dishes and everything was great. I would recommend first timers the chicken wings, best chicken wings I’ve had in Thailand so far, so hot and fresh.

5 stars because the price is so good and cheap ! It was quite busy last time I went to so there may be a short wait sometimes
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuta Sai

sample_reviews_en.text: I have dined at this restaurant twice, but the second experience was truly disappointing. I ordered a 450g medium-rare beef steak, but what they served me was a completely cooked piece of meat—either done or well-done—yet they insisted it was medium-rare. Just take a look at the steak, and you can clearly see it was fully cooked. Such a letdown.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nguyen Minh Tam

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered on grab and asked for no shrimp and not spicy. The salad is full with shrimp. I’m allergic so it can go to the trash. Portion size is a joke… same for the boat noodles. Broth tastes like dirty earth, size is small. did someone ate half of the order before it was delivered?! Please don’t go here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Annabella Kadavanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered mama (noodles) for takeout and asked the Burmese staff to serve the noodles and broth separately, but they didn't understand and served them together.

The noodles had absorbed the broth and were soggy, and were not tasty at all. Very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: さう

sample_reviews_en.text:
N/A never again...
Waited 30 minute for noodles... Order got mixed up.
Food was horrible. Ordered yam tuna but couldnt eat it... So wrapped it up to give staff at office...
Hate it when the first meal of the day is so so bad.. it grouches the whole day..
sample_reviews_en.author: Jo K

sample_reviews_en.text: The second branch focuses on easy-to-eat Thai food, served as a plate. The boat noodles are not very strong, the taste is a bit spicy, the amount of free food is appropriate. The grilled pork neck is quite delicious. Overall, it is considered okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat

sample_reviews_en.text: definitely the best food I've had in bangkok. there are dishes suitable for foreigners, but the thai food is also incredibly good. make sure you try it! the staff are very friendly. it's a hidden paradise even though it's in a very hidden place :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Saygın

restaurants.name: Apple Market (ก๋วยเตี๋ยวรสเจ็บ)
restaurants.address:

54/15 Vibhavadi Rangsit, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. We were one of the first tables when it wasn't crowded. We ordered our food a long time ago, but it still hadn't arrived. Meanwhile, 4-5 tables that arrived later had already received their food. Some tables had even finished eating while we still hadn't received ours. We asked a female staff member about our order, and she said it was being prepared. After about half an hour, we asked again. A male staff member checked and said it was still being prepared. The female staff member didn't check or follow up at all when we asked. In short, we waited for an hour. We ordered Pad Thai, and the portion was large, but the taste was awful. I don't know if it was because they rushed it, but I was very disappointed. A long wait and an unappetizing meal. Terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanikan Jarernrom

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are as delicious as ever, but the service is much worse than before. The staff ignore customers, don't take orders, and have no service mind. In the end, I only got one bowl of noodles, even though I intended to order other things as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasawat D

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this restaurant in a destroyed and strange area ! It’s eclectic, comfortable . The owner is so pleasant , the service perfect and smiley , I live in Thailand for 15 years and catch the Thai taste when it is there . Full of Thai clients .
sample_reviews_en.author: Philippe Moisan

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and satisfying, the taste never disappoints. The boat noodle soup is tasty, the tom yum has plenty of ingredients, and the yen ta fo has lots of ingredients. The prices are great value. The papaya salad is also to my liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: พี่กุ้งกดสิว สาขาจตุจักร

sample_reviews_en.text: I love it, always fresh and tasty. Drinks are great, coconut smoothie is my number one. Noodle and rice dishes are great. I like sea food and chicken and they can make both very well. They also have pork which looks tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: rafamusic2020 check

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is spacious. You can choose to sit in the air-conditioned room or outside where it's not hot. The noodle soup is rich and delicious. There are many menus to choose from. It gets quite crowded at lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wera Pra

sample_reviews_en.text: The instant noodle dish with pork and waterfall sauce was delicious. The liver and pork were very tender, the noodles were perfectly cooked, and the waterfall sauce was tasty. The price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: chutinun nopun

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) was excellent, the Som Tum (papaya salad) with crab and fermented fish sauce was incredibly spicy, and the fried chicken wings were the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: Idbus KS

restaurants.name: bangbon bar
restaurants.address:

2, 5 Soi Ekkachai 64/7, Khlong Bang Phran, Khet Bang Bon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Mingalarbar Restaurant is a hidden gem that brings the authentic flavors of Myanmar to life in the heart of [City]. From the moment you step through the door, you're greeted with warm smiles and the traditional Burmese greeting, "Mingalarbar," setting the tone for a delightful culinary journey.
sample_reviews_en.author: naksen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food here is good and you will never get disappointed with their food.

All the people here are very good, lovely and cute. They give more than what I expect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nyan Min Htut

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the service is good, there's air conditioning, and a wide variety of dishes to choose from, including Burmese food that's not usually hard to find. The Shwe Beer draft beer is also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: House Gear

restaurants.name: 17 Something • ทองหล่อ
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 351/5 สุขุมวิท 55 ปากซอย ทองหล่อ 17 หมู่ แขวง คลองตันเหนือ เขต วัฒนา คลองตันเหนือ วัฒนา Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Ordered the chicken steak with mushroom sauce using the “คนละครึ่ง” promotion and paid only 49.5 baht total. Incredible value for money!

You get a generous portion of protein - the chicken steak is a good size and very filling. The taste is solid and meets expectations. The mushroom sauce is decent, and it comes with rice and grilled vegetables.

At this price point, it’s extremely worth it. Perfect for anyone on a budget who wants to enjoy a steak meal. Highly recommended! 👍
sample_reviews_th.author: Benya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Owner needs to check with whoever is cooking tonight. We have been ordering delivery for months but tonight was awful.

Lasagna is just cheese and sauce, no noodles or meat.

Corn soup doesn't taste the same at all anymore, very very bland.

Caesar Salad was packed with all the hot food and was wilted, croutons mushy, Caesar dressing was watery, too much and bland.

Garlic bread with the soup is just stale bread now with no seasoning.

Bolognese was ok but lacked the savoriness of the previous orders.

Pretty disappointed, this was one of our go to orders for cheap and tasty pasta and soup. Clearly something is going wrong in the kitchen, I hope they fix it for their sake but I won’t be ordering again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shane

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very serious beef steak cooked with perfection. I usually don't like fries but their fries are special - fresh and non-oily. The beef is truly amazing. We've ordered their food many times but today we decided to eat at their restaurant.

I would say their beef steak is better than all the other fine dining restaurants and hotels offering beef steak. We paid so much for steak at Grand Hyatt Hotel but the steak here is far better.

Steak here is less than 500 baht ($15) and it tastes better than the steak we had at Grand Hyatt Hotel which we paid $300.

Honestly, 17 Something beef is even better than El Gaucho we had in Bangkok and Ho Chi Minh.

Come here for very serious steak at very affordable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole Ling

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have the MOST SEVERE food poisoning ever, I'm practically dying. I'm 100% sure because I ate nothing the whole day, and the chicken smells rotten or bad too. But I trust the store since it's not my first time.

I've vomited the whole night & still are, diarrhea is insane, and I've had the worst headache I've ever had.

I know it's a good store but after this experience, I will never order ever again & I recommend every customer to double check their foods before eating or else they will be visiting the depth of hell like I did.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Meng

sample_reviews_en.text: Call for delivery from FoodPanda. They said it took around 25 minutes, they received and processed the order, I paid by card so the meal was charged. After 35 minutes, the restaurant canceled my order because they ran out of the chosen dish?! Shouldn’t it be canceled sooner if that was the case? And after all, no apologies, not even a word. Very unprofessional and disrespectful towards customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Hoang Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re after something quick, affordable, and genuinely satisfying, this little takeaway spot hits the mark. The menu is simple — no frills, no fuss — just good food done right. Everything I’ve tried has been tasty and fresh, with portions that leave you full without draining your wallet. It’s the kind of place you find yourself going back to again and again because it’s just that reliable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Bruce

sample_reviews_en.text: I went here last night and ordered  99B chicken steak. when I see the price and thought chix is only 100g and with some chips but the chix was around 180~ 200g with more chips and veges as well. Wow. Mushroom sauce was perfect. My friend ordered a caesar salad (99B) its pretty big size as than price  and  presentation was great!  definitely come again!!
sample_reviews_en.author: samuraidrive77

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything tastes delicious when you're hungry. I love the food and the prices at this restaurant. Actually, ordering just one dish and sitting down to eat is both delicious and very filling, plus it smells great. The staff taking orders are lovely, the atmosphere is chill, and the prices are worth it considering the high rent in Thonglor (laughs).
sample_reviews_en.author: PinkSisSis

restaurants.name: บ้านบางกอก สาขา HomePro ประชาชื่น
restaurants.address:

บางเขน อาคาร HomePro ประชาชื่น unit S1005 31 Pracha Chuen Rd, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff provided excellent service.
The food was varied, clean, beautifully decorated, and delicious.
The atmosphere was airy and comfortable, with good music and bright lighting. I liked it.
sample_reviews_en.author: panita sompet

sample_reviews_en.text: This one meal includes fried rice, fried egg, fried chicken, and sausage. It's a filling and satisfying meal; you'd be missing out if you didn't try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Auttachai Kanthenras

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried chicken should be improved a lot. The noodles were mushy, the chicken was rancid, and the squid was so old it was hard to chew.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichapat Lampetch

sample_reviews_en.text: The crispy chicken is delicious. The spring rolls are crispy but the dough is a bit thick. The shop is clean and quite good.
sample_reviews_en.author: S C

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is delicious and the price is reasonable, especially the chicken which is quite crispy and excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyapong Rote

sample_reviews_en.text: The crispy chicken basil rice is delicious! The restaurant is located on the 1st floor of HomePro Prachachuen.
sample_reviews_en.author: beatlebum home

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice noodles with crab and fish curry are delicious! The coconut ice cream is also incredibly tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Auddy Mon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, it was great!
The food was delicious, the wait time was short, and the staff were very polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปพัสส์รัตน์ชา บรมภิบาล

restaurants.name: Delawan
restaurants.address:

773 เดลาวัน 1หมู่2 Soi Suk Sawat 30, Bang Pakok, Khet Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It was my first time there. It's a wild game restaurant that serves venison, ostriches, and frogs. We ordered a lot of food, and I'm not sure if everything arrived because there was so much that we sometimes forgot or missed some items. The food was average in taste. There were two dishes that were surprising: the winged bean salad took 2 hours to arrive! And it was a salad with dried shrimp and winged beans, with a dressing that tasted like a Thai fish salad – I was completely baffled. The other dish, the "snakehead fish with garden vegetables," was fried fish served with blanched vegetables and a seafood dipping sauce, but that also took another hour. I've never seen snakehead fish with garden vegetables like that before; it was a huge surprise. I felt sorry for the staff; there were only 3 of them, and each dish took so long to arrive. And I was shocked by the bill; it was so faded that I couldn't even see the order clearly, so I couldn't check if everything arrived. The bill came out to 6518 baht. I was so confused.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krongthong Thongart

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spicy Mussel Curry: Good
Stir-fried Cabbage with Fish Sauce: Good
Curry-Style Catfish: Terrible. This was the worst dish. Fried catfish with curry sauce and pineapple. The curry sauce was watery and poured over a large piece of fried catfish. It didn't soak into the meat and didn't go well with the pineapple at all. It would have been better to order it fried with fish sauce, or with sweet and sour sauce, or just with curry sauce. Most importantly, it took a very long time to prepare. This dish took half an hour, while the spicy snail curry and stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce only took 5-10 minutes.
Service: I asked about my food, and the waitress said she would go check on it, but then disappeared and didn't come back to update me. When I asked again, she said it was ready and would be served, but it still wasn't brought. I had to ask a third time before it was served.
Atmosphere: It's good that the seats have fans to keep mosquitoes away. If you sit at a corner table without a fan, you'll be bitten by mosquitoes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanarak Chua

sample_reviews_en.text:
I brought my family to have dinner here on August 21, 1969. We arrived at 8:40 PM and received our food at 9:27 PM. We ordered 5 dishes, but they didn't all arrive at the same time; there was a 10-minute gap between each dish. We only received 3 dishes initially. The server was using their phone while serving. We asked about the remaining 2 dishes three times, but still hadn't received them. They said there was a mistake in the order and they were working on it.
At 9:50 PM, we still hadn't received the remaining food. I was furious and hadn't even finished eating, but the wait was too long. I lost my appetite.
The service was terrible, and the food serving management was awful.
There were only 6-7 tables of customers, but the wait was incredibly long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wiraya 1046

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was extremely spicy and the wait was incredibly long. The dishes I ordered first arrived last, after I'd already finished eating, and they wouldn't let me cancel my order. I also tried to cancel earlier orders that hadn't arrived yet, and they said they were fried and waiting to be stir-fried, but it took forever. I ordered a winged bean salad, but it looked and tasted like a mango salad. The chicken stir-fried with cashews tasted like a jungle curry with mild chili peppers. The staff were completely inattentive. One staff member was incredibly clueless. Overall, I was very unimpressed with both the food and the staff, especially the staff who were impolite and completely clueless.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jane Janny

sample_reviews_en.text:
My experience this time was not very pleasant.
The waitstaff were unwelcoming, uninterested in taking orders, and inattentive. The food was delayed and incomplete; some items weren't even noted down. When the food finally arrived, there were no plates or cutlery, and we had to wait over 10 minutes before getting them ourselves. Even getting the bill took a long time. The food was quite oily, making it an overall negative experience.

However, the music was okay and the atmosphere was relaxing.

P.S. Judging from the bill, the restaurant was quite attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tto I onn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food took a very long time to arrive, especially the steamed fish. Anyone thinking of eating here should read the reviews first. I came because it's close to home, but I didn't expect it to be this bad. The service was terrible. A waiter was scratching his feet before getting food; I had to remind him to wash his hands first.

The restaurant has a lot of mosquitoes and standing water inside; it's not very clean.

No matter how cheap the price is, it's not worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pacha Tu

sample_reviews_en.text: We arrived at the restaurant around 5:15 PM and waited until 6:00 PM for our food. Then the owner said the waiter made a mistake. I want to ask why didn't you ask the customers if they ordered incorrectly? Why didn't you ask if it was another table? Or do you think crocodile meat eats everything that other tables ordered? Also, we started to wonder why we arrived first but didn't get our food until 2-3 other tables received theirs. Seriously, isn't that infuriating?
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyawadee Riubon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food portions have decreased significantly, the service is slow, and the food delivery is delayed, even though there were only a few tables of customers. I asked for the bill 10 minutes ago and they still haven't come to collect it. I'm very disappointed, especially since I've been eating at this restaurant regularly since I was a child. Maybe not every year, but I used to come very often, even on my birthday.
sample_reviews_en.author: pisitsin kumsuk

restaurants.name: Rumruai minigrill ร่ำรวย มินิกริลล์ 发财小串
restaurants.address:

9 Yards RCA Alley, บางกะปิ Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently tried three different barbecue restaurants in Yanbian, and this one was the most affordable.

Regular meat skewers are about 20 baht each, smaller skewers are around 10 baht, and cold noodles are 98 baht. Drinks are priced like any other restaurant, so overall it's good value for money.

The taste was quite good; the meat skewers were delicious, and the cold noodles were also good.

Overall, there were no major problems; the price was reasonable, and the taste was good. Most importantly, it's close to home, making it convenient when I want barbecue.

I'll probably come again and bring my friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryan H

sample_reviews_en.text: 🍢🔥 Authentic Chinese BBQ restaurant newly opened in the Rama 9 area. Grilled over charcoal, prices start at just 10 baht per skewer! 😍 Tastes just like in China, but much cheaper! Delicious, high quality, and affordable. Perfect for chilling and having drinks with friends late at night – the vibe is great! 🍻 This is another favorite spot. The BBQ is pre-cooked and ready to eat, incredibly delicious, flavorful, and inexpensive. Plenty of fresh, clean ingredients, diverse menu, spacious and comfortable seating. Open until 5 AM. Highly recommended! Excellent service, 10/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilaiporn Khruasri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hey everyone! "Ruay Ramruay Mini Grill" has moved to Bravo BKK, 6th floor +1, but the deliciousness hasn't changed at all! Still melts in your mouth!! 😍

Starting at 10-20 baht per skewer, same great price! Lamb, beef, pork, chicken, etc. – they have it all! Grilled to perfection, so fragrant and delicious. Great value, complete and satisfying! 😘

Come visit! "Ruay Ramruay Mini Grill" is open every day until late. Great atmosphere, beautiful view, not stuffy at all. I love it! 💕💕💕
sample_reviews_en.author: Lun La Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: Rumruai Minigrill is a great place for grilled food with lots of flavor. The skewers were delicious, well seasoned, and cooked just right, making them very enjoyable. There were plenty of choices to try, and everything tasted fresh. The atmosphere is casual and lively, perfect for eating with friends and sharing food. Overall, it is a fun spot for tasty grilled dishes and definitely worth visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Roberts

sample_reviews_en.text: This amazing Chinese BBQ restaurant has moved to a rooftop on Rama 9! The food is just as delicious as before, with rich and flavorful mala broth. The atmosphere is great, with a cool breeze – you won't feel lonely. The prices are very reasonable, averaging 300 baht per person, and they're open until 5 AM. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Euakarn Ruangroje

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the taste was great. There was a wide variety of ingredients to choose from, and the prices were clearly displayed, which I really appreciated. It's perfect for chilling with friends; the restaurant is spacious, the air is nice, the staff are friendly, and it's clean. I'll definitely be back! 👍🏻✨
sample_reviews_en.author: พัชราภา สมจิต

sample_reviews_en.text: We stopped by just walking around the area and so glad that we did. Very nice atmosphere and the skewers were very delicious especially lamb, grilling right on our table. You are allowed to bring in food from outside and we ordered grilled shrimp from the next door, which was good too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emmy Chung

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here many times, and it's just as delicious as always. I especially love the grilled beef intestines! The charcoal fire is satisfyingly hot, and the atmosphere is great. It's busy these days, but the wait isn't too long. Everything is delicious; I love it so much!
sample_reviews_en.author: Manood Tangdao

restaurants.name: Roast at Sathon
restaurants.address:

Building A, Bhiraj Tower at Sathon, 31 S Sathon Rd, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the 4th Roast we have been to, and we rated it highly. We got there really late which is why my photo shows an empty restaurant. My wife just had the soup but they still managed to serve up a roast dinner for me. We shared the strawberry waffle - ice cream had delicious strong flavours, and I would need a Canadian to confirm that it was not real maple syrup. Top quality. BTW no photo of the roast dinner as I could jot stop myself. Right next to Surasak so absolutely no effort to get to from the BTS
sample_reviews_en.author: Andy D

sample_reviews_en.text:
ROAST, formerly known as Roast Coffee & Eatery, is one of the first modern cafes to offer a complete range of coffee, savory dishes, and desserts. Their new Sathorn branch is fantastic.

Their Sunday Roast is delicious (I tried it at OCKEN's brunch when they separated brunch and dinner). It's only available on Sundays, so if you can make it on a Sunday, I highly recommend it. I missed out!

The service is good, the air conditioning is cool, and the seating is comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prassy Srikittichai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a terrible experience with the service here.
​I ordered the Peruvian chicken, and after waiting over 40 minutes, my food still hadn't arrived—even though all 7 of my friends had already received theirs. When I finally asked staff for an update, they casually informed me that my dish takes longer and asked if I wanted to change my order. Why wasn't I told about the long wait time when I ordered 40 minutes earlier? Extremely disappointing communication and service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenneth H

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very limited offerings at this Sathorn location. Drinks, some pastry, and sandwiches. Probably just heated up.

I only had coffee and that was just ok they didn’t have the any more of the pistachio drink that I wanted. Slim selection of food offerings there.

Not as pleasant as the Central World Roast. Which has a lot more food items. You can sit and order rather than (at Sathorn - order at the counter while you hold up the line trying to decide.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul SanDiego

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place located right next to the BTS Station Surasak. While we should have booked in advance, the staff helped accommodate for us to have a seat. The tables which help when sharing plates. The salmon wellington was delicious and perfectly well cooked, and their signature coffee with Ice cubes made of coffee was a cool touch.
Their dishes are very well seasoned and balanced which is rare for brunch spots around the city
sample_reviews_en.author: Carlo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been sitting here for ages, and no one's come to take my order. I asked the bartender for water, and they just stared indifferently.

I ordered the chicken ginochi, but it was tasteless, bland, and salty.
The tomato soup was incredibly salty, unlike the one at Central World.
The kale salad was just sour, lacking balance.
The taste is so different from the Central World branch, it's baffling.

They should improve.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poomchai Prasertkunlavong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Roast at Sathon and really enjoyed it. The place has a cozy, relaxed vibe — perfect for just sitting down and taking your time.

The staff were super friendly and attentive, which made the whole experience even better.

The food was really good too — a nice mix of European and Italian dishes, everything tasted fresh and well made.

It’s a great spot for breakfast or brunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Анастасия Тушнолобова

sample_reviews_en.text:
📌 A casual all-day eatery with a simple, comfortable atmosphere, featuring wooden furniture in brown tones.
🍽 The food, drinks, and desserts are all delicious.
👍 The Weekday Lunch Set is excellent.
🌟 Each dish contains all five food groups – a great combination.
🍮 The Creme Caramel is fragrant, delicious, and creamy.
♦️ The service is excellent and attentive to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lara Linh

restaurants.name: Saint Of Salt
restaurants.address:

Saint Of Salt, Opp Villa Market, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If it was possible to give no stars i would but unfortunately its not so i give it a 1. I had a very disappointing experience with this club. My friend was pressured to tap her bank card twice after staff assured her that the first transaction had been voided. However, her bank showed that the first payment had actually gone through.

The next day, she returned to the club with proof from her bank that both transactions were on her account. Instead of resolving the issue or refunding the duplicate charge, the staff refused and told her to dispute it with her bank. When she contacted the bank, they confirmed that the club had claimed the payment. She then called the club to let them know what the bank had said, but the call was abruptly ended when they hung up on her.

Based on this experience, the customer service was extremely poor, and the handling of a billing issue was unprofessional. I would recommend others check their bank statements carefully after making payments here
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna - Mariá

sample_reviews_en.text: Went to this restaurant for a comedy night and was very disappointed in the service I received. I got there during happy hour and there was no direction on what was included. The server we had had no idea about anything and was always going back and forth and asking other colleagues anything we had asked about. After finally being able to order we were told that the drinks he said we could order weren’t actually included in the happy hour and by then happy hour finished. So we took whatever was similar. My boyfriend and I then ordered well done wings and fries. We didn’t get any information on different sauces or anything that was included. The order came out over 45 minutes later and were a weird grey colour. We were really concerned and the restaurant was so dark. We made sure to use our flash light. My boyfriend decided to give it a try and would you believe the wings were even still bleeding too smh. Honestly most disgusting thing ever. We won’t be returning
sample_reviews_en.author: Janel H

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was told to tap my card twice because I was assured the first transaction would be reversed. It never was, leaving me out of pocket. Instead of fixing their mistake, they've completely ignored me, and when I finally managed to get through by phone, they hung up on me.
I even showed up there the next day, they told me to dispute with my bank which I DID, my bank CONFIRMED with me they ALREADY CLAIMED the money TWICE
The customer service is beyond appalling. Taking someone's money is easy, but taking responsibility apparently isn't. If this is how they treat paying customers, it says everything about how this place is run.

Check your bank transactions very carefully if you go here. Based on my experience, I wouldn't trust this place with my card, and I certainly won't ever be coming back. There are plenty of bars that know how to treat customers with basic honesty and respect—this isn't one of them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jackeline Turner

sample_reviews_en.text:
Saint of Salt truly lives up to its name. From the moment you walk in, the ambience sets the tone—stylish, relaxed, and effortlessly cool. The service is exceptional: warm, attentive, and perfectly timed without ever hovering (a rare art, well mastered here).

And the shisha? Simply the best in town. Smooth, flavorful, and expertly prepared—clearly done by people who respect the craft the old-school way, not shortcuts.

A place that gets all the basics right and then adds a little soul on top. If you know, you know. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nick Sharma

sample_reviews_en.text: Initially we went for the shisha and we went back because the food was so good - get the lababdar! The shisha was great both times, but coal service was better the second time. Not a fan of the plastic pipe the second time though! Staff were lovely but service could have been more attentive, sometimes couldn't get anyone's attention even though the place wasn't particularly busy - when the manager was on our floor he was very on top of it. Couple of points for improvement but would definitely go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melissa Black

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there with my husband some lady come to us and sitting next to my husband and then they ask for drink and touch my husband they didn't respect me at all

So confused this is a club or BAR GIRLS like foreign said Be careful, when anyone come to Thailand
sample_reviews_en.author: Selena Sean

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff are so friendly
The food is awesome
I would recommend this place to all locals and traveller's alike
We really enjoyed the food
And atmosphere
I met Naman it was a great meting good service by the man and he take care of us very good
sample_reviews_en.author: Andy Piddington

sample_reviews_en.text: Just learnt bout this newly opened place on sukhumvit soi 11 and i must say it qas an amazing experience the ambience very comfortable and calming . Excellent indian food loved it. Will definitely recommend for couples and groups alike
sample_reviews_en.author: Waqas Younas

restaurants.name: ตำมั่ว
restaurants.address:

เดอะมอลล์ ช็อปปิ้งเซ็นเตอร์ 3522 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted delicious, the service was good and fast. Today, the staff informed us that we received a free glass of Coke for customers dining in pairs. After the food arrived, we started eating the papaya salad but found a hair in it. We informed the manager, who resolved the issue by serving us a new plate of food. Overall, it's a suitable restaurant for dining with friends and family; the food tastes great and the service is fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sariya S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I used to like the taste of the food at this restaurant, but lately the food doesn't match the pictures at all. Before, when I ordered papaya salad with vegetables and pork cracklings, I could see each item separately. Now, it's just two pieces of pork cracklings and very few vegetables. Everything else is there, but the quantity has decreased. 165 baht isn't cheap either. 😢
Recommendation: Chiang Rai style fried pork 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Milk Station

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad menu is as delicious as ever, except for the fish wrap (miang pla). After the renovation, the restaurant's location isn't great; the seating area is stuffy and lacks ventilation. The food is slow to arrive, with very long waits. The staff are unenthusiastic and seem untrained. Service, both in and out of the kitchen, needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Orange Juice

sample_reviews_en.text: This pork skewers with dipping sauce is 110 baht. The corn salad is almost 100 baht, very sweet, I had to add fish sauce. The larb (spicy minced meat salad) was delicious! Prices have gone up a lot, but the ingredients are good. It's tasty, but I wish they would reduce the sweetness. There are many menu items and lots of staff, but the service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: kany kate

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the second branch that opened. Initially, we thought the staff were very welcoming. However, lately, it seems the restaurant is having some problems. We feel the staff aren't as welcoming. Customers who come to eat at your restaurant are usually satisfied with the food and good service. But recently, we feel your service has been lacking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiraporn Pengsukrat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The spicy pork sausage salad was amazing, so delicious!
The duck larb was tasty and fragrant.
The instant noodle salad was just okay.
The fried fermented fish was tasty and nicely sour.
It gets crowded on weekends, so allow extra time. Food is slow to come out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rattananvalai Thongsir

sample_reviews_en.text:
After The Mall Bangkapi's renovation,

a new Laotian-Vietnamese restaurant has opened near the water park ticket counter.
The food was slow to come out, even though it wasn't crowded. We waited about half an hour.
The food itself was delicious though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Berry Sweet

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service! I waited for an hour, and when the food arrived, they didn't bring any plates or spoons. They just made me sit and stare. Awful! They wouldn't bring them unless I asked. I know they don't have many staff, but this is unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: pornmanee sripattanet

restaurants.name: 11:15 Eleven Fifteen ไก่กรอบ กะหรี่จีน & เส้นหมี่สด ปรุงรส น้ำจิ้มซีฟู้ด สูตรเด็ด
restaurants.address:

76, 17 Chan Rd, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've ordered delivery several times, and it exceeded my expectations! I ordered the fried chicken, braised pork with eggs, and stir-fried minced pork, and all three were delicious.
The fried chicken was the best! They use thigh meat, the skin is crispy, the meat is tender and juicy, and the flavor is perfectly salty. It's amazing with rice.

The braised pork with eggs was incredibly flavorful – a perfect balance of sweet, sour, and slightly spicy, not at all greasy. I loved that they added cilantro, which made it very fragrant. They use high-quality ingredients and are generous with the portions, just like homemade food.

The stir-fried minced pork was rich and delicious, perfect with hot steamed rice. The rice from this restaurant is also high-quality.

The packaging was good, delivery was fast, and the price was very reasonable considering the quality.
If you like simple yet creative dishes that taste like mom's cooking, you have to try this restaurant! I will definitely order again! 🍗🍳🍚💕
sample_reviews_en.author: Arisa Kamchokechai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I regularly visit 1115. They give a generous portion, so much so that one box is enough to fill me up. Their new dish, the braised pork, is absolutely amazing! The egg is cooked perfectly, with a rubbery texture, and the braised pork is melt-in-your-mouth tender. The soup is incredibly spicy. I've had it three times this past week and I'm absolutely hooked.

Another dish I find unique at this restaurant is the fried chicken curry rice. The curry is similar to crab curry, but paired with fried chicken. The restaurant also serves an incredibly delicious seafood dipping sauce. It's truly impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamoltip Puttamilinpratheap

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered without expecting much, but it turned out to be unexpectedly delicious! 🍛✨

I saw the menu looked interesting and decided to try some, and it turned out...everything was amazing!

💛 My favorite is the "Minced Pork Stir-fried with Garlic and Pepper."
The flavor is rich and goes perfectly with hot steamed rice. It feels like home-cooked food made with care. And adding a crispy fried egg on top...I'd say, it was "You Made My Lush Time!" I was so happy! 555+
sample_reviews_en.author: Honeydew Ang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great taste, good quality ingredients, generous portions, excellent value for money.
I've ordered again and again, everything is delicious, especially the minced pork stir-fried with soy sauce and the seafood dipping sauce, so spicy and delicious! Even better with the curry stir-fry 👍😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Diva F.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a delicious restaurant near my house that I order from regularly via Line Man. I especially love their stir-fried pork with curry powder and rice; the pork is so tasty. Their seafood dipping sauce with rice noodles is also incredibly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichaya Hongsrichinda

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love the spiciness of the food here.
They also give you fragrant Japanese rice ⭐️
I recommend the crispy chicken curry rice 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
Pork with lime noodles 👍🏻👍🏻
The seafood dipping sauce is also delicious 🔥🔥🌶️🌶️
sample_reviews_en.author: nathavut thamputirat

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish is delicious, the flavors are great, and it's not too sweet, which I love. It's perfect for a quick lunch on busy days when you still want tasty food. Ordering through the app is convenient and fast!
sample_reviews_en.author: Popcorn P

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fried chicken is delicious.
The buttered pork is delicious.
The stewed pork is delicious.
The dipping sauce is incredibly spicy!
The portions are generous, great value for money!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kay Supakitpatana

restaurants.name: Joy Table
restaurants.address:

56 Lat Phrao 64 Alley, Lane 6, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just a small cafe with lack of menu, they offer the salad menu which using the vegetable just take off from the farm next to their cafe. We have tried the salad tofu, homemade cake and also the detox vegetable drinks, the ingredient of course is fresh, but the taste is just ok.
This place is hidden inside the house area, have to drive carefully when passing the small soi.
Here’s my opinion for sharing:-
Food & Beverage=3/5
Location =3/5
Service=5/5
Ambience=5/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Marcus Chua

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is lovely. I came when it was drizzling and there were only a few cakes left, but it was very cozy. The desserts and drinks tasted good, and the owner was very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: S. P.

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem in the heart of Bangkok! They grow their own vegetables, and their tofu salad is amazing... Don't forget to order the passion fruit soda – it's fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakeranam Thada

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients from the backyard and neighbor's garden are amazing. The cakes are good, the food is delicious. I'll definitely go again, and it's close to home too.
sample_reviews_en.author: 吳寜林 linn's life

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely enjoy this homely place, the salad and drink were super good!! So worth it to come and the owners planted those greens and they are very nice too:)
sample_reviews_en.author: Jessi Tsai

sample_reviews_en.text: Earl Grey #latte plus caramel coffee cake for a Sunday afternoon with jazz music. I love the cake and the green view of vegetable farm.
sample_reviews_en.author: Youyou

sample_reviews_en.text: fantastic food and cake I have been there several times and really love the food and beverage!
sample_reviews_en.author: sugar shishishi

restaurants.name: Tonsei
restaurants.address:

11 Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I found them on Lineman and unfortunately had a bad experience with them. They did my order wrong and when I called to see if they can make my order and send it to me the first thing the lady said was “if you wanted that why didn’t you order that?” 😂As in if I was in a restaurant if the kitchen made the wrong order I would ask them to make the correct thing. I asked them to make the menu i ordered and send it to me she said order another one and we will make it correct this time. Not offering a refund or an apology for making the wrong thing. Their miso soup doesn’t have seaweed and they put carrots in it instead I’m not sure that’s the way it’s normally done but I have never had miso soup like that. I don’t normally make bad reviews but I felt the food portion wasn’t even big and the taste wasn’t good because if it was I wouldn’t complain😂 but this place doesn’t deserve a good rating in my opinion. There’s so many Japanese restaurants in Bangkok I would not waste my time here. I think I wouldn’t be this upset if they were able to handle the situation better she just kept on laughing and making it a joke. Normally a chill person but this lady really got to my hangry side😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Sophia Karlsson

sample_reviews_en.text:
Last Friday, I stumbled upon this hidden gem, and I’m so glad I did. The atmosphere was incredibly impressive, it felt less like a restaurant and more like walking into a Japanese grandma’s kitchen. You could truly taste the passion and effort put into every single dish.

I was blown away by the Tempura Soba. The Soup was light and absolutely delicious. The Mixed Fry Set was another highlight, offering a great variety of textures. My personal favorite was the Potato Croquette so creamy inside! And I can’t forget the Shrimp Tempura fried to perfection with the shrimp still bouncy and snappy.

The set also came with drink, and considering the quality and portion size, the price was surprisingly cute and wallet-friendly. I will definitely be coming back for more!
sample_reviews_en.author: Suphanai Chaichorfa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Updated December 2025
It's been about three years since my last visit. I had the classic Western-style set meal for 300 THB. The price hasn't changed, but the soup, which used to be pork miso soup, has been replaced with regular miso soup. Despite rising prices, I feel they're making a great effort to stay afloat. It was as delicious as ever. I'm rooting for them from behind the scenes, so please keep it up!

Below is a previous post:
A good old-fashioned set meal restaurant. I'm glad they've preserved the traditional flavors, like a long-established establishment. I recommend the Western-style set meal or the mixed fry set meal. I sometimes crave the fried food here.
sample_reviews_en.author: 2pong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really good authentic Japanese teisyoku restaurant near the Phrong phong BTS station!!
I ordered saba teisyoku and husband ordered fillet katsu teisyoku and both are yum!
The place is not fancy but makes you feel like as if you are at a small local restaurant on a small country town in Japan 😋
Deducting one star as the rice was a bit too over cooked (soft) but otherwise the food was good. The fillet katsu was very tender.
Price was reasonable so head here if you want a good quality Japanese food at a reasonable price.  Really good VFM!
sample_reviews_en.author: Miho

sample_reviews_en.text:
All time great Japanese restaurant. I used to have meals here very often and visited again for the first time in years.
Decent taste and enough serving with a variety of choices.
These are the Japanese people's daily menu not like Sushi, Sashimi, and Tempura, which are for special occasions.
If you want to explore what ordinally Japanese people eat as a daily meal in this area of Bangkok, this is one of the best. You would see a lot of Japanese expats at dinner time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Santa Claus

sample_reviews_en.text: I was running errands around Sukhumvit 26. The restaurant is on the street in a shophouse, with no parking. Lots of office workers were coming and going. I ordered a set meal, priced around 2xx-3xx baht, which I think is very reasonable for the Sukhumvit area. The food was served hot and fresh. I forgot to take pictures because I was too busy eating! The taste was even better than some of the Japanese restaurant chains found in shopping malls.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. WSRWTN

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quite local and can see a lot of Japanese expat eating here. Atmosphere is a bit hot and dark, but good and pricing is good.
The miso soup is a bit salty and the daikon in miso soup is a bit hard. Would be perfect if it’s softer.

The curry is good and generous, katsu is nice too. The high ball is very nicely priced  too.

Will return if there are more Japanese craving or when I meet up with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jerome Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I'm a regular customer. It's another restaurant that's been open for a long time. Mostly Japanese customers come here. Today I had sushi don and hot plate grilled beef. The fish was very fresh and served with side dishes. The staff are friendly and the owner is very kind. I highly recommend it for anyone who likes sashimi. You won't be disappointed! It's become my go-to restaurant. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Dokor Phumkaew

restaurants.name: 10 Corner Restaurant
restaurants.address:

260, PGF5+QJ6, 262 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were uninterested and unenthusiastic about following up on orders or repeating the food items. When taking the order, they just handed over a piece of paper to write on. Overall, the taste was mediocre.
The service was terrible. They only served two dishes, but I was confused because the rice wasn't ready. I thought they were still cooking the rice, so I waited. In short, they forgot what I ordered. When I followed up, it was incredibly slow. Two people asked, but they still hadn't gotten it. It was like the staff were busy drinking with friends or something, completely ignoring the customers. By the time the food arrived, I had lost all appetite. They only served fried chicken tendons and a single bowl of rice. They forgot the mixed seafood salad, but they still served it. When I asked to take the extra items I ordered to go, they agreed, but there were no spoons or anything provided.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anchalee Landa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the prices are great, and the staff are lovely and friendly.
I'm a regular customer. I highly recommend it; they have a wide variety of dishes. My frequent orders are the seafood hot pot (Po Tak Talay), which is delicious, spicy, rich in flavor, and the fish is very fresh. The portion is huge! ❤️
The shrimp salad is also very tasty and flavorful.
The grilled fish with herbs and spices (Miang Pla Pao) is also delicious, with a fantastic seafood dipping sauce.
You absolutely have to order these three dishes. They're so delicious and addictive. I don't want it to get too popular because I'm afraid it'll be crowded, haha, but I really want everyone to come and try this delicious food. I'm not exaggerating, it's genuinely delicious. Here's just one picture for now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patty Kanoknapat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located opposite Icon Siam about 100m to your left.
Busy with a constant flow of locals so we thought it must be good enough. More importantly- this place was air conditioned.

No English was spoken and we used google translate to read the menu.

Ordered:
Stir Fried Morning Glory - tasty , generous portion.

Spicy Pork Rib Soup (google translate - spicy cartilage soup) - tasted just like tom yum prawn soup but with pork ribs- excellent!! Tender meat.

Spicy Fried Clams (pippies) - stir fried with holy basil and chilli - frozen clams were used. Great sauce, well balanced.
White steamed rice
Beers

Very reasonably priced and generous serves. Staff friendly and tried to help with our order despite the language barrier.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrianna H

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were incredibly friendly. They knew we weren't Thai, but they tried their best to make it clear to us. There was a cat outside, and a very kind staff member came over and told us in English that the cat had babies. It seems to be a family-run restaurant. Excellent value for money! Highly recommend this place! ❤️❤️❤️ I've eaten there twice in the last 3 days.
sample_reviews_en.author: Man mAn

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice food for the price. Large portion size. Very authentic Thai food. However if you are a foreigner you will probably have some trouble ordering food because you need to write your order yourself. Also there is essentially no parking space because it is right on the road. The place is also a bit rundown. Despite the downsides, I would definitely recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tinnapop Stenberg

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good place for a late night Isaan snack.

I live close by and came here many times. They are usually open until early in the morning. I tried several dishes and they were always fine: Ton Saep, Tom Yum, Laab moo or grilled beef.

The place is also a good choice for a late beer and people watching. Prices are ok. And they always have a seat available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice little restaurant nearby to Icon Siam. Had some Thai food, and because my friends don't eat spicy so we went for a low level spicy Pad Krapao Pork, Shrimp Omelette and a White Fish Tomyum. Food were delicious and I believe it will be even better if the spicy level can be like normal. Price is affordable, and food is fresh and  service is prompt.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Chan (www.roadtrippers.asia)
