restaurants.address:

317 Thanon Tiwanon - Pathum Thani, ตำบล ตลาดขวัญ Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The Khao Chae (rice in chilled coconut milk) was good, but not everything was delicious.
The restaurant received a Michelin Bib 2026 award, but some dishes were just average. The candied bananas were not good; it was like boiled bananas with boiling coconut milk poured over them. The bananas lacked the moistness and shine of sugar. Suitable for health-conscious people. The Khao Chae set costs 320฿ for one person, and the accompaniments are standard.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jasper P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
During Songkran, for some reason, I had a strong craving for Khao Chae (rice in jasmine-infused water) and Khao Man Som Tum (rice with papaya salad). I searched on Maps and never imagined there would be an authentic Thai restaurant, even a Michelin Guide establishment, near the entrance of Soi Rewadee.

Food: I only ordered two dishes: Khao Chae and Khao Man Som Tum. The Khao Chae was fragrant and delicious; the jasmine-infused water was perfect, and the accompanying vegetables made it a complete and authentic traditional version. As for the Khao Man Som Tum, those unfamiliar with it might say the papaya salad was sweet, but that's actually the correct flavor for Khao Man Som Tum. The rice was fragrant and delicious, and it paired well with the sweet papaya salad. It came with three pieces of fried chicken and shredded pork.

Restaurant Atmosphere: It felt like eating in a royal family home. The house was a modern/mid-century style, with air conditioning and a restroom.

Staff: They gave off a real homey feeling, very friendly and like a genuine family business. However, sometimes I felt the staff were talking amongst themselves a bit too loudly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Earth Thanavie

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went for dinner, which made finding the restaurant almost impossible. There was no sign at the entrance, and the surroundings looked like it was under a highway pillar. Luckily, Google Maps helped us dare to turn in despite the darkness and dusty road. The service felt like a family business; there was no structured approach like a restaurant with trained staff. The employees just did their jobs without much consideration for customer feelings, but they were polite.

We intended to try the Khanom Jeen Sao Nam and the Nam Ya (rice noodles with coconut milk and fish balls).

We waited quite a while, but the food was served in a very good presentation. Large plates, served as a set with all the condiments clearly separated. The rice noodles were fragrant and chewy. The coconut milk with fish balls was bland, like drinking milk; we had to add chili and fish sauce. The other side dishes were good and up to standard. Overall, the flavors were bland and not as intense as we hoped. Adding more fish balls and dried shrimp would have made the meal more enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samphant Ponvilawan

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are seeking an exceptional dining experience that encapsulates the true essence of Thai cuisine, look no further than Banya Thai Restaurant & Home Cooking. Located in the heart of Nonthaburi, this culinary haven is a perfect blend of tradition and excellence.

Upon entering this charming old house restaurant, guests are immediately enveloped in a cozy and welcoming atmosphere that sets the stage for a remarkable meal. The menu at Banya Thai Restaurant offers a tantalizing array of authentic Thai dishes that are a celebration of flavor, freshness, and creativity.

It comes as no surprise that Banya Thai Restaurant & Home Cooking has garnered recognition from Michelin, a testament to the exceptional quality and authenticity of the dishes served here. The attentive and friendly staff further enhance the dining experience, ensuring that every guest feels like a cherished member of the Banya family.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been a regular customer at this restaurant since I was a kid. It's a traditional Thai restaurant with delicious, high-quality food. But this time I was extremely disappointed. The service was incredibly slow; after 40 minutes, the food still hadn't arrived. The Khanom Jeen Sao Nam (rice noodles with coconut milk sauce) was served at the wrong table, and only after I had almost finished my meal did they bring the boiled egg. Furthermore, the green curry chicken was replaced with green curry fish. Having been a regular customer before, I will definitely not be coming back. The service quality has deteriorated significantly, and the food quality has also declined; it's not as delicious as it used to be.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shrimpy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered 4 dishes.
I only liked one: Grandma's Crispy Rice Noodles. The filling, a mix of coconut and shrimp, was well-made, and the dipping sauce enhanced the sweetness.

The Khanom Jeen (rice noodles) was different because of the addition of snakehead fish to the coconut milk broth.

The Larb Noodles had the larb (spicy minced meat salad) incorporated into the rice noodle sheets.

The Khao Chae (rice in chilled broth) was good, but the rice grains were just average.

The service staff needs to improve their approach to customer service.
When customers pay, they should look at them and respond in a friendly manner.
The dining atmosphere would be improved if this were the case.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลุงเสือ แม่ริม

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not so good, not too bad. Simply Thai food, not authentic, but they offer a variety of traditional and local dishes for everyone in the family.

- The staff are lovely, and the atmosphere is warm, like eating at Grandma's house.
- But Grandma who hasn't cooked in a long time >_<! If you don't have high expectations, you won't be disappointed.
Khao Chae (rice in chilled broth): The rice is fragrant and refreshing, but the fried toppings are quite soggy and oily.
Kraprao (Thai pancake): The dough is delicious and flavorful, but the filling is average.
Khao Soi Larb (spicy minced meat salad): The noodles are thick, the larb isn't flavorful, and the filling is terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phimchanok YoYo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baan Ya Tiwanon – Michelin-Level Royal Thai Cuisine

This traditional Thai restaurant excels in both taste and atmosphere. Every dish is meticulously prepared using authentic royal recipes, such as Khao Chae (rice in chilled broth), Larb Wrapped Noodles, and Khanom Bueang (Thai crepes). The atmosphere is warm and inviting, like a traditional Thai home, with friendly service. It truly deserves its Michelin Guide award. Perfect for those who love authentic Thai food in a warm, homey setting, like dining at a friend's house.
sample_reviews_en.author: TEERUNYAPUN V.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, the food tasted average, rather sweet. The plating and presentation were appealing.
- The salad looked unusual, using Miang Kham sauce as a dressing.
- The "One Day Potato" dish was unique, but it seemed to have been fried a bit too long, resulting in a burnt smell when eaten, and the potatoes were served a dark brown color.
- The Beef Jaew dish was the most disappointing; the beef was extremely tough, to the point of being inedible. I had to spit it out and stopped eating the rest of the dish.
- The marinated chicken tasted good and was tender, but the flavor was predominantly sweet.
- Beef Wellington, on average.

The restaurant is located by the roadside with no parking. It's a small place with only a few tables and does not accept credit cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: SH

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was totally and pleasantly surprised by this small, unassuming restaurant! I live very close by and have walked past it many times without really noticing, so the surprise was all the more delightful.

The ambiance is really pleasant, the music perfectly suited the mood—both the genre and the volume were just right. A super relaxed atmosphere.

The pasta with tomato sauce and shrimp was sensationally good, one of the best dishes I've had here so far. There was a bit of a small amount of pasta, but the shrimp were generous, and ordering extra spaghetti made up for it perfectly. The staff was also incredibly friendly and attentive.

The menu looks very interesting overall; there's definitely a lot to discover. I'll definitely be back in the next few days!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marcus Walter (Smartphone Video Coach)

sample_reviews_en.text: Absoloutley brilliant find! Love this kind of cuisine, it's the type of cuisine that comes from passion and real culinary backround, the people that run this obviously have both alot of passion and understanding of what they are doing, and it shows creativity and thought. All the food I have ate here since finding Kler has been excellent. The vibe in the restaurant is great and service too. Must go try ! I have now been twice since in 2 weeks since I first came across this restaurant and il be going again on Sunday with some friends, and I have a few other friends that went a few days ago after me recommending. They also loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Travel4food with Chef Jake

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, perfect for a date. The food was served quickly and tasted delicious. The pasta was perfectly al dente. The grilled mushrooms and the on-the-day potato dish were the best. On the day we went, we inquired about the seating time because we were considering ordering a bottle of wine. The restaurant informed us that they have reservation slots for tables, which limits the dining time. Personally, I felt like we were rushed and had to be mindful of the time allotted for our meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: AnŸ

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't usually come around this area, but I was here for errands today so I decided to try this place. The food was really good. The duck breast salad was well-made; everything in it was a great combination. The truffle pasta was delicious, the sweet potato fries were tasty, and the three-ingredient fried rice was perfectly cooked with beautifully separated grains. Even the basic dishes were good. I was very impressed. If I have the chance to be in this area again, I will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: pommie pm

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! I liked the fish dish and the salad the most. The salad was refreshing, and they had a selection of daily specials for the fish, which was grilled deliciously and tasty even just with salt. The duck pesto pasta was also fragrant and delicious. The desserts were refreshing, I especially liked the passion fruit! The atmosphere was nice, perfect for hanging out with friends. The staff were attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutikhan Na Songkhla

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai-fusion cuisine with a variety of unique menu items at quite reasonable prices!

- Best salmon Sriracha mayo in town.
- Steak cooked beautifully.
- Cold tofu is also very nice — soft and tender.
- Another must-try dish is the Kanom Taan waffle with coconut ice cream. The waffle thingy smelled insanely good! 🥺

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was amazing! The fried rice was smoky and flavorful, with juicy beef and a perfect lava egg on top. The seabass  had crispy skin and tender meat, while the green sauce pasta was fresh and paired beautifully with the roasted duck. Great service and a lovely atmosphere—I’ll definitely be back!

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨Isaan Food Festival in Progress😋
.....This Isaan restaurant is located under the expressway. It's right by the road, and the view from the road is quite ordinary. There's limited parking in front, although it might look a bit messy right now due to road construction.
.....But once you walk inside, the atmosphere is great. There's a pond, a bridge, a fountain, lotus flowers, and many gazebos to sit in, giving it a countryside feel. There's also live music with male and female singers alternating, performing popular Luk Thung (Thai country) songs. They have great voices, making it much more enjoyable than listening to music from YouTube.
.....The Isaan food is diverse, served quickly, and delicious. The prices are reasonable. I've been there three times already, and the service is always good. There might be some insects or mosquitoes, but they provide insect repellent and fans in the gazebos.
sample_reviews_en.author: tae true

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious Isaan food, good atmosphere.
The day I went, there were a lot of customers, and the food came out a bit slow.
- Salmon wrapped in shrimp was delicious, with fresh, crispy shrimp. The dipping sauce was a perfect match for the food, so I ordered three more.
- Papaya salad, very flavorful, spicy, and the fermented fish was fragrant and creamy.
- Papaya salad with thin noodles, perfectly cooked.
- Spicy salad, spicy.
- Fried fish with crispy lemongrass, fragrant.
- Fried rice, well-fried, fragrant with the sauce and pan-fried sauce.
- Jaew hon, beautifully presented, fresh food, and generous portions.
**. The jaew hon soup was light in flavor, but the jaew hon dipping sauce was a bit lacking in flavor.
- It was dark and crowded with mosquitoes, so I asked the staff for mosquito repellent.
- The restaurant has a nice, shady atmosphere, and parking is available in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: อาหารเป็นมิตร FoodFriendly

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious Isan-style food, cutely presented on plates, served under banana leaves. The crab fried rice was fragrant and delicious, but the tom zaap had a slightly bland soup flavor. Everything else was delicious. I recommend the som tam, which was tasty. The atmosphere was nice, with a garden and waterfall. There were many cute corners to choose from. If you go in the evening, there are a few mosquitoes, but there are mosquito coils. The natural scenery is beautifully decorated. Playing classic Thai music would be better than playing remixes or pure Isan music. There are also instruments for small children. Overall, I really like it. I recommend coming to eat. I like the atmosphere and the taste of the food.

customers like us...

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a regular customer, visiting 2-3 times a month. Recently, a car backed into mine and then fled. I've already had the repairs done myself and I'm too lazy to follow up.

sample_reviews_en.text: Cheap (but good) eats in the Siam shopping district are becoming harder to find. Rising rents and chain restaurants are become more prevalent so thank goodness for Nual Chan Real Thai Noodles by Linda. Sitting on the 2nd floor of the Bangkok Arts and Cultural Center, this cute, no frills noodle shop serves delicious Tom yum and other noodle dishes for 55 to 70 baht! A bargain for the area and added bonus it’s indoors with air conditioning. Quality is high and the shop is busy at lunch time, popular with students and office workers alike.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located on the second floor of the Bangkok Art and Culture Center, this is a great place to grab a quick meal. The food comes out quick and fresh. Some of the staff members speak English so it is foreigner friendly. I got the egg noodles with beef for 65baht. The beef was a little on the tough side but the broth was AMAZING.
Overall, I would recommend trying this spot if you’re already inside the Art and Culture center.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bryanna H.

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped by Nualchan Real Thai Noodle on the 2nd floor of BACC. Went for the boat noodle soup with a clear broth base, rice noodles, and pork toppings including sliced sausage, cilantro, and garlic. Simple, comforting, and nicely balanced. Paired it with a refreshing lemongrass pandan drink, which worked perfectly alongside the noodles. A nice little stop when exploring Bangkok Art & Culture Centre.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text: The boat noodles have a mild flavor that's not overpowering, and the taste improves with seasoning. The portion is generous; the picture shows the special order, which is quite large. The restaurant is located on the second floor of the Bangkok Art Gallery. There's a moderate amount of seating, and the atmosphere is quiet and pleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanat PREMSATIT

sample_reviews_en.text: Stepping into this Noodle Shop is a delight. The cold AC is instantly refreshing, and the noodles? Bursting with flavor and just the right amount of spice. Prices are impressively low for this area, making it easy to enjoy without guilt. Friendly service rounds out the experience, leaving you already planning your next visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chu Chu

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't expect to find amazing noodle soup here in the art and culture centre. The soup is bursting with flavours and the glass noodles are chewy and bouncy. For 55 baht per bowl, it's so worth the journey and I'm going to regret not ordering more. I had the pork clear soup noodle.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yumi Mok

sample_reviews_en.text: 🙄🙄🙄👎👎👎 They took my order wrong. I ordered one regular and one special, but they made two specials. When I paid, they said I'd already eaten some. Why didn't I complain? Like, how am I supposed to know?💁 This isn't my fault, and if this were America, I would sue. 😛🙄
sample_reviews_en.author: Khemjira Kittisurin

sample_reviews_en.text: I just found out the art gallery has such delicious noodles! A small bowl of spicy noodle soup is only 55 baht, with plenty of pork and chewy, soft noodles – so tasty! 👍🏻 I highly recommend it if you're visiting; it's on the 2nd floor. The owner is so lovely! ☺️ …
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanchanok P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The air-conditioned room is cool and the food is delicious. Stir-fried minced beef with basil, stir-fried minced pork with basil, pork with garlic, and hot steamed rice. 4 people can share the cost.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mo_ Mo

It's an air-conditioned restaurant with soft music playing.

sample_reviews_en.author: เกศรา แซ่อึ้ง

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is near the accommodation. The food is delicious. The staff provides good service. I recommend it.

sample_reviews_en.text: There are plenty of seats in the restaurant, the air conditioning is cool, and the wait for food is not long.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. The restaurant is air-conditioned and comfortable. The service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchai Kumchuysin

restaurants.name: Rosirin Café & Bar รสสิรินท์ร by เวียงใต้
restaurants.address:

237 Thanon Tanao, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Run away, it's a scam with appalling customer service! It's February 6th, 2026, and I ask in the afternoon what time dinner is served until. I'm told 9 PM and if I can pay by credit card. I'm told yes, starting at 300 baht. Out of respect for the staff, I arrive later that evening at 8:18 PM and order a cocktail, a club sandwich, and a bottled beer. The club sandwiches arrive a little while later. I start eating, and at 8:50 PM, an older woman comes to tell me I have to pay immediately! I explain that I haven't finished eating, but she insists! Overcome by her urgent desire to leave, I finally go to pay, and then I'm told I have to pay in cash, plus an additional 17% tax and service charge! I know the owner will tell me it's written on the menu... Yes, that's true, but you practically need a magnifying glass to read it, it's so small! Seeing that I wasn't happy, they gave me a 27 baht discount on my bill, but it's the only restaurant I went to in Bangkok during my week-long stay where they charge you 17% extra tax and kick you out as closing time approaches. I will NEVER go back!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phil Tchek

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem in Central Bangkok. Serving Thai and international dishes at reasonable prices.

This colonial-style house, likely over 100 years old, has been renovated into a homey restaurant in the garden. It offers a serene atmosphere and classic Thai cuisine.

The food is great. Some dishes are spicy, but generally very tasty. We had a pleasant time.

If you're visiting Bangkok and in the area, I highly recommend this place.

Ample parking and friendly staff.

The restaurant is incredibly charming, like stepping back in time to a beautiful and peaceful era. There's ample parking and several seating areas to choose from. The food is delicious, with a delicate flavor – not too salty or spicy, a uniquely delicious taste I've never experienced before.

I highly recommend trying it! I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Malinee Ron

sample_reviews_en.text:
A surprising random find. Genuine quality across the board.

I found Rosirin by chance. I selected three dishes completely at random, and while I would not dare assume these are their absolute best offerings, they were already excellent. It speaks volumes about the kitchen's consistency.

Highlights:
• Shrimp Paste Fried Rice (Khao Kluk Kapi): Executed perfectly. The rice was evenly mixed with the paste. The fried chili provided a wonderful aroma and a distinct "hot" sensation without burning the mouth.
• Green Curry Fried Rice with Crispy Gourami: The texture was fantastic. The fish was fried to perfection and boneless.
• Appetizers: A great showcase of "old-time" sweets. Hard to find ones made with this level of care.

I will definitely be coming back to try the rest of the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gawin J

sample_reviews_en.text: What a fantastic dining experience! The food was absolutely delicious, full of vibrant and authentic flavors that made every dish memorable. The restaurant itself is beautiful, creating a welcoming and enjoyable atmosphere. Our waiter was knowledgeable, attentive, and provided excellent recommendations that enhanced our meal. Everything we ordered was outstanding, with fresh ingredients and bold, well-balanced flavors. To top it all off, the prices were very reasonable for the quality of food and service offered. Overall, it was a truly enjoyable experience, and I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for great food in a lovely setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abeer Ajounli

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely brilliant experiance. All staff were so kind and our waitress Oil made our visit so special (she even made me a custom strawberry matcha). The food was incredible. We had a Pad Thai (best in Thailand) and a Tom Yum, both fantastic! There was also beautiful soft karaoke going on and although there seemed to be a big wedding/ event at the time of our visit, we were still treated so well and we felt very welcomed. The owner (we think) even came to check in with us and made the experience very personable.  Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: harriet Johnson

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in a small alley in the old town area and they has enough parking space. The first impression when arriving is the polite and warm service from the staff. The introduction of drinks and food is professional. The decoration of the plate and the taste of the food show great delicacy and care. As for the dessert, it makes this meal a perfect end. Coming to this restaurant is not just to taste delicious food, but to open up an impressive dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chakrapan Panyarachun

sample_reviews_en.text: Classic Thai restaurant. When it comes to food. Apart from that it comes with a few surprises. The garden and old mansion setting by the Khlong…find. That‘s something you expect. Although it is surprising to find such a spacious place in this otherwise very dense area. But what was really surprising was the Friday afternoon karaoke session. Super random. In the garden. At 1pm. At 34 degrees. But it added to the charm. And the food was very good too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very pleasant place, like a small oasis in the middle of Bangkok’s hustle and bustle. It has a beautiful patio terrace, perfect for relaxing and enjoying a quiet meal.
The food is delicious and the staff are incredibly friendly. The waitress who served me was lovely and very helpful with recommendations.
A great spot to enjoy a calm and enjoyable dining experience. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: fanny bessonnat

Review from a visit in 2024

Enjoy!

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first impression was negative.
1. The food was very slow. I arrived a little after 1 AM and didn't get my first dish until 2:10 AM.
2. I ordered a margarita but received a vodka + blue Hawaiian mix, and then waited an hour and 5 minutes for just one margarita.
3. I raised my hand to call a staff member. Several staff members were serving other tables. I turned to the other side of the restaurant and raised my hand. As soon as I raised my hand, the staff member saw me but turned away, pretending not to see me, and deflected by talking to their friend. I'm usually very laid-back when eating out, but this restaurant was my first and last time there. That's it.
sample_reviews_en.author: ดาริสา กงล้อม

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the atmosphere was great, but I'd like to see improvements in the cleanliness of the waitstaff. During my visit, I encountered a waitress—I'm not sure if she was a woman or transgender person—who was large, had long hair, and a rather strong body odor. I was enjoying my meal, but her bringing water ruined my mood. Overall, everything else was good, but please consider making these improvements. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Bee Bii

sample_reviews_en.text: The welcome was good, and there were plenty of tables to choose from. The service was good, but the restroom was extremely dirty. There was toilet paper on the floor, none available, and no cleaning staff. The restroom was truly unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุภาพร บุตรสาลี

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place seems to be the only 24-hour spot nearby.
The prices are reasonable and the food is delicious, so I’d definitely recommend coming here.
The downside is that once you buy alcohol, you can’t cancel it even if it hasn’t been opened.
sample_reviews_en.author: DENNIS

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was served very slowly, and honestly, it didn't taste good at all. The service was terrible; they were inattentive and unsure about anything, even answers questions without knowing the answer. The atmosphere was just average.
sample_reviews_en.author: MR.Nasachon Khumdee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is so slow. If it's not ready, just say so. If it's not available, just say so. You made me wait for so long. I've been waiting for 3 hours and now I can go home without eating. This is how customers feel. 😡😡 …
sample_reviews_en.author: อธิชา ทับผา

sample_reviews_en.text: Getting the bill took forever! Even asking for takeout took a long time. Food came out a little slow too. I'm adding an extra star because the restrooms were clean and the atmosphere was nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattamon Nakthong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and affordable, the waitstaff provided excellent service, and the atmosphere was great. If you like a chill, relaxing place to hang out, this is the place for you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kornwalai

restaurants.address:

Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
🏡 This royal-style restaurant is a small, single-story establishment located on a quiet street, seating approximately 10 tables. The interior is simply decorated in a retro style.

🚗 There is parking available in front of the restaurant for about 4-5 cars.

👉🏻 They have a menu with some dishes, but not as extensive as some other branches.
- Salted Fish Fried Rice (250฿): The taste was good, but I was quite disappointed as the rice was soggy and, more importantly, it didn't seem worth the price. There was very little salted fish, and the presentation wasn't very appealing.

💰 Prices are relatively high.
sample_reviews_th.author: oHo oHo

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant, "Lai Rot" (Many Flavors), truly lives up to its name. I recently brought a group of friends here because they love their stir-fried sataw (bitter beans) – the rich, intense flavor is perfect for us southerners. Lai Rot is a restaurant we always take our foreign friends to when they visit, because we're tired of eating at malls. It's a fun drive here, the owner is kind, and the staff are excellent. Our friends, especially the older ladies, say the food tastes like royal cuisine. It makes me so happy! We even celebrate our wedding anniversary here because the food is truly delicious, living up to its name.
sample_reviews_en.author: gai sirisamphand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were friendly, and the food was delicious, especially the royal-style rice in chilled broth. I specifically came to eat here, as it's an old, established restaurant. One serving of rice in chilled broth is enough for 1-2 people; if you're sharing with a group, you can order other dishes to share. The price might be a little high, but it's worth the visit.
The restaurant isn't large, and there's parking for about 7-8 cars in front. There aren't many tables, and when there are groups of customers, it can get a bit noisy, which might disturb other tables. Playing music would create a better atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phichet Kanogsirima

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old, Michelin-awarded Thai restaurant that has received awards for several years. It serves authentic Thai cuisine, including royal court dishes. A must-try is the Khao Chae (rice in chilled water), a refreshing and fragrant dish that pairs perfectly with the side dishes. The Khao Man Som Tum (rice with papaya salad) and Gaeng Gai (chicken curry) are also delicious. The restaurant has a small number of tables, is clean, and has a simple atmosphere. There is limited parking in front, but more parking is available at the gas station next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichanan I

sample_reviews_en.text:
A traditional Thai restaurant, perfect for Thai food lovers. Stop by for an evening meal with friends; they offer both individual dishes and sharing platters.

The restaurant is small, with a cozy, traditional Thai feel.
The Thai food is authentic, though the flavors might be a little mild, but still delicious. I personally loved the Chinese sausage in the chicken rice and the stewed pork.

There's a wide selection of desserts to choose from, delicious and not too sweet – just the right way to finish off the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: nys

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely enjoyed this authentic Thai food & restaurant!  We liked Mee Krob the most and Khao Chae was so refreshing.  Each dish was flavourful and good quality of ingredients.  I just knew Lai Ros is also one of Michelin and well-deserved apparently.  The place and vibe was very cozy like we were having lunch at home.  Staff were very attentive.  Highly recommended!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aom K

sample_reviews_en.text:
The prices are quite high compared to the food and service.

The Khao Chae (rice in fragrant broth) is 450 baht; the broth is refreshing and fragrant. The sweet fish, shredded pork, bell peppers, and shrimp paste balls are okay. The stuffed fish is just average.

The Pranburi-style salted fish fried rice is 250 baht; it's delicious but expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: JJ Chayapong

sample_reviews_en.text: I found a long hair in my water spinach salad. I immediately informed the staff. There was no apology; they just took the rice and salad away and made a new dish for me. That was it. I couldn't eat it anymore, so I asked them to put it in a doggy bag to take home. The green curry was just okay, but the salad was delicious. What a shame.
sample_reviews_en.author: May Rin

sample_reviews_en.text: A highly recommended place to Indian travellers who are staying near Bangkok khao sang road, high quality food, drinking in the restaurant options are available but family people don't have to worry about it, …

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a horrible Masala Dosa which was filled with a tiny bit of potatoes. I'm not a big eater but that wasn't enough for me. Got stomach cramps half an hour later. No tissue provided! Wouldn't go there again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Isa Van Haag

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was so great.. if you are bothered by the smell of Thai food then definitely come here.. we tried tea and paratha 🤍 so great the staff was so good the manager is from Gujarat the hotel is a Gujarati

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic and very satisfying Indian vegetarian thali. The food felt fresh, balanced, and full of flavor, without being too heavy/spicy. One of the best thalis I’ve had in a long time.

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved this restaurant: ultra-fast service, perfectly seasoned and flavorful dishes. The staff is welcoming and efficient, ideal for a quality meal without waiting.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's been a long time since I ate at Yayoi. The prices have gone up, and the quality and quantity have decreased. This branch was already small before. This set probably costs 300 baht + a little more, and you could get much better pieces of sashimi at a nicer restaurant. I've ordered online before, and it was the same – not impressive. This is my second time eating here in almost 6 years, and I probably won't eat here again.

**I forgot to mention that I ate at the Robinson Bang Rak branch once. The food was excellent, the portions were appropriate, and it looked very appetizing. I wonder what the standard is anyway. But I've been very unimpressed with the Central Rama 3 branch since I was in middle school until now, almost 30.**
sample_reviews_en.author: Ary L

sample_reviews_en.text:
We've eaten here with our family many times. The place is spacious and clean. The staff are kind, polite, and have a genuine service mindset.
(One male staff member is especially kind to children; we've seen it every time we've been here.)
It's suitable for young children, even those aged 2-3 years old. They have children's meal sets, and the staff are attentive.
The mall itself is also ideal for bringing young children. It has spacious and clean children's restrooms, a changing room for mothers, and wide walkways for strollers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poonyaporn Bo.

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on the 5th floor, near the glass elevator. It's quite large and there was no queue. You can order food yourself via tablet. The staff were very attentive and provided excellent service. We ordered refillable green tea and the staff kept refilling it for us. After we finished our set meal, when the staff came to clear the plates and noticed we hadn't eaten the salad, they informed us that if we didn't like the salad next time, we could change it to something else. That was great!
sample_reviews_en.author: J Phinun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The male staff member (young, around 50 years old) was polite, enthusiastic, and provided excellent service. He informed me of promotions and free food options without holding back or holding back.
I've been eating at this branch for many years and see him every time.
I admire and thank him for his dedication and consistency. Customers can feel it.
The food is up to standard, both in taste and price. It's reasonable and I can eat there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe Fo

sample_reviews_en.text: Japanese restaurent  central rama3 brunch where serve fast japanese foods with moderate price. The taste of food is ok. Today i ordered tempura tendon with 99 thb which is promotion price. In the past, this restaurent come with cheap price concept for japanese food but right now it was higher than in the past. However it is acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maethinee Proetpraywong

sample_reviews_en.text: All the staff were lovely, but I'd like to commend the male staff member who promptly checked on our food without us having to ask and kept refilling our water glasses. Very impressed! If you come during peak hours, the food might be a little slow, but that's understandable given the limited number of staff. Keep up the good work!
sample_reviews_en.author: Barry Chitranukroh

sample_reviews_en.text:
In terms of taste and freshness, I must say the food is excellent. The rice is soft but not too mushy, with a nice, round grain texture in your mouth.
The hot plate grilled beef with rice is also delicious, stir-fried with a very flavorful sauce. It comes with a salad that complements the beef and miso soup to wash it down.

The food was good! super delicious
BUT This is the first time in my life the waitress didn’t speak a word with her service! bad service ! Make me feel so uncomfortable. And when I just sat on the table she stood there silently immediately didn’t give me or other costumers time to read menu, taking a note and when I finished order she walking away so confused if waitress even get my order?!! When she was serving food just put it on table no word again… “ขออนุญาตเสริฟนะคะ” non of that! I’ll never go back there again if she still there or a services still being like this
sample_reviews_th.author: Viv Skull

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dining room on the ground floor of Gateway offers a mix of Japanese and Thai dishes. The environment is clean and quite tastefully decorated, only the tables could be a little bigger to make the seating a little more comfortable.

The service is fast, but completely disinterested. Maybe robots could serve here, since it is a Japanese restaurant/chain, the experience would definitely be more interesting.

From the menu we chose Tom Yum with pork and marinated fried chicken wings, plus a pretty good iced green tea. The food here is great, even spectacularly served, but the taste of the soup was so flat that after a few hours of visiting the restaurant I had to search my memory deeply to remember its taste. That probably says it all.
The wings were definitely better than the soup. The very tasty marinade and well-fried meat definitely improved the impression of the soup.
However, even good wings didn't earn a rating higher than a three.
Too bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kena Groot

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hachiban Ramen @ Gateway Ekkamai
138 THB

The portion is rather small, but I appreciate being able to get tsukemen outside of Japan.

The broth is slightly spicy, topped with scallions and a small amount of meat. A squeeze of manao (Thai lime) adds a nice citrus accent.

Overall, it’s decent—neither outstanding nor disappointing. It would be better with thicker noodles and more bite, but at this price point, it feels fair.

Hachiban Ramen @ Gateway Ekkamai
138 THB

The portion is small, but it's nice to be able to eat tsukemen in a foreign country.
The soup is a little spicy, with green onions and a little meat?
The manao adds a nice accent.
It's neither good nor bad. The noodles would be even more delicious if they were chewier and thicker, but I guess it's worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aldo Yamada

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a Japanese ramen shop in Gateway Ekkamai that's frequented by locals, and occasionally you see some Caucasians there too. It's often full during lunchtime on weekdays, with customers lining up to wait. It seems Japanese ramen is fairly well-received in Thailand. The ramen itself is pretty ordinary, but the taste is decent. I've never eaten at Hachiban Ramen in Japan, though. I ordered the Tonkotsu Chashu Ramen. As everyone has pointed out, the amount of noodles is a little on the small side, probably in line with the portion size of Thai Kuay Tiao. It's probably been Thai-ized.
sample_reviews_en.author: A

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located in Gateway Ekamai Mall, near the Max Valu exit door, there's a decent amount of seating available. However, if you come during lunch or dinner time, you might have to wait in line (the staff will provide paper queue tickets, so don't forget to ask for one).

Open from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM, the food is served reasonably quickly, tastes good, and meets the restaurant's standards. The staff are polite and courteous.

For those who like a bit of spice, I recommend the Kara-men or the Tonkotsu Tantammen 🌶.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tote Varisorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Having already liked Kakuni, I was immediately intrigued when I saw Hachiban had this on the menu, and I had the chance to try it the other day.

"Kakuni Ramen": The kakuni was soft and sweet, which was okay, but the broth was bland and oily, which was a bit unexpected. I'll try it at another branch when I have the chance.

"Gomoku Ramen": I thought this would be similar to Champon, as it said "with gravy," but it was actually just a thin, dark-colored sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kung S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
• A soul food of Japan's Hokuriku region (especially Ishikawa and Fukui prefectures).

• It's best to eat it as a new genre called "8ban Ramen" (8th Ramen) rather than just ramen (ramen) (🍜).

• The price range is cheaper than in Japan, which is a pleasant surprise.

• Recommended dishes are miso ramen and fried rice.

⚠️ Some people may feel a gap between their expectations and reality if they go expecting typical ramen. Please be aware of this.
sample_reviews_en.author: たそまる

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw a ramen chain from my hometown and decided to stop in. 

They had dishes like tom yum goong ramen, which probably doesn't exist in Japan, but personally I wasn't impressed. 

They also didn't have the typical "thick noodle vegetable ramen," and instead had thin noodles like a Chinese noodle shop. 

My order was forgotten, so it was a bit of a disappointing experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuki Tsuboi

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is near Ton Tam Thai, the other restaurant is called Ton Tam Thai 2. Tour buses can park in the Thai police parking lot; parking is free if you eat here, but you have to pay 100 baht if you come for a massage. The food portions seem quite small, with only a few dishes on the menu, but the prices are excessive. I think you should increase the portion sizes and perhaps offer a parking fee for the drivers so they'll bring tour groups more often. Please pass this message on; share the food, don't eat and not share, or you won't have any customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiattichai Sanjek

sample_reviews_en.text: The food quality is poor and suitable for Chinese tour groups, but they should really prepare better food because the tour groups are paying for food. It's mostly vegetables, which should impress Chinese tourists more.

sample_reviews_en.text: The meal for Chinese tourists was a buffet; the taste was average, and there was a brief Thai folk performance during the meal.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is specially opened for Chinese tour groups. The food tastes average and suits Chinese tastes.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was okay, mostly Chinese cuisine, but it was too crowded and chaotic, so the quality was average.
sample_reviews_en.author: nan null

restaurants.name: สว่างบะหมี่ก้ามปูรุ่น3 เอกมัย - sawangnoodle ekkamai16
restaurants.address:

192 6 Ekkamai Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Sawang Noodle (สว่างบะหมี่ก้ามปูรุ่น3) in Ekkamai is a great spot for a comforting bowl of noodles with a bit extra.

I ordered the tom yum noodles with shrimp wontons, BBQ pork, and crab meat. The combination worked really well—the broth had a nice balance of spicy, sour, and savory flavors, and the toppings added good texture and richness.

Also had a longan juice on the side, which was refreshing and paired nicely with the meal.

The place is clean, the service is friendly, and the overall experience was very enjoyable. Highly recommended if you’re around Ekkamai and looking for flavorful tom yum noodles.
sample_reviews_th.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Speaking as someone who has lived in Ekamai for a long time, I would rate this as the best noodle shop in the area. The egg noodles here are much tastier than those at Bami Seri near Thong Lo Station.

This is a branch location, while the main branch is a famous establishment featured in the Michelin Guide.

It is an excellent place for those who love Bami (egg noodles), and also a great spot for beginners to try it for the first time.

The toppings are also superb.

When ordering, order the cheapest option, No. 1, and request it without broth. (The broth is served separately.)

Try the basic version first, and if you like it, then try the menu items with slightly more expensive toppings.

However, the Tom Yum broth is quite rich, so it might not suit everyone's taste.

I recommend trying the brothless version for first-timers.
sample_reviews_en.author: 테디의소소하고 맛있는 방콕

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sawang Noodle shops are Michelin guide-listed noodle spots in Bangkok. This small, unassuming shop on Ekamai has limited seating, so large groups may need to wait. However, the wait is well worth it for their delicious take on traditional wantan mee.

The BBQ pork and Crab are specialties of the house and price depends on small, medium or large Crab claws. The soup is deliciously smooth and crab delicately sweet.

The noodles are cooked to perfection, with a fragrant twist - they're tossed in fried onion oil, adding a depth of flavor. Unlike typical wantan mee, which uses dark soy sauce, these noodles are lightly colored, allowing the natural flavors to shine through. Family friendly, great service and location... this Sawang Noodle offers great soups at affordable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: chad svastisalee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Noodles more for Thai palate than Chinese style. Ordered the standard char siew or roast pork noodles with wanton - only one wanton.

The serving was decent with 5-6 pieces of char siew but just one wanton. The soup was extremely peppery .. pepper soup. Wanton was hardened. The noodles were starchy and carries a factory after taste ..The only saving grace was the char siew which was decently tasty like what char siew should be.

Total disappointment …
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark mk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Been wanting to try this for a while, and finally got to! 🤣
Dry Noodles with Charcoal-Grilled Pork 🐽: The noodles are thin, chewy, and delicious. The charcoal-grilled pork is amazing.
Sichuan Pork Dumplings 🥟🐽: 6 pieces for 100 baht.
Young Coconut Pudding 🥥: The best young coconut pudding I've ever had! 👍🏻 Fragrant and sweet, a great palate cleanser. They really used coconut flesh to make the pudding. Absolutely not to be missed! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Pung Chu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered delivery via Grab.
The only thing similar to the Si Phraya branch is the noodles. Everything else is different. The dumplings are bigger, but they only have a strong soy sauce and pepper flavor. The char siu pork doesn't have that honey aroma at all. And especially the soup, the taste is terrible. It lacks any aroma. It looks good, but the taste is awful. I won't order again. Very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: N Esr

sample_reviews_en.text: Originally, I was going to go to Watanapanit, but it was closed, so I was looking around and the smell of a delicious restaurant wafted in, so I went there~ It was more delicious than I thought~ The problem was that they only accepted cash, so since it was the last day of my trip, I ran out of cash and had to go through the trouble of going to the bank in front to exchange money~
sample_reviews_en.author: 한아름

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the other location of the same Michelin bib gourmand store.
Get the Noodles with shrimp wonton, bbq pork, and crab claws and order it dry to get the full experience.
Shrimp wonton was excellent, bbq pork was tender with the right amount of flavor, the crab claws was fresh, and the dry noodles packed a punch.
Definitely coming back again
sample_reviews_en.author: Billy Chen

restaurants.name: MoMo Grill & Izakaya
restaurants.address:

45/74-76 ม.10 Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is a favorite! For meat lovers, you absolutely can't miss it. The meat is tender, juicy, and flavorful. Most importantly, the beer is incredibly refreshing – perfectly paired with the meat! 🍺 The atmosphere is great, comfortable, and spacious. The staff are friendly, smiling, and attentive. Plus, there's convenient parking, no need to worry about finding a spot.

This restaurant has it all: great taste, atmosphere, and service. I highly recommend it to anyone who hasn't been here yet.

====================

This place is absolutely a favorite of mine. If you’re a beef lover, you definitely shouldn’t miss it. The meat is tender, juicy, and full of flavor—perfectly cooked and incredibly satisfying 🤤
And the beer? Ice-cold and super refreshing 🍺 It pairs perfectly with the meat—such a great combo. The atmosphere is also great comfortable seating, not crowded, and very relaxing. The staff are friendly, attentive, and provide excellent service. Plus, there’s convenient parking, so no need to stress about finding a spot.
Overall, this place has it all: amazing food, great atmosphere, and top-notch service.
Highly recommended for anyone who hasn’t been here yet
sample_reviews_en.author: oliver richard

sample_reviews_en.text:
⚠️Service:
-The food came out extremely slowly. There were only 4 tables occupied in the whole restaurant. We finished eating and the food still hadn't all arrived.
-The grill's heat was very weak. Shouldn't the staff be watching? For a restaurant at this price, the service should be more attentive. The staff were clustered in a corner of the restaurant; we had to wave our hands 360 degrees to get their attention.
⚠️Taste: Most of the dishes were bland. The yakisoba, miso-braised beef, and the Zabuton wagyu set were the best. The others were just average. The sushi pieces were large, which was good.

This kind of service will probably be our only visit. They should improve if they want to sell at this price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patchakul Yimngam

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are unreasonable for the portion sizes. I ordered the salmon rice bowl for 188 baht, and the piece of salmon looked much bigger in the menu picture. The kimchi soup was also in a tiny bowl. The mixed beef set for 1200 baht only had 4 pieces of each beef. The beef was supposed to be A4 and A5 grade, and it tasted good, but there was very little of it. I also ordered pork belly and pork neck, and those were also very small pieces.😅 The rice was ordered in a bucket, advertised as enough for 2-3 people, but in reality, it was probably only enough for one person because they gave a separate bowl for the rice, like a dipping sauce bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanittha K.

sample_reviews_en.text: I called to ask and was told the last order was at midnight. I arrived at the restaurant at 23:55 and was told it was closed. So, it should have meant the last order was at midnight, right? That way I wouldn't have had to rush driving there. I even called twice to double-check. It was frustrating; the staff wasn't great. I understood that "last order" meant ordering and finishing within a specified time frame, not after midnight, and then getting the bill immediately. But when I arrived, the restaurant was already closed.
sample_reviews_en.author: ANTHIYA A.

sample_reviews_en.text: Buying over 3000 baht worth of food and the waiter decided to give us a plate of wagyu we didn’t order so he adds another 500 baht to the bill. Then 30 minutes later I go to buy another drink and notice they added another 500 baht Wagyu plate charge to my bill that they never brought us 😬!!!!’ This place tries to scam people with charges on your bill for plates you didn’t take!!! Don’t give these people your money there are way better and restaurants in the city!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vince

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is of good quality, the atmosphere is great, and the restaurant and food itself are very clean. The prices aren't too expensive, reasonable for a restaurant of this caliber. It's located in the heart of the city, not crowded, and the restaurant is spacious and comfortable. There's also parking available. If you're visiting Pattaya, I highly recommend trying this place; you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luckycat testfood

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Good quality sashimi, quite fresh.
- Tender meat, melts in your mouth.
- Grilled stingray fins are fragrant and delicious.
- Free self-service skewers of vegetables (one time only).
- Free peanuts as an appetizer.
- Free watermelon at the end.

The staff are polite and provide good service. They changed the grill grate without being asked. No smoky smell on your clothes. Parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat Patsorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is good, although the restaurant might seem a bit tucked away in an alley. But rest assured, the service is excellent, the quality of the food is good, the restrooms are clean, the staff are friendly, the food tastes great, and the service is quite fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pom Puy

restaurants.name: Shaligram Gujarati Restaurant
restaurants.address:

59, Near V C Hotel, Opp.Seventh Day Hotel 2nd, 29 Pattaya Sai Song Rd, Pattaya City, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was ok. Expected better for the higher ratings I've been seeing. Not bad but also expected more flavor for the chicken kolhapuri. Pani puri was good. My wife really enjoyed the dosa. However, all the food lacked spice. They provide chilli peppers on the side to help but not the same imo. All in all, expected better for the price we're paying and raving reviews. Still a good spot. Just not great.

I do like that they have a vegetarian specific menu and they split the restaurant between veggie and nonveggie eaters. Service was also good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pronob B (Pro)

sample_reviews_en.text: “In the middle of Pattaya’s lively food scene, finding comforting veg food felt like home. Yesterday and today I had Khichdi – simple, healthy, and full of warmth. The flavors were gentle yet satisfying, a perfect balance of spices that made it light on the stomach and soothing to the soul. For vegetarians, Pattaya surprisingly offers really good options, and this meal proved that veg food here can be just as delightful as anything else!” 🌱🍲
sample_reviews_en.author: Namaste Stella

sample_reviews_en.text: Had an amazing Gujarati food experience in Pattaya! The taste was absolutely authentic and reminded me of home. Every dish was perfectly balanced — from the delicious dal and soft rotis to the flavorful sabzis and farsan. The staff was warm and welcoming, and the service was quick. It’s not easy to find such genuine Gujarati flavors abroad, but this place truly delivers. Highly recommended for anyone craving real Gujarati food in Pattaya!
sample_reviews_en.author: sachin khetiya

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited Saligram Restaurant in Pattya and had a wonderful experience. I met Kishor Bhai, who was an absolute charmer! The host was super nice, and the Gujarati thali felt just like home-cooked food. I thoroughly enjoyed it and would highly recommend visiting with family and friends. It's conveniently located near the Beverly Hotel in Pattya. Thanks so much, Kishor Bhai, for your warm hospitality!"
sample_reviews_en.author: jenish patel

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re an Indian in Pattaya missing home-cooked food — this is the place. I had dal rice and aloo paratha, and it genuinely tasted like home. Pure comfort food!

What made it even better was the warm hospitality of the owner, who personally came over to check on my experience.

Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic Indian flavors with a homely touch. A must-visit! 🙏🍛
sample_reviews_en.author: Mayank Upadhyay

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is a hidden gem! The food is absolutely delicious – every dish is full of flavor and made with fresh ingredients. The prices are very reasonable for the quality you get. Easy to find, cozy atmosphere, and the owner is super friendly. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food at a great price!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chattiyapan Srilasak

sample_reviews_en.text: I was skeptical about the reviews online before going to this place. But the food was authentic Gujrati and was giving complete feeling of home cooked food. The service was and atmosphere was good but can be improved further. Will definitely recommend this to other people looking for home cooked food in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rohit Singh

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the worst paw bhaji I ever had… before also I had food here and I found top class Indian food but this time totally disappointed with the paw bhaji, don’t know what was the reason but I am pretty sure that this is not paw bhaji which they serve me in the name of paw bhaji… I will never order again 😞
sample_reviews_en.author: GURUJI IN ACTION

restaurants.name: สเต็กลุงหนวด พัทยา
restaurants.address:

27/81 Sukhumvit Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I drove all this way, arriving at 11:10 PM. None of the tables or umbrellas were cleared yet. There were only two tables occupied by customers. When we approached, a male employee immediately asked if we were ordering takeout or eating in. We said eating in, and he said only takeout was allowed. I saw two young women standing there laughing. I understand that people want to go home by the time the tables are cleared, but by the time they finish clearing, we'll have already finished eating. This kind of employee and business owner is terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: สนธิยา เคนอรัญ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was neither good nor bad. I had a T-bone steak, which was tough and thin, which is understandable considering the price! The menu is extensive and has photos, so it's easy to order, and the prices are low and portions are large, so it's a good value for money restaurant! It's located on a main street, so I wouldn't recommend it during busy times or on rainy days as it's an open-style restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: 千葉ちゃん落花生

sample_reviews_en.text:
Takeout food should include a spoon.
There should be utensils that allow you to eat right away.
Sometimes customers are in hotels and eating in their cars. They can't know whether the restaurant will provide a spoon or not; they have to wait and ask for one.
Because if it's takeout food in a box, it should include a spoon. It becomes inconvenient for customers to have to go buy a spoon to eat with.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prisana Yanphimai

sample_reviews_en.text: The chrysanthemum tea was bland and smelled like rags, very musty. I informed the staff and asked them to check, but they replied that they couldn't put too many chrysanthemum flowers in it because it would be bitter, and that the chrysanthemum flowers they received varied from bag to bag. Seriously? Understand this first! It's musty and it smells bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Looknam Charoenphon

sample_reviews_en.text: The black pepper sauce was watery, tasteless, and terrible. It was nothing like the other branches I've been to. I ordered extra truffle sauce, and the female employee glared at me and made a very unpleasant face, but then spoke sweetly and smiled sweetly to a male foreign customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Momo Tanskin

sample_reviews_en.text: This Western restaurant is located along Sukhumvit. I came here because I had heard it was good value for money. Sprite was 20 baht, sirloin steak was 85 baht, and fries were 35 baht. It's not a high-end restaurant, but the prices are reasonable. The food is freshly cooked.
sample_reviews_en.author: 尾形武志

sample_reviews_en.text: It would be good to train your staff a bit. You paid to eat here, not to beg. You put on a brave face. I've eaten here many times, and the staff are the same. The waitresses are small and have broken faces. Please have some manners. They're customers, not beggars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Madelyn Bootdee

sample_reviews_en.text: Steak Lung Nuat, Pattaya branch, is located on Sukhumvit Road at the Pattaya Klang traffic light intersection. Everything is delicious. There are many menus to choose from, including beef steak, pork steak, chicken steak, fish steak, German …
sample_reviews_en.author: Phasuk Ruangram

restaurants.name: Zab Sena
restaurants.address:

83 20 Thanon Sena Nikhom 1, Chorakhe Bua, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are reasonable, the food tastes delicious, and the place looks clean. I especially like the grilled pork neck because it's real pork neck, not just the regular pork shoulder like some other restaurants. Parking is very difficult, but today I was lucky enough to park right in front of the shop 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Namphung T.

sample_reviews_en.text: Tom Yum noodles are delicious, no need to add seasoning. A regular boy came to buy some, and the kind auntie gave him a free shrimp ball. Hehe.
sample_reviews_en.author: ooly leela

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good service, polite and helpful.
The fried chicken, grilled pork, and dipping sauce were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunshine Pearts

sample_reviews_en.text: Grilled chicken, fried liver, mango papaya salad, bamboo shoot soup - all delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakkalin C

restaurants.name: Gourmet Salads & Healthy Juices
restaurants.address:

137 Central Pattaya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the quality is excellent. I've eaten at other places where the broth is very thick, but this place really does pack in the fruits and vegetables. They emphasize quality and the taste is delicious, I can confirm. The owner makes it himself, is attentive, and friendly. Most importantly, the portions are generous. If you can't finish it, they'll wrap it up for you. I'm so impressed! Healthy eaters, you have to try this place. I highly recommend it; you won't be disappointed.

Very delicious, very good quality, don't miss it! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaewkarn Liawprakhon

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely loved it here! The food was fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully presented — you can really tell care and quality go into everything. The salad was super satisfying and the juice was so refreshing!🍹 Friendly and welcoming service made it an all-around great experience. Perfect spot to get a healthy, tasty lunch. Highly recommend and will definitely be coming back! 💚
sample_reviews_en.author: Sophie Lockhart

sample_reviews_en.text: “This is by far the best fruit smoothie I’ve had along the beach! You can really taste the quality of the fruits rich, flavorful, and generous with ingredients. The price is very reasonable too. The owner is also super lovely and kind, which makes the experience even better!”
sample_reviews_en.author: Katy Oliver

sample_reviews_en.text: This dish is delicious. The chicken is very tender, and the addition of ripe mango creates a unique and perfectly balanced flavor. The price is great at only 179 baht. Health-conscious people who follow a clean eating lifestyle should definitely try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jitra Okhan

sample_reviews_en.text: It is super nice place! Very good quality of food, super nice service and a good place to eat something fresh and healthy. Big portions, wide selection and interesting and original menu options. Definitely worth recommending
sample_reviews_en.author: Aleksandra Olejnik

sample_reviews_en.text: Just been to this new place and would highly recommend it. Excellent service, generous portions, and most importantly the food and drink is of a very high standard. So good I’m coming back for more tomorrow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Richard Pradic

sample_reviews_en.text: I've never tried this style of food before, and I loved it after trying it. I didn't think it could be this delicious. The staff were also very welcoming and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nonvasin Thanakijpongjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text: Friends who like healthy, clean, and delicious food should definitely try this restaurant. I can assure you, you won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: little mix empire
