sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old noodle shop with reliable taste, though the prices are a bit high. I ordered dry noodles with wontons, crab, and char siu pork. The noodles were soft and chewy, but the highlight was the wontons – perfectly chewy and bouncy, with a well-balanced flavor and smooth, perfectly mixed filling. The char siu pork was appetizingly colored, tender, and easy to chew. The blanched bok choy was just right, cut a little too short, requiring frequent picking up, though it was a bit oily. The broth was flavorful and rich. The dim sum was decent, thanks to the wontons. Soy sauce, garlic, and toothpicks were provided in the box. It's a pity the shop looked a bit messy, possibly due to ongoing renovations.
I'll definitely be back next time.
Taste: 4/5
Location: 3/5
Price: 4/5
Service: 3.5/5
Cleanliness: 3/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Ken Journeys of Life

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steamed dumplings were incredibly delicious!
The dipping sauce was a little sweet (which I liked).

The shrimp dumplings were plump, large, and very tasty.
The food came out quickly; I didn't have to wait long.

The char siu pork was delicious, tender, and not chewy.

The only downside was that the restaurant was a bit hot. It's a glass-walled room but they didn't have air conditioning, so it was quite stuffy.

I saw a sign saying you could park at Market Place for free for 1 hour.
But on the day I went, I parked at Vachira Hospital and it cost 20 baht per hour, which was convenient for a walk across.
sample_reviews_en.author: MyBlooD MJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't buy from them! The quality has deteriorated significantly. It's strange that there were no customers at all. I ordered shrimp wonton noodles, but they gave me pork wontons instead, yet charged me the full price. The portion was very small. Since it was takeout, I couldn't exchange it. When I called to ask, they argued endlessly, claiming I ordered incorrectly. Goodbye. Don't patronize them again. There's no parking, and there's construction going on; the dust was overwhelming getting to the shop.
I hope the owner will train their staff better!
sample_reviews_en.author: hun tae kim

sample_reviews_en.text: I happened to stop by for a meal while running errands. The shrimp dumplings were huge and very filling. The crispy pork rice wasn't very hot, almost cold. They have a huge menu with everything from dim sum and steamed buns to crispy pork noodles. When I went in November, there was road construction in front of the restaurant, so it was quite dusty. It might be best to avoid eating in and order takeout instead. However, the staff were constantly wiping and cleaning the tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: ไม่เอาชื่อจริงได้มั้ย อายเค้า

sample_reviews_en.text:
Where has the shop moved to? I saw that several rooms in that row of buildings were demolished.
Edit 21/1/2568 I've lost count of how many times I've eaten here, but I've been eating here since the days when stainless steel bowls were 20 baht each and dumplings were 2 baht each when I was in first grade. Nowadays, the shop has many new menu items, but the old menu items still retain their classic taste. I'm a big fan of the roast pork noodles; this flavor is only found here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Can I run it

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered dry wonton noodles with barbecued pork for breakfast around 8 am. The noodles were mushy and not chewy after being blanched in hot water. The wontons smelled like they'd been left overnight. The soup wasn't boiling either, just slightly warm. If you're not ready, don't rush to open for business. Selling leftover food is unacceptable; it damages Yui Ki's reputation...
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanphat Kijprueang

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are misleading and excessive. I used to eat there when an old man in a white shirt would cook the noodles for 20 baht a bowl while he sat at a table. Back then, JS100 advertised it, and the price went up to 30-40 baht. This time it's 65 baht, the sign says 60 baht, and the roast pork rice is 70 baht, but they charged 80 baht. I only go there occasionally.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saowslak Sae ngow

sample_reviews_en.text: The yellow noodles are incredibly soft and delicate; it's rare to find a restaurant that makes such thin noodles. The picture shows Tom Yum Wonton Noodle Soup with BBQ Pork; the broth was perfect as is. The air-conditioned room is nice and cool, with 6-7 tables. They also have delicious pork and shrimp dumplings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peerapun Rujipongkul

sample_reviews_th.text:
The SPICIEST pad Thai I’ve ever had!
Not sure if this is a secret recipe of this restaurant but It’s way to spicy for my liking
I couldn’t finish my meal as I can’t tolerate the spice anymore, unfortunately

Will try other menu and re-evaluate star ratings in the future as I notice loads of different dishes to try.
The restaurant is quite small so you may have to wait for table. The food arrives rather quickly

Parking is available on the basement of ลานกทม.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jidapa Samphunjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baan Pad Thai is one of those places that remind you why Thai cuisine became world-famous in the first place. Everything here feels authentic yet refined — the interior has that rustic, old-town charm with a modern touch, and the service is warm without being over the top.

Of course, I went for their signature Pad Thai, and it was outstanding. The noodles had the perfect balance of chew and wok char, the tamarind sauce was tangy but not too sweet, and the shrimp were fresh and juicy. Every bite carried that smoky, slightly caramelized flavor only a proper wok can create. Add a sprinkle of crushed peanuts and a squeeze of lime, and you’ve got pure comfort food magic.

It’s definitely more polished (and pricier) than your average street stall, but the quality and care behind every plate make it worth it — especially if you want to experience the national dish in its best possible form.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mustafa Gokcel

sample_reviews_en.text: The Pad Thai is delicious, with a perfectly balanced flavor and not soggy. I've been here many times but only just got around to reviewing it. This time I tried the rice mixed with shrimp paste, which was also delicious. The shrimp was crispy, and the lime (which you can add yourself) and mango were fragrant. The portion size was just right. The prices are reasonable to mid-range, and I felt it was good value for money. There aren't many tables, so the turnover is fast, and the food comes out very quickly, which explains why the restaurant looks so empty. Parking is available along the street (free), but it can be a bit difficult to find depending on the time. There are also several paid parking areas, which are convenient and safe, but you'll have to walk a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nonth T.

sample_reviews_en.text: I'll not say this is the right taste for Phad-thai, and will not say it's yummy either. Food is so so, It's too oily, salty and not provides complete ingredients of Phad-Thai. I have high expectation for Phad-thai because their restaurant name. By the way, this restaurant is good choice for easy single Thai dish, many choices, reasonable price, clean places, stop by for one quick easy meal is okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanwara Phu

sample_reviews_en.text: I absolutely love this place. Their Pad Thai is super delicious, one of the best I’ve had in Bangkok. I’ve come back several times already because it’s just that good. The location is easy to find, the staff are friendly, and it’s also halal, which makes it even better. Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adia

sample_reviews_en.text: Baan Pad Thai was super easy to find and has tons of menu options to choose from. Everything we tried was tasty, and the prices were pretty reasonable too. So glad we found this halal resto in the middle of the area — really convenient. Would come back for sure!
sample_reviews_en.author: Astrid Rahardaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Back after reviewing 5 years ago. Resturant has had a refresh and food etc still excellent. Vegetarian Pad Thai also.
Family run business been there forever frequented by regular locals mostly but occasional Farang. Excellent.
New menu catering for Farang now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fred Balls

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered three dishes: green curry, pad Thai, and rice mixed with shrimp paste. The green curry was good, but the pad Thai noodles were a bit mushy, and the rice mixed with shrimp paste didn't come with either the sweet chicken or the egg; …
sample_reviews_en.author: janggo badboy

restaurants.address:

MRTท่าพระ ทางออก2A Phet Kasem Rd, Wat Tha Phra, Bangkok Yai, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, and you could tell it was well-prepared.

The traditional glass noodle salad with crispy dried shrimp was fragrant, the minced pork and noodles were excellent, and the flavors were perfectly balanced.

The stir-fried Gnetum leaves with egg used tender, not coarse, leaves, and were very fragrant – I loved it.

The fried rice with pork cracklings was fragrant, delicious, and not greasy.

The salted beef in coconut milk was a dish I'd never tried before. The beef was quite chewy, and the coconut milk broth was fragrant and rich, similar to Tom Kha Gai (chicken coconut soup) but rather sweet. Even as someone who usually prefers sweet coconut milk curries, I found it a bit too sweet, but I still finished the broth – it was delicious.

The food took a while to arrive, but it was worth the wait.
The restroom is located outside the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daowadee Teera-apisakkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. High-quality ingredients, great cooking skills, and perfectly seasoned.
I want to try other dishes and will definitely come back again :)

After returning several times:
Many dishes were delicious and the cooking was excellent.
- Traditional Glass Noodle Salad: A perfect balance of sour, sweet, and salty. The fried dried shrimp was tasty, and the crispy fried peanuts added a nice crunch.
- Salted Egg Yolk Sauce Stir-fried Shrimp: Large shrimp, seemingly pan-fried beforehand, giving off a wonderful wok aroma. About 7 large shrimp. The salted egg yolk sauce was rich and delicious.
- Crispy Pork Belly: The only downside was that there was more fat than lean meat.

P.S. The food was served quite slowly. This is understandable given the chef's dedication to preparation.
sample_reviews_en.author: PO

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a very long wait, but the food is incredibly delicious (I arrived when the place was packed). But I can tell you it's worth the wait. They serve Thai food, and the recommended dishes displayed outside the restaurant are all tasty. I especially love the pomelo salad, tom yum soup, grilled chicken, and for dessert, the longan juice is a must-try – not too sweet. There are four parking spaces in front of the restaurant, but if they're full, you can park next to the school. The restaurant is near MRT Tha Phra; you can walk there easily. It's become my go-to spot when I'm not too hungry. I highly recommend trying it! If you're on the Thonburi side of Bangkok, you absolutely can't miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sira. N

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. The Ran Juan curry had a very fragrant and unique aroma. The braised beef was very tender. The prices were moderate.
The stir-fried three-smell dish was tasty, but not amazing. The fried egg was delicious. The sago dessert was excellent, with great coconut milk and just the right amount of sweetness. It's a good Thai restaurant. There aren't many tables. Parking is available at the school, which is connected.

However, I encountered an issue: I found a foreign object in the sago dessert. The staff took it back and only apologized. I really think they should have compensated me with a new bowl or waived the bill, especially since it wasn't expensive (59 baht).
sample_reviews_en.author: Thikumporn R. (Kirara Lab)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. I was looking for a place to have dinner and walked past this place. At first, I hesitated, but after trying it, I'll definitely be back.

Pineapple Fried Rice - It has pineapple and raisins, which might be a bit niche, but the restaurant fried it perfectly. The shredded pork sprinkled on top made everything blend together wonderfully.

Bua Loy (Thai rice balls in coconut milk) - The dough was chewy and soft, and the sauce wasn't too sweet. The restaurant said it was naturally colored. It was served warm, just right.
sample_reviews_en.author: KLos Wasa

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the wait was extremely long. I waited an hour for my food. There weren't that many customers when I arrived. They should have informed customers beforehand if a wait was possible, especially if it would take that long. When I asked the server, they said my order was next to another table's, but then I had to wait another 30 minutes. I saw them preparing two more delivery orders (like those from other lines). They were clearly in a hurry. I asked beforehand so I wouldn't wait if it took that long.
sample_reviews_en.author: PloyPS

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a really delicious Thai restaurant. I only tried 3 dishes, and they were all amazing, but I'd rank the traditional glass noodle salad as number one. It had all the flavors perfectly balanced. Next best was the stir-fried shrimp with salted egg yolk; the sauce was incredibly rich, and the shrimp had a wonderfully fragrant smoky flavor. Finally, the crispy pork belly with fish sauce was delicious, although there was a bit too much fat on the day I visited. Overall, I will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: change preeprem

sample_reviews_en.text: I came based on Google reviews and I wasn't disappointed. The food was delicious and flavorful. I called ahead to check parking because I was worried there wouldn't be any space, as there's only parking for 4 cars. I ordered Gaeng Ranjuan (a type of curry), crispy pork with chili and salt, and traditional glass noodle salad. I forgot to take pictures of the other two dishes: stir-fried Gnetum leaves with egg and sago with longan. Overall, everything I ordered was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: pairjum Radsalue

restaurants.name: Om Kitchen
restaurants.address:

122/41 Ratchaprarop Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today afternoon, I visited Om Kitchen and ordered the Indian Thali, Palak Paneer, Sweet Lassi, and Lemon Soda.

**Taste Review:**
- **Palak Paneer:** Lacked flavor and was bitter.
- **Dal Fry:** Very little salt and no taste. Additionally, I was promised papad, which was never served.
- **Channa Masala:** Overly spicy, to the point of burning my mouth.
- **Soda and Lassi:** Quite good.

I am writing this detailed review primarily due to the poor service from the waiter. When I mentioned the issues with the Palak Paneer, he dismissed my feedback, attributing the bitterness to the Thai spinach. He also insisted the Dal Fry was fine because the chef had tasted it.

There was no apology for the subpar food, and the waiter questioned whether I had tasted Palak Paneer at other restaurants. I informed him that while it was my first visit to their restaurant, I have had Palak Paneer at many places in Thailand, where I have lived for the past eight years.

I am very disappointed with the waiter's behavior and lack of professionalism we don’t know the waiter name but you can check the order 7/07/24
12:30 pm. ( we paid 360 THB )
sample_reviews_en.author: Priyanka Chatterjee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disapponted. Never had such experience in my 10 years in Bangkok.
I ordered food at 1020AM morning. Food arrived on time at 1115PM . While I just finished half of my aloo paratha, the restaurant guy called me and said " Calling from Om restaurant, Do you know how much less we earn from deliveries? Why did you write so long about us in grab? "
I was surprised I have not even open mobile yet to rate.
Upon learning he said sorry and cut the call.
I am writing this beacuse he said me the F word.
He should be sacked for such foolish behavior, whoever it is.
To all, Avoid this restaurant, smallest quantity of food for the money not also the authentic taste. See pic

I STILL HAVE NOT EATEN THE SOUTH INDIAN MEAL, only rice pack is looking bigger. Smabar chutney 1 teasfoonful each.
The food photo I have added is at 1148AM.
They called me at 1124

That is all I have to say. Food , behavior , quality, quantity all included above.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samujjal Kalita

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for Indian food in Bangkok, Thailand, Om Kitchen is a great choice. This restaurant is located between Pratunam Market and Indra Square and served the most affordable and delicious Indian food we had on our entire Bangkok and Phuket trip.

We had lunch here, and what really stood out was that a hearty Indian Thali was available for just 150 Baht. The quality, quantity, and taste of the food was truly outstanding for the price.

The staff is very friendly and helpful. They welcome customers, guide them well, and ensure you have a pleasant dining experience. The food has a distinct Indian flavor, making it feel at home even abroad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucky soni

sample_reviews_en.text:
While looking for a place for dinner in Pratunam night market, we were recommended to this Indian restaurant. We have tried Prawn Curry, Tandoori Aloo, Paneer Pakora, and Masala Tea—all well-prepared and enjoyable. The curry was flavorful with tender prawns, while the tandoori aloo had a nice smoky taste and soft center. The paneer pakora was crispy and fresh, paired well with the green chutney served on the side.

Service was friendly and the price is overall reasonabe. A downside is that the space is a bit small, and the restaurant is somewhat hidden and not easy to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tran Minh Tuan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Felt like home away from home.
Best Indian food in indra market. You will see lot of guys in indra market asking for Indians food so we also went we little expectations.but to failed our expectations good was very tasty and complete Indian style.
We tried paneer masala,prawns curry and jeera rice,chole bhature were highlight.kids loved Chole bhature. Aaloo paratha and veg thali also had gulabjamun.
Everything was just delicious.
Quick service and reasonable price. 1200bht for 9ppl. Other Indian restaurant charged 1200bht for 6ppl.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sid's Location Lens

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came out to an area of Indian food according to maps.   Found this little alley full  and struck gold  with this place
I had the Rogan Josh and my wife the Korma
What a spread     My mouth LOVES me
The flavours were amazing

Go looking for the out of the way places….thats where you find the best.

Pics of what we left
You know what it looks like in the beginning
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul

sample_reviews_en.text: Pathetic food and service.  Don't depend on their menu which u find online as you will get many surprises later when u visit at their restaurant.  Also on whole Bangkok I did shopping and dining with my card swipe but these restaurant people charge u 5% extra on ur final bill which is truly a kind of cheating.  Strongly not recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Ranjeet Pathak

sample_reviews_en.text: I was really disappointed with my experience at this Indian restaurant. The service was slow and inattentive, and the food was overcooked and lacked flavor. The interior was dingy and not very clean, which made me feel uncomfortable. I would not recommend this restaurant to tourists or anyone else looking for good Indian cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: TheBestOf MoviesScene

restaurants.name: Tempura Yamaya (Central World)
restaurants.address:

ห้องเลขที่ B607/1 ชั้นที่ 6 ศูนย์การค้าเซ็นทรัลเวิลด์ โซน Beacon Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to "Tempura Yamaya" inside Central World in Bangkok, Thailand.

This restaurant offers the same all-you-can-eat mentaiko (spicy cod roe) style as Yamaya in Japan, which is quite reassuring even when you're overseas.
This time, I ordered mainly shrimp tempura rice bowl, along with salmon sashimi, dashi-maki tamago (rolled omelet), and sea urchin tempura with shiso leaf.
The shrimp tempura, in particular, had a light batter and was crispy from being freshly fried. The sauce wasn't too strong, and it balanced well with the rice.
What was impressive was the all-you-can-eat mentaiko and takana (pickled mustard greens).
They maintain high quality even in overseas locations, which I think is a very welcome service for Japanese people.
The sea urchin tempura with shiso leaf had an impressive appearance, and the aroma of the shiso leaf combined with the richness of the sea urchin made it a good match for alcohol.
The dashi-maki tamago had a mild flavor and was perfect as a palate cleanser.
The restaurant was clean and had a welcoming atmosphere, probably because it's inside Central World.
It's a restaurant I would recommend when you're craving Japanese food in between Thai meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: N_foodtrip

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tempura Yamaya

This Japanese-style tempura restaurant impressed me from the first bite. The highlight is that the tempura is freshly fried to order, the batter is thin and perfectly crispy, and most importantly, it's not greasy, making it easy to eat continuously without getting tired of it.

What I loved most is that the restaurant offers unlimited refills of mentaiko (seasoned cod roe) and pickles. Eating them with hot Japanese rice is incredibly satisfying; some people find the rice and mentaiko alone worth the price.

There's a wide variety of tempura sets to choose from.
Unlimited refills of Japanese rice.
Unlimited refills of mentaiko and pickles.
Food doesn't take long to arrive, even though it's freshly fried.
The tempura is crispy, light, and not greasy.

Another charming feature of the restaurant is that at the end of the meal, you can pour broth over the leftover rice. It's a Japanese-style way of eating that provides a warm and delicious way to end the meal.

Overall, it's a high-quality restaurant with great taste and a unique style unlike typical tempura restaurants. If you like Japanese-style fried food, this is one I would highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana Relax

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating at Tempura YAMAYA, and I was impressed with the taste and portion size. The tempura wasn't oily or greasy; I could eat it continuously. The tempura was perfectly fried. You can choose your tempura vegetables without extra charge (options are on the menu). The set meals include unlimited refills of rice, soup, and side dishes (but the initial portion of rice was sufficient for me, so I didn't need refills). They also offer dashi soup to pour over the rice to make a delicious and comforting porridge at the end. I especially want to commend the staff; their service was exceptional. They explained the menu items thoroughly before I ordered, making them easy to understand. They constantly refilled my water and side dishes during the meal. The food was served at a good speed, neither too slow nor too fast (perhaps because I visited on a weekday evening when it wasn't very crowded). I will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat Chumnarnkha

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate there yesterday and was very disappointed with the food quality.
I ordered the shrimp set and my husband ordered the salmon set. The shrimp was good quality, but the tempura batter and frying were terrible. The batter became soft and peeled off in thick, oily pieces almost immediately after being served. I only ate a little before it was incredibly greasy. The rice was soggy. This is supposed to be a tempura specialty restaurant, but the frying and batter were far worse than other Japanese restaurants that specialize in tempura. They don't seem to care about the unlimited refills of mentaiko or pickled vegetables, because the restaurant's focus should be on the tempura. The restaurant's atmosphere looked very cheap, with the tables arranged like a noodle shop in a back alley. The price and atmosphere are completely mismatched with the quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phantipa Ketsamphan

sample_reviews_en.text:
A famous tempura restaurant from Japan ⭐️🍤
I've seen reviews for a long time but never had the chance to go to the Bangkok branch, so I'm very happy that they opened a branch at Central World.
- Taste: It's incredibly delicious, just like eating in Japan. In fact, it's even better than what I've had in Japan because it's saltier, which is perfect for Thai tastes. I especially liked the pieces with shiso leaves; they were so refreshing. I also loved that the rice and mentaiko are unlimited refills. The staff provided excellent service; they immediately refilled my mentaiko whenever it ran out. In short, I ate 2-3 bowls of mentaiko 😅
- Price: ~300 baht, but it's worth it. It's like a buffet; very filling.
- Atmosphere: I went on a weekday afternoon, so it was quiet and not crowded. No need to queue at all!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alise

sample_reviews_en.text:
Personally, I felt it wasn't worth the money. I ordered the Salmon Set, and the salmon I received was a tiny piece, about the size of chopsticks, in the middle of the plate – just one small piece out of the entire 429 baht set. I felt like if it's going to be this small, it shouldn't even be called a salmon set. It was gone in 2-3 bites.

The service was good, but I was shocked. Paying half a thousand baht for a salmon set and getting such a small piece of salmon – it was disappointing. I probably won't order this menu again. I felt like I was cheated. ☹️

I ordered the salmon set, and all the salmon I got was the little piece in the middle of the plate. I feel bad and feel like I got scammed. This shouldn't be called a Salmon Set.
sample_reviews_en.author: Weather Boy

sample_reviews_en.text: If you like tempura and mentaiko, you have to eat at this restaurant. The tempura is perfectly fried, both the shrimp and the vegetables. You can change the vegetables in the set. Mentaiko is served as a side dish and you can refill it. It tastes just like the one in Fukuoka. No need to buy it to take home anymore; you can just eat it here. Mentaiko mixed with rice and eaten with tempura shrimp is delicious. We each had a bowl of mentaiko. The price is reasonable, around 300+ yen per set. The service was excellent; the female staff member gave great recommendations. The restaurant is smaller than expected and doesn't have much atmosphere, but that's okay because the meal doesn't take long. I will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tommy Weerapol

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's located on the 6th floor of CentralWorld.
I had a hard time finding it and wandered around for a while, but if you know it's on the 6th floor, anyone can get there!

Of course, since it's Yamaya, just like in Japan, mentaiko (spicy cod roe) and takana (pickled mustard greens) are all-you-can-eat! The taste is the same as in the Japanese restaurants.
It's tempura, but they pay attention to the quality of the oil, and it's simply delicious in a good way!
It's better than some mediocre tempura restaurants in Japan!
The tempura set meal includes unlimited refills of rice and miso soup,
and you can even finish it off with mentaiko takana ochazuke (rice with tea).
I recommend it if you're craving Japanese food!
sample_reviews_en.author: もんた

restaurants.name: บะหมี่ตรงข้ามไปรษณีย์บางซื่อ

741 ถ. กรุงเทพ - นนทบุรี Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The appearance and taste were exactly the same.
I often walk past this shop. Just glancing at the dried roasted pork hanging there is enough to know what the texture will be like. But since they didn't have anything else for sale, and I don't want to judge a book by its cover, I decided to try it. The seller had a grumpy face, a harsh tone, and was completely unprepared to serve. I ordered dry noodles and got a clump of noodles that weren't coated in garlic oil. The noodles were hard and undercooked. The roasted pork was dry, chewy, and tasteless. The crispy pork was hard, like it had been reheated repeatedly. The soup was bland and smelled of radish. The price was 55 baht, average, but it felt expensive because of the terrible taste. 😱
sample_reviews_en.author: MyMine Miine

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, my mom went to run errands at the Bang Sue Post Office and took the opportunity to cross the street to eat noodles at the opposite side.
She ordered dry wonton noodles with barbecued pork topping.
It was delicious. Because my mom went in the evening, the shop seemed quiet. It's probably busier during lunchtime.
If you want to eat at this shop, you'll probably need to find convenient parking and walk over.
sample_reviews_en.author: รัตนธร

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, good taste, old recipe, soft red pork, shrimp dumplings (boiled fresh in every bowl). The highlight is the red pork sauce, it's quite hard to find this flavor/crispy pork, when you chew, people at the next table must hear it. The price is according to the ingredients. There is a restroom. You can park on the side of the road or send a parcel on the opposite side and then come over to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: S. ASAVA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recommended menu items: Dry noodles with crispy pork and red pork.
- Open early in the morning. We arrived at 8 a.m. and it was already open.
- The crispy pork is not too thick, but almost every part is crispy. If you like crispy pork, this is the place for you. It's "honest crispy pork."
- The red pork isn't too fatty, so it's quite good.
But I really like the crispy pork. It's the best! 👌

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pork, red pork, and crispy pork wonton noodles

The crispy pork is excellent.

The price is reasonable.

Parking is a bit difficult to find.

sample_reviews_en.text:

sample_reviews_en.text:
A really good spot for a quick bite or to wind down the day. Located on the Samsen River, you can see a lot of everyday life. The staff are typically Thai, which is another reason for me to visit this nicely decorated place. I haven't eaten here much yet, but when I have, it's been tasty. However, they do cater to their mostly tourist clientele. So, if you'd prefer your meal to be more traditional, you should mention it when ordering.

Update 11/2025: A few things have changed again, but it's still the perfect place to stop by for a drink, whether for a short break or a longer stay. It's convenient because my usual accommodation isn't far away, a fruit vendor sells her wares on the opposite corner, and you can observe a lot of daily life. Very nice...
sample_reviews_en.author: Wolfgang Emerich

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don’t usually write reviews but this place actually deserves it. I’ve been coming back almost every day and I’m not even exaggerating. Every time I try something different and somehow it’s always on point.

The food’s just proper. Flavours hit, portions are solid, and nothing feels half-assed. You can tell they actually give a shit about what they’re serving instead of just pumping stuff out for tourists.

At this point it’s become a bit of a routine for me. Rock up, pick something new, and leave full as hell and already thinking about what I’m getting next time.

If you’re around and don’t try it, you’re doing yourself dirty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lagz Ragz

sample_reviews_en.text:
I haven’t been in Bangkok for very long, but this shop has already become one of my favorite places. The atmosphere is peaceful and relaxing, the coffee tastes amazing, and the prices are very reasonable.

Also, one of the staff members, Aung, is incredibly friendly and welcoming. He’s funny, easy to talk to, and always makes sure I’m comfortable and well taken care of whenever I visit.

Really appreciate the good service and warm environment here. Definitely recommended 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Yujiro

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely a hidden gem. Found by accident whilst very hungry last night, came back again purposefully tonight.  Freshly cooked amazing authentic Thai dishes, the best cocktails (wonderfully strong upon request), and the service is second to none!!! A lovely young lady is the face of this place and has made us feel so welcome and at home and her attention to detail is astounding. So happy we found this place.  AWESOME 👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Louise Williams-Lewis

sample_reviews_en.text: We ended up here for a late lunch on the first day of our vacation. And at the end of our trip, two and a half weeks later, back in Bangkok, we happened to walk by again and were actually recognized. Because the food was so delicious, we simply sat down at the same table again and had another wonderful meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steven Nobel

sample_reviews_en.text: The ladies were very welcoming and I got to try the mojito and Khao soi. It was very delicious and not spicy, so I requested and they provided some Thai chili sauce. I would say the mojito was pretty strong. It was 94 F on this day so the 4 fans in the dining area was appreciated too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenny Fang

sample_reviews_en.text: We stumbled upon this place by chance and we weren't disappointed! The food is excellent, and the service is incredibly fast. The staff is very friendly, welcoming, and always smiling! We even received complimentary fruit for dessert. I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lea Alves

sample_reviews_en.text: We ate there on two evenings and had my best vegetarian Khao Soi. We had a lovely evening with Navy, and she was very knowledgeable about Germany. Of course, we'll be back on our next visit to Bangkok. Best regards from Axel and Brigitte. Thank you! 🙏

sample_reviews_en.text: The quality has dropped significantly. The restaurant is hot, there aren't enough fans, and all the staff are foreigners. I don't know if that's affected the taste. I've been eating at this branch for a long time, and every time I eat here, the quality gets worse.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of my favorite restaurants that I visit very often. The fish balls are soft and bouncy, but the fried shrimp balls are even better – so delicious I'm hooked! Anyone who tries them will definitely want to come back for more...🤤🤤 …

sample_reviews_en.author: Thanarat Prechawanich

sample_reviews_en.text: My husband and I stopped by for a meal. I ordered a large bowl of Yen Ta Fo noodles with extra shrimp meatballs. It was delicious and didn't need any extra seasoning, but they gave us too little broth. It quickly became dry noodles! 😅 My …
sample_reviews_en.author: Karnrawee Naratham

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate at the restaurant because I had ordered takeout before, but I was quite unimpressed. The staff seemed grumpy and they took orders from other tables before I had even finished ordering, even though there were only two other tables …
sample_reviews_en.author: PpP P.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered both the clear fish noodle soup and the tom yum soup. They were delicious without needing any extra seasoning. They had a variety of tasty fish balls. The fried pork dumplings were also good; you could order them as a snack.
sample_reviews_en.author: Danupol Panomthanasak

restaurants.name: Genius Bar BKK - Bone Broth Cafe
restaurants.address:

The Eight Thonglor, Level LG 88, 36 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really, really solid bone broth at reasonable prices. I loved the chicken broth with turmeric, ginger, garlic, and cilantro. Very tasty and filling. Be careful because it’s served quite hot! The bar is on the bottom level of the mall, so be sure to search for it.

Update: Came back recently and had a fantastic, well-priced meal. The chicken bone broth is just as great as I remember. The “genius” pad Thai noodles are made from potatoes and I ordered mine with chicken. They were delicious. The side of mixed vegetables was also good—seasoned and grilled perfectly. Another win from Genius Bar!
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher Gorrie

sample_reviews_en.text: 135 Baht, which is around $5 for a small cup of chicken broth. I didn't like it. It's more like water and ginger and  a very small fraction of chicken taste. 230 baht for pad thai with rice and chicken breast. I didn't like the taste, and my stomach got uncomfortable. It's only rice, a very small portion of vegetables, a very small portion of chicken breast. I paid $7 to $8 for the pad thai, which arrived at my table 15 to 20 minutes after I had ordered. the prices are extremely high for small portion and low quality food. I didn't enjoy it. waste of money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Svetlana Tatyana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Healthy food that ACTUALLY tastes amazing (believe me, I'm a food enthusiast)! 🙌 If you want balanced, flavorful meals that don’t feel like “diet food,” this is the spot.

They serve healthier versions of Thai favorites; my go-to is the Pad Thai Fried Rice: super tasty, high in protein, and still reasonably light on calories. The Bone Broths are also a must-try, very filling and comforting.

I’ve been eating here for over a year and I still haven’t gotten bored. Highly recommend if you want healthy, delicious food without sacrificing flavor!
sample_reviews_en.author: I Ting Liu

sample_reviews_en.text: Love this place for providing quality bone broth and delicious healthy food. Bone broth is so important for providing healthy and needed nutrients to support gut health. They offer four tables to sit and enjoy either beef, chicken, or 50/50 mix bone broth or food choices. Or you can even purchase 1L bag of frozen broth for takeaway. I've been here many times and will keep coming back. They are constantly good! (NOTE: The Google Maps location is currently not correct, it's located in The Eight Shopping Mall - Floor LG)
sample_reviews_en.author: Troy S. Wood

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am a big fan of your 3 litre frozen broth option, but I’m disappointed that it is not available now. I would order more often if it were available, especially the beef and chicken.
Also, I am discouraged by my attempts to add you to my Line account. I have reached out to you several times on messenger, but get an automated response. You sometimes respond several days later with same Link name(doesn’t work) or a link that didn’t work.
It would be nice to communicate about the frozen and when you offer for purchase.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dorothy Sykes

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. (Yes Genius Bar is awesome!)
But Google sends you to the wrong address in maps. Google says it is in the Grand Centerpoint Resort. No. It is not.

2. The restaurant is in the lower level of the Eight Thong Lo shopping center. I am trying to get the correct location updated and fixed.

3. It’s only four little two top tables. There were a ton of take away orders while I ate the steak and veg, with a large bone broth. Perfect!

10/10 coming here a lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: roy herron

sample_reviews_en.text:
I purser almost daily from grab and come times come by if I’m in the area.

If you want Thai food without the nasties: msg, seed oils, refined sugar +++ this is the place to come and get a meal.

Most pleases advertised as “healthy” should follow up, so hard to find a seed oil free restaurant in BKK.

Great job, keep the healthy food industry actual healthy with grass fed, free range and organic ingredients.

🔥🔥🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan C. V.

sample_reviews_en.text: For Thailand, this food is bad. The beef Thai basil tasted fatty. The chicken was ok. The chicken broth was ok too. There was no pork option. The atmosphere is fine, simple but honestly go to boat noodle place or din tai fung which is in the same complex. Or if you want Thai, there’s another shopping mall a few blocks down for half the price and better taste
sample_reviews_en.author: Karen Lithern

restaurants.name: เจี๊ยะเจริญ ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำ หมี่ไก่ฉีก (อาเจี๊ยะ)
restaurants.address:

1883/15 Phahonyothin Rd, Lat Yao, จตุจักร, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A cozy little spot that’s perfect for a slow, laid-back day. The noodles are decent—nothing mind-blowing, but satisfying enough for a quick meal. What really stands out is the atmosphere: quiet, uncrowded, and relaxed, which makes it easy to enjoy your time without the usual hustle and bustle. Service was friendly and fast too. A great place to drop by when you’re not in a rush.
sample_reviews_en.author: Erinnn

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, especially the pork bone broth sukiyaki, tom yum noodles, and custard buns. The prices are high because the air conditioning is on, but it's not very cool. The queue management during peak hours is terrible, both inside the restaurant and for delivery riders. The restaurant is also quite cramped. It's best to go during off-peak hours or order takeout.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rassamee W.

sample_reviews_en.text: The shredded chicken noodles were well-made, and the glass noodle salad was delicious. Overall, the food tasted quite good. However, the service was a bit slow and inefficient. Improving the service to be more proactive would be great. The only downside is the lack of parking. I still frequent this place because my kids love their shredded chicken noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jutha Chanikorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The tom yum noodle soup with thick broth and added a soft-boiled egg was very diluted. I had to season it myself to make it tasty. You can ask for extra lime, which the owner kindly provided. The restaurant was a bit hot inside, but the atmosphere was great. The prices were reasonable. I encourage you to continue improving the food's flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naomi

sample_reviews_en.text: Just a random place on a rainy day but SURPRISE it was so good. The pork bone soup mixed with Malta was spicy and creamy which gave me the real authentic flavor of pork bone and Chinese herbal hint. Lots of food selections with affordable prices. Recommended as a hidden gem in Bkk. 竖起大拇指
sample_reviews_en.author: Haru Shu

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here two days in a row. Every noodle dish I've tried has been delicious. The spinach, ham, and cheese bread is also amazing. The shop is cute, and they also have drinks and smoothies on the menu. The location is great, right on the main road, easy to get to on foot.
sample_reviews_en.author: PP

sample_reviews_en.text: It's incredibly delicious! The noodles are very affordable considering the price, quantity, and taste. It's totally worth it! Much tastier than many expensive restaurants, and much cheaper. I especially love the Tom Yum noodles – they're amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gunyapatchara Phatikulsila

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers both savory and sweet dishes. The atmosphere inside is great, the prices are reasonable, the food comes out quickly, and most importantly, it's delicious! Please come and support them! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: BABY BUNNY BOO

restaurants.name: Bangkok​Sleep​Nest​Hostel
restaurants.address:

2435, Phatthanakan 47, Phatthanakan, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. Atmosphere and Design
• High level of privacy: Although it's a shared room, the use of thick blackout curtains around the beds provides guests with perfect privacy.
• Industrial Loft style: The choice of gray tones contrasted with wood and black steel frames gives a modern and clean feel.
• Lighting: Warm white lights and beautifully designed lamps make the room feel spacious and relaxing.
2. Facilities
• Common areas/bathrooms: The bathrooms are bright and clean, using glass blocks to allow natural light in while maintaining privacy. There are also shelves and a large, convenient mirror.
• Cooling: Air conditioning and exhaust fans are installed in positions that distribute coolness evenly throughout the room.
3. Service
• Owner: This is arguably the strongest point. The owner provides friendly and attentive service, making guests feel comfortable and at home.

Impressive points: The cleanliness of the wooden floors and the orderly arrangement of the beds make the overall shared room feel much more premium than typical hostels.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nickoro Smart

sample_reviews_en.text:
⚠️Caution⚠️
Check-in is until 7 PM. After that, the entrance is closed and no one is there!!
There was no information about this anywhere, so I arrived at 7:50 PM without knowing, and it was pitch black with hardly anyone around. I was stunned, thinking, "Oh, I'm going to be sleeping here..." For some reason, the phone number and LINE messages weren't working either. After waiting 40 minutes, a staff member finally came out to open the door after seeing the email I sent. I booked through Agoda, and sent a message in English saying, "I'll arrive at 8 PM," and received a reply saying, "Understood. We'll wait until then." I never imagined this would happen 😂

However, the facilities were incredibly clean, and I was the only one in the dormitory, so I had everything to myself, which was fantastic ✌️
I was able to book it for ¥1200 per night!

14 minutes from the nearest station to Suvarnabhumi Airport!

About a 10-minute walk to the nearest station!
sample_reviews_en.author: 楽天ぱんだ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Their rooms and toilets are so clean and fine.
The beds are high. Even if I sit on the bed, I don't hit my head.
They give a free water bottle and a towel.(The hostel I lived before asked extra 30 baht for towel)
They have a washing machine (30/time) and drying area.
They have a cafe on ground floor. You can order foods and drink until 7 pm.
The staffs can speak Burmese and also English.

But, my bed has no privacy I think. Because of the gap between the wall and the bed, everyone passing by could see me.

Also, they don’t have a wide
common area or kitchen room. So if you want to work, this hostel is not for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boom

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a really great hostel, excellent value for the price of 300-400+ baht. The rooms are good, clean, and have drinking water and earplugs for sleeping. The bathrooms have hairdryers and are clean. Each bed has a curtain for privacy. And best of all, they have separate rooms for men and women, which is fantastic.

The owner and staff provide excellent service. Once, I had to postpone my stay at the last minute, and they were incredibly helpful. I was very impressed.

Thank you for creating such a great hostel and providing a safe and comfortable place for travelers like us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattharasuda Montha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good place to stay, rooms are really clean and spacious. Bed is very comfortable. Staff are really nice.

Only downside is the private rooms and I think dorms face a major road and are reallyyyyyyy noisy. Definitely wouldn’t stay if you’re a light sleeper. They do provide earplugs which is nice, but be prepared.

An OK location for non tourists. Lotus grocery store about 5 min away. But not that close to the airport link, still a 15 min walk.

Cafe downstairs has coffee drinks, opens at 8am
sample_reviews_en.author: Ernest Pang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I booked online to stay at BKK Sleep Nest after my arrival to the airport.  I came via the airport express train and it was a short walk to the hotel.  I loved the location, all shops are near by and it's not in the middle of the hectic downtown.
The staff was super helpful and courteous.  Rooms are spotless clean, very comfortable, and very nice decore. Cafe is really good too, and reasonably priced.
I would easily recommend to friends and family, and stay again!
Thanks BKK Sleep Nest!
sample_reviews_en.author: Morgan Hunt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was great, from the rooms and service to the staff and owner, who were all very friendly. The price was affordable, and the breakfast was delicious. I was very impressed. It's close to Suvarnabhumi Airport. I give it 5 stars! I will definitely come back again. Recommended 5 star services, cheap, good & beautiful place with Thai hospitality.
Guaranteed a great hotel, cheap, especially good service and decoration. I will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Franky Cai

sample_reviews_en.text: Constitutional and human rights atrocity. I was knowingly coerced and/or deceived out of a number of basic human and constitutional rights, including very fundamental privacy rights, on the basis that I could not reliably obtain shelter and/or sleep and/or hygiene without doing so. I was tortured prior to coming here and my access to shelter and sleep were predicated upon trying to be made to give up among the most fundamental rights upon arrival.
sample_reviews_en.author: K

restaurants.name: KFC One Bangkok
restaurants.address:

One Bangkok Boulevard Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered from this branch because it was close by.
However, I was very disappointed. The chicken was mostly bone-in batter, with no visible color. The oil was very old and salty.
There was a time when I had some leftovers and bought a set for 469 baht. It came with 8 large pieces of bone-in chicken, enough for 3 people to eat. But I could only eat the spicy wings. As I ate, I felt they were definitely giving me old chicken because it wasn't tasty. I was very disappointed and wasted my money. Currently, there's still some chicken left. If no one eats it, I'll probably just throw it away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khunn Jum

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered the signature The Box set, but we asked the staff to change it to chicken thigh instead, but they gave us a displeased look. We overheard the staff member in the red shirt next to the cashier say, "So, where's this not chicken thigh?" The male staff member in the black shirt was very good and spoke politely. I don't know the staff member's intentions when he said that. I don't know if he was talking to us or the staff member who gave us the items, but we should have talked about it behind the scenes.
sample_reviews_en.author: NUTNICHA MUNJIT

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located on B1 floor of the mall, opposite Swensense. The store is large and very prominent, easy to find. There are plenty of seats with various table options. The store has an open layout and modern decor. I like that they have some secluded tables where you can sit quietly and avoid the hustle and bustle.
The taste is good, up to KFC's standard.
Orders must be placed via a self-service machine; there is no option to order from a staff member. This might not be ideal for elderly customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parisara Chancharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: As a tourist, when you go to an international fast food restaurant chain, you don't do it for the good food, you do it for familiarity. This restaurant does not have the crispy strips menu, the staple of KFC everywhere in the world. They do have 2 crispy strips as a snack, so they do store and cook the item, but they do not offer them as a menu. Instead, they have many items with specific names which you don't know if it is breast or thigh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Valentin Ursu

sample_reviews_en.text: I was surprised to find a KFC store this bright and clean. It's all self-service ordering, but there weren't many machines, so I'm unsure if they can handle the crowds during peak hours. The selection doesn't seem as extensive as a typical KFC, so I'm not sure if I missed anything, but at least I got the spicy chicken burger I wanted. The dining environment is fantastic; it has the potential to become a brand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bart Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The people who use the restaurant have to sit together with people who haven't ordered food from the restaurant and bring other food into the restaurant to eat, just walking in, opening the lunch box and eating it right away. There are a lot of them. The remaining seats are messy, and there are too many hidden corners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanar Furiko

sample_reviews_en.text: This KFC branch has a much better atmosphere than other locations. The decoration is unique and stylish, with a spacious layout and a modern self-order system. There’s also a souvenir shop selling KFC-themed items like shirts and sweaters. The overall vibe is really impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: NNchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a large KFC outlet located inside One Bangkok. I ordered a Green Chicken Curry rice bowl along with unlimited refill softdrinks.

The green chicken curry tasted  real good and went along well with the rice. This outlet also sells KFC merchandise.
sample_reviews_en.author: Venkata Ratnam Rayala

restaurants.name: Chef phu kitchen Steak and salad สาขาบางแค
restaurants.address:

240 Phet Kasem Rd, Bang Khae Nuea, Bang Khae, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Having tried the food at this restaurant, I was very impressed and it exceeded my expectations. We started with the main course, the salmon steak, which was perfectly cooked. The fish was thick, soft, and juicy, while the skin was grilled to a crispy, delicious perfection. It was served with teriyaki chicken with rich flavors, making it a protein-packed and filling dish. Next was the beef and fried egg on rice, which was seasoned with a perfectly balanced sauce. The meat was soft and smooth on the tongue. When mixed with the perfectly runny onsen egg, the flavor became even more smooth and delicious. We finished with the Korean spicy chicken. The fried chicken was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The sauce had a rich, spicy, and sweet Korean flavor. It went really well with the rice. Overall, every dish we ordered was deliciously seasoned, with both quality and quantity, making it worth every baht. Anyone looking for a restaurant that serves solid food at a reasonable price and packed with protein should not miss this restaurant. We recommend that you give it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warit Saenghiranwatana

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came because of the many 5-star reviews; I thought I'd found a hidden gem.
The reason for the 5-star review is that you get a 5% discount for giving a 5-star review.
The food was a little slow to arrive, possibly because there were many online orders beforehand.
The prices are mid-range, neither cheap nor expensive.

Pros:
1. The chicken steak sauce was delicious, well-balanced, and the flavor really stood out. I'd say it was amazing. The chicken was moderately tender, so I'd give it a middle rating.
Cons:
1. The air conditioning was very hot. It was set to 26 degrees and they were using a fan, but the kitchen is in the same room, so hot air kept blowing in. Even though we were the only table in the restaurant.
2. The Kurobuta pork was very tough and had a quarter of it fat. I couldn't chew it and had to spit it out.

If they improve the meat and the restaurant atmosphere, they'll definitely gain many more regular customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitiwat Ng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let me start with a warning:
The portions at this restaurant are HUGE. Don't order everything at once.

I personally ordered three dishes. The first was Fish and Chips.
The menu picture showed a reasonable size, but in reality, it was four large pieces. I could only eat one piece and had to take the rest home.

Next was the steak combo – pork and chicken. They came in large, thick pieces. The sauce was delicious.

For a side dish, I ordered mashed potatoes. These were actually tasty, but they were served cold and bland. I'd almost deduct half a point for that.

Overall, it was great. I'll definitely be back again...
sample_reviews_en.author: Warawut Songserm

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I drove past this area and was very hungry, so I decided to look for a restaurant to eat at before continuing my journey. I didn't think there would be such a high-quality steakhouse in Bang Khae. The quality exceeded the price. We ordered the salmon teriyaki and my grandson ordered the spicy chicken steak. We also ordered mashed potatoes, which were delicious. Both dishes were delicious. I've recommended this restaurant to a friend in Bangkok who lives nearby. If I'm in Bangkok again, I'll definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siriwimon Joyphukeaw

sample_reviews_en.text: I was in the area for errands today and searched for restaurants, finding this one that served steak. I ordered a sirloin steak and it was delicious! The meat wasn't tough at all; it had a nice chew, not quite melt-in-your-mouth like Japanese beef, but it was good value for the price. It came with three sauces, rice, and salad. Of course, one plate wasn't enough, so I ordered a box to take home as well. Plus, I used a promotion and got a 5% discount. I'll definitely stop by again next time I'm in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: วีรวัฒน์ บูรณารมย์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was very impressive, delicious and of high quality. I ordered the grilled salmon salad and got a large piece of fish with crispy skin, served with both tartar sauce and regular dressing, a good amount of salad greens, and beautifully arranged. The menu is diverse. The restaurant is a single shop unit with no dedicated parking; you'll need to find parking elsewhere or take the MRT and walk from Bang Khae station, which isn't far.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat today was incredibly tough and didn't taste the same. The fish and chips were oily, the fish was very dry, and the dipping sauce wasn't fragrant. I don't know if the chef wasn't there or if he wasn't cooking for us. I'm very disappointed, especially since I came all this way. Also, the beef burger seemed to have too many spices; it didn't have that beefy aroma at all. The mashed potatoes weren't flavorful either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukanya Pupae

sample_reviews_en.text:
Air conditioned eatery away from the glaring sun.
I ordered the spicy buta don, the wrong (long grain) rice was used and the Kimchi side dish tasted weird.The taste was ok.
The staff service was not up to par, no greeting or acknowledgement as we walked in. The waiter couldn't speak Thai so had to wait for another staff member so ordering took a while.
Cleanliness is only surface level.

There are other options nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ken V (Ken6548)

restaurants.name: KFC Lotus Rama 3
restaurants.address:

172 Narathiwatrajchanakarin Rd. Chongnoncee, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
On March 9, 1969, around noon,
I ordered food at the kiosk to eat there.
However, when I went to pick up my food, I requested that the egg tarts I ordered be for takeout, and the chicken be a mix of thigh and drumstick meat. The employee reacted very aggressively while preparing the order, picking up and handling items with a loud banging and slamming them down forcefully, clearly displeased. This made me feel a very negative energy because of their aggressive demeanor. The employee, who was thin and possibly LGBT, showed a complete lack of service mindset. Having a degree in customer service, I believe this behavior demonstrates a complete lack of empathy and a positive attitude towards customers, as well as a lack of problem-solving skills and emotional control.
sample_reviews_en.author: meen say

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch's fried chicken is genuinely better than other branches. I quite disagree with some of the other comments, but this branch is really delicious; I love it. Everything is great. Once, I got spicy wings that weren't spicy enough, so I went to tell them and they re-coated them with the seasoning. I also like their spicy chicken rice bowl, but usually, 7 pieces aren't quite enough to fill me up; it's a surprisingly satisfying feeling. If I want an extra portion, the staff can add more for me at an additional cost. This branch is excellent. They might not always smile as much, which is understandable; not every day is perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Metha Win

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service is terrible. If you're not ready to provide service, you shouldn't be at the counter. I've been disappointed twice now while using this service. I asked about the chicken set menu, and the employee just stood there, not saying a word, just pressing buttons on their phone. They could have said "please wait a moment," but they didn't. Plus, they made faces at me.
This has happened twice now. If I could post pictures, I would.
I will never use this branch again.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุทธิพร มากมูล

sample_reviews_en.text:
The worst kfc branch in Thailand for sure. Dirty seats and food and rubbish all over and always runs out of mash potatoes. Ridiculous.

And just across the street, literally 300m away at up Rama 3 is prob the best.

It's 2022 and fast food joints don't bother to improve on their ordering and collection system just cos they're lazy. Shame on you yum foods
sample_reviews_en.author: Leonard Wee

sample_reviews_en.text: I would like to complain about the behavior of my overweight male boss. He is uninterested in his work, speaks impolitely, rarely does his job, doesn't pay attention to orders, and ignores large groups. When I asked him about it, he responded rudely. His behavior needs significant improvement; it is unacceptable for a manager.
sample_reviews_en.author: อิสิวัฒน์ อมรรัตนเกศ

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered delivery over 10 minutes ago and they've only just started entering the order. I don't know what the staff are doing. They often run out of items. Sometimes I've waited for half an hour and they only just tell me they're frying the chicken. There's a complete lack of preparedness in their service.
sample_reviews_en.author: PongPun Meeroekyai

sample_reviews_en.text: The employee had just served their first customer, so I went to queue. When it was my turn, the employee went into the store and disappeared. I waited for 5 minutes. When they came out, they had a terrible look on their face and said the machine was faulty. ????
sample_reviews_en.author: Parinya P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were extremely slow. I ordered a larger size for takeout, but it seemed like the size didn't increase. They dropped the french fries out of the bag, and instead of replacing them, they just shoved them back into the bag. I saw …
sample_reviews_en.author: Newpst

restaurants.name: 2 Sab | 2 แสบ
restaurants.address:

121, 123 ซอย สาทร 11 Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
After visiting Health Land Sathorn, I did a Google search.

Open kitchen. Clean interior.

The seasoning is absolutely perfect (usually salty).

Som Tum. In particular, the sauce seems to be made with crab. It's so delicious. ^^

Gone in a flash~

If you're in the area, you can enjoy delicious Thai food for under 100 baht. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: 최muppy

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork neck fried rice with a Coke for just THB 100 is honestly one of the best deals in Bangkok. Not only is it incredibly affordable, but the flavour is outstanding — I ended up coming back 4 times in a single week while staying nearby. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Uncle Tullio

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and clean. The pork salad was on another level, incredibly flavorful. We also really enjoyed the papaya salad. The only downside was the portion sizes, which were much smaller than they appeared in the photos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hernando Pacific

sample_reviews_en.text: I wouldn't say it's the best fried chicken I've ever had, but it's definitely delicious for this price range. I stumbled upon it twice in the past two years; the price is okay, and the taste is alright, but nothing special.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lgglpsj

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at the restaurant and ordered takeout. The taste is good and well-balanced. You can specify your preferred level of spiciness. Oh, and the smoothies aren't too sweet, which I like, and they don't melt quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Numfon Vareeporn A.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, especially the papaya salad and spicy soup – absolutely fantastic! The prices were reasonable, the staff were friendly and smiling, and it was air-conditioned, so it wasn't hot at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: จิตติมา ฤทธ

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried rice with grilled pork neck and spicy dipping sauce was delicious! The fried rice wasn't greasy, the grilled pork was perfectly cooked, and it tasted great with the spicy dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arisara Kwang

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Thai cuisine at fair prices. The menu isn't extensive, but it includes a wide variety of classic dishes. The portions are generous and the food is delicious. Definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: DP ABC

restaurants.name: The Bay
restaurants.address:

114/1 ถนนบางกระดี่ 1 Bang Kradi 14 Alley, Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, especially the fish and chips, which were amazing. Another dish I loved was the stir-fried pork and squid with garlic. I wish more people could try this restaurant. The owner is lovely and the service is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudkanueng Buranarachada

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly delicious! I was so hungry when I arrived that I didn't take any pictures. I'll definitely come back and try everything on the menu. The minced pork basil rice with century egg was amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: PricPone CDKP

sample_reviews_en.text: Very beautiful place, staff who take good care of customers with kindness and courtesy. I highly recommend this restaurant which offers a laundromat right next door to clean your laundry. A must-see place 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Benoit Marcel

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was very well-prepared. My favorite was the crispy pork stir-fried with chili and salt – it was delicious! The shop is small but feels cozy, and the owner is lovely and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: อาทิตยา ตรึกตรองรัมย์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, especially the steak and spaghetti. The Thai food is also good; I recommend the stir-fried shrimp with stink beans. The restaurant is clean and the service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai Chaynamkem

sample_reviews_en.text: This fusion restaurant serves delicious food at mid-range prices. The beef burger and the spaghetti with dried chili and bacon are incredibly delicious. I could eat here again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: GotzJi SanJi

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the service was excellent and friendly, and the prices were moderate—not too expensive and not too cheap, very accessible. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: เกวลิน หงษ์ลักษณ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the drinks are tasty, and the owner is very friendly.
Please wait a moment after ordering; the chef is putting a lot of effort into preparing your food.
sample_reviews_en.author: SIAM KUNCHORN NA AYUTHAYA

restaurants.name: Wander BKK
restaurants.address:

64 Pan Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Google Reviews
Caption
🚗 Getting There
The restaurant is located in Soi Wat Khaek, Silom (Silom area).
Very convenient to get to, near BTS Saint Louis / Surasak station.
For those driving, there is parking available at the restaurant, so no need to worry about parking.

🍽️ Food
Foie Gras and Pork Fried Rice – Fried rice with a light wok aroma, served with perfectly seared foie gras that melts in your mouth in just the right bite, like adding luxury to an everyday dish.

Stir-fried Instant Noodles with Chicken and Onsen Egg – Dry-fried noodles with a chewy texture, a great street food style, topped with a runny onsen egg that makes every bite smooth and easy to swallow.

Volcano Set – A drink set with a presentation like serving fog from a volcano. Just seeing it is mesmerizing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jingjai Review

sample_reviews_en.text:
This has been my go-to restaurant for four to five years now. The food remains consistently delicious, and they continually add new menu items.

I particularly love their salmon with fermented fish sauce and the salty beef fried rice - the flavors have remained authentic over the years.
They offer many fusion-style dishes to choose from as well.

The restaurant serves several delicious cocktails and has regular beer promotions.

The atmosphere is perfect with both indoor and outdoor seating, making it ideal for dining and chatting with friends.

The staff members are always cheerful, and many have been working there for a long time, consistently providing excellent service.

A must visit after work!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dao Phalida

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stopped by spontaneously on our way to find a good meal and weren't disappointed. The food was excellent. The service was friendly and polite, as you'd expect in Bangkok. The only downside was that the two dishes didn't arrive at the same time, with almost a 10-minute delay.

While we were there, a singer was performing, and he was fantastic. We enjoyed our meal and conversation while listening to the lovely music. The prices are relatively higher than in other restaurants, but the atmosphere is worth it. We'll definitely be back! Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Di

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is terrible. We got to the restaurant after a long drive. When we got there, there was only one other company there. We waited 50 minutes for tom yum!!! They forgot about it. We were hungry, so they brought us a bottle of wine and, a long time later, a Thai beef salad. It was raw beef and bloody. We asked for it to be mild, it took 20 minutes, and they still didn't bring it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kristi

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious. I especially loved the beef with dipping sauce and the pork with lime. The shrimp fried rice was also fantastic. However, the signature sauce with the flame effect wasn't quite there yet. The free water from the sharing session was delicious! The atmosphere was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanida Nuanmanee

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in Soi Wat Khaek. It's a large restaurant with a great atmosphere and live music. The food is delicious and flavorful. There are promotions for customers: add them as a friend, take a photo and check in at the restaurant to receive a free mocktail (which is delicious).
sample_reviews_en.author: atida assawa

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very impressed with the taste of the food. The flavors were rich and delicious. I highly recommend trying it. Every dish was tasty. The prices weren't too expensive, the restaurant atmosphere was great, and the staff provided excellent service. I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mamoo_nung

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, live music, beautiful decor, and delicious food. It's a shame we went on a weekday when it wasn't very crowded; there was only our table and one other table occupied. The food isn't too expensive, but there is a service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ize' Supattra

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here with high hopes, and ordered the mala ramen. Service was not as friendly as I hoped, perhaps a little cold.

The ramen itself, although the meat and vegetables was good, the stock itself tasted a little bit strange, perhaps reconstituted in some way (pulverised) from something that was prepared away from the actual store (This is a chain, but that is not necessarily a bad thing in thailand).

Reading other reviews, perhaps it was what I ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ho Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
For a quick no-frills, easy & quick bite, List Ramen is perfect.

Nothing fancy but the staff are friendly & lots of mixed seating which usually isn’t too busy depending on the time.

Food came out quickly, decent portion sizes and definite value for money for the area.

Ordered a rice bowl while friends ordered ramen.

Parking available & supermarket next door for shopping after if you need it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tazio Lai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I stopped by Donki Thonglor and found Lustramen there too. It's a comfortable place to sit in front of the shop.

I ordered the beef tongue ramen with an added onsen egg; it was delicious and the flavors blended well. I also had their Japanese-style chicken wings, which were tasty and perfectly fried. This is definitely another fried chicken restaurant I'd recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปรัศนีย์ โอภานันท์

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered for dine-in. The food looked delicious and tasted great, not too greasy. Every dish was to my liking. The chashu pork was flavorful, the marinated salmon was juicy and delicious, and the pickled lemon soup was intensely sour and fragrant with pork bone broth – a must-try!

For takeout, the restaurant separated the noodles and soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai T.

sample_reviews_en.text: The Japanese Ramen Restaurant located in Floor 1 of Donki Mall in Ekamai offers a unique take on the classic Tonkotsu Ramen dish. While the noodles have a good texture, the use of sliced pork belly instead of traditional Shashu may not be …
sample_reviews_en.author: Shared drive

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I ordered mala ramen from Don Quijote to eat at home.
(via the Robin Hood app) The price was very affordable! It was amazing! The store packaged everything very well. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanida Yamsai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a local ramen chain in Thailand.

It's popular with Thais, but while it's not quite the same as Japanese ramen at the same price, it's a good option for a quick meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: FX-EA LABO

sample_reviews_en.text: Teriyaki grilled beef rice bowl, freshly grilled and very fragrant, served with miso soup, 179.- baht. Absolutely delicious. The staff were helpful in recommending dishes.

sample_reviews_th.text: Great breakfast for the price - ฿170 when I ordered. Came with iced tea, and I also got a hot americano for ฿60. Bit hidden away depending on your accommodation but worth the trip if you're exploring breakfast locations.
sample_reviews_th.author: Robert North

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent, delicious coffee. The decor is wonderful; it's a shame to ruin such beauty! The owner is smiling and talkative. If I have the chance, I'll come back again.
The café is hard to find; the neon sign is inside. I only noticed them when I saw a customer sitting by the entrance with a cup of coffee.
They're located on Buakao Street. If you walk behind the Avenue, you'll pass a handicraft shop, then a large fence, then a building with a large sign almost opposite the hotel. Next to this sign is a small door with tables in front of it. The doors are closed due to the air conditioning; that's the café.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ел Анд

sample_reviews_en.text:
Although the auntie running the business alone was slow to prepare the food, the Thai dishes she cooked were absolutely delicious. They were on the spicy side but very flavorful overall (this time I ordered basil pork and stir-fried instant noodles). Adding a coconut for only 50 baht made it the perfect place to spend a rainy afternoon.

The auntie was very friendly, personally demonstrating how to scoop coconut meat and even inviting chatting customers to sit in the next table so she could keep both sides looking busy! 🤣🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: yen chen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this place two or three times. During my visits, I met very warm, welcoming, and cheerful people. I also met a girl whose name starts with the letter “D.” I am not sure whether she is still working here or if she has moved on. However, I must be honest—I truly fell in love with her. I simply wanted to express this. Those were some of the best days of my life.

I was the person who had been in summer. Probably between july 15-22 dates of months.
sample_reviews_en.author: BEN DUMAN EDİCEM

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't recommend this place. We entered this establishment and sat down to choose what to eat. As a result, we didn’t like anything on the menu and finally decided to go to the restroom, after which they didn’t want to let us out of this establishment. As a result, they started swearing at us and shouting bad words at us. And while we were passing by on a bike, this crazy woman stood with a stick and wanted to hit us.
sample_reviews_en.author: LEKRAV

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was charged more than the menu price, but I wasn’t given a bill to check.
I’m not sure if they added a service charge or tax — they didn’t mention anything.
Other small local cafes don’t usually add these charges.
They should clearly state any extra fees on the menu and provide an itemized receipt instead of just a total.
Some restaurants in Pattaya overcharge, so always remember to check your bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: MC C

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to only to go for the English breakfast as my son will only eat English food in Pattaya. I looked at the pictures and reviews and seeing it served English food but once we walked in there, there was no English food available on the menu so we didn’t actually eat it we just thanked them and we left and went to somewhere else for our breakfast.,,, so this is why I only give it a three star
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Modlinsky

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice little cafe in quiet location and decent coffee.
Downside was very slow service. Ordered 2 meals and were only customers ordering food but it took 25 minutes for first meal to arrive and after 30 minutes the 2nd meal still not here.
Was not impressed with what did arrive.
Much better options at lower price available nearby.

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s a very small place, and once you’re seated, you can’t see the order numbers on the screen. sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent and very friendly. The chicken was very crispy and perfect as a side dish. I loved it and will definitely come back. I highly recommend the Wing Zabb (spicy wings) if you're passing by.

sample_reviews_en.text: Good service, polite staff, food prepared quickly and served hot – what could be better? Overall, it was very good.

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff were excellent, the food was served quickly, overall it was very, very good.

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent, the food was delicious, and the atmosphere was great.

Baan were not the best I had but more than satisfactory when baked fresh and hot. With this price, I expect a higher standard of service and atmosphere/decor. Waiter didnt understand the simplest English and didnt care with a wrong bill. Overall, it was an ok experience, and wolud love more of the butter chicken and soup next time.

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is good but it depends in what you order. Salads are not good. Rice dishes are good. BBQ fish is good

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's the perfect place to experience an exotic atmosphere in Thailand.

Is this really Thailand?
