restaurants.name: Gopchang House Thonglor
restaurants.address:

351/4 Sukhumvit 55 (Thonglor 17 ปากซอย ทองหล่อ 17 หมู่ แขวง คลองตันเหนือ เขต วัฒนา, คลองตันเหนือ, วัฒน, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We started by craving grilled intestines and stir-fried chicken feet with chili, as these dishes are hard to find elsewhere. We were very impressed! It might get a little overwhelming if you eat a lot, but the restaurant offers unlimited refills of side dishes. The staff were very friendly, served quickly, and gave clear recommendations.
The food had an authentic Korean flavor; not too spicy or overpowering. My friend, who doesn't usually eat spicy food, could enjoy it. The dipping sauces were delicious. Personally, I like spicy food, so I added chili and garlic.
The restaurant atmosphere was simple, nothing fancy. I personally don't really like grilling on skewers, so I gave that a slightly lower score.
Parking is available in the common area and is charged by the hour.
We went as a group of three and ordered so much that the staff asked what happened! Divided among us, it came out to about 800+ baht per person, which isn't surprising considering the portion sizes. It's a mid-range price for the Thonglor area.
sample_reviews_en.author: tktm ntch

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall Review
Gopchang is better than samgyeopsal. Friendly and delicious soup.

Food
We had samgyeopsal and gopchang. The samgyeopsal was average, but the gopchang was really tasty. Of course, the gopchang varies depending on the type, but the soup was really good, and the meat was delicious.

I had the cheese steamed egg, which was quite tasty. The cheese was really sticky, and it looked and tasted great.

Service
When you go to a restaurant run by Koreans, the service is truly outstanding. This place offered exceptional service. They grilled the meat themselves, which was very convenient. The staff were all wearing masks, so I didn't see any angry smiles, but they were very friendly and eager to serve.

Atmosphere
The small entrance made me think the restaurant would be small, but it was surprisingly spacious. Going up to the second floor, I found a larger space than I expected, perfect for four people to sit down and eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Botacu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Far from helping each other out as fellow Koreans, I really don't understand the mindset of having a staff member make me pay a 1,000 baht fine of 40,000 won just because I brought my own soju from somewhere else.

Even if they couldn't provide service...

I would have gone there more than 10 times and eaten at least 1 million won worth of food...

I don't know when they even explained this,

and how could a Thai person have explained it?

Since I live nearby, I took water a few times in the bottles provided by the apartment complex, not regular ones, and then took half-empty soju twice.

How can they treat me like I'm someone who always sneaks things out...

Seriously... anyway, it's really ridiculous.

The staff member said, "The fine is 1,000 baht."

That's what they said.

A fake review?... Are you treating me like I'm making things up?

This place is seriously ridiculous.
sample_reviews_en.author: 박주영

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are a lot of things that happen in the world, and there are a lot of things that happen in the world.  It's not a good idea, it's a good thing.
The only way to go is to go back and forth. 우리 테이블이 예민한거라고 하심.
참고로 나는 곱창을 좋아해서 어느정도는 냄새나는거 감안하고 먹는데 여기는 역한 냄새가좀 심하게 났음.
강력히 비추함.
The rags had a strong unpleasant smell and were of poor quality. Everyone ate one or two pieces and then returned them to the staff to be thrown away.
I spoke with the Korean owner or staff member. And he said our table had delicate rags.
I like rags, so I ate them with some degree of smell in mind, but this place smelled quite disgusting.
I recommend you don't come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: YoungDae Shim

sample_reviews_en.text: I spotted this place while passing by, checked the photos on Google, and decided to visit. The portions were generous, and when I asked them to serve it grilled, they grilled everything for me. The fat had drained away, so it wasn't greasy; instead, it was crispy and savory—tastier than most gopchang restaurants in Korea. The gopchang stew was also delicious; it was hearty and spicy like a gochujang stew, without any sugary sweetness. The staff were incredibly friendly, and it was a very satisfying meal. I noticed they prepare the side dishes fresh every day and even sell them separately, just like a side dish shop. It's delicious :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryan Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, good ingredients, clean restaurant, comfortable atmosphere.
Grilled dishes: Beautifully grilled pork belly, not too fatty, good pork intestines, no unpleasant smell. The staff are very skilled at grilling; the pork is perfectly dry, and the intestines are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.
Soup dishes: Seafood soft tofu soup, delicious, rich, and very flavorful.
Other dishes: Korean-style stir-fried squid, mild flavor, good for eating continuously. If left for too long, the squid becomes a bit chewy.
All the side dishes are delicious and of high quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fai Pinky

sample_reviews_en.text: Loved loved loved the food!! Such a spread and everything was fresh and tasted great, even the banchan and fresh veggies. The lady at the front today was amazing, I didn't get her name. But she's the warmest and kindest staff I've met this trip, super helpful and smiley all the time to everyone. She greets, takes orders, serves, cooks, manages payment, everything! Everything was cooked to perfection. She was also so attentive and added on more veggies for me the second I took my last lead. Amazing service thank you so much!!! I loved the meal 🥹🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Vanessa Yee

sample_reviews_en.text: The set meals were beautifully presented. We ordered the 1500-2000 baht set, which was perfect for four people. The staff were all very attentive, grilling the food for us and offering recommendations throughout. The side dishes were all delicious and refillable. However, there are limited tables, so we recommend calling ahead to reserve a table. Some of the offal had a strong smell; those sensitive to smells or who don't like offal might not enjoy it. There's no parking; we recommend parking at Common Road instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: neon minatozaki

Today I ordered mala hot pot, specifically a portion of black pork neck, and it had a strong smell.
The portion wasn't the full amount they initially weighed. It was terrible. I had to go ask about it, and they said they forgot to cook it for me. They made a new portion for me. I usually never leave bad reviews, but this is from the heart of someone who loves mala hot pot.

sample_reviews_en.text: Keep receiving wrong food for 4 times strait and 1/4 of orders didn't receive to the point where we have to walk to the staffs to remind them multiple times and even that we still haven't received them anyway
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitipong Mea

sample_reviews_en.text: Pretty cool spot to chill with some iced cold beers and listen to live music. They offer a lot of tasty small plates as well, especially the grilled pork and roasted cashews!

sample_reviews_en.text: Unprofessional services, make sure to double check your order twice or you may be charged for some extra stuff. Generally all items are pricey.

sample_reviews_en.text: Great bar and restaurant with Chinese Thai and snack food. Check out the mala station and beer. Live music too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Willim Mitchell

restaurants.name: Bang Bao @Bangkok (บางเบา)
restaurants.address:

159 Charan Sanitwong Frontage Rd, Khwaeng Bang Phlat, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Haven't tried the food yet.  Was on a random walk and stopped by.  Its difficult to find unless you're looking for it.  The decor is incredible " I work for a usa based interior design company".  The alcohol selection is great.  I attempted all 4/5 beers on tap, each being a more mellow version of a usa based staple.  The dry stout i found incredible, a very light chocolate stout without much after taste.  The hazy cider a very mellow apple cider.  The rest were refreshing but not to my pallette.  The radler was out, so the only one I haven't attempted.

Music was a good mix of thai / english classics.  Have not stayed for live music yet.

I would definitely bring people from usa to this bar as something close enough to home for them to decompress.  Koh san and several other tourist traps can be overwhelming when the home sickness kicks in.  This place so far has been easy going on the nerves and soothes the soul.

Unfortunately not wheelchair accessible due to a few steps to enter.  My brother being in a wheelchair, I'd just pick him up and move him in for an enjoyable night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Douglas Baker

sample_reviews_en.text:
Since it was my first time visiting, overall it's a chill place to hang out, with live music. The style is modern, mixed with a spacious, open-plan feel, and divided into sections. There's a bar for smokers, and the place has friendly female staff and a pool table.
However, the food was a bit disappointing; the price and portion size didn't quite match. I understand, though, it's a bar, so most people come to drink and have fun with their friends rather than eat.
Overall, it was very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yeesoon Ji

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Highly recommended the grilled beef with salt, it’s scrumptious! Other Thai food also available. There are craft beer on tap, cocktails and wine served with reasonable price.
- At 8.30pm, the live music band will start. The music theme will be different each day: Blues on Mon, Jazz on Tuesday-Wed, 90’s on Fri, and Rock music. Please check with them on FB page for the exact list of each week.
- Restroom is surprisingly well-decorated. So artist. There is the area for smoking next to it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warittha Tantartorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went on a Friday evening. There was a band playing typical Thai songs. The place is quite unique, cool and stylish. The restrooms were clean, and the staff were attentive. You can watch football on a fairly large screen.
>>However, the beer is very expensive. A large bottle of Singha beer is 180 baht. Considering the atmosphere, the live band playing typical Thai songs, and the view overlooking the street, I don't think it was worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: รีวิวไปเรื่อย

sample_reviews_en.text:
🇬🇧 English:
The bar was really good! Prices are fair, there was live music, and even a pool table. The staff were very friendly, and the interior looks great with a warm and inviting atmosphere. Definitely worth a visit!

🇹🇭 Thai:
The bar was great! Reasonable prices, live music, and a billiards table. The staff were super friendly. The interior is beautifully decorated with a warm and inviting atmosphere. Highly recommend! 🎶🍺
sample_reviews_en.author: Husky Lykin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a great time here, the staff were really friendly and went out of their way to be helpful. The meals were really good, we shared the morning glory, a spicy chicken salad - and the dry aged beef with a whole roasted bulb of garlic was just divine.
Shame the musicians called in sick that night but the sound track they played was easy listening.
sample_reviews_en.author: cas mira

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great. The restaurant is right by the road, but the traffic noise doesn't come in at all. The food is delicious, the band is good, the staff are lovely, and they even have board games to play. If you enjoy a chill atmosphere and listening to music, I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thankamol Prinyakul

sample_reviews_en.text: A really nice, nearly like a local experience. Very loud music when we arrived, but when the singer startet it became easier to talk to each other. The food was surprisingly good, but the drinks was a bit of a joke (never seen smaller, but anyway, they was not that expensive).
sample_reviews_en.author: Dorthe Löyche

restaurants.name: BAMBITE Co.,
restaurants.address:

173, 175 Soi Rong Mueang 4, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Hong Kong standards without having to fly to Hong Kong.
I've heard about Kam's Roast for a long time as a Michelin-starred roast duck restaurant from Hong Kong. Today, I finally had the chance to try it at the Central World branch.
The main dishes I ordered were Roast Duck and Crispy Pork. The roast duck had thin, crispy skin, and the meat inside was tender and juicy, not dry at all. It had a subtle aroma of Chinese spices. I loved it. The crispy pork was equally good; the skin was puffy and crispy throughout, and the meat wasn't tough at all. It was delicious even with plain white rice.
What impressed me most was the consistency of the taste. I felt that every piece I received was of very similar quality, not just a piece that looked good on top and was mediocre on the bottom.
The price is a bit higher than typical restaurants, but if you want a serious Cantonese roast flavor, this place is perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phoovich Phuengphaendin

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this delicious Burmese traditional food restaurant. It caters to a wide range of tastes, especially the semolina – I highly recommend it! It has a subtle buttery flavor, not overly sweet as I expected, but rather a very unique and delicate taste. I'd definitely go back again if I had the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chin Chin

sample_reviews_en.text: The place has a really nice, relaxed vibe good for just sitting and enjoying your food. I had the spicy chicken and it was full of flavor with a nice kick. The Burmese iced milk tea was my favorite though, super smooth and not too sweet. Overall a really good experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eshikaa Pradhan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a beautiful view and a very peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. It’s a perfect place to sit, enjoy your coffee, and spend some quiet time.
A special thanks to Cho Zin! She was very friendly, speaks English well, and …
sample_reviews_en.author: Harden Harden

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a new restaurant and I really liked it 🎶 The food was delicious 🎶 The staff were super cute 🩷 I went late at night but they kindly welcomed me and provided excellent service ♡♡ I want to go again!!
sample_reviews_en.author: 祝迫智美

sample_reviews_en.text: The food quality was impressive, portions were generous, and prices were reasonable. Service was fast and professional, and the restaurant was clean and well-maintained. Will definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hnin Darlie

sample_reviews_en.text:
I loved their laphet thoke, tea leaf fried rice, and Dalgona coffee that the barista served.
At BAMBITE, I had laphet thoke fried rice and Dalgona coffee. It was delicious. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuuka Kawabata

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried Shan Noodles for the first time, and they were delicious! They're similar to rice noodles.

The restaurant had a stylish interior, and the coffee was also delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ksk

sample_reviews_en.text: Went in to order only to be brushed away from the machines because the employee was ready to close the machine early and take orders at the counter but the problem with this is the machine has all options available in multiple languages not just Thai so I was disappointed.  Then once at the counter, despite many pieces of chicken being visible we were told any order has a 20 minutes wait.  Maybe I don't understand their work requirements but this was rude behavior and I don't intend on returning.

sample_reviews_en.text: I placed an order, but the delivery rider said the order didn't show up for the rider, so I had to wait a long time. And the Pepsi... I don't know who shook it; it spilled everywhere when I opened it. Even though I had already opened it and let it fizz, it looked like someone intentionally shook it. Normally, when I order from other shops, the liquid doesn't spurt out like that. This one definitely got shaken.
sample_reviews_en.author: 2#;アイス

sample_reviews_en.text: I once ordered to eat at the restaurant and didn't receive all the chicken I ordered. I had to go and ask for the missing pieces to get them. It was good that I ate at the restaurant; if I had bought it to take home, I probably wouldn't have gone back to get the missing items again.
sample_reviews_en.author: มิ่งมงคล

sample_reviews_en.text: The french fries were like they'd been fried for too long and were very hard. The chicken had an unpleasant smell. I've been disappointed every time I've gone, thinking it would get better. I won't be going to this branch anymore.

sample_reviews_en.text: Used to be the best KFC in Pattaya. Something has changed recently. New management? Staff layoffs? Chicken was red hot, dry as the Sahara Desert. Much more bone than usual. Fries soggy and barely warm. I won't be back.

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch is the worst! The customer ordered chicken legs but received only chicken breasts. It's not what I ordered at all. I'm very disappointed. It's deceptive and dishonest. I paid for it, you know!

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered two Snack Fun sets and added mashed potatoes. I asked for extra sauce, which is one thing, but to be surprised they only gave me chili sauce? Very confusing and disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: parn ziiz

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible! I ordered a 5-piece chicken set and only got 4 packets of sauce. Are you kidding me? I even told them in the app that I only wanted ketchup. Read the comments! Awful!

restaurants.name: Kerala House
restaurants.address:

Thanon Second, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were travelling from Australia to India and had a pit stop in Thailand, spent 6 days in Pattaya. While looking for authentic Kerala food, we stumbled upon Kerala House. One visit at this place and we ended up having dinner everyday from there. The food truly felt like a taste of home, especially after travelling. Every dish was full of authentic Kerala flavours, freshly prepared, and absolutely delicious. Even kids loved this!

The service deserves a special mention — friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming, which made the experience even better. The atmosphere was relaxed and comfortable, making it a great place to enjoy a proper meal. Special Thanks to Chef Abhi and his team!

A big highlight was Chef Abhi’s biryani — hands down one of the best we’ve had. Perfectly cooked, flavourful, and clearly made with care. If you’re in Pattaya and craving authentic Kerala/Indian food with great service and a homely feel, Kerala House is a must-visit. Highly recommended! We will definitely be back to enjoy the culture and food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sushama Johnson

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had lunch here yesterday and came back for dinner today — that should say enough! Their service and hospitality are just superb. Chef Abi is super friendly and helpful, made us feel right at home.

Food was delicious and totally worth it. Authentic Kerala taste — we tried the king fish fry, Kerala porotta, chicken biriyani, chickpeas curry, ghee roast, Matta rice, and even their Kerala-style fresh milk tea (which is hard to find).

Abi and Santhosh took great care of us both times. They not only made sure we enjoyed our food but also helped us with taxis, crossing the road with kids, and even gave shopping tips — seriously helpful!

Honestly, after dealing with that strong Thai food smell in places like Saravana Bhavan, this place was such a relief. Clean, calm, Kerala music playing, and super friendly staff. If you're in Pattaya and missing good Indian food, would recommend 👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Jibu Jacob

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the worlds worst Kerala Restaurant in the world. Ordered Kerala meals and they given a Kerala Dummy Meals - rice and one poriyal and one potato ( North India Dish) then rasam ( chilly water ) No curd curry ( need to pay extra) Sambar ( worst level ). Please never visit this place seriously you will start hating Kerala foods

Spend 750 Thai Bhat for lunch , one beer and water bottle - utter waste of money and not even work for single penny
sample_reviews_en.author: Krish S

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an incredible experience at this Kerala restaurant. The food was authentic, flavorful, and reminded us of home.

What really made our visit special was the service. The entire staff was very friendly and welcoming, but a special thanks to Abhi for his exceptional hospitality. He made us feel right at home from the moment we walked in. Highly recommend if you’re looking for great food and a warm atmosphere!
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrin Issac

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're craving authentic Kerala cuisine in Pattaya, Kerala House is the place to go. The Malabar Parotta and Kottayam Fish Curry are exceptional and the Kerala Fish Curry is a must-try. Fresh ingredients and traditional spices make every dish stand out. The friendly staff and cozy atmosphere add to the overall experience. Highly recommended for a genuine taste of Kerala! Special Thanks to Chef Abhijith. ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Hassan Alamana

sample_reviews_en.text: 25.11.2024 we visited Kerala house restaurant pattaya thailand all foods are so much tasty especially kerala rice, fish gravy, chicken gravy, pepper chicken, chicken briyani, and i love Butter milk gravy so tasty 😋 thanks for the taste to Chef Mr.KIRAN, Respect and Service is very well done by ms.SUMITHRA😍😍😍 by RAJKAMAL PUZHAL CHENNAI TAMILNADU😍😍😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Raj Kamal

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was tasteless and there was almost no meat in the dishes. The service was poor. A waiter who was rushing around. We also got two different menus for two restaurants to start with. In addition, pages of the menus were missing. The seats are very uncomfortable. Will not visit this place again. Not recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenneth Salvadhoor

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service provided was exceptional, and the Kerala cuisine was of the highest quality.
In particular, Abhi, the chef itself, provided us with impeccable assistance, ensuring that we did not waste any food.

Kerala House Restaurant Pattaya deserves our utmost commendation.
It is a must-visit establishment.
sample_reviews_en.author: KRISHNAKUMAR S MENON

restaurants.name: CoCo ICHIBANYA - Central Rama 9
restaurants.address:


sample_reviews_en.text:
Coco Ichibanya at Central Rama 9 is a well-known Japanese curry restaurant chain. Its highlight is the customizable option, allowing you to adjust the spiciness level, rice portion, and various toppings. You can choose from a variety of meats and fried items to pair with your curry – everything goes well together.

The taste is standard for a chain restaurant; easy to eat, well-balanced, and served quickly without a long wait. The restaurant is comfortable, suitable for both quick meals and more substantial dining. The location is convenient as it's in a shopping mall, easily accessible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthaphon Sueb-Am

sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous Japanese curry restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes. The spiciness level of the curry can be selected from 1-5. Level 2 is just right, not too spicy.
I recommend the pork cutlet curry with creamy egg; the flavors blend together perfectly, and the pork cutlet is crispy.
Another must-try item is the pickled vegetables. They are delicious and help cut through the richness of the curry. You can refill them as much as you like; I always get 2-3 bowls every time I go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Snow

sample_reviews_en.text:
4.5⭐️
We were in the mood for Curry.
We found this place online and had it delivered. There are a few locations, but we ordered from this one. My husband got the Chicken Cutlet Omelette Curry.
I got Chicken Cutlet Curry. The potions are really good size, and the food is very good. We will be getting food from here again, and I would definitely recommend CoCo Ichibanya to anyone looking for some good curry.
sample_reviews_en.author: AL Franklin

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is pretty much the same as in Taiwan, except they offer an extra curry powder option, which is quite unique. They also have fried squid heads, which are quite refreshing and delicious. A 2-star spiciness rating is already quite spicy… I'd suggest those who can't handle spice don't order anything above 2 stars…
sample_reviews_en.author: Kurt Lin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thank you for always having Coco Ichibanya there when I miss Japanese food! 
You can enjoy almost the same taste as in Japan at a reasonable price. 
Since you've come all the way to Bangkok, make sure you take the time to enjoy comparing the differences with Coco Ichibanya in Japan!
sample_reviews_en.author: レイコ

sample_reviews_en.text: I always look for CoCo ICHIBANYA curry whenever I come Thailand. I prefer curry here over Japan branches. This is the first time I came to Central Rama 9, absolutely taste good! Pork Omellete + spinach + spicy level 3 is a must! Tried other side dishes as well, kimchi also not bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sai Peng Eng

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I ordered curry rice with egg and breaded fried pork, spiciness level 2, and it was delicious. I also ordered curry rice with egg and creamy mushrooms, spiciness level 1, which was good too. It's been a while since I last ate here, and it's still as delicious as ever! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Kangkang Km

sample_reviews_en.text: Service is very good with my particular server. I love coco ichibanya. I have been to many of them. This get a 5 star for a coco ichiban. The store is a bit dirty, a bit of a weird arrangements of seats, though the food was very good. I always enjoy.

sample_reviews_en.text: This rice and curry shop offers a wide variety of delicious dishes, including rice and curry, stir-fried glass noodles, stir-fried pumpkin, square-cut pumpkin, fried chicken sausage, fried mackerel, and many more. There are special options like adding extra rice and two dishes for 50 baht, or one dish for 45 baht. Many night shift workers queue up for service. They accept cash and QR code payments. sample_reviews_en.author: Kasem Likhitwithyawut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khwanjai Driver's Favorite Curry Rice Shop: Delicious and affordable, open 24 hours, Monday to Saturday.
This is where we eat 1-3 meals a day. It's located at the four-way intersection near the train tracks. Parking is a gamble as there may be spaces available. The atmosphere is that of a roadside shop, not fancy, a bit crowded, but very cozy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hmusaming Pa Radd

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a budget-friendly rice and curry shop. One dish is 30 baht, two dishes are 35 baht. The portions are generous, you'll definitely be full. The taste is delicious, and there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from. The shop is open 24 hours a day, only closed during lunchtime on Sundays, but other vendors take over on Sundays.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gui Him (Jiub)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The local atmosphere is great.
You can choose from a wide variety of side dishes.
They asked if it was spicy and then served it on my plate.
I was recommended the soup, and it had a Thai-style flavor that made me want to come back.
It's a place tourists rarely visit.
I highly recommend trying the delicious Thai food with the locals!
sample_reviews_en.author: OSAMU MIZUNO

sample_reviews_en.text:
This spicy curry rice shop has a huge menu and is open 24 hours. It's a favorite among office workers. They give generous portions at affordable prices.
The taste isn't amazing, just average, but they provide chili sauce and chili paste to add.
Parking is available on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: UT

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is always freshly cooked and hot, and they're open 24 hours, so you can eat anytime you want. The taste is great, and most importantly, the portions are very generous. I highly recommend this place; it's become one of my favorite curry rice restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Riththigrai Bunthoathook

sample_reviews_en.text: A regular dish is 45 baht, adding rice is 50 baht. The rice is quite hard. The side dishes are edible, mostly stir-fried with curry paste. There are fried dishes with an extra charge, which is quite expensive for people on a tight budget.
sample_reviews_en.author: N9PPOL MAN

restaurants.name: Sammy's Food And Drink
restaurants.address:

199, 10 Phatthaya Klang 16 Alley, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tucked away in a cozy space, this restaurant charms with its classic British homestyle vibe. I suspect it’s run by a British owner and his Thai partner which might explain the wonderfully diverse menu. You’ll find everything from British classics and American favorites to Thai dishes, all offered at very reasonable prices.

The portions are noticeably larger than what you’d typically see in local Thai restaurants, perhaps catering to its largely expat clientele. Though the restaurant is quite small, seating around 20 people, it feels warm and inviting.

Service was a little on the slow side, but not unreasonably so, especially since everything is freshly cooked to order. I didn’t manage to take any photos of the food. we were too hungry, and the dishes were too delicious to wait! Even the small details, like the little coffee bean grinder shows how thoughtfully the place is run.

It’s definitely a spot I’d return to when I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Happitel Apartment

sample_reviews_en.text:
A restaurant serving American-style breakfast. I ordered the breakfast set. The largest size meal is 160 baht, which is a really cheap price. You can enjoy a meal from the entire menu shown in the photo for this affordable price of 160 baht.

The staff are friendly and can communicate in simple English. I changed the standard coffee to iced coffee, but there was no extra charge. Other restaurants charge extra for ice.

The well-cooked toast, sausage, mashed potatoes, bacon, and steamed beans all tasted good. The sausage was especially tasty, though the bacon was a bit dry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robo Tatoo

sample_reviews_en.text: Quite place. Eaten here 3 times. Ordered british big breakfast. I didnt like beans tbh, sauce of it taste like ketchup. But try it anyway its not that bad. Bacons are good but i dont think they properly cook them so after first time i told them to cook bacons  well done.  Tea is just not good. Besides those minor problems, its a good place to have breakfast. Recommended. Breakfast was quite cheap.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I highly recommend this place!

I go there at least every two weeks to enjoy the Patkapao Beef (Spicy) or Mixed Seafood Salad (Spicy). It's usually good, except for one time when they mixed something together (with noodles and other things!!). I didn't like that, and I pointed it out to the server.

Best regards, I.k.

P.S.: I know what good Thai food should taste like; many foreigners don't!!

sample_reviews_en.text: Stir fried vegetables with egg noodle and chicken. Mild flavor for those like me with “sensitive stomachs”. I like spicy foods, but my stomach does not agree, so I am resigned to eating more “plain” foods. Nice restaurant not far from central Pattaya Rd , serving many English type dishes & lots of Thai options . Clean premises , soft music playing .
Staff friendly , service good

sample_reviews_en.text: Eaten here 2 times , very close to March hotel. Good food at fair prices. Have eaten Thai food and western food here and both are good. Very friendly family, only reason not 5* is there was no pancake or waffle option on the menu and was really wanting some haha.

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️Sapporo draft beer is of high quality❣️
The glass, pouring method, and taste are all excellent⭕️
There's a wide variety of sake⭕️
The drinks are carefully chosen to pair well with the food⭕️
Even if you only go for the food, it's a great place to eat, with dishes like shiso pesto, squid salted innards yam, crispy and juicy gyoza🥟, and the numbing sensation of mapo tofu⭕️ Non-alcoholic drinks are also available.
The friendly and funky owner, a former liquor store employee, is always there and makes the experience enjoyable⭕️
It's also great that they're open until late at night⭕️
The restroom is outside the restaurant and has air conditioning.
Closed on Mondays
sample_reviews_en.author: ぽんぽこ社長

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small, cozy bar with a wide selection of sake and delicious food.
•Miso-marinated egg yolk: So delicious I want to make it myself!
•Char siu (grilled pork chashu): Generous portion.
•Negito Tsumami (stir-fried tuna with chopped Japanese scallions): I love this dish!
•Yaoshi and kyuri no Yamawae (wafer omelet with long tuna and yuzu) • Mountain yam and cucumber with wasabi salad: This one was just okay. I ordered it because I like eating mountain yam.
• Oba Genovese Pasta: Pasta with shiso leaves. Surprisingly delicious.
• Cheese Fry: A kid-friendly menu item.
• Kirinyama and Hidakami: Both were good.
sample_reviews_en.author: KANNI ANUTHI

sample_reviews_en.text: One word: spectacular! It was a welcome change to have Japanese cuisine amongst all the Thai food, and boy this place did not disappoint. We ordered the sake flight and several tapas-style dishes - fried camembert, tuna Ceviche, homemade gyoza,. All delicious and exceptionally prepared with quality fresh ingredients. Our waitress was delightful and very knowledgeable about sake. Not a single bad thing to say about our experience at this wonderful establishment! 10/10

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came across this sake bar randomly on a weekday. The atmosphere is relaxed both indoor and outdoor seats available if you smoking
I didn’t try the food myself, but my friend did the portions are quite small, more like snacks to go with drinks rather than full meals.
The sake selection is interesting, and they serve it in wine glasses, which gives it a slightly different experience. Cool spot if you’re looking for a casual drink

sample_reviews_en.text:
A sake bar with a huge selection of sake.

The food was also delicious.

Parking is available inside the project, making it super convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: PIMNADA T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Arrived late so only appetizers were available (kitchen closes at 22:30), but they were excellent. The bartender helped me find a Sake that perfectly suited my taste. Will definitely be back.
Conclusion: Sake flight + my type of Sake + 2 appetizers 1,350 baht 😁

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northeastern Thai restaurant in Soi Suan Som has great-tasting food that suits my palate. There's plenty of seating, the wait time is short, the portions are generous for the price, and the service is friendly. The only downside is the number of mosquitoes. I recommend bringing mosquito repellent or a mosquito swatter for a guaranteed good experience!

- The hot pot (Jjimjyum) comes in a small set for 1-2 people, a medium set for 2-3 people, and a large set for larger groups. We really loved the duck larb, and the grilled pork neck was also delicious. There are so many other delicious dishes, I can't review them all! 😂😋
sample_reviews_en.author: อรุชา ไตรยศ

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled beef tongue was cut into very small pieces, not worth the price. The food didn't taste as good as before. I noticed there were very few customers. In summary, it's not worth the price; the food is quite expensive and doesn't taste as good as it used to be.
sample_reviews_en.author: โต บางหัวเสือ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and inexpensive. There's parking available. Closed on Mondays. Food is prepared quickly, no long wait. I'm deducting one point because the music was a bit too loud and there were a lot of mosquitoes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benja Puengroekdee

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish is delicious, everyone I've brought here has loved it. The service is like family. The owner, Auntie Khae and her husband, are very kind. I highly recommend this restaurant.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious... comfortable seating... located right by the road. I highly recommend the grilled pork neck, it's delicious!

The shrimp wontons have soft, not mushy, wonton wrappers, and the broth is flavorful.
The portions are generous and the price is cheap.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soottipong Winyoopradist

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious, I loved it. The shrimp dumplings were big, and the pork dumplings were also large with plenty of filling. I really liked them.
sample_reviews_en.author: phloenphit jongsomdee

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to place. When I can't decide what to eat, I always order the shrimp wonton noodles. The broth is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warang Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: It doesn't taste as good as before...the dumplings are still good...but it's getting more expensive every day. 🫢🫢🫢
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is nice, the atmosphere is pleasant for dining, and the noodles taste delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิภา สำเภา

restaurants.name: Ootoya Silom Complex
restaurants.address:

B Floor 191 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat at OOTOYA and eat there often. Today, I chose the gyudon (beef rice bowl), but it turned out to be stir-fried beef instead of boiled beef. This resulted in a strong, gamey smell and the flavor didn't penetrate the meat. The onions added were also a problem. I understand that OOTOYA's food tends to be milder in flavor, but this dish should have had more taste. The raw garlic had a strong smell that didn't go well with the dish at all. I was very disappointed. Some dishes shouldn't even be made at all. I thought they were trying to give customers more choices, but this was a terrible result that doesn't live up to the standards of a Japanese restaurant. I absolutely do not recommend this dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Santi Samadhi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ootoya restaurant at Silom Complex is located in the basement (B Floor) of Silom Complex Shopping Center, 191 Silom Road, Silom Subdistrict, Bang Rak District, Bangkok 10500.
It's a standard Ootoya restaurant, like other branches.
We ordered the Kimchi Nabe set (cheese-filled pork cutlet) and the beef curry rice set.
We finished with a scoop of matcha ice cream (others ordered different things).
The total cost was a little over 1,300 baht, which was acceptable.
The restaurant is open for lunch and dinner.
There is parking available inside the mall, but it's a bit of a drive up the hill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaroonphan Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted the same as at other branches, but it wasn't very hot when served; it was almost cold. The most frustrating thing was the service. I had to ask for chopsticks three times before I finally got them. I don't know why the staff were arguing about who should get them. I told the first person, they went to tell the second, the second walked past, so I called the second person again, but they still didn't go get them. They even went to serve water to other tables until the first person walked past again. Then I had to rush them again to get the chopsticks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Silky White

sample_reviews_en.text:
Standard of quality maintained with exceptional service.

“The food quality here is exactly as expected from Ootoya—reliable, comforting, and delicious. As shown in the photo, the grilled fish set was prepared perfectly with the usual high standard of side dishes.[amazonaws]
What really stood out at this visit, however, was the service. The staff were highly attentive and well-minded, ensuring a smooth and pleasant dining experience from start to finish. It’s rare to find service this proactive. Highly recommended for a satisfying meal.”
sample_reviews_en.author: Lightler Minize

sample_reviews_en.text: A regular menu item that I eat every time I come here. The flavor is a bit less intense than other restaurants, but in reality, it's healthier. As for the service of the staff, I was a bit surprised at where they were rushing off to. They came to collect the first tray of food and saw that the steamed egg hadn't been eaten yet. They still tried to collect the second tray that wasn't finished yet. I didn't eat the steamed egg and miso soup. As for the price, it's considered okay, and I got a 15% discount from participating credit cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papawee M.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Two of us went for lunch. There weren't many customers, so we ordered two sets, each one for ourselves. The first set arrived after about ten minutes. After another 25 minutes, the second set still hadn't arrived. Basically, each of us would eat alone, while the other would have to wait or wait for them. You don't go to a restaurant with friends to eat alone. We canceled the other order we were waiting for, paid, and will never return.
The food quality was average, like many others.
sample_reviews_en.author: Enrico

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just pure disappointment. Otoya was one of my fav Japanese chain restaurants which keeps declining on food quality and service.

For example you can see all the excess water from the salad which ruins the whole dish. The grilled chicken doesnt have a charcoal aroma like it used too and is overly salty. Service is also quite confusing with not fully seated customers.

Now Otoya might become a restaurant I recommend everyone to avoid
sample_reviews_en.author: Kinn Ola

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located in the basement of Silom Complex

I had the Oyako-ju (THB 252, or ¥1,260) and the Katsu-ju (THB 340, or ¥1,700)

Both were delicious, but the miso soup was so thick and salty that I couldn't drink it.

Do they not taste the soup before serving it to customers?

I had hoped to eat the chawanmushi while it was still warm, but unfortunately it was lukewarm.
sample_reviews_en.author: Spallow Jack

restaurants.name: ปุ๊ สุกี้
restaurants.address:

1327, 1329 Charoen Nakhon 21 Alley, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
🤗🍜 Dry sukiyaki from a restaurant that everyone says is expensive... I think it starts at 100฿... I like it, a little sweet though 🥰
Normally I order takeout because you can't park in front of the shop... the police are very strict 🥶🚔
Even when ordering takeout/buying and eating at home, it's still super delicious...
Today I ordered 🍜 Dry sukiyaki with beef 💖

✅️ When I ate at the restaurant, it was great. Good ingredients, clean restaurant.
⁉️ At first I wondered why they kept asking if I wanted rice... 555 Well, I had already eaten and there was still a lot of broth left, so I ordered extra rice ☺️
💁🏻‍♀️ I like the idea of ​​putting tissues on the wall for two tables to share, and it looks clean.
😋 Additional recommendation We ordered extra blanched vegetables for only 20฿, omg, it was so good!
🤤 The fried banana stall next door is also delicious, it's so good, it's hard to find a place that makes it this good, don't miss it!
🍴 So next time, I'll just add extra vegetables or maybe not have the noodles at all. The taste is just so good! 🥰🤤
sample_reviews_th.author: Pang Kate

sample_reviews_th.text:
The pre-cooked sukiyaki is incredibly delicious and flavorful.

Dry sukiyaki is ฿100, special ฿120. The marinated pork is tender and in large pieces. It would be even better if there were more vegetables; there weren't enough. However, the flavor is very well-balanced. The dipping sauce is fantastic, slightly tangy, which I really like. The price keeps going up; last time it was ฿80, today it's up ฿20, but I understand because things are getting more expensive.

The sukiyaki soup has a fragrant and delicious broth. I even wanted to ask for extra broth! It was so good. The marinated meat is tender and the crispy squid is also tasty.

Parking is available on the street in front of the shop. There are signs prohibiting parking during certain hours, so your car might get towed.

The service is good.
sample_reviews_th.author: Being Journal

sample_reviews_en.text:
This street-style sukiyaki offers a rich, succulent experience in every element. The pork is exceptionally tender, while the vegetables are cooked to perfect softness without becoming mushy—ideal for those who prefer a gentler texture. The dipping sauce is uniquely crafted, delivering a distinctive yet delicate flavor that sets it apart from conventional versions. This dish is especially suited for those who appreciate a smooth and mellow sukiyaki experience.

This street-style sukiyaki dish boasts succulent flavors in every element. The pork is melt-in-your-mouth tender, and the vegetables are perfectly cooked without becoming mushy. Perfect for those who prefer a more gentle sukiyaki experience, the sukiyaki sauce has a unique flavor profile, not overly spicy, yet distinctly distinctive, providing a distinctly different texture from typical sukiyaki. It's a perfect choice for those seeking a soft and smooth experience in every bite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Review Tee Jing Jai รีวิวที่จริงใจ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This sukiyaki restaurant has been in business for over 20 years. Located on the roadside, parking can be a bit of a gamble.

They offer both dry and soup sukiyaki, with pork, chicken, beef, and crispy squid.

Today, I ordered two types and three bowls.
The dry beef sukiyaki was incredibly tender, stir-fried just right, with a slight gravy. It was pre-seasoned, and I personally ate it straight away. It was delicious, no need to add any more seasoning.
The beef and pork sukiyaki were incredibly tender, especially the pork, which was more tender than the beef. The pre-seasoned sukiyaki was already prepared, so I asked for an extra spoonful of dipping sauce for a richer, more flavorful flavor.

They also offer take-home sets. Orders are constantly coming in. They also offer ordering via various apps. Prices start at 100 baht, but considering the ingredients and flavor, it's a great value.
sample_reviews_en.author: attpocari

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best sukiyaki restaurant I've ever tried. It used to be S. Suki, but it's often closed. We've been eating there since it was a food cart parked in the evenings near the Charoen Nakhon 3 bridge, on the Soi 18 side. Back then, we ate there regularly and thought they must be really rich because the taste was so good, unlike other sukiyaki restaurants at that time. When you come to this new location, you have to order the dry sukiyaki with beef and pickled squid; they go together perfectly. Eat it with a bowl of hot rice for the best flavor. The price is a bit high, comparable to mall prices for a roadside stall, but the taste is guaranteed to make you want to come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bikie Detective

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually don't like sukiyaki with fermented tofu dipping sauce, but this restaurant makes it delicious.
I ordered dry sukiyaki, but the restaurant made it more on the wet side with a little broth. It was tasty, but expensive.
The service was good. Even though there were many customers, the food didn't take long to arrive.
One downside is that parking is difficult. You have to park on the side of the road, and be careful; parking in the wrong place or at the wrong time can get your wheels locked. The police in this area are very diligent.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐวุฒิ วาจาสุข

sample_reviews_en.text: The dry sukiyaki is delicious, with a rich and flavorful broth. It's 100 baht per bowl, which might be a bit pricey. I ordered the mixed dry sukiyaki with everything: chicken, tender pork, beef, and large pieces of crispy squid. The ingredients are high quality. There's sukiyaki dipping sauce in a pot at each table for customers to help themselves. The pandan jelly drink is delicious and not too sweet. Ice is 2 baht per glass. The total for this meal was 127 baht. The restaurant is near my house. Next time I'll try the sukiyaki soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: KaeRu

sample_reviews_en.text: This dry sukiyaki is packed with quality ingredients. It features large, tender, juicy marinated pork pieces, crispy squid, and soft, juicy chicken tenderloin, all served with fresh, crunchy Chinese cabbage. The stir-fry is perfectly cooked, not too soggy, and the flavor is excellent – ​​not overly sweet, but emphasizing the natural taste of the ingredients. If you want a little more sweetness or spiciness, you can add the dipping sauce provided. // Delicious! A bit pricey, but the quality is worth it. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: realview review

restaurants.name: ร้านส้มตำน้องฝ้าย​ (อิ่มแซ่บ)​
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 337 Ramkhamhaeng 52/2 Alley, Khwaeng Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was staying at a hotel on Ramkhamhaeng Soi 40 and was craving some delicious somtum (papaya salad) not too far from my hotel. I checked Google Maps and read the reviews, believing it would be as good as I thought. I took a taxi and the staff were very helpful. I ordered somtum with crab and fermented fish sauce, minced pork salad, grilled catfish, grilled chicken wings, and bamboo shoot soup. The food arrived quickly because it wasn't busy at 10 am. In short, everything was delicious and satisfying. The somtum was great, the minced pork salad was delicious, the catfish was good, and the chicken was okay. The bamboo shoot soup was just average. Overall, I'd definitely go again; I loved the somtum! 😬
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunantha Damkham

sample_reviews_en.text:
To all customers who visit and read this review: If you plan to park your car, please find a proper parking spot and avoid blocking neighboring houses or anyone else's property. We do not provide parking for the restaurant.

The restaurant is wealthy, but please also have some common sense. In the mornings, we play loud music, and some nights we hold parties and wash mortars and pestles on the street in front of our house. We have all the evidence. Please be considerate of other residents. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamonvan Somboon

sample_reviews_en.text: I was at Ramkhamhaeng Hospital and stopped by this restaurant to try it out. The staff were very polite, and the owner was lovely. The food was delicious; the bamboo shoot soup, Thai papaya salad, and corn salad were all excellent. My favorite was the grilled chicken – the skin was slightly crispy, the meat was tender and fragrant. The pork neck was also great. It gets crowded at lunchtime, so it's a good idea to call and reserve a table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sue Manachairak

sample_reviews_en.text: The corn salad and the fermented crab salad were incredibly spicy! Personally, I think anyone who can handle spicy food should tell them it's extra spicy. In the pictures, it didn't look that spicy. The fermented fish sauce was very flavorful, not too salty. However, the grilled chicken seemed like it hadn't been fully infused with the flavor. There's no parking available. The ice cream was delicious too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Happiness is food

sample_reviews_en.text:
A popular restaurant in the Ramkhamhaeng area. Good prices, cool air conditioning, lovely owner, plenty of staff, fast service, and quick turnaround.

Recommended dishes: Luang Prabang papaya salad, spicy soup, crab and fermented fish papaya salad, fried duck beak, grilled chicken.

Parking is available in the condo parking lot across from the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: แมวเหมียวสีส้ม

sample_reviews_en.text: I was craving some spicy papaya salad, so I searched for it on the app. Following the GPS, I walked from Silom Home Hotel, Soi 50, and arrived at my destination in 4 minutes. The room was cool and air-conditioned. The staff were friendly and the food didn't take long. Everything was fresh and delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: S Su

sample_reviews_en.text: I explored on google maps and this thai restaurants got a good rating which is also near by my hotel. I went there throug GPS and they have pretty good menu and taste too. I will go there again if I stay near by hua mark. Fully recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai Aye Aye Aung

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northeastern Thai restaurant in Soi 52/2 Ramkhamhaeng serves delicious food. Their papaya salad is excellent. I recommend the catfish larb, grilled chicken, and papaya salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: lerpop pornchai

restaurants.name: ร้านก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือกากหมูอยุธยา
restaurants.address:

50 1 Ratchaprarop Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered one stewed pork noodle soup and one braised beef noodle soup, but received two bowls of sliced ​​pork instead of stewed pork and braised beef. I planned to eat them late at night, one for my girlfriend and one for myself, but when I opened the package, both bowls were just sliced ​​pork. Not only was I wasted money, but I also felt disappointed. This happened on April 14th, 2026. Before that, I ordered no vegetables, but they included vegetables and bean sprouts. The owner asked me to fix it, but I don't know how, but it ended up being sliced ​​pork instead of stewed pork and braised beef. It's incredibly bad. I ordered around 4-5 pm to eat late at night, and when I opened the package, both bowls were just sliced ​​pork. It's ridiculous.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิภัทพงษ์ เจริญรัตน์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes really good, both the rice and the noodles. If you only like good taste, you should come. But if you also like good service, you shouldn't. We had to ask for our water twice and it still wasn't served. The male waiter gave us a sour look. Our order was incomplete; we had to ask for the plain rice before it arrived. The papaya salad didn't come, and water, which is the first thing we ordered, shouldn't even need to be repeated. Even after repeating it, he just gave a curt "yes" and still didn't bring it, even though other tables that came later were served immediately. I overheard the table behind us also having to repeat their order. The female waiter was a bit better and apologized, saying she forgot when we checked the bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: PP YOUTUBE

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been to this restaurant many times. The food is delicious; the creamy tom yum goong (spicy shrimp soup) is excellent 👍. However, the papaya salad and other salads are very sweet. The noodles weren't as impressive. Overall, the taste is good and the price is worth it. But I'd like them to improve the ordering process. Sometimes the orders are incomplete, and I've had to double-check when checking out to make sure everything was there. The atmosphere inside the restaurant is quite hot; I recommend sitting outside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ner Nat

sample_reviews_en.text: The Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry) is delicious; I've eaten here twice already. However, the air inside the restaurant is extremely hot. This really needs to be improved. I've seen new customers come in, and they all complain about the heat. It seems like there are a lot of foreigners here too. I was sweating so much it was unbearable. I felt uncomfortable while eating; it wasn't enjoyable at all. I think moving the kitchen outside or to the back of the restaurant would be much better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaew-Go-Round

sample_reviews_en.text:
We arrived in the evening, and there were already people sitting outside, so we went inside. The air inside wasn't very well ventilated, so it was quite hot. Even though the shop has fans, it was still very hot. Sitting on the sidewalk in front of the shop would have been more ventilated.

The tom yum noodles were rather salty, and the nam tok soup was just so-so. I think the signature dish here is the rice dishes. The boiled eggs were very beautiful and impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Iamoou maomao

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of my favourite noodle shops, and I visit it regularly whenever I can. I ordered the Tom Yum noodle soup, and it was delicious. Since I don’t like very spicy food, the staff kindly prepared it with almost no spice, and it still tasted excellent. The staff were also friendly, welcoming, and very helpful. I always enjoy eating here and would happily recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: May Moe Wah

sample_reviews_en.text: The best part is that it's open 24 hours, making it a great destination for people of all ages. Noodles are made very quickly; rice might take a little longer if there's a queue. Overall, it's good and the prices are reasonable. They have a wide variety of food. Service varies depending on the time of day. Overall, it's good. The noodle soup is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karaake

sample_reviews_en.text: I heard the spiciness level is divided into 1-10, so be careful when ordering or you won't be able to eat it. The prices are reasonable, and it's great that it's open 24 hours. The waiters are friendly and smiling. The only downsides are that the food comes out a little slowly, and there are a lot of flies during the day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian

restaurants.name: Khun Ying Restaurant
restaurants.address:

20 Mithuna Alley, Lane 13, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This has been my absolute favorite local restaurant for over 10 years! It truly serves the best local Thai food you can find. A must-try dish is the Khao Pad Kaprao (Basil Fried Rice) topped with a perfect 'fire egg' (a crispy, runny fried egg)—it's consistently amazing. If you're looking for an authentic and reliably delicious Thai meal, this is the place in area I recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanoth Boonruean

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes great. Every dish we ordered was delicious. We've been here many times and ordered many different things to try. They have a huge menu. The food tastes great, the staff is lovely, and the prices are good. Highly recommended! The Tom Yum stir-fried noodles were rich and flavorful, living up to the name "Tom Yum."
sample_reviews_en.author: tong wang

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small restaurant, but the service is excellent and the food is delicious. I've tried many dishes and they've all been great. I order the glass noodle salad every time. I've tried various main courses, and they're all delicious. I especially love the macaroni; it's amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthanicha Upasan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went here for dinner and had fried pork belly with chilis and garlic and a fried rice topped with an egg. Prices are fair and the owner is friendly.
Pork belly was seasoned well and the flavor was good but though the meat itself was too tough. Fried rice was decent.
sample_reviews_en.author: L

sample_reviews_en.text:
There’s a great variety of dishes for the whole family.
Tried the Mama noodle salad and wow 😍 it’s super spicy, flavorful, and absolutely delicious! (A must-try for anyone who loves bold flavors!). And my daughter really enjoyed the American fried rice. 😋😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Nannaphat V

sample_reviews_en.text: This has been my regular restaurant since I lived in a condo nearby. My favorite dish is the stir-fried fish maw; it's just as delicious as the famous restaurants, but at a much more affordable price. I always stop by whenever I'm in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasita sewing

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small but local restaurant with a massive menu. The food is incredibly tasty and flavorful and the prices are very reasonable

Order some kai dao (fried eggs), as they are truly remarkable and add protein and flavor to your meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: That Guy

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is okay, some dishes are delicious, some are a bit confusing. The prices are alright. Worth trying, and importantly, it stays open late. There's parking in front of the shop. The restaurant has air conditioning.
sample_reviews_en.author: montraa montareeya

restaurants.name: Chester's Grill
restaurants.address:

2 Wat Sutthawat, Siriraj, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service. I ordered delivery and they didn't prepare all the items before handing them to the rider. I asked for spoons and didn't get any. I ordered Set B and only got rice and chicken with no sauce whatsoever, not even chili sauce for the fries. This kind of terrible service has happened several times already, otherwise I wouldn't be complaining like this. It's awful. This time I didn't just order one set, but two! How am I supposed to eat all that?
sample_reviews_en.author: kung thanida

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch is located on the G floor of the Siriraj Piyamahakarun Building, within the food court area. There are approximately 6-7 tables, and they do not accept cash; you must purchase a cashcard beforehand.

Most menu items require a 5-10 minute wait time as they are made to order. The fried chicken is incredibly crispy. For rice dishes, the staff provides complimentary fish sauce and chili peppers in a separate bowl – no need to ask.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuu T.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's already expensive and expensive, and they don't seem to be giving the power back to customers. The promotion is high. It would be good if the price were lowered a bit. I've eaten there before. It's still expensive, but the cost of the chicken is low. The management and marketing department should accept this, so that we can buy it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: วาธิณี แย้มคํา

sample_reviews_en.text: Chester's is located on the 1st floor of Siriraj Piyamaharaj Karun Hospital, in the same area as the food court (CP Food World). This branch does not participate in the TrueYou app promotion, but the restaurant still offers various set menus as usual, which are diverse and delicious (you can request chili fish sauce as normal).
sample_reviews_en.author: SD Surakit

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I come to this shop, it's like they don't really want to sell anything. When I ordered grilled chicken, they said it would take a while, and asked if I still wanted it. Then they didn't offer any recommendations or anything else. They just ended the conversation and let the customer leave.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prang Pranggy

sample_reviews_en.text:
I felt the portion size wasn't worth the price, but I really enjoyed the grilled chicken with spicy sauce and rice; it was delicious.
The service was okay, not bad.
The atmosphere was busy during lunchtime, but there were always seats available, and the air conditioning was nice and cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: Methawin S.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through a delivery rider, but I can't contact the shop. I've already paid, and they haven't improved at all. Do they think they can make sales no matter what? Terrible service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siri Thongtrae

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let the pictures tell the story. Is the item in the picture a good match to the actual item?
Is the quantity commensurate with the price?
I would like the shop to reconsider this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ladii Me

restaurants.name: ร้านแสนอร่อย ก๋วยเตี๋ยวไก่มะระ
restaurants.address:

258 Lat Phrao 122 Alley, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't want to give even one star, but I can't post it. Today, I'm not going to tolerate it anymore because I've tolerated it for too long. Hey, old lady, I'm not asking for free food, I'm a regular customer, I spend over a hundred baht every time. How dare you speak to me and make such awful faces at a customer? I hope your shop goes bankrupt and is utterly ruined. Your shop survives only because customers pay for it, remember that in your rotten head!
sample_reviews_en.author: สมฤทัย พุทธรักษา

sample_reviews_en.text: You can eat it. It's a normal bitter melon chicken noodle soup. The taste is average and the price is not expensive. The shop is on the side of the road in Soi Lat Phrao 122. There are 5 tables. The atmosphere is hot (the chicken rice is delicious). There are vegetables on the side. Anyone who comes to this area, come and try it. It's another good shop. 7.5/10
sample_reviews_en.author: wannalak Wawkratok

sample_reviews_en.text: It's incredibly dirty. The chubby kid who serves the food never washes their hands, and always dips their fingers into the bowl before serving. Plus, they smell terrible. I can't bring myself to eat just walking past. And the vendor has a terrible mouth...
sample_reviews_en.author: watthanai rodjakpai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good. I saw a post about the auntie and I went to eat there today; she was very nice. I didn't notice the chubby waitress's fingers, I'll have to check again later.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanae Chan

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious chicken noodle right in front of Atelier Suites Hotel. You will get a bowl of noodle soup with two big chicken thigh and fresh veges. It’s all only for 50 bath.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiswasono JD

sample_reviews_en.text: I wanted to ask, is the vendor unwilling to sell or something? With this kind of customer service, I don't think I'll be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: ANoff anoff

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles taste good and are inexpensive. The shop is located on the street in Soi Ramkhamhaeng 65. There is no parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai Dateyou

sample_reviews_en.text: A favorite for late-night diners. The soup is delicious, the special (55 baht) portion is generous, perfect for a late-night meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: DR.G

restaurants.name: Uncle John
restaurants.address:

279, 2 Suan Phlu 8 Alley, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
No frill french (and thai) food

Food - high quality french food (I am also surprised). Steak and foie gras is very well executed. Chef previously works at Sukhothai hotel and graduated from Lausanne. So its a real proper french restaurant.

Price - prob 10% - 15% cheaper than the proper french restaurant.

Service and ambience - well, its a no frill french restaurant ie you can come in shorts and flip-flops. Dont expect any proper attentive services.

If you are looking for good quality food in your relaxing attire, this is the place.

We spent c.1,000 baht per pax.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonkarn K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great atmosphere with very friendly staff, one of whom spoke very good English and was very helpful on explaining the various dishes and how hot they were.

Food came out quickly and was incredible. We had three Thao meals and one Italian meal, all of which were very good.

I agree with another reviewer on that I wouldn't call this place a French Restaurant - it definitely has a good mix of Thai, Indian and European meals.

Excellent value for money, and the air con was perfect on a balmy Bangkok night.

Will definitely be back again
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Ferris

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been coming to this place over the many years visiting Bangkok. The best dish I had was the first time when he had a special with steak and foie! Delicious.

Tonight I had a coconut shake, not on the menu but they accommodated me, lobster bisque, and sirloin steak.

The bisque has some tiny pieces of vegetables, which was different for me. The sauce for the steak was an Asian flavor. I still prefer my peppercorn or beurre blanc sauce.

I think this place is great for good steak at low prices. My steaks are always super soft.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve T

sample_reviews_en.text: Surprised with this place which is in the middle of a Thai street food area. Here you can find Western dishes well cooked and presented in an unpretentious way. They also have Thai dishes and even Indian. The chef worked before in big hotels and you can see that in the multiple pictures hanging on the walls. The wine list looks curated with bottles from all over the world. It looks to me that the chef chose each bottle as he knows that they go along with the good quality- price ratio of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jordi Bartual Paris

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve had several delicious meals at this gem. I usually have sea bass over spinach and potatoes. Yum! Tasty Ceasar salad. Today I tried — grilled shrimp and avocado salad.. OMG! So good!  Pasta cooked just right. I like the basic with fried garlic olive oil and sun dried tomatoes.. (although tomatoes not always sun dried) - was a flavor delight. KEY- You get complementary bread, that’s soooo good on its own. And this amazing pesto sauce puts it into orbit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul SanDiego

sample_reviews_en.text: I am one or the very first patrons of this place, and despite several flaws, always found it to be good value. But tonight was the last straw...prices of most dishes have increased a lot, with no justification, with those ridiculous stickers on the menu. Worse of all was my overcooked duck with 50% of the breast having a fish flavor, yes, fish (I supposed the plancha hadn't been cleaned)...So long Uncle John !
sample_reviews_en.author: Antoine Yssard

sample_reviews_en.text: A hole in the wall kind of place. You can walk past it, and won't think about it twice, but the food here is pretty good. The menu has a good variety, from authentic Thai to Spanish tapas, to choose from. The staff are extremely nice, and quick to serve. Only issue I had was that the food a little bit expensive for what I was getting. Other than that, it was a pleasant visit, and would definitely go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syed Zuhair Abbas

sample_reviews_en.text: Really mediocre duck breast. It had almost no flavor. The potato was the highlight. The price is pretty average for the neighborhood, but there are so many other food options here I will not be back. I like that there is street food outside for the atmosphere. The staff wasn't too attentive, but I think it's because there wasn't enough staff for the volume of customers (which wasn't very many).

restaurants.name: AKA YAKINIKU สามย่าน มิตรทาวน์
restaurants.address:

171 Phaya Thai Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
All-you-can-eat is available from 384 baht per person (tax included).

The restaurant has a modern atmosphere and is bustling with young people. The charcoal grilling was a nice touch, but personally, I was a little disappointed with the meat itself... It was thin and flimsy, with a lot of fat, and even after grilling, it was dry. For those who want a hearty meat meal, the quality is honestly a bit disappointing.

However, the all-you-can-eat side dishes like shrimp, kimchi, namul, and fresh vegetable salad were a saving grace! I gave up on the meat halfway through and focused on the shrimp, a large amount of kimchi, and salad, which was refreshing and delicious, and I managed to finish everything.

If you're expecting a full-fledged "yakiniku" (Japanese BBQ) experience, you might be disappointed, but it seems like a good option for those who want to fill their stomachs reasonably priced, including shrimp and side dishes.

*For a more detailed and honest review of this restaurant, photos, and other solo travel information, please check out my note "Solo Travel Girl Lime"! If you're interested, please search for "Solo Travel Girl Lime" and check it out! ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Solo Traveler Lime ソロ旅女子らいむ

sample_reviews_en.text: The promotion was great, the food was delicious, flavorful, and high-quality. The wait staff were good. The only problem was the male cashier – I'm not sure if he was the manager – his manners were terrible. I just asked if I could use credit card points for a discount, and he answered curtly, as if he didn't want to answer. He snatched the receipt from the EDC machine so quickly it's probably broken. He just said, "Sign here for these two," and slammed the bag down without any politeness or courtesy. Someone with such bad manners shouldn't be in a service job. I wanted to eat at this restaurant, but the service was awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phannita J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's been a while since I ate at this branch, and it feels like there are fewer staff. I ate there on a Sunday, and it took quite a while for them to set up the grill and the food to be served. The staff kept dropping spoons and bowls, making a lot of noise throughout the restaurant. It seems like more staff start arriving around 6 PM. If you arrive before 6 PM, you might experience slower service. The food quality is still delicious, and it's good that they change the grill rack frequently, otherwise the food would stick and burn.
You can park in the mall and get your receipt stamped.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert RW

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and the prices on the menu didn't vary much. The beef, pork, everything was good. However, when I arrived at the restaurant around 11:20 AM, no one greeted me. I finally got in at 11:36 AM and had to sit there for a while before getting the QR code to order food at 11:51 AM. There were only 4 tables occupied in the restaurant. But once I ordered, the food was served relatively quickly. I ordered bacon, but it didn't arrive. However, I was already full, so I didn't ask for it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fineday

sample_reviews_en.text:
The all-you-can-eat BBQ buffet is great value at 559 baht, including VAT 598 baht, but you have to buy refillable drinks for an additional 50 baht. You can scan the QR code for the food selection. There's a wide variety of pork and beef, with many cuts of beef, especially pork tenderloin, with many sauces including the delicious XO and mala sauces. And most importantly, the grilled marshmallows are the best!
🫰🫰🫰😁
Almost forgot, the side dishes are all excellent.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the worst branch I've ever eaten at. I waited half an hour for my food. There were only four tables occupied, but I don't know why the food took so long. There was no one to greet me when I walked in; I had to go and ask someone to get their attention. After they seated me, they just disappeared, leaving me sitting there. sample_reviews_en.text:
I probably won't be coming back anytime soon, so I'll just write whatever I like.

My hotel is nearby, so I dropped in around 9pm thinking I'd drop in on a detour.

This bar has a lot of ladies you can choose from. You can also invite a lady you like to dine with, or of course, you can dine alone.

I was standing in front of the bar and invited a lady who could speak some Japanese. It's not so much that I invited her, but as she was shown across from me and sat opposite me, she asked for a drink, so I thought I'd buy her a drink and enjoy a conversation, but she was a regular customer or had a reservation—I'm not sure—and after ordering a ladies' drink, she immediately left me and went to join the other customer. Of course, I had to pay for the drink. Even if I concede that it's unavoidable that regular customers or those with reservations are given priority, I couldn't forgive her behavior, which led me to write this post. Well, I guess I could just accept it since I'm a foreigner, but it really was unpleasant.

I don't think I'll be going there again.

P.S. I have been to Thailand many times, but this was the first time I had experienced something like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: . Sugar

sample_reviews_en.text: Keep carefull eye on your tab or bill!! They would scam you in a second and load your bill, especially after you've had a few!! sample_reviews_th.text: Boat noodles on Wednesday promotion: 20฿ per bowl (regular price 25฿). The flavor isn't very strong, so you need to add the shop's vinegar to make it just right. One bowl isn't enough; you'll need several. There are several types of noodles to choose from. It's not crowded on weekdays. The price is reasonable compared to other restaurants in the mall. Located on the 2nd floor of The Walk.
sample_reviews_th.author: zip K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Central Bangkok Boat Noodle Restaurant is incredibly popular. Whenever I go to the branch at The Walk, it's always packed.

• Marinated Pork with Rice: The pork is incredibly tender and delicious.
• Pork Satay: Very tender, but they didn't give much sauce. I really liked the sauce though.
• Boat Noodles: I ordered both thin and vermicelli noodles. Both were delicious and didn't need any extra seasoning.
• Pork Dumplings: Delicious and served hot.

The menu prices are mid-range. Noodles aren't too expensive, but rice dishes are a bit pricey, though worth it because they're delicious. The restaurant is clean and spacious, although the tables are a bit close together. Each table has a central stove, and the staff are very polite and provide excellent service. There's plenty of parking, although most of it is in the sun.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnatorn Vechaputi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The queue management system is poor, and there aren't enough staff during peak hours. Without proper queue management, customers can cut in front of those who have been waiting.

I experienced this firsthand today. When I informed the staff that someone had cut in line and gotten a table before them, their response was to claim ignorance and tell me, the one who was cut off, to wait.

The customer who cut in line may or may not have known, but this is an unfair solution for those who were patiently waiting.

I used to frequent this restaurant because the food is decent, there's a good variety, and I've never had any problems during off-peak hours. After this experience, no one wants to return.

Management should oversee and improve the queue management system.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pear Chainares

sample_reviews_en.text:
We're usually regulars, but today we encountered terrible queue management. When it was our turn, a mother and her child just walked in and got a table, the table that should have been ours.

We went to tell the staff, who said they didn't know they'd walked in first, then wrote us a new queue card.

The standards are so low. The staff lacks basic social etiquette training. When a problem arises, even the manager can't immediately address it.

They let the customers leave, and they decide to choose to lose customers rather than doing the right thing.

If you don't eat here, you won't die. There are plenty of other restaurants to support.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fame Twist

sample_reviews_en.text: The boat noodles here are delicious and there's a variety to choose from, including pork (25 baht), Kurobuta pork (35 baht), and Wagyu (60 baht). The prices are reasonable considering the quality of the food. Besides noodles, they also have fried pork dumplings, salads, and many other dishes. Parking is easy in The Walk Ratchaphruek. The staff provides good service, and the restaurant has a nice, beautiful atmosphere.

I like it.
