sample_reviews_en.text: The food was okay. Today I had pork blood soup. I thought I'd charge my phone while I ate because I wouldn't be eating for long anyway; I wasn't planning on lingering like in a cafe. But when I looked at the wall, I was like, "Wow!" 555. Charging my phone cost 10 baht, and there was no service for customers at all. Today was a public holiday, and we were driving around looking for other restaurants, but this was the only one open, so we had to eat there. I planned to just charge my phone for a bit because I forgot to charge it last night. When I saw the charging ports, I almost left without eating, but... I didn't want to drive around looking for another place, so I had to pay the extra charge. I'll probably only eat here once. If I have the chance, I'll go to a different restaurant.

sample_reviews_en.text: Yentafo, Tom Yum noodles, pork blood soup, Hainanese chicken rice – this is a long-time customer who has moved locations several times. Now they're situated on Somdej Chao Phraya Road, opposite Somdej Chao Phraya Hospital. It's a small, single-shopfront establishment. This one shop offers almost every dish imaginable. Whether you want noodles or rice, they have it all. Prices start at 50-60 baht per dish. I personally prefer the dry egg noodles. They add fish balls, fish cakes, boiled pork, and minced pork, all served with thin noodles. If you order the Tom Yum noodles, they use vinegar instead of lime. Don't forget to order the crispy fish skin to eat with it; it's a perfect combination!
sample_reviews_en.author: Art Suwarnatemiya

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small, long-established shop is a regular haunt. When I'm on a diet, I like to order the clear broth noodles with just pork – no meatballs, no fried garlic. They also have Hainanese chicken rice; you can order it with:
plain rice and chicken (no skin), or chicken noodles. The owners, a husband and wife team, might seem quiet, but they're actually very friendly and lovely. You can park on the street in front of the shop.
P.S. If I'm not on a diet, I always order the fried fish skin with my noodles – it's delicious! Only 20 baht a bag.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. Rattanareungdej

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle vendor was so grumpy! ❗ I don't know who she was angry at. We walked past her shop and decided to turn back. When we went in, she said, "Why are you walking around in circles without coming in?" When we ordered wonton soup with toppings, she asked again, "Everything?" When we said, "Everything," she said again, "Why don't you state your order completely?" The special wonton soup came as pictured: 3 wontons, 1 shrimp ball, 2 fish balls, 1 fish cake, 1 slice of pork, minced pork, and some vegetables. The price was 60 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Srisukhon Kuntisophon

sample_reviews_en.text:

It suits Korean tastes!

I would like to recommend this place to Korean tourists staying at nearby hotels.


Central Pattaya Rd, ตำบล.หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
We visited in the early afternoon with three people.

About 60% of the seats were occupied.

We ordered shark fin (300฿ and 500฿) and Khao Pad (fried rice).

The shark fin wasn't served whole, but there was a decent amount in the delicious broth.

We didn't really feel the price difference between the 300฿ and 500฿ portions.

I'd like to go there once every two or three times I visit Thailand.
sample_reviews_th.author: EDM 2017

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Chinese restaurant, located about a 15-minute walk from Central Pattaya, serves delicious shark fin soup. They prepare the soup right at the entrance. Shark fin soup is their main dish, and you can choose the size: S is around 500 baht (approximately 2500 yen), and M is around 800 baht. The soup is served bubbling hot in a pot, so you can add the accompanying vegetables and simmer them, or eat it as is; the soup itself is delicious.
There are so many chunks of shark fin in it—more than I've ever seen—and the texture is fantastic, making it feel luxurious.
We also ordered Hong Kong fried noodles and Hong Kong fried rice, both of which were delicious. Both S sizes are 100 baht.
The S size is more than enough for one person.
Thank you for the meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: 孤独旅トミモン

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried shark fin for the first time. Honestly, shark fin itself wasn't to my liking, but I was surprised that the small size (500 baht) of the shark fin dish at Ma Chai Yai Lam had such a large piece. It's a much more affordable price to try than in Japan.

I especially enjoyed eating it with fried rice; in fact, this combination left a stronger impression on me. The fried rice was 90 baht and drinks were 30 baht, so the prices were generally reasonable. The restaurant had air conditioning, making for a comfortable meal.

There were many Chinese customers, giving the impression that it's a popular place. I think it's a good restaurant for anyone who wants to try shark fin in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: YU

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered shark fin soup and crab fried rice. The smallest shark fin soup was 500 baht. Since I was alone, it was plenty. There were lots of small pieces of shark fin in the soup, and it was slightly sweet. The crab fried rice was also very tasty. There were two French bulldogs in the restaurant, and they were very friendly and cute. If I had to point out one problem, it would be that the man who seemed to be the owner was playing a game on his cell phone at full volume in front of the customers and staff. There's nothing wrong with playing games, but if it were me, I would do it somewhere where there were no customers or staff. Otherwise, there were no particular problems.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hige Yuki

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shark fin ramen I had at Tokyo Station a while ago had more shark fin on it.
I can understand if the fin is big but misshapen, but shark fin of this size?
It doesn't even have the texture of shark fin.
I wonder if the people who are giving this high rating have never tried shark fin?
Are they satisfied just by the name "shark fin"?
This is the first time I've seen such a bad experience at a restaurant with such high ratings.
I'm starting to lose faith in Google Maps.
By the way, I've never had a bad experience with a restaurant with high ratings on Google Maps before.
I think 9 baht for the crab fried rice is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: best scampi

sample_reviews_en.text: This old restaurant is delicious, especially their hairdressing fried rice. They also serve authentic Chinese seafood, and the ingredients are fresh and of high quality. The environment is very clean and tidy, clearly a long-established business. Parking is convenient; you can park on the street or in the parking lot across the street. I recommend ordering one serving for 500 won, which should be enough. If you want a larger portion, you can get it for 800 won.
sample_reviews_en.author: jianquan wang

sample_reviews_en.text:
A food connoisseur who's been lying down commented on this!

This is a unique little shop offering delicious and affordable food. We ordered shark fin soup, fried rice, fried noodles, and bird's nest. The flavors are very suitable for Chinese palates. I saw Japanese, people from Northeast China, Guangdong, and Shanghai dining there. The shop is located in the city center, opposite Big C. After eating, you can browse around and buy some souvenirs to take home!
sample_reviews_en.author: wider

sample_reviews_en.text: Their soup base is really important. I saw that they just mix packed chicken broth with other kinds of prepared broth. You can check the real soup base; it must be boiled for a long time with ham, chicken, and something else. That's just a chemically-laden soup base, not worth buying. Don't fall for it! It's all MSG-based soup base. I saw it with my own eyes as they poured out a packet of chicken powder, then added a second packet of some unknown ingredient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaleung Man

restaurants.name: 泰韵味 伟哥烧烤 岳阳烧烤(บริษัท ไทย วิน เวล จำกัด)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the owner was very friendly, and the price was about the normal level for Chinese BBQ in Bangkok, but the portions were huge! It was filling and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: COCO (waihao)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is terrible. The dishes are okay, but people who come here to eat should not drink a little bit of alcohol and bark like dogs. Go somewhere else and bark so loudly.
sample_reviews_en.author: N M

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my third time eating here!! The beef tendon is super delicious, and the pork belly wrapped in lettuce is so good 😋 It's very authentic Yueyang, Hunan barbecue!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: 柒柒

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is surprisingly similar to what you'd find in China, and the ingredients are fresh. Highly recommended! I'll definitely bring my friends next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: cc jay

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, fresh ingredients, and attentive service; surpasses many nearby barbecue restaurants, authentic Hunan spicy flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuanjun Zhao

sample_reviews_en.text: The stinky tofu was absolutely delicious, and the pork belly with lettuce and garlic was so fragrant! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: 孙秋云

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great barbecue restaurant; it might be the best-tasting barbecue I've ever had. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Happykitty Happykitty

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious, we finished it all, so there wasn't enough time to take pictures. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: 袁

restaurants.address:

829 Pracha Rat Sai 2 Rd, Khwaeng Bang Sue, Khet Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible experience. A female employee didn't inform customers about the membership promotion when processing the bill. After seeing the sign, we inquired and found out we needed a new bill and had to transfer money twice, with refunds promised within 3-7 days. After 7 days, no funds were credited to our account, forcing us to return the item to the branch. 👎🏻 This branch is awful. I will never go back here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kayla Amandes

sample_reviews_en.text:
A famous French fries chain with many branches throughout Thailand. This time, I ordered through the online app from the Lotus Prachachuen branch. I ordered a Giga size French fries in Sweet Corn, Chili BBQ, and the new Flaming Chicken Dipping Sauce flavor. No matter which branch, it's always delicious.
Price: 5/5
Quality: 5/5
Taste: 5/5
Cleanliness: 5/5
Speed: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Location: 5/5
Value for money: 5/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapatr Chiraarreebutr

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff is very slow. Taking orders is slow; I saw people standing and waiting but they didn't come to take their orders. The orders they did make were also wrong. This isn't the first time. The last time I went, it was near closing time and a female staff member said they were no longer taking orders. Then, when another customer arrived, a male staff member took their order normally. Very confusing.

Around 9:40 PM on some day, I think I saw a male employee using a white powder substance inside the store, sniffing it under the cashier. I can't remember the exact date though; I just saw him while coming up the escalator. Also, when he ordered food, he seemed displeased or showed signs of dissatisfaction towards a female employee. This needs to be addressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิมพ์พิชชา ประติฎฐิตานนท์

sample_reviews_en.text: There were only two employees at 7:00 PM on January 11, 2026. I feel sorry for them; one has to cook while the other takes orders and puts the food in bags, causing very slow service. I waited almost 5 minutes for the employee to take my order. Please consider this; there are many customers but very few employees, so they can't keep up.
sample_reviews_en.author: ขวัญหทัย อําพันพึ่ง

sample_reviews_en.text: The french fries were extremely cold. It had been 30 minutes since I placed the order, but when they arrived, they were so cold they seemed like they'd been sitting out for a long time. I called the restaurant to inquire, and the employee …
sample_reviews_en.author: papawarin kraisarin

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were lovely. They gave great product recommendations. It was my first time shopping there, and I was a little shy and didn't dare order, but the staff member explained everything clearly. Kudos! 👏💯
sample_reviews_en.author: ประวิทย์ ฉลาดเขียว

sample_reviews_en.text: Smiley's is delicious! It's crispy mashed potato fries that are even better with the seasoning powder. I really like it and hope it's available every year.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชนสรณ์ พรรณา

restaurants.name: น้องอรอาหารตามสั่ง Nong On Thai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

414 Geeta Ashram Thailand, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A huge thumbs up to the kind and friendly owners! We're from Taichung, Taiwan, and happened to be staying nearby after seeing many Taiwanese reviews recommending the place. This morning, we ordered but were 10 NTD short. We were about to go back to our guesthouse to get the money, but the owner immediately said it was no problem.

We also got a takeaway of Thai stir-fried rice noodles, which were absolutely delicious! They even added peanut pieces for texture, and the shrimp were fresh and quite large. Authentic Thai food is truly flavorful.

For dinner, we returned. My wife greeted the owner, and I don't know if she recognized us, but we ordered a dish of basil pork and stir-fried vegetables. When we opened the package, there were two servings of rice! We're not sure if the vegetables came with rice, or if the owner gave us an extra serving because there were two of us. We were so touched. This time, the owner's friend even helped us with the order. You are all such wonderful people. Thank you for giving us a fantastic travel experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: 元士豪

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited after seeing reviews saying the food was cheap and delicious.

The staff were friendly and had kind smiles.

The food prices are cheap! The food tastes delicious!

The portions were generous, and I was completely full.

My 2-year-old child also enjoyed the food and said it was delicious.

There's no air conditioning, so it's hot, but there was a large fan running, so the heat wasn't unbearable.

There are 9 seats.

The restaurant is small, so it's a little cramped.

It's a hidden gem, and I really like it here.

I want to try other dishes, so I'd like to visit again.

~For those with children~
There is no space to put strollers inside.

There are no high chairs or cutlery for children.

There is a fan, but it will probably get quite hot during the hot season.

If you request that dishes like stir-fried water spinach not be spicy, they will make it completely non-spicy, so children can eat it.

I didn't check the restrooms.

They also sell chilled bottled water and tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: GAO

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the perfect local neighborhood eatery - small but makes you feel at home the minute you stepped in.

We stumbled upon this gem during our stay at a nearby hotel and we went back multiple times.

They served a good selection of local dishes and the must order is the tom yum gung which we couldn’t have enough of! The fried flat noodles is a must try too. We tried the stir fried pork belly with basil, stir fried squid, garlic and pepper pork, chilli pork with veges, fried egg salad, fermented meat fried rice, fried egg with pork (that was supposed to be in the empty plate 😅)

If you are in the neighborhood, this is your canteen of choice 👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Winnie Yeoh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended: What a fantastic and affordable spot!

This place is a real find! We traveled with a group of four and were so enthusiastic that we ate here every single day during our stay in Bangkok. Whether it was for breakfast or dinner, it was consistently delicious and the atmosphere was always great.

Watch out for spiciness:

An important tip: if you can't handle spicy food well, make this clear when ordering ("not spicy!"). If you don't, your mouth is guaranteed to catch fire!

We absolutely recommend this place. A top choice for a great dining experience on a small budget.
sample_reviews_en.author: iamFalc

sample_reviews_en.text: This affordable street food was great! We ordered fried rice, basil pork rice, omelet rice, and water spinach – all delicious and satisfying! The owner was worried we'd be hot, so he turned on a fan first. He also kindly asked if we wanted less rice (because the portions were quite large), as we were two girls and might not be able to finish. We still couldn't finish it all. This budget-friendly restaurant has flavors that suit Taiwanese tastes. I'd recommend trying it sometime (the opening hours are 9:00 AM to 8:30 PM).
sample_reviews_en.author: 梁欣瑜

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a shop run by a husband and wife, run by very friendly Thai people 🇹🇭. I recommend everyone who lives nearby to try it. The food is very good, authentic, and the prices are reasonable. I ordered the crispy pork that my Chinese friends recommended before, and it was delicious ✅. I accidentally finished all the dishes, and still had half a bowl of rice 🍚 left, but I wasn't full yet, so I ordered a Tom Yum soup. It was flavorful and went very well with rice. I ate it all, leaving only some spices.
sample_reviews_en.author: 叶子

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was raining so heavily...

I stumbled upon this restaurant by chance to escape the rain, and it is truly, genuinely delicious.

You won't find food of this quality and made with such care at this price...!

I have visited Thailand countless times, but I am so happy to have found one of the best restaurants of all time :)

The owner is friendly and speaks great English, so I had a wonderful and delicious meal.

Here is what I ate!

Pad See Ew 50 baht

Seafood Curry 85 baht
sample_reviews_en.author: David Byun

sample_reviews_en.text: Prior to dining, the ambiance of the restaurant, "Simply Life Simply Family Restaurant," evokes a sense of familiarity, akin to enjoying lunch at home while experiencing the outdoors. Furthermore, the quality of the cuisine is exceptional, attributed to the use of uncomplicated cooking methods. ***i made this post before they served. And the portion are huge with good price! Natural flavor!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenneth Li

restaurants.name: I Like To Eat - Coffee Breakfast Pastries Icecream
restaurants.address:

No 71, Samsen 4 Alley, Khwaeng Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is seriously amazing!!! It’s not just about the food (which is incredible, by the way, thanks for the Thai woman chef). We had the avocado toast with scrambled eggs and bacon, and everything was perfect, the bread was so soft, and the eggs were cooked just right.

What really makes it special is the location. It’s tucked away in a small alley surrounded by locals, and you don’t just visit, you feel immersed in everyday life there. It’s like stepping into the rhythm of the neighborhood, being part of it, and experiencing the culture up close.

It gives you a true local Bangkok experience, but at the same time, the food is so well done that it feels like home. Definitely a spot I’d come back to!
sample_reviews_en.author: Adriana Fontes

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall great little breakfast spot to come to.

There were 2 of us, ordered a smoothie, pineapple juice, yoghurt bowl and bacon and egg sandwich.

Unfortunately the collegen smoothie came out as a coffee, but we didn't ask as there was only 1 lovely lady running it.

The food was great and cooked perfectly, about 4 - 5 tables inside, air con and lovely staff.

Remember card machine has a 3% fee, total came to around ~ £12 all together, not too bad.

I would come back if I were in the area, however I believe you could go somewhere else for better value. Maybe we just went on an off day!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kai Sweet

sample_reviews_en.text: A truly relaxing experience. The coffee was absolutely delicious, perfectly made and comforting. The toast was soft and light, and the jam was easily my favourite, fresh and full of flavour. We also enjoyed eggs and toast, which were simple yet done really well. What made the experience even better was the host, who was incredibly polite and friendly, making us feel very welcome. A calm, cosy spot that’s perfect for a relaxed breakfast or coffee break. ☕✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Sameshni Moodley

sample_reviews_en.text: Got fooled by the good reviews. The food was very basic and below average for a café. Service was disappointing as well - it felt like the staff member really didn’t want to be there. The only positive thing I can say is that after telling us they had no ice for our iced lattes, she actually went out to buy some. Bottom line - if you’re looking for a coffee shop, don’t go here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Rasmussen

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was tasty, coffee was okay. Came here by following Google reviews. I would give 5 star until the very last moment when owner said "we have a special promotion, we give you a croissant for a review on Google Maps". That's discouraging if majority of reviews were "bought" by a croissant. Otherwise a decent place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ostap Gonchar

sample_reviews_en.text: A small cozy little place, serving the best scrambled eggs i have had in a while. Very fresh! Good coffee. Although i got a cappucino eventhough i ordered an americano. But the kind owner made it free of charge. 10/10 recomend to anyone in search for some nice inexpensive breakfast. Will visit again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hjalmar Lidström

sample_reviews_en.text: What a great place! Don’t let the small size fool you. The coffee is excellent, the breakfast menu is delicious, and the hosts are the nicest people you’ll find. They went out of their way to give us recommendations for little known places to see in Bangkok. Highly recommend!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tillman Farley

sample_reviews_en.text: I opted for the vegan yoghurt breakfast with peanut butter which was a perfect breakfast dish in the morning. The staff were nothing but perfect, great service, warm smiles and all round good people. I definitely recommend this place 10/10!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Hamilton

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mr. Bao MALATANG 🌶️🍜

📍 Self-service Mala Tang (Spicy Hot Pot) Shop

🥬 Choose your own ingredients, priced by weight.

🌶️ Adjust the spiciness to your liking.

🍜 They also sell noodles and wontons.

⚠️ Some ingredients felt a little overcooked.

🥣 The broth was good.

👍 Overall, it's pretty good and worth recommending.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's incredibly delicious! I hope it stays open for a long time. Every time I come back to Bangkok, I eat it every day. Please don't close! I beg you, please, please, please stay open for a long time. No other place can surpass this one. I've eaten mala at many places, but this is the best I've ever had.
sample_reviews_en.author: Plostchildzj

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the upside-down glass had a musty smell, possibly because it hadn't been properly dried. Everything else was 10/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: sukanda Kiangkai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and the staff were very friendly and helpful. Free parking on the school side for 2 hours was also great!
sample_reviews_en.author: พรกนก คําสุดที

sample_reviews_en.text: Affordable prices, delicious food, lovely staff, and parking available. I've eaten here many times.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณิชชญา โสลําภา

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times, it's delicious.
The staff are lovely and the restaurant is clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: อชิรวิทย์ พึ่งพินิจ

sample_reviews_en.text: The mala is delicious! I eat here often and never get bored. The staff are also lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุกัญญา ศรีจันทร์สุข

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. The taste is good. The staff are lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: snall002

restaurants.name: Sukiya (สุคิยะ) - ซัมเมอร์​ พ้อยท์
restaurants.address:

PH7R+XQ6 Summer Point Building7 Sukhumvit 69 Alley, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, I didn't want to give even a single star. I ordered food but didn't get everything (perhaps I hadn't confirmed it yet), so I asked the staff if the additional order had been placed yet. If it hadn't, I could cancel it. Staff: "Customer, just order this."
So I asked if I had already ordered, but it might not have been entered into the system. I protested that it hadn't been placed yet, so instead of replying, "Did you get any items you didn't get yet? I'll take care of it." "No," he replied, "You just ordered this." I then spoke to the superintendent sitting in the picture, "Is this how you serve me?" Instead of asking what was missing, he said he'd hurry up and fix it (I was the only one in the restaurant at the time). He replied, "No order." So I asked the superintendent what he wanted.
He couldn't solve the problem, and I ended up paying 119 baht.

Then I asked him, "How many years has this restaurant been open? Do you know?" He didn't even know. I'm a frequent diner at this branch, so to be honest, I won't be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eehttan!!

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those that don't know, Sukiya is kind of like a Japanese McDonalds. It's essentially fast food service.

With that in mind, I think the food, service, and standards are up to par given the affordable prices for this worldwide Gyudon chain.

You can view the menu by scanning a QR code and placing your order. The food is pretty decent, but occasionally orders get stuck and the food orders don't go through so if you're sitting there for more than 10 minutes and haven't received your order be sure to check with the staff.

I still frequent this location semi-regularly because the food is good, cheap, and fast. The service is lacking a bit because they are relying on the automation to do it's job, and so customer service just doesn't happen.

You get greeted, told to scan a QR code, they drop your food when it's ready, and that's it. If there an issue, it's not easy to get service.

Overall, it's not a bad establishment as long as you understand what you're getting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ron T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noon, my friend and I visited your restaurant for lunch. Following the waiter's instruction, we scanned the QR code on the table to select dishes and place the order. However, after waiting for more than 30 minutes, our food still hadn’t been served.

When we asked the waiter about this, we were informed that their system had not received any order from us. The two of us waited in the restaurant for half an hour, yet the restaurant neither took the initiative to confirm our order status nor checked for system issues. This poor service attitude and system vulnerability have seriously ruined our dining experience, and we hereby file a complaint.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wongthai Pravit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is slightly different to what you'd get in Japan, so it's fun to compare the different flavors.
I ordered the cheese beef bowl, and the cheese in particular tasted different to what you'd get in Japan, making it delicious in its own way.
The restaurant was hygienic and the service was good.
The prices are surprisingly only slightly higher than in Japan, so if you're craving Japanese food, be sure to stop by.
I did find it a bit inconvenient that you have to order on your smartphone by scanning a QR code rather than ordering verbally or using a meal ticket.
sample_reviews_en.author: かにトラベル

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a fast food chain familiar to Japanese people.
It's a recently opened store that's open 24 hours a day.
It's relatively low priced, and the beef bowl tastes as it is.

The beef is stuck together in a clump, but that's pretty normal in this country.
It was a large portion, which is unusual for Thailand.

The pork soup was piping hot and pretty much as it was.
There were lots of toppings too.

I don't think Japanese people eat ramen very often at Sukiya, but it seems they cater to a wide variety of needs.

It's a comforting taste for us common people.
sample_reviews_en.author: a k

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm Japanese. I've eaten at Sukiya countless times in Japan, so I'm leaving this review. The service was incredibly fast. So fast it felt like a lightning-fast boat. And the taste was just Japanese. I thought maybe there wasn't enough soup, but it didn't matter because it was so delicious after such a long time. It brought back painful memories from my student days and I almost cried, but it's also true that Sukiya has helped me to work hard. It made me want to work hard again. Please forgive my incoherent writing. Thank you. I'm rooting for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katsu “K”

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food came out very quickly, just in time for my hunger.
The staff were very welcoming and everyone was smiling.

Ordering via QR code was easy and convenient.

The taste was typical Sukiyaki – not too salty or too sweet.
Good value for money.

Beef bowl + Coke: 169 baht.
The atmosphere was okay; no strong food smells in the air, the air conditioning was cool, and the music was playing softly. The tables and floor were clean, and the condiments were also clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anongsri Boon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sukiya Standard

If you're craving Japan, you won't be disappointed.

The breakfast menu is incredibly affordable.

We recommend arriving before noon to order breakfast.

For 69 baht, you can get a Japanese set meal, which is fantastic.

You can also change the rice to porridge for no extra charge.

The taste is exactly like eating in Japan.

The food is served quickly, perfect for those in a hurry and hungry.

I'll definitely be back often, as it's close to home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yumi 1412

restaurants.name: Jason Chicken Rice
restaurants.address:

302 Rama III Rd, Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jason's dry chicken rice today 🍜✨
May your life be like your favorite restaurant's soup — flavorful, warm, and filled with love from others 🤍
May money pour in like a full plate of chicken, with good luck that doesn't need any extra seasoning 🐔💸
May your heart be full after eating too 🌤️

#Jason'sChickenRice #DryChickenRice #Foodie #Delicious #TastyMeal #EatWell #GoodLuckLikeDeliciousFood #TikTokFoodReview #Foodie #ComfortFood

sample_reviews_en.text: I've passed by this place many times, but only recently had the chance to eat here. Parking is available on the street. The rice is good, fragrant and not soggy. sample_reviews_th.text: The food is delicious, the taste is great, and the prices are reasonable. The staff provides good service. The Vietnamese spring rolls (แหนมเนือง) are delicious, and the corn salad (ตำข้าวโพด) is also delicious.

It's even more delicious than before! Today, two of us went and initially ordered 4-5 dishes: larb, som tum suan (spicy papaya salad with noodles), sweet vegetable curry, fried chicken wings, and mixed spicy salad. Everything was so delicious! The fried chicken was crispy and hot, just as tasty as always. The spicy salad and som tum were perfectly balanced, with a spicy kick that's perfect for those who love spice. The sweet vegetable curry was refreshing and easy to drink.

The best part was the mixed spicy salad and the incredibly fresh crab! It was so fresh we were surprised and ordered extra crab to eat. It was the best thing ever! We even cut ourselves on the shell while eating the crab, but we kept eating because it was so fresh and delicious.

Please maintain this level of freshness! It makes the spicy salad look so fresh and clean. 💗💗

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lao | Vietnamese by tummour
Cuisine Type: Lao-Vietnamese
Recommended Dishes: Vietnamese Platter, Grilled Pork Neck, Fried Chicken Wings
Food: There are a huge variety of dishes to choose from. They have over 10 types of papaya salad. We ordered the Thai style papaya salad, which was okay, not amazing. The highlight was the Vietnamese platter, which included many kinds of fried items. It was a little oily, but the dipping sauce wasn't to our liking. The grilled pork neck and spicy pork neck salad were delicious. The fried chicken we ordered last time was also delicious. The three-mushroom curry was average. The spicy dipping sauce was good.
Atmosphere:

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually like to eat som tam at Tam Mua. Their flavors are truly delicious. This Lao-Vietnamese restaurant by Tam Mua has to say that the flavors really do not disappoint. I ordered fresh spring rolls, grilled pork noodles, and pork sausage with herbs. Every dish was delicious and flavorful, especially the pork sausage with herbs. The pork sausage was very soft and the ingredients were very flavorful. The service was excellent. The staff were polite and served the food very quickly. I highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanpirom K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small Northeastern Thai restaurant in Central Rama 2 (they have several branches in Central malls). There aren't many tables. The portions are generous and filling. If you don't want to wait in long queues at other restaurants, I recommend this one.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly delicious! Perfect for a mala lover like me. They even let you choose your spice level, which is awesome! What impressed me just as much as the food was the service. The staff were so kind and polite, and they helped guide me since I'd never been to a restaurant like this before. I was confused several times, but they still smiled and provided excellent service without getting annoyed. The atmosphere in the restaurant was also very comfortable and cool with perfect air conditioning. The music was just right; I almost fell asleep while eating because of the overall ambiance. It felt so relaxed, like eating at home (or my safe zone). This is my second visit, and it's definitely one of my favorite restaurants!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patitta Butkaek

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is super clean, and there's a huge selection of food to choose from. It's incredibly good value! Anyone passing by Ramkhamhaeng University should stop by. You can use Thai Plus too. Another really special thing is that Ramkhamhaeng University students get a 10% discount! I was so excited, I filled my plate so much and paid less than 100 baht! It's also an Islamic restaurant, so Muslim students can eat here too. The owner is super kind, I'm so impressed! Don't forget to stop by for some mala after your exams! The shop is right in front of the university. And the taste is amazing, the broth is flavorful and the dipping sauce is fantastic. 10/10/10!

sample_reviews_en.text:
“How about having Hainan Chicken rice + Thai massage?”
.
This place is one and only Hainan chicken place around this area. “Eak Hainan Chicken Watergate” is a sub branch of the famous “Goang Hainan Chicken rice” in the watergate area. Unfortunately, Eak doesn’t live up to Goang legacy. Their dish is dry and doesn’t give out satisfaction through out the meal. The only good thing here is you got a FREE refill for soup.

Their staffs are ok but the location is terribly bad, only best for walk-in/taxi. DO NOT DRIVE HERE. There are NO parking spot around this place. There are lot of flies in front of the stores and fews inside that the staff should have taken care of too. Luckily, their restroom is clean on moderate level, so this place isn’t all that bad.

Also, there are Thai massage on the 2nd floor of this place that I haven’t try it yet. If you are looking for any Thai massage + restaurant. This might be a place for you.

Overall rating
Pricing : reasonable
Place : 5/10
Food : 7/10
Service : 8/10
Cleanliness : 7/10
Parking spots : NO

Hope this helps!
ACWJ

When I got to the location on the map, the shutters were closed. I went to a nearby food court and, just as other people had said, found the restaurant sign!

📍2929 Rama IV Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

I wonder when they moved to the food court?

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located in Bangkok's Khlong Tan district,

Pad Thai Mae Am is a long-established Thai stir-fried rice noodle restaurant. The taste is very traditional and authentic. The chef is an elderly lady whose skillful cooking belies her appearance.

The flavor is very much to the liking of Thais, slightly sweet. The rice noodles have the perfect texture—firm and springy, not too mushy.

The staff are friendly and quick-witted. Seeing my bewildered expression as I didn't speak Thai, they immediately gave me an English menu. Since seating is limited, it's recommended to visit after peak hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: BLAKE CHENG

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to eat here often, but recently the taste hasn't been the same. It's bland and doesn't taste like Pad Thai; it's just like eating regular stir-fried noodles. Even though the staff added a lot of seasonings like fish sauce and sugar, it's because they just reheated the noodles and added more seasoning, instead of stir-frying them with the original Pad Thai sauce which tasted much better. Also, the staff can't remember my orders; if I order multiple dishes at once, I get the same thing every time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a classic, old-style Pad Thai. I'd say it's as good as the popular Thipsamai (maybe even better) but much cheaper. They offer delivery on GrabFood, which is preferable as coming to the shop is quite a hassle (no parking, so we parked at Tesco and walked) and the shop has no air conditioning, making it uncomfortable in the super hot April weather.

The Pad Thai is delicious, the noodles are chewy and soft, the flavor is good, and the price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bangkok Stray dog

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the kind of restaurant that used to come to my mind when I thought of Bangkok.
Small, hole in the wall, run by an auntie who also cooks all of the food. Pictures of a yesteryear on the walls.
Pad Thai is very good, not the best, but different from others in a good way. The auntie cooked it right in front us.
Fair prices, but the shrimp Pad Thai has only 2 shrimps. So I would get the chicken option instead if I were you.

Would come back.

It was only 50 baht, so it was definitely worth it◎

restaurants.name: Türk Restoranı İzmir Restaurant
restaurants.address:

382/26 ล็อค A, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I never imagined I would encounter such taste and quality in Thailand. İzmir Restaurant truly lives up to its name. From the moment you step inside, you are greeted by a spotlessly clean and meticulously maintained environment. Every corner of the place is tidy, and they are extremely meticulous about hygiene. As for the food; it was the most delicious Turkish food I've had in a long time. The quality of the ingredients, the care in the presentation, and the way they perfectly reflect the taste of authentic Turkish cuisine are admirable. I felt as if I were eating in a restaurant in Turkey. Especially the hospitality and sincerity of the owner, Altuğ, made this experience even more special. His personal attention to customers, his consideration for every detail, and his smiling face made you feel at home, not a guest. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone living in or visiting Thailand. It's a perfect 10 out of 10 for cleanliness, quality, taste, and service. I have no doubt that anyone who comes once will want to come again. For those who miss Turkish cuisine, this is definitely a must-visit place. Thank you İzmir Restaurant, thank you Mr. Altuğ. We'll be back soon! 🇹🇷❤️🍽️
sample_reviews_en.author: Emre Cetin

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a saying, "The food is legendary, like it's made with a mother's touch," and yes, this place is just that. The owner and chef are the same person, my brother Altuğ 👨‍🍳. He approaches things with great care and never lets anyone else cook for him. He uses high-quality olive oil, butter, and selects every ingredient himself. When combined with his culinary skills, imagine how delicious it becomes. We, a family of four, have been going there to eat since the day we arrived. He sends us the menu for the day, and if you want something, he'll make it for you the next day. He's such a wonderful person. We've been here so many times, eaten at dozens of Turkish restaurants, but finding this kind of taste wasn't easy. We finally found it! Thank you so much, we'll be going again today 🫠
sample_reviews_en.author: Fatma Özbudak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't go. Absolutely do not go.
You go there excitedly and happily after seeing the Turkish flag, but you leave disappointed, hungry, and angry. You can't eat anything, you can't be happy.
The salad isn't a salad, and the complimentary raw meatballs are so bad even animals wouldn't eat them.
Go if you want to eat rice. Just rice.
Be careful, their yogurt is sour. They can't make it properly, and then they make excuses, saying they don't have yogurt. You order Adana kebab, and it's bone dry. We ordered calamari, and it was raw, undercooked. On top of all this, you pay for a week's worth of food in Pattaya, Thailand, and you don't even get to eat in one night. In short, don't go; they're making Türkiye look bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bilal Tuncer

sample_reviews_en.text: For anyone living in or visiting Pattaya, this is one of the top places where you can find Turkish food, stews, breakfast options, and other alternatives. With its friendly staff and owner, Mr. Altuğ, you'll feel very comfortable and can enjoy your meal with peace of mind. I ordered the chicken, rice, yogurt, and side dish trio for takeout. It was delicious and offered excellent value for money. I highly recommend visiting this Izmir restaurant. Also, the tea and Turkish coffee are always fresh 😉
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuri Acar

sample_reviews_en.text: I wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant to everyone. Not only because the food is delicious, but also because the owner is a highly cultured, educated, and intellectual person. I encourage all my fellow citizens to visit and support this valuable establishment. I sincerely thank him for his hospitality and genuine warmth. He truly knows how to run a business and keep his guests happy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fatih Asef Başıbüyük

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner is a warm and friendly person from Izmir; he's very attentive and his conversation is warm. It has a friendly atmosphere, and the Turkish food is truly like the best flavors of Anatolia. I was very pleased and I thank the owner and staff. I recommend it to everyone coming to Thailand. Definitely stop by when you're in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahmet

sample_reviews_en.text: As Turkish travelers exploring the world, sometimes what we miss most is a plate of home-cooked food. We wholeheartedly thank İzmir Restaurant and its friendly team for helping us satisfy this craving in Pattaya. The taste, sincerity, and hospitality were truly wonderful. If you ever find yourself in the area, be sure to visit! 🙏🇹🇷
sample_reviews_en.author: TUFAN YABANOĞLU

sample_reviews_en.text: I recommend you don't forget to ask about the day's menu at dinner. Our friend Altuğ is a person worth getting to know with his pleasant conversation and professionalism. The availability of brewed tea at all hours is also a great plus for the restaurant.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a somtum (papaya salad) restaurant I saw reviewed by influencers on TikTok, so I decided to try it. The dishes I ordered today were grilled chicken, somtum with crab and fermented fish sauce, somtum suan (a type of papaya salad), somtum with pickled shellfish, and somtum with bamboo shoots. Overall, the taste was pretty good. I especially liked the somtum with bamboo shoots and the somtum with crab and fermented fish sauce. The grilled chicken was delicious and very tender. If you're driving, there's parking available, but you might have to park at Union Mall and walk over. The restaurant's atmosphere is quite nice, with a vintage feel. As for the price, I think it's a bit pricey, but not excessively so. It's affordable. However, one thing I'd like to see improve is the staff; I felt they weren't paying enough attention to customers and were chatting loudly amongst themselves. But overall, it was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyahphat Mala-E

sample_reviews_en.text:
I hesitated for a long time about whether to try this restaurant or not, because the reviews on Google weren't very good 😅

But today I finally had the chance to try it. The food tasted great! The grilled chicken was incredibly tender, and the dipping sauce was delicious – a perfect balance of sweet and sour. The papaya salad was okay, average. The crispy catfish salad was incredibly spicy and delicious – like a Thai-style salad, very easy to eat. The ant egg dish wasn't quite to my liking; the eggs didn't seem fresh enough and lacked the creamy texture I've had at other restaurants. But overall, the food was good.

The owner, an elderly lady, provided excellent service. She smiled, chatted with me, recommended drinks, and even opened a bottle for me. So sweet!

I recommend giving it a try! It's pretty good 💖
sample_reviews_en.author: Sonya Cn.

sample_reviews_en.text: This somtum (papaya salad) and grilled chicken restaurant is located in Soi Ladprao 1, a short walk from the MRT station. It's not a very big restaurant, but the decor is nice, although the lighting is a bit dim. They offer a variety of dishes, ordered via mobile phone. We ordered somtum with crispy pork skin, crispy catfish salad, shrimp larb, and grilled pork neck. The portions were quite large. The somtum was okay, not too spicy. We ordered the crispy catfish salad less spicy, and it was delicious and a generous portion. The larb was also good, with a well-balanced flavor, but after eating everything together, it became a bit salty. The grilled pork neck was in large pieces, but it wasn't hot anymore and was too fatty for our taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaya Aungtananukul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small restaurant is another safe haven for somtum (papaya salad) and grilled chicken.

It's easy to eat, the taste is okay, and the price is good. The downside is that it's located on a street in a side alley, so there might be some unpleasant smells wafting through.

The grilled chicken is on the dry side, salty and sweet with a slight herbal aroma. I personally liked it.
The Thai somtum and Luang Prabang somtum were both good. Ordering them with normal spiciness was standard; those who don't like spicy food might need to ask for less chili.
The pork sausage was delicious, but a bit too thin.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirayu Visanuruk

sample_reviews_en.text:
The manager is a foul-mouthed guy (I think), and there's only one of him. He's unfriendly, speaks rudely, and is very aggressive, even towards strangers. I feel sorry for the staff who have to work with someone like that.

[Responding to the store's reply again: "We did not intend to cause any discomfort," but please review the behavior of your staff. (The other staff members are lovely and friendly.)]

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is in a somewhat cramped commercial building. The decor is vintage, with cute old-fashioned tableware.

The food is delicious, but personally, I found the flavors a bit sweet. Not overly sweet, but with a noticeable sweetness. The papaya salad with fermented fish sauce was very fragrant but slightly sweet; the fermented fish sauce dip was tasty. For the spicy pork rib soup, I recommend ordering it regular spicy for a spicier experience.

The food came out quickly, the staff provided good and attentive service, and the prices were reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Littlepaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stayed in this area for a few years but only tried it this year. Always saw their roast chicken in their roasting oven outside their shop. Indeed the roast chicken is good. Special mention on the sauce that goes with the chicken. Tom Yum & pad Thai taste different from what I used to ate but is above average. Noted most of other customers ordered Som Tum which must also be their signature dish.
Came on Jul 2026. Chicken still good. Boat noodles surprisingly good. Basil pork with century egg I like. Only the pork ribs soup I felt so so only.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrick Loh

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good, it was okay.
The Thai papaya salad was a bit sweet, not very sour.
The fermented crab papaya salad had a flavorful fermented fish sauce, the papaya strips were crispy, and it was mixed just right. Personally, I prefer it more mushy.
The grilled chicken was tender and delicious, served with a tamarind dipping sauce that was a bit sweet. The minced pork salad was pretty good, with a nice herbal aroma, well-made, and not too sour. This restaurant tends to keep the sourness low.
Overall, it was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pai Pai Jitlada

It is fantastic value and very highly recommended.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small Southern Thai restaurant in the city with a very warm and charming atmosphere 🥰 Beautiful decor, giving you the feeling of Southern Thailand – simple, warm, and unique 🌴

The food was incredibly delicious! 😋 Rich, bold, and full of authentic Southern Thai flavors, yet perfectly balanced. You can really taste the care put into every dish.

Another highlight was the excellent service from the staff, who were fluent in English 😊 Polite, friendly, and communicating well with international customers, making the atmosphere even more enjoyable.

A small restaurant, but with big quality ❤️ The food, atmosphere, and service were all excellent. Definitely a place I want to return to!

For Foreigners:
The food was absolutely delicious! 😋 Rich, bold, and full of authentic Southern Thai flavors, while still being perfectly balanced. Every dish was packed with flavor and clearly made with care.

The service was excellent, and the staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and fluent in English, which made communication very easy and the dining experience even more enjoyable. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcharee S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious! I found this place by chance, but I'll definitely be back. Authentic Southern Thai flavors, and the prices are really affordable. I want more people to try this restaurant. The decor is cute, and the seating is comfortable. I'll be back soon! 💘💘💘

-Dry Fish Kidney Curry with Rice > So delicious! The fish kidney curry is fragrant and not fishy. The rice isn't soggy, and the spiciness is just right.
-Chaiya Pad Thai > I've never had this dish before! The sauce has a very unique and fragrant aroma. The noodles are chewy and delicious!
-Shrimp in Spicy Soup > My eyes lit up when I tasted it! The flavor is very rich and the tangy taste is perfect. It's the best with rice and vegetables!
-Stir-fried Shrimp with Sataw and Shrimp Paste > This might not be my preferred style (I like it drier and thicker), but the flavor was good. The shrimp was fresh and crispy, and they used authentic Southern Thai sataw.
sample_reviews_en.author: pp

sample_reviews_en.text: A lovely place with delicious, fresh food. There was an array of beer available including some pale ale and a dark lager - welcome variety. Some of the food was properly hot ('Thai spicy') but I was kindly warned by the waiter and given an opportunity to back out. The yellow curry was certainly a fiery experience, but a worthwhile one. The green curry was also rather powerful, but very delicious. There were plenty of gentler options available. The shrimp that came in the fried rice were large, juicy and plentiful. The spring rolls were some of the tastiest we have had. The white sangria drink, full of fresh fruit, received rave reviews. Vegetarians in the party were well catered for.
sample_reviews_en.author: George J

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious! The restaurant isn't very big, but the decor is cute. Every dish was amazing, full of flavor. The tangy chili paste was perfect, the yellow curry was fantastic with plenty of young coconut shoots, and the fried chicken was incredibly crispy – the skin was super crunchy! Another highlight was the iced Thai tea!! It tasted like authentic Southern Thai tea, so fragrant. The prices were reasonable. I was very impressed.

The owner was very friendly and lovely, even offered me a sample of their special chili paste.

Overall, I loved it and will definitely go back. There are many more dishes I want to try! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: fns

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Southern Thai food here is perfectly seasoned and generously portioned. The shrimp dishes are excellent, with fresh, crispy, and large shrimp. We ordered several dishes including fried chicken, sataw (bitter beans), sour curry, Chaiya pad Thai (with chewy noodles), pomelo salad, crab curry with rice noodles, and sweet pork. Every dish was worth the price. My favorites were the sataw and fried chicken! 😍 The restaurant is quite small, but the food didn't take long to arrive.

It's near Sam Yot MRT station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dear J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious! It's typical Southern Thai family-style cuisine. Besides classic Southern Thai dishes like shrimp stir-fried with stink beans, stir-fried bai-lien (a type of Thai egg), and various yellow curries with rice noodles, they also offer Chinese dishes rooted in Southern Thai culture, such as braised pork belly and fried crab balls – all very tasty! 😋

The price is great – no tax, no service charge, the taste, the location – it's really good value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hilda Huang

The Malaysian/singaporean-style coffee, tea, and food here are incredibly authentic, and the pastries are delightful! ☕🍰 I truly enjoy the delicious offerings at this spot. 💖

sample_reviews_en.text: Experience Malaysian food: Malay rice and Hakka fried chicken. Personally, I didn't find the taste as impressive as what I've had before. The sweet chili sauce was similar to Thai chili paste, and the fried chicken was battered and bland. Compared to the price of 150 baht, I thought it was overpriced. The mixed fried platter at 100 baht was also expensive considering the portion size. However, the dry noodles with char siu pork were delicious; adding some vinegar and chili powder made it worth the price. The drinks, surprisingly, were strong, tasty, and worth the money. You can try it if you're passing by, but I wouldn't be captivated. I haven't tried the desserts yet, but they looked tempting.

sample_reviews_en.text: I originally saved this restaurant as one of my favorites, and then I saw on the map that it was located nearby. It originally moved from Rat Burana. The food is just as delicious and impressive as before. The custard toast is crispy, the noodles are flavorful and not too dry, and the milky coffee is very refreshing. I didn't get a picture of the fried pork sandwich though, as the pork was a bit chewy. There is parking available.

If you are someone from Singapore, Malaysia, etc. or miss this type of food from your trip there, please come here to bring back those memories. Very recommended!

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on Ratchawat Road, and you can park on the side of the road. They have a very diverse menu, including crispy pork rice, Hainanese chicken rice, chicken rice, and noodle soup (kuy chap). But their signature dish is the offal rice; you won't find it anywhere else – only here. The noodle soup is good; the broth is rich and flavorful, not too salty, just right. The offal rice has the same ingredients as the noodle soup, but it's served over rice with the restaurant's special sauce. The owner is very kind. The restaurant opens early and closes at 10 PM. The prices and portion sizes are excellent, starting at 50 baht – very affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benz

sample_reviews_en.text: Khao Kuk Noodle Shop is located on Nakhon Chai Si Road, opposite Ratchawat Market. It's an open-air shop with several tables for dine-in. They sell noodle soup (Khao Kup), fish maw soup, Hainanese chicken rice, chicken leg rice, crispy pork rice, pork offal rice, and thick broth noodle soup. The taste is good, and the prices are moderate. Parking can be difficult.
