sample_reviews_en.text:
A Divine Culinary Journey at SHIKI Omakase Bangkok

Dining at SHIKI Omakase Bangkok was extraordinary. It’s not just the best omakase I’ve ever had — it’s the best meal of my life. Every course was a masterpiece, combining precision, creativity, and an uncompromising respect for premium ingredients.

From the first bite to the last, the flavors were perfectly balanced and deeply satisfying. The otoro was buttery and rich, the uni was sweet and  fresh, and fish selections showed off the chef’s refined technique and deep understanding of umami. Every dish told a story, and every moment felt thoughtfully curated.

If you’re in Bangkok get a seat at SHIKI. This isn’t just a meal — it’s a celebration of Japanese culinary art at its highest level.
sample_reviews_en.author: parinya raksakaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
-This omakase restaurant on the 7th floor has an amazing atmosphere. Walking in, you get the full Japanese vibe. The decor is beautiful, the mood is great, and there's a rooftop-style balcony with a gorgeous garden and gently flowing water. Sitting outside offers a different ambiance as well.

-The food in the course was excellent in every dish. The signature dishes were outstanding, perfectly balanced, and melted in your mouth. The dessert, probably a sorbet, was tangy, refreshing, and had a delightful crunchy texture.

-The chef explained the dishes very well and was very friendly. The staff were also lovely and attentive.

-There's also parking available 🚗

Loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nina C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been to this place last night for the first time as newly opened restaurant. And I found that it was so amazing with a breathtaking view of Bangkok. I think, the restaurant is presented a new style of Japanese Omagase ambience, not like others with a vibrant and fantastic fun mood by the music. Their food is so fresh in each course. The chef offered various kind of fresh-made food. The price is reasonable. The restaurant is on the roof top of Value Plus Bldg, near Samsen Train Station. The building is clean and there’s a parking inside.
In summary, it is highly recommended place for anyone who likes to try an Omagase Japanese Food in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panchita Banleuchairit

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere feels really calming and relaxing, the decorations and soft music adds a cozy vibe. There is an outside balcony with a beautiful garden you can take photos in and the view is really nice. The service made me and my family feel very welcomed and we felt like we were at home. Lastly, the food is amazing!! There’s so many deluxe selections and they are all top tier. I really recommend this restaurant especially coming with your friends and family. And if you want a private space it’s perfect because they even have a private room. I guarantee you that you will have a great time here and an amazing tasty meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rongrong Bhuridej

sample_reviews_en.text:
a hidden omakase spot around the Samsen area. The view is beautiful, the atmosphere is lovely, and most importantly, the course price is very good value for what you get.

Their sushi uses red vinegar rice, with flavors that are nicely balanced — not too bold, not too light. The menu is well-rounded: about half is sushi, and the other half includes sashimi, simmered, grilled, and fried dishes. The ingredients are of good quality and thoughtfully selected.

I went for the 3,500-baht course (13 courses) and even got to enjoy premium-grade uni, served generously in a full row — absolutely impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hangry Joobert

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant's signature dish is excellent. The appetizer is highly recommended, offering a mix of sweet and savory flavors. Many dishes are rich in flavor. The restaurant uses Yuzu in many dishes, making it refreshing enough to continue eating until the end of the course. The dessert is a perfect balance of light and heavy flavors, ending with Yuzu Sorbet, which is tangy and refreshing. Anyone who loves a refreshing taste should not miss this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: F329

sample_reviews_en.text: This omakase restaurant is not overly complicated, and the atmosphere is relaxed (the outdoor lighting at night is amazing and subtly romantic). Every dish was delicious. You can tell the chef what you don't like or don't want. Some dishes were so good I had to ask for seconds. The dessert and sorbet were fantastic and incredibly refreshing. They even had a cute little birthday surprise cake on the day I went.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gybbie

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time trying omakase was amazing, and I was incredibly impressed. The ingredients were fresh, the flavors were excellent, the atmosphere was wonderful, and the decor was beautiful. The exterior features a Japanese-style garden. The restaurant isn't very spacious, giving it a cozy feel. It's perfect for a date or a family outing. It's located on the 7th floor, and parking is available downstairs.
sample_reviews_en.author: เที่ยวกับคิน กินกับกาย

restaurants.name: Little Tiger Thai BBQ
restaurants.address:

สี่แยก 3781 Kluai Nam Thai Rd, Khwaeng Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a typical pork barbecue. The food is as pictured, but not as extensive as what some review pages have posted. It costs another 50 baht for the grill. If you're in a hurry to grill seafood, I recommend getting it grilled right away. The charcoal ran out and they wouldn't refill it. When I called the staff, they were confused and didn't know what to do, just walking past without paying attention. The shrimp weren't fresh, but not terrible. It was edible enough to pass the time. But the worst part is that the restaurant is very stingy. The shrimp are refilled very slowly. I asked, and they said they refill every 15 minutes. I waited until the charcoal ran out, but they still didn't refill it. After an hour, they refilled about a full tray. It took two people to finish it.
I'd like the restaurant to improve:
1. The staff service
2. The refilling. Buffets need to be more generous and generous. Don't hold back on food. Customers will only experience this once.
The taste of the food is average, standard for pork barbecue. The price isn't expensive. If they can improve on those two things, it would be great.
sample_reviews_en.author: yuht nong_o

sample_reviews_en.text:
My family and I recently dined at Little Thai Tiger BBQ, and it was a delightful experience! This cozy spot offers an impressive array of authentic Thai dishes, all cooked to perfection on their barbecue grill. The aroma of the sizzling meats and vegetables immediately draws you in, and the flavors do not disappoint. From the juicy skewers to the flavorful curries, every bite was a burst of deliciousness.

The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with friendly staff who make you feel right at home. While we enjoyed the overall experience and would rate the food and ambiance highly, we encountered a few minor issues with the service that could be improved. Overall, we rated our experience and critiqued the food quality a 3.0/5.0. Whether you're a fan of spicy dishes or prefer something milder, their menu has something for everyone. I recommend Little Thai Tiger BBQ for anyone looking to enjoy a fantastic Thai barbecue experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan Phan

sample_reviews_en.text: I don’t understand why this amazing restaurant got so low score. We lived close to here and every night this restaurant is full of local people until late night. So we tried today and it was AMAZING!!!! The crab scramble egg has so many crab inside only 200B!!! Curry seafood full of real big fresh seafood only 200B!!! Raw shrimp huge pieces like that only 100B!!! The food is almost 1/2 price of the tourist site and no matter the quantity or quality is top of the top!!!! We have 3 people and this 4 big plates are just too much. We wanted to order more but with this portion it’s almost not possible to finish!!! The service is busy and not quite English speaker, most time we pointed at the picture. The service speed is fast. Just LOVE the food here!!!! You almost don’t see tourists here. Definitely a place worth better score!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: M G

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered noodles, but I'm not sure what it tastes like... I ordered a drink, but the employee forgot, so I asked again and they brought it to me. I waited for over 30 minutes for an additional menu item, but it didn't come out. The employee who took our order was nowhere to be seen, and when I called another employee, she pretended not to know. When the woman who came later answered my order, I told her that I would cancel my order if it hadn't been processed, but she apologized, saying she was too busy. It seemed busy, but the people who arrived after us all ate and left, and the delivery service kept coming, but our food didn't come out, so I thought, "Are they ignoring us because we're foreigners?" The taste and service were both poor.
sample_reviews_en.author: 박찐쩐

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my second time here!!!
I discovered this restaurant when I unexpectedly ordered from Shopee Food.
But it turned out to be incredibly delicious!
Clean, good quality, and reasonably priced.
The jasmine rice was soft and smooth, and the crispy pork was crispy.

I loved it so much I drove up to the restaurant and ate there by myself. It's a Thai-style barbecue restaurant that also serves made-to-order food. Most of the customers are Chinese. Parking is available at the PTT gas station, and there's plenty of parking.

The staff are polite and polite. Five stars just isn't enough. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Pisha Thongmoa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The a la carte food at this place tasted quite nice and is recommended. They also serve cheap buffet moo krata.

Most negative reviews are from Grab drivers, of whom there is always a line at this place, ordering online takes long, it's better to eat on location instead.

Place is right next to the street so be ready for a lot of noise and cars right next to you.

♿ Accessibility:
Place has seating on the sidewalk which is wheelchair accessible, to get inside there are some steps down
sample_reviews_en.author: Outboundclub - travel blog

sample_reviews_en.text:
During lunchtime,
it's a buffet-style boat noodle restaurant.
69 baht per person, unlimited time, order as much as you want.
They serve pork/beef noodles in a spicy broth, with all types of noodles available.
Orders are written on a paper slip.
It's not very well-known yet, so it's not very crowded. Good, relaxed service. The restaurant accepts cash and bank transfers.
There's no parking because it's located next to the Kluay Nam Thai traffic light intersection.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitinun PItak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Friendly service, delicious food, a wide selection of dishes, and reasonably priced.
One of the staff members spoke good English, which made ordering easier.
We were a larger group, so tables were quickly set up so we could sit together.
The restaurant seems to be popular because, despite numerous similar restaurants nearby, many people came here for takeout.
I highly recommend it.
The one-star rating is probably a bit of a misnomer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angela Sa

restaurants.name: Tokyo XXX
restaurants.address:

nihonmachi 117 Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small, cozy restaurant with only 4 tables.

They offer a variety of meats.

Only bottled beers are available:
Asahi
Sapporo
Sigha
Heineken

The charcoal fire is strong.
The smoke extractor is efficient and powerful.

Shoes must be removed before entering the restaurant.
The staff will take them away for you.

There is no dipping sauce provided at the restaurant, so you can fully appreciate the flavor of the meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: chamachote chokboonmongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: Not impressed at all. Prices are high for the very small portions served. The Korean-style salad was drenched with dressing so very salty. The tongue was so tiny, with only 5 pieces served. The soup was salty without much flavor and hardly had any meat in it, even though it was Kalbi soup. Overall, a rip-off. No wonder there were no customers, even during peak dinner time on the weekend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phoebe L (Phoebe)

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem of a restaurant has only four tables. The meat is excellent in every way. The liver sashimi is amazing – a must-try! The tomatoes with peach syrup are also delicious and a perfect combination. The staff are lovely. It's a small place, but the atmosphere is warm and charming.
sample_reviews_en.author: PinkSnake

sample_reviews_en.text:
Super good beef! Perfectly balanced for fat and red meat, not too fatty, and the yukhoe is a must-try.

The place is a bit tiny (only 4 tables) and pretty dim—struggled a bit with my bad eyesight 555. Fast service though. A bit pricey, but totally worth it. Left super happy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaktat J.

sample_reviews_en.text: Tokyo XXX offers a truly unique experience, starting with its quirky entrance—half the usual door height—making it feel like you’re stepping into a different world. The ambiance is surprising and unlike anything I expected. The quality of …
sample_reviews_en.author: Putt (Wonderer)

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was excellent! There was a wide variety of food to choose from. The staff provided great service, the restaurant was clean, and you could even change the grill. Meat lovers must try this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: อิงครัตน์ วัฒนะอรุณรัตน์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Large variety of beef of high quality. Not cheap for sure.
Nice service. It is a big room, sitting on the floor, nothing too fancy nor high end, very lively.
sample_reviews_en.author: guy plusplus

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the grilled meat was excellent and tasty, the staff provided good service and the dipping sauces were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิภาทิพย์ วีรหิรัญธานนท์

restaurants.name: นักล่าหมูกระทะ
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ห้อง A202 ปั๊มน้ํามันซัสโก บางบําหรุ Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Bang Bumru, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
- A famous Mookata (Thai BBQ) restaurant has opened in Pinklao, located in Susco Square.
- Parking is easy to find with plenty of spaces, but it's also very crowded.
- Today, we waited for about 40 groups and it took about an hour.
- The food tastes good. The pork is fresh and of good quality, marinated with just the right amount of salt. The pork belly was marinated less saltily.
- The smoke extraction system is excellent, removing 90% of the smoke in the restaurant, and they provide hats to wear to prevent the smell from clinging to your hair.
- You can take unlimited amounts of vegetables and dipping sauces. The vegetables are very fresh and there's a wide variety to choose from.
- The staff provides good and fast service, but table clearing might be a bit slow while waiting in line due to the high volume of customers.
- The price is reasonable compared to roadside Mookata, but the quality of the meat is significantly better.
- It's recommended to book in advance through the app.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kan Treeranurat

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious. Many dishes taste good. I eat at this branch very often because it's close to my house. But I'd like to see some improvements. There are few staffs. It's quite difficult to ask for help. Today, I came to eat but the QR code had a problem, making it impossible to order food. I told the staff. They asked for the food items that I wanted to order so they could key in the items. They probably didn't key in all of them, but that's okay. I waited for a while and was sure that the food hadn't come yet, so I told another staff member that I couldn't order food via the QR code. One staff member said that they would help key in the items, but they probably didn't key in all of them. I haven't had the fried squid egg salad yet. They told me to wait a bit, but I waited and waited until I didn't want to. In the end, I didn't get to eat the fried squid egg salad today. I recommend that if the QR code has a problem, if it can be changed, the customers should change it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nirat Thong

sample_reviews_en.text:
!!!Urgent Improvement Needed!!!
Visited on 01/01/2026
We had to wait in line outside the restaurant. We thought it would be busy inside, but it turned out the staff wouldn't clear tables after customers had finished eating, leaving them full of plates, bowls, and pans.
We were a group of 6 and had to wait for staff to clear a large table because they initially wanted us to sit separately, but we refused and wanted a large table to sit together.
I don't know if it was because there weren't enough staff that day, but I hope they improve. The staff were friendly and easy to talk to, but the table clearing service was slow and needs improvement.
If this continues, I won't be going to this restaurant again.
Food: Good
Atmosphere: Good (the lack of table clearing ruined the atmosphere)
Service: Terrible
I don't know what other branches are like, but this branch is really not good.
I sympathize with the staff and other customers. I hope they improve.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vadhin Khrueasungnoen

sample_reviews_en.text: !!!Urgent Improvement Needed!!! The restaurant closes at midnight, but you can order food until 11:30 PM. We arrived close to 10:30 PM, and the staff were already unwelcoming. Furthermore, the garlic, a key ingredient in Thai BBQ, was already out of stock before 11 PM. We asked if it was just in the kitchen or the entire restaurant, and the staff said it was all gone, in a very reluctant and grumpy way, as if we were begging for food, even though we were being polite. Is it even possible for garlic to be completely sold out like that? What was the rush? Even roadside BBQ restaurants aren't like this. The service was terrible. They gave us water but didn't provide glasses. No one seemed to notice us when we called for help; we had to go and get it ourselves. Honestly, no matter how good the taste is, this will be our only visit. It's a shame they opened in such a good location, but the service is worse than a roadside stall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornpimol Pornpimol

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is our favorite Mookata (Thai BBQ) restaurant. We're so happy they opened a branch near our house! This branch is large and not too crowded. The food is delicious and clean. However, compared to other branches, there are two things we'd like to see improved:

1. Desserts: Normally, the desserts at this branch are amazing, served hot with ice cream – so refreshing! But at this branch, they were very cold. The toast was dry, the butter hadn't even melted and seeped into the bread – it was like eating fish-shaped bread!😆 I understand the staff might be new, but I'd like them to receive more training.

2. Service: The staff were polite, courteous, and friendly. However, because the restaurant is large and not yet crowded, robots serve almost 100% of the time. It's very difficult to ask for anything extra because there are no staff members. You have to go and ask at the food bar.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sun G

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch has many tables, is spacious, and has parking at the Susco gas station. It's busy during lunchtime and dinnertime. The restaurant is open until 2 AM. Overall, there's still room for improvement in food service. Many dishes were missed, requiring three follow-ups, especially the spicy salad which should have come first as an appetizer but arrived last – by which time we were already full. It was also cold. Despite the app showing "delivery completed," the staff seemed numerous and chaotic.

The prices might be higher than typical BBQ restaurants, and the quality of the ingredients is good, but the portions are a bit small in my opinion. If it's not the buffet, it might not be worth it. I initially really liked this restaurant, but after trying the à la carte menu, I wasn't as impressed.

I hope they improve. I'll continue to patronize the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: D James

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw they opened a new branch,
so I decided to try it on a Wednesday around 1 PM.
I ordered the 399 baht set – the portion size was decent.
What impressed me was that the vegetables, glass noodles, and seaweed were unlimited.

However, there are things I'd like them to improve:
On the day I went, there were about 10 tables occupied,
but the service was very slow. I had to ask for my order three times.
First time: Kimchi and main dishes – waited 20 minutes.
Second time: Water – waited 20 minutes.
Last time: Brown sugar toast with ice cream – waited 30 minutes and still didn't receive it, had to ask again. Total time taken: 40 minutes.

I'm rooting for them to fix the service issue.
Because everyone who comes expects fast service.
There are a lot of tables in the restaurant; I think they'd get a lot of complaints if it were full. I'm rooting for them!
sample_reviews_en.author: อาร์ม อินชัวร์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Moo Kata (Thai BBQ) restaurant at the Susco gas station in Pinklao had extremely long waiting times for food.
1. I ordered fried pork dumplings at 7:48 PM. As of the time of this screenshot (8:40 PM), I still hadn't received my food. The estimated waiting time was 52 minutes.
2. I ordered spicy instant noodle salad with bouncy pork at 8:08 PM and received it around 8:30 PM+. This was acceptable.
3. The papaya salad was terrible.
4. Giving them a chance to redeem themselves after the papaya salad, I ordered another spicy salad. It was equally disappointing.
5. The ordering process should include additional notes for customers, as the taste of the food was awful. I understand they aim for a milder flavor to appeal to everyone, but honestly, the taste we received was very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: นายพัชรพล สีมา

restaurants.name: บ้านสวนคุณย่า
restaurants.address:

147 2 Pracha Uthit 72 Alley, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: First of all, I am local. I found this place while driving past this road a couple of times. So, I decided to have lunch here. The atmosphere looked awesome when I first arrived. There is a pond with fishes, which is able to feed them. In addition, the food is pretty amazing compared with the price. I ordered a fish called "ปลากระพงสามรส". Its taste is good, and its size is large. I can assure you that having a meal here won't make you feel wrong.
sample_reviews_th.author: Ming Pitchayut

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went exactly at noon. It was very quiet and peaceful. The entrance looked a little rough, but once we arrived, the weather was great, it was calm and cool, and the atmosphere was wonderful. The staff were welcoming and the service was excellent from everyone we met ❤️. The food was delicious in every dish we ordered. The fried sea bass was perfectly cooked, the meat was tender and not dry. I usually eat at this type of restaurant around Bang Khun Thian often, and I usually have a favorite, but this one was even better. The fish wasn't dry and felt genuinely fresh. The stir-fried razor clams were flavorful and well-balanced; other restaurants' versions are much spicier. I really liked the one here. The crab fried rice had plenty of crab meat, the rice was perfectly cooked and not soggy. Another dish I'd recommend is the glass noodle casserole; it was fragrant and delicious, the noodles weren't mushy. The crab curry was a little rich, but also had plenty of crab meat; it would have been better if it were a bit spicier.

I think we'll definitely come back again because the food is so good and the service is excellent. I hope the restaurant stays open for a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wachi W

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baan Suan Khun Ya (Pracha Uthit 72) is a hidden gem that feels like a peaceful countryside escape right in Bangkok, complete with a large pond and lush gardens.
The Food: Their Thai menu is impressive, featuring highlights like Deep-fried Snakehead Fish with Herbs, Crispy Fish with Fish Sauce, and various traditional dips. The flavors are authentic and well-executed, though the Jungle Curry (Kaeng Pa) packs a very serious spicy punch!
Vibe & Entertainment:
Seating: Choose between AC and outdoor garden views. (Note: The lakeside zone is undergoing renovation in March 2026).
Music: Enjoy great live music on Friday and Saturday nights with singers who know exactly how to play to the crowd. It's best to call ahead for the set times.
Good to know: Parking is easy right in front of the restaurant. If you sit outdoors in March, be prepared for some small seasonal insects shortly after sunset.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aey Angel

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate there today and encountered a problem with the shrimp and acacia leaf sour curry. The acacia leaf omelet smelled foul, like spoiled eggs were used. I informed the staff, who took it to the chef to check, but no solution was provided. Only the manager returned the original bowl, saying the chef had tasted it and said the eggs were fresh and the sour curry broth had altered the taste. I was quite confused. Is this how they solve problems for customers? The acacia leaf omelet smelled foul and was inedible. How am I supposed to eat that?? I regretted only eating the shrimp. The restaurant atmosphere was nice and not hot. Other dishes were fine, but I probably won't go back. I had a bad experience.

I recommend you don't order the shrimp and acacia leaf sour curry!! The acacia leaf omelet smelled foul.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chicha TK

sample_reviews_en.text:
🦞🦀 Grandma's Garden Kitchen 🌿✨
Fresh seafood, delicious and generous portions. High-quality ingredients, and affordable prices too! 😋💚
The restaurant is huge with tons of seating, both indoor and outdoor, plus a very chill garden area 🌳🍃

There are also several karaoke rooms 🎤🎶
Perfect for families, groups of friends, or even parties.

Great photo opportunities 📸✨
There are waterfall spots, garden areas, and other beautiful spots to take photos to your heart's content 🥰
If you're looking for a restaurant with a great atmosphere, delicious food, and friendly prices, I highly recommend it! 💕

#GrandmasGardenKitchen #FreshSeafood #DeliciousSeafood #Karaoke #RestaurantWithGreatAtmosphere #BeautifulPhotoSpots #ChillOutRestaurant #MustTry #Foodie
sample_reviews_en.author: พ.อ.หญิง กุลริศา เล็กใจกล้า รร.สธ.ทบ.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is awesome!
In the middle of no where, when we reached is a real big surprise!

The place is surrounded with pond.
Thou is night time, there isn't any mosquito.

Would say excellent place for family gathering. If you go to a typical seafood restaurant ,the atmosphere would be loud. This is the right place for peaceful dinner and bonding.

The food is great, great as in value for money.The fried fish is a must try
Oyster egg is very fresh too.

If you are looking for the unusual in BKK this is the place
sample_reviews_en.author: EDWIN SIM

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes great, the ingredients are fresh, the tables are clean, the service is good, and the staff are friendly and cheerful. There's ample parking. The atmosphere is pleasant, with options for seating in pavilions, gazebos, air-conditioned rooms, or private rooms. It's perfect for a family meal, a special date, a business meeting, or just a relaxing gathering. There's live music on Thursdays (one band per day) and on Fridays and Saturdays (two bands per day).
sample_reviews_en.author: สมชาย แซ่แต้

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in Soi Pracha Uthit 72.
The atmosphere is like sitting in a garden.
The restaurant is shady with seating in gazebos and live music.
The singer has a beautiful voice.
As for the food, the flavors aren't too strong but are delicious.
I especially liked the spicy stir-fry; it was very tasty.
The staff were also very attentive.
There is parking available in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nit Cha

restaurants.name: อลังการซูชิ เซ็นทรัล พระราม 3
restaurants.address:

79/3 Sathu Pradit Rd, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is on the ground floor. The staff are lovely, providing friendly and attentive service. The salmon is fresh and delicious, the sushi pieces are large and satisfying, and the rice is tasty. Highly recommended, you must try it! You can use the Thai Help Thai Plus payment method here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pantira T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located on the G floor near the Central entrance. I tried their new menu item, the sushi tacos, and they were incredibly crispy and delicious.
The fish was fresh and there was a wide variety to choose from. The prices were also good.
The staff were very lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kinpaimod

sample_reviews_en.text:
The sushi looks appealing and colorful, especially the rolls with sauce on top, which give them a slightly more premium feel. It's perfect for those who want a quick sushi meal without going to a big restaurant.

It's good value for money, convenient, and easy to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: watermelonwithyou

sample_reviews_en.text: Come try the sushi tacos and other sushi dishes at Alangkarn Sushi, Central Rama 3 branch. The service is excellent, the ingredients are top-notch, the food is visually stunning, and everything tastes delicious and tempting.
sample_reviews_en.author: เลิศลักษณ์ ศรีอุทัยภรณ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff are lovely and the service is excellent. There's a wide variety of delicious and fresh food on the menu. The prices are reasonable, and they even have a "buy 10 get 1 free" promotion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Baibua kaewsubsak

sample_reviews_en.text: Fresh, clean, and delicious. The sashimi was excellent. The sushi tacos were unique but fantastic; crispy without being fried. Very impressed! The staff were lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Netmanee Net

sample_reviews_en.text: The salmon was incredibly fresh, and the staff were friendly and lovely. If you're a sushi lover, you absolutely have to try this place! You'll definitely love it.

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The food lived up to the restaurant's name – truly spectacular! The price was good and the staff were incredibly lovely. 🩷🩷🥰

restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Nice ambience, good service and reasonably priced food."

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is located inside a shopping mall. Since there are no tourists, the atmosphere is quieter and more relaxed compared to the Beach Road location. The wine cellar has a decent selection.

(If you’re coming by car from the south side of Sukhumvit Road, you can’t access the restaurant directly due to the rotary restrictions. You’ll need to go up to North Pattaya and then come back down, which can be a bit inconvenient.)

The portion sizes are quite generous. If you’re dining as a pair, ordering a pasta dish each after an appetizer or sharing a single pizza should be enough. As is common in Thai restaurants, appetizers and main dishes tend to arrive at the same time, so it might be better to order the main course a little later.

They also offer  them by Grab Food, so if you live nearby, it might be worth trying. We’d be happy to dine here again if we get the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cortana

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am so happy for this Wine Connection. It's under new management. I told the manager (her name sounds like is "Ah-bow") that I stopped coming there for two years. They only had 2 staff serving and they were slow. Sometimes I was the only customer.

Go back if you left. The manager was checking on every table and the restaurant had more customers than I ever saw before. The servers were professional, prompt and added some classiness. My meal was delicious. I had an incredible, "Super Salad" and had chicken added. The chicken was tender and juicy they gave me olive oil rather than the citrus balsamic. I could go there again tomorrow. It's the first time I noticed customers being served outside! The atmosphere was warm and friendly. The manager was at every table to check on every customer. She's a pro! Congradulations Wine Connection for making the right moves!
sample_reviews_en.author: Claire

After I left the restaurant , 3 people including manager run  after me and said the transfer ( scan ) didn’t work and asked me to check the account . sample_reviews_en.text:
📌 Khao Sia Po, Charoen Krung 19

This #KhaoSiaPo is incredibly hard to find. If you're passing by, you can't miss it! Order it with refreshing winter melon soup.

“Khao Sia Po” is a rice dish that mixes everything in it. It's considered an ancient dish, not many people know about it these days. The bowl contains everything from roasted pork, crispy pork, duck, tongue, tripe, pork offal, liver, jade, and Chinese sausage – whatever you choose to add.

In the old days, gamblers would come to eat this after losing all their money. 30-40 baht was enough to eat everything – a huge portion for a cheap price. Or you could order plain rice with the stewed pork broth to fill you up for the next meal.

Uncle Nan says that lately, there are fewer customers and sales are slow because people don't have money to go out. If you're passing by, stop in and support him – you won't be disappointed! Or order via #GrabFoodTH. He also caters for various events.

#SharingisCaring
sample_reviews_en.author: MonZterella Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: Khao Sia Po or Che Po is a type of rice dish that used to be sold cheaply to gamblers who had lost all their money at gambling dens. The vendors would pour scraps of pork, chicken, duck, and offal over the rice. Nowadays, it's become a dish with a variety of toppings, some shops even including up to 12 different ingredients. This particular shop has been open for over 40 years. When I visited near closing time, there were only a few toppings left: roasted pork, crispy pork, egg, tripe, liver, tongue, and roasted duck. The sauce was quite salty, unlike the sweeter sauce of roasted pork rice. Khao Sia Po @50, Braised Duck with Pickled Lime @30.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanin Makarukpinyo

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was great. This roadside stall still maintains its delicious taste, but while I was eating, I overheard the vendors complaining about customer reviews saying the portions were small. However, considering the price of 50 baht in Bangkok, the taste isn't bad at all. I don't understand what those who post negative reviews are trying to convey. What do they mean by "small portions"? The portions are reasonable for the price, location, and taste. Anyone passing by this way, I highly recommend trying it and seeing if it's really as bad as some people complain. Personally, one visit isn't enough for me; I'll be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: possawee sillapun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate there yesterday, and it wasn't like the posts at all. The male owner was very rude, but the female owner was okay.

The man brought the food and asked if we wanted to order the braised duck with pickled lemon. We don't like pickled lemon, so we said no.

He made a displeased face and went to get another dish, but he slammed it down. What a jerk! We were a group of three and ordered three glasses of ice and Pepsi. He brought the ice but the Pepsi was a 10 baht per bottle, 345cc size. Disgusting. I'm never going back there again. I curse them!
sample_reviews_en.author: ริน เปล่งฉวี

sample_reviews_en.text: Apparently, this is the kind of meal that a man who gambled away all his money would eat in tears. It certainly feels like it was made with leftovers, but that is Khao Sia Po (sad old man's meal). Having a surly old man (who is actually a nice guy) bring you your meal in a pitch-black alley is something that is unique to Chinatown. If you don't like that, you can just eat at the restaurant next door (where you can get the same thing). In addition to Khao Sia Po, they also serve regular Khao Na Phet (roasted duck rice).
sample_reviews_en.author: THAI SANPO FUJII

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located in an alley off Charoen Krung Soi 19. Apparently, they've been selling it for a long time. "Khao Sia Po" (or a variation called "Che Po") is a dish meant for people who lost gambling, so they just pile on whatever they have. It includes roasted pork, crispy pork, Chinese sausage, boiled egg, roasted duck, and pork offal. The sauce is similar to the sauce used for roasted duck rice. It's perfect for when you want to eat a variety of things at once. The price is very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coke Somchai

sample_reviews_en.text: Khao Siap Po is a combination of roasted duck and char siu pork rice (containing roasted duck, char siu pork, crispy pork belly, Chinese sausage, egg, and offal). It uses a less thick duck sauce than the char siu pork sauce, poured over the rice. It tastes good, has plenty of ingredients, and is an old traditional recipe.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Friday, October 11, 2024
Food around Ratchawat
Nakhon Chai Si Road, Phra Nakhon District, Bangkok

This is my first time trying the food around Ratchawat.
I've heard good things about this place for a long time.
I've also seen many reviews.
I parked at Ratchawat Market, 20 baht/hour.
I tried 3 dishes:

Roasted Duck and Crispy Pork Rice (70 baht): 4 pieces of roasted duck, 4 pieces of crispy pork, 2 slices of cucumber, a little pickled ginger and blanched Chinese cabbage. The sauce was sweet.

Dry Noodles with Roasted Duck and Crispy Pork (70 baht): 4 pieces of roasted duck, 4 pieces of crispy pork. The sauce was sweet.

Wonton Soup with Char Siu Pork (60 baht): 6-7 wontons. The soup was okay.

Overall, the taste was average, and the portions felt quite small, perhaps because ingredients have become more expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonlanet S.

sample_reviews_en.text:

The roasted pork is tender and not fatty, the crispy pork is also good, and the roast duck is tender and delicious with a flavorful sauce. The noodle soup is good, the thin noodles are soft and tasty, and the shrimp dumplings have whole shrimp in them. The restaurant isn't very hot inside. Overall, it's delicious and worth the price.
*****I didn't get a chance to photograph the other dishes before I ate them.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Updated information, May 2024.
A casual Thai restaurant.
Mid-range prices. The setting is rustic, perfect for families or a chill meal and drinks with friends...
I've been here with family and friends many times, and the taste has been quite consistent.
Some dishes are quite spicy.
I've been eating here since 2015 until now, 2024.
Overall, all the dishes are delicious and suit my taste...
Our family's favorite dishes are: Crispy Catfish Salad and Crispy Catfish Stir-fried with Ginger and Chili.
We also have: Fried Fish Cakes, Stir-fried Fish Balls with Chili, Wing Bean Salad, Tom Yum Snakehead Fish, Tom Yum Shrimp, Fried Chicken Wings, Stir-fried Water Spinach with Chili, Fried Shrimp with Tamarind Sauce, Stir-fried Pangasius Fish, Tom Yum Pangasius, Stir-fried Coconut Shoots... Oh, there are so many, I can't remember them all...
