sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant advertised opening at 10:30 AM, but when I called, nothing was ready. They said the chef would be ready at 12:00 PM.
Why didn't they state from the beginning that they would be ready to open at noon?
It wasted my time and I had to find another restaurant.
Please correct your opening time. That way, we won't waste time or have any misunderstandings. It's easier to manage the waiting time and avoid unnecessary delays.

I dislike restaurants that write one opening time and then deliver something completely different. It disrupts my plans and I have other things to do. It's not just a half-hour difference; it's almost an hour and a half.

If you're not ready, please correct the time so we don't waste time managing the situation.

It's a shame because the food tastes delicious, but the management is terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: whale e

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spicy food, large portions, good service.
The young woman selling the catfish is skilled.
The stir-fried fish ball with chili paste is excellent, spicy, and the fish is tender and chewy.
The stir-fried water spinach with chili uses tender shoots, delicious.
The crispy catfish with chili and ginger is a large portion and delicious.
The vegetable soup is easy to drink.

The winged bean salad is standard, with a sweet undertone.
The fresh shrimp and cha-kram leaf salad tastes similar to the winged bean salad; I wish it had a soft-boiled egg.
The stir-fried catfish with chili paste is a little too sweet.

The atmosphere is airy and spacious.
Arrived at the restaurant at 11:00, waited for the cook for a while.
First dish served at 11:32.
I took a friend to try it, and it was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tipwan Trakarnwijitr

sample_reviews_en.text:
I actually wanted to keep this a secret because the food is delicious, the service is excellent with no tantrums (because there are few staff and it gets very busy). We booked a karaoke room. Honestly, the restaurant itself is very simple, but the JBL sound system in the room had great microphones and speakers. The room cost 200 baht for 3 hours of singing. Almost every dish was flavorful, and the fried items were perfectly cooked. This is definitely a restaurant I'll be back to. The lemongrass salad was amazing, and the chicken with cashew nuts tasted just like the Chinese restaurants I used to eat at as a kid – so good!

In short, I loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: SuperyingSuperhappy

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent! Everything was delicious. They have a huge menu. There's plenty of comfortable, spacious, and breezy seating. The service was great too; the staff were friendly and smiling. The five dishes I ordered today were all amazing. The crispy fried catfish was delicious and the portion was huge! The Tom Yum soup with snakehead fish was fantastic – the broth was spicy and the fish was fresh. The fried fish cakes were chewy and fragrant. Everything was delicious! Highly recommend! I came back for a second visit and ordered the pork dip, which was also incredibly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sineenath Nacharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very delicious, but it's not a restaurant I would recommend to anyone. I've eaten here twice, and the menu is quite outdated. Even on my second visit, some of the items I'd previously been told were sold out weren't available. Neither time has the food been served without delays, and I've experienced discrimination; regular customers were served first even though they arrived later. On another occasion, I ordered takeout at 6 PM and arrived at 7 PM, but it wasn't ready until 7:30 PM. In short, all four items I ordered took over 90 minutes to prepare.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภูริทัศ วิเศษสมบัติ

sample_reviews_en.text: Every fried dish at this restaurant is delicious. I forgot to take pictures of many of the dishes, especially the fried chicken with cashew nuts. It's better than any other restaurant I've eaten at. The fish fried in fish sauce is juicy and still very crispy. It's delicious without the need for dipping sauce. The prices are reasonable, but the food takes a while to come out because there are only a few people making it. If you're going with a large group, you should call ahead to order. You'll have to be patient and wait for the delicious food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katty S.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I didn't know existed before; it was purely by chance. It's located quite deep in an alley, but there's plenty of parking. The staff are all very friendly and provide excellent service. My recommended dish is the Cha-am leaf salad – it's delicious. The Tom Yum fish soup is amazing, and the salt-fried chicken is also fantastic. Yesterday, I ordered six dishes and the bill came to around 1200 baht. They also have high chairs for children. The staff are all very cheerful and lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyachat Rungkiattiwong

restaurants.name: Susan Croissant (Asok)
restaurants.address:

32 Stecon Tower, 61 Sukhumvit 21 Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥐 The Best Croissant in Thailand!🥐

I was absolutely blown away by the croissants at Susan Croissant, Sukhumvit 39. Every bite was pure perfection—
crispy, buttery, and fresh. The food here is unmatched in quality, and the service is just as fantastic. The staff was welcoming and attentive, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

The interior of the café is cozy and stylish, making it the perfect spot to relax and enjoy an amazing pastry. You can tell they take pride in their craft by how beautifully everything is presented. If you’re in Bangkok and looking for a top-notch croissant experience, this is the place to be. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Brice G

sample_reviews_en.text: What if your croissant is freshly bake uppon order? this is the experience that you going to have in this cafe. I ordered Truffle Cream Sauce, Mushroom and Bacon, Almond Cream, Spinach, Honey and many other croissants, all of them taste is wonderful. It's took 10 to 15 minutes for food to be ready but it is worth of waiting. I highly doubt they could keep up with busy day but be patients it will be rewarded.
sample_reviews_en.author: In Mean

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I came back to try a new menu: heart timber ring stuffed with pandan custard. I was very impressed with the overflowing filling and freshly baked dessert. Even if you have to wait a bit. But it's worth a try. Another thing is flat croissant. There are many flavors to choose from. I chose raspberry. It's sourness that perfectly cuts through the sweetness.
sample_reviews_en.author: PENPIMOL AIYARA

sample_reviews_en.text:
When you have the word Croissant in your name I'm expecting a really GOOD croissant! Oh boy did they deliver❤️
Hands down the best Croissant I had in Thailand - Almost perfect 🤩
Personally I prefer my 🥐 a bit more moist on the inside, but that's a matter of debate.
Crunchy, delicious with a good hint of butter. Well done 💪
Butter Croissant 50 bat
🥐🥐🥐🥐🥐
sample_reviews_en.author: Rune

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited this bakery, and the croissant truly lives up to its reputation as the best in Bangkok—perfectly flaky, buttery, and absolutely delicious. The coffee was also quite good, though I wish they offered a piccolo to complement it. Overall, it's a lovely spot for a quick pastry and coffee fix, and I’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: KayVibes Daily

sample_reviews_en.text: I think Susan Croissant is one of the famous croissant cafe in Bangkok. This cafe have a lot of bakery and various kinds of croissant whether it is Croissant, Royal Thai Tea and Matcha Nama Chocolate even ice Chocolate, all of these are worth a try. You can choose adding to your croissant for instance, fried egg or avocado, etc.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyaphan Hovilailux

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stumbled upon this gem by accident. I love the design, the menu options - flat croissant is so special! Such a variety of flavors!
Tried the raspberry one and their English breakfast tea - both tasted heavenly. Can’t recommend them for for your afternoon tea. Surely coming back to try more! My favourite place for pastry for now.
sample_reviews_en.author: R

sample_reviews_en.text:
Such a lovely shop for baked goods & coffee. The branding and interior design of the shop is beautiful, trendy and a great place to sit and enjoy a coffee and baked goods while on your computer.

Definitely recommend this  place if you are in Sukhumvit and looking for great coffee and friendly staff!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenny James

restaurants.name: BEEF INDA BOWL
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvitpattaya 42, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here to say the food is sooosooo good!
I actually ordered two items on grab. Everything was fresh, and cooked to perfection. I had saba and a chefs choice beef bowl. They both had amazing and balanced accompanying sauces. The skin on the Saba was to die for, and the beef was cooked with an amazing garlic butter blend (they even packed the yummy garlic up for me☺️).
I have eaten and traveled to many places high and low… I can say this is truly a hidden gem. Can’t beat the price and quality of the food. I will be ordering here again. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Paloma S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pattaya hidden gem. This is the second time I have been here with my wife and I forgot how good it is. I’m a local and I eat out a fair amount and I can’t think of a better value for quality in the area. They seem to source a higher quality beef and sashimi than I am used to getting around here. My wife and I tore through the menu, drank three Bud talls (yea, they have imported Budweiser here) and the bill was under 2kbht. Plus we had take home.

It’s a bit hard to find but worth it for some authentic style Japanese in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam Stone

sample_reviews_en.text:
A gem in Pattaya!
I'm a food enthusiast and quite knowledgeable about Thailand. I can assure you that in this restaurant, with its simple yet distinctive atmosphere, you'll find authentic Thai cuisine prepared and served with care and attention. It's fascinating to watch the chef cook live... and with latex gloves (top notch!). Every dish will be a pleasant discovery. If you can't stand extreme spiciness, let us know when you order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simone Rigamonti

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant atmosphere is nice, clean, spacious, the music is good, and the staff provides good service, but the wait was extremely long 🥺🥺. The grill was more like a Korean BBQ style, not the yakiniku style advertised, and the meat wasn't marinated in any sauce. The taste was mediocre considering the price and the wait time, so I'm deducting some points.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anantaya Chantarothorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The woman selling papaya salad in the shop put some pork or meat out to dry in the sun on a bamboo fence. I saw a rat run down from the bamboo. After a while, she took what she had put out to dry and continued grilling. She probably didn't see the rat. So I didn't dare give her anything to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sithisak L

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food is delicious. I really want the restaurant to be popular. The Thai fish sashimi is very delicious. The meat is especially high quality. You won't be disappointed if you come here (the price is also cute). Come in large numbers. I really want you to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Voranuch

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first visit was very impressive.
The food was delicious, the meat was excellent, and the sashimi was superb.
The music was great, making it a very relaxing place to sit.
I highly recommend it. I'll definitely visit again next time I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mattika Inta

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice place if you like sashimii and Japanese food. Good Japanese BBQ and tasty raw beef and tuna. Very nice and relaxing atmosphere and friendly staff and good cold beer. We were here for our anniversary and enjoyed a lot. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Sevcovs

restaurants.name: Somjai Potchana
restaurants.address:

309/9 Nang Linchi Rd, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: This duck noodle place is a classic! Their portions are a bit small so I recommend getting their extra portion option (พิเศษ). They are also open much much earlier in the morning than what is shown on google maps. We were there at 8am and it was already open!
sample_reviews_th.author: Dain Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! I usually don't like duck because it has a gamey smell, but the duck here had no smell at all and was very tender. The blood pudding was also very tasty. The restaurant was very clean, both the noodle preparation area and the tables.

The noodles were delicious, chewy and soft. The thin noodles were perfectly cooked, not mushy, and they still had some rice flour mixed in, not just glutinous rice flour.

As for the portion size, I think it's appropriate for both the price and the amount of duck meat. 50 baht a bowl gives a suitable amount of duck meat.

The restaurant only accepts cash, so don't forget to bring cash.

The restaurant has been around 450 years. I normally don't like duck because it's quite gamey, but this place changed my mind. Not only is the smell not strong, but the duck is also very tender.

The preparation area and the tables are very clean.

I disagree with some of the comments that stated the portion is too small. I think for 50 baht it's quite reasonable, and I also think people are just getting used to the huge portions that they offer nowadays.
sample_reviews_en.author: j s

sample_reviews_en.text: At first, I wasn't that impressed when I arrived at the restaurant. The seating was right on the street in an alley. The food arrived very quickly after ordering. I started with a noodle soup, and finished it in no time. It was delicious, but the portion was a bit small. So I ordered the duck rice as well, and that was gone in a flash too. I have to admit, the taste and ingredients were excellent. The only downsides are the small portions and the seating so close to the street. P.S. I forgot to take a picture of the duck rice because it was so delicious I forgot my phone!
sample_reviews_en.author: ปัย ทัม งาน แต่ต้องได้เที้ยว

sample_reviews_en.text: Traditional Local Duck noodle soup! One of delicious  noodle soup in Bangkok. If you are not local, you will never known. On NangLinChee road for years, I pass by all the time without trying.  Duck meat is tender and sliced thin to put on delicate Egg noodle Aldente. Soup based aroma of lightly Chinese herbal not too overpower taste. Fresh beansprout blancing quickly in boiling water to its crispy. Garlic oil, Chilli vinegar, All well into great taste!!! Hope #Michelin star visits this place soon. A rare local gem of restaurant. Not sure how long they will operate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vyn_Walking_all_the_time

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent duck noodles. Hearty duck broth loaded with fried minced garlic and pieces of duck breast. You can also order sides of extra duck meat or wings. Small local style portions so eat at least 3 bowls! 😬 Doesnt look it since it’s almost like street food but it’s safe and clean. We eat here every time we are in the area. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Roland Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The duck meat was moderately tender and the taste was acceptable. The breast meat was sliced ​​very thinly. The duck blood was soft and tasted okay, cut into small chunks. The soup was not well-balanced, leaning towards sweet. Compared to the portion size, it was overpriced. (1.7)
sample_reviews_en.author: pongsathorn poolpoka

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the original recipe for braised duck.

I think the shop tried to reduce the saltiness, which changed the taste.
The duck meat is good, the braised duck is good, the noodles are good, the fried garlic is really good..., and the soup is now easier to drink.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisby

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good. For the Hainanese chicken rice, you can tell the cook which part of the chicken you prefer, and whether or not to include the skin. The duck noodle soup tastes good, but the amount of duck meat is a bit small compared to the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wiwat T

restaurants.name: Dastan Restaurant
restaurants.address:

26/89 ม .10, ซ เย็น สบาย Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Friendly and welcoming staff.
Delicious persian cuisine.
Eat in, take away and delivery service available. Black tea also available.Definitely recommend Dastan restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Majid Najjari

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good Iranian food, clean, good taste. A good and clean Iranian restaurant, popular and authentic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hh Mhd

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent, everything is a pure Iranian dish that even your mother couldn't make for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: kasra poorabdollah

sample_reviews_en.text: All fresh-made delicious Persian food, makes you feel at home. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maxwell World Energy Company

restaurants.name: ร้านก๋วยเตี๋ยวแสนสุข สาขา 2
restaurants.address:

68 Thanon Happy Land Sai 2, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Happy Tom Yum Noodle Shop 2 - Long queue!
Long wait, 30+ people. Usually I order in advance,
pay, go for a walk, and then come back to pick it up.
Delicious, but the queue is long.

Special Tom Yum Noodles: 60 baht.
Spicy and flavorful, with lots of chilies.
Generous portion: minced pork, liver, meatballs, pork ribs, fish cake.

Dry Tom Yum noodles with a spicy and flavorful dressing. Moderate toppings, but
the dressing is already coated and mixed with the noodles.
Spicy enough without any extra seasoning; I love it just with the noodles coated in the dressing.

Taste 🌟🌟🌟🌟
Quality 🌟🌟🌟
Service 🌟🌟🌟
Cleanliness 🌟🌟🌟
Convenience 🌟🌟🌟
Price 🌟🌟🌟🌟

*☺️☺️* This is a personal opinion based on my preferences, tastes, experiences, biases, and quirks. I paid for the meal myself, so I'm giving an honest review and critique based on what I ate and experienced on the day I visited. I want to see feedback used for improvement rather than anger, hatred, or curses. I ask for forgiveness here. Regarding some shops, in short, there are some issues that the shop should address, but I won't go into detail to avoid damaging their reputation.☺️😊**
sample_reviews_en.author: วันจันทร์ ที่ผ่านมา

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible experience. I waited for an hour! People who came later got their food first. I don't know how they manage the queue. They only made bags for people to take home and prioritized delivery drivers, even though we saw they came after us. They even served people they knew first. Those of us sitting and eating just waited forever. The queue-jumping part is infuriating. I just walked out. I'm so disappointed. I really dislike this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: พัชรา แซ่เติ๋น

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is great, very delicious!!!
Perfect for those who can wait and aren't in a hurry!!!
The wait is about 40 minutes or more, but we could wait.
It's really delicious, I recommend trying the Tom Yum soup.
If you don't want to wait a long time,
I recommend ordering from the nearby street food stall,
Auntie Toi's, which serves made-to-order food. You can eat there while you wait.
It's another very delicious restaurant right next door.
sample_reviews_en.author: A- ARMY

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are delicious and the price is great. I ordered the Tom Yum glass noodles and it was very tasty and cheap, only 40 baht per bowl. Crispy wontons are 10 baht per bag. I liked the minced pork, it was delicious. The shop is located opposite the Happy Land food court. I deducted one star because I went at 2 PM and had to wait a little while. It's suitable for people who are not in a hurry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yaowares Chunakornpat

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum noodle soup tastes good, and the crispy pork cracklings are delicious. The fact that only one person cooks and prepares the food helps maintain quality in each bowl, but this comes at the cost of long waiting times for customers. It's especially inconvenient if there are delivery riders or takeout orders mixed in, making it a waste of time if you have other errands to run.
sample_reviews_en.author: a-somo R.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating at this restaurant in The Mall Bangkapi since my mom's first branch over ten years ago, and now I'm eating at her second branch, run by her daughter. Delicious food is worth the wait! She works alone, so you have to understand. Before, there was no online ordering or queuing system; you'd wait about half an hour to get your food. But now, you just have to be patient.
sample_reviews_en.author: วุฒิไกร ไชยมาตร์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fast service, delicious food, short wait time. Limited seating.
Constantly busy, you can watch the chefs prepare the food while you eat – feels like an omakase experience.

The Tom Yum soup is incredibly tasty, only 40 baht for a regular portion – great value.

Motorcycles are more convenient as parking is usually easier to find. Cars are a bit difficult to find parking.

(1/8/2025)
sample_reviews_en.author: Kritt Kreurad

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodle soup tastes decent for the price of 40 baht.
The quality of the noodles, pork, and meatballs is average, giving it 4 stars.
However, I deducted 1 star because of the long wait of over 40 minutes. I wouldn't recommend it for hungry people. And I deducted another star because the queuing system was very chaotic; people who came later were served first as if it were normal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthachak Prangsuk

restaurants.name: Baywatch Restaurant
restaurants.address:

290/51 Beach Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We've been here three times. The tom yum is delicious, that's what we came for. But the staff is completely negative. They're always dissatisfied; you smile at them, and they give you a dissatisfied face. We've been there three times, and three times the same thing, as far as the staff goes. Several groups of Europeans came in while we were there, and they were actually very smiley. So keep in mind, Russians are not welcome here. The waitresses in the photo are always mean. Especially in black 👎
sample_reviews_en.author: Евгения Садовская

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is notable for its location – right in the heart of the beach. That's where the positives end, I think. Mediocre food, overpriced, ok service.
We went on a recommendation – and both the recommendation and the recommendation were trashed. :)
In short, there's nothing much to praise, except for the presence of a restroom.
sample_reviews_en.author: vsevolod anikin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves European and Thai food and is located on Pattaya Beach Road, Soi 13/4.
The baked vegetables with cheese are delicious and worth trying. It's not far from Walking Street (the night market). After a satisfying meal, you can stroll around, get drunk, and continue the fun!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arunwatee Sangphitak

sample_reviews_en.text: For a good restaurant, I recommend Pat Thai, which has pork and kelp soup and a seafood salad platter with fish, shrimp, and squid. Three people can share three dishes without ordering rice, and it's just the right amount to fill them up.
sample_reviews_en.author: YE

sample_reviews_en.text: the mushrooms in the tom yum soup are spoiled, minced pork smells like Indian food rather than Thai food. The waitress is cold like the top of mount Everest. Not even look me in the eye when I make a payment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harry Citradi

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first visit and I had the English Breakfast. It was neither good nor bad, except for the sausage, which was a bit sour. Next time I'd like to try other lunch or dinner options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Makoto Sasaki

sample_reviews_en.text: The only relatively decent place in the area, with breakfasts and a fairly extensive menu at mid-range prices. There are only Indian restaurants around, but this one is like an oasis.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dima K

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been coming to Bay Watch for several years now. The food is top-notch, everything is delicious, and the bill is average, but the quality is excellent. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: A R

restaurants.name: บ้านอิ่มสำราญ
restaurants.address:

87/3 หมู่2 Ngamwongwan 18 Alley, ตำบลบางเขน อำเภอเมือง Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
When you come here, you must try the braised pork or braised beef.
The broth is flavorful, not too strong or too weak, and the meat is perfectly braised with just the right amount of fat. Eating it with hot rice is incredibly delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanakan Wongleelaseth

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised beef/pork is tasty and inexpensive, but the seller is a bit grumpy. It's a self-service shop; you pick up your own bowls and put them away yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลุงเสือ แม่ริม

sample_reviews_en.text: The stewed pork, stewed beef, and pork leg noodles are all delicious and reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: ประพัฒน์ ศัตตบุศย์

sample_reviews_en.text: Pork leg rice, stewed pork noodles, stewed beef – everything is delicious. Self-service.
sample_reviews_en.author: กนกวรรณ รับพรดี

sample_reviews_en.text: Selling pork leg rice, noodles, and soup (beef and pork). Free water (self-service).
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchai Chaisirilarp

sample_reviews_en.text: Pork leg rice, stewed pork noodles, rice with chili paste and seafood. Self-service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat Wan

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork noodle soup tastes great and the ingredients are of good quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Satawat Srilam

restaurants.name: Vegan and Vegetarian Chana Songkhram
restaurants.address:

17 Chana Songkhram Alley, Chana Songkhram, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was curious about this restaurant, which is always bustling near my usual lodging, so I went in. I later found out that it mainly serves vegetarian dishes. It certainly does focus on seafood, and I ordered three dishes that caught my eye, and they were absolutely delicious. I was honestly surprised. The river fish fried rice in particular was the absolute best. I'm sure any Japanese person would find it delicious. The menu isn't in Japanese, let alone English, but with Google Translate, it's no problem. Just beyond that lies a paradise of food. If you're staying at Khaosan, make the effort to come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryutaro Machi (DJ急行)

sample_reviews_en.text:
We attempted to dine here two nights in a row and were refused service both times.

The first night the restaurant was busy and we were told there would be a one-hour wait for food, which seemed reasonable, so we left.

The second night we returned and were again turned away, told that the kitchen was still “preparing food.” However, other customers were already seated and had been served drinks. The inconsistency was hard to ignore.

Based on our experience, we genuinely believe they do not serve foreigners. We may be wrong, but that is certainly how it felt. It was disappointing and very unwelcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ren Lengyel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good Thai food. They have a mix of different local cuisines: Thai-Chinese, Isaan, Central Thai, etc. And it‘s not purely vegetarian. They also serve meat and fish dishes. We had a Tom Buay for example. A Thai-Chinese plum soup with minced pork. Very tasty.

The service was nice. He was basically working alone and rocking the whole show. The owner is a real character. Everybody seems to know her. And even though this place is next to Rambuttri there are a lot of Thai people eating and hanging out here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: Really really bad experience.I saw the good comments and took a cab from far away place to come here.On the map it’s 23:00 close.But 20:00 they said we don’t have anything except for wonton and gyoza.At last I ordered and got the weirdest wonton I’ve met.It just fried wonton skin and some wrapped one stick of bean.And the cooking lady has really bad attitude at beginning she said I can order things on the menu.Then everything I ordered she said we don’t have it at last only gyoza and this weird wonton.😂😂😂
sample_reviews_en.author: X W

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is good, nice menu posted in front
Dishes range from 120 baht and up
A bit pricey for vegetarian food but it is located near the  bus station to the Gulf of Thailand. Very touristy area.

Service was lacking. They did not come to my table to take my order, I had to go up to the counter, which is odd because diners at other tables did not have to. The servers came to their tables...??

Food was tasty, som tum vegan style.
I would come again if I was in the area, but I would not make a trip for it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jia Moon

sample_reviews_en.text: I would say the the vegetarian food is a good quality but unfortunately and although I explained for both waiters and even showed on Google translate that we DO NOT WANT  garlic and onion in our food since we have allergy, still one of the dishes came with full big chunks of garlic in it!!! They apologized but made us pay full for the food anyway!! Make sure you say not spicy to avoid extra spicy like the Papaya salad we had.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phanendra das

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic vegetarian food.
We came in during rush hour and had to wait for each dish an hour. The drinks came quickly, but food starter one hour, main one hour and desert we nearly gave up, but it came after one more hour…

The service was excellent. Great guy apologizing. So just come here if you’ve got a little time or outside the usual rush hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raphael Bartke

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was amazing.
The guy who served us was really nice, but he was running around like a headless chicken 😂.
The reviews said the service was slow, but we didn't have to wait at all. We only waited for napkins, they didn't have any, so we went to the 7-Eleven on the corner 🫶.
I would definitely go back. Everything was so delicious 🤤.
sample_reviews_en.author: Diana Fernandez

restaurants.name: ร้านเจ๊หงษ์ อาหารตามสั่งปากคลองตลาด
restaurants.address:

169 Atsadang Rd, Khwaeng Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The portion size doesn't match the price. Garlic shrimp with rice, special edition, takeaway box is 100฿. The price is higher than the menu price because the menu isn't clearly listed. I ordered a regular portion but got a special one. Crispy pork rice, special edition, 80฿, extra 20฿ from the menu price.
sample_reviews_th.author: Ff Furby

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was incredibly fresh and delicious. The stir-fried vegetables were flavorful and went perfectly with rice porridge. The stir-fried liver with basil was fragrant with fresh, vibrant green basil leaves—the liver was slightly overcooked, but still delicious thanks to the dry, fragrant seasoning from the high-heat stir-fry. The stir-fried snakehead fish with chili paste was perfectly balanced with a sweet, sour, salty, and slightly spicy flavor. The large, perfectly fried tilapia in three-flavor sauce was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, not dry or tough.
The water spinach was crunchy and not chewy, and the stir-fried morning glory was excellent, easy to chew. The atmosphere by the roadside, with a refreshing breeze blowing by the canal, was lovely.
The location near the legendary Route 8 bus stop, with its slightly thrilling passing by, added a nice touch to life.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunshine Pearts

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop owner spoke to her female employee, who is about the same age as your mother, in a very rude and disrespectful manner. If she wanted to scold someone, she should do it behind the counter, not in front of customers, because she might lose customers. No one wants to patronize a shopkeeper who uses such abusive and disrespectful language. Please improve your behavior. She's an employee, not a punching bag. Have some consideration for her; she's very old. Speak to her respectfully. If you don't improve, beware that customers might report you to the Department of Labor Protection and Welfare and take legal action. It doesn't matter if she's working daily or hourly. Please improve your behavior. Consider her as someone your mother's age.
sample_reviews_en.author: Orawan Srr

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I was near Pak Khlong Talat, planning to eat stir-fried fish or tom yum soup. The restaurant wasn't in a tourist area, so I thought it would be 60-80 baht per bowl. But when I looked at the menu, OMG!! 250-300-400 baht and up! Too cheap! So I ended up with stir-fried water spinach with salted fish for 60 baht.
I counted 3 pieces of salted fish (and they were tiny!). Really tiny. Extremely tiny.
Bottled water was 10 baht.
And ice was 2 baht.
(Normal price)
This is my review as a customer. Thank you and goodbye. I'm fed up!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tenler's Sweden

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good and delicious. The wait wasn't too long.
The auntie serving the food might be a little slow at times, please be patient with her and don't rush her. She's elderly. Overall, it was a good experience. If I'm in the area again, I'll definitely come back. 🤍🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Namfon

sample_reviews_en.text: This rice porridge shop is open from 6 PM to 2:30 AM. The food exceeded expectations. The garlic chicken was so delicious I had to order a second plate. The sour curry was very thick and flavorful. It's located by the canal near the mouth of Khlong Talat.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิจิตรา ปฏิมากร

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was very slow, the food wasn't to my liking, they forgot my order, and the prices were comparable to seafood restaurants, but it's a roadside stall across from a bus stop. Every time a bus leaves, you can smell the exhaust fumes.
sample_reviews_en.author: ATK BOSS

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a simple roadside restaurant that exceeded expectations and is definitely worth a repeat visit. Parking is available near the restaurant, or you can ask the owner for directions. 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Memie Mie

restaurants.name: Admire Hotel (Thonburi)
restaurants.address:

90 Soi Inthara Phithak 1, Bang Yi Ruea, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The hotel was very clean, and there's a 7-Eleven right next door for shopping. It was a bit compact, but really good for backpackers. The price was reasonable; I'd skip breakfast and grab something on the go. The bathroom was cute but adequate, and the staff was very friendly. Public transport is easily accessible from there, and Wat Arun is about a 1.5-hour walk away. If you want to take a tuk-tuk, haggle well; it's an experience worth having (100 baht or less). Taxis that use the meter are significantly cheaper than fixed fares.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dennis Herrmann

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're staying here, pin the location to Soi Inthraphitak 1. There's a 7-Eleven at the entrance of the soi. The hotel is a short distance in on the right-hand side. If you follow GPS, you'll definitely get lost!

The room is a bit small, but the water pressure is strong. I got a room at the very end with lightweight walls, and there was constant knocking and rattling noise. It felt unsettling and I didn't sleep well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thames

sample_reviews_en.text: This very well-located hotel offers a room with breakfast included. Last year, the price remained the same without breakfast, but an à la carte option was available. The result was nonexistent: a bit of coffee, but nothing else! However, the reception staff, including the hostess Nud, were very helpful in facilitating our stay. We have been staying at this hotel for the past four years, around the same time of year.
sample_reviews_en.author: Exploration558804

sample_reviews_en.text: There was no room service at night. There was footsteps around 2 AM and loud doors slamming almost all night. I called reception but no one answered. The hallways should have carpets.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wiphasiri Samerjai

sample_reviews_en.text:
very Good service.
I arrived 31-12-2022 to stay in New Block
Everything just New, Good Value to long stay
1.5km to Icon-Siam.
sample_reviews_en.author: pk steven

sample_reviews_en.text: i only went to the restaurant but the pad thai i had there was the best i had so far in thailand ... Great pad thai!
sample_reviews_en.author: camille

sample_reviews_en.text: Very Spacious and clean room. Great location with delicious street food close by. Will stay here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Clark

restaurants.name: CASABON Brasserie
restaurants.address:

69 Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious (though the pasta with meat was a little too salty for our taste), and the atmosphere was nice and not noisy, probably because we went on a Sunday evening when there weren't many customers. The staff member named Matum was lovely and provided excellent service (I recommend that if you're celebrating a birthday at the restaurant, they have a cute cake for you!).
I'll definitely go back again during the daytime next time to experience a different atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Murffit P

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the opportunity to dine at CASABON today. It feels very special, the staff is very attentive. Polite speech. And the food was delicious. Unfortunately, my friends and I couldn't sit for long. Because we have business to attend to. Promise that we will come back to this shop. The store manager is very attentive to the customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yun

sample_reviews_en.text: Don’t bother .. there’s better place in Bangkok. Trying to be something they are not. Really disappointed and frankly way over priced. My partner had his food 15 minutes before me so had to eat on my own . Worse experience in Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Zobert Asloune

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the atmosphere is great. For those who don't want to sit in the heat, the restaurant has air conditioning. The staff provided excellent service and gave great food recommendations. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: chotika chimparatt

sample_reviews_en.text: Had lunch with my son, we took a stake, a ceasar salad, a juice and a smoothy. All very good. The place is nice and comfy, environment is modern yet warm. And staff is very friendly
sample_reviews_en.author: Gianfranco Di Maira

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is very beautiful. My friend and I came in randomly. But it turned out that the food was very delicious. The atmosphere is quiet and suitable for sitting and talking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongsatorn Chetpakin

sample_reviews_en.text: A stylish cafe restaurant on Sukhumvit 26. They also serve Italian and Thai cuisine and have a wide selection of wines and other drinks, but the prices are a bit high.
sample_reviews_en.author: カトちゃんネル

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited the restaurant yesterday and was very impressed.
The staff recommended many delicious dishes, and the restaurant's atmosphere was beautiful.
sample_reviews_en.author: จิดาภา ชูดอกไม้

restaurants.name: บุญอิ่ม อาหารตามสั่ง
restaurants.address:

23 11 ปาก Wutthakat 45 Alley, Bang Kho, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I wouldn't recommend it. I ordered through Foodpanda. The wait was over an hour, but that's not the main issue. What's important is the food itself. It looked unappetizing. The stir-fried noodles were burnt – the pork, noodles, and egg were all burnt. The pork seemed like a mix of old and new pieces, as the flavors differed. I ordered an omelet, but got one that was greasy. The order was incomplete. Foodpanda listed it as 4 stars, but the reality is only worth 1 star. Extremely disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Baimint Nammint

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't know about others, but the person preparing the food was really unpleasant. I saw a picture of what looked like grilled pork in front of the shop, and since they also serve papaya salad, I asked if they had grilled pork neck. The person at the front asked the person in the back, but that person came out and said they didn't have it. They were asking where I got that from – their response was really inappropriate and emotional.
sample_reviews_en.author: 20 อภิชญา กิมเม้ง

sample_reviews_en.text: It's like someone who can't cook but wants to sell food. I ordered fried chicken wing tips via Line Man; the chicken was black, the batter was sour, and it was greasy like the chicken hadn't been drained of oil. The crispy pork curry was just regular pork belly, not crispy at all. Don't bother eating at this place, you'll regret wasting your money.
sample_reviews_en.author: กัญญาภรณ์ จุลพันธ์

sample_reviews_en.text: Before, the wait time for food was extremely long, the taste was mediocre, and I didn't even want to order again. But seeing how long it took, I ordered again, and it was even worse—everything was burnt and inedible. The rice spilled everywhere, and I even encountered a delivery rider with a terrible attitude. I will never order from them again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amp Phoemcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Boon Im Restaurant, made-to-order food.

Ordered delivery via Line Man, with a discount code.
3 boxes for a great price.

Generous portions in every box. Tried the dry pork sukiyaki, tasted okay.

Support the restaurant! I understand some orders might not be to everyone's liking, but the food I received was tasty and good value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was so-so, and the male owner had a foul mouth. I once bought some plain rice and talked with a friend about how little it was for a group of people to eat. The owner told me to try counting the grains. Since then, I haven't eaten it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: นฤเบศน์ จงเกริกเกียรต์

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions were huge, but the taste was terrible. The stir-fried basil chicken was awful; it only smelled of soy sauce. I've already scooped out 5-6 spoonfuls of the broth from this picture.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitiwat Buranapong

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, with bright lights and vibrant colors lining both sides of the Ratchada to Wutthakat road. The prices are affordable, and the food is delicious and satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุไลมาน มะลีเยาะ

restaurants.name: KFC CP Tower Phayathai
restaurants.address:

34, CP Tower 3, Phaya Thai Rd, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Convenient when you live nearby and don't want Grab! delivery, not too expensive, and unlimited drinks with the menu.
The service is fast and polite, no hassle.
Orders can be placed via terminals or from a cardboard menu that you can request at the cash register.
They could add a few more fries.
The decor is completely lacking, with no privacy or green plants.
It's marked 24/7.
Hand washing facilities are available on site.
sample_reviews_en.author: ab angell

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small shop on the first floor of CP 3 Building. Right outside the front door, you'll find it. It's a small branch with few customers, so the wait for food might be a bit long. However, you'll get hot chicken instead.

Because the shop is right in front of the building, whenever people walk in and out, they'll see us eating chicken. Personally, I felt a bit cramped.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerayut Mueangklang

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried chicken was hot and delicious, fresh and good. However, the staff seemed a bit slow in taking orders, but it was forgivable because the chicken was nice, hot, crispy and delicious. There were few seats but not cramped. The air was good and the shop was open and comfortable. It was also next to the BTS, making it very convenient to walk around.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanwisa Keawtomma

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, everything was good. The chicken was delicious. The staff provided good service and took orders quickly. However, the restaurant was quite small with few seats. When people finished work, the tables were full, but the staff quickly cleared the tables, making more and more seats available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bussarin

sample_reviews_en.text: Probably the slowest KFC in history. It took 45 minutes to receive my order. In any other country they would refund you and give you the food for free. The whole idea of fast food is that it is fast. I would recommend eating elsewhere unless you brought you sleeping bag and an iPad.
sample_reviews_en.author: T Rich

sample_reviews_en.text: The female employee did not look welcoming to the customer even when I informed her of the order. She looked bored with the world. If she is not ready to serve, I think it would be better to stay home. Please tell the management to warn the employees who are on duty at night.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิน ดีเซล

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff is absolutely terrible. They took my order half an hour ago, and when I arrived, they still didn't know I'd received it. They were just standing around playing and joking around. If the employees are like this, I'm sure the manager is no different.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุวรรณ จอดนอก

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ate there in the evening. The building had turned off the air conditioning, but the restaurant was still open, making it incredibly hot. I was sweating while eating.
The cleanliness of the restaurant wasn't particularly good either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Itachi Uchiha

restaurants.name: Yayoi
restaurants.address:

L7, Zone B, Central World, 99/9 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I chose this restaurant because other restaurants had long queues, but the food was bland and lifeless. It tasted like it was made by robots following a recipe, not by any chefs. It didn't seem fresh; it was pre-made and then served to customers. I ordered tempura, but got fried shrimp with a very thick batter, nothing like the picture. The staff seemed unenthusiastic and I had to keep calling them. They lacked resourcefulness and service mind. Even with robots helping to serve, the food took a very long time to arrive, and I still had to call the staff. They neglected their duties and didn't notice if customers needed anything. It's no wonder nobody goes to this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanapa Churat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in the Beacon Zone, 7th floor, Central World. There are various seating options to choose from, and it's quiet and peaceful.

We ordered two Yayoi Healthy sets, adding gyoza, green tea ice cream, and strawberry ice cream. Each set costs 299 baht.
We also ordered Teriyaki Chicken with Bamboo Shoots Rice (199 baht) and Spicy Chicken Steak with Mushroom Rice (209 baht).
The food took about 20-25 minutes to arrive. The taste was standard; the rice sets with chicken, rice, and dashi soup were delicious.

The prices are net, with no VAT or service charge added. Members get a 10% discount when paying cash or via bank transfer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutthida S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Menus shouldn't be placed behind customers' seats. When customers are seated and the menu is placed down, it makes a loud noise that startles them. After finishing the meal, while I'm drinking water, the staff comes to clear the plates as if they're in a hurry to rush me. Some staff members make faces, while others are friendly and smiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koko Cho

sample_reviews_en.text: The food doesn't taste as good as before. The soup was served lukewarm, not hot at all. I ordered a matcha frappé, but they served me green tea instead. When I asked for another drink, it seemed like they just blended that one and served it – it was incredibly bland. Everything tasted bland. The service seemed confused.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wimonsiri Phukjit

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu offers a wide variety of choices, and the prices aren't too high, but the food wasn't quite to my liking. It's hard to explain, but the dishes looked exactly like the pictures. The taste, however, wasn't impressive. I might try other dishes next time in case I find something I really like.
sample_reviews_en.author: Princess Mia

sample_reviews_en.text: Not the most friendly or enthusiastic waiting staffs. It was very bare and quiet at lunch time, which works well for those who wants a calmer place to dine at Central World. Foods were served out of the kitchen by a robot. Food was as expected and consistent with the other Yayoi outlets.
sample_reviews_en.author: S ZS

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff took the order quickly and gave good advice on promotions.
The food arrived late, about 20 minutes after ordering.
The service staff were good, polite, and spoke nicely.
They should improve the slow food service.
Because the wait was far too long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gargoyle Jibinoriko

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited Yayoi with decent expectations, but overall the experience was just average. The food didn’t quite live up to the hype—especially the pork steak, which I remember used to be served sizzling hot on a hot plate. This time, it arrived …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tan T

restaurants.name: OHoi Gyoza Ekkamai! the best Taiwan Gyoza beef ramen!/今囍!台灣手工餃子 台式牛肉麵/เกี๊ยวซ่าและก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อสไตล์ไต้หวัน/台湾餃子と牛肉麺
restaurants.address:

86 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Perhaps because it is run directly by a Taiwanese owner, the food was really delicious! 🇹🇼

I had Taiwanese-style beef noodle soup for the first time in a while, which I had been missing, and I was very satisfied. The fried dumplings were also tasty.

Ordering was easy because a Korean menu was available, and I liked that the restaurant atmosphere was clean and comfortable. The owner and staff were also friendly, making for a pleasant dining experience.

It is a place I would love to visit again! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Juhyeon Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
If I hadn’t looked up, I would’ve completely missed this place! I’m super glad I didn’t 😮‍💨

The owner was very kind and the staff work behind the kitchen/bar and are delightful. They accidentally forgot to give me something so gave me a free kombucha to apologise (which they didn’t need to).

THE NOODS ARE ABSOLUTELY DIVINE TOO, I will be coming back asap 💖 Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Saki

sample_reviews_en.text: We were just walking by Ekkamai area and found this very cute Taiwanese lunch place. We tried their braised pork rice and pork chop. The owner served us cabbage salad, his grandma’s recipe and we loved it! The place is very well thought out, I loved the open kitchen space and the grungy walls. Would definitely come back for the beef noodles!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yee Mon Lwin

sample_reviews_en.text: Super impressed! The beef noodles are super authentic—the broth has amazing depth, and the beef is so tender. The fried pork chop is insanely delicious too! Also, so glad to finally find thick-skin dumplings nearby (Bangkok usually only has those thin Japanese ones).
sample_reviews_en.author: Elise K

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is authentic Taiwanese-style noodles. If you're craving Taiwanese-style noodles, this is it. It might not be exactly to everyone's taste, but it's totally authentic. The dumplings are also great.

Real Taiwanese-style noodles. When I miss Taiwan, I'll be here.
sample_reviews_en.author: phisut deachkoontod

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was a very pleasant experience for us to have dinner here.
That was our first real taste of authentic Taiwanese flavours. We will definitely come back. We must try many more things here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Edit

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The soup was fragrant, and the meat chunks were large. I was very satisfied after eating it. The braised pork rice was also delicious. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuhong Hao

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish I tried was delicious. The noodle bowls were huge, so I could only sample a few things. All the seating downstairs is counter seating facing the kitchen.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

restaurants.name: เกี๊ยวซ่า ณ บางหัวเสือ
restaurants.address:

18/11 Soi Bang Hua Sue, Tambon Bang Hua Sua, Amphoe Phra Pradaeng, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The gyoza from this shop is so delicious! At first, I preferred the pan-fried version. Then my child tried the deep-fried version and said it was delicious. My grandmother walked by while I was eating and asked me to try some. Now she asks me to order some for her every week! Sometimes I want it, sometimes my child wants it, sometimes my grandmother wants it ❤️ Now we both love the tuna filling ❤️ And the owner is so lovely, taking orders quickly. The delivery guy is also very polite and nice. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: kanitha boonnitirungkij

sample_reviews_en.text: The salmon is incredibly fresh, with a beautiful, juicy texture. The marinade is amazing – so delicious you don't even need dipping sauce or soy sauce. Don't even think about putting on too much wasabi, or you'll cry! The side dishes are plentiful, and the price is affordable. Overall, it's great. Buy it, you won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: อ้อ อ้อ

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish is fresh and the portions are generous, even exceeding the expected weight. The vendors are friendly and polite. The marinated shrimp is delicious and plentiful, with large shrimp. The rice portion is also generous. The prices are reasonable, and they often have promotions. I'm so impressed I order every month!
sample_reviews_en.author: Uzi Giiez

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish is good, juicy, and fresh. It's so delicious, you'll want to keep going and share the goodness. If it wasn't truly good, it wouldn't have made it this far. Amazing promotions every month. And it's not just the fish that's great; the gyoza is equally amazing. Go try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: ชลิดา สิทธิ

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I've been eating at for many years. The owner is very kind, and the food quality has never dropped. Both the salmon and gyoza are delicious – the taste is exactly what I like. I've never gone to another restaurant! 🐟🫶🏻🧡
sample_reviews_en.author: grapemtp

sample_reviews_en.text: Fresh fish, delicious marinade. The flame-seared salmon is a must-try. A rare secret menu item: salmon skewers with three dipping sauces – original, seafood, and mala. Don't miss out, everything is delicious! 🎣🎣🎣🍣🍣 (Gyoza at Bang Hua Suea)
sample_reviews_en.author: สไปร์ท กินกับอะไรก็อร่อย

sample_reviews_en.text: The salmon is excellent. I order it very often. When I can't decide what to eat, I just go for salmon! I never get tired of it; I want to eat it every day, haha. This set is great; I recommend trying it. It's truly delicious, I confirm!
sample_reviews_en.author: Khanirtha Sornphim

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish is very fresh and delicious. Every time I eat here, it's a truly satisfying experience. They always have great promotions. We'll definitely be eating here for a long time! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: บจ.เกรียงไกรสตีลเซ็นเตอร์ ฝ่ายบัญชี

restaurants.name: ข้าวมันไก่ แม่ปราณีต
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์อาหาร ณ ริมน้ำ ตึก รพ.ศิริราช Siriraj, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had Hainanese chicken rice at the food court by the river at Siriraj Hospital. I ordered boiled chicken rice; the rice was soggy and clumpy, and the chicken wasn't tender, but the dipping sauce was good—sour and spicy. I also ordered Tom Yum soup with chicken thigh, but personally, the flavor wasn't well-balanced; it was more on the bland side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

sample_reviews_en.text: Mae Praneet Hainanese Chicken Rice is at (ex) Hor Prachatippatai (Democracy Dorm) which is now it is the Food Court. Mae Praneet Hainanese  Chicken  Signature dish is butterflypea rice or the purple rice. Rice is a bit hard and not too oily. The shop give big piece of Chicken meat. Price is very friendly. The dish in this review is 50 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aey Angel

sample_reviews_en.text: They usually sell at a riverside stall near the doctors' dormitory. Their Hainanese chicken rice is delicious, and the rice comes in several colors using herbal water like butterfly pea flower for the purple color. Now they've opened a small shop, seating about 8-9 people, at Thonburi Train Station. Parking is usually available there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanjana Waniyom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mae Pranit's Chicken Rice...
I thought Tom Saep would be real boiled chicken soup.
But the restaurant uses the same boiled chicken used for chicken rice. The picture shows thighs and drumsticks, but what I got was only thighs. This bowl costs 55 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text: The best of chicken & rice food stall in Thailand, very delicious. The sauce has no match in taste and texture. They have varieties of healthy rice and grains to be chosen. The soup is rich in taste. The chicken is very good, too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaturong Therdphaothai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered delivery of drumsticks, didn't know where the meat was, tough.
The sauce is delicious, the curry is ok.
White rice can be used, rice berry rice is very hard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Danittha Limakaraungkul

sample_reviews_en.text: He said it was delicious, so I went to try it...it was just average. Even the rice with natural coloring was very ordinary, not tasty at all...
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun O

sample_reviews_en.text: Soft rice, tender chicken, spicy dipping sauce, sweet and savory broth, colorful rice – a favorite of doctors.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bsjf Hsjvs

restaurants.name: ซิ่วลั้ง ข้าวมันไก่
restaurants.address:

40 Na Phra Lan Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It suits Korean tastes.
The owner is friendly.
The pig's feet and rice were really delicious.
The pad thai was a bit bland at first, but it was delicious when mixed with the seasoning they gave me (fish sauce, sugar, etc.).
The fried pork belly was the most expensive item I ordered at 200 baht, but it was worth it.
The first photo is fried pork belly.
The second photo is the pig's feet and rice.
You can choose the meat for the fried rice (pork, beef, chicken, shrimp).
They served a half-and-half spring roll and the other half roll, but it was average.
I'm very satisfied with the food and the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: KL

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't usually write reviews, but I am leaving this for the benefit of fellow Koreans. This place is definitely a great restaurant with very reasonable prices and friendly service.

Someone recommended the pork trotters rice bowl in a review, so I tried it, and it is perfect for Korean palates (under 100 baht).

The spring rolls taste just as you would expect, but the pork trotters rice bowl is delicious. Be sure to try it with a little of the accompanying sauce.

I would love to come back and try other menu items next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: 박제형

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best place to eat if u are visiting grand place and emerald Buddha.
Me and my husband had Duck-chicken rice and they recommended Thai chicken curry with Thai milk tea and cold coffee.
The meals were incredibly delicious we absolutely loved it. Drink was okay.
And shop owner was really friendly guy.
Overall experience was really good.
When it comes to price, it’s not expensive either. We can order big plate for 100bhat and medium/regular plate for 80bhat.
And drinks were 30bhat.
Comparatively cheap from other places.
sample_reviews_en.author: まん丸月

sample_reviews_en.text: Unbelievably kind and prompt service. After a long day and a few disappointing encounters, it was the service here that turned my mood around today. I believe the young man who works here has a name that starts with a B sound but I don't remember. He was happy to direct me to the ATM a block away near the Navy Wives Club when I was a bit short on cash. The food was awesome. Prices are more than reasonable. A must visit. So close to the Grand Palace
sample_reviews_en.author: A Edwards

sample_reviews_en.text:
Instant regret
-The menu is limited and yet the food all taste the same(bland) as if they used one same seasoning on everything.
-It is not clean. You can see its very old and havent been cared for.
-They text each other the order and when it was time for us to pay. They are pointing at our food and screaming at each other to figure out what we ordered and how much it is. So unpleasant if you are stuck in between that.
We barely finished our food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Enerel Tsolmonbayar

sample_reviews_en.text: Very close to the Grand Palace, a relatively small shop, the food is very local, because I have been in Thailand for two months, have been used to the taste of these foods, no merit, no fault, mango sticky rice can be tried, although 10 baht more expensive than in Chiang Rai, but it is a whole mango, in general, you can come and try, the value for money is OK
sample_reviews_en.author: TAOHONG LI

sample_reviews_en.text: Packed wall to wall. Had to wait for a table, but it wasn’t that long. The food was worth the wait. It was good and I don’t even remember what the name of the noodles I had was. I was encouraged by one of the staff to use this hot sauce and it was hot for a second until I used to it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Don Chocolate

sample_reviews_en.text: In the Royal Palace district, it's hard to find a simple and good meal. You have to push open the door of this little shop to find yourself in a popular little Asian restaurant... the food is tasty. They serve beer, but the iced tea (ordered without sugar) is very refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernard Lambert

restaurants.name: Nak Klam Noodle
restaurants.address:

PG6G+PFQ ซอย จันทน์ 18/7 Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Strongman Noodles! And built for a strong hunger indeed.

I was out on to this spot by the fantastic YouTube page OTR Food & History which did a showcase on this family and the history of Cantonese food in Bangkok.

This is the last shop in what was a hub for Cantonese migrants in years gone by, and visiting the family run shop feels like a walk down memory lane.

The noodles are absolutely belters! No question some of the best egg noodles I've ever eaten. Traditionally processed with a bamboo pole, though now done machine - the love put into their food is palpable.

As so many others have mentioned, so good I immediately ordered two bowls.

With nowhere to hide, this is simple food at its best.

Do yourself a favour and taste a slice of history whilst you still can.

I look forward to my next trip back to BKK just to eat these again!

Top-tier Gut Luggage 🤘
sample_reviews_en.author: Maxwell Andrew Buckley

sample_reviews_en.text: Retro vibe. U come here for the experience and the nostalgia. And you eat what uncle cooks for you. There are no wrong orders, u r just not sure what u ordered. JUST EAT! Also remember to flovor your soup, it's not blant or they forgot to add flovors. It's the way you eat your noodles here. Add the vinegar or fish sauce to your taste. Be patient. Uncle might be napping, so wait. As much as I love it, might not come here again as the location is way off the main road. Took me 20 mins to walk just to get there. I got another place to get my noodle fix at a more accessible location. At least I came here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fels Young (费尔雅室)

sample_reviews_en.text:
January 2025. A hidden gem in an alley.

Perfectly cooked, bouncy noodles, dumplings, and pork. Plus, a refreshing broth.

The portions are quite generous. A true hidden gem that lacks nothing.

Regular 50 baht. Large 60 baht.

Google says it opens at 3 PM.

The sign in the store says it opens at 2:30 PM, but the female owner said they also open at 1 PM. Closing time is 11 PM.

October 2025

Still exuding the vibe of a great restaurant deep inside the alley!!

The owner is friendly. Bouncy dumplings, refreshing broth.
sample_reviews_en.author: Korea Jay (4K WALK STUDIO)

sample_reviews_en.text: "Bodybuilder Noodles 🍜💪🏻, Soi Chan 18/7 ✨" is a legendary local shop in this area, hidden away in a mysterious alley. They sell pork wonton noodles with char siu (roasted pork). The egg noodles are chewy and al dente; the day I visited, the owner, an elderly gentleman, cooked them perfectly – not mushy at all. The wontons are generously filled with pork, delicious, and perfectly sized, with a fragrant aroma of crispy pork lard. I personally love the dry wonton noodles. Please support the owner! 💖
sample_reviews_en.author: NANNREVIEW

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old-fashioned wonton noodle soup with barbecued pork. The broth is bland and needs seasoning. The noodles are chewy and soft, the barbecued pork is average, neither good nor bad. The highlight, however, is the homemade pork wontons, which have a surprisingly good flavor that stands out from everything else.

Overall, it's okay, but not good enough to warrant a special trip. It's more of a neighborhood eatery you'd pass by on your way home for people in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyapong Bhookham

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good wonton soup. I guess wontons itself are homemade (the pastry is thin and elastic, meat is juicy), there are a good portion of them, the broth is transparent and light, pork meat is tender. I would prefer a little bit more bright taste, maybe with sesame oil or with a fried onion, but this way is ok too, it has it's own style. Price is 50-60 for today.

The place was open at 6 pm, so the working hours are correct I guess.
sample_reviews_en.author: Liudmila

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating this since I was a kid, it's so delicious! Years ago, when they sold it on the street, during busy periods I once waited in line for up to 20 minutes for a takeaway order. After they moved to the alley, there's no more waiting in line, and the taste is still the same. The highlight is the crispy pork crackling oil. I recommend ordering the dry noodles and a separate bowl of wonton soup. It's truly delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: P Theerakawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
-For me, the highlight is the soft and chewy noodles, the broth is average, and the char siu pork isn't anything special. The price is inexpensive: 50 baht for a regular bowl and 60 baht for a special one. I ate two bowls.
-When I went, there were only 3 tables to sit at; most people were buying takeout.
-The downside is that the owner, who is usually the cook, sits smoking in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: T&T STORY By Tum

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times. Many dishes are delicious, especially the traditional glass noodle salad. But the unexpected highlight is the coconut ice cream. It's incredibly rich, creamy, and delicious – even better than many famous ice cream shops! It's the perfect way to end the day.
sample_reviews_en.author: N T

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes okay, but the price is a matter of personal taste. It's neither cheap nor expensive. But if you want to save money, the Pad Thai stall on Ekkamai Road is a great option; it tastes good and is cheap. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: sarinya kunabutara

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is always delicious here and tastes healthier than other Thai food , they have many options from western food to Thai . Staff are very friendly and polite . Thank you 💕
