sample_reviews_en.text: The Little Room has improved so much under the new management. Great Thai food, a cozy atmosphere, and service that makes you feel like family. Definitely worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Liam Y.Mekler

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ambience.. food options taste.. hospitality..service.. everything is just awesome..
Price is moderate not too high not too low
sample_reviews_en.author: Pradeep Karwande

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted great, and the price was reasonable for the portion sizes. It was mid-range, not too expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jellal Gu

restaurants.name: Northern City Restaurant
restaurants.address:

WVCH+5WC, Pattaya 3rd Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Hidden Gem for Northern Thai Food in Pattaya

Craving authentic northern Thai flavors in Pattaya? I’ve found the perfect spot for you. This small, family-run eatery serves a variety of traditional northern Thai dishes, and it’s a true hidden gem.

Their Khao Soi is outstanding—rich, flavorful, and on the spicier side (which I personally love). But the real star of the meal? The Hung Ley Curry. It wasn’t just delicious—it was an experience. Eating it made me emotional, and I can honestly say it’s the best Hung Ley I’ve had so far.

I’m giving five stars for the atmosphere—not because it’s cozy, elegant, or upscale, but because of its authenticity. This place embodies the simplicity and soul of Thailand. If you’re looking for the real deal, this is it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rolf (Aspergillus)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm not sure if the owner is here or if they're letting their employees do the work. They need to come down and check the quality.
Today was my first time there. I ordered Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao (rice noodles with spicy pork broth), and it seemed like they didn't put fermented soybeans in it, instead using fermented fish sauce. There were also a lot of strands, and the smell was very strong. Because I don't eat fermented fish sauce, I had to take it home for my family from Isaan to eat.
As for the Nam Prik Num (spicy green chili dip), it was completely wrong. They used a blender, not a mortar and pestle. Wherever I eat it, it's always strands of chili. The owner needs to come down and inspect the quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pete PP

sample_reviews_en.text: I went into the restaurant at 1:40 PM on Wednesday, but there wasn't a single customer. The staff were completely indifferent to my presence, so I wondered if they were closed and asked, to which they grumpily replied, "We're open." The atmosphere from ordering to payment was hostile, and I couldn't understand why I had to pay money while feeling so miserable. I've lived in Thailand for two years and thought I'd gotten used to Thai quality, but this place was just awful. Do they hate Japanese people? I found this restaurant on YouTube and went in, but I deeply regret it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 中村武美

sample_reviews_en.text: if your thinking coming please do!! this place deserves all the stars! the food is always good and the plates are always cleaned by the time we leave! the khao soi and kaeng hang lay is our favorites, and a pan fried egg is the best way to start the day!! the workers are the sweetest around and always make you feel at home no matter how far you are from it! the traditional thai music is a lovely touch, there is space to pull up to the shop for a quick pickup and a bathroom inside if you’ve been chugging water to handle the delicious spices plus icey cold coke! ❤️💙
sample_reviews_en.author: josilyn mclean

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northern Thai restaurant offers a wide variety of delicious dishes. The Gaeng Ho (mixed vegetable curry) is especially good. I recommend the Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao (rice noodles with spicy pork broth) and Nam Prik Ong (spicy chili paste) with a large plate of vegetables. The owner provides excellent service, always smiling and cheerful. Even when some dishes were too spicy for children, they thoughtfully made an egg for them – so thoughtful!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wareephorn Sampan

sample_reviews_en.text:
There didn't seem to be an English menu, so we ordered by pointing.
It seems to be a family-run business, and we were served by a friendly man and woman.
Vegetables were included, but I didn't know how to eat them, so I ate them with the side dishes. It was spicy, but within tolerable limits. It wasn't greasy and was delicious. This restaurant has now become one of my favorites.
Thank you, Pattaya Channel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiyotaka Matsumoto

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has now moved to Soi Land Office 3. There's parking in front of the shop.
The Northern Thai food is delicious, not too sweet, with an authentic taste. The Nam Ngiao (Northern Thai noodle soup) is rich and flavorful, and the Gaeng Om (Northern Thai curry) is incredibly tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: waranchalee wongdokmai

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through Grab: Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao (rice noodles with spicy pork broth), not too spicy but still spicy, and a very large bowl. The Nam Prik Ong (spicy chili paste with pork) had way too few vegetables: one head of cabbage, one eggplant, and four stems of long beans.
sample_reviews_en.author: Society Helper

restaurants.name: KAGONOYA
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 9/8-9 Kagonoya ชั้น 7 ห้อง 730 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10320, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
November 29, 2024. Visited after the menu update. Rating with The One Card:
1. It ruined all the good points of this restaurant. 699+ baht.
The meat grade is unacceptable. Even the meat at a local restaurant (like Teenie) is softer.
2. The added sushi is just average.
3. Fried items are very slow to arrive, 20-30 minutes or more.
4. There are two types of staff: those in yellow shirts provide good service, offer recommendations, and give discounts.
5. Some staff in black shirts try to avoid customers, acting like they don't see them when called.
*I wish the restaurant would bring back its old strengths. The shabu-shabu meat should be good first, then the side dishes can come later. Because the meat is tough and other orders are slow to arrive, it ruins everything. The kitchen probably isn't designed to handle large quantities of fried items or sushi at once, resulting in an overall poor experience. Normally I visit once a month or two, but this year I'll take a break and wait for news of improvements.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narin Narat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a premium shabu-shabu buffet, perfect for meat lovers. There are three buffet price options; we chose the premium 699+ baht option, which includes VAT and service charge, totaling around 800+ baht.
You can choose two soups. We opted for sukiyaki soup and pork bone broth, both delicious. The pork quality was excellent, especially when dipped in the broth with raw egg. (I don't eat beef, but my friend loves it.) As for the pork bone broth, after boiling the vegetables for a while, the green color from the vegetables started to show, making it look like green curry.
I liked that there was a huge variety of food to choose from, including fried items and other things, all served hot. The sashimi and sushi were also excellent.
The atmosphere in the restaurant wasn't too busy, and the staff provided good service. However, the air conditioning was quite warm on the day we went, and the restaurant is a bit hard to find, located on the 7th floor near the children's play area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaya Aungtananukul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This review reflects a rather negative experience 😓
I took my family of 5 to eat here. The price per person is quite high at 699++ (approximately 823 THB/person net) and there's a 90-minute time limit. However, the overall experience wasn't worth the price paid.
The wait for food, especially the fried dishes and sushi, was very long, about 20 minutes per order. There were also ordering restrictions:
- For fried dishes and sushi, you can only order 1 piece per item, and 1 piece is one bite.
- You can order a maximum of 3 orders at a time.
This meant we could only eat 3 pieces in one sitting. Combined with the slow service, the 90-minute time limit was insufficient and felt like an indirect way of limiting how much customers could eat.

Overall, I felt it wasn't worth the price paid and I expected better management from the restaurant. Given the quality of service and the lack of value for money, I definitely won't be going back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicky

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were unprofessional. It wasn't terrible, but the service should have been better. The problem stems from the restaurant's quality control system. The service was very slow; I waited a long time. I ordered meat from the premium course, but it wasn't up to standard. They served me two plates of substandard meat. When I tried to return it, the restaurant refused, saying it wasn't allowed. Another staff member came over, seemed confused, and took it back, even though it was obvious it wasn't right. Ultimately, they served the substandard meat again. For those who can't wait in line at the other popular shabu-shabu restaurant, this is the place to go. This is my third time eating here, and each time I chose it because the other popular place has long queues, but I still wanted shabu-shabu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Y.

sample_reviews_en.text: I like this restaurant because the meat is delicious and they have a wide variety of dishes. However, I haven't been to this branch very often because the previous staff weren't great. But this time, it seemed like a new team was working, and they were lovely and the service was much better. Even though they did forget an order, it was forgivable. The new butter-based soup is delicious; I recommend it if you visit during this season. As for desserts and special drinks, they change regularly depending on the month or season. Besides that, they have a variety of other dishes. The Nagoya fried chicken is delicious, and their fried items are also great. I also recommend the new cheese-rolled beef dish. To finish, the Sakura ice cream and peach cheesecake are incredibly delicious and refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerin N.

sample_reviews_en.text: The service at the restaurant was very unimpressive. Even though there were only two tables occupied, and my friend hadn't arrived yet, we asked if we could wait for about 25 minutes. The restaurant informed us that once we sat down, the timer would start counting from 10 minutes later. However, my friend was arriving in 25 minutes, and there were empty tables. We suggested that if 10 minutes passed or if other customers arrived before our friend, we could leave, but both the staff and manager insisted we couldn't. Ultimately, we were going to eat with my friend at this restaurant, but why couldn't they let us sit down a little beforehand when there were no other customers? Other restaurants aren't like this; they're very welcoming and let customers sit until everyone arrives.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kara Treeya

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese-style shabu-shabu buffet restaurant starts at 800 baht per person (net price). They offer a wide selection of fresh ingredients, including pork, beef, vegetables, and side dishes. The quality of the meat was excellent – ​​not tough, and very tender.

I also liked the other Japanese dishes like sashimi, sushi, fried items, and steamed egg custard, which were all delicious.

The dessert selection was a bit limited, with only ice cream available.

The restaurant has a decent number of tables, both indoor and outdoor seating. The staff provided good service, but you might need to call them occasionally as they are constantly serving. P.S. Some items might be sold out if you come in the evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Littlepaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and up to standard, but this branch is better than the Mega Bangna and K-Village branches because the air conditioning is cooler, making it more comfortable to eat, and the ventilation is better, so the smell doesn't linger as strongly.
I like the meat here; the wagyu outside cut is large and tender. The yuzu and plum sauces are excellent, perfect for cutting through the richness.
However, I have to deduct points because they're constantly sold out. For example, the breaded fried beef has only been available once, even after several visits. The mixed tempura is also sold out, and even the vanilla ice cream is gone.
And this restaurant is frequently out of stock, even at lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: ** PYMN **

This is a famous chicken restaurant. Today I ordered the crispy fried chicken with fish sauce. At this branch, the chicken wasn't as crispy. However, overall, they still maintain the restaurant's standards.
Price: 5/5
Quality: 4/5
Taste: 4/5

Speed: 4/5
Service: 5/5
Location: 5/5
Value for money: 4/5

sample_reviews_en.text: The phone number listed is out of service and unreachable. The food quality has deteriorated significantly. The fried fish with spicy salad was the same size and width as before, but this time it was incredibly thin, like cardboard. The spicy salad dressing was packed together in the rice box, spilling out completely. Even the salad in a separate box had its dressing leaking out. The packaging was terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Como

sample_reviews_en.text: Chester's at the Queen Sirikit Convention Center branch has terrible service; they have no customer service mindset. When clearing tables, they are very loud and banging, almost spraying water on customers' heads. We ate there near closing time, and before we had even finished eating, the staff didn't come to inform us beforehand, but instead turned off the lights and chased us out. TT
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanwisa Roongroj

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordering through the app was a complete mess. I ordered 20 items, 8 of which were Coke Zero. I expected them in bottles like other branches, but they came in cups, and only one had "Zero" label. Then, the snacks – 2 pieces of wings – were all put together in one box, 6 pieces in total. How are we supposed to distribute these? This is insane!
sample_reviews_en.author: poqpy K

sample_reviews_en.text: The table wasn't wiped clean at all. There was water spilled on both the table and the chair. When I informed the staff, they responded, "But it's a wet cloth." Really? There were puddles of water; I had to wipe it myself. I stood there watching for a long time, and they didn't wipe it. I asked politely, but they still wouldn't clean it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 373 Hathaipat

sample_reviews_en.text: Chester's offers both crispy chicken with rice and crispy chicken with various sauces, providing a wide variety of menu combinations. The taste is okay, meeting the restaurant's standard. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayuth Mangmesap

sample_reviews_en.text:
The counter staff member with glasses looked like she was forced to work there.
I don't know why she had such a grumpy face 🙄
Doesn't this branch do any random checks?
sample_reviews_en.author: Milk Minnie

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken was undercooked. The staff ignored the customer even after they called out to them two or three times. They just walked past without a care in the world.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saowalak Wanmai

restaurants.name: กูโรตีชาชัก บางซื่อ
restaurants.address:

1038 ถ. ประชาราษฎร์สาย1 Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I've placed to go order for 3, I feel unsafe of hot Roti packed in plastic container with staple. Even if it packed with small paper at the bottom but we carry on the way home, there're still some part of hot Roti touch the plastic container directly. I'm not sure how this plastic heat resistant works or what kind of plastic container are they using (PE/PPE,..,etc.)?
The Banana&egg Roti and Egg Roti were 49฿=8pieces, but I don't like how regular Roti looks. It should have cut better than this to looks nice.
sample_reviews_th.author: Kana Vanasorn

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered chicken nuggets but received french fries. When they changed it to nuggets, they were undercooked. I told them the nuggets were undercooked, and the employee just responded, "Oh, undercooked?" without apologizing at all. They even charged me for the undercooked nuggets on the bill. I was confused. Not only did they not apologize, but they also charged me for the undercooked nuggets. I had to ask if they were really including the undercooked nuggets in the bill, but they didn't answer. I had to get a new bill that didn't include the nuggets, and I still didn't receive any apology from the restaurant. I understand mistakes happen, but I wish they had shown some responsibility.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montakan Khodcharat

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a new owner now, and it's so much better than before! The tea is delicious, the roti tissue is perfectly crispy, and the fried chicken wings are so good my kids ate them all.
We even took some mataba home. Everything looked so tempting. We'll definitely be back. The air conditioning is great, and there's free parking for 1 hour in the back. 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Chawanut Chakaropaspilai

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I ordered food from Grab to eat in my room, and the quality was terrible. The whipped cream looked abnormal; it was just foam. I couldn't eat it all together. I wanted to try it, but as I said, the toppings were soaked in water. Was there a problem with the whipped cream? I wanted to eat the whipped cream, but it was all foam.
sample_reviews_en.author: อาโน บีเคเค

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is very different from other Guroti branches. It seems like they're cutting corners on ingredients. The Thai iced tea isn't good, and the bread uses low-grade margarine. Customers know this, it's not okay. Compared to other branches, it's a completely different story.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worapon Tk

sample_reviews_en.text: Cheese roti is amazing. I order it every time I go. It's delicious, crispy, and the cheese is great, but you have to eat it while it's hot. Ordering it to go isn't really a good idea. If you're driving, there's paid parking at the back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Whaanjai jub_jub

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, with both savory and sweet options. The wait time is reasonable. The restaurant participates in the government's co-payment scheme. There's a parking lot behind the restaurant with free parking for one hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Strawberrii Oo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pulled tea allows you to choose the sweetness level, but it's not the frothy, strong, or fragrant style from the south.
The roti mataba is delicious, the dough is good.
But the prices are a bit high.
sample_reviews_en.author: B B.

restaurants.name: TAKAKI
restaurants.address:

936/3 ถนน สุขุมวิท Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited "Takaki" after playing golf. Our goal was Jiro-style ramen.

We made a reservation by phone from the golf course and headed there. Upon arrival, we bravely ordered the Jiro Nabe (a type of hot pot). With four of us, it's all about guts!

We ordered double garlic, feeling YES! But our bodies said NO to the pork back fat!

We ate the Jiro-style ingredients piled high in the pot among the four of us, and after some of the ingredients had been eaten, we dumped in the noodles. It tasted just like Jiro-style ramen. Our usual pork ramen was complete.

One serving of noodles wasn't enough, so we ended up ordering another. I completely ruined all the progress I'd made with my recent diet. I felt like I had to start my life all over again. There's no going back.

They have a wide variety of ramen, so it's also good for lunch. Next time, I want to try the Dan Dan noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: james won

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Mid Aug 26. It's a casual Chinese izakaya that's been operating in this area for over 10 years, but it's also a ramen shop that specializes in Jiro-style ramen. It has three floors and a large capacity, and there are plenty of cooks, so the food comes out quickly and the staff are efficient! The food is delicious, and I tried their recommended Jiro-style ramen for the first time in my life. You can order it to your individual preferences, and this time we ordered extra noodles and shared it among four people, and it was delicious. However, they use a lot of garlic in every dish, so it might be a concern for some people... Thank you for the meal!
Oh! It's also great that they're open all day from lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: YUJI U

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the pork ramen and the beef with green peppers.

It seems like they have a lot of dishes with strong flavors.

The pork ramen is just as good as everyone says; it's a very tasty Jiro-style ramen.

It's not just thick noodles and a huge portion of bean sprouts; they've really paid attention to the flavor. The soup is just the right richness, and the noodles and bean sprouts absorb the flavor well. There are many Jiro-style ramen shops in Bangkok, but I think this is one of the best.

You can specify the noodle firmness and the amount of vegetables/oil/garlic using a paper with Japanese instructions.

Ultimately, it's a matter of personal preference.
sample_reviews_en.author: zef-orz

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was the second Jiro-style ramen I ate in Bangkok. It was even more delicious than the first. I ordered half the amount of noodles, but even the regular amount of vegetables was more than I expected, so it was just right. Amazingly, if you order half the noodles, you get a free topping! I chose the quail noodles without hesitation. By the way, this is the amount of oil for the regular amount.
As I was leaving, I saw a staff member come back to the kitchen grabbing bean sprouts with his bare hands from the cooler outside, and it really gave me a Thai vibe.

I ordered a soft drink, which came with an appetizer. On this day, it was menma bamboo shoots.
sample_reviews_en.author: skx

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ramen Takagi in Bangkok 📍
I've been there many times, and each time I feel like the flavor just keeps getting better.

It's truly rare to find such exquisite Jiro-style ramen in Bangkok.

The soup is packed with pork flavor, the noodles are chewy, and the sweetness of the back fat is amazing.

The thick, tender pork slices are a perfect match with the seasoned egg.

The portion, flavor, and balance are all consistent, so if you're craving Jiro-style ramen, this is the place to go.

Personally, I think this is the best Jiro-style ramen in Thailand.

I'll keep going back.
sample_reviews_en.author: 無名のおぢぢ

sample_reviews_en.text: Lately I've been coming here just to eat Jiro (Inoue-style pork ramen), but the izakaya menu is also delicious. I remember the dandan noodles, mapo tofu, and snacks being especially tasty. The menu says Inoue-style pork ramen, but when the waiter brought it to me he said "Jiro-ka," so it seems to be called Jiro ramen inside the restaurant too. Lol The soup, noodles, and garlic are mixed just right, and it's my favorite flavor of all the Jiro-style ramen I've had in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: H Onishi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had dinner with two senior colleagues. It was close to the hotel and had a great selection of Japanese izakaya (pub) dishes. It's a smoking-friendly restaurant. We went on a Saturday night around 6:30 PM and were seated on the third floor (smoking allowed) without a reservation.

The food was delicious, and I'd definitely like to come back. I finished with curry, but the half-size portion was huge! 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: 木村憲一郎

sample_reviews_en.text: A foreign resident of the area took us here. I thought the menu would be mostly snacks, but there was a wide variety of items. The restaurant is three stories high, and when we went, the customers were mostly Japanese. The food was average, and the prices were relatively cheap compared to similar restaurants. We had Jiro-style ramen for the finale, which was of decent quality. We were very satisfied.
sample_reviews_en.author: 1969やす

sample_reviews_en.text: Pizza Hut branch 1150, Ratchawithi 38 (Suan Aoi), is located opposite Suan Dusit Rajabhat University. The restaurant is quite large, spacious, and clean, with an on-site restroom. They offer both dine-in and takeout options, including online ordering and home delivery. They accept cash and credit cards. Check out promotions at the store and on their website. They have a diverse menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phongsthorn Chaosongkhorn (Pai)

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! Not too crowded, the restaurant is spacious with plenty of seating.

Additional information:
Parking might be difficult because the restaurant is right on the main road opposite the university. It's better to take a taxi or bus and allow extra travel time as traffic in this area is quite heavy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supachet Saetung

sample_reviews_en.text: Simple and relaxed atmosphere, not too crowded. The wait time is quite long for a pizza place, but it's normal, no more than 20 minutes for the Ratchawithi branch. The staff are friendly, but they need to be more careful when preparing orders for customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eat and trips

sample_reviews_en.text: Currently, we are not open for dine-in, but you can order online or come and order in person. Motorcycles are recommended as there is no parking for cars. Parking on the sidewalk would be inconvenient as the shop is right next to a bus stop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kriengkrai Story Teller

sample_reviews_en.text: The pizza is delicious, the spaghetti is flavorful, and the chicken is fragrant and tender. Everything is served hot. The restaurant is large, spacious, and well-lit. The restrooms are clean, and the service is fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kantavee Wiengsima

sample_reviews_en.text: They made it so fast, I couldn't cancel the last tray in time. I was planning to go eat bingsu afterwards, but I missed out. //In short, it was good. Very, very good..^^
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonchanan Pongsuchart

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was served hot and tasted great. There were plenty of tables, so we didn't have to wait long. The location is right by the road, making it easy to get to.
sample_reviews_en.author: TangmoOK _

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come try the pizza buffet! Buy 4, pay for 3.
The crust is thin, crispy, and delicious. The restaurant has restrooms, but parking is difficult to find in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: MyTravel MyMemo

restaurants.name: AL-YAMANI RESTAURANT PATTAYA المطعم اليمني بتايا
restaurants.address:

363 Pattaya 16 Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant offers a wide variety of high-quality dishes. I dined there and had delicious lamb mandi and madfoon. The broth is served as a welcome gesture, and the salads and meals are generously portioned for the price. They are known for their fast service and genuine enthusiasm for customer care. The second floor is very comfortable and, thankfully, has a prayer room and clean restrooms. There are also floor seating options and tables with chairs. The air conditioning is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: abo talal

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely the best place for authentic Arabic food in Pattaya! As a traveler looking for high-quality Halal options, Al-Yamani Restaurant exceeded all expectations. We tried the Mandi and the grilled meats—everything was seasoned to perfection and served in generous portions. The atmosphere is very welcoming and traditional, making it a great spot for families or groups. If you're in Pattaya and craving real Yemeni flavors, this is a must-visit. Highly recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: naveed ahmed

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a half-baked chicken and rice from them through the Grab app. Honestly, the chicken had no flavor, and the rice was full of cardamom, cinnamon, and other things—it was like biryani rice; you had to clean every bite before eating it. I'm sure the cook wasn't Yemeni; he was probably Indian or someone who used to work in an Indian restaurant.

This was my second experience, and I won't be repeating it.
sample_reviews_en.author: F

sample_reviews_en.text: A beautiful and newly opened restaurant, formerly Abu Abdullah Restaurant. The food is delicious and the staff is friendly. I ordered lamb madfoon, lamb zurbian, and hummus, and everything was excellent. They also offer complimentary tea after the meal. The owner is personally overseeing the restaurant, which in itself guarantees high quality and excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaser H Al Yami

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were here first time, well, we haven't explored the city yet, well, this restaurant always saves us, Yemeni food is the best in the world, and this restaurant is very tasty, especially mulaouah bread and rytaab bread so our order was dinner lamb liver and cheese over meat was wonderful 👍.
Service was amazing guy who take our order was friendly and very kind .
sample_reviews_en.author: Kal Kal

sample_reviews_en.text: The mandi there is excellent, priced at 380, and allows you to customize your order by choosing different types of meat and rice. I hope they continue offering it, and that the portions are the same as those in Yemeni mandi restaurants in Bangkok and Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: marwan yavuz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the service was good. The goat dish was especially good. The goat was probably sourced from Watthana Farm Goat and Sheep Slaughterhouse in Pattaya; they are a major goat supplier.
sample_reviews_en.author: สมเจตน์ เรืองปราชญ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had Fashah lamb and white beans with egg. Very tasty and authentic
Bread portions are huge.
We mistakenly ordered 2 bread for 2 persons.
Anyway Nice Yemeni food place
sample_reviews_en.author: Khaing Zin

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the fried chicken from here on Grab and the food came looking nothing like it was pictured. What the picture shows was a Thai style fried chicken not heavily battered chicken like they sent me. I contacted the number given and I assume the owner picked up to only asked which branch and that’s the last time I heard from him. The branch called me after and basically told me that’s the food they’re selling offering no solution or shown any regret. I tried to tell her explain my concern and telling her that this isn’t what I ordered and I won’t be consuming it they can do whatever they can with it pick it up and refund me or throw it out. The lady from the branch called me again and this time she apologies first and then right after the was cutting me off and didn’t even allow me to finish any sentences. She has poor manners and also poor temperament. I’ve contacted grab to report this incident and checked the review section and no surprise, the same incident same complaint was there, I guess they just did not care about this at all.

So many other places to in this area. Don’t waste your time. Not only the food looks terrible but this is down to management and staffs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Summer B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not very tasty, oily.
The drinks are only sweet. Gu Roti Cha Chak is a franchise of roti and cha chak (Thai milk tea) shops with original recipes from Southern Thailand (Songkhla), famous for its tissue roti with whipped cream and strong-flavored cha chak. It emphasizes an air-conditioned shop atmosphere and has expanded to over 200 branches nationwide. Their signature dishes are usually the crispy tissue roti and the cheesy, stretchy roti.

Highlights and Interesting Information about Gu Roti Cha Chak:
Concept: Elevating roadside roti to a cafe-level snack that can be enjoyed all day.
Signature Menu:
Tissue Roti with Whipped Cream: Thin, crispy roti dough, fragrant with butter, served with whipped cream, shredded egg yolk, or various toppings.
Cheesy Roti: Thick and soft roti packed with cheese and butter.
Cha Chak: Strong-flavored, sweet and creamy Southern Thai milk tea.
History: Founded by "Ah Wang Bilangload" (Bang Ah Wang), it has been open for over 30 years.
sample_reviews_en.author: NWD

sample_reviews_en.text:
If I could give a negative rating, I would give it a negative rating…
1. The dessert was overwhelmingly sweet, not tasty, and took a long time to make.
2. I found a cockroach in my iced milk! I almost threw up! There was a whole cockroach! Where is the cleanliness?!
3. When I told them I found a cockroach in the glass, there wasn't a single apology. Manners? Service? Negative! I returned the glass with the cockroach and told them not to bring a new one… I couldn't drink it!
4. Because of the three points above, I couldn't eat anymore. When I went to pay the bill, they still dared to charge me for the glass with the cockroach, and again, no apology. At this point, I couldn't take it anymore, so I told them, "You still dare to charge me for my drink that has a cockroach in it?" I didn't even get the apology I wanted.

I'm thankful I didn't walk out without paying. That's it. One time is enough. Now I have to force myself to vomit. The worst experience of my life!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerisa Phetklap

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the atmosphere is good. But I don't understand. I ordered rice for 89 baht. When the rice was served, the staff asked to charge 99 baht for the rice first. At first, I was suspicious but thought that I must have read the price on the menu wrong, so I paid. I was going to pay in cash, but the staff said they didn't accept cash, only scan to pay. Then I looked again and the price was really 89 baht. So I told another staff that I ordered rice for 89 baht, but they charged me 10 baht more. The staff said, "Oh, the prices are not the same." Then she walked away. I didn't mind paying 10 baht more, but I was confused. Why were the prices not the same? Is this called deceiving consumers? And that's all the staff said without explaining anything further. I'm confused.
sample_reviews_en.author: กุลธิดา เหมนเเก้ว

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted great! The only downside was the confusing menu; it felt like they just shoved the orders in my hand.
The atmosphere inside the restaurant was nice, the decor was pleasing to the eye.
What I'd like to see improved is the staff. There was no greeting upon entering the restaurant; they must have been tired. They need to learn to speak more, not just point. I'm not expecting 5-star service, but the staff should learn how to provide good service. Or maybe the staff are actually the owners? 🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimpisut Khunpakdee

sample_reviews_en.text: You can easily enjoy Thai-style milk tea (cha chak) and roti. The sweet and fragrant roti is crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside, making it feel like a dessert. The cha chak is quite sweet but rich, and it pairs very well with the roti. The prices are local prices, making it perfect for a light snack or a break. It has more of a local atmosphere than a tourist spot, and it gets more crowded and lively at night. If you're walking around the Saphan Khwai area, I think it's worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yusuke

sample_reviews_en.text: I go there very often, it's my regular restaurant. But during busy periods, the staff completely ignores customers. When I asked if the tables were full, they just said yes without saying anything more. Today, I asked if there were other payment methods, and they said no and quickly turned to show me a QR code as if I wanted to transfer the money immediately. Asking doesn't mean I wouldn't pay! Please train your staff better. Experiencing this is really disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: My Joy

sample_reviews_en.text: The roti is delicious, I've been here twice. Both times, the counter staff were unfriendly. When I went to pay the bill and said we'd split the cost, they just stayed silent, handing me the receipt with the price. I told them again that we'd split it, and that's when their attitude became even more unwelcoming. Then they handed me their phone to scan, which was very confusing since I'd already told them the first time. Everything else was great except for the staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: nuttika Sae-oui

restaurants.address:

1180 ถ. เจริญกรุง Khwaeng Bang Rak, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The interior is very good but the rest leaves a room for improvement. The food was OK but very expencive. Coffee was bland. The staff was very polite but for some reason you can't make adjustments to the menu: make something without ice or without chilli. The location is good but there is no smoking zone. We had to wait for food for a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arseniy Garipov

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very impressed with the service from the staff. Since I ordered an unsweetened iced chocolate, the staff thoughtfully added extra toppings as a substitute. The serving style was like a fancy restaurant. The atmosphere of the shop is nice and peaceful, perfect for working with concentration.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nu Dang

sample_reviews_en.text: What a beautiful cafe!!! Marc was such a warm & welcoming host from the moment we walked in. We found a perfect, quite corner to sit and enjoy our lattes & this deliciousness french toast. Wow!! So good paired w/ the latte. Comfy, beautiful, quite & tasty. Perfect ending to our day out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cindy Perry

sample_reviews_en.text: The servers were very friendly! Very welcoming and smiling, however, the carbonara pasta was really disappointing! It had a very processed taste that I definitely wouldn't recommend. My friend, however, had a tuna sandwich which was very good! The portions were also very small!
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Trijeau

sample_reviews_en.text:
The brown candy coffee was soo good! Not too sweet and the candy is so delicious. I ate some of it and then let the rest dissolve in the coffee, giving it a sweet burned caramel taste!
The vibes of the place is also great! And the staff are so nice
sample_reviews_en.author: Hana Alaa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good place to relax around neighborhood and friendly staffs

Pass here many times during street photo shooting. Stop by for coffee and some refreshments

Today heavy rain, got a nice welcome to wait until rain stop

Will come by again!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arkkapol Dhanaraks

sample_reviews_en.text: My favourite place to stay and eat in the city !!! Very nice and peaceful, excellent staff who are so kind and lovely! Love all my meals …. Love everything about this place. Thank you to everyone for always taking care of me
sample_reviews_en.author: Landi Andries

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible place and service. Waiters bring you the wrong food, and managers don't even try to solve the problem. They use unoriginal recipes and yell that it's our fault. They're completely uncustomer-oriented.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jazz Va

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_en.text: This sweet bun in Bangkok... the dough is soft and chewy, and the chicken and vegetable fillings are sweet, unlike savory buns at all. It tastes more like a bread dessert, gentle and comforting. The texture is smooth and not greasy, with just the right amount of sweetness. Stumbling upon it while wandering the streets of Bangkok is definitely worth it; sweet tooths, grab it without hesitation!
sample_reviews_en.author: 大金子

sample_reviews_en.text: Their bao looked great in the pictures and was ready to go and order a lot but in 40 degrees weather outside these smart guys didn’t come up with the idea of offering any drinks at their restaurant. No water, nothing. No beverages. Talk about a great business mindset. I just went to a restaurant next door. Next level stupid

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dough was okay, but the balls were small, the filling was minimal, the taste was average, and they were incredibly expensive—6 small balls for 100 baht. I think Chao W is better.

I happened to be passing by and saw good reviews, so I decided to give it a try. But I think it's probably a fake.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patchranan Chaichantipyuth

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd like to ask how to order takeout. Which restaurant is it on Grab? I can't find it. The owner on Xiaohongshu only accepts private messages. Can't they just publicly disclose the takeout order channel? It's a restaurant that mainly does takeout; it's unacceptable that customers can't find it.
sample_reviews_en.author: keeyaa

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner is nice, the food comes out quickly, and most importantly, it tastes great. Being able to eat there in Bangkok is very satisfying. I hope the owner keeps up the good work and expands the business! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: 白子桓

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I didn't want anything else for dinner, so I just wanted this. Everyone's tastes are different, but you have to try the steamed buns to know how good they are. Everyone really loves them!
sample_reviews_en.author: 罗汉

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop I highly recommend!
The food was original Chinese flavor, all made by handmade.
Bao is so soft and the shop is so clean
Can see they make the real bao
The best bao shop in Thailand 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: 뽈뽈

sample_reviews_en.text: The steamed buns were just left out like that, which was very unhygienic. The taste was also mediocre; the meat was rather bland, and it was only the oil and salt that masked the flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: aroi life

restaurants.address:

ล็อค A3-285 Kanlapaphruek Market, 10/3 ถนน กัลปพฤกษ์ Khwaeng Bang Khae, Bang Khae, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried noodles were bland and didn't look anything like the picture. The portion was large, but not very tasty. Stir-fried noodles should be delicious without any seasoning; this was like they didn't know how to cook them. They used packaged vinegar, so even with the seasoning, it didn't taste good. The water spinach was wilted and tough. The shrimp was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: PrayerGirl Pear

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles in gravy were delicious, the pork was tender and the flavor was well-balanced. The stir-fried noodles with soy sauce were also very tasty. I ate there yesterday, the staff were very lovely and it wasn't expensive either 🥰 I'll definitely go again if I have the chance 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Me Stamp

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! I loved it. I've never had such delicious noodles in gravy anywhere else. Ordering it with a crispy fried egg makes it even better. The stir-fried noodles with soy sauce and other dishes on the menu were also delicious. Good service too 💜
sample_reviews_en.author: jjao D

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crispy noodles with gravy were delicious! 👍🏻
The noodles were crispy and not rancid, and the pork was very tender.
The gravy was served piping hot.
I highly recommend it! I'll definitely be back to this restaurant many more times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Budzii

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so delicious!!! I love the pork the most; it's so tender. When I worked near Yaowarat, I ate it almost every day. The crispy noodles with gravy are also delicious. I'm so happy they opened a branch near my house.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chu Hut

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible experience. It smelled burnt, and they ignored my warnings. Don't expect to eat there again. The owner was incredibly rude. If there were a million negative stars, they would be perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: วรวุฒิ ฉัตรมาลาทอง

sample_reviews_en.text: The gravy noodles are delicious! The noodles have a fragrant wok-fried aroma, the pork is tender and there's plenty of it. A complete and satisfying meal in one bowl. Made fresh, bowl by bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: phannara suphansomphop

sample_reviews_en.text: My favorite stir-fried noodles with gravy! I've been there many times and it's never disappointed. It's incredibly delicious, the flavor is just perfect. The staff are also very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: พี่กุ้งกดสิว ตลาดบีบีบางใหญ่

restaurants.address:

886 Srinagarindra Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went there for dinner buffet with Hungry Hub app… Foods are ok not so tasty. Ingredients also just ok maybe we came too early around 10.50AM
Coffee also so so… Pork shop look ok cook well and juicy.
Overall dishes also not so impressive.

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The restaurant is located on Srinakarin main road and next to the MRT Yellow Line, Kalantan Station. There is parking available in front and behind the restaurant. The interior is beautifully decorated and the atmosphere is nice.
- The food, however, needs improvement. It takes a long time to prepare (there were no customers when I went), the portions are small and not worth the price, and every dish tastes too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wikavin Suttikornworarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, I really liked it. I especially enjoyed the truffle spaghetti, pesto shrimp, and rocket salad.
The service was also excellent, the food came out quickly, the staff were polite, and the restaurant was beautifully decorated and clean. I'll definitely be back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wipawan Pansombat

sample_reviews_en.text: They've added rice porridge to the menu, and it's delicious. I especially like that they sell it as a set with rice porridge and four side dishes. The rice porridge is just the right portion, and the price is reasonable – great value!
sample_reviews_en.author: BENZTUBE -

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful, the atmosphere is great, and the food is delicious and unique. The prices are moderate, but considering the quality and service, it's worth it. I recommend contacting them to reserve a table beforehand.
sample_reviews_en.author: AD01 Prachya Thap

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautifully decorated, with only a few tables, but the decor is stylish. The menu focuses on single-serving dishes, suggesting it's a fast-food and drinks place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonporn C

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, cool air conditioning, friendly staff, lovely owner, parking available, clean restrooms, and they sell a yellow-colored drink 🍺🍺
sample_reviews_en.author: Anuwat Choosri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious.
If you order a lot, you might have to wait a little while.
There is parking in front of the restaurant and inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poly Ploy

restaurants.name: SEOULCHON สาขาMRTท่าพระ
restaurants.address:

13/8 Phet Kasem 12 Alley, Wat Tha Phra, Bangkok Yai, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: My Korean fried chicken experience was one of high expectations, but the flavors were completely lacking. The kimchi soup was like plain broth, not spicy at all. The spicy fried chicken wasn't spicy at all. The instant noodles were okay, but you could make them yourself. The 389 baht set included 10 pieces of chicken and two side dishes of rice or coleslaw – very uninspired. Overall, it's edible, but don't expect too much or you'll be disappointed. The best thing was the cheese fries. That's it.
sample_reviews_en.author: kikises vap

sample_reviews_en.text: The food came out quickly, the sauces were flavorful, and the staff were enthusiastic. The fried chicken was crispy and delicious. Today I had the nachos, real mac and cheese, and fried cheese. In terms of taste, the nachos were Korean style, the real mac and cheese was milky with both cheesy and spicy flavors, and the fried cheese was a bit starchy and bland. Overall, it was okay and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natchanan Pongrux

sample_reviews_en.text: If we're talking about Bonchon, I'd rank Solchon as the second best among Korean fast-food restaurants. It's much more affordable, the fried chicken doesn't have that gamey smell like most famous chains, and the flavor is really good and suits my taste. If you haven't tried it yet, I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerapat Asawataweechoke

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff was terrible. I gave them my order number, but before I could even finish speaking, they interrupted me and told me to sit and wait, even though the order was already ready. They should have checked and verified the order before speaking.
sample_reviews_en.author: RattanakunPho

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch opened during the first lockdown in April 2021. It's a shophouse with a few tables, so it's not crowded and offers a relaxing atmosphere.

Most of the customers are riders who come to pick up their items and deliver them to their homes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boon Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The tables and chairs are made of metal and are difficult to move; they make a very loud noise when moved.

But I like the boneless chicken. I like it because the batter is hard and crispy, unlike anything else. I really like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: ArkCross X

sample_reviews_en.text: We came based on reviews. My son wanted to eat here. The food was delicious and the staff were lovely. We didn't have to wait too long because we arrived around 11:30 AM, but there were non-stop orders from Line Man and Shopee!
sample_reviews_en.author: pradthana suthum

sample_reviews_en.text: No parking available, located on the street. Plenty of tables, but mostly focused on delivery. Delivery drivers (Lineman) pick up orders quickly. Food comes out fast and is delicious – perfect for Gen Z! 😀
sample_reviews_en.author: Tas T

restaurants.name: PASTAIOLI Emsphere
restaurants.address:

564 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are looking for authentic, high-quality fresh pasta, Pastaioli at Emsphere is definitely worth a visit. Every single dish served here is absolutely delicious, with a clear focus on mastered pasta creations.
​
The menu is heavily centered around their incredible fresh pasta. The texture and flavors across all pasta dishes are top-notch.
​
The menu is quite streamlined. They offer a few salad options to accompany your meal, but note that the selection of appetizers or light finger foods is fairly limited. Come here ready for the main event!
​
​The service is excellent. The staff is attentive, polite, and welcoming.
​
The restaurant is cozy but has limited seating layouts. There is only one table available that can comfortably accommodate a larger group of friends. The rest of the seating is best suited for smaller parties of 2 to 3 people.
​
If you're planning a group gathering, make sure to book that single large table in advance! Otherwise, it’s the perfect spot for an intimate date night or a catch-up with a couple of close friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanaporn Yamjinda

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had dinner at PASTAIOLI when visting Emsphere.

Overall we thought our experience was good.

The food was excellent, very fresh and tasty and we enjoyed all the dishes we had. I did order a dish with roast potatoes which were sparse when they arrived so maybe portion could be better.

Service was also okay and attentive.

The slight issue we had was we were seated next to a concourse area with the menu next to us so people often watched us eat as they walked by or decided to look at the menu. This was fine and we could have moved if it bothered us.

The star being knocked off is because of the bill which did stun us a bit when it arrived considering we did not order any alcohol, and especially after tax and service is added on top!

That being said the food was good quality so we didn’t feel completely short changed and can recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay

sample_reviews_en.text: Thought it was going to be good because it looked like they make fresh pasta dough with good care. Unfortunately they ruined it with extremely bland and flavorless sauce. I took 3 bites and couldn’t continue. Tasted like water. I also ordered a bottle of water without looking at the price as I always do in Thailand. Super shocked when I went to pay and the water was 100 baht! Insane lol. Didn’t even ask if I liked my food after seeing I ate basically nothing. Bad food, bad price. Oh well
sample_reviews_en.author: Dave Carson

sample_reviews_en.text:
Picture on the left was the first time I came and loved it.  Picture on the right, I came today and it's so watery it looks like it's sitting in soup!!!

Horrible inconsistency. Informed the waiter and all he said was "We can make it dry if you want."

No apologies from the waiter.  I told him upfront he has terrible customer service and he just gave me a sullen look and kept quiet.

Also, it was MEANT to be dry.  So not sure what he meant by saying they can make it dry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Malay Non Mi

sample_reviews_en.text: Pastaioli is a fresh handmade “pasta bar” on the G floor of Emsphere in Bangkok, serving Italian-style pasta with both fresh and dried shapes cooked properly al dente.  Reviews often highlight it as an authentic-leaning Italian spot, with an emphasis on correct pasta texture and classic sauces rather than heavy, overly rich flavored
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. Ahmed Abdulshakour

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very impressed with the chicken in the Caesar salad; it was really tender and delicious, even though the salad itself wasn't quite what I was looking for. The fresh pasta was definitely different from the pre-made kind; it was delicious. I also found it amusing how they dried the noodles like clothes.
sample_reviews_en.author: kit dan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pasta was perfectly al dente.

We had the pasta with ragù and with seafood. Both were delicious, and the service was attentive and friendly. The prices were perfectly reasonable for what you get.

The ambiance was also Italian, which suited the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katharina

sample_reviews_en.text: Lovely lunch at Pastaioli in Emsphere. The seafood pasta was absolutely delicious and full of flavour. 🔥🔥The seafood was super fresh and the portion was generous. Great atmosphere and perfect for a relaxed lunch. I will definitely come back again. 🤌🏻❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalita Dowdeswell

restaurants.name: Papa’s Kitchen
restaurants.address:

Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went for 50% off burgers.
Great burgers, yummy ice cream (esp. Salted Caramel), friendly staffs and attentive service. Wonderful place for food and chillaxing!

Adjusted down May 2023

After the  COVID freeze we went back as we missed the great food...well, management has changed and so did everything else... things are at the bottom of the hill. Food tastes bad, not fresh, ingredients are less than average and service..chaos. Just not going to go back for another long while..maybe management will change again..a real shame.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asanee Isarowong (B)

sample_reviews_en.text: If we can give it a minus 5 star, we would. The service was good and food taste ok. The supreme burger was a tall tower with a single beef patty, which falls apart and feels not entirely cooked. We had it around 8pm. By 3pm, we were having diarrhea and vomiting every 30mins. That torture continued until the next day until we were too weak to crawl out of bed except for the toilet. In total, my wife and I were in bed and fasted for 48 hours. Almost died.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lawrence Ng

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is delicious, with a great ambiance and plenty of parking, making it suitable for entertaining friends and clients. The singer is fantastic. I hope the portions can be larger so more customers will come and patronize the restaurant; please don't go out of business.
sample_reviews_en.author: 雪梨

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu is extensive, with burgers, pizzas, salads, and spaghetti. It's a large restaurant with plenty of seating, but it's not crowded, giving a private feel. The decor is styled like a foreign pub. There are promotions almost every day, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siwakorn Job

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re looking for a great American-style burger in Bangkok, Papa’s Kitchen is the perfect choice. I love having delicious burgers at reasonable prices and Papa’s Kitchen is definitely my go-to burger eatery in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Auttawut Oat

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a Western-style restaurant, but you can order papaya salad from Yod Lab Ped restaurant because they have the same owner. Spaghetti with shrimp, eaten with spicy papaya salad and fried shrimp, is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุทธิพัฒน์ อินทร์เผือก

sample_reviews_en.text: The pasta was delicious, but the small burger was just soso. The pizza was okay. They seem to have live music so better take a table outside, if available, if you like to chat with your friends
sample_reviews_en.author: Herve Bergmans

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The steak melted in my mouth, the nacho dipping sauce was crispy and fun to chew, the burger was big and tasty, and the spaghetti was very good too.
sample_reviews_en.author: ViLaI PR

restaurants.name: Kuenwang The Garden Boutique Eatery
restaurants.address:

55/5 ซอยเพชรหึงษ์ 26 หมู่ 4 Bang Nam Phueng, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great boutique restaurant in Bang Kachao

This was our first time in Bang Kachao and we were very lucky to find this wonderful place for lunch. The food was delicious and the atmosphere is fantastic, surrounded by pure nature and birdsongs. The owners, very friendly and well educated, gave us a very warm welcome and made us feel like family. They have created a lovely place with plants growing everywhere and a modern, comfortable design. We had a tasty and generous Pad Thai Kung Sod and a fusion Spaghetti Bacon. Both were perfect. We also had a delightful Fried Moringa dish that is quite difficult to find nowadays. Excellent!  Finally, for dessert, we had Krathon Loikaew. To die for! Incredible taste, really. The chef has been traveling extensively in Europe and combines both Thai and Western culinary cultures to perfection. Overall, quality food at very good prices in a bucolic setting that makes the whole experience even more enjoyable. This place and the wonderful owners really made our day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atinee P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pros: Beautiful restaurant, nice and cozy atmosphere, good location with parking, many unique menu items.

Cons:
- Food service is extremely slow. It's best to order the day before and come to eat. Even water with ice takes a long time to come out.
- The food tastes mediocre and isn't worth the price.
- The bacon and scrambled egg rice had burnt bacon.
- The grilled beef with marinated egg rice had a broken marinated egg in one dish, and the beef was dry.
- Drinks were acceptable.

📍 The restaurant cannot accommodate a large number of customers. The kitchen and customer service system are unable to keep up, resulting in a less positive customer experience, despite the restaurant's efforts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimkarn Kiraiwirapakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was delicious. The price/quality ratio was perfect. Royal cuisine requires advance reservations – this isn't fast food, and high-quality ingredients must be fresh. The approach was superb. We ordered simple dishes and were delighted with the chef's professionalism. Special thanks to the drinks.

The prices were lower than I expected, and the taste was superior to 99% of cafes and restaurants in Thailand.

I hope your team keeps up the good work, and if you want, you'll earn a Michelin star! I'll be praying for your success, and soon you'll be inundated with customers. Thank you for a pleasant and relaxing lunch. See you again ;)
sample_reviews_en.author: Анастасия Л

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the cooking is excellent.
They have rare, traditional Thai dishes on the menu, as well as a variety of modern dishes.

The restaurant uses very high-quality ingredients and prepares and creates each dish with meticulous care.

The owner was a former flight attendant and learned traditional Thai cooking from a member of the royal family (according to a recent magazine interview). That explains the amazing, well-balanced, and flavorful taste.

The atmosphere in the restaurant is also lovely, lush and green.
There's convenient parking available as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ped N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice place to dine in. Can serve up to 14 customers, ideal for solo traveler/ couple.

The chef recommended “pad thai”. I ordered. The dish come with well sliced banana blossom - perfect for pad thai lover especially you don’t have to hand grab the bb anymore. The taste is great - not too oily, the prawn is both soft and crispy.

They later offered a piece of coconut role (karaked role) for free. Taste well, burnt coconut sliced in pieces with salty sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: karn siddhi

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner is lovely and friendly. They gave thoughtful and patient food recommendations, and even helped suggest nearby tourist spots. I was very impressed and will definitely visit this restaurant again if I'm in the area. The food was delicious and everything seemed carefully prepared. The atmosphere is great; the air-conditioned area is cool and comfortable, while the outdoor area is shady. The restrooms are also clean. 👍🏻🩷✨
sample_reviews_en.author: imw.

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is something more than amazing. A small cafe home style, very welcome very comfortable, the food is something unthinkable, 100 times much better than many central Bangkok restaurants. The quality and even the eggs are very genuine and local quality amazing. I would recommend this place to anyone who happen to be there. The price are something unthinkable too, real value for money. We will come back soon for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: GastroTravel

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow! An amazing find in Bangkok's green lung. We found this on Google after checking out the market and it was the best part of the day! The ladies who run the play are amazing and they did a great job explaining the foods and their history. We tried so many cool dishes and I especially liked the traditional Thai appetizers and dessert. Thank you so much. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: audreylaw

restaurants.name: Tamar Bakery and Restaurant
restaurants.address:

WVFM+W8G, ซอย เฉลิมพระเกียรติ 10, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a carrot cake and a yuzu coffee. Both was amazing. It‘s like a western styled cafe, where you can get authentic european, british and American cakes.

I also ones tried thai lunch here. Its was very delicious.

The glass front is very nice to look out. The AC is not too cold.

The hotel inside is modern and by the way its the cleanest building I‘ve seen in whole Thailand.

They also sell safe made jewelry, cards and stuff. I recommend.

We have known this resource for ministry and rescue for hurting people for years while we were living and serving in Thailand and since our retirement. They are entirely credible and deserving of prayer and support.
BEWARE of hostile attacks on this Godly presence by some "anonymous" and very sinister posts from another source posting on Google who is obviously from dark and predatorial, opposing, sources.
sample_reviews_en.author: RB Kuter

sample_reviews_en.text: A friend of mine and I are visiting from America and have had breakfast, lunch and dessert at Tamar Cafe we have enjoyed everything about it. The food is fresh and delicious. There are a lot of options. The staff is so friendly, helpful, and easy to understand. It’s clean, inviting, bright and the atmosphere is peaceful. It’s refreshing to come in after being us a bustling and noisy city.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Herr

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really enjoyed my breakfast here. I ordered the 2 eggs with toast and bacon and coffee and orange juice.
All was great.
Sorry, I forgot to photograph the meal before I ate it all. 😂 but I did remember to photograph the coffee and the menu.

The atmosphere here is great. Good air conditioning and very clean.  Nice tables to sit at, bar seating facing the street, and table outside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Doctor Kutchapeckeroff

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every detail here is meticulously considered. The place is clean, beautifully decorated, and the food is delicious. There are rooms upstairs as well. The rooftop is perfect for parties, offering a 360-degree view and great weather.
There are also handmade items for sale, such as cards, bags made from coffee bags, scarves, etc.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aylin Sky

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very impressed. The food and drinks were delicious, the atmosphere was lovely and comfortable, the staff were friendly and provided good service. Most importantly, the desserts were amazing, especially the cakes and matcha. 🍰🍵
It's a place that makes me feel good when I visit, and I want to come back again. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: full 5 salon Ladkrabang

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a fantastic restaurant and café!

The decor is truly beautiful and creates a cozy, inviting atmosphere. We were there for lunch, and I can especially recommend the green chicken curry – absolutely delicious! The service was also incredibly friendly and attentive.

Thank you so much!
sample_reviews_en.author: Renita Penner

sample_reviews_en.text: A group of 7 of us enjoyed lunch at Tamar Bakery and Restaurant. We ordered Thai and American food and it was fresh and delicious! Their drinks were delicious and they offered a large variety of options. Their desserts were some of the best I’ve ever had!! We will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brenda Herr

restaurants.name: Steak Bar by Lung Yai Charoen Nakhon 35
restaurants.address:

51 Charoen Nakhon 35 Alley, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great, with a full view of Asiatique.
It was chilly and breezy when I went.
Perfect for hanging out and having beer with friends.

The food was okay, tasty and not bad, but I went with my dad.
He ordered medium rare steak, and I was surprised it was a bit too rare.
We informed the staff, and they made a new one for him.

There's a cute cat in the indoor area.

The cooking is homemade style; the kitchen isn't big, so you have to wait a while for your food.
The prices are reasonable, not expensive. Black pepper pork was less than 100 baht!

Parking is limited. There are about 8-10 tables outdoors.

If you want to chill, sip beer, eat steak,
and enjoy the river view, I recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: GOOG.PUTCHONG Chotprakaykiat

sample_reviews_en.text: The steak prices are great, especially considering the riverside location. Highly recommended! Prices start from a reasonable 100 baht note (with change from a 100 baht note). Eating here in the evening is very relaxing by the river. However, there are only a few tables, about 3-4 inside the house, but the outdoor area has a great atmosphere. The steak prices are similar to Uncle Nuad's Steakhouse, and they're delicious. I tried the Godfather steak for 149 baht; the pork cutlet was huge! I also ordered the sausage and pork chop combo, which was delicious, especially the sausage. It's at the end of Soi Charoen Nakhon 35, turn left. There's parking for 5-6 cars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rojjana Rungrattwatchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
22/12/2567: The restaurant is located at the end of the soi (alley) next to the Chao Phraya River. It's a small restaurant, but every dish we ordered was delicious and everyone liked it. The prices are reasonable. It's recommended to call and check for table availability before coming. There isn't much parking, but it's convenient to park. The service is good. I recommend ordering the fried calamari, smoked sausage, and the various value sets.
The restaurant is open from 4 PM to 10 PM and closed on Mondays.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I searched on Google Maps for a mid-range restaurant by the river and found this one! I ate several dishes but forgot to take pictures😂
When I went, we were the only table there, so I think the restaurant had just opened. My friends and I ordered about 3-4 dishes; everything was delicious and reasonably priced. There's parking in front of the restaurant. If you don't have a car, it might be a bit of a walk from the main road, or you could just take a Grab. Highly recommend it! 🚗🍽️
sample_reviews_en.author: Sara S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork steak, fish cutlet, spaghetti, and crispy onion rings were all delicious. The meat was tender and the sauce was delicious. The fish was moist and tender, and the outside was crispy and delicious. The crispy onion rings are a must-have. They're the perfect beer snack.
Koreans will love this dish.
The bathrooms were clean, and the puppies were cute.
The family atmosphere seemed nice.
The strong breeze kept us cool even without the air conditioning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rosa Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
An Asian riverside view blocked by wire mesh haha

I went based on the reviews, but hmm... the food wasn't very good!

The beef was too tough, and the pork was just... the chicken was the best. The spaghetti is just cheap.

The prices are affordable!!

My older child said we shouldn't come again, but my younger one said it's okay to come one more time.

If you go into Soi 35, it's located in a dead-end alley. Parking is available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rudi

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this restaurant by chance while searching for steak restaurants on the map. The food was delicious, the portions were generous, and the price was good, in line with Thai pricing trends. The service was also good. It was raining the day I went, so we sat inside, but unfortunately, we couldn't enjoy the riverside view. I've bookmarked this as my go-to restaurant for steak. I'll definitely go again! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutthida Mano

sample_reviews_en.text: First time here. The food was good, the taste suited my palate, and the price was reasonable. The atmosphere would be better if there weren't any metal bars blocking the view, but I understand the reason for them. The nighttime view with the riverside lights was amazing. I loved it and will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisada Ruengkajit

restaurants.name: GUGU Chicken สาขา Imperial World Samrong
restaurants.address:

999 หมู่ที่ 1 Sukhumvit Rd, Samrong Nuea, Mueang Samut Prakan District, Samut Prakan 10270, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dreadful service. Around 10 staff working but I have no clue what on earth they are doing.

We arrived when there was 1 other table at the restaurant. 2 of us ordered 10 wings. After 30 minutes we got some kimchi. After 1 hour we got some fries. After 1 hour 20 minutes we got half of our wings. Then they said 20 more minutes for the other half of our order. The taste was ok but definitely not worth 500+ baht and waiting 1 hour 40 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Declan Joseph

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the 10-for-10 free promotion via LINE at the branch location. The service was fast and convenient because this promotion isn't available for delivery. It's a great option for those who want to eat but don't have time to come to the store. You can order and arrange for a delivery, and the staff even walked me to the delivery rider – amazing! Thank you! The chicken tastes just like the familiar 10/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: ดรีม

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to the restaurant on a day they had a "buy 10 get 10 free" promotion. The food was served very slowly, and they didn't follow up on my order. The service was terrible; the staff were making faces, staying only in the kitchen, and talking loudly enough for the staff to hear. Do they have no customer service or management skills at all? The food wasn't amazing, and the restaurant was cramped.
sample_reviews_en.author: Min Na

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible. Takes so long to prepare the small order when they don’t even have a lot of customers. And the staffs need to know that they have to inform when something in the menu is not available while we are ordering. They only told us after we have waited for so long and asked them about that dish again. The worst restaurant everrr. Worst service
sample_reviews_en.author: Khin Chit Oo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was excellent, the staff were very helpful and gave great menu recommendations. The service was truly impressive, especially the manager who explained everything.
The chicken was delicious, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and the drink included in the set was a perfect match. 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐวัชร เปรมาโนช

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw the staff recommending a new menu item, the spicy squid, and it looked amazing! Delicious!
The staff were all very friendly and the food came out quickly. I'll try eating in the restaurant next time. It's a shame I was in a hurry today and ordered takeout, so I didn't get the side dishes 😢
sample_reviews_en.author: Jim's

sample_reviews_en.text: I went during the buffet period. The restaurant is quite small, and there aren't enough staff to provide adequate service. They didn't explain to customers what to do or where to queue. I was really disappointed after going there specifically to eat. They should have better management.
sample_reviews_en.author: 15 PIMNAPAT

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff are lovely and friendly. The food arrived quickly, the portions were generous, and it was delicious. It wasn't crowded, so if you prefer a more private dining experience, this branch is for you. However, it can get busy in the evenings or on weekends. I loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutisara Rattanawong

restaurants.name: ร้านส้มตำมะหน่อ
restaurants.address:

888 Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
- I've been here many times, but I've never written a review.
I've been here since the market first opened. It's changed a lot, but the som tam shop hasn't changed much. At first, it wasn't as crowded as it used to be... but now it's selling very well because it's truly delicious, I can confirm. Let me commend it first.

- The som tam is delicious. The fish sauce is amazing. It's incredibly spicy.
If you can't handle it spicy enough, don't forget to tell the vendor because it's really spicy. And if you like it spicy, you have to try this! ‼️
There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from. Come and enjoy the deliciousness!

- The atmosphere depends on the season, but right now it's cool, not hot at all. So relaxing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nittha

sample_reviews_en.text: Google Maps said it was open, but when I drove to the restaurant, it wasn't. The opening and closing times change very frequently; it was a wasted trip. The food is undeniably delicious; I've eaten there since they opened at 6:30 PM, and also ordered takeout. Lately, they've been open very late. I wanted to try it again when I had the chance, but it was closed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natkotchanan Duandee

sample_reviews_en.text: At first, I just intended to take the medicine without expecting much, but it turned out to be the perfect medicine for me. The taste is the best I've ever had, and the papaya salad with crab paste, which I usually eat with chili paste, was unexpectedly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pie Yu

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is so delicious!
Crispy pork rinds taste good with any kind of papaya salad.
The papaya salad with crab paste is incredibly good.
The mango salad with grilled fish has an amazing dressing.
Good service.
But there are a lot of people and a long wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: lution chang

sample_reviews_en.text: "I highly recommend the 'Spicy Bamboo Shoot Salad with Fresh Shrimp and Crab Paste'. The flavor is incredibly delicious and well-balanced, a perfect blend of ingredients from different regions. The price is very reasonable, but be prepared …
sample_reviews_en.author: toto toto

sample_reviews_en.text: The vendor was very rude and unwelcoming. We arrived while she was setting up her stall. I understand she was preparing things, but I asked if I could place an order beforehand so she could prepare everything at her leisure, as there were …
sample_reviews_en.author: Napakan Techanan

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time eating there was incredibly delicious! It's the kind of somtum (papaya salad) I've been searching for. The flavors were amazing! I'd never tried the crab paste before, and it was a surprisingly good experience. We waited in …
sample_reviews_en.author: thitiworada prasertsri

sample_reviews_en.text: I went late at night and the service was excellent. The staff asked about my queue number and kept me informed when it was almost my turn. There were a lot of people in line, both online and in-store, but the restaurant managed the queue …
sample_reviews_en.author: pannathorn

restaurants.name: เชฟเสื้อกล้าม ครัวอาหารใต้
restaurants.address:

1856/1 Soi Charoen Krung 70, Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is much more than just a Southern Thai restaurant — it feels like a cozy creative space filled with warmth and care in every detail.

The food was absolutely delicious. Rich Southern flavors, great quality ingredients, and everything tasted thoughtfully made. The atmosphere was beautiful and relaxing, making it easy to spend hours here without realizing it.

What made the experience even more special was the service. Everyone was incredibly welcoming, and the owner was genuinely kind and friendly, which gave the whole place a very personal and heartfelt vibe.

I also loved that the space offers art and coffee workshops, adding another layer of charm beyond the food itself. It feels like a place built with passion and creativity.

And the organic dried bananas are a must-try — naturally sweet, high quality, and surprisingly addictive. The prices are slightly on the higher side, but honestly, the overall experience, quality, and atmosphere make it completely worth it.

Definitely one of those places you leave feeling happy and wanting to come back again 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Pomm Koko

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Southern Thai restaurant in Charoen Krung offers top-quality food. Every dish is delicious, and I was impressed that they offer three sizes: S, M, and L. We chose S, allowing us to try several dishes at once. The owner is a true Southerner and prepares every dish herself, using only the finest ingredients. The service was excellent. For drinks, I recommend the Southern Thai iced tea and the butterfly pea lemonade – refreshing and perfectly complementing the food. Plus, there's a cute little shop selling trinkets nearby for a fun shopping experience before you leave. 🛍️✨

Parking: You can park at the Cove Hill project and walk a short distance – it's very close.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthawan M.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious Thai Southern Food :
