Arrival experience: The staff who greeted us was genuinely nice and kind.
Dining experience: we want to try many dishes and they have different portions size (S, M, L) with different prizes to offer. We opted for small size so we can order 6 dishes for 3 people. All the dishes were yummy and authentic tasty.
Atmosphere: Nicely done on coverting the shophouse to be a restaurant
Others: 2nd and 3rd floor are art galleries and art workshops
Parking : No parking offered by the restaurant, but you can park at nearby community mall; Cove Hill which charges by hour unless you spend in thier mall.
sample_reviews_en.author: pawinee norasetgamol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chef in a Tank Top Restaurant, Charoen Krung Soi 70/1
Authentic Southern Thai curry flavors, not overly spicy.
Perfect for those who love Southern Thai food, Nakhon Si Thammarat style, with rich flavors. Today I ordered four Southern Thai dishes:
Pork Rib Curry & Mixed Vegetable Sour Curry - fragrant curry paste, original flavor, delicious with hot steamed rice.
Stir-fried Gnetum Leaves with Egg & Omelette - perfectly thick and fluffy, not oily. Finished off with taro ice cream with caramel sauce.

In summary: Absolutely delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kantes Teskeo

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai restaurant serves delicious food in a single shophouse unit on Charoen Krung Road, near the Chatrei Hotel. The restaurant is air-conditioned, and dishes are available in S, M, and L sizes to suit your needs. There's a diverse menu. There's no parking available. The prices are reasonable. The upper floor houses an art gallery and art classes.
sample_reviews_en.author: พร้อมพูล ชอบเพื่อน

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, with authentic Southern Thai flavors. There are various sizes to choose from, allowing you to try many dishes at once. The prices are affordable, and the atmosphere is relaxed, like eating at home. 😋

The staff are very friendly and have excellent service minds.

I will definitely come back again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Praesawan Saipia

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem on Charoen Krung 70/1 serves incredibly flavorful Southern Thai fusion cuisine, truly in the style of Nakhon Si Thammarat. They also offer easy-to-eat and delicious Central Thai single-dish meals. There's an art gallery on the second floor as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krittika Huayraerai

sample_reviews_en.text: A really nice place! We originally went only for coffee but ended up having two meals which were really really good! The quality, the price, everything was spot on🤌 highly recommend. Photos only of the empty plates cause we ate everything so quickly 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Gosia

restaurants.name: น้ำปลาร้าซัดดำ By ชัดดำ
restaurants.address:

60/43 Chok Chai 4 Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate here before and it was much better.
This time, almost everything was terrible.

1. I called out to the elderly waiter, and he heard me, but then just walked to the front of the restaurant without anyone coming to help.

2. I ordered 3-4 dishes, but one stood out: the soft bone pork rib soup. It tasted exactly like a spicy soup. The waiter who served it even said it was spicy soup, but I was confused because I ordered soft bone pork rib soup. So I called another waiter over to ask. He also said it was spicy soup and went to the kitchen. When he came back, he also said it was spicy soup. Okay, I didn't make a big deal out of it.

But the worst part was the female cashier. She was awful and spoke very rudely. She said, "This is soft bone pork rib soup. That's how we make it at this restaurant. Do you want us to make it like everyone else? I don't know where you've eaten before, but that's how we make it at home." My boyfriend and I discussed it, but we both insisted it was spicy soup. I was so disappointed. I won't be going back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phornjanta Somtrakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on Chokchai 4 Road, this roadside stall has no roof and about 10 tables. Som Tum (papaya salad) starts at 40 baht. I recommend the grilled pork neck som tum (60 baht), which has a generous portion of grilled pork neck. The som tum here isn't spicy; if you like it spicier, ask for extra spice. The beef waterfall salad (70 baht) is tasty but not as spicy as the som tum. The tripe is large, white, and delicious but not very flavorful. The crying tiger beef (70 baht) comes without any beef, but has a strong beefy aroma; it looks like it might be tough but isn't, and the dipping sauce is perfect. The highlight is the fried chicken tendon and fried chicken thigh; they're freshly fried, crispy, and delicious, at a great price (50, 45 baht). They also sell single-dish meals starting at 50 baht, including salads and typical Northeastern Thai food. Since the shop opens in the evening, there are white and red lines on the roadside, so parking is not available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text:
Once is enough. It was the worst experience I've ever had; I've never reviewed a restaurant before. The food wasn't bad,
but the service was terrible. The food took forever to arrive, over an hour, and only one dish came. Then the staff told me they forgot one of my orders and asked if I still wanted it. It started raining, and there was no tent to cover our table. Instead of covering our table with food, they put umbrellas for tables that came later and hadn't received their food yet. They didn't even ask us to move tables. When it started raining heavily, we finally called a staff member and they said everyone had already moved inside under the umbrellas. The food still hadn't arrived until we waited for the staff to put up the umbrellas, and by then it was already getting wet. No one apologized at all. The staff were rude and spoke very poorly. Even though the food wasn't bad, it wasn't worth the hour-long wait and the terrible service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Snownice

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the first time! The best place to visit in Essen is to visit Langem. There are a lot of things to consider when it comes to food – it's a good idea, it's a good idea. Personal services are your own personal service provider. The Atmosphäre in the restaurant is a restaurant. Jedes Gericht hat is not a begeistert, besonders der scharfe Papayasalat mit der hauseigenenenen Sauce. There are many restaurants in the area where you can eat and drink food. There are many ways to define the world.

Very cool! Best Thai food I've tasted in a long time. The flavors were perfectly balanced, fresh, and delicious. The staff were friendly and the service was quick. The atmosphere in the restaurant was warm and welcoming. Every dish we ordered was delicious, especially the spicy papaya salad with the restaurant's special dressing. I highly recommend this restaurant for anyone who wants to experience authentic Thai food. I will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Oliver Beh

sample_reviews_en.text: We had high expectations for the taste and were really looking forward to eating here because we saw it was crowded. We ordered the pork hot pot set. After the first round, before we'd even finished the pork in the pot, we cracked an egg into it. But the egg we got had a runny white and a hard, black yolk stuck to the shell, and it didn't smell good. We called the staff member over to ask about it. After a while, they came back and said the egg was old and still edible. We lost our appetite completely. We asked for the bill, and this time the same staff member said they buy fresh eggs every day or two. So what about the egg we got? Not even an apology. Is this what you call service? That's it. First and last time. The food taste was mediocre, and the dipping sauce was just sour from tamarind. Only the corn salad with salted egg was edible. Please improve your service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ornicha Ua-ampon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating at this restaurant for a long time, since about 10 years ago. It used to be delicious.

Today, the taste wasn't the same.

The fried chicken wasn't as juicy as before; it was dry, even though it was thigh meat. 2/5

The "Tiger's Cry" (beef salad) – as I understand it, means 70-80% fat, but mine was almost half lean meat. 2/5

The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce didn't have a single crab. The taste was good, but it felt like something was missing. 3/5

The minced pork salad with liver – the liver was soft, and the salad itself was okay. 3/5

Overall, my appetite has decreased after today's visit. Hopefully, the restaurant will improve in the future.

The wait for food was still long, as usual because it's crowded.

I give it a 2/5.
I might try again in the future if I have the chance, but that will probably be a long time from now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kraff UselessZ

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait was incredibly long. I understand they're serving in order, but simple items that could have been served sooner, like grilled pork neck and grilled intestines, weren't brought. The staff were unhelpful and inattentive; we had to get the menu ourselves and deliver it ourselves. The plates were dirty, and the food tasted terrible. We ordered six dishes, and only one was edible. They didn't even give us a bill (they claimed they've been doing this for a long time, but how would they know if something went wrong?). Three of us went, and all three got diarrhea afterward. Overall, it was awful!! Be prepared for a bad experience if you're planning to go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pop Natchakon

sample_reviews_en.text: I waited in line for a very long time, an hour! The food wasn't even that good. I ordered 6 dishes, but could only eat 2. It wasn't worth the long wait. The sweet liver was tough and the pieces were very thick. The "Tiger's Cry" beef was just regular grilled beef, nothing like the picture. The point is, I wanted to try the real "Tiger's Cry" beef, but maybe that's their recipe. And while I was waiting in line, the vendor was handling other customers' food. When I looked, she said, "Don't look, you haven't received your payment yet." I was so confused! I didn't say anything! It was so weird. In short, the wait was long and the food wasn't even tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: sirinapa panman

restaurants.name: ยำเซนต์หลุยส์เจ๊อ้วน By อ้อ
restaurants.address:

258/4 ซอย จันทร์ 18/7 แยก 28 Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Friday evening, let's grab something to eat around St. Louis.
Parking around here is a matter of luck, haha ​​😆

So, let's cut to a salad shop. Ordered 3 dishes.
It took a while today, probably because of the high volume of online orders.

So I had some orange juice first, haha.
My boyfriend laughed; after he finished his orange juice, he went and got a whole bottle! 😆😅🤣😂

You all have to try it, it's delicious and the orange pulp is so juicy! 😄

And then the food arrived. The shrimp were big and bouncy.
All the salads were ordered with less spice, haha.

The grilled pork neck salad was amazing, so good with rice.

The instant noodle salad was also tasty, the squid was a bit chewy, but the shrimp was bouncy and firm.

*I don't know if it's the shop owner's fault, but the tables and chairs are too high.

I'm a 173cm tall guy, so I had to bend down almost 45 degrees to eat, haha.
(Just kidding, sis!) 😆😆😆

If anyone's tired of the food around here... You should try this restaurant! Delicious, amazing shrimp, good price, top-notch quality... I'm going to die from hunger! 🤭🤗
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Chokchai Metapipattanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: I only ate there once, many years ago, just once. I'd been waiting for over half an hour, so I got up to ask how much longer it would be. I was really hungry and wanted to go eat somewhere else. But the tone of voice and the vendor's facial expression... I didn't even need to ask, didn't need to follow up. I remember it vividly and thought I would never, ever eat at that restaurant again. I came to buy, not to beg for free food. There are much better restaurants nearby, next to the 7-Eleven, and another one in an alley next to the Cha Tra Mue tea shop. This is a 100% firsthand experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัชชา ลาดมุณี

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a bit far from BTS. From Saint Louis Exit 2, walk straight to the end and turn right; you'll see a green sign with a beautiful woman's face on it. They have an English menu with pictures, and you can also translate it directly, so you can't go wrong with any of the orders. The sweetness and spiciness are within acceptable limits. The signature squid and shrimp salad is excellent, and the soft pork salad is surprisingly good. I also ordered polemo shrimp and raw shrimp separately; the size was truly impressive, and I really liked them. It's great value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: IronE

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been a loyal customer since the beginning, but these last two times I've felt the quality and taste have declined, making it not worth the price. I hope they maintain the quality. As for the service, it's terrible. The staff completely ignores customers sitting and eating, not even asking what we want to drink. We can wait a long time, but they don't care about the customers waiting. They only care about delivery riders now. I'm rooting for you, Auntie Aoo, to restore quality to the St. Louis area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Apisit Sriwan

sample_reviews_en.text: The space is clean, but... is it really worth visiting all the way here?... It tastes like something you can find anywhere.... The service is friendly,... the orange juice is delicious,... it's just Korean pork ribs,... the rare shrimp salad has a little papaya in it,... and so, two dishes and one drink came out to 207 baht,... and they don't accept cards,... the large fans work well, so it's not too hot,... and there's a big TV, so I watched Thai variety shows.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bom L

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered three dishes:
Three Crispy Salad: The shrimp and pork were perfectly cooked, bouncy and crunchy.
Crispy Fried Fish Maw: Delicious, not fishy, ​​the dressing was sweet, sour and spicy.
Instant Noodle Salad: Okay.
Grilled Pork: Very delicious, the dipping sauce was also tasty, fragrant with roasted rice.
Parking might be difficult at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kinjonboum

sample_reviews_en.text: The spicy salads are delicious, the flavors are great, and the prices are reasonable. I highly recommend them! My regular orders are fish larb, shrimp larb, three-crisp salad, mixed blanched vegetables, and don't forget to order the grilled pork to balance the spiciness – it's delicious even without dipping sauce!
sample_reviews_en.author: W. Anantacha

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves traditional, spicy "three-crisp" salad and instant noodle salad. However, the restaurant itself is not very busy; most customers are delivery riders or order takeout. Parking for cars is difficult, but motorcycles can usually park in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: saravut kitisrivoraphant

restaurants.name: Eat Pot Central Plaza Rama 9
restaurants.address:

9 9 Thanon Rama 9, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The taste is good, but the portion is a bit small. Not filling enough 😅
The price is a bit high. I recommend ordering the hot pot instead.
Noodle soup set with pork, 2 meatballs, 2 pieces of braised pork, pork cracklings, and plain rice. Price 155฿
The staff provided good service. No service charge. There is 7% VAT.
Located in the basement, in front of Tops.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sp inggy

sample_reviews_en.text:
My recent visit to this restaurant was a disaster. I wanted to order Kurobuta pork noodles without the pork skin, but they insisted on serving them together – no exceptions.

When I asked the manager why, she was incredibly rude and said they couldn't change it because the chef had a special recipe, and it came with a high price tag.

Unfortunately, the noodles were terrible – no flavor at all. We also tried their Crispy Pork Kaprao, which was neither crispy nor tasty. To make matters worse, we found a small cockroach in our noodle soup.

This place is hands down the worst noodle shop in Thailand, and it's way too expensive. I strongly recommend avoiding it and trying the nearby restaurants instead. You'll get better food and a better deal elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Owen T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The same place, the same food, the same taste, the same service—it's all perfect.
I've eaten here almost every day, really. The food is delicious, and the staff are very attentive. The restaurant must have trained its staff very well; everyone is dedicated to their work. I've been eating here since I was a young woman, with a boyfriend, and now my child is about to be born, and I'm still eating here. I heard it's closing down, and I'm a little sad. I want my child to be able to experience the food and atmosphere we used to enjoy. Time will inevitably change and improve, but I'll try to come as often as possible before it closes. ♥️👩🏻‍🍳
sample_reviews_en.author: 제인jane

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dry noodles with crispy pork and chili salt stir-fry are delicious, I highly recommend them. They come with a flavorful and tasty soup. The noodles are tasty, and the crispy pork looks like it would be very crispy, but it's surprisingly tender when mixed and eaten – excellent!
The chrysanthemum tea is very fragrant.
The fried pork cracklings with garlic are delicious.
The crispy pork dumplings with minced pork filling are tasty, and the dipping sauce is good, slightly sweet and a nice contrast.
The fried chives are well-fried, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.
There are many other dishes that look very tempting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mag Turbo, Rider Fox Chatchawan T.

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw a name Tom yum and took it immediately, but apparently it’s different than everywhere else. This Tom yum has the wrong name and should be called Pho bo with pork. I expected the seafood and taste of lemongrass with other spices. Also I asked in case a woman about seafood after paying and she confirmed that this soup is with seafood. In fact, she just didn’t want to bother with returning money and cancelling the order. This is really awful especially for me, because I don’t eat pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lina

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't try the noodle. It looks like other expensive wagyu beef noodle shops. My colleagues would like to come here (her 2nd time) so I follow. I order ox tounge rice and it's surprisingly good. The tounge is soft and the taste is nice, no need to add chilli fish sauce. Crispy Kui Chai (deep fried veggie rice cake) is also nice. I don't like  grilled pork ball, no taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Little Bunny

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered spicy pork rib soup with fresh lime, but the dish that arrived used bottled lime juice. The taste just wasn't right; it was very strange. The portion size was appropriate, but the taste was unacceptable. If you say "fresh lime," you should use that. When you use bottled lime juice, you have to taste it first, and the flavor just doesn't work.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kampon Itngarm

sample_reviews_en.text: Quite expensive; one beef set cost THB447 with very little meat and vegetables, and the service wasn't very good either. The pot contained only a few slices of meat and vegetables, and the waiter even opened a bottle of water and poured it for you; only after you said you hadn't ordered it did he take it away, apologizing for misreading the contents!
sample_reviews_en.author: YUJU PREBBLE HUANG

restaurants.name: Taco Bell
restaurants.address:

189/1 Room B1, MidTown Asoke, 73 Sukhumvit 21 Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually order delivery from this one as it's the closest one to home but sometimes we go to the market next door and drop in for a quick snack. Four stars because the staff is not paying attention to the order. Multiple times the order was not correct after delivery and even one time when we did not check the order and did takeaway it turned out the order was not correct again. There's very little atmosphere but it's in a convenient and quiet location. There's no parking available. As far as I know, there is only shared toilets in the shopping mall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Latte

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taco Bell feels more like an American fast food restaurant than a Mexican restaurant. It's a casual place to stop by.
The Asoke branch is located in an office district, so it gets crowded on weekdays, but is quiet on weekends.
The key to ordering is to change the chips in the set to fries for an additional 10 baht. The fries are sprinkled with Mexican-style chili powder and are delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text: the place is right behind the bus stop so i usually eat here waiting. i once lost a charging cable in there, called in another day and one employee helped me find it. sometimes the staff is unfriendly though, kind of random. the food is average.
sample_reviews_en.author: d4

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the California Bowl from Grab, but I was disappointed that it didn’t come with any tomato salsa. I’ve submitted a complaint but haven’t received any response, and there’s no phone number for the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manao

sample_reviews_en.text: They delivered my tacos with only vegetables and out the taco packing it says "meat packed separately to keep freshness" but there was not ground chicken meat accompanying the tacos in the bag..... cheating me !!!
sample_reviews_en.author: CK Ho

sample_reviews_en.text: Large restaurant, also offering vegetarian tacos and burritos. Unlimited refills on drinks. Visa card payments accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Saywer

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent; they were attentive and quick. The prices are the usual international prices (expensive).
sample_reviews_en.author: Tim Biechele

sample_reviews_en.text: Not convenient to order on Grab food app. Taco bell is supposed to be fast food, but their timing says otherwise.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pearl

restaurants.name: Steak Diamond ตลาดพระประแดง
restaurants.address:

MG5M+VV9, 36 Phetchahung Rd, Talat, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I've passed by this restaurant many times, and today I finally had the chance to stop by and eat.
Pork/Chicken Steak 129฿ - Delicious.
Shrimp Macaroni (3 medium-large shrimp) 99฿ - Delicious.
Shrimp Salad 129฿ - Delicious.
Strawberry Yogurt Smoothie 70฿ (Large glass) - Good flavor.
American Fried Rice 99฿ (I only tasted a little of my boyfriend's😅) - No comment 😂
Bottled Water 2.24฿, Ice 2.6฿
👉 Total 556฿. Delicious, I'll definitely come back.
The atmosphere in the restaurant is okay. You can chill out or have a proper meal. Unfortunately, I didn't take any pictures because I was too hungry 😅
sample_reviews_th.author: Amonrat KP

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a great atmosphere with a slightly foreign feel. The food is delicious; everything is great. There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, ranging from steaks and spaghetti to appetizers and spicy salads that are very tasty. Finish off with a sweet and refreshing bingsu. I've eaten here many times and have never been disappointed. The restaurant has been open for a very long time. A true Prapradaeng resident here!
sample_reviews_en.author: kulnatcha Damrong

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, we thought it was bad, even awful. The food tasted mediocre, the steak was average, but considering the taste and price, it was extremely disappointing. I wouldn't recommend going with family. What displeased us the most was the staff; they had no service mindset, were terrible, and awful. We will never go there again. It was a waste of money. Eating at a BBQ place would have been much better.
sample_reviews_en.author: RainNa N.Angelo

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small restaurant on a side street near the market. Two of us ate there for lunch. Rice, pasta, chicken, and some appetizers, water, and Coke cost us 470 baht. The food was really good, the place isn't very big, plus it has a bathroom, and it's perfect for groups of up to four people. The service was quick and friendly, and the food was really good, so I recommend it to everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrea “Viaggiando a Bangkok”

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was mediocre and didn't feel worth the 540 baht I paid. Furthermore, the staff didn't inform me that changing from black pepper chicken to spicy chicken would cost an extra 15 baht. I felt that the amount of chicken and the simple change in sauce meant an extra 15 baht wasn't worth it. If I had known about the extra charge, I wouldn't have made the change.
sample_reviews_en.author: XezaniaX

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was nice. The steak tasted delicious; it wasn't tough, very tender and flavorful, well-marinated. The black spaghetti with basil had delicious, perfectly cooked noodles that weren't mushy. The baked vegetables with cheese were amazing, very cheesy and fragrant. The salad was tasty, and the dressing was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thongchai poonyaarpa

sample_reviews_en.text:
A casual cafe serving steaks, rice dishes, snacks, and bingsu.
The atmosphere inside the cafe is inviting and the decor is beautiful.
I like that they have an air purifier with aromatherapy, making the shop smell clean, fresh, and refreshing.
The food is affordably priced, perfect for teenagers, children, and students 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuwadee Kobsakul

sample_reviews_en.text: This steak restaurant is near Phra Pradaeng market. Personally, I think the taste is good. The morning glory salad wasn't sweet at all (I really liked that 👍👍). The steak was tender and juicy. Overall, it was delicious. The service was good. The restaurant is air-conditioned, clean, and you can park on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

restaurants.name: ร้านเย็นตาโฟเจ้าเก่าสะพาน3
restaurants.address:

85 Chan Rd, Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
If you're in the Chan Soi 27 area and want to eat noodles, this shop is a good option. The meatballs are decent, although the shrimp meatballs weren't quite to my liking. Overall, they give generous portions of toppings.
The Yen Ta Fo soup wasn't too sweet, although it was a little less hot than I expected that day. The price is inexpensive; a bowl of boiled meatballs is only 40฿. The owner is friendly and has a nice smile.
sample_reviews_th.author: Narumon Intaraprom

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd give it a 0 if I could. I ordered two bags of Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) and asked for the broth to be served separately. The person making it spoke to me in a very rude manner, saying, "Why didn't you wait for me to finish scooping it first?" The taste is inconsistent every day, the service is terrible, and favoritism always gets you served first. I'm done with this place. I'd rather go to a restaurant with delicious food, good service, and a pleasant dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: PIMCHANOK PECTSONG

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm exploring street food around Saphan Sam (Bridge 3) and gathering information along the way. #FishballNoodleSoup This stall is at the entrance of Soi Chan 27 (a row of shophouses at the intersection, opposite Soi Saint Louis). It's been open for a very long time. I've eaten here twice. The fishballs are okay, but nothing else is particularly special. This time, the Yen Ta Fo soup was alright but not very fragrant. 😋😋😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree T.

sample_reviews_en.text: This old, established restaurant's recommended dishes are Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup), Tom Yum noodle soup with fish balls, and crispy fish skin (fried in-house). The clear broth is delicious, and each bowl costs 40 baht. The ingredients are fresh, and the place gets busier as it gets later, especially after a night out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khanit Jetaphunya

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) shop provides chili paste to add.
The Yen Ta Fo tastes good, and the ingredients are of good quality.
The meatballs are good, the noodles are good, and it's delicious. The shop is clean.
There is no parking. Tissues have to be purchased.
Overall, it's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: gummo s.

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup is delicious; if you don't like strong flavors, you barely need to add any seasoning. But if you like spicy food, try the spicy noodle salad (Yum Noodles), which comes with all the necessary condiments: chili paste, ground peanuts, pepper, and tasty fish balls. The price is affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: นพพร ณพัทธ

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw a lot of people there in the evening, so I decided to try it. I didn't take any pictures because I didn't think it would be on Google Maps. The taste was average, acceptable. The noodles cost 45 baht and contained about 5 pieces in total: fish balls, shrimp balls, and fish cakes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree Srithawatch

sample_reviews_en.text: There’s this noodle place around here, but the taste’s kinda hit or miss. Honestly, the guy who makes it is way better than the lady. Also, no tissues—just a heads up. If you’re into Yen Ta Fo and Tum Yum, I’d say give this place a shot and see for yourself if it’s worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawat .P

restaurants.name: จื้อ เนื้อตุ๋น หมูตุ๋น Zhao, braised beef, braised pork
restaurants.address:

32 ถ. ประชาราษฎร์สาย1 Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a long-established noodle shop serving beef and pork noodles. I recently had the chance to visit again, and the taste is still the same. When I arrived at 3:30 PM, they were out of beef, so I opted for the fresh pork and braised pork. The fresh pork was marinated, flavorful, and in large, tender pieces. The braised pork was slow-cooked until very soft and tender. At 50 baht per bowl, the portion size is very generous. The shop closes at 4 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nui Su

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, fragrant, and the broth is just right. Adding chili vinegar makes it even better. The braised pork is excellent. There's a queue, but they give you a numbered queue ticket. The wait wasn't too long.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิจิตรา ปฏิมากร

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is average, but the price is good value. The rice is fluffy and not hard or dry.
Many price tags are old and haven't been updated.
If you go after noon, you'll have to wait in line for a seat.
sample_reviews_en.author: merced merced

sample_reviews_en.text:
Braised Beef Noodle Soup
I think this is the best in the area.
The portion size for the price is excellent value.
The taste is great and all the ingredients are included.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patchalit Sangaime

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best in town…
Definitely worth a try!

Parking is a bit difficult. I recommend parking across from the pedestrian overpass and crossing over to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moo Por

sample_reviews_en.text:
The broth is piping hot and flavorful.
The offal is clean and the meat is tender.

It's busy at lunchtime, but the restaurant manages the queue very well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerapat Ungsriwong

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised beef noodle soup is delicious. The beef meatballs are incredibly tasty, and the broth is flavorful without needing any extra seasoning.
sample_reviews_en.author: พลินพัชญ์ เล็กดํารงค์ศักดิ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's not just beef noodles; they also have various stir-fried noodle dishes.
The stir-fried vermicelli was dry, fragrant, and tasted good.
sample_reviews_en.author: WingZero 00W0

restaurants.name: MHAN
restaurants.address:

479 40 หมู่10 S Pattaya Rd, ต.หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Thai food. This restaurant offers classic of Thai fast food with good taste and nice jasmine rice. It has both air-conditioned area and outdoor area.

Pad Kaphrao, stir-fried holy basil, chili, and garlic, has a nice and strong flavour using dry chili to give spicy taste. You can pick different meat to go with your Pad Kaphrao from chicken to beef to seafood like squid, shrimp, crab meat, or scallop. We have scallop which the size is small but they give planty of them.

Mama, instant noodle, Kaphrao is nicely cooked and come with additional cripsy holy basil.

Stir-friend chicken with black pepper has a nice aroma. Not spicy but has the heat of pepper. Instead of normal size, we try their XL size that come with 2 fried eggs and twice the size of rice and meat for just 130 baht.

Price is so affordable! Chicken meal over the rice is just 50 baht. If seafood like scallop or squid then just 70 baht. Egg on top which you can choose as fried egg or Thai omelette, costs another 10 baht.

100% Thai food, Thai taste, Thai price. Try it yourself especially if you are looking for quick and easy meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Apichart Dausiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those who love Thai food, especially Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry), I highly recommend this restaurant. It's located in South Pattaya on the main road, very easy to find. Today, I ordered Pad Krapow with scallops and instant noodle hot pot, both incredibly delicious. One plate wasn't enough! Importantly, the restaurant uses jasmine rice (which tastes good with everything). They also sell desserts.
As for seating, there's both outdoor and air-conditioned seating. The air conditioning is very cool, and they have JBL speakers, so you can enjoy music while you eat. You can sit wherever you like. One of the two female staff members who greeted us was beautiful, cute, and very friendly. If you come to Pattaya and don't visit this restaurant, you're missing out! For me, it was my first time eating here, and I loved it. It's now one of my favorite restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Γαλνανατ Πυχομχιτ

sample_reviews_en.text:
🏡 The restaurant is located on Pattaya South Road, Bang Lamung District, Chonburi Province. It's open from 11:00 AM to 8:30 PM. Parking is available under the roadside and behind the restaurant (approximately 3-4 cars).

🪑 The restaurant has outdoor seating and an air-conditioned indoor area with about 5-6 tables.

💸 The main dishes are single-serving meals, including stir-fried basil, cumin, garlic, curry paste, bird's eye chili, mild chili, and black pepper. Prices start at 55 baht for pork and chicken, and 70 baht for seafood. They also have various soups.

🍚 The stir-fried beef with basil was dry-style and ordered extra spicy, which was delicious and satisfyingly spicy. The seafood basil stir-fry was ordered less spicy, and the ingredients were decent and the taste was okay. The food is good, but the staff didn't seem very cheerful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited this restaurant because a Japanese YouTuber highly recommended it in a video. I walked for 40-50 minutes from the intersection on 2nd Road, passing through the Cyber ​​Building Tutcom and the world's largest 7-Eleven, but I wouldn't recommend it. Using the ride-hailing app Bolt would have made it much easier. Wiping away the sweat, I ordered the crab meat omelet rice that was recommended in the video...or so I thought, but it seems I made a mistake with my order and ended up with a simple omelet rice without any fillings. However, I was happy to have eaten such delicious omelet rice. It's not a romantic restaurant, but I liked it. Next time, I'll definitely order the omelet rice with crab meat!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yazan Gable

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good and the prices were normal, but the service from the staff—their facial expressions and words—was unwilling to serve. They didn't even tell us that some ingredients were missing (we ordered minced pork basil stir-fry with mixed seafood: squid, shrimp, crab, and scallops. There was only a little minced pork, two small shrimp, and about three scallops). After checking out, they didn't even say thank you. However, they provided excellent service to a male foreign customer, smiling and speaking very politely.
***I specifically wanted to eat basil stir-fry and drove all the way to this restaurant, but after such terrible service, I won't be going back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: รวิสรา ยาวิชัย

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small shop in Pattaya Tai specializes in overpriced Krapao. If you can't handle too much spice, I suggest specifically asking for less spicy. I've passed by here countless times, but today was my first time trying it. I tried two Krapao flavors: squid ink rice and beef rice.

Overall, the Krapao here has a fairly traditional flavor and is extremely spicy, not the more unique flavor I was looking for.

Parking is limited; you'll likely need to park on the main road and walk most of the time. The staff are friendly, and the shop has both indoor and outdoor air conditioning.

The prices are higher than typical Krapao restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: YansenPattaya555

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited around 1:30 PM on a Friday.

There were 6 indoor and 4 outdoor tables.

All 4 indoor tables were occupied.

You order by writing. 💦
Choose your cooking method → ​​choose your ingredients → choose your portion.

The menu is also written in English, so even if you don't speak Thai, you'll be fine.

I ordered the seafood gapow (70B).

I also ordered a fried egg and water (10B each).

I thought the portions were a little small.

If you're looking for a hearty meal, it might not be enough.

I didn't try the Thai omelette, but it looked delicious, so I'd like to try it next time with a group of people.
sample_reviews_en.author: RYU THAI

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant's basil stir-fry is the best! I love it so much. I've been a customer since they opened in Bang Saen, and I'm still a loyal customer now that they've opened in Pattaya. The flavor is great, spicy, and fragrant with dried chilies. The price is reasonable. Other dishes are good too, but I highly recommend the basil stir-fry. It's delicious and you won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapapan L.

restaurants.name: GOOD DAY SHABU SHABU
restaurants.address:

MFH8+358 ถ. พระราม ๒ Bang Mot, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥢 Good Day Shabu – Rama 2
A cozy shabu-shabu experience with delicious food at an affordable price ❤️

This is an à la carte shabu-shabu restaurant; no need to serve yourself!
Choose your own ingredients, including sliced ​​beef, pork belly, shrimp, squid, and various meatballs.
Everything is fresh, clean, and of excellent quality for the price!

🍲 The broth is delicious and rich.
Fragrant and well-balanced, not too salty or oily.
Even the plain broth is delightfully smooth.
Both the clear broth and the mala broth are fantastic.

🌶️ The dipping sauces are the highlight!
A unique recipe with a perfect balance of sour, salty, sweet, and spicy.
They go well with everything!

Affordable prices and friendly service.
Ideal for a meal with friends, family, or a warm after-work meal.

Truly lives up to its name, Good Day Shabu! 😄

#EatAnywhere #GoodDayShabu #Rama2 #ÀLaCarteShabu #GoodValue #DeliciousAndWorthIt
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachit Chairat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in a gas station. It's not very big and serves a la carte shabu-shabu with individual pots for each person. There are sets with beef, pork, and seafood, each including a vegetable platter. You can also order individual dishes.
There are two types of dipping sauces: a typical sukiyaki sauce and another that seems like soybean paste or chili paste, I'm not sure. You can customize your sauces with soy sauce and vinegar. If you like ponzu sauce, you can ask for more.
There are three soup options: clear broth, black broth, and tonkatsu broth. Overall, the taste is good. After the meal, each person gets a slice of watermelon, with or without condensed milk.
If you're coming in a large group and want a big table for four people with two pots, it's recommended to call and reserve in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben Ben

sample_reviews_en.text: Shabu Good Day is located in a Susco gas station on Rama II Road, just before Bangmod Hospital. Don't worry about parking. It's a small restaurant with about 25 seats, each with its own private sukiyaki pot. However, if you want to share, there are two tables available. I visited around 3 p.m. on a weekday. The restaurant was open and comfortable, with a short wait. The food was delicious, with fresh ingredients and a good price. However, I asked the staff about the weekend, and they recommend making a reservation because it's busy. Oh, and this restaurant is also cute. After checking your bill, they serve you free fresh watermelon with condensed milk.
sample_reviews_en.author: HIA CHIM - TASTE MASTER

sample_reviews_en.text: This shabu-shabu restaurant is located in the Susco gas station, right in front of the building. You can park right in front of the restaurant. It's a single-pot shabu-shabu style, with individual pots for each person. You can order sets at reasonable prices. They have pork, Australian beef, Thai beef, and seafood sets. If you're still hungry, you can order extra plates with many options to choose from. The restaurant also has promotions; checking in on Facebook gets you free minced pork. They also offer chilled watermelon with condensed milk for dessert to cleanse your palate. Give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitibordee Yindeear-rom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Homemade Shabu Shabu (A la carte)
Location: Inside the Susco gas station at the entrance of Wat Yai Rom alley.
Although it's a small shop, it's packed with quality ingredients and fresh vegetables.

There are 3 soup bases to choose from: Clear / Dark / Rich
Service: The staff are very friendly 😻
There is parking available in front of the shop and in the Susco gas station area.
>>> 19 stoves are available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pixel Diary

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! Each person gets their own pot. I personally loved the tender pork. The squid meatballs were also tasty, and the dragon dumplings were good too. Overall, it was good. It was crowded and the restaurant is a bit small. You can park in the gas station nearby. I'll come again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The shabu-shabu restaurant located in the Susco gas station offers individual hot pots for each person. The ingredients are fresh and good. They offer sets or à la carte options. The staff provides good service, and they offer sweet, chilled watermelon to enjoy after your shabu-shabu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narumon Intaraprom

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of my favorite affordable shabu-shabu restaurants. The food is easy to eat, the broth and dipping sauces are all delicious. The food selection is good, and everything is tasty at a reasonable price. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Orapim C.

restaurants.name: Hon Aji Ramen
restaurants.address:

104/1 Lat Phrao Rd, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Food prices don't include VAT, yet some menu items already include VAT. This seems intentionally misleading to customers from the start.
- Lack of attentiveness; tables weren't cleared or dishes taken away before new customers were seated, as if there was no one supervising the staff.
- The food is delicious and uses good ingredients, but the pork slices are slightly smaller than at other restaurants. The food presentation is beautiful.

I entered the restaurant because the price was 189 baht, but I actually paid 203 baht. This has a significant psychological impact, making me feel cheated, even if it's only a little over ten baht. The restaurant should have stated the full price from the beginning. Once customers feel cheated, trust is lost. The restaurant should be straightforward with customers from the start. I don't think I'll be going back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pratya P

sample_reviews_en.text:
This ramen shop is located in the MRT Lat Phrao station. There are bar-style seats around the kitchen, approximately 11-12 seats in total. Seating is quite limited, and almost all seats were occupied. Before sitting down, you have to order and pay at the cashier. They offer both rice and ramen dishes.
- Tonkotsu Ramen is the shop's basic menu item.
- Tonkotsu Kakuni Ramen: Ramen with large pieces of pork and a rich broth. Delicious! If you don't like spicy food, I recommend this one.
- Spicy Tonkotsu Kakuni Ramen: This ramen has added spiciness, along with large pieces of pork and a very rich broth. I liked this one.

The shop is located at the entrance to the Gourmet Food Court; it's very easy to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pupae Zuza

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those observing a vegetarian/vegan diet during this period,
HonAji restaurant offers vegetarian options.
They have pork katsudon (rice bowl with pork cutlet), mixed hot pot, and vegetarian gyoza and spring rolls, all made from plant-based ingredients, suitable for vegetarians/vegans.

I ordered the pork katsudon, but they were out of dipping sauce, so the staff asked if I wanted the sauce for the pork instead. I personally thought it was delicious, but the vegetarian "pork" was a little too salty, so I'm deducting one star for that. The set comes with seaweed soup and seaweed salad, making it a filling meal. If you're looking for vegetarian/vegan food, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tak Tan Sriphatchayakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ramen is delicious, the noodles are chewy and soft, the price is moderate, not too expensive. The food doesn't take long to arrive. I stop by to eat every time I'm in the area.
The female staff member, who is probably the manager or supervisor, provides good service and even recommends promotions.
sample_reviews_en.author: hot chocolate

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like their tonkotsu ramen, my sister had shoyu ramen, and my dad had Zaru ramen with pork topping.
We ordered food at the counter before going to our seats.
I had tonkotsu ramen, my sister had shoyu ramen, and my dad had Zaru ramen with extra pork.
We ordered food at the counter before eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: vipawee lsk

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying this restaurant, and the Tom Yum Pork Chashu was incredibly delicious! I wonder how they manage to cook it so perfectly – the sour, salty, and spicy flavors were just right. It's my absolute favorite dish. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Moom Mimm

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spicy ramen with a broth you can keep sipping, soft noodles, and tender pork.
Located in the Gourme area of ​​MRT Lat Phrao, you have to walk downstairs.
Refillable green tea. Limited seating.
Few service staff, seemed incomplete, only 3 people.
sample_reviews_en.author: NongKoi-P’Ou

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I visited HonAji at MRT Lat Phrao branch. It was delicious as always! They have a new menu item, Katsu Mala Miso Ramen, which is incredibly delicious – spicy and numbs your tongue… You have to try it! A quality product from Betagro Group.
sample_reviews_en.author: chisanupol khaosa-ad

restaurants.name: เจ้ยี้ ก๋วยเตี๋ยวลูกชิ้นหมู-เนื้อ บางขุนนนท์
restaurants.address:

1, 5 Bang Khun Non Rd, Bang Khun Non, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Clear broth beef noodles
Contains tender and stewed beef.
The beef is delicious and the soup is fragrant.
Personally, I just added a little vinegar and it was perfect.
As pictured: White noodles with mixed beef (special) 70 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: PO

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! Both the beef and pork are great. I eat here regularly, I can confirm. It's open late, so if you can't find anything to eat, come here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Veravut Pipatworakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup is delicious! It's located at the entrance of Bang Khun Non Soi. They accept the government's co-payment scheme. Stop by and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpichai Ratchadanuwat

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious, the broth is excellent, and the price is reasonable. They're open late. I always order the extra-large portion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wattikorn Rukkijkul

sample_reviews_en.text: We've been eating here regularly for many years, the whole family loves it because it's delicious and the price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyapath Karnjanasiripon

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! The beef meatballs are superb. They're open from evening until late. They have both pork and beef meatballs.
sample_reviews_en.author: w K

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles at this shop are delicious! The Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup) is amazing, and the braised pork is superb.
sample_reviews_en.author: IAM ARISARA

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is definitely delicious. Once you try it, you'll be hooked and will definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ticha Hirunyamanee

restaurants.name: McDonald's Palladium
restaurants.address:

096 room 1, st floor, palladium shopping mall, Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thanks to three staffs, two "Tong" and another personnel which I believe she is the manager during that shift of my visits, short hair with eyeglasses.

My husband and I had cup of coffees and breakfast here every morning during our visit. I got porridge breakfast meal which can't be found in US. It is delicious.

I had Mc Fried Chicken meal twice and one meal from KFC next door during this trip. I am not a fan of fried chicken but I have to say Mc Fried Chicken tastes better than KFC.

Those three staff above provided great service. They are friendly, polite and courteous. They accommodated us per our request.  We have a wonderful experience here.
Excellent work🙂
sample_reviews_en.author: suntaree wainwright

sample_reviews_en.text:
This McDonald's in the Palladium Mall was very convenient and just a short walk from my hotel. I stopped by for a snack and found the experience very smooth.

I used the kiosk to order, which was very user-friendly. I requested table service through the machine, and the food was brought directly to me. The staff provided great customer service and the food was quickly delivered with fresh.

The shop is spacious with a perfect atmosphere for dining in.
Pro-tip: Try to grab a seat by the window—it offers a really nice view of the busy street while you eat! It wasn't too crowded during my visit, making it a very relaxing stop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ravindra Indrajith

sample_reviews_en.text:
I know i'm foreigner.
I order some food and should be change money.
Then they give me minus 100baht without saying sorry.
Fortunately i' ask and want that 100baht change.
They give me back the change without sayingg sorryyyy?????
The photos is one of the employee
And the one who gave me the change minus 100baht is the manager. When i done. He/she (not sure) is gone
This place in the platinum. Besides olino
You should be good please. Since we are (foreigner) is not stupid
sample_reviews_en.author: inneke AK

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's understandable why it's more crowded than the KFC next door.

The staff here greet customers proactively as they enter. Ordering is done at self-service kiosks, with card payment or cash at the counter.

The staff calls out numbers in Thai and English, or you can take a number and have them served at your table.

There are plenty of charging stations in the seating area. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Kelly

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stopped by McDonald’s for a quick meal. Nothing fancy, just your usual go-to comfort food, and everything tasted pretty much as expected. Service was okay and the place was decent overall.

The only downside was that it felt a bit hot inside, which made the experience a little uncomfortable. Still fine for a quick stop if you’re hungry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taco & Nacho’s Möm

sample_reviews_en.text: Another McDonald's. We ordered two McChicken meals, one medium and one small, with McBites and Cheese Fingers, and it cost 407 baht (about €11). It doesn't have a restroom, but you can use the ones in the shopping center, a 1-minute walk away. It also has power outlets for charging your phone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jose

sample_reviews_en.text: We have been there the twice during our holiday at Bangkok. The place is clean, staffs are friendly and service are good. I left my phone at the store luckily the staff Hom, held on to it until I came to claim for it. Thank you very much Hom - you are such an amazing person.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Koo

sample_reviews_en.text: You have to place your order at a kiosk, but don't worry, there are staff members available to help you navigate the process. The kiosks conveniently support both Visa and Mastercard, so payment is hassle-free. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ushan Withanage

restaurants.name: Kwanchai Yum Mamuang Pou Maa
restaurants.address:

ตลาดโต้รุ่งทวีผล ศูนย์การค้าวรรัตน์ Chan 16 Alley, Lane 1, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant never improves its service. They have walkie-talkies outside for delivery riders, but the riders are sometimes heard and sometimes not, and they don't repeat the order. When we approached to ask, they were unwilling to answer and just grumpy. If you wait inside, they won't give you another table for other customers. It's truly terrible. If you don't want to interact with delivery riders, you should put the ready-to-eat food out in front of the shop so they can see and pick it up. You're busy, and we're in a hurry too! Improve your service! It's a business job!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaising Kaewsai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes great!
The grilled fish is fresh and reasonably priced. Delicious, highly recommended!
The seafood papaya salad and other spicy salads are a must-try!!
While waiting for your food, you have to help yourself to drinking water and serving yourself. Please help the restaurant as there are limited staff. Order all your food at once so it arrives together.
The restaurant also offers Lineman delivery service.
While you're eating, you'll see staff lining up to order food all over the restaurant. Hurry and grab a table!
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Praeploy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible. They spoke rudely and abruptly. From the moment I entered the restaurant, they didn't even say "kha" to me. I was so disappointed. The food wasn't bad, but I was very disappointed. If you ask me if I would eat there again, I'd say no. They didn't make the right food.
They said I didn't understand what I was writing, even though I had written it clearly. So I stopped eating there because the service was really bad. I was completely consumed by the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Earth Nathanan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spicy Pork Sausage Salad with Salted Egg Yolk and Fresh Shrimp, 160 THB.
We used Line Man delivery service and made a special request for no MSG and less spicy. The flavor was quite strong, even though we ordered less spicy. The amount of fresh shrimp was so generous that we couldn't finish it all, especially the salted egg yolk. We would definitely order again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wrwln B.

sample_reviews_en.text: I read the reviews here before coming to eat. Many reviews said it was good and delicious, so I decided to try it. But I was very disappointed. Every single dish was cold, like it had just been taken out of the refrigerator. I emphasize, every single dish. Even the dipping sauce was cold. Extremely disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: นราธิป เนื่องไชยยศ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, I'll admit, but the restaurant was incredibly dirty. They were changing a baby's diaper in the middle of the restaurant while we were eating. That's it. I will never eat there again and will never order online. Stop patronizing them!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tidarat Khuenok

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located near the market. There's motorcycle parking in front. The price is reasonable. I've been here many times and love the papaya salad and grilled shrimp. They're delicious. There are a lot of Grab and Line Man users, and they keep coming.
sample_reviews_en.author: BeRRy Bee

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and very flavorful. There's a bit of a wait, but it's worth it. If you want to eat here, order everything at once because there are few people working, sometimes only two, sometimes just one, but the restaurant is always full.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชมพูนุช ปัญญะธารา

restaurants.name: On the table - Esplanade
restaurants.address:

99 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khwaeng Din Daeng, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

restaurants.name: VietCuisine
restaurants.address:

Silom Edge, 1/ Floor, No. 2, Si Lom Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500

sample_reviews_th.text:
The dry pho salad was delicious, the grilled pork was good and well-seasoned.
The price was 169฿, and the portion was generous, more than enough to fill you up.
There are many other dishes on the menu that I'd like to try.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sudarat Burana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best Vietnamese restaurant I've ever been to.

Taste 10/10
Atmosphere 10/10
Service 10/10
Quality matches the price.

Dishes ordered:
1. Pho with Vietnamese Pork Sausage: The broth is mildly sweet and flavorful with a hint of basil. The noodles are soft and delicious, and the Vietnamese pork sausage is excellent.
2. Vietnamese Crepes with Pork: Simply delicious, a little oily but acceptable.
3. Baguette with Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork): The bread is excellent, and the sauce is delicious.

Overall, it suits Thai tastes.

I wish they would take better promotional photos of the food to make it look more appetizing.
sample_reviews_en.author: TC Review

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted okay, but the service was terrible. I took my family to eat there, and before we'd even finished eating (it was lunchtime, so it was quite busy), the staff slid the bill down on the table instead of properly, as if trying to rush us to leave. They even asked to clear some of the plates before we'd finished eating. At first, it wasn't a big deal, but then they slid the bill down like that while we still had food on the table, and we hadn't even finished eating yet. The food was delicious, but I'll probably only go once. I'm done with this branch. I was very disappointed. The staff really needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quite disappointing.
I ordered pho with tenderloin and braised beef. The broth was strangely spicy. The tenderloin was very tender and tasted like pork. The braised beef pieces were tiny and tough.
The spring rolls had soggy wrappers and a strange filling.
I ordered a blended star fruit juice, but they didn't have any.
My wife ordered Saigon-style noodle salad with Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork skewers) and said it tasted good and finished it all.
The service was decent, polite and fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prasas Prasasvinitchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went here a few months ago, I was craving a heartwarming pho soup and I should of checked the review before walking in.

The pho soup tastes so bad it was a huge disappointment. Tasted nothing like pho and I’ve had pho’s around the uk and they tasted better and consistent, whereas this it was just a sweet soup with no dimensions in it at all.

The lemongrass lime drink was really good though. And the prawn spring roll was decent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthawut Intharason

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm satisfied with my meal here in VietCuisine which is located in Silom Edge mall. It is a Vietnamese food restaurant with some adaptation of Thai taste from my perspective. My favourite dish is the dried noodles with grilled chicken, crispy shallot, and sweet & sour peanut sauce that come with assorted of fresh vegetables serving along with fried crab roll. Their fresh spring roll with prawn tastes decent. Try it yourself!
sample_reviews_en.author: Apichart Dausiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have visited Viet Cuisine several times. {1st floor in the Edge}
This small eatery with only 7-8 tables serves authentic Vietnamese food.
The beef PHO has a flavorful soup. 😋
I won't add any extra snag enhancers - which only speaks for the quality of the food.
The staff is service-minded and attentive.
A good Vietnamese food  place

5 ⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Hans Vagtborg

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is cramped with limited seating, but manageable because I came when it wasn't crowded.
The lanterns outside are stylish, I like them.
The staff didn't smile much, they were indifferent.
The food came quickly, but the spring rolls were a bit overcooked.
Personally, the dishes I ordered tasted okay, nothing special.
sample_reviews_en.author: Than Pad

restaurants.name: Baegathin 2
restaurants.address:

WV9R+MHX, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was there three times. First two times my bill was higher than I expected. So third time I was there for check this matter and I order three beer and some food and when the bill arrived happened same thing as previous times. So I went to the cashier and cross check my bill with him and they put bill for 6 beer instead of I bought 3 beer. I assume that previous times also happened same thing and this is not a mistake. So I advice you to not go there and  if you go there please check your bill twice before you pay it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asela Thennakoon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was terrible. Everything was not fresh. I ate only a little bit and the pork was not fresh, including the seafood. I don't know what kind of pork they used. It was not cooked no matter how you grill it. Overall, the quality was very bad. I told the staff but they didn't care. They just came to refill drinks and only sold ice and drinks. It's better to go somewhere else with similar or lower prices. I recommend going to eat somewhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anita Anita

sample_reviews_en.text: It's located along Pattaya Thai (South Pattaya Road). It has a nice atmosphere and the Moo Gat is delicious and reasonably priced. The first store is diagonally across the street. The khao (rice) is quite large, so one portion is enough for two people. For two people, we ate our fill and had some beers, and it came to 450 baht (about 1,450 yen). It's a good idea to casually lend the ladies some insect repellent. They were very happy.
sample_reviews_en.author: タカダース軍曹

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a gem!
Started off on the wrong foot when a pineapple smoothie turns out to be alcoholic (riding motorcycle) and after I refused it learnt the waitress was going to be charged 🤬🤬🤬
I took I back to save her embarrassment.
Definitely going back and not having that smoothie.
This is a Thai place, they don't speak English.
Watch out for the Larb Gai.....it will burn twice 🚽🧻
sample_reviews_en.author: sean mccarthy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Instead of BBQ, just order pork neck or pork belly a la carte.
There are a lot of items in the assortment that I don't eat. Also, the meat is about 2/3 fatty. The a la carte is the best. The shrimp is good. A large cola is 1 liter. Anyway, they're open until dawn, so it's nice to come and eat comfortably.
The final price is much cheaper. ^^
sample_reviews_en.author: 망고바나

sample_reviews_en.text: I recommend going to another restaurant. The service is terrible. They've run out of food and don't have enough stock; they should close. The grilled seafood platter only had shrimp, and those were the size of a pinky finger. Everything they had was of poor quality. They're taking advantage of customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucky Lucky

sample_reviews_en.text: Expensive, but worth every penny. The staff is great and the screen is very large. However, they don't show live football matches here, and not the Champions League yet. Otherwise, it's top-notch and highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marcel Kleist

sample_reviews_en.text:
In 2019 it was a all you eat buffet 219TBH per person with offer for 2 person 1 coca- cola bottle free, beer / alcohol  separate purchase.

That time seafood option were good with chiken pork and other too.
sample_reviews_en.author: R Dutta

restaurants.name: เด็ดกะเพรา ตลาดน้อย
restaurants.address:

949 ถ. เจริญกรุง Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located in a small market, the service from the female staff is terrible, the worst in the world. Even when I asked, "Could you smile a little? You look cute," she just frowned. The owner should seriously consider this; otherwise, it will damage the business's reputation. Anyone without a service-oriented attitude shouldn't work there, or should be moved to the back office.

The food was also mediocre. Go eat at a restaurant with a better service mind.

Ich war in Talat Noi. The Service is a professional service provider, so you can get the most out of your experience in the Welt. In this case, when you ask: "Bitte in the morning, when you take a shower, you have to take a shower." In the past few years you have been able to make friends with your friends and family. Please feel free to contact us at our service page.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thailand NZ

sample_reviews_en.text: The female staff member provided terrible service. She was unfriendly, expressionless, and lacked a service-oriented attitude. When I asked the total price when paying, she didn't answer, instead just handed me the bill to look at myself. I feel this needs significant improvement. (I've encountered bad service before, but never considered writing a review on Google Maps; this time was too much to ignore.) The food wasn't particularly tasty either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tawans

sample_reviews_en.text: You should change this employee. Their service manners are terrible, absolutely awful. Today, around 6:20-6:00 PM, I was about to order when the employee asked me in a very rude manner, as if I wasn't asking for free food (asking if I wanted to eat in or take out). They had a very disrespectful and curt attitude, like they didn't want to sell anything. Think carefully about hiring this employee (male employee).
sample_reviews_en.author: Chirawat Yuppharat

sample_reviews_en.text: The ambiance is pleasant and the air conditioning is good, and the tables are very clean; you feel comfortable. The food was tasty, an average portion size for a fair price. The service was quick, but we were also the only customers there, so it wasn't as warm as you might expect from other restaurants, but it was okay. Overall, it's a good place to eat for a reasonable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nico210599

sample_reviews_en.text: I have to say, the basil chicken was delicious. But I ordered Tom Yum pork to share with my friend, and it wasn't sour enough. When I asked the staff, they said they were out of limes. If they were out of limes, why did they still serve it? Shouldn't they have avoided taking the order in the first place?
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamolporn Sakollapattanawat

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered beef basil stir-fry with a soft-boiled egg, but got a chilled boiled egg instead. I was confused. Another dish I ordered was minced pork basil stir-fry with a creamy egg, but got a fried egg instead. Only the rice and the beef basil stir-fry were delicious; everything else was just average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonjang Jang3210

sample_reviews_en.text: Ubath is the most unpleasant restaurant I've ever eaten at. The service was terrible, nobody was welcoming, they just sat there oblivious, not paying attention to anything. I'm not sure if they were even Thai, they seemed to have a speech impediment.
sample_reviews_en.author: เบล เบล

sample_reviews_en.text: 89 baht, the amount is as good as a child's, the taste is average, the amount of crispy pork is very little. I think it's expensive because it's a tourist location and they take care of their employees more. Compared to other made-to-order …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chef Mun Via Australia

restaurants.name: ตำถาด แอท มหาดไทย
restaurants.address:

10 Lat Phrao 122 Alley, Phlabphla, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This somtum (papaya salad) restaurant has a new location. I came here after exercising and found it right away. This is my third time here. There are three adorable little dogs.

The taste is great. I love the large, crispy shredded papaya.
If you like it this way, I recommend the somtum with crab and fermented fish sauce. I tried the somtum with mixed vegetables the other day, but I personally prefer the somtum with crab and fermented fish sauce.

The spicy salads are also delicious. I highly recommend the clear tom yum seafood soup.
Today I tried the grilled chicken, and it was also delicious, served hot and fresh.
But my favorites are the somtum and tom yum.

The restaurant was quite busy, but not overly crowded; there were always tables available. They have a selection of soft drinks.
Next door is a BBQ restaurant, which was also busy. Personally, I prefer the somtum.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tassa Lerdwatta

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and cheap. I usually eat here regularly, often. Sometimes I even order from here while eating at the BBQ restaurant next door. Today, I ordered and ate at the BBQ restaurant. At first, I thought it would take a long time because there were a lot of customers. After more than 40 minutes, I went to ask if it was my turn yet and if I could cancel the order if it wasn't. The answer I got was that they had prepared it but hadn't brought it because they didn't know which table it was for. That was an incredibly bad response. The restaurant next door isn't that big; they could have just checked each table. It was my fault for not telling them my table number, but the staff didn't even bother to come and serve me.
sample_reviews_en.author: MINT panadda

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and clean. I highly recommend it!💕

The fermented fish sauce is a Northeastern Thai flavor. The seafood platter is also delicious (the shrimp are bouncy and you can order them cooked or uncooked).

For those who don't like fermented fish sauce, I recommend the papaya salad with salted eggs (just the right amount of sweet and spicy).

This restaurant is great, with a great atmosphere and three fat dogs.

Joe Jee Jee (the owner's sons are so cute!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyarak Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff was unwelcoming. I went with two friends, dressed casually. We sat down, but no staff member came to greet us or bring us a menu. At first, we thought they were busy, so we waited. Then, a group of teenagers came in and sat down, and a tomboyish staff member immediately went to take their orders, even before the teenagers had sat down. We felt really uncomfortable. I told my friends we should leave; they probably didn't even notice us.
sample_reviews_en.author: รวีวรรณ ธรรมพิทักษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a somtum (papaya salad) restaurant that I always go to after a concert at Rajamangala Stadium. It's so delicious, the flavors are perfect, it's clean, and the food is served quickly. I recommend the spicy pork rib soup and the grilled pork neck. They are incredibly delicious! Whenever I go to a concert at Rajamangala, I have to eat at this somtum restaurant. 100/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchinan Mun-ok

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious every time I eat here 👍 As for the soups, I felt they were a little too salty, but maybe it depends on the time. The staff provides good service, but if you're driving (especially in the evening), parking can be chaotic 😉 because there's another BBQ restaurant in the same area. You might have to get up and move your car while you're eating 🤭
sample_reviews_en.author: PPUI P.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant in Mahathai Soi serves Northeastern Thai food, including som tum (papaya salad) and grilled fish. The som tum is served in a large platter, tastes good, and is good value for money. Traffic can be congested, so parking might be difficult in the early evening or on weekends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanuwat Meesinsath

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! I stopped by for the first time while running errands. I ordered the corn salad with salted egg. If you're looking for a really good somtum (papaya salad) restaurant, I highly recommend this one. You won't be disappointed! 🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: suwisa phomphang

restaurants.name: MK Restaurants Happy Avenue
restaurants.address:

801 แฮปปี้ อเวนิว ลาดพร้าว 101 ซอย ลาดพร้าว 101 ถนน ลาดพร้าว Khlong Chaokhun Sing, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered just three fresh items to take home and waited for half an hour. If I hadn't asked, I probably would have waited even longer. People could walk in and eat immediately. I'm so confused. What's going on with their normal management system? And they weren't even delivery riders. Even if they were, it shouldn't take that long. Normally, when a rider arrives, the items should be ready because the customer ordered through the system and should have been notified beforehand. Here, I'm just a regular customer buying groceries. I walked in to ask about my order because I hadn't ordered much, and no one paid any attention. There were plenty of people walking around, but they ignored me. They gave me a weary look when I asked about my order. Seriously?! I understand that sometimes they're responsible for customers on different sides of the store, but if there's someone standing in front of the store, they should call a colleague or someone who's assigned to handle customers. Not just ignore them and not notice them. This isn't just about buying groceries to take home; sometimes I even eat in the restaurant, and there are so few staff members, they don't even look or turn around.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratiros

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let me join the MK buffet! The highlight for me was the Green noodles, which I really wanted to try. I went to MK buffet mainly for the noodles and the sliced beef — the other dishes didn’t matter much to me. The staff provided great service and everything was served quickly.

I went during the August promotion when Green noodles were included, but sadly they won’t be available in September anymore. I wonder why MK is a hot pot restaurant, but my hair and head didn’t smell at all after eating there😂. This buffet promotion is only 299 THB net. I also ordered the roasted duck for around 200THB.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chomticha S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I ate at the buffet and found a hair in my pork. I saw it as soon as I lifted the tray; it was a small strand, like usual, a man's hair. So I called a staff member and said, "Excuse me, there's a hair..." A female staff member, who seemed older, came over, picked it up, and didn't say anything. A little while later, she came back with a new tray, placed it down, and walked away without saying a word. If you're not willing to provide good service, you should quit. I'm paying for this meal, not asking for it for free. This is unacceptable. 😌
sample_reviews_en.author: Palmmiqx

sample_reviews_en.text: I arrived at the restaurant around 7:30 PM to order duck, but the staff said it was sold out. Another customer who arrived later ordered duck, and the staff said they could have it, but it would be a small portion. I was very disappointed because I really wanted to eat duck. I want to know why this happened. The staff didn't even tell me that a small portion of duck was available; there was no explanation whatsoever. This is terrible service. I really want an explanation for this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aphinya J

sample_reviews_en.text: Don't even think about trying this place! Lucky Suki (Tee Noi Suki) is much better and faster. The food here is slow, the staff are indifferent, and they only bring the cheaper items you ordered first. The expensive items are forgotten or served very slowly; they don't ask or follow up, and they just don't bring them. I hesitated to eat here because of the bad reviews, but my experience was enough. One time is enough. Trying again in 10 years was a complete waste.
sample_reviews_en.author: SORAKRAI PROMLUE

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered just three portions of jade noodles, and it took almost an hour to prepare. When I asked the rider, the employee refused to do it. Terrible service!!! Three portions of jade noodles in an hour at MK Happy Avenue, Ladprao 101. Do you even enjoy providing service? If it took that long to prepare something so simple, if I had ordered duck too, they'd probably need a golden duck and I'd have to wait another lifetime! Absolutely awful!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ton Diary

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat at other branches without any problems, but at this branch, the staff were indifferent. I asked for a menu twice, and in the end, I just ordered one bowl of sukiyaki. After waiting 20 minutes, a staff member finally came to tell me that if I ordered sukiyaki, I would have to wait 20 minutes. In short, I waited 40 minutes for just one bowl of sukiyaki. It was a complete waste of my time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yokk Tanaprn

sample_reviews_en.text:
There is parking available in Soi Ladprao 101, Happy Avenue project. The staff are good, as expected from their standard.
The dipping sauce at this branch is okay, not too sour compared to other branches which seem to have adjusted the recipe to be more sour. The air conditioning is comfortable, and the place is clean. The restrooms are outside at the back of the restaurant and not very clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwankao Syr

restaurants.name: The Nest Sports Bar & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

33/126 LK Metro Aly, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not sure why this is flagged as a rental place even though it says Bar and Restaurant in the title - either way.

Good sports bar, mostly euro and US expats. In fact there were a number of fans that they graciously keep the open season football game on for. Good service. Really good food.

I came here for lunch a number of times and was never let down. Strong drinks and the best smoothies I’ve had in Pattaya. Wish they would make a banana daiquiri with what they have now, but if ownership sees this, next time maybe I’ll be able to order one without making my own.

I will definitely be back. Retirement, I wish you were closer!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Barrett

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come here often for the Sunday roasts, and they are consistently very good.  Food is normally served hot, meats are usually cooked correctly, and the small roasts (which are anything but small), represent excellent value.
Just a quick thing to point out.
