On the roast order sheet, it just says cabbage under the vegetables section, people who aren’t familiar with the menu, won’t be aware that the cabbage is mixed with bacon.  You should know that not everyone likes or “can eat” bacon, so the bacon should be referenced on the sheet.
Overall, one of the best value and quality Sunday roasts you can get in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony Thai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent food at moderate prices!

I had pea soup – it was just as delicious as my mother's used to make :-) I was told the chef is from France. The other dishes were also delicious and plentiful.

You can sit inside in air conditioning or outside right on Soi Diana and watch the hustle and bustle or sports on the numerous TVs. The drinks were good and cold – what more could you want?

Both servers who served us were friendly and very nice, spoke excellent English, and were very efficient, so I was happy to leave a tip. I highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike van Dyk

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve tried the Sunday roast in three places in Pattaya now — Robin Hood, Hemingway’s and Nest.

Nest was exceptional. The quality of the food really stood out and the gravy was probably the best of the three.
One of the best Sunday roasts I’ve had here.

Staff were always helpful and proactive 5 stars ⭐

When I first arrived, I actually thought about just heading back to Robin Hood, but I’m very glad I stayed. Definitely the right decision.

Easily my favourite Sunday roast so far and somewhere I’ll be coming back to.
sample_reviews_en.author: jason guiry

sample_reviews_en.text: I can see why this has a good rating.  Nice building with decent food it would seem the odds of things going well are in our favor.  My problem is with the service I witnessed and experienced during my visits. I was born and raised in the USA if the waitress doesnt understand what I said she doesnt need to roll her eyes.  When I told her I was leaving she just picked up the menu and went back to what she was doing.  Didn't apologize I guess she was happy to go back to sitting in her chair.
sample_reviews_en.author: hayward022

sample_reviews_en.text: This sports bar is also frequented by families with children. The comfortable, air-conditioned indoor seating is a welcome feature. The daily specials are highly recommended. They also offer à la carte Western and Thai dishes. The daily specials are generous portions and come with a small bottle of beer at a great price. A pint of Chang beer is only 99 baht for a refill. It's a fantastic deal. The friendly staff make for a pleasant and wholesome dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: toshio okamura (oka3)

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered half a chicken with french fries, salad and gravy via Grab. I received 2 cold and minuscule chicken legs (220g), a small portion of extremely soggy and cold french fries (100g), also 100g of watered down gravy and an underwhelming salad. I understand that some food places are not as good as others, but compared to others for 385 baht this felt a bit like a theft. Definitely not recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mila Frau

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve visited this this place many time and rate it as a good place to watch sport.  I hate writing negative review but I was insulted last night when I ordered from the new BBQ menu.  I ordered the Aussie beef medium rare and what was dished up was totally unacceptable, 2 small minute steak burnt to buggery.  So disappointing as it was a special occasion.  No more food here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony Jones

restaurants.name: Andhra Restaurant 2 South Pattaya
restaurants.address:

59, Beside Beverly Hotel &, 18 Moo 10, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Andhra Restaurant 2, and it was a wonderful experience, especially for anyone craving authentic Indian flavors.

The restaurant offers a great variety of dishes across multiple cuisines, with a strong focus on rich and satisfying Indian meals. The taste feels homely and well-balanced, making it a perfect spot for Indian visitors as well as anyone who enjoys flavorful food.

One of the highlights of my visit was the warm hospitality from the hotel manager, Mr. Ramu, who was extremely kind, attentive, and helpful throughout. His approach truly enhances the overall dining experience.

The ambience is pleasant and comfortable, with a clean setup that makes it suitable for both relaxed meals and group dining.

Overall, I highly recommend this place for its delicious food, good variety, welcoming service, and enjoyable atmosphere in South Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naveen M

sample_reviews_en.text: I went here specifically to eat biryani because I missed the taste of the biryay I used to have when I was in Hyderabad. And I can say for sure that I came to the right place because the taste is exactly the same as what I had in Hyderabad. The staff were very welcoming and made me feel comfortable with their friendly service.The food prices are reasonable.The restaurant is located in an area with many Indian restaurants, but this one is a hidden gem.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hennessy

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst experience ever. Ordered mutton and got mostly bones with barely any meat way too salty too. When I asked them to check it, they said “it comes like that. Found hair in my food, and the guy just said ‘’let me check” and walked off. Dirty washroom if that’s how they keep the bathroom, I don’t even wanna imagine the kitchen. Would never recommend this place
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephen Gerard SR

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken curry is a must! It's a bit spicy and smoky. Overall, they have a huge selection of dishes and the staff is friendly.
We also had the dosa (lentil flatbread) – also highly recommended. It's not spicy at all. Served with interesting sauces (nut and ginger).
We stopped in by chance, as the restaurant was full of Indian guests – a sign of high quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Оксана Крупина

sample_reviews_en.text:
A real oasis of Indian food in Pattaya among  too many mirages of so called true Indian Restaurants.

This is not just an Andhra Restaurant. The north Indian options too are very good. Go for it.

Sadly for me I visited on the last day of my visit to Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rajesh Tholapi

sample_reviews_en.text: First time to this place and I brought home make pickles for using here during stay here but here andhra restaurent food is very nice and staff is very much co operative.  Hence I have not used my food brought from home.
sample_reviews_en.author: koteswara kasyapa

sample_reviews_en.text: The food in this restaurant is very tasty, especially our Andhra style food, I recommend it to everyone.Must try Hyderabad Dum Biryani & Crispy fish so yummy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ramu Ramu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good place to eat, taste is nice, south indian and other veg food options available

service is little slow but food is good
sample_reviews_en.author: praveen sharma

restaurants.name: The QUAD - Sukhumvit Eatery
restaurants.address:

Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hey so I had to go to a meeting and I picked this place cause it was new and I wanted to try it out and do a review on here so we decided to meet here!

Unfortunately this time I didn’t try the food but I did have a coffee at cupping which was really good and I like the service it was really nice I really like the place I think a place that you can hang out with friends especially in the afternoons for coffee and then there’s really good restaurants that you can choose from to eat ! 🥹

I will definitely be back and I would highly recommend people to go here it’s a casual but very nice and quiet atmosphere which makes it nice for meetings and even just for networking and also for get together with friends ! 😁
Lots of space to sit and good choice of restaurants !

Follow Fauzia for more amazing of new places popping up in Bangkok and beyond definitely follow us here and you can follow us on our social media channel is Instagram Facebook our TikTok has full videos and also our YouTube channel has more amazing content!! 💕💕💕💙
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't let the menu fool you; this place is a total letdown. While the burger itself was okay, everything else about the meal was unacceptable.
The Pizza Scam: I ordered a pizza and received what felt like a quarter of a portion. It’s a joke to serve such a tiny amount to a hungry customer.
Disgusting Fries: The fries served with the burger were vile. I’ve had better fries at a bottom-tier McDonald's. These were greasy, flavorless, and honestly inedible. It’s embarrassing to serve something this bad as a side.
The Smoothie Rip-off: We asked for a banana smoothie (which wasn't on the menu). They said they could do it, then charged us the "Premium Signature" price for a basic blend of milk and two bananas. Charging top-tier prices for the cheapest ingredients is deceptive and greedy.
The verdict: Overpriced for small portions and terrible sides. I won't be coming back, and I suggest you don't either.
sample_reviews_en.author: NaysS

sample_reviews_en.text: I do not often leave a bad review but our meal at Pastaio the Quad was truly one of the worst Italian meals I have had in years - maybe ever! We ordered 2 classics the Carpaccio and the Carbonara. 2 true basic Italian dishes which if you want to call yourselves an Italian restaurants you HAVE TO get right. Both were miserable failures. The meat was stringy and the Carbonara had literally no taste. We could just as well have chewed on Pasta only. I had ordered some bread to eat with my Carpaccio which in most Italian restaurants comes complimentary. Here they charge for it and it arrived after 15 minutes when we had already finished our meal. So, guys I am not sure where your google rating comes from but you really have to pull up your socks if you want to one day justify it. Bangkok' food scene is too unforgiving to let such low quality food survive. We will certainly never come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jurgen Wolf

sample_reviews_en.text: Located within The Quad in the Landmark Hotel, the PASTAIO pasta counter stands out for the quality of its preparations, freshness, and originality of its creations: you'd think you were in Florence or Naples... You can also finish with a dessert from the neighboring counter, and in particular, a truly remarkable revisited tarte tatin... There's a large hall where you can sit anywhere, and a few tables on the terrace overlooking Sukhumvit (with the noise and pollution of this major thoroughfare)... Very close to the "red-light" Nana district, which is less upscale!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pierre Loti

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been back several times, and the concept here is fantastic.
You can enjoy authentic Thai, Chinese, Italian, and American cuisine all in one place.
It looks like a food court, but you don't need to go to each individual restaurant; the staff takes your order for all dishes at once and serves them to your table.
It's great for solo diners, but also perfect for groups sharing various dishes.
The prices are very reasonable for a hotel restaurant, and the staff service is excellent!
I'll definitely go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: よー*バンコク

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm coming on Friday. It was not a restaurant anymore, It was 100% discotheque. This is crazy, with techno music... Cannot speak. I told the manager to put down a bit the sound she told me to moove away. I come many time and the food it is quiet good and the ambient was very nice and staff gentle but if you want to go by the week end in a 5 star restaurant don't come here. Very impolite the manager.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fabio Confalonieri

sample_reviews_en.text: The Quad allows ordering from various cuisine so we had Italian, Chinese and American food among a group of 3 friends. The burger is outstanding. We really enjoyed the congee and pasta too. The music was quite loud so if you prefer a quieter spot, ask the staff to pick a quieter location.
sample_reviews_en.author: J C

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good and the service was friendly, however, they charged us for some strange things, such as 400 baht for not having drunk any alcohol, and another 400 baht for drinks for the staff without our consent. These charges weren't mentioned to the server and weren't on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gian Paulin

restaurants.name: โจ้กับแกล้ม JoeGubglam
restaurants.address:

169 jakkapatdipong rd, Wat Sommanat, Pomprabsuttrupai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant will always be my number one favorite ❤️

I want to eat their fried rice every day, but since I live far away in Pathum Thani, I have to ask myself if twice a month is enough 😆

Actually, it's not just the fried rice that's good. Almost everything I've tried on the menu is delicious. The atmosphere is charming and different each day. Some days are quiet and peaceful, like a place to relax; other days are so lively it feels like a small party is happening.

Joe and Nui, the owners, are incredibly lovely and friendly. They always take care of customers with a smile. And Nui's cakes are a must-try; they're so delicious I always want to order some to take home.

It's a hidden gem that I'm kind of keeping secret, but hey… I want you to try it at least once because I believe you might fall in love with this place too 💙
sample_reviews_en.author: Supreeya Muangrod

sample_reviews_en.text:
We have been in Bangkok since 2 days and before arriving we were so hyped for the food in this city. However many Thai restaurants has this weird method of buying google review as 5 star from people. So these Thai places with +4.5 stars are offering free drinks or food if you give them 5 stars. We refused to accept this kind of scamming people.
So we gave-up our good local real Thai food search and ended up in this very cute Japanese place. We have tried Tonkatsu curry rice and gyoza which were amazing! The place is small and feels a local Japanese atmosphere with nice ambience. Staff was very kind and service was also very good. Prices were reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Basak Tarim

sample_reviews_en.text:
This izakaya-style bar and restaurant in the Lan Luang area near Wat Saket is a small, single-shop space with a cozy atmosphere. There are only about two or three tables and a long bar counter.

The food focuses on appetizers and snacks to enjoy with drinks. Prices are standard for this type of establishment.

Parking is available on the street, but a taxi is the most convenient option. Don't drink and drive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pisit Wongsawat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small izakaya-style restaurant with both seating and bar seating. The atmosphere is warm and slow-paced. Service is quite slow because there's only one front-of-house staff member. The food tastes good, but the ingredients could use improvement, as the prices don't quite match the quality. For example, the beef bowl had several tough, chewy pieces of beef. Parking is available on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: HIA CHIM - TASTE MASTER

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow, what a shame we can't go back to this place! This little gem has it all: great atmosphere, delicious food, and excellent service. What more could we ask for? Thank you for making our last day in Bangkok so wonderful. I hope to return someday ♡

(The teriyaki chicken melts in your mouth 🫡)
sample_reviews_en.author: KARINA FIGUEREDO

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't expect much at first, but the food was surprisingly delicious. Everything I ordered was amazing, even better than some Izakaya restaurants I've been to. The prices were very reasonable, and I ordered a lot. To finish, the chocolate …
sample_reviews_en.author: pakaporn Luengthongjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food and service are excellent. The place is super intimate and has a great vibe. We ordered the udon with meat and the gyudon, both were fantastic.
We'll definitely be back since the menu is extensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Federico Strauss

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem near Wat Som, discovered during Songkran.
A friend told me I had to try it. I don't want to overpraise it, but
it was surprisingly delicious, exceeding my expectations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenny Jenny

restaurants.name: Kone Htet BKK
restaurants.address:

4485 Sukhumvit Rd, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here (Saturday night) hoping to eat a classic chicken rice I’ve had since 2000s, for dinner. Said they ran out.
Left the place disappointed eating biryani instead (chicken drum stick is relatively small compared to other establishments serving MM biryani).
The menu is too diverse, not that diversity is bad but if they can’t focus on serving their signature/classic chicken rice, then they have either tarnished the term ‘ကုန်းထက် ကြက်ဆိထမင်း’.

My take on this place - completely different to the Kone Htet I know from Yangon. Basically trying to bite more than they can chew, to put it plainly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanna Shein

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is taste of home truly. The service is good and wide variety of Myanmar food available.
The main dish signature chicken rice takes me back to Yangon. We visited frequently, this time they offered us free deserts, and there was also deep discount on certain dishes. Will be coming again whenever I m near.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wai Yan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish carried that authentic, home-style flavor that’s so hard to find abroad. We tried three dishes, and honestly, each one hit the mark but the standout for me was the ထောပတ်ထမင်း.
Highly recommended for anyone who wants a genuine Myanmar food experience in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: JOY

sample_reviews_en.text: Foods are not tasty enough as expected, and feel like it’s a bit overpriced compared to other Burmese restaurant in this area. Price is acceptable if foods were great. However, the restaurant and foods look clean, which is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ye Lin Aung

sample_reviews_en.text: Just discovered this Burmese restaurant in Bangkok. The food was incredibly tasty! Full of rich flavors and authentic spices. Service, atmosphere, everything was very good. As a food lover, I feel very satisfied 💯 Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Berkay Bahceci

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious! There's too many verities of Myanmar foods available. I ate Mala Xiao Kao, Shan Noodles, Rakhine Mont T salad and Faluda. Restaurant gave free dessert cup also. I will definitely go with my friends again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Titi Chaungtha

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a restaurant that I come to occasionally because it's close to my house. When guests come, I bring them some rice noodles instead of beans. We eat chicken rice, rice noodles, snow pearl ice cream, and falooda.
sample_reviews_en.author: win thida

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, the food doesn’t taste like the original one. Some ingredients from Faluda are still frozen when served, and the ice cream is too sweet for me.  Menus are also a bit overpriced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kris Kyaw

restaurants.name: more moo cafe
restaurants.address:

Muban Royal Nakharin Village Alley, Khwaeng Nong Bon, Khet Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a healthy beverage shop offering creamy soy milk and black sesame glutinous rice balls in soy milk. The atmosphere is warm, with pleasant music and comfortable seating. They also serve food, ice cream, and hot, cold, and blended drinks. It's located on Srinakarin Road, opposite the Cross Srinakarin Hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapairat Chan

sample_reviews_en.text: The soy milk had a strange smell. The soy milk was insufficient, I thought it was a soybean spirit. The matcha was in chunks and not broken up. The service was not good at all. The shopkeeper had a sour face as if she didn't want to serve. The shop was beautifully decorated.
sample_reviews_en.author: nanjees sarida

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second visit. I really love their creamy hot soy milk. Today I also ordered toast, which was delicious too. There's parking behind the building. If you're looking for soy milk, this is another place I'd highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tuangnoii Tuangrat

sample_reviews_en.text: This newly opened shop has a great atmosphere, plenty of parking, and nice music. The honey lemon soda is amazing! It's perfect for working, having business meetings, or just chilling. The best part is that it closes at 11 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: SUGAR SU

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a strawberry fresh milk frappe & loved it here . The ambience was so good that they have a real tree inside the dining & the staffs were so gentle and great. Try this place for sure♥️
sample_reviews_en.author: gowri shankar

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, perfect for working. I ordered a matcha latte and it was delicious. There are charging stations available, and the staff are lovely and provide excellent service.🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: le mon

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so delicious! And the owner was so lovely. He let us out of the rain and even bought us drinks. Thank you so much! I'll definitely invite my friends to come here again soon. ☺️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanyakan

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is pretty and charming. The desserts are delicious, especially the soy milk and the crispy water chestnut dessert. Anyone passing by this area should stop by and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bass.

restaurants.name: Silom Char Siu Rice
restaurants.address:

PG6G+4MV ซ. จันทน์ 23/2 Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let's try the roast pork rice! This roast pork/crispy pork rice shop also offers stewed soups such as bitter melon with pork ribs and seaweed with minced pork. The shop is a small shophouse by the roadside, set up on a cart next to the building. The owner is kind, and the staff are attentive. Prices start at 60 baht, and the special is 70 baht.
The dishes I tried were: Roast Pork/Crispy Pork Rice and Bitter Melon with Pork Ribs.
- Roast Pork/Crispy Pork Rice: The roast pork is sliced ​​thickly, tender, and not chewy at all. The crispy pork skin is crunchy, but unfortunately, it's a bit fatty with not much meat. The roast pork sauce is light brown. You can add sweet soy sauce and dried chili peppers to enhance the flavor and add a spicy kick, which helps cut through the richness.
- Bitter Melon with Pork Ribs: The bitter melon is well-stewed, soft, and not bitter at all. Importantly, the texture isn't mushy, giving it a nice chewy feel. The soup is fragrant and flavorful, clear and refreshing. The pork ribs are tender but not mushy; the meat comes off easily with just a bite.
If you're in the St. Louis area, give it a try! It's delicious, I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirichai Thananunthakit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant's roast pork rice stands out with its unique sauce, which has a fragrant Chinese herbal aroma. Those who enjoy this type of flavor will find it delightful, but those unfamiliar with it might find it a bit unusual.
The roast pork itself is dark in color, tender, and flavorful. The crispy pork is grilled, so while it may not be as crispy as the fried version, it's noticeably more tender. However, the skin isn't crispy throughout, remaining soft and juicy due to the grilling process.
The Chinese sausage is dry and crumbly. The restaurant also provides scallions, pickled chilies, and soy sauce, all prepared using clean, high-quality stainless steel utensils. Ice is free, and tea is also available. The regular price is 60 baht, which is reasonable considering the quantity and quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Lai

sample_reviews_en.text: Anyone who hasn't tried it should definitely come and eat here. They accept the 60/40 discount. It's delicious! If you eat at the restaurant, they provide dried chilies, vinegar, pepper, and fish sauce to season to your liking. You can eat this roast pork rice up to 3 times for 60 baht, or only 24 baht with the discount. Generous portions of meat! Don't forget to support us because the 60/40 discount ends in just one month.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayutthaya

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is not very clean. There are cockroaches running around. The tables are wet and not wiped. It's not delicious. The crispy pork has only meat. No part is crispy at all. It's expensive. I passed after one visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: PV J

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old, established restaurant that still uses a recipe for roasted pork rice and crispy pork, a flavor that has remained delicious for a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: นายปวิช อุดมรัตนชัยกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: Roast pork, crispy pork, and Chinese sausage rice – this is an original shop in Saint Louis. Parking on the street is manageable. …
sample_reviews_en.author: W. W.

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! I've been eating here since I was a kid, and now I'm 32 and I still go there. It's just as delicious as ever! 💯💯💯
sample_reviews_en.author: RICHY RICHY

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating here since I was a teenager.
The service staff has changed over time, but the taste is still to my liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: thong thai

restaurants.name: Durian House
restaurants.address:

94 Pracha Uthit, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The person managing the shop was incredibly rude. The meat they gave me didn't match what I'd requested. I asked to see another piece because the meat was firmer than I wanted. The price wasn't an issue; I was willing to pay for a larger one, as I was buying it for my mother's birthday and it's usually our family's shop. The second piece was so soft it was mushy. I was then scolded for not providing the correct information, and told I had to buy multiple pieces. So I just paid for it, even though I didn't get the meat I wanted.

Honestly, I'm a working person too, and I don't want to take advantage of anyone. I understand that perfectly. But other shops have much nicer service. I'm very disappointed and upset. I will never buy from this shop again in my life.
sample_reviews_en.author: KRN S.

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm so disappointed! My dad went to buy durian at a durian shop, but got a hard, inedible one!!! 😔 We went back to the shop, and the seller said to leave it outside the refrigerator for 1-2 days and it would soften. But today is the second day, and it's still hard! We've already thrown it away!!! It's so frustrating because we really wanted to eat it, but we couldn't. 😭 The seller even said that if we had bought a bigger one, we would have gotten the kind we wanted. Why didn't they tell us that from the start? They should have offered a better deal and been honest with customers. People who come to buy with a specific intention are willing to pay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pactprich

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm not sure if I bought the durian when the price had dropped, but I was so satisfied! For 425 baht, I got 6 segments. It was a great deal, although you have to wait a bit because they peel it for you right there. There's plenty of parking. I chose the soft, not crunchy, Monthong variety – it was incredibly satisfying and full of flavor. I'll definitely go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: PATTHANAN PALEEKAN

sample_reviews_en.text: The durian had excellent flesh and just the right amount of sweetness; it was delicious! The owner selected the perfect durian for me according to my specifications 😊 The parking lot is spacious and convenient. I'll definitely be back to buy more; I've become a regular customer! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Prin Anthony

sample_reviews_en.text:
Monthong durian has lots of flesh and a thin rind.
It's crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, which I love.
I went to buy it in the afternoon, but they were sold out; they hadn't ripened enough to sell yet.
sample_reviews_en.author: kanmanee Juengkitsophon

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is terrible. They gave me bad durians, but blamed me for it. The durians smelled bad and were very bruised. When I called, they spoke rudely to me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wachiraya Chaiwinij

sample_reviews_en.text: The durian here is top-grade, so the price is reasonable, but it's definitely worth it. If you're going to eat durian, you might as well get the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: ss6272 S

sample_reviews_en.text: It's best to call and reserve before you go, as the durian may not be ripe on some days, and they may sell out quickly on others.
sample_reviews_en.author: mon S

restaurants.name: Papaya Salad 4 - ส้มตำแยก 4
restaurants.address:

14, 13 Charoen Krung 109 Alley, Lane 4, Khwaeng Bang Kho Laem, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥣 Som Tum (Papaya Salad) & Northeastern Thai Food
🚙: No car parking, only motorcycle parking available.
🚧 The restaurant is located in a small alley, making it difficult for cars to access.
You might have to park at Seri Market and walk.
💵 Inexpensive and good value for money.
🧑 Good and polite service.
🪑 Approximately 10 tables. The restaurant looks clean.
🥗 Good taste.
🕙 Open at 10 AM, likely closes at 9 PM.

The mixed mushroom Tom Yum is excellent! I loved it!!! It contains enoki mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms, straw mushrooms, oyster mushrooms, and white/black shimeji mushrooms. 🐽 The grilled pork neck is also good, very delicious, sliced ​​into perfect bite-sized pieces. Another great dish is the pork larb, which includes liver and pork skin. The fermented fish papaya salad is also spicy. Overall,

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Local Guides Th

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious and spicy! Anyone passing by should stop in, or order through the Grab or Robinhood apps.

Papaya salad and various other salads are available.
They also have boiled rice noodles, vermicelli, and sticky rice to eat with your meal.

My go-to dish is the grilled pork neck with spicy sauce. It's delicious, made with real pork neck. Anyone who tries it will love it! 👍👍👍👍👍

There's no parking at the restaurant. You'll have to find parking in the market area and walk to the restaurant. There's indoor and outdoor seating. The outdoor seating is next to the building.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanalit Thanunyaviiranun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The first thing that impressed me was the service from the staff.
Everyone in the restaurant spoke to both customers and delivery riders with such great manners.
Sometimes I felt too shy to order anything complicated.
The food tasted really good.
I can't find anything to criticize.

The only downside to this restaurant is:
They don't have any beef on the menu!
I really wanted their Crying Tiger beef and sun-dried beef!
sample_reviews_en.author: SurthuunZ Ansir

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times. The flavors are incredibly rich and satisfying. The Thai papaya salad with salted egg is amazing. But the best is the grilled pork neck; it's so tender and delicious with the dipping sauce. My only complaint today was the fermented crab dish, which had a slight smell. The spicy soup was excellent, and the catfish larb was the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: kikises vap

sample_reviews_en.text: I searched for "Som Tum near me" and saw many positive reviews, so I decided to try it. It lived up to the reviews; the food looked very clean, the service was polite, and the price was reasonable. The taste was perfect; I ordered it non-spicy and mildly spicy, and they made it exactly as requested. I'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: bo boo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have complete confidence in the cleanliness of this restaurant.
I've been eating here for over ten years.
The fermented fish sauce is clean and cooked thoroughly. The freshwater crab is delicious, and they also have salted crab. They even trim the crab claws here.
sample_reviews_en.author: CYN

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean, the staff provides good service, the food is delicious, fresh, and flavorful, and the prices are reasonable. The owners are very friendly and you can tell them exactly how you want your food flavored.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirinart Piyawanichsakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious! The flavors are intense, my boyfriend loved it. Most importantly, it's clean – the plates, bowls, spoons, tables, and chairs are all spotless.
I wish I had found this place sooner! 🥹🥹❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: POM S.

restaurants.name: Tha Sholay restaurant
restaurants.address:

247/119-120-121, Pattaya 3rd Rd, ตำบล หนองปรือ, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tha Sholay Indian Theme Restaurant in Pattaya, Opp: Hotel Goldan Star, offers fantastic, authentic Indian food, featuring highly-rated dishes like bhindi masala, paneer masala, excellent Matar Paneer, and delicious Mixed Veggie etc. The atmosphere is clean and bright, complemented by friendly service, making it a highly recommended spot for affordable and delicious Indian cuisine in the area.

Highlights of the Experience

Food Quality: The food is consistently described as authentic and tasty, particularly the Dahl and various veggie dishes.

Value: It offers great deals, specifically the widely praised in Indian dishes.

Ambiance & Service: The venue is clean, air-conditioned, and has a cool, comfortable vibe.

Vegetarian and Non-Vegetarian Friendly: They have great Vegetarian and Non-Vegetarian options available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hitesh Patel

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is delicious. They offer both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, and they are prepared separately, not together. This is a great option for vegetarians. It's especially good for people from India who miss home-cooked food. I tried it, and it tasted amazing, just like home-cooked food. The service is excellent, and the place is very clean. The seating and tables are also comfortable. In my opinion, you should definitely try it, especially if you're from India. I loved it. (The dishes I tried were: Matar Paneer, Jeera Aloo, Naan, Tawa Roti, salad, Dal Tadka, and rice)
sample_reviews_en.author: sunil molwa

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been the perfect restaurant to arrive in Pattaya. Even a buffet, wish is really accessible (250bath), there is large diversité of meals well cooked and the service is just awesome. There where eventually a large group of people gathering but still worked did there best so anyone get everything. they brought me bread on the table as they saw i didnt got at first buffet around. awesome and good vibe
sample_reviews_en.author: Robin Prevent

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely loved this place! The food was outstanding—perfectly cooked, well-seasoned, and beautifully presented. The staff was polite and attentive, making the whole experience even better. The ambiance was clean and comfortable. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality food and great service.
sample_reviews_en.author: rizvi khan

sample_reviews_en.text: We had lunch at Sholay Restaurant, an Indian restaurant in Pattaya today. The food was very good and the service was also good. The owner of the hotel is from Hyderabad and the hotel owner Satish gave very good service. When you come, definitely visit this hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunil Dhage

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was absolutely delicious and well presented. Service was quick, polite, and professional. The ambiance was warm and comfortable. Truly a great dining experience—will definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: deepak kumar

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is extremely good and the staff member is very kind and polite. I love the ambience of the restaurant , really had a awesome experience ☺️
Will surely visit again in future😊
sample_reviews_en.author: harshit srivastava

sample_reviews_en.text: Got into this restaurant accidentally, ordered Dal Makhni with Garlic naan and Jeera rice. So glad I had food here. Best food for the price . Very economical. Keep it up guys,,…
sample_reviews_en.author: Neeraj Bisht

restaurants.name: ไฟแรงหม่าล่า
restaurants.address:

คันนายาม Khlong Lam Chiak Rd, Khwaeng Nuanchan, Khet Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I arrived at 10:40 PM, thinking the shop was closing. The staff informed me that only pork bone broth was left / grilling was no longer available (?). I was confused, but said okay. After a while, they said there was only enough left to make one serving. There were two of us, so I was wondering if we had to sacrifice for each other, haha. And the bowls of fresh ingredients were haphazardly dirty, not washed at all. People just piled them on top of each other after use. There weren't any separate tongs for handling fresh meat, vegetables, or meatballs. Ugh.
sample_reviews_en.author: ของขวัญ The Violinist

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service, extremely slow. They didn't inform us that they were out of sauce. The food was grilled and had cooled down before they even brushed it with the mala sauce. They could have at least told customers that the sauce was gone. They only served new customers even though they didn't have any mala sauce left to brush on. Poor management. They even asked what we wanted after we dropped something. Why didn't they think about grilling a new one or something? We had to stand and wait after we had already asked. Never going back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: maliw botoa

sample_reviews_en.text: This mala shop sells by weight, 35 baht per 100 grams. There's a soup base charge for orders under 100 grams. They also have mala skewers, mostly 15 baht each, with okra drinks for 10 baht. The food is fresh, chilled, cooked to order, and served hot. However... the spiciest dishes, both in the soup and the grilled items, were actually quite salty. The dipping sauces were delicious. The atmosphere is nice and the decor is beautiful. There's no restroom, and the indoor seating is a bit stuffy, but there are fans.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tipaporn BUA

sample_reviews_en.text: Once is enough! If it's popular because of social media but the management and service are this terrible, don't bother coming back. Waiting for half an hour is one thing, but after grilling, they ran out of sauce and didn't even bother to apply it. Why didn't they inform or ask the customer? The food got cold and soggy. They only cared about new customers. When I asked if I'd just use the sauce powder, they still dragged their feet and wouldn't finish preparing it. They completely ignored me! Terrible! Bye!
sample_reviews_en.author: PRM MINCT

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is as delicious as ever, but the freezer compartment at the bottom, which didn't have all three doors closed a few months ago, is still the same this month. Plus, the light is gone, and it's not cooling well, even though I need to store fresh food. I'm quite worried. I've been eating here since the first month-end restaurant opened. I hope they'll fix the freezer. The selection of food is also slower than when it first opened.
sample_reviews_en.author: TuppyPu-Ni

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a mala restaurant that offers both skewers and grilled mala. The overall taste is okay. For those who like spicy food, it's incredibly spicy – ​​so spicy it's almost bitter! 🥵🥵🥵 The mala dipping sauce is delicious. However, I deducted one star because the drinks menu doesn't show prices. The shop next door, Duangchai, has really delicious milkshakes and bread.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasithorn Boonplook

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fresh food quality is Average.
Price is affordable.
Service is okay.

Improvement: 😂 Needed plz …
The Soup is toooooo salty … have to dilute with a cup of hot water.

Inside the shop, smell is weird and humid … need to improve on air ventilation, and the situation get worse while you eat hot and spicy mala soup!  🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: Ying Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup was delicious, but they didn't have many of my favorite items. The display case was difficult to open, and there was a long line of people waiting. I still haven't decided what to eat. The drinks at Duangchai were just okay. I haven't tried the bread or bingsu yet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Polly

restaurants.name: Gokuraku
restaurants.address:

25, 12 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Pricey and food is sub standard. Ordered a garlic fried rice, cha siew ramen, Grilled gizzard, Grilled beef steak and a clams miso soup. Only good thing was the garlic fried rice. Gizzard tasted hard and tasteless, Street side stalls can triumphed that hands down at a fraction of the price that we paid. Grilled steak was overcooked, it was initially served medium rare and I requested for it to be cooked further to medium and it ended up served well done, and everything was dry and tough with a nasty gamey taste of cheap beef. Clams were fresh and succulent but the miso soup taste was overwhelming and covered the entire taste of clams. Ramen broth was bland and reeking of bamboo shoots taste. Not exactly expecting it to be authentically Japanese even though there were a few Japanese seated inside, but this quality of food is nowhere authentic and atrocious for the price that we were charged. Entire meal amounted to 723 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: J. S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Returned in April 2025
The curry is consistently consistent. However, the rice seemed a little dry. Perhaps it was left in the rice cooker for too long? The new menu item, Yangnyeom Chicken Karaage (180 THB), uses frozen food. The portions are large, so I think the price is reasonable. Happy hour is long, from 5 PM to 9 PM, which is nice. A beer was 79 THB.

Added May 1, 2023
The curry here is delicious and homemade. I highly recommend the Katsu Curry (220 THB).

This long-established izakaya is open late into the night. It's a great place to stop by for noodles or curry to finish off a night of drinking.
sample_reviews_en.author: 2pong

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of our favorite places in Bangkok. We've been here numerous times. The food is always good and the service has always been friendly.

Not the cheapest place but not expensive either. Compared to other Izakayas in Bangkok, pricing is reasonable here - especially since they are located in Thonglor. They have an extensive menu here, but I usually get a variety of sushi rolls and sashimi when I come here.

Place is a bit small and can get crowded during busy times. They also have upstairs with more seating but the stairs are a little steep.

We love it here and will keep coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jimmy

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is tasty and very delicious for some dishes.. like karaage, udon soup… standard menu with lots of set meals for both lunch and some for dinner. Happy hour and dinner menu starts from 5 pm only with standard beers at 75baht per pint, the Kaku high ball was potent enough…Japanese steak at 600 baht with asparagus, carrots and onions by the side.. just to warn that the portions for Ala carte are big and it is economical for families… limited seats in ground floor but they have a second floor. No parking on site but you can park at Nikko hotel just next door.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark mk

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice little place! I was very impressed. I had a delicious combination. The tempura was well prepared. The waitresses were very friendly. Not too pricey….nothing negative to say! The restaurant may have to make accommodations for large groups but they had an upstairs area that I did not see, which may have had tables? I do not know? Anyway, I definitely recommend this place for Japanese food. A great place to eat and forget about the awful Trump Administration and its incompetent misfits!
sample_reviews_en.author: Griffin

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's great that they have a happy hour until 9 PM where you can get beer and shochu cocktails for 79 baht. They also have set meals, Japanese izakaya dishes, and Thai food, so there's a huge variety to choose from. I ordered the stir-fried chives and egg dish because I wanted something light and vegetable-based, and I was happy that it was inexpensive yet generously portioned.

During lunchtime, it seemed like there were a lot of Japanese-looking office workers eating there.
sample_reviews_en.author: piace a-

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located on Thonglor Road, it's easy to find. It has the feel of a traditional, casual izakaya (Japanese pub). It seems more popular with men than women.

The menu has a wide variety of dishes and is reasonably priced.

* Pork ginger stir-fry: 130 baht
* Rice: 40 baht
* Clam soup: 60 baht

It might be more appealing if they had set meals.

Although VAT and service charge are added separately, they did serve an appetizer, which was nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: AT

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here two years ago.
I ordered either a tuna bowl or a seafood bowl, but the sashimi was absolutely awful. It was so dry, like it had been squeezed by hand, and it was extremely unfresh. For the first time in my life, I left some sashimi uneaten.
I think the taste is unbearable for Japanese people.
However, I have had similar sashimi at other restaurants in Thailand, so it may be well-received by Thai people.
sample_reviews_en.author: K J

restaurants.name: Bistro de Flora
restaurants.address:

34/4 4 Thanon Ratchaphruek Bang Rak Noi, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the worst experiences I have ever had at a restaurant in Thailand.

We started to order food and the waitress cut us off and only took half the order, she replied she will come back to take the rest of the order later.

When I managed to get her attention again she took the rest of the order by which time half my wifes food had arrived.

An hour went by with no food arriving and despite prompting them that my food had not arrived they jusy asked me to wait.

15 minutes after asking the first waitress returns to tell me they forgot what i ordered and had not started to cook anythiny despite having been in the restaurant for over an hour. I cancelled everything and asked for the bill for the half of my wifes order that actually arrived.

They insultingly offered a 26 baht discount (3%) as an apology and still charged me 10% for service. No respect for customers and lacking in any sense of responsibility for poor service.

I unfortunately cannot recommend anything from the menu as despite ordering and waiting for a considerably length of time I am yet to actually eat anything.
sample_reviews_en.author: Callum Wainwright (Grandsgt Rocket)

sample_reviews_en.text: Almost 5 stars, but the service was a letdown. It seemed like they were trying to be helpful, but I don't understand why they were in such a hurry to clear the plates. We hadn't even finished our savory dishes yet, and they still seemed to want us to have dessert. They were trying to finish clearing the savory dishes, and I was already annoyed. I asked for the bill, but instead, they brought the dessert menu! The food tasted good, considering the price and portion size. I was thinking of coming back next time because I'm on a diet these days, but with this kind of service, it might be my only visit...
sample_reviews_en.author: ao

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautifully decorated, has a great atmosphere, and the restrooms are clean. It's perfect for a meal with friends or family. There's ample parking. The Western food is delicious and served quickly; the cheesy dishes are fragrant and tasty – if you like cheese, you can order them. Thai food takes a little longer to prepare, and desserts also take some time to arrive. But if you're not in a hurry, it's a nice place to relax, eat, and chat. A minor complaint is that there are no serving spoons; you have to ask the staff for them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bun BNE

sample_reviews_en.text:
Savory Dishes // The pasta dish was pretty good, with plenty of cheese and a nice portion. However, the sea bass steak had several bones that could easily get in your mouth, so be careful when eating.
Desserts // Better than many famous dessert shops. Not too sweet, making them easy to eat continuously. Fresh fruit with a distinctive flavor.
Drinks // The iced coffee was too sweet. The soda drinks were just right in taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meow Review

sample_reviews_en.text: Menu looks great, with choice of western and Thai food. We had garlick bread (perfect) and onion soup (good). Then they served my spaghetti with salmon and cream (okay, but way too sweet) and after that they brought my spouse her Thai steak which was composed 90% of fat. The Beer selection is great but in not sure I would come back just for that. Sorry. Maybe the Thai dishes are great? The place seems well attended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Axel Hoebeke

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to restaurant; I've been here at least 10 times. The food is delicious, they have a wide variety of desserts, including many ice cream flavors and smoothies. The restaurant is beautifully decorated, perfect for taking photos. They have private rooms for small meetings, it's clean, the owner is lovely, the service is good, and there's parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oh! Y Trendy

sample_reviews_en.text: This European-style restaurant and bakery is located near Maria's (on the white side). It focuses on Western food; the taste is decent but could be better. The recommended dish, the river prawn spaghetti, was a bit bland. The restaurant is beautifully decorated with many photo opportunities. Drinks are quite expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: K. Wangvitayakun

sample_reviews_en.text: The cafe has a nice, cozy atmosphere, perfect for chilling out. The coffee is delicious, and they often have a buy-one-get-one-free promotion, which is great. The staff are friendly, smiling, and polite. I tried the cake, and it tasted good, but the texture was a bit coarse.
sample_reviews_en.author: Life style Tiger

restaurants.name: ข้าวต้มแห้ง บะเต็ง วัฒนา
restaurants.address:

39, 89 ปาก Lat Phrao Wang Hin 52 Alley, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌸 Minced Pork Noodle Soup with Three Spices
Flat noodles with minced pork shaped into small balls. Those who prefer stronger flavors might need to add more seasoning. The pork is crumbly and lacks the desired texture.

🌸 Dry Rice Porridge with Soft Bone and Pork Ribs
The rice is perfectly soft, neither too soggy nor too dry. The soft bone is tender and goes well with the provided chili sauce.

What I liked most was the broth; it had a good flavor, was easy to drink, fragrant, and mildly spicy with pepper. However, those who prefer stronger flavors might find it unremarkable.

The prices are a bit high compared to the portion sizes.

There is no parking at the restaurant; you might have to park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: a.aloniix saniiz

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant offers a variety of dishes including rice porridge, flat noodles, rice with toppings (fried pork neck), blanched vegetables with dipping sauce, and other snacks.
• Personally, I like the flavors as they don't need any extra seasoning. The noodles are delicious, perfectly cooked, not too mushy.
• The pork rib cartilage with dipping sauce is very tasty.
• There is a wide variety of drinks, including herbal drinks and soft drinks.
• There is no designated parking area; you can find parking in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Veeravat Changkeb

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is such delicious rice porridge, it's hard to describe. I recommend you give it a try to experience what delicious rice porridge is like.

*In my personal opinion, rice porridge from any restaurant is similar, no matter where you eat it, the taste will be the same. Until I had the chance to try it at this restaurant, I understood what delicious rice porridge is like.
sample_reviews_en.author: ARM TOYOTA SURE

sample_reviews_en.text: The other day I was craving some rice porridge with bak teong and found this restaurant. I wasn't disappointed, though. It was delicious. I wish the bak teong was a little more intense. The rice grains were a bit drier. Overall, it was good. The restaurant was clean. The orange chili sauce was really good. The fried pork neck was also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenika Aomm

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located at the entrance of Soi Ladprao Wanghin 52.
They have rice and noodle dishes (including flat noodles).
Besides braised pork, they also have soft pork ribs, duck, and seafood. The taste is good and the service is good.
Parking is available on the street.
(The cat at the restaurant is very cute and sits to greet you.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutathip Suchiow

sample_reviews_en.text: The dry rice porridge with mixed pork was delicious! The braised pork was excellent, and the pork ribs were fantastic. This was my first time eating here, and the owner was very helpful and gave great recommendations. He was very polite and friendly, the restaurant was clean, and the atmosphere was great. Perfect for Gen Z!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakinee Pansiri

sample_reviews_en.text: A restaurant serving dry rice porridge during the day is quite rare in the Sena area. If you come here, you have to try it. The recommended dish is dry rice porridge with braised pork, but today I tried the sea bass rice porridge. It's 80 baht per bowl and has several large pieces of fish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chuchart Tritrungtassana

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted delicious. I ordered takeout to eat at home in the rain. I ordered plain braised pork with toppings and mixed seafood with dipping sauce. They even gave me some soup, which was delicious and flavorful. The soy sauce dipping …
sample_reviews_en.author: KNG Channel YouTube

restaurants.name: Hakata Tempura Nagaoka Ekkamai
restaurants.address:

345 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Do think it is a bit overpriced given the ingredients."

sample_reviews_th.text: I had the omakase set at ฿1200. It was pretty good with friendly service. Do think it is a bit overpriced given the ingredients. The shrimp tempura was pretty good but the scallop tempura was still cold in the middle (not sure whether it is supposed to be like that or not). The appetizer set was pretty interesting. The squid with mentaiko was good though the shrimp with broccoli and mayo sauce (?) was relatively underwhelming. There is parking space available at Park X but there is no stamp available at the restaurant so still have to pay for the parking fee.
sample_reviews_th.author: Napasorn

sample_reviews_th.text:
Very well Japanese tempura style !

Here’s my thought

Pros :
- Quality of foods
- Fried food are not that oily (ทอดไม่อมน้ำมันดี)
- good service, friendly staff.

Cons :
- No parking lot
- Booking in advance is recommended (tiny size of restaurant)
- a little bit expensive
sample_reviews_th.author: Napat Wadhanakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not sure what to order, we went with the omakase set for two and added the blue crab rice pot. The portions were generous—we were both full by the end, with some rice left to take home.

Each tempura dish arrived fresh and piping hot, straight from the fryer, ensuring every bite was crispy perfection. The oyster tempura stood out for its briny richness, while the charsui tempura was an unexpected yet delightful twist, blending savory pork flavors with the light batter that melted in the mouth. The shrimp tempura was a classic done right—succulent and tender—while the crab soup jelly tempura gave a refreshing break from all the flavors.

Dessert was included, and we loved both options—the fresh, vibrant strawberry and the warm, comforting apple with ice cream.

We got there early and had the place to ourselves, which made the experience even better. The service was outstanding—we got to chat with every staff member, and they made us feel welcomed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nij Mee (Zign)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Follow this resturant from Bim's youtube.
Services and staffs are very nice and polite.
The appetizers and sashimi are really great.
But after that, tempura omakases especially meat and seafood are disappointing, for example tiger prawn not fresh, bad texure, fake ikura, unpleasant uni.
Veggie tempura is good with its texture and sweetness.
Clay pot rice is a real nightmare, taste is really flat without any aroma, do you forget some mirin? sake? some ginger? fake ikura make it worsen, bad smell and unblended with rice.
Supermarket mochi tempura with ice cream ?? this is what i pay for?

With this price (2600+) I expect more quality of ingredient. Chef assistant- she doesn't know even how to use the knife, how could you dare sending her to the front of the counter??
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichet Wattanapreechanon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a special tempura shop that serves both omakase and a la cart styles. I personally prefer a la cart as we can choose what to eat. It is my second time visit, and everything remains quite the same in terms of service, quality of product, and price. There is no parking space, those who are driving should park at Park X Ekkamai building with the rate of 50 bath/hour. I made reservation via their official instagram account (fast reply).

My most favourite is Pineapple Tempura (Must order). Other recommended menus are Shirako, Black Tiger Prawn, Wagyu, Radish Oden, and Camembert cheese. The price rage is quit high, but somehow reasonable. Average price per head is around 1,500 THB ++. I only suggest you come to this shop if you are a fan of tempura.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattinan Nantasen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent tempura by young Japanese chefs. Friendly and casual atmosphere from the staffs and the chefs. Long table/counter provides a bit difficult seating arrangement. Tempura batter is thin and crispy, complement the ingredients just fine. Everything was very fresh, perfectly cooked, perfect texture preserving the integrity of each protein and produce. Only minor criticism would the ebi was not as fresh as I expected. Not bad but could be better.

The mixture of savories and sweet tempura helps with palates fatigue over long meal. Also the desserts are a must! Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somphon Potisophon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the service is good, but the price is high. (If you average 1,000 baht per person including drinks, you might not be full, but you'll get to try some unique and new dishes. To be truly full, you'd probably need to average 2,000 baht per person, or go for the omakase set at 2,600 baht for two people—prices exclude drinks and tax—which would be worthwhile. However, since we don't eat raw fish, pork, or beef, we couldn't have the omakase set. We had to order à la carte, which is a bit more expensive.)

Parking is available at Park X building for 40 baht per hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rinlita Srirojpinyo

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the spot for people who want to try a wide range of fish tempura that’s not easily available. This is a high end yet casual and relaxing place to enjoy some fresh ingredients and expert execution. I was able to come in at 4pm after checking their availability on Instagram story. Impeccable work overall by a Fukuoka chef and a caring and attentive team. It’s a treat to watch the team seamlessly run the place.

Big BUT—credit cards not accepted. Bring enough cash if you want to eat absolutely everything you want without worrying about running out of $.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ellie

restaurants.name: McDonald's Restaurant
restaurants.address:

WVFH+HGM Tukcom, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I just left McDonald's and feel like I've been through a dumpster. The service? Eh, about what you'd expect from a fast food joint. The fries? Cold as a witch's heart, and I complained like three times. The burger? Rare as a unicorn, practically raw. But the real kicker was the place itself: a total dump. Never seen a McDonald's this gross. It looked more like a post-apocalyptic wasteland than a place to eat. If you're looking for a truly unique, unforgettable, and downright disgusting dining experience, this is the spot for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Danilo Angelini

sample_reviews_en.text:
Whoever signed off on this abomination of a restaurant needs to go back to design school.
Lousy layout, cramped and uncomfortable seating and low energy staff make this McDonald's one to miss. Better making the extra effort to go to another Pattaya branch if you're looking for the true McDonald's experience . (But avoid Beach Road near Walking Street because it suffers from the same malaise.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Stanley

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a Happy Meal for takeout. The advertisement said it included a hamburger, french fries, popcorn, and a drink, but what I received was completely different. There was no popcorn. Also, when I selected a toy at the vending machine, I chose one item but received a different one. I'm very dissatisfied. The process wasn't thorough or careful. 👎
sample_reviews_en.author: Papitchaya :3

sample_reviews_en.text: For some reason, this mcdonald's location was off on the taste.When we visited it, everything had a little bit of a strange taste to me. That's one of the hallmarks of mcdonald's amazing consistency across the world.And this one really had kind of an aberrant taste to me. We'll try again because it could have just been an off night
sample_reviews_en.author: ROB PARKS USA

sample_reviews_en.text: Just went their today 18/12/25 all I wanted was a cheese burger and I was show the electronic order display. I go to Mac Donald's to buy and eat not to stand in front of a display order box the staff is there just take the order and call out my number. More people contact instead of electronic order boxes .Not happy Mac donalds
sample_reviews_en.author: Joel Adam

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here in the morning wanting to try McDonald’s in Thailand for the first time. Like many other reviews, the service here sucks pretty bad. I don’t know what’s the deal but it is just as bad as you would find it at a lot of locations …
sample_reviews_en.author: Timothy Te

sample_reviews_en.text: Easy to work with the ordering board. Pay with card or scan or pay at counter. With McDonalds App you get promotional discounts and some great deals. Clean tables, service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miksu tietty

sample_reviews_en.text:
The employee's attitude and treatment were very poor.

I hope he improves his behavior with customers. The employee was working the morning shift on Friday, July 25, 2025.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ms Malak

restaurants.name: ZEN Central Festival Pattaya
restaurants.address:

333/99 หมู่ 9 ถนน พัทยา สาย 2 ตำบล หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
took the 699+ buffet empty stomach and hungry. ordered sashimi trio(the only option). the only sad thing is that it have to come with fake crab sticks if you order that. each piece of sashimi comes with 2 slices of crab stick as shown in the picture.. it felt like a punishment to people getting the 699+ package if they want to enjoy raw fish slices. was already quite full after eating those things at the start.

staff were polite and friendly. service is a little slow. seem many tables waiting long for their food to come as they were quite under staffed.

buffet time limit is 2hours but food can take 15 to 20mins or more to arrive. when im left with 15mins there was a reminder from staff but the last course of food wasnt here yet. managed to gobble down before 2 hours mark. it was quite stressful to eat against time to avoid paying extra.

food: fried salmon belly is nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: jfree

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic sushi and food in general.
Unfortunately, the service staff is busy talking to each other instead of serving the guests.
Ordered a buffet for two people. Very long wait for the food. Several times they didn't bring what we had ordered.
Bought a liter of beer - when it was empty, they didn't come and asked for a refill.
Instead, I first ordered one mineral water. It never came... I then ordered two mineral waters - after 10 minutes I went to the "water truck" and got them myself.
The restaurant wasn't busy - about 15-20 guests in total and maybe 10 employees...
Finally, I ordered 3 sushi (the same) - I waited 21 minutes for them 😮
ZEN Central Pattaya - the staff needs to do better... Too bad when the concept is otherwise REALLY good and the food REALLY good!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pavia Rosing

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had mixed feelings about this restaurant. Later I noticed that even on Google the rating is quite low, and now I understand why. The service was strange. I came in, sat at a table, and waited for the menu. For about 5 minutes nobody came to me, the staff were just standing at the counter and, for some reason, watching me. Then they finally decided to come over.
They also have advertising banners saying there is a lunch set for 200 baht, but there are no such sets in the menu. The cheapest options start from 220 baht++, and most dishes are 300-400 baht and up. Overall, I think it’s better to go to one of the other Japanese restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maryna Y.

sample_reviews_en.text: Came in for the buffet, placed an order and the sushi never arrived, only got my drink and a side mushroom dish, after 40 minutes waiting, nobody acknowledged my existence so I stood up, went to the cashier and said I have not received my order after waiting 40 minutes, 40 minutes of hunger waiting for my food, after I complained at the front they finally bring my sushi. 6 hours later I have diarrhea, and I keep going to the toilet with liquid poop. Over 730 baht to waste my time, destroyed my mood and got diarrhea. Wish I never visited this place. A “sorry” does not fix the terrible service
sample_reviews_en.author: Rick brown

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't have much time, so I opted for à la carte. I ordered the Salmon Belly with Pepper and Salt (395 THB) set with soup and salad. The fish was very dry and the pieces were small. The salmon belly was scraps with no meat at all. It was a very disappointing quality. Be careful if you order this dish. The staff seemed tired; they promised to bring a plate but then disappeared, so I ended up getting it myself. They really shouldn't have included the service charge on the bill. Overall, it wasn't worth the money. I probably won't go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went in because there were seats available.

The drinks took forever to arrive. Only one drink came, and after repeatedly asking for more, the beer got warm before the second soda finally arrived.

The fish set meal arrived in the same manner, but the sushi never did. After asking several times, it still didn't come, so I canceled the order. Terrible service. The staff were like garbage, unable to even properly apologize. I've never seen such awful management.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tex Terada

sample_reviews_en.text:
My husband and I stopped in for lunch!
And oh my god, the rice was so delicious! 🫠😍🥰 I haven't had rice like this in a long time! It was absolutely delicious!!! The staff was so friendly and attentive!
Thanks so much to the chef for the delicious food! 🙏🏻🤗
The only downside is there's no coffee! 😩
My husband and I decided we'll come here again! I highly recommend this restaurant! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Алена Лисичкина

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. The staff were standing around chatting in front of the shop, ignoring customers. Some orders were missed, and I waited over 15 minutes with no one checking on my order. The staff said the bill had just been processed, but the system showed it had been sent a long time ago. I strongly do not recommend this place. 👎👎👎👎👎
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattarika Klinkajorn

restaurants.name: Krua Sathon
restaurants.address:

26, 59 Chan Rd, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Old-time family restaurant that serves “cook shop” style food.

“Cook Shop” is the term for the type of restaurants that runs by Chinese chefs that cook East-meet-West dishes of steaks, salads, soups and breads made from local ingredients and their interpretation of Western food.

The unique dishes are the moistened ox tongue stew, as well as, the freshly made bread with chicken curry which is rather light and mild than being thick and spicy
The chef originally worked at the famous, Silom Restaurant (สีลมภัตตาคาร), to Sathorn Kitchen (ครัวสาธร) - this one.
sample_reviews_th.author: theerada suphaphong

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came here because we saw it was a Thai-style cookshop. The atmosphere is family-friendly, there's parking, the prices are normal, and there are plenty of lovely staff who are attentive and helpful with recommendations.

The beef tongue stew was tender and delicious, but the flavor wasn't as strong as I'd hoped. I've only ever had it made in Japan, never in a Thai restaurant, so I wasn't sure if that's normal.
The braised pork with vegetables (I can't remember the name of the dish) was delicious! The pork was tender and the bones easily separated, and the flavor was great. The vegetables were sweet too.
The stir-fried morning glory was also delicious.
The coffee ice cream was tasty as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lady Rinna

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good and there's parking available, but the service is absolutely terrible. The staff are grumpy, unwilling to serve, turn off the air conditioning, are noisy, and chase customers away. Their page states closing time is 9:30 PM, but they turned off the air conditioning and kicked customers out at 9:00 PM. No matter how good the food is, if the service is bad, I won't go back. They were rude to customers but charged a 10% service charge. If they're unwilling to serve, they shouldn't be charging a service charge at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Untitled Untitled

sample_reviews_en.text: We had our Triam Udom Suksa Class 726 reunion here. The atmosphere was warm and friendly, yet very upscale. The food was meticulously prepared and incredibly delicious. We reminisced about old times, from 1979, our high school years, the entrance exam, working lives, and even reconnecting with friends who couldn't make it, all the way to our children's weddings. The owner recommended the roti and sour curry with water spinach, and we weren't disappointed. We'll definitely be back here for our next reunion!
sample_reviews_en.author: Golden Dragon Productions

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is surprisingly close to being in the heart of Sathorn. Stepping inside feels like being lost in a forest, but the atmosphere is incredibly lush and the place is much larger than expected. The food is a fusion of Italian and Thai, with flavors ranging from average to excellent. It's suitable for family meals. The staff are lovely and provide great service. There are plenty of photo opportunities, and parking is available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack Ekkayuth

sample_reviews_en.text: I understand that a chef from Silom Restraurant ( a famous old restraurant I knew since childhood. I'm now in the early seventies) has moved here after Silom Restraurant moved to Kalapapreuk road. You can find signature dishes of Silom Restraurant here which include chicken curry, roasted pork rib, beef salad, braised ox tongue, etc. And many more other tastety dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manasilp Dumrisomkul

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai restaurant on Chan road not so far from Chan-Naradhiwas intersection and Market Place Nang Linchi. This time I order beef tongue stew and fried soft shell crab with garlic and pepper. At first sight it look not in a good shape as I expected, but not to judge a book by its cover, it taste very good. The price is reasonable, quite cheap in Sathon area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisutdhi Jitnuyanond

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, there's convenient parking, and the prices are reasonable. If you miss traditional cookshop-style food, this is a convenient and comfortable place to dine. Today I had the crispy noodles, baked pork ribs, beef tenderloin salad, and finished with ice cream and jelly. ❤️❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Soamshine B

restaurants.name: ข้าวต้มแห้งคุณนิด สาขา เยาวราช X ก๋วยเตี๋ยวลูกชิ้นปลาเจ๊ส้ม
restaurants.address:

469 Phlap Phla Chai Rd, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I went to the Tai Hong Kong Temple to pay respects and make merit for the annual Chinese New Year.
Today is called Chiu Chik (the 7th day of Chinese New Year).

After making merit and donating, my stomach was rumbling.
So I stopped by this restaurant and ordered two bowls (dry thin noodles).

The thin noodles were perfectly cooked and soft, the meatballs were delicious, and I added a little seasoning to make it slightly spicy 😆😆

The restaurant has many other dishes too. I have to try them all next time. Today I'm full of both merit and food 😍🥰

The restaurant accepts QR code scanning. The place looks clean, maybe a little small, but the wait wasn't long.

60 baht per bowl, not expensive, the portion is just right. My boyfriend even ordered a second bowl, haha.

Give the restaurant a kiss! ☺️
Chokchai AIA
It's better to have it than to need it and not have it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Chokchai Metapipattanakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥢 Je Som's Fish Ball Noodle Shop (Yaowarat Branch) x Khun Nid's Dry Rice Porridge. This shop is located near Phlapphla Chai Police Station.

•I've eaten here 2-3 times. They have a good variety of dishes.

Including clear noodle soup, tom yum, yen ta fo, dry rice porridge, roasted pork rice, fish maw soup, and snacks.

•I like their noodles. The fish balls are homemade, without flour or chemicals. They have a chewy, bouncy texture and are delicious. The shrimp balls have a nice shrimp aroma.
•I ordered the wonton noodle soup; the broth was flavorful and delicious without needing any extra seasoning. I also wanted to try the roasted pork rice, and it was surprisingly delicious.

📍 100 meters from Phlapphla Chai Police Station
🕰️ 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM / Closed Wednesdays
🚆 MRT Wat Mangkon

#noodles #JeSomsFishBallNoodles
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnaporn Siriviriya

sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous dry rice porridge shop has a branch that also serves fish ball noodles.

The menu includes both dry rice porridge and noodles.
You can choose your toppings; the price varies depending on your selection.

Today I tried the mixed pork noodles with an onsen egg.
I really liked it. The noodles were good, and the toppings were decent and not smelly.
They recommended adding some soy sauce dip, which made it even better.

The other bowl was a cold Yentafo soup. It was fairly standard, but not amazing.

The shop doesn't have air conditioning, but it wasn't hot. It's clean and comfortable.
The owner and staff are lovely and willing to serve.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichsaran Ves

sample_reviews_en.text: I happened to be visiting Ya Faeng's shrine and was hungry, so I found this restaurant. The menu looked appealing, so I ordered the baked pork and crispy pork rice. It was delicious, very flavorful. The Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) was also tasty. I really liked the chrysanthemum tea; it wasn't overly sweet, just mildly sweet. The fried pork dumplings were also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hi, MAMMY

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second visit, and the food is still as delicious as before. The dry rice porridge, both with pork and offal, is tasty and flavorful with no unpleasant smell. The dry noodles are delicious without needing any extra seasoning. I especially love the fish cake (Huer Kwai) in the blanched dishes; it's delicious, flavorful, and has a chewy texture.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jip Arun

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! The fish balls are really tasty, and the broth is refreshing – not too bland, not too strong. I like that they offer flat noodles and you can pay by scan. Most shops around here only accept cash, so people without money can't eat here. This shop is a lifesaver, and it's delicious too! Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Guiide Rotchanaseri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered through a food delivery app. The dry rice porridge had good toppings, but the rice itself was just okay. The soup was delicious, and the dipping sauce was a bit sweet.
The iced coffee (O-liang) was delicious, strong, and really woke me up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Venus Vannaprapa

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish balls are delicious and exactly as pictured, a must-try signature item. They're homemade, incredibly soft and juicy, with a flavor similar to Yaowarat fish balls but with a different texture. The other fish balls are also tasty and …
sample_reviews_en.author: Torpong Chiamtawongse

restaurants.name: Brio
restaurants.address:

2571-3 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Samrae, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
A mistake we made on Christmas was having  lunch here. The foods were tasteless.

We ordered  an Angus steak (1,800++) which tasted weird.
I think it’s not good Angus beef or it may be Meltique.

The other dishes also tasted cheap.

The weirdest thing was their black truffles, thick slices, but NO AROMA “at all”. I didn’t smell anything.
I also asked 3 waitresses about this. But I got no answer back.

I don’t even like their olive oil and balsamic.

The service should be improved.

We paid ฿6,811. Nothing was worth the price.
We were so disappointed.
sample_reviews_th.author: Bebby

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had a wonderful dining experience and would highly recommend this restaurant!

The fish was outstanding—perfectly cooked, incredibly fresh, and full of flavor. The pasta was equally delicious and authentically prepared. To finish, we enjoyed a warm chocolate lava cake that was absolutely amazing, and the tiramisu was one of the best we have ever had—rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced.

A special thank you to Arm and Book for their exceptional service. They were both incredibly friendly, attentive, and welcoming, making our evening even more enjoyable.

We will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadja

sample_reviews_en.text: I had been there before with my kids and didn't think much of it. This time I went with w good friend who knew how to order. Start with a cold beer. Rocket salad, some cheeses, two different pastas (seafoods olio and mushroom cream), and wonderful tiramisu plus coffee gelato. It also had a wonderful wine list. We had a great bottle of red wine. The servers were superb. I would go for a boozy lunch and stay until 4pm!
sample_reviews_en.author: S Bobby Gerjarusak
