sample_reviews_en.text: The place is beautiful and more than wonderful, and the food was absolutely amazing, authentic Italian flavor. We also thank the employee for her excellent cooperation and for sharing her knowledge about the dishes. She was friendly, helpful, and kind. We commend her and wish her continued success in serving customers at Iceland. We also thank the wonderful staff and their collaborative spirit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Haitham Alaghbari

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came to Brio restaurant in Anantara Riverside and I was very satisfied with the service. All the staff were so kind and the atmosphere as well as the food was so delicious! It was a really pleasant experience.

I am especially satisfied with the staff service.
Hostes. wawa
Waiter. tle, korn
Super. Tik
I think today will be a happy day.
sample_reviews_en.author: 이석

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious Italian food and excellent quality. The food is comparable to Italy and the quality of the ingredients is amazing. We ate here on our first night in Bangkok after a long day of travelling and this was the perfect meal to start our holiday! A big thank you to the team, Arm, Ice, Tle and Korn - we really enjoyed our meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sapna Patel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Italian restaurant with all you can eat pizza & pasta.
With a 1k baht prize, it's really worth it.
Even though the menu had not many choices, but the taste was so rich and yummy.
The pizza was thin crust style.
Finally don't forget to try a tiramisu.
It's not included in a package, but believe me it really nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: sarasate eimatanasate

sample_reviews_en.text:
Our last visit was not satisfied with the taste and food quality.

Food were just eatable. Not tasty for all dishes.

It was a bit over price compare to the portion.

The resturant is under renovation.

We were stunned with the smell of painting colour.

Staffs were well-trainned with good service mind.
sample_reviews_en.author: CottoN

sample_reviews_en.text: A cozy hidden street coffee spot in Bangkok with a great local vibe. They use dark roast beans, offer various milk options, and the coffee tastes rich and smooth. Friendly service and a nicely designed shop. Prices are very affordable—latte is only 65 baht. Perfect for a chill break.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thant Sin Htet Aung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Strolling down Memory Lane, I found this brand new coffeeshop around the block 🌃

The iconic Honda Astra stole my attention just like my late grandpa's belongings 🛵 & the Dyson air purifier though 💨

Optioned for 🍋🥤 to fuel the day

Thank you for the warm welcome 😇
sample_reviews_en.author: khlfiz

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop has a cool, retro style with vibrant colors that stand out in this neighborhood, haha. They have a variety of interesting coffee options at reasonable prices, but today I'll start with a hot chocolate. It's rich and flavorful, and delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: siriporn poonkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: Alien-themed cafe! 👽 The atmosphere is friendly and the prices are reasonable. I had an Americano with orange juice to drink in the cafe; the coffee strength was just right, very refreshing. I also ordered Thai tea to go; it was very …
sample_reviews_en.author: PangNF

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice coffee shop with original italian coffee machine.

Coffee has a very good taste and it can be chosen between medium and dark beans.

Besides classic coffee, there is also extraordinary coffee with coconut and other.
Great little coffee shop, with an interesting drink menu. The matcha fruit soda and ice cappuccino we had were both delicious! We also bought a local craft soda to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zee Hoople

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop's decor is cute and nice. The food and drinks are more affordable than I expected. The food I ordered today was delicious. I'll definitely come back again! 🥰 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Natchaya Kollawat

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a lovely shop with great photo opportunities and a friendly atmosphere. The hot chocolate is delicious and the prices are reasonable. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Usanee Rittispn

restaurants.name: Tandoori Night Indian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

083 Buakhaow 15, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Avoid at all costs. Save yourself from food poisoning. In 54 years of enjoying Indian food this was by far the worst food I have been served. So much so that when the food was delivered to our table we looked at it then paid and left. Chicken was a greasy grey in colour and full of bones. Rice was dried out and looked like it had been cooked quite a while ago. We broke our own rule not to eat in an empty restaurant so are partly to blame
sample_reviews_en.author: graham dickinson

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is just ok but not worth it. We experienced the worst service of our lifetime here. They only have two chefs and one waiter for service. They are not handling the dining but also the take aways of Grab App as well, that's why they have very slow and poor service. The waiter also gets hyper when he is asked to bring the food timely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Muhayy u Din

sample_reviews_en.text: Horrible! Paid 700 up baht for TINY(barely fitting in the palm of my hand)  portions, butter chicken looks like it was watered down, and cucumber salad presented on grab is just sliced-up cucumber for 89 baht. Tasteless butter chicken and watery! 😡😡😡
sample_reviews_en.author: Albina Kanyuka

sample_reviews_en.text: Just stopped to have a quick lunch - Mushroom Masala with Butter Roti. Excellent flavoured sauce and the Roti's were delicious - golden in colour and a nice accompaniment to the masala. Will definitely eat there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Len Lever

sample_reviews_en.text: There seems to be a reason why restaurants with customer ratings of 3 stars. The spinach curry tasted like seaweed and was not good. It was not cheap either. It was my fault for being fooled by the Grab advertisement.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Oh

sample_reviews_en.text: Chicken masala was very bad in taste. Chicken peices were not fresh and smelled  like fish. Portion was very low. They said Chiken biryani was their speciality, but sadly, that's very poor quality biryani.
sample_reviews_en.author: snehalkumar sankpal

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered off grab to a nice fish and chips photo one big whole piece when it arrived it came in the smallest box possible with chopped up multiple pieces of fish that’s breadcrumbed not batter fried
sample_reviews_en.author: P

sample_reviews_en.text: The biryani was the worst biryani I ever had in here, it was like Tiryani not Biryani. So expensive and the feeling of eating biryani was lost after I had biryani in this restaurant on 24.10.2024.
sample_reviews_en.author: Establishment 22

restaurants.name: 369烧烤海鲜 369บาร์บีคิวซีฟู้ด 369BBQ seafood
restaurants.address:

425, 10 Pattaya Sai 2, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This will probably be my only time.
From a person who loves Mala BBQ so much.
Many of the dishes tasted terrible. The grilled eggplant had no flavor other than saltiness. The BBQ was grilled too dry and burnt. Many of the meats had a sour smell. The grilled corn was tough and soggy.
The price was also expensive and not worth it.
As for the atmosphere inside the restaurant, smoking is allowed, which is highly discouraged if you're bringing children.
The service from the staff was good, but the other thing was, I ordered one thing and got another, and the food was incomplete.
sample_reviews_en.author: June Thirteen

sample_reviews_en.text: Two people spent over 3000 baht on a terrible meal. The shrimp was rotten, and there were crawling worms in it. When we complained, a man from Northeast China loudly told me, "It can't be rotten; he bought it today." If that's the case, either you bought rotten fish and shrimp, or your cook cooked the shrimp badly—the menu said crayfish, but the dish served was shrimp from the seafood market. I'll never do this kind of one-off business again. Only Chinese people eat there.
sample_reviews_en.author: X F

sample_reviews_en.text: Walk past and decide to give it a try. You can use ipad to order and it come with English and Chinese. Although the English menu could be a little confusing base on the name and description, but thankfully I'm able to understand. Food taste good and price is value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zhi Wee

sample_reviews_en.text: A great place if you're craving Korean kebabs! The lamb kebabs are absolutely delicious! I highly recommend them. A small kebab costs 30 baht, and I had seven of them, which is a very satisfying meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nerzon

sample_reviews_en.text: PLEASE DO NOT eat here. They are a terrible bunch of people, obviously. They keep large monitor lizards in a small cage outside, just for publicity. This is blatant animal cruelty!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohamad Mahdi

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is too high, the ingredients are cheap, the taste is no different from street BBQ, the service attitude is arrogant, there is no reason to patronize again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chi keung Chan

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a delicious Northeast China barbecue restaurant, with many ingredients sourced from China. It's a great choice for those who love Chinese food.
sample_reviews_en.author: RUSH Wang

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and fresh. I visited by chance and was extremely satisfied. Everyone should try it. The staff were very lovely and enthusiastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanh Phan

restaurants.name: Papa burger
restaurants.address:

Thappraya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Well, first time in Thailand traveling from the United States, my brother and cousin and I stopped by there and was welcomed like we're at home.Mr. Raz(pappa Burger) And his 2 sons are amazing people and take pride and instill  quality and the work they do . I would recommend anyone that stops by To try his double beef mushroom cheeseburger, it's incredible, and that's coming from a Detroit city boy from the States. We will see you in April and finish Recoding Good Friend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jody Caruana

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent chicken burger, clean, proper restaurant with easy to find signage, many options to choose from, and if you need cannabis, they have quality products from what I can sense.  I was there for the food and I am glad I stopped in to try the burger.  They make their own bread buns, which is a plus!  Try it, I think you will like the burgers. It is tough to really improve on the product, the chicken was juicy and seasoned right.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chok Dee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Second time eating here, the cheeseburger is affordable and a good quick snack but their (signature) mushroom burger is something else, almost too big to handle, juicy without leaking, full of flavor: the food is simply amazing!
It’s a family run business with a weed dispensary on the 2nd floor, so they will serve everything you need ;)
Also they have some cats, truly adorable😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenny van Weert

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely burger shop. The mushroom sex burger is amazing!! Must try. Family owned and they are very friendly people. Also there are 4 adorable cats (they don't come near the food, but it's great to cuddle them and play with them)
Weed dispensary is upstairs on the second floor. In case you get the munchies after it's a win win.
Will definitely return on my next trip to Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kim M-McG

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came to try the falafel burger as I’m vegetarian.   I was very impressed with the good quality ingredients and very authentic classic burger taste, from the sauce to the pickles.
Delicious.  Washed it down with the banana milkshake (with real banana) and I enjoyed it.
sample_reviews_en.author: beachphilosophy

sample_reviews_en.text: The burgers are really delicious! The place is combined with a coffee shop (on the second floor), but that doesn't bother us. We went during the day, and there was no one else in the place. We stopped in by chance and were pleasantly surprised!
sample_reviews_en.author: _NRP_ _NRP_

sample_reviews_en.text: I was looking for a place to eat and saw this 5-star place on the map, so of course I stopped in. The burger was delicious, and most importantly, the staff was very friendly. It's definitely 5 stars. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Артём Барковский

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good afternoon!
Cozy place, delicious food.
Attentive owner.
At the end, they asked if everything was to our liking and gave us a free scoop of ice cream. It was very nice, thank you for the great atmosphere and service. 😇
sample_reviews_en.author: Руслан Камалов
