restaurants.address:

268 Phet Kasem Rd, Bang Khae Nuea, Bang Khae, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I often go to the mall and saw that Prakai Chan had opened a shop there. I bought some to try and found it delicious; the dough was very soft.
sample_reviews_en.author: preeyaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like the steamed buns from this shop. The dough is soft, fragrant, the filling is generous, and they're very delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lookmoo Netnapa

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good. The staff provided good service and gave good recommendations. I really like it. It's very delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: นภสร ปัตภี

sample_reviews_en.text: The steamed buns with braised pork filling are so delicious! I always buy them whenever I shop at Lotus.
sample_reviews_en.author: D Sarocha

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a long time since I ate this, and now I'm back for another round! It's delicious!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: better better

sample_reviews_en.text: The steamed buns were delicious! The seller was very friendly and gave good recommendations.
sample_reviews_en.author: rit ra

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I buy it often. Highly recommend it. This is the Lotus Bang Khae branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pema Paphan

restaurants.name: Ramyun Kitchen (EmSphere)
restaurants.address:

628 Emsphere, G Floor, Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I often find myself overwhelmed by choices when I visit Emsphere, but yesterday, I discovered a gem that made my day. Nestled in the food court area. While it’s not a traditional restaurant, the setup is perfect for casual dining.

The flavors were bold, the portion was satisfying, and it came with side dishes of fermented kimchi and fermented white radish. The spice level was higher than I anticipated, so if you’re not a fan of spicy food, I recommend asking them to go easy on the chili flakes.

The only thing I would tweak is the tangy sourness, which I prefer a bit stronger. Price-wise, it’s on the higher side for a meal at 250 baht, but considering the quality, it felt reasonable. If you’re craving Korean food at Emsphere, this place is definitely worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Naw Hsu Ei Thin Zar (kk)

sample_reviews_en.text: The ramyun was very tasty and seems like what a professional chef would do to a pack of store-bought buldak instant noodles (which is what they use). It’s definitely a cheat meal, because of the cream and salt, but it was thoroughly enjoyable. What ruined the experience was the rancid service. I was “helped” by the rudest woman I’ve met in all of Thailand, with zero sense of customer service and a rude stare. At that point I wish I could have just ordered via a digital kiosk or online.
sample_reviews_en.author: Felipe Latorre

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're craving delicious Korean noodle soups, kimchi rice and fried chicken, Ramyun Kitchen at EmSphere is a good-try. Known for its generous portions and customizable spice levels, different flavors . This casual restaurant offers a flavorful experience. It is located at food court area so self-service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried the Korean stall at the EMSPHERE food court today. The food was decent—nothing particularly memorable, but it satisfied the craving. What I enjoyed most was the food court itself: spacious, clean, and surprisingly comfortable, making it a nice place to sit, relax, and enjoy a meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Archie C

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lady on desk said "it's little bit spicy" haha 🥵
It's nothing like carbonara, more like 7/11 instant noodles with lots of red pepper and raw egg. Thai style, definitely not Korean. I left the food, it's insanely hot/spicy for European people, they should stop lying to the customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dmitry Kashin

sample_reviews_en.text: The tonkatsu kimbap was just okay - I wouldn't rush to get it again. It came with a side of kimchi and a tonkatsu sauce for dipping, and personally I felt that the radish was too big a chunk for this roll, distracting the flavors of what I was eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Only Honest Reviews

sample_reviews_en.text:
A lovely place at the heart of the mall , I must admit I wanted to die just smelling their ramen chicken biltak carbonara , the smell was like a processed food that was just heated

But the fried rice was a stunning loved the flavour and spice so much
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. V (The Hybrid Bite)

sample_reviews_en.text: Super slow and was served meat instead of the veggie version during the vegetarian festival. When I returned the meal and asked whether we could keep the wasted meal for my girlfriend, they refused and threw it away instead. Not recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jürgen Stolzlechner (Jéo)

restaurants.name: BELGO - BELGIAN BRASSERIE
restaurants.address:

อาคาร Groove ชั้น 2 208 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We’ve enjoyed Belgo
already for the fourth time as a refreshing escape from the constant stream of Asian food in Bangkok, and our first three visits were genuinely excellent. Unfortunately, our most recent experience fell short of what we’ve come to expect.

A new staff member was working in the service team, and although friendly, it was clear he was still learning. This led to a few mistakes with our order. Instead of the requested double mayonnaise, we received two portions of fries at the table.
My salmon, which I ordered medium‑raw, arrived far too raw, to the point that I couldn’t finish it. The béarnaise sauce that normally accompanies the dish never arrived at all.

It’s a shame, because Belgo has been a reliable place for us when we want something different because we stay always a long time in Bangkok.

And to my utter astonishment, when I got back to the hotel I saw that they had charged for those extra portions of fries which we didn’t order as well, so BE CAREFUL when you pay; we are definitely not going back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rene de B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stopped by Belgo Belgian Brasserie at Groove @ CentralWorld in Bangkok and had a great experience.

The restaurant brings a true Belgian brasserie atmosphere to the heart of Bangkok, with an impressive selection of Belgian beers and a menu featuring classic Belgian favorites. The food was well prepared, the service was attentive, and the overall atmosphere was lively without being overwhelming.

If you're looking for something different from the usual dining options in Bangkok, Belgo is worth a visit. Whether you're a fan of Belgian beer, mussels, fries, hearty European comfort food, or simply want to try something new, this place delivers.

A welcome addition to Bangkok's dining scene, and I'll definitely be back.
★★★★★
sample_reviews_en.author: Scott Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came in for some snacks and a beer.  I definitely want to return and try some of their more substantial entrees.

The Belgian fries were a miss for me.  My impression was that they not hand cut or cooked in a traditional beef tallow oil.  Please correct me if I am wrong but they had sort of a burnt aftertaste.

The Bitterballen were excellent.  Served with a mustard, this was a large portion.

They have several Belgian style house made beers.  I opted for the reliable imported La Chouffe.

The staff was both courteous and engaging and the brassiere really does give off a Brussels vibe even though we’re in downtown Bangkok.  Plenty of polish brass everywhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Bruneel

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s only been about a month since Belgo opened, and we’ve already been there twice whenever passing by Central World.
The place has a true brasserie feel, convivial, lively, and warmly welcoming, which brings a refreshing and different vibe compared to the usual mall restaurants.
The selection of Belgian beers, brewed in-house, is excellent and worth the visit on its own. And while we love Thai food, it’s a real pleasure to enjoy a lunch or dinner here, with a menu inspired by Belgian and international cuisine, with subtle Thai touches.
A genuinely warm and friendly spot, also very kids-friendly: perfect for relaxed moments with family or friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeremy Keen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited on Saturday afternoon with my wife and daughter and was immediately drawn to the colonial-style décor and natural light. The design has a stylish, modern colonial feel, with a subtle “Tintin in Asia” vibe.

There’s both a bar and dining area, with a pleasant atmosphere and a warm welcome.

The menu is decent, but you really come here for the beer. My cherry Belgian beer was excellent, and my wife enjoyed her pineapple juice. We also had fries, a Belgo salad, spaghetti bolognese, and a waffle — all good.

Friendly staff throughout. I’ll definitely return, next time to try the bar area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sylvain D

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful, the atmosphere is great, and the decor is lovely. It's a perfect place for both dining and relaxing. The food is delicious in every dish, and the ingredients are of high quality, making it excellent value for money. What impressed me most was the service from the staff. Everyone was smiling, polite, attentive, and provided great care throughout the meal. Overall, it's a restaurant that has it all: great atmosphere, delicious food, and excellent service. I was very impressed and will definitely return again.
sample_reviews_en.author: NTT PKK

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time trying Belgian food. Overall, it was a pleasant experience, although the dishes were not particularly memorable. The French fries were excellent (crispy and better than average)

The Flammekueche (similar to a pizza) had a nicely crispy crust and was enjoyable. The mussels in white wine sauce  and waffle
were also flavorful

The restaurant is a bit pricey, but the service was attentive and professional.

Conveniently located on the 2nd floor of Groove, with easy access via the skywalk connecting to CentralWorld.
sample_reviews_en.author: KinTiewBaoBao

sample_reviews_en.text: The bitterballen were very tasty. There was plenty of meat in them. However, regarding the Dijon mustard, I have my doubts as to whether it really is Dijon mustard. The flavor was far too mild. In addition to the bitterballen, we also tasted the "Sausage combo". However, this was disappointing. I suspect that the sausages are thawed just before frying, making them very watery. Also, the flavors of the sausages themselves did not appeal to me. One of the sausages was even spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dieter Wijnen

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือ ป.ประทีป สาขาลาดพร้าว 122
restaurants.address:

249 Lat Phrao 122 Alley, Phlabphla, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10312, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I ordered beef noodle soup and got two pieces of beef and two meatballs for 30฿. The beef flew off in two breaths! (The picture shows the food before I even took a bite.)
sample_reviews_th.author: Natcha Prachayakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was absolutely terrible, especially the woman with long hair in the white shirt. She had an unwelcoming expression, ignored the bill, and when calculating the bill, she didn't even say the price, just showed it on the machine screen. After I transferred the money, she didn't even say thank you. While I was eating, she slammed things around, even throwing a basket of vegetables – it was like she didn't want to work at all. I was so confused. The noodles were delicious though; I wanted to order more because I was still full, but after seeing the staff's behavior, I quickly asked for the bill. If this kind of staff continues, I will never go back. It was awful. The bill time is as shown on the slip. If the owner sees this, please review the security camera footage and reprimand the staff for their poor customer service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patiya Prakoppran

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was too strong, like the flavors were overpowering, I'm not sure why. It's very expensive and the portion is small; I finished it in three bites. Even ordering the special, I only got two pieces of meat! The staff should quit and go play games; they played so much I didn't dare order more. They acted like I was asking for free food, and didn't even say thank you. How will the owner improve this? I've seen many reviews saying the same thing, but this is my first and last time here.
sample_reviews_en.author: สมัคร ศันสนีย์

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! I just ate there yesterday. The broth is flavorful, the pork and liver are perfectly cooked, and the meatballs are tasty. If you don't like spicy food, you can order it less spicy. The flavor is a mix of sweet and sour. Yesterday I tried both the regular and less spicy versions, and both were delicious. I ate 4 bowls and 2 servings of crispy pork rinds! This is definitely going to be one of my regular restaurants. The owner is also very nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: BunnyBen Jong

sample_reviews_en.text: Let me be honest. I bought two bowls of boat noodles to take home for 50 baht each. I couldn't even get five spoonfuls out of them. It's the smallest portion I've ever eaten in this area, and I'll probably only eat there once. If you want a filling meal, I recommend going to another restaurant; it's not suitable as a main course. But if you just want it as an appetizer, I'd recommend it – the small portion is great, and it's only spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: MusDiary Channel

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the dirtiest restaurant I've ever eaten at. I wonder if I'll catch mold from eating their noodles?

The major problems are:
1. The wooden chopsticks were extremely dirty and covered in black mold.
2. When I asked the staff for new chopsticks, they responded curtly, "No, we don't have any."
3. There wasn't even an apology or any offer of advice.
4. This is the only restaurant where customers have to go buy their own chopsticks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapan Wongwicha

sample_reviews_en.text: After reading the reviews, I was hesitant to try it because they weren't very good, but I decided to give it a try anyway. The flavor was well-balanced, the broth was thick, and it had a strong aroma of roasted chili peppers. Overall, it was delicious! No need to add any seasoning. Prices start at 20 baht, and they have both pork and beef. Overall, it's worth the price and the taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicha Than.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service staff was terrible, both male and female. Customers were constantly on their phones, playing games like ROV. Customers had to go and hand in the bill themselves and stood there for a long time before the staff finally paid attention. It's confusing; we weren't asking for free food, you know.
Please improve your staff service.
sample_reviews_en.author: tim tie

restaurants.name: Chicky Chic (ชิกกี้ชิก) สาธุประดิษฐ์
restaurants.address:

617 Sathu Pradit Rd, บางโพงพาง, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious. The staffs are very good. I buy so often that I have to become a member of this shop. I really like the fish nuggets.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dec c

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and satisfying, generous portions, and the vendor is kind, always offering discounts and freebies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patchawat Chumpetch

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff provided good service, the restaurant was clean, and the food was reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pai loie

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff are lovely and give good product recommendations. Please come and support us a lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: นบชนก กรจิรโสภณ

sample_reviews_en.text: It smelled so good while driving past! And it was delicious when I finally got to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: วรัญญา ทิพดง

restaurants.name: Momento
restaurants.address:

Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This used to be one of my favorite restaurants in Pattaya. Now, our second visit is disappointing. We ordered medium-rare steaks, and they brought us some strange meat called "well done." The waitress spent a long time picking at it with her fork and hands. About 10 minutes later, the hostess came over and said they'd redo it. No apology, no compliments, nothing. In the end, they brought us meat with a light crust on top—seared in a pan for about 20 seconds, but raw and cold inside! They brought a hot stone with the dish and told us we had to fry it ourselves. So, we kept frying, but the stone wasn't hot enough for the steak. The meat certainly got warmer, but the texture was boiled. Overall, it was a complete waste of time, and two steaks cost 1,000 baht.
I'd also like to point out the completely incompetent staff. Even a simple Thai restaurant would give you better service...
sample_reviews_en.author: Анфиса

sample_reviews_en.text:
An absolutely incredible stay at Momento Beach Resort, Pattaya!

A huge thank you to the owners, Didier and his wife Géraldine, wonderful people, always smiling, welcoming, and attentive to their guests. You truly feel at home from the moment you arrive.

The food is simply exceptional 🤤🔥
Every dish is a delight: flavorful, generous, and beautifully presented. The food is incredible, honestly a real pleasure from morning till night. You can taste the quality and passion in every plate.

The pool is magnificent, well-maintained, very pleasant, and above all, perfectly sunny ☀️🌴 A true haven of peace to relax and fully enjoy your vacation.

The hotel is superbly run, the atmosphere is warm, and the owners are incredibly helpful and attentive.

I highly recommend this place! A must-visit in Pattaya 👌✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Ammar Ramda

sample_reviews_en.text: I have visited this restaurant three times in the past. All three times, I ordered the chicken dish that comes on a sword, an excellent dish! This time there was a waitress who did not speak proper English, a really bad accent! The menu is in French and there are very few words in English and I asked the waitress to explain it to me and she got angry at me and shouted that it was chicken, don't you know what chicken is? She simply did not know how to explain in proper English how to say grilled chicken. She started talking all kinds of nonsense and started shouting at me and getting angry when I asked her.. My Thai wife tried to understand in Thai, but in vain! The waitress was really angry and shouted at us. I will never return to this place. Bad and unbearable service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roy Tapiro

sample_reviews_en.text:
A lovely setting, but the food and service were abysmal.

We came to Momento Beach hoping for a pleasant evening, but the charm of the location unfortunately couldn't mask the disaster on the plate. The price-quality ratio is simply outrageous.

The kebabs (chicken and duck) were grilled in name only; the flavor was completely absent. The fries, swimming in oil, seemed to have been repeatedly deep-fried. To accompany this, a béarnaise sauce was charged at an extra 80 THB, but served in such a meager portion that it was more of a sample than a side dish.

Reflecting the poor management of the establishment, the owner at the reception remained utterly indifferent, not even bothering to ask about our satisfaction when it came time to pay the bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gilles Thomas

sample_reviews_en.text: Did a work vacation type thing. Only going to stay a few days. But I ended up for a couple weeks. Awesome place and people. Owners are super polite a d care about food and there customers. The food made me fat I ate so much. ( French Cuisine  )  The reason why the price for dinner is high must be my few beers and a aperitif.  Although it's good. You cant eat all the time here. I found other good and bad options in walking distance.  There is everything close by you need. And taxi take you anywhere cheap to explore the busy parts on Pattaya. I have previously stay down on the strip in top end hotels.  If I ever back to Pattaya, Momento Resort will be my choice
sample_reviews_en.author: Ed George

sample_reviews_en.text:
There were six of us who came for dinner two nights in a row.

The food is very good, prepared by the owner himself.

Very generous portions.

We were also warmly welcomed by the manager.
A parrot at the entrance nods its head to you; its cage is always open, so it's free to come and go... Animal lovers are my friends!

The setting is beautiful with a lovely pool.
The owner offered us some mango tarts from his latest creation at the end of the meal!
I highly recommend it and I will definitely return on my next trip to Pattaya!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mehdi Many

sample_reviews_en.text: A warm welcome awaits you; the owner always has a smile and is always ready to help. I had serious back problems, and the owner changed my bedding two days after my request. The service was perfect, the large swimming pool is idyllic, and the setting is beautiful, surrounded by lush vegetation with very pleasant background music throughout the day. I come back to this establishment with great pleasure for at least six months a year. I highly recommend you all come and discover this place. Bruno
sample_reviews_en.author: Special Assurance

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very pleasant, peaceful, and original place, with some effort put into the decor.

The meal was perfect. I recommend the kebabs, which were delicious and generous... there were six of us, but we didn't see the owner, who is apparently much nicer than the owner's wife, who keeps coming back, snubbing you, and practically berating you if you have the audacity to try to pay with a credit card... in short, apart from this deplorable welcome, a very pleasant evening!
sample_reviews_en.author: CHRISTIAN LESCORNEC

restaurants.name: Food Exchange
restaurants.address:

ชั้น7 โรงแรมNovotel Bangkok 19/9 Sukhumvit 20 Alley, Khlong Toei, เขต คลองตัน Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
1399 Baht per person snow crab buffet dinner review.

FOOD:

The pumpkins were spoiled. Must have been since noon. This point is unacceptable.

The snow crabs were not so fresh. Didn't expect fresh but was a bit worse. Good that it is quite meaty.

The stone lobsters were kind of dark. The grill section seems fresh. Lamb was okay. Beef was no seasoning. Prawns were okay.

Sushi is a disgrace.

The ready to be spooned and taken food were overcooked. Fish is dry. I suspect the pork to be dry to.

There were only three cheeses, gouda, blue, and brie. Pasta and cooked blood noodle seems average. The baked fish was empty already.

There's only coffee or tea. Alcohol, soft drinks are charged for extra.

The crepe with blueberry jam was good. The small red berry jam tart was good.

SERVICE:

Initially gotten a table in a dark side, no light above the table. Had to ask for a new table. Service seems quite busy even with very few tables booked. Still water had to be waited for repours.

ATMOSPHERE:

Normal music. Few people.

SUMMARY:

Too pricey. There are better food choices at this price. The snow/king crab was fridge born. No dish had the word quality stood out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcharanon Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Below my expectation
Services: front staff is helpless when we tried to call the hotel and asked for parking lot as its full due to wedding event. Staff could not help anything but asked us to contact the bell boy or security guard. So we ended up parking in front of the hotel (street side). Staff at restaurant seemed to have poor communication among each other, the guy actually led us to sit at the table that reserved to someone else, its totally a mess up for us.
Food: variety of station, japanese is good but taste is a frozen food. Seafood is rather simple, but grilled prawn is great. Same as khao soi chicken is tasty.
Staff is trying to get guest sign up for accor member to get free flow of soft drink. If you dont need, just ignore and no need to do.
Total price is 1200 THB nett which i think its not reasonable for foods and services you probably get. For me, i bought a voucher during double day sale around 666 THB each, otherwise i will end up very upset of what i have to pay for.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawinee Santichalanan

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those who made a reservation via Eatigo, kindly ensure that you receive an email with the discount code, otherwise, be prepared to pay the full price of 2099baht.

We made the reservation through Eatigo and when we arrived the restaurant, the manager was not able to find our booking in their system, even though we had an email of the said reservation through Eatigo, just no code which could be due to their system glitch. He did not bother to render any service and was adamant to charge us full price. As we do not want to disappoint the entire family since it was raining, we paid the full price.

This is a reminder for all who are keen to go for their buffet which in my opinion, the quality and variety is not worth the full price. Thus better to reserve at Eatigo platform for just 1399baht instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: CasCas

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my second time using a voucher, but this time I wasn't impressed. They charged extra for drinks, 50-100 baht per person, without informing me of the terms and conditions beforehand. The salmon quality was poor, the crab was still salty and only small pieces were available, and they didn't refill it often. The lamb was okay, but some pieces of beef were tough. The grilled foie gras wasn't as good as the first time; it was quite mushy, small, and greasy. The Peking duck had been sitting out too long and was so tough I couldn't bite through it. I probably won't come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Migelle S

sample_reviews_en.text: The crab was exactly as advertised, but it was nothing but scraps. I went on a Saturday. The crab didn't match the picture at all; they didn't refill the food. The river prawns were large, the foie gras and lamb were delicious, and the staff provided good service. The only downside was the crab section – it was awful. The advertising picture looked delicious, but what I actually got was just scraps of legs. It felt like I had to wait for them to refill it; they only refilled it once, and by the time I was there, it was all gone. Very disappointed and not worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: เปรมศักดิ์ สำลี

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the Saturday seafood lunch buffet. After eatigo discount it was 650 baht all in. Great value for money. The sashimi was fresh. The seafood was all fresh and variety was good. My only complain would be the deserts were disappointing and some of the dishes were cold. Even the Tom yum had nice big prawns. The grilled salmon was very good. Salmon papaya salad was very good. All food tasted good. It was good that they kept a smaller variety then other places but made sure everything tasted great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohammed Khanani

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very disappointed with the crab; it didn't match the promotional picture at all. The reality was just scraps. When I asked for refills, they only gave me leftovers. The desserts were of the same quality as a 300 baht buffet. Other dishes were just passable. Only the lamb and spaghetti were tasty. The restaurant is beautifully decorated and the staff provided good service, except for the crab station, where they seemed annoyed when I asked for refills.
sample_reviews_en.author: JackMaid

sample_reviews_en.text: Is really bad. The fresh oysters is not fresh , there is not much varieties as claimed on webpage. And I don’t even understand why there is good review about their Saturday crab buffet. Is below average expectation. Is a crab buffet but the variety of crab is worse than other hotel. Even their salmon sashimi at their jap corner don’t even look fresh. Really regretted my choice. But service staff is ok. Will not recommend anyone to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jo Tan

restaurants.name: Halal Muslim food
restaurants.address:

11 Beach Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A must try place for anyone who wants Authentic Thai!  Amazing prices and the taste and quality of the food is outstanding! I went here twice in 2 days! The flavours were potent and spice level hit the spot! The atmosphere is great! You are eating outside on Beach Road! Please note this is a Food Shack/Van not an actual shop. Looks like a family run business Mother and 2 Sons. Mother is the Chef!
sample_reviews_en.author: Umar Mehmood

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a surprise to find halal food on Pattaya Beach. Upon arrival, we were greeted warmly. Although the stall is simple, the quality of the food and presentation is excellent. All the dishes we ordered, including the tom yam, pad thai, fried rice, fried chicken, and spring rolls, were excellent. Perfect for Indonesian palates. I recommend this stall to my Muslim friends visiting Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bambang Suryanto

sample_reviews_en.text:
This halal stall is located ring in the centre of Pattaya Beach Road. It's easily located next to McDonald Beach Road.
Even though the stall is small, it offers a variety of Thai food. The food is tasty, the service was quick, and the price. We enjoyed the food so much that we came here twice during our four-night stay.
It is highly recommended that you look for halal food in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: A.U Alisan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Promoting Halal-friendly Pattaya
Halal Local Authentic Cuisine

It offers a good experience with its perfect location on Beach Road, ensuring easy accessibility. Their authentic cuisine caters to the needs of Halal-conscious individuals, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a Muslim-friendly dining experience in Pattaya.

By: Ahmed A.
sample_reviews_en.author: A. Ahmed

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai halal restaurant is known for its delicious food.

Despite the small kitchen, it offers a wide variety of very tasty Thai dishes.

I highly recommend it to everyone. I ate there every day during my stay in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Halit Ömer

sample_reviews_en.text: Expensive for the food campared to the rest of the tai and portion very small, charged me 200bhat for this shrimp soup which I found to be ridiculous! Only 5 shrimp rest was veg and too much soup
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr S

sample_reviews_en.text: Halal food by the roadside and near the beach. We tried few menus : padthai, prawn with tamarind sauce, crab and prawn fried rice and tom yam. The taste quite good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sharifah Ibrahim

sample_reviews_en.text: A halal Thai restaurant, offering a variety of delicious Thai dishes, professional female staff and a highly respectful chef, a clean place, and excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: saud

restaurants.name: Greendish
restaurants.address:

1 ซอยประชาราษฏร์บำเพ็ญ5 ถนนประชาราษฏร์บำเพ็ญ Bangkok 10320, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The Amaranta Hotel comprises two towers. One tower has a restaurant called Copper Restaurant in its basement, offering buffet breakfast and dinner. The other tower has a restaurant called Greendish on the ground floor, with both indoor and outdoor seating. It's not too crowded, and although it's a hotel restaurant, the food is reasonably priced and quite tasty, making it worth recommending.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yue Keung Cheung

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and there's a wide variety. The pizza is delicious. The drinks are very tasty. The atmosphere is nice and green. It's easy on the eyes. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phacharanat Pho.

sample_reviews_en.text: No Italian food any more, only Thai dishes. For local food quite pricy and no vegetarian options on the menu. The atmosphere doesn't look Thai at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mary M

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice restaurant. Love the appetizer dish "bread stick & dipping source". Recommend to order BBQ pork ribs, very large dish and taste great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayumi Mumu

sample_reviews_en.text: An Italian restaurant with a quiet atmosphere. I recommend trying the pizza. It's really delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saran Wangthammang

sample_reviews_en.text: I would rate it 4 out 5. It's bit expensive than other Thai restaurants in the same area
sample_reviews_en.author: waqarali subhani

restaurants.name: Malatang Hotgirl Century
restaurants.address:

15 ชั้น 2 Phaya Thai Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Phaya Thai, Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I usually love Mala Tang, I really, really love it. I've been to the Square One (Siam) branch many times, and I've taken my siblings there, and everyone loves it too. The pork bone broth and the Mala Tang broth are flavorful and delicious; you don't even need dipping sauce (but the dipping sauce is only 10฿ and unlimited).
Today, I happened to find the newly opened Century branch. I recognized the decor of the restaurant, "LOVE SPICE." Even though I already had food in my hand, I had to stop by. I tried it, and it didn't disappoint, just like before. This branch also had excellent service from the staff. I mentioned that the tofu skin wasn't fully cooked, and they quickly re-cooked it and added more broth. They even gave me a complimentary delicious and refreshing dessert (you have to like and share their Facebook page).
I highly recommend the Chinese-style jelly similar to O-Ew (I don't know the name of the menu item) and the mango pomelo tea, which is incredibly refreshing. ⭐️👍🏻⭐️👍🏻⭐️👍🏻
Food prices start at 49฿ per 100g.
sample_reviews_th.author: J Sawittree

sample_reviews_en.text:
The prices are steep. They don't even list the price per gram; I heard it was over 40 baht. I was shocked. And other items are charged separately. The dipping sauce is 10 baht extra. I understand the refillable drinks, but buying one bottle of water and only getting one glass of ice for the second glass is 3 baht – I don't understand that. I know it's expensive because it's in a mall, but could you please make it simpler? There's not a huge selection of items, and the dipping sauce too. Most importantly, I don't know if other people find it tasty, but personally, I didn't like it. My boyfriend also said it was bland. Thank you.
P.S. I hope you'll take this into consideration and improve, not just delete my comment. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: JUTAMAD CHUANCHAROEN

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't like the soup taste.They don't even know how to prepare the dish.brocoli is very soft and I can't find my crab meat.I will recommend to go to buffet restaurant instead of coming here.I had in a restaurant like this in Maesot.They honest with the customer they charge for the soup.Here I don't even know how many gram did I take.I just need to give them what that say.Sauce for 10B also insane.I won't come back again.I spend 300++ here .
sample_reviews_en.author: Kyawt Kyawt Paing

sample_reviews_en.text: A mala shop where you can select your own ingredients, and the price is calculated based on weight. Unlike many similar places, this restaurant stands out for its wide variety of ingredients, including seafood at no extra charge—while other places usually charge separately and expensively. The soup base is a bit too oily for my taste, but the sauce station offers a great variety. Overall, it’s a good experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: NNchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually eat mala hot pot. The soup is okay, not amazing.
But the stir-fried noodles are delicious, not too salty.

The fish stew with pickled mustard greens is cheap and the portion is large (because it has a lot of ingredients, including noodles and mushrooms). If you order it with rice, you'll be more than full. However, the flavor is a little mild in spiciness and sourness.
sample_reviews_en.author: ttanngai

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch serves the same portion size but the price is much higher than the Siam branch. They charge for dipping sauce and ice, and there's no refill service. The store isn't divided into zones and is located next to a crowded shopping area. However, the taste is just as delicious as before.
sample_reviews_en.author: NITI CHAIMONGKOL

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sooo delicious! The new tomato soup is a real hit! I love that you only pay for what you take (be careful not to take too much, lol).
- Dine-in and take-out available.
- A variety of noodles to choose from.
- Three soup bases (mala, pork bone, tomato) and a dry version (stir-fried mala).
-
sample_reviews_en.author: Phasukarn Tuntrajin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Better than expected!
There's a good selection of meat, vegetables, and meatballs. Don't take too much!
The pork bone broth is excellent. The stir-fried dishes are also delicious. You can take leftovers home in a doggy bag.
They also play nice music! 555
sample_reviews_en.author: Naam Wiriya H

restaurants.name: Uzbegim restaurant
restaurants.address:

Mosaic apartment, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very, very delicious! The best restaurant in Pattaya with CIS cuisine. The manti are amazing. The portions are huge – enough for two. The samsa is beyond reproach. The prices are high. The manti are 350 baht. But, again, the portions are for two. In the end, after sitting in the restaurant, we took some food home. The bill came to 1,000 baht.

The only downside was the service. After receiving the menu, my husband asked for time. We had a child with us, and I always carefully search the menu for something "child-friendly" for him. We were given the menu, and after that, the hostess didn't leave our side. She didn't give us time to look at the menu, the ingredients, or the prices. She just stood over us, hovering over the table, repeating what they had available. Then a man (probably the bartender) came over and stood on the other side of the table, and they waited while we looked at the menu.
I got the feeling they didn't want us to see the prices or take pictures of the menu, I don't know. It was VERY uncomfortable! They were rushing us. The hostess kept repeating the dishes she had. Maybe that's how they stand over you.

Of course, we'll be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Инна Стародубцева

sample_reviews_en.text:
A while back, we often ordered delivery (from Grab courier), takeout, and also ate in the establishment. Everything was delicious, and we considered this the best Eastern restaurant. After a couple of months, we decided to order a few dishes again from Uzbegim and were unpleasantly surprised. The pilaf was dry and overcooked, the manti were oversalted, and the meat was poor quality, with enormous sinews (which they simply put in place of the khanum without warning). We ordered cabbage rolls, but they only gave us two, two dolmas, and stuffed peppers, which no one here eats.

It's all very strange. Maybe the chef or owner has changed, or maybe the cook just wasn't in the mood. But everything used to be excellent, and now I don't recommend going to this establishment or ordering food from them at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lina

sample_reviews_en.text:
How wonderful it is to have such a family-run restaurant with delicious national cuisine! If you haven't been there yet, be sure to visit. You'll be greeted by a pleasant, homey atmosphere, excellent service, and pleasant music. We've tried almost everything here: shurpa, lagman, dumpling soup, manti, pilaf, amazing shashlik, samsa and flatbreads cooked in a tandoor, various types of meat, and homemade cutlets. And what amazing ayran they offer! Only here did we try ayran with dill. Impressive. There's too much to list. The portions are large. You can easily share a meal, but you can sample more dishes.
Come, you won't regret it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Galina Samokhina

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thank you so much! Today is my birthday and I wanted some non-Thai food and the choice fell on Uzbek cuisine.
We are delighted! I want to kiss the cook's hands!
Plov, manti, samsa, tomato salad, sauces (especially "ogonyok"), everything is top notch! I have not regretted for a second that we chose your establishment to order food. I sincerely recommend it to everyone!
Special thanks for the on-time delivery, we ordered in advance and asked for delivery by 18:00, and everything was delivered on time❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan Bukin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent Uzbek and Bukharan cuisine...!!!
Fantastic service...!!!
Many thanks to the gracious restaurant owner, Shevkan, his hospitable wife, and his nephew, who served us so well...
I recommend the wonderful manti, the luxurious boiled lamb, the sparkling ayran, and much more...!!!
I highly recommend it to everyone, friends...!!!:)))))
sample_reviews_en.author: alik Rogol

sample_reviews_en.text: What an excellent place! Very unique food, it's freaking delicious! I highly recommend going here. I always go when I'm in Pattaya. The owners are amazing and the food is so delicious. Get the Plov, Manti (both types), the salad and either kebobs or beef with potato. So delicious!. Thank you so much. I love you guys
sample_reviews_en.author: Shawn Dunn

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered home delivery based on the reviews. We really liked everything, everything was delicious, hot and piping hot, and everything was delivered quickly. 🙏😊 Thank you so much to the chef and the director of the establishment 🔥☺️ …
sample_reviews_en.author: Светлана Коршунова

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was reheated, the room was smoky, and the price—if you subtract the cost of the dishes, a teapot with one Lipton tea bag cost 100 baht. For those nostalgic for Soviet-era food service, well come.
sample_reviews_en.author: Евгений Лосев

restaurants.name: เย็นตาโฟ ป้าเสนา เล้งแซ่บ สาขา 2
restaurants.address:

191 หมู่ 4 Prasert-Manukit Rd, Chorakhe Bua, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: So delicious! I recommend the Tom Yum Lemon Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup). The lemon aroma is wonderful, and the thin, soft noodles are delicious. 70฿
sample_reviews_th.author: N.K. Latte

sample_reviews_en.text: Don't try this scam! I ordered seafood yentafo (Thai noodle soup). Everyone assumes it would have shrimp and squid, right?! Yes!! That's what I understood too. But what I actually got was yentafo without any squid or shrimp. So I called over a man, probably the owner, and told him I ordered seafood yentafo. He replied, "Yes, this is seafood yentafo." I asked what was so "seafood" about it. He said, "Seafood fish balls and two small pieces of crispy squid." I was completely confused. Then he just walked away, leaving me bewildered, but still charged me the full price.
sample_reviews_en.author: moo mooo

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's been a long time since I last ate here. The flavor isn't as strong as it used to be. The price is a bit high. Today I had Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo noodles, fried shrimp balls, and iced black tea. Overall, the taste was average. I secretly expected it to be tastier. Parking is available on the side of the road, but you might have to walk a bit to park all the way to the bus stop. 😜

Update as of May 11, 2023:
Ordered special Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo noodles with extra egg,
and iced coffee. The price was 115 baht, but the taste really wasn't as good as it used to be. 😭😭😭
sample_reviews_en.author: a r t s @ t i t a t a r n

sample_reviews_en.text:
Large flat rice noodles in Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo soup: soft noodles that absorb the broth, giving a smooth and delicious taste. It's topped with various ingredients including fish balls, shrimp rolls, minced pork, white wood ear mushrooms, water spinach, and bean sprouts.
Dry Tom Yum vermicelli noodles: This version has a stronger Tom Yum flavor, emphasizing the lime taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Weerawat Piyakriengkrai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yentafo (Thai noodle soup) is delicious without needing any extra seasoning.
Leng Saap (spicy pork rib soup) lives up to its name; you can order it with extra chili peppers to your liking for spiciness.

Tom Yum Noodle Soup with Lime: fragrant with real lime, a delicious and well-balanced flavor.

Parking is available along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHARUN PREMWUTI

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great local red noodle soup. Tasty with a lime aroma. Recommended.
The Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo (spicy noodle soup) is delicious! It has a lovely lime aroma, crispy squid, and the shrimp meatballs are okay. The fish meatballs are just average. ^^ I'll definitely come back again. P.S. The owner is very kind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pavisa Pr

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup): The taste was okay, but it lacked the fresh lime flavor. Price: 70 baht.
Yum 3 Saap (Spicy Seafood Salad): Meatballs with seafood dipping sauce. Price: 50 baht.
Overall, it was decent. This meal cost 120 baht. Not cheap, not expensive, but not a must-try.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHARINTHORN

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is on the main road, but the road surface is marked with red and white lines indicating no parking.
You have to take a chance if you want to eat there.
Their specialties are Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup), Tom Yum (spicy soup), and Leng Saap (spicy pork rib soup).
sample_reviews_en.author: My Love

restaurants.name: Scrumptious boat noodle shop by Por Pratheep @BTS Pho Nimit
restaurants.address:

Krung Thon Buri Road, Bang Yi Ruea, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is good, rich, and perfectly seasoned; no single flavor is overpowering or weak. The roasted chili peppers are fragrant. They offer fresh pork, braised pork, meatballs, and liver. They also have fresh beef, braised beef, meatballs, and liver. Noodle options include thin rice noodles, thick rice noodles, egg noodles, instant noodles, and various soups: clear broth, dry, and tom yum – whatever you order. Free vegetables are available, but only in limited quantities. Crispy pork rinds, dumplings, pork cracklings, pork satay, and pork sausage are sold separately. The atmosphere is simple and relaxed by the roadside, though it can be a bit noisy with passing traffic. On days that aren't too hot and humid, eating at the restaurant is incredibly enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: expen sive9

sample_reviews_en.text:
- I found the restaurant through Line Man and saw it was nearby, so I decided to try it. There aren't many tables, and I saw people coming in constantly while I was eating.
- The location is good; you can get off at Pho Nimit BTS station and the restaurant is right by the elevator. If you drive, you can park on the side of the road.
- The prices are inexpensive; regular is 25 baht, and special is 35 baht. The portions are generous, and the stewed beef is delicious and not chewy.
- The crispy pork cracklings are tasty and not rancid.
- The service is good; I didn't have to wait long after ordering.
- The place isn't too hot, there are fans. The cleanliness is average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aor Smtg

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, I wrote down my order specifying the type of noodles, for example:
"Small noodles with fresh beef, no vegetables, no chili." What I was supposed to get was "small noodles with fresh beef, no vegetables, no chili." But what I received were bowls with meatballs, stewed beef, and liver – every single one of them was the same. When I pointed this out, the staff member said, "Next time, please write your order more clearly." I mean, if it wasn't clear, shouldn't I have asked first? Shouldn't I have repeated the order before making the mistake? Otherwise, why write the order in the first place? It's really not okay that the customer is blamed first...
sample_reviews_en.author: Jarinya Wachirapunyanukoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a famous boat noodle brand with many branches, but this particular branch tasted better than many others I've tried.
The restaurant is located right at the entrance of Phothinimit BTS station.
There's no parking for cars, but you can park motorcycles, though be careful of traffic police.
Eating at the restaurant is better than taking it home or ordering it for takeout.
Personally, I prefer the thin rice noodles with either pork or beef in the waterfall-style broth.
sample_reviews_en.author: TOMashi R

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, great flavor. Fresh, clean vegetables are available to help you choose. The crispy pork rinds are well-wrapped in plastic. The food is clean. Parking is a bit difficult to find, and the restaurant is a little hot. There's a slight wait for the food, but it's worth it for every dish. Excellent boat noodles!
sample_reviews_en.author: chanin45042

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is really delicious. The owners are very friendly and cheerful, both the husband and wife team. They are quick and efficient. The noodles are delicious and the service is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: thongprasert yomtiangtae

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodle soup is rich and flavorful.
For those who don't like spicy food, I recommend ordering it less spicy.
The Tom Yum noodle soup is in a large bowl.

It's worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: tamqbubu

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are delicious. There's a small parking area on the side of the road if available. The owner is incredibly polite and the service is excellent ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwi Sri

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวป้านิด ^^ Auntie Nid Noodle
restaurants.address:

RG5C+RC9, Ratchasap Alley, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cheap noodles, 40 baht per bowl.

Overall, they use good quality ingredients. Toppings include shrimp, squid, char siu pork, minced pork, fish balls, fish cakes, and many more options. I heard they also have fish cake slices. The broth is sweet and flavorful, as expected. It comes with large pieces of radish and green onions.

It's clean for the price. Plenty of seating. Parking is not available in front of the shop; you have to park at Wat Bang Pho.

Auntie Nid cooks everything herself, one bowl at a time. You need patience if you want to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: R R

sample_reviews_en.text:
Aunt Nid's Traditional Tom Yum Pork Noodle Soup topped with Cilantro
This small, family-run noodle shop is located in a house. Aunt Nid prepares the noodles herself, and the shop is known for its Tom Yum pork noodle soup with minced pork and roasted pork, uniquely topped with chopped cilantro, giving the broth a fragrant aroma.

Located in a side street in the Bang Pho area, the shop is mostly frequented by locals, especially office workers during weekday lunchtimes.

The noodle bowls are large, with generous portions, and the prices are standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soottipong Winyoopradist

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small but cozy noodle shop. There's no parking, and it's located down a narrow alley, but it's always busy. The Tom Yum noodles are delicious and spicy. The offal has no unpleasant smell at all; the ingredients are well-prepared. The blanched liver is especially tasty. However, the elderly owner is starting to have hearing problems and can't remember orders, so you have to tell her what you ordered while she's cooking. That's part of the shop's charm and warmth.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alice Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating here since I came to Bangkok as a freshman.
10 years have passed, and the taste of Auntie's cooking hasn't changed at all.
She still treats me like her own child or grandchild.
No matter how much I ordered during my studies, she only charged me 40 baht.
After I graduated and started working, she finally charged me the regular price. ✌🏻✌🏻✌🏻✌🏻

I recommend the "Spicy Tom Yum Noodle Soup with Roast Pork, Crispy Pork, Pork Intestines, and Chicken Leg".
sample_reviews_en.author: Supanat Rachawong

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle shop is located in Pracha Rat Sai 1 Soi 21. Cars can't enter. It's set up in front of a house and has about 4 tables. They only serve pork, no beef. They have offal like liver and intestines. I arrived at 2:44 PM and they were out of liver. They have roasted pork, fish cake, meatballs, and minced pork slices. They also have shrimp. I ordered dry noodles and they gave me some soup as well. A special bowl of noodles costs 60 baht. (February 25, 2024)
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text: This small noodle shop serves incredibly delicious noodles. I especially like the offal; the intestines aren't bitter and are perfectly cooked. The liver is tender and bouncy, and the noodles are excellent. The tom yum soup might be a little sweet, but the broth is fragrant with pork bone flavor. At 50 baht, it's a small shop with superb quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: lemmy pillow

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! All the ingredients were there. It's an old-fashioned Tom Yum noodle soup recipe, which is becoming hard to find. There was a bit of a wait because the grandmother makes it all by herself, but it was worth it. The presentation was beautiful too. (You can't see my bowl, I forgot to take a picture before mixing it 😅)
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawut Nganpinyo

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious noodles with lots of toppings. I recommend it to people in the area. If you don't come, you'll miss out. The atmosphere is like eating at home. The auntie is kind. The price is reasonable. I envy the people in this area. If I lived nearby, I'd come to eat every day. This delicious restaurant is not a secret.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naruethanaphan Ponsombattanavi

restaurants.name: Raan Rao
restaurants.address:

104, 60 Thanon Charoen Wiang, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The rating for this restaurant was high on Google Maps, so I decided to give it a try, but ended up very disappointed. The Tom Yum soup was very salty, and the shrimp were not fresh, making it hard to drink more than a couple of sips. The Thai-style fried noodles were also very mediocre. Compared to the neighboring restaurants, this one opted for a low-price strategy. However, leaving hungry after spending 250 Thai Baht doesn't really feel cheap, especially since I ended up spending more money by going to another restaurant for dinner afterwards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bars Bars

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was amazing and authentic at such an affordable price. There are over 60 menus for you to explore. If you want to experience freshly cooked herby Thai food , all the curry you could imagine. Here's what you are looking for. The restaurant is located on a small local street in the middle of Bangkok. My favorite dish is Tom ka khai( spicy galangal soup with  coconut cream and herb) and Panang curry with chicken. The owner is so lovey and welcoming. She said her restaurant is already 20 years old.
sample_reviews_en.author: suthawee wilaipornsawai

sample_reviews_en.text:
All dishes were priced at 80 baht (as of June 13, 2023).

There were several dishes on the menu priced at 50-60 baht, so I ordered a 60 baht salad. When I paid, I was told, "That's been raised to 80 baht." While paying that amount isn't significant, I felt cheated because they didn't mention the price increase when I ordered.

It's not as cheap as some previous reviews suggest, so I think you'd be better off going to one of the slightly more expensive restaurants in the area for a more substantial meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanshiro Blog

sample_reviews_en.text: Just landing in Bangkok and waiting for our room to be ready, we wandered around for lunch and found this place.  They have fresh vegetables at the front of store cooking area.  I always judge Thai restaurants on how they prepare staples.  I ordered a chicken and basil stir fry and Tom Yum soup.  They made the best soup I ever tasted and the stir fry was tender and flavorful.  Go to this place for a genuinely good hole in the wall place.  Total price for two (with Singha beers) was just under $10!
sample_reviews_en.author: Niel McCaffrey

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant near Robinson Shopping Center was empty when I went there after 2 PM on a Sunday.
As others have said, their tom yum goong is cheap and delicious.
It has just the right flavor—not too spicy or sweet, perfect for Japanese palate. I specified medium spiciness when ordering.
The three dishes—fried rice, tom yum goong, and yum woon sen—came to 260 baht.
There's no air conditioning, so you'll likely sweat while eating. 💦
The price, on the other hand, is incredibly reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naoya Tohyama

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing! Every time, depth of flavour is what you want, no fake watered down dishes, everything cooked from scratch. An oasis of authentic Thai food in amongst a sea of western burgers & coffee!
We come back again and again and…. Family owned/ run and so friendly
And… an actual (not advertised) COLD Chang beer, all others are warm, nobody wants that
sample_reviews_en.author: Twomoonjunction

sample_reviews_en.text: So we live a couple hundred meters from this restaurant and stop by at least once a week. Although I've had several dishes here, and they are all delicious, I almost always get the panang with pork. I could easily eat this about everyday! My Thai girlfriend mixes it up more and she also loves everything she has had! Go try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Curtis Darby

sample_reviews_en.text: I asked for their recommendations, and I got served this vermicelli stir-fried dish with some interesting vegetables (tasting green and healthy) and deep-fried chicken with bareleaves and lemongrass. The food was real tasty and authentic. Recommended!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maiko S.

restaurants.name: ครกอร่อย
restaurants.address:

333 Pracha Rat Bamphen Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions were generous. The mackerel wrap came in a large platter, the serving dish was beautiful, I loved the creativity. The vegetables were fresh and crisp, the dipping sauce was delicious, and the mackerel was large. It was enough to fill a large group. The pomelo salad with fermented fish sauce was a great combination; the fermented fish sauce wasn't smelly or dark, it was clean, I loved it. I even secretly asked if they sold fermented fish sauce, haha. The service was impressive, they took good care of all the customers. Parking was convenient. The plum juice was refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: mali phuengchit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a good Thai restaurant serving high quality Isaan style food. We ate Pad Sen, Tam Pu Gatoy, fried chicken (with cartalidge served with chili, ginger, and peanuts), and fresh strawberries in a spicy sauce. I was pleasantly surprised by the strawberries, a dish I had never eaten before.

Clean with good service and moderately priced, but you'll probably struggle if you don't read and speak Thai, because I don't think anyone on staff speaks English, and the menu was all in Thai as well.

Perhaps 800 meters from Huai Khwang MRT on Prachara Bamphen Road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bill Horgan

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is amazing! I ordered delivery from them before and loved it, so I tracked down the physical restaurant and wasn't disappointed. The service was impressive and the food was delicious. I especially loved the durian papaya salad with fermented fish sauce; it was unique and I'd never had anything like it before. The restaurant is clean, the atmosphere is great, and there's parking available. It's a perfect place to sit and chat for hours. I came with my gang and we ordered a lot, but we finished everything! So delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: color tunya

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the service is impressive. The restaurant is also clean. My girlfriend brings me here often. We always order three dishes, and my favorite is the healthy option: Surat Thani oysters – very fresh and the dipping sauce is spicy. Other dishes are also delicious; everything is tasty. The fried pork belly with garlic is fragrant and crispy. The pomelo salad is very creative; I didn't think a fruit salad would go well with fermented fish sauce, but I tried it and loved it! I'm hooked! 5555
sample_reviews_en.author: BCcomputer

sample_reviews_en.text: I went back to Thailand last month to try this place after a friend's review, before they closed for dine-in. I have to admit, it was really delicious. I ordered the mangosteen salad with fermented fish sauce; it was incredibly unique. You can chew the mangosteen seeds too – I was amazed at how it tasted good with the fermented fish sauce! The staff were attentive, and the restaurant was clean. It's located at the entrance of a soi (alley), a bit far from parking; you have to walk to the main road.
sample_reviews_en.author: palupol meesub

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw YouTubers filming here and came because I wanted to try the strawberry papaya salad with fermented fish sauce. It was really delicious! The fermented fish sauce was unique, unlike any other, flavorful and fragrant. I loved it. The fried pork belly was also good and tasty. The stir-fried noodles were very fragrant with soy sauce, and went well with the fermented fish sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Usuma Suphachon

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! Even ordering it not too spicy, it was still amazing. Most restaurants say that less spice reduces the flavor, but not here. The portions are huge, and the flavors are incredible. I could eat it continuously. My favorites are the two-tone corn and shrimp salad with fermented fish sauce, and the pork sausage and lotus stem salad with fermented fish sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukanya Suksamran

sample_reviews_en.text:
5 Reasons to Come Back Here Again!
1. Great ingredients! The shrimp are fresh, large, and exactly as advertised.
2. Great lotus stems! They're tender and not chewy at all.
3. The fermented fish sauce is flavorful and not too strong – I love it!
4. The oysters are sweet and fresh.
5. It's a very clean and delicious somtum (papaya salad) restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุภาพร สุขสำราญ

restaurants.name: Shwe Kayin Family
restaurants.address:

1669 ถ. สุขุมวิท Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Burmese food can be rarely found in Bangkok, but mostly in areas with a significant Burmese community, so anytime I fiund then I tried my best to taste.
Here you can enjoy both made-to-order dishes and rice toppings. I opted for curry rice today, and the variety is overwhelming, as everything is delicious and many flavors are unique.
“Rice topped with chicken offal and stir-fried okra” reminded me of a favorite spot near Bangkok Hospital, with the chicken liver offering a robust taste, complemented by the tangy okra.
I also tried the “fish roe curry”, which surprised me as it turned out to be Spanish mackerels fish roe rather than catfish roe. The roe had a rich, oily flavor, paired with a slightly spicy and salty sauce that wasn’t overly greasy.
Additionally, the restaurant provides complimentary vegetables and soup, along with a chili paste made from fermented fish that differs from Thai versions, featuring a lighter consistency.
Overall, you can enjoy authentic Burmese cuisine at reasonable prices without the need to travel to Myanmar.

By: Sunset @ Nonthaburi peer
LGL10 F6B
♎️ Enjoyably reviewing either Engineering documents or Yummy foods😆 ♎️
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanakorn Jornjarern

sample_reviews_en.text: This Burmese restaurant is located on the first soi of Sukhumvit Soi 71. They have two menus and a wide variety of dishes. The garlic stir-fried okra (80 THB) was excellent. The white wood ear mushroom salad (70 THB) also had an interesting flavor. The spicy fried rice (150 THB) had a different flavor than Thai khao pad and was quite spicy; the inclusion of cauliflower was memorable. A medium bottle of Singha beer was a reasonable 90 THB. They have a wide variety of curries and they are cheap, so I will definitely come back. I entered at 6:30 PM, and about 80% of the seats were occupied, so it seems to be quite popular.
sample_reviews_en.author: 2pong

sample_reviews_en.text: Here, you can always find a diverse range of lifestyles, making you want to stay longer. In fact, just 200 meters from True Digital Park, there's a rare green living community in Bangkok—SKV64, a development tailor-made for white-collar workers in terms of both location and the quality of its community. Especially noteworthy is its 9,900-square-meter green park, known as "the Bangkok community where you can fly kites." Whether exercising, using the sauna, swimming, or hosting private parties, community life offers endless material for your personal vlog.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucas “泰国地产微信hwrj456”

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went there the second time with a friend to introduce him to Burmese food. Was a little skeptical, as my first experience was only so-so.

But: They really upped their game. We ordered 3 salads and their skewers, and everything surpassed our expectations by far.

Will definitely come again, and recommend it to everyone for the Burmese food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sascha Heylmann

sample_reviews_en.text:
Decent Burmese place but many menu items were Thai and Chinese dishes. I wish the many Burmese restaurants opening in Bangkok would stick to Burmese dishes. If I want to eat Kai Kraphao in Bangkok, why would I ever want to go eat it in a Burmese restaurant?

The curry selection was just average, the mohingha was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Howard Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice ambiance, the staff are friendly, and there's complimentary Chinese tea 👍👍. Ordering rice dishes is definitely worthwhile; a serving costs around 80-100 baht and includes a plate of vegetables, soup, and a generous amount of rice. Don't order noodles as they're too expensive at 150 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sophia Tang

sample_reviews_en.text: 😡I ordered one bowl of Rakhine-style noodle soup (80 THB) and one omelette (70 THB), but they charged me 190 THB instead of 150 THB. This is clearly overcharging customers on purpose. Very dishonest and disappointing experience. I will report this to the consumer protection authority in Thailand.😡
sample_reviews_en.author: 徐世陪

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a very disgusting restaurant
I've eaten here twice. Both times they reheated the leftovers and threw them away. When I said the dishes were too salty and sour, they didn't do anything about it and pretended not to know. They were trying to please the customer and apologized 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: thansoe aung

restaurants.name: Zaap Der Vietnamese Food
restaurants.address:

S Pattaya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
A great Vietnamese cafe. I felt like I was back in Nha Trang. The Pho Bo is amazing – a huge portion with meat, herbs, and rice noodles, all in a rich broth (80 ฿). They also serve sprouts, lettuce, and basil on the side. All I need is the honking of a moped to fully immerse myself. 😁
Thanks to Job for helping me pay via AIS Points❤️
sample_reviews_th.author: Olga Sazonova

sample_reviews_en.text: I walked to the restaurant, which took about five minutes. I wanted to eat Vietnamese food. About 5-10 minutes passed after I arrived, but no one approached me. Later, a woman in an apron came out of the kitchen, and when I asked if I could order, I was told "no." Meanwhile, there were already guests eating in the dining room. This begs the question: what's the point of being listed as a restaurant on maps if customers are treated this way and are unable to order food?
sample_reviews_en.author: Dmitrii Mueanthai

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so delicious, just like my grandma's! I personally loved it. At first, I only ordered spring rolls, but after finishing them, I had to order two more dishes. We're from Bangkok, and this was amazing. I even wondered how I'd manage to eat it again when I get home. There might be some flying insects, so if you don't like that, you can order it to go to your accommodation or home. But I really want you to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: varintorn klaymag

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kwai jaab Yuan is a Vietnamese - Thai fusion dish that worth trying here. Personally, I always crave this dish. The other Vietnamese dishes are authentic and not bad either. Many fresh greens are offered accompanying the food.

The prices are more expensive than Vietnamese restaurants in Isan, but it’s fair since it is located in Pattaya City.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deviant DJ Jehuty

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was great but no bread so the banh mi wasn’t available sad:( but the pho and other stuff was delicious. Only negative for farang is everything on the menu was in Thai - I had a Thai friend with me which made it possible and I used translation app on menu. Definitely a local place with arroy maak food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lance A

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef pho was delicious, fresh, and clean. The noodles were good and the broth was fragrant. 8.5/10.
The Vietnamese steamed rice rolls had thick wrappers that tasted like wide rice noodles. The filling was bland and only tasted good with the dipping sauce provided. I couldn't eat it alone. 7/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: NettyZs

sample_reviews_en.text: The Vietnamese spring rolls (Nem Nuong) were delicious and affordable. The Tom Yum Leng (spicy pork rib soup) was also incredibly flavorful, with real lime juice and satisfyingly large pieces of pork ribs. All of this for 335 baht, including two bottles of water.
sample_reviews_en.author: PHAN KO

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a while since I've been here. The restaurant used to be clean, but today the tables aren't cleared and there's only one person working. It looks like the restaurant is about to close. Where have all the staff gone? But the food still tastes delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: อิสระ ไรไธสง


384, 114 Pattaya Sai 2 Soi 18, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chanced upon Baan Thai via Google Map.
Read the review and decide to give it a try..
Had take away dinner and is fast and delicious.
Very cosy dine in environment and reasonably priced for the food and a good size portion!
The boss is very meticulous and eventually played the songs for my language while I am waiting for my order. Thank you!
Well recommended!!
sample_reviews_en.author: David Ng

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai restaurant absolutely delighted me! The service was friendly and attentive, and the food was simply delicious. The dishes were freshly prepared and perfectly seasoned, making every meal a true pleasure. I highly recommend this restaurant and will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: jefazo

sample_reviews_en.text: Stumbled upon this place while walking around Pattaya on a sunny afternoon. It’s a small place located on the main road. We ordered the Fried rice, green curry and the crispy Pork. The food was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Malbert Rodrigues

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent home cooked food, made us feel at home, with good prices and quality.
Worth the ride on Bolt taxis to visit and collect.
Would definitely visit here again!! Five stars from three visitors!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kash Patel

sample_reviews_en.text: The food, especially the spaghetti with dried chili and bacon, is exactly the flavor I've been searching for. I ate so much I had to order a second serving. You have to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chia Chichi

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was in a small alley, not cheap, and the ingredients weren't good. It wasn't tasty either. I went there because of the good reviews, but I was very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: whj h

sample_reviews_en.text: The fact is that the food is great. They have such a wonderful palate for spice and use it so deliciously! Small place, air conditioned. Really shouldn't be missed
sample_reviews_en.author: Russ K

sample_reviews_en.text:
So tasty, we went back a second time.

We had two different pork dishes and both were delicious.

Also had Pad Thai and a rice dish, with of which we enjoyed
sample_reviews_en.author: Tee Hea

sample_reviews_en.text: Cooking here is like using a charcoal stove; it takes forever. A charcoal stove might even be faster. Sometimes it's just too much. I know it's a queue system, but have some consideration for others. It's not like you can just take an order and then spend almost an hour cooking it. And the taste isn't even that great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanakorn Pitakngoendee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food preparation for delivery riders is extremely slow, every single time. Why not just close the online order service if it's so slow? Why make riders wait for so long? Have some consideration for the riders; they already earn very little per delivery and then have to deal with such slow service. It's awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธีรภัทร มหาสมบัติ

sample_reviews_en.text: Run away, don't eat here! What kind of order is this? I ordered one thing and got something else entirely. I was so confused. I was starving and this was terrible. We waited a long time, I don't know if it was because there were a lot of people or what, but we didn't get the food we ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeje Kayehaojai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the portions are generous. Those who leave negative reviews, if the food wasn't to their liking, should keep it to themselves. People are trying to make a living; learn to be considerate. Didn't they say Thai people were kind?
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikki Botanica Thai

sample_reviews_en.text: It's really delicious! I order regularly through the app. The waiting time varies depending on when you order. The food is delicious and the price is very good. Even though the app adds a price markup, it's still acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bovii Chat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I waited for almost an hour, but when the food arrived, the rice was undercooked and inedible. I had to throw away both boxes.
When I called the restaurant, they didn't apologize or say they would send the food back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: S B

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the portions are generous, and the price is very cheap. It's incredibly good value for money; they give you way more than you'd expect for the price. The chef is also very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: MANRT

sample_reviews_en.text: It took so long to prepare, it was incredibly slow. The portions were small, and it wasn't even tasty. I ordered one thing and got something else entirely. The portions were ridiculously small.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dew All new

restaurants.name: SOUP SIP | Local Asian Fusion Cuisine & Chill
restaurants.address:

156/21, ชั้น 6, KITSCH HOTEL, Phetchaburi Rd, Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This restaurant is beautiful and the food is incredibly delicious! 😻🫶🏻⭐️ I was extremely impressed. It's located on the 6th floor, and everything is stunning from the sign to the restaurant's concept and decor. The color scheme and overall design are amazing ❤️💚🤎🤍🩵🩷. The atmosphere is great, with both air-conditioned indoor seating and an outdoor balcony area. We went on a Saturday evening, and it wasn't crowded at all. It's definitely worth checking out!

The food was delicious in every dish. They offer a fusion style menu with almost every type of cuisine imaginable. My friends and I celebrated a belated birthday there, and we went all out! The staff were attentive and efficient; the food arrived super quickly. If you're looking for a dinner spot with your partner, friends, or family, I highly recommend it! 😋💗

P.S. My friends and I ate a lot – food and drinks – and the total bill was around 4,332฿. Divided among us, the price was very reasonable. We ate until we were completely full and satisfied!

📌 The restaurant is near Ratchathewi BTS station. You can walk there or take a motorbike taxi.
sample_reviews_th.author: Tunchanok SK

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a hidden gem on the 6th floor in the heart of Bangkok: SOUP SIP.
The restaurant is tucked away on the 6th floor rooftop of Kitsch Hotel, a charming boutique hotel in the Ratchathewi area.
The decor is retro with a modern twist.
They serve easy-to-eat comfort food.
Open from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM, last order at 9:00 PM.
-Shrimp Toast: Bite-sized bread topped with minced shrimp mixed with Sriracha mayo. Crispy and intensely flavorful.
-Braised Pork Belly: Pork belly braised in caramel sauce and the chef's special blend of seasonings until tender. A chewy, sweet and salty snack with a satisfying bite.
-Spaghetti with Crispy Squid Curry: The crispy fried squid pairs perfectly with the curry, and the spaghetti noodles are delightfully chewy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Giftoun Blog

sample_reviews_en.text: I went for lunch with friends and ordered a lot, about 7 dishes including dessert. Every dish was delicious. There were actually more dishes than pictured, but I didn't get a chance to photograph them because I was too hungry! We had a comfortable, long conversation. The staff were lovely and provided excellent service. The food looked small in the pictures, but the actual portions were amazing. The banana in coconut milk dessert was surprisingly delicious – a real comfort food spot I'd definitely visit again. The drinks, like the Thai tea, were also incredibly tasty. Overall, the value and taste were excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaya nitiworaphat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a great vibe and is located in the same building as the hotel.
There's a wide variety of food to choose from, and many dishes look delicious.
Personally, I enjoyed almost everything except the shrimp toast, which was more like egg and shrimp toast.
The drink menu is a bit limited; adding more cocktails or beers would be nice.
The air conditioning was a bit warm, but the staff provided good service. I'll definitely come back again.

The admin on Line responded quickly and provided complete information.
There's free parking near the hotel (but it closes at 10 PM).
sample_reviews_en.author: puffypocket

sample_reviews_en.text: The Kitsch Hotel is already very cute, but going up to the top floor to eat at Soupsip, a chic rice porridge restaurant, is even better. The taste is great, perfect for chilling and chatting with friends. The food is delicious, flavorful, and spicy – ​​Thai fusion cuisine. They have both rice porridge and steamed rice, and many dishes go well with the porridge, which I really enjoyed. I'll definitely be back! :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Natha Wattanaphanuchok

sample_reviews_en.text: Reception informed us about a new floor (6th floor), and wow! It's a rooftop cafe with a great vibe. From what I saw on the menu, it's mostly comfort food. I personally loved the spicy salad – it was delicious! They also sell wine. It was raining the day I went, which made it even more relaxing. I really want to bring my friends here! We could even get drunk and sleep at the hotel, haha!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dolnaphar Tuntivithayakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
