The restaurant is on the 6th floor of the same building as the Kitsch Hotel.
I was staying at the hotel, so I went up to the restaurant to get my welcome drink. I saw the menu and it looked very interesting, so I decided to try something. The sous vide chicken was delicious, very tender and juicy. It's a shame I didn't get to try their breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bua Chantawong

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying this place because I was staying at the hotel. It was so chill and I found a new hangout spot! The food was delicious, the wine was reasonably priced, and the rooftop on the 6th floor made it even more relaxing. It would be even better with live music!
sample_reviews_en.author: F F

restaurants.name: ร้านมัลลิกา ชุมพร ร้านสวัสดิการ ศพม.
restaurants.address:

QG9J+67Q, 315 Ratchawithi Rd, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old, established Southern Thai restaurant (originally located in Soi Rang Nam), with another branch at Chulalongkorn Hospital. The food is delicious, and the curry isn't overpoweringly spicy. The restaurant is air-conditioned, has parking, and is easily accessible.

Recommended dishes include: Yellow Curry with Fish (didn't order this time, so no picture), Steamed Stuffed Squid with Lime (delicious, the squid wasn't chewy), Som Tum Nang Fah (papaya salad), and Prawns in Tamarind Sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ariya

sample_reviews_en.text: Mallika Restaurant, Chumphon Branch, located at Phramongkutklao Hospital, is situated on Ratchawithi Road, near the school for the blind, before the Tukkai intersection. The restaurant has comfortable seating for approximately 30-40 people. The Southern Thai food maintains its delicious taste, comparable to other branches. The staff provides good service, and reservations are recommended. For dessert, the taro sticky rice balls are recommended; they are homemade and available every Tuesday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuntawan D.

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I first visited this Thai restaurant around 20 years ago, and I’m so happy to say the food and service are still just as fantastic today as they were back then. The flavours are authentic, the vegetables are fresh, and every dish is made with care and high-quality ingredients. The texture, taste, and attention to detail remain exactly the same as I remember, which is rare and very special. It’s wonderful to see a place maintain such consistency for so many years. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eddie Journey

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious Southern Thai food.

Actually, I drove past the restaurant before realizing that Mallika's restaurant had opened in this area. So I went back down Rama VI Road and into Soi Ratchawithi 15 to find it.

Overall, the food tasted good and suited my palate. The food came out quickly, with minimal waiting time. The restaurant was clean and pleasant, and there was convenient parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanvi K

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Thai food is tasty and the place is clean. The staff are polite and lovely, and the service is good. There is parking available.
The prices are on the higher side.
The seats are hard, making it difficult for elderly people to sit for long periods. The restroom door is noisy.
I recommend improving the smell in the restaurant; it's very stuffy and makes me feel dizzy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Allawa R. F.

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for a lunch spot, I recommend this place. Honestly, the food is really good. My favorite is the yellow curry; it's not as spicier as other places, but the flavor is well-balanced. The portions aren't huge, so you can order several dishes. There's parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanutcha Jensanoi

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were so unhelpful and unhelpful. I asked to use the restroom but they wouldn't let me. I wanted to order some food, but I ended up not ordering at all. Terrible experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: May tiida

sample_reviews_en.text: I was so full and the food was delicious I forgot to take pictures! The atmosphere was nice, and there was parking available. Lots of vegetables, and it was good value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natrada K

restaurants.name: タイ料理屋台
restaurants.address:

217 8 Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Very good and great prices, better than 400 baht overpriced fancy food."

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there at 7 AM since it was right in front of the hotel, and as of the date of this review (March 20, 2025), they say it is open 24 hours.

You can choose between beef and pork, and for the noodles, you can choose between rice noodles and egg noodles.

Seeing the locals eating chicken rice, it looks like it would be delicious.

The photo is of the beef rice noodles. Maybe because I went without high expectations, it was tasty, and if you sprinkle a little chili powder on it, it's perfect for a hangover cure. They serve fresh bean sprouts and herbs with it. There was just a tiny bit of cilantro in it—so little you could barely tell. You can adjust the amount of cilantro when ordering.

It's great for a light meal!!

It's delicious!!

The price is 50 baht👍👍

The chicken rice is also 50 baht.

You can buy beer or drinks from the convenience store next door.

It's delicious😭
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is located in the 7-Eleven parking lot and seems to open around 11:30 AM. When I tried to go for breakfast, it was closed.

I had what I think might be called Kuay Tiao Moo (or something similar), a pork noodle dish.

It was delicious. The thin noodles, like ramen, and the flavorful broth, with a touch of cilantro for accent, made me want to finish every last drop of the soup. The ingredients, including pork, meatballs, and bean sprouts, were also satisfying.

If they had offered extra noodles, I might have eaten even more.

You can also add fish sauce from the table to change the flavor, so you won't get tired of eating it.

I thought 50 THB was a bargain for this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tak O

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s practically a street stall, so it’s surprising that it’s listed on Google...

Both the noodles and the rice bowls are top-notch.

It’s a local place with local-style prices, but the taste is actually less off-putting than what you might find at a restaurant in a tourist area.

You can bring in outside food, and if you buy a drink from the 7-Eleven next door, they even give you a cup.

Of course, since the main items are noodles and chicken rice bowls, it’s not a place you would go out of your way to find, but it’s a great spot to grab a meal if you’re in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: JK Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! I ordered both the oxtail soup and the khao man gai to take home and enjoyed them at the hotel.
They provided spoons and chopsticks for the sauce, and the oxtail soup and khao man gai were served in proper containers.

It's a food stall, but it's clean and the locals seem to eat their meals quickly.

The oxtail soup (non-spicy) in particular was delicious and the portions were generous.

The khao man gai sauce was a little different (thick and sour).

I read the reviews and it was a good decision! 🙆‍♀️
sample_reviews_en.author: i

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was so delicious I went there two days in a row. 😋
The pork backbone soup (60B) has an exquisite broth with a slight sourness and spiciness, and is filled with savory meat similar to Bak Kut Teh. I highly recommend ordering it with chicken rice (50B)!

About 100 meters away, next to the 7-Eleven, there's another restaurant in the same chain, with a similar menu.

They don't seem to have the pork backbone soup there, but the young man there kindly told me about it, so I'd like to try it there next time. 🍀
sample_reviews_en.author: M

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's right in front of a 7-Eleven. Judging by the sheer number of locals, it must be a local favorite. It's seriously delicious. When I went at night, the son ran the business, and during the day, the mother ran it. You can choose your noodles, with the basic options being rice noodles, sildangmyeon, kalguksu, and ramen noodles (+10 baht).
They also eat a lot of rice, but the noodle soup is amazing!
Add a little chili powder from the seasoning containers on each table and enjoy! It's a spicy hangover cure.
sample_reviews_en.author: 정원

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken rice was delicious and inexpensive. The pork bone soup hadn't been made yet, so I didn't get to try it. The accompanying clear soup was also tasty. The tables and chairs at the restaurant were simple and a bit hot; it was much more comfortable to eat it in the air-conditioned hotel room.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHIA MING CHAN

sample_reviews_en.text: Decent environment, just outside of 7-11 and across soi 6 road. Truly unexpected chicken rice with a special sauce provided which simply overwrites my usual chicken rice recipe in Malaysia. Really reasonably priced and I had twice during my stay in Pattaya and I'll revisit again for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: chris chin

restaurants.name: ข้าวต้มเก้าอี้ขาว
restaurants.address:

VG43+9VG, Tambon Talat Kwan, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A restaurant serving rice porridge and other à la carte dishes at relatively cheap prices in Soi Rewadee.
The creamy tom yum soup with mixed seafood is spicy and flavorful, and the portion is quite generous for the price of 65 baht per bowl, which is a price you don't find anywhere else these days.
The stir-fried morning glory with crispy pork is moderately flavorful, not too salty, and comes with a good amount of morning glory.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rangsan Akarapan

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located at the entrance of Soi Rewadee 55 in Nonthaburi province. The food is delicious and affordable, with prices around 70, 80, and 100 baht. The restaurant is open from 12:00 PM to 2:00 AM. It's recommended to call ahead to check their opening hours, as they may be closed on some days.
sample_reviews_en.author: NATTAPHONG ANURAK

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a roadside rice porridge shop in Soi Rewadee. The food is inexpensive and reasonably priced for the portion sizes. The dishes aren't large, so two people can order several things. We ordered five dishes. The taste was moderate, not too strong, but we finished every dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: patil milk

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and affordable. I wanted a rice porridge restaurant with small side dishes so I could try many different things, and this place was perfect. Two of us ordered four dishes and took another bag home for only 370 baht. Delicious and great value for money!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thidaporn Hongsakai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my go-to rice porridge shop since I moved to the Rewadee area.
The prices are cheap, the taste is great, and the service is excellent.
I recommend every item on the menu; they're all truly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supanat Rachawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious and totally worth it! The prices are like going back 10 years.
The fried sea bass with fish sauce was so easy to eat because it was all flesh. The Tom Yum soup was also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patta

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is great and delicious. I highly recommend this restaurant. The food is delicious, the owner is nice, quiet but kind. Truly delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: กริช ดิเรก

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely delicious! This is the best made-to-order restaurant I've ever been frequenting for many years, and it's still as delicious as ever.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monsikarn Thussawin

restaurants.name: Indian Barbeque Nation 57
restaurants.address:

367 Paracha Uthit 57, Khwaeng Bang Mot, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried Indian food for the first time in my life 🥄. Every dish I ordered was delicious! It was a great experience. I ordered almost 10 dishes in total, but the price was less than 1000 baht! Amazing! 🙂‍↕️💝 The staff were also very attentive, constantly checking on us and giving great recommendations. 10 out of 10! 🤭🤟🏻

P.S. The cheese naan and butter chicken were a perfect combination 🔛🔝
sample_reviews_en.author: C. Supakant

sample_reviews_en.text:
That food are very bad no taste
Zero taste no good food I have the worst food in my life . This is my real review if you want to check what I am order you can go and check on grap food I am Mutton biryani my grap order name is Kwee ok
Everything is very bad I got biryani with normal rice mix which is 100 white one the bad food in my life
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwee Du

sample_reviews_en.text:
The naan bread with cheese and the naan bread with garlic cheese are incredibly delicious!
The shrimp is super fresh, highly recommended!
The chicken tastes good and isn't tough.
The chicken roll is also delicious.
However, the food takes a little while to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puii Puii

sample_reviews_en.text:
The biryani was awful.
It was too spicy, and the chicken didn't absorb the flavors well.
The naan bread was very chewy, like it had a grainy, sandy texture.
The butter chicken was delicious, though a little too sweet.
But the biryani rice was a complete failure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hadee Chimkul

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop owner provides excellent service. The prices are good; a large portion of naan bread is only 35 baht. They have many types of bread and curries. I especially like the pani puri bread. The shop is easy to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: pat ty

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The chicken curry was fragrant, rich, creamy, and just the right amount of spiciness. A must-order item is the naan bread; the potato naan was incredibly delicious and well worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutkung crub

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the prices were reasonable, and the service was good. I was very impressed and will definitely visit again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: นฐา ธนพิทักษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the service was good, and the restaurant was decorated in an Indian style. Overall, it was a great experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปภาชนก โพธิ

restaurants.name: Greyhound Cafe - MedPark
restaurants.address:

G floor, 3333 MedPark Hospital Rama IV Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Slow food, messy service, incomplete orders, and no improvement.
This is a restaurant I frequent when meeting clients or my team for meals because they have a variety of dishes that taste okay. However, what I encounter every time is extremely slow food service. It's so slow that it's frustrating. They frequently forget dishes. Believe it or not, I have to follow up on my orders every time because 1-2 people still haven't received their food. The food service is terrible. Even simple bread is served incompletely and unevenly, and they still forget things. This is unacceptable. The food is expensive, and they charge a service charge. I even received dishes I didn't order twice. It's very confusing. Do they not know how to key in or count tables? How are they managing the restaurant?
sample_reviews_en.author: Natha P.

sample_reviews_en.text: This option offers Greyhound comfort within the environs of MedPark hospital. The wings hit first: a loose hill of golden chicken on paper, pandan leaves fried through like green confetti. Bite in and the crust snaps, then slips into soft skin and fish-sauce savour, a little funk, a little pepper, nothing polite about the craving it triggers. Fried salmon toro doubles down on comfort: buttery belly in a thin crisp coat, garlic chips catching the light, kaffir lime leaves threaded underneath while three sauces argue over who gets the last piece. In the glass, iced lemon tea behaves like the house manifesto: tea-ice cubes, dry tannin, real zest and juice, sweetness dialled to “second glass, still happy”.
sample_reviews_en.author: Loo Yeo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ok I honestly did not expect this branch to be this good since it's located in a hospital but I was mistaken!

The design is unlike any other branches (which is mostly black and white tone). This place actually has neutral, warm, earth tone and designed so differently from the usual Greyhounds.

The food is good like any other places but the service has to be highlighted! They were fast, attentive, thoughtful, polite, and just nice overall. I have been disappointed by services from a lot of branches like the Siam Center one with how rude and slow everything is but this one takes the best service.
sample_reviews_en.author: A

sample_reviews_en.text: We pre-ordered our dishes in advance, but unfortunately, the restaurant was unprepared as many ingredients were out of stock. Several menu items that were listed as available were not actually in supply, and the staff had forgotten to prepare our order. This led to delays in serving our meal, which was frustrating. While the food itself was tasty, the overall experience was marred by the restaurant's lack of readiness. They should ensure they are better prepared for rush hours to avoid such issues in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanatcha Oey

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered clam soup.
But almost all of the clams smelled bad.

So I informed the staff.
The staff replied, "Oh, that's just the natural smell of clams. 🧐" I was confused for a moment, then said okay, whatever.

I usually order this dish, and I regularly eat clams.
Clams are my favorite.

So, customers can't tell the difference between fresh and stale clams by that smell? I was confused by the staff's answer and lost my appetite.
sample_reviews_en.author: จิรา นะ ลำเลียง

sample_reviews_en.text: Greyhound Cafe has opened a new branch at MedPark Hospital, its first branch located within a hospital. This branch features exclusive, easy-to-eat, and delicious dishes such as its incredibly tasty deep-fried pork, dry rice porridge, pan-fried eggs, croissants, club sandwiches, and much more. Come and try them!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rojjana Rungrattwatchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like the food at GREYHOUND CAFÉ. They have both Thai and Western food with a twist. The place is also stylish.
Originally, they were famous for their Hainanese chicken rice, but now they've added many more Thai dishes.
They also have a branch in London, England.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr.Arnon Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: Poor service from the staff and kitchen.: We waited over an hour for our missing food, but the waitress said it had been sent to another delivery instead of us. And we have to wait another 30 mins till the food is served.
sample_reviews_en.author: BambooDrinker

restaurants.name: ICU Bar
restaurants.address:

Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A typical Finnish-style bar in Pattaya’s Three Town area. The service was a bit reluctant, perhaps reflecting a touch of Finnish reserve. The place was quite empty and quiet, so you’d expect quicker service, but I had to stand around for quite a while and wave to get the server’s attention to place an order. Ordered meatballs with mashed potatoes, and they were delicious—just the kind of taste to ease a bit of homesickness, if you have any. They also serve Finnish “lonkero” (long drink) for 160 baht. A decent spot to satisfy a craving for meatballs and maybe run into other Finns.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sami Moilanen

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped in for a and some pool, only interaction with staff was to get my drink and pay my bill, Sunday night 7:30-8pm, drink 95b, good view of pole dancers accross from, but they only thing that was, finished my drink and left
sample_reviews_en.author: craig Read

sample_reviews_en.text: Great Suomibaari. Good food and sports broadcasts on several TVs. It was like this a year ago, now the young waiters are not interested in working. So the star rating drops to 2.
sample_reviews_en.author: MARARA68

sample_reviews_en.text: It is the largest and best view point place in Tree Town. Drinks with delicious food and good ingredients. and we can enjoy the new billiard table and darts game (free)
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the staff are friendly. I go to this restaurant often.
It's a friend's restaurant located in Soi Tree Town, Pattaya Central, in Soi Buakhao.
sample_reviews_en.author: teelak teelak

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is good. Service is absolutely terrible. 8 scumbags typing on their cell phones and putting on makeup. I had to pay for what I didn't get. Not going again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jari Tapio Tolvanen

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good and comfortable restaurant great situation in Tree Town one of the best in town. Also one of the best place eat western or Thai food. Best recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jyrki Ikonen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The host is absolutely amazing and the sandwiches are even better. Get a tent +++
5 screens where you can see what you want. The best F1 bar in Pattis
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Stalhane

restaurants.name: Panda Mala
restaurants.address:

MJP6+5GH, Sukhumvit 101 Alley, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Self-serve Mala soup 39฿/100g. I chose medium spicy Mala soup. The flavor was a bit bland; I wish it were more intense, but it did have a slight spiciness and numbness. The dipping sauce is self-serve and the recipe is provided.
sample_reviews_th.author: The Hungry Oab

sample_reviews_th.text:
Average Mala soup, you pick from different ingredients and weight to pay for the meal. ฿39/100g  4 different choice of soup for ฿20 and ฿20 for dipping sauce.

I order Mala 2 soup, very spicy but tasted plane.
sample_reviews_th.author: Pasit R

sample_reviews_th.text: I ordered takeout for 463฿. The dipping sauce was very little, and I couldn't ask for more. The soup portion was also very small. (How can it taste good with so little dipping sauce?)
sample_reviews_th.author: Pom Phavilay

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying self-selection mala tang. You can choose what you want to eat, and they'll charge you by weight, which is THB 39 per gram. Then you choose your soup (mine was tomato) and pay. They'll serve your homemade soup at your table. It's quite nice since you choose what you eat. For the tomato soup, I think it needs more tomato flavor.

The first time I tried the tomato soup, I took only what I could eat. They gave me a lot of soup, and it was delicious. The staff were good. There's a separate dipping sauce charge of THB 20, but you can refill it as much as you want. Ice is free. Overall, it's good. However, if you eat a lot, a buffet might be more suitable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Won S

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, but the female employee with glasses was very rude and disrespectful. She made faces, argued with customers, and even glared at my friend who dropped her tongs, as if she'd been in a fight. When my friend told her she threw tongs at someone, my friend replied, "Who throws tongs at customers when they come to eat?" When I told her, "You could speak more politely," she retorted that I was being rude too. This kind of behavior is unacceptable in the service industry. This is the first time she's been so rude. I won't be coming back to this restaurant. Goodbye.
sample_reviews_en.author: benjawan baisophon

sample_reviews_en.text: The broth is delicious, and the ingredients are of good quality and clean. The prices aren't too expensive, but be careful not to pick too much, as it might increase the price. You can buy by weight at 39 baht per 100 grams. Broth and dipping sauce are 20 baht each. They also have sliced ​​pork in trays (red tray, 40 baht), sliced ​​pork belly in white trays (50 baht), and sliced ​​beef in yellow trays (60 baht). You weigh it and pay, then the staff will cook it and serve it to your table. The restaurant is consistently busy, but there's rarely a queue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaii Kung

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are much higher than other restaurants, but the selection of ingredients is smaller. They also charge separately for the soup and dipping sauces, and the staff didn't even ask if we wanted them. It felt like we didn't get everything we were supposed to get. We paid extra for the duck intestines, but only got a tiny bit. The air conditioning wasn't working either; we were sitting in the heat. Overall, we'll probably only eat here once and won't go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Little Doggo

sample_reviews_en.text: My friend invited me, saying the peanut dipping sauce was amazing. The restaurant was crowded, and the staff found us a table and told us to help ourselves to the sauce. After we finished serving and paid, we went to get the dipping sauce, but there was no peanut sauce!!!... They should have informed us from the start. And it wasn't just our group; others had the same problem. It was disappointing. I wish they would be honest with their customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: P C.

restaurants.name: Thai food & steak
restaurants.address:

19 Ban Baep Alley, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent Thai Cuisine and Warm Service!

I recently dined at Thai Food and Steak, located near Saphan Taksin Station, and had a truly wonderful experience. The restaurant offers an authentic taste of Thai cuisine with a great selection of dishes, all beautifully prepared and full of rich, balanced flavours.

Every meal was fresh, delicious, The combination of Thai and Western dishes makes it a perfect spot for anyone looking for variety without compromising on quality.

A special mention goes to Chef Thu, who not only prepared our meals with great care but also came to our table to ensure everything was perfect. He friendly attitude, attention to detail, and genuine hospitality made the dining experience even more memorable.

The restaurant’s clean, cozy atmosphere and convenient location near Saphan Taksin Station make it an easy choice for both locals and visitors.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Thai flavors, great value, and outstanding service. I’ll definitely be returning soon!
sample_reviews_en.author: nuwan widyarathna

sample_reviews_en.text:
How could anyone dare give 5/5 to this clean but utterly banal dive? The decor is completely charmless, with plastic chairs, folding tables, and a wood-look linoleum floor—in short, it's dismal!
The food is edible, but again, incredibly basic!
The drinks aren't spared either: a dreadful flower juice and an industrial, undrinkable "orange juice"! Luckily, a coconut quenched my thirst…
The only positive points are the friendly service and the more than reasonable prices: 250 baht for this dismal meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jean-Yves Doukhan

sample_reviews_en.text: Hello everyone! This is a wonderful place with excellent food! I highly recommend the shrimp fried rice, fried chicken with broccoli, and delicious Thai tea. The staff is very friendly and the service is excellent, I highly recommend it. We chose this restaurant for dinner and ate there all week, and everything went very well. 🙏🏻 The prices are very reasonable, the portions are large, and the food is prepared very quickly. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Максим Дробышев

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great food & excellent service!

We ordered 3 dishes: shrimp omelette, Pad Thai with shrimps, and Spicy seafood salad. The ingredients were fresh, seafood in the salad had variety, and all dishes had great flavours.

Will definitely return.

The only suggestions for improvement are: pls reconsider the use of uncomfortable bright lighting and loud music (A/C would be great too) .
sample_reviews_en.author: Aussie Koala

sample_reviews_en.text: Staff was friendly, very accommodating and the food was great. We had Thai food a few days and then we asked for a meal that was not on the menu and the chef was great at accommodating us. Price was also reasonable. We really enjoyed eating at this restaurant. Also the coconuts were amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: cliff Lowe

sample_reviews_en.text: Was a grateful surprise! Saw this place near the hostel I'm staying and decided to give it try. The food is really good, delicious! I ordered papaya Thai salad and pineapple fried rice. I think the portions are quite okay. I totally recommend it to others to come by and try it out too! 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Dante Grech Klimt

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent food, freshly prepared with explosive flavors. There's a slight wait when you order, but it's well worth it. It's a family-run business, so there's no need to elaborate on the service; friendliness is standard in Thailand 🇹🇭 🫶
sample_reviews_en.author: David Destefanis

sample_reviews_en.text: Staying in a hotel nearby,so passed this restaurant quite a few times. Last night,5/02 had the pork steak and chicken steak with garlic and parmesan fries, few beers and the food was great. Nice smiley staff. Thoroughly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darren Pope

restaurants.name: Little Hut House Of Waffle
restaurants.address:

20/1 Soi Sukhumvit 23, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is also a chain Thai restaurant, a small shop located inside the mall. It has very long opening hours, so you can still enjoy a meal even after lunchtime, which is very convenient – ​​a big thumbs up for that alone!

They have almost all the common Thai dishes. I ordered a few home-style dishes based on the pictures. The taste was authentic, like a Thai family-style restaurant. The flavors were approachable and the prices were reasonable.

Especially the famous Thai soup... Tom Yum soup! Its sour taste with a hint of spiciness was incredibly refreshing and cooling. No wonder it won the global soup competition early on! It was so delicious!

I took an early morning flight and checked into a nearby hotel. Having missed lunch, a hearty meal here made me feel so much better! I feel like I've come back to life! 😄😄
sample_reviews_en.author: Jean LIU

sample_reviews_en.text:
I reserved a private room on the 2nd floor for a work dinner for over 20 people. Little Hut was extremely accommodating, describing the reservation process (pre-order menu 2 days in advance + pay 50% up front), showing me the room, and keeping me updated on Line.

They were extremely accommodating when we had to push back our reservation time day-of due to traffic delays. The food was hot and ready to serve when we arrived. Everything was delicious, drinks were topped off regularly, and we had staff serving our room exclusively.

Considering the touristy area, the restaurant itself was quiet, peaceful, and very easy to talk in. I'm so glad we decided to work with this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Juliana Mak

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner and all the staff are incredibly kind, treating us like family. I actually regret visiting on our last day. After lunch, they went out of their way to personally hail a tuk-tuk for the kids and even arranged a Grab for us. The food was so good that even the kids, who had struggled to adjust to Thai cuisine for the past five days, wanted to go back for dinner after getting a massage. If I had just a little more time, I really wanted to have dinner and express my gratitude, but it is such a shame I couldn't. Thank you so much,사장님 (owner), and I wish you great success. We will definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Heojaewon sksmswodnjs0412

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for a place that combines affordability with top-notch quality, Little Hut is the spot! The prices are unbeatable, and the food is consistently delicious. Whether you're craving something familiar or want to try something new, their menu has a great variety that never disappoints. The portions are generous, and every dish is prepared with care and attention to detail. It's a perfect balance of value and taste – truly a hidden gem that you won't want to miss! Highly recommend for anyone looking for a satisfying meal without breaking the bank!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aditi Upadhyay

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is located in a detached house on Sukhumvit Soi 23. It was closed during the COVID-19 pandemic, but has now reopened.
They have a full range of Thai dishes, and the food is generally tasty and reasonably priced. It's not usually too crowded, and the atmosphere makes it easy to drop in even if you're dining alone, so I sometimes go there.
The restaurant also has a cafe attached, so you can use the cafe alone.
Apparently it originally started as a waffle specialty shop, for some reason, so I'd like to try a waffle with a coffee someday.
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! Last time I ordered Pad Thai, this time I ordered Khao Soi and Seafood Salad. I ate it all by myself, and the food was worth the price. The wait wasn't long. The staff provided excellent service and recommended dishes for my next visit. Thank you for the great food and service! (I was wearing a t-shirt and running shorts; some restaurants don't provide good service because of clothing, but all the staff at this restaurant were exceptionally good. I was very impressed!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuchjarin Phumhan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had pig leg rice 140 baht. Delicious but double the price of another famous outlet specialist only in pork leg.
But this restaurant serve variety more choices of food. Environment is nice quiet and relaxing. Closed in Sunday

8/09/2025 Monday 2nd visit with 3 dish. Morning glory below average (skip) 100 baht, curry shrimp only 5 shrimp lot of curry with egg (skip) 180 baht, psork leg this round ask only meat no skin ( good) 140 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Goh kiah khin

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday, I happened to walk by and notice an empty restaurant around dinner time. Thought I would give them a shot.  GREAT FOOD.  I'm not a thai food expert, but for me the food had lots of new flavors that I really enjoyed.  Came back again today and tried two other dishes and ate like a .....    Anyway, I highly recommend this place.  I never asked about waffles.  It was all Thai food for me at dinner time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rodney G Rodriguez

restaurants.name: Kang Kaang
restaurants.address:

1204 Song Wat Rd, Khwaeng Chakkrawat, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is by the river and has great photo opportunities, but the food takes a very long time to arrive. It's a QR code scanning system, each table has its own order, but even after scanning, the order doesn't show up. People wait, and the staff doesn't know. The tables by the river are very beautiful for photos, BUT!! While we were sitting there, people who weren't customers came and took pictures, even though they weren't paying customers. The restaurant might not mind, but paying customers sitting there are being able to take pictures just as freely. And when the food finally arrived, this is a plate of Pad Krapow (Thai basil chicken) for 180 baht and a bottle of water for 30 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nan Pirawan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The view in the restaurant is lovely. It is this which brought us in. On top of what seems like a very traditional Thai kitchen set up.

However, the food was very expensive and not value for money. The papaya salad with crab had half of a small soft shell crab. When we brought this up they said sorry and little else. No soda/pop. Paid 60baht for a jug of water. I suppose they can get away with it given the area

The stir-fried pork neck was okay though. Still upsetting
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseff Pole

sample_reviews_en.text: To put it simply, the view wasn't that great, and the food wasn't worth the price of 160++ baht per dish. You could get much more for 40 baht. The instant noodle salad didn't even have half a packet of noodles, the dressing wasn't good, and the vegetables seemed undercooked. I wouldn't go back. If I could give 0 stars, I would. The wait for the food was also long.
sample_reviews_en.author: tanya studio

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai restaurant, located by the river, offers a pleasant view and is filled with greenery, but lacks air conditioning. The food is average and the prices are quite high (pork neck 170 baht, green papaya salad 120 baht, and meatballs 80 baht). The green papaya salad is rather bland, but overall, it's a good place to enjoy a drink and the river view.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Chiu

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu requires scanning. The food selection is limited and expensive. The rice dish was a regular-sized portion and tasted mediocre. The coffee was terrible and overpriced. I'm not sure if they offer takeaway cups. The food took a while to prepare, but the service was okay and the staff were polite. The view was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Not ur Boo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice vibes and music. Nice Chaopraya river view. You order via QR code but pay cash at the end, has an English menu.

Food took too long, messed up my friends order and they kept trying to get us to pay/leave when they hadn't even served the food yet. Food was ok when it arrived.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali Hafiz

sample_reviews_en.text: Great location, right on the river, but the prices are outrageous. Around €4 for a 0.33l Singha beer (which is also a Thai beer) – you don't even pay that much for a 0.33l beer in Europe. I won't be coming back. Two stars only for the location and the view.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony Montana

sample_reviews_en.text: A riverside eatery with a cool atmosphere, the place is simple but the food is delicious, the fried rice is really delicious, it tastes like home cooking but better, it is recommended to come here, the tomyam dish is no doubt, many foreigners also eat here
sample_reviews_en.author: Sams Bahri

restaurants.name: TMEET PATTAYA
restaurants.address:

585 2, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles were delicious (didn't take a picture😅). There's also a drinks and shaved ice shop, which was refreshing and tasty. The restaurant's decor is tasteful, modern, and photogenic. The food is priced appropriately for working adults, and looks very appetizing. I'll definitely try other items on the menu if I get the chance! 💗😊
sample_reviews_en.author: มิ้นอยากจะแชร์—MintYakJaShare

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered shrimp paste mixed rice, crispy pork and red pork. Both of the pork were not good, crispy pork skin was hard like rock. The red pork show signs of being reheated multiple times.

The restaurant is located next to pattaya tai road. Since there's no door, it was very noisy with traffic sounds.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohammad Syawal

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered rice with roasted pork and crispy pork, grilled pork meatballs, wonton salad, and shrimp wonton noodles in soup. Everything was delicious. There's plenty of seating inside. The restaurant is decorated like a food court, divided into separate stalls. The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Woody Witch

sample_reviews_en.text: It feels a bit like a food court, and the menu is quite diverse. Nothing really caught my eye, so I had the noodles, and they were decent. The portion was a bit too small, which was a shame, but since I didn't go there with high expectations... it was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hand Golden (골든핸드)

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a fantastic soup here. The service was great and the place is really clean. We will DEFINITELY come back a second and even a third time. Highly recommended and, most importantly, delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: DJMahaG

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the service was excellent. It's definitely one of my favorite restaurants! 10 out of 10 ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Peerawit Rittimon (พีพี)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, there's a wide variety of menu options, and the staff were very welcoming 🤗
sample_reviews_en.author: บนเดือน

sample_reviews_en.text: The dumplings with spicy dressing were delicious, but the tom yum noodle soup wasn't sour enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aylin Sky

restaurants.name: Hainan Rice Noodles
restaurants.address:

1319, ปาก Charoen Nakhon 19 Alley, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I ordered two bags of the special, each costing ฿114, but what I received was like food scraps. Where is the value in that? Was it worth the price? This was my first time ordering from this shop, and it was a terrible experience. First and last time ordering from this shop. Anyone thinking of ordering from them should be prepared for a bad experience.
sample_reviews_th.author: OBER YNWA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Charoen Nakhon Hainanese Rice Noodles is a traditional Hainanese rice noodle restaurant. The restaurant has two sections, with the main menu items being Hainanese rice noodles and braised pork ribs.

The atmosphere is open-plan, with tables on both sides. During dinner time, it wasn't crowded, and there was no need to queue.

Today, I specifically tried the braised pork ribs section. I ordered Tom Yum instant noodles with braised pork ribs and yellow egg noodles with braised pork.

The Tom Yum soup was delicious, with a prominent sourness and a hint of sweetness. The pork ribs were tender and easy to chew.
The yellow noodles were flat, and the braised pork was soft.

The two dishes cost 140 baht. The government's co-payment scheme is accepted. For those who don't want to travel, online ordering is also available.
sample_reviews_en.author: J'adore

sample_reviews_en.text: I've never eaten there myself, but my family orders from them often. Today, I was free and went out to drive for Grab, and I got an order from this restaurant for a noodle soup. There was no sign, so I walked around to see if it was the right place and was about to call to ask. A man in the restaurant asked what kind of restaurant I was looking for. I said "noodle soup..." Okay, so it was the same restaurant that serves rice noodles. After a while, the mother came out of the restaurant and spoke abruptly, saying why didn't I ask, and grumbling in a harsh tone. I have to say, her behavior was terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: tiSt

sample_reviews_en.text:
💟💟 A legendary restaurant that's been open for decades, guaranteed delicious by numerous customers. If you love Hainanese-style rice noodles, you can't miss this place!

💟💟 We stopped by this area for a break and found this restaurant, which opens very early in the morning. The menu looked delicious. We ordered three bowls, and they were all delicious, especially the hot, flavorful broth.

❌❌ No parking in front of the restaurant. We recommend parking in the alley next to it. ❌❌

✅ Open daily ⏰ 05:30-20:00

📍📍 Location: The restaurant is located at the entrance of Soi Charoen Nakhon 19.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patinya Wisuth

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually order from this restaurant because I like the taste. But today, I ordered and there were red ants mixed in the soup, and while eating, I chewed on a staple. I called to report it and asked them to check the ingredients, but the restaurant seemed unwilling to admit it and didn't seem to care. No matter how delicious it is, this will be the last time I order from them.

I’m very disappointed of the food quality. There are ants and a staple in my noodle, which I think I’m quite lucky to have noticed during the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maya

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was walking around looking for breakfast and found this place, the only one open in the area (6:45 AM).

So I decided to give it a try because I'd never had Hainanese rice noodles before.
The noodles were similar to udon, not very soft, more on the chewy side.
The soup was delicious, with a slight sourness from the pickled cabbage, which was a unique experience.

I tried it with shrimp paste, and it went well together.
The price is typical, 65-80 baht.
It was a unique and interesting experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaaim sqwe3z

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Hainanese rice noodles were delicious. We ordered the dry version with pork offal, and it was very tasty. The offal wasn't gamey or chewy, and the noodles were delicious.

When we ate there, the owner, an elderly woman, spoke a bit curtly, as if she was busy with this and that, and perhaps not in the mood to welcome customers. But we didn't mind too much; we just ate and left.

The restaurant isn't very big, with only a few tables.
The food prices are reasonable and inexpensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noyna little Thai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I walked past and decided to try it because I'd never had Hainanese rice noodles before.

The noodles were more like udon noodles. They had both pork and beef. What surprised me was that they recommended eating it with shrimp paste.

Basically, this dish is a love-it-or-hate-it kind of thing.

But I know this restaurant has been open for a while and has a decent number of loyal customers. If you're in the Charoen Nakhon area, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mooaorcafe

restaurants.name: 한식당 사랑식당(24시간 영업과 배달 ) 배달은 delivery-K(사랑식당)이나 카카오: kking00900 Line: nongnina29(thai) 로 하시면 됩니다.
restaurants.address:

415/18, DJ mansion, SaLang restaurant, Soi Bongkock 10, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Living in Thailand for 4 years.

I visit often whenever I crave Korean food.

I've tried a variety of items on the menu, and they are all above average.

It must be difficult to replicate that exact taste in Thailand, but it is delicious.

The only downsides were that the kkakdugi (radish kimchi) didn't taste like the Korean version, and the sundae gukbap (blood sausage soup) was a disappointment.

However, since I wasn't expecting the exact same taste as sundae gukbap in Thailand, that wasn't too bad.

My favorite menu item is the tteokbokki (spicy rice cakes), and it is tastier than most places in Korea.

The ramyeon set meal is also priced and tastes so good that considering the price of Shin Ramyun in Thailand, I wonder if it's even okay to sell it at this price.

May your business always prosper.

Ps. Sometimes people compare the taste to what they eat in Korea... but it is not easy to compare it abroad, especially in Thailand where food is cooked with different spices.

"Grumbling people will complain wherever they go, so you don't need to worry about every single one of them."

I just enjoy the meal with gratitude :)
sample_reviews_en.author: 김한주

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've lived here for a few months and have been to most of the local Korean restaurants... not this one, but most of them are truly pathetic.

Some try to cater to local tastes by making things a bit salty, and the labor and ingredients are cheap...

But the side dishes and food are so poor that it's hard to even call them Korean food...

I wonder what the relationship is between the person who left the angry review below and this restaurant.

Even if it's expensive, if the food is good, people will go to the restaurant even if it's in a remote area.

If it's good value for money, it'll get great reviews without even begging.

If a Korean restaurant in a foreign country is truly Korean, even if you criticize them, customers will come with a smile.

I'll avoid this restaurant too.

The mindset of people who think others' reviews are sabotaging and terrorizing their business without reflecting on themselves is not good.

The Korean restaurants in this area need to change!!
sample_reviews_en.author: 미래향해서새로운

sample_reviews_en.text: Owner, I understand you need to cut corners on ingredients, but please at least match the price of the food. We ordered two servings of ramen and kimchi stew. Including the delivery fee, the total was 520 baht—well over 20,000 won—but the kimchi stew had only 6 pieces of meat measuring 1.3 cm. The side dishes consisted of three types of kimchi, 6 pieces of kimchi, 19 strands of seasoned bean sprouts, and 5 pieces of seasoned cucumber. We ordered two servings; is this really right? Lol. To make matters worse, the delivery driver must have shaken the kimchi stew so much that half the broth spilled into the bag. I won't complain about the delivery driver's fault, but the food looks incredibly uninspired, and for someone running a food business, your portions seem very small.
sample_reviews_en.author: 장고고

sample_reviews_en.text:
Korean restaurant I never want to go to again! I went to this place a month ago.
Even when a customer walks into the store and makes eye contact with the staff, there is not a single greeting. When I ask if I can order, only then do they respond. On the table, there are stains of red pepper paste soup, and the utensil container and tissue holder are completely empty. It seems like a restaurant that is not managed.

Look at this 200baht ramen setting the ramen noodles are soggy and overcooked. In Thailand, 200 baht is enough to go to a Thai style meat buffet. This place charges menu prices high like other Korean restaurants, but the service is worse than a 50baht street noodle shop.

After the food was served, there were no staff waiting nearby until I finished my meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: edward

sample_reviews_en.text: This was the most delicious doenjang jjigae I had during my three months in Pattaya. I was a bit taken aback by how salty it was, but soon I could taste the flavor reminiscent of the stew my grandmother used to make. I think it would have been even more delicious if it had been just a little less salty. Anyway, I ended up eating two bowls of rice. I ordered pork belly, but there was no separate oil-based dipping sauce. It was a bit difficult to communicate because the staff didn't seem to know what I was looking for, but they searched around diligently and eventually found sesame oil and brought it to me. Thanks to the kind service from the staff, I had an even more enjoyable meal. I would definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Good So

sample_reviews_en.text: The tteokbokki is delicious. If you ask for it to be spicy, they will make it. Sometimes, when I'm craving it late at night, I order delivery. I eat it while walking for exercise. I always go late, but I haven't seen the owner, but the servers are very friendly. I don't eat Korean food often, but I think I eat at this place the most. It's a bit rustic, but it seems to be a place that gets the basics right. However, I don't really reach for the side dishes. It's not that they don't taste good, it just doesn't go well with them. But sometimes, I put them in the fridge and eat them with ramen. It's not bad for that purpose.
sample_reviews_en.author: NJ C

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had lunch and dinner yesterday.
The soft tofu stew was just okay, but the seafood(?) and pork were mixed together, so it was a bit odd.
The ramen was perfect, and the tteokbokki was a bit sweet, but I thought it might be because I have a sweet tooth, but the three people I went with also enjoyed it very much.
I took three bites of the chewy noodles and didn't finish them. It had a strong bitter aftertaste, perhaps from the seasoned gochujang or the vegetables.
The female server always had a smile and was very good at serving.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay

sample_reviews_en.text: While walking down the street, I stumbled upon a Korean restaurant with a Korean sign and went in. I tried kimchi jjigae, doenjang jjigae, tteokbokki, and squid rice bowl every other day, and even ordered delivery to my hotel. I was always satisfied. I was amazed by the deep, rich flavors and impressed by the friendly staff. Unfortunately, I haven't tried the janchi guksu yet, but I definitely plan to try it on my next trip. I was so happy to be able to enjoy such a hearty Korean dish in a foreign country.
sample_reviews_en.author: 장현철

restaurants.name: ร้านลาบยโสธร (ลุงเสก-ป้าบัว)
restaurants.address:

94375 Prasert-Manukit Rd, Khlong Kum, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Larb Som Tum Rod Ded is a restaurant that truly delivers incredibly spicy and flavorful dishes. If you enjoy authentic Northeastern Thai cuisine, you should definitely try it. The flavors are intense in every dish, from som tum (papaya salad) and larb to nam tok (spicy meat salad) and various salads. The Thai som tum is especially delicious.
The atmosphere is relaxed, like having a meal at a friend's house. The prices are reasonable, the portions are generous, and the staff are friendly and provide fast service. Anyone who loves intensely spicy Northeastern Thai food must try this restaurant at least once. The flavors are guaranteed to satisfy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Revolution

sample_reviews_en.text:
Friday at 6 PM, after work, I invited my parents to come eat. It was raining nicely, perfect! 😅 You can park in front of the restaurant.
I eat here often, but this time I tried the pork hot pot and it was delicious. Usually I order grilled pork neck, grilled pork, duck larb, papaya salad, and bamboo shoot soup.
It's a casual, home-style restaurant, a mix of Northeastern Thai and Bangkok influences.
They have a wide variety of dishes on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakura Midori

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good (but on the sweet side). There's a wide variety of menu options, and the prices are reasonable. However, the service wasn't very impressive. On two occasions, we had to pay the bill more than three times, and each time it took over 10 minutes, the staff acted as if nothing had happened.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fvhzz

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northeastern Thai restaurant is located by the roadside. The food is delicious, the dipping sauces are tasty, and the prices are reasonable. You can park on the street in front of the restaurant, or park in Soi Nawamin 68 and walk through.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sora Aram

sample_reviews_en.text: "Tiger's Tears" (a Thai dish) is the best. The last time it was dry, because Uncle Sek makes it drier and it tastes better, but Auntie makes it oilier. We prefer it juicy. Next time I'll emphasize that I don't want it dry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sinith Boonyarat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good, but when it's crowded, things get chaotic and don't follow the queue. You have to keep following up and directing them. The billing is also disorganized and slow. It's best to come when it's not busy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jitta I (Nook)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good and the prices were moderate. The Thai papaya salad was delicious (I forgot to take pictures of many dishes). The sweet dipping sauce and the beef shank were also tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is good, but I haven't figured out which papaya salad is the best yet because I don't like sweet food, and they already season it.
The sweet liver and grilled liver were excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattaratorn Pimsarn

restaurants.name: Shabushi by Oishi
restaurants.address:

162/1-2,168, 10 Pracha Rat Sai 2 Rd, Khwaeng Bang Sue, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff are unproductive. I don't know what they're doing in the kitchen. I happened to go refill my water and saw some of them sitting around doing nothing in the kitchen. The conveyor belt wasn't full. There was only one young woman working at the front of the store, constantly asking customers if they wanted anything extra, but she also had to attend to new customers. Who am I supposed to order from? I'm so confused. What are they doing? Does the manager know about this? It looks like the store is about to close down. I won't be using this branch again with this kind of service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apirak Suwanyotee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The portion was very small, only 3 pieces of pork as shown in the picture.
(My personal opinion is that it's too little for this price.)
I called the restaurant and they said it was standard. If this is the standard for this restaurant, then...

Other Shabushi branches give much more.

I've seen people talking online about some branches giving small portions.
This branch is probably one of them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttaphon Rungruangkanokkul

sample_reviews_en.text: I just went there at 7:30 PM. The restaurant is a bit small, but I liked it. The service was excellent; the staff kept asking if I wanted anything else. When they saw I was getting full, they even brought a tray of fruit – "Would you like some fruit?" How could I refuse? The tempura shrimp was hot and crispy, the curry was delicious, and the sushi was good too. I ate until I was completely full!
sample_reviews_en.author: A VaR TaR

sample_reviews_en.text: Great! They replenish the stock regularly, it's clean, delicious, and they maintain this standard. It's fantastic! I'll definitely come back again. (At first, I was a little worried because I've been to other branches before where the food wasn't replenished often and didn't look fresh and appetizing, but this branch is great in every way.)
sample_reviews_en.author: P N

sample_reviews_en.text: The price isn't cheap. When I asked for a second serving of garlic, they said they reserved that for new customers only. What kind of service is that? Your dipping sauce isn't so amazing that it'd be delicious without any seasoning. The staff were also inattentive; they disappeared when I called them. It was incredibly frustrating.
sample_reviews_en.author: nantida kanpatanon

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff were good, and despite the large number of customers, they remained cheerful. However, my criticism is regarding the ingredients and food quality. Knowing that it's the beginning of the month, they should have been better prepared. You timed us for eating, but the food came out slowly. This needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: รัชพงศ์ แดงอำพล

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup made the food salty from the moment it was opened, I don't know why. The serving dishes took a long time to arrive, and we had to ask for the dipping sauce. The portions were very small for the price; some items were unavailable, which should have been noted. The food portions were really, really small.
sample_reviews_en.author: LeeB Ka

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is still the same, and the blonde staff member with braids is cute, cheerful, and provides excellent service. I ate there last month and only just remembered to write a review to show my support. The cleanliness of the restaurant is okay, maybe because I went during a less busy time.
sample_reviews_en.author: sivanad ninthiam

restaurants.name: Hatam Restaurant
restaurants.address:

WVCH+Q8Q, Soi tukcom, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm really disappointed with my experience at Hatam Restaurant. I've been there twice, and both times were bad.

It's a self-service place, but the prices are high, and the food quality is very poor. The food tasted old and not fresh at all. It honestly felt like they kept food from previous days instead of preparing fresh meals.

After eating there, I had stomach pain and felt very sick, even to the point of nausea. That's completely unacceptable for any restaurant.

In my opinion, you're better off eating street food than going here. It's not worth the money—everything is overpriced, from the food to the drinks.

I do NOT recommend this place to anyone.
The restaurant is rubbish, all the food is leftover from a few days ago. When the food is left over, it is not thrown away, it is reheated for the customer and sold again. The price of its food and drinks is also more expensive than buying it elsewhere 👎🏼👎🏼👎🏼👎🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Marashi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I think it's Middle Eastern cuisine.
The restaurant is clean and always kept tidy, including the way the food is arranged.
The staff are very friendly.
Canned drinks and other items cost extra, but they're not expensive.
You can also eat as much fruit and ice cream as you like.
The kebabs are grilled outside and are popular, so we waited for them to be replenished. The fries were crispy and delicious.
It's not super tasty, but for a 250b buffet, I think it's a good deal.
If you don't have a canned drink, you pay 250b, but if you give 300b and give it as a tip, everyone will say "kop kun ka" (thank you).
I recommend leaving at least a tip.
sample_reviews_en.author: かわかわ

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had unlimited evening buffet for 250 baht. Most of the dishes were wonderful, i only didnt like two. The choice is huge, theres also fresh veggies, fresh fruit, selected soft drinks and a scoop of ice cream for dessert. Never tried persian food before, but im very happy with Hatam! Also ladies working there are super nice and helpful. Comes highly recommended!
Food - top.
Staff - top.

The only complaint i have are blinking lights inside the restaurant. There is lots of them. It is a nightmare to photosensitive people, might even cause a seizure. So if you are one of them - take that into account.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michał Zygmunt

sample_reviews_en.text:
The environment was very cool. The staff was very polite and respectful, they spoke a little Persian. The salads and fruits were good and very varied. The meat dishes like chicken, kebab and fish were not very good and the meats did not smell good at all. But the stew of gheeme and ghorme was delicious, provided you don't eat the meat😂
But still, because I don't really like Thai food, I went there twice and ate there. Overall, I don't think it's possible to find a first-class Iranian restaurant in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: ebrahim niazy

sample_reviews_en.text: If I had to give this restaurant a real star rating, 3 would be fine, but I'd give it 5 because the owner of the restaurant was very helpful. My tour leader was deducting 4,000 baht from me for a tour I didn't go on and said he would take half of the money. But with the help of the restaurant manager and his threat to the tourist police, I got all the money back. I may not go back to that restaurant anymore, but I want to thank them very much by posting this. I hope they read my message.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ramin Ketabi

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good, but the vegetable stew had almost no meat. The manager made the atmosphere bad, she always either stands next to you or walks over and controls what and how much you eat. I was completely disappointed with the food and she treats her employees like a barracks. The outdoor furniture is also very old and the springs are useless and you sink into it. The restaurant was clean and the layout and variety of self-service dishes were good, but they didn't have fish.
sample_reviews_en.author: A P

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited this Irani Restaurant for their buffet and had a great experience overall. The food quality and taste were excellent, with a wide variety of traditional Iranian dishes that were well-prepared and flavorful. The ambiance was warm and inviting, adding to the authentic dining experience.
The staff was courteous and accommodating.
It's a great place for those looking to enjoy a delicious Iranian buffet. Highly recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr Zeeshan ul Haque

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is perfect except the two of the stuff who are over serving in a way and in the same time don’t do anything. Just walking around and asking you several times if you like coke or water.. i said “you already asked me twice, if i want i will take” also the other stuff is asking me same things.. and they are both patrolling around the buffet with the hands behind the back like guards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marko Ivkovic

restaurants.name: เตี๋ยวต้มยำ นาคนิวาส ลาดพร้าว71(เจ้าเก่า ฮีโร่ )
restaurants.address:

3 1 ซอย ลาดพร้าว71 Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a noodle shop I frequent, alternating with the Muang Phra Rot noodle shop. Their delicious dishes include regular noodle soup, Tom Yum noodle soup, and creamy Tom Yum noodle soup with pork ribs. They also have Northeastern Thai food like Som Tum (papaya salad) and Larb (spicy minced meat salad), but I wonder why they don't have sticky rice.

It's located in the same shopping mall as Tops Daily Mini, so there's ample parking.

Before it became a shopping mall, this area used to be a kindergarten, so it has a pedestrian crossing and traffic lights (which were installed during the time of Mr. Phichit Rattakul as Bangkok's governor, who wanted to promote Soi Nak Niwas as a model street). However, you still need to be careful when crossing the road because some cars don't stop for pedestrians.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noppadol Kanjanatawewat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop offers a wide variety of dishes, including clear broth noodles, tom yum noodles, and creamy tom yum noodles. They also have rice dishes and other à la carte options, such as basil chicken and fried rice, which are very popular. Dim sum like shrimp and crab dumplings are also on the menu, as well as papaya salad.
For us, the tom yum noodles are delicious and reasonably priced, with generous portions of ingredients. The fried dumplings are a must-try; they're inexpensive and perfectly crispy.
There's plenty of parking available as it's located in an area with coffee shops and a hair salon, making it very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thavisak Phongsai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tom Yum Goong (creamy version) (9/10): I'd rate this as the best dish of the meal. The restaurant did an excellent job; it was rich, flavorful, and packed with ingredients.
Tom Yum Gai (traditional dry version) (7.5/10): The flavor was moderate, seasoned to suit everyone. The highlight is the fragrant fresh lime, with a prominent sourness. Those who prefer it saltier or sweeter can add more seasoning to their liking.
Overall: Generous portions for the price. Good quality ingredients; the pork and offal pieces were large and satisfying. (If you don't like spicy food, I recommend ordering "mildly spicy".)
sample_reviews_en.author: charnwit mena

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a wide variety of food to choose from, including noodles and Northeastern Thai dishes. The noodles are delicious, the broth is flavorful and goes well with the noodles and toppings, but the portion size is a bit small; one bowl isn't enough to fill you up. The fried chicken here is incredibly crispy and delicious; I order it every time I go. The papaya salad is average. There's air-conditioned seating and outdoor seating. The restaurant is quite large. The prices are mid-range to slightly high. You can park in the complex.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to restaurant. I recommend it to anyone who asks; everything is delicious. I personally love their Tom Yum soup, which comes in a wide variety of options: minced pork, bouncy pork, pork meatballs, fish balls, and even the offal is excellent – ​​not smelly or fishy. It's great value for money; the portions are generous, with so many ingredients I often order extra noodles. It's incredibly filling! I haven't tried their rice or appetizers yet, but I'll try them next time. There's plenty of free parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chinanang Tamrongtanakijakarn

sample_reviews_en.text: To be honest, the restaurant has expanded its menu, but if you can't maintain the taste, you shouldn't add more items. For example, today I had Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup), while others had Tom Yum (spicy soup) that tasted fine as usual. Mine was completely tasteless. If you're going to add more menu items but can't maintain the quality of the taste, then don't do it. Customers are happy to pay 60-70 baht for a bowl of noodles if it tastes good.
sample_reviews_en.author: THANAWAT MANASIRIJINDA

sample_reviews_en.text:
• All the dishes were delicious.
• The service was excellent.
• I especially liked the garlic pork and the papaya salad.
• We ordered the spicy pork rib soup (Leng Saap) with less spice, and it was just the right amount of spiciness. I'm not sure if ordering it less spicy would result in a much spicier version.
• The prices were good. The rice dishes come with hot soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chawal

sample_reviews_en.text: Usually, my orders are always correct. Today, I went back specifically to buy it again. I clearly ordered Tom Yum soup with pork ribs (creamy version) in the box, but what I received was something without ribs. I only realized it when I got home and opened the bag. I'm extremely disappointed. The order was prepared quickly but incorrectly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mee Mee

restaurants.name: Rice Soup Shop
restaurants.address:

WWP2+RQ2, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: What's going on? I arrived, sat down at a table, and they ignored me, didn't come to take my order. I had to look at them and call out to them. When I tried to order, they asked in a rather dismissive way, "What do you want?" Then, when I said, "Could I have a menu, please?", they took the menu and threw it at me. When I tried to order, they just walked away. I only ordered one thing, and they just walked off. I wasn't even finished ordering! It was so confusing. And there was only one other table of customers at the time. It's baffling. Do they really not want to serve or provide service that much?
sample_reviews_en.author: DJ PEE salted egg

sample_reviews_en.text:
You can use the Thai Help Thai Plus program here. The food tastes great, the prices are affordable, the portions are generous, and the flavors are spicy and delicious, both the main dishes and the appetizers. You can sit and have drinks in a nice garden atmosphere with lots of trees, and there's relaxing folk music playing in the evenings. The kitchen closes at 3 AM, so you can stay as long as you like.
There's also a tattoo shop and a barbershop. I got a tattoo at the barbershop; the price wasn't too high. I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: jitpanoo rumruay

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was in the area and was thirsty. I went into this open-air bar to get a drink. I sat down in the shade and waited until someone paid attention to me. Then my order was brought to me.

The food at the next table looked good, and I was told it tasted good too. I didn't eat anything myself because I wasn't hungry.

I don't want to say much more about it, but a little more friendliness would have been nice. Go there yourself and see if it suits you...

P.S. Regarding recommendations... I'd rather not comment on that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Horst Christian

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean, has music, and the food is delicious. They use fresh fish, squid, and shrimp, and the portions are large and generous. The prices are reasonable. It's a typical Thai rice restaurant style food. We ordered stir-fried kale with crispy pork, mixed seafood salad, and steamed sea bass with dipping sauce, and everything was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ittrock Boonkerd (โก๋ทุ่ง)

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves rice porridge, à la carte dishes, single-serving meals, appetizers, and ice-cold draft beer. It's a great place to stop for a delicious meal while driving. The service is friendly and the fish is fresh, purchased directly from local fishermen for a sweet, firm texture, and served with a spicy dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: nat natnat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, but the music is too loud. If it were played more softly, it would be more pleasant to listen to and would complement the food better. The guitar riffs were too loud and drowned out the overall atmosphere. Overall, it was good, but the music was excessively loud.
sample_reviews_en.author: นรินทรา โอลิเวอร์

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times and the food is generally good. However, this particular dish, "Yum Sam Krob" (crispy mixed salad), which contained fish maw, cashews, and fried dried squid, was a real waste of money. The taste was terrible. 1/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Star

sample_reviews_en.text: It was past 3 AM, I was starving, so I opened Google to find a restaurant. I found this one that said it was open 24 hours. I drove all the way from Jomtien, it was freezing, and when I got there, it was closed. What a mess! 😡
sample_reviews_en.author: Nina Williams

restaurants.name: MC 69
restaurants.address:

23 Charoen Rat Rd, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Rooms for rent near Wongwian Yai Market, close to BTS Skytrain, Silom, Sathorn, Charoen Krung Road, and Bang Rak Market.
sample_reviews_en.author: taworn pongkajonthon

restaurants.name: Home
restaurants.address:

3 Ruam Chit Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small shop near the Phichai intersection has air conditioning and an air purifier.
The menu focuses on egg-wrapped rice, but they also have other dishes.
The food looks delicious, with clean plates and a relaxed atmosphere.
The prices start at 69 baht. An uncle takes your order and delivers it to the kitchen. I initially thought I'd have to wait a while, but it wasn't.
We ordered a plate each and it was just the right amount of filling. They also have a few sweet drinks, like lemon tea and green milk tea, each for 35 baht. It's not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cactus156

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small, cozy restaurant with a homey feel. The elderly gentleman taking orders is very friendly and dedicated to providing excellent service. The prices are reasonable considering the quality and quantity of the food. The flavors are mild, suitable for those who prefer balanced tastes, and I personally like this style. Parking might be a bit difficult, and seating inside is limited. The food doesn't take too long to arrive. If you're in the area, give it a try – it might be a new restaurant to explore.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theeraphat Ruangvicha

sample_reviews_en.text:
A simple, inexpensive restaurant. It's clean, and the food I had was tasty. I would happily revisit and try more things from their menu.
The owner ( I assume) was friendly and the service was good.
I had chicken with garlic and fried rice. There a loads of garlic and it was all very flavoursome
sample_reviews_en.author: Doug Slowman

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent restaurant, we thoroughly enjoyed our meal! The Green Curry chicken and shrimp omelet combo was fantastic! The Tom Yum was delicious! The gentleman who served us was very welcoming and readily offered recommendations! Furthermore, the prices are very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Degos Maelle

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food at affordable prices. It's a small shop but packed with quality. The owner provides excellent service. They offer both food and drinks, including coffee, green tea, Italian soda, etc. The menu focuses on egg dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Songkran Wairattana

sample_reviews_en.text: Great omurice/eggyrice restaurant. A lot of options, tom yum and pad kra pao flavour were great. Toppings inside really added too it. Tea was also great and prices are very reasonable. 10/10 will visit again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Seth Hoffman

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is excellent and the hygiene is impeccable. During my time in the city, I've stopped by whenever I could. I definitely recommend it, as the service is also very courteous and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Victor Vargas (vict8rv)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the restaurant has a comfortable, homey atmosphere. If you're in the Suan Ruen intersection area, I recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Banyat Sittikraipong

restaurants.name: เจ๊หย่ง ข้าวมันไก่ไหหลำ ศาลเจ้าพ่อเสือ (พุทธบูชา 29) ข้าวมันไก่ ไก่ทอด หมูอบไหหลำ
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 9/5 Phutthabucha 29 Alley, Bang Mot, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the opportunity to try Hainanese chicken rice near Phutthabucha. I chose this restaurant because it had parking, air conditioning, and good reviews.

The restaurant offers three menu items, and I recommend trying them all to experience the full flavor. Today, we ordered:
• Hainanese Boiled Chicken • Fried Chicken • Hainanese Braised Pork

Here's a review of each item without bias:
• Boiled Chicken: The offal was excellent. I personally prefer breast meat, and this restaurant prepared it well—not tough, but soft and tender.
• Fried Chicken: Even with plenty of dipping sauce, it remained crispy.
• Hainanese Braised Pork: I recommend not eating it plain; add the orange dipping sauce on the table and eat it with the hot rice—it's delicious!
• The rice was perfectly cooked. The restaurant said it's delivered through a third party, preserving the authentic flavor from the grandfather's recipe.
• The dipping sauces on the table are unlimited.
• They also offer free hot and cold Chinese tea. I really appreciate this, as I drink a lot of water and enjoy sipping hot tea to cleanse my palate and cold tea to finish—refreshing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tipsuda Khamphanyim

sample_reviews_en.text: This is truly amazing Hainanese chicken rice. I first tried it via delivery and was so impressed that I tracked down the restaurant and finally came to eat in person. I was very impressed with the ingredients and taste. The special order was just the right amount to fill me up. The chicken was tender and firm, the rice was fluffy and not too oily, and you can refill the dipping sauce as much as you like. The soup was delicious, comforting, and you can ask for refills. Other dishes were equally delicious, especially the Hainanese braised pork with Nan Chu sauce; the pork was tender and easy to eat. The chrysanthemum tea was fragrant and not too sweet. The restaurant has a warm atmosphere with limited seating. The owner and staff are very friendly. Parking in the complex is limited; if it's full, try parking at the 7-Eleven lot at the entrance of Soi Phutthabucha 31.
sample_reviews_en.author: Spidey P. Tien

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chicken Rice that's claimed to be delicious:
: The portion ordered was "extra," as pictured.
: The chicken meat is sliced ​​thinly, bite-sized, no thick chunks.
: The chicken is tender, not tough or chewy at all.
: The dipping sauce is in a sealed bag, easy to open and not messy.
: The soup is served in a rubber band, quite cold, only slightly warm. The chicken soup has a slight fatty smell.
: The soup should have been hotter when ordered around lunchtime.
: The rice is short and plump, but lacks the fragrant aroma of rice.
: There's no sweet soy sauce included; you might have to ask for it.

For most people, it's considered average.
(For foodies who have visited over 200 restaurants)
(Visiting is optional.)
For me, it's something I do occasionally when there's nothing else to eat.
