I might stop by again, but the soup not being hot is disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shin Shinra

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Hainanese chicken rice is delicious. The rice is fragrant, sticky, and soft. The chicken pieces are thick and well-cooked, not mushy. I like that they provide ginger separately so you can add it to the dipping sauce yourself.

The owner is friendly and dedicated to making good food for customers. Today I went alone but wanted to try the stewed chicken with pickled lemon. The regular size is too big for one person, so they sold me a smaller size.

The restaurant is clean, bright, and has self-service tea.

I've been eating here since they were located near the Shrine of the Tiger God, and I stop by every time I pass by after they moved to Phutthabucha (but whether I can get a table is another story because they sell out very quickly 😆).
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanaporn L

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant started in 1970 at the Chao Pho Suea Shrine 🐅 and has branches in Charansanitwong, and this is the third branch (run by the son).

It's a small shop that gets its ingredients from a central kitchen. The taste is good, guaranteed to sell out before 11 am every day.

The rice is salty but not soggy. The chicken is juicy but not greasy, though not as good as Kuan Ah on Rama 3. The chopped chicken pieces are thick enough to chew, and delicious. The portion size might be smaller than other places compared to the price, but the taste is not ordinary.

The atmosphere is cozy with 3-5 small tables. It's air-conditioned and has parking for 6-8 cars shared with other businesses.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teethat Ongkosit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Hainanese chicken rice restaurant that impressed me on my first visit, and I've become a regular customer.
The rice is soft, not sticky, and perfectly dry.
The chicken is tender and juicy, and you can choose your preferred part. This restaurant is very accommodating to customers; you can even order half a bowl of rice. For the dipping sauce, they provide chopped ginger and chili peppers to add as you like. You can also ask for refills of the soup. The soup is carefully simmered to perfectly complement the Hainanese chicken rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiddy

sample_reviews_en.text: The Hainanese chicken rice was delicious. The chicken was tender and juicy, the rice was flavorful and soft (though not very fragrant). The dipping sauce was tasty, with a nice soybean paste aroma. Ginger and chili were available to add as desired, as the sauce wasn't very spicy. The soup was also tasty. The price is 60 baht for a regular portion and 70 baht for a special portion, which is neither cheap nor expensive considering the quality of the food. The staff provided good service, and the restaurant was very clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: komkrit Petsong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch of the famous Hainanese chicken rice restaurant near the Chao Pho Sua Shrine is located in a small complex with very limited parking. You have to park at the nearby 7-Eleven and walk back. I arrived at noon and they were out of fried chicken 😭
I had the regular Hainanese chicken rice. The chicken was tender, the rice was fluffy and not too oily, but the aroma wasn't very strong. The soup was okay, and the dipping sauce was decent. Personally, I liked it more than another famous branch nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: kritboon thamcharoensathit

restaurants.name: Five Dollar Philly Cheese Steaks - Sathorn
restaurants.address:

20 Chan 18 Alley, Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Second time ordering, first time was the Philly Cheesesteak (Not $5) it was a success… should have just stayed with that.

This time extra Fish N’ (10) soggy Chips with a side of Mini Corn and Mac n’ Cheese. Wouldn’t recommend any of them again. The 70 baht for the 3 spoons of corn felt pretty rude (photo attached).

Stick to the Philly Cheesesteak even though it’s not $5 = 150baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Travis A.

sample_reviews_en.text: I was surprised to discover this spot away from the usual tourist areas. The Philly and poutine were well cooked- the meat was not greasy or overcooked, and the fries were generously loaded with just the right amount of cheese.  My order was done by the owner of the franchise, which was a personal touch to the experience. Highly recommended if you’re looking for decent Philly
sample_reviews_en.author: Elijah Shel

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered grab delivery and the food was made quickly and packaged securely. It was even still hot when it got to us, which was a big plus. The bread was fluffy, the beef was delicious and the portions were large. The potato wedges were not dry, and the dipping sauce was also tasty. We will be ordering again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachael T

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered the Australian Beef Philly and wasn’t sure how good it would be. I was so surprised at how good they nailed it. There was so much flavour, a decent sized bun, the bread was fantastic and overall great quality. Even with delivery, it was still warm and didn’t go soggy. Would definitely recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eleanor Mills

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this restaurant because I really wanted to eat mac and cheese, and it was amazing. The food here is very delicious, and the mac and cheese is the best I have had in a long time. The place is nice and the staff are friendly. I really enjoyed my meal and I want to come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Around N

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve been to the On Nut location before. This location just opened up. For me it’s the best cheesesteak in Bangkok. The new location is convenient, very clean, and very cozy. I had the bacon cheeseburger with nacho chips. You can’t beat this quality of food for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lance Sodsaikich

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place for Philly cheese! Quality food with reasonable price. Salad was also delicious. There were about ten seats in the indoor dinning area. One table outdoor. No parking at the restaurant but you can park at the gas station nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wan Jai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food and friendly service. The staff speaks both Thai and English. You can bring your foreign friends here.

The restaurant doesn't add VAT or service charge to the menu, which is rare these days.

I'll definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gao Bulakul

restaurants.name: FOLK
restaurants.address:

94 Beach Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited this restaurant three times for dinner during my last year visit to Pattaya. Located inside the walking street beside Mouline Rouge and right opposite to Fahrenheit bar. It is bit expensive but due to its location and service as well as taste of Pizza I felt it was worth its price. You will really like the atmosphere there during night. I am not sure if it remains open during day time. They have wide range of food items along with Pizza but on all my visit there I ordered pizza only hence can't comment on other food items.The service was good. They have outdoor as well as indoor sitting arrangements. The big problem i facee was due to n availability of non smoking area there. I don't smoke hence I had tough time eating there when a gentleman was smoking. All in all my overall experience was good. You can try dinner here and must other the pizza of which I uploaded the photo (green one) . That is a must.sorry i forgot the name of the pizza but it was non vegetarian. The other one was just ok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kundan Rawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a handy place to eat when you're struggling to find a place to eat on Walking Street.
It used to be called KING CAFE, but it's now called FOLK. The food is brought in from the neighboring King Seafood, so it might be part of the King Seafood group.
What surprised me this time was the Gapao Moo Sap I ordered on a whim. It was incredibly delicious. I've had Massaman curry and hamburgers here before, and I remember those being excellent as well.
They also have Pattaya Beach Beer, a local craft beer that's been getting a lot of attention lately.
Considering its location, the prices aren't high, it's not too crowded, and the indoor seating is air-conditioned. This is a truly recommended place.
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text:
I cant recimmend this restaurant.
Very nice restaurant  on Walking street Pattya Thailand. I ordered  the Japanese beef with rice and a banana smoothie. The beef and rice were good, but the bottom of my smoothie  inside the glass there was a bug. The establishment refused to take the smoothie off my bill. My waitress was very professional and advised management of my complaint,  but they refused to take the smoothie off my bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathan Sanders

sample_reviews_en.text:
The environment inside is amazing. Music at s reasonable volume, lower lighting, good air con. Nice!

The food is terrible.  Ordered a wagyu burger. Medium.  Came out well done and topped with stuff not mentioned on the menu. Like smothered in coleslaw.  I ask for a new burger no coleslaw, and remind her I want medium.

Next burger came out RAW. Like each side kissed the grill and then served.
sample_reviews_en.author: Drew Craven

sample_reviews_en.text: Those waitresses are amazing friendly and helpful to service my foods and drinks. The  medium well Rob eye steak was superbly done. The sauce was amazing too. Great service and it sits in the middle of the WALKING STREET. Recommended to come and enjoy the great foods and services.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mackintel

sample_reviews_en.text: A really cool restaurant on the famous walking street in Pattaya Thailand. Really cool fitout with a fifties vibe and a rear section with beautiful chestershire leather couches. A good range of drinks and a great menu with plenty of variety. Food was well prepared and presented.
sample_reviews_en.author: C C

sample_reviews_en.text: Had chicken masaman with rice. Portions are large and food was tasty. Large selection of food available right in the middle of walking street and prices were surprisingly moderate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arjun Mallik

sample_reviews_en.text: Hello, I have tried the lamb shank with mashed potato, I would say very basic, nothing special, the service was quite good, not a place to keep in my list really..thanks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Al H

restaurants.name: XIAN Halal - เซียน เนื้อตุ๋นฮาลาล
restaurants.address:

736 Happy Land Sai 1 Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, I don't usually eat beef. I only recently started trying it, but this restaurant does it really well. I especially love their Hainanese beef rice. They use beef oil instead of vegetable oil for all their stir-fried dishes, which is amazing – it makes the food incredibly fragrant and flavorful. I couldn't eat there in time, so I ordered three boxes to go. The soup was light and not too strong, perfect with the rice. The mala stir-fried beef was delicious; I loved the aroma of their beef oil mala. It wasn't too spicy, which is exactly how I like it. They emphasize that they don't use MSG or preservatives, so you can eat here with peace of mind. The staff were polite and provided lovely service. My photos aren't great, but I just wanted to say I actually ate here. The Hainanese beef rice was SO delicious (again!). Please, please, please make more of this!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pk Sun

sample_reviews_en.text: Masha Allah, Alhamdulillah, got chance to stop by to a beautiful small restaurant with white clean theme. Car parking needs to find a bit in front after the shop. Food is fantastic especially during rainy season like now, mala soup base noodle is a perfect match. They have rolled and silver noodle options but our kids love egg noodle more. Must try the braised beef with egg noodles. Their man tau is also excellent. Will definitely come back again to try the rice menu. Good price for a bowl of delicacy. BarakAllah, may Allah bless this shop and jazakumullah khayr. 🙏🙏🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Lukman Prasetyo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Starting with the staff, they were very polite, lovely, and provided excellent service; I was very impressed. However, the food wasn't very impressive. 1. The hot pot I ordered had cold broth, not hot at all. The alcohol burned out very quickly, and the water hadn't boiled yet, resulting in undercooked vegetables and a very bland broth. This needs improvement. The rice was soft, though.
The stir-fried basil with egg had a generous amount of meat and was decent.
sample_reviews_en.author: sukunya maligong

sample_reviews_en.text: We always come here as a family and the food is absolutely delicious 🤤 especially the rolled and silver noodle soup, the beef is so tender and with the chili oil it makes it even better. Also the xian style beef and rice is soooo good 👍.The owner and her workers are so nice and always have good service. The restaurant is also nice and clean I recommended for everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yous Kha

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is in a good location, right by the road. However, the taste was quite bland; the soup was very, very bland. The noodles were a bit too soft, like they were overcooked. The meat was tender. The price is 85 baht, excluding drinks, which is a bit pricey. Overall, I wasn't as impressed as I expected.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittichai Prangprasat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Alhamdulillah. One of the best Halal restaurant in Bangkok IMHO. Not many sell chinese style halal in this town.
Location a bit far from tourist area, but its worth every penny. The soup is very delicious and fresh. The beef is very tender. Surely will come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Adhitya Nugroho

sample_reviews_en.text: Good service, clean restaurant. Parking is available on the street in front of the restaurant. The food is average in taste. Some pieces of braised beef and tendon weren't very tender, so elderly people might need to make some effort to chew.
sample_reviews_en.author: Songwut W

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice and the restaurant is clean. If you like braised beef, this is suitable. The noodles are soft and the braised beef is perfectly tender. The broth is clear, like typical Chinese broth. Overall, it's good.
sample_reviews_en.author: ไชยา อังสไพศาล

restaurants.name: Rosdang - Rice with Crispy and Barbecue Pork
restaurants.address:

184 Maha Rat Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
67.10.06_Today I visited Wat Phra Kaew (Temple of the Emerald Buddha) and then took my mother here for lunch.
I recommend this place! The crispy pork with a rich, savory and sweet sauce is delicious. The pork is truly crispy and looks fresh, not leftover from the previous day.
The sauce is salty first, then sweet, and the half-egg is a nice touch. It's very tasty.
The rice is also good quality, soft and not hard.
Crispy pork with rice costs 70฿ per plate, and iced coffee is 20฿.
sample_reviews_th.author: ห๊ะะะ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of my favorite restaurants that I frequent because the food is easy, quick, and tastes great. Those with a big appetite might even order two or more dishes. The restaurant offers a variety of dishes, including roast pork rice, crispy pork rice, braised pork stew, braised pork curry, and Hakka noodles.

Today, I happened to be buying things in the area, so I stopped by for the roast pork and crispy pork rice. It was excellent! I was very impressed.

I heard that the restaurant has been open for over 40 years. The atmosphere inside is quite classic, which adds to the experience (but if you come in a large group, don't expect to sit together; you'll definitely be separated, haha!). The restaurant is quite small and gets crowded. I've never actually gotten to sit with my friends; sometimes eating with strangers can be a fun experience too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khajohn Wichakort

sample_reviews_en.text: The roast pork and crispy pork rice is incredibly delicious! I came back today and had the roast pork and crispy pork noodles. The sauce was great, the noodles were good, and the crispy pork was super crispy. Everything was cut into bite-sized pieces. It was perfect as is, no need to add any extra seasoning. It's a small shop run by the owners themselves, and they're very friendly. You might have to wait a bit during lunchtime, but it's definitely worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: N X

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crispy pork rice is fully loaded with Chinese sausage and egg. The taste isn't bad, edible but not exceptionally delicious.
The crispy pork is very crispy, not in very large pieces.

The dry noodles with crispy pork are not a large portion; one bowl might not be enough to fill you up. It's not bad, edible but not exceptionally delicious either.

Free parking is available at Sanam Luang, and you can walk to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: TK TK

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious!
The roasted pork is crispy and fragrant.
The braised pork curry is amazing; the pork is so tasty.
The curry sauce is a bit like Thai curry but with a Japanese curry flavor.
Adding a little dipping sauce makes it even better.

The noodle soup is also very good.

They have fresh sugarcane juice, which brings back childhood memories.

I eat here regularly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daily D

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very authentic Thai-Chinese restaurant with amazingly tasty pork stew. I highly recommend this menu!! Or you can enjoy the pork noodles or rice with crispy pork.

Great tasting pork stew!

I've been eating here since I was a student, and it's been 20 years now, and the taste is just as delicious. Anyone in the area should definitely try this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitsumon Dummananda

sample_reviews_en.text:
Roast pork rice & crispy pork rice are delicious.
Crispy pork curry rice is decent.
Stewed pork soup is good.
The restaurant is clean and the owner provides good service.
If you're in the Tha Maharaj area, I highly recommend eating here.
The restaurant is next to a shop selling traditional Wat Pho balm and massage oil.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teady Juntui

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stopped by for a bite before visiting Wat Mahathat.
Ordered roast pork rice and stewed pork soup. The roast pork rice was okay, the crispy pork was very good, and the stewed pork was also good, but overall the portions were a bit small.
The restaurant was clean and the food came out quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyada B.

restaurants.name: Goi Si Mi
restaurants.address:

11 Happyland Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This is a homemade-style Chinese restaurant.
It's located at the beginning of a village, an old place with an old air conditioning unit that wasn't on when I visited during rush hour, probably broken. I ate quickly and left.

I ordered two dishes: Goi See Mee (stir-fried noodles with seafood) – average taste, good ingredients; and Drunken Chicken with Jellyfish (฿180) – delicious.
The chef cooks everything himself.

Parking is available on the street in the alley.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sakura Midori

sample_reviews_en.text: This small restaurant, discovered through social media, is surprisingly delicious. The taste is comparable to high-end restaurants, but at very reasonable prices compared to expensive Chinese food. The Hong Kong-style stir-fried noodles with kale and beef were amazing – the flavor was great, the beef was tender, and the noodles were perfectly cooked with a nice wok-fried aroma and a slightly crispy texture. The chicken stir-fried noodles were also excellent, tasting just like those from a big restaurant. The dry-fried fish maw was also fantastic. The mixed vegetable stew with glass noodles was incredibly flavorful – I loved it! I'll definitely be back. Five stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vitaya Kunavichayanont

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Wonderful Taste of Traditional Chinese Cuisine

I had the chance to try the drunken chicken, and it was excellent. The chicken was tender and flavorful, and the XO dipping sauce was wonderfully balanced and delicious. I enjoyed the sauce so much that I had to buy a bag to take home—only 35 baht!

The Goy See Mee was also delicious and very much to my taste, while the salted fish fried rice was another standout.

Everything was flavorful, well-balanced, and satisfying. A lovely place for anyone who appreciates traditional Chinese cooking. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Prawut PATHOMYOK

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is a bit hidden, but if you're a regular customer, you won't get lost. The atmosphere is simple.

The stir-fried noodles (Goi See Mee) are good, delicious, and exactly as pictured; the sauce isn't too thick.

The shrimp rolls (Hae Geun) are crispy and delicious with a good filling, and the plum sauce is just right.

The fried noodles have a wonderful wok aroma and are perfectly cooked, not too dry.

The fried rice is good; the rice grains are fluffy, and it has that slightly smoky wok flavor. A sprinkle of chili fish sauce makes it even better.
sample_reviews_en.author: MR. Mah Street food

sample_reviews_en.text: This is our family's favorite restaurant! The food is delicious, the flavors are great, and the service is good. It's a home-based restaurant, clean and tidy, the prices are reasonable, and the quality and quantity of the food are excellent. There's parking available in front of the village. My parents came here after seeing a review by "Phayoonbood" (a Thai food reviewer) and have been back many times. It's truly delicious! If they have taro ice cream, you must try it; it's amazing and the portion is very generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natemiseiko

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small, affordable Chinese restaurant in the Happy Land area. The food is decent, and the prices are very reasonable considering the quality. Recommended dishes include stir-fried noodles with seafood, oyster omelet, drunken chicken, and fish noodle soup with black bean sauce. The restaurant also sells mooncakes year-round, at 2 for 150 baht, with both lotus seed and durian fillings. The staff are friendly. Parking is available in front of the restaurant and in Soi 1.
sample_reviews_en.author: Buntoon Ekbundit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a homemade-style restaurant with delicious food. The portions are large, served quickly, and you don't have to wait long. They also offer single-serving dishes. The staff are helpful in recommending dishes. The fried Chinese dates are especially good. All the food tastes like it's from a high-end restaurant, but the prices are affordable. You can enjoy fine dining at a budget-friendly price.
Parking is available along the street throughout the soi (alley).
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukanya Krishnasreni

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered two items for delivery:

Stir-fried noodles with fish and black bean sauce (80 baht)
- The flavor is quite strong. There are plenty of pieces of fish, and the noodles are fragrant.

Stir-fried noodles with chicken (70 baht)
- The flavor is light and easy to eat. The bamboo shoots are crispy and delicious, not chewy. The noodles are a little oily.

Overall, the taste is good, the portions are appropriate, and the price is reasonable. Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Notdy I am

restaurants.name: SEOUL’s COAL Major PINKLAO
restaurants.address:

QFHG+JV5 Klinsri Plaza, Bang Bumru, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Run away!! The prices are cheap, but the food quality is the worst I've ever experienced at a Korean BBQ restaurant. The pork slices were frozen, with a mix of fresh and old pieces, some even greenish, and they kept them in the freezer untouched. It's like they don't freshen the stock daily. The vegetables were a mix of wilted and fresh; only those with good eyesight could eat the fresh ones. The glasses weren't properly dried after washing; they were still wet. The water in the fridge wasn't refilled. The soda, even though it tasted the same, had different flavors – one was less soda and sweet, the other more soda and not sweet. The kimchi was clearly spoiled, both in smell and taste, and hadn't been kept cold enough. Didn't they check the stock before opening? It's unbelievable. The cashier had long fingernails and was covered in tattoos – I've never seen anything like that before, except maybe at a nighttime restaurant. I've never encountered anything like this at a Korean BBQ restaurant. In short, I'm never coming back. Goodbye.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phooza Adluz

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨Today I tried the buffet at Seoul's Coal and was very impressed!

• Food: The meats and seafood were of very high quality and there was a wide variety to choose from, including pork belly, large mussels, and fresh squid grilled over charcoal – so delicious!

• Side dishes: The side dish line was extensive, with fresh vegetables, kimchi, and sesame oil bean sprouts – all with an authentic flavor.

• Highlights: My favorites were the "pork skin," which was perfectly chewy when grilled, and the generous portion of "enoki mushrooms."

• Desserts: The selection of ice cream in various flavors was perfect for finishing off the meal.

• Atmosphere: The restaurant is beautifully decorated in a modern Korean style, clean, and the service was fast and attentive.

💰They also have a promotion with 3 red cards (for discounted prices).

📍If you're looking for a great value Korean BBQ place, I highly recommend this one! You won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: ชวนกินตลอด

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is really delicious. They don't have many appetizers, but that's okay because we were more interested in the grilled meats. The marinated pork is amazing – tender, flavorful, and incredibly fresh. They also have other types of pork, including frozen options, which keeps it fresh. I've eaten at many yakiniku restaurants, but this one's marinated pork is my favorite. They have three dipping sauces; one thick, orange sauce (I don't know the name) is delicious. The price, around 319 baht, is reasonable. We were completely full. The smoke extraction system is excellent; I've eaten here twice and my hair didn't smell like smoke at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: AK ak

sample_reviews_en.text:
📍: Seoul’s Coal, Major Pinklao Branch

A great Korean BBQ restaurant in the Pinklao area 🔥
It's an all-you-can-eat BBQ buffet with several price options 💰
The menu has a wide variety of choices, and the ingredients are good, fresh, and clean 🥩
The pork is tender and flavorful. Grilling it and wrapping it in Korean lettuce is amazing 🥰
They also have appetizers, like kimchi soup to cut through the richness.
The restaurant is located on the G floor of Major Pinklao 🚗
Parking is available in the Major parking lot.

#1stEyeView
sample_reviews_en.author: Tananun Na sai

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork is very fresh and clean, with no odor. They have pork tongue, neck, and belly – a complete selection. If you want high-quality pork, not the kind that's been marinated with chemicals, I highly recommend it. Importantly, the sauces and ice cream are delicious and not to be missed, especially the taro, coffee, strawberry, and chocolate chip flavors. I was hesitant to go in because there weren't many people, but I'll definitely be back. Just getting such a wide variety of fresh pork is worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: comewithme951

sample_reviews_en.text: I was so annoyed! There were cockroaches everywhere. While I was eating, a cockroach walked to my table. When I got my drink, a cockroach fell into my glass. The pork was green and had hair on it. At first, I endured it and ate because I really wanted to try it after reading such good reviews. But I couldn't take it anymore; I couldn't finish it and had to ask for the bill and inform the staff. The cockroaches even showed themselves to the staff. The meat also had a strange smell. So sad. 😭
sample_reviews_en.author: ชนาพร รอดช่วง

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu offers a wide variety of choices, and the food tastes delicious. Besides grilled items, there are plenty of side dishes and snacks. The ice cream is amazing and shouldn't be missed. The overall atmosphere is good, even though there are only 1-2 staff members at the counter, the service is friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: zE_Ro

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to eat there that day and really wanted to write a review. They charged a 10% service charge, but the staff provided no service at all. You had to get your own plates, bowls, and spoons. Why charge 10% then? It doesn't make sense. It's like they don't even have a tax invoice number.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joylyzcl

restaurants.name: NYE cafe
restaurants.address:

432, 1 Chiang Mai Rd, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant isn't very big, it's located inside a hotel. The atmosphere is great, and the staff are incredibly attentive and helpful. They're always smiling and giving good recommendations. There are seating options by the river or in an air-conditioned room. The light in the evening is beautiful, offering great river views. The food is delicious. The lotus stem sour curry was amazing – I'd never had anything like it before! 👍🏻 The fish cakes were chewy and came with a creamy and apple sauce, very unique. The braised pork spring rolls had a wonderfully crispy wrapper. But my favorite was the shredded duck salad; it had lychee in it, which balanced the sweetness perfectly. They have a huge drink menu with cocktails, mocktails, and their own herbal drinks. I ordered "Jan Krachang" and another drink I can't remember the name of, both delicious – a chrysanthemum tea mixed with lemon, honey, and other ingredients; the flavors were perfectly balanced. The restaurant has parking in a side street, and you can either take a golf cart to pick you up or walk, although the street is a bit secluded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ntm L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located quite far inland, but there's a parking lot across from Lhong 1919, and you can call the hotel's golf cart to pick you up. We went on a Sunday, so it wasn't crowded. We got a seat outside by the river. 📍Atmosphere: There are indoor and outdoor seating areas. The indoor area has a retro feel with music playing. The chairs aren't very comfortable, but the outdoor area is quieter. Staff brought us fans, but the outdoor tables don't have speakers, so it might be quieter, and you can hear music from the tour boats passing by on the Chao Phraya River.
📍Food: The Thai food wasn't as spicy as I expected. The portions were appropriate. I'd rate the food 7/10. There aren't many appetizers; the menu focuses on main courses.
📍Drinks: There's a wide variety of drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: peeraya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, with bold and flavorful dishes. Every dish was superb. I heard that the chef here is a top student of Chef Yingsak.
The mocktails here also have unique flavors that you won't find elsewhere, such as the mango sticky rice flavor. I regret not trying many more flavors.
Besides the food, what sets it apart is that the restaurant isn't very large because it's located in a boutique hotel, but the atmosphere is fantastic, right by the Chao Phraya River.
The staff are also very friendly and provide excellent service.
The rooftop, in particular, has an amazing atmosphere in the evening, perfect for booking for private events.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanavit Pitaksith

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice atmosphere with indoor and outdoor seating by the river. They accept the government's co-payment scheme. If you need to use multiple co-payment accounts, please inform the staff in advance that you would like to split the bill into 300 baht payments, as they are not yet familiar with handling multiple co-payment accounts. Parking is available in the hotel's designated parking lot opposite the former Lhong 1919, then walk out into the soi (alley).
sample_reviews_en.author: Greeze Papayaz

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered the award-winning dishes: fish cakes and shredded duck. Personally, I preferred the shredded duck to the fish cakes because it was more flavorful and well-balanced. For dessert, I tried the avocado coconut ice cream, which was delicious. I guessed it was made with Thai avocado because it wasn't very creamy.

We came in the evening, so it wasn't too hot because the view faces east. We took the elevator up to the rooftop to watch the sunset.
sample_reviews_en.author: Johnwick

sample_reviews_en.text: Must-try dishes include the fried fish cakes, unlike any other – incredibly delicious and chewy! And for dessert, the rich coconut ice cream. Parking might be a bit far from the restaurant, but it allows you to experience the local community along the way. The restaurant even provides a golf cart for transportation back. The staff are polite, courteous, and genuinely willing to serve you.
sample_reviews_en.author: piyawan somsuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food area is stylishly decorated, and the food, snacks, and drinks are all excellent. Breakfast is also good.

The atmosphere by the Chao Phraya River is lovely with a cool breeze.
The boutique style decor creates a private, warm, and comfortable feeling with a cool breeze.

The staff are very attentive and polite, paying attention to every detail.

I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Ch

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s a hidden gem!
Everything we ordered was delicious.  The atmosphere was amazing & the service was impressive 👍
Special thanks to Khun Ain and Khun Tony for their service.
Also, a very nice gesture from Khun Ain who arranged a plate of fruits with a candle since it was my daughter’s birthday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sonia Narang

restaurants.name: Panini Bakery Chef
restaurants.address:

Soi Bongkot 414/50-51, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hello,
Today I arrived at the Panini restaurant in Pattaya. Between 15:00 -16:00.
The location is excellent, lively and comfortable, the place is very suitable for families and more.
Upon entering the restaurant, I received a warm welcome from the owner and the waiters. The place has new and neat furniture, smells good and is pleasant to stay in.
The menu is rich, including food of all types. Such as Israeli, Omani, and Thai cuisine, including kosher meat.
I ordered oven-baked chicken, it came with a quality baguette, salads from matbuha, hummus, tahini salad, rice, and sahug. It was great, delicious, and fresh. The style of serving was wonderful, lively, rich in different flavors, the most beautiful serving in Thailand.
Thank you very much for your wonderful service.
Recommended for families.
Groups.
And individuals.
Yes, a big force!! 🙂
sample_reviews_en.author: DORAL TALGAUKER

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw advertisements for the place and said we'll check it out. It started with the fact that I didn't have breakfast at the hotel so I came for breakfast and very quickly came back for dinner. The place is cozy and inviting with a homely atmosphere that suits anyone who wants fresh and delicious food under the management of Gili who makes sure everything is perfect.
I tried almost the entire menu and everything I ordered was delicious and fresh (shakshuka, schnitzel salad, chicken breast, hummus, bagel toast, goulash and more). I had fun and delicious eating there to the point that I spent every day there during my stay in Pattaya.
In short, the place is recommended, delicious, fresh and most importantly, all the products are kosher and the place is not open on Shabbat.
sample_reviews_en.author: nuriel zabari

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent food, the owner gives an amazing attitude and good service, one of those places you simply have to go to, Thais don't understand these little nuances in food that only we Israelis understand, very tasty food, feels like home, highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gadi Perez

sample_reviews_en.text: Good homemade food, along with local dishes, pastries and sweets. Clean! Pleasant and light atmosphere. Gili, the owner, is pampering, with a big soul - an exemplary host, always there and making sure it is delicious and pleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: BEN DAVID

sample_reviews_en.text: I came for quick bite and a barista coffee but I was surprised to find that you only do espressos. This is my 2nd visit when my first was mid last year 2025 when you had just opened and you said you would introduce other coffees.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nelson Chan

sample_reviews_en.text: I was at the restaurant twice today. The first time I received a dish I didn't order. I waited an hour and received a dry dish. The second time I also waited a long time and received a very small dish and left hungry.
sample_reviews_en.author: שלו יהב אביב

sample_reviews_en.text: The hummus I ordered was excellent, too bad it didn't come with a salad. Friends ordered Yemeni soup and enjoyed it. The service was okay, a little expensive, but that's how it is in all Israeli restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moshe Gazal

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited the place and saw the meat refrigerator without any prior notice. All meat is Chabad kosher. The kitchen is hygienic and clean. The owner and service are excellent. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: zohar d

restaurants.name: Mk Restaurants Big C Suanglung Rama9
restaurants.address:

Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible, inattentive, and customers had to follow up themselves.
From the moment we waited outside the restaurant, we were told the tables were full and to wait a while. When a table became available and was cleared, they still didn't call us to sit down. The staff walked around serving customers, ignoring those waiting (inside the restaurant). We had to ask ourselves if we could sit down, and only then did they say, "Yes, yes."
We forgot our spoons on the table, so we asked for them as usual and ordered more items at the same time. But the staff just went back to wiping tables. We waited a very long time, and even after asking a second staff member, we still didn't get the spoons. We finally asked a third staff member, and the first staff member clearly took our request but didn't take any action. They just kept wiping tables as if they didn't care. It was very confusing.
And the four portions of jade noodles we ordered were all hard, like they weren't cooked. Normally, when we eat at other branches, they don't blanch them, but everyone else at the table agreed that the noodles were hard and raw. Only the manager was polite, nice, and smiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: nattakan yimchucherd

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch is near my house, and I eat here very often. There aren't many tables, and it's always full in the evenings, especially on weekends. They offer both à la carte and buffet options. Sometimes the service is slow, sometimes it's fast, which is understandable.

But my last visit was extremely bad. The service was incredibly slow, and some items were missing – I can't even explain it. The table next to me even called a staff member over to complain and demanded their bill before they'd even finished eating.

I've noticed that the staff at this branch change constantly. I don't know how they manage it, but personally, I think this is the worst branch in Bangkok!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bestlingchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This buffet was totally not worth it. Everything took forever to arrive. They should hire more staff or just offer à la carte options. The food wasn't even delivered on the 90-minute order.

With à la carte, you just get missing items and they cancel the orders, but with the buffet, you still have to pay the full price even if your order is incomplete, unless you have incredible patience. We had to ask for our food at least three times, and they didn't even bother to check on our drinks until they were all gone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenjira Chaimanee

sample_reviews_en.text: They finished preparing the food but didn't bring it out, didn't ask, and didn't inform us. We went in to complain, but we wasted time waiting outside. The inside area was full. We waited almost an hour for just two boxes of pork noodles. They finished preparing it and left it inside to get cold, as if it were inedible. The staff didn't even come out to ask anything. Terrible service. How are they trained? The management is completely disorganized.
sample_reviews_en.author: คลาสโนว่า ราม2 ลิ้นรัว

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food service was extremely slow. They didn't bring all the necessary utensils, and even after placing the fresh ingredients, there was no soup served – at least three times. I ordered two glasses of the same drink, but they were different types, which was confusing.

I asked for rice three times, and even after finishing the pork, the rice still hadn't been served.

This was a regular meal, not the buffet.
sample_reviews_en.author: mochii zz

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in the same area as Big C Supermarket,
Suan Luang Rama IX branch.
MK Restaurant is on Chalerm Phra Kiat Rama IX Road,
opposite Suan Luang Rama IX Park.

The restaurant has been newly renovated. The interior is clean and tidy, and the staff provides good service.
It's a small branch with only about 10 tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: kan onun

sample_reviews_en.text: This time, the service was good. They kept refilling our water and asked if we wanted lemons. The bill was processed quickly. The food is consistent across all branches. This branch has a sink in the restaurant, even though it's not large, but there were insects flying around the sink area. This should be improved.
sample_reviews_en.author: b_chrys

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu is inconsistent; there's no roast duck, plain rice, or steamed pork ribs on the menu. There's a limited selection, I don't know if it's because it's a small branch or for some other reason. My order was cancelled because it wasn't available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thongprakay Chaisena

restaurants.name: Pepper Lunch Central Rama 3
restaurants.address:

L5, Central Plaza 79/3 Rama III Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is okay, expensive but tasty, but the service from the male staff is terrible. For example, I ordered a chocolate Coke but got a plain Coke, saying it was a mistake and that the ice cream wasn't frozen yet. I asked if I could drink it plain, and I had to say yes. I even asked if the price was the same before they would fix it. I ordered two drinks and only got one straw, and it was the kind used for smoothies. I asked for another straw and requested a regular straw, but the same person said they didn't have any, only this type. I called another person and asked for another straw, and got a regular straw, but the same person said they were out of those. Extremely inconsiderate. Terrible service at Central Rama 3. Avoid this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: ชายกลาง คุณพระ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible service... Sit down 10 mins without notice, no one to accept my call, no staff on the floor, just a cashier doing her work.
The (head?) staff come out from back door and take my order (15 mins passed 🥲) then she walk to a table nearby to clean the seat AND she use the same cloth to clean the table 😱😱😱
Then she repeats... use the same piece of cloth to clean the seat then the table!!! No other cleaning tools besides that little piece of cloth for cleaning during this pandemic.
I swear not to come here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beau Palida

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the SECOND time I am complaining about the poor portion control at the Central Rama 3 branch, and it seems management just doesn't care. Today, I ordered the 'Beef and Hamburg' combo again, and the beef portion was shockingly small—barely one-third of what it should be. The Central World branch is 2-3 times better in both quality and quantity. If management keeps ignoring regular customers like this, I will stop eating at Pepper Lunch altogether. Unacceptable service
sample_reviews_en.author: Kids Emilia Show

sample_reviews_en.text: The service at this restaurant is poor. It's understandable that delivery riders have to walk in to place their orders, which is correct in case the restaurant's order notification doesn't show up. However, this needs improvement. They shouldn't just tell riders to sit outside, and if they sit outside and no staff pays attention to them, they're sitting for free. This needs to be improved.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surasak Issarachan

sample_reviews_en.text: I recommend eating at other branches. After the food is served, you'll be almost finished with your drink by the time they serve it. There are four kitchen staff, two serving. Compare the price with the service, there are much better food options at other locations at similar prices. However, if you have a lot of time, you can come here. You can wait half an hour for a glass of water.
sample_reviews_en.author: Artiz ATk

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff member named Nat provided terrible service. She was impolite, abrupt, and lacked a service-minded attitude. Requests for water refills were extremely slow; she told me to wait a moment, but then forgot and I had to remind her again. I usually eat at this restaurant often and have never experienced anything like this before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Victor

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste wasn't to my liking. It was spicy only from black pepper, more like Western food.
A small child ate there and couldn't eat much.
Smoke was billowing out of the restaurant.

There was only one staff member taking orders and serving food. The manager only appeared briefly. Customers waited a long time for service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Billy Than

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! It came in a piping hot dish, so I had to stir-fry it quickly 🤣 I barely had time to take a picture!
It's okay for an occasional treat. The taste is good, and you can add sauces to your liking. They give you a generous portion of rice. The staff were friendly and provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: PizzaP

restaurants.name: Sungkom Clinic - Paediatrician doctor / child doctor
restaurants.address:

48/11 ถ. ประชาราษฎร์สาย1 Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

restaurants.name: Chester's Central RamaIX
restaurants.address:

ห้องเลขที่ B35 ชั้น B1 9/9 Rama IX Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff is terrible. People are sitting and waiting, and when the appetizers are ready, they just leave them on the shelf without calling out, even though the order was placed a long time ago. They claim it's just sitting there, not ready yet. The food is cold by the time it's been sitting there for ages. Their excuses are so illogical! Absolutely awful!
sample_reviews_en.author: ปลายทาง ที่ว่างเปล่า

sample_reviews_en.text: Expensive and tasteless. The picture shows a chicken breast, but they brought out chicken skin, fat, and a tiny bit of meat. The meat was already cold. The portion was very small. The price/quality ratio was very poor. There were huge, fat flies flying around the table. It was a terrible experience. I highly do not recommend it.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here twice now and I've been impressed, both when it was quiet and when it was busy. The staff are attentive, the counter staff speak clearly, and the other staff members are friendly and caring. Keep up the good work! It's rare to find a restaurant where the staff are so dedicated to their work.

sample_reviews_en.text: Ate at grill guru. The waitress was impressive and knew English very well. We got a few seafood dishes and steak. It was a wholesome experience and food was great. We ordered fried morning glory, papaya salad, medium steak (which turned out medium well but was still good) and a dish that we thought it was pork ribs but ended up getting served the vertebrae of a pig! As we had seafood, it was more on the pricier side of 700 per pax.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yeo Jun Khai Nicholas

sample_reviews_en.text: Very disappointing experience. The restaurant is overpriced for what you get — the portions were small and the quality of the food did not meet expectations. The service felt pushy rather than welcoming, and not particularly friendly. On top of that, they add a 5% service fee, and the prices listed on the menu do not include VAT, which makes the final bill even higher than expected. Overall, not good value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mátyás Mohos

sample_reviews_en.text:
The volcano ribs were terrible; the meat was stuck to the bone, not tender enough, and not flavorful enough. The tofu and egg soup was too oily and greasy. The Tom Yum seafood soup was good—rich and flavorful. The basil pork was okay. The stir-fried water spinach was good.

But only those who like strong flavors will enjoy it. If you prefer lighter fare, maybe don't come to Thailand? 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Puma Liao

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible food comes with cold rice and cold eggs stale mango. Small positions, worst place in all of Thailand. A solid 1 star with an arrow down. Also for waiting for a long time. Incompetent staff. If you want a bad stomach and frostbite from their air conditioning then this is the place for you, left with a cold nose cold ears and a stomach that was not full. Close your shitty shop.

sample_reviews_en.text: Missed a dish, we had finished the rest of the food and was told it would be 1 minute 10 minutes later we cancelled my main dish and asked for the bill, no apology for the food being missed off or the drinks that we had to ask for when our food arrived. Chips over cooked, duck came out lukewarm. Probably better places around, give this a miss.

Terrible. Food was cold. Server forgot one dish we ordered. Had to ask twice for drinks as the server forgot. Very disorganised. Do not be fooled by the full restaurant, very poor food and service.

Oh and 650 baht for the food was too expensive
sample_reviews_en.author: Luke Jones

restaurants.name: สืบ SUEB 思 @ถนนจันทน์ ข้าวไข่ข้น ข้าวผัดปู กุ้งอบวุ้นเส้น
restaurants.address:

244, 246 ซอย จันทน์ 18/7 Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sueb 思, a restaurant specializing in glass noodle casserole with shrimp, has opened a branch on Chan Road. They also serve rice with creamy scrambled eggs, crab fried rice, and glass noodle casserole.

I'd driven past a few times, and finally got a chance to eat today. After a tiring run, I recharged before heading home with the rice with creamy scrambled eggs and crispy chicken stir-fried with chili and salt. The chicken was fried perfectly crispy and not oily, the chili and salt stir-fry was flavorful, and the creamy scrambled eggs were fluffy and not too runny. The rice was soft. It was a delicious dish 😚

I saw many other tempting dishes, including Tom Yum and Tom Kha soups (all with young coconut shoots), glass noodle casserole with shrimp, and glass noodle squid (they stated the squid was cuttlefish). The glass noodles used here are high-quality Tha Ruea glass noodles.

If you're passing by Chan Road 18/7, stop by. There's a parking lot called Vegas nearby, which is quite spacious and convenient. It's located amidst many delicious restaurants on Chan Road, and you can easily walk to Sueb from there.

#SuebGlassNoodleCakesWithShrimp
#RiceWithCreamyScrambledEggs
#FoodIsLife
sample_reviews_en.author: Tong Limmontree

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been a customer since their Phra Athit Road branch.
I love their baked glass noodle dish because they use really good quality glass noodles, and the shrimp are already peeled. This branch has a wide variety of creamy egg rice dishes, and most importantly, everything is delicious! I love it.

The staff are friendly and the place is spacious, comfortable, and very clean.
My absolute favorites are the baked glass noodle with shrimp (large size), the creamy tom yum soup with coconut shoots, and the creamy egg rice with minced pork, chili, and salt. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: dolaya boo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I arrived when the restaurant was about to close, but the staff came out smiling to greet me.
The food was delicious. I followed them from their Phra Athit Road branch. The restaurant is clean and spacious, and the prices are reasonable with good value for money. I ordered minced pork with chili and salt, creamy egg, and baked shrimp and squid with glass noodles.

The staff were polite and helpful, recommending dishes. If you're passing by, don't forget to stop by and eat. I'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตุ๊กตา กินไปเรื่อยยย

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered two dishes.
The crab fried rice cost 90 baht. It had only crab claw meat, the taste was bland, and the price was high – not worth it.
The other dish was glass noodle casserole with shrimp for 120 baht. It was a very small portion, and also very expensive. It tasted only salty.

Furthermore, the restaurant should accept customer reviews and use them for improvement, instead of explaining what ingredients the restaurant uses, as seen in previous reviews.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nam Tnt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely fantastic!!!
The glass noodle casserole with shrimp was excellent; the noodles were chewy and soft, and the shrimp were fresh and bouncy.
The crab fried rice with pork cracklings had a wonderful wok aroma and the rice was perfectly cooked. Eating it with the crispy pork cracklings added a delicious texture.
The creamy egg rice with stir-fried chicken in chili and salt was just the right amount of spiciness and fragrant with garlic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pomme

sample_reviews_en.text: The glass noodle casserole with shrimp was delicious, the shrimp was smooth and the dipping sauce was spicy but a bit hot. The crab and pork crackling fried rice had a wonderful wok aroma, but the flavor was a bit bland. Adding chili fish sauce and a squeeze of lime made it incredibly delicious. Overall, I highly recommend it. The prices aren't too expensive either. We finished everything in the pot!
sample_reviews_en.author: charoen thotakanunt

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted great and was well-prepared. The prices were moderate. The creamy egg rice with crispy chicken was 75 baht; the eggs were soft, the chicken was crispy, and the rice was of good quality. The portion wasn't too big, just right for one person. The staff were cheerful and provided quick service. They even gave us ripe mango to finish the meal, which was a lovely touch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwanant Sirinaphakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Have a chance to try new restaurant around here. I think most of foods are average.  But signature dish with screamble eggs is quite good. The rest I think are fine. The price a bit expensive for this area but you can also find similar place to get cheaper. If yu would like to try. Please do. But I would consider to try something else for next time for all I paid. 🍳🥚🌭
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawat .P

restaurants.name: LAMPU.BKK
restaurants.address:

153 Soi Lamphu, Wat Sam Phraya, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for a place that feels like a warm hug, Lampu is the spot. The atmosphere is incredibly warm and cozy, making it the perfect place to unwind.
We started with their coffee, which was rich and aromatic. The fried sweet potatoes are a must-order—so crispy and delicious! For the main course, the Mushroom Spaghetti was impressive; the pasta was cooked to a perfect tenderness, and the subtle spicy kick made the whole dish feel so refreshing alongside the mushrooms. Lastly, the Signature Steak was a standout—the fried carrots were surprisingly good and paired perfectly with the steak and the egg. Everything about this place feels homey and special.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saranya Cha

sample_reviews_en.text: Chef Ploy's restaurant has a warm atmosphere, lovely staff, and excellent service. They offer both food and drinks (the latte is delicious and smooth). The food menu has a wide variety of choices, from rice dishes to snacks. The food tastes great and is easy to eat – I'd give it a perfect ten out of ten. The ingredients are high-quality and clean. I highly recommend it for anyone looking for a place to have a meal with friends, a date, or a business meeting; you can sit and chat all day. After your meal, you can take a walk around the area, as there are many tourist attractions nearby. We will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Panchika Kittipalo

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a fantastic atmosphere. Every corner is adorable, with cute little details everywhere. The air conditioning is wonderfully cool, and the food is delicious – every dish is fantastic. The drinks are refreshing too. It's a satisfying and worthwhile experience. The staff are lovely, kind, and provide excellent service. I'll definitely be back often! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: พัชริญา ปรีชาพันธ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere and the food is delicious.
I tried the risotto, pork neck steak, and spicy shrimp spaghetti and loved every dish. The prices are moderate. It's a short walk from the main road near Wat Sangwet. From what I saw, there's no parking available; you might have to park near Bang Lamphu and walk a short distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiti Khatphitthaya

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff doesn't care about the customer. The food is barely edible, the portions are ridiculously small, and the price is very high. 303.- baht. I ordered a pork steak with Café de Paris sauce and fried carrots. I also had a small bottle of water to drink. It wasn't a steak, and the sauce was disgusting. I advise against going there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julien Engelhard

sample_reviews_en.text: A nice restaurant named Lampu.bkk is located in Soi Wat Sangwet. There is a wide variety of food and beverages. Today I had the grilled pork neck pasta with a fried egg, and carrot crisps, and the mushroom barley risotto with grilled mushrooms. They were all delicious! There are also many spots to take nice photos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pranee Sutthasri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cozy atmosphere, very good taste of food, reasonable price ( cafe latte just 80 B), there are two blends of coffee which fit all people favorite 💛

The food is delicious and so unique, it’s well rounded of perfect combination between thai & italian… the risotto is one of the best fusion dish i’ve had
sample_reviews_en.author: NN NN

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food with reasonable prices. The coffee and desserts are also very tasty. The atmosphere is warm and cozy, making it feel just like home. It is a great place for all types of customers, whether you come with family, friends, or on your own. Highly recommend !!!
sample_reviews_en.author: pattaraphan satim

restaurants.name: Mook Milk
restaurants.address:

Charan Sanitwong 60 Alley, Bang Bumru, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time there, and I tried the iced milk bread with extra toppings... it tasted amazing. The bread was crispy and large, not overpoweringly buttery. It cost 59 baht plus 5 baht for each topping (there are various prices), making it a great deal at 89 baht in total. It was delicious! They also played nice music. I didn't order any drinks, but I'm giving this menu item a full 5 stars. I'll try other things next time and give a more detailed review. Oh... and the fruit smoothies are 45 baht each (orange, pineapple, watermelon), but they use bottled juice, not real fruit... I was quite disappointed, so I'm deducting a star for that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Traveler at Southern

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered freshly squeezed orange juice. I asked a plump woman at the counter inside, who sounded like a foreigner, if it was made from real oranges. She said it was real oranges... but I was suspicious because I couldn't see any real oranges in the background. So I told her that "real oranges" meant it was freshly squeezed. She looked very displeased and said, "Real oranges are whole oranges, how could we have time to squeeze them? This is from real oranges." Finally, when it was delivered to my table, it was bottled orange juice, not freshly squeezed as she had lied... she was a total liar. I'm done with this shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tigger Pinkpanter

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! I felt energized and refreshed after eating it. There's free water, music, a jukebox, and speakers (but they didn't turn it on, which was fine – we took the opportunity to chat, haha). We came on the 14th of Songkran (Thai New Year), and you can park on the street in front of the shop, no need to worry. The shop has a lot of menu items like milk bingsu, toast, and more. We had the lychee and rambutan bingsu, honey toast, and french fries. I highly recommend it – it's delicious! You won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tie DAIMARU

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered buttered toast, not buttered toast with milk. I clearly wrote "no milk, no sugar," but I received toast with milk soaking the bread. So I went back to order again, specifically asking for no milk and no sugar. The employee said, "Customers have to write it down." Did they even read the order slip? No. They didn't even bother to check the incorrect order slip. They didn't apologize or take responsibility for the mistake.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paphada Panya-in

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here several times, and it was usually just okay until I tried this one. It was a huge disappointment. The bingsu was incredibly bland; I think they used a water-based base. The milk topping was watery and runny. It cost a little over 200 baht, and they charged 20 baht for extra milk, so I declined. I'd also say the only thing that seemed worth it was the toasted bread for around 20 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Non Khunawut

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were talking very loudly and disrespectfully to customers. It was incredibly loud; we were eating and trying to talk to our friends but couldn't hear each other. When we looked at them, they made displeased faces and spoke even louder. It was a terrible experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนพล ทีประวิภาต

sample_reviews_en.text: This dessert shop is perfect for a quick bite before heading home. They have toast and bingsu at student-friendly prices, and the portions are generous. The tables are a bit small, giving you a rushed eat-and-go vibe, but I always feel like I've spent my money here.
sample_reviews_en.author: hispeed design

sample_reviews_en.text: The bingsu is so delicious, I have to give it a thumbs up! The desserts arrived super fast. The shop is very easy to find, right on the new road, near the Sirindhorn MRT station. But if you're driving, remember to allow extra time for finding parking. 🍧🍯
sample_reviews_en.author: นฤมล จันกง

restaurants.name: Naturefarm Cafe
restaurants.address:

34 14 Soi Phong Si Chan 1, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has three floors to choose from, with spacious and airy seating, perfect for a relaxed meal.
We ordered:
Nature’s Charm Fish & Chips (390 baht) – This dish surprised us; they use banana blossom coated in batter and fried, and it tasted surprisingly good. Delicious but not too heavy.
Southside Spaghetti (290 baht) – A dish adapted from Thai crab curry noodles, it has an authentic Southern Thai curry flavor with just the right amount of spiciness. Importantly, they use jackfruit instead of crab meat, which pairs perfectly with the Southern Thai curry and spaghetti. Highly recommended!
What Pancake Dreams are Made of (280 baht) – Soft pancakes served with fruit for a refreshing touch. You can add ice cream on top if you like.
For drinks, we ordered a strawberry shortcake smoothie, a rich and delicious strawberry smoothie. Highly recommended for those who enjoy tasty drinks in the afternoon.

I highly recommend it; the vegan food is easier to eat than you might think.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ok Vatchara

sample_reviews_en.text: I was shock to see the shop upon arrive, it is nothing like a cafe. It is nothing like the photo in this accounts. There is nothing ready to be served. Only frozen foods and dried goods. Disappointed, and hangry. Was very much looking forward to taste good food and do some shopping. Came here all the way for nothing. I wish the account could be more truthful and reveal the current images of the shop, misguided.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kobebb WCP

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is easy to find, has parking, Wi-Fi, is quiet, clean, has a good atmosphere, has a lot of clean food, coffee, and desserts to choose from. The shop owner welcomes and takes great care of customers and gives good product recommendations. Most of the items in the shop are not to be missed. Many menus are more delicious than non-clean food. CF
sample_reviews_en.author: Narinrat phakdeemintra

sample_reviews_en.text: All health concious patron should visit this cafe. All food are made with health in mind. I grab some premade food since the cafe about to close. Looking at the menu should grab nice looking panxake and juices. loves health, recommend this restaurant. Love it. Cute owner and will visit again for proper seat in experiance in this cafe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yoges

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a wide selection of healthy food and snacks, Wi-Fi is available, the shop is a nice place to sit all day, the weather and atmosphere are great, the owner is beautiful and lovely, and the service is friendly, welcoming, and truly attentive to everything.
sample_reviews_en.author: นรินทร์รัชต์ ภักดีมินตรา

sample_reviews_en.text:
A healthy food and dessert shop with a friendly, lovely, and talkative owner.
They moved from Ari.
They have a wide variety of food and dessert brands to choose from. It's a bit tucked away, but there's parking for about 2-3 cars at the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: C Muthita

sample_reviews_en.text: The food might be typical, but I liked the healthy snack, the truffle-flavored crispy pumpkin. The atmosphere is nice, shady, peaceful, and cool, surrounded by greenery and nature. It offers good privacy, giving you the feeling of having a …
sample_reviews_en.author: Phukawee Pipattanacharoenkul

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers delicious and varied healthy food and desserts. The atmosphere is pleasant, with convenient Wi-Fi access. The shop is clean, and there's a wide selection of healthy food and snacks to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Powdernarinrat Phakdeemintra

restaurants.name: Modern Fujisan Youganyaki
restaurants.address:

2, 39 Sukhumvit 41 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant owner (Mr. You Ji) is very gentle as well as staffs are so kind. the manu is written in english and the staffs willingly explain the all foods details very well.
I think the signature foods are meat sashimi (raw meat with marbling) and other kind of yakiniku (chicken and meat, pork) that are always delicious and especially the seaweed soup is awesome.
The foods are little bit expansive but, It is also not street food in Japan so, for me, it is reasonable.
You can have also Japanese friends in the restaurant and if you allow them to have same stove (sharing food its Japanese culture) will be very funny.
The drinks like all Japanese beers and whiskeys are available and its chilled in there.
In general, espacially for Korean can enjoy the foods since all foods taste are very simiral each other and other nations shall try this for feeling unique Eastern Asia culture and food.
sample_reviews_en.author: JUNGJIN PARK

sample_reviews_en.text:
This renowned restaurant lies in a small alley between Thonglor and Phrom Phong.

They grill a variety of ingredients on a lava-grilled plate.

You can grill the ingredients yourself, but the staff will generally grill and serve you for you.

The prices are extremely reasonable for a Japanese-style restaurant overseas, but the quality is very high.

We recommend the 3- or 5-course omakase menu. Omakase in Thailand might sound expensive, but that's not the case here.

They also have other delicious grilled dishes, such as pork chops and innards.

Of course, they don't just serve meat. They also highly recommend the takowasa (octopus with wasabi) and other classic izakaya dishes.

The manager, Yuji, is a very kind and lovely person, so I always have a great time.
sample_reviews_en.author: 谷口和也

sample_reviews_en.text:
I thought this was a pretty amazing restaurant, with skirt steak and tongue cut into pieces on the first Saturday night of the month...
I didn't know what to eat, so I ordered a four-piece chicken sashimi platter, but as you can see in the photo, it looked like it was cut by an amateur...
I ordered 200g steak and marucho pork, but there was nothing particularly noteworthy and it was just average.
However, the sauce was not very tasty...
Also, the staff were incredibly unfriendly and rude (lol).
They left only vegetables on the lava slab and never came back.
They kept piling up and pulling away plates, as if they were going to break.
I'm never going again...
sample_reviews_en.author: Harry Yokoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant had a calming atmosphere, allowing us to enjoy a leisurely meal.
On this day, we ordered beef liver sashimi and heart sashimi as special menu items.
We also ordered chicken liver sashimi, grilled mixed offal (heart and liver), chicken thigh, meatballs, and chicken neck from the regular menu.

The liver had no odor at all and was very easy to eat. It had a rich yet robust flavor. The heart sashimi was also fresh and very delicious.

Their distinctive lava-grilling method really brought out the flavor of the meat. This is a restaurant where you can fully enjoy the quality of the ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: 滝沢瑠菜

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd always been curious about this restaurant because it's always bustling. The large butter-grilled scallops were incredibly satisfying, the grilled oysters were plump and delicious, and while I had the impression that Hitachi Wagyu steaks are thin and unsatisfying, this one was sweet and incredibly tasty. The waitress grills the food to perfection on a lava plate placed on the counter, so you can enjoy the food piping hot while chatting and drinking, which is fantastic. I would definitely like to go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jan Aki Uchy

sample_reviews_en.text: I think it's a grilled shop, but I went there for Oden. So it's okay that oden is not it's specialized. The service was good. Oden was so so, I think it's bland taste. Other customers were all Japanese, it reminded me a bit of when I traveled there. The total price will have svc 5% and VAT 7%, so svc charge was cheaper than other shop. (Normally charge at 10%) Overall it's not a place for oden, maybe try some yakiniku next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mae Hame

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good vibe
I visited this restaurant at 1PM and the staff told us that chef is not here. After 3 mins we can enter the restaurant (a bit confused)
Overall, the quality of the food is good compare to the price. The pork slice is very delicious. Rice bowl costs 50THB which is a bit expensive for me. Another thing is staff cooks very slow. When the first dish had been served, the beer didn’t cool anymore.
sample_reviews_en.author: Runn S

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner is Japanese and the service was very attentive. The meat grilled on the lava stone grill was tender, and the flavor remained strong, giving it a different flavor when grilled over charcoal. The menu has so many options that it was hard to decide what to order, and I'd like to try other dishes, so I'll definitely be back! ✨Thank you for the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: しげもり

restaurants.name: Rolling Stone Bar (Boat noodle)
restaurants.address:

ตึกไบหยก3, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Menu in English available.

'Boat noodles' (a dish on the menu) costs 70 baht. It's a large bowl with plenty of noodles and meat. The broth has a unique and delicious blood-red flavor. The broth is slightly sweet, but adding chili vinegar makes it even better. There's a generous amount of fresh vegetables served with it. If you like, you can add fried pork skin to the noodles (small bags tied with rubber bands and hanging nearby).

The restaurant is located inside the market, near Baiyoke Gallery (Pratunam). There are clothing shops nearby. There are tables for customers to sit and eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phoenix_NH

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been to this place twice. At first, I just went in and tried it out of curiosity 😄. After the first bite, I decided to come back a second time. I won't give a wrong description, maybe it's just my language... I still can't get the correct name of the food I ordered 😅~~ I kept getting the same conclusion: "kuitiao" 😬. Actually, there's another thing I wanted to try: their tom yam. But I was so drawn to the kuitiao... I ordered it twice! 🤣🤣 The owner is very friendly and friendly, managing everything in the shop 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Vian

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious, my temper vanished instantly!

My partner found this little shop the day before. It was hot and we couldn't find the way, so we were in a bad mood. Even after we sat down, the lack of air conditioning made us irritable. But one bite of the noodles and our temper disappeared! The seasoning was rich and flavorful, but incredibly delicious!

Later, I ate at other places or in department stores, but nothing tasted as good as this. Highly, highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: winnie

sample_reviews_en.text: Becareful of this place. There is no price list anywhere and the man charged us 160 baht for 1 order of boat noodles and 1 pack of crackling. He must have recognized that we are tourists and took advantage of us. Their boat noodles is not even hot. My wife and I shared for 1 bowl because we were full from our lunch so she couldnt finish 1 bowl by herself and we just wanted to try boat noodles.. Be careful of the man operating this place, he's a scammer
sample_reviews_en.author: sTroKeZ Labra

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork noodles here are an absolute must-eat. I ended up coming back three times in just 24 hours because the food was that good. The broth is incredibly rich, the pork is tender, and the flavors are perfectly balanced. I’ve tried many places in Bangkok, but this one quickly became my favorite — which explains why I couldn’t stop returning. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Huy Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text: When I asked Google Maps for a good restaurant near me, it recommended this place—and it did not disappoint. From the restaurant's aesthetic design and background music to the food, everything was great. Plus their service was great. The only challenge was finding it, as it is located deep inside Pratunam Market.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kayzie Faji

sample_reviews_en.text: Boat noodles was 60baht. On first glance from the outside there wasn't any English menu but no worries they do have an English menu! Bowl came with different cuts and kinds of meat which were all very nicely seasoned. The soup was flavorful and not overly salty. Good find among the shopping stores.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a noodle shop I have to eat at every day. The food is incredibly delicious, the portions are huge, and the prices are very affordable. sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice place to charge your phone. Thank God i found this KFC when i really2 need it. The food is great. The chilli sauce is noy spicy at all :( [compared to Indonesian chilli sauce]

The price is okay. Spacious place. Great for dine in or even take away. RICE is available altho not on the menu. My friend ordered rice, chicken & mineral water for 90 baht.

The french fries is a bit disappointing (not crispy enough) but the mash potato is awesome. Drinks are refillable. The coleslaw salad is SO DELICIOUS!
The one I ordered cost 207 baht because the mashed potato is 50% off.

I really recommend this place. The staff is friendly (some can understand English). Overall it's good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Valentine Merrita Sari

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't usually review specific branches of fast food chains, after all they are supposed to provide a near identical experience everywhere. But this KFC deserves its own rating. Very rude order taking staff, more barking than talking. The fries were tasteless, soft, soggy and cool. Just felt old and stale. I ordered the combo meal with 2 pieces of chicken and in my countless visits to KFC in many different countries I have never received such ridiculous servings. Tiny, almost no meat, inside mostly bones and a thick layer of bread crumbs. The 7-up was 70% crushed ice and an almost syrup-free watery taste.
Absolutely ridiculous and disappointing.

The mashed potato is so watery, previously it's not like that

Children over 130 cm can play by themselves. The price is quite expensive at 400 baht per person (for 2 hours), even for parents just to supervise their child. It's okay to visit occasionally. We quite enjoyed it. However, a 1-hour option would be nice because 2 hours feels a bit too long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jan Yousagoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s unfair for 6 year old kids that can play by themselves but under 120cm that parents have to pay for sane amount 400 thb. Understand for paying to get in to supervise. But 400 thb is ridiculous, especially for young kids total 800 thb to play and they could not make 2hours .

Even though my kids join party of his brother which already have few adults in, they still charge 800 thb . Rule is unfair.

sample_reviews_en.text: Fun place to go in Pattaya! It cost 400 baht each for adults, which was for 2 hours. The trampolines were good, and they have a ninja area too. It would have been nice if there was somewhere to buy drinks or snacks, because to do so you had to go to another floor.
