sample_reviews_en.text: Sweet tooth lovers, you absolutely can't miss this!! If this isn't the best crepe shop in Bangkok, could it get more than five stars? Personally, I'd give it a hundred stars! 555555 The first time I went, I ordered the Nutella banana crepe (the kind the owner slices and puts in a box like in the picture). It was SO delicious! I'm hooked. The crepe batter is crispy and fragrant, with plenty of Nutella and banana. Guaranteed generous filling! Paired with green tea, it's the perfect combination. My absolute favorite! If you're in Charoen Krung and haven't tried Crepe Jer & Milk yet, you haven't truly experienced Charoen Krung. The owner is so lovely, kind, and makes incredibly delicious crepes. I'm so sad my house is so far away. I wish they would open a branch in Nong Khaem too! I'd support them every day. I'll definitely go back again when I'm in town. It's truly amazing. I'm so impressed. I want everyone to try it. Deliciousness worth sharing! And importantly, there are adorable cats! Go play with them! Come support them! You'll definitely love it. Guaranteed deliciousness! Ten out of ten, I'd give it a hundred! 💖💖💖
sample_reviews_en.author: tasaporn onlamoon

sample_reviews_en.text: This crepe shop was a chance find while I was getting my computer repaired. I ordered a crepe and a drink to tide me over while waiting. The crepes were delicious; the batter was fragrant and crispy. The first time I ordered the ham and shredded pork crepe (I forgot to take a picture because I was so hungry and ate it too quickly, haha). The second time I tried the mini crepes. I like them because they're smaller, so I can order more and they're easier to eat. The matcha coconut drink was delicious; the matcha was rich and flavorful. I ordered it unsweetened, and it was perfect. I'll definitely be back! The owners (mother and daughter) are very lovely. They're very busy, with orders coming in constantly, sometimes with long queues. The owners are meticulous in preparing their orders, so you might have to wait a little.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warinmas K

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I stopped by Crepe Jer and was very impressed. The fillings were so plentiful I couldn't decide. But what impressed me most was the incredibly fragrant dough. I had to stop whenever I walked by. Moms must try it. The dough was delicious, and the price was very friendly. The owner was lovely and friendly. The shop even had an "orange cat" to cuddle with. It was so cute. Overall, I was very impressed with this crepe shop. I'll definitely come back to buy more next time. 😍🥰✨
sample_reviews_en.author: 607-32 -Natnaree

sample_reviews_en.text:
It seems like Koreans don't come here. I was browsing on Google Maps and went because it was close to the Four Seasons Hotel, and seriously, it's the best crepe of my life. It's super crispy.

I paid 30 baht for a banana crepe. I'm very satisfied.
sample_reviews_en.author: 이정민

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a wide variety of fillings to choose from. They have both the regular large crepes and smaller, folded crepes similar to Tokyo-style crepes. If you want to try multiple fillings, ordering several small ones is a great option.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to shop! The food is delicious, they have a huge variety of fillings to choose from, and the prices are cheap. Plus, there's an orange cat to play with!

restaurants.name: Teng Hai
restaurants.address:

44 รองเมือง ซอย 1 สัมพันธวงศ์ Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cheng Hai Braised Goose is an old Chinese restaurant in Yaowarat, famous for its Teochew-style braised goose and duck. The owner originates from Cheng Hai District, China. He speaks a little Thai, but you can order from his staff.

Restaurant Information and Recommended Menu Items:
Braised Goose and Braised Duck: Signature dishes known for their tender meat and flavorful braising sauce, made according to the original recipe.
Other Recommended Menu Items: Besides braised dishes, they also offer fish maw soup and other Chinese single-dish meals.
Atmosphere: The restaurant occupies a single-unit shophouse with a simple, local, and airy atmosphere; no air conditioning is used.
Price Level: Mid-range prices.
Getting There and Opening Hours:
Location: Phadung Dao Street (Texas Lane), Yaowarat. Approximately 100 meters from Charoen Krung Road, the restaurant is on the right-hand side.
Opening Hours: Open daily from lunchtime until approximately
9:30 PM.

Cheng Hai Braised Goose Restaurant (澄海淘鵝飯店)
sample_reviews_en.author: Vit

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually only eat at Lao Tang and Urai, but I've walked past this place many times and finally got the chance to try it for the first time.
The braised goose was tender and delicious. The braising sauce was fragrant, salty, and not sweet like authentic Chinese braised goose. The intestines were chewy, the blood pudding was soft, and the liver and gizzard were okay, but next time I'll probably just order the intestines and blood pudding. The dipping sauce was good.
I'm relieved to have this restaurant added to my list of favorites 😊
They also have single-dish meals. I ordered stir-fried water spinach and clear soup with Chinese cabbage to try, and they were alright.
sample_reviews_en.author: SP

sample_reviews_en.text: I was going to grill Urai goose at Songwat, but I thought Thai people would be closed during the Lunar New Year. I didn't know that Chinatown is closed during the Lunar New Year because there are many Chinese stores. In the end, I couldn't go to Urai, which I wanted to go to, so I went to this place that I had saved as a second choice. The goose here was also good. It had a slightly different taste from duck, but it suited my taste better than duck. And the chewy texture. If you enjoy a texture similar to that of a thousand leaves, you should definitely order Yachang (goose intestines).
sample_reviews_en.author: Beenii Joo

sample_reviews_en.text:
2 Sept. 68. An old Chinese restaurant, small restaurant, delicious, good price, no parking, you can park at Texas Suki's parking lot, 40 baht per hour. This restaurant is across the street.
Ordered 3 dishes: Braised Goose, small plate (500), delicious, well-seasoned, good flavor; Oyster Omelette (150), crispy batter like fried oysters, not to my liking, I prefer the soft kind; and Hong Kong Kale with Abalone (300), well-fried, very delicious, I recommend it, if you like this dish you must order it.
Good service from the staff, will come back to eat again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jinny Soontorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
📌 This restaurant serves braised goose and duck, and also offers a la carte Chinese-style dishes with a diverse menu.
🦢 The braised duck is fragrant, tender, and the salty sauce is delicious with rice. 🌟 The chili garlic dipping sauce is flavorful and spicy,
excellent and enhances the taste well.
🍲 The seaweed and fish ball soup has a good flavor and is easy to drink.
🍽 The oyster omelet has small, fresh, and sweet oysters, and is well-fried with both chewy and crispy batter, although a little oily.
♦️ The service and recommendations are good and fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lara Linh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious! The goose is top-notch, world-class. The offal is perfectly prepared, with just the right amount of spice – not too sweet, not too salty, perfectly balanced. The pork belly with its jelly-like texture is my absolute favorite.
The boiled bitter melon tasted unlike anything I've ever had before; it was perfectly balanced and delicious – a perfect blend of bitterness, sourness, spiciness, and aroma. The owner is so kind; he came over to ask if it was delicious, and I answered loudly, "Hò jìcía!" (Delicious!) 👍🏻😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Mommy

sample_reviews_en.text: This is our family's favorite Teochew Chinese restaurant. The food is delicious, not dry, the owner is kind, the staff provides good service, and the prices are reasonable. Recommended dishes include braised goose, steamed grouper with soy sauce, stir-fried vermicelli, boiled shrimp, stir-fried fish maw with basil, braised fish maw in red sauce (available with both fresh and dried fish maw), stir-fried spinach with oysters, fish ball soup, and oyster omelet (available in both crispy and soft versions).
sample_reviews_en.author: Bright

sample_reviews_en.text:
Arrived at the restaurant at 12:45. Parked at Texas Parking (40 USD/hour).
There were 3 of us, and we ordered way too much.
The fresh fish maw soup was delicious! The stir-fried water spinach and goose had a wonderful soy sauce aroma.
The shrimp rolls were just okay for me.
The tofu was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The oyster omelet had fresh oysters but was crispy like a fried oyster omelet. The staff provided good service and gave honest food recommendations.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Originally from Nakhon Pathom Province, Tekkor, currently 70 years old, learned cooking from his parents since childhood. His personalities include diligence, perseverance, ambition, and a desire for progress. His unique approach allowed him to consistently learn and adapt cooking techniques from his parents. In the 1970s, he invented pork meatballs under the name "Tekkor Pork Meatballs," which have become famous to this day.

The noodles are delicious, and they even have nice take-away packaging! 😋

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tek Kor Noodle Shop is located in the PTT gas station on the Nonthaburi bypass road.
It's convenient to stop by because there are various other shops nearby.

As for the noodles here, I ordered Tom Yum soup, but it came out a bit bland. I'm not sure if it's because I went when the shop first opened and the broth hadn't fully developed yet (I'll try it again and write a new review).
But...
The bouncy pork was delicious!
The meatballs were delicious!
The fried pork patties were also delicious!

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted okay. The chicken dish I ordered, with its snow onion topping, had stale onions, which reduced the overall enjoyment. The cheese dish came in two compartments; I wish it had included sweet corn, that would have made it even better. The utensils provided for the chicken included two forks and clear plastic gloves. There was a trash can for food scraps on the table. The kimchi soup was decent. The service from the staff was good. Parking is available in front of the shop on the street, but it's mostly motorcycle parking, so you might have to park a little further away or across the street. The restroom is accessed through the kitchen, and it didn't feel very clean.😅 There were large mosquitoes and small cockroaches even invading the kitchen, making me worry they might eat with us!🤣🤣🤣🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Paowara Kang

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff at the restaurant were incredibly lovely and polite. While we were ordering at our table, even though they were taller than us, they kept bending down to talk to us, speaking very politely and kindly. ^^ My boyfriend, who doesn't usually like kimchi, ate it all! The kimchi was delicious. The chicken was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, so yummy ❤️ The kimchi soup was fragrant and flavorful. We'll definitely be back! ❤️

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese restaurant offers Thai-style flavors, and the food tastes great. It looks like homemade Japanese food.
The restaurant is located inside the PTT gas station on Charoen Rat Road. Apparently, it recently changed owners, but they've maintained the food quality. The service has also improved because the new owner is more attentive and serves the customers personally.
I'd rate it highly for value for money. For three people, we ordered five dishes for just over 500 baht. We had both salmon and shrimp. The salmon was very fresh, and the shrimp was succulent. The portion sizes were generous, making it feel like great value. I'll definitely be back often.
sample_reviews_en.author: ต่อจักร ภิญโญสินวัฒน์

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a reasonably priced Japanese restaurant with average ingredients and decent taste. You have to understand that you get what you pay for; don't compare it to big, expensive restaurants, or you'll be dissatisfied with everything.

Dishes ordered at Kiyomi:
- Jellyfish salad: Generous portion, sweet flavor. Adding a little wasabi helps cut the sweetness.
- Salmon sashimi: Still slightly frozen.
- Tempura shrimp maki: Freshly fried and hot. Finishing the whole roll is filling.
- Green tea: A little diluted.

In summary, good value for money. Will try other sets next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcharak Thiensunchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a great cafe with Japanese cuisine! It's worth stopping by for sushi and tonkatsu rolls. This was the first cafe in Bangkok where we had a delicious Philadelphia roll; it was so delicious I didn't even have time to take a photo before we ate it. And considering the prices are relatively affordable compared to other cafes, this place is definitely on my list of delicious and affordable cafes and restaurants! The staff is very friendly and helpful! Thank you for a delicious lunch!!!
Posmotrinamir recommends!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ilia Iakovenko

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese restaurant has great food. Everything is delicious. The salmon is fresh, the sushi pieces are large, and the tonkatsu is a generous and worthwhile portion. The prices are reasonable, there's a wide variety of menu items, the service is good, it's conveniently located, and there's parking available. I'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beaut Kusalin

sample_reviews_en.text: The seared salmon belly was incredibly delicious – soft, bouncy, and wonderfully fatty. The eel roll had good eel and well-formed rice, and the pork katsu had a fragrant, crispy batter and juicy, delicious pork. The restaurant is located in a PTT gas station, making parking easy, and the staff were friendly and provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffrey Tantacha

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese restaurant offers a relaxed atmosphere, a diverse menu, delicious food, and affordable prices. Whether it's sushi or fresh salmon sashimi, it's definitely worth a visit. Perfect for a casual meal or a meal with friends and family, and conveniently located in the heart of Bangkok. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: แอนนา แอนนา

sample_reviews_en.text: Many dishes were delicious. The salmon was fresh and tasted great. The price was good, not expensive at all. I'll definitely come back again. I personally recommend the fresh salmon salad; it's really refreshing! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: AOF NAPAT

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. The owner is lovely and the service is friendly and welcoming. The seating is comfortable and there are charging ports. Overall, everything is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรพิมล ศรีเพ็ง

restaurants.name: Shell Phochana (Khlong Toei)
restaurants.address:

1388 Rama IV Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came on a Sunday, it wasn't very crowded so I didn't have high expectations.
But I found it to be amazing!
They have a good selection of thin noodles, with a nice thickness.
The beef shank was nice and tender.
The fresh beef looked like it would be chewy, but it wasn't at all and had great flavor.
The tendons were soft, the heart was crunchy, and the intestines were bouncy.
The rice was good, and the soup was flavorful (a little salty), not too herbal.
I could eat it continuously. The price is reasonable at 60 baht.

Parking: You can park right in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mildmie' Pinkcheeze

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves braised beef and pork. While there are other famous restaurants in the area, such as Heng Chun Sen, this restaurant offers a refreshingly light flavor with a subdued sweetness. A large portion of Gao Lao is 70 THB, and a large portion of Kuay Teow is 60 THB, making it an attractively affordable restaurant. While it's relatively quiet in the morning, it gets very busy at lunchtime, so be careful about the time you visit. They also serve hot pots, which is a good choice if you're traveling with a large group.
sample_reviews_en.author: 2pong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beef and pork noodle shop in the Khlong Toei area.

The taste is average, not particularly delicious.
The offal is cleaned thoroughly, and there's no fishy smell.
They offer noodles, kao lao, and hot pot.
The shop separates the beef and pork, so they don't mix them.

The grilled meatballs here are okay. The sauce is good, so you can eat them while you wait.
I thought the rice was a bit soggy.

Overall, it's edible, but not particularly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Unexpert

sample_reviews_en.text: The beef noodle soup is delicious. The tender beef and pork belly melt in your mouth, the offal is good and not gamey, and the broth is fantastic—even for those who don't like strong flavors like me, no extra seasoning is needed. The soup is 60 baht, rice is 5 baht, and ice and water are free. Highly recommended! Oh, and for those who don't eat beef, they also have pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: wasakorn faknuam

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old noodle shop specializing in braised pork and beef noodles in the Khlong Toei area. It's located in a two-shophouse building opposite the Thai Government Building (JS100). Parking can be difficult, and you might have to wait for a table during lunchtime. The braised pork is excellent, and the grilled meatballs are also good, grilled to order over charcoal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapong Laungsathaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle shop, according to my colleague, has been around for over 60 years. Their signature dish is the hot pot, and you can order the noodles separately. The broth is delicious, and I ordered the braised beef and tendons separately. It's extremely crowded at lunchtime. I went around 2 PM and there was nobody there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Littlesherry J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Braised pork noodle soup. The pork is tender and melts in your mouth. The portion is just right, not too much or too little. The pork pieces aren't too small. The broth is rich and flavorful, and easy to season.
Price: Special order 60 baht, rice 5 baht, water 10 baht.
Location: Plenty of tables available, clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pan Chantakulchai

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been in this area but never tried it before. Today I finally got the chance to try it, and it was amazing! The soup was delicious, the braised meat was incredibly tender, and the offal was perfectly prepared – no unpleasant smell or taste. I really enjoyed it and will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: New

restaurants.name: Ben House Restaurant
restaurants.address:

WV4H+JQ8, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The basil rice at this restaurant tastes so mysterious, like a blind box from a spice warehouse that's been overturned; one bite and you'll question your existence. The seafood has a built-in "fermentation buff," the fishy smell lingers around the table three times over, as if it was just caught from the Chao Phraya River and cooked straight away. The grilled chicken is so dry you could use it as a toothpick; chewing it feels like a workout for your jaw muscles. The only MVP of the whole meal is the tomato sauce, which purely saved my taste buds. I suggest renaming it the "Thailand Food Mishap Research Institute," a place specifically for daring and greedy tourists—you'll know how "surprising" it is once you try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: cong yangcong

sample_reviews_en.text: Their boat noodles are so delicious! It's right across from the Thai go-kart track, and they also have other things there, though I don't know about Shenzhen. They also have other specialties and dishes that are really good. They also have some good other things, like a fruit called "Golden Pillow" (a type of fruit), and their fried chicken noodles are excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: jianquan wang

sample_reviews_en.text: I had pork leg. What a blast! I'd got used to Dek Sen next door but went in here after several years absence. With all the spicy trimmings I had one of the best one plate meals ever. I'll be back for one of the legendary Thai classics. Paneng, green curry, som tam, pad Thai, pad krapow etc etc.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phineas John

sample_reviews_en.text: It's true that some waiters are unresponsive; they won't come no matter how much you call them, and they won't come unless there's a specific reason. The food is also just average. Chinese people don't lie to other Chinese people, so there's no need to make a special trip to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuhao Yang

sample_reviews_en.text: I placed an order and sat at the table for about 20 minutes. My friend's entire order was brought to him and he managed to eat it all. We decided to find out where my order was and were told it hadn't even been prepared. It was a mess with the orders and a lot of flies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vladimir

sample_reviews_en.text: A small bowl allows you to try several different kinds at once. There are many varieties of pork and beef noodles, and the price is very cheap. You can eat your fill for about 60 yuan per person. The soup is super rich and has a slightly spicy and spiced flavor!
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷芭提雅.高端外围&伴游 Home service

sample_reviews_en.text:
The weather was nice, the food was delicious, and the staff were beautiful and provided excellent service.
The "Tiger's Tears" (a type of beef dish) had a dipping sauce that was a little too sour. Overall, everything was great. ☺️😘🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Kie Phou

sample_reviews_en.text:
I encountered a situation where an employee lost a bill and told the customer they hadn't received it yet. It felt like they were blaming the customer for not sending the bill.
Terrible service and rude staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: สตางค์ ใช่

restaurants.name: Charlies Kitchen
restaurants.address:

PHR3+C6M, Sukhumvit 4 Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small place with absolutely giant flavor.
The drinks were good and strong, the food was superb, the service was quick and clean, the overall quality is very high.

I ordered some salmon sashimi, and let me tell you about the size of the slices they cut! 5 giant slices, with 2 medium size prism cut pieces. The phrat kaphrao gai was amazing. The sauce was flavorful, and the dish was packed with chili (I ask for spicy). They didn't make the spice overpowering (wish they did until I seen the amount of food I had).
I paired the chicken with fried rice with lump crab. And that was also great. Though I wish there would have been more crab.

Overall I highly recommend this spot to anyone looking for a good meal at a fair restaurant price. It's not cheap like the street shops but it's not priced out like the overrated fancy spots.

I gave the atmosphere a lesser score because it just had a normal small kitchen vibe to it. Nothing spectacular but nothing bad either.
sample_reviews_en.author: M. Galloway

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is a welcome reprieve from the hustle and bustle of Soi 4 and nearby Nana Plaza.  It is a bit of a misnomer to label Charlies as a Thai restaurant.  While there is an ample number and variety of good quality Thai dishes on the menu; Charlie's also offers an extensive selection of sushi and sashimi and a nice selection of Western dishes when you are looking for a break from the wonderful Asian food that dominates the Bangkok restaurant scene.

The restaurant is kept very clean and has great Air Conditioning to help you recover from the Bangkok heat and humidity.  The seating is comfortably situated to provide enough separation from the other customers to allow a pleasant, quiet conversation with your dining partners.

The prices are very reasonable and the service is prompt and friendly. A very good meal and dining experience is what you get at Charlie's.
sample_reviews_en.author: mojovoyager

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was hot outside, so I looked for a completely indoor restaurant and found this one. Besides Thai food, they also have Japanese food, including seafood and curry. I was surprised to see a counter-style refrigerator like you'd find in a Japanese sushi restaurant.

I ordered Tom Yum Goong and Katsu Curry.

The Tom Yum Goong was quite tangy and delicious. The katsu was thin but nice and crispy, and the curry had a homey feel to it – very good. You could tell both dishes were well-researched.

The service wasn't bad, but they kept coming to our table over and over, seemingly eager to clear the dishes. Eventually, they even took away the small amount of food we still had, asking "Are you done?" It wasn't even busy at the end of lunchtime, and it wasn't closing time either.
sample_reviews_en.author: ひげなしルイージ

sample_reviews_en.text: When going to Charlie's think hole in the wall diner. With a bit of a twist. One doesn't expect a full sushi menu when going to a diner. It's odd I know but a lot of people order it and one can see Japanese eating in here. So the menu is a mix of Western, Japanese, and indeed Thai food. Like most restaurants in Thailand that are based on Western or Asian foods there will always be Thai food on the menu. And Charlie's is no exception, The Thai food is delicious. The staff speak English. Tucked away in the throws of Soi 4, near Nana Plaza, however non assuming and quiet once inside away from the melee. Day or night Charlie's is a great choice for a quick bite.
sample_reviews_en.author: BANGKOKBANKS

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Charlie’s Kitchen in Bangkok – and although the area right outside the BTS/MRT station might not look the nicest at first glance, it’s absolutely worth coming here.

What impressed me:
•	Great service: very friendly, attentive, and quick. You feel truly welcome.
•	Fresh, homemade food: no frozen ingredients, no convenience products. Everything is freshly prepared, and you can taste that it’s cooked with love.
•	High quality: the ingredients are excellent, portions are generous, and you can tell real care goes into the cooking.

If you’re nearby – maybe just off the MRT or BTS – you should definitely stop by. I’ll be back for sure!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marco Steins

sample_reviews_en.text: Unfortunately it is what it looks like: An overpriced tourist trap with - at best - mediocre food. The Thom Ka Gai was pretty tasteless without any hint of spiciness, the spring rolls fatty and the Pad Thai with chicken definitely had made good friends with the seafood at one point - yuck. Service was fast but couldn’t have cared less about hospitality or friendliness. Service charge of 10% added on the bill. Overall > 700 Baht for 2 - we had MUCH better lunch at the food court of Terminal21 mall with a world class Thom Ka Gai for all in all 185 Baht. Mango shake was good but can’t safe the day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Bruss

sample_reviews_en.text:
2016 update.
I went December 2016
My final meal dinner in Thailand for 2016 was here.
I have been here a few times in the past so went again.
I started with pork and chicken satay then steamed jasmine rice topped with stir fried beef with basil leaves and stir fried broccoli & shitake mushrooms with shrimps.
All very tasty with good prices.
Service was as good as always.

2015
I took a chance with this restaurant by looking at the menu.
I wasn't disappointed. I enjoyed a few meals here in late 2015.
Mid range priced eats all done well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great restaurant in the Nana area of ​​Bangkok, near Sukhum Avenue. We went for dinner and found the food very good. The shrimp Pad Thai, in particular, was delicious. The other dishes we ordered were also very good.

Furthermore, the price was reasonable and the service was excellent. We were very satisfied.

If you're in the area and want to try some local cuisine, this is a good place. There are also many bars and restaurants on the same street where you can grab a drink after dinner. I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luis Galiño

restaurants.name: Bukkhalo Chicken Rice
restaurants.address:

366, 16 Soi Charoen Nakhon 62, Dao Khanong, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another chicken rice place I used to frequent a lot when I lived in the Charoen Nakhon area.

I've been eating here since the owner's children were little.
Haven't been here in almost 10 years.
Now they're grown up and helping out at home. 🙂

The rice is dry and not too oily.
The chicken is tender but not dry.🤣
Unlimited dipping sauce, very flavorful.
The soup is bland but I absolutely love it.
The portion is a little small, a bit more would be good.

This chicken rice place feels like homemade food, and the atmosphere is like a home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakon Anantachat

sample_reviews_en.text: I had breakfast at Anantara a decade ago, and I returned after another ten years. It was even better than I remembered. Personally, I found it even better than the Michelin-starred chicken places in Siam. The sauce was especially good, the best I've ever had, and I'd pay to buy it. Fifty baht's worth of happiness.
sample_reviews_en.author: jiyoun park

sample_reviews_en.text: Located in an alley next to a redevelopment construction site. It's a small shop with only about five tables, but the chicken rice is delicious and made with care. It's boiled, fried, and mixed. The soup is also refined and not overcooked, so I went there two days in a row.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noriko Okada

sample_reviews_en.text: The only downside is that they don't offer the government's co-payment scheme; otherwise, everything is great. The food is delicious
sample_reviews_en.author: badboy boy

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another place that's pretty good. The dipping sauce is excellent, the rice is delicious, and the chicken is decent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Songwit Charoensukpattana

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken is tender, the rice is soft, and the dipping sauce is good. Parking is difficult for cars.
sample_reviews_en.author: TinyPayForYou

sample_reviews_en.text: chicken is so tender and restaurant’s atmosphere is quite local. they are trying to be polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Targaux

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait wasn't long, the taste was delicious, and the rice was perfectly cooked, not soggy.
sample_reviews_en.author: พริก แกง

restaurants.name: Bonchon Lasalle Avenue
restaurants.address:

อาคาร ลาซาลอเวนิว เลขที่ 549,549/1-2 ห้องเลขที่ B007-008 ชั้น 1 ถนน แบริ่ง - ลาซาล, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff was terrible. They didn't even bother to double-check anything. The restaurant itself is supposedly perfect, though. The problem was, we ordered through the app 30 minutes ago, and it still hadn't shown up as being prepared. So we called. The restaurant said the system was definitely correct and that they would make it if there was an order. But when we pointed out the order, they acted like they didn't care whether it existed or not, didn't double-check, and just said they checked and there was no order. How frustrating for someone hungry late at night! If they had just said, "Excuse me, I'll check right away," it would have been much better. Their service mindset is completely negative, living up to its reputation. If you don't want to get upset, don't mess with this restaurant. I'm telling you, I'm completely fed up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukanya Juthaphathra

sample_reviews_en.text:
There were too few staff, and the service was slow. There was only one person at the front of the restaurant. The manager sat at the counter or behind the kitchen, and didn't help the staff, even though there were 2-3 tables of customers and a delivery driver.

The food took 15-20 minutes, but the staff informed us when we ordered. Personally, I don't think it was the staff's fault.

The taste was delicious, as expected for this restaurant. I tried the new menu item, the kimchi fried rice and cheese lava. I was a little disappointed that the omelet was placed underneath (to make it look like cheese). It wasn't all cheese, just the top layer.
sample_reviews_en.author: N B.

sample_reviews_en.text: It took forever! The staff management system is completely flawed. It took a while to even get a menu. The staff said the food would take 25-30 minutes, which is already long, but we actually waited 45 minutes. I was so hungry I lost my appetite! And to make matters worse, our order was incomplete and we had to keep asking for it. I noticed the table next to us waiting for ages without getting a menu and eventually leaving. I'll definitely only eat here once. I urge the relevant department to manage staff more effectively to handle the increased orders.
sample_reviews_en.author: op

sample_reviews_en.text:
The kimchi soup tasted like they forgot to add kimchi; it was like a "spirit" of kimchi soup.
The restaurant had a slightly musty smell, like urine.
I really regret spending my money at this branch.
I just saw the reviews on Google, and many people were complaining.
I don't understand why the head office doesn't think about improving or training the staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana Tangchaiphithak

sample_reviews_en.text: There are too few staff, and the food is incredibly slow. The staff said the wait would be 10-15 minutes, but I've been waiting for 45 minutes and still haven't received my order. I ordered ramen, and I didn't expect it to take this long. If you want to eat Bonchon, I recommend going somewhere else. This place is extremely slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fan Ta

sample_reviews_en.text: I've used the service twice and the staff have a rude expression, drag their feet, and are annoying. Another person is sitting and talking loudly on the phone, which is disturbing. This is the slowest branch I've ever been to. It's slow every time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Red baron

sample_reviews_en.text: The food took a very long time. I ordered chicken thighs and waited 45 minutes. It might not be suitable for people in a hurry. Tables that came after us and ordered wings received their food first.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Cha

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the staff provides good service, and they answer questions politely. The restaurant is open 24 hours and there's plenty of parking in the avenue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Looknu Manikan

restaurants.name: FAV Cafe & Brunch
restaurants.address:

Soi Charoen Krung 67, Khwaeng Yan Nawa, Khet Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is small with only a few tables. I've been here before and was very impressed with both the food and the owner's friendliness, so I planned to return.

However, today's experience was completely different. The children were playing their tablets so loudly that it was almost impossible to see the menu. The parents didn't reprimand or do anything about it, and the staff didn't ask for cooperation either, which I found very confusing.

In a public space, using headphones or headsets shouldn't be too difficult, right? This isn't a children's cafe, but in such a small space, three children were able to play their tablets loudly at the same time. It was shocking and very disruptive to other customers.

I hope the shop will prioritize the atmosphere and comfort of all customers more in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: HyeRan Min

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small shop has great vibes.
The staff are incredibly lovely. I ordered a coconut matcha,
but received a coconut matcha latte (with milk) instead.
I quietly said to my boyfriend, "Oh, it has milk in it," but the staff overheard.
They quickly offered to make a new one. I said it was okay, I could drink it, but they insisted on making a new one. So impressive! 🥺

The drinks tasted great. The matcha was rich and had young coconut flesh as a topping.
My boyfriend ordered a mint chocolate, which was also delicious and not too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: kaewnum PT

sample_reviews_en.text: FAV Cafe is a hidden gem tucked away in a quiet soi. Located opposite a charming traditional building, the cafe’s modern and relaxed vibe creates a striking and refreshing contrast. The coffee is excellent, reasonably priced, and you can even choose your preferred beans — a nice touch for coffee lovers. The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming. If you’re in the neighborhood, it’s definitely worth stopping by for a cozy and satisfying coffee break.
sample_reviews_en.author: DylanDaniel

sample_reviews_en.text: Having read great reviews , this place was a disappointment,  557 bart or $26 aussie dollars for 2 x cheese and ham bagels and 2 small coffees. The bagels had processed cheese slices the kind you dont buy anymore , the coffee givem as strong weak and a table that rocked while you ate in a small setting no plants or music. This is worst experience in Bangkok todate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Team LightWork

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very cozy coffee shop with breakfast options. Everything was delicious, filling, and healthy. The employee was very nice and welcoming – she showed us the different types of bread and how to cook a boiled egg. 💕
We loved everything and were satisfied. The toasts are large, so you can easily share one and try it out first.
sample_reviews_en.author: Outsider

sample_reviews_en.text:
This chic and cute shop is located in an alley opposite Wat Sutthiwararam. They sell food, drinks, and desserts.
The prices aren't too high, and they also have bagels. The staff are lovely and helpful, providing good recommendations and explanations.

You can park across the street from the shop in the temple's parking lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manaschanok Buanark

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon a cozy little cafe tucked away in Charoen Krung Soi 67. I ordered Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry) and a non-coffee drink. The staff recommended the Summer Pink, which was delicious, refreshing, and perfect for someone who doesn't drink coffee. The Pad Krapow was flavorful and spicy. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wannee P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍵 Great matcha, great desserts, great service. They gave really good information and recommendations.
🏠 Clean shop, comfortable atmosphere.
📍 In front of Wat Sutthiwararam School. Parking available in the temple, very convenient. #JannySaysIt'sGood
sample_reviews_en.author: patsarocha charoenpruksachart

restaurants.name: The Pizza Company
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvit Rd, บางนา Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff completely ignored customers, leaving them standing in line for ages to order. No one was at the counter; I could only hear people talking inside, but no one came out to check on the customers.
They didn't care at all. After ordering, there was no receipt or queue number notification. The food was ready, but they didn't call out my name; they just placed it on the counter and walked away, even though there were 2-3 other customers waiting. They should have informed me when my order was ready and what my queue number was, but they didn't care at all. And I waited for ages.
Terrible service!
So, so bad! 😡😡😡😡
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutnicha

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't know whose turn it was, but the service was terrible! They kept customers waiting for ages and didn't inform them of anything. I waited for over an hour, thinking there were a lot of customers, but then they told the rider they didn't see the order because the computer was down. That's awful! Please check your computer properly next time. Don't just ignore incoming orders. And please pay more attention to customer service. I feel sorry for the rider; it wasted so much of his time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukunlaya Khaengmuang

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch has extremely slow service. The staff are inattentive to customers, and orders are processed very slowly. It's unclear what they're doing. I'm wondering if the delay is due to insufficient production capacity (if they can't keep up, they shouldn't be processing so many online orders at once) or if it's due to poor management (many staff but poor kitchen management). Management should come and oversee this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siramet Thinoros

sample_reviews_en.text: I was planning to eat at this branch, but as I was about to park, a security guard came and told me that this area was only for takeout and delivery, and they didn't know where to park for dine-in. In the end, I couldn't eat there. I wish the restaurant would tell the security guard to be more polite. People who come to eat are there to enjoy their meal, not to be spoken to in such a rude manner.
sample_reviews_en.author: ยลธิดา ล่ําสันต์

sample_reviews_en.text: The service at this restaurant was terrible. They made customers wait for their food while the staff stood chatting behind the counter. Many delivery riders were waiting in front of the store, but the staff ignored them, only glancing at them briefly before going back to their conversation. Overall, it was a very bad experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: พลวรร จันทสส

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service. I ordered on their app and they are unable to read a delivery address from their app. They can't use google maps to navigate in their own soi. They tried to call but unfortunately none of the staff could speak English. They just let the order run on the app and I actually had to call the support to cancel.
sample_reviews_en.author: عين

sample_reviews_en.text: Not too bad for what it is. Definitely have had worse pizzas. The size is definitely more snack size and the dough can be a bit too thick, but the ingredients are tasty. Yes the wait is long but it looked like they manage a lot of other orders. Would try again for sure but this is definitely not an everyday food.
sample_reviews_en.author: A. M.

sample_reviews_en.text: The cashier service was extremely slow. Customers placed orders via Grab, and we, the food delivery drivers, waited for a very long time. The people in the kitchen were busy chatting, and the orders were so slow that the Grab drivers who arrived before us had been waiting for two hours. Terrible service.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลักษมี สังวรณ์

restaurants.name: McDonalds
restaurants.address:

24 Soi Pattaya 13/2, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: They will discriminate you as a non customer when you asked to use the toilet even though you have been sitting there for more than 30 minutes. You ordered a set meal and asked for a service water and they would deny you that. Telling you to buy a bottled water worth 30 baht. The server who went to my table also told me that they have no regular chicken even though I already paid in their self-service counter. That counter should have crossed that option if they can't provide such food. And guess what, they asked me to wait for 25 minutes instead. Shout out to the crew named Monique who told me to order first before using the toilet. And to Pai who asked me rudely to wait for 25 minutes after they realized that there is no regular chicken left. THIS BRANCH GIVES MCDONALD A BAD NAME!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sir Kev

sample_reviews_en.text: An employee told us we had to wait 7 minutes for our food... The restrooms were locked and only accessible with a code. When paying at the self-service kiosk, we didn't receive a receipt because the printer was empty. The McDonald's didn't smell clean or fresh. Many employees were standing around watching us customers. Why did the order take 7 minutes then?
sample_reviews_en.author: Checkeljoe Racing

sample_reviews_en.text: They operate around the clock, providing convenience for customers. They also offer a self-service ordering kiosk, so you can place your order easily. Once you've submitted your order, it usually takes about 10 to 15 minutes to be prepared and served to your table. Overall, it was a decent experience, and I don't really have any major complaints.
sample_reviews_en.author: Quiet Navigator

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were denied an order at the cash register, although this is selective. We had to go and order at the kiosk, then go and pay at the cash register. The restroom is locked with a code, and they don't give you the code. You have to ask someone on staff, and they even do it with a disgruntled expression.

I didn't feel happy at your McDonald's.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marina Gulaia

sample_reviews_en.text: They don't seem to like people sitting without buying - which is fair enough if they're busy. I was asked what I had bought when the place was half empty, though and I had just finished my food - lucky I kept the receipt or I can only imagine I'd have had to leave. If you want to sit and relax, I'd look elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert North

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beware of scams!
Change is only given upon request. Be sure to check the amount you pay. It's better to pay at the machine! I was so taken aback that I didn't point it out to the employee with ID129850.

In general, the quality of McDonald's here is light years away from what you get in Europe.
sample_reviews_en.author: MarkiMark

sample_reviews_en.text: The surrounding shops only open around noon, so it's great for people who want to enjoy Pattaya Beach from the morning because it's open 24 hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: kyon kyon

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious, and they helped me pay in cash at the checkout. There were plenty of seats and air conditioning. The food arrived very quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Виктория Семенова

restaurants.name: แซ่บนัว ครัวกรมช่าง
restaurants.address:

QGXM+54P, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We've reopened! The restaurant has been redesigned with a new layout, including a karaoke room, an air-conditioned dining area, and a chill garden zone. Our service has been improved with friendly, polite, and courteous staff to ensure greater customer satisfaction. Importantly, our prices have been lowered, while we still use only high-quality, delicious, and hygienic ingredients. Come and try it…we guarantee you'll love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: วสันต์ เมืองวงษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The male employee at the service counter is terrible. I've encountered him several times, and his manners remain awful. He yells at customers even though he's the one who incorrectly entered the order information. If he continues working there, the restaurant will likely see a decline in customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: MinE PHoBia

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been there several times. The food tastes good, but this time they gave me very little papaya salad.

Last month when I went, they gave me much more. It feels like their cooking isn't consistent. This time the portion was surprisingly small. I'm very surprised!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rosie B

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a garden view, with both air-conditioned and outdoor seating areas, plus private rooms. There's parking available. The food is delicious, the staff are friendly and provide good service, and the food doesn't take long to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natapon Dumrongkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere. The air conditioning is nice and cool, the mood is good. The papaya salad is flavorful and the fermented fish sauce is very tasty. It's really spicy! 🌶️🌶️🌶️
sample_reviews_en.author: Nantaporn Thamathitikhun

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad was delicious, especially the crab and fermented fish papaya salad. The grilled meat wasn't tough, and the prices were reasonable. Plus, it's air-conditioned.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nampueng

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious and great value for money. I highly recommend it, especially the boiled beef with dipping sauce – so spicy and delicious! 😋😙😗
sample_reviews_en.author: Attakorn Jakkorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The coffee was delicious, the Northeastern Thai food was fantastic, and there was plenty of parking. I'll definitely be back! 😍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: สุทธิ พ่วงน่วม

restaurants.name: Yayoi Big C Ratchadamri
restaurants.address:

97/11, Big C Ratchadamri, 4th Floor, Ratchadamri Road, Lumphini, Khet Pathum Wan, Bangkok, 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This yayoi at big c rajdamari used to be good, we liked to come and used to com very often years ago. This time big disappointment about the food and the service was terrible. Ordered the food and needed to wait almost for 1 hour and there were not even many customers, including our table not more then 5 tables. We ordered different items and drinks even the drinks took them 30 minutes to deliver to our table and waited for 1 hour , the lady came and said one item we ordered was not available so funny, they should know which is available and which is not. We had to ask 2,3 times and 1 item came when we were making the payment and they didn’t even bother to ask if we wanted to cancel or take away. So bad service. They should change the waiters
sample_reviews_en.author: Kay Hlaing

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it was delicious. I think it tasted even better because I was craving clean, Japanese-style food at the time. We ordered dishes like Tonkatsu Nabe and Soba noodles, and everything was clean and well-prepared. The prices were reasonable, and it was a good place to have a beer. Since they stay open until around 10 PM, I was able to have a meal, even though it was a bit late. Just to keep in mind, I don't think it is a restaurant with particularly friendly service or a great atmosphere. It’s the kind of place where you eat quickly and simply.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김현미

sample_reviews_en.text:
Starting with the upstairs, it's a great place to eat before shopping at Big C. Their signature dish is the Hamburg. It's a great price for this much, and it's delicious. You get miso soup, salad, and kimchi. Another favorite is the croquettes, which are so soft 🤤

The staff only speaks a little English, but that's not a problem, as the food is incredibly delicious. I absolutely love it here 🫰🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherry

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is pretty alright. The standard japanese fare and the meat is well cooked. But this place needs an improvement in their customer service of the staff because they weren’t attentive and always talking among themselves. They also seems to be quite unhappy that we walked in to order food. The chefs were quite ok and even came out to serve the food themselves.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yingying

sample_reviews_en.text: Used to love eating there. Now it is so bad that I got severe food poisoning from the curry when I visited two days ago, completely ruining my vacation days in Bangkok. Service is more busy looking at their phones than doing their job. Horrible. 1 star is too kind with how bad I’m feeling at the moment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melissa Jung

sample_reviews_en.text: It is a Japanese restaurant and it is located inside the Big C super market on the Ratchadamri Road. I tried a "Rice topped with Fried Pork Cutlet and Egg" set [168 Baht] and it was good. This place is famous for its well priced Japanese Meal Sets which are displayed outside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Venkata Ratnam Rayala

sample_reviews_en.text: After finishing my meal, I wanted to pay, but there was no staff present. I waited in front of the counter for nearly 10 minutes, when a woman eating at a table next to it asked me irritably which table number I was at. It was the worst experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: mw Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rating based on the fact; they no longer take orders by person. They only drip QR code to table and say all order online. No other explanation. Qr code does not work.   So had to go somewhere else to eat as not possible to order.
Very bad system.
sample_reviews_en.author: peteg68

restaurants.name: Sukiya (สุคิยะ) - บิ๊กซี พระราม4
restaurants.address:

2929 Rama IV Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Came to edit the review, so angry. Said the beef was out of stock, pork was out of stock, whatever, but the vegetables were out of stock. 555 Just close it. Ordered the same menu 6 times and got to eat it 2 times, excellent even with trained staff. Or do you just bring it and shout that you're testing it? And what are you testing so often? It's annoying. Should you manage the stock first? When they served water first, it was really annoying. But I haven't eaten yet. Waiting for sukiyaki. Wait a bit, then they say it's out of stock. Can you change it? I want to eat sukiyaki. How would you know that you told the same person many times with the same menu that it was out of stock, so you served water to force them to come first? You shouldn't have done it. You should have served it all at once. You're practicing shouting to impress. Stop it. Make sure the stock is sufficient first. I was suspicious since no one ordered sukiyaki in the restaurant. How many days has it been gone????
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattarapan Sukarnjanaporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I went for service, ordered, and forgot I was going to buy a thermometer. I went to the counter and told the staff member, "I'll be at the pharmacy in a minute." The staff member nodded.

I sat there for a while, and everyone had their food. A male staff member came up to ask what I wanted. I had already ordered, but he didn't prepare it, and he didn't ask for everyone else to finish their order first.

I was going to go look for a complaint form, but instead, he asked what I wanted.

The staff member at the counter was rude and didn't give me any service. Leave. I don't want to work. He doesn't care.
sample_reviews_en.author: Astasit Kaewnanuer

sample_reviews_en.text:
The famous gyudon franchise form Japan. The taste meet the standard of the franchise. If you expected a fancy or luxurious plate, this is not going to be your place. If you want a quick meal, sensible price and tasty standard food, feel free to get here.

The service is kind of moderate self-service. You have to order by yourself via mobile device (the shop prepared you a QR code to scan at every table) and also payment - do at cashier. Only when food serve, shop member will deliver you a food at your table.

Overall, everything meet the standard they should be 👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Gaan Puenpipat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the Thai chain of Sukiya, one of Japan's top three gyudon chains and the country's largest gyudon restaurant.

It offers a wider variety of options and a more diverse price range compared to Yoshinoya, which is considered the originator of gyudon.

Personally, I think Yoshinoya is better for the authentic taste of gyudon, while Sukiya is better for a more comprehensive meal.

It's a shame that Matsuya isn't in Bangkok, haha. It would be fun to compare the three major chains.
sample_reviews_en.author: 강마에

sample_reviews_en.text: I like this place, but the staff change all the time. Today (March 11th, lunchtime) the staff were talking without a mask on. It was a little dirty. If they think the restaurant industry is bad, they shouldn't work there. Also, the menu is too tedious. It doesn't seem like the number of staff has decreased, and they're raising prices even when customers use their cell phones and the internet, so it gives a bad impression. I wish they'd improve it a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: MI SO

sample_reviews_en.text: I have been to this restaurant and what I found is that the staff are inattentive to customers. There are no staff on standby because the staff is playing with their phones in the kitchen (I saw this). The taste of the food is good according to the restaurant's standards. I want to take away but I can't call the staff at all (the call button doesn't work at almost every table or maybe all of them!!). I am not satisfied with the service at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: BOIGOLF

sample_reviews_en.text: Japanese beef bowl chain restaurant located on the first floor of Big C Extra Rama 4.  Relatively new.  It has a fast food restaurant vibe, but is actually full-service, except when customers have to bring checks to the cashier themselves for payment.  Food is good in accordance with Sukiya’s standards.  Prices are very reasonable, especially set menu.  Good polite service staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: mars universe

sample_reviews_en.text: Overpriced for the quality of food served, Gyudon had no taste and tokatsu was red and not properly cooked when received (no taste either) I asked them to cook it more and they just microwave it overcooking the rice, didn't  finished, know is cheap but definately nor worth it. Never coming back to any place of this chain again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Laura Garcia

restaurants.name: บ้านเสธ.หมูกระทะ
restaurants.address:

251 1 Soi Pracha Songkhro 45, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but I ordered two dishes and received three, overcharged by over 100 baht. I ordered rice with toppings but wanted it to go, yet they cooked it for me. My first visit was unimpressive. The staff were difficult to communicate with. When taking the order, I saw them write "2 servings of crispy pork with kale," but I said "1 serving," and the staff member just walked away. When I went to get a refund, the staff member who took the order told the cashier that I ordered side dishes, but I specifically asked for rice with toppings to go. The stir-fried basil with crispy pork was 79 baht per plate, so three plates would be 237 baht, but they charged me 337 baht. I complained and only got 100 baht back, plus they took one bag of side dishes away. I then said, "If you're going to take it away, then charge me for two dishes and give me another 69 baht back, totaling 169 baht." But the cashier said the side dishes alone were 169 baht. I then said, "Never mind, I got the crispy pork with kale for 158 baht and the stir-fried basil with crispy pork for 79 baht." Terrible experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: เพชรนารี กันยาประสิทธิ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mookata (Thai BBQ) restaurant in Bangkok. It's very far from the tourist area, so the clientele is mainly locals. It closes very late at night. The food is of good quality and the service is friendly. Average prices. Recommended.

(Note: The Thai BBQ restaurant name in Bangkok is a bit out of the way of tourist attractions, so the clientele is mainly locals. It closes very late at night. The food is of good quality and the service is friendly. Average prices. Recommended.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Nubaza C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dipping sauce is delicious. The amount of meat and vegetables is smaller.
I last visited on July 30, 2022. The price has increased, but the amount of meat and vegetables has decreased. I understand that the product price has increased, but since the price has increased, the quantity should not decrease.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zj Heartbreaker

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a regular customer, but today the staff seemed inattentive. I mentioned that there were black sediments falling from the Pepsi refill, and the staff member (likely a foreigner) said, "Then we can't refill it anymore," but still allowed other customers to use it without trying to fix the problem.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nopparuch Muenkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the service was terrible! We waited for our food for ages; it was incredibly slow. Communication was impossible; they said one thing when we ordered and another when we got the bill. Never again! The staff kept making faces as if they didn't want to serve us.
sample_reviews_en.author: yiixx 45

sample_reviews_en.text: For Korean palates, the broth was fantastic! Haha It's open 24 hours, so it's okay to visit late, and after you're done eating, you can just buy some fruit from the market! The meat is lean and very light, and it's not a buffet, so you pay according to what you order~
sample_reviews_en.author: susu

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious! The BBQ pork was especially tasty. There were also many other appetizers. Personally, I loved the marinated salmon and the pork satay – they were amazing! The vibe was great. It's a perfect place to chill or have a meal with family.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulchada

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is slow, and the details are unclear. I eat here often, but every time the service is so slow that I have to serve myself everything. Food preparation is also slow, and the beer promotions aren't clearly explained. It's really not okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: thanyathon phukongchai

restaurants.name: เนื้อแท้ Wok กะ Steak Lotus Onnut
restaurants.address:

1710 Sukhumvit 50 Aly, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Nuatair (Authentic Meat) is a restaurant and premium quality beef supplier founded by Bang To (Weerachon Sratthaying). Its core motto is "A butcher's shop for meat lovers," emphasizing quality, 100% Halal certification, and selecting self-raised Australian beef. The meat boasts a distinct flavor at accessible prices. Key features of Nuatair's top-quality beef include: use of premium Angus beef raised under meticulous control, resulting in tender, marbled, and uniquely flavorful meat; the concept of "The Authentic Meat of Each Dish"—emphasizing the natural flavor of the meat in dishes such as steaks, stir-fries, and braised beef, without any gamey odor; 100% Halal certification; various business models including restaurants (general branches), Nuatair Noodle Shop, butchery (fresh meat sales), and buffet (special branches); and quality control—Bang To personally tastes and selects the meat to ensure quality standards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boontin Jitraviparat

sample_reviews_en.text: Not knowing what to order, I tried the Australian beef steak that was on promotion outside the store. It came with two side dishes, so I chose two Caesar salads. They weren't exactly like Caesar salads, but they were edible. It's a semi-self-service restaurant, which is convenient. You order and pay at the counter first, then choose a table and pick up your food yourself after it's prepared. There are staff to collect the plates after you're finished. The atmosphere is bright, spacious, and airy. Being a new restaurant, it feels even brighter and more pleasant to the eye. I'll try the rice dishes next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: jesda yenjabok

sample_reviews_en.text: The basil stir-fry was incredibly delicious! Mine was minced beef basil stir-fry, perfectly dry-fried, and the flavors were just right in every way. There's nothing to complain about. I chose the ribeye, which is a bit pricey, but it wasn't tough at all; it was very tender and had a nice smoky flavor. I loved it! It might have been slightly overcooked compared to my request for medium rare, but it still wasn't tough. The Caesar salad side dish wasn't to my liking, but overall it was great. I wish they had a branch like this near my house; it's a quick meal place with a stylish and comfortable atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalalai J.

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices for the cast iron skillet menu are the same as at the Neua Tae food court (slightly cheaper than the main restaurant). They have more affordable steak options and desserts like donuts and croissants. The taste is good and up to Neua Tae's standard. They offer refillable soft drinks like a fast-food restaurant. It's a self-service restaurant, but the dishwashing area is small and not often cleared, making it difficult to clean up. Many customers don't clear their own dishes, and staff don't clean frequently, resulting in tables looking messy often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shariff Masae

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I tried the minced beef basil stir-fry with rice and a fried egg. Everything was good except for the fried egg, which was still runny on top, so I deducted one star. The flavor of the basil stir-fry was good and up to the restaurant's standard.

The only issue I deducted a star for was the service. The staff seemed inattentive to cleaning up the tray return area, resulting in a large accumulation of red trays with used dishes, making it difficult for other customers to return their trays.
sample_reviews_en.author: Earn Nigizer

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant, Neua Tae, serves delicious sliced ​​beef basil rice. The beef is tender, not chewy, and has no gamey smell. It's stir-fried to a perfect dry consistency, with a distinct basil aroma and a rich, well-balanced flavor. It pairs even better with a fried egg. Overall service is good, with polite staff, but the wait for food is quite long, around 20 minutes. The restaurant's atmosphere is well-decorated, stylish, and clean, making it suitable for dining with family or friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Methaphan Patchotasingh

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. The stir-fried pork with basil is tasty and meets standard expectations.
2. The chicken breast steak (135 baht) was completely dry and bland. Even the steaks at 7-Eleven are tastier. Improvements are needed.
3. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere and comfortable seating.
4. However, the wait was very long. Only two tables in the entire restaurant had received their food, but we waited 20 minutes before getting ours. They were busy prioritizing rider orders first.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pariwat Duangkamnoi

sample_reviews_en.text: We spent 550 THB for two people, but it was a very disappointing experience. The steak was dry, small, and completely lacking in flavor—honestly one of the worst meals we’ve had. They served it poorly, and the service felt careless. We also had to wait a long time for the food, and it was really uncomfortable hearing people sneezing from the kitchen. The place was also quite noisy, which made it even worse. Definitely not worth the price or the experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Myat Phyo Phyo

restaurants.name: Collis Restaurant & Bistro
restaurants.address:

WVC7+57M, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Great place nice breakfast and well priced 🙂."

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent restaurant with reasonable prices, outstanding wait staff to whom I was able to relay my wishes quite well, some are quite proficient in English and all speak enough. After an almost 3 month stay in SEA I was craving some western dishes so although I love Thai food I can't comment on those dishes. Love the chili con carne, personal favorite of mine anyway. Also had a nicely cooked Australian beef steak. Probably a western European owner, German would be my guess. Oh the beef roast is delicious as well, so tender.

Can't say I've been losing weight since I started frequenting this place, they have a nicely stocked dessert display case, the blueberry cheese cake is wonderful. Also a nice place for breakfast/lunch btw, pretty much stopped going anywhere else to be honest.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bas Kalter

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best restaurants in the entire area. The quality of the ingredients is excellent. The service is always very discreet yet friendly. From cordon bleu and hamburgers to Thai food, they have it all. My personal highlight was yesterday. I wanted to eat at home and ordered goulash. I asked if I could have spaetzle, even though it wasn't on the menu. The chef prepared a huge portion of goulash with homemade spaetzle for me to take away within 15 minutes. The food was absolutely fantastic! Another great thing is that you can play a round of pool 🎱 in the bar across the street and order food. They'll bring it right over to you, and you can eat at the bar with your friends.

The prices are also unbeatable compared to other restaurants in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marco

sample_reviews_en.text: Good day, friends, I usually don't write reviews, but this restaurant exceeded my expectations! After places like "Van Pen" (they're also good, but not like this one!), this place is simply wonderful. We ordered lasagna - 10/10! Not everywhere in Italy and Russia makes it so delicious! I know. Then the Greek salad - 10/10, it was like I made it! The cheese is just like ours, very tasty, the portions are big! And the chicken strips. We came in the evening, so maybe the meat wasn't that great, so I give them 5/10. It's tastier at KFC. Price + water = 503 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hello Hello (Ioui)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I eat here at least once a week. The waitress's service was exemplary and so pleasant.  I watched a video on YouTube reviewing the restaurant.  The review was spot on. The food was fantastic. I asked the waitress in English for Ribs cooked with no sauce. I asked her not to dip the ribs in sauce but to give me BBQ sauce on the side.  I got exactly what I asked.  The cole slaw was cold and the fries and ribs were piping hot.

Did I mention the prices were reasonable?  Put this place on your must go list.
sample_reviews_en.author: Howard L Bloom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Too hot!
Always too hot!
It's air conditioned and it should be cool, but even after 12 years in Thailand I find it too hot.
Maybe a dehumidifier would help? Not a sweaty person, but in here, even my hands are sweating. This really, really needs sorted. A common problem in the Far East is staff controlling the temperature. If I want to be warm I'll sit outside, I shouldn't be sitting sweating in an indoor eatery.
I'd drop in more often, but something needs to change.
sample_reviews_en.author: G S

sample_reviews_en.text: We're excited to welcome you for the 2026 season! This is a wonderful establishment with delicious food, excellent service, and a pleasant, welcoming atmosphere. Large portions, beautiful tableware, and reasonable prices. We loved it! Thank you for the wonderful moments you've created. The roast beef simply melts in your mouth. The waitresses are so smart and beautiful!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ренат А.

sample_reviews_en.text: Tonight I went to eat at this restaurant and bought a burger and fries for 285 baht. I told the waitress I wanted my burger to be cooked medium rare, but it was overcooked, and the burger wasn’t that big or juicy. I informed the waitress and she took a picture of the burger. Not sure if I will be eating at this restaurant in the near future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rob

sample_reviews_en.text: Thank you very much for the service, it was very tasty, we ordered 2 tom yum soups, 2 pizzas, the service was fast, the staff was very friendly, the atmosphere was pleasant, it was just a pleasure to sit there and eat, everything was neat and tidy, it was very pleasant to be there, we will definitely come back to you in the next few days ☺️🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Алексей «MALISH» Таравков

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือกลางกรุง สาขา Market Place Nanglinchee
restaurants.address:

79 ซอย นางลิ้นจี่ 3 Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The first time I ordered Tom Yum noodles, I asked if they had a special version, and they said no.
I ordered again with a different staff member, who said they did, and then I ordered the special.
When the special arrived, it was just the regular version. I took it back to get it changed. They just added more soup and noodles, but nothing extra was added, and they didn't even make it spicy enough. They just put the soup and noodles back in the same bowl.
The food is delicious, but the staff is incompetent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wuthisith Kijkriengkrai

sample_reviews_en.text:
They even have lamb boat noodles!!! I love it 😍😍 The broth is fragrant and delicious. They have other options to choose from too. I'm hooked!

My second and third visits were the same dish, but it wasn't as good as before 😢 The second time it was too sweet. The third time I asked them not to add sugar, but it seemed like the cook didn't care. Plus, the broth wasn't as fragrant as the first time. I've taken a break from it lately, but I still love the lamb, so I'll try it again sometime.
sample_reviews_en.author: ML Sawansiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The waterfall-style noodle soup was incredibly bland and tasteless. No matter how much I seasoned it, it didn't taste good. I ordered thick noodles but got thin ones. The price was similar to Tha Siam's, but the taste was completely different. Even a 30-baht roadside noodle stall is much better.
If I didn't mind spending the money, I would have just left it and paid and gone home.
This happened around 6 PM on March 21, 2019.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supatra Juritong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, but the service is terrible. I ordered one thing and got another. It was the same at the Esplanade branch. It's like they don't understand Thai or something. I ordered one thing and got something else, and they didn't apologize. They even glared at me rudely. This happened both times. Delicious food but terrible service? I won't be coming back. Customers have plenty of other options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunyaphat Sukpholtham

sample_reviews_en.text: I love eating boat noodles at this branch in Bangkok because the broth is delicious – not too spicy, just right. It's clean, well-cooked, and most importantly, I love the black pork version; the meat is tender and goes well with the broth. This branch also has papaya salad, which is tasty. The service is good, the restaurant is spacious and comfortable, and the food comes out quickly – no long queues.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maturada R.

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food is incredibly spicy. Even the papaya salad I ordered was not spicy, but it was incredibly spicy. The tom yum noodles were incredibly spicy. Make it a little mild. Even people who can handle spicy food can't handle it. Please adjust the taste. The customer said it wasn't spicy, but you made it so spicy that it's too spicy. Try it yourself first. The staff probably can't handle it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nut NVM

sample_reviews_en.text: Every Wednesday, a small bowl is 20 baht, which is considered good value for the thin rice noodle boat soup with beef. The bowl is larger than the Phra Nakhon boat noodle soup. The taste is on the salty side, but judging from reviews about very slow service, I didn't dare order more. Today it wasn't slow, but other menu items besides boat noodles might take longer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narin P. Rattanaroj

sample_reviews_en.text:
Long wait, chaotic queue system. Eight people who arrived later received their food before us.
No apology when we inquired about the delay.
The food served was also incorrect; we ordered no sprouts but received bean sprouts, requiring an additional wait. It's unclear if the fault lies with the kitchen or the server.
The food tasted average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiramate Natepatiparn

restaurants.name: ครัวริมคลอง บางน้ำผึ้ง
restaurants.address:

MHGF+Q4H, Ying Amnuai Rd, Bang Nam Phueng, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "The low-priced beers complete the experience!"

sample_reviews_en.text:
Short and sweet❣️❣️ Everyone said in unison, "Awesome!"
🌈Uncle and Auntie's food...the taste is amazing!!! 100/10!!!
I was running errands in this area and felt hungry...opened the map to find a restaurant...the first impression when I walked in...was like 😅 "Hmm...why is it so quiet? Should I find a new restaurant?" Hahaha!
But girl!!! From the heart of a Ratchada/Bangkok resident, I give Uncle and Auntie's food a 10-10-10!!! The rice was soft, and the food was incredibly flavorful.
❤️‍🔥First dish: Glass noodle salad with pork sausage...served and finished in 3 minutes! Hahaha! It was tastier than any glass noodle salad I've ever had in Bangkok! 😆😆😆👏🏻
❤️‍🔥Second dish: A must-try at any street food restaurant, "Stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce"...the aroma of the wok filled the air!! The flavor was perfectly balanced. Winner, second place!!
Other dishes: Deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce, creamy tom yum seafood soup, baked shrimp with glass noodles... 100% satisfaction guaranteed! 😆😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Phoowa F

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is near Bang Nam Phueng Floating Market.
The pork fried rice tasted good, just like the fried rice I ate as a child. I personally like the rice to be fluffy and separate grains.
The tofu and minced pork soup was flavorful and the bowl was large.
The stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce lacked the wok aroma and tasted predominantly salty.
The spicy pork salad was sour, salty, and spicy.
The service was good. The restaurant is spacious, open-air, and has convenient parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

sample_reviews_en.text:
So incredibly delicious!
Everyone should come; it's so delicious it'll make your taste buds explode!
Not crowded, not many people know about it. The owner is lovely, and the staff are kind.
Soft music is playing, very relaxing.
It's shady with trees, and the owner even turned on a fan for us.
The food is delicious and not expensive.
*You might have to wait a little while for your food because the owner cooks it.*
But it's worth the wait, it's really worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fa Rafair

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was served extremely slowly. There were only 3 tables occupied in the whole restaurant, but we waited for an hour. Many items were out of stock, but they only told us after we had waited for almost an hour. If they were going to say the restaurant was actually closed and they didn't have the items, they should have told us before we ordered. The only positive thing is that it wasn't crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hathaipat Noon

sample_reviews_en.text: The cook is an auntie, and she does everything herself... so the food takes a little while to prepare, but it's worth the wait 🥰😋 Auntie's cooking is incredibly delicious 🥇✨️✨️ The rice is perfectly soft, and each dish is perfectly seasoned. Eating it is just... pure bliss!!! Everything is delicious. …
sample_reviews_en.author: After1AMii

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers delicious and affordable food in a cozy, homey atmosphere with soft music playing. It's a great place to relax and chill for a long time. If you're visiting Bang Nam Phueng Floating Market, I highly recommend this place. The prices are very budget-friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cha Eak

sample_reviews_en.text:
High value (the lowest prices we have seen), a limited menu delivers delicious food, the chicken wings are exceptional!
Set in a rural setting, (a field) you can dine in the shade of a huge Kapal tree on very comfortable furniture. The low-priced beers complete the experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian Hawkes

sample_reviews_en.text: My partner and I had our best meal in Bangkok at this place! We had the stir-fried noodles with soy sauce and the Thai-style sukiyaki, and both were delicious. The family is very welcoming, and don't hesitate to share your positive feedback with the chef.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bianca Lefebvre

restaurants.name: เตี๋ยวต้มยำ-เส้นคลุก มะ ราชวัตร
restaurants.address:

