791 Thanon Nakhon Chaisi Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Khet Dusit, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on Nakhon Chai Si Road, near Ratchawat intersection. There's no dedicated parking lot, but you can park along the road. It's a small restaurant with moderate seating. They offer noodle soup, dry noodles, and stir-fried noodles. The prices are affordable, the portions are good, and the taste is delicious – well-balanced with plenty of toppings. The stir-fried noodles are tasty even without additional seasoning. The staff provides good service, and the food doesn't take long to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Athit Upakan

sample_reviews_en.text: The boiled noodles were perfectly cooked, the crispy pork cracklings were delicious, and the tom yum soup had just the right balance of sourness and sweetness. It was very tasty!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nittaya Yoopakdee

sample_reviews_en.text: Simply amazing. Tasty 😋 top. The owner is incredibly gentle...the food is super! My favorite restaurant in Thailand for sure 😃😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefano Ambrosini

sample_reviews_en.text:
Traditional Tom Yum Noodle Soup, a well-balanced flavor, perfect for dinner.

Clean, delicious, and a variety of menu options.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชนันต์ มาตะราช

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious! Similar to kaisenmen, but with even more flavorful ingredients.
A must-try. It's hard to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: DanDan Kokoro

sample_reviews_en.text: Good service, cheap prices, free water, generous portions, and delicious. I eat here regularly.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฐิติภา อัศวินิมิตร

sample_reviews_en.text: Tom Yum noodles, stir-fried noodles, delicious late-night treats. The minced pork is the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: KRiCHiE Vasudhâra

restaurants.name: Bangkok Congee (Soi Pracha Songkhro 21)
restaurants.address:

4757 ซ. ประชาสงเคราะห์ 21 Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Good place to grab a delicious bowl of Jok (rice porridge, โจ๊ก, pronounced like the English word “joke”).
sample_reviews_th.author: Foo Dee

sample_reviews_en.text: In the evenings, it gets very crowded and there's no parking. This porridge shop is clean and safe. The pork is flavorful and not too spicy with pepper. The rice is very soft. Importantly, it's perfect for people with digestive problems or those who get diarrhea easily. If you ask for a portion for a child or someone who can't eat much, they'll flatten the pork so it's easy to swallow. Plus, it's only 20 baht for a child's portion, but adult portions are 30 baht and up. #HealthConscious #SuitableForYoungChildren They sell from around 4 PM to 9 PM, even during the COVID period.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried the congee at Prachasongkroh 21 and it was so bad, even a dog wouldn't eat it. The pork smelled bad and no matter how they seasoned it, it just didn't taste good.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธีระชัย บัวเผี่อน

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is extremely popular! The food is delicious, the prices are cheap, the portions are generous, and most importantly, it's very clean
sample_reviews_en.author: โจ๋ อ๋อง

sample_reviews_en.text: I've passed by it, but I've never tried the food. It looks very appetizing, though. I'll definitely try it when I get the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Byเฟิร์น โมเดลคาร์

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, clean, and affordable. The rice is smooth and fragrant. They also have chicken noodle soup with bitter melon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawadee Sriborisut

sample_reviews_en.text: Very tasty and comforting! Good for a long day after art bienalle and chatuchak. We had 2 bowls each! Heh thank uu!
sample_reviews_en.author: Janine L

sample_reviews_en.text: It kept the soup at a good temperature, the flavor wasn't weak, and it was delicious even without seasoning.
sample_reviews_en.author: ncb03150e

restaurants.name: Motherbkk
restaurants.address:

811 ถ. เจริญกรุง Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went for a dinner tasting menu. Food wise its alright, not my cup of tea as nothing is super special and exquisite. The reason I am leaving a 3 star is because the restaurant waiter kept pouring water all through the night, even a little sip, its re-filled. By the end of the night everybody have a full glass of water on the table with still loads of water left in the bottle.

8 ppl 9 bottles of Acqua Panna Big size bottle, doesn’t make sense. It was kinda rude not to ask your customer if they wanted more water for the table. Also a fine dining experience you will notice if the serving service is coming to an end - towards the last dish soon, you wouldn’t keep serving new bottle of water.

Need more training, very young team.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanaporn Sopchokchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place deserves a michelin star! Staff were polite and very attentive. We had the BK Restaurants Week menu, so the price was incredibly reasonable. The menu was well-thought. We ate well with high quality food which tasted delicious. The oyster was so flavourful with different texture in your mouth.

Our main dish was catfish on rice. We were impressed by how the catfish was cooked. Tender and tasty, unlike the usual grilled catfish you usually find as street food.

The dessert was very creative and gave a nice balance between sweet and salty.

Lastly, a nice finish with guava sorbet.

There are also parking spaces in front of the place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arisa S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beautiful space. Friendly and helpful service.

The food on the other was not at all to my taste. We ordered 5 dishes, 2 were good and 3 were not good. Every dish had lots of deep fried elements, was very oily and super salty, some to the point of being inedible. And even though I appreciate them trying to be creative with the flavors, the general fusion of flavors did not work at all. Odd spices and flavors that do not go well together.

I would not recommend or return.

Also a small pet peeve, but I dislike restaurants of this caliber only offer expensive bottles of water and don’t provide free water.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Perfect spot, in a converted and renovated urban building. Open kitchen, with a chef and assistants who have magic hands. They know how to combine Thai finesse, elegant presentation, originality, and the expected precision of an establishment at these prices without too much fuss. All things considered, it remains very affordable for Westerners visiting Thailand.

The waitstaff is incredibly attentive and will appreciate your expressions of pleasure once you take a bite.

As always in Thailand, you'll need to be mindful of the chilies you eat. ;)

Thank you to this wonderful team!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sébastien Gihoul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love my experience here and will definitely come back next time to try their other set menu!
I got a chance to try the colab menu between motherbkk x tempura which turns out very impressive. 2,5k bth for each. Love the attentive they put into the decorations and food quality. The menu is very creative, taste good and looks nice !!
During my weekend in bangkok, i got to try another 1-michelin star restaurant, but motherbkk gave me a better impression !!
Highly recommended for modern thai cuisine around chinatown :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Phạm Mi

sample_reviews_en.text:
From the menu, we can see how they design street food into their signature menu, and the chef's heartfelt explanation of each dish made for a delightful and surprising evening.

The staff are very nice.

Each dish reflects the chefs' dedication, transforming Thai street food into exquisite dishes. The chef's attentive explanation of each dish made for a delightful and surprising meal.

The staff service was excellent.

This restaurant is highly recommended! 👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Eat and travel

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place does modern elevated Thai food. Everything was beautifully done and you can tell a lot of thought went into the dishes. We got the bread and butter to start and for the entrees we got the fried fish salad, the duck, and the stuffed squid. The bread and the duck were a bit underwhelming and didn’t feel uniquely Thai. The salad and the squid were great though!

Service was good and the restaurant was very aesthetically pleasing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lisa Huang

sample_reviews_en.text: An unforgettable experience. Truly Thai while being so unique I can assure you that you will never have a meal like this in your life. The perfect compilation of flavours, textures, and local ingredients. Impeccable food and service. This has not only been a highlight but an essential during my time in Bangkok. Genius chef that seamlessly marries local childhood experiences with modern culinary practices. Cannot recommend enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mel S

restaurants.name: Hungry Panda American Chinese Eatery
restaurants.address:

A4, 404, Xzyte Square, 190 Chaloem Phrakiat 23 Alley, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hungry Panda is our 'go to' whenever we go to Pattaya. The food is excellent. The portions are plentiful. The price is easy on the pocket/wallet. The staff are always happy to see us.

We live in Bang Saray which is 20km south of Pattaya but we see Hungry Panda as a good reason to do an hour plus round trip for their food.

Special shout out for the salt and chilli chicken which could easily become my staple diet.

Very easy to park in Xzyte Square too and as the restaurant is twinned with Skinny Joe's next door, there's Philly cheesesteaks, burgers and shakes also available in a nice air-conditioned area as well as outside seating when the temperature cools down.

Well worth a visit when in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Scott Buchan

sample_reviews_en.text: Before I share my dining experience,I must first compliment the greeting as you enter the restaurant.A group of team members never fail to welcome you  as they offer to seat you.The meal is freshly prepared and hot as you are served at your table.The unique Asian Cuisine is second to none and leaves nothing to be desired.The tasty recipes combined with quality products make this a must stop dining destination for both locals and travelers.The cleanliness of the restaurant adds to an overall enjoyable meal.Be prepared to carry some food home with the healthy portions they provide.Dine in or take away,you will also become a regular patron at Hungry Panda.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Blackburn

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered food through Grab app and , They keep sending me wrong order i ordered shrimp curry they keep sending me beef 3 times this has happened. I sent them proof of order from Grab Management was so unhelpful told me nothing they can do, I spent a lot of money with them and that's how they treat there good customers i will Neaver order Hungary panda food ever again ,They should get a proper Manger who knows how to treat loyal customers. Regards Mr I Malpas  19 /12 2025 issue date when
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian Malpas

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is shooting itself in the foot. I have used them for over a year now. The food is excellent and freshly cooked. However recently they have started to reduce the portions. I always order a large egg fried rice and a large sweet and sour chicken. Until tonight they didn't fully fill the boxes. Tonight the boxes were visibly smaller. If this is not addressed they will lose customers and go out of business. I will now order elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Skinner

sample_reviews_en.text: Called in for a takeaway New years eve. So glad I did,the staff where very polite and wished me Happy new year. Now the food you can see it been cooked it was all delicious,the salt and chilli spare ribs where absolutely spot on and the house special curry and chow mein where just as delicious. Worth more than 5 stars,keep up the good work. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Godfrey

sample_reviews_en.text: We visited this place 3 times a week because they have a menu for American food (hamburgers, sandwiches, milkshakes, etc.) and another menu for Chinese food. We got the Chinese chicken combo with a choice of various sauces, rice or noodles, and a dumpling; it was delicious. Because of the variety on the menu, I highly recommend it for families.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Takahashi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best Chinese food I've had in years.
Huge portions, I could only eat about half of my order. I sat inside as the outside tables were full and you watch the chefs prepare the food while you wait. I went outside to finish my meal when a table became available.
Egg fried rice, chicken curry and crispy chilli beef all tasted great.
sample_reviews_en.author: andrew nichols

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you crave UK style Chinese food you must come here
I had sweet and sour chicken
Chicken curry
Chicken chow mien and they were all GREAT !!!!
If like myself , living far away ,
the team even give you your favourite sauces to cook with at home . A wonderful fun filled visit .
Thank you to the team
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronald Mclean

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเป็ดย้งฮุย ตลาดพลู
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 1 Soi Thoet Thai 20, Talat Phlu, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We're at Talat Phlu!
Another place we're visiting today is right next to Je Aeng's:
"Yong Hui Duck Noodles."
This is a famous duck noodle shop in Talat Phlu.

The highlight is that they use Thai ducks, which aren't too big, giving the meat and skin a chewy texture. Of course, it's a different style from larger ducks or braised goose. Those have thick, tender meat and smooth skin, but this one is a bit more rustic, with a bit of a chewiness, but still tender, not tough.
The duck blood is excellent, very soft. The liver and gizzard are also soft and delicious.
The braised broth is salty, not sweet. There aren't many braising spices or Chinese herbs; it's not a strong herbal stew. The flavor isn't intense, but it's good for sipping.
Personally, I think the taste is decent and the price is affordable at only 60 baht.
My only complaint is the vegetables they use; I was confused. I saw lots of kale and celery, but they only put in bean sprouts. Disappointing! 😑
sample_reviews_en.author: Thananont Krittayawiwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Legendary Duck Noodle Soup in Talat Phlu
The broth is fragrant with Chinese herbs, well-balanced and delicious.
Not too sweet or too salty 🍲

We ordered duck noodle soup with flat noodles, which we loved.
The broth is delicious and fragrant, served with tender duck meat.
It's not chewy and has no gamey smell at all 🦆

A must-try dish!!
The braised duck wings in an earthenware pot are the best!
They serve it in a piping hot earthenware pot.
Served boiling hot 🔥

The duck is incredibly tender and melts in your mouth 😚
You barely need to chew.
It's only 100 baht and the portion is generous.
What I liked most is that there's no gamey duck smell at all.

If you're passing through Talat Phlu,
don't forget to stop by and try this place. It's truly amazing 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: TikTok - Miss Boss Diva ชอบรีวิวแบบจริงใจ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let me tell you, anyone who loves duck dishes has to try this!
The broth is fragrant and flavorful, simmered until rich and intense, with a subtle aroma of Chinese herbs. It's very easy to drink. 🥣

The duck meat is tender and odorless, with thin, lean skin. It pairs perfectly with the noodles, which are neither too hard nor too soft. 🍜 Add a little chili vinegar for the ultimate experience. 💯

The price is also reasonable considering the value. It's filling, delicious, and delivers the full flavor of duck. 🦆

👉 Summary:
• Taste: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4.5/5)
• Ingredients: Fresh, tender, odorless
• Broth: Rich and fragrant with spices
• Value for money: Worth the price, very filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: THATPICHA “PICHA” W.

sample_reviews_en.text: There is a bit of a wait. A Thai gentleman waiting with me even used Papago to order my food and arranged for us to eat at the same table.😁 The duck noodle soup is very delicious for just 50 baht. Since the menu is only in Thai, I don't know what other dishes are available, but the gentleman at the same table had mixed noodles and a dish consisting only of duck. The neighborhood of Talat Plu is nice, I met a kind person, and I ate delicious food, so I think this will be the most memorable part of my trip.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taelim Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The duck meat is tender and the duck blood is delicious. The shop is located right on the road at the intersection under the Ratchada Bridge crossing the canal. There is ample seating, so there's a good turnover, and you don't have to wait long for a seat. It's a good place to grab a hearty meal before continuing your exploration of Talat Phlu market. Prices start at 50 baht per bowl. There are other à la carte dishes available from the shop next door.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben The Pathfinder

sample_reviews_en.text:
A famous old noodle and duck rice shop in the Talat Phlu area.
This is Yong Hui Duck Noodle Shop, Talat Phlu.

Duck rice is 50 baht per plate.
They also have a clay pot duck soup for 150 baht.

The braised duck has a rich and delicious flavor.
I highly recommend trying it if you're in the area.

The shop accepts cash and QR code payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is another one of my favorite restaurants.
The clay pot duck dish is amazing; the wings are incredibly tender, the blood is delicious, and the gizzards are great.
The broth is rich and flavorful, and the noodles pair perfectly with it.
The owner is friendly and the place is packed. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nt Ome - Travis

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice local duck noodles in this area.
Good price, good quality.
Super nice soup.
Friendly owner.
Recommended!!

The soup is delicious, rich in flavor, and the duck is tasty.
But I forgot to tell them not to include offal.
Food is served quickly.
The noodle vendor is friendly and gives good recommendations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ja JaMie

restaurants.name: เอี๊ยบเท่งอิ๋ว
restaurants.address:

1300/1 Pracha Chuen Rd, Wong Sawang, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located opposite the 7-Eleven on Vibhavadi Soi 41. The atmosphere is like eating at home, with a cool breeze.

The food tastes great. I was particularly impressed with the Mapo Tofu rice bowl; the sauce was delicious with the rice.
The sukiyaki sauce was also unique, with a tasty soybean paste flavor. You can choose your desired level of spiciness.

The chrysanthemum tea had a very original taste, not too sweet, like the kind you'd find in old-fashioned pharmacies.

We ordered two types of shaved ice. At first, we thought they would be the same, but the sweetness and sourness were different. The one with watermelon was more fruity and tart, while the one with dragon fruit was slightly sweeter. Both were delicious.

The fried cream-filled buns were incredibly delicious!

Overall, the food tastes good, the prices are reasonable for the portion sizes, and the restaurant has a comfortable atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: verte lete

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, but I probably won't be going back.
I usually go around 8 PM, which might make it inconvenient for the counter staff to serve me.
However, the wait staff provided good service and recommendations.
In terms of food taste, atmosphere, and price, I wanted to recommend it to friends, but honestly, after visiting, I won't be going again.
*************************
I ate there twice in a row. Saturday, September 24th (the first time I was treated rudely, but I thought the staff was probably tired) and Saturday, October 1st. I invited friends to eat there because it's near the university and the food is reasonably priced, but I didn't go because the counter staff seemed unhappy (maybe because we went during closing time). Their speech and demeanor were unpleasant. The wait staff, however, provided good service. I apologize to the counter staff for my disappointment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat Joonlamanop

sample_reviews_en.text:
I only recently had the chance to eat at this restaurant after moving to Vibhavadi 41. The atmosphere is relaxed, like eating at a friend's house. The highlight is the rice with a fried egg, soy sauce, and Chinese-style chili oil. The braised pork is incredibly tender and melts in your mouth. The pickled vegetables provide a nice tangy contrast. Adding crispy chicken is a great addition. The soup is fragrant with a light sweetness from Chinese dates and radishes.

The dessert is amazing! It's Chinese jelly with fruit and honey-lemon syrup – fragrant, delicious, and refreshing.

It's a bit difficult to get there, but worth the trip. The only downside is that there aren't many staff members. At first, I thought it was closed because I didn't see anyone. Overall, I will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: R. Nalyn

sample_reviews_en.text: There's no physical storefront, but the location on Google Maps was misleading, causing me to get lost. Upon arrival, the staff told me I could eat in and they would order for me. I asked for a menu, but there wasn't one, so they told me to check the menu on Grab instead. I asked before ordering if the prices were cheaper than on Grab, since I wasn't ordering through Grab and there were no app or rider fees. The staff said they were, but when the food was served and I asked for the bill, they charged exactly the same price as on Grab (I could have gotten a discount if I had ordered through the app for home delivery, which I missed out on). The food itself was delicious, everything was tasty, but everything else was terrible. I wasn't impressed and will definitely not go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Morca Moon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Older reviews were for the old branch. This Pracha Chuen branch doesn't have a storefront; you have to order delivery, or if you come to the restaurant, you can sit at Je Kai's restaurant and write down your order for them to order. The menu has gimmicks that make it look appealing, such as 100-Year-Old Soup or Divine Soy Sauce, but the taste is average. The Kou Rou pork is tender and delicious, similar to kakuni in ramen. The Grandpa's Fried Rice has plenty of ingredients and a fragrant wok aroma. The Mapo Tofu and Sukiyaki are mediocre.

On weekdays, you can park on the street during off-peak hours, but if you really want to sit at Je Kai's restaurant, it's best to park in their parking lot in the alley next to the restaurant and support them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Grid Truengsatitwong

sample_reviews_en.text: It was great...the atmosphere was okay, and the food wasn't expensive. The set in the picture was 99 baht, including sukiyaki, bubble tea, and two small steamed buns. The restaurant's decor is nice, and the food tasted good. At first, I wondered if I could eat Chinese food...but I could, and it was delicious. We went with 4 people, each ordered a different dish, and we also ordered crispy chicken, dim sum, shrimp dumplings, pork wontons, and dessert. The total bill was 673 baht. In this day and age, I think that's quite affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Songkran Sawangsri

sample_reviews_en.text: I called but no one answered, so I brought my child to the restaurant around 11:00 AM. Based on the reviews, I thought the kids would like it, but the restaurant wasn't open when we arrived. The staff told us to sit at Je Kai's restaurant instead. I asked for a menu, but they said they didn't have one and told me to check the app instead. So I changed my mind and decided not to eat there. They didn't seem ready to serve walk-in customers. They should update their Google listing to say they only accept online orders. 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawut Nganpinyo

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm so confused. I was going to eat at the restaurant on Viphavadee 41, following the map pin. The picture looked like a restaurant, but when I got there, it was just a house that served as the kitchen. I called the restaurant, and the staff said that picture was of the Kaset branch. I guess they edited the Google map and didn't remove the pictures of other branches. So confusing and a huge waste of time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wuttisak Saad

restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 13/237,13/238 ม.5 Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through Shopee Food, and the food items were not ready, so they canceled the order without calling to inform me. This happened twice, I repeat, twice. The success of a restaurant depends on its staff. A branch can fail because of …
sample_reviews_en.author: ธธิดา อิ่มสบาย

sample_reviews_en.text: If it's almost closing time at 2:00 AM and you're not comfortable or don't want to process orders, I suggest closing at 10:00 PM instead. Waiting almost an hour for just 1-2 items, and the staff's attitude is terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: ทองไทยเล็ก

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came from Bangkok, was hungry, so I ordered delivery via Grab.
I ordered food, but they ran out of spoons and forks. How am I supposed to eat?
This kind of service and management is just like a street food stall.
sample_reviews_en.author: saritchai mahasup

sample_reviews_en.text: Very Good Food and Service! I wish the Wings would be served hotter! They were just warm! But overall , this is a solid Bonchon location! It’s a Tale Out Place! There is no place to sit down and eat inside!
sample_reviews_en.author: Root66 Root66

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is normal but very slow to prepare. The service is average. The atmosphere is very bad. The location is very bad. We need to think of a new system.
sample_reviews_en.author: ITTHIPHAT BOONROD (SUN)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The crispy chicken with its unique sauce is a signature of the brand. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: จิรัชญา ชิดสิน

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch doesn't have radishes, does it? I ordered twice and neither time was ideal. I even emphasized it the second time.
sample_reviews_en.author: ROBOTWAKEBOARD CHANNEL (Audi)

restaurants.name: Assembly Point Thonglor
restaurants.address:

289 1 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is on the 7th floor of One One Bangkok Hotel, Thonglor. We bought the 499 baht package which included two dishes per person and unlimited drinks for 1.5 hours. It was Valentine's Day, so we bought two packages and ordered four dishes. We each drank six glasses of rum, gin, blackbell, and vodka – we got incredibly drunk! The drinks were very strong. The service was 11 out of 10 stars because it was excellent. The food was delicious; we barely had to wash any dishes. The house music was fun and not too loud. It looked like there might be live music because we saw a stage, but we went in the evening and left at 10 pm and didn't see any singers. I don't know when the singers actually come on. The only downside was that it's a rooftop bar and they allow smoking freely. The table behind us was a group of Asian foreigners smoking cigars. Overall, it was a very satisfying experience. We will definitely go back again.

Note: I apologize for being so drunk that day. When I called for a taxi, it was already in front of the hotel, so I rushed off and forgot to leave a tip.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sayomphu Youyen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, it's a good place. It's spacious with plenty of tables, suitable for company parties and gatherings. There's a view to enjoy, although the bar area is a bit small. The sound system is good.
| The only downside is that the food might not suit everyone's taste. It felt incomplete, for example, the fried chicken wings had an unusual flavor unlike anywhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: PEERAPAT P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good service, amazing performance, perfect cuisine and romantic atmosphere.I think it deserves more customers and reviews.
The only pity was that when the lead singer chatted with us in the middle, we couldn’t respond because we’re from Taiwan and don’t speak Thai, but the performance was still very enjoyable💕💕
sample_reviews_en.author: 葉秉鑫

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a nice place to eat and drink for only 699 baht per person. Entrance is inside the one one building on 7th floor you'll see the signs. Special thanks for a music playlist it's not annoying and make some pleasant environment. Highly recommend to visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Denis Sazonov

sample_reviews_en.text: Loved the place. Went there for a couple of drinks with a friend. The live music was great and the place was so beautiful! They also had happy hour (buy 2 drinks and get a free one). 100% would recommend. Also the views are quite good.
sample_reviews_en.author: mery

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great deal at 499 baht for free flow drinks with 2 dishes included!!
Staff are friendly and always check if you need more drinks. Music isn’t too loud. Good place to hang out and chit chat with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nungruthai Tudnui

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was fun and lively. I must commend the staff for their excellent service. The cocktails were delicious, absolutely perfect! 👑 I'll definitely be back. 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Niramol Kusanchai (Yui)

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere at this place is great, especially during this month when the weather isn't too hot, you can just relax and chill for a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jasada Srisawat

restaurants.name: Chai Tapri Fastfood & Cafe
restaurants.address:

579, Khao, Phra Tamnak, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
hai Tapri Pattaya is an absolute gem if you’re craving Indian street-style chai in Thailand!

From the moment you walk in, you get those cozy tapri vibes — simple seating, upbeat music, and the aroma of fresh masala chai everywhere. It feels just like home.

The Cutting Chai, Masala Chai, and Adrak Chai were all kadak and perfectly brewed. Not too sweet, just the right balance. We also tried Vada Pav, Samosa, Bun Maska and Pav Bhaji. Everything was served hot, fresh, and bursting with flavor. The Vada Pav chutney had the perfect spicy kick!

What I loved most: the prices are very reasonable and the staff are super friendly and quick. The place is clean and well-maintained too.

It’s the perfect spot to chill with friends after a long day at the beach or shopping. If you’re missing home food or just want a good cup of chai with Indian snacks, this is the place to go in Pattaya.

Highly recommend to Indians, NRIs and tourists alike. We will definitely come back again. Keep up the great work, Chai Tapri team!
sample_reviews_en.author: NARESH

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Indian Taste in Pattaya!

Chai Tapri Fast Food & Cafe, right opposite Hotel Citrus in Pattaya, is a hidden gem for desi food lovers!

I tried their Puri Bhaji — fresh, flavorful, and just like home. The Thepla with aloo jeera sabzi was a pleasant surprise — soft, perfectly spiced, and super satisfying. Their Vada Pav is crispy, spicy, and full of Mumbai vibes.

But the real magic is in their Chai — rich, aromatic, and absolutely refreshing. Easily one of the best spots in Pattaya for Indian snacks and tea.

Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ravin Paanchal

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bad experience. I inquired serving time before ordering, they said 5 mins but took 15 mins+. And  on top of that cheated, I asked for parcel pav bhaji but only bread and chutney was packed and I had no time to check the parcel... Wrongly trusted them. Very bad service.
Bcoz of their delay in service, I missed my bus... Loss of ova bhaji TBH 100 + bus fare TBH 171... Sad that after informing them that I have a bus to catch they still gave a bad service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abha K

sample_reviews_en.text:
hidden gem in Pattaya for tea lovers! ☕🇮🇳
The taste of the tea here is absolutely amazing — it truly feels like real Indian chai. Strong flavor, perfect balance of spices, and every sip gives a feeling of home. The atmosphere is simple but full of positive vibes, and the owner is very friendly. If you are in Pattaya and craving authentic Indian-style tea, this place is a must visit. Truly heartwarming and refreshing experience! ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: TECH R Jethva

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, very well-ventilated. It's perfect for sitting there in the afternoon without getting hot. The tea is delicious, with a milky, gingery flavor. The french fries are crispy and coated in something I don't know what it is, but it's surprisingly delicious. Definitely going back for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Z

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow, that Indian food was incredible!  The chef and staff were so sweet. I had some tea, golgappas, and paneer paratha – we really missed that food in Australia! You absolutely have to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Himmat Singh

sample_reviews_en.text: They do not maintain hygiene during cooking. Their utensils are not clean, and although the food is good, hygiene is not maintained. I can see the kitchen area through the window.🥵🥵
sample_reviews_en.author: Foodie Couple

sample_reviews_en.text: We were looking for a quick place to eat and the girl who served us was fantastic. She recommended delicious dishes, the service was very fast, and it was also very inexpensive 🥰🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Angela Fernandez Molina-Prados

restaurants.name: ก้อยนัวข้าวคั่วหอม
restaurants.address:

Charoen Nakhon 24 Alley, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was in the Thonburi area for dinner and was looking for a chim chim hotpot, so I went to this Isan restaurant. There were tables lined up in front of the restaurant, so I sat down at an open-air seat. Looking at the menu, I saw that the chim chim hotpot and beer sets were reasonably priced, and since there were three of us, we ordered the set menu plus a few mild dishes as individual items. Being an Isan restaurant, the menu had a wide selection of meat and vegetable dishes, all reasonably priced. The portions were generous and all delicious. The beer was also cheap, and even though we were feeling the heat outside, we ate our fill while enjoying relaxed conversation, and the bill came to just 350 baht per person, which was a bargain. That's a bargain. I think I'll cross the river again next time to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: toshio okamura (oka3)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small Northeastern Thai restaurant is located on Charoen Nakhon Road, slightly opposite the Siam Commercial Bank. Street parking is available. The menu includes grilled fish and hot pot.

The pork curry was tasty, and the boiled beef slices were slightly chewy but still delicious. The Korat-style papaya salad was a little too sweet, but you can ask for extra lime.

Overall, the food was good and the service was friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: JJ Garnet

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes delicious, but it's slow to come out. One staff member provided poor service; they would make a grumpy face when customers ordered anything extra, I don't know what they were angry about. I've eaten there many times because of the delicious food. The owner is lovely, but the staff needs some improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: run rnp

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend the Luang Prabang papaya salad; it's incredibly delicious! I've been eating it for two days straight. It's so spicy and flavorful. The fried dishes, like the fried pork neck and fried chicken, are also delicious and crispy, and the grilled beef is excellent too. I highly recommend it! I'm hooked! 🤤👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Timmy robot

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went there without hesitation after seeing the good reviews, but were ultimately very disappointed. After five days in Bangkok, our first dinner there was a real disappointment. The food wasn't tasty and the ingredients were of very average quality.

The place itself, however, is very nice, as is the atmosphere!
sample_reviews_en.author: Morgane F

sample_reviews_en.text: Fantastic fish with Thai herbs and amazing salsa type sauces. Great papaya salad - incredibly reasonable prices while my only  complaint - and there is nothing they can do- It’s on a very busy road so there’s a lot of road noise. My last night in Bangkok for now, but I will definitely come back here.
sample_reviews_en.author: evelyn brodie

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is so delicious! The owners are very attentive. The papaya salad is amazing, and the grilled tiger ribs are the best!!! The prices are great. We ate here in November, and the weather was perfect. It's cheap, delicious, and absolutely fantastic! 💗🤏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchaya Wongkitiya

sample_reviews_en.text: Classic Isaan restaurant in a classic Isaan-restaurant setting. Outside plastic chairs seating. Regular Isaan menu: grilled fish and meat as well as soups and son tum. Very nice family running the place. Prices are very fair and the place …
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

restaurants.name: krua isan ครัวอีสาน
restaurants.address:

2194 Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Solid food, but the overall experience feels somewhat opaque.

The restaurant Krua Isan (ครัวอีสาน) generally offers good food. The dishes were tasty, the portions were adequate, and the price-performance ratio seemed acceptable at first glance.

Nevertheless, the visit leaves a mixed impression. Several people actively promote dining there outside – however, it only becomes clear later that the "restaurant downstairs" and the actual restaurant upstairs are essentially one and the same establishment. The kitchen and staff are centrally organized, so you end up being served by the same people regardless of where you sit.

This setup feels somewhat artificial and can quickly give the impression that you're being deliberately steered in a certain direction. Although the food was good, you feel a bit confused afterward and not entirely transparent.

Overall, an acceptable restaurant with good food – however, one should be aware that the structure is somewhat confusing and does not quite live up to its outward appearance.
sample_reviews_th.author: Life is a journey

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow! This restaurant's food is a true rice killer! Every dish is incredibly delicious and goes perfectly with rice! 👨‍🍳✨ Today I ordered stir-fried water spinach, minced meat stir-fried tofu, and green curry. Impeccable, every dish was amazing. The spices were just right, incredibly fragrant, and I couldn't stop eating. It was so satisfying!

The prices are similar to those in Taiwan, making it excellent value for money! If you've finished exploring the Asiatique The Riverfront Night Market, definitely stop by for a meal – highly recommended!

The service is also fantastic. The staff are always ready to assist, attentive and friendly. Although there's no air conditioning, they provide fans, making it comfortable and not stuffy.

What touched me most was that it felt just like a Taiwanese stir-fry restaurant, allowing me to enjoy a familiar and delicious meal comfortably even in a foreign country. It's like a mini-Taiwanese haven in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: 張玲玲linlin分享世界

sample_reviews_en.text:
Krua Isan is a traditional Thai restaurant located in the lively Asiatique Riverfront market, offering the charm of classic Thai street food but in a comfortable sit-down setting. What truly stands out is the simplicity and warmth that reflect the authentic spirit of Bangkok’s local eateries.

As with most Thai places, you can easily request vegan versions of typical dishes, and the staff is incredibly kind and accommodating to any dietary needs. I tried the spicy Tom Yum soup with mushrooms, and it was excellent—flavorful, fragrant, and perfectly balanced.

Prices are very reasonable, staying true to the accessible nature of Thai cuisine. If you’re exploring Asiatique and want genuine, tasty Thai food with great service, Krua Isan is definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Davide De Luca

sample_reviews_en.text:
Looking for Thai Vegetarian Food in Asiatique? Highly Recommended Krua Isan Restaurant! The restaurant has Very Delicious Authentic Thai Vegetarian Food options. The restaurant is very packed at peak hours but don’t mind the wait, it is a must to eat there. Gravy Noodles (Ladna), Tomyum, Green Curry (KhaewWan), PadThai and other dishes are great.
Great services by the staffs, good recommendations of the food. Thai Culture environment 🎉
We always visit to eat here whenever at Asiatique.
#VegetarianPass #Vegetarian #ThaiFood #Bangkok #Asiatique
sample_reviews_en.author: VegetarianPass

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is good. In terms of service, there’s nothing to complain about. All staff were eager to help. The food on the other hand, was just okay. The shrimp cake patties weren’t too impressive. It came with a sweet marmalade type sauce but I wish it were it with something more acidic to cut the oily taste. The Galanga soup was a solid option, wish it came hotter. But it was creamy and sour and just really flavorful. The tomyum fried rice was just okay. The wings (not pictured) were crispy and came with a sweet chili type of sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fidelle Sapigao

sample_reviews_en.text: The food's flavors are geared towards foreigners, not authentically Thai. It's quite bland; if it's salty, it's very salty, like the stir-fried morning glory which was saltier than other dishes. I forgot to take pictures. There were very few staff members; they couldn't keep up with the service and didn't come when called. I understand there were a lot of customers, but adding more staff during holidays or weekends would be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: H I have H a p p y

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're a Korean looking for Phad Phung Curry, come here.

It's not on the menu, but if you ask them to mix soft crab and curry, they'll make it for you, and it's delicious.

I've failed at everything I've eaten since coming to Thailand, but I've finally found a good place.

They told me to add this to the menu because Koreans like it, so it might be added later.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김화평 (Pyeongkim)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had some time before the transgender show, so I stopped in for a light meal.
While many restaurants were expensive, I decided on this one as they had three options for around 150b.
Rice flour noodles? The soup was perfectly salted and delicious.
Also, I was a little wet from the rain, so they brought a fan to cool me down.

Thank you very much.
sample_reviews_en.author: かあ

restaurants.name: ข้าวต้มซุปเปอร์ท็อปลอยฟ้า
restaurants.address:

92 16, Racha Thewa, Bang Phli District, Samut Prakan 10540, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Midnight ข้าวต้ม - the taste is just okay but worth it in term of serving portion compare with the price.
sample_reviews_th.author: Ruj P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This kind of late-night rice porridge restaurant(called Khao Tom) is pretty common around Bangkok. Every place has its own unique vibe and signature dishes, and honestly, this is the real local Thai food experience.

If you’re a foreigner and want to really feel what everyday Thai people eat like, no touristy fluff. This is totally your kind of place.

How it works is simple: you order 1–2 side dishes to go with either steamed rice or rice porridge (your choice). The food is usually stir-fried dishes, fried stuff, spicy salads (yum), or soups. Every dish comes with some kind of meat or veggies depending on what you pick.

This particular place is really good. I’ve tried many of these restaurants kind in Bangkok, and this one’s one of my favorites. It’s not far from the airport either. The only downside is, if you’re not local, it might be a bit tricky to get there. No public transport nearby, and the menu’s all in Thai. So you might need a Thai friend to bring you along.

It’s open-air, casual, street-side vibes. You can park on the street, but if you go during busy hours, it might be hard to find parking, and food can take a little while to come out. Still 100% worth it though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donlawat Chitsing

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was delicious and affordable!
The stir-fried clams with chili paste were amazing!

The stir-fried shrimp with black pepper was the best – the shrimp was so fresh!

The crispy fried fish salad was the best; the chef fried the fish until crispy and then made a hot, crunchy salad – I loved it!

The fried chicken wings with fish sauce tasted like Korean fried chicken – no dipping sauce needed!

Now I have my favorite restaurant. Thank you for the delicious and cheap food!
sample_reviews_en.author: ปพัศร์ชิญา อมราพรภิรมย์

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a delicious restaurant with great-tasting food, although the stir-fried dishes are a little too sweet. The quality of the ingredients is excellent for the price. It's a place I'd rather keep to myself because I'm afraid it'll get too crowded! Parking is a gamble; you have to park on the side of the road, but I've always found a spot whenever I go.
sample_reviews_en.author: JH K

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant is located along the road near Suvarnabhumi Airport. There is no parking lot, so you have to park in front of the restaurant. 
The food is all delicious, the portions are just right, and the prices are reasonable. It's the best restaurant! If this restaurant was closer to home, I would definitely go there every day.
sample_reviews_en.author: YOLO

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is incredibly delicious! I was pleasantly surprised by how good it was. Recommended dishes include: Crispy Pork Belly with Chili and Salt (we ordered two plates!), Steamed Sea Bass with Soy Sauce (the fish wasn't overcooked, it was fresh and had a great aroma), and Tom Yum Soup (the flavor was spot-on).
sample_reviews_en.author: Atichart Somsupangsri

sample_reviews_en.text: This rice porridge restaurant serves delicious food at good prices, offering generous portions. Most of the dishes I've ordered have been great. Recommended dishes include the stir-fried pork intestines/crispy pork with chili and salt, stir-fried kale, and stir-fried cabbage.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kodchaporn P

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very delicious, spicy, and served quickly. The price is very good and the portions are worth it. I recommend the Tom Sup, stir-fried cockles with chili paste, and the spicy gourami salad. It's very delicious. I highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jann KS

restaurants.name: KEUM WAH Korea Dining
restaurants.address:

135/2 Premiere, Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is truly something else. This is the first time I’ve encountered such an impressively terrible Korean restaurant in Bangkok.

I thought they fermented the kimchi using some special method. Do they dry it out in the air for hours before serving it? It takes a talent just to serve such dry and tasteless kimchi to a customer. I wonder if they have some kind of philosophy of never throwing it away, even if it spoils, because they feel it is a waste to throw it away.

The egg on top of the cold noodles was also truly impressive. Seeing the fingernail marks clearly imprinted on the half-egg, it looks like it was "carved" with great care by hand in the kitchen. Is this a matter of hygiene or a realm of art? I am astonished by the confidence to serve it to a customer in this condition.

Also, when I ordered the cold noodles, I wondered if they were hiding the mustard and vinegar; I had to ask twice just to get a tiny bit. It seems like this place has no concept of basics.

It was an unforgettable experience in many ways. I will absolutely never go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Faii

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went during the soft opening and had the recommended menu that day. The Korean chef's delicious cooking is a highlight. It's a course meal, and the combination of appetizers and main dishes is excellent. They have private rooms, so it's a great place to visit for entertaining or when you're craving Korean food. They have many other menu items, not just the ones pictured. I would definitely visit again. This is a high-end Korean restaurant in Thonglor. The parking lot is spacious, and best of all, they have a dedicated room attendant. I think it's better to wait outside rather than in the room (it's always annoying while eating, haha).
My only regret is that I wish the rice came with soup. Koreans and Japanese people prefer the rice and soup combination. ^^
It's not 100% accurate, but since most of the main ingredients are imported from Korea, it was the perfect dinner for me, a Korean. If I visit Bangkok again for travel or business, I'll definitely come here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Min

sample_reviews_en.text: Among Korean restaurants in Thailand, Geumwa seems to offer the best value for money. I hesitated because of the expensive-looking exterior, but the clean interior and friendly staff left me feeling warm and at ease. In particular, the pork ribs and earthenware pot chicken offered flavors rarely found even in Korea. It was my first time receiving such attentive and heartfelt hospitality in a hot country. The taste comes from genuine care, not just treating customers as fleeting visitors at a tour restaurant! I highly recommend this place. Thank you so much,사장님 (owner). Please stay true to your original vision and continue to share the same delicious flavors for a long time. I will definitely visit you next time with my friends. I wish you great success and hope you spread the word about the taste of Korea.
sample_reviews_en.author: 황금빛 무지개희망

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Geumwa Korean Restaurant for a gathering. While I had high expectations, the experience was somewhat disappointing. While there was a variety of menu items, including jokbal (pig's feet), pajeon (green onion pancake), and naengmyeon (cold noodles), the overall taste fell short of what I'd expected from the reviews.

The jokbal was supposed to be boneless, but it actually tasted more like bossam (sliced ​​pork belly), which was a bit confusing. The pajeon (green onion pancake) was thick, making it difficult to appreciate the traditional crispy, savory flavor. The side dishes also felt somewhat lacking in flavor.

Personal tastes may vary, so please keep this in mind. I think more attention should be paid to the taste and quality.

The parking lot is spacious and convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: 홍종표

sample_reviews_en.text:
A few days ago, I was struggling to decide where to meet an important client, but I ended up visiting this place based on a friend's recommendation.

We tried various dishes, including braised pork ribs, beef brisket trio, and braised tofu. I have weak teeth, but I found the meat incredibly delicious as it came off the bone so easily. The tableware was luxurious, and I was especially satisfied with the friendly staff and the owner's thoughtful consideration. Since it was an important occasion, I couldn't take photos, but I plan to revisit with my family soon and write another review then.
sample_reviews_en.author: 바람따라구름따라

sample_reviews_en.text:
I liked that there was ample parking space and the restaurant had a quiet atmosphere!

There are private rooms available, making it great for a comfortable meal, and the owner is really friendly 😊

Overall, the food wasn't too salty or spicy, so it was easy to eat without feeling overwhelmed.

I especially recommend the pork rib kimchi stew, fish cutlet, and fried chicken gizzards 👍

We ordered all three together, and the combination went surprisingly well and was truly delicious!

It's a great place to visit when you want to enjoy a delicious meal in a quiet setting :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Orangii Som

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited because I heard it was new.

The seasoning was off overall.

It seems like the ingredients aren't rotating well because there aren't many customers.

The Jjolmyeon (spicy cold noodles) was delicious.

The squid jelly, bossam (boiled pork), meat stew, etc., were all below expectations.

Some of the side dishes had lost their flavor.

I would go somewhere else for the same price.

It looks gloomy because the remodeling of the old Japanese restaurant was unfinished, and

water was dripping from the air conditioner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chin Chin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Of all the Korean restaurants in Bangkok, this one is the most delicious, and the care you put into making it is evident.
I came here because I was craving kimchi jjigae, and even the naengmyeon (cold noodles) were delicious!
I'm planning to try the pork jjigae next time.
I thought the prices would be a bit steep because of the classy interior, but I was pleasantly surprised at how reasonable they were.
From the basic side dishes to the excellent private rooms, it was a truly satisfying meal.

200% likely to return.
sample_reviews_en.author: suzy kim

restaurants.name: Song Pinklao
restaurants.address:

127, ชั้น 4 11 ถนนสมเด็จพระปิ่นเกล้า Bangkok, Bangkok Noi, อ่างทอง 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Decades have passed... but the "legendary" taste remains unchanged 🦈🍲 Here at Song Pin Klao Shark Fin Soup, today we're serving up a feast of soup that you'll finish every last drop! The broth is simmered to perfection, fragrant and served in a piping hot clay pot. Followed by "Baked Goose Leg Noodles" with tender goose leg that melts in your mouth, and "Hong Kong Style Fried Noodles" with generous toppings and an amazing wok aroma.
If you miss the authentic taste of fine dining in the Pin Klao area, this is the only place to go. You won't be disappointed! ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: เฉลิมชัย ทัพพะจายะ

sample_reviews_en.text: Last place on earth to eat famous shark fin soup. My father in law's favorite, he would take his family here when they come to Bangkok. It's been open for decades. They serve three sizes of shark fin soup, made with REAL shark fin. Of course the higher priced has more shark fin. Ours costs 3000TB. As pictured, it's the entire shark fin. It's so delicious and well cooked. The other famous dish is whole crab claws with vermicelli.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mei Chi Siu

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a famous old restaurant in the Pinklao area. Every time I go, the food is delicious. The first dishes I always order are shark fin soup and roasted goose leg. The staff are friendly and provide excellent service.
They take great care of their customers. I'm impressed every time I visit. Delicious food and friendly service.
sample_reviews_en.author: PP Nokky

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's quite a distance to get there, but it's worth it!
The shark fin is incredibly delicious!
The other dishes are delicious too!
The portions are quite large, so the small size might be a good choice!
We went as a group of three men, and we were all full!
Thank you for the meal Ψ( 'ч' ☆)
sample_reviews_en.author: AKINORI UEDA (Nicholas)

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small, unassuming restaurant, but the food is delicious. Parking is available on the street.
The baked glass noodles are amazing when made by the owner; a unique and delicious taste.
The kale with sole fish is truly delicious.

Prices vary depending on the order, size, and weight.
sample_reviews_en.author: วันจันทร์ ที่ผ่านมา

sample_reviews_en.text: A straight 45 years in the business, this place is one of the Shark fin restaurant legends in Bangkok. The quality of all ingredients were high. Tasty soup like it used to be back in the old days. Great services. Parking along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thossaporn Poonwatana

sample_reviews_en.text: The shark fin and fish maw were of good quality, the shrimp was fresh, and the food tasted great. It's a small, old restaurant with friendly staff. Parking is available on the street. The prices are quite high.
sample_reviews_en.author: PPL Pro

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly recommended dishes are Fish Maw, Goose web, if you are a crab claw fan, too lazy to peel and dont mind the 500baht / pc price then its also good and fresh. Family owned and run for over 4 dacades
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Anotai (HolyTRINITY)

restaurants.name: ลาบอุบล เบียร์วุ้น
restaurants.address:

Phlabphla, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10312, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible. The papaya salad had only one crab leg in it, which was awful. The grilled pork neck was incredibly dry, tough, and bland, like it had been leftovers from the night before. Grilled pork neck should have some fat marbling; this dryness is unacceptable. I ordered "Tiger's Cry" (a type of grilled pork dish), and what did I get? Extremely spicy pork with chili peppers. This has happened 4-5 times with my previous orders (grilled pork neck or Tiger's Cry). What's wrong with the order taking process? I ordered two servings of sticky rice, and they gave me rice noodles with a hair in them. Cleanliness is zero. Improvements in order taking and cleanliness are crucial. Customers expect delicious food, and this is unacceptable. This is my first and last visit. Please improve. The vendor was unfriendly and unwelcoming. If you're going to sell food and work in this field, you need to be customer-centric and listen to feedback to improve. I'm giving it one star because the papaya salad tasted good, but I'm upset and disgusted by the single crab leg.
sample_reviews_en.author: Non Thananop

sample_reviews_en.text: My usual noodle shop was closed, so the delivery rider kindly bought from another shop. I know this shop because there are two in the alley. The one I usually go to was closed, and it was terrible. The noodle broth was so sour it overpowered all other flavors. It looked like it had been sitting there for days. I couldn't eat it at all. It was awful. I only ate two bites. What a waste of money. The vendor was also too pushy. She heated it up until it was piping hot, but it was still awful. I didn't dare eat it; it wasn't worth the doctor's visit or getting diarrhea. The worst ever.
sample_reviews_en.author: รัชนีกร เครือแก่นแก้ว

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this Northeastern Thai restaurant on an online food delivery app. I ordered Som Tum Sua (papaya salad with noodles) and Larb Moo (spicy minced pork salad). The cook is definitely from Northeastern Thailand. Even though I ordered it less spicy, it was still quite spicy. The Larb Moo was delicious, but the Som Tum was just okay.

Price: 4/5
Quality: 4/5
Taste: 4/5
Cleanliness: 5/5
Speed: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Location: 5/5
Value for money: 4/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapatr Chiraarreebutr

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I bought grilled fish, but it wasn't cooked through; it was burnt.
What a waste of money. And the dipping sauces, both types, were awful. Honestly, the taste was completely different from any seafood dipping sauce I've ever had; it smelled like raw, green vegetables. I really wanted to eat it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanyalak Butthanu

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. Comfortable seating, a spacious and airy restaurant.
2. Plenty of draft beer, so you can get drunk without realizing it.
3. Open 24 hours, always a friend.
4. Delicious dipping sauce, delicious minced pork salad, and delicious fried papaya salad. Also, delicious pork congee.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moss Wannarat

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered special pork blood soup, 2 rice, got special pork blood soup, 2 rice. The wrong thing was given. The spoon was not clean and had yellow stains. There was hair stuck in the rice. The rice also had a smell (not a bad smell), it was the smell of cooking water.
sample_reviews_en.author: ammy iii

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered grilled fish from the restaurant via Foodpanda. As soon as I opened the delivery, it was a burnt, overcooked fish – exactly as its name suggests. It looked like leftover fish from yesterday that had been microwaved. Terrible!
sample_reviews_en.author: woottipong krabtoon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was terrible, nothing tasted good. Even the omelet wasn't tasty. The restaurant was also very dirty, and the owner/vendor was extremely unfriendly. Never eating there again! Remove this restaurant from your list!!
sample_reviews_en.author: hi teto

restaurants.name: Fire Tiger by Seoulcial Club - EmQuartier
restaurants.address:

12 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered drinks through Shopee. When the drinks arrived, they didn't taste like they usually do. They were very bland, and the tapioca pearls were hard and clumped together. When I called to complain, the staff denied everything and blamed the delivery service, even though I'm a regular customer who orders through this channel and have never experienced this before. The taste has always been consistent with the delivery time. I feel that the staff at this branch don't listen to customer feedback at all.
(Additionally, when I called, the staff hung up without speaking to me.) I think this is unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rinsign SRoj

sample_reviews_en.text: I made a special trip to check out the popular bubble tea shop, Fire Tiger, and it was amazing! Their signature Thai milk tea is made to order, topped with a charcoal-roasted caramel sauce and a flame effect—it's incredibly impressive. The tiger-striped cup is gorgeous; every shot is photogenic. The milk tea is silky smooth and rich, with complex layers of flavor, and the combination of fresh milk and handmade pearls creates a unique texture. The staff are friendly and attentive; it's a double treat for both the taste buds and the eyes. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: zy Gan

sample_reviews_en.text: I just bought around 5 minutes ago. I am not sure if there are many customers using Grab Dine In vouchers before me. Because the staffs have to figure out and process quite a long time. While the barista had done my drink already. And I could not take my drink right away. I understand they have to follow the procedure, if not the cashier would be hard to end the shift later. Really appreciate that the staffs are helpful and I could have my drink finally. Much appreciated.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angel Journey

sample_reviews_en.text: The drinks here are absolutely delicious. Located on G floor at emquartier a short walk from the gourmet market. The service is quick and polite. There is plenty of parking at emquartier. You can park for free for 2 hours. I recommend getting the milk tea, it’s absolutely delicious. The seating spots are limited so keep that in mind if going with a bunch of people, usually people just take away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay

sample_reviews_en.text:
I should have looked it up before going...

They were seriously completely unfriendly.

It went beyond just being unfriendly; they threw the money at me and glared at me just because I changed my order once.

This is the most unpleasant experience I've had since coming to Thailand.

I absolutely never want to go there again.

The saying that Thai people are friendly is not true for this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김정화

sample_reviews_en.text: I would like the shop owner to pay more attention to and strictly enforce hygiene standards for staff when preparing drinks. The staff weren't wearing masks while preparing drinks, scooping cream and sugar, preparing to use the torch, and were constantly talking to their colleagues, even after closing the cup and handing it to the customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittipitch Watnoi

sample_reviews_en.text: The latest batch of Tiger Egg dessert was extremely chewy and hard. If we told the staff, they would do something, but if we did, they would make a displeased face, act annoyed, and speak incoherently. Seriously, a dessert costing over a hundred baht, and they're acting like this? I'd rather not eat it. So arrogant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tintinjuly

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today at 4:40 PM, I ordered two drinks. The staff were chatting loudly and were very slow.
It took 10 minutes just for a tea and an apple juice order, even though there were no other customers. ***(The owner should investigate this, as this isn't the first time someone has given a 1-star review.)***
sample_reviews_en.author: ทัพพ์วริศ วงศ์พานิช

restaurants.name: Kun Seafood
restaurants.address:

1669, 9 New Petchaburi Rd, บางกะปิ Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had dinner at Kun Seafood in Huai Khwang, and overall, it was an excellent experience. The food was absolutely amazing and delicious, with every dish showcasing the freshness and quality the restaurant is known for. The flavors were spot on, making it a memorable seafood feast.

However, the service was a bit slow, which I believe was due to how busy the restaurant was during my visit. It seems to be a popular spot, so the wait time might be longer during peak hours. Despite this, the incredible taste of the food made it worth the wait.

I would highly recommend this restaurant to seafood lovers, but it’s a good idea to visit during off-peak hours if you’re looking for quicker service.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChuLuxe Explorer

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. Food

I didn't have high expectations when I went, but when I ordered, it was delicious. I ordered the crab curry stir-fry and fried rice. The seasoning was just right, and the crab meat was spread all over the place, making it easy to eat.

2. Price
It looks like a high-end restaurant, but the prices are more reasonable than you'd expect.

3. Atmosphere
The interior is spacious and clean, making for a comfortable dining experience.

The restaurant has a very quiet atmosphere.

4. Overall Review
You can enjoy a variety of dishes at reasonable prices, so I highly recommend visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김자유

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here because of the good reviews and images. The photos on the reviews are old from a time gone by. The menu is nothing like the images show. They seem to call themselves Formosa now. I ordered what looked like a decent plate of pan fried shrimp from the menu. Received flame grilled dried out shrimp. I just left it. Don't waste your time here. Don't expect to recieve anything on that display board.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leon Botes

sample_reviews_en.text: The seafood is very fresh. A must-try dish is the salt-grilled shrimp. It gets a perfect 100 points. The staff are friendly and helpful. The food is delicious. You don't have to wait long. They give you a lot. The price is reasonable. Coming during the 50% off promotion is a great deal. The whole family can enjoy it. It's conveniently located near the MRT.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐวดี ทัดเทียม

sample_reviews_en.text:
The indoor and outdoor seating is spacious and excellent.
They also have a promotional menu, so you can enjoy discounted prices!
It was my first time trying Tom Yum Kung, and it was delicious!
You should definitely try the Poo Pad Pong Curry!
The other dishes are also delicious! 🦀🦀
It was so delicious that I even drank all the alcohol.
sample_reviews_en.author: 박다솜

sample_reviews_en.text:
Traffic jam, my daughter needed to use the restroom.
We stopped to ask to use the restroom. The staff member was very nice, polite, and friendly. Very impressed. We'll definitely come back next time. Today we had errands to run. The staff member was beautiful (LGBTQ).
Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: alin da

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was very delicious! The grilled fish had perfect texture, not too dry.
The crab fried rice was delicious, and the seafood was fresh.
The restaurant has parking, or it's close by MRT or car.

The food is tasty and fresh.
Very convenient to come to the store by MRT or car.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch Kong

sample_reviews_en.text: The dishes are very good-like, and the taste is not salty or bland. Everything is just right. Fried crab, Tom Yum Kung soup, stinky tofu, fried fish, hollow vegetables, etc. are all excellent. Strongly recommend! You must try it when you come to Bangkok!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Prince Line

restaurants.name: Local Thai Food Stall
restaurants.address:

PHP5+G67, 35 Suk Chai Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A truly local eatery.
I went there because other Japanese people had rated it highly as "delicious."
It seems to be popular for takeout too!
I ordered:
Chicken, coconut, and Thai herb soup (80 THB)
Shrimp Pad Thai (50 THB)
The Pad Thai was sweet, and the peanuts were a great accent.
The soup had a Tom Kha Gai-like flavor with added sourness, giving it a Sinigang-like feel.
Both were incredibly delicious!
The staff were very kind; they asked about my spice preference when I ordered and even managed to give me change.
I recommend this place to anyone who wants to experience local cuisine!
sample_reviews_en.author: 千鳥飯

sample_reviews_en.text:
Well, I'm not sure.

I'm not sure if it tastes good.

It's just that locals get takeout because the location is in an alley,

but I don't get takeout because it tastes good.

And it's just that there aren't any local restaurants nearby.

I don't understand why the reviews were so positive.

*The noodle dishes are heavily seasoned.

The ingredients seem old; they are soggy.

*Shrimp fried rice.

There is only one shrimp.

However, the ingredients seem fresh, and the onion texture is good.

The chef is an elderly woman.

Since the menu items are cheap, I gave it 2 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: geuni (강렬한)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I skipped the hotel breakfast and ate here every day lol. It’s a truly local eatery.

There were some Westerners, but there were also many locals on motorcycles getting takeout.

I think a Pad Thai was 40 baht.

It was much tastier than the places where I paid relatively more money!

If you are staying at a hotel nearby, make sure to stop by here!!

I also ordered Tom Yum Goong, and the shrimp just kept coming out endlessly, so you might end up getting sick of shrimp while you are in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김혜수

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very authentic and filled with local vibe. Food is very flavorful and iconic, the utensils are clean. The portion of food is comfortable which enables you to taste multiple dishes. tom yam is very sour(!) and strong, there were many chili flakes so be a bit careful. Pad Thai is on the sweet side which balances the spicy flavor of krapao so I recommend you order these two simultaneously.
sample_reviews_en.author: 小米

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible food experience.
Ordered garlic beef stir fry, and the lady brings chicken. I asked her why she brought chicken when I specifically ordered beef, she shrugs it off.
The food itself was like reheated leftovers. And scraps, too. They had the unmitigated gall to charge full price, too.
Wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mina Mita

sample_reviews_en.text:
Local restaurants like this must be delicious no matter what. This is because hygiene is a concern and the portions are small. Unless the taste is outstanding, the value for money is low compared to the food quantity and the environment.

This place is not very tasty and is cheap. Therefore, the value for money is low.
sample_reviews_en.author: H S

sample_reviews_en.text: This little shop I passed by had amazing fried rice! The Tom Yum soup was all straw mushrooms… I've been ripped off so many times in the mall these past few days~ But the food was delicious. If you like the local atmosphere, you should definitely try it! Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shao-han Xu (Shao-Han)

sample_reviews_en.text: Fresh-tasting, friendly staff, perfect hole-in-the-wall feel. I had the fried noodles with chicken. The only downside is the portion size and amount of meat, but for the price, it’s hard to complain. You may just need two dishes per person
sample_reviews_en.author: Dipesh Solanky

restaurants.name: White Wood Green Cafe (Brunch & Coffee)
restaurants.address:

45 Yen Akat Rd, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is very beautiful, but the food taste is average, nothing amazing. It feels more like a cafe for spa patients than a place to hang out with friends. The food prices are quite high compared to the portion sizes. The portions don't feel worth the money. The food presentation is also a bit disappointing. I think if they're selling brunch, they should make it more worthwhile. I ordered an egg & toast for 190 THB with bacon for 90 THB, but only got one small piece of bacon. I was a little disappointed. Could the restaurant please consider improving their brunch offerings? I want the food to feel worth the price considering the beautiful setting. The wait for food was a bit long, but not excessively so. Overall, I give it 3 stars. If I have the chance, I'll try their spa services.

P.S. For those reading this review, you might think the prices are too high, but honestly, I can afford it. I've had brunch elsewhere that was more or at the same price and felt much better value.
sample_reviews_en.author: unna smpyhappy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went for a sunday brunch around 11 am.

We felt like our dishes were prepared quite slower than we would like to. I would expect two small surdough orders to be prepared and delivered at the same time, but they arrived separately with considersble time gap in between.

The surdough toasts we ordered were fine, altough definitely on the thinner side.

After our main meal we ordered pancakes, which took what felt like an eternity to be delivered.

We enjoyed our food, but I wouldn't recommend this place or come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bruno Húska

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a premium spa with a small cafe.

The spa appointments are very long, so reservations are necessary. The cafe is small and cute, with a diverse menu including brunch and pancakes, giving it a Japanese feel.

Parking is available for about 10 cars, a bit cramped.

The service is excellent, befitting a premium spa.
sample_reviews_en.author: 7ackie Srichompan

sample_reviews_en.text: A great way to start a good Sunday with a nice shop and a quiet atmosphere. The food is delicious, and the coconut coffee has a unique taste. The only downside is that there's a bit of a wait for the food, but it's worth the wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shoji Kubo

sample_reviews_en.text: Really love this place! The food is super tasty, coffee is great, and the vibe is really comfy. The owner and staff are super nice and thoughtful, and the service makes you feel very well taken care of.
sample_reviews_en.author: Erin Y

sample_reviews_en.text: Great little cafe hidden behind the spa and wellness centre, pop in for a coffee, read a book, or simply take out your laptop for some relaxed vibes and good food while getting in a little work.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leroy Saunders

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recharge and relax in a warm, vacation-like atmosphere at "White Wood Green Cafe"! 🏡✨
White Wood Green Cafe is a lovely and peaceful brunch café located in Soi Yen …
sample_reviews_en.author: loca chill

sample_reviews_en.text: The decor is fresh and the environment is comfortable, but the drinks don't taste very good, although the pancakes are okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ho Yan yan

restaurants.name: 海味蒸汽海鲜(HW Seafood )ตำทะเลนัว
restaurants.address:

355 8 Sukhumvit Pattaya 51 Aly, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This Chinese restaurant has very fresh seafood 🦞 with a wide variety, though sometimes the selection is limited, so reservations are recommended. They also sell milk tea outside, which is quite good (30 pesos). Shrimp costs 500-600 pesos, and shellfish ranges from 200-500 pesos. The prices are reasonable, and most importantly, the food is delicious. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Romila

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍤 Featured Dishes Highlights:

* Extra-large Mantis Shrimp: Salt and pepper or steamed, incredibly fresh!

* Thai-style Raw Marinated Shrimp: Authentic Thai flavor, spicy and refreshing!

* Curry Crab: Rich and flavorful, with an unforgettable aftertaste.
sample_reviews_en.author: kefei li

sample_reviews_en.text: The price was indeed quite high, but the seafood was incredibly fresh. Freshness is paramount for steamed seafood, and it came with traditional Chinese sauces. The owner was very kind and even acted as a part-time tour guide.
sample_reviews_en.author: 贺云飞

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great way to enjoy fresh seafood. The bottom of the pot is for cooking porridge, so the porridge underneath will be cooked after the seafood is steamed.
sample_reviews_en.author: 潘杰

sample_reviews_en.text:
Half of everything we wanted to order was unavailable.

Very impersonal, amateurish service. And all of that way, way too expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hans B

sample_reviews_en.text: The seafood is fresh and delicious, slightly more expensive than a typical seafood market. The garlic prawns were especially good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Po Po

sample_reviews_en.text: The seafood was incredibly fresh, retaining its natural flavor, and the price was excellent! I'll definitely come back again 🌹
sample_reviews_en.author: Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is fresh and delicious, there are private rooms, the staff provides attentive service, and the owner is kind.
sample_reviews_en.author: ยุพาวดี พุ่มจันทร์

restaurants.name: Prime Restaurant
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 7, โรงแรม สกายวิว, 12 Sukhumvit 24 Alley, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The management in the kitchen is very bad. My order is lost and the food is very slow. The menu in Thai is Grilled River Prawn (กุ้งแม่น้ำย่าง) but look what did I get.
sample_reviews_th.author: wachi eksat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Such a ripoff for the 990baht that was paid for this 'ala carte' buffet.
Portions were ridiculously small, like a teaspoon of guacamole for each serving, thus you had to order many portions of the same dish if you want to be remotely satiated.
The service was frustratingly slow, even though the whole resturant had 3 tables. And we had to wait 20 mins for our order to arrive, given there is a 90 minute dining period,  its one of the most annoying aspect to this meal.
Even after reminding the waiters repeatedly that we were waiting for our next order, we were told to "please wait" even though the whole restaurant was practically empty. At the end we were only full from frustration after leaving the restaurant.
I was a guest staying at the skyview hotel and I would have rather order from GRAB and have a decent meal for 990B per pax than this waste of time and ripoff.
I can't understand all the rave reviews posted others but I would advise to avoid at all costs! Even if it was free i wouldn't dine here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ting

sample_reviews_en.text:
