Prime Restaurant is the all day dining at Sky View Hotel. Currently there is a  buffet menu for dinner in which you can choose an assortment of appetizer and main course of thai and western dishes.  As opposed to large portions the food came out in beautiful minisized dishes which was better than expected. Taste is considerably good, and we enjoyed many of the dishes. Slight issue is that dishes came in the order they are finished so the dining order could be a little interesting. One of our appetizers that we ordered at the start came at the end.

Slight issue with the buffet offering is that there were no dessert options in the buffet, which is a shame. We ended up ordering some cake and drinks ala carte in addition to round out the meal.

If you are looking for a good ala carte styled buffet with a wide range of western and Thai dishes at a reasonable price point, Prime should cover your needs well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pisal S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I bought a deal on the Hungry Hub app for a fine dining buffet, costing around 890 baht per person for 90 minutes. The menu varies depending on the time of day, and it includes one soft drink per person.

The food selection was quite diverse. Even if you don't eat pork, there were other beef options. The food tasted good; nothing was bad. The food came out quickly, maybe because I went on a weekday.

I especially liked the wagyu sirloin steak; the meat wasn't tough and the sauce was delicious. I ate four pieces and was full!😅 The first dish took a little longer, but subsequent dishes came out quickly.

The staff provided good service, and they offer cakes for special occasions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutkamol U.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thank you, Kwang, for taking such good care of me throughout my stay here. The service was truly exceptional, very attentive, professional, and welcoming from start to finish.

The location and atmosphere are absolutely beautiful and definitely one of the highlights of the experience. The overall ambience, view, and hospitality made every morning very enjoyable.

The food was good and well presented, although for me personally it didn’t fully reach the same level as the service and the setting. Still, I had a very pleasant experience overall and would recommend coming here for the atmosphere and outstanding hospitality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Veli Mutu

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an all-you-can-eat buffet booked through Hungry Hub. You can choose your items freely, and the menu changes frequently, though I'm not sure how often. I've eaten here 4-5 times already. Some items have disappeared, while others have been added. However, lately, the taste seems inconsistent. The pasta is undercooked, and things like that have happened. When I mentioned this to the staff, they asked me to write a comment, but even on my last visit, it seemed like they hadn't resolved the issue. I'm hesitant to go again now. I hope they improve soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jubilee Joob

sample_reviews_en.text:
We tried the hungryhub party package for 3 cost about 1500 baht in total. For this you get to choose seven dishes from the extensive menu. It was a variety of unique dishes from Thai Chinese Japanese to Italian. The pork belly miso chili sauce, Green tea soba krapao sauce steak, beef boat noodle with bok choy and crispy spare rib mala sauce are all worth a try. Don't try the scallop baked spinach that was the only one dish we did not like.
The location is also prime just next-door to Emporium shopping center where we went to get dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vasin At-Bangkok

sample_reviews_en.text: Most of the dishes were very tasty and the presentation is very fancy, (remove that thing that is supposed to be a taco and its disgusting), the service was very dedicated and they had a dj. We got that great deal of the menu with drinks included and it was a great price in the end. My favourite dish was that pastry with baked pork, real xmas flavour. Nachos were super good too. I don’t understand why they need to decorate the plates with those white fried things, just a waste of food in a world where many people are hungry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Salvador Cornelio Marí

restaurants.name: Tee Yentafo
restaurants.address:

392 ซอย อมร Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The seller seemed unwilling to sell. When I asked to exchange my order, they made a face and said, "We're doing it!!" with a very displeased expression. Then the server served the wrong item. I thought maybe they misunderstood my order, but it turned out they served it to the wrong table. Instead of asking me anything, they just stood there arguing about the mistake. They didn't even bother to ask. They just said, "It's okay, wait a minute!!" What kind of behavior is that? I was very disappointed. Was it because I wasn't wearing makeup? I was just going out for a meal, so I wasn't dressed up. Is that their reason for acting like this? I'm extremely disappointed with this branch. One time is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ladda Santa

sample_reviews_en.text: Tee Yentafo is a legendary shop near Nang Linchi Market, known for its soft and smooth fish balls. Their dry yentafo (noodle soup) is a highlight. They offer a variety of noodle options: wide noodles, thin noodles, vermicelli, egg noodles, glass noodles, and wonton noodles, along with fish balls, shrimp balls, rugby-shaped fish balls, fish cakes, and even fish slices sold by the portion. It's delicious! The shop is open every day except Sunday, from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Guaranteed delicious by Vittyhello.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vitty Hello (Vitty)

sample_reviews_en.text: This Yentafo noodle restaurant is quite nice. The taste is quite good, and there’s no need to add more seasoning. I recommend trying the Yum Yentafo as it has a better taste than the regular Yentafo. However, the fish balls were just okay; they didn’t taste homemade. They provide self-service beverages for free, and the food was served quite quickly. The atmosphere is average; the space is small and there are no parking lots, but you can park at the paid parking lots across the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: NNchan

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves various types of noodles: thin noodles, thick noodles, egg noodles, glass noodles, and also Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup). The noodles taste good, and it's quite popular with customers. Parking is convenient, and it's a reliable place where many friends and family come to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Weera Sinsmutra

sample_reviews_en.text: Yes, is it the one about twenty meters from the intersection on the left? If so, the fish balls, fried fish balls are amazing, the fish cake is amazing, the garlic is a little burnt and slightly bitter, but the fish balls are amazing, salty. If you like fish balls, you have to come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tui Dusadee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've only been there twice, but I really like the noodles here.
The soup is very flavorful, the fish balls are delicious, and all the toppings are delicious. The noodles are chewy and just the right amount of chewy.
I'll definitely visit again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภัทราพร สุขขำ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yen Ta Fo restaurant. The Yen Ta Fo flavor is rich and delicious.
The dry noodles are especially delicious. The noodles are so good, no need to add any seasoning.
The dry wontons are okay.
Tissues are provided, but there's no parking.
Overall, highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: gummo s.

sample_reviews_en.text: Hidden gem! This restaurant is packed with locals during lunch hour and busy with take-out orders. (This is how you know it's legit!) Their broth is flavourful and doesn't have any MSG. Their fish balls are all home made and very bouncy. Made my day!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kendra

restaurants.name: Shabu Nangnai
restaurants.address:

PFWP+366, Wat Arun, Bangkok Yai, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just had an incredible meal at this shabu buffet restaurant and I can’t stop raving about it! For only 329 THB, you get all-you-can-eat access to the entire menu — honestly such an unbelievable value.

The food is fresh, clean, and clearly made with care. I order 2 dishes of 3 type beef and seafood and it came out on a massive plate!
.
Everything was so fresh, especially the seafood. The jellyfish was perfectly tender — not tough at all and not overly salty. I genuinely loved every single dish I tried.
.
Service was warm and attentive, and they even give free plain water. Parking is a bit limited (small space within the premises), but it’s fine. I visited on a Sunday evening and there was no queue at all, though I’d still recommend calling ahead to be safe.
.
This is the kind of place where you get excellent quality and fantastic service at a price that’s hard to beat. I’m definitely coming back again soon, and I have a feeling this restaurant is going to be really popular very quickly! 🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanokchan Aun

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there several times and always ask for refills of the sesame sauce, but it's usually sold out. I usually go alone, and I only ask for refills 2-3 times, just 2-3 small bowls of dipping sauce. It feels like they're really stingy with the sauce. When I ask for a third refill, they always say they're out, but then they give sesame sauce to other tables who ask for it. It's really disappointing; I was really looking forward to eating the meat with the sesame sauce, but it was all gone. It was so frustrating, especially since it wasn't even that busy when I went. Every time I went, it was sold out. I'm giving up on going there. I've found a new restaurant now that I can enjoy without them. Anyone who wants to eat it can go ahead, but I'm not going anymore. Keep the sauce to yourself, you're so stingy! 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Northstar Damoos

sample_reviews_en.text: I hope this Shabu Nang Nai branch reads this so they can improve, because I want to return. The service was very good, but the non-pork/beef items that were frozen and sliced ​​were not fresh at all. The liver was starting to smell bad, and the meatballs were starting to taste sour. Even on a Sunday, when they should be preparing for customers on a holiday, the food was almost spoiled and inedible. The shrimp and squid were okay. The jellyfish was very salty and needed to be soaked in water longer. The dipping sauces were not tasty; they were too thick, and the pongsu sauce was too sour. It seems like they haven't met the standards. It's a shame, I like the location.
sample_reviews_en.author: Promporn Kaewdamha

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste was mediocre, not worth the hype. The price wasn't expensive, but there are better value restaurants out there.

What was most frustrating was ordering the "Tiger's Cry" beef (a type of beef brisket). It was tough, chewy, and smelled bad. When I asked, they said it was the shoulder cut because the Tiger's Cry was too tough. Then they changed it on the menu. I sent it back to be changed to the chuck steak, but they kept bringing the same dish back and saying it was chuck steak. I had to show them the chuck steak I ordered earlier.

What is honesty in this?
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaipol Takpradit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Popular shabu-shabu, good value at 329 baht (with meat). Food is served quickly and in generous portions; almost no wait. I like that the shrimp are already peeled, leaving only the tails.

Suggestions for improvement:
- The mala soup has a very weak aroma and flavor. Lately, with more ingredients added, the mala aroma has disappeared (even after adding extra seasonings, it's still too mild).
- The food and dipping sauces are a little too sweet.
- I've eaten here several times, and the marbling and taste of the meat have changed, especially the shoulder blade.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasan Chanto

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a buffet, priced at 279 baht, which isn't expensive. The dipping sauces tasted good, but... the pork was terrible! The shabu-shabu pork was sliced ​​too thick, both the belly and the neck. My girlfriend and I both agreed that the pork was incredibly tough. This type of slice is more suitable for grilling. Because the pork was tough, everything else was bad. We forced ourselves to eat it all.
I've been to the Charoen Rat branch twice, and the pork wasn't this tough then. I'm not going back there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: nunduang srathongkhwaen

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and they kept refilling it. The staff were welcoming. The prices listed were all-inclusive, no hidden charges. We ordered the most expensive set, 426 baht, which included drinks for two people, totaling 852 baht. This set included meat, sushi, and dessert, all served to your table. You could choose from three types of soup. The seating was a bit cramped. Parking at the mall was convenient, 20 baht for 4 hours. A great place to eat!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eakachin Techapongkul

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a comfortable place to sit and eat. The young man serves with intention. He's a giver and a part of the business owner. It's appropriate to let the employees of other restaurants come and see the work. The food is delicious, full and satisfying. The price is affordable and makes your belly full. I recommend this restaurant. It's delicious. Come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลงพุง กับลุงพงษ์

restaurants.name: ไขว่ เย็นตาโฟแมงกระพรุน สาขา2
restaurants.address:

62 ต, 260 Thepprasit Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This roadside restaurant, #Khai, serves delicious food, especially their jellyfish yentafo (Thai noodle soup) and spicy pickled squid. No need to add any extra seasoning! #PleaseTasteBeforeAddingSeasoning Otherwise, you'll be seriously overwhelmed. They also have fish noodles, jellyfish rice porridge, and other dishes at affordable prices. Stop by and try it before heading to the beach! 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Phairot Ruenroeng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Famous fish ball noodle soup from Nakhon Sawan, located on Sukhumvit Road.
50 baht per bowl. The government's co-payment scheme is accepted. The thin noodles aren't very soft. The Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup) contains jellyfish and no blood (blood).
sample_reviews_en.author: Ich reise gerne

sample_reviews_en.text: The Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) tasted good, and the blanched fish with dipping sauce was excellent! This meal cost 310 baht for two servings of Yen Ta Fo, mixed blanched fish with dipping sauce, and two drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Candy Ing

sample_reviews_en.text: The Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) tastes good; it's flavorful. It's the same branch as the one in Nakhon Sawan, but the one in Nakhon Sawan had fewer ingredients than this one. The price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Tor

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is a bit high, but understandable because of the jellyfish. The vinegar, chili, and soybean paste sauce is delicious. The noodles were a little too chewy, like they were cooked too quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chavakorn Samthong

sample_reviews_en.text: They moved to a new location in a shophouse on the main road, just before Soi Na Jomtien 1, a little further from their old location...but the food is just as delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Neeranat Wongsakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish ball noodle soup was still not tasty even after all the ingredients were used up. Sorry for complaining, but the Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup) was acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: kawinchon laophiophan

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍜Every time I go to Pattaya, I have to make time to eat at this restaurant.
Personally, I love the flavor...it's good and delicious, just the way I like it 😋👍💯
sample_reviews_en.author: Choki Choki

restaurants.name: แซ่บหัวมุม
restaurants.address:

1577 Lat Phrao 94 Alley, Phlabphla, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has convenient parking and looks clean, but the food is expensive compared to what you get.
Stir-fried water spinach with 4 small shrimp, soggy, 130 baht.
Pork omelet rice, very basic, 120 baht. Even upscale restaurants charge less and taste much better.
In short, not recommended. One visit is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: bigery1984

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great and the food is delicious. I really liked it. The price is considered moderate, not too expensive. If you're tired of ordinary à la carte food, you should try this restaurant. The staff are also lovely and provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawin Arun

sample_reviews_en.text: If anyone is okay with sitting and eating in an air-conditioned restaurant with people who smoke e-cigarettes, then go ahead. But it should really be a bar if they're going to let people smoke e-cigarettes freely like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gunparwitt Phuwadolwisid

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean and has parking. The service is good. The plates and cutlery are very clean, wrapped in plastic. The food is decent, and they have a variety of dishes; I'll come back to try other menu items.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate_aum Temi

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean and offers a variety of food. Today I ordered papaya salad, spicy soup, and glass noodle salad; they were a bit too sour. The fried chicken was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Penluck Ruangrabeab

sample_reviews_en.text: The waterfall noodle soup wasn't very tasty. It had an overpowering spice smell that made it unpleasant. The price didn't seem reasonable considering the portion size.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat Mainarak

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The Northern-style stir-fried larb and the stir-fried noodles with water spinach were especially tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chompunuch Winurat

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean, the beer is cold, the food is delicious, and the prices are good. This is the place to dine!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanakorn thitiratsanont

restaurants.name: ข้าวมันไก่ ลิ่มซังท่าพระ
restaurants.address:

385 18 Ban Chang Lo Alley, Khwaeng Ban Chang Lo, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lim Sang Tha Phra Chicken Rice
This chicken rice shop serves huge portions. This dish is only 50 baht.
The chicken was a little dry; it would be much better if it were crispier, as it seems to use free-range chicken, which is a bit tough. The boiled liver was dry, like the old-fashioned version; it would be better if it were softer.
The rice was fluffy, with separate grains, fragrant with garlic, and mildly salty.
The soup was served in a very large bowl, with plenty of chicken bones.
Self-service drinking water is available.
The shop is located on the main road and easy to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Generous portions, but not clean.
All staff are Burmese.
I'm a regular customer, but lately the hygiene has deteriorated.
1. Once, the dipping sauce started to smell, and the chicken smelled bad.
2. I found plastic in the chicken. The staff didn't apologize, saying it might be a leaf. I told them it was plastic, and she asked if I wanted a different plate.
Another incident I can't remember.
I eat at this restaurant regularly, but the longer I eat there, the less hygienic it becomes.
*There will be no next time. Very disappointed.*
sample_reviews_en.author: Watcharat

sample_reviews_en.text: Unlimited chicken broth. Regular Hainanese chicken rice is 50 baht, special is 60 baht. Generous portions of rice and tender chicken. The chicken is delicious, but the rice lacks flavor. I'm deducting one star for that. Open 24 hours. Plenty of dipping sauces available, along with galangal and fresh chilies. Delicious taste. Cash only, no transfers. The chicken is so delicious and tender, you'll want a second plate!
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisakan Watchakapong

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered chicken rice with thigh meat around 8 PM, but the staff said it was sold out and acted sullen and uncaring (the female staff member, likely a foreigner). In reality, there were plenty of cooked chickens in the pot, 4-5 of them. I usually eat here regularly, but this time I felt very disappointed. Please, owner, train your staff better.
sample_reviews_en.author: ROOSTER'

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on Isaraphap Road, towards the train station, on the left-hand side. The chicken was old and tough; they didn't flatten the meat, so it was even tougher. But the rice and dipping sauce were delicious as usual. I've eaten at the Don Mueang branch, on the way to Wat Nawong, and their chicken was tender and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sriyupa Boonlon

sample_reviews_en.text: The 60 baht special was a huge portion but not tasty. I used to eat at the original Tha Phra branch many years ago and it was delicious, but this time the rice and chicken were dry and difficult to swallow. I could eat it, but it wasn't as good as the hype suggested. I could only eat half a plate and couldn't finish it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robba W¡ll¡amS

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken rice portion is very generous. Regular is 50 baht, special is 60 baht. Even the regular portion is quite large. The soup is delicious and flavorful. The shop only serves boiled chicken rice; nothing else is available. You can park on the side of the road, but be careful not to get your car towed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chet Pro

sample_reviews_en.text: The female employee in the other review photos is a bit overweight and has an unfriendly expression. When I ordered food, she just looked at me and went back to preparing it without speaking. Plus, it was dirty; I saw a pile of chicken, about 10 or more, on the floor used for washing, behind the ice station.
sample_reviews_en.author: tmV1 v1

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวป้าชิต (ก๋วยเตี๋ยวป่าช้า)
restaurants.address:

168 Charan Sanitwong 4, Wat Tha Phra, Bangkok Yai, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Aunt Chid's noodle shop is open on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays, from noon to evening. It's located inside Wat Tha Phra temple. The noodles are delicious and inexpensive. If you can't find it, ask a motorcycle taxi driver – you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Podtawon Chinnaswasd

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is really good and the portions are generous. They have pork, chicken, and beef. However, there's limited parking for motorcycles in front of the shop. Cars can park in the parking lot across from the pavilion and walk a short distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตระการ ศรีผาวงศ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, perfect for night owls!
But it's a good idea to apply mosquito repellent before going to the restaurant. The mosquitoes are aggressive, and you might not enjoy your noodles if you're busy swatting them! 555
sample_reviews_en.author: สุรัชชัย เจิมภู่

sample_reviews_en.text:
Open late so I eat here once in a while.
The beef is tender but there is too much meat.
But the quantity is large and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rangsiman Ifeelgood

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is no longer open at night.
We only sell during the day on Saturdays and Sundays from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: ไปเรื่อยๆ มาเรื่อยๆ

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely fantastic! The taste, portion size, and the friendliness were top-notch. The aunties were lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: SIN_NER

sample_reviews_en.text: I would like to express my condolences on the passing of Pachit. I just heard the news on the internet.
sample_reviews_en.author: เสริมไกร ตันบูรณาok (Housexchickenxteak)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd like to ask if the shop is still open for business...?
The last review I saw was from last year.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aun Buddha

restaurants.name: BENDITO (MEXICAN ROOFTOP RESTAURANT)
restaurants.address:

55 Rimthangrotfaisaipaknam Road, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

restaurants.name: Zen Sensod
restaurants.address:

9, 1 Ekkamai 8 Alley, Khlong Tan, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Japanese-style fresh rice noodle shop in Ekkamai
🎏 IZAKAYA: Cozy, homey atmosphere.
Enjoy rice noodles during the day and grill skewers at night while sipping beer 🍻
This shop combines Thai and Japanese cuisine in one place!

One shop…but two modes! Enjoy fresh, Japanese-style rice noodles during the day, and transform into a chill izakaya-style yakiniku (Japanese BBQ) at night!
Wow…it has it all?! 🍜🍢🍺”

The atmosphere is cozy and homey…but the menu is the ultimate fusion.
The noodles are freshly made every day,
uniquely chewy and springy!
They pair perfectly with the Thai-style broth.

They have an izakaya, a traditional Thai-style BBQ grill 🍢🍻
Enjoy delicious rice noodles during the day, and then continue with fragrant charcoal-grilled izakaya-style BBQ in the evening. It's a perfect Thai-Japanese fusion experience! A truly wonderful combination!
Along with cold beer, everything from food and grilled items to drinks is included!
sample_reviews_en.author: นอน ว่างๆ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves fusion-style fresh rice noodles, using a Chiang Mai recipe with an authentic Thai flavor – fragrant and rich. Besides rice noodles, they also offer Nam Ngiao (Northern Thai noodle soup), grilled dishes, and various salads – many worth trying!

Must-try dishes include:
• Rice noodles with coconut milk hamburger curry, clam curry, and mackerel curry. The curry sauces are delicious, fragrant, and intensely flavorful. They pair perfectly with the side dishes.
• A5 BBQ Roller. This grilled dish is also not to be missed.
It's incredibly delicious, grilled over charcoal for a wonderful aroma – no dipping sauce needed!
• Grilled Prawns. The prawns are fresh and firm.
• Sous Vide Beef Tongue. A must-try for beef lovers – incredibly tender and bouncy.
• Vietnamese Rice Paper Stuffed with Pork and Corn. The pork and corn filling is delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: aom anong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place goes far beyond the typical Thai rice noodle shop; they serve fusion Thai rice noodles in a Japanese style.

The restaurant is a two-story white wooden house, with both outdoor and indoor seating decorated in a Japanese style, offering several different zones.

The rice noodle menu is incredibly diverse and creative, and the plating is so appealing it's perfect for photos.
✨Recommended dishes: The first in Thailand to use Wagyu beef in their hamburger curry sauce – tender and fragrant – mixed with a perfectly balanced curry sauce; authentic Chiang Mai-style Northern Thai curry noodles; and Northern Thai style larb fried rice, best enjoyed mixed with shallots and a squeeze of lime.

🅿️ Parking: Available in front of the restaurant / in the alley / near Big C Ekkamai.
sample_reviews_en.author: เอไปเจอนี่มา

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant just opened at the end of last month, and I visited around 12 PM. The food took quite a while to arrive, almost 30 minutes. I noticed a steady stream of customers, so the delay might be due to the restaurant still adjusting its workflow.

The ambiance was decent, though it felt a bit warm inside. Better ventilation or air conditioning would definitely improve the dining experience.

The food presentation was lovely – beautifully plated and very photogenic. The taste was okay, not exceptional, but acceptable for a newly opened place.

(Note: The last line about the restaurant is a separate comment and not directly related to the restaurant description.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanisa M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Zen Sensod

📍 Zen Sensod – Ekkamai 8
Fresh Thai rice noodles & charcoal-grilled dishes in a charming Japanese house setting 🍜🔥 This is a premium and very attractive Thai rice noodle restaurant.
The rice noodle recipe is based on traditional Thai cuisine, but served in a Japanese style ✨

The restaurant is decorated in a warm, wooden tone, reminiscent of a Japanese house. There's an outdoor area where you can watch the chefs grill food over charcoal – a truly wonderful experience 🪵

The restaurant offers a welcome drink to start your meal. They really pay attention to detail from the very first sip 💛
sample_reviews_en.author: Eatwitht

sample_reviews_en.text:
•Premium Quality in Every Dish: We select only the finest ingredients to ensure every bite is fresh and perfectly seasoned.

•Must-Try Specials: Try our freshly made rice noodles, prepared daily – fragrant, soft, and chewy – unlike any other! Or indulge in a feast of fresh seafood grilled over a traditional charcoal grill, a rare find for its authentic flavor. 🦐🔥

•Relaxed Atmosphere: Whether you come alone, with friends, or with family, enjoy a delicious meal in a warm and friendly atmosphere.

•Convenient Location: The restaurant is located in Ekkamai Soi 8, very easy to find!
sample_reviews_en.author: OK CHAK BAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
I loved it! The rice noodles with curry sauce were delicious. They make every dish perfectly 💖 The curry is fragrant and the flavor is rich 😋 The ingredients are fresh, high-quality, and large. / The crab salad was amazing! The seafood dipping sauce is fantastic. / They have a perfect blend of Thai and Japanese cuisine. The grilled beef tongue was incredibly tender – a must-try ✨ The grilled dishes are prepared using a Japanese grilling method, keeping the meat moist.

🚗 The restaurant has parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: mamaw nutcha

sample_reviews_en.text: There are very few restaurants I'd give 5 stars to for food, service, and atmosphere, but this one is truly exceptional (perfect for me personally). From the moment you walk in, the restaurant feels spacious and inviting. The menu offers a diverse selection of dishes, including noodles, rice, and wine. The food tastes excellent, and the prices are moderate—not too expensive, but not cheap either. The price is reasonable considering the taste of the food and the ambiance.
sample_reviews_en.author: way sa ga

restaurants.name: ข้าวแกงป้าติ๋ม พัทยากลางสาย3(ราดข้าว1อย่าง40บาท2อย่าง50))
restaurants.address:

60 Central Pattaya Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Food is well priced, fresh and delicious."

sample_reviews_th.text:
Khao rat Gaeng (rice curry)

Aunt Tim's Curry Rice Pattaya Sai 3

2 kinds of dishes over rice, 50 baht (could be 60 for some choices)
Got others options, NaamPrik 👍🏻, some desserts too.

Good taste
Clean food
Cheap price
Open early
Kind staff

It’s a popular place, customers comes to take away or to eat here, many delivery drivers too.

I made it my breakfast/lunch place, and always find a table to sit.

ถูกและดี
อร่อยด้วย

(When it’s closed, a similar restaurant is located on the other side of the road.)
sample_reviews_th.author: Jérôme • เจโรม

sample_reviews_th.text:
Advantages of my favorite cheap eatery:
1. A wide variety of delicious dishes.
2. You can specify the amount of rice.
3. It's cheap (large rice and two side dishes: around ฿50)
4. There are tables set up on the side of the restaurant.
5. Plastic cups, cold water, and ice are provided.
6. The staff are all friendly.
sample_reviews_th.author: Osamu Uemoto

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the Khao Gaeng (rice topped with three side dishes) for 70B.

There are about 20 side dishes to choose from. I chose three: ① Green curry, ② Stir-fried crispy pork and kale, and ③ Simmered cabbage and mushrooms. All were subtly sweet and savory, and extremely delicious.
① is moderately spicy and should be easy for most people to eat. It's full of umami.
② is edible as long as you carefully remove the finely chopped chili peppers. The crispy pork has a great texture.
③ is not too spicy. The dish was served with plenty of soup, so I was able to enjoy the rice soaked in the broth.

Maybe it's just me, but I often don't get enough vegetables in Thailand. Khao Gaeng makes up for that, so I find it very useful.

The constant stream of locals and delivery motorbikes passing by shows that this is a popular restaurant.

Please help yourself to the free water.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text:
A local eatery whose name I don't even know.
You can order by pointing at the items displayed outside the shop.
Pork curry and stir-fried vegetables on rice cost 40 baht.
Adding a soft-boiled egg costs 10 baht.
Water is available and you can drink as much as you like.
There are over 10 items on the menu, and they speak basic English.
There are tables set up next to the shop where you can eat, or you can take your food to go.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was looking for a breakfast place a little after 6 AM when I came across this restaurant. It had a lot of customers, a wide variety of side dishes, and seemed promising, so I ordered the three-dish rice bowl.

It was packed with vegetables, had just the right amount of spiciness, and was delicious. I was very satisfied.

I'd like to use this place often again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Takeuchi Tadamichi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Open from 5 a.m., this restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes, all of which taste great. It's a very dedicated business, but unfortunately, it only stays open until 4 p.m.!

The prices are reasonable and affordable. Ice and cold water are provided free of charge. The seating area is spacious, making it a place you'll want to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: C. L HSIEH

sample_reviews_en.text: Leaving the pub hungry, I saw this restaurant open and stopped by. The prices weren't too high, and the food was average. The spicy stir-fried catfish was delicious, but the braised eggs were very bland. The mixed vegetable stew was average in taste, but the best part was it was piping hot – perfect for sobering up! Overall, it was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nina Williams

sample_reviews_en.text:
A place where you can choose rice and three side dishes for 80 baht

It is crowded and has many customers

If you are thinking of Uyi Xiang, I recommend Biing Chu

There are many types of side dishes, and they tasted good

Parking is available on the white line next to it, and it is a place where many locals buy food
sample_reviews_en.author: 박미진

restaurants.name: ห้องอาหารต้นเตย
restaurants.address:

ประชาราษฎร์ สาย 1 ซอย 24 ถ. ประชาราษฎร์ สาย 1 Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Haven't seen a review in a while, but the restaurant is still open!
I had the chance to stop by and try it. There were quite a few cars parked during lunchtime. Today I tried the stir-fried chicken (80 baht) and the shrimp fried rice (100 baht).
I really liked both dishes. The stir-fried chicken was delicious, with a great wok-fried flavor and marinated chicken, plus crispy fried dough sticks. The fried rice was even more unique; the restaurant uses a type of rice similar to sticky rice, with separate grains that are chewy and have a good flavor.
There's parking for about 9 cars. I'll definitely come back to try other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thavisak Phongsai

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, homey food. It's like eating a home-cooked meal, made to order, with both rice and noodle dishes. Importantly, their buttered bread is incredibly fragrant, soft, and soaked in butter – absolutely delicious! The aroma is amazing as soon as you open the door. I recommend calling to reserve the bread beforehand because it sells out very quickly. The glass noodle salad is also delicious. Another thing I loved was their jelly ice cream – so tasty and nostalgic, just like when I was a kid.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fah Jutakarn

sample_reviews_en.text: This decades-old restaurant is located inside a badminton court on Pracha Rat Road. It's another place that serves rare beef stir-fried noodles (Rad Na), a dish that's hard to find in Bangkok. The menu is diverse, focusing more on single-dish meals, making it suitable for families with diverse culinary preferences. There's parking for about 10 cars on-site. The entrance is one-way, requiring access via Bangkok-Nonthaburi Road Soi 13.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paraj Ratanajaipan

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here. It looked quiet from the outside, but clean and tidy inside. There's air conditioning and plenty of seating. I ordered the stir-fried noodles with chicken, which tasted great. The side dishes were crispy, and the buttered bread added a nice touch. It's a shame the kitchen closed at 4:30 PM; otherwise, I would have had another place for dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Konlayut Heemingoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old, long-established restaurant. My mom recommended it, saying the food is good and their milk bread is delicious. Today I tried the shrimp fried rice; it looked different from other places, but it was delicious!!
The restaurant is clean, not crowded, and has parking. Overall, it's good.
sample_reviews_en.author: chia shu liao

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, and I have to say the food was delicious and perfectly suited my taste. The rice noodles with chili paste, the light salad, and the beef with oyster sauce were all great. And the prices were very reasonable too.
sample_reviews_en.author: charl lui

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai food tastes excellent, especially Khao Chae (rice in chilled broth) and Khanom Jeen Nam Prik (rice noodles with chili paste). The flavors are well-balanced, with no overpowering tastes, showcasing the chef's skill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ind Iemchuen

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a 40-year-old restaurant. I used to eat here when I was in kindergarten. The single-dish meals are tasty and inexpensive. There's parking available and a badminton court.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pty L

restaurants.name: Chai 4 Noodle and Wonton
restaurants.address:

Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

One of the best local meals I had in Bangkok.

I discovered this little place while walking from Ratchathewi and loved it. It's a very simple restaurant, the kind where you see locals eating, which for me is always a good sign.

I ordered duck noodle soup for only 60 baht, and it was one of the tastiest and most affordable meals of my entire trip. They serve it with fresh vegetables and the noodles separately, so everyone can prepare the soup to their liking. There are various seasonings and spices on the table to personalize the flavor.

The service was very friendly and quite fast. The atmosphere is completely local, with outdoor seating, ideal for those who want an authentic Bangkok experience.

If you're staying in the Ratchathewi area or passing nearby, I highly recommend it. Excellent value for money and a great option for trying homemade Thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: DORCA HT

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the kind of street food that made Bangkok popular as a street food place. Great quality, specialized on just one dish (egg noodle soup with pork).
I’ve eaten at many Chai 4 stalls, but this is one of the best. The taste of the soup and the red roasted pork is exceptional.
It’s located on a busy street, so not great atmosphere, but if you just want an authentic street food experience with great food, this is the place.
Street food vendors who uphold their quality like this are becoming more and more rare, so I appreciate it every time I find someone like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Foo Dee

sample_reviews_en.text:
They overcharged us just because we were foreigners. They saw in the reviews that a bowl of noodles cost 50 baht, but they told us it was 60 baht! This happened years ago! The boss is dishonest!


The boss charges us more than locals just because we are foreigners. This happened 4 years ago. I saw the comments say one noodle costs 50 baht, but he charged us 60 baht!!! Although it's not that much money, the experience is terrible!!! Dishonest boss!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: luna_mom

sample_reviews_en.text: Returning home at night after a long day of walking, I happened to get off at Ratchethewi station and stopped by this place. It's just a street food stall, but they have super delicious char siu noodles and wontons. I'd say they're even better than the nearly 120 baht bowls at the restaurants near Wat Pho temple 😂 A bowl of noodle soup/dry noodles here costs around 40-45 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenas Nguyễn

sample_reviews_en.text: 60bath 😁. Its not exactly tradisional wonton noodle if you’re Malaysian or from Hong-Kong. Quite wet with the soup mixed in and softer noodle compare to Hong-Kong version. They only sell 1 menu so I guess it’s easy to order. The bbq pork is good and tasty. The wonton is pork based; can’t taste any shrimp inside. Not bad for a late night meal freshly made meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hilman Suradja

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavor is amazing! The roast port, wonton, noddles. The soup taste so good, nice vegetables in the soup! The owners are very friendly! As expat living in Bangkok and working nearby. This is probably the best place in the area! Don’t confuse with the other one nearby. Look for the red tables and yellow sign shop! Only open in the evenings!
sample_reviews_en.author: Angel DF

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are reasonable, and the service is fast. However, I'm deducting points for limited seating due to it being a roadside stall, and for a minor order error (just a request to omit vegetables). It would also be nice if all tables had the same utensils, such as tissues and condiments. Overall, I give it 4.8 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: frxddy.biker98 Chanel

sample_reviews_en.text:
A reliable Chai 4. A regular-sized bowl of bami (wonton + roast pork) was 50 baht. 
Chai 4 is a franchise, and the flavor varies slightly depending on the store, but the soup at this store was sweet. It may depend on the time of day, but it was the sweetest soup I've ever had at a Chai 4. The owner was very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roland Ly

restaurants.name: Beef Sociaty - พริกกะเกลือ สาขาอารีย์
restaurants.address:

The Feast Ratchakru Phaya Thai Road 105, Soi Phahon Yothin 5, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow their beef bowl was sooooooo yummy! (Pic for reference cos idk what it’s called, all I know that it’s beef and pointed at it when we were ordering) Bang for our buck! Will definitely come back!

Update: we went there 4/5 days of our stay in BKK because it’s sooooo good. We’ve tried the other restaurants around but it was not as good as this. Oohwee we even ordered it online and was able to compare their food with another brand and wow, we straight up told ourselves that the latter is just overhyped.

We’ll definitely be back for this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patricia Racinez

sample_reviews_en.text:
Prik Ka Kluea restaurant is located in The Feast Ratchakru project. The menu features dishes in the style of stir-fried chili and salt, basil, and creamy scrambled eggs.

We ordered the seafood creamy scrambled egg rice. The taste was very sweet. It might be delicious for others, but we found it too sweet. Overall, it was okay, just too sweet. The ingredients were average, not exceptionally fresh or amazing. A little disappointing. 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: GINKGO Hansa

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered pork fried rice (I don't know the name of the dish), and it was very delicious and went perfectly with the hot weather, especially with the green dipping sauce (it was very spicy, the kind that burns your lips). The price was also very reasonable, only around 100 yen. Highly recommend my first meal after landing! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: PeTer

sample_reviews_en.text: We found this hidden gem near our hotel. Turned out to be one of favorites in Bangkok. We found the food even more tasty than that of much more expensive restaurants. The price was amazingly low. Only drawback for me is there is no AC, so might not be a good option in a hot summer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jennifer Z

sample_reviews_en.text:
Salt and pepper stir-fried salmon. Salmon chunks ♥️ topped with garlic and fresh chili.
Shrimp with scrambled eggs.
Stir-fried minced pork with basil and fried egg.
Good taste, friendly price, suitable for working people. Around 100 baht per person if you order seafood.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pa Billa

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and flavorful, with moderate portion sizes. The price was a little high. There was sufficient seating, although there aren't many restaurants in this area. I saw this restaurant on Google and decided to give it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaisiri Sanjai

sample_reviews_en.text: Prik Ka Kluea Restaurant, Branch 4, Soi Phahonyothin 5. You can get there by BTS Skytrain, exit 1. Walk straight ahead for a short distance, then turn into the soi (alley). The food is delicious! 😋👍 And they have a wide variety of dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mom&Moky กรุ๊งกริ๊งกระดิ่งแมว

sample_reviews_en.text: They're so stingy with the dipping sauce. Sometimes they give very little, sometimes they don't give any at all. The food is delicious, but they're just too stingy with the sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: supalerk phadunglak

restaurants.name: Le S50 Bangkok
restaurants.address:

Luea Suk Alley, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The one waitress is very dismissive of westerners and was happy to drink with her friends.
There is nothing wrong with the food at all it’s great and good value for money.

Beware ‼️ the happy hour drinks. They are buy one get one free.
BUT if you buy one and both of you have one of each of the drinks they will charge you full price for each drink. We didn’t have the same drink each but they still charged us.
I ordered one beer and two beers arrived 150 for the two small beers, fine! They tried to pour both beers at the same time.
My wife had one water, consumed no beer but they charged for two beers at 300.
It’s a rip off that they do not explain properly. Once corrected the waitress was all apologetic blaming the other waitress unfairly.

The owners really need to address this.

Shame as it’s a nice cozy place 😤
sample_reviews_en.author: Sharon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is quite pricey and there is a piece of rubber in the white rice that we ordered.  The waitress doesn’t know how to do a service because while I was eating and had a conversation with my friend, she came to my table and cleaned some plates at the table without saying anything. Additionally, when I told her about the rubber in the rice, she didn’t say sorry but only say “okay” instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Linny V

sample_reviews_en.text: Lovely service, the owner is very attentive. It's a small shop with a cozy atmosphere and comfortable seating. The only minor drawback is that there aren't enough tables; arriving late might mean no seats. I recommend making a reservation beforehand to ensure you get a table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pooh Pho

sample_reviews_en.text: This small, cozy shop offers attentive service, delicious food, small bottles of beer, and wine by the glass. The owner and the staff are lovely and friendly; you won't feel lonely even if you come alone. They also play fun international music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Golf RACHAPAKDEE (Golf)

sample_reviews_en.text:
We are very impressed with Le S50. Good food and service. Friendly staff.
I highly recommend this restaurant. You must come! The food is delicious, the drinks are good, the service is superb, and the staff are very friendly and welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manita Kaonog

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great bar Good prices and they make a mean Mojito
BIG is a great friendly host and Kate will stop any bad music and put good tunes on for you
If you are near On Nut call in you will not be disappointed
sample_reviews_en.author: David Dearden

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stuff was rude of really hard rain I couldn’t even pass through the bar under their roof because you have to order a drink for that!!!
Even though I was a consumer before!
sample_reviews_en.author: Petr Aleksanin

sample_reviews_en.text: Service is good and accommodating staff 🫶🫶🫶🫶, Food is good and affordable ❤️😍👍👍👍👍👍, Good vibes and greay atmosphere 👌  just a little tight and heat
sample_reviews_en.author: WayKlaro

restaurants.name: น้ำปั่นและอาหารตามสั่ง ร้านน้องหมา
restaurants.address:

112/12 ศิริราช Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in an alley, but not too far in. It's clean and looks nice. They serve a wide variety of Thai à la carte dishes that look incredibly tempting. While waiting for the food, they served seaweed soup to whet the appetite.
This time I ordered marinated pork fried with chili and salt, a fried egg, and spicy fried chicken salad with a boiled egg.
The fried pork with chili and salt was amazing! Another highlight was the chili fish sauce – a must-try! I asked the restaurant to pack some for me to take home, which I really appreciated as it enhanced the flavor of the food.
I also took home three more boxes of stir-fried shrimp with curry powder and scrambled egg rice. They were still delicious even after reheating at home. The stir-fried shrimp with curry powder was very flavorful, rich, and aromatic.
The dogs, Santa and Santy, are adorable, clean, well-behaved, affectionate, and super friendly. The owner is very nice and talkative.
The food is delicious and the portions are generous.
It was great value for money and a very satisfying meal.
Santa and Santy are so cute!
sample_reviews_en.author: P.Nutthaphat M

sample_reviews_en.text:
At first, I was confused walking past because so many medical students and residents frequented this small shop, not to mention the Grab drivers who kept coming to pick up orders.

Today, after trying the food, I understand. The food tastes great, the prices are reasonable, and there's a huge variety of dishes to choose from—like, a massive selection!
The walls are covered with pictures of the food. Honestly, you can order whatever you want.
The minced pork basil stir-fry today was surprisingly generous; I asked for less rice, and still got a lot. It's probably even bigger than usual, and it only cost 60 baht!

The owner is lovely, speaks politely, and is very friendly.
There was also a cute little dog that greeted us in the shop; it was super tame and wriggled around.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichsaran Ves

sample_reviews_en.text: We stumbled upon this place by accident, tucked away in a slightly secluded alley. It's a made-to-order restaurant with incredibly delicious food. They have a huge variety of dishes, and you can tell they put a lot of effort into making them. Every dish is perfectly seasoned. My boyfriend and I ordered stir-fried morning glory with crispy chicken and stir-fried basil with crispy pork. The flavors were bold and delicious, and the chicken was perfectly crispy. The prices were great, with specials under 80 baht, including seaweed soup. There are two adorable and friendly dogs inside, and the owner is very kind. The restaurant is air-conditioned, making it comfortable to sit in. Overall, a perfect 10/10. I hope more people discover this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanokchon Hanyawongse

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently dined at a Thai restaurant that I highly recommend. Not only was the food delicious, with a great balance of flavors and spices, but the smoothies were also a standout. The staff were extremely kind and attentive, making the dining experience even more pleasant. The restaurant has a warm and inviting atmosphere, and I particularly enjoyed the cozy seating. The menu offered a wide variety of options, including both traditional Thai dishes and more modern takes on the cuisine. Overall, I had a fantastic experience at this restaurant and would definitely go back for more of their delicious food and smoothies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saksorn Juthakitti

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a hidden gem tucked away in Wang Lang area. The food and drinks here are incredibly delicious. My favorites are the stir-fried noodles with water spinach and the perfectly deboned fish with rice – you don't even have to debone it yourself! The dipping sauce is amazing, and all the drinks are delicious. The owner is lovely and very friendly. Despite being so hidden, they're surprisingly busy, constantly doing orders for LINE MAN delivery. If you're in the area and looking for a great place to eat at an affordable price, try this place. Prices start at just 40-50 baht, which is incredibly cheap.
sample_reviews_en.author: เห็นแก่กิน Hengairkin

sample_reviews_en.text: Santa and Santi's made-to-order food shop. Photos of the little girl and the food are all over the place. Unfortunately, I didn't get to see her on the day I went. She was sleeping upstairs because I had a haircut appointment that night. 555. I tried three dishes: Mama noodles with crispy chicken and basil, sukiyaki fried rice, and morning glory with bacon. All three were delicious. It's no wonder students eat a lot. And the prices aren't expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Raksat

sample_reviews_en.text: Personally, I'm sensitive to saltiness and tend to prefer sweeter flavors, so I felt the food was a bit too salty (my friends ate it without any problems, saying it wasn't salty at all lol). But I could tell they put a lot of care into making it. The portions were huge! The price was cheap, the service was great, and everyone was lovely. There's even an adorable Santa and Santy dog ​​to welcome you, cheering you up on a really gloomy day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cygne E.

sample_reviews_en.text: They keep canceling orders on the app. I don't know why. No matter how many times I order, I never get my food. I guess they've already made enough money and don't want any more. I ordered at 4 PM, which isn't even closing time. If you don't want to sell anymore, just shut down the app instead of canceling orders. It wastes my time waiting for food and makes me not want to try this restaurant again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikonikki N.

restaurants.name: ตำมั่ว สาขา เซ็นจูรี่ เดอะมูฟวี่ พลาซ่า (อนุสาวรีย์ชัย)
restaurants.address:

15 Phaya Thai Rd, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. I've eaten there many times, but after what I experienced today, I swear I will never go back again. The man who seemed to be the owner was very displeased, slamming the plates down while serving, which we could feel. He showed extreme displeasure on his face and in his body language. We just asked for a larger table because my friend is big, and we ordered a lot of food, even though there were plenty of empty tables available. I rarely encounter this kind of service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saowanee Deesutin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is too expensive.
There are no staff to take orders; you have to write them down yourself on paper like a street food stall. It doesn't justify the price and the attempt to make it a high-end restaurant.
The shrimp pad Thai lacked any pad Thai flavor.
The food didn't taste right; the fermented pork ribs didn't taste like fermented pork at all, just like bland fried pork.
I think it's difficult for them to continue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunakorn Vootivakinskul

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like Tam Mua restaurant, and I saw they had a branch at Century Plaza so I chose this one. It was terrible; the taste was completely off. Everything was disappointing. The instant noodle salad was awful, the fermented fish was oily, dark, and not hot. Many of the dishes I ordered weren't like what I usually get. The staff were incomprehensible and uninterested in customers. I will definitely not be going back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pykm P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Find the worst papaya salad in this picture. It was the worst I've ever had. It cost 85 baht. The strands were so long, I couldn't put them in my mouth; I had to cut them with a spoon. What kind of noodle peeler did they use? Who are they serving this to? It looked like leftover vegetables, hastily prepared and served. I don't know if they'll improve, but I'll never order this again.

The fried larb was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: P picha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered 4 dishes, and they were less tasty than other branches I've eaten at.
Papaya salad was very sweet.
The larb had fried shallots mixed in almost half the plate, like they were trying to make it look like a lot. The taste was very ordinary.
The fried chicken and tom yum soup were average in taste, not very tasty. The sticky rice was cold, not hot.
End of review and no repeat visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuki Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went in the evening, and there was a steady stream of customers.
Actually, we ate more than what was stated. The duck larb was excellent. Other dishes like the vermicelli salad, green bean salad, and three-mushroom curry were considered average (depending on individual taste). #myopinion The grilled pork neck was good.

The staff provided quick service, and the restaurant was clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: YingWow Lucky

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant leaves the doors open, letting customers in the smell of food smoke. The service is poor, and customers have to wait a long time to pay. The papaya salad isn't even tasty, considering it's supposed to be a papaya salad restaurant. If this is all they can do, they should just close the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanathip Yana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai papaya salad with crab + bamboo shoot curry with yanang leaves + bamboo shoot soup
Balancing with crispy fried chicken wings and fried sea bass with fish sauce.
Spicy, flavorful, and so delicious you'll lose track of time 💚

A good life starts with... delicious food right in front of you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Metta Nakarungsu

restaurants.name: ร้านส้มตำยายไม้
restaurants.address:

102 63, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled chicken is incredibly delicious. I don't know how they marinate it, but the skin, especially, is amazing. Chewing it with sticky rice is pure bliss. The dipping sauce with roasted rice and chili powder is even better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Momo Talo

sample_reviews_en.text: Great taste, affordable price. The sticky rice is delicious, fragrant, and soft. It's a high-quality variety of sticky rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: พงฐกร สิริการ

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually buy papaya salad from this shop regularly because the auntie makes it really spicy and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boonchai Chaichanasak

sample_reviews_en.text: Grilled catfish, grilled chicken, papaya salad, and larb are delicious. Motorcycle parking is available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanagorn Jaimun

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is quite good, not too much or too little. The food is well-prepared; you should try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thongchai P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Grilled chicken, grilled liver, catfish larb, offal soup, papaya salad.
Very delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: ธีระเดช กาญจนธำรงกุล

restaurants.name: เอี่ยวไถ่ สุกี้โบราณ เดอะ คริสตัล เอสบี ราชพฤกษ์
restaurants.address:

555/9 ห้องเลขที่ ซี220 ชั้นที่ 2, Ratchaphruek Rd, Bang Khanun, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Old-school suki, this is exactly where you need to be.

Everything tastes just as amazing as the original. The marinated suki pork is soft and tender, and it pairs perfectly with their legendary dipping sauce—it still has that unique, traditional flavor that you just can't find anywhere else.

A massive surprise hit was the Beef Rad Na, which is actually included right in the buffet set! The beef was cooked to perfection and the gravy was packed with flavor.

The quality and taste are unbeatable. Every single dish was spot on, incredibly delicious, and totally worth every baht. Highly recommend bringing a friend or family here if you want a hearty, satisfying meal!

This review is based on their amazing 399 THB All-You-Can-Eat Buffet!
sample_reviews_en.author: โอภาส ยมกกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very disappointed with the food quality today. It wasn't like the previous times I've eaten here, especially since I ordered these dishes because they were delicious. That's why I'm writing this review. The oyster omelet was mostly batter with less than 5 oysters. The stir-fried fish maw was mostly egg with only two pieces of fish maw. Only the Rad Na (noodles in gravy) was acceptable in terms of taste and quality. The steamed fish with plum sauce and the crab spring rolls were just average. Overall, I'm giving it 3 stars. The female server was okay, but the male server needs improvement; he didn't come when called. My niece said we should try a different restaurant next time because the price isn't worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jintana Ngamvithayapong-Yanai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great deal! I booked through Hungry Hub for the 1,130 baht net set.
The meal offers a variety of choices: 3 categories, 4 dishes + 1 dessert, and 1 tea or drink per person.

Today I ordered stir-fried crab meat with curry powder, grouper fish sukiyaki, braised fish with black bean sauce, and grilled river prawns (I only got one large prawn).
Personally, I thought the vegetable set with the sukiyaki was quite small (it came in a small tiered tray, whereas normally at full price I've paid, I get a separate plate of vegetables that's 2-3 times larger).

Overall, all the dishes were delicious. Very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: K P (มอหมึก)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, but some dishes are surprisingly expensive.
The crab noodle rolls were absolutely amazing! 290 baht for 6 bites.
The seafood glass noodle salad was flavorful and excellent, 160 baht, reasonable price.
The grouper sukiyaki set was 380 baht, a good price, lots of fresh and good fish, but very little vegetables included, you have to order extra.
The taro rice was 180 baht per plate, delicious but a bit pricey.
The restaurant is comfortable and wheelchair accessible.

I ate here again, using a Hungry Hub deal which was great value. The stir-fried spinach and the crab curry were excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wednesday Child

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried dried fish maw was delicious. The steamed sea bass with lime was very fresh, although the sauce was a little too sweet. The crab claws were excellent, large in size. The dumplings were best eaten hot; the wrapper was soft and the filling was smooth and bouncy. Overall, the set meals were good and tasty, but there wasn't enough, so we ordered Peking duck as well. The taste was decent; the meat was stir-fried with black pepper, resulting in a rich and delicious flavor. However, I wasn't particularly impressed with the sukiyaki. Overall, it was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chang Noy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Peking duck and grilled dishes here are truly delicious.
They're must-order items.
My go-to dishes every time I visit are:
- Hot plate oyster omelet
- Drunken chicken / Sesame oil jellyfish
- Crab rice noodle rolls
- Shrimp patties
- Fish stew
- Peking duck (I usually order the fried duck with garlic / stir-fried duck with chili and salt, and also the duck in gravy sauce)

The staff might be a little slow at times, but the service is good and friendly.
The food might take a while to arrive,
but the quality is consistently excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apha S

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Beef, The Pork!! OMG!!!

If I needed to get meat melted with a hot pot cooking technique and I just happened to be around here. This place is the best of the best of the best of the best, definitely.

Service was...almost self-service with a service charge added.

The seat was a typical Chinese restaurant design; too large, too far and we were too short. Everyone on the table had to get up and get their precious meat.

Do not come alone here, that's the definite suggestion.

And I'll be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: D. B.

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a wide variety of food to choose from. The Peking duck was okay considering the price. The drunken chicken wasn't good; it was tough and seemed old. The stir-fried jellyfish with sesame oil wasn't as tasty as what I've had elsewhere. Our recommended dishes, which we enjoyed, were the sukiyaki, crab rice noodle rolls, and dumplings. The seating was comfortable, but the staff here have limited communication skills.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawan S

restaurants.name: BangMad halal restaurant
restaurants.address:

WWP5+9FF, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a family-run business selling Pad Thai, fried oysters, and oyster omelets in a shophouse along the road.

The Pad Thai is excellent, with all the ingredients, including crunchy pickled radish, and a perfect balance of salty and sweet.

The oyster omelet has a surprisingly generous amount of fresh oysters. I thought they were closing for the day, but I was completely full after eating it!

The prices are reasonable, and the atmosphere is relaxed, typical of a shophouse eatery. The father cooks, the mother sells, and the son serves. When he's free, he plays games like a typical kid, but it doesn't interfere with his work.

Parking is a bit difficult; you'll have to park along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Watson Pinkaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
Reviews are true
One of the tastiest shrimp “Pad Thai’s”  for only 65 bahts ($1.80 usd)
Perfect amount of seasoning; sweet,  sour,  salty and peppery. All mixed with dried shrimp , fresh shrimp , crisp tofu , eggs and peanuts with a side of sprouts, baby scallions and palm leaf.
Is a mouth bursting with flavors, textures and smokiness.

Next time I’ll try the oyster pancakes 🙏🙏🙏

Hospitable family run business

A must try if you like Pad Thai

If this review was helpful, please give it a 👍

Happy Travels
sample_reviews_en.author: SoloJoe

sample_reviews_en.text: Their food is delicious, we went back again the next day to tapaw for our dinner. We ordered pad thai and oyster omelette and it is so good. Authentic thai taste cooked by Muslims and halal certified 👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Umairah Morris

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is very good, and there are many options to choose from. For the fried items, you need to call and order in advance, otherwise you'll have to wait in line.
sample_reviews_en.author: อุมัด บินยาซีน

sample_reviews_en.text: It's tasty, and for those with money, it might not be expensive. But I think 80 baht a plate is too much; I'd only eat it occasionally. Haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนากร เนียมจิตต์

sample_reviews_en.text:
So good! I'd book a plane ticket just for one dish here.
All the ingredients are perfectly balanced and you can barely taste the oil.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohamed El shendey

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service, food took a very long time to arrive, and oil even got on the customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: ซีน่อน เซร่า

restaurants.name: เบส บีน คาเฟ่ (ร้านชมพู)
restaurants.address:

194 Soi Yotse, Wat Thep Sirin, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were rude. They didn't understand my Thai and didn't complete my order, but then they asked me back, as if I was in the wrong. They didn't even apologize. The food took ages to arrive.

I ordered Pad Kee Mao (stir-fried noodles) a little spicy, but it was very spicy. I don't mind, it's just a personal preference, but when I gave them feedback, they said it was already mildly spicy, and next time, I should order it very mild. It's ridiculous. Please improve. The food was delicious, but the service was terrible. It ruined my dining experience. I won't be recommending it to anyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prang Prem

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is really delicious, the portions are generous, and the prices are reasonable. Highly recommended! I used to work in that area and ate there almost every day. Even now, when I have free time, I still go there. It's a bit far, but the delicious food makes it worth it. The air-conditioned room is nice and cool. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: BYL BPJ (BB)

sample_reviews_en.text: Affordable, good, and delicious. The basil chicken with century egg in the picture is 60 baht. They have an air-conditioned room to sit in, which is nice and cool. It's near Hua Chiao Hospital. I'll definitely visit again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pypt BJ

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered this for delivery and I have to say, the shrimp paste fried rice was incredibly delicious! I already reviewed it on the food delivery app, and I couldn't resist reviewing it here too! 😃
sample_reviews_en.author: JJK JU

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, it feels like mom's cooking. The prices are affordable, and the portions are generous – very filling! They give you a lot of crispy pork, and it's made fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: WFH

sample_reviews_en.text: First time eating here, and I'm impressed. Great value for money, generous portions, and air-conditioned seating available. Thank you! From Table 15.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pick Pongsakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good atmosphere, friendly prices.
The highlight is the crispy pork.
(Good food with reasonable price
All menus with crispy pork are a must)
sample_reviews_en.author: Somchai W. (Nume)

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried egg and rice were well-prepared and delicious, except the rice was very dry. If the rice were improved, it would be perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patci

restaurants.name: L.A. Diner
restaurants.address:

338, 127, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place serves truly authentic American food. The fried chicken breast is incredibly tender, and the dipping sauce for the fries is amazing. The menu offers a wide variety of tempting dishes and side dishes that keep things interesting. The tuna sandwich is packed with ingredients, and the homemade pancakes are made fresh to order. My favorite is the natural yogurt with fresh fruit. They also have refillable coffee for breakfast. The American chef husband cooks in the kitchen, with his Thai wife carefully adapting the recipes. The portions are HUGE, and the taste is worth the price. (Forget about Uncle Big's fried chicken!) This restaurant has a diner-style seating arrangement – ​​perfect for eating, not for meetings. 🥪🌯

📍Monday-Saturday 8 AM to 8 PM
📍Parking available
sample_reviews_en.author: ศุภรัตน์ ดอยไพรสณฑ์ SUPARAT D

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing food and a very welcoming environment. Helpful host who was very patient in answering questions related to the menu. I ordered a strawberry daiquiri and chicken dinner, both were delicious and I finished the whole American sized portion by myself. The accessibility of the diner is also a plus point because it is at a walking distance from major hotels in Pattaya. This was my first experience going out and ordering food by myself in Thailand and I was a little nervous about how it’ll go. Since this was such a pleasant experience, thanks to the owner, it laid a good groundwork for my solo cafe-hopping in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pooja L

sample_reviews_en.text:
Anyone who loves authentic Western-flavored food must try this place!

The Chicken Stix & Fries are amazing!
The fried chicken 🐔 is a winner, especially when paired with the Cole Slaw – it's mind-blowing! 🎆

The Cole Slaw is fantastic; the vegetables are crispy 🥗, not too sweet, and tastes just like the ones I've had abroad.

It's a local restaurant, and the food is so good I wouldn't be embarrassed to bring anyone here. 🤣 My daughter loves this place 💟. Even takeout is just as delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: K V

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the CHICKEN WRAP. The fried chicken was crispy and juicy. They use organic ingredients, so the salad and meat were fresh and delicious. The dipping sauce is homemade and goes great with both the chicken and potatoes. I highly recommend it!
The owner was a friendly and very nice person.
It's a family-run business, and I was served by his cute daughters. I'd definitely like to return and try their other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: K K

sample_reviews_en.text:
We all pick the hill to die so here I go. This is the best American Breakfast in phra tam nok/jomtien beach. The star of the show is the pancakes but the supporting cast is solid as well. An expert in Thai food declared her meal "Yummy!" as well.

There is no photo of the American Breakfast as I was unable to spare that 20 seconds 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: mike casey

sample_reviews_en.text: I missed my breakfast at the hotel so this place was very close to the hotel that I was staying at. It is a cute cozy place with good music. I ordered a ham sandwich which was really good and the fries were amazing as well. The owner was sweet too☺️ They have vegan options as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sai Ghagare

sample_reviews_en.text: An awesome family run business with great food and lovely atmosphere. The food tastes just like home cooking. The chicken is amazing, whether in a wrap or on its own. And the pancakes are the best I’ve ever had. My new favorite place in town. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Becky Watson

sample_reviews_en.text: Our family had an excellent experience here. The food was great the staff were delightful and super helpful in helping us find family frie day activities for us to do while we holiday here in Pattaya. 10/10 we are coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cory Gardner

restaurants.name: Suki Thewet
restaurants.address:

Luk Luang 14, Dusit, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible! Both the service and the owner's attitude were awful. The prices didn't match the signs; there was no 100 baht price listed. Today I ordered the special mixed dry sukiyaki and paid 100 baht, but the portion size was far too small for that price. My friend ordered the special pork sukiyaki soup without vegetables, which only had pork and glass noodles, and paid 80 baht. When we asked for tissues, they made a displeased face at us. I understand it's a legendary restaurant, but if the service is this terrible, they should just close it down.
sample_reviews_en.author: nes ss

sample_reviews_en.text: It's unbelievable, because I just ate there today. The sukiyaki was made with tap water, and it smelled strongly of chlorine. The dipping sauce smelled rotten (I suspect they poured new sauce into an old jar). The cabbage was incredibly bitter (they didn't wash the vegetables before cooking; it was full of pesticides). It's an unbelievably bad-tasting sukiyaki restaurant. I think the owner probably doesn't care and just lets the workers sell whatever they can get, thinking the restaurant is already famous.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. อ้วน พ.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This roadside sukiyaki stall is located in an alley next to a 7-Eleven.
Pork sukiyaki costs 60 baht.
I ordered both the soup and dry versions.

The taste was delicious, the portion was generous, the pork was tender, and the dipping sauce was okay.
However, I have to deduct points for the dry version; it wasn't dry at all and was extremely oily.

I recommend ordering the soup version instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichaaa

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a legendary sukiyaki restaurant with a long history. It has a unique and delicious flavor, with amazing dipping sauces. The dry sukiyaki is fragrant and tasty, and the sukiyaki soup has a delicious broth. You can order in advance and drive there quickly. There's comfortable seating for dine-in, or you can take it home. They also have a children's menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: panist nakrumpai

sample_reviews_en.text: Sukiyaki at Thewet is delicious. They make each dish to order, and it's fast and efficient... I ordered the dry version, but it was a little too wet, though the vegetables were perfectly cooked and crispy. I loved it! The marinated pork was tender and had a nice hint of sesame oil. The dipping sauce was the traditional kind, but a little too sour.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text: This stall specializes in Thai Suki (ski). The menu only has Thai Suki naam (soup ski) and hen (fried ski). There are four types of ingredients: pork, chicken, shrimp, and squid. The sauce they are proud of is quite spicy. The soup is made with pork bones. They also have vegetarian ski without any toppings.
sample_reviews_en.author: THAI SANPO FUJII

sample_reviews_en.text: The sukiyaki restaurant is located in a small alley. The taste is decent, the dipping sauce is good, and the portions are generous. The price is reasonable. It's a small restaurant with limited seating, and it can be a bit smoky.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tin Ruikchuchit

sample_reviews_en.text: Dry pork sukiyaki. No matter how many times I eat it, I never get tired of it. It's delicious as always. Maintaining the standard. Delicious dipping sauce. Soft pork. If you go after 8 PM, it might be sold out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakrit Promsangkaha

restaurants.name: นมคับ - Nom Cup
restaurants.address:

หมู่บ้านเสนาวิลล่า84 เลขที่ 712/1, คลองจั่น, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner should come and supervise the staff. I only ordered one item, the person taking the order told the person making the food, but they ignored me. I stood there for several minutes, putting pressure on them, and they still couldn't communicate. I stood there for 10 minutes, and the staff didn't talk to each other at all, like they hated each other from a past life. I reread reviews from two years ago and there were similar staff problems, and it's still just as bad. In short, I'd rather go eat burgers and satay at the shop next door.
sample_reviews_en.author: NuvoLa Decimo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fresh Milk Bread Shop
Outdoor atmosphere, parking available along the road.
Menu items tried:
- Steamed Bread with Pandan Custard (THB 50): The steamed bread was well-cooked and soft. The custard was a little too sweet, and the pandan flavor wasn't very strong.
- Hokkaido Overflowing Milk Filling Bread (THB 35): The bread was crispy and fragrant with butter. The milk filling was truly overflowing.
Overall, the taste was decent and the prices were reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boat ANRPS

sample_reviews_en.text: The dessert tastes good. Today I tried a new menu item; normally they only have smoothies and bread. This time they had iced bread, and today there were 3 flavors: cocoa, pink milk, and iced tea. This menu item costs 89 baht, and you can choose 4 toppings, or you can let the shop choose the toppings for you. The shop doesn't have staff assigned to each table, so the service is average. They speak nicely, but their facial expressions aren't very welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sugar lili

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordering via Grab was so delicious! The bread was chewy and soft, the Thai tea custard wasn't overly sweet, it was creamy and flavorful.
