The buttered milk bread was also perfectly balanced in taste. Everything was packaged very well. I'll definitely go eat at the shop next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Metta P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop has a huge selection of desserts! The whipped cream is incredibly delicious, with a lovely caramel aroma and a light, pleasant sweetness – so enjoyable to eat. Personally, I love the caramel banana bread the most. There's also a resident black cat at the shop! 😻
sample_reviews_en.author: Chananchida Jansaengsee

sample_reviews_en.text: The unsweetened Milo milkshake is the best I've ever had; it's incredibly rich and satisfying. Everything else was great too! Comfortable seating, delicious food, perfect for a late-night chill-out session.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beige Magenta

sample_reviews_en.text:
The friendly staff explain everything really well, lol.

The taste is pretty good too. It seems like the toast with Hokkaido milk and pandan is very popular. I ordered them too, and they're great!
sample_reviews_en.author: 행재

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The fresh milk is delicious, and the iced bread is delicious. The prices are cheap, and the atmosphere is nice. I've been here many times. I highly recommend you come and try it! 💖
sample_reviews_en.author: A Google User

restaurants.name: Pizza & Pasta Corner
restaurants.address:

6 Sukhumvit Alley 22, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waiting almost 1 hour for just 1 box of pizza.
Not well organized. I have to track my order by myself due to the delivery guys noticed me it's almost an hour for my order. No Thai speaking staff answered the phone call when I was tracking my order. Only foreigner staff who pick up the phone with no clear answer for the order. If the restaurant did not ready for selling in delivery application. So, please turn off the delivery service in the app to avoid confusing all the customer who want to order via delivery app. 1 hour waiting for food is not right way for customer, food quality & restaurant.
HIGHLY NOT RECOMMEND.
sample_reviews_en.author: S Obma

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delivery order review

Trust me, this place seems to be buying their Google reviews... Pasta for Bolognese is spicy and super oily, it's like 1 inch of oil, penne carbonara is dry, disgusting, tasteless, their ham and bacon pizza, seems to look like thick chunks of raw meat slapped onto cooked pizza, with it tasting hard, raw, dry and unpleasant, ordered their fish and chips, didn't arrive, nuggets dry, ordered cheese fries but then got just fries.
P.S we paid $60 USD for this meal and regretted
sample_reviews_en.author: Tan Jian Jie

sample_reviews_en.text: Our first time here and we weren't sure what to order. But our hawaiian and baby spinach bacon pizza turned out great. We also had caesar salad, spaghetti carbonara and fish & chip that were tasty. I personally like their cheese. Service was also nice and the price was reasonable. Definitely recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narumon Joonjaroen (Apple)

sample_reviews_en.text: The carbonara was a huge failure because the cheese and oil separated. I ordered fried chicken legs, but they turned out to be drumsticks instead of legs. The margherita pizza had so little cheese that it was like wheat bread. The worst delivery restaurant I've ever been to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jin Jin

sample_reviews_en.text: I had dinner alone with outside seating. I ordered anti Pizza Perproni it's delicious and continue with Greek salad was delight. I would to thank you Pizza & Pasta Corner staffs for talking good care us. Definetly Recommended for pizza and pasta Lovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: AMAN SHARMA 21GSFC2020014

sample_reviews_en.text: We stayed in Bangkok for 4 days and have been at "pizza & pasta Corner" twice. The food is very good if you love pizza, pasta and fish finger. We tried them all.  The staffs are very friendly and helpful. A place that we definitely would recommend. 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Rehbar Khanna

sample_reviews_en.text: Extremely slow. Not a single customer. Grab drivers have been here for half an hour and they still haven't started preparing the food. This restaurant is notorious among partner drivers; nobody wants to accept orders because of the long …
sample_reviews_en.author: กั๊ด ต๊อง

sample_reviews_en.text: This is by far the worst pizza I've had in Bangkok (possibly the world). It lacks quality ingredients, flavor, and crisp. It resembles something you might find in the freezer section of a low rate grocery store. Not recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: brandon Merry

restaurants.name: เตี๋ยว ยูซุป
restaurants.address:

203 1 ถ. ประชาอุทิศ Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The broth is the best! I'm usually someone who only eats the noodles and toppings, not the broth, but at this restaurant I slurped it all up until the pot was almost empty. The meat was well-cooked and not too thin, and the tendon was clear, bouncy, and crunchy – excellent! This has become our family's regular restaurant. Next time I'll try their papaya salad and fried chicken.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rasi da

sample_reviews_en.text: All the papaya salad dishes are delicious. Fish food is available for 10 baht per bag. There are both chairs and floor seating options. A restroom is located behind the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: KoLe B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Braised beef in spicy broth, Michelin-star quality!
Braised beef noodle soup with meatballs.
Papaya salad. Order anything, it's all delicious and very affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุพัชรี เอ่งฉ้วน

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious noodles, a super chill spot with a riverside atmosphere.
You'll be impressed... 💗 I love it!

Meat lovers shouldn't miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaitawat Rowdawan

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great and the food is delicious. You absolutely have to try the hot pot at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zen Sir

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup was spicy and delicious. The restaurant is by the river with a nice atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: 4aJourney

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, delicious food, and parking available in front.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wit

restaurants.name: I Jap Yuan
restaurants.address:

WVCQ+8FP, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We enjoyed the food here so much we came here twice during our stay in Pattaya. This modest hole in the wall restaurant was probably our favorite eats in Pattaya. I forgot the name of the dish I had but it was the noodle dish that wasn’t pho. We also had the fresh spring roll and the rice paper crepe filled with meat (also forgetting the name 😅). The owners don’t seem to speak much English but there is a menu for English speakers. The first time we went we ordered everything with chicken but they misunderstood and gave us the noodle and rice crepe with pork but this was a blessing in disguise bc it was delicious! The next time we went we got the dishes with chicken but we prefer it with the pork. The brother is rich and the noodles are nice and chewy. The spring rolls are also made with really fresh vegetables with a lot of basil so it was the perfect palate cleanser after so many days of eating Thai curries. For some reason the older reviews seem to be about the 7/11 nearby so we thought it was in the 7/11 but thankfully the google maps address takes you to the correct spot :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Joa

sample_reviews_en.text:
A unique Seven Eleven, with a ship decoration in front of the store.

Unlike a regular Seven Eleven, this place has a unique and distinctive interior. The food and beverage options are more extensive. There's a cafe serving delicious coffee and food.

The cafe is quite comfortable, with plenty of electrical outlets. You can charge your phone or laptop. It's a great escape from the Pattaya heat. 😃

Oh, and the food and beverage prices are also very affordable.

My new favourite soup. I got the pork ribs, they fall off the bone and melt in your mouth. The broth is rich and meaty without being too salty. A little bit of chilli and you’re in heaven. I don’t think you can beat this value ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️

The picture doesn’t do it justice. If you like meat and soup, you have to try it.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The other day I went out for drinks and was able to pay with my credit card, but when I went back a few days later they were cash only.
Sure enough, there was a sign on the wall that said American Express wasn't accepted (I have a VISA card), so I said, "It says American Express isn't accepted, but it doesn't say anything else, so of course you'd think it would work, right? But I was able to use VISA last week," and they said, "You can use your credit card with a minimum spend of 500 baht."
But wait... when I was here last week I was able to use VISA for just one beer, right?" I said, and they sighed loudly and said, "OK, OK! (sounding annoyed)," and it worked out fine, but I was the one who said it in English, but I'm sure well-bred Japanese people would just pay with cash.
It's best to be careful about paying with cash. They say it's cash for their own convenience, but don't be fooled. I think the cashier was probably just trying to make a killing.
Bangkok is constantly getting more and more cunning with the constant stream of tourists, so be sure to insist when you have to.
sample_reviews_en.author: TK

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service and food. So extremely disappointing.  Both our dishes tasted like they had been sitting around all day and simply lightly reheated. If you want punchy deeply flavored Thai food THEN AVOID THOS PLACE.  The Pad Thai was actually disgusting and when we gave it back to them  uneaten they just laughed when we said it was no good. No offer of a new dish, no apology nothing just laughed! The staff have zero motivation and basically stand around talking to each other and each time we needed anything we had to get up and go over to them. I would agree with the previous reviews and just wish I had seen them before going. A complete waste of time , money and a regretful experience.

sample_reviews_en.text: The cheese tofu was spoiled. The restaurant has switched to a non-buffet system, and I feel the prices are too high. The old buffet system would have been much better. With the price increase and the quality of ingredients deteriorating without a buffet, it's unacceptable. I only ate a few things, and the total for two people was almost 1000 baht, or 400-500 baht per person. And then the cheese tofu was spoiled – it was very sour and I could tell it was bad because I love it, but this time it was unacceptable. I advise anyone thinking of going back to avoid it. It's incredibly overpriced, even more expensive than famous restaurants in malls. The price is unreasonable. I will never go again.

I'll say it right now, this is my first and last time here. Furthermore, the staff's service was unacceptable; they just sat and stared at customers while they ate. Manners are essential.

sample_reviews_en.text: Crispy fried oysters and shrimp. The batter is deliciously crispy, and the oysters, shrimp, and squid are very fresh. Highly recommended! It's also reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: f f

sample_reviews_en.text: Crispy fried oysters with large oysters and delicious dipping sauce can be found at Hoi Tod Praeng Phuthon. Enjoy the chill roadside atmosphere in the evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saowalak Meedacha

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried oysters are very delicious and not expensive. Parking is a bit difficult. They are only open for a few hours, from 5 p.m. to 10 p.m.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pooh Piyaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, crispy dough, fresh shellfish, perfect combination. If you like your bean sprouts a bit more cooked, you can tell the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oakie Chiraskamin

restaurants.name: ร้านยอ การยำ
restaurants.address:

499 Soi Sathon 3, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A wide variety of spicy and flavorful Thai salads (Yum) with a delicious fermented fish sauce dressing. Order any kind of Yum you like, including fresh salmon Yum, oyster Yum, cockle Yum, fresh and cooked crab Yum, fresh and cooked shrimp Yum, and many more. The highlight is the use of fresh lime juice, not bottled lime juice. Yum lovers absolutely cannot miss this! If you don't like it sweet, please let the chef know.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kotchawara Lianpech

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't take any pictures of the spicy salad stall in front of Suan Plu market. I went without any expectations, but it turned out to be delicious. The winged bean salad with crispy pork (I can't remember the full name) was amazing, so flavorful! I also ordered a spicy pork sausage salad with salted egg and fermented fish sauce, which was also delicious. I'll definitely be back often!
sample_reviews_en.author: PPunch Punch

sample_reviews_en.text: Just looking at the storefront made my mouth water, so we ordered some food to take home. The crispy fried pork belly with its amazing dipping sauce was delicious, and the pork sausage and corn salad was also tasty. My boyfriend ordered the crispy pork belly with creamy egg, and he loved it. This will definitely be another restaurant we frequent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aui Kumjing

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good, the fermented fish sauce didn't have a strong smell.
The fried chicken and Thai steamed dessert were delicious, but many items were sold out, it seemed like the restaurant wasn't quite ready to sell them. The cockles weren't fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Little J Rabbiz

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered food through Line Man. I ordered a mixed salad for 450 baht, but received a very small portion. It was nothing like the advertised photo; the quantity was half of what was shown. Absolutely appalling. Never ordering from them again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duen Pim

sample_reviews_en.text: We actually walk past it often but never stopped in. But that day, I went to eat with my daughter. The restaurant is clean, quiet, and peaceful. The owner is lovely and does everything herself. It was delicious. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piano Life

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! It's hard to find a really good roadside spicy salad (Yum). This one is flavorful, you can order it spicy or sour, it's really tasty, and the portion is just right.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐพล ธนะสิกานนท์

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious. The price of the spicy salad was normal, neither cheap nor expensive. The shrimp were large and the pork sausage was tasty. The shop is near the police station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amara

restaurants.name: The Spicy House
restaurants.address:

60 อาคาร ศูนย์ประชุมแห่งชาติศิริกิติ์ Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is good and spicy as desired.
However, I think it's too pricey for the quality of ingredients they use, especially the meats (being out of the fridge for too long, they seem not fresh). I still prefer The Spicy House at Samyan Mitrtown to this branch.
You also have to pay an extra 50 THB for the Mala sauce if you order spicy soup.

The taste is as good as at Samyan Mitrtown, but I'd like to suggest improving the quality of the ingredients. They shouldn't put so many items out in the display case. I understand the display case is refrigerated, but it's not cold enough, causing the ingredients to not be fresh. This is especially noticeable with the meats and seafood. Lowering the price would make it more reasonable. Or maybe the staff weighed the ingredients incorrectly? Usually, they serve about the same portion size, but the price is very different from the Mitrtown branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: RAYA

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you love mala, this is another place I highly recommend. It's always crowded with people waiting in line to get in, and the wait was almost an hour.

At first, I was skeptical, but after trying the food, I realized it's a restaurant with strong flavors. The mala is medium spicy, just right, and the extra spicy level is really, really spicy. So, if you don't like spicy food, I wouldn't recommend ordering it too spicy, or you might be overwhelmed. The winter melon juice is delicious, served in a can, and it's refreshing. It also helps reduce the spiciness and richness of the mala.

If you want to try this place, I recommend making a reservation early, even before you're hungry, and then taking a stroll to kill time. I arrived at the restaurant just as I was starting to get hungry. If you can't finish your food, you can ask the restaurant to take it home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tak Tan Sriphatchayakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Spicy House, conveniently located inside the QSNCC, is a great spot for Mala lovers. As a big fan of Mala, I had to give it a try, and it did not disappoint! For those craving authentic Mala, The Spicy House offers both Mala Xiang Guo and Mala Tang, available in soup or dry versions.

I ordered the least spicy option, and it was exactly what I wanted, not spicy at all but still packed with that signature Mala taste. It pairs perfectly with a bowl of rice, making for a satisfying meal. The staff are friendly and happy to guide you through the process if you’re unfamiliar with how to order. You can pick and weigh your own ingredients by the gram or opt for one of their set menus. Whether you’re new to Mala or a longtime fan, this place is definitely worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Naw Hsu Ei Thin Zar (kk)

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are excessively high for the quality. They're significantly more expensive than other restaurants of the same caliber, and unreasonably so. There's no prior notification of prices before customers start serving themselves; only at checkout do you realize the restaurant charges for many different items, including vegetables, mushrooms, meat, and seafood. The system seems disorganized; I didn't order any seafood, but the bill included it. Furthermore, when weighing the food, the staff only separated the pork from other ingredients, but the bill listed the prices for multiple components, making it impossible to understand the calculation. They even charged for the dipping sauce, which tasted like pre-made sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Allow me to share my opinion as a customer.

I understand that the cost of ingredients and the quality of the food may be high, but what I find unacceptable is the pricing strategy and the overall menu structure. For example, the extra charge for dipping sauces or other elements that seem to add up, making the dining experience feel less worthwhile.

I hope you'd consider the customer's perspective. If you adjusted the menu sets or considered the reasonableness of the pricing, customers would likely be more impressed and want to return more.

Thank you for listening to my feedback. I hope you will make changes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joo Zugar

sample_reviews_en.text: After a disappointing meal at a different restaurant downstairs in the gorgeous Corner Ekkamai this past Friday, I walked past The Spicy House wishing that I had chosen this place instead. Notwithstanding, the very next evening, I came back to “The Corner” and had the most delicious hot pot at The Spicy House! I also loved that this restaurant gave a hot pot choice of “dry,” “dry with some soup,” or “soup.” Sometimes I see only “dry” or “soup” offerings at hot pot restaurants. The ingredients here were very fresh and amazing. The restaurant is right off the Ekkamai BTS stop. I will definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Griffin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pick your own ingredients: vegetables, meat, meatballs, squid, pork. There's a wide variety to choose from.
We ordered two Phuket meatballs, one pork meatball, three slices of pork, three pieces of bacon, two pieces of Chinese cabbage, two stalks of Chinese broccoli, one enoki mushroom, and one white mushroom.
Don't get carried away! You can choose your spice level. We chose extra spicy (though it wasn't too spicy), and you can choose between soup, dry, or a soup. The price is a bit steep, more expensive than the buffet.
But the mala soup was delicious, served in a giant bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saithip Kob

sample_reviews_en.text: Run away ~ The queue is quite long, tables are all squeezed together, sitting on top of each other with no way to walk. The price of the sauce is an additional charge + VAT, but you have to squeeze it yourself. No one explains what to do or how to do it. The staff doesn't speak clearly, maybe because they are foreigners, but they still don't speak clearly. The taste of all the food is bland. Ordered medium spicy, but it still wasn't spicy. The ingredients aren't that good. Compared to the price of ordering two bowls, almost 1000, very bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: SH ERE

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหาร J&B
restaurants.address:

215 รร.แกรนด์ไชน่า ชั้น5 Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a very quiet and friendly little food court-style restaurant. It's a Chinese-style Thai restaurant, but the portions and flavors are more than double the price. Food prices are usually between 90 and 150 baht.
If you happen to be in Chinatown,
take the stairs to the right of the China Grand Hotel, enter the entrance, and take the elevator directly in front to the 5th floor. J&B Restaurant is right there. Don't worry if it feels a bit strange, just try the food.
The food is filled with delicious sauces and the aroma of smoky fire.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna

sample_reviews_en.text: The coconut ice cream was delicious! The woman was incredibly hospitable and very friendly. We arrived because it was raining very hard outside, but the restaurant was already closed. Nevertheless, we were allowed to wait there and were able to get coconut ice cream. This restaurant deserves five stars for the hospitality with which we were received alone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Esther Mostert

sample_reviews_en.text: It is a small restaurant you might easily walk past. It is located in a large hotel on a corner. The food is super delicious, made with love. We all enjoyed it. We had a fish and chicken dish with cashews. Absolutely fantastic!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Selma

sample_reviews_en.text: It's quiet and not crowded. The air conditioning is cool. The food tastes a bit bland, but that's understandable since it's sold in a hotel. The ingredients are good. The coconut shake is very delicious. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Por-Ban Gamer

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s a restaurant I went to without thinking much about it.

It’s on the 5th floor, so it’s hard to get to unless you specifically look for it, but

the food tastes good.

Make sure to get a key when you go to the restroom.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hanoi Park

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Tom Kha was very nice. One of the best I must say.
But the chicken was terrible! Dry and fried without the flour! I specifically asked 3 times if it has bones and been assured that it hasn’t. It wasn’t eatable
sample_reviews_en.author: Dominik Rzepiel

sample_reviews_en.text: Recommended dishes: Hong Kong style crab noodles, stir-fried fish ball with chili paste. They're delicious! The restaurant has different fresh fish each day, so you can order anything you like.
sample_reviews_en.author: natthanicha zaii

sample_reviews_en.text:
I once ordered from Phat and the food was really delicious, even though I've never been to the restaurant.
I'm lucky to have met her. The food is amazing, I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Export Peak Logistic

restaurants.name: BAPSANG - the COMMONS Thonglor
restaurants.address:

335 Akkhara Phatsadu Alley Khwang, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐ Korean comfort food at The Commons 🥢
Warm soup, light rain, and a chill dinner spot.
Simple food that tastes good and feels right.

Bapsang is on the ground floor, near the elevator.
There are about three tables inside, but you can also sit outside if you want more space.

They don’t sell soft drinks, but the shop next door does, so you can just grab one there.

I went in the evening when it was raining and wanted something warm.
Ordered the kimchi soup set — mild flavor, good portion, just nice for the weather.

Easy, cozy, and good overall.

#MindyNReview #MindyNCarysme
sample_reviews_en.author: Mindy N. Carysme

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good, but it was very hard for me to enjoy eating because one of the supervising staff (woman with short hair) kept yelling at another staff (a man, maybe a trainee) throughout the entire meal. The man was very polite in his responses. The woman was very unkind. The entire staff looked stressed. I also felt stressed listening to her yell for a whole hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: MaCherie Doerfler

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was OK! I understand that we went during lunch time and the orders were packed. But when we get our foods , it was cold. The main thing was the cashier girl was very RUDE. ( the girl with short hair ) she couldn’t listen our order and even talk to us back with a very angry tone. I mean , we were just starting to ORDER ??!! CALM DOWN.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rebecca Ei Mon Han

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve been to this restaurant many times and I’ve repeatedly seen one of the Indian kitchen staff going outside with gloves on and returning to handle food without changing them. This happens very often and it’s quite concerning. Kitchen hygiene needs to be taken more seriously.
sample_reviews_en.author: zelia

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dujonku is delicious💕
The moist filling and the pistachios are so nutty
The hazelnuts taste like injeolmi
This is my first time trying black sesame dujonku, and it's unique and delicious, with a rice cake-like texture
I liked the hazelnut the best.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had the bulgogi beef as a set.
They should rename it bulgogi onion, as the majority are actual onions. Taste is ok, you get far better Korean all over Bangkok. For me it's a no repeat. Service is ok, asked for some spicy sauce, but she said NO ....
sample_reviews_en.author: Matthias Z

sample_reviews_en.text: The short-haired(bob-cut)cashier was very rude,0 for customer service.The food was below mid;mushy rice,bland flavors,i ordered pork bulgogi deopbap and it was cold even if i went and took right after it’s ready.Took 45 minutes to get my food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yu Waddi

sample_reviews_en.text: Korean food with terrible service. The female staff has a very poor attitude when taking orders, and the food takes a long time to arrive - can be 20-40mins. But they don’t inform you, so you keep waiting without knowing how long it takes.
sample_reviews_en.author: kai

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวลูกชิ้นหมูเด้ง เจ๊หน่อย

99 19 - 20 Nakhon Kuan Kan Rd, บางพึ่ง Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this place through Google. It was so delicious! The restaurant is clean. We came with 4 people and ordered 8 dishes. The seating is comfortable. It's open late until 2 AM. You should try it! The Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) was amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dao Reviewka

sample_reviews_en.text: I'll take pictures after I've finished eating, lol. The noodles are delicious and the price is good and cheap. The roast pork and crispy pork noodles are also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Namon Review

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this restaurant on Google Maps.
The food is good, fresh, clean, and delicious.
The price is reasonable and appropriate for the portion size.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattamavadee Didtawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup here is delicious and incredibly cheap. One of the best things you can order is their side dish 'crispy fried wanton'.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khunat Pongsiripoj

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! This is my go-to shop in the Phra Pradaeng area. The owner provides great service too! 👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: NIDA

restaurants.name: ChonGang Bar&Bistro
restaurants.address:

51 ถ. บางบอน 5 Bang Bon Nuea, Bang Bon, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow, this is amazing! I never thought I'd find a place like this in this out-of-town area...

The atmosphere is fantastic, luxurious, with expensive sofas. You have to experience it at least once. Taking photos here is something you won't be ashamed to share.

And the live music? Even the foreigners were impressed, saying they couldn't understand the lyrics. They really handpicked the musicians. This place is still new, but soon it will be a must-visit spot. Come visit, you won't be disappointed!

Truly outstanding, a 5 out of 5 for everything!
sample_reviews_en.author: light Worker of life

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice, the bass is good, and the music is age-appropriate. However, I have to criticize the food. It seems like it was just made to get it done, because people will want to eat it anyway. The fried rice was extremely oily, the fried chicken wings were very dry, and the roasted cashews seemed like they weren't properly roasted—they weren't crispy, more on the chewy side. I want to emphasize that food quality is a crucial factor in making people want to come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harry Potter

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to see the Fahrenheit concert on August 11, 1969. The restaurant advertised a free concert. I reserved a table for 1000 baht and got 6 bottles of Leo beer, with the remaining balance to be used as a discount on food. However, upon arrival, the discount didn't work. They suddenly changed the promotion. The restaurant was dishonest and lied to customers. The restrooms were also dirty. I was very unimpressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: จิณห์กรชยา เตชะวิวิธสิน

sample_reviews_en.text: We hadn't even gone inside yet, and the PR girls were standing around in a group, too shy to go in. My senior who was with me was afraid of being pressured into buying drinks, lol. But if you guys go by yourselves, with a full wallet, go for it! The PR girls are good-looking (from afar, of course, because we hadn't gone in yet). After parking, we discussed it again and decided to go to another bar nearby, lol.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aliz Maya

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing food and drinks! Must try the mango chicken! The owners son, Kitt, was so kind and knowledgeable! He sat with us and told us the best local spots. This is a family owned bar and restaurant that is authentic and a great experience for travelers. I am here to teach English in Bankkok and I will definitely be coming back! Best spot I’ve been to since I arrived in Bang Bon!
sample_reviews_en.author: allison kline

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is great for English speakers in the area who don't want to go all the way to Bangkok. Live music that usually do American covers. Owner speaks English and is very nice. Cheap drinks and food available.
sample_reviews_en.author: BDW

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is surprisingly cheap, the atmosphere is great, and the staff are very friendly and welcoming. It's perfect for bringing clients for business meetings. The music is nice, and the restrooms are clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattasit Sky

sample_reviews_en.text: The customer hasn't even left yet, why are they clearing out the food just to pee? Or is it because they've already paid the bill? They haven't even finished eating the fish yet, and there's jellyfish too.
sample_reviews_en.author: ๋JaJah KSD

restaurants.name: Abu Ibrahim Halal Restaurant
restaurants.address:

200 Pradiphat Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Owner and server were both very rude to me. Neither reciprocated even any decency or politeness. Said thank you 4 times, not one thank you back, intentionally omitted on the owner’s part. Just glares and a strong gut feeling they don’t wanna serve me. Smirks from the other staff. Atmosphere is completely dead. Such an uncomfortable feeling.

The price for the size and quality of the meal is pretty ridiculous too. It was so small! The taste is decent, I got mutton soup, but nowhere near worth the 210bhat. Everything w Nan, Lassi, and water was 320bhat. I haven’t felt this cheated in a while, even on a personal level.

Their attitude was one of the worst I’ve ever experienced. Seriously I hope I can save someone from coming here, don’t trust the reviews. Even if you payed me to eat here again, I would not go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karim A

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finding a good halal restaurant in this area can be difficult, so I was really happy to come across this place. It's peaceful, not crowded, and a comfortable spot to enjoy lunch or dinner.

The menu offers an interesting mix of fusion dishes, including Pad Krapao, Indian curry, and several other unexpected options. The food was tasty, portions were satisfying, and the prices were reasonable.

The owner is very friendly and welcoming. He even speaks Malay, which makes it easy for Malaysian visitors to communicate. If you're looking for halal food in the area with a relaxed atmosphere and warm hospitality, this place is definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniyal Saleem

sample_reviews_en.text:
Abu Ibrahim
This old Indian restaurant has been open since 1978, passed down through generations. The staff are friendly and welcoming, always ready to recommend dishes.
I tried the naan, chapati, goat leg soup, and grilled goat ribs, and they were all delicious. And of course, the lassi, or Indian-style yogurt smoothie, was refreshing.
Another restaurant I recommend trying.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Short answer: not recommended.
The taste is hardly okay. I mean it's edible, not more. There were ants on the table, It is clear that the restaurant does not care about cleanliness as required.
They don't have a card payment.
I ordered one milk tea, they put it in a plastic pack!!
sample_reviews_en.author: ZAID ALJOAN

sample_reviews_en.text: Good place, not crowded and food is not bad. They serve fusion dishes, got pad krapao, indian curry, and some things you would least expect. Owner is friendly, speaks malay and easy for malaysians to communicate too, friendly uncle.
sample_reviews_en.author: Riaz Shah

sample_reviews_en.text: Wonderful 40 years old vintage restaurant in Bangkok with delicious food. We had dinner with chicken tikka, chicken korma, garlic naan, grilled lamb chops and cold drinks. The price was most reasonable. Highly recommended in Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Sougata Ghosh

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried it and it was better than expected. Ordered goat biryani, bread with beef curry, and mushroom soup. Total was almost 600 baht. Delicious and good price. Clean handwashing facilities available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tikky

sample_reviews_en.text: Most of the common items werent available and took more time to serve the food. Waited for so long and when asked knew that they havent prepared it. To be honest the food werent so good
sample_reviews_en.author: Fathimath Ismail

restaurants.name: Piri Piri Flaming Grill Emporium
restaurants.address:

4th floor, 622 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
4 stars is generous, but I’ll tell you why I’m giving it four stars.

I ordered the tenderloin steak which was ฿680 came with fries and a salad. I did …
sample_reviews_th.author: Jason Denison

sample_reviews_en.text: Hi Mani, my sincerest apologies, I didn't intend to give such a low rating. I was surprised myself to see that score. I'm correcting it now with this comment. To be honest, your chicken is fabulous and deserves a 5/5 on its own. However, I would like to comment on the use of 'Portugal' even when a dish has nothing Portuguese about it. It's something that's noticeable in one of your visual presentation materials. We greatly appreciate that there are people who want to promote our gastronomy so far from Portugal, but I think it shouldn't be used as a marketing argument for dishes that are certainly from other parts of the Mediterranean. I hope you don't take offense; once again, our dinner with you was a success and a very pleasant experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joana Da Graça

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a long time since I had chicken at this restaurant. I was craving the honey mustard flavor, so I stopped by. When the chicken was served, it wasn't the same as what I used to have. Instead of grilling it and basting it with sauce until the skin was juicy, they just squeezed the sauce directly onto the chicken. It's not the same anymore. My era is over. Don't bother thinking about honey mustard grilled chicken anymore. The garlic butter clams were okay. The chicken liver with peri peri sauce was good; the liver was good and the sauce was good. It was acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: cloud549

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying this restaurant, and I was surprised by how spicy the grilled chicken was! I didn’t expect it to be that spicy, but it was delicious and full of flavor. They also offer a wide variety of sauces, and each one gives the chicken a different taste experience. The grilled chicken breast was nicely cooked and not oily, served with fresh salad and crispy fries. I tried the chicken with every sauce provided by the restaurant, and honestly each combination tasted great in its own way. A really enjoyable meal and worth trying for spicy food lovers!
sample_reviews_en.author: Minky Somtong

sample_reviews_en.text:
A handy spot for a quick bite to eat on the 4th floor of Emporium. It's close by the escalator heading up to the cinema in food court area.

Piri Piri Chicken Burger 285 baht with fries was fresh, spicy and tasty. The service is very efficient and my meal was quickly freshly cooked and served.

Adding a bottle of water the total bill 370.76( 10% service, 7% tax added to the meal prices).

Part of a chain but this is a decent branch. Comfortable seating too makes it a decent option.
sample_reviews_en.author: D J

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pretty disappointing. It's a copy of Nandos, at the same price as Nandos anywhere in Europe, but everything comes nowhere as near.

The "two chicken breasts" burger was pieces of chicken breast, so it was less than 2 full chicken breasts... presentation was bad too.. photo shows I took a bite before photo but the plate was half empty on delivery.

Was already disappointed at the price I was about to pay, before they banged the 17% on for service & vat..
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris

sample_reviews_en.text: When one google Portuguese food in Bangkok this one pops up top of the list.  Despite frequenting the food court at emporium quite often we somehow didn’t make an effort but finally after trying out several Spanish meals during the Songkran week.  I must say this place was a super deal.  I opted for the lemony sea bass, my daughter chose the chicken skewers. The portions were good and the food tasted really good. Will visit it again !
sample_reviews_en.author: Bale Takhel

sample_reviews_en.text: Burger was good,  price is fairly cheap for this area,  they don't charge service fees or tax which is very good so I will eat here again. the mall is a nice place,  easy to get to. Staff are polite and service is good. They have a good selecting of food,  great for kids as well. I will come here again when I need a burger. I also like this mall,  often busy which is always a good sign.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brendon

restaurants.name: Khun Aeo Vegetarian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

1998/54 ซอย ประชาสงเคราะห์ 32 Pracha Songkhro Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoyed eating here daily while staying in Huai Kwang area. Conveniently located 10 mins or so walk from MRT station and easy to catch most busses from the area as well. Found toward the end of the busy street market, be mindful of cars/motorbikes. Lovely ladies working in this Jay restaurant will always greet you with a smile. Delicious and affordable vegan food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Pittman

sample_reviews_en.text: Really tasty vegetarian food for legit Thai palates. Not dumbed down flavours for foreigners. Thai buffet style where the servers get a plate of rice and then they plate up whichever dishes you want. I ended up getting two full plates because I wanted to try so many things and it came to about 150 baht. Really friendly staff too.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Firth

sample_reviews_en.text: Good for your health! Come support the vegetarian food at Huai Khwang Fresh Market. They offer a variety of dishes, it's clean, delicious, and the prices are reasonable. The vendors are all lovely and kind. Buy food, dried goods, and natural herbal drinks to take home and enjoy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chokchai Ekataksin

sample_reviews_en.text: Great spicy vegan food! You can get a plate with rice (quite a lot of it) and choose which toppings you want to add. Staff does not speak English, but just point at the toppings and they will understand. The mock meat is very good! Price is …
sample_reviews_en.author: Esther

sample_reviews_en.text: Busy day during J (vegetarian) festival, staff was patient and helpful, and the lady who served me spoke useful English. We buy vegetarian food here every October during the J Festival. Bought enough food for 6 or 8 people for 300 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bill Horgan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great vegan food. The noddle soup was amazing. Curries are also very good. Everything is a little more spicy compared to most other vegan
Khao gaeng Restaurants. Very good!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mattias Gebhart

sample_reviews_en.text: They have rice with curry and noodles, no à la carte dishes. The food is delicious and the taste is great. I ate there near closing time and the food was still okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: นิภาพร เพิงจันดา

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and high-quality vegetarian food is available in many varieties at reasonable prices, and importantly, it's hard to find it elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: oz chan

restaurants.name: อี้จาหม่าล่าทั่ง สาขาอุดมสุข
restaurants.address:

307 Udom Suk 7, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best mala tang spots in the Udomsuk area. The shop is clean, well-organized, and very comfortable to eat in. Ingredients are fresh and there’s a wide variety to choose such vegetables, mushrooms, tofu, noodles, meats, and seafood, all displayed nicely and refilled regularly.

The mala broth is rich, fragrant, and well balanced. You can really taste the spices, and the numbing sensation is just right without being too overwhelming. I like that you can choose your own spice level, so it works for both people who love very spicy mala and those who prefer something milder. The soup stays flavorful until the last bite and doesn’t feel too oily.

Portions are generous for the price, and the quality is consistent every time. Staff are friendly and helpful, especially if you’re not sure how the system works or what spice level to choose. Service is quite fast even when the shop is busy.

Overall, a very satisfying mala tang experience with great value for money. Definitely a place I would recommend if you’re around Udomsuk and craving something warm, spicy, and comforting. Will come back again for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elio Merval

sample_reviews_en.text: My first visit was impressive; the food came quickly and was fine. However, on my second visit, there was a queue. I waited outside the restaurant, but suddenly two students walked in and started getting food right away. I thought they were taking it home, but no! They got a table and food before me, even though I arrived first. I was furious, both the restaurant staff and those two students. They should have been more considerate; it was obvious there was a queue and the restaurant was full. Instead of asking the staff first, they just started choosing their items. The restaurant itself didn't manage the queue properly. Even though the queue wasn't long at that time, it was very infuriating to be "cut in line." Who likes being cut in line? Please improve your queue management. It's a shame because the food is delicious, but the service and queue management are poor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phatnaree Nithithornpornkul

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered via LINE and waited for hours. I called the first time and they said they would follow up, so I waited. I called again and they said to wait another 10 minutes. When I checked the time, almost 20 minutes had passed and I still hadn't received my order. They said there was no rider to pick it up. Okay, I understood. So I said I would pick it up myself at the store because I had been waiting so long. But they still told me to wait and wouldn't let me. It's like they forgot to make the order or something, I don't understand. They made me wait this long without even calling to inform me. If there's no rider available, shouldn't they at least call? I waited over an hour. I've never waited this long before. Please pay attention to my orders!
sample_reviews_en.author: Irada Chatree

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good prices, but the restaurant was very dirty and seemed unprepared for service. There were many customers and not enough tables. When ordering takeout, they only gave one small container of dipping sauce; at least two would be better.

Update 3/7/25
Today was very impressive! The welcome was excellent. I'm not sure if it was the owner.
1. The restaurant is much cleaner now and more pleasant to sit in.
2. The tissues are no longer torn.
3. The food selection is quite full.
4. It's not as slow as before (previously, it seemed like there were only three staff members and they couldn't keep up with the customers).
**Overall, it's much better. We've eaten there more than 5 times (but only for takeout).
sample_reviews_en.author: สุดารัตน์ สวนสีดา

sample_reviews_en.text:
First of all, the cleanliness needs significant improvement. The floor was dirty, and the place looked unprepared for service. As for the service, the staff didn't introduce themselves or greet us at all upon entering. We were left confused, and there were no clear signs indicating the service points.
The food taste was okay, not bad for the price, and good value. However, both the service and cleanliness need improvement. On the day we went, we waited for our food for less than 20 minutes, which was acceptable for us as it wasn't too long, but the restaurant's system needs better organization.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonwan Phuruangthai

sample_reviews_en.text: I go there very often, but there aren't many tables. If you don't want to wait in line, go on a weekday before 6 PM to get a seat. There's a wide variety of food to choose from, it's clean, and they replenish it constantly. I recommend the mild mala soup; it has a perfect flavor that you can eat continuously. The staff service gets better every time I go; they're more polite and courteous. What I like most is that the staff don't rush when cooking the ingredients, ensuring everything is perfectly cooked, tender, and easy to chew.
sample_reviews_en.author: OS Wiw

sample_reviews_en.text: There are so many things to choose from. There's only pork belly, fried tofu skin, and chicken eggs, which cost an additional 10-20 baht. Try the dry stir-fried mala. You can choose between very spicy and less spicy. It's delicious, not 10. Then order the mala soup, which is a soup mixed with mala and pork bones. It's really good. The dipping sauce is delicious, in the Yija style. Note: Be careful of wheel locks when parking in front of the shop. You can park after 10 p.m. If you come early, park in Soi 5. Parking fee is 10 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: PORSCHE REPORTER

sample_reviews_en.text:
I feel like the food I picked, weighed, and paid for wasn't complete.
I intentionally counted how many pieces of each item I wanted.

But after it was cooked,
it wasn't all there. This has happened both times I've bought from them.
But I thought maybe the staff accidentally dropped something while pouring or boiling it? That's probably it.

Next time, I might secretly film a video of me picking and paying for the food, and then again when it arrived.
Then we can clearly see if I get all the pieces I selected.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khunn Audit

restaurants.name: ยายทำให้หลานขาย อารีย์ 1
restaurants.address:

2 3 Phahon Yothin 7, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
A taking out Thai sweet shop where’s located at Ari alley. (You can follow from the location and opening day!)🔔
There’s various types of Traditional Thai desserts such as “วุ้นกะทิ” Coconut jelly, “ขนมชั้น” Chewy Thai coconut mochi(as quite its description)), “ขนมใส่ไส้” coconut bomb with secret Thai filling 😅
Their bestseller ’s ขนมใส่ไส้ which always sold out before 8.30 am (you have to pre-order for sure)
sample_reviews_th.author: Thanthip Trisurat EVE

sample_reviews_th.text:
This dessert shop is a favorite among office workers in the Ari area. Everyone buys from here.
But sometimes I think the prices are a bit high, starting at 50฿ per box.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jantana S.

sample_reviews_en.text: About 10 meters from the entrance of Soi Ari 1, on the right-hand side, is a small soi (lane) just wide enough for cars to pass through. The shop is on the right-hand side. They now have a wider variety of products for sale, so you don't have to scramble to buy like before. There is no parking; you have to find parking along the side of the road or park at Villa Market and cross over.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anocha - あのちゃ

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't know the regular price, but they had a booth at Q House and this box cost 60 baht, and there was no price tag anywhere. It's probably expensive because of the rent. If this is the regular price, it's probably too expensive. The taste is pretty much the same as anywhere else, but they should have displayed the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aun Kung

sample_reviews_en.text: Coconut milk pudding dumplings, 4 dumplings per box. The coconut milk is not too sweet and has a slightly salty taste. The dumplings are filled with fresh coconut flakes, which are sweet. When eaten with the pudding, the sweetness is just right. They are delicious and look beautiful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fok Gloria

sample_reviews_en.text: They now have a branch in Wang Hin, located in front of a famous boat noodle shop in the area. They have more desserts than when they were located opposite Wat Ladprao, and they taste just as delicious as before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phakwipha Kaewwisit

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered delivery through Robinhood. The shop packed everything very well, and the driver drove well.
The taste was delicious. I bought stuffed pastries, banana cakes, coconut jelly, and young coconut jelly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vee Thavee

sample_reviews_en.text: I found it at a booth at an event. 60 baht per box. I bought some sticky rice pudding and pandan-flavored jelly to try. They had a nice pandan aroma, but the taste was just average, nothing amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chachi yo

restaurants.name: จันทร์เจ้า - CHAN CHAO
restaurants.address:

MJX6+MQF, Sukhumvit 97/1 Alley, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Road side restaurant on Sukhumvit SOI 97.  Need to order food and drinks via a QR code which links to an online menu. It seems to work Ok. Ordered the Isaan food and a couple of beers.  The food was good and the beers cold. Prices seemed to be slightly higher than normal street food. A large flat screen showing YouTube videos provides the entertainment but the sound system is excellent.  It wasn't busy on a Monday night so plenty of free tables. Good friendly service and plenty of off street parking.  Recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Neil McArthur

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times, but the food quality keeps getting worse. The fried beef tongue with garlic was tough and chewy, causing jaw pain, like they'd reused old tongue. The seafood tom yum soup was overwhelmingly sweet, and the salmon salad had fresh-looking salmon on top, but the salmon inside seemed old, pale, and not fresh at all.
Three dishes for 700 baht. I feel like I wasted my money. I probably won't go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zhenx Hairdog

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good, and most importantly, the service was excellent. Everyone was lovely! 🥰🥰
The restrooms were very clean, with hand sanitizer and tissues readily available in multiple locations. These little things make a great impression! 🥰🥰
There was plenty of parking, the atmosphere was airy and spacious, and the chairs were comfortable – no back pain! 😍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Lhin PinG

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is expensive and the taste is just okay. The service is good, but they should send the female owner away. Her behavior is so rude, it's like she's running a boxing camp. Her words and actions are completely unfiltered, driven only by emotion, and she thinks she's the boss.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aa Aa

sample_reviews_en.text: It felt like a camping spot, the atmosphere was great, and the service was excellent. Sitting and enjoying hot pot, listening to soft music, and sipping on cold beer was pure bliss. The food was delicious, the prices were reasonable, and the portions were generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tum Thanyathep

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a weekend night, but perhaps due to the rainy season, there were only four local customers. The prices weren't very reasonable, and there were no Grab services available...but the staff were friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papa Tanukimusuko

sample_reviews_en.text:
New place close to where I live
Good food comfortable seating
Good prices and beers at 90thb or 249 for 3 large beers
Thai and isaan food no western
Also no a/C but enough bentilators
sample_reviews_en.author: geert reygaert

sample_reviews_en.text: There are fans, but it's still hot and smelly. The food isn't very good, especially considering the price. Some staff members provide good service. The restaurant is also noisy.
sample_reviews_en.author: YJJS G7

restaurants.name: นิดะห์ข้าวมันไก่ข้าวหมกไก่
restaurants.address:

2027 ข้าง 1 ซ. อ่อนนุช 39 แขวง อ่อนนุช Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

restaurants.name: Bali Hai By The Sea
restaurants.address:

WVF9+WG8, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really bad, dreadful, not sure it qualifies as a restaurant. I’m still sitting here, looking at the waitress that I ordered a bottled beer from 10mins ago standing at the bar playing on her phone. It’s a bottled beer, it’s in the fridge next to her, just pick it up, open it, bring it here and then go play on your phone? I’d give her the benefit of the doubt but this is the 3rd beer it’s happened with.

The service is non-existent, nobody seated us, nobody brought a menu over until we asked and then only 2 when we needed 4. Had to call someone 20mins later to place order, then 1 persons food comes out 20mins after (it was below mediocre, frozen supermarket food warmed up), then another persons 20 mins after that and the last persons food 10mins after that. All of it was terrible.

All of this is bad, but when you consider the prices they charge in comparison to anywhere else, HOW are they in business????
sample_reviews_en.author: Rory Cook

sample_reviews_en.text: They said the steak would take about 30 minutes, so I said okay and waited, but it didn't come out even after 30 minutes. The server said it would take another 30 minutes, then suddenly a supervisor said it would only take 10 minutes, but it still didn't come out even after 20 minutes. I was so pissed off that I left. There were tons of mosquitoes, and they couldn't speak English.
sample_reviews_en.author: YJ LEe

sample_reviews_en.text:
This buffet was incredibly disappointing. There was no free-flow drinks; what buffet doesn't offer free drinks? Only the first drink was free. The seafood barbecue was okay, but after 7 pm, all the beef barbecue was gone—it was all taken, and they didn't restock. There was a live band, which created a good atmosphere.

In conclusion, this buffet wasn't worth 888 Baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: 杨誉

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful, in front of the beach, with great music and nice atmosphere. Food was delicious, and there are multiple veggie options. The dish sizes are pretty good. Unfortunately, the service was quite bad. The staff is very young and does not seem to have any training.
sample_reviews_en.author: Silvi N

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was on the expensive side, the taste was acceptable, but the drinks were terrible.
I recommend the barbecue seafood platter; although it's a two-person portion, the portion size is quite large, and the seafood is fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Chang

sample_reviews_en.text: Beautiful scenery and people, friendly and great service. Outdoors eating breathtaking views. Oh, food is delicious, be careful if you like spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lyndon Kraft

sample_reviews_en.text: Great atmosphere, beautiful view of Laem Bali Hai pier, delicious food. After COVID, the seafood buffet is only available on Saturdays.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanthasiri Sangthong

sample_reviews_en.text: It was great! The weather was nice, the view was beautiful, the food was delicious, and all the staff were lovely. ☺️🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Ant PPK

restaurants.name: MK Restaurants @ Lotus's Prachachuen
restaurants.address:

829 Pracha Rat Sai 2 Rd, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
MK Restaurant is located on the 1st floor of Lotus Prachachuen shopping mall.

Currently, they have a buffet promotion for 299 THB (net price). This branch closes at 10:00 PM. For the buffet, you must arrive to queue before 8:30 PM, and the last order is approximately 9:15 PM.

In addition to family-friendly sukiyaki, they also offer à la carte dishes such as sukiyaki soup/dry, duck rice, crispy pork rice, etc.

For dim sum lovers, they also sell steamed buns.

MK truly maintains its high standards across all its branches.

The restaurant accepts cash, QR code payments, and credit cards (no credit card transaction fees).
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Delicious food, good service, and a nice atmosphere."

I've eaten at this MK branch many times. The food is fresh and clean, and the roast duck is as delicious as ever. I love the jade noodles and the unique sukiyaki dipping sauce. The staff are quick and polite, even when it's busy in the evenings, the management is still good.

The atmosphere in the restaurant isn't very quiet because there are many people, but the tables are well-arranged and comfortable. Overall, I'm impressed. I deducted one star because there was a slight wait for food at times, but I would definitely go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: P Peepo

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered duck rice to take home. The staff made me stand and wait but spoke well. Ordering to take home is not like eating at the restaurant. When ordering outside, it's like eating at the restaurant. When eating at the restaurant, the rice is fragrant and very soft jasmine, but when ordering to take home, the rice is very hard. The duck is sliced ​​very thinly. For 90 baht, the meat is tough. I'd like this to be improved.
sample_reviews_en.author: Morakot Charaviwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here twice. The wait was very long. When I asked about my order, the staff forgot to write down my food order. If I hadn't asked, I probably would have waited until the restaurant closed...
And even after I asked, the food arrived incorrectly... lol
Just imagine, a hungry person coming to eat, but the wait is too long, how would you feel?
sample_reviews_en.author: พ.อ. ณฤทธ์ กล้ายประยงค์

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came for the MK Buffet 299 baht. I was the first customer! This branch has a steady stream of customers, and the food comes out quickly. It's early in the morning, so there aren't many people yet.

The restaurant opens at 9:30 AM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kra Jeab

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff didn't seem very enthusiastic about providing service. The slightly plump female manager was great, but the slim female manager was very attentive to every table. The customer service needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krits Hong

sample_reviews_en.text: Please follow "WhereTopGo" on YouTube! I was very impressed. The service was excellent, they gave great advice, the food was delicious and healthy, and there was plenty of parking. Excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: -WhereTopGo- Youtube

sample_reviews_en.text: Hey!!! Every year on my friends' birthdays, I have to bring them here. We get free snacks and free framed photos, it's so cute! And most importantly, you can't miss the stewed rice dish!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: teddy teddy

restaurants.name: Meridian Cruise
restaurants.address:

Meridian Cruise Co., Ltd 1343 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My boyfriend and I booked a dinner cruise through Trip. After booking, we contacted the staff to request our seats and were very helpful in getting the seats we wanted, which was great. We boarded the cruise at Icon Siam pier. It was a little chaotic when boarding because several cruises were departing at the same time, so people crowded around the pier.
The tables at the front of the cruise had a great view with nothing blocking it, but other customers might walk over and stand next to your table to take pictures. Also, the lighting was a bit dim, resulting in dark photos, with only the small lamps on the tables helping to illuminate the scene. I think the photos would be better if we sat further inside with brighter lighting. The live music had a beautiful singer who was very entertaining and sang songs from almost every country on board. Foreigners would get up and dance when their own language songs came on, which was fun to watch. The staff provided good service, and the food was plentiful and constantly refilled. The cruise lasted about 2 hours, and the scenery along the way was beautiful. I recommend sitting by the sides. It's perfect for a dinner date.
sample_reviews_en.author: mizcandy cawaii

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dining on a cruise ship is a fun and worthwhile experience when visiting Thailand. The ship glides along the river, creating a romantic and relaxing atmosphere. However, the food was only average. The dishes featured shrimp and salmon, suitable for seafood lovers, but the others were just average, nothing special. The menu wasn't very extensive, and the quality of the dishes wasn't outstanding.

A big plus is the complimentary water and tea, helping you relax throughout the meal. The atmosphere on board was quite cheerful, with singers providing entertainment, creating a lively and enjoyable dining experience. However, it was a bit disappointing that the staff didn't call out Vietnamese names when calling guests, despite the large number of Vietnamese passengers on board. This made the atmosphere a little somber, possibly because they didn't know how to sing Vietnamese songs.

Additionally, during check-in, the staff at the table were rather unpleasant and unfriendly, which dampened my initial positive experience. Overall, however, everything was fine, and I think it was a unique experience that you should try if you have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nguyễn Ân

sample_reviews_en.text:
I used this service for a night cruise.
Tickets are picked up at a dedicated desk outside ICONSIAM before the cruise begins.
Once you receive your ticket, you have free time until boarding.
I chose a slightly VIP seat, but the cheaper seats on the second floor had better views, and although there was no air conditioning, it looked like it would be nice to enjoy the night breeze.
So, after eating, I ended up sitting outside and enjoying the night view.
The food was served buffet-style, with a wide variety of dishes.
There was live band music and dancing on board.
The salmon was delicious.
Drinks were all-you-can-drink, but only juice was available.
And you had to fill your own bottles with the juice.
The cruise departed at 8 PM and lasted about two hours.
We went upstream, passed ICONSIAM, went downstream, and then returned.
We passed many other cruise ships.
If you sit at the bow, water occasionally splashes on you (´；ω；`)
But the night breeze was very pleasant, and everyone was enveloped in a sense of freedom. I felt so comfortable just gazing at the night view.
sample_reviews_en.author: komasan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Indo tourist in here!

Enjoying sunset while having dinner on a ferry boat was quite an experience. The food stalls were all yours for the whole 2 hours. They have 2 shift where it starts at 5pm and 7pm. Booking in advanced is needed as the seat is limited. It is recommended to book online as sometimes price could be cheaper.

All the food is halal food so it's Muslim friendly. The food varies between meat, vegetables, sushi, and a lot of cake and snacks as a dessert. The seats are already being set  by the organizer and we can't move if it's all already full. The taste is quite good for the price but in here I thought the scenery was amazing.

Even though having dinner on the boat, the wave is not that big and you can enjoy your dinner peacefully. Watching the sunset and having evening breeze while enjoying Bangkok skyscaper alongsidecthe river became the most memorable experience in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Geraldy Previanza

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went on the Meridian 2 Sunset cruise.

I really enjoyed the food and think it is good value. The top floor was all booked up so we ended up on the bottom floor. The reason I didn't give the cruise 5 stars is they didn't tell us that some of the food was only available upstairs. I was confused where some of the advertised food and tea and coffee was, and eventually found it upstairs.

Also, the cruise promised entertainment. We had none. Why? Because the singers only performed upstairs despite there being a mic and stands downstairs. Felt like anyone downstairs wasn't seen as important.

I went out the front for the views and realized there was live singing upstairs. On the plus side downstairs was quiet.

Enjoyed the food and views regardless.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melanie Esterman

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time on a river cruise in Thailand for dinner.
I made a reservation on the website, specifying a seat on the upper deck.
Seats are reserved in advance, but luckily I was able to sit at the front, which has no roof.
However, being at the front made me feel a little uneasy as other guests came to take photos, but still, eating while enjoying the view from here was amazing.
Being a river cruise, I wasn't expecting much from the food, but I was wrong; there was a wide selection and it was warm and delicious.
I was happy that the staff were so considerate, probably because I ordered a bottle of Thailand's famous rum.
It was lucky that fireworks were set off for 10 minutes that day, as it was a wedding for a wealthy Indian couple.
sample_reviews_en.author: K-2

sample_reviews_en.text: We took a sunset cruise on the Meridian Cruise Line 1. It was the best value for money, and although we were a little worried, it was perfect for enjoying the atmosphere. Choosing the quiet front deck for just the two of us, away from the lively live music, was the right decision for us. We were able to take lots of beautiful photos and relax with beer (for an extra charge). Last year, we took a dinner cruise departing from the opposite shore. There are so many boats to choose from, but we found that the sunset cruise is just as enjoyable. In August, it was bright when we went out, but the sun had set when we returned.
sample_reviews_en.author: 黒良

sample_reviews_en.text:
Booked Meridian Dinner Cruise (745PM-945PM) through Klook for $25 each (with discount) for my in-laws birthday for 10 PAX.

Boarding went smoothly even though with long line.  They have covered spot with chairs as a waiting area.

Wasn’t impressed with the food.  Always runs out and slow refill.  Hot foods should be served as hot.  I didn’t even get the grilled river prawns, which is listed on the menu.

At least we enjoyed the show with talented singers and dancers.  Great selections of songs too.  Also, great views along the way.

Recommended but try to first check reviews of the other boat cruise for options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher U

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารอินเตอร์
restaurants.address:

146/45 ถ. วิสุทธิกษัตริย์ Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered through a food delivery app.
The rice set with shrimp paste chili dip included one mackerel, one boiled egg, a moderate amount of fried vegetables, and some fresh vegetables. The price was inexpensive, but there was a bit too much oil. The packaging wasn't very good, and some chili dip spilled. 99 baht.
The mixed vegetable stew was a bit bitter. 50 baht.
The rice was the kind you'd find at a typical Thai curry rice shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Venus Vannaprapa

sample_reviews_en.text: I love the food here. The Pad Krapao was very aromatic and tasted excellent. The cook was also very nice and prepared a plate with three different dishes for me, as I wanted to try as much of the delicious food as possible. What can I say? Everything was very, very good! 👍 Thank you so much for having me as your guest.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefan K.

sample_reviews_en.text: The khao kaeng is so delicious and tasty,I often pack dishes seperately for dinner after having lunch because it is that good and keeps well in the fridge.The staff are all smiles, hospitable and 2 of the young adults speak English well,if Thai is not your strong suit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jerome Francis

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Thai restaurant with bold and delicious flavors; almost every dish is tasty. The prices are affordable, so I eat there very often. Plus, it's extremely popular with foreign tourists. Every time I go, I have to wait in line for at least half an hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apple Rungrat

sample_reviews_en.text:
German
Very, very tasty. It looks great and tastes even better! Pleasant spiciness. The portion is just right. We'll be back.

English
Very, very tasty. It looks great and tastes even better! Pleasant spiciness. The portion is just right. We'll be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruben

sample_reviews_en.text: The à la carte dishes are delicious, the portions are generous, the prices are affordable, and the food comes out quickly if you go before
sample_reviews_en.author: Hating

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely delicious. Menu in Thai and English. One of the best meals we have had all holiday in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Colette Parkinson

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were polite and lovely, the food was very hot and clean, and parking was very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: มนตรี อัมววรรณ์

restaurants.name: Yamaguchi Ginza Restaurant
restaurants.address:

78, 43 Moo 9 Nongprue Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Pattaya food disaster #1: Being from northern China, I love noodles, so I braved the blazing sun to eat at a noodle shop. The noodles I ordered were only spicy and tasted bland. A beef bowl cost 200฿, but there were only five pieces of beef, and they were incredibly tough and dry, a real pain to chew. Unbelievable!
sample_reviews_th.author: Lucas Liu

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem of Sichuan cuisine, nestled in a foreign land, is a veritable culinary oasis for overseas gourmets. Its uniquely crafted noodle soup is a Southeast Asian marvel, the springy noodles infused with the rich aroma of Sichuan, a flavor that transcends mountains and seas. Every bite evokes a breathtaking taste memory—such exquisite craftsmanship is hard to find even in the seventy-two provinces of Siam. For those long residing abroad, this is a haven of comfort for the Chinese palate, especially its stunning cold-served beef: the carefully selected beef first bursts with a numbing, spicy sensation, followed by waves of rich aroma that unfold in layers, culminating in a breathtaking explosion of flavor in the throat—a pinnacle of Sichuan culinary aesthetics. The flavors here are enough to rekindle the warmth of home in every Chinese stomach.
sample_reviews_en.author: 王星月

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pattaya foodies craving Sichuan and Chongqing flavors, gather here! 🙋‍♀️ This Shuangjie Noodle Shop completely cured my homesickness! Most of the food is air-shipped from Chongqing. One bite of the noodles and you can't stop eating – the broth is so delicious, you have to drink it all! It tastes just like the old streets back home!

You can't go wrong with anything!!

The pea and minced meat noodles are savory and addictive, the red oil wontons are a taste of home, the hidden gem of a hot pot with braised beef brisket and potatoes is incredibly delicious with rice, and the braised duck neck and head are also amazing!

The large private rooms on the second floor are perfect for gatherings and late-night snacks. The Chongqing owner is super nice, proactively recommending hidden dishes and sharing food stories. I had a wonderful time eating there!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pinky Harry

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was moved to tears when I ate this Chongqing noodle soup in Pattaya 😭! Who would have thought that Chinese food overseas could be so authentic? It completely shattered my stereotypes!

Pea and Minced Meat Noodles: Go for it! The peas are soft and chewy, and the minced meat sauce is savory and rich.
Every noodle is coated in sauce, the spiciness is just right, I can't stop slurping!
Pork Intestine Noodles: A dream come true for pork intestine lovers! The pork intestines are incredibly clean and perfectly braised.
The spiciness is just right, a bite of pork intestine followed by a bite of noodles, so delicious I'll lick the bowl clean!
Beef Noodles: Absolutely amazing! The beef chunks are ridiculously large, stewed until tender and juicy.
The meat is incredibly flavorful, and after slurping the noodles, a sip of the soup brings pure bliss.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joey

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn't expect to eat Chinese food in Pattaya, but this noodle shop totally surprised me!

Authentic Chongqing flavor, it tasted just like the noodles downstairs from my hometown! ✅

The pea and minced meat noodles are a must-try! The peas are so soft they melt in your mouth, and the minced meat sauce is incredibly generous.
The sauce coats the noodles perfectly, spicy and savory, it's so satisfying to slurp up!

The pork intestine noodles are a must-order! The pork intestines have no unpleasant smell, they're braised until tender and flavorful.
The spicy kick is amazing, one bite is so satisfying!

The beef noodles are divine! The beef chunks are ridiculously large, stewed until they're so tender they fall off the bone.
The meat is incredibly flavorful, every bite is packed with goodness, and the value is unbeatable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Qi Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very sincere little restaurant with exquisite decor and thoughtfully prepared food. It's especially suitable for dining alone. The wontons are both numbing and spicy, but there were no green vegetables inside; I had to add the water spinach separately. If you're like me and can't handle too much spice but still crave vegetables, you must have a smoothie with it. I recommend the coconut cocoa; the portion is generous, and it's served on a chocolate smoothie base. It's not too sweet, making for a perfect meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: xinyuan zhang

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice noodles were unappetizing, to say the least. What was most infuriating was that a huge gray rat, about two palm-lengths long, scurried out from under our table, crossing right past my feet. I was even wearing slippers today! It was disgusting! I couldn't eat anymore. I tried to report the hygiene issue to the manager, but the staff said the manager wasn't there, and they seemed completely uninterested in my description of the hygiene problems. It's hard to imagine the hygiene conditions of this restaurant. 😠
sample_reviews_en.author: Kai von Imhoff

sample_reviews_en.text:
Twice-cooked pork. Extremely salty.
The pickled fish was too bland; later they mentioned the kitchen cleaned it again and it tasted much better.
The steamed buns had a piece of ginger inside. I didn't like it. But the filling was quite good, similar to xiaolongbao (soup dumplings), six in a pack.
The wontons were the best of the meal.
The tangerine peel smoothie was surprisingly delicious. Very refreshing. Not bitter. I liked it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 张婷婷

restaurants.name: อิเจ้แจ่วฮ้อน&ชาบู สาขา One Bangkok
restaurants.address:

PGGW+8W3 ลุมพินี Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
We went for lunch on January 18th and 19th, two days in a row. We barely took any pictures because we were so hungry! 😅 Everything was delicious. The pork was high-quality. I hope they maintain this standard. The papaya salad was already great, and the "Tam Krathai" (spicy papaya salad with various toppings) was excellent.
The restaurant was clean, and the utensils were really good. I loved it. I'm a little disappointed they were out of lod chong (Thai dessert) on the 19th. 🥲
This is one of my favorite restaurants. I recommend you come; you'll be hooked like I was.
For the soup, we chose the Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce) and Truffle soup. 👍🏼
There's a 100฿ discount promotion until the end of January.
sample_reviews_th.author: Mai T.

sample_reviews_th.text: Tried the all-you-can-eat at อิเจ้แจ่วฮ้อน One Bangkok. While the place offers a great value promotion, the overall freshness of the ingredients could be improved. Some items, especially the marinated egg, had an off smell. A fair choice if you’re going for the price, but not the top pick for ingredient quality.
sample_reviews_th.author: Veerapat Charinkan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The new branch at One Bkk is great!

The staff are lovely and attentive, constantly checking on food, clearing plates, and refilling soup without being asked.

The food is of standard quality. The Northeastern Thai dishes are tasty, and the Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce) soup and dipping sauces are delicious. However, I wasn't a fan of the beef and pork, not because they weren't fresh, but because they were sliced ​​way too thick. The shrimp was excellent; the texture wasn't mushy, and it was sweet. The squid was also delicious and large. They were out of sea bass the day I went, so I only had the whole tilapia, which seemed fresh with clear eyes and sweet flesh, but it had that typical tilapia smell.
