People who don't like that smell probably won't.

The location is at One Bkk, but there were a couple of annoying flies, so I deducted a point for that.

Oh, the Thai steamed pudding was delicious!

I'll wait until things settle down before going back to try it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirayu Visanuruk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I tried this place. They have a wide variety of food, including papaya salad, Thai food, and even Jaew Hon Shabu. They currently have a promotion with a 100 baht discount per person, so I decided to give it a try.

The Jaew Hon soup base was delicious, and the dipping sauces were also tasty.
The selection of vegetables was limited.
I only liked the pork belly; it was really delicious. The pork belly itself was a bit tough and difficult to chew.
I also tried the seafood, both the white shrimp and the prawns, but they weren't fresh at all; the meat was mushy.
My favorite dish today was the fruit salad. It was incredibly delicious; I ate three plates by myself! The dressing was amazing.

Next time, I might try sitting on the section with non-shabu dishes; that might be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: wangm

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a buffet and à la carte restaurant serving Northeastern Thai-style hot pot. They have a wide variety of Northeastern Thai dishes. The papaya salad is incredibly delicious and flavorful, the Lao-style rice noodles with curry are tasty, and the glass noodle salad is excellent. The beef and pork are high quality. They also have snow fish, abalone sashimi, and grilled eel with soy sauce. There are so many appetizers that I couldn't try everything! 😅 I've actually eaten at their Silom Age branch before, but this location seems larger and the decor is nicer. Most of the staff don't seem to be Thai, but they try their best to provide excellent service. You might need to listen carefully to their speech and repeat yourself a bit to be understood. Overall, it's a good place.
sample_reviews_en.author: NiiNg

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited 2 days continually.
- 1st : very impressed
- 2nd : impressed but not as much as 1st day cuz there is a problem with ordering system which cause me almost an hour without any menu delivered, but staffs are very helpful and can solve the issue smartly.

Food is very delicious, everything tastes great and you can write a comment how would you like to have, such as, Tum Thai but not too spicy. Quality is GREAT!! I ordered most of the menu they have. Here are some recommended plates from me : Fried sea bass with fish sauce, Tum Thai, Larb Wagyu, etc.

Conclusion
🥘 Food : Outstanding and tasty. Ingredients quality is great
👩 Staff : Very good for service and caring

Sure to comeback again!!

Btw, I suggest coming in the afternoon onwards to have every system stable
sample_reviews_en.author: Natchnon Chantachitpreecha

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant offers both buffet and a la carte options. We opted for the buffet, starting at 498 net, with almost two hours of dining time. It was quite crowded during lunchtime. Ordering food via QR code was very slow; we constantly had to ask staff to follow up. Some items arrived, some didn't, and by the time we finished our time, we were already full. The soup and dipping sauces were okay. The buffet bar had salad rolls, stir-fried noodles, and other dishes. However, all the desserts were sold out; the ice cream freezer was empty. Personally, I thought the meat wasn't very good, quite tough. The papaya salad was too sweet. Some other dishes were alright.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kawinthip Polsuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered food, but within the first 25 minutes, some items weren't arriving. I informed the staff the first time, and they said they would expedite it and it would arrive in about 5 minutes. I waited another 20 minutes and had to get up and ask if the order hadn't been updated in the system because it said 40 minutes had passed. Do you understand what it's like to be hungry? The fact that some items were missing made the meal unappetizing – not because the taste was bad, but because I was so disappointed. I hesitated to order again because I was afraid of ordering duplicates and not being able to finish them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peerapong Boonyaem

restaurants.name: Som Tam Luem Phua
restaurants.address:

PFPX+M3M, Somdet Chao Phraya, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
All this for 490 baht, including a liter bottle of Coke and a bucket of ice.
The taste was incredibly good. The seafood papaya salad was very flavorful and the portion was generous. The grilled pork neck, fried pork intestines with garlic, and crispy-skinned catfish baked in a clay pot were all excellent. There were 3 dipping sauces: seafood, chili powder with tamarind, and a spicy chili powder with lime sauce. It was so much fun to eat. Compared to the price, it's more than worth it. You can park right in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anupab “O”

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Northeastern Thai restaurant serves decent-tasting food.
*Grilled pork neck: Not fatty, tough, and not very fragrant.
*Pork larb: Flavorful, but the pork offal had an offal smell.
*Spicy pork rib soup: Not very flavorful, just average.
*Papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce: A bit too spicy. The papaya should have been shredded; this one was too thick and didn't absorb the flavor well.
*Service: Good, standard service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lara Linh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spicy and flavorful Thai dishes with generous portions of ingredients at affordable prices.
The grilled pork neck is amazing and worth ordering every time. The pork is grilled perfectly with just the right amount of fat marbling.
It gets quite busy, so you might have to wait a little while for your food, but it's manageable.
sample_reviews_en.author: candidior1

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad was incredibly flavorful; I enjoyed sipping the fermented fish sauce broth so much. The grilled pork neck was delicious, and the dipping sauce was amazing. This was my first time here, so I didn't order much because I wasn't very hungry. Next time, I'll definitely order a lot!
sample_reviews_en.author: ongying zaab

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a great dinner here after a bike tour around the city. The food was excellent. Highlights were the grilled pork neck, tom yam and chicken in chilli paste. Great value, nice location and friendly staff. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryan Wilkins

sample_reviews_en.text: Super unique and authentic Thai experience. Although communication in English was a bit hard, the staff was really friendly and helpful. Loved the food and the experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiki Houtenbos

sample_reviews_en.text: I like this small restaurant very much. Every thai salads here tastes so good. The staff is friendly. Will come here again if i go to thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Quang Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice and authentic Isaan restaurant. This place is run by a family - like most Isaan places. Everybody helps out. Even the teenage boy. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

restaurants.name: Jee Seng Heng Restaurant - ร้านจี่เซ่งเฮง เป็ดพะโล้ เจ้4
restaurants.address:

62 ซ. นานา Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've ordered through food delivery services several times (Grab, RBH).
Prices vary depending on the location.

The original restaurant offers food delivery or pick-up only; there is no dine-in service. They have many duck stew dishes, including individual servings and sets of duck for various festivals.

Today, I ordered half a braised duck. The restaurant chopped it up and put it in a box, along with the braising sauce, chili vinegar, and two separate pieces of duck blood in a bag.

The taste was delicious, slightly salty, not sweet, which is my preferred style. The duck meat was reasonably tender, but some parts were a little chewy. The duck blood was good quality, with a fairly large piece. The chili vinegar enhanced the flavor and prevented it from being too greasy. Half a duck is enough for 3-4 people.

My only criticism is that I found several duck feathers still attached to the duck skin. I suspect the restaurant hasn't cleaned and removed the feathers properly, so I'm deducting one star for that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ning Nanta

sample_reviews_en.text: Eager to capitalize on the growing number of would-be influencers stumbling down Soi Nana taking selfies, Jee Seng Heng has added some tables along the alley, attended by a waiter in a tiny booth. He telephones orders to the kitchen in the atmospheric back alley where the kitchen sits, and a cook eventually trots out with your dish. Jee Seng Heng’s roast duck is famous enough that it long survived on delivery orders alone. The duck is great and the herbal sauce even better, suffused with Chinese herbs and spices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wayndering

sample_reviews_en.text:
Takeaway order: One whole braised duck. Includes offal but no intestines.
550 baht per duck. Packed in a styrofoam box.
The duck tasted good, and they gave plenty of braising sauce and dipping sauce.
No parking available.
Accessible by motorcycle.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sodsai Zhou

sample_reviews_en.text: They have no store but this is the best traditional marinated duck in Nana area. I have ordered the half of fried duck, it tastes amazing. Meat is soft and good aroma with sweetness of brown sugar! Nothing wrong with this menu and others.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried the dry duck noodle soup at the One BKK branch. It was fragrant, tender, and not too salty. The noodles were soft and the portion was generous for 100 baht. There's limited seating, so it's best to take it home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapaporn K

sample_reviews_en.text:
The duck meat tasted really good and was very fragrant 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
The braising broth was so good, you could add ice and drink it like a herbal drink. The broth was fragrant and not salty at all. Superb! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Chartpanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was incredibly delicious and the portion was huge! We ordered half a braised duck and couldn't finish it between two people. The duck was so tender and the spices were amazing.

It was enough for two meals! 🎉
sample_reviews_en.author: ธีรสิทธิ มากละเอียด

sample_reviews_en.text: Best suited for takeout. Food quality is very good, but prices are higher than other restaurants. Access to the store is inconvenient. Special menu items require calling ahead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somkiat Tangwongpimook

restaurants.name: La Fiore Cafe Asiatique
restaurants.address:

2194, ชั้นที่ 1 ห้องเลขที่ 4 Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The mango juice was delicious! The staff were also kind, and it was a wonderful trip memory. ◡̈♡
ขอบคุณมาก!!!
sample_reviews_th.author: mo mo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was excellent, but the service was a complete disaster. Waiting 15 minutes for a smoothie and 30 minutes for a waffle is unacceptable, especially when the staff lies about the waiting time.

Additionally, it feels strange to pay upfront, which is uncommon in Thailand. My gut feeling is that they know their service is slow, so they take the money first to make sure customers are forced to wait for their food.

Unfortunately, this ruins the entire experience despite the great food
sample_reviews_en.author: Dipesh Shrestha

sample_reviews_en.text:
La Fiore Cafe at Asiatique is a nice little spot to get some desserts while roaming the area. It is located right in front of the ferric wheel so it definitely has a good amount of foot traffic.
The ice cream themselves and sundae were good. My favorite of course was the chocolate sundae. The matcha and strawberry ice cream were ok.
The service was quick. The workers were nice and respectful.
Thank you very much 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Liang

sample_reviews_en.text: We have been in Thailand for two weeks now and have never encountered such a climatic place and such friendly service. We tried most of the items on the menu and everything was exceptional! Both the toast, bingsu and the classic Mango Sticky Rise tasted amazing. The cappuccino was probably the best I drank during my stay in Thailand and the prices were very attractive in relation to the quality offered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katarzyna Szeligowska

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried bingsu for the first time here and it was fantastic. Went for caramel and the ice itself was the real star, fluffy, packed with flavour, and shaved so fine it genuinely felt like eating a cloud. Refreshing without being sickly sweet, which is exactly what you want on a warm Bangkok evening.

Good introduction to bingsu if you've never tried it, and it's made me want to seek it out again elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Aberman

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a very unpleasant experience at this place. The staff kept speaking loudly in their own language in a way that felt uncomfortable and disrespectful, even though we could understand them. One of the male staff members was especially rude in the way he spoke. Overall, the service was very poor and not acceptable at all. I would not recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Htoo Sat Aung

sample_reviews_en.text: First time to visit Thailand and it was my first time to try this Bingsu. I can just say OMG amazing experience from the taste that took me to a different place to the service, I met the owner who was extremely kind and professional. I wish really that she can expand and open outside of Thailand. They are great and thank you for everything seriously.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahmed Baddar

sample_reviews_en.text: I absolutely do not recommend this place. It's famous for its ice cream. We ordered a latte, cappuccino, and passion fruit mojito. The orders were terrible. The coffee was ready-made but its color was unnatural; we couldn't drink it. The French toast was somewhat acceptable, but the waffle was dry—it was more like a crusty bread than a waffle.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawal

restaurants.name: ร้านลาบเป็ดอุบล ปากซอยสิรินธร 7
restaurants.address:

QFQH+W7F, Bang Bumru, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ubon Duck Larb (Sirinthon Road Branch)
A Larb restaurant you won't want to tell anyone about!
This roadside larb restaurant is recommended by locals. It's a small place that also sells hot pot and other Northeastern Thai dishes. The restaurant's deliciousness is guaranteed by its red folding tables and red plastic chairs. The highlight here is the grilled pork neck; the flavor is amazing, the meat is tender and juicy – ​​one bite won't be enough! The spicy salads are perfectly balanced, the various larb dishes are flavorful, and the spicy soups are incredibly delicious and spicy.
The papaya salad is also tasty; I recommend the Korat-style papaya salad – the strong flavor is perfect with sticky rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: natthawat noothong

sample_reviews_en.text: For this hour, this restaurant is definitely one of my favorites. Everything is truly delicious. The grilled pork neck, grilled chicken, grilled intestines – the grilled items are amazing. They're grilled perfectly, the fat is dry, fragrant, and the flavor is fantastic. Other dishes like papaya salad, larb, and nam tok are customizable; you can adjust the spiciness to your liking. The prices are reasonable, neither cheap nor expensive. It's a satisfying and delicious meal. Anyone passing by this area should stop by and try it. It's a simple-looking restaurant, but the taste is extraordinary. I highly recommend it!🤣🤣🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Niccy nan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce was incredibly flavorful, the original recipe, 45 baht.
The grilled crying tiger beef was well-marinated, delicious and not chewy, 90 baht. The grilled chicken was 45 baht, tasty but a little dry.
The spicy pork rib soup had a rich and balanced flavor, 80 baht.
And the squid larb was okay, 70 baht.
There are about 6-7 tables for seating along the road and in front of the clinic.
Parking is available along the roadside.
Cash and scan-to-pay are accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Raksat

sample_reviews_en.text: This little shop is absolutely amazing! The pork neck is the best I've ever had in Thailand 😋, and the grilled chicken leg is the best I've ever had! It's incredibly fragrant, juicy, and delicious, the service from the waiter is excellent, and most importantly, it's incredibly cheap! The value is incredible, I want to come back every day!
sample_reviews_en.author: 杨月欣

sample_reviews_en.text: If you rarely get to eat really delicious, traditional-style papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce, then you have to come to this restaurant. Everything from the papaya salad to the duck larb, grilled pork, and other dishes is incredibly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manadee

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The grilled pork neck is amazing. The papaya salad with crab is delicious, with thin strips of papaya, which I love. The spicy pork rib soup is very flavorful. I've eaten there many times, and the taste is consistently delicious every time.
sample_reviews_en.author: sasipatch borwonmahasathit

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! I've lived in Bang Phlat for 10 years and this is my first time here. The owner is lovely, the prices are good, and the portions are very generous. You must order the grilled pork neck. The fermented fish sauce is also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Issarapohn P

sample_reviews_en.text:
The papaya salad tastes good, the grilled pork neck is delicious, and the prices are reasonable.
You have to park on the side of the road in front of the shop; there are limited parking spaces, so you have to try your luck on the spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parisara Chancharoen

restaurants.name: Love cuisine 9 (Chinatown)
restaurants.address:

334 Yaowarat Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I would call to be bit cautious with this place. They put 10 % service charge on top of the prices, even the price level is already bit elevated compared to the competition even without. Service charge is mentioned on very last page of the menu as hand written paper glued to the end cover. Very sneaky. Good business behaviour would be put it on the first page when extra charge is issued automatically.

Fish with chili sauce was not that great. The chili was kind of sweet chili and I had to add a lot of spicy chili from the extra container that was available on the table. Still very sweet.

Morning glory portion was quite good size even I took small. And its quality was great. In that sense it is reasonably priced before the service charge.

This service charge rant is not about is it big or small money. It is about justice and how fair business is shown to its customers.

The service was not that exceptional compared to competition around.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aatu Dorochenko

sample_reviews_en.text:
my family has been patronising this establishment for years every time we come to bkk , however we believe that there was a change in management and our experience here is absolutely terrible. our server was extremely slow and sloppy in his work (already had plates and cutlery on the table , but kept trying to bring us more multiple times ??).
food served was not fresh at all (the fish had a stench) and the only decent part was the canned drinks and some spring rolls. other than that, the tomyum soup tasted like mere instant seasoning added into hot water , it was served lukewarm. during our meal , the server repeatedly asked us if we were Chinese , which i really don’t understand if that matters (i understand if he was just curious but he kept asking the same question throughout the meal). food took a long time to be served as well and im sure we got overcharged for it too. overall it was just a really terrible experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole Hiu

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here at night (11pm) after roaming most of chinatown, we were looking for fresh seafood as my dad is pescatarian. I'm glad we just wandered in as the low star rating doesn't reflect what we experienced. Most of the low reviews are about price, which we honestly didn't notice as it was our first day in Bangkok and we live in London so from our scale of comparison it was VERY cheap for what we got. The floors were a little dirty and it's definitely not an upscale restaurant...but that's expected for street food. The AC inside was great though. The crab fried rice was DELICIOUS, we cleared the plate– I wish I could go back for it. We also got fresh grilled prawns and lobster with chilli garlic and that was yummy too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Modupe Reis

sample_reviews_en.text: Special recommendation for vegans (and everyone else). We had three different tofu dishes from the menu card. We asked for them to make it vegan and they were just positive and creative about it. Had the red bean curd with tofu. Asked for no egg, no fishsauce and no meat (in thai though). It felt like a warm hug. The other two dishes I don't remeber the name of. One was fried with tofu and some finely chopped vegetables, also from the tofu menu. The other one was from the vegetable dish part of the menu and we just added tofu to that one. All extremely good. They made us a free fried morning glory just cause they felt like it. Big recommendation
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandra Vestergaard

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate duck rice and pork leg rice, 99 baht per plate, with a 10% service charge that didn't feel like service at all. The food was very different from the pictures; it was just scraps of duck and pork leg. I ordered two bottles of water, but they weren't served, yet it was on the bill even though there were plenty of staff sitting idle. While eating, I had to inhale the smell of incense from the shop and dust from the staff sweeping at 12:00 PM. I usually never go to places like this, but my partner was very hungry, so we chose this without checking reviews beforehand. Avoid this place if you can!
sample_reviews_en.author: KEEP IN TOUCH

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm sorry for the food was really not fresh. The prawns were mushy but garlic and flavour was good so I paid for it. The snail shellfish was so bad that I totally can't eat it. They served raw prawncake so I showed them inside was totally gray they refry it as shown in second pic. It is really unprofessional. We also waited one hour for the fish maw soup which didn't come. But then they let us cancel the fish maw and also the smelly stall shellfish. Anyway wanted to say the morning glory tasted very fresh and good. So I gave them overall 2 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amanda Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: No stars should be given to this stall. The foods were terrible!!! The steam fish was not fresh. Informed the manager, she just said sorry and that's all. The tom yam and fish served in metal pot and plate w/o fire so not sure what is the purpose on this. Maybe save cost? Waiter keep asking us if we were chinese? Why? So that serve us the not fresh foods? By the way, we just paid the whole bills and left the place. We didn't ate half the fish, it was scope to my family plates and the fish was still at their plate!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lee Joanne

sample_reviews_en.text:
We only came here out of necessity because our favorite across the street doesn't open until 6:00 PM :-( The food itself was okay. But there's a lot of room for improvement in terms of hygiene (cleanliness of the tables), attentiveness of the service, and friendliness. Most of the staff are standing outside on the street soliciting new customers.
And beware: a silent 10% surcharge is added to the bill – tip? Cover? Tax?
sample_reviews_en.author: Werner Mayrock

restaurants.name: Pork BBQ
restaurants.address:

QGPX+MMC Sundown Phahon Yothin 14, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The small set is good for two people. They had a free 550ml Pepsi as a grand opening promotion. There's sukiyaki and seafood dipping sauce; mixing them together works okay. The charcoal grill was nice and hot, and they brought the piping hot broth with a sizzling sound. The atmosphere was good, with soft music playing, making for a comfortable conversation. There were no mosquitoes (the fans provided good ventilation). I wish they had a place to make your own dipping sauces and green noodles. The broth was just okay, a bit powdery. The liver was well-cleaned and not tough, but it wasn't marinated and lacked flavor. The Australian beef might still be... well, you know. Anyone who likes BBQ with alcohol will probably like it, because they have more alcoholic drinks on the menu than BBQ items.
sample_reviews_en.author: นาก

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was slow, the staff were inattentive, and we waited a very long time for our food (a simple salad). We had to ask for it before it was finally prepared. They served ice but no water; we had to ask for it again, otherwise the ice would have melted. The rice was served after we had already finished eating; I don't know what to eat it with. We ordered just one bowl of plain rice and waited for an hour. The charcoal wasn't even hot; it seems this restaurant focuses on a slow-paced dining experience. In the picture, the food has been grilled for almost 10 minutes, and there's absolutely no charring. In short, I was extremely unimpressed. One visit is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Honey Toast

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, the food is delicious with a wide variety of choices. It's a comfortable place to chill with friends. The restrooms are very clean. It's conveniently located with parking. The BBQ pork is delicious, the dipping sauce is amazing, and the spicy salad is also tasty. The food is clean, the staff provides good service, and the complex is very clean. It's also close to my workplace. I love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mxmar RTNPT

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was very fast today. Plates and spoons were already on the table, ready to grab. We didn't have to wait long, about 5 minutes, for the hot pot to arrive. We ordered the small set for 333 baht, which was about this much – a generous portion, just right for two people. And the dessert to finish was delicious; buttery bread topped with milk cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nyu Gaming

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a Korean BBQ restaurant in the heart of the city, set up in a slightly camping-like atmosphere. The prices are affordable, there's a screen to watch football matches, the staff provides good service, and there's parking for about 10 cars.
sample_reviews_en.author: waritsara chanbunditnun

sample_reviews_en.text: My sibling and I went to eat during opening hours when it wasn't crowded yet, only about 5 tables occupied. No staff member paid any attention to us. Then we noticed a QR code and ordered. Turns out, it was still very slow! It took half an …
sample_reviews_en.author: nookbaa sikikyuhandolee

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice, but the food is very slow. There might be too many tables; the kitchen size and the number of cooks don't match the large number of tables. Fried dishes take a very long time, and the BBQ grill wasn't very hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noppakorn.k 09

sample_reviews_en.text: Moo Krata Heel Jai (Thai BBQ) has a great atmosphere, is clean, and the prices are reasonable. There are other shops nearby, including beer bars, drinks, and à la carte restaurants, making it suitable for various lifestyles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Threechada B

restaurants.name: KFC Central Huamark
restaurants.address:

Central Huamark, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had no choice but to come here because there was no McDonald's, but the unlimited drink refills were nice. They said there wasn't a separate menu, so they told me to just look at the screen at the top, but it was all in Thai... I like the Black Label Burger in Korea, so I don't eat the Zinger Burger, but the only burger on the screen was the Zinger Burger, so I just ordered that. The staff were friendly, even though we couldn't understand each other. However, it was still bland. The chicken was unusually over-fried and really salty. It tasted like the chicken skin fries from KFC in Korea, but the spiciness was more like ramen soup. I kind of liked it, but... October 23rd
sample_reviews_en.author: Sha Kim (Sha)

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday, I intended to buy KFC to take home, but when I arrived, there were only two employees at the counter packing chicken into boxes, completely ignoring customers. I stood waiting at the counter for almost 10 minutes, and they didn't even turn around to look at me. I understand there are few staff members, but you should pay attention to customers waiting to order. Even just turning around to tell them to wait a moment would have been nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: sistar.x1

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch keeps the sauces for itself. Online orders are very limited. If you order and specifically ask for no ketchup, they should at least add chili sauce instead. I ordered a set of 4 chicken pieces and 2 Wing Zabb (spicy wings), and only received 4 packets of chili sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rangers

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so frustrating! I ordered KFC through Grab, and the order arrived on time, but there wasn't a single packet of sauce! I ordered a burger, Colonel Sanders' fried chicken, Zesty wings, and french fries, but none of them came with any sauce. So stingy!
sample_reviews_en.author: sailor moon

sample_reviews_en.text: There weren't enough tissues compared to other branches. I ordered online but chose to eat at the restaurant. When I inquired about my order, the staff looked unwelcoming. I wanted to change my order to take the food home instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anirut Sukkiun

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered from foodpanda and specifically mentioned in the order details and in the chat with the driver that they gave me breast meat instead of thigh meat, which was inedible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanapat Towantakawanich

sample_reviews_en.text: There were noisy customers in the store, and children were jumping around and singing loudly. I went to tell the staff to help, but they didn't do anything.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ii Ed

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the Spicy Running Chicken with the orange app, and the chicken came like regular fried chicken; the spicy running flavor was barely there at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mahdee Tehyo

restaurants.name: ป่ายยี่ 百億 Bǎi yì ชาบูหม่าล่า สายพาน
restaurants.address:

45/32 Rung Pracha Rd, Tambon Wat Chalo, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Good food, affordable prices, excellent taste. Free soup included. Highly recommended. Plenty of items for 5฿ and 10฿. Currently, there's a prize draw and I won a 40฿ discount – incredibly good value!
sample_reviews_th.author: manachai bestgoody

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mala Shabu offers a variety of soup bases.
The conveyor belt menu also has many items, including pork, chicken, shrimp, various vegetables, ramen noodles, and konjac noodles.
Delicious and enjoyable.
There are many dipping sauces to choose from, which you can customize to your liking. There's sukiyaki sauce, peanut sauce, or you can choose from the sauces the restaurant has prepared.
Parking is available a short distance from the restaurant; there's plenty of parking space.
They have a loyalty points program.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anchalee Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to mala restaurant. Their mala broth, made with beef oil and pork bones, is delicious and flavorful. The ingredients are clean and varied. They usually only have 1-2 pieces of beef, from what I've seen. The prices are quite affordable. The vegetables are clean, fresh, and crisp. They have a wide selection of noodles. What I really love is the broth; it's tastier and more flavorful than other places. There's free parking near the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: ytkyo

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious. You choose the color of the skewers and pay according to the price. The taste is good. The ingredients are ordinary. The sauce is delicious. The shop is not big. There is only one conveyor belt. You sit around in separate pots. For people who don't eat a lot, it's suitable for enjoying a meal. But if you eat a lot, I recommend the buffet. You can eat more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarocha Khobroob

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat here all the time. The restaurant has changed its format to a self-service style where you can choose your own ingredients for the soup. The mala soup is fragrant, spicy, and satisfyingly numbing. The black soup is sweet, clear, and easy to drink. I also ordered pineapple and guava juice, only 19 baht per glass. Come support them!
sample_reviews_en.author: ฝนฮิ

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a very complete range of flavors. The shabu-shabu has a wide variety of soups to choose from, the ingredients are fresh, and they even have freshly made Vietnamese steamed rice rolls. The drinks menu is amazing – incredibly delicious! Three of us ate and ordered four drinks! 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: นิลรัตน์ จันทร์สุวรรณ

sample_reviews_en.text: The Mala Bai Yi soup with vegetables was delicious! It was rich, flavorful, and just the right amount of spicy. However, we went when the restaurant first opened, so they didn't have many ingredients yet, and the soup took a little while to prepare, but they boiled it pot by pot, so it was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyapak P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are many soup base flavors to choose from, such as Tom Yum, Mala, and Shiitake Mushroom.
Prices range from 5 baht to 40 baht.
It's an à la carte menu; a filling meal for about 400 baht per person with change left over.
8.0/10 ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัชชา ชาช่า

restaurants.name: Sukiya The PARQ
restaurants.address:

160/112 Rama IV Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Hokkaido grilled pork rice bowl (large size) had a generous portion of rice and cost 144 baht. I added a salad, miso soup, and iced green tea for only 60 baht extra, bringing the total to 204 baht. The salad was served in a very small portion; I'd recommend ordering the chicken karaage or gyoza instead for better value. The Hokkaido grilled pork wasn't as good as the original Japanese restaurants; the original restaurants have a distinct charcoal-grilled aroma, but the Thai branch lacked that flavor, tasting like microwaved food. The original Japanese restaurants also offer three different sauces and dips for customers to add to their grilled beef and pork.

Upon entering the restaurant, staff instructed customers to order via QR code. After ordering, the food arrived very quickly, likely because it was close to closing time (9 pm) on a Saturday and there weren't many customers. The restaurant had a fairly spacious atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิน วิน พลัส

sample_reviews_en.text: We went for dinner around 6 pm. Most restaurants were closing by then, so we decided to try this one. First of all, there were no staff members serving us at the front. It was our first time, and we didn't know how to order. We just walked to a table, saw a QR code, and ordered. There were very few food options left, and the choices were limited. The food came relatively quickly, but the water service was very slow. We asked for it twice, and continued asking until we had almost finished our meal. There were too few staff members, and no one was clearing food from customers who had already paid their bills. Overall, we weren't impressed, but thankfully the food was delicious. If we were to eat here again, we would choose a different branch than this one.
sample_reviews_en.author: -TP

sample_reviews_en.text:
A standard meal with efficient tech but surprisingly poor inventory management.

Sukiya delivers a decent enough flavor, and the self-ordering system at each table ensures the service isn't slow, but the logistics leave something to be desired. It’s quite a letdown to find that popular items like karaage are already sold out as early as 12 PM, suggesting they weren't quite prepared for the lunch rush. To make matters worse, the staff appeared fairly confused about the orders they were handling, which adds an unnecessary layer of chaos to a system that’s supposed to be automated and straightforward.
sample_reviews_en.author: NNchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Crisis of japanese bowls.
It’s a new branch that just open not long time and it has operation issues as I saw from the staffs in kitchen.
Price is friendly with officers and general but the taste is the problem
Ramen was so oily, soup taste liked instant noodle pork flavor, the slide pork had only one piece, strong texture and not tasty.
Fried chicken “Karake” was so simple, and tepid.

For the beef rice bowl, taste of beef is so simply. No comment at all.
They could increase the standard of the taste and services
sample_reviews_en.author: Alissa Right

sample_reviews_en.text: I've tried to eat at this restaurant on weekdays around 8 PM. Out of five times, I've only been able to get a table twice. The same male staff member keeps saying they're out of rice or the kitchen is closed, even though Google Maps says it closes at 9 PM. I'm very disappointed with this branch. I even asked another staff member and they said the kitchen closes at 8:30 PM. I don't know what to say. If you want to eat here, go to another restaurant. Don't waste your time like I did.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anakorn Wimuttichai

sample_reviews_en.text: You could call this a comfort food restaurant. I've eaten here a few times, but I've been impressed by the delicious taste, generous portions, and reasonable prices. I ordered the stir-fried pork ribs with sauce and two onsen eggs, topped with soy sauce – it was a perfect combination. They also provide complimentary sliced ​​pickled ginger as a side dish, which is great with Japanese food.
sample_reviews_en.author: LazyWeekend

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered food at 12:58, and now it's 1:36. I haven't eaten.
1. The restaurant didn't clear the table and didn't take care to check for other tables with QR codes.
2. The food was sent to another table and they didn't immediately resolve the issue, so I still have to wait.
3. I called three times and they didn't fix it, so I had to cancel.

I recommend avoiding this branch if possible.
sample_reviews_en.author: WhiteKuma

sample_reviews_en.text: I've ordered grilled beef rice bowls many times, and I'm never impressed. The meat is all fat, way too much fat. Even the L size, priced at 164 baht, has thin, sparse slices of meat, with 70-80% being fat per piece. In the end, I only get to eat a tiny bit of actual meat. The picture shows the fat I had to pick off; there was actually more, but I was hungry so I had to eat it.
sample_reviews_en.author: P

restaurants.name: Lakkhana Phot Na
restaurants.address:

Lot 3 , 1/37 , Rama 2 Road , Chom Thong , 10150 Chom Thong, Bangkok, 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a great made-to-order restaurant. They might not have a huge menu, but the food is excellent.
-Crispy pork basil stir-fry with fried egg: Delicious! It's stir-fried dry, and the crispy pork is perfect – not hard at all.
-Sukiyaki soup: The dipping sauce is a bit spicy, Chinese style, not sweet at all.
-Crispy pork noodle stir-fry: The noodles have a wonderful wok aroma and go well with the dish.
-Minced pork basil stir-fry with fried egg: Very well-prepared and delicious. The chili fish sauce is also tasty!
The prices are very reasonable. They have people calling in orders and walking in all the time, even though it seems quiet. The restaurant isn't hot inside, so it's comfortable to wait.
----------------
There's no parking. Parking in front of the shop near the curve is dangerous and can be stressful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana Relax

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old, established restaurant serving Chinese-style made-to-order dishes. Their signature dish is the tender marinated pork in a gravy-style sauce. Everything on the menu is delicious because the flavors are rich and intense. The stir-fried noodles with soy sauce and the sukiyaki are standout dishes, but the basil pork and garlic pork I tried today were equally excellent. The basil pork was flavorful with a slight sweetness, while the garlic pork wasn't too salty and tasted perfect with chili fish sauce. The restaurant has about 5-6 tables and isn't usually crowded. If traffic isn't bad, you can park right in front of the restaurant. During peak hours, I recommend parking before the bend in the road and walking a short distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pesama Saksanit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lakkhana Pochana, Rama 2 Road

I intentionally took a taxi over 10 kilometers to eat at this restaurant.

The garlic pork and basil pork stir-fry were excellent. The pork was marinated to be tender and cooked quickly – superb! The minced pork and preserved plum soup was delicious, with a peppery flavor that rivals the taste of the delicious rice porridge restaurants of the past.

I wanted another dish even after finishing my main course, so I ordered rice with stir-fried kale and pork. It seemed like they added fermented soybean paste, which was good. Next time, I'll ask them to make the garlic pork version with kale added.

Location:
On Rama 2 Road, at the curve of the three-way intersection heading towards Suk Sawat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has a grandpa who gets ordered around by grandma (the owner) to do many other things, but the food is excellent and tastes great. The cleanliness of the food is 3 stars; the inspector is from the Chom Thong district. There's also an old man who likes to cook for alms giving; I see him every morning, and he makes good food. The restaurant has a mischievous grandson who's easily angered but useful. He likes to tease grandma, like kissing her cheek while she's sleeping in the restaurant. This grandson is very naughty; even grandma says he's very mischievous. His name is Tee Noi. Oh, I forgot to mention, the old man likes to do housework.
Written by. The owner's grandson (Tee Noi)
End
sample_reviews_en.author: ไรวินทร์ พฤทธิ์กุลโรจน์

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recommend the stir-fried chicken; it's very fragrant and delicious!!
The pork fried rice is also delicious, with a wonderful wok-fried aroma.
The Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) is flavorful and packed with ingredients.
Delicious and reasonably priced.
It's a short walk from the Honda center.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nu Aro

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has an original feel to it.
It seems like it's been open for a while.
The overall taste is delicious, with a nice wok aroma.
Each dish is cooked to order over high heat.
For those who don't like strong flavors,
it might be a bit salty; you should ask them to reduce the saltiness.
sample_reviews_en.author: S Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on a bend in the Rama 2 road. Parking is a bit difficult, but I pass by it often and only recently had the chance to try it. It serves made-to-order food, and the taste is OK; a good place to grab a bite to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: charl lui

sample_reviews_en.text: I had sukiyaki. The dry sukiyaki was delicious. It has an old-fashioned flavor with fermented tofu. It's being made by the next generation now, so it might not be as delicious as the father's, but it's still pretty good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eakwat Vinijchaikul

restaurants.name: ร้านประจำ
restaurants.address:

24 Asok Alley, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my go-to curry rice shop in the Asoke area, and it never disappoints, no matter how many times I eat here. It's packed almost every day, especially at lunchtime, but the queue moves quickly. There's a huge variety of food to choose from, including stir-fries, curries, soups, and fried items, all neatly arranged in the display case – it's hard to decide! The atmosphere is simple and clean, with seating both inside and outside. It's perfect for people working in the Asoke area who want a delicious and affordable lunch. The portions and quality of the food are excellent value for money.
If you work in or are passing through the Asoke area and are looking for a delicious curry rice shop with a wide variety of dishes, consistent taste, and friendly prices, this is one of my top recommendations without hesitation. I've been eating here for years, and it's still my regular spot. ❤️🍛
sample_reviews_en.author: siwa jakdusit

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times. The food tastes good, and the staff has always been helpful. I usually order takeout, but today I wanted to dine in but was worried about not being able to finish everything. I asked the staff about the food, speaking politely and respectfully, but the staff responded with a sarcastic "Huh?" and acted as if I were begging for free food. They exchanged glances with another staff member, seemingly unable to answer my question. Their body language was very condescending. I simply said, "It's okay," and left the restaurant immediately. If the owner sees this, I hope they'll consider improving their service. No matter how delicious the food is, this kind of service is unacceptable. Ignoring the poor service, the food itself is fresh and clean, and I always recommend it to my colleagues. This experience was quite disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: PIMLAPUs P

sample_reviews_en.text:
This rice and curry shop, "Pracham," in the Asoke area, has a long queue. Around noon, the line is usually this long (about 2.5 blocks).

I've eaten here many times when I'm in the area. I usually avoid lunchtime, preferring to go between 9:00-10:00 AM. This time I went at 11:00 AM, and as I finished eating and walked out, the line slowly started to form. My favorite dishes are the garlic/soy sauce pork (both sliced ​​and chunky) and the fried rice.

The shop is located in a shophouse on the street next to the Ratchapark Building. It's open from morning to afternoon and closed on Saturdays and Sundays.

Location:

https://maps.app.goo.gl/Md56bmX6TB2hkxpJ8?g_st=ic
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree T.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted okay, but considering the price of 60 baht, I think it's a bit high. Overall, it's okay. It's very crowded at lunchtime (I arrived at the restaurant at 12:10 PM). There are few seats and a very long queue. There were few lunch menu items left, presumably because they had been selling them since morning and didn't make more once they ran out. I asked the person serving if they had any more, and they said they were sold out. ***The restaurant charges 60 baht and stated that it was a stir-fried dish.*** Please check the receipt. The price was not stated before serving.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reindeer

sample_reviews_en.text: I can’t speak thai yet they understand what I want to order. This is one of the best meal in Bangkok, so good!!!! Especially the fried chicken with korean sauce, omg I can it eat it everyday! I even join their Line group to know their daily menu although I need to translate it 😭 It’s a real food and the place is clean, so almost everyday we buy at this store even on the weekend 🥰 Today’s service could be better tho, I only get a very little portion of fried chicken (4 small pieces, not the one in the pic) huhu but don’t worry we’re still be back tomorrow hehe
sample_reviews_en.author: Desti Rispakasari

sample_reviews_en.text:
[Korean] A Khao Rad Kaeng (Thai-style set meal - rice bowl) restaurant where they put your desired toppings on rice.

If you like Thai food, it seems like it would suit Korean palates well.

Two side dishes + 1 fried egg + Coke.

For a price in the low to mid-3,000 won range, the taste is decent and it's filling.

It seems like a lot of office workers from nearby companies eat here.

The tables and floors also appear to be well-cleaned.

If I lived nearby, I would probably come here often without hesitation.
sample_reviews_en.author: flow Steady

sample_reviews_en.text: The food taste is average, meeting standard expectations to appeal to a wide range of customers. Prices after May 20, 2024, are moderate to inexpensive, making it a suitable daily spot. The atmosphere is simple: order food, pay (scan payment available), and bring your food to your table. There are various seating options, from bar stools to regular tables, across two floors. Overall, it's ideal for a regular hangout, not for special occasions, but for convenience and cost savings.
sample_reviews_en.author: plam.135 (Pavarid S)

sample_reviews_en.text: This curry rice shop has been a favorite among office workers in Asoke for many years. The prices are mid-range, the menu is diverse, and the taste is just right. This was my first time trying it, based on a recommendation from employees in the area. I've taken the TOEIC exam at the BB building many times, and only recently realized how popular this place is. Next time I have a TOEIC exam in Asoke, I'll definitely come here for lunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Commizza

restaurants.name: Bamee Giao- Moo Daeng
restaurants.address:

472 Kiattichai Alley, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bamee Giao- Moo Daeng

In my opinion, if you live near Rama 9 Station and can eat pork offal, this is a top-tier place for a hangover cure.

It is only open in the afternoon, but since it is located on the roadside, takeout is available if it is inconvenient to eat there.

The broth tastes like galbitang (beef rib soup) with plenty of pepper added, and I ordered the Pork Soup Special. Cilantro is added by default, so if you can't eat it, I recommend the "Mai Sai Pak Chi."

You can have a hearty hangover cure for 70 baht, including rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김부추

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited based on a recommendation from the owner of the Korean guesthouse, Dra Seoul, across the street.

Since it was my first meal of the night, I went without any expectations, but the moment I tasted it, I realized this is Thailand and was overwhelmed with anticipation for what tomorrow would bring.

I had a standard crab omelet, but be careful as you can chew on the shell pieces.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles were perfectly cooked and the dumplings were quite good. The broth was just okay, with radish added. The char siu pork was good. The pork blood soup was delicious; the sliced ​​pork and minced pork were of good quality, the offal was varied, fresh, clean, and odorless, the pork blood was good, and the broth was tasty. The food arrived quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the place that could eat cheap, real, local and good Thai foods. If you like local feelings, very good to visit. Everything I tried was great taste, if I would choose one recommendations, try the green curry! And you don’t need to worry if you do not speak Thai. they have an English menu with photos. I like this place very much.
sample_reviews_en.author: ken masuda

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wonton Noodle Soup with BBQ Pork
Thin, silky noodles with a crispy texture.
Tender, roasted BBQ pork.
Medium-sized wontons with medium-thick wrappers, soft and not mushy.
Flavorful broth.
Affordable price.
Busy with customers in the early evening, mostly buying takeout.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soottipong Winyoopradist

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so delicious! The best! If I don't eat it one day, it feels like something's missing from my life. I can live without a boyfriend, but I absolutely cannot live without this pork blood soup! 🥰🥰🥰 …
sample_reviews_en.author: นัสชา นัสชา

sample_reviews_en.text: Good quality at reasonable prices, with a wide selection—Thai curry, Thai hot and sour, green curry, fried rice noodles, fish dishes, soups, rice, and a Thai coffee bar.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali Ali

sample_reviews_en.text: Pork blood soup with hot and delicious broth. Dry noodles with thin, soft noodles. Dumplings in soup are fragrant and the soup is delicious, no need to add seasoning.
sample_reviews_en.author: นรินทร์ เพ่งจิตต์

sample_reviews_en.text:
A place to relax and enjoy evening and late-night meals for a healthy lifestyle.
Many aspects contribute to a fun and enjoyable life for local people.
At night, when people don't bother each other, problems don't arise in our lives.
Living in society leads to a happy life.
sample_reviews_en.author: pol 1234

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice noodles are delicious, the portions are generous, and it's very cheap. The sauce is flavorful and thick. They have a variety of delicious dishes, especially the pork and chicken larb, which are amazing. And the prices are very affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noy Nilavong

restaurants.name: Goodies Ari
restaurants.address:

490/15 Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: This restaurant uses a smoke-extracting stove, so your clothes and hair won't smell like smoke after eating. Food prices start from 10฿-80฿, with a wide variety of choices. There are several soup bases to choose from. The mala soup isn't very spicy, but it has the characteristic numbing sensation of mala, making it easy to eat continuously.
sample_reviews_th.author: Khanittha Sangob

sample_reviews_en.text:
We tried this place because the restaurant we intended to go to was closed (in the Aqua project).
We ate the buffet, which cost 329+ baht (excluding drinks).

The quality of the ingredients was good. The tofu skin was delicious, the cheese-wrapped pork and sweet potato noodles were tasty. However, some dishes seemed like they had been prepared a while ago, like the pork which was tough and stuck to the plate.

The staff provided good service; they cleared plates constantly, and the food arrived relatively quickly.

😱The only downside was the saltiness!!! We only ordered the black broth soup, and it was extremely salty. Even pouring half a bottle of Singha water into it couldn't dilute the saltiness.

The dipping sauce provided by the restaurant (the egg yolk sauce) was also extremely salty. The marinated pork/beef was also incredibly salty, intensifying the saltiness. This was the first time I felt something was so salty it was bitter and numb to the tongue. I quickly checked out before I had sudden kidney failure.

The total bill was 344 baht... I felt like I could have bought noodles from a shop near Saphan Kwai instead; it would have been tastier.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawa Payo

sample_reviews_en.text: I went right when the restaurant opened, so it wasn't very crowded. The decor drew me in; the interior is gorgeous, a lovely Korean-style decoration. I loved it, it's prettier than many other restaurants. There's a wide variety of menu options. They have platters with various types of meat, the most expensive being 80 baht, but the meat is high quality and delicious. The ingredients are premium. Some skewers are slightly more expensive than other places. The broth is rich and flavorful, especially the spicy pork bone broth and the mala broth – they're amazing! They also have craft fruit drinks from Northern Thailand, which are delicious. There are also nice photo spots for checking in, if it's not too crowded. 😆 Overall, I recommend trying this restaurant, especially if you like mala or if you've never tried it before. And importantly, the ice cream is amazing! I loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nittha

sample_reviews_en.text:
This conveyor belt mala hot pot restaurant really doesn't leave you smelling like smoke after eating!

This is the first time I've ever encountered a mala conveyor belt restaurant where you don't leave any lingering smell in your hair. Plus, the ingredients are top-notch, the broth and dipping sauces are delicious, and they even have homemade ice cream for dessert. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pay Watson

sample_reviews_en.text: 😋 The soup is very rich, we like it (more rich than many restaurants I've been to). The pork and beef are also of good quality and worth the price. The dipping sauce is deliciously mixed. The egg goes well with the meat, it's a bit salty, contrasting with the meaty flavor. The restaurant is clean, highly recommended. Another thing is that there's no lingering smell, very impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darin Thongson

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was very clean, the meat was perfectly prepared with a film-like coating on every plate, and the beef was fresh and high-quality. The dipping sauce with egg was delicious and flavorful – I really liked it. There was a variety of soups to choose from. Overall, it was delicious, great value for money, and importantly, I didn't smell like food afterwards! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: ck

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pros: There's a smoke extractor, so the smell won't linger on your clothes. The soup (dark broth) is quite good. There isn't a huge variety of food, but there's a good selection of pork, chicken, and beef.
Cons: The price is quite a bit higher than typical conveyor belt mala restaurants, from the soup and dipping sauces to the food on the conveyor belt.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pccw Pup

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! I loved the soup and the egg-flavored dipping sauce. The meat was also very tasty, especially the meat with the egg-flavored dipping sauce – it was amazing! I was very impressed. The restaurant was clean, the soup and the dipping sauces were all delicious, and the prices were reasonable too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudarat Promkong

restaurants.name: ทอดมันปลาอินทรี หน้าวัดจักรวรรดิ
restaurants.address:

223 ถนน จักรวรรดิ Chakkrawat, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I arrived at the shop at 11:20. Although there was no one waiting outside, there was a queue of people who had called in to reserve. I had to order my fried fish cakes from the female owner. I expected to receive them around 12:30. // After shopping for other things in the area, I returned to the shop around 12:35. They still didn't have enough fried fish cakes, so I had to wait for the next batch. In the end, I received them around 1:00 PM.

The fish cakes were chewy and delicious, not too spicy.
The dipping sauce was thick and flavorful, with a generous amount of sweet, sour, and spicy sauce.
One set costs 50฿ and contains 18 pieces, along with the dipping sauce and separate cucumber slices.
The quality and taste are excellent for the price. No wonder the shop has so many customers.

I recommend calling to order in advance, because if you wait outside, you'll have to wait over an hour.

The shop accepts cash and QR payments.
sample_reviews_th.author: Ning Nanta

sample_reviews_th.text: These deep-fried king mackerel fish cakes are made with tender and chewy fish, and come with a delicious dipping sauce. A set costs 50฿ and they're sold on the roadside in front of Wat Chakrawat. Today, they were freshly made and hot from the pan. However, if you come when there are many customers, you might have to wait in line for a bit.
sample_reviews_th.author: Narumon Intaraprom

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located on Anuwong Road, near Wat Chakrawat. It's right in front of the shop if you walk from Sampeng, just cross the pedestrian bridge. There are no tables to sit at; it's takeout only. There's no parking; you have to park in the temple and walk back. Menu items start at 50 baht. We ordered fried king mackerel fish cakes and spring rolls (vegetarian and fish cake fillings) for 50 baht each. The dipping sauce was flavorful and slightly sweet. Personally, the fish cakes were chewy and a bit oily, but the spring rolls were too doughy and had little filling. The vegetarian spring rolls only had tapioca pearls in them; they should probably be called tapioca spring rolls instead. The fish cake-filled spring rolls were practically empty; they'd be more like wonton wrappers with a fish cake flavor.

The front-of-house service was excellent and fast. They brought tissues very quickly when we asked.
sample_reviews_en.author: cosmo

sample_reviews_en.text:
When you're walking around Sampeng, you have to stop by the area in front of Wat Sam Pluem to try the 100-year-old recipe for deep-fried king mackerel fish cakes from Auntie Lips' stall.
In front of Wat Chakrawat (or Sam Pluem), there are two old-school food carts, one selling fried meatballs and the other deep-fried fish cakes, run by relatives and located right next to each other, near the Chao Krom Peh shop in front of the temple.
Anyone who likes deep-fried fish cakes with a chewy texture and a rich, flavorful dipping sauce should definitely stop by this stall every time. Now they've expanded to a new location next to Auntie Aon's curry rice shop, occupying a separate shop unit. They're incredibly popular, with two fryers and a full staff. If you're visiting the temple or Sampeng, you absolutely must stop by.
sample_reviews_en.author: Art Suwarnatemiya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Deep-fried Mackerel Fish Cakes near Wat Chakrawat
I drove past just as they opened, so there weren't many people. I parked and bought two bags to take home.
👉 The stall is right in front of Wat Chakrawat, a food cart that's easy to spot.
👉 You can park along the roadside.
👉 While waiting, the aroma of the deep-fried fish cakes was so tempting that I had to buy a set of fish cakes and spring rolls. They came with separate dipping sauce and cucumber, which looked great. When I got home and tried them, the spring rolls were super crispy, and the fish cakes were plentiful, hot, and delicious.
👉 Each set costs 50 baht. Compared to the quality, it's very cheap.
I recommend trying it if you haven't already. The stall opens at 9:30 AM.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชรินทร์ วิภาวีพลกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're not a regular customer, don't go there. I personally experienced a male seller with a foul mouth who cursed at customers. Even when I called to reserve a pickup time, he couldn't find my name and accused me of cutting in line. He just kept rambling. I apologized and told him I had a call recording app on my phone. When he finally found my name, he went silent. I retorted, "You can curse at customers, but you can't apologize?" He's probably gone from there; he's popular for his sales but has a terrible mouth. There's a famous fried food stall in Bangkok, one on Saint Louis Street, Soi 3, opposite the entrance to Assumption College Primary School.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamthorn Charoensinporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop's deep-fried king mackerel fish cakes have been around for over 100 years, located in front of Wat Chakrawat temple. They use real king mackerel, which results in a chewy texture. Adding too much flour would make the fish cakes less chewy and easily break apart. Upon arrival, you'll need to get a queue number at the shop sign. Once it's your turn, you can order. A set costs 50 baht and is quite generous in portion size; one set is enough to fill you up. Highly recommended for anyone in the area!

#FoodieTour
#Foodie
sample_reviews_en.author: M Shayutpong Kiatpimolkul

sample_reviews_en.text: When I got off the bus and passed by, I saw a huge queue. I thought I'd just join the crowd. Turns out it was a Michelin recommendation! They were frying food on the spot, and many people were ordering by phone, so don't assume there were only a few people in line. One serving costs 50 (presumably in local currency), and it's really delicious when eaten hot. This is a local delicacy that only they know about; you must try it if you have the chance to come.
sample_reviews_en.author: lily chen

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken is delicious, but I once received old chicken that tasted sour. The rice, however, smelled spoiled and rotten, absolutely disgusting. I order from this restaurant regularly. The first time I had this problem, I didn't think much of it, but now it's happened twice. I'm going to stop ordering from this place.

sample_reviews_en.text: I asked someone to buy this for me. The outside was burnt, the burnt smell permeated the meat, but the inside was undercooked. I'm so confused! They didn't control the heat at all. 🥲 The dipping sauce was way too salty. I was really looking forward to eating it, but I'm so disappointed.

sample_reviews_en.text: I personally love this grilled chicken. I've been here three times before deciding to write a review. The best charcoal-grilled chicken in Pattaya ❤️ Highly recommended.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered plain rice through Grab but received sticky rice. I couldn't contact anyone either. It's not a huge problem, but it's frustrating.

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled pork is not cooked, the grilled chicken is delicious!! Before, I had to wait a long time, now I don't have to wait.

sample_reviews_en.text: Was a little bit disappointed, had alot of hard bits in the food, unsure if small bones or not. Might just be this time.

sample_reviews_en.text: You knew the chicken wasn't cooked properly, yet you chose to serve it to us. Once is enough. I'm very disappointed.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Clean, delicious, and easy to eat flavors.
Some dishes might be a bit sweet (especially the spicy salads).
There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, and the service is very fast. The staff is good.
-Squid larb: Fresh, bouncy, and not fishy.
-Sweetened liver: Not dry, not fishy, ​​large pieces.
-Lotus stem with shrimp: Fresh, large shrimp.
-Grilled pork intestines: Well-marinated, with a nice spice aroma.
-Spicy rice noodle salad with blanched vegetables: Delicious, the noodles are perfectly cooked, not overcooked.
-Spicy pork rib soup: Just okay, the broth is refreshing, but the pork itself is just average.
Overall, good, excellent, definitely worth trying!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirapatch Tongprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
This time, the papaya salad wasn't to my liking. The Luang Prabang style papaya salad only had the smell of shrimp paste and was bland. So I tried ordering several different types of papaya salad. In summary, the Lao style papaya salad was okay, but the crab papaya salad lacked flavor, and the rice noodle salad was too sour. The lime flavor was bitter in every dish.
I'd like to go back to the Pinklao branch like before. Their cooking is consistent, and the food is delicious every time I eat there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tuk Tuktuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located on the ground floor in front of Tops. The corn som tam is delicious, and the salad is quite tasty.
They also offer sets, such as Set 1 for 644 baht.
There are about 5-6 tables. Recommended dishes include the pork sausage salad and the corn som tam with salted egg. The flavors are perfectly balanced and the price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pim lada

sample_reviews_en.text:
I go to this somtum (papaya salad) restaurant very often. The food is really delicious and the taste is great. The crab here is 100% genuine freshwater crab.
The fish sauce is very flavorful and not too salty. Every time I go, I finish all the somtum sauce. It's my favorite regular restaurant. The other dishes are just as delicious.
🤤🤤🤤❤️❤️❤️👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Piya wan

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is great! You can choose the spiciness level. Even those who can't handle spicy food can eat the medium spicy version. If you like really spicy food, I recommend choosing the extra spicy option. The price is reasonable considering the portion size. The food didn't take long to arrive, and the drinks were served quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anny Rose

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! My absolute favorites were the mangosteen salad and the crying pork. All the other dishes were great too: grilled chicken, papaya salad, salmon salad, fried chicken wings, and stir-fried noodles with grilled pork. The portions aren't huge, so you can try a variety of dishes. And the prices are very affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawut Nganpinyo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located on the G floor, in front of Tops. The spicy salads are delicious.
There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from.
Recommended dishes include spicy pork sausage salad and corn salad with salted egg. The flavors are perfectly balanced, and the prices are affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ailyn S

sample_reviews_en.text:
🤩 Fancy some good spicy flavors and love the north eastern Thai taste 🌶️ - then this is the place for you.

We had a few dishes and all were great. I recommend the shrimp papaya salad. Good taste 👍🌟🌟🌟. Oh and the esaan sausages were nice as well. 👍

Hope you have a good time here.

- PP 🌱
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuii & PP

sample_reviews_en.text: From the outside, the entrance looks like it's under construction, made of corrugated iron. But upon closer inspection, you'll see a cafe serving food and coffee. The food is delicious. The staff seemed a little confused but were attentive and provided good service. The prices are typical of a cafe/restaurant. It looks like a small place, but the back area has many large tables, a fountain, swings, a slide for children, and even a chicken coop. Apparently, there's live music in the evenings, and they also have a beer buffet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sineephan Piyanaraporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and flavorful.
The BBQ pork is tasty, the dipping sauce is rich and flavorful, and they also have seafood dipping sauce. The soup is like a savory rice porridge and is delicious.

Other dishes are also delicious.

There's plenty of parking.
The restaurant has a great atmosphere. Coming after 4 pm, the breeze is cool and comfortable.

They also have pets: chickens, rabbits, and parrots.

Other details:

The staff provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sittichok Thanawatphong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the staff provides good service.
The restaurant has a spacious and airy atmosphere with parking available.
The restaurant mentions live music on Fridays and Saturdays.
The restaurant is open Monday to Saturday and closed on Sundays.
Just be careful when entering and exiting the restaurant; it's located in an alley, so be careful not to miss it, and watch out for oncoming traffic when leaving.
sample_reviews_en.author: FB :Tidty Tid Piyathida

sample_reviews_en.text:
We booked a table for an evening office dinner, but because it was during a New Year's party, there were a lot of offices and it was very crowded. The food took a very long time to arrive. I recommend booking a table or calling the restaurant beforehand if you plan to go.

The weather and the location were great. The man, who seemed to be the owner, was very attentive and helpful. 👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: fahh SP

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, Ploy visited Plearndee Cafe. The atmosphere is amazing, and they have a wide variety of food at reasonable prices. It was a great place to have a meal and listen to music with my boyfriend. It was a perfect vibe! 💗
sample_reviews_en.author: Varaporn Srirattanapan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is good, staff is also provide good service mind too.
But bad service and communication from owner.
He presents rude manner to their staff and also customer.
Never go again

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, great atmosphere, reasonable prices, and light live music around 7:30 PM.

The only downside is there's no dessert to cleanse the palate. 💋♥️
sample_reviews_en.author: Prangky Narak

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great, the food is delicious and worth the price, and the service is good.
The owner is lovely. I recommend this cafe near Hua Mak, Rama 9.
sample_reviews_en.author: nanta Wara
