480 Phatthanakan 30, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Betong-style Hainanese chicken rice is incredibly delicious. Everyone who tries it loves it. The rice is fragrant jasmine rice with a great flavor. The chicken is large, very tender, and perfectly cooked. The chicken offal is not tough, but soft and delicious. There are two dipping sauces: a very tasty seafood sauce that pairs well with the chicken, and a savory black soy sauce that offers a different kind of deliciousness. You won't be disappointed no matter how many times you try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasan Saengmongkhon

sample_reviews_en.text: The Hainanese chicken rice is delicious. The rice grains are perfectly cooked, and the chicken is tender. The restaurant serves two types of dipping sauces: a dark one and a light one. The dark one is saltier, while the light one is more sour. Both are delicious and well-balanced. I tried mixing them together. The restaurant also has high-quality sweet soy sauce for those who prefer a sweeter taste. I highly recommend trying it; you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monthon Richmantoy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rice is tender, the boiled chicken is soft and sweet, not chewy, the fried chicken is crispy, the dipping sauce is delicious, and the soup is sweet and fragrant.

Overall, everything is good, all at the same price of 50 baht per dish.
The special is 60 baht. I ate here for the first time when I was a student, that was 15 years ago. It wouldn't have lasted this long if it wasn't good.
sample_reviews_en.author: pronong BSD

sample_reviews_en.text:
There is parking in front of the shop and on the street across the street.
The rice is delicious, the chicken is tender, and there are two types of dipping sauces, a light one and a dark one, both delicious. If you prefer a mild flavor, I recommend the light one; if you like a spicier flavor, I recommend the dark one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitisin Changtrakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste has changed; I wish it were the same as before. I'll try again next time. The chicken seemed a bit tough. The amount of rice and chicken has increased. It was just the right amount to fill me up (special) 60 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Non Nontakarnkul (Andy)

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice is dry, fragrant, and delicious. The chicken isn't as juicy as those from famous restaurants. There are two types of dipping sauces: sour and salty. Overall, it's delicious. Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Komson Satjavitvisarn

sample_reviews_en.text: Clean and tasty, but quite expensive considering the portion size. A regular serving is 50 baht for 4-5 pieces of boiled chicken. There's limited parking, only 2 spaces in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: TBK

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered large Hainanese chicken rice with fired chicken. She gave me normal one and said rice is almost ran out, but she still can serve to another table
sample_reviews_en.author: Maetad Sukarasud

restaurants.name: Tee Kha Moo
restaurants.address:

335 ซอย สาทร 11 Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: New plates, new glasses, new condiment containers, chilies with stems removed, peeled garlic, new teapot—everything's been changed. Even the spoons have been replaced. (The old-school charm is gone, like with the teapot.) The pork knuckle is good, though a little small. All that's left is to repaint the restaurant and tile the floors. Free water would be perfect again... Fewer customers than before, but I'm rooting for them. We've been eating here for a long time. Maybe they should check out the competition in the area. The taste is slightly sweet, depending on personal preference. If you like thin, crispy skin, then this is it.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Nivatyakul

sample_reviews_en.text: I learned about this restaurant 34 years ago from a friend's recommendation. They said I had to come early, so I went around 9:00 AM, but they were already sold out. They said I had to come at 7:00 AM to really try it. So I had to find another opportunity. The next day, they still had some, but the pork knuckle that my friend recommended as amazing was gone. So I had to come back again the day after that. This time, I had to order it in advance. I have to admit, after that first visit, I forgot about all other restaurants. It was truly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Viroon Aroonnithi

sample_reviews_en.text: When my mother used to sell, people would line up since around 2 a.m. There would be a lot of people waiting to eat. They would fight to buy it. It was so delicious that they would bring a cooler full of liquor and beer from home to drink with their friends until the shop opened. The owner was scared, haha, because he wouldn't stop drinking. Now it's delicious, but it can't compare to my mother. I'm worried, my little sister. P.S. Even our own people say so.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichai Thitiwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Anyone who wants to follow Mr. Tan here to eat, stop thinking about it.
The restaurant is going out of business. The taste is strangely sweet and not rich.
It's not what I expected. The restaurant is extremely dirty. The spoons and plates look like they haven't been washed. I thought you were trying to continue what your father did, but you weren't trying at all. If you're not paying attention like this, you should just go bankrupt.
sample_reviews_en.author: Armyo Zendai (ARMYO)

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait wasn't too long, and the taste was good, but the side dishes were sparse. There was no price list. I ordered three bags to take away (each bag had very little meat). The price and taste didn't match at all. I think it might have tasted better and been more consistent before, but now it's not good enough. Or maybe I just don't appreciate the taste? It was a waste of time waiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Loveday14

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've never been there to eat, but I've heard about it from Mr. Tan.
Mr. Tan is a lovely person who helped the restaurant to get back to where it is today.
Please maintain Mr. Tan's kindness.
It must be delicious if we love what we do. I'll definitely go try it sometime.
#Sending you encouragement and wishing you a warm and loving family.
sample_reviews_en.author: สัมพันธ์ อินทร์เพ็ญ

sample_reviews_en.text: I followed the story and wanted to support them, but I was very disappointed. The flavor wasn't strong, it was too sweet, and the portion was tiny, like something you'd find in Chinatown. I won't be supporting them again. I ate there on April 1st, 2020.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธิติ ตัณฑเศณี

sample_reviews_en.text: I haven't tried it yet, but I hope I might go someday. I followed them from Mr. Tan's show. I'm hoping they're truly dedicated to their work. I think everyone is hoping and waiting for the restaurant's flourishing success. I'm rooting for Tee Kha Moo!
sample_reviews_en.author: 9face Design group

restaurants.name: The Patio
restaurants.address:

196, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found a time-specific discount for the buffet on a certain discount website and made a reservation for 8:30 PM. To my surprise, there was only one other group of customers, but all the desirable items were gone!
I regretted being lured in by the discount; this is what a time-specific discount is supposed to be like.
I asked the staff at the sashimi counter, just to be sure, "Are you out of sashimi?" The staff were incredibly kind and said they could make a set for me if I wanted!
While I waited, eating other things, they brought me a sashimi set. This alone was amazing service, but a little later they brought a sushi set, then a gratin in a seashell, and then a seafood BBQ platter—so many dishes I absolutely couldn't eat them all!
Of course, I enjoyed them all. I'm so grateful.
It seems this hotel restaurant is often used for gatherings of Japanese people in Pattaya.
In any case, I recommend going to this restaurant's buffet early.
The customers seem to know this and rush in early, so by late hours, both the customers and the food are gone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Spanky Kun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really don't understand the two Koreans who gave low ratings below, haha.

First off, regarding dinner, the menu was decent and seemed to be tailored to Korean tastes. When we visited, there were a lot of large groups of Korean middle-aged men and women, so it seemed like Koreans visit consistently.

The service was the best among all the hotels in Thailand. I consider staff friendliness to be the standard for service, and they were incredibly kind. There was even a staff member who spoke fluent Korean, so we were able to make requests easily.

The atmosphere is a matter of personal preference, but as long as other guests don't ruin the vibe, the hotel's atmosphere itself was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: JUNG MOND 정몬드

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a buffet exclusively for Koreans. Since most guests are brought in by travel agencies, reservations are essential. I recommend booking in advance using a travel agency coupon. The food is generally delicious, the service is friendly, and there is a live station serving a variety of noodles (Pad Thai, pasta, etc.). Additionally, each person is provided with an all-you-can-eat seafood platter. I was so full I almost got indigestion. It is a buffet with great value for money. I recommend visiting at least once if you come to Pattaya, but please keep in mind that over 95% of the customers are Korean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ricky Yu

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a wonderful breakfast at Patio, the hotel's restaurant. The breakfast spread was not only delicious but also diverse, offering a wide range of options to choose from. Whether you prefer a hearty meal or a light start to your day, you'll find something to suit your taste. The quality of the food and the attentive service made my mornings at the hotel truly enjoyable. I highly recommend starting your day at Patio – it's a fantastic way to kick off your day during your stay at the hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ming Yue

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overpriced Buffet for 1000 baht . seafood selection very limited and controlled distribution to the customers . The general taste medium to poor. Large groups of tourists visit the place with huge busses , mass tourism groups visit the hotel restaurant.
Seafood a little cold and prepared one or two hours before from the hotel personnel in order to serve it fast to  the groups .
The general salad bar and Buffet inside the restaurant very poor in taste too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Scamfoghter Sec

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, my wife and me have a good dinner buffet at The Patio.
Good price, food and service. The F/B Manager: Mr. Yuki get us
a very good service and suggestion of food. We enjoy the dinner
very well.

The Patio is inside Hotel VIsta. And location at North Pattaya Soi 4. We will go again and recomment our friends to come.

The F/B Manager: Mr. Yuki is very kindly and professional staff.
Can give you a good service.

Thanks again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Joe

sample_reviews_en.text: We went for a seafood buffet dinner that we booked online. There was a huge variety of seafood available, served in sets, and you could ask for refills. The staff even peeled the seafood for us, which was fantastic! The seafood was fresh and delicious, the seafood dipping sauce was great, and the salmon was delicious too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simpson Ka

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very impressed with Neptune and Yuki! Neptune and Yuki were so lovely, always asking if we wanted more food and recommending delicious dishes. The food at the hotel was also delicious, I highly recommend it! The hotel is reasonably priced and the service is great. I will definitely come again!
sample_reviews_en.author: อรฉัตร บุ่งอุทุม

restaurants.name: Fa Pla Tahn EmSphere
restaurants.address:

G43, 564 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍲 Fa Pla Tahn @ Emsphere — Great Flavours, But Service Needs Work

This was our second visit to Fa Pla Tahn at Emsphere, but unfortunately, we noticed a dip in service quality. The staff seemed disengaged and unwelcoming, which affected the overall dining experience. It’s always disappointing when the hospitality doesn’t match the food.

That said, we tried their Red Soup Yen Ta Fo, which really impressed us with its variety and richness. The broth had that familiar sweet-sour base similar to what you find in Singapore, but their version came fully loaded with a generous mix of toppings:
•	Fish cake
•	Deep-fried tofu skin
•	Fried fish
•	Pork blood
•	Deep-fried spiced yam roll
•	Fried pork dumpling
•	Fish dumpling
•	Boiled morning glory (kang kong)
•	Served with flat rice noodles

They also offer a choice of 7 different noodle types, including egg noodles and their signature egg white noodles, which adds a nice personalized touch.

Overall, the food was hearty and comforting — but the lack of attentive service held the experience back from being truly enjoyable. Hopefully, management can look into this and bring back the warmth and friendliness that made our first visit memorable.
sample_reviews_en.author: WanderWithWit

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate here several times as I was feeling the need for some comfort food after falling ill in Bangkok.

On two occasions, I ordered the Boiled Rice with Fish with clear soup.  The soup itself was not as tasty as I was expecting it to be.  Quite mild, certainly not bad, just did not have the depth of flavour that I hoped for.  This was made up for, by the quality and texture of the fish.  Nice juicy solid pieces of fish, with great bite and mouth feel.  I also tried the fried wonton as a separate additional dish with this dish.  To be honest, the wontons were a bit over salted and their fried saltiness did not really seem to fit well with this dish (it was overpowering).  Get the fish soup, leave the wontons!

On the second occasion, I ordered the fish balls with egg noodles soup.  The Fish Balls were excellent.  Full of flavour, nice bouncy texture.  Soup was good and this time, with only two pieces and a different soup, the fried wonton added a nice crunch and texture to the dish (and was not too salty).

So overall, it was quite good, and certainly what I needed at the time.  Good enough to have me return multiple times!
sample_reviews_en.author: I

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fish noodles here are very Teochew influenced, focusing on a wide selection of fish balls, fish cakes, and fish slices made from different types of fish. Very tasty and pretty light. You can have them with noodles, with soup, with pork, or all of the above. You can also select from 5 different types of noodles, from thin rice vermicelli to thick egg noodles.

My only gripe is that I wasn’t convinced that the rice vermicelli I ordered was the right one. I’m pretty sure I got the thin version instead of the thicker one that I prefer with Teochew soup bases.

Speaking of soup bases, they also have a special red “yen tau fu” soup base that is more tangy and can be made spicy, for a twist. Southeast Asian ethnic Chinese should be no stranger to this concept.

It’s one of the few restaurants in the Food Hall at Emsphere with a generous seating area. Decorated with multi colored lanterns, it offers quite a vibrant atmosphere. The staff is also quite attentive and helpful.

Overall, not a bad choice if you’re wanting something easily digestible yet filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: j L

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a fish ball noodle lover, I eat Thai fish ball noodles non-stop when I come to Bangkok. Today, after shopping at Emsphere Mall, I tried "Kam Fook Kee" (a chain store). It's best to sit down and eat slowly, instead of standing around so messy. Besides the basic Thai fish ball noodles, they also have real fish slices to choose from, and you can choose between clear broth or tom yum soup base.

I tried their signature fish ball noodles. The fish balls were very bouncy, with a Thai sweet and fresh flavor, and a smooth texture. They were a perfect match with the thin rice noodles, which soaked up the broth beautifully. The clear broth base was relatively less MSG and not too thirsty. The counter had all the necessary Thai chili powder, fish sauce, sugar, and vinegar! You can DIY and create the perfect balance of sour and spicy flavors 😋

The shop is clean and tidy. For a place in a mall with this kind of atmosphere, it's more than enough. But you get what you pay for; the three of us ate for 1200 baht!
sample_reviews_en.author: 秋葉緣

sample_reviews_en.text:
A noodles and Teochew porridge place at the basement. Small eatery in the middle of many other options. I like how the noodles came with a bit of everything, from fish cake to sliced fish (of different types) to fish ball and their wanton. The fried fish is what will have me returning. A variety of noodle types to choose from too, including Fish Noodles (chewy fish paste like noodles). Portions are small but they have options for larger portions and a wide range of sides that look really good if you have a group big enough to share.

Didn't try the rice porridge this time but it did look good (peeping over to the next table), felt like it would make a hearty meal on a rainy day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daphne Yeo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is part of a cluster of eateries in Emsphere. It offers a wide variety of noodle dishes, including dry noodles and soups, as well as yen tou fu and tom yum. They also have a complete selection of fish balls, rice soup and starter snacks.

The noodle tom yum red sauce is a must-try. It comes with all the complete toppings and allows you to choose your preferred noodle type. Adding some Thai chili makes it even more delicious. It’s also better with a refreshing chrysanthemum drink.

This place is the perfect spot to enjoy authentic Thai noodle and fish ball dishes.

As always, the service at this restaurant is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: M *

sample_reviews_en.text: The guy wearing the supervisor name tag is a total jerk^^ When I asked what the famous menu was, he didn't answer and didn't even speak aloud. When I ordered, he didn't even make a gesture to show that he understood. Why are you so angry from the beginning when I didn't even do anything...? This is the first time I've had such an unpleasant experience in Thailand, so I'm embarrassed.. I don't usually leave reviews, but I'm leaving one so that Koreans don't get scammed~~ It's not something you necessarily want to eat here, so go eat somewhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: minyoung kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
My wife discovered this place last Christmas and I love them ever since!
The rich broth with depth and flavor is the best part! Egg Noodles are always soft, that’s how it is in most restaurants in Bangkok except a few authentic HK style wonton noodles! I like everything in this dish except the fried piece of fish! The batter is always mushy because it’s been soaking in the hot broth, and fish is smelly like catfish, I think it’s some king of river fish! Only 179 Baht plus tax, still under 200!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pepper Morris

restaurants.name: MK Restaurant Big C Extra On Nut
restaurants.address:

114 On Nut Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible, especially at table 49 in the very back. This was because there were only 10 tables occupied when we arrived (they didn't clear the tables after customers had finished eating). The elderly lady who took our order was nice, but after that, getting anything was incredibly difficult, from chili and garlic to dipping sauces and lime juice. If these things are so hard to get, they should consider having customers serve themselves.
Next, the orders took forever to arrive. What angered me the most was that my order was incomplete. When I asked the employee in the white uniform (probably a student), she didn't even look to see what the missing item was and just brushed me off. When paying, I informed another employee about the incident, and it was probably the manager who came to apologize, along with the person responsible [in a perfunctory way]. I left because everyone in the restaurant was staring at me. I understand I was dining alone, but compared to other tables with more than two people, the service was like I was asking for free food. I only ate at this branch because it's on my way home. I'm done with this branch permanently. Bye.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutcha “Natcha.niiw49” Wich

sample_reviews_en.text:
MK Suki is another restaurant that maintains high standards in food quality, taste, and service. I've eaten at many branches and have always received a warm welcome and attentive, polite service. The care given to customers, including refilling dipping sauces, drinks, and suki soup, is very impressive. However, some branches may experience some delays due to a high volume of orders exceeding the number of staff.
My favorite branch is the Big C On Nut branch. When I go, the staff always attend to me. The last time I went, a staff member greeted me with a very polite and attentive manner, showing great respect for customers. The staff are very helpful, offering recommendations and answering questions in a friendly way. It's a branch I like to bring foreign guests to or to meet friends at. The food tastes consistently high, maintaining its original value. The taste is almost identical to what I've enjoyed for decades.
The staff are well-trained, calm, polite, and dedicated to providing excellent service.
It's a restaurant I regularly frequent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ding

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was standard.

However, the staff were unaware of the current promotion details. They had to ask a senior colleague and take photos from my phone to confirm the terms and conditions.

When paying, they only asked how I wanted to pay, disappeared for a while, and returned with a QR code to scan. I was confused about whether the discount was applied or not; I had to ask myself. Normally, staff will let you check the food items to make sure they are correct and will inform you of the discount amount and the final payment.

Other restaurants will refill your water (even when paying). Here, there was none. I only got one full glass of water. They paid and that was it. I didn't leave until the staff looked at me but didn't say anything. I couldn't stand being thirsty anymore and had to ask them to refill my water before leaving.

It's not like the branch I usually frequent. There must be a difference in training.
sample_reviews_en.author: b_chrys

sample_reviews_en.text: On October 12, 1965, between 7:45 PM and 7:55 PM, my noodles were almost finished, and I wanted to put the vegetable tray on the table but couldn't. So I called a staff member to ask them to clear my noodle plate. I don't understand why they made a face at me. There weren't many customers in the restaurant. Was it because I wasn't well-dressed that they could serve me however they wanted? Seeing that, I said, "Okay, never mind." My girlfriend told me to give it to them, and I didn't want any trouble, so I handed the plate to the staff member who made that face at me. Why? Was it because I wasn't well-dressed? You can check the security camera footage. I was wearing glasses, a maroon crew-neck shirt, and a fanny pack. That way you'll know who the staff member was.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bunpot Buretharn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch is similar to all other MK branches all around Thailand .  The only difference is seen in location, service, location, and atmosphere.
First impression is immediately after stepping in, we were noticed by the staff, and our presence was acknowledged by a welcoming speech.  Staff also guided us to select a dining table and immediately given a mobile tablet for menu browsing, selecting, and ordering electronically. Automated Robot was also helping staff in serving ready meals and delivering food to the table.  Paying was straightforward, this time felt a slight delay in receiving remaining change for the bill, after paying in cash.
Scenery was limited as it is located in ground floor of a shopping center.
sample_reviews_en.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disclaimer: I visited this restaurant during Covid 19, and some of the lack of quality could be contributed to that. Now on to the review.

The food in no way matched what I actually received, many items were missing, or clearly not what was shown in the menu. What I did get was incredibly bland and mediocre. The water had.. something else in it. It tasted vaguely of soy sauce, but in reality, it was probably just dirty water. The cola was an incredibly small portion for 40 baht with No refill.

I'm not one to write bad reviews, in fact this is the first review I've ever bothered writing in my entire lifetime. Honestly, I'd just stay away from this one for now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Colby Eisbrenner

sample_reviews_en.text:
A sukki specialty restaurant located on the first floor of Big C Onnut.
MK sukki's flavors and ingredients are similar or identical across branches, making it difficult to differentiate reviews. It's all about the familiar flavor. The only differences are the management, atmosphere, and service attitude of the staff.

It was my first time experiencing MK sukki in a long time.
The ingredients were fresh, and everything was excellent.

I appreciated the staff's frequent attention to and care for our table.

However, I was a little taken aback when there was no staff member to show me to my seat upon entering.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soon Taek Kwon

sample_reviews_en.text:
**Updated**
This branch of MK RESTAURANT is located on the first floor of BIGC Extra Onnut on Onnut Road. The food is delicious, the atmosphere is great, and the staff provides excellent service.
The food is delicious, and the dipping sauce remains their secret recipe. They constantly update and add new menu items, which I really appreciate. The staff provides great service, and I especially like that they employ students, senior citizens, and even people with disabilities. I support this initiative. You can pay by scanning a QR code, which is very convenient.
(Updated pictures taken on December 1, 2023)
sample_reviews_en.author: KJ Thangs

restaurants.name: Mae Prayoon
restaurants.address:

408/3 Rama V Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mae Prayoon Pad Thai & Fried Seafood (Ratchawat)
Found it on Google, it looks like Pad Thai.
Dry style, not oily or soggy.

Menu ordered:
Regular Pad Thai 60 baht
Shrimp and Radish Cake 90 baht
Bottled water + ice 12 baht
The portions aren't large.
The prices might seem high compared to the quantity.
But the quality and ingredients are good.
The dried shrimp are large. The pickled radish and other ingredients are good.
The vegetables provided are good, including banana blossom.

The Pad Thai is dry-fried noodles.
It's slightly sweet.
Add some chili powder and squeeze some lime.

It's delicious!

The radish cake is a bit salty.
There aren't many vegetables, but it's acceptable.

The staff are very friendly and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bewara Forday

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Pad Thai here is top-notch, incredibly delicious, and the price is great. The service is good too, and there are tables to sit at. However, if you come by car, you'll have to park at Ratchawat Market. The shop is located on the main road.
The owner, an elderly lady, is very lovely and provides excellent service. Anyone visiting this area shouldn't miss it! ✨✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanathip Chanrueang

sample_reviews_en.text: The Pad Thai was incredibly delicious, and the crispy fried mussels were also amazing. It was clean and delicious – I give it 5 stars! I didn't intend to eat there; I was running errands in the area and happened to walk by. The owner, an elderly gentleman, was cooking and called me in. I was very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Milk Naritcha

sample_reviews_en.text: Egg wrap pad thai with prawn lacked flavor depth (and ingredients). For this price we expected bigger/more prawns or at least more noodles. The crispy mussels omelet was good, crispy edges and soft in the middle. Tasted better than the pad thai. Staff was nice and sweet, great service.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Time Was Had

sample_reviews_en.text: The Pad Thai with fried mussels was delicious! The Pad Thai wasn't too sweet, the flavor was just right. Adding a little chili made it even better. It had plenty of ingredients, and the fried mussels weren't oily, there were lots of them, and it was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyathorn Namhirankul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fried food was excellent, crispy, and not greasy. Mae Prayoon's daughter was very welcoming.
I recommend trying this place if you're in Ratchawat; it's better than other restaurants and open until 3 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภาวิน

sample_reviews_en.text: The Pad Thai was delicious! The fried mussels had a crispy batter and weren't greasy. The owner, an auntie, and her mother were lovely. It's a shame the radish cake was sold out today, I missed out!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichaya Promrat

sample_reviews_en.text: Pad Thai is not soggy, fried oysters can be ordered crispy or not, very delicious, if you come to Ratchawat, you must not miss this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: jamestonado panang

restaurants.name: SEOULCHON สาขาเซ็นทรัลพระราม2
restaurants.address:

MC7Q+JMR, Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes as good as always, but the restaurant management is terrible. I won't be eating here again. I've been to other branches that were much better in many aspects. Firstly, the floor vibrates constantly. There are two walkways, and staff walk in and out past our table, and the floor feels unstable or the structure is faulty, but it vibrates excessively, causing the water on the table to shake constantly (near the counter, not sure about other areas). The cleanliness is unacceptable. From the moment I entered, there was a foul smell, similar to dog food. Various items like rice sacks, instant noodle boxes, and egg cartons were placed on the floor and on the tables. The plates were unclean, stained with black debris. They only provided one tissue. The service was disorganized; the prioritization of orders was poor. All the food was served, and we had already started eating, but water still hadn't been served, even though it should have been the first thing to be served. We waited quite a long time for our food. Overall, ordering takeout is the best option because the food tastes better, but the overall atmosphere is terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: xiu _ns

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, but the service is very slow. We waited for an hour. The tables that arrived 2-3 later already had their food. We've been sitting here waiting for an hour and the food still hasn't arrived. We've done this many times before and I'm finally able to review it. Does this branch not follow the order of customers entering the restaurant? Or do they just order a few items and then cut in line to the table with the most orders first? The tables that arrived later were so full they were about to leave the restaurant. The food just arrived. We asked the staff and they said they were bringing it. But after that, we had to wait for almost 10 minutes. They're bringing it. It doesn't mean it's ready and then they're bringing it right away, right? It's just one bowl of ramen.
sample_reviews_en.author: cqhxmzi

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant staff were lousy and didn't pay attention to the customers. I raised my hand and made eye contact with the staff, but they didn't come. I waited and didn't say anything. The second time, they did the same thing, and I started to feel dissatisfied. I waited for the food for an hour. If I didn't follow up, I wouldn't know when I would get it. The menu didn't provide complete details. For example, the menu I ordered had seafood sauce that came with the rice and egg, and in the picture, there was a lot of sauce. I actually only got this much. I asked the staff if I could add more, but they couldn't, and I had to order another dish myself if I wanted to add more. Overall, the taste was good, but the service was terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minda

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hello.

I waited over 30 minutes for my food.
I ordered the spicy chicken Mama noodles. It was delicious.
The fries were crispy and flavorful.
The soft drinks were delicious.
But the 199 baht fried chicken set (including chicken) tasted like...
It wasn't crispy or anything.
It was like you fried the chicken and then reheated it for the customer.
Your back-end system is a failure.
And your service should be a little more attentive. When you place the food on the plate or when it's served, you should place it slowly and in the right place. Don't just rush through the 4x100 menu, like you're rushing to get it. That's not right, sir.

My personal opinion.
Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: JAKKAPHAT Wessuriya

sample_reviews_en.text: A bowl of chicken rice might not seem like a lot but it's actually filling. It's fried chicken with crispy batter and a little meat, depending on your preference. The meat isn't soft but it's not hard either. The flavor is rich and the sauce is generous. The Rose Tteok is rich and a bit sweet. The Nashville chicken has been improved, crispy but not hard. I've ordered delivery many times and it's always been hot. The pickled egg is marinated and chewy every time. The French fries aren't very tasty. The table is a bit unstable. The seats on the tiled side are uncomfortable. The tiles are now falling off a lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: jay

sample_reviews_en.text:
Plain plain

Since I unintentionally went to Central Rama2 on last weekend and searched for Korean Recipe and found the interested one in 3rd Floor near Education Zone. The menu of this day , I have 1 tricolour fried chicken with Coke glass with valuable price 119 Baht per set and need for SEAFOOD kimchi Soup , not sure for price , 179 Baht,

I think it’s a little salty for Kimchi soup but very hot from their bowl. Also, the Squid and shrimp are very plain.

For the main dish, overall is ok but taste is not yummy but enough for eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Godzillakid A.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is on the third floor and serves Korean-style food.
They have ramen, fried chicken, and various snacks.

We went with a large group and didn't wait long for our food.
They have a wide variety of dishes to choose from, including set menus.
The food is average in taste and reasonably priced, not too cheap or expensive.

✅I recommend ordering and sharing.✅
We ordered a main course and found it too rich.😭
We ate more than half the plate and couldn't stand the richness of the fried chicken anymore.
sample_reviews_en.author: plaifah pf

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, I have to come back often. The food comes out quickly and is satisfying. I've been here twice already, but the staff at the front of the restaurant are not enthusiastic. There was only me in the whole restaurant, and they were slow to bring the menu. There were only two of us standing at the counter. They never smiled when taking the order or collecting the money. It's good that there is no service charge, otherwise I would have only used the service once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanya

restaurants.name: Khaing Khaing Kyaw Bangkok (Khlong Toei Market) burmese food
restaurants.address:

1 Soi 5, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Category: Food Court

Food: On this visit, I tried the curry noodles. I found the taste to be standard, but still quite enjoyable as a simple meal. The curry sauce was savory and suitable for lovers of Myanmar cuisine, although overall, it wasn't a particularly striking flavor. This place is known as one of the Burmese restaurant chains in the Khlong Toei Market area, making it attractive for those looking to try a variety of Myanmar cuisine in Bangkok.

Price: ± IDR 25,000 per person.

Place: The restaurant feels more like a food court than a formal restaurant, with a practical and simple atmosphere for a quick meal. It's located in the Khlong Toei branch, one of Bangkok's largest and busiest markets, so the atmosphere tends to be busy, bustling, and typical of a market.

Service: I found the service to be okay, and the staff were friendly, which made for a pleasant dining experience. This atmosphere makes for a more comfortable dining experience, especially in a casual dining area within the market area.

Verdict: 4 stars for both food and place
sample_reviews_en.author: IP IP

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khaing Khaing Kyaw Restaurant is a fantastic place to enjoy authentic Myanmar food. The dishes are delicious, the portions are generous, and the prices are reasonable. The restaurant is clean, the atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the staff provide excellent service. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for quality Burmese cuisine.

Su Htike, I'm so happy to see you working here. Your friendly attitude, hard work, and excellent customer service make a great impression on everyone who visits. Keep doing your best—I’m proud of you and wish you continued success in your career. I'll definitely come back to support you again!

Your Customer for August 5
Zaw Zin Soe
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr Jhon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kai Kai Kyaw Burmese Restaurant
is a Burmese restaurant with branches in Myanmar.
They've opened a branch in Thailand, at Khlong Toei Market,
on the 2nd floor of the Khlong Toei fresh market.
The food has a strong spice profile,
influenced by Indian cuisine.
Prices vary, from normal to expensive.
I ordered the goat meat,
which is a bit pricey at around 250 baht,
but the portion was quite generous.
It came with a variety of side vegetables,
similar to Korean food – fresh vegetables, pickled vegetables, and various other accompaniments. A bowl of soup was also included.
If you want to try Burmese food, give this place a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piya Jirapapongpan

sample_reviews_en.text: Khaing Khaing Kyaw is established traditional restaurant in Myanmar. We took our late lunch at Khlong Toei Market Branch. The food is extremely delicious, authentic with very low cost, and the service is also optimal. We got burmese traditional side dishes and dessert as typical burmese meal. Definitely worth trying if you are interested in traditional cuisine and Myanmar authentic food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nyan Myat Mn

sample_reviews_en.text: This Myanmar restaurant is located on the second floor of Khlong Toei (wet) Market Building. This restaurant is also very famous in Myanmar. In this branch, you can try a variety of Myanmar meals with delicious and cheap prices. Customer Service is also nice. Be aware that they do not have an English menu, and the space can get quite warm due to the tin roof without ceiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lat Aung

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a famous traditional restaurant back home. We had a late lunch at this Branch. The food is delicious, tasty with reasonable prices, and the service is also excellent. We had traditional side dishes like laphet.. and dessert as part of burmese meal. And they were great!  Definitely worth a try. Highly recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: TT Oh

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time trying Burmese food. Some dishes tasted a bit unusual to me, but the vibe and service were excellent. A good option if you're curious about this cuisine.​ A heads-up if you're bringing a car: you'll need to park at the golf course nearby, which charges a 50 THB hourly fee for diners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiendanai Bus Sermboonpaisarn

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating Burmese food. The catfish soup was rich and delicious. It's a little pricey, but the portions are generous. It's on the second floor of the market, so it's a little hard to find. The staff were very helpful and explained the menu to me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hachiro Hey

restaurants.name: YUMSAAP
restaurants.address:

Unit #SS 4013, 388 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yum Zaap Restaurant, Siam Square One Branch

Yum Zaap is an old Thai restaurant. I hadn't eaten here in a while. Today I was at Siam Square One and walked past it, so I decided to give it a try. The restaurant is located on the 4th floor of the mall.
I ordered several dishes:
Korat Noodles (99 THB): The taste was okay, a little oily.
Ratchaburi Fried Chicken Rice (99 THB): I really liked this one.
Spicy Clam Fried Rice (89 THB): I also liked this one.
Fried Papaya Salad (59 THB): This dish was average. It came with imitation crab.
Thai Papaya Salad (89 THB): This dish was average.
Fermented Pork Fried Rice (79 THB): I really liked this one. The fried rice tasted great.
sample_reviews_en.author: BangkokCondoCenter Co., Ltd.

sample_reviews_en.text: I came to eat at this Yum Zaap branch because all the branches near my house have closed (Central Rama 9/Terminal 21/Central World). This time, I felt that the portion sizes had decreased, and most noticeably, the prices had increased (as seen on the menu). I want Yum Zaap to maintain its original quality. It's a Thai restaurant that I really like, but encountering this is disappointing. The papaya salad had almost overcooked papaya and very soft noodles. Other dishes were still okay, but the quality has dropped significantly from before. It's a real shame, and I hope the team will improve and develop. I still want to eat Yum Zaap 💓💓
sample_reviews_en.author: Panggg S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This will probably be the last time I eat spicy Thai salad (Yum Saap).
The last time I ate it, it was so salty it left a lingering taste, so I stopped eating it for a while.
This time, I decided to give it another try.
The salmon salad was a huge disappointment. At 159 baht, the salmon had a strong smell and was sliced ​​extremely thin.

The instant noodle salad was too sweet, priced at 139 baht. There were fewer ingredients than before, but that's understandable considering the price.

If you're hesitant about ordering, check out the pictures to see if the food matches the actual dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: PO

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually order the rice with chili paste and mackerel, plus blanched fresh vegetables. I normally order from the CTW branch, but it seems to be closed, so they listed the Siam branch as an option. Everything looked okay when I opened the box, but when I touched the mackerel to see if it was freshly fried, it was very cold, while the rice was still warm. Was this freshly fried to order or fried and kept in the refrigerator? This was the most disappointing experience. The sticker says "FRESHLY COOKED."
sample_reviews_en.author: A Aa

sample_reviews_en.text:
So sad, been in Thailand 9 months and never been served cold old rice that was hardening again. Don't know the names of the dishes but stay away from them all. Low quality chicken with joints and bones. Papaya salad sauce was funky. The shrimp salad something was nothing like the picture in the special promotion. Some Thais just don't care anymore about the culture and who they represent.  The empty plate was the fried chicken wings 2 stars.
Do Better.......

578 bht I need to somewhere else to eat
sample_reviews_en.author: Ebi Obidake

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was terrible. The restaurant utensils are not clean even the water cup. The fish is not fresh, everything is very sweet for no reason. Like very sweet, sweet.

Even my Thai friends complained about the foods quality. The pork backbone soup is very sour. And overall price is very expensive. It’s not worth it at all.

If they wanna ask that price, they should better improve the food quality and utensil. I would never ever come back to this restaurant. I am done.
sample_reviews_en.author: MYAT NOE WAI

sample_reviews_en.text: I was a bit tired after walking around Terminal 21, so I grabbed a bite to eat. I ordered a fish and chili-fried eggs set meal, and also a chicken leg. The chicken leg was very tender and delicious with the chili. The fish was a little dry, but the chili-fried eggs were fantastic—the spicy flavor was really addictive. I was short on time, so I just ate a little something. I'll try something else next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: cheng guo

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant was nearly empty, but I already know why: the food was absolutely terrible. The fish was incredibly sour, and it wasn't cheap at all. We ordered two dishes, and the bill came to over 600 baht. We ended up with upset stomachs and diarrhea. I would never recommend it! The drinks had a strong artificial flavor and tasted very cheap. It's been years since I last visited a ramen shop run by a Thai company. I was lured in by the flying fish broth on the menu. Unfortunately, they didn't have a simple flying fish broth ramen, so I ordered the flying fish broth ramen topped with char siu. 🍜
The ramen 🍜 was brought right away, and I tried the soup, but... It didn't taste like flying fish broth at all. I pulled myself together and tried the bamboo shoots, which were somehow sweet... sample_reviews_en.text: This branch is terrible. The quality is far inferior to other branches. I found a large piece of plastic while chewing, and I'm not sure if I actually ingested it. The staff just came to take the bowl and make a new one, showing a complete …

sample_reviews_en.text:
You bar/restaurant is just along, 80 meters or so, from the Triangle Bar.
I like to come here whenever I visit Pattaya, or at least this area of Pattaya.
You are always made to feel genuinely welcome by the wonderful, friendly staff.
The food, both Thai and 'Farang' is excellent.
Today, even though it was 13.00hrs, I had a big breakfast, real bacon, tasty sausage, fresh tomatoe, all the toast, tea, and coffee you can drink, for only 199 baht.
No beer today as I was driving!
It is well worth a visit. Comfortable, good fans to keep you cool, nice relaxed atmosphere. Fast service, and you never feel pressured or rushed. Take your time, relax, enjoy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul White

sample_reviews_en.text: I had an American breakfast (99B) for brunch at this restaurant. It included all-you-can-eat bread, coffee, and orange juice. I had high expectations, but the bread was cheap store-bought and the coffee was just heated instant coffee. The orange juice wasn't very tasty either. I was a bit disappointed, considering my high expectations. I probably won't be returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: TAKASHI MIURA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Room for rent monthly with or without electric/water included.
Weekly and daily rates too (see photo)
No lift, higher the floor cheaper the price.

Thai and western food available too.

The food is good, the prices ok. Friendly staff.

He is the owner, he can do whatever he like, but in future without us.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a fantastic place to stay. It's a two-minute walk to Three Town. Right in the center. The best Kaw Pad Kai in the area, and the pizzas are fantastic. For those who enjoy it, there's a wide selection of Thai and other delicious dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wesley Dhondt

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a large portion of Pad Thai and it wasn't salty. The portion was larger than I expected, so I looked at the bill. I paid for two. I've had Pad Thai hundreds of times in Thailand, but other places charge a 10-20% premium or just …

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is a bit more expensive than local food, but it tastes good.

The accommodation has good room conditions and rentals are cheap.

However, electricity bills are very high.

The location is the best.
