sample_reviews_en.text:
"Quick, Delicious, and Always Satisfying!"
I've been to a lot of sandwich spots, but this place stands out! The ingredients are always fresh, the bread is perfectly toasted, and the flavor combinations are on point. Service is fast and friendly—even during lunch rush. Whether you’re grabbing a classic turkey sub or trying one of their signature creations, you won’t be disappointed. Affordable, tasty, and reliable—my go-to for a great sandwich on the go!
sample_reviews_en.author: Paing tha Kyaw

sample_reviews_en.text: So this shop opened up down the road from my condo, and when I saw they had Philly cheesesteak sandwiches, I stopped in my tracks. I had the honor of being their very first customer. I purchased the Philly cheesesteak and the chicken club sandwich. Both were delicious. They provide generous potions of meat and it's not overcooked or over-seasoned. I would eat here several times a week if I didn't care about my weight. I highly recommend them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charles Charles

sample_reviews_en.text:
A few days ago, I had their hot dog and it was delicious!!! With such an overwhelming flavor that each bite made a little punch with the taste of chorizo sausage. One thing that sets it apart is the crunchy chips added to it.

The pink sauce here is sooo good also,  it’s creamy, and just sweet enough to balance everything out. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: JINGYI HAO

sample_reviews_en.text: I have been looking for a good sandwich place in Pattaya for years now. This place is legit. Delicious and massive amounts of meat and veggies compared to any other sandwich i've tried in Thailand. Staff is quick and friendly. A single sandwich is enough for 2 meals. Totally worth the price at under 400 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: David G

sample_reviews_en.text: Tonight I ordered Philly Cheesesteak with Hot buffalo and BBQ sauce . The taste is so amazing and best Philly ever I tried . A lot of meat and cheese inside . Staffs are very friendly and nice . They made very fast within 5 mins they severed my order . Love this place . I’ll come back next time .
sample_reviews_en.author: Kee

sample_reviews_en.text: My 4th "Philly Cheesesteak Sub" order from this lovely place. They prepared it fast and delivered it quickly. It was delicious, full of ingredients. The bread was very soft, tasty and nice. This sandwich shop has been one of my favorite late night food places. Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yiğit Hacıefendioğlu

sample_reviews_en.text: I wanted to try some American food, so I ordered the honey mustard chicken burger. It was really good! The bun was soft and fragrant, and the chicken was tender and juicy, just right. The staff member, Ellie, was very friendly and provided excellent service. 🥰✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Babynan Wibwab

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is always fresh and the service is fast. The chefs speak good English and are friendly. The owner is also a nice lady; she took your feedback and told you about the new features and the app for pickup. Thank you, I want to keep all my money with you :(
sample_reviews_en.author: Smok e Feed

restaurants.name: McDonald's # Central Pin-klao
restaurants.address:

เซ็นทรัลพลาซ่า ปิ่นเกล้า ชั้น g 7/222 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I decided to eat at a familiar burger chain but was disappointed, especially because I was really hungry and wanted to enjoy the food. The staff was kind, polite, and helpful, which wasn't their fault at all! The service was very fast! The burger itself was a big disappointment... The menu picture on the screen looked delicious, of course, but the real thing was anything but. The cola was just cola, the fries were just fries, but the burger patty was awful, and it's scary to even think about what it was made of. And the advertised Big Mac wasn't that big, although it was tasty enough. It looked decent on the outside, but when you look under the bun, it immediately became unappetizing... And of course, it left a bad taste in my mouth; I never want to eat burgers at McDonald's again... It's a shame I didn't take a photo of that hideous patty under the beautiful bun; my hands were already dirty, and they don't have wet wipes. By the way, they also don’t have their own toilet, just keep in mind that there’s only one sink and it looks sad, and I had to look for a clean table even though there was almost no one there anymore...there are some questions about cleanliness, yes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lessa Pinkredmi

sample_reviews_en.text: What I don't understand is that in less than half an hour, when you get up to go to the bathroom, your food is already left on the table to let people know you're still there. And there aren't many customers in the shop, yet they're still cleaning the table and putting away your things. Sometimes, you still haven't finished eating your food and have already put it away. When I asked, they said they were afraid it would get lost. If the owner of the property isn't afraid of it getting lost, then who is afraid for them? The food that was left there isn't that valuable, so they dare to leave it. So, do you just throw away the food that you didn't finish eating? Is that food waste? When I asked, they said they would take responsibility and get you new food. They didn't want new food, they wanted to eat the food that they had eaten. This has happened 2-3 times already. I know that if food gets lost, the shop doesn't want to take responsibility, but should the food that was thrown away be thrown away?
sample_reviews_en.author: BBACK NAONE

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited McDonald's at Central Pinklao and had a positive experience. The staff members were friendly and attentive, ensuring that my order was taken accurately and promptly. The restaurant was clean and well-maintained, providing a comfortable atmosphere for dining.
The food at McDonald's was delicious and freshly prepared. My order was served hot and the ingredients were of good quality. I particularly enjoyed the chicken nuggets, which were crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.
Overall, I had a great time at McDonald's at Central Pinklao. The staff provided excellent customer service and the food exceeded my expectations. I would definitely recommend this location to others looking for a satisfying meal in a pleasant environment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hitzero Xo

sample_reviews_en.text:
On December 22, 2024, there were very few staff members taking orders. They were all clustered together shouting out the order numbers, instead of helping with the food preparation. The order sequence was already displayed on the screen.
There was a chubby female employee at the counter who was constantly on the phone, even though if it was an order via Line, the order details should have been generated by the program. After the call, she didn't take orders, but walked to the order notification area and made another phone call.
There was only one young male employee taking orders and working alone.
He even picked up the wrong order, even though most of the staff were busy preparing the food. The male employee taking orders had to help correct it.
sample_reviews_en.author: lemon chang

sample_reviews_en.text:
💗 If you want quick and efficient food service, I highly recommend this branch because the staff are very willing to serve and everything is done very quickly.
💗 Using a coupon from the McDonald's app was very worthwhile.
✅ Plenty of seating, very convenient.
✅ Good ventilation, not hot.
✅ They have high chairs for children.
✅ The Happy Meal toys are still available, which is very impressive.
✅ This branch is incredibly clean. The cleaning staff are excellent. I saw with my own eyes how they even crawled under the tables! So, if you eat at this branch, please help keep it clean and lighten the workload for the staff. 🫠🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: AURA ไดอารี่

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch is spacious, and sometimes it's so busy there's no place to sit. It's so popular that the staff can't keep up with clearing the trash from the tables. Today I tried the chocolate sundae with corn pie. The price was great, only 55 baht. The staff were friendly. The pie took 7 minutes to be freshly made, indicating its popularity. However, if you choose the pineapple pie, you get it right away. I sat and ate my ice cream in the store while waiting for the pie, and when I finished, the staff brought it to my table. The taste was delicious, as always, both the sundae and the pie.
sample_reviews_en.author: Veera Ratchatavarotai

sample_reviews_en.text: I was at the mall and wanted some ice cream, so I went to McDonald's. I saw an advertisement saying that if you downloaded the My McDonald's app and registered for the first time, you'd get a free medium order of French fries. So I did it. The app is available for both iOS and Android. After downloading, the app had various coupons at special prices. It was easy to use. For the French fries, there was a coupon; I just pressed to use it, showed it to the staff, they scanned the QR code, and I got them for free.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ph031

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here for my favorite menu item, a frozen coke. The store is large with many tables. It gets quite busy when I come because it's around school and work dismissal time, but there are still usually tables available. There are only two ordering machines, which I think might not be enough in case of an emergency, but overall, the wait time to order wasn't long, the food arrived quickly, and the service was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: อยากลดน้ําหนักแต่ของกินแซ่บเกิน

restaurants.name: מסעדה כשרה ברכת אליהו-Kosher restaurant Berket Eliyahu
restaurants.address:

198, 30 Soi Bua 5 15, Pattaya City, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chang Wat Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible place and appalling service!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
We arrived, ordered food and it took an hour to get our food, it's important to clarify there was only one table with us in the place.
The food came in parts, and the earliest we got was after 40 minutes which in my opinion is a hallucination!
I went to tell the waiters that in my opinion it doesn't make sense to wait an hour for food
The waitress started to get annoyed and she said that it was very, very logical, and also said that the food was coming out now which in retrospect took another 20 minutes! And when I told her about it she got annoyed like I owed her something, rude.
And when the food arrived! It was terrible!!!!!! Average minus, the burgers arrived burnt and not tasty, and the mashed potatoes were heated in the microwave, even the falafel we ordered was heated in the microwave
Very shallow level
Do not recommend at all, it is better to starve than eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lior Sananes

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good evening, righteous people, in light of an incident I heard from a friend who visited this place, pay attention! This is what I was told
The rabbi of the synagogue there is a tyrant and behaves like a simple talker. It is simply shameful. It is impossible to pray properly. Secondly, the manager of the restaurant, who is the same person, simply behaves disgustingly and stinks of drugs. I have never seen a manager who simply stinks of drugs and also behaves like this. I ask the nice owner, who I have heard good things about, to fire the guy immediately. Thank you and please spare other visitors such incidents (the friend asked to remain anonymous)
sample_reviews_en.author: אור שמש

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dear Marciano, a huge man hosts hundreds of people at his own expense every Shabbat. Really, wow, big.

But on weekdays, when the place is a restaurant for kosher people, the prices are like in Israel.
To remind you, we are in Pattaya, Thailand
The dishes are not plentiful...
The flavors are reasonable..
This is the only place that is truly kosher. Maybe that is the problem.
Dear Marciano, continue on your way with your huge heart.. but maybe you will notice what happens on weekdays too.. Something in the place is a mess... and it is a shame.
sample_reviews_en.author: פדי חכמון

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered food for Friday night. Let's start from the end, I didn't receive it and they kept me waiting until Shabbat began with no answer. My husband waited in the lobby with money for a delivery man who didn't show up. The last time I was able to talk to them, they claimed the driver was on his way and there was traffic on the road. Disrespectful service and humiliating treatment. I have never encountered anything like this in my life. Of course, I will never go anywhere near it and I will not recommend it to anyone. A disgusting business.
sample_reviews_en.author: sarit dino

sample_reviews_en.text: Not good, bad service, the food is not tasty and expensive, the waiters behaved disrespectfully, the atmosphere was bad, the waiter didn't stop arguing with us, we asked to change the girl's dish, it was like sand in it, sweet and disgusting, they didn't want to change it, so my brother went to ask for a change and they told him you complain about everything, he replied, what do you want, I'll tell you, the dish was beautiful, the dishes and the service, ugh, I don't recommend going there, expensive and disgusting🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: אגם פרץ

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered delivery and the hotel is a 2-minute walk away. They charged 200 baht for delivery. We ordered 2 portions of hummus (comes with 2 pitas) and an extra pita and only received 3 pitas. Where are the pitas for the second portion? And the prices listed on the website are incorrect because our calculation came out to 910 and when the delivery man arrived he said 1360 (including delivery). This is too big a gap and it was unpleasant to suddenly have to add more. Has this happened to anyone else?
sample_reviews_en.author: תומר יפרח

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great restaurant!
I don't understand what all the bad reviews are about here....
We went in with concerns because of the reviews, but we were very pleasantly surprised.
The food is delicious and fresh, we had Yemenite soup, chicken breast, chick, and in the morning a vegetable omelet in pita, everything was very delicious!
There is free Wi-Fi.
Excellent service!
There is also a synagogue in the complex.
Highly recommend, don't be afraid like we were!
sample_reviews_en.author: מוריה מ

sample_reviews_en.text:
We barely found the place (the restaurant is on the second floor of a hotel, there is no signage downstairs),
We ordered a chicken breast with fries and a Thai soup with coconut milk and chicken. The chicken breast was okay and the soup was perfect. The price for both dishes and 2 soft drinks was about 800 baht (a good price for kosher food).
The atmosphere and design of the place need improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: קרן טל

restaurants.name: พ่อครัวน้อย CLOUD KiTCHEN 24 ชั่วโมง สาขา 8 สาธุประดิษฐ์ ถนนจันทร์ สาธร
restaurants.address:

9, 11-12 Sathu Pradit Rd, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Upon entering the restaurant, the floor was sticky and the tables and dishes weren't cleared, even though there were no customers eating inside (perhaps they were preparing things for the restaurant). The staff didn't greet customers at all; my friend had to ask if the restaurant was open because all the staff looked confused and unprepared to serve customers, even though the restaurant claims to be open 24 hours. When ordering food, there was no menu recommendation or order taking from the table; we had to hand the order to them, even though we were the only table occupied the entire time we were there. The food took a very long time to arrive, over 30 minutes, which made me uneasy and almost led me to leave, but we waited because we had already ordered. I noticed that the delivery riders each waited a very long time to pick up their orders, possibly because the restaurant is accepting orders through multiple channels. The food tasted average. I had already eaten more than half a plate of rice before I received the soup that should have been included with the meal, which made me realize it was supposed to come with it. Please investigate the restaurant's operations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robby Romanek

sample_reviews_en.text:
Order from this shop very often. At first, the taste was delicious. Later, the taste was bad. Plus, they often forget to add extra items for regular customers. Plus, the berry mix steam, if it runs out every time I order, remove the menu. The staff called every time to ask if it ran out and could I change it to something else? And the price is 10-20 baht different.
Change other smoothies. In the app, it's 69 baht, berry mix is ​​99 baht. Think about it. It's really unfair. Selling expensive and not training new staff. Plus, new staff can't read. The details that are included are useless. Please fix this branch owner. Oh, and the air conditioning. It's so hot.
Plus, open the glass of the cash register next to the kitchen. Think about how hot it is. Selling expensive and not caring about anything. I've encountered this many times. It's very uncomfortable. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุธีรัชต์ พลเรืองวิทย์ (บอม)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Restaurant or scam!!!!
Today I accidentally walked in and ordered chicken sukiyaki. The bill said 79 baht. The portion size was quite generous, but the taste wasn't that great. 79 baht still felt expensive compared to regular sukiyaki. In the end, when I paid, they said 99 baht. They'd just changed the price two days ago and the sign wasn't finished yet!!!
Is this really okay? I also looked at reviews from four months ago and saw people complaining about the price not matching the bill (even though they said the price had just been changed two days ago, why were there reviews that didn't match the price four months ago?)
Warning! Don't fall for it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rosanan Wangpaitoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm tired of this restaurant. I love the taste the most, it's my favorite, but the spiciness is inconsistent. I've ordered almost a hundred times, but the stewed pork is out. Why didn't they call to tell me and just send me stewed ribs instead? Why not?! I don't want to eat it!!!! The ingredients are always mixed up, many times. And the chilies are never the same. I'm fed up.
The owner should acknowledge this and fix it. He's so sloppy and the prices aren't cheap.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natha P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food at this restaurant is extremely expensive, twice as much as it should be.
The taste and portion size don't match the price.
A regular sizzling pork rad na costs 200 THB, and a regular sizzling stir-fried noodles with chicken costs 170 THB.

The restaurant has no air conditioning, no parking, no impressive decor, and no reputation. The food tastes average, like what you'd find in a cafeteria. But the price is double the cost.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jira-bhadhra Wongwathanavikrom

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the dry sukiyaki, and it was extremely sweet. The water spinach and celery were very old and tough, impossible to chew. The chicken had a slight off-putting smell.

The garlic pork was incredibly salty, and it seemed like it was stir-fried with pre-made garlic sprinkled on top, as shown in the picture.

I was so disappointed with this meal. I wanted to cry. 😢
sample_reviews_en.author: Kayoo Chuen

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought Tom Yum Seafood to take home for 159 baht, but the quality was terrible. The shrimp was dry and tough, the squid wasn't fresh, it was dry and chewy. They put a lot of vegetables on top, but they weren't chopped; they were just added in long, uncut pieces. It was appetizing and tasted very ordinary. For this price, they should definitely improve the quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supassara View

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered food from this restaurant via food delivery.
The food I received didn't match the picture, so I reported it via the app. The restaurant called to apologize and asked the marketing department to change the picture. However, I didn't receive a refund.

The food was rich and flavorful, with a sweeter flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Polar Bear At the sea

restaurants.name: CocoBee พุทธมณฑลสาย1
restaurants.address:

ร้านโคโค่บี 33/1 Thanon Phutthamonthon Sai 1, Bang Ramat, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious. I really liked the cheesy tteokbokki; the flavor was well-balanced. All the food at this restaurant was good. It's a shame they didn't have the gochujang pork stir-fry. The bibimbap was excellent. I'm deducting points because the staff weren't very helpful with recommendations.
sample_reviews_en.author: C P

sample_reviews_en.text: Followed from HomePro. The taste is delicious as usual. But I was a little confused when parking. I didn't know that we were eating together with the noodle shop. Overall, I like it. The staff who took orders provided very good service. The servers were average. 🤟🏻 I'll stop by again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narttheera

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is decent and reasonably priced. They have promotions for 2 or 3 people, but don't expect authentic Korean food.

Parking is available at HomePro. It wasn't crowded, so there was no wait, and the food came out quickly.

The staff were lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Salanthorn P

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying Korean fried chicken, ordered through a food delivery app.

The fried chicken tasted delicious.

It was crispy, tender, and perfectly coated in a sweet and spicy sauce.

The portion size was also good for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิงห์ อัยเยอร์เวง

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. I liked the fried chicken, the cheesy rapeseed rolls, and the kimchi soup. The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Artha Yotsinee

sample_reviews_en.text: Korean​ stlye​ food​ from​ CocoBee.​ The​ portion is​ small.​ The​ pot​ is​ not​ enough hot for​ cooking​ bibimbub.​ I​ vote​ 2/5.
sample_reviews_en.author: sumpun Thammacharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Branch 1
The pork kimchi soup is too expensive at 140 baht. There are very few ingredients, including two small pieces of tofu.
sample_reviews_en.author: K P

sample_reviews_en.text:
We're the first group of customers today!
Every dish is delicious, the service is great, and the staff are very lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prisananakin

restaurants.name: Abu Nawas Pakistani & Arabic Restaurant
restaurants.address:

363/12 Moo 10, Soi, 16 Walking St, Pattaya City, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: They have a hotel, a restaurant, and massage. We were at the hotel. THIS IS A HOLE!!!! There are decent hotels in Bangkok and Phuket for this price. We were in room 408. The price on Booking.com was 350, but in reality it was 550. The bed was dirty, the duvet had no cover. We went into the room and there was an open bottle of water and a roll of toilet paper (the remains). One light bulb worked in the room. The TV was not set up, there was no Wi-Fi. The bathroom was terrible. The view was like some kind of slum. We returned to the room, and a huge street cockroach climbed from the table into the drawer, which, by the way, was broken. Right outside the window, above the bed, there was a real dump, I'm not kidding!!! There's a roof there and they throw garbage in there!!! We asked for breakfast to be made since we were leaving at 5:30 a.m., early, but the hotel refused. In fact, we spent exactly 5 hours in the room, during which time we tried to sleep. I had to sleep with the light on. Overall, it's terrible!!!! Never book a room here!!! And there are ants crawling around near the balcony.
sample_reviews_en.author: Юлия Прошина

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited this place yesterday, so I decided to leave a review while it's fresh:
We visited with five people – two adults and three children.
We were alone the entire time we were there.
We ordered one lamb curry, two beef kebabs, one chicken kebab, spaghetti bolognese, hummus, and flatbreads.
We ordered the chicken kebab for our little one (5 years old) – when ordering, I repeatedly asked if it was spicy. It was brought out suspiciously red – we tried it, and it was spicy with red paprika.
The two kebabs were completely worthless – some kind of absolutely tasteless minced meat, and completely dry.
The curry portion – besides the sauce, there were two decent-sized bones with maybe 70 grams, maybe 100 grams, of meat on them. The spaghetti bolognese wasn't great either; 7-11 sells better ones for 35-40 baht.
Overall, it was terrible. A completely ruined evening.
Including soft drinks, the bill came to 2,350 baht.
Stay away from this establishment!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eugeny Zilbershtein

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stayed at this hotel for just one night, and it was honestly one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had. The room was *very, very dirty* – it looked like it hadn't been cleaned in weeks. The bed had mites, and I couldn’t sleep at all the entire night because of the itching and discomfort.

To make things worse, the toilet was disgusting – it clearly hadn’t been cleaned. There were visible urine stains on the toilet seat, and the whole bathroom smelled bad. It was extremely unhygienic and unacceptable for any hotel, regardless of price or rating.

I would not recommend this place to anyone. It was a *pathetic experience* and I deeply regret booking it. Spend your money elsewhere – this is not worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anila Riaz

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is condition of Luxurious room

First of all there is nothing like website on Agoda there is edited photoes there so don’t go in that scam better not to book this hotel at all there is many good options near by

In photoes being told there will be garden view for 60 meters room but there was nothing just a noisy backyard
Whole hotel have fungent smell

All rooms is like hell hard to sleep in night or morning phase

There is no AC remotes as well in room you have to ask again and again from reception women
sample_reviews_en.author: Alligator Fx

sample_reviews_en.text:
We booked two rooms but had to cancel! We couldn't check in at all… As soon as we walked in, the manager said, "The room doesn't match the pictures!" (What the hell?)
I'm telling everyone to run away. It smelled musty and suffocated from the elevator onwards. And don't even get me started on the room itself. It was the dirtiest place I've ever been in my life. (I checked the reviews, but my friend said they might have improved, but no, it's exactly as everyone else described.)
sample_reviews_en.author: สุพิชญ์รดา ฮวดปากน้ํา

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bad place... Booked one night but didnt sleep there because the room was a mess.
Smelly & dirty. We had cockroaches in the bathroom, cabels hanging out the ceiling & trash infront of the window. We ended up booking another room and just left our big luggage in there. I even felt bad for our luggage😂

+Location
+Cheap Cheap
+We somked some in there

-No hygiene
-You have to share the room with the cockroaches
sample_reviews_en.author: Ni Carra

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a hotel and restaurant and I consider it a hidden gem. I didn't stay at the hotel, but had dinner here several times. The food is absolutely delicious and the people are very friendly. We have come back many times and always have a good experience. Their sandwiches are so good and the curries are out of this world. If you're looking for Indian or Pakistani style food, you should come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: U E

sample_reviews_en.text: The worst experience of my life. I abandoned the room and the money. Entering the room was a completely different world. It was the dirtiest place I've ever stayed. I didn't dare walk in; I just stood by the door looking at it because it was so filthy and smelled so strong I wanted to wash my nose. The room looked nothing like the pictures.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภัทรรินทร์ ประภาศรี

restaurants.name: LukKaiThong One Bangkok
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์การค้าวัน แบงค็อก ห้องเลขที่ 1306,OD1306 One Bangkok, 3rd floor (Parade zone), Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
**1/5 – Food**

We visited this branch after enjoying other locations previously, but this experience was a real letdown.

We ordered the signature Hong Kong fried rice noodle, a dish we'd loved before. This time it was very bland — the taste was flat and nothing like what we were used to. All three of us at the table agreed immediately after the first bite.

We flagged it to the staff, and to their credit, they took the dish back for the chef to taste. However, the chef returned saying nothing was wrong with it. We didn't argue, but that response was disappointing — especially when three of us agreed the taste was clearly off.

I am not writing this to be difficult. We simply expected the same quality as their other branch, and this visit fell short. We won't be rushing back to this location.
sample_reviews_en.author: Srisuk Rujisaritwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Every dish we ordered was delicious, especially the garlic pork. The garlic was fragrant, the pork was tender, and the flavor was perfectly balanced. It was amazing with hot rice!

The stir-fried noodles with gravy were also excellent; the noodles were fragrant, the gravy was rich and flavorful, and the vegetables were fresh and crisp – a perfect combination!

Finally, the Thai tea bingsu was delightful. It had a genuine Thai tea aroma, just the right amount of sweetness, and the shaved ice was soft and smooth – incredibly refreshing!

The restaurant was clean, the staff provided good service, the food came out quickly, and it was great value for money. We will definitely be back! Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: ออย ลี่

sample_reviews_en.text: I dined there on August 5th at lunchtime. I ordered about six dishes. One dish tasted strange, with an unusually fishy flavor. I informed the staff, and the manager said it was the normal taste. However, I personally found the flavor odd and fishy; almost no one at our table ate it. We didn't dwell on it until we received the bill and invoice. The same staff member, who was also the manager, was unfriendly, didn't smile, and seemed unwilling to provide good service. I would like to see improvements in this aspect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ma Pha

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is famous for being delicious, I really want you to try it, especially the garlic fried pork, the pork is tender and fragrant with garlic. And to finish off, the Thai tea bingsu is a must-try for dessert, they call it Thai tea here, it's rich and flavorful. If I have the chance, I'll definitely stop by again. I highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Min Aung

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Thai royal cuisine restaurant that serves delicious red curry.

They also have many dishes with Chinese elements, such as fried rice and wonton noodles, so I understood it to be a restaurant that broadly incorporates Thai and Chinese influences rather than serving purely Thai food.

The red curry in the photo costs approximately 1,000 THB.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shin Sugawara

sample_reviews_en.text: Aroy Ka (Very delicious 🤤) decent food and vibe, the Luk KaiThong. The seafood here is highly recommended! The jumbo shrimp are wonderfully creamy and fresh, the crab legs are perfectly sweet, and the sea bass soup is absolutely unforgettable. If you’re visiting One Bangkok, this is the perfect spot to wrap up your day!
sample_reviews_en.author: Athena Cheung

sample_reviews_en.text: Yeah staff need training for sure. Not once stopping by asking if everything was okay, do you like another drink, just putting the next dish on the table, while still on my first dish. My mango salad with see bass was really nice so as the Wonton soup. And yes price/quality is out of balance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo van Zijl

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent, the staff were lovely, the food was delicious, the restaurant was beautifully decorated, and the atmosphere was quiet and peaceful, making me feel relaxed. Highly recommended! I will definitely come back again 😊😊😊
sample_reviews_en.author: BKEE BKEE

restaurants.name: Prae Bua House Coffee
restaurants.address:

1007 Bang Mot, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I never noticed it was a restaurant when I drove past; I thought it was some kind of trendy boutique. There's no parking, and you can't park discreetly because there are so many cars. The food is delicious and fresh, they even use Japanese clams, which is why it's a bit pricey. The restaurant is small but has a large menu, including fresh pasta, spaghetti, pizza, rice dishes, salads, and steaks. At first, I was hesitant to order because of the prices, but after trying it, I'll definitely be back to try other dishes. I heard their coffee is also pretty good.
sample_reviews_en.author: C Wana

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very small shop. I've passed by it many times and finally got to try it. But the taste is anything but small! You can park at the gas station and walk over. I managed to get a seat on the second floor because the downstairs was full. Walking upstairs, you might get a bit of a mess as leaves and grass are blowing in your face – it feels a bit cluttered, like being at home. I ordered cheese pizza, spaghetti, and salad. Everything was delicious, except the butterfly pea lemonade didn't have any lemon aroma; it was strangely sour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onweena Patta.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The photos in the menu were beautiful and the dishes looked delicious... but the delivery wasn't as good as the pictures.

I ordered the "Black Spaghetti with Scallops and Cream Sauce." The sauce wasn't creamy at all, it was watery, and it didn't have the shrimp roe shown in the picture (only fake caviar). The "Scrambled Eggs with Shrimp Pasta" was just average, and the "Baked Sweet Corn with Cheese" was okay.

In summary, I wasn't very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aomm Suvanapha

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those who like bitter coffee, this way please. The coffee is very bitter.
But it's a bit hot inside the shop.
There's no parking; you'll have to find a spot on the street or in the alley.
The price is average.
sample_reviews_en.author: CYN

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the menu is diverse, and the prices are reasonable, but the wait is a bit long. If you plan to go, I recommend calling to order at least 30 minutes in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worawath Th.

sample_reviews_en.text: There was no parking, the staff forgot our order, the taste was just okay, and the price was okay. It was confusing because no one greeted us when we entered the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Big

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're not opening at the stated time on Sundays (10:00 AM), please correct it. It's unacceptable to get an angry look from customers when they ask if the shop is open.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niji N.

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're passing by to pay respects at Wat Luang Pho Opasi, I'd recommend it. I tried it for the first time and it was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Orawan V

restaurants.name: Ovaltine Braised Pork With Rice
restaurants.address:

2, 6 Phetchaburi Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don’t be fooled by the crowd lining up outside this restaurant! In reality, the place is empty seats available because A rude, boss lady stands at the entrance like some kind of inspector, her face with 8 inches eyeliner like clown makeup, blocking the door and forcing customers to place their orders one by one before they can go in and sit down.

When it was our turn, she **forced us to order a meal for our 2-year-old toddler**. Her exact words: *"This is the system. If you’re not happy, you can leave."* And yes—there is no "system." **She is the system.**

I was completely stunned by her arrogant, condescending attitude. It was as if she was saying, *"If you don’t want to eat, there are plenty of people waiting behind you. We don’t need your business."* No wonder this restaurant only has **2 stars—it’s not just me saying this. Check the **Google reviews**, and you’ll see everyone complaining about that woman.

**DO NOT EAT HERE!** Every shopping mall’s food court serves the exact same braised pork rice and I’ve tried them—they’re just as good!
sample_reviews_en.author: clara Cla

sample_reviews_en.text:
Have been treated not particularly pleasantly on entrance. We wanted to order 4 dish and a side cause we're on vacation and didn't want to fill up on pork as this is just a stop of our food hunt. But apparently there was 6 of us and we HAVE TO order 6 main dishes and they say they would help us to put in order for the side inside. The staffs were not particularly keen to take new orders and we didn't get to order the side we wanted. They only offer to put in order for drinks but the way the waiter offer the options I find rude (throw the drinks menu in our table and 👀 at us waiting for us to point out what we wanted). When the mains arrived they were all "undersized" (vs normal portions that other stores would serve).

All in all not a particularly good experience I would say. Fortunately the food taste was not disappointing and the restaurant is clean and tidy air conditioned and staffs dressed tidily.
sample_reviews_en.author: Riley Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Portion & perception:
•	Served in a deceptively large bowl but the actual portion is very small.
•	For Indonesian appetites, one bowl is never enough. Many locals and tourists alike end up ordering two or three.

Flavor & texture:
•	Springy, QQ-textured noodles are the star.
•	Char siu is mildly sweet and tender, paired with flavorful wontons.
•	Some find the noodles a bit too oily or light in seasoning but still enjoyable with added chili and vinegar.

Ambience & service:
•	Quick, no-frills service in a semi-air-conditioned space near Platinum Fashion Mall.
•	Expect efficiency over friendliness this spot is focused on moving lines fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raphael J. Soeroyo

sample_reviews_en.text:

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't order anything, but I wanted to review the staff. 🥹 On October 9th, 2025, around 6:05-6:10 PM, I called to inquire about the Happy Meal set, which is no longer available for delivery. The staff member wasn't sure of the information, but didn't refuse the customer. They said they would find the information and call back. This is excellent customer service; if they're unsure, they should find the information to provide the clearest answer. I sincerely commend them. Within 10 minutes, the staff member called back. I'm not sure if his name was Mr. Noppol or Nopporn (I couldn't hear clearly 😂). He was very polite, gave excellent advice, and was very fluent, like he'd had eight million years of experience 😂. Amazing! I want to give him a raise and throw away his plates, replacing them with an award! Your branch is very lucky to have such a service-minded and empathetic staff member.
sample_reviews_en.author: Spring Day

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought a coupon from the Blueplus+ app for a buy-one-get-one-free McDonald's ice cream cone, originally 24 baht, but with the coupon it cost only 12 baht. It was easy to use; just tell the staff you're using a coupon and they'll scan the QR code. It was convenient and saved me money. This McDonald's branch is nicely decorated and has plenty of seating and charging stations. It gets hot in the afternoons in the sun, but the air conditioning inside is still nice and cool. It's located in the PTT gas station on Borommaratchachonnani Road, Soi 97, right at the front. They also have a drive-thru and ample parking around the gas station. The staff at this branch provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ph031

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're thinking of McDonald's, this branch is located in Pinklao, at the PTT gas station before the left turn onto Kanchanaphisek Road, on the way to The Mall Bang Khae. I ate here when it first opened and was hooked, especially the fries – freshly fried, not too salty, and tastier than those at other branches. The service from the staff is still excellent today; they're always attentive and ready to help. The seating area is spacious and comfortable. There are handwashing facilities near the restrooms, and separate men's and women's restrooms (two clean women's restrooms). Parking in front of the store is convenient.
Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sopin P.

sample_reviews_en.text: McDonald's in Bangkok is still affordable, though not in the expensive shopping malls or purely tourist areas. If you have a rental car, just search for nearby McDonald's on Google Maps. That's how we found this one—super modern, with a choice of a Big Mac, XL fries, and an XL drink for 235 baht. Next door there's a Kentucky Fried Chicken, a 7-Eleven, a gas station, and various other shops; everything looks brand new.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Müller

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were okay to talk to, but other restaurants have even better communication. Everyone was helpful, but they should improve their skills in recommending menu items. The burgers were delicious! They should add more vegetable options to the menu.

The food is a little pricey. There's a restroom and parking in front for about 5-6 cars.
Open 24 hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually stop by this branch for ice cream after work. I'd like to commend the female employee in the red shirt and glasses; she's very cute and provides excellent customer service. She's polite, attentive, and remembers that my girlfriend likes ice cream. Today, they were out of stock, and she promptly informed us. I really appreciate her service.
sample_reviews_en.author: จารุกิตติ์ บัวศรี

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were incredibly helpful and friendly.

They were very polite and attentive to customers.

We ate there at 2 AM.
Everything was freshly prepared.
The chicken was very crispy.
It's a shame we didn't get to try the ice cream because the freezer was closed.

I was most impressed by the staff.

(The restaurant is open 24 hours.)

THIS IS The only new 24-hour Mc Donalds' around here, the only saver for starvers like me during 01:00-04:00am. 😵‍💫😵😙

The place is inside a shopping mall, in the food court area. Having air conditioning is huge perk, so it’s a good option to grab a tasty and cheap lunch while you take a rest of the heat outside.

I really enjoyed the food, and I made sure to try something that wasn’t too spicy.

The place has won Michelin stars for multiple years, but this location is no their main one.

You can also go for desserts in the nearby stores 🍨
sample_reviews_en.author: David Ojeda

sample_reviews_en.text: I am sure it is very delicious at the original shop, but the one at iconsiam is not on par. Service is bad, with 4 out of the 5 staff sitting down while expecting me to get my own noodles. I was the only one at the shop at the time. 90 Baht for a super small bowl of noodles is pathetic by Thailand food standards. Guess they charge this price because of the Michelin fame. Pad Thai is horrible, too sweet. The seafood also tasted a bit off.
Nam prik set okay with a small bowl of crackling pork, but the amount of vegetable is really sad.

sample_reviews_en.text:
"This is our favorite restaurant! Every time we come, we always order our go-to dishes: Crab and fermented fish salad, corn salad, grilled beef, hot pot, and fresh shrimp salad. Every dish is incredibly flavorful and perfectly balanced.
* Crab and fermented fish salad: Rich and savory, the crab is fresh and firm.
* Corn salad: Sweet, sour, and spicy – ​​a perfect blend of flavors. The corn is crunchy and delicious.
* Grilled beef: Perfectly grilled, tender and juicy. Dipping it in the spicy sauce is amazing!
* Hot pot: The broth is flavorful, and the meat and vegetables are fresh.
* Fresh shrimp salad: Large, fresh shrimp, and the flavor is intensely spicy.
Besides the delicious food, the service is excellent. The staff are attentive and caring. The restaurant is clean, comfortable, and inviting.
If you like spicy Northeastern Thai food, I highly recommend this restaurant. You won't be disappointed!"

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, with authentic Isaan flavors. They have ant eggs, which are tasty, and crispy fried pork belly with fish sauce – all delicious. The mixed grill is also excellent, well-marinated. The hot pot is decent, with many dipping sauces to choose from; the soup is tom yum style. The meat is a bit thick and chewy, but it's nicely marbled. It's conveniently located with parking. There are two seating areas: inside the restaurant and a more private gazebo seating 4-6 people. The staff are friendly, offering to take photos for you, providing good menu recommendations, and ensuring cleanliness, including providing tissues and drinks. You can bring your own alcohol without a corkage fee. The food prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warassanuwit Chiaranai (Ging)

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was a rainy day when I visited this restaurant, which features a variety of Isaan dishes. We placed our order and waited a bit longer than expected.

We tried the sticky rice, rice with omelet, Somtum, Laab, grilled fish, and Jimjum. The omelet was slightly burnt but still enjoyable. The Somtum was excellent, while the Laab was good though not quite to my taste. The grilled fish was a bit dry. But the Jimjum was outstanding—the soup was especially delicious. I wish they had provided a spicy sauce for the Jimjum. The restaurant had a cozy country atmosphere with plenty of tables, and there were adorable hen wandering around. We’d definitely return just for the Jimjum!
sample_reviews_en.author: Praewa Saengaroonchalomesuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai-Isaan restaurant in the Phawana-Wang Hin area offers a cozy, homey atmosphere. The decor features wood, bamboo, and straw. Inside, there's a spacious, airy outdoor seating area, as well as separate gazebos/sheds for families seeking privacy.

The food is quite good, especially the larb, koi, nam tok, and jim jum (Thai hot pot). They also offer a variety of Thai dishes like stir-fries, curries, and soups – all excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Albert PJ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, but there are too few staff. Tables aren't cleared; I wanted to sit in a nice atmosphere, but the tables weren't cleaned, and the staff wouldn't clear them for me. They just told me to sit at any empty table. They only seemed to attend to large groups, resulting in inadequate service and discrimination. Sometimes the service is also slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชาดานันท์ ชลศิริ

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a simple yet delicious Northeastern Thai restaurant with friendly prices and fast service. The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce is amazing, and the fried chicken with fish sauce is a must-try – it's incredibly tasty. The staff are friendly and welcoming.

sample_reviews_en.text: This homey, open-air restaurant offers authentic Thai food. If you love grilled meat, this is the place to go. Their signature dish, made with squid tentacles, is absolutely delicious and fresh. I'm deducting one star because the mosquitoes bite and it's a bit too hot. ^^

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yakiniku + Shabu Buffet, open until 3 AM, at The Street Ratchada.

The restaurant offers both shabu-shabu pots and yakiniku grills.
Ordering via QR code is quick and efficient.

Snacks include karaage chicken and takoyaki, freshly fried and very crispy, not too salty.

Recommended to order truffle fried rice to eat with the grilled meat; they go together perfectly.

The restaurant offers 4 sauces: yakiniku, barbecue, ponzu, and a spicy Thai-style BBQ sauce.

Finally, green tea and vanilla ice cream are included in the buffet.

This meal cost 299 THB + 39 THB for unlimited drinks.

Good price, good quality meat, and delicious side dishes.

This restaurant has another branch in IT Square.
sample_reviews_en.author: MichAom

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm giving it 1 star because the service staff seemed confused. They need more training or better prioritization. I went with my girlfriend, and she received her food but no plain rice. The staff said to wait a moment for the rice to cook. Five minutes passed, and the rice still hadn't arrived. When I asked again, they said, "You have to understand that the rice needs to dry; even though it's cooked, we can't serve it immediately." During the five minutes I waited, I saw other tables being served their food with plain rice, which was very confusing because those tables arrived after us, and they also received their food with plain rice.

sample_reviews_en.text: "The food is delicious, the ingredients are fresh and great value! The service is good and friendly, and the atmosphere is comfortable, perfect for dining with friends or family. I'll definitely be back again!"

restaurants.address:


sample_reviews_en.text:
Across from Harbor Mall.

Kau Mu Daeng + Khao Man Gai Mukbang. Thai pork rice bowl + chicken rice bowl. Khao Mu Daeng actually originated in the Hainan region of China. However, it's now reinterpreted as a Thai-style Khao Man Gai, using the same ingredients but served with Thai sauce. It's a Thai home-style dish made with well-boiled chicken (kai) placed on top of plain rice and served with a sauce. These days, Khao Man Gai is a common street food. Because it's such a popular dish among Thais, it's often sold at street stalls. The chicken in Khao Man Gai is tender and juicy, and the sauce, used for dipping or mixing with rice, adds even more texture. Khao Mu Daeng is a perfect blend of pork and fish cake, and when mixed with the restaurant's special sauce, it's delicious.

I had a great meal and left.
sample_reviews_en.author: Traveller Jun

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is famous for its homemade fish meatballs, an old recipe that has been a part of Pattaya's history. It's a go-to lunch spot for people working in the Second and Third Street areas. It's located opposite Silpabann, one of the top stationery and school supply stores for students and teachers in Pattaya. Parking is available on the street. Most Pattaya locals come by motorbike. The owner has a slightly serious expression; just enjoy the noodles and don't take offense. There are cats running in and out of the shop constantly. The noodle soup has a moderate flavor, and you can season it to your liking. The roast duck is tender and delicious, and the fish meatballs are soft and bouncy.
sample_reviews_en.author: MaprangNey

sample_reviews_en.text: The Hainanese chicken rice was delicious, the rice wasn't too oily. The noodle soup with meatballs was refreshing and hot 😋. The crispy pork was very crispy. The braised pork rice was also very delicious, but my only complaint is that there was too much sauce 🤣 I don't like a lot of sauce. I'm not deducting any stars because everything was delicious. I even secretly ordered a special Hainanese chicken rice to take home 😅😋😋
sample_reviews_en.author: ไปกินไปเที่ยว กับoppa

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to buy some crispy pork belly and asked the price. The owner said 150 baht per box. I asked how many grams it was, and she hesitated, unable to answer, just saying "one box." So I ordered some. Turns out, the crispy pork belly was terrible! It was mostly fat, with almost no meat. The quality didn't match the price; they gave very little. Don't eat at this shop!

sample_reviews_en.text:

The soup was delicious, with a clean, refreshing taste and no strong flavor.

I found it to be delicious just by adding a small amount of fish sauce, but some people might prefer to customize it to their liking with the various condiments on the table.

sample_reviews_en.text:
In terms of meat quality and taste, the roast duck, crispy pork, etc., at this shop are just like any other food stall, nothing special. The meat is also quite dry and lacks flavor.

The only difference between this shop and others is that the crispy pork comes with fried pork rinds.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came specifically to eat crispy pork belly, but the crispy pork here is more like pork cracklings than large pieces of pork belly that have been sliced. It's cut into small pieces, so you get the crispiness, not the tenderness.

However, the taste is still pretty good.

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_en.text:
I eat here often, but I get stood up repeatedly.
Never eat at this place again. It's terrible.

The restaurant changed to a new system; you scan to order.
I waited for 45 minutes. This is the second time my order has been pushed back.
The restaurant said my bill went missing. 4-5 other tables that came after me have already received their food and are about to leave.
The staff have no service mind. They noticed I was waiting a long time but never came to ask how long it had been since my order. It was me, the customer, who noticed that other tables had already received their orders and I was waiting a long time. I thought there must have been a mistake, so I went to point it out.

The apology from the staff was insincere; they didn't seem genuinely remorseful or interested in retaining customers.

The food is delicious, but the service and lack of genuine effort have ruined my desire to eat here. I wanted to give them a second chance, but it happened again. If they had apologized or shown genuine remorse, I might come back.
