sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this restaurant on the way to my accommodation.
I ordered shrimp fried rice.
The shrimp were very old and tasteless.
The rice was of very poor quality.
The seasoning was artificial and incredibly awful.
If you're going to eat here, I recommend getting a bento box from the 7-Eleven located a little further inside.
I took a picture of the shrimp, so I'll upload it.
The shrimp were squashed and had no aroma or taste.
The other picture shows it half-eaten, so there's a bit more to it. But it was so awful I left it.
The staff were busy dealing with Grab customers and didn't say anything.
They just said, "Scan the QR code to order."
Very disappointing.
My wife ordered the same thing, but said, "If it's bad, you can make it spicy to mask the taste and make it edible." Smart move.
sample_reviews_en.author: Takehiro Yoshida

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a made-to-order restaurant with incredibly delicious Tom Yum soup, especially their Tom Yum instant noodles. It's spicy, flavorful, and better than many famous Tom Yum hot pot restaurants. It's a hidden gem on Soi 72, comparable to the Unio Condo location.

As for the service, I won't comment... the staff are quite introverted, and the restaurant has multiple cooks, so the taste varies. It's best to be prepared for that.

"If you're a foreign traveler looking to try real Thai-style Tom Yum without spending much, you should definitely check out this place!"
sample_reviews_en.author: Imnotmachine

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered food but have been waiting for ages, 1 hour and 30 minutes, and still haven't received it. Some tables that waited less than half an hour have already left. The queuing system is completely disorganized. The delivery riders already got their menus. I'm still sitting here with my stomach rumbling. It's terrible, incredibly long, and the service is mediocre; they don't even care about the customers. I'm never eating here again. Read the reviews carefully before you decide to come. However, the food itself is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhuvasu Panyadee

sample_reviews_en.text: Raw fried egg. Normally, if the yolk is raw, it's edible. This time, the egg white was runny and watery. It was very fishy. It was so cold that you have to spit it out when you put it in your mouth. I eat it often because it's close to home, even though the taste is average and expensive. But this time, it was the worst I could accept. I won't eat it again. The staff always had a sour expression. If I complained to them about improvements, I was afraid of being scolded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krittima Intharaprasert

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant didn't know how to make it, but they didn't tell me. I ordered Pad Khee Mao (spicy stir-fried noodles) and got fried rice with instant noodles instead of rice. There was no chili, nothing that indicated it was Pad Khee Mao. They added water spinach, carrots, and cabbage. Why? And the taste was terrible. What a waste of money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duckling Ugling

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered pork with garlic and two undercooked fried eggs. One egg had the yolk spread everywhere, the other was fully cooked. The food tasted so bad I only ate one bite and threw it away. Buying instant noodles would have been better. It's like someone who only has a pan and a spatula dared to open a food stall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pari Tem

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered food and asked for mushrooms, but they didn't put them in. And they served old rice; it was hard and clumpy, not in separate grains. Sometimes I order the same dish, but it tastes different. The food used to be delicious. Now the restaurant doesn't seem to care about its customers at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanoknard Namkaew

restaurants.name: ลาบยโส รสเด็ด
restaurants.address:

PJ5F+V89, On Nut Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I highly recommend this hidden gem of a local Northeastern Thai restaurant. The food is flavorful, the prices are affordable, and everything is made fresh.

Recommended dishes:
Grilled Beef and Grilled Pork Neck: Perfectly grilled, tender and not chewy, with a lovely charcoal aroma.
Grilled Fish
Papaya Salad with Crab and Fermented Fish Sauce: Not fishy, ​​fragrant and flavorful.
Spicy Minced Pork Salad (Larb Moo): Generous portion.
Pork Curry: Fragrant, well-balanced flavor, not too spicy.

I recommend coming early, as the restaurant gets quite busy. I was a little disappointed that the grilled chicken and fish were sold out the day I went, but I'll definitely be back. Everyone is welcome!

The restaurant has parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poongmhanoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted amazing! The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce was fragrant, spicy, and perfectly balanced. The grilled pork was salty, sweet, and juicy. The beef dipping sauce was incredibly delicious and the portions were generous – very satisfying! It was great value for money, and the prices were very reasonable.

The restaurant is quite busy these days because of reviews on TikTok. You might want to allow some extra time. There are about 10 tables, but it's always packed. They serve customers on a first-come, first-served basis, so you can relax while you wait. You can also enjoy some delicious soy milk nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: KANARPHA SEENUANCHAN

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a somtum (papaya salad) shop that you might miss if you didn't see the reviews. It's located upstairs next to the sidewalk, in a tent with no sign. It's easy to find using a map, and there's plenty of parking for both motorcycles and cars. The menu isn't extensive, but the taste isn't bad, and most importantly, the prices are very cheap – definitely worth it. There might be a queue because the grilled items are always in demand. Personally, I liked all the grilled items, but the somtum and other dishes weren't particularly amazing. The best part is the price. I recommend giving it a try; you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: jaru gill

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great papaya salad! The fermented fish sauce papaya salad wasn't too fishy or strong at all; I enjoyed it so much I finished the whole plate.
The grilled pork was delicious, tender and not too fatty.
The pork intestines were also good.
I missed out on ordering the chicken this time; I'll definitely order it next time.

Parking is very limited. I recommend taking a Grab taxi or something similar.
Parking is extremely crowded, with cars double-parked. There are some cars parked along the street, but the restaurant said there are frequent rear-end collisions.
Arrive early, as it gets quite busy.
sample_reviews_en.author: กินกับแว่น

sample_reviews_en.text:
The papaya salad was spicy and made to order. The grilled pork was delicious and the dipping sauce was amazing.
The hot pot was tasty, although the dipping sauce was a little too sweet.
It was very crowded, especially in the evening. People kept arriving and filling the restaurant.
The food came out gradually, so there was a bit of a wait.
The restaurant probably has about 8-10 tables.
The prices were very cheap, not expensive at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fuji Chongcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and affordable. I drive past every day but never stopped. Once I did, I was hooked! The papaya salad is so spicy I order two plates for myself. However, I often miss out because the tables are full. I finish work late, around 10 pm, and frequently can't find a seat, so I have to leave. But that's okay, I guess it depends on luck whether I get to eat there or not. 🤣🍽
sample_reviews_en.author: Artist wra

sample_reviews_en.text: WARNING!!! Do not come here. The food is terrible, not delicious at all. The wait time is extremely long, at least 45 minutes. The older waitress, when I ordered sticky rice, said "just a moment," then just walked away confused and went to do something else, even though she wasn't busy at all. She could have just gone and gotten it for me. Ridiculous.
sample_reviews_en.author: จ.ส.อ. ณัฐภูมิ โฆษิตฤทธิเดช

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the staff arranging the seating and serving were terrible. Their attitude was poor, they ignored customers, and were completely uninterested. It was awful. I'm giving it one star for now because of the service. Improving or replacing the staff would be much better.
sample_reviews_en.author: One Two Five Coffee

restaurants.name: Madenah Halal Noodle Food
restaurants.address:

26 ซอย ชลนิเวศน์แยก 16, Khwaeng Chatuchak, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Most of food are delicious, and of course halal food, so you can easy to choose the food. There is also prayer room for muslim (musholla) behind the Madenah Halal Noodle Food Store. It is in the middle of the Chatuchak Weekend Market, there are also some kind of halal food stalls around there
sample_reviews_en.author: Mishbahuddin, Badnur Medisa

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was the most overpriced meal we had in 4 days. It wiped out all of our 4-people-pool money in one shop, when the same amount could cover all transportation cost and two 4-person meals. Food tested better at Nissareen.

Halal meals without halal prices.

I hope they could do better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nur Huda

sample_reviews_en.text:
Must try mango sticky rice in this place....much better than Saman Islam in the same area.
At Madenah the price is cheap compare to other halal food in Chatuchak Market...also very near to perform solat at Madenah
sample_reviews_en.author: Jon Wak

sample_reviews_en.text: Offer limited menu, the food and drink were not worth the taste. I ordered mango glutinous rice. I gave only 1⭐️ for it.  There is halal stall in mixt mall. The food taste was good and worth the price
sample_reviews_en.author: Chupacabra machupiccu

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup tasted really bad. It lacked the expected broth aroma, the soup smelled like chlorinated tap water, and the meat had a strange, strong smell. The price didn't match the quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fu yuck

sample_reviews_en.text: Exquisite. When in Chatuchak market please visit this food stall. Halal. Super fast service. Really good dishes for a cheap price and nice quantity. Definitely recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ikrame Dahmane

sample_reviews_en.text: Went to the market for shopping and stopped here for lunch. We enjoyed the food very much. The green curry was very nice rich and balanced in flavour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Javi

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is average but the most important is Halal. Chatuchak is really crowded, we just need to find any empty table and halal for lunch break.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahmad MS

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือกลางกรุง สาขา Central Rama 2
restaurants.address:

Rama II Rd, Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant never improves its service.
They don't make eye contact with customers and don't pay attention to serving them.
I sat there for a long time, almost 5 minutes, which is very long. They just stood around chatting. When a customer called out, one person would say, "Please wait a moment," before I could even order. And when I finally did order, they got it wrong again. I've never received what I ordered, and this has happened many times. I ordered a small bowl of mixed beef noodles, knowing exactly what should be in it. But when the food was placed on the table, it was nothing like the regular beef noodles. I asked the staff to confirm if it was the mixed beef noodles, but the staff member's expression was indifferent, and they just repeated the question, "Yes, mixed beef," as if unsure. When it came time to pay, it turned out the mistake started with the person taking the order – it was supposed to be regular beef noodles, but they repeated it wrongly. I'm so angry. This has happened so many times that I'm finally going to say it. I only eat here because the food tastes good. @central should be aware of the shortcomings of this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ongkarn Sema

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Krua Klang Krung Boat Noodles" at Central Rama 2

This restaurant has opened a branch at Central Rama 2 shopping mall, G floor.
The location is very easy to find, right in front of the Central Food Court.
My first reaction was, "I'm so happy that a boat noodle restaurant has opened in a mall I frequent!"
The restaurant is always full of people. Hmm! I guess it must be delicious.

I went in and looked at the menu... Boat noodles start at 50 baht, large bowl 90 baht.
They have pork and beef options. Beef lovers shouldn't miss it!
They even have Wagyu and Ribeye.
They have appetizers, main courses, light meals, salads, boiled meatballs, and much more.

After trying it, I have to say I loved it! Absolutely delicious! It's my favorite!
These boat noodles are incredibly delicious!
Krua Klang Krung Boat Noodles, a delicious find in Rama 2.
sample_reviews_en.author: Todsap Tawan

sample_reviews_en.text: I should have listened to the reviews. My parents wanted to try this store and somehow the shop was full, so we thought this place was gonna be up to our expectations. Turned out it was one of the worst experiences we had. From the staff told us to wait without queue and other customers just shamelessly cut the line, the staff acted like they didn't remember us and didn't even try to apologize, which is fine for us as we are hungry. But our experiences from their services throughout the meal were terrible. The food was alright, but if the owner sees this and other reviews, they should make some changes to the staffs immediately.
sample_reviews_en.author: L A B

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located in the basement, like a food court, but it's not. If you're looking for something to eat and want boat noodles, give it a try.

If you come on a Wednesday, a bowl is only 20 baht, but on other days, it's the regular price.

Speaking of the boat noodles, I have to say they can't compete with P. Prateep's.

The flavor is a bit too sweet, and not very tasty. You have to season them, or they'll be too sweet.

But if you like sweet flavors, give them a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aely Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff is terrible. Excuse my language, but the food itself is fine. The staff needs to be replaced. I ordered via QR code, but my order was incomplete. When I asked for the missing items, the staff member replied, "You didn't order from us, we don't know," and then walked away with their head held high. Is that acceptable behavior? I'm baffled. Luckily, I didn't get up and slap them. They're good-looking, but it's like they're being forced to work there. Awful!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: fern Npt

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste was terrible, very ordinary. The broth wasn't flavorful. I ordered Nam Tok (spicy beef salad), but it lacked richness. The chrysanthemum tea was bland and bitter, not tasty at all. 40 baht per glass, a real waste of money.
There weren't many chairs with backs either; mostly just round chairs without backs.
The staff had grumpy faces, like they were forced to work there.
My first time trying it, and that's enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mee -

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were unhelpful and forgot to prepare our order. When we tried to cancel, they immediately made it and packed it for us to take home without asking. We were very confused and wondered if this was acceptable. We ordered two bowls of noodles and finished them. The second item was pork with lime, which they forgot to make. There are no positive reviews for this branch at all. We were very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raisara Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was absolutely terrible. The staff were grumpy, made disgusted faces, and gave condescending looks. They skipped over customers even though we were sitting and waiting in line. Another customer even asked why they were skipping our turn, and they still acted unwelcoming. I don't understand why they're working there if they're not prepared. The food was mediocre, but the management was the worst.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patthamawan Karlsson

restaurants.name: J’Noy Seafood
restaurants.address:

Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "280THB for a small portion of vegetables is way to overpriced"

sample_reviews_en.text: On May 6, 2024, we went for dinner overlooking the sea. The staff were like schoolchildren from neighboring countries, like Cambodia. The food and drink menus were all unpriced, and while we were choosing, he stood over us, watching what we were choosing. We asked for beer while we were looking at the menu, but he didn't move an inch. When we finally decided on our options, it turned out the dishes were prepared by the kilogram, and nothing smaller. Why would I need a whole kilo of scallops, for example? We ended up just asking for a bottle of beer...and then waited for half an hour. The customer service is disgusting; we absolutely do not recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Сергей S

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was tasty, but the staff was incompetent. They forgot customer orders, making customers seem demanding and difficult. The only good service was when an Indian staff member turned on a fan for us – they treated us like royalty. Our table had 7 people including me, and it was terrible. The worst in Walking Street. My friend ordered scallops, and the staff said they'd already served them and another friend had already eaten them, but it was actually grilled fish. The staff called grilled fish scallops! They need to screen their staff immediately. Terrible, terrible, terrible!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shi Mon

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't recommend this place. It bills itself as a seafood restaurant, but the seafood is terrible. The squid is rubbery, impossible to chew, and the batter is so thick it felt like I'm gnawing on a nut. The mussels are the same: they say they're grilled, but they taste raw. The only thing I liked was the salad, but for that price, I don't even know. It's very expensive and tasteless. After this dinner, I had to go elsewhere and eat there. I highly recommend it. The only draw is the terrace with a sea view, but I don't want to pay that kind of money for that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Юлия Мавлеева

sample_reviews_en.text: Negative review, not recommended. The seafood at this seafood restaurant wasn't fresh enough; the shrimp was mushy, the baked oysters weren't very fresh, and the stir-fried scallops and golden shrimp didn't taste like they were stir-fried. The stir-fried vegetables were scarce and didn't taste stir-fried at all. The two pots of Tom Yum soup tasted completely different—one sweet, the other salty. The waiter didn't inform us that bringing in outside drinks would incur an extra charge; they only told us about the extra charge after we bought the drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: steve lee

sample_reviews_en.text: They rip me off just because I came alone. They made it difficult to calculate by showing me the bills separately. The price came out higher than what was on the menu, and the service was extremely slow. The female part-timers staring at me is annoying. Those bitches only care about money. I hope this place goes out of business.
sample_reviews_en.author: 쩡따저

sample_reviews_en.text:
The worst place ever~

Don't go... The food is terrible, and the staff are like elementary school kids...

Seriously, don't trust them and go~
The food comes out differently from the photos, and even though I ordered a beer, they won't cancel the order even though it wasn't opened.

You have to drink everything you order lol
sample_reviews_en.author: 라상균

sample_reviews_en.text: Usually not the biggest fan of seafood but this restaurant was amazing. Food, service and a nice atmosphere by the beach with a beautiful scenery. Would definitely recommend it to tourists and locals specially with those affordable prices. Definitely coming back when I revisit pattaya👌🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: georges fadous

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there on the recommendation of an acquaintance who lives there. It seems to be quite famous and often recommended, but honestly, it's terrible.

While tastes vary, there wasn't anything particularly delicious.

You'd be much better off eating various foods from street stalls.
sample_reviews_en.author: T VCM

restaurants.name: Madras Kitchen Restaurant
restaurants.address:

205/34 Moo 10, Pattaya Sai Song Soi 15, Main Road Corner Bang Lamung Nongprue Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a very bad experience after eating at this place. Within hours of dining, I started experiencing severe stomach pain, fever, nausea, and vomiting. It escalated quickly, and I had to be rushed to the hospital, where I was diagnosed with acute food poisoning. I ended up spending two nights under in the hospital.

It was my first meal of the day.

The restaurant needs to seriously review its hygiene standards, food storage, and preparation practices. When I went there was no customer at the restaurant and I believe they gave me stale food. I ordered Chicken Tikka Masala, Panner Prantha, Rumali roti (which was so hard to eat, usually rumali roti is soft) and tea, they brought the tea to me which was already cold.

I will reported this incident to the local health authorities, and I hope they take appropriate action to prevent others from going through what I did.

Absolutely unacceptable. Eat here at your own risk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyush Monga

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited Madras Kitchen during my recent Bangkok trip expecting authentic South Indian flavors, but was thoroughly disappointed with the food quality.
Ordered sambar idli and vada; the sambar tasted pre-cooked and stale, while the chutney was the only decent part. When I raised this with the manager, he claimed it was “fresh” but admitted it wasn’t good, then provided a replacement after 10 minutes which was just okay—not fresh or flavorful.
The vada was equally poor, soggy and lacking crispiness. Do not recommend this restaurant to anyone seeking genuine South Indian dishes—better options like Chennai Kitchen nearby offer superior idlis and service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Globetrotter

sample_reviews_en.text: I was driving around Pattaya when I noticed this restaurant and decided to give it a try. We reached around 11:45 pm, and there was no one else in the restaurant apart from us. The staff were welcoming, and the service was good. We ordered Mysore Dosa, Chicken Dosa, and Poori Sabji. The food was just okay, but I would not describe it as authentic South Indian cuisine. The coconut chutney was decent, while the tomato chutney was sweeter than I expected. I also felt that the masala in all the dishes had more of a North Indian influence than a South Indian one. Overall, it was an average experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jayakrishnan Nair

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried Madras Kitchen in Pattaya, nice setup and clean interiors, but the experience was underwhelming. The wait time for food was way too long, and to make things worse, they only accept cash, which wasn’t mentioned anywhere upfront (but in a small signage)

Ordered dosa and vada, hoping for authentic South Indian flavors, especially given the name of the place, but both were disappointing. Not the right picks, maybe, but still expected better.

Decent ambiance, but definitely room for improvement when it comes to service and food quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manoj G J

sample_reviews_en.text:
Way to expensive for the amount of meat you get.
I ordered chicken curry. Only 4 chunks of chicken and >50% of it was bone. My wife ordered chicken massala. Same  >50% bone so hardly any meat.
We also ordered tea which came when we were almost finished. The roti and the naan bread were the only good things.
sample_reviews_en.author: j vdk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Descent restaurant with both veg and non veg options. The staff is also good and courteous.
The food was tasty and place looks hygienic. The location is not very far from the start of the Walking Street.
The only issue was that they only accepted cash and no card payment option was available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ankit

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m an Indian myself, i have tried so many Indian restaurants in Pattaya mostly all have delicious food. But Sorry to say this Madras Restaurant food is Tasteless food, we ordered South & North Indian items, none of them have good taste.
We wasted our money
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarabjit Singh

sample_reviews_en.text: Beware of Food Poisoning. They serve old & stale food in style. My friend ate South Indian Thali and he is suffering with Food Poisoning and I ate Onion Dosa which was spoiled batter and later they served plain Dosa now I’m suffering food poisoning too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernard B (Benny)

restaurants.name: Phrannok
restaurants.address:

QF4F+4FQ, Phran Nok Road, Ban Chang Lo, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The area around Phran Nok offers a wide variety of food.
Japanese, Northern, Northeastern, and Southern Thai cuisine are all available to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: สมเจตน์ ชูเพ็ง (Chet)

sample_reviews_en.text: The large intersection offers access to many routes and has a variety of shops and a fresh market.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roch

sample_reviews_en.text: Along the sides of this road, there are many different kinds of fruit that vendors sell.
sample_reviews_en.author: ประยูร แจ่มแจ้ง

restaurants.name: ร้าน ละออโภชนา ข้าวต้มกุ๊ย
restaurants.address:

42 Soi Thian Thale 7, Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food ~ Every dish was delicious and well-prepared. The stir-fried bitter melon with eggs had both sweet and bitter melon, and I preferred it with chili peppers.
The bitter melon wasn't bitter at all. The jungle curry was rich and flavorful, and the sour curry was also delicious – a recommended dish.
The pickled mustard greens salad with salted egg is highly recommended. The seafood glass noodle salad was also tasty.
Many dishes were delicious; I recommend trying them yourself before you just take my word for it.
I finished several bowls of rice porridge.

Service ~ The staff were friendly and polite, greeting customers with a bow.
The food was prepared quickly, and the kitchen was clearly visible.

Atmosphere ~ There are air-conditioned and glass-enclosed seating areas, comfortable in any season – winter, summer, or rainy season. There are also outdoor seating options, but I personally preferred sitting inside because it was cool and comfortable. There are restrooms and sinks available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy Yam

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered a lot of dishes, but the portions were quite small. The food was delicious, though perhaps the ingredients were lacking. For example, the seafood tom yum soup had way too much broth—only 3 small shrimp and a few squid. Compared to the bowl, it was like getting a whole pot of soup. The rice porridge was fragrant with pandan leaves.
The chicken with cashew nuts was the best value and delicious; a must-order.
The stir-fried preserved olives were also good. The stir-fried morning glory, stir-fried pork ribs with chili, and stir-fried chili and salt dishes were all tasty. The wait was quite long, and the food came out one dish at a time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Primpinky Korea

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food took a little too long to arrive.
Before ordering from this restaurant, we went to a nearby restaurant and paid around 7:40 PM, then walked to this restaurant (very close). However, it took until about 8:28 PM to get our food and pay.
We only ordered two items for takeout, and there weren't many customers in the restaurant (about two tables).
I understand that the restaurant might have orders from multiple sources, but it would be great if they could improve their time management.

The restaurant was responsible and offered compensation 👍 (but we didn't accept it because we just wanted the food we ordered).

Food taste: It was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daisy Cai

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. The food is expensive, the portions are small, and the taste is mediocre, nothing amazing.
2. The Chinese sausage salad was burnt; it was charred beyond recognition, which is strange.
3. The pandan-flavored rice porridge was a complete mismatch. It was like eating a sweet and savory dish mixed together. They should offer a regular version as well. The staff didn't inform customers beforehand that the rice porridge was infused with pandan leaf water; otherwise, I wouldn't have eaten it because it was so bad and didn't taste good.

If you want rice porridge, choose this restaurant as a last resort.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirinya Piyarat

sample_reviews_en.text: This rice porridge restaurant has decent food with a diverse menu, and the dishes are quite tasty, especially the salads. However, the stir-fried clams seemed to be cooked too quickly over high heat, resulting in some clams not being fully cooked. Some dishes are a bit pricey, such as the stir-fried morning glory, which wasn't a large portion but cost 80 baht (I think 60 baht would be a better price for that amount). Parking is easy and well-organized with ample space. The restaurant is air-conditioned and comfortable, and the staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kongdej Keesukpan

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time here. Overall, the food is delicious. The first time I ordered stir-fried kale and chayote shoots. This time I ordered the same dishes, plus stir-fried preserved radish with egg. It was dry-fried and not greasy, very tasty. The chicken feet soup was also good (it would be even better if the chicken was more tender). The spicy sausage salad with century egg was also good, goes well with rice porridge or plain rice. (Sorry, I didn't take a picture before eating).
sample_reviews_en.author: PSornsri1989

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. We ordered pickled mustard greens salad, stir-fried morning glory with chili, and garlic squid. Everything was delicious, especially the pickled mustard greens salad. The pandan-flavored rice porridge was very fragrant. The restaurant is air-conditioned, comfortable, and clean. The service was good, and the prices were reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattra J

sample_reviews_en.text:

The sour plum soup is refreshing and easy to drink.

sample_reviews_en.text: Truly a beautiful, typical Thai place. Come here for a delicious breakfast, lunch, or dinner, or grab a "Chang beer" or a Thai whisky in the evening—highly recommended!! The woman who runs the place is super nice and helpful! As an extra treat for the Dutch: look for the bald man who often sits on the terrace. He has been in Thailand for twenty years and is a wonderful storyteller. The best part is, he can tell stories in Dutch!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jojo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice little restaurant with cheap and delicious food. Even though the portions could be a little bigger for good eaters.

When you try to go there keep in mind that the location on google maps isn‘t on point. The restaurant is right next to the 511 café/bistro at the main road.

Also the opening hours are a little off. It opens earlier than 1pm. I was there at 10am.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice place and not expensive. Good quality fresh food and Thai style freshly cooked. Very helpful lady owner and staff.

sample_reviews_en.text: Arriving at Bangkok by train from Hua Hin Station, I stopped by a Thai restaurant in front of the station. You can enjoy a variety of Thai dishes, including Pad Thai and Som Tam. It's a great place for a leisurely dinner, with the illumination of the station's landscape. It's a place enjoyed by backpackers and locals alike.

A good restaurant for resting after weary feet of touring temples.

Open, reasonable, ordinary food.

This popular restaurant is perfect for a casual stop.

sample_reviews_en.text: Have never tried their food stopped in for a coffee while waiting for a train.  Nice open place.  Smoking permitted on the street tables.  Easy to find and good location.  The staff are friendly but the owner seems to be overly persistent.

sample_reviews_en.text: We went there in the evening and all the dishes we ordered were delicious. The service was excellent. The owner is very friendly and takes great care of her customers. The children also loved it.

sample_reviews_en.text: My accommodation was nearby, so I was looking for a decent restaurant and visited this one because it looked clean. After arriving in Thailand, I had a sore throat, swollen tonsils, and a headache... I had no appetite, but this place sold shrimp porridge(?) soup(?) and I ate it to feel better. It tasted like Korean food. The surrounding street vendors were a bit dirty, but this place was clean, cheap, and delicious. Most of the food was under 100 baht! There was a huge selection of food! There was even air conditioning.
sample_reviews_en.author: 말리

sample_reviews_en.text:
We totally love this place. It’s nothing fancy but it gave us the experience we want in trying out the Thai flavor on a local restaurant. We love the food and the drinks we’ve ordered.

We also appreciate the effort of the restaurant crew to understand our orders and questions. Kudos to them, we had a great time! I’ll definitely recommend this for those who want to try the food on the streets of Bangkok.

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant occupies a single, air-conditioned shop unit on Sunthorn Kosa Road, next to Sacred Heart School. The menu offers a diverse selection of dishes including steaks, salads, spaghetti, Thai food, and single-serving meals. The taste is average, the prices are affordable, and it's a comfortable place to sit, perfect for the hot summer months.

sample_reviews_en.text: They have a good selection of menu items, including steaks, à la carte dishes, spaghetti, and even fresh milk bread. Free Wi-Fi is available. The food is delicious and affordable. I'll definitely recommend it to my friends and bring my family here again.

restaurants.name: Xin Xin Malatang The Mall Tha Phra
restaurants.address:

FH4 B-Floor, 129 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Bukkhalo, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Mala Hot Pot restaurant is located in the basement of The Mall Lifestyle Store Tha Phra, next to the food court, near KFC and McDonald's.
Everything is priced at 49 baht per 100 grams, with a minimum of 200 grams, but I always end up with half a kilo every time I scoop it up, lol. After scooping your ingredients, choose your desired soup base: dry-fried mala, regular mala, tomato soup, or mushroom soup. Today, I chose mushroom soup. The food price includes a 10 baht soup charge and a 10 baht dipping sauce charge.
After paying, you'll have to wait no more than 10 minutes. While waiting, you can take the dipping sauce bowls they provide to the sauce bar, which has a variety of ingredients, and mix it to your liking. Then, you can take your food to a table, which is in the restaurant's own area, so you don't have to mix with people sitting in the food court.
The mushroom soup is mild in flavor and slightly fragrant. I recommend adding dipping sauce to your liking.
I recommend weighing the ingredients before scooping them to control your budget as needed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kia KK

sample_reviews_en.text:
❣️The food is fresh, clean, and looks very appetizing. The pork and meatballs always look fresh, not mushy or watery.
❣️The staff are good; they cleared the table immediately when asked.
❣️The soup is tasty and quite good. The mala isn't too spicy, and the mushrooms and tomatoes are nice. The food is presented in bowls very attractively.
❣️My only criticism is the dipping sauces. The soy sauce and vinegar are very watery, more like the kind used with dim sum. Usually, the mala sauces I've eaten at in Thailand and China are much more concentrated. When mixed with the sesame sauce, it completely overwhelms the flavor. No matter how I season it, it's not as rich as what I'm used to. I'd like them to try using different sauces. 🥰 The sweet sukiyaki dipping sauce is delicious.

Overall, it was great and I will definitely come back again. ❤️💛
sample_reviews_en.author: Risa 04

sample_reviews_en.text:
Xin Xin Malatang has just opened at The Mall Tha Phra, B Floor, in the food court area at the front of the mall.

Currently, there's a grand opening promotion: spend 150 baht or more on food (excluding drinks) and receive a free water glass. This offer is valid until November 15th, 2024 (or while supplies last).

The restaurant uses authentic pork bone broth and offers four options: Mala broth, mushroom broth, tomato broth, and a dry-fried version.

Add as much as you like to your ingredients (100g for 49 baht). Options include seafood, meats, fried tofu, various meatballs, and several types of noodles.

Choose your own dipping sauces: mix and match sesame sauce, chili oil, garlic and sesame oil to pair with your soups, and there's also a sukiyaki sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: AomAmmTaLonGin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Strengths:
1. It feels like a reliable mala restaurant brand. The flavor isn't outstanding, but it's good for satisfying mala cravings. The mala soup is decent.
2. The ingredients are of good quality, appearing fresh and clean. The tofu skin is delicious.
3. This restaurant offers four cooking methods: milk mala soup, tomato soup, mushroom soup, and dry mala (I haven't seen this one at other branches).

Weaknesses:
1. Be careful when scooping ingredients; scooping too much will cost more. I've never spent less than 200 baht. I tend to be a bit heavy-handed with my portions.
2. I wish they had a new, tastier dipping sauce recipe. I tried making it according to their recipe, but it wasn't quite to my liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakaya Klongyut (Kia)

sample_reviews_en.text: There was no cashier staff. I saw someone sitting and playing with their phone in a corner. There were 3 people in front of the store before I saw a customer standing and waiting to pay?? What is this? This is not the first time I've seen this. The first time was probably at 11:00, and there was no one at all. I had to knock on the door and call them, even though it was the store's opening time or not. The staff didn't pay attention to the store front or the customer. They said they wanted to buy it to take home, but they handed me a bowl of dipping sauce until I had to emphasize that I should put it in a box to take home. This has happened twice in a row. That's it.
sample_reviews_en.author: tookkata Onuma

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good, but there was a lack of honesty towards customers. We ordered about 3-4 pieces of tteokbokki and one piece of fish, but when we received our order, there was no fish and only one piece of tteokbokki. The restaurant should consider whether this is acceptable practice. They charged the full amount, but the food we received was incomplete.

If anyone visits this restaurant, it would be a good idea to take pictures while picking up your food and to check that everything you ordered is included. With a closed kitchen, there's no way of knowing if anything you took might have been removed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supansa Surikam

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was okay, but the service was terrible. The management was awful, lol. They gave us free tteokbokki. My friend and I got some, and mine was sour, so I went to tell them I tried it and it was a bit sour. The staff said it wasn't sour. I then said that my friend's wasn't sour, so they couldn't answer my question. They weren't answering my question directly either. Finally, I insisted they try it, but they refused, only to say, "That's just how it is, it's always sour." I was so confused. I decided to just leave and not eat there. 🥲🥲

Please, owner, address this issue. The food tastes good, but this is a problem.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered food from Grab today and it was extremely overpriced.
If you're going to sell at this price, you should at least consider the quantity. Customers don't have a problem paying this price per unit, but the portion sizes are really excessive. The bitter melon and pickled cabbage soup was 145 baht, as you can see in the picture, and that's all I got. The garlic chicken was 90 baht, and it was practically just the bottom of the box, and it wasn't even all meat; about 30% was chicken skin. I can't believe raw materials can be that expensive. The dishes I ordered were very ordinary. The restaurant needs to reassess its business strategy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joy Joice

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time ordering delivery from this restaurant, and I was very dissatisfied with the communication. I ordered via LINE, but the branch didn't receive the order. After 40 minutes, I asked the admin, and they replied that they would call the Thonglor branch to expedite the process.
This means that the order and payment I made earlier were meaningless.
Please improve the quality of your communication and service. This is regarding the operational staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: nana s

sample_reviews_en.text: We only ordered 3 dishes: Panang Beef, Stir-fried Pickled Cabbage with Egg, and Fried Vegetables. We waited 50 minutes. Others who arrived after us got their food first. Could you please explain how each order is processed? Why did others get their food before us? If it's based on the queue, then getting food in order is understandable. But we were a group of more than 10 people, and others ordered more expensive items but received their food first.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noonetpt thongnu

sample_reviews_en.text: I found a large cockroach in the head of a mackerel. I had already finished eating the fish meat and was about to eat the head when I opened it up. I wanted to vomit. It was huge! I'm actually a regular customer of this restaurant. I thought that because it's expensive, the food would be clean and good. But now I understand that's not the case.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicki Siri

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through Grab at 10:32 AM today. At 11:30 AM, the rider informed me that my food would take another hour to prepare because there were 30 orders ahead of me. This is way too slow. I don't know what the restaurant is doing. In the end, I had to cancel the order and find something else to eat. It was a terrible experience.

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I ordered through Grab and the food portions were much smaller than before. The stir-fried chives with liver only had 3 small pieces of liver; it used to be much more. The beef panang curry also had very little beef, just 3-4 tiny pieces. If it continues like this, I'll stop ordering. It's too expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jasmine szn

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered Maggi seasoning for my pork dish. The pork was so hard, you could probably break a dog's head with it. The mixed vegetable sour curry also had very tough vegetables; the carrots, corn, cabbage, and beans were all incredibly hard. I didn't dare eat any of it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Save a life

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through Grab. I was shocked by how thin the fried eggplant was, and it also had an unpleasant oil smell. Was the oil old? Or had it been reused many times? This needs improvement. The chili paste, however, was delicious; just the right amount of spiciness.

sample_reviews_en.text:

Good stink beans, good shrimp, good dip. Giving 5 stars because I could order again.

I absolutely do not recommend this restaurant.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered takeout. The stir-fried pork with sataw and spicy curry paste was perfectly seasoned and delicious. sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the chicken mild. It came with a very spicy sauce, which I then had to leave off. Without the sauce, the food was very dry. A lot of rice with one chicken leg for 99 baht is too expensive. The rice and its spices are probably a matter of taste. I've always enjoyed the food at other Indian restaurants. They don't sell beer there, and I wasn't allowed to drink beer from 7-Eleven. Instead, I had to buy two bottles of beer at the bar next door for 90 baht each. The meal ended up costing 380 baht for two people. The Wi-Fi didn't work either. I get much more for my money elsewhere. Not recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Andreas Noack

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a biryani restaurant located on Baywalk on Beach Rd.
I got the 99B Dum Chicken Biryani to take home and eat.
When I took it home and transferred it to a plate, half of it was this much. I didn't think I could finish it all in one sitting, so I saved the other half for tomorrow's meal.
It had a light, dry curry texture and was delicious with a great spice. The chicken fell apart easily from the bone, making it very easy to eat, and it was soft and delicious.
Next time I'd like to try the Egg or Vegetarian option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hitoshi Abe

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited here because I wanted to eat biryani. The price had been revised and the chicken biryani was now 149 baht. The taste was slightly spicy and easy to eat, and the portion was large enough to fill me up. However, since the price has gone up, there are many other options, so I can't say it's good value for money anymore. What a shame!
sample_reviews_en.author: onikichiku

sample_reviews_en.text: This is anything but biryani. I have eaten biryani how many times I cannot even count but this is not biryani at all. The spices are not at all in proportion. The rice mixed with gravy with a piece of chicken is not biryani. First of all please have biryani from a good place and learn how to make. I didn't like it.
