restaurants.name: ฟ้าปลาทาน - Fá Plā Tahń Emporium
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์การค้าเอ็มโพเรี่ยม ห้อง FH4F006 ชั้น 4, เลขที่ 622 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located on the 4th floor near the Emporium food court, the restaurant's signature dish is fish, as the name suggests. The main courses focus on noodles and rice porridge.

We ordered Tom Yum Noodle Soup with Fresh Fish and Fish Balls (199 baht). We chose flat noodles, which paired well with the Tom Yum broth – no need to add any extra seasoning. The toppings included about 3 small pieces of fresh fish, 2 fish cakes, 1 fried taro fritter, 2 round fish balls, 1 rugby-shaped fish ball, 1 fried shrimp ball, 1 fried fish, and 1 fried wonton. It also came with bean sprouts and was topped with chopped scallions and fried garlic.

We also ordered Sea Bass Rice Porridge (219 baht). There were 4 large pieces of fresh sea bass, with no fishy smell. The soup was neither too salty nor too sweet, making it easy to eat. It also included braised pork.

The restaurant is large with plenty of seating. The staff were attentive and provided good service. However, I deducted one star because the food prices are a bit high.

*Prices do not include a 10% service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: natp

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fish noodle soup was delicious. The battered and fried fish was crispy, firm, and flavorful. The small fish dumplings lacked flavor. The round and rugby-shaped fish balls were standard. The shrimp balls were tasty. The clear noodle soup was a bit bland; honestly, some other places with clear soups taste better without needing any seasoning. The Tom Yum was too sour. The Yen Ta Fo had a good flavor, but the squid was a bit chewy and not as crispy and bouncy as it should be. Overall, it was delicious and I'd go back, but not often.
The staff were polite and lovely.
The price was a bit high, so I had to deduct points. Eating there frequently would be expensive. Thongsmith is more affordable, but the ingredients are different, which I understand, but it's still pricey there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poko Lasalle

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chanced upon this place on Google as we were craving noodle soup. We ordered the creamy tomyum noodles and the sliced fish flat rice noodles, both with sea bass, plus add-ons of fried fish and fish dumplings. The fried fish was actually very good, but the broth was underwhelming and the sea bass slices, while fresh, tasted a little dull — maybe slightly overcooked. The fish dumplings weren’t really worth adding on either.

Service was a bit slow despite the restaurant being rather empty, though the overall ambience and decor were nice and comfortable. It was an okay meal, but nothing that would make me come back specifically for it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angela Hoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Loved every bit of the retro Thai-Chinese vibe here! The decor instantly took me back in time, with vintage signs, red steel chairs, and cozy neon touches that create the perfect backdrop for a hearty meal.

I had the Mee Kiew with crispy wonton and tender sliced pork — flavorful, comforting, and just the right portion. The Thai iced tea was aromatic and not overly sweet, just how I like it!

Service was quick and friendly, and the whole place had such a welcoming energy. A perfect spot for casual dining with nostalgic flair. Will definitely return to try more of the menu. ❤️🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: Veerapat Charinkan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fish ball and rugby balls were not up to par!
The flavour of the overall noodles was good and their fried things were well fried.

I ordered fried tofu and it was delicious .  Very crispy yet light on the outside and very soft on the inside.  The sauce was good too.

If it wasn’t for the fried tofu, I would’ve given a one or two star for the noodles

A bit pricey for just two things, but considering they are in the department store so ….
sample_reviews_en.author: Arlene P. T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
They also have branches in Central Chidlom and Emsphere, but this is the most recently opened Emporium branch.
Their tom yum noodle soup is delicious. This tom yum, which doesn't contain coconut milk, isn't creamy, but rather has a straightforward richness and spiciness.
You can choose from a variety of toppings, including meat and seafood, and in addition to noodles, they also have rice dishes. Yen Ta Pho is also popular.
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent Thai fish and pork noodle. Up scale Thai noodle from street food to better quality. Excellent taste you can get from their dishes. Fresh and good quality ingredients made their food are so good. They have several branches so you can enjoy every location which all are same taste. English menu and picture are available. Staffs are really good. Credit card accepted. Enjoy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Supakij Khomvilai

sample_reviews_en.text: Popular chain restaurant with fish noodles and rice soup.   I like to order the noodles with soup on the side,  so as to keep the fried battered fish(almost like fish and chips) dry and crispy.  It's tasty without the strong fishy taste.  Highly recommended.  Service is always good at this chain.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lawrence

restaurants.name: ร้านเรือจีน
restaurants.address:

1513 Chumnum Phanit Rd, ต.ตลาด Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This somtum (papaya salad) shop in Phra Pradaeng is worth visiting because the owner is more cheerful and friendly than the other two popular shops in the area. The grilled chicken has thin, tender skin and delicious dipping sauce. The pork neck is also very tender. The somtum has a great flavor, with crispy papaya. The spicy salads and waterfall salads are refreshingly sour. I give it 5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nam Pimpim

sample_reviews_en.text: For authentic Northeastern Thai food in Phra Pradaeng market, this is the place to go. It's another restaurant that's sure to deliver a flavorful and satisfying experience for everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: พี่จ๊ะจ๋ากับน้องเจ้าสัว

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small shop, but
the food is delicious. The prices are standard, perfect for ordering takeout to eat with family at home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phusit Ngamdungjai

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves delicious som tam and other spicy salads, with customizable flavors. Come try it and you'll be hooked!
sample_reviews_en.author: คน คน

restaurants.name: Larp Suanplu ลาภ สวนพลู
restaurants.address:

490 Thanon Suan Phlu, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Reasonably priced tasty Authentic Thai dishes with high quality ingredients."

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered glass noodle casserole with shrimp for takeout. They put it in a non-heat-resistant, clear fruit container. The heat caused the container to warp. I called to ask if they would remake it, and the restaurant said yes, but I had to arrange my own delivery. In the end, I arranged for a delivery service to pick it up, and they remade it, but without the shrimp. They have no ethics; don't eat at this restaurant. The food might be contaminated, and they only care about selling. 250 baht + delivery fee. Throw it in the trash.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasikan Supradith

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is not so clean (baby cockroaches were walking around). They are definitely interested on your food. Tables need to be wiped by ourselves.

Staffs are overstaffed since only the cashier seems to comprehend what’s ordered. The rest are just pretending to be working.

Some bright side is the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: took ti

sample_reviews_en.text: Reasonably priced tasty Authentic Thai dishes with high quality ingredients. Extensive menu in 4 languages (English, Chinese, Japanese & Thai). The staff are always friendly and tourist friendly. As for all authentic Thai dishes, they can be hot & spicy so ask your wait staff to make your dishes non spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: David T

sample_reviews_en.text:
A simple restaurant serving local cuisine at very low prices. The decor is rather uninspired, and there's no table service, but the food is truly excellent, especially the "Gai Ped Med Mamunang" – chicken with cashew nuts (not on the menu, but listed on the blackboard).

Absolutely delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: thomas Elias

sample_reviews_en.text: I go to Larp Suan Plu branch about once a month. They serve reasonably priced Isaan food. The menu has Japanese translations, and it's less crowded than the Silom branch, so I think it's a good place for everyday use.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kumar Kumam

sample_reviews_en.text: It is a so-so, average restaurant. The morning glory is delicious, but the noodles in the Pad Thai came out clumped together.... Perhaps because I visited around 9 o'clock, there wasn't a single person there.
sample_reviews_en.author: 정진경

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good food at a low price.

But if you're looking for comfort, this isn't the place for you. Thai style!

And if you like a beer with your meal, bring your own.

We'll definitely be eating there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andreas Putzönius

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu is written in Japanese, making it easy to order.
The taste, prices, and service are all good, so it's a restaurant I'd love to visit if it were nearby.
There is also a branch in Silom.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yusuke Sato

restaurants.name: ว่าน ว่าน ราดหน้ายอดผัก by LarksenLairose เจริญนคร17
restaurants.address:

ปากซอยเจริญนคร 17 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by today and ordered basil chicken rice, stir-fried water spinach, and an iced drink. It was a simple meal, but very satisfying. The basil chicken was very fragrant and tasted great with the half-cooked egg mixed with the rice. The water spinach was stir-fried perfectly, not too oily or too salty.

The shop isn't big, but it's clean and comfortable with air conditioning, making it pleasant to eat alone. The owner and staff were very friendly, and the food was made to order and served quickly.

The prices are reasonable, and the portions are generous. It's a local little shop that I'd definitely want to come back to. If you're ever in the Charoen Nakhon area and don't know what to eat, I highly recommend trying this place. Next time, I'd like to try their signature Thai-style thickened rice noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: 蜀道山

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ate here for the second time today. The food is of good quality and the taste is excellent. It doesn't look very polished, but the food itself (which is what matters) more than makes up for it. Tip: go for the authentic Thai dishes such as the pad thai or the chicken with cashews, etc.

The price-quality ratio is fine. There were four of us, including drinks, spending 535 THB.
sample_reviews_en.author: Danielle Kuipers-Delis

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the interior is nice and air conditioned. The thing is that we ordered spring rolls and yum and we waited for 45 minutes. We ate the main meal but when we wanted to pay we got the bill with spring rolls, which we still didnt get, but no yum. Then the waiter told us that they fried spring rolls long ago but she forgot to put them on the table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Baitoei N.Obradovic

sample_reviews_en.text:
Goodness me I passed by this place dozens of time during my stay nearby and never once thought to go in. On my last night I was very hungry and it was late so I took the plunge.

Wow, fantastic food at a fantastic value. The workers were fairly friendly and kind to foreigners and I really have no complaints. Wish I tried this place earlier.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cloud

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered spring rolls, chicken teriyaki and thai style noodles.
- Spring rolls were tawn from the fridge
- Chicken steak was half frozen (after returning I got the same plate again, just 2 minutes more into the mictowave)
- 'Thai style' noodles were just noodles in oil with some egg parts.
Disgusting, don't come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mathias K

sample_reviews_en.text: Vast choice of Thai and Western food, and one of the places with the best price/quality ratio I met in Bangkok for the latter. English menus, waiters' English poor, but it doesn't create a problem in communication: they're nice and they'll remove/add ingredients to a dish if you wish so.
sample_reviews_en.author: George Gavrilita

sample_reviews_en.text: A small but excellent restaurant with a wide selection of delicious dishes. The staff was very friendly, helpful, and attentive. The food was very good and offered at a fantastic price. As is almost always the case, it was very busy (with both tourists and Thais). Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sascha Egloff

sample_reviews_en.text:
Small and authentic street food stall. English is a bit of a challenge, but they use pictures to help... works perfectly.

The sauce for the spring rolls takes some getting used to... But all in all, highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ralf Ketterer

restaurants.name: 万丰包子铺（辉煌）
restaurants.address:

223/4-5.ถ.ประชาราษฎร์บำเพ็ญ3/1 แขวงห้วยขวาง เขตห้วยขวาง กรุงเทพมหานคร, Huihuang, 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was a bit pricey, but the taste was okay. However, the service was terrible; the waiters were incredibly rude and gave customers the cold shoulder. As soon as I entered, the waiter next to me gave her a hard time, and she confronted him directly. I bought a fried dough stick, paid, and the waiter went to turn on the stove. He started chatting, and after 10 minutes, nothing had come. The stove was smoking after 10 minutes, and I asked if it was ready yet. He said the oil wasn't hot enough??? Then he went out to get it for me, and when it was done, he just slammed it on the table. The dough stick was still very hot from the stove, and they put it directly into a plastic bag. It was so hot that the plastic bag stuck together. How could anyone eat that?
sample_reviews_en.author: lifang wang

sample_reviews_en.text: It's 40 degrees Celsius outside, and inside it's like a sauna. What's the difference between having your air conditioning on and off? And those steamed buns, 5 for 100 baht? Fine, I'll take that. But have you even eaten those buns yourself? Are they even fit for human consumption? How long have they been sitting there? I initially ordered beef noodles, steamed buns, and fried dough sticks. I finished all the buns and fried dough sticks, and then everyone else ordered noodles, but I hadn't even ordered them! Your food and service are truly awful. I've been in Thailand for so long and eaten countless Chinese restaurants, and I never give reviews to anyone. But your food and service—which one of them is even remotely acceptable?
sample_reviews_en.author: qiang mike

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the staff members had such a terrible attitude that it completely ruined my appetite! It's a shame we didn't even get to try the food there. Avoid this restaurant if you don't want your appetite ruined by the worst customer service ever! What's with throwing the menu on the table and giving us a long face?! If you're not happy about your job, go do something else! The staff member's attitude was absolutely awful; they threw the menu on the table, had a long face, and acted like we owed them money. It made us feel incredibly uncomfortable first thing in the morning. I wouldn't go to a restaurant with this kind of service even if I were paid! I highly do not recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cass

sample_reviews_en.text: Boss, if you still want to run this business, please manage your employees. The female employees' service attitude is terrible! They always have a sour face, like customers owe them money. They won't answer any questions; are they deaf or unable to hear? While customers are dining, the female employees are video chatting with their friends, talking loudly on speakerphone, which greatly disturbs the dining experience. The self-service food area should also be covered; flies are buzzing around. If the staff's service attitude and hygiene improve, I will return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nwe Nwe Win

sample_reviews_en.text: I hadn't had steamed buns in a long time, so I made a special trip to Huihuang to find one, which I found through a recommendation on Xiaohongshu. The shop was easy to find, the signboard was eye-catching, and the interior was bright. I just ordered a few things randomly. The scallion pancakes were delicious, the steamed buns were average, and the sweet rice wine was just okay. Overall, the taste was decent, nothing bad, but nothing amazing either. If you're craving steamed buns, you can give it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: inho Ronald

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, I don't understand why this kind of shop can still operate in Huihuang. First, the food: 100 baht for 5 small buns—regardless of price, the taste alone would make me only come once! And what I find strange is that a bowl of plain rice porridge costs 80 baht!! That's outrageous! As for the service, the waitress's face scared me; I don't know if I offended her. I hope everyone avoids this place. A higher price is fine, as long as the food is at least acceptable...
sample_reviews_en.author: joo Devil

sample_reviews_en.text: The steamed buns were delicious, but the service was poor. There were many servers in the shop, but when we went to eat, we ordered two small bowls. The first server just looked at me without nodding or shaking her head, and didn't say anything more. We had to ask another server who was passing by before she told us we needed to get them ourselves. Actually, they were available, as the shop isn't very big.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lu Lu

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time at this restaurant, six months later, and the quality control has changed drastically. The steamed buns and scallion pancakes weren't freshly made; the five buns were all different sizes. I came during peak hours, and they still weren't making them fresh. I was very disappointed, having taken a taxi here just to eat here. Objectively speaking, the noodles were okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Menglun Chen

restaurants.name: KFC Makro Sathon
restaurants.address:

Makro, Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: At the KFC branch in Makro, the staff made a mistake. They took an order but skipped over it, prioritizing orders from customers in the store first—skipping about 6-7 orders before finally making the delivery orders. They wouldn't have started unless I followed up, even though they said it was ready at the time of taking the order. Why leave the delivery orders if they can't wait that long? Those ordering delivery should be aware of unnecessarily long waits.
sample_reviews_en.author: jaii office

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken rice salad was extremely sour. They mixed old chicken with new chicken in the salad.
🌟The worst part🌟 The employee in the red shirt was very condescending towards the employee in the black shirt during a training session. Even though they hold a special position, they are still employees and shouldn't be speaking to a coworker like that, especially in front of customers. Improve your attitude and you'll have more people to share your workload.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthaya Khongmuang

sample_reviews_en.text:
For chicken lovers, best place to satisfy their chicken tooth. Within Makro, you can feast here before or after shopping. They use to have lots of offers running. We had chicken bucket in 69 baht. Chicken is crispy and spicy.
Good space available for seating. Free refills available for your Cold Drinks. Minimal ice cream options but yet worth trying. Hand wash available. Nice ambience with superb staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanjay Choudhary

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat at Makro often because I have to buy groceries there (Sathorn area). The food tastes fine. The only issue is that the hand-washing tap for customers has been broken for a long time and hasn't been fixed. The trash can is overflowing with food trays and leftovers. I think there aren't enough staff to supervise everything properly, especially with the COVID-19 pandemic. Please look into this.
sample_reviews_en.author: กาแฟ 168

sample_reviews_en.text: I came to eat at 8 PM. I asked the staff if they were still open and they said I could order, but I had to wait for half an hour. They also turned off the refillable drink machine. This really tarnishes the reputation of fast food. If they're going to close, they should just say so, not make us wait without informing us.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปทิตตา ทองกระจาย

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken was incredibly delicious today! I almost cried from hunger, but this made it 1000% more delicious! The staff were very quick. The restaurant seemed to have few customers, which was nice. The atmosphere was good, the air conditioning was cool, and the music was fun 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Thida Akkasoon

sample_reviews_en.text: I only visit this branch occasionally because I don't shop at Makro very often, so I don't get a chance to stop by. But today I did, and I felt the store was cleaner and more comfortable. The staff were smiling and provided good service. The fried chicken was delicious too.
sample_reviews_en.author: My happiness

sample_reviews_en.text: I visit Makro quite often. Before this, there was an all-you-can-eat shabu-shabu restaurant, but it went out of business due to a lack of customers, and now KFC has opened up here. It is quite busy. The service is fast food level. They even have a menu for Thai people.
sample_reviews_en.author: jay kang

restaurants.name: อี้จาสุกี้หม่าล่า สาขาบางซื่อ
restaurants.address:

243/4 Pracha Rat Sai 2 Rd, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
299฿ (excluding drinks). The ingredients are of pretty good value for the price.
Ordered via QR code, waited over 10 minutes.
sample_reviews_th.author: suntorn teamrat

sample_reviews_th.text: The buffet is 299/399฿, a great price! It includes both BBQ and a choice of two drinks. Good service and good food.
sample_reviews_th.author: Areerut Inchui

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a branch near my house that I eat at very often (10+ times). It's not crowded unless there's a promotion. If you come in the afternoon, sometimes there's hardly anyone. If you come on a busy day, be patient because there aren't many staff members, and they might not be able to manage everything quickly enough.
The ingredients are fresh, the portions are large, and it's clean. The buffet is reasonably priced considering the quality, starting at 299-399 baht. Refillable drinks are 39 baht. The soup is okay and tasty. You can make your own dipping sauces or ask the staff to make them for you. If you add refillable drinks, you also get ice cream. The last time I went, I saw the restaurant was wrapping the fresh ingredients on the conveyor belt with plastic wrap.
The staff are lovely and provide good service. There might not be many of them, but you can always call them over.
I love eating here and I encourage everyone to come. I hope they stay open for a long time.🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: Faii P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were incomprehensible. We intended to eat the buffet but didn't want to sit with other people, so we asked the staff how much it cost to sit separately and if it was still a buffet. They couldn't understand, just kept saying "à la carte, à la carte." So we told them we'd rather sit with the others. My boyfriend and I were planning to eat the buffet, but the staff said they heard us say "à la carte." It was the staff member who said that. After eating for a while, we noticed we didn't have a QR code, which we usually get. We asked the staff, and they gave us an à la carte bill of 1,196 baht. We were very upset and still weren't full. This is actually one of our favorite restaurants, but after this experience, we're done with it. 😡😡😡😡😡😡
sample_reviews_en.author: Juthamat8

sample_reviews_en.text: The tables and chairs have cramped spaces; you have to carefully lean in or crawl on your knees on the cushions before slowly sliding your legs in. / There's a wide variety of food options, but the river prawns were unavailable. / The service was mediocre. Importantly, I asked the staff if they had slotted ladles, and the answer was "we're out." (I wondered back at the table if the restaurant only washes dishes once a day or something.) And to top it all off, they charged the wrong table. We opted for the 399 baht package to eat beef, but couldn't find the beef on the menu. In the end, the staff charged us the 299 baht package. TT
sample_reviews_en.author: Ariizcita

sample_reviews_en.text: The food, especially the soup, was quite ordinary and edible, but the atmosphere was extremely hot and stuffy. It was a buffet, but the service was incredibly slow. It was the same the last time I came; they never improve. If you don't keep asking, you barely get anything, and sometimes even after asking, you still don't get it. Despite the high price and small portions, the service is still terrible. The ice cream was free, but it was so cold it was impossible to scoop. It was extremely hard. Normally, at other places, the ice cream is hard but you can scrape it off with force, but this one was impossible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bi5Hz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is fresh, good, and there's a wide variety to choose from on the conveyor belt. There are many soup bases to choose from. They offer both à la carte and buffet options. I liked the tofu, different colored noodles, and various vegetables. Drinks, ice cream, and fruit are also available. There's no dedicated parking; you have to park on the street, but be careful not to get your wheels locked. The staff are attentive, polite, and friendly. The price is reasonable. I wish this branch would have some promotions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mui Asawin

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch offers two buffet options: 299 and 399 baht, excluding drinks (refillable drinks are +39 baht). The food variety is good. You can choose to sit at a table or at the conveyor belt. The staff are attentive, and the food tastes decent, with a slight Chinese herbal flavor. Unfortunately, the restaurant had flies, especially on the conveyor belt where the fresh food was kept. Dessert includes ice cream. It's a roadside restaurant, and most customers seem to arrive on motorcycles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fon Kawaii

restaurants.name: Pet Im-Un
restaurants.address:

198, 3 Chan 18 Alley, Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lately, I've been trying out new restaurants near my house, and I just discovered this one. "Why did we only just find this place?!"

The food is delicious! They sell roast duck, char siu pork, crispy pork, and braised pork. I usually don't like char siu pork with rice because I hate the sauce, but this place's is so good I have to admit it's amazing! 👍🏻 Everything is fantastic. I've been coming back quite often lately; it's so good I always order a second serving.

- The crispy pork and roast duck are incredibly crispy and delicious.
- The braised pork is also fantastic – tender and juicy, served with a delicious sauce.

They offer it with both rice and noodles, and both are delicious. If you're in the area, I highly recommend trying it! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Zzapp

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the rice with roasted pork, crispy pork, and duck for 90 baht. The food tasted sweet; people who like sweet flavors would probably love it. The crispy pork was very fatty and not crispy at all. It shouldn't have been pounded before serving because it was all mushy. The crispy pork was dry. The duck was juicy and sweet. It's too oily; you'll get tired of it after just a few bites. It's not filling for those with a big appetite. There's little meat but a lot of rice. Not recommended for those watching their carb intake.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duean K.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a good restaurant. The duck has a slight gamey smell, but overall, it's delicious when mixed with Chinese sausage and crispy pork. A great advantage is the dozens of different stewed soups to choose from, all at cheap prices and tasty. The tea cart in front of the shop also makes excellent tea. The coffee shop is always packed with soft-boiled eggs, coffee, hot tea, and iced tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: thanyaphan limkangwanmongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: Normally, we buy this as takeout, but today the dry noodles with crispy pork had crispy pork that tasted like salted fish, including the texture – mushy like salted fish. It also had a salty smell (not the sauce, it was a different smell). I'm worried I might get food poisoning. The noodles, vegetables, sauce, and soup were fine; only the crispy pork was spoiled.
sample_reviews_en.author: pg w

sample_reviews_en.text: The duck rice is delicious! Anyone passing by should stop and try it. They have duck rice, crispy pork rice, noodles, and most importantly, their duck is cooked in their own unique style. The prices are also affordable. Please support this restaurant! And don't forget their Chinese herbal braised pork and many other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: นิกร นิลสนธิ

sample_reviews_en.text: The roast duck tasted good, with crispy skin, and the sauce was delicious, just like MK's roast duck. However, the downside was the poor quality and soggy rice. The portion of duck was also very small; I finished the duck but still had half a plate of rice left. This dish cost 40 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyapong Bhookham

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste was amazing, everything was delicious. The flavors were just right, perfectly balanced and incredibly tasty. I was very impressed and will definitely come back often.
I recommend the roast duck and the wonton noodles with char siu pork. I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitinan Chuennok

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ped Im Oun (Warm and Satisfying Duck)
A restaurant serving Teochew and Hong Kong-style roast duck and char siu pork rice.
The taste is good and satisfying. Recommended if you're passing through Soi Saint Louis, which connects to Chan Road. Stop by and enjoy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Term Sook (Chef Ma)

restaurants.name: เด็กเส้นพัทยา&เด็กดอยคาเฟ่
restaurants.address:

229 64 ม.12, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I wouldn't give it even one star. The service was terrible. The food was slow to come out and there were many mistakes. We waited a long time for our food, and we understood that there were probably a lot of customers, but we got impatient and worried about our order getting lost, so we asked the waiter to check on our food. But the waiter replied, "We already brought the food to you, and you said you didn't order it!" I sat there for ages and no one had served me anything. So I asked to cancel the bill. A new waiter came to check the bill, but didn't say a word or provide any service. They just handed me the bill without saying anything. I paid, and they didn't thank me or apologize. They just blamed the customer. It was a huge waste of time. And look at the bill carefully; it's wrong all the time.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชลณิชา ศรีวงศ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
This time was a huge surprise 😂 It's like the restaurant changed to a whole new team of staff. The atmosphere and service are so much better than before. I could feel it from the moment I walked in; it's a completely different vibe from the last time.

I saw some reviews and was a little hesitant, but in the end I thought, "Okay, let's try it myself." 😂 And I wasn't disappointed at all! You really have to try these things yourself, because everyone's experience is different.

This time gets a thumbs up 👍 If you've had a bad experience here before, try coming back again; you might get the same feeling as me! 555
sample_reviews_en.author: Nong Tar

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, but the only downside is that the staff aren't very attentive to customers. They seem more interested in chatting amongst themselves. Every time I called them, I had to raise my hand 4-5 times or more. Each time I turned around, they were still talking. Sometimes they seemed to see me but didn't. I suspect they might not have been able to see customers because of where they were standing. They should improve their customer awareness and avoid having staff clustered together like that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norraphat Anantaphumin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible. We called to order, and when we asked if they had this type of meat, they didn't know and walked away before we'd even ordered anything. We had to call someone else to order again. They slammed the food down when they handed it to us. I don't know if it's because we're Thai that they don't want to serve us.
I'd like to pass this feedback on to the owner: even if the food tastes good, I won't want to go back if this continues.
sample_reviews_en.author: อภิญญา แก้วสุวสิงห์

sample_reviews_en.text: I've passed by this place many times and finally decided to try it. Turns out they have a wide variety of food. At first, I thought they only served noodles, but the rice I ordered was delicious from the first bite! The restaurant is spacious, airy, and comfortable, with a cafe corner. The food came out quickly, I loved it. I'll definitely go again. It's only 200 meters from my place! 😅😅❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Catch me if you can

sample_reviews_en.text: I wasn't very hungry, so I ordered a very small bowl of noodles for 25 baht. It was surprisingly generous in portion and delicious. Regular bowls of noodles are 79/89 baht. They also have papaya salad; I tried the "Tam Sua" (spicy papaya salad with noodles) for 125 baht, and it was delicious and flavorful. They have a wide variety of free vegetables that you can help yourself to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Na na

sample_reviews_en.text: The food in general tastes good and is reasonably priced with a variety of dishes. It would be even better if the saltiness were reduced by half, especially the stir-fried basil chicken, which was extremely salty – I had to scoop out only the meat and didn't dare touch the broth. Normally, the Pad Thai is more sour and sweet, but this restaurant's was predominantly salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: กวิสรา ปินะกัง

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible, incredibly slow, and expensive. It took 1.5 hours just to eat a bowl of noodles. A complete waste of time. Tables that came after us got their food first.
The short female employee taking orders was very arrogant and argumentative, with a haughty attitude and terrible manners. She made a mistake but didn't apologize at all. Once is more than enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: มะลิสา แววศร

restaurants.name: Shinkanzen Sushi เมเจอร์ สุขุมวิท
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 1 ศูนย์การค้าเมเจอร์ซีนีเพลกซ์ 39 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I went during their 11th anniversary promotion. The food arrived quickly; I didn't have to wait long at all. It was delicious, up to the standard I've experienced at other branches. The newly opened branch was clean and the atmosphere was okay. The staff provided excellent service, **except for the manager**. We were running short on time as the restaurant was about to close, and we still had a lot of food left to eat (it wasn't a buffet). We asked if we could have it packed to go, but the manager's expression was so unpleasant it shone through their mask. They just stood by our table, not asking which items we wanted packed or saying anything at all. My friend and I discussed that we understood if there was an extra charge for packaging, as we were paying for everything ourselves and it wasn't a buffet where we were just asking for leftovers. We understood the extra cost. However, we would like the manager to improve their manners/behavior or communication style with customers. What started as a delicious meal and a good mood turned into a really unpleasant experience. 🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: amperesiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
I waited 40 minutes for my food. I ordered at 6:34 PM (not including the 5-minute wait for the QR code to scan the menu), and the food arrived around 7:15 PM. I had to ask for it several times, even having to tell them that the movie I was going to see was about to start at 7:30 PM before my food finally arrived. In the end, I had to eat quickly and leave. It was a terrible experience.

Do you really need to allow an hour or more for food?

I feel sorry for the waitstaff and cashiers who had to deal with so many orders. But if they know the order volume is high, they shouldn't accept more customers.

I suspect the kitchen prioritized orders for delivery riders. Next time, I'll order through the app to get a discount code if the wait is long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phatchayamon Namwong

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my second time here, and the service was just as bad. Many things were disappointing and unimpressive. The restaurant has no queuing system or name-taking system, forcing customers to ask around and causing confusion about how to wait. Communication was disorganized; there were arguments in front of customers, with one person saying they weren't next in line but another had already been seated. Orders were taken without writing them down, relying instead on memory. After ordering, the staff would ask, "Did you forget what you ordered?" When I asked about my drinks, the staff claimed I hadn't ordered them, repeatedly blaming me. I've seen so many negative reviews; does the owner ever care about their own branch? 😩
sample_reviews_en.author: tta

sample_reviews_en.text:
The music was playing in some unknown way, it was really annoying to listen to. It sounded like streaming with a slow internet connection, constantly cutting out. I reported it to staff to fix it, but there was no response. Lol.
If the music quality was bad, it would be better to have no music at all.
The food quality is commensurate with the price. The salmon cake, priced at a little over 200 baht, was quite creative. It was thinly sliced, using minimal ingredients, but the rice inside was creatively prepared, making it interesting.
The food is in a price range that makes it worth trying.
The food took quite a while to prepare.
It's Japanese food with a Thai twist, easily accessible.
Overall, it's okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฏฐ์ ประเสริฐเมฆ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was as delicious as at other branches, but I ordered at 6:35 PM and didn't get my food until almost 7 PM. I think the staff forgot, but luckily I followed up; otherwise, it probably would have taken even longer. You have to spend over 500 baht to use a credit card. The restaurant was quite crowded compared to other restaurants in Major Sukhumvit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarefah Ganoknan

sample_reviews_en.text: I waited for my food for a very long time, almost 30 minutes, even though the table that came later got it first. I finished eating and it still wasn't ready. I told them to hurry it up, but they still had to wait a while. When it arrived, it looked like it was made in a hurry and without any care. I was very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Preeda Akara

sample_reviews_en.text: One dish took almost half an hour to arrive, even though tables that came after us and ordered the same thing had already received their food and finished eating. When we inquired, the staff were unhelpful, didn't apologize, and gave dismissive answers, acting as if they hadn't heard us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anuttra Chaiyanandha

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible even before I entered the store. I stood waiting for a long time, and nobody asked about the queue. Then, a new person walked in and got a queue number right in front of my eyes. It was awful. I will never set foot there again. Other restaurants are much better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tossapol Chayanon

restaurants.name: Salapao Shanghai
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 306 ซอย จันทน์ 18/7 Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shanghai Steamed Buns @ Saint Louis Lane: This steamed bun shop is famous on social media because of all the reviews, so we decided to try it ourselves. The shop is located right by the road and is open daily from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

We ordered both steamed buns and dumplings.
- Char Siu Pork Filling: Absolutely delicious! This is my favorite filling. The pork is in chunks, mixed in a juicy sauce with a perfect balance of sweet and savory flavors that complements the dough well.
- Cream Filling: This filling is equally delicious. The custard cream is smooth and subtly sweet.
- Vegetable Filling: Vegan-friendly option. It's a mix of vegetables stir-fried with textured vegetable protein.
- Pork Filling: We ordered this too, but didn't take a picture. It contains minced pork, shiitake mushrooms, and salted egg.
- Pork Dumplings: Perfectly sized bite-sized dumplings. The filling is generous, mixed with pork and shrimp. The wrapper is thin, and they're delicious on their own.

The shop sells everything at the same price: Steamed buns and mantou are 18 baht each for all fillings. Dumplings are sold in sets of 10 for 60 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Su Praewy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shanghai-style Steamed Buns

This famous steamed bun shop in St. Louis is located across from the renowned Braised Pork Leg restaurant. I crossed the street to try it. The steamed buns are of an old-fashioned style; the dough has a yellowish-brown tint, not pure white like modern ones. The outer dough is slightly dry, oily, chewy, and firm. The pork filling is generous and well-seasoned. The char siu (roasted pork) filling is also excellent, rich and flavorful with a perfect balance of salty and sweet. The cream filling is sweet and fragrant, just right. Steamed buns start at 18 baht each, with seven fillings available: pork, char siu, vegetable, soybean, black bean, taro, and cream. They also sell mantou (steamed buns) and dumplings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supha Kit

sample_reviews_en.text: The long, flat bread seems to be the raisin barley bread. I highly recommend this one. It is really delicious. Also, I do not recommend the red bean steamed bun, but I recommend the soybean steamed bun because it is tasty. I haven't tried the taro steamed bun so I don't know, but I think it would be okay. Since this place sells Shanghai-style steamed buns, I feel like the ones filled with meat might not suit Korean tastes... I haven't tried them myself, but based on my experience, the "normal" flavored bun I mentioned earlier was delicious. The vendor is a bit gruff, but since they are handmade, you can really taste the flavor haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: SO HI

sample_reviews_en.text:
The zongzi (rice dumpling) had a major flaw: the glutinous rice was undercooked, still raw white rice grains.
The filling was okay and tasty, but the undercooked rice ruined it.

The steamed buns were soft, warm, and freshly made from a high-quality stainless steel pot. They looked clean and high-quality. The dough wasn't sweet, and the pork filling was savory and well-balanced – just right. At 18 baht, the filling might not be abundant, but it was delicious and met the standard for pork steamed buns.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Lai

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first and only purchase. I asked what vegetables were in the filling, and they only said cabbage. I then asked what else was in it, but they didn't answer and instead went to ask the customer behind them what they were ordering. I wasn't asking to copy the recipe or anything. The seller probably has no food allergies whatsoever. One day, they'll probably lose their temper with a customer who can't control them.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธเนศ คล้ํามณี

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those who aren't in a hurry, you can watch the owner being relaxed, not talking much, slowly picking up items, walking around. If you arrive while they're steaming, expect a wait, not including the queue.
~~~~~~~~~~~
Steamed buns are 18 baht each.
Dumplings are 60 baht for a set of 10.
~~~~~~~~~~~
I bought a char siu pork bun. The dough wasn't fluffy or thick.
The filling was plentiful and not soggy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchin P

sample_reviews_en.text: These are traditional steamed buns. Personally, I prefer softer dough, but these are delicious too. Importantly, the filling is very generous, especially considering the price of 18 baht per bun for all fillings. The minced pork is substantial. However, the dough dries out quickly if left out for too long, so you need to microwave them. They're delicious eaten hot. The vendor was also friendly and okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Princess Mia

sample_reviews_en.text: The male seller was rude. Who would want to buy from him? And it wasn't even worth driving a long distance to eat it. Even the steamed buns... are better. I don't want to praise a big company, but the seller at this shop should learn how to speak to customers better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Happy Mantow

restaurants.name: Oho! Pung Pong
restaurants.address:

122/47 Ratchaprarop Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is quite decent, but the service is one of the worst I've experienced. Firstly, they do not allow customers to use the toilet. It is only available for their staff, which I find quite unreasonable. Secondly, the staff were rude, impatient and lacked basic customer service. This resturant definitely do not deserve to have 1 star rating for their services.

My mum ordered the char siew rice, but the serving she received consisted almost entirely of fatty meat. When she politely asked if it could be changed, the staff refused

The issue isn't that there was some fat in the char siew. The problem is that the entire serving was almost all fat. If that particular section was too fatty, couldn't they have balanced it by adding some leaner pieces? Serving a whole plate of mostly fat is simply unacceptable.

After arguing with the staff for quite some time, they finally agreed to replace it, but they did so very reluctantly and with a poor attitude.

I would not recommend this place unless they seriously improve their customer service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ng Tiam Poh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Oho! Pung Pong: Incredibly Delicious Noodles, but Be Prepared to Wait in Line!
Oho! Pung Pong, a restaurant serving roasted pork, crispy pork, and roasted duck on Ratchaprarop Road, is an amazing place that many people stumble upon unintentionally.
What makes this restaurant stand out is the taste of its incredibly delicious noodles. The noodles are perfectly chewy and soft, and the toppings like roasted pork, crispy pork, and roasted duck are all exceptionally well-prepared. It's a flavor that will leave you wanting more and wanting to come back again.
However, a word of caution for those in a hurry: ordering food takes a long time because the restaurant is very popular and has a complex food preparation process. You might have to be prepared to wait in line for a while.
In short, if you have plenty of time and are looking for premium-tasting noodles or rice dishes in the Pratunam area, this is an excellent choice that's definitely worth the wait!
[View Map of Oho! Pung Pong]
sample_reviews_en.author: Toon Tran

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best boat noodles I’ve found at such an affordable price point!(80THB). This spot is conveniently located right in front of One Food Center in Pratunam, very close to the Pratunam Night Market.
The broth is incredibly tasty with just the right amount of spice, and I love that you can customize your bowl by choosing your preferred type of noodles. Honestly, I could eat this every single day!
Make sure to try their duck, boiled chicken, and crispy pork as well—they are absolute must-tries. To top it all off, their Nom Yen (Thai pink milk) is the perfect way to quench your thirst and satisfy a sweet tooth. Highly recommended if you're in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kelvin Kabigting

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but I'm not sure if they judged us by our appearance when it came time to pay. I went with two friends, and we all ordered the same dish – noodles. One friend paid 60 baht, another ordered a special version for 70 baht, and mine was 80 baht. (P.S. We didn't order any drinks or special dishes.) I just wanted the price to be fair for everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: KATAWAN THAHIN

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered a portion of duck and pork without a side dish, each for 200 baht. We were expecting a large portion, but what we received was very small, with a few slices of cucumber on each plate. Overall, the portions were very small, the presentation was poor, and the meat was cold and dry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Папа готовит

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here in the early morning around 1 AM – 2 AM, and it’s honestly the perfect time to eat. The food is great! Also, I highly recommend this specific brand of crispy pork skins (pork cracklings)—the quality is much better than others I've tried. A must-visit for late-night food lovers!
sample_reviews_en.author: October Shwe Yi

sample_reviews_en.text:
For the tom yum soup, I found it quite good for 90 baht if I remember correctly.

But my husband's chicken dish cost over 200 baht, I think. The taste is good, but it depends on individual preferences.

Compared to the price, I think many places in the area offer better value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Diem Le

sample_reviews_en.text: My dining experience here was very enjoyable, and all the dishes suited my taste perfectly. The only downside was that the restaurant did not provide ice for drinks and there was no restroom available. Overall, it was still a pleasant experience and a place worth visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khoa Phạm

restaurants.name: Hachiban Ramen MRT Wat Mangkon
restaurants.address:

523 ถ. เจริญกรุง Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Quite possibly the worst ramen I've had in Bangkok. The noodles tasted like instant noodles and the broth was salty. Moreover their set menus offered a coke, which was around the same price as green tea - however the staff flat out refused to swap me a coke for green tea. Staff were not friendly either. The kaarage was also average and was served with 4 pieces of chips (odd). Overall I get the sense that they don't care much for your business. If you're looking for Japanese in the mall, go to the shop just around the circle - their customer service is much better and the food far tastier.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anne Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: Good but nothing special. Hachiban Ramen is located inside a shopping mall, and the prices are very reasonable, perfect for a casual lunch. We had the fried chicken and gyoza appetizers, and the first was rubbery, almost like it was reheated, while the gyoza were truly excellent. The same goes for the ramen; my chicken was delicious, but the duck was bland and dry. If you choose the right dishes, you'll enjoy a good, no-frills lunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Giada Viani

sample_reviews_en.text: The entire restaurant only had two employees: one cooking and the other taking orders, serving, clearing tables, and handling payments. There were almost 10 tables occupied, and naturally, the employees couldn't keep up. I don't understand how the restaurant manages its staffing schedule, because when I went, it was lunchtime, and even on a weekday, it was still very busy. They should definitely have more employees.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pariyakorn R.

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is standard. I like the ramen; it's refreshing and cold. The food came out very quickly, probably because there weren't many people on a Saturday afternoon. I always order the gyoza; it's delicious with the gyoza dipping sauce that has chili powder in it. The yakisoba was a little too salty. The prices are very reasonable. The staff provides good service. The only downside is the expensive parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Guitar.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located on the 2nd floor of i'm Chinatown mall.
Underground parking is available; get your parking ticket stamped at the information counter.

Food didn't take long to arrive, but the staff taking orders were chatting amongst themselves and weren't in a hurry to take our order.
I ordered the Paitan and Ramen, which were both delicious and up to standard. However, there wasn't much vegetable in them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Billy Than

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is tasty and consistent in quality, but service is slow at all branches, even when it's not busy. Order management isn't very efficient; even easy-to-get items like the kids' fish balls, ordered at the same time, arrived later than the ramen. Overall, it's okay because I'm used to Hachibang's slow service. It's still worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Purichssarun K

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very impressed with this branch. It wasn't crowded, the atmosphere was relaxed, and I could eat comfortably. The staff were polite and attentive. The food tasted delicious, as always, up to Hachibang's high standards. If you want a relaxed, unhurried meal, I recommend this branch! 🍜😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Gift T.

sample_reviews_en.text: It doesn't kill you but it gets you out of a "trouble" if you want to eat something simple and that won't cause you any problems. It's not very tasty nor do they have a staff that stands out, but they have restaurants in key places
sample_reviews_en.author: Irene Sedano

restaurants.name: เด็ดกะเพรา สีลมเอจ (Original Thai Basil Stirfried)
restaurants.address:

ร้านเด็ดกะเพรา ชั้นB1 สีลมเอจ เลขที่ 2 Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The taste was delicious, but I was disappointed with the presentation. The picture showed an appetizing dish – minced pork basil with creamy egg for 90฿. At that price, I thought it was acceptable, which is why I bought it – because I really wanted to eat it. Why did it come in such a narrow paper bowl?
sample_reviews_th.author: S

sample_reviews_th.text: I ordered the stir-fried basil with creamy egg (90฿). It was incredibly oily, probably from the egg.
sample_reviews_th.author: กฤษณะ เดโชพล

sample_reviews_en.text:
I bought food on Wednesday around noon. I was the first in line at the cashier. I saw a young female employee wearing glasses packing lunch boxes for delivery riders. As I was about to order and handed her a Tupperware container to put my food in, she said, "Please wait a moment," and continued packing. I stood and waited. Then another female customer stood next to me and ordered stir-fried beef with basil. The employee took her order, and even though I blurted out that I was in line first, she still took her order. That customer paid and got served before me. (Even though it meant waiting an extra 5 minutes, this shouldn't have happened in the first place if the employee valued this basic right of the customer.)
I expect the restaurant to pay much more attention to the service of its employees.
I didn't have a problem with the taste of the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: WP

sample_reviews_en.text:
I arrived at the restaurant around 11:45 AM, almost noon, last Wednesday. When I tried to order, the female cashier said they weren't taking walk-in orders at the moment (okay, no orders at noon). The male employee managing the queue said they needed to clear delivery orders first, which would take 5-10 minutes. Basically, they wouldn't let me order. Personally, I would have felt better if they had informed me that the food would take a while.

I requested a crispy, well-done fried egg. The employee fried the egg with one hand, constantly on their phone, not looking at the pan. I got a fried egg that was flipped back and forth, flat and dry – not worth 15 baht. I won't be coming back. Bye.
sample_reviews_en.author: chatchaya T

sample_reviews_en.text:
My office is in this area, so I came down for lunch and tried this place.

The basil chicken/pork stir-fry had a fragrant wok aroma. You can tell the staff how spicy you want it. The fluffy omelet was also delicious and went well with the basil chicken.

The price was probably 85+ baht, I'm not sure, but around that range. 555

The staff taking orders didn't seem very welcoming; they had a grumpy expression. 55555 I'm confused. If they don't want to work that much, they should quit and find something else.

For anyone who doesn't know what to eat in the Silom Age Building, try this place. It's pretty good.
sample_reviews_en.author: JKS

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of our favorite places for Beef Pad Krapao (Stir Fried Basil). We love the taste of their Beef Krapao especially with mild and medium spice. With excellent and very friendly service, and for just 80B for the Beef Krapao, this place easily became our favorited spot at Silom Edge.

The staff were very friendly, conversational even with limited English, and we had a few laughs. Very accommodating to get us seated, and food came fast and hot. Had excellent fried eggs as well.

Buy drinks at 7/11 a few steps away, and sit on the counter high chairs, and all will be well in Bangkok regardless of your mood.
sample_reviews_en.author: R Brown

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered basil chicken with creamy egg, and the cook stirred the eggshells in a bowl before pouring it into the pan. Every customer I've seen do this. Are eggshells really that clean that they'd use them to stir the eggs? Why not use a spoon or fork? Such careless cooking, they don't think about the customer. If the eggshells were dirty or broken, the customer would probably get extra nutrients, right? The cook is so inconsiderate, and they're not even Thai, a foreigner.
sample_reviews_en.author: สายชล บุญครุฑ

sample_reviews_en.text: Stop ordering from them! I ordered delivery and the order was incomplete. The service was terrible. They should retrain their staff on customer service or hire people who love and care about providing good service. Don't hire people who just want to work for the money and provide poor service; it will only damage the restaurant's image.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yourself Guy

restaurants.name: Bonchon Gateway Bangsue
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์การค้าเกทเวย์ แอท บางซื่อ ชั้น G 162/1-2,168 10 Pracha Rat Sai 2 Rd, ตำบลบางซื่อ อำเภอบางซื่อ Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was slow. The staff needs service training. The service was slow, unprofessional, and lacked expertise.
We were a group of 5 and sat at the table the entire time without getting up, but only 2 people received plates and cutlery before the staff went off to do other things, ignoring the fact that there were 5 people at the table. The other 3 people hadn't received their plates and cutlery and had to ask for them twice. Not only was the food slow, but the service was terrible. I regret paying the service charge. The drinks had ice in the glasses but weren't served; we had to ask for them 3 times before they were finally served. It took so long that the ice melted, and we had to get more. I understand the restaurant is busy, but the service needs improvement. You're charging a service fee, so the service should be commensurate with that 10%.

Thank you in advance. I hope you will improve your service.

Date of service: March 31, 2024, Time: 5:30 PM
sample_reviews_en.author: สุดใส นุรากุบ

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. No staff greeted us at the entrance.
2. A staff member brought the menu and said the food would take 30 minutes. Another staff member took our order and said it would take 20 minutes.
3. We ordered an extra bowl of rice, but only one was served. We waited almost 15 minutes for the rice, followed up once, but there was no sign of it. Meanwhile, we saw other tables getting plenty of rice. Finally, we followed up again, and the rice arrived.

All of this was for just two dishes. If we had ordered more, it would have taken at least two hours.

Overall, there were few staff members, and they weren't focused on their work. I don't know if there's a branch manager, because the staff seemed to be of similar age and experience. If there was an option to give negative stars, I would.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitaree W.

sample_reviews_en.text: It was during a promotion, but when I arrived at 7 PM, they said they weren't taking orders outside the restaurant anymore. So I ordered takeout and waited for a very long time. Almost every order before me had problems; it was chaotic. The staff didn't know how to manage things. They made me wait for half an hour, even though I was first in line. Then it took another hour to order and another hour for the food. In total, it was 1 hour and 30 minutes. The staff couldn't solve the problems; everything was so slow and a huge waste of time that I had to spend on other things. The chicken was all soggy by the time it was ready.
sample_reviews_en.author: G N

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant said they would make improvements, but it's still exactly the same. It takes a long time to get their attention by raising your hand; they're busy chatting and trying on new clothes at the counter, talking very loudly as if there are no customers. They haven't cleared the tables that have been finished eating, leaving only a few empty tables. I've been sitting here for almost an hour, and the staff still haven't cleared my table. Only one person provided good service; the rest were terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sventong. X

sample_reviews_en.text:
A famous Korean fried chicken restaurant with many branches in Thailand. This time, I ordered online. I chose a promotional set because I personally like the soy garlic chicken thigh. The set also included soup. The taste was the same as the branches I've been to before. Personally, I felt that the Bonchon Bites fried chicken was too dry and not very tasty.

Price: 3/5
Quality: 4/5
Taste: 4/5
Cleanliness: 5/5
Speed: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Location: 5/5
Value for money: 4/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapatr Chiraarreebutr

sample_reviews_en.text: I have a complaint about the service. The waitstaff placed the food down carelessly. I ordered food many times, but it never came until I had to ask for it 3-4 times. When I asked for anything, they kept saying "please wait," but nothing came, so I had to ask again many times. Even refilling my water was met with displeasure. Please improve your attitude and service behavior. I'm paying for my food, not asking for it for free. It was terrible. Don't come here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorada Thuamlee

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been in the restaurant for 20 minutes, and the staff haven't taken my order; they're just standing around chatting. It's been 20 minutes since they took my order, and my drink still hasn't been served. I understand the chicken takes a long time, but the drinks are taking forever! There were 6-7 staff members, all chatting amongst themselves even though there were only 2-3 tables of customers. Terrible service! One visit is never for this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yui Pimpan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Extremely salty! The chicken was sooooo salty.
I couldn't eat it; my tongue burned. 😖

The service was incredibly slow. It's been here before, and it's just as slow as it used to be. The front-of-house staff seemed to be standing around waiting for something at the food delivery area. They didn't even clear the tables after customers had finished eating.

The slow service was tolerable, but the food just wasn't tasty enough. 😤
sample_reviews_en.author: Hutta Pha

restaurants.address:

69 ถ. นครอินทร์ ตำบล บางไผ่ อำเภอเมืองนนทบุรี นนทบุรี 11000 บางไผ่ Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🫔 Nonthaburi locals love eating roti late at night. Gu Roti Cha Chak closes at 1 AM.

🚗 Drive across the Rama 5 Bridge to the Thonburi side, then stay in the left lane on the parallel road.
⌚ There are two roti and Thai milk tea shops here that stay open late: Gu Roti Cha Chak and Roti Cha Chak Chao Ruea. We arrived at 11 PM and there were still many people eating.

🫔 The pandan custard roti had a pretty average custard flavor. The roti dough was thin and crispy, but a little oily. We think it would be tastier if it were thicker and softer.
🍛 Gu Roti Cha Chak also sells other dishes.

Location 📍 Nakhon In Road, inbound side
⏰ 1 PM - 1 AM
🚙 Parking available along the road

🙏 Thank you all ♥️
for clicking "Follow"

YouTube 🎬 Paopao Studio
TikTok 🎙️ Paopao Studio
Wongnai 🍭 Paopao Studio

#RoadsideTastes #EatBeforeBed #PaopaoStudio
sample_reviews_en.author: Paopao Studio

sample_reviews_en.text:
(I've eaten here many times before and always thought the food was good and the price was reasonable.)

But today‼️
The price is completely disproportionate to the taste and quality.
The prices are high, but the food is terrible.

Review of the dishes ordered today:
-Toasted bread slices (39 baht each): Smells stale.
The butter and milk topping was okay, but the pandan custard and Thai tea custard toppings were sparse and not rich in flavor.
-Iced milk (55 baht per glass): Watery milk, not rich in flavor.
-Spaghetti Carbonara (109 baht): Couldn't find any cream sauce, very dry, and no crispy bacon.
-Fried chicken with fish sauce: Very average. It used to be better.

The only things that were edible and tasty were the minced beef basil stir-fry and the iced bread.
sample_reviews_en.author: Toop Jatuporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The queuing system is completely disorganized.
People who arrived later got served first.
We waited an hour for our food, and what we received was a mistake.
The male staff member was very rude, slow, and argued about every mistake. There was no apology. The staff brought the food, then took it back, saying it was wrong. An hour later, they brought us the wrong roti from the first order. It was cold, the cheese was lumpy, and the broth had melted completely. They kept prioritizing new customers, completely ignoring those waiting in the restaurant. It was appalling. The staff kept saying "I thought..." over and over. A complete waste of time and a very frustrating experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saranya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Gu Roti Rama 5 is located beside the infamous Ancient Tomyum Noodles. The shop offers both foods and dessert. Roti is holding the spotlight here!! You can choose more than 10-20 kinds of roti as well as the bread. Drinks are nice especially the warmth milk (my personal favd).

The shop has aircon and 8 tables. It’s suitable for family and friends. Clean and warmth welcoming owners.

The shop is open at 13:00 until 01:00!!!
Starving and carving for dessert? This is the right place for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: SwiftFox

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered one plain roti and one slice of buttered milk bread.
The plain roti was undercooked; the dough was still white and inedible. I called a staff member over and told them I wanted to add one slice of buttered milk bread.
I told the staff member that the roti wasn't cooked properly; the dough was still white. They said they would make a new one, but the new one was hard and inedible.
I also didn't receive the extra bread I ordered. The staff member didn't seem to care at all. 👎🥲🥲
sample_reviews_en.author: Aom Mliwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The price is disproportionate to the taste. The tea tasted like it wasn't properly cooked, bitter and sour. I couldn't drink the Thai tea at all. The Nescafe tea was even more bitter; my boyfriend finished the whole glass while it was still bitter. The roti was just okay.
(I usually eat at another branch and it's fine, I just happened to be passing by today so I tried this one.) Out of goodwill, please check the taste of the tea. It's a waste of money.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตะวัน พัสกร

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the croffle menu and it took almost an hour to get it. I asked the staff about 4 times. The table next to me ordered a similar menu but got their food before me. When my food arrived, the frozen strawberries were still warm. It was terrible. I usually eat there regularly, both delivery and in-store, but after this experience, I will definitely not eat there again. I'm very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Z

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waited forever, almost an hour. Terrible management.
If they can't keep up during peak hours, shouldn't they close order acceptance on the app first? There were 5-6 riders waiting for over half an hour. I sat in the store until I was bored. I ordered two items; the first took 10 minutes, the second took almost an hour.
I feel sorry for the staff; they have almost 200 menu items.
sample_reviews_en.author: sirinapa homsin

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don’t usually leave reviews, but I felt I should share this experience.

One of the male staff members (brown skin, wearing a gold necklace) had very poor customer service. When we ordered our burgers, he didn’t make any eye contact and didn’t show basic respect. His tone also felt a bit aggressive, which made the interaction uncomfortable.

We are not asking for special attention, but simple courtesy and polite behavior should be standard. This experience left me quite disappointed and honestly a little upset.

I hope the management can address this and remind staff about proper customer service, so other customers don’t have a similar experience.

PS-only him ,(all staff are nice and sweet)
sample_reviews_en.author: Ella Myat Mon

sample_reviews_en.text: As of 11am, April 21, 2026. The male employee who brought the food was quite friendly. However, when I went to the counter needing a straw, the female employee with slightly blonde hair frowned and gave me a very rude look. She handed it to me as if tossing it over like she was giving alms to a beggar, giving the impression that she couldn't even be bothered to lift a finger. I felt absolutely disgusted. It is largely my fault for going to McDonald's after coming all the way to Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manggo Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the worst McDonald's in Thailand.
Stop standing around doing stuff oh you wipe extremely long time so the food and there's not even any customers in the place.

When the food came in it it had been sitting around for a long time it was not hot and I had to return it.

There is no quality control on the level of service here would get a zero out of 10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeff

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have to give McDonald's some credit.

It was a weekend on Khao San Road, packed with drunk people, and yet everything was served to me very politely and cleanly.

I'm deducting a point because the toilet I used didn't have soap, even though I paid.

It probably isn't McDonald's standard practice, but I still expect it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: Went here to get McDonald’s breakfast as I arrived early into Bangkok. Was apprehensive as it is located right on Khao San Road but it was really clean inside. The big breakfast set was so fresh. Staff were really nice and the coffee was great. Better than you get at many brunch cafes in Thailand
sample_reviews_en.author: Josie Campbell

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, this restaurant gets very few customers because it's blocked from view.
But the cost of renting a new location is very expensive, so they have to maintain the same prices. This forces them to reduce food portions, resulting in dishes that don't meet customer expectations.
sample_reviews_en.author: ดอกบัว บุณฑริก

sample_reviews_en.text: There is a crazy woman in the shop and it’s not safe. They need to manage that first. That person is very rude and super unfriendly. She yells at the customer and when the customer speaks loud she complains lol. When she was the first who was rude and aggressive first. That’s funny.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sdlaufeyson

sample_reviews_en.text: Always fun to try new items from mcdonalds in a foreign country. Pineapple and corn pie surprisingly don't taste bad (compared to other pies at least). Mcnuggets are usual, the plum sauce doesn't work for me tho. But other than that just go to street food, cheaper and tastier.
sample_reviews_en.author: Slatki Eats

sample_reviews_en.text: There are many restaurants here, and many of them serve delicious food. However, the surrounding area isn't very clean or pleasant to walk on. The sidewalks are narrow, forcing you to walk on the road. Trash is dumped on the road, causing a foul and dirty smell. Most restaurants also don't have seating, so you have to find your own place to sit. Furthermore, the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration hasn't yet provided any public spaces for people to sit and eat. I would like to see improvements in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: สนธิ ยิ่งยวด

sample_reviews_en.text:
Buzzling with life!
There were a couple of street food vendors who are Michellin-starred but the queue could really be long. But where there is a crowd, there must be great food!
I would suggest going on a weekend for the full experience as the whole street could be limed up with vendors selling practically anything!
sample_reviews_en.author: Junix Arcega-Salinas

sample_reviews_en.text: It is such a vibrant street comes at night.  The street was closed off to cars the weekend I was there.  There were street performers, great street food vendors, authentic Thai and Chinese restaurants and some wonderful dessert vendors.  It cannot be missed if you’re in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dahlia Garden

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the old local street food shops in China Town. The taste was great and the price was very reasonable. Although the shop is not very fancy, it's good for tourists to stop by and taste local foods here. Don't worry. There are English and Chinese menus available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kongdej Keesukpan

sample_reviews_en.text: It was incredibly busy, with food vendors, lottery (lottery gambling) vendors, and visitors from various countries gathered to enjoy a variety of food, dominated by seafood and fruit. The majority of vendors were Chinese.
sample_reviews_en.author: penta peturun

sample_reviews_en.text: If you want to eat delicious food, Yaowarat is the place to go. They have almost everything you can think of at reasonable prices. But you have to find a place to park, or else you'll get a ticket.
sample_reviews_en.author: kreangkai kk

sample_reviews_en.text: The best way to sight seeing at night for China town. We have various delicious food. Such as China food shark fin soup ,China noodle,Thai fried               noodle and sea food  restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayapa8268

sample_reviews_en.text: We came for a walk. There are many things worth buying, and the prices are about the same in almost every shop. The food here is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ning.santira1971@gmail.com ning.santira@hotmail.com
